caption:
The image is a wedding portrait of a couple standing close together outdoors, photographed in a soft, romantic style.

On the left is the groom, wearing a light blue dress shirt with a pale blue tie and a textured gray waistcoat/vest. A white rose boutonniere with green leaves is pinned to the left side of his vest. He is also wearing light-colored trousers with a brown belt. His posture is relaxed, with one hand near or in his pocket, and he is turned slightly toward the bride.

On the right is the bride, wearing a white wedding dress with a fitted bodice. The dress has delicate lace or embroidered detailing with small sparkling embellishments, especially around the upper bodice and straps. A smooth, ruched waistband wraps around her waist. She has a long, sheer white veil flowing behind her over her shoulder. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo with curled sections, and she wears a small tiara or jeweled hair accessory. She also appears to be wearing a necklace and bracelet.

The bride is leaning toward the groom, looking up at him, with her hands resting against his chest or shoulder area in an affectionate pose. The groom is looking down toward her. Their faces are intentionally blurred, but their body language suggests a tender, intimate moment.

The background is dark and out of focus, likely a rocky or wooded natural setting. The shallow depth of field makes the couple stand out sharply against the muted, shadowy backdrop. The overall mood is soft, elegant, and romantic, with the pale blue and white wedding colors contrasting against the darker natural background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示新婚夫妇亲吻瞬间的婚礼摄影照片。新娘穿着传统的白色婚纱，头戴花环，面带幸福的笑容，而新郎则身着灰色背心和蓝色领带，佩戴着胸花，他们的手轻轻相触，似乎在表达爱意。他们站在模糊的岩石背景前，整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种温馨浪漫的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a nighttime urban scene centered on a large illuminated sculpture of the euro symbol (€). The sculpture is bright electric blue and dominates the frame, tilted slightly and mounted on two cylindrical metal supports. Around the euro sign is a ring of large, glowing yellow five-pointed stars, representing the European Union flag motif. The stars are three-dimensional, with golden side panels and bright yellow front faces, giving them a lit, sculptural appearance.

The euro symbol itself is oversized and glossy, with its curved “C”-like form and two horizontal bars clearly visible. The blue lighting is intense and saturated, contrasting strongly with the dark sky and the warm yellow stars. Some stars are partially behind the euro sign, while others project outward around it, creating a sense of depth and movement.

In the background are tall office buildings and modern city structures, mostly dark, with scattered lit windows. The setting appears to be a financial district or business plaza. A smaller version or reflection of the same euro-and-stars symbol is visible in the lower-left background near a glass building entrance. The surrounding area includes grass, low shrubs, paved walkways, streetlights, and glass-fronted architecture. There is also some graffiti visible on a low wall or structure at the lower left.

The sky is very dark and slightly grainy, emphasizing that the photo was taken at night. The overall mood is urban, financial, and symbolic, with the brightly lit euro monument standing out as a landmark against the shadowy cityscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在夜晚的欧洲中央银行标志的照片。标志由一个巨大的蓝色欧元符号和周围的黄色星星组成，位于一座城市的中心地带。背景中可以看到几栋高楼大厦，以及一些现代建筑的细节，如窗户和招牌。整个场景被柔和的人造光源照亮，营造出一种宁静而正式的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit river scene with a long, narrow wooden boat carrying a group of children and two adults across muddy brown water. The boat stretches horizontally across the lower middle of the frame and appears low in the water, with a dark gray/black hull, red trim, and a small red-painted bow section.

Most of the passengers are children wearing matching light-blue athletic-style uniforms, suggesting they may be students or part of a group outing. A few children wear white school shirts with red bottoms, resembling school uniforms. They are seated along the length of the boat, some facing inward, some looking toward the water, and a few leaning over the side. Their faces are blurred. Near the right side of the boat, an adult in a light-blue shirt and cap sits facing away, while at the far right another adult, dressed in darker clothing and a cap, appears to be rowing or steering with a long paddle.

The water fills most of the image and has a rippled, reflective surface, colored tan and brown, likely from sediment. Small floating plants or water hyacinths are visible in the foreground near the bottom right.

In the background, across the river, there is a riverbank lined with dense green trees and several wooden stilt houses or riverside structures. Some buildings have corrugated metal roofs, weathered wooden walls, and raised platforms supported by posts over the water. There are also shaded areas, docks, and small signs, giving the scene the feel of a riverside village or settlement. The lighting is bright, with strong sunlight reflecting off the water and casting shadows under the trees and buildings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常生活场景的照片，其中一艘长船在河面上缓缓行驶。船上坐着八名穿着统一蓝色上衣的人，他们似乎正在享受一次休闲的水上旅行。船头站着一名男子，他正握着桨准备划船。河水显得有些浑浊，周围是岸边的房屋和绿色植被，营造出一种宁静而自然的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a traditional Japanese castle or castle keep photographed at dusk or nighttime, viewed from directly in front at a low-to-mid angle. The building dominates the center of the frame and rises in several stacked tiers, each with broad, sweeping tiled roofs that curve upward at the corners. The rooflines are dramatic and layered, with decorative ridge-end details and rows of small rounded roof tiles tracing the edges.

The castle façade is a mix of dark wooden walls and bright white plaster sections. Strong artificial lighting, tinted greenish-yellow, illuminates the white eaves and gables, making them stand out vividly against the deep blue evening sky. The lighting emphasizes the castle’s symmetry and the repeated triangular gable shapes across the front. The uppermost tier is darker and more silhouetted, with a small pointed roof and ornamental finial at the peak.

The sky behind the castle is a rich cobalt blue, suggesting twilight just after sunset. There are no clouds visible, which gives the scene a clean, dramatic backdrop. Bare tree branches extend into the upper-right corner, while dense trees and shrubs frame both sides of the castle. On the left, some foliage is lit with warm reddish-orange light, contrasting with the cooler green lighting on the castle and nearby greenery. On the right, a large mass of leaves glows green from spotlights.

At the bottom center is an entrance approach with a dark, roofed structure leading toward the castle. The foreground is mostly shadowed pavement, with a walkway extending inward. Small lantern-like lights near the entrance add warm highlights. A fence and low barriers are visible around the lower area.

On the lower right side of the castle, there appears to be a construction or maintenance area: scaffolding, poles, and a green covering or tarp are visible. A signboard stands near the front right, displaying visitor information, including visible hours that appear to read “9:00–17:00.” The lower section is darker overall, with the castle’s illuminated upper tiers drawing most of the attention.

Overall, the image has a striking, atmospheric quality: an illuminated historic Japanese castle framed by trees, glowing against a deep twilight sky, with a strong contrast between traditional architecture and the modern lighting and maintenance elements near the base.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统建筑在夜晚被灯光照亮的照片。建筑呈现出典型的日式设计，具有多个层叠的屋顶和尖顶结构。建筑物的主入口处有一个黑色的门廊，上面悬挂着灯笼。周围环境由树木和路灯构成，其中一些树木的叶子呈现了秋天的颜色。整个场景在夜幕下显得宁静而庄严。

caption:
The image shows a pack of mosquito coils and several coils laid out on a light, slightly wrinkled white surface.

At the upper half of the image there is a stack of dark reddish-burgundy mosquito coils. The coils are circular spirals made from a thick, rough-textured material. One coil is resting on top, with its spiral clearly visible from the center outward. Beneath it are more coils stacked together, creating many concentric curved lines and shadows between the layers. Some coil edges appear slightly uneven or chipped, especially along the left side.

In the lower half of the image is a brightly colored cardboard box for the coils. The package is mostly yellow with red diagonal sections and a green strip along the right edge. Large branding on the box reads “Mortein” and “Mortein King Xtra Power 12.” It also mentions “Mosquito Coils” and “12 hours,” suggesting long-lasting protection. There is an illustration of a mosquito being struck or repelled in a starburst graphic near the center-lower area of the box. The packaging includes text in multiple languages, including English and South Asian scripts, and mentions the insecticide ingredient “d-trans-allethrin 0.12% w/w MC.”

Overall, the image appears to be a product display of Mortein mosquito repellent coils, with the opened coils placed above their original box on a plain white background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示红色蚊香和相关产品包装的图片。在图像的上方，有一堆紧密排列的红色螺旋形蚊香，它们的纹理清晰可见。下方是黄色背景上的绿色文字的包装盒，上面印有'12'号和一个黑色的虫子图案。整体场景放置在一个纯白色的表面上，使得产品的颜色和细节更加突出。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny view of the area outside **Nagasaki Station** in Japan.

In the foreground is a broad pedestrian plaza paved with square tiles in pale pink, gray, and beige, arranged in a grid pattern. A strip of yellow tactile paving runs across the walkway, indicating an accessible route for visually impaired pedestrians. Along the edge of the plaza are dark metal railings with decorative lattice panels and square posts topped with pointed caps. Rectangular planters with small flowers and greenery sit near the railings.

On the left side, part of the station complex is visible. A large curved canopy with a metal truss structure extends outward, supported by many angled white beams. Above and behind it rises a beige striped hotel building with Japanese text reading **“JR九州ホテル 長崎”** (JR Kyushu Hotel Nagasaki). A tall, dark green streetlamp stands prominently near the center-left, partially overlapping the hotel and canopy.

Near the center of the scene is a station sign with large lettering: **“長崎駅 / NAGASAKI STATION.”** A round clock is mounted above the station sign, showing the time. Behind it are lower station buildings with a green roofline. Several advertisements are visible on the station façade, including one promoting **Nagasaki wagyu beef** and another transport-related sign with Japanese text and images of vehicles.

In the lower left foreground, a colorful billboard features a sleek white train graphic and Japanese text including **“2022年 長崎、発進!”**, suggesting a promotion related to the Nagasaki route or rail development.

The background is dominated by lush green hills and mountains. On the ridge of the central hill are several communication towers and small structures. To the right, an orange-and-white tower structure rises above the station area. The sky is vivid blue with scattered soft white clouds, giving the scene a clear, pleasant daytime atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a clean, modern station plaza with urban infrastructure set against Nagasaki’s mountainous landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本某火车站入口的摄影照片。图像中心是一个带有现代设计元素的火车站建筑，其上方有'ISHIKAWA STATION'的标志。站台上设有自动售票机和信息显示屏，旁边是通往站台的楼梯。站前广场铺有石砖地面，并放置了几个绿色植物盆栽。在图片的背景中，可以看到一座高耸的信号塔和远处轮廓分明的山脉。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dining or tasting setup on a long rectangular table covered with a beige tablecloth. The scene appears to be indoors, likely in a kitchen or dining area, with warm but somewhat dim lighting and a shallow depth of field that keeps the foreground wine bottles relatively sharp while the background is slightly blurred.

In the center-right foreground are three prominent bottles of red wine standing upright. Two of the bottles have labels reading “Rutini,” with dark glass, black caps, and ornate cream-colored labels. Between them is a bottle labeled “Lagarde,” with a red capsule at the top and a pale pink label; the label includes “Blend de Tintas” and appears to indicate an Argentine wine. Behind these three, additional wine bottles are visible, including one farther back on the left side of the table.

Several wine glasses are scattered around the table. In the foreground near the bottom center is a stemless glass containing a small amount of red wine. There are also empty or nearly empty glasses near the bottles and toward the left side of the table. The table is set casually, with clear square or rounded plastic plates, wooden cutting boards, forks, and red-handled knives. One wooden board sits near the bottom left with crumbs or residue on it, suggesting food was recently served. A small piece of bread or pastry lies on the table to the left of center.

Near the middle of the table is a white paper towel roll standing upright with a wooden holder. Around it are various serving items: a bowl, a dark tray or container, and a few small dishes. The table looks used and informal, as if people have been tasting wine and eating snacks or appetizers.

On the right side of the image, a person is partially visible from the shoulders down. They are wearing a blue, white, and gray argyle sweater over a collared shirt, along with blue jeans. Their hands are clasped together in front of their chest or torso, suggesting they may be standing and talking or waiting.

In the background, there is a kitchen area with countertops, cabinets, and a tiled backsplash. A bottle of wine stands on the back counter or far end of the table. To the right rear is a set of white-framed glass doors or windows, with darkness visible outside, indicating it is likely evening or nighttime. The overall atmosphere feels like a casual wine tasting or dinner gathering at home.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示品酒活动的室内照片，桌子上摆放着几瓶葡萄酒和一些品酒用具。最前方是一个装有红酒的透明玻璃杯，旁边是两个木制的酒塞和一个金属酒刀。桌子中央是三瓶不同品牌的葡萄酒，其中两瓶已经打开。在桌子的一侧，可以看到一个空盘子和一块未切割的奶酪。背景中模糊地显示了一位穿着格子衫的人站在厨房里，手部动作表明他可能正在准备食物或与桌上的物品互动。

caption:
The image shows a wide, elevated view over a historic town on a bright sunny day. Most of the frame is dominated by a vast pale-blue sky, with a few soft white clouds scattered low along the horizon. The lighting is strong and clear, suggesting midday, with sharp shadows and warm colors.

Below the sky is a dense cluster of old buildings with weathered red and orange clay-tile roofs. Many of the roofs are aged, with darkened patches, mossy tones, and uneven coloration that give the scene an antique, lived-in feel. The architecture appears traditional, with low-rise structures, sloped roofs, narrow façades, and muted yellow or gray walls. On the left, a prominent old gray building with a triangular gable and a worn tiled roof rises above the surrounding rooftops. Its façade looks aged and slightly weather-stained, with simple rectangular windows and decorative trim.

A narrow street runs from the bottom center of the image into the distance, slightly curving through the town. Small groups of pedestrians and a few motorbikes can be seen along the road, making the scene feel active but relaxed. The street is lined with buildings, greenery, hanging decorations, and utility wires crossing overhead. Near the lower center, several people walk beneath strings of lantern-like decorations, including small green hanging shapes and red lanterns closer to the storefronts.

On the right side, there is a rooftop terrace or balcony with wooden decking and a dark decorative lantern mounted on a post in the foreground. This foreground element adds depth and frames the street below. The terrace edge, railing, and nearby rooflines create strong diagonal lines leading the viewer’s eye toward the street and the distant buildings.

The overall atmosphere is warm, historic, and picturesque. The combination of terracotta roofs, yellow walls, narrow streets, pedestrians, lanterns, and lush green plants suggests an old town or heritage district with a calm tourist-friendly character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示亚洲某地传统街道的摄影图像。图中，一条狭窄的街道从前景延伸至背景，两旁是排列整齐的传统建筑，屋顶覆盖着红色瓦片。街道上行人来往，一些人在交谈，而其他人则在行走或停留。街道两侧种植着绿色植物和花卉，为这个场景增添了生机。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间，整个画面呈现出一种宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up outdoor portrait/selfie of a person standing in a wooded area. The person’s face is heavily blurred, obscuring all facial features, while the rest of the image remains visible.

The person has dark reddish-brown hair parted near the center and styled into two braids that fall over the shoulders. Each braid is tied with a light pink hair tie, and the hair catches the sunlight, giving it a coppery red shine. They are wearing a shiny black puffer jacket zipped up to the neck, with the zipper and quilted texture clearly visible.

The lighting is high contrast: strong sunlight hits the front of the person’s head, hair, and jacket, while much of the background is in deep shadow. Behind them is a forest or wooded area with tall, thin tree trunks and dark foliage. A few patches of blue sky and bright highlights appear between the trees. On the right side of the image, a pale tree trunk stands out against the darker background.

The framing is very tight, with the person’s head and shoulders filling most of the image. The overall mood is a bright, sunny moment in a shaded forest, with dramatic contrast between the illuminated subject and the dark woodland behind them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在自然光照下的特写照片。她穿着一件黑色的夹克，头发是红色的，部分披散下来。她的脸部被模糊处理以保护隐私。背景中可以看到树木和阳光透过树梢洒落的斑驳光影。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of supermarket shelves stocked with **Ayam Brand canned pineapple chunks**.

Several cylindrical cans are stacked in rows on a white metal shelf, separated by pieces of corrugated cardboard. The cans have bright, eye-catching labels dominated by **red and yellow** colors. Across the top of each label, the brand name **“AYAM BRAND”** appears in large white letters with a dark outline. In the center of the label is the Ayam Brand logo: a colorful rooster inside a circular emblem, with text around it and the phrase **“Since 1892”** printed nearby.

Most cans are labeled **“PINEAPPLE CHUNKS”**, with smaller text underneath reading **“Pineapple Chunks in Syrup.”** Some cans display the Malay wording **“KETULAN NANAS”**, followed by **“Ketulan Nanas dalam Sirap.”** The labels show yellow pineapple pieces in the background and a large image of a whole pineapple on the right side of many cans. The net weight is shown as **454g**, with a drained weight of **245g**.

At the bottom left of the image, a yellow price tag is visible on the shelf. It shows the currency **MYR** and a large price of **5.00**, indicating the cans are priced at 5 Malaysian ringgit. The tag also references Ayam Brand pineapple chunks.

The cans are tightly packed, with some partially cut off at the edges of the frame. On the far left, part of another red product or packaging is visible, and on the far right, another pineapple image from a neighboring can appears. The overall scene looks like a grocery store display focused on canned fruit products.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示AYAM BRAND品牌菠萝块罐头的图片。罐头被整齐地摆放在货架上，每个罐头上都有红色和黄色的品牌标志以及产品信息。价格标签显示这些罐头售价为5.00。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a weathered stone relief carving of a reclining bovine, likely a bull or ox, possibly resembling a sacred bull figure such as Nandi.

The animal is shown in side profile, lying down with its body stretched horizontally across the frame. Its head is turned slightly upward and to the left. The face has a rounded muzzle with a clearly carved nostril, a small mouth line, and a visible eye set beneath a raised brow. The ears or horn area are worn but still suggested by protruding shapes near the top and side of the head. A pronounced hump rises behind the neck, which is characteristic of a zebu-type bull.

The body is broad and smooth in outline, with a rounded back and large hindquarter on the right. The legs are folded beneath the body in a resting posture; the front legs appear tucked forward along the base, while the rear leg is bent under the torso. The tail is faintly visible curving near the back end.

The sculpture is made of brownish-gray stone with a rough, pitted surface. Its texture looks aged and eroded, with patches of darker staining and lighter worn areas. Behind the animal is a carved stone background panel, also rough and weathered, with faint vertical and irregular tool marks. The carving sits on a raised base or ledge at the bottom, suggesting it may be part of a larger architectural or temple relief.

Overall, the image has an ancient, historical feel, emphasizing the tactile texture of the stone and the stylized but recognizable form of the reclining bull.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古代石刻艺术的照片，特写了一只栩栩如生的羊雕塑。羊雕塑位于画面中央，呈现出一种安详的姿态，头部微微抬起，眼神平静而专注。它的身体线条流畅，肌肉和骨骼结构清晰可见，表现出精湛的雕刻工艺。背景是粗糙的岩石表面，与羊雕塑形成对比，强调了其精细的细节。

caption:
The image shows a bright winter seaside scene under a clear blue sky. A snow-covered pedestrian path leads straight toward a pier and a white building extending out over the water. The composition is very symmetrical: the central walkway, flanked by wooden railings, guides the eye toward the pavilion-like structure in the distance.

In the foreground, the ground is covered with packed snow and icy patches, with darker exposed pavement showing through in places. Long shadows stretch across the snow, suggesting low winter sunlight. On both sides of the path are benches, black trash bins, and low concrete borders. Snow-dusted grasses and bare shrubs line the edges, giving the area a cold, coastal feel.

Tall white poles with small dark green pointed caps stand throughout the scene, some very close to the camera on the far left and right, and others receding toward the pier. Their vertical lines contrast with the wide horizontal expanse of the sky and sea.

At the center background is a white seaside pier building with many windows, a dark roof lightly dusted with snow, and small turret-like roof features. Behind and around it, the deep blue sea is visible, with the horizon running across the image. A few people in winter clothing are walking along the pier and nearby paths, appearing small against the open landscape. There is also a red-bordered bicycle sign near the right side of the central walkway, likely indicating a cycling restriction or route.

A couple of birds are flying in the sky above the pier, adding movement to the otherwise calm, crisp scene. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, cold, and sunny, with strong contrast between the white snow, the dark railings and roofs, the blue sea, and the expansive cloudless sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季海滨景观的照片，画面中心是一座白色的木制码头，码头上和周围覆盖着一层薄雪。码头的尽头是一座具有尖顶和装饰性屋顶的建筑，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。码头上有几位游客正在行走或停留，他们的影子在雪地上拉长。左侧有一个垃圾桶，旁边是几根高耸的路灯柱。远处可以看到一片宁静的海洋，天空晴朗且几乎没有云朵。

caption:
The image is a close-up portrait of a young child being held by an adult. The child is centered in the frame and has dark, slightly tousled hair, soft round cheeks, and a calm, curious expression. Their eyes are looking slightly off to the side rather than directly at the camera, and their mouth is slightly open, giving a quiet, observant look.

The child is wearing a pale pink-and-white striped shirt with a white bib or scarf-like cloth tied around the neck. A small gold-colored necklace is visible near the collar. On the left side of the image, the child’s arm is raised with a small clenched hand, as if mid-gesture or being held up.

An adult is partially visible on the right side of the frame, cropped so that only part of their face, neck, shoulder, and hand can be seen. The adult appears to be holding the child securely, with one hand placed across the child’s chest and side. The adult is wearing a reddish top and a gold necklace, and there is a gold ring visible on one finger.

The background is out of focus and dark gray, which makes the faces and clothing stand out clearly. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the child’s smooth skin and the texture of the clothing. The overall mood of the image feels intimate and candid, like a close family moment captured in a crowded or outdoor setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示家庭温馨时刻的照片，画面中一位小女孩穿着粉色条纹衣服，表情专注而好奇。她的右手被一位成年女性温柔地握着，这位女性的面容在照片中模糊不清，但可以感受到她对小女孩的关爱和保护。背景虽然简单，但颜色柔和，为这个温馨场景增添了一丝温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a person posing at what appears to be a red-carpet or event-photo backdrop. Their face is intentionally blurred, while the rest of the upper body and outfit are visible.

They are wearing a bright, eye-catching sleeveless dress covered in shiny sequins. The dress is primarily purple, with vertical multicolored sequin patterns in teal, red, gold, black, and pink. It has a deep V-shaped neckline and fitted bodice, giving it a glamorous eveningwear look.

Their hair is dark brown or black, styled in voluminous, loose waves swept over one side. Some lower sections of the hair appear to have reddish or burgundy tones. They are wearing large dangling chandelier-style earrings with sparkling stones, as well as multiple bracelets on both wrists. A ring is visible on one hand, and their nails are long and decorated with glittery nail polish or nail art.

The person is posed confidently with both hands on their hips, elbows angled outward. The background is a dark blue step-and-repeat wall with partial event branding visible, including large light-blue letters and part of the word “Vodka” in white near the lower left. The lighting is direct and flash-like, creating bright reflections on the sequins and jewelry.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的人物特写照片，展示了一位女性站在蓝色背景前。她穿着一件闪亮的紫色晚礼服，上面点缀着多彩的亮片和图案。她的头发被卷曲成波浪状，并佩戴了与服装相呼应的耳环和手链。她的双手自然地放在腰间，表情不可见，整个姿态显得自信而优雅。

caption:
The image shows the Eiffel Tower rising above the rooftops of Paris, but it is heavily obscured by thick haze or fog. The tower is centered in the frame and stretches vertically almost to the top edge, though its details are softened and partially lost in the pale, milky atmosphere. Its iron lattice structure is still visible, especially in the lower and middle sections, but the upper portion fades into the bright mist, giving it a ghostly, almost translucent appearance.

In the foreground, a dense cluster of Parisian buildings fills the lower part of the image. The rooftops are mostly flat or gently sloped, with chimneys, vents, railings, rooftop terraces, and small architectural details visible. Several plumes of white steam or smoke rise from chimneys across the rooftops, drifting upward and blending into the hazy air. The buildings are mostly light gray, beige, and off-white, with muted tones that match the subdued atmosphere.

The lighting appears soft and diffused, likely from early morning or late afternoon sunlight filtered through fog or pollution. The overall color palette is very pale and desaturated: warm cream, gray, beige, and faint gold tones dominate the scene. The background is nearly washed out, with very little sky detail, emphasizing the density of the haze.

The composition creates a strong contrast between the monumental scale of the Eiffel Tower and the ordinary urban rooftops below. Despite being one of the most recognizable landmarks in the world, the tower feels distant, quiet, and almost unreal because of the atmospheric veil surrounding it. The mood is calm, misty, and slightly melancholic, capturing Paris in a subdued, wintry or smoggy moment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示埃菲尔铁塔在薄雾中的照片。图像中，埃菲尔铁塔耸立于城市建筑之上，其独特的螺旋形结构和尖顶清晰可见。周围的建筑物被一层轻薄的雾气所笼罩，细节不甚清晰，但可以辨认出屋顶、窗户和一些建筑轮廓。整个场景被一种柔和而朦胧的光线所照亮，营造出一种梦幻般的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a modern outdoor café or courtyard seating area with an industrial-minimalist design.

In the foreground, the floor is covered with light gray gravel stones. Two small round black café tables stand on slim black pedestal bases, each paired with simple wooden stools that have black metal legs. One of the tables on the left has a small ashtray or metal object on top. Behind them is a low, built-in concrete bench or retaining wall that runs horizontally across the scene, forming a raised platform.

The middle ground contains a landscaped strip with small, neatly trimmed green shrubs planted in a row. Behind the plants are multiple wooden tables and chairs arranged in groups, suggesting an outdoor dining or coffee area. The furniture is warm-toned wood, contrasting with the cool gray concrete surroundings. Some tables are paired with several chairs, while other smaller tables have black metal frames and wooden tops.

The background is dominated by a tall gray concrete wall made of large rectangular panels. The wall has an unfinished, raw texture with visible seams, circular bolt marks, and subtle stains, giving it a modern industrial appearance. Several small square electrical outlets or wall fixtures are visible along the lower part of the wall, and a few small black wall lights or fixtures are mounted higher up.

Above the seating area is a long black metal-framed canopy with translucent or frosted panels, allowing diffused daylight through. The canopy stretches across much of the upper part of the image and is supported by slim black posts. Small track lights or spotlights are attached beneath parts of the canopy.

On the left side, there are concrete steps and platforms, along with a tall, thin tree trunk rising upward. Another black cylindrical support column stands near the center-left foreground, extending from floor to ceiling. On the right edge, leafy green branches from a tree partially enter the frame, softening the otherwise hard architectural lines.

Overall, the space feels clean, quiet, and contemporary, combining raw concrete, black metal, gravel, wood furniture, and small greenery to create a stylish outdoor lounge or café patio.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代设计风格的户外休息区的照片。照片中，我们可以看到几个圆形的黑色桌子和配套的木质椅子整齐地排列在由混凝土制成的长条形座位上。这些座位被放置在一个由灰色混凝土构成的开放空间内，周围铺有碎石地面。在座位的一侧，有一排绿色植物装饰，为这个简约的空间增添了一抹生机。整个场景通过自然光照明，营造出一种宁静而舒适的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a crowded outdoor gathering centered around a traditional bamboo-weaving activity. In the foreground, several people are gathered closely around a large, partially completed woven bamboo object, possibly a basket, tray, or ceremonial craft. Thin bamboo strips extend outward from the woven structure like spokes, while the central weave forms a tight, crisscrossed pattern.

At the center, a tall man wearing dark clothing and a patterned traditional cap is leaning forward with his hands on the bamboo weave, appearing to demonstrate or participate in the weaving. Around him are several other men and women, many dressed in dark or formal-looking clothing. Some of the men wear patterned traditional head coverings, while many of the women wear colorful headscarves or veils in shades of green, purple, turquoise, blue, and patterned fabric.

On the left foreground, a woman or girl in a light green headscarf sits or kneels near the weaving, holding thin bamboo strips. On the right foreground, an older woman in a bright blue headscarf is seen in profile, looking toward the weaving activity. Near the lower right and center, other participants appear to be seated or bending down, also focused on the bamboo work.

The background shows an outdoor village or residential setting with red clay-tiled roofs, a green-painted building, trees, utility wires, and a loudspeaker mounted on a pole. The lighting is very bright and overexposed, especially in the upper portion of the image, giving the sky and background a washed-out appearance. The scene feels communal and ceremonial, with people gathered closely together in traditional attire around a shared craft or ritual activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这张照片展示了一群身着传统服饰的人们聚集在一起，其中一位男性站在前景，他戴着一顶黑色的帽子，并手持一个大型的编织物。周围的人们穿着色彩鲜艳的传统服装，包括绿色、紫色和蓝色等颜色。背景中可以看到一座具有当地特色的建筑，这些建筑的屋顶呈尖顶形状，表明这可能是一个宗教或文化活动的场所。

caption:
The image shows a wide, dramatic view of a public square dominated by an ornate historic clock tower at the center. The tower is tall, slender, and richly decorated with carved stone details, arched openings, lattice-like patterns, and small domed elements near its base. Near the top, clock faces are visible on multiple sides, and the tower is capped with a small open pavilion-like structure and a finial.

The square appears wet, likely after rain, and the stone pavement reflects the sky, people, birds, and surrounding architecture. The glossy surface creates a strong sense of depth, with the paving lines leading the eye toward the clock tower.

There are many pigeons scattered across the plaza and flying through the air, giving the scene movement and liveliness. Some birds are close to the camera on the ground, while others are silhouetted against the cloudy sky. A few people are walking through the square: on the right, an adult and a child walk together; near the tower, a couple of people appear to be taking photos or observing the monument. Another person stands toward the left among the pigeons.

Tall palm trees frame the clock tower, one prominently to the left and another to the right, adding a Mediterranean atmosphere. In the background on the right is a large modern white building with rows of dark windows and air-conditioning units. Flags fly on poles on top of the building, including a red flag that appears to be the Turkish flag.

The sky is filled with large, layered clouds, with patches of blue and some sunlight breaking through on the left side. The lighting is moody and atmospheric, suggesting a storm has recently passed or is approaching. Overall, the scene combines historic architecture, urban life, wet reflective paving, palm trees, pigeons, and a dramatic sky, creating a vivid and dynamic city-square atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示雨后城市广场的摄影作品。图像中心是一座高耸的钟楼，其上装饰着精美的石雕和一个显眼的时钟面。广场上铺满了水坑，反射出周围建筑和天空的倒影。几棵棕榈树点缀在广场的一侧，而一群人在湿漉漉的地面上行走，其中一些人正在喂食地上的鸽子。背景中可以看到现代风格的建筑物，以及飘浮在空中的云朵和飞翔的鸟群。

caption:
The image shows a busy indoor public event or gathering, likely in a community center, school hall, or carnival venue. Two older men are seated in the foreground, while a crowd of people stands and moves around behind them.

On the left, an older man is wearing a bright green polo shirt with a gray collar and gray trim around the neckline. His face is blurred. He has short gray hair and is sitting with one arm raised, his hand touching or scratching near his ear. He wears several bracelets on his wrist, including beaded bracelets and a metallic band. A pen or small item appears tucked into the chest pocket of his shirt. His posture is relaxed, and he is seated near a column or wall.

On the right, another older man is seated closer to the camera. His face is also blurred. He has very short gray hair and is wearing a white polo shirt with horizontal maroon and black stripes and a black collar. He appears to be turned slightly toward the left, as if listening or speaking to the man in green. His right hand is visible near the bottom right, holding what looks like the handle of a cane or umbrella, along with a black strap or lanyard.

Between and behind the two men is a large vertical sign or banner with bold black lettering that reads “LET’S CARNIVAL.” The same phrase is repeated faintly in the background pattern of the sign. Near the bottom center of the image, there is a colorful red bag or promotional item with large text and bright blocks of color, also related to the carnival theme.

The background is crowded with many people standing in line or gathered in groups. Some are wearing casual clothing such as T-shirts, backpacks, and striped tops. A person in a red shirt with a black backpack stands near the center-right background. Another person in a light blue shirt faces away from the camera. There are also children visible among the crowd. The area has a concrete or tiled floor, overhead fluorescent lighting, and streamers or decorations hanging from the ceiling, reinforcing the festive or event-like atmosphere.

Overall, the scene feels lively and crowded, with the two seated men in the foreground providing a calmer focal point against the busy carnival or public event happening behind them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位老年人物在室内活动场所的摄影照片。左侧的人物穿着绿色上衣，佩戴着手表和耳环，正坐着并用手轻触耳朵。右侧的人物穿着条纹衫，手戴手表，正在专注地查看手中的物品。背景中可见其他参与者和活动的宣传海报，营造出一种社区或公共活动的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a historic stone gatehouse or fortified entrance, likely part of a medieval town wall or castle complex, photographed from a low, slightly upward angle.

In the foreground, a cobblestone road or bridge leads directly toward a large arched gateway. The paving stones are irregular, gray, and worn, giving the path an old, textured appearance. Low stone parapet walls run along both sides of the approach, suggesting the road may cross a bridge or raised causeway before entering the structure.

The central feature is a massive rounded stone gate tower with a wide, pointed arch opening at its base. The arch is built from large pale beige-gray stone blocks, with visible weathering, chips, and discoloration. The entrance passage beyond the arch is dark and shaded, creating a strong contrast with the sunlit exterior. Through the archway, another section of the fortification or courtyard wall is faintly visible.

Above the arch, the stonework curves outward in a rounded defensive form. The upper portion of the gatehouse has dark wooden timber framing and support beams set beneath a deep overhanging roof. The timbers form triangular braces and vertical supports, giving the structure a half-timbered medieval look. Small projecting stone supports sit beneath some of the wooden posts. Near the center above the arch is a narrow, keyhole-like opening or slit in the masonry, possibly a defensive or ventilation feature.

The roof is covered with reddish-brown clay tiles, uneven and weathered, with a slightly wavy edge. The roof extends beyond the walls, casting deep shadows under the eaves. To the right, the roof continues over another stone section of the fortification, where a small circular opening or window is visible set into a square stone frame. To the left, another connected stone building with a tiled roof peeks out from behind the main gatehouse.

The walls are made of large, rectangular stone blocks, many of them rough, stained, and aged. The masonry shows centuries of wear, with cracks, darker patches, and variations in color from light tan to gray. Strong sunlight illuminates the right side of the structure, while large angular shadows fall across the arch, walls, and cobblestone road.

The background is dominated by a bright, clear blue sky with only a few small, wispy white clouds. The overall scene feels quiet, historic, and well-preserved, evoking the entrance to an old European fortified town or castle.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老石拱门的摄影图像。石拱门位于画面中央，由坚固的石头构成，顶部有一个半圆形的屋顶结构，上面装饰有木制横梁和尖顶。拱门两侧是厚重的石墙，墙上嵌入了小型窗户和装饰性元素。拱门下方是一条铺砌整齐的鹅卵石道路，阳光从上方照射下来，在地面上投下长长的阴影。背景中可以看到蓝天和几朵白云，增添了一丝宁静与和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor scene in bright daylight, likely on a balcony, terrace, or covered walkway.

On the far right side of the frame, an older man is partially visible from the chest up. His face is intentionally blurred, but he appears to be wearing dark sunglasses and a light-colored bucket hat with a dark band around it. The band has visible white lettering, though only part of the text can be read. He is dressed in a white polo-style shirt with dark horizontal stripes and a dark collar. His right arm is extended forward, resting on a polished wooden railing or bench back. A metal wristwatch is visible on his wrist.

The foreground is dominated by the wooden railing or bench structure, which runs horizontally across the lower part of the image. It is made of rounded, varnished wooden slats with a warm brown tone and visible wear or texture. There are darker metal supports underneath.

The background is softly out of focus. It features a modern building or covered outdoor structure with white columns and pale concrete ceilings. A flat roof or balcony overhang spans across the upper portion of the image, creating shaded areas beneath it. Several vertical white pillars support the structure. Behind the columns, there are blurred green trees or shrubbery, suggesting a garden or landscaped area nearby. The light is warm and natural, giving the scene a relaxed, sunny atmosphere.

The composition places most of the empty architectural space on the left and center, while the person occupies the right edge, creating an off-center, candid feel. The shallow depth of field keeps attention on the man and wooden railing while leaving the background soft and indistinct.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位戴着帽子和太阳镜的男性坐在户外长椅上的照片。他穿着条纹衬衫，手臂搭在长椅的扶手上，似乎在休息或沉思。背景中可以看到一些模糊的建筑结构和树木，营造出一个宁静的户外环境。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of a large passenger ship’s lifeboat mounted on the side of the vessel. The scene is brightly lit by sunlight under a clear blue sky.

On the right and center of the image is a large enclosed lifeboat, painted mostly white with a bright orange-red upper section. The bow of the lifeboat faces the viewer, creating a symmetrical, rounded shape. Large black numbers “13” are printed on both sides of the bow, and the name “SPL PRINCESS ANASTASIA” appears along the white hull. Beneath the name, “VALLETTA” is printed, indicating the vessel’s port of registry. On the orange band near the top, white text reads “144 PERSONS,” showing the lifeboat’s capacity. Several ropes and attachment points hang around the edges of the lifeboat.

The lifeboat is held in place by a large white davit system: a curved mechanical lifting arm extends from the ship’s side up and over the lifeboat. Cables and support lines run diagonally across the image, connecting the boat to the lifting mechanism. The davit has visible hinges, pulleys, metal brackets, and hydraulic-looking components, suggesting it is used to lower the lifeboat into the water in an emergency.

On the left side of the image is the white exterior of the ship itself. It has railings, decks, ladders, vents, pipes, and structural panels. The ship’s surface is clean and bright, with shadows emphasizing its curved and layered architecture. A partial red-and-blue logo or marking is visible high on the white superstructure.

In the background, beyond the ship and lifeboat, there is calm water and an industrial harbor area with low buildings, cranes, and dock structures. The sky is vivid blue with a few wispy clouds and a larger cloud bank near the horizon. The overall impression is of a ferry or cruise ship docked in port, with its safety equipment prominently displayed.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘名为'PRINCESS ANASTASIA'的救生艇与一艘大型船只相连的照片。救生艇被固定在船体上，船身为白色，顶部和底部边缘涂有鲜艳的红色。救生艇上方清晰地标注着编号'13'，并附有文字说明。照片背景中可以看到蓝天、远处的建筑群以及平静的海面。

caption:
The image shows a scenic waterfront view of Istanbul, centered on a large historic Ottoman mosque, likely the Yeni Cami/New Mosque near Eminönü. The mosque dominates the middle of the frame with a broad central gray dome, many smaller cascading domes, arched windows, and ornate stonework. Several gold finials top the domes, catching the soft light. On the right side rise two tall, slender minarets with dark pointed spires and multiple carved balconies, while additional minarets and domes from other mosques appear in the hazy background.

In the foreground, choppy blue-gray water fills the lower portion of the image. A white passenger ferry is moving across the scene, creating foamy waves at its bow. The ferry has black rubber fenders along its side, people visible on the deck, and red lettering on the upper side reading “Modoko.” Another boat is partly visible at the far left edge. Along the shore behind the ferry are docks, railings, pedestrians, and the base of the mosque complex.

The atmosphere is soft and slightly misty, with a pale blue sky occupying much of the upper half of the image. A seagull flies high near the mosque’s dome, and a few more birds skim low over the water. The overall scene combines historic architecture, busy urban waterfront life, and maritime movement, giving a strong sense of Istanbul’s Bosphorus/Golden Horn setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伊斯坦布尔城市景观的照片，画面中心是一座宏伟的清真寺，其金色圆顶和尖塔在蓝天的映衬下显得格外引人注目。一艘白色的渡轮正在河面上行驶，船上可见乘客，而远处则是城市的建筑群。天空中有一只鸟儿飞过，为这个宁静的城市场景增添了一丝生动的气息。

caption:
The image shows a bright coastal harbor scene viewed from an elevated position, possibly from a hillside road or moving vehicle. A large expanse of pale blue sky dominates most of the frame, with only a few faint, wispy clouds near the horizon. Below the sky, the sea forms a calm blue band stretching across the background.

In the harbor, two large white cruise ships are docked side by side. The ship on the left is slightly smaller and has a distinctive red-and-black funnel; it is moored near a pier with low port buildings and container areas nearby. The ship on the right is much larger, with many rows of balcony cabins and yellow lifeboats along its side. It sits close to a quay near a tall rectangular port building on the far right. Small boats and service vessels are visible around the cruise ships, emphasizing the scale of the vessels.

The foreground is filled with lush greenery, including palm trees, shrubs, and flowering plants. Some of the vegetation and a dark horizontal railing appear blurred, suggesting the photo was taken while moving past the scene. The railing runs across the lower portion of the image and partially obscures the harbor below. At the very bottom, there are hints of port infrastructure, stacked containers, roads, and industrial areas.

The overall atmosphere is sunny and warm, with strong daylight, tropical or Mediterranean vegetation, and a busy cruise port set against a calm sea.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示港口码头的照片，前景中有一排树木和栏杆，透过这些元素可以看到背景中的几艘大型游轮。最前方的游轮停靠在码头上，而其他几艘则停泊在更远的地方。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为整个场景增添了活力。

caption:
The image shows a surfer riding a wave in the ocean, captured from a distance with a wide, horizontal composition.

In the lower left-to-center area, a person in a black one-piece swimsuit is crouched low on a surfboard, balancing with knees bent and arms extended slightly for stability. The surfer appears to be moving leftward along the face of a dark blue-green wave. The surfboard is mostly dark, with a hint of green along the edge or underside near the water.

The wave rises behind and to the right of the surfer, forming a smooth, curved wall of water. Its face is deep teal and navy, with lighter turquoise highlights where the water thins and catches the light. On the right side of the frame, the wave is breaking into bright white foam, creating a large, frothy splash. Spray and churning water trail behind the surfer, emphasizing motion and speed.

The ocean fills nearly the entire image. The foreground contains rippled, reflective water with patches of white foam, while the midground shows the active wave. In the background, the sea stretches toward a distant horizon, with layered bands of darker and lighter blue water. The sky above is muted and hazy, a soft gray-blue, with no distinct clouds visible.

The overall mood is calm but dynamic: the ocean feels expansive and slightly overcast, while the surfer’s movement and the breaking wave add energy and tension to the scene. The image has a cool color palette dominated by blues, grays, teals, and white foam.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冲浪运动的摄影作品，画面中一位穿着黑色冲浪服的冲浪者正蹲在冲浪板上，身体前倾，专注地驾驭着一个正在形成的波浪。海浪呈现出深蓝色和白色的泡沫，而远处的海洋则相对平静，天空则是灰蒙蒙的，没有明显的云彩。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor street market or fair set along a broad pedestrian walkway paved with reddish, grid-patterned tiles. It is a bright sunny day, with strong sunlight filtering through large leafy trees overhead and casting dappled shadows across the ground.

Colorful triangular bunting flags are strung across the walkway in several lines, creating a festive atmosphere. The flags are in many colors—red, yellow, green, blue, orange, and white—and stretch from stall to stall and between trees or poles. The upper half of the scene is dominated by dense green tree canopies, with patches of pale blue sky visible through the branches.

On both sides of the walkway are market stalls and tents. On the left, a stall with a yellow canopy displays hanging items and what appear to be printed sheets, posters, or collectibles arranged in vertical rows. Several people walk past this area, including a man in a light blue short-sleeved shirt moving toward the foreground.

In the center background, there are more stalls with bright awnings, including a red-and-white tent with a sign partially visible. People are gathered around counters and displays, browsing and talking. The market appears busy but relaxed, with shoppers strolling through the shaded walkway.

On the right side, a large stall under a beige canopy displays many decorative objects and crafts. Visible items include framed pictures, small figurines, masks or doll-like faces, ornaments, plates, and other handmade or antique-style pieces. A group of people stands in front of this stall, looking at the items. One older man with a cane stands near the center foreground facing the display, while several other visitors stand nearby, some with their backs to the camera. A woman in light-colored clothing and a pale hat is also browsing at the right-hand stall.

The scene feels vibrant and festive, combining the greenery of a park-like setting with the bustle of an artisan or flea market. The mix of shaded areas, bright sun, colorful flags, and varied stalls gives the image a cheerful, casual, community-event atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙市场场景的照片，人们在色彩缤纷的旗帜和摊位间穿行。左侧有一排摊位，出售各种商品，如书籍、玩具和其他小物件。中间有一位男士正在查看手机，而其他顾客则在浏览商品或与摊主交谈。右侧有几位女士站在一个带有遮阳伞的摊位前，似乎在挑选物品。整个场景被绿色的树木环绕，营造出一种宜人的购物环境。

caption:
The image is an abstract, angled view dominated by reflective surfaces, brass-colored metal framing, and glass panels. It appears to be taken inside or near an ornate elevator, atrium, or mirrored architectural structure, looking upward or through layered reflections toward the exterior of a building.

Several diagonal golden bars cut across the frame, forming sharp triangular and diamond-like shapes. These metallic edges have a warm brass or gold tone and catch the light strongly, creating bright highlights against the surrounding darkness. The composition feels tilted and disorienting, with no clear horizontal or vertical reference point, giving the image a kaleidoscopic quality.

In the center and upper-right portions, bright reflections reveal the outside of a pale cream or white building façade. Rectangular windows with greenish or bluish glass are visible, along with a patch of vivid blue sky. These exterior details appear fragmented and distorted by the angled glass and mirrored panels.

Much of the surrounding area is dark and shadowy, especially along the left and right edges. Within the darkness, faint decorative patterns can be seen—possibly ornate wall or ceiling designs with scroll-like motifs, suggesting an elegant or historic interior. Small warm orange light spots appear on the left and right sides, resembling reflections of lamps or small bulbs.

The image has strong contrast between the warm, dim interior and the bright outdoor reflections. The focus is slightly soft in places, and motion blur or glass distortion makes the reflections appear fluid and layered. Overall, it feels architectural, cinematic, and abstract, emphasizing geometry, reflection, and the contrast between enclosed interior space and bright exterior daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑内部结构的摄影作品，通过一个带有玻璃窗户的金属框架向外部看去。图像中心是一个透明的玻璃窗，透过它可以看到外面的蓝天和几栋建筑物。金属框架在阳光下反射出金色的光泽，而窗户的反光则形成了镜面效果，增强了视觉深度。

caption:
The image shows a grand outdoor entrance or plaza photographed from the bottom of a very wide staircase. The scene is bright and sunny, with a blue sky filled with large soft white clouds.

Dominating the center is a tall, gray stone archway made of two rectangular pillars supporting a broad rounded arch. The arch has several nested curved ridges, giving it a layered, monumental look. It stands at the top of the stairs and frames a building behind it.

Behind the arch is a distinctive building with a red-tiled lower roof and a golden, pyramid-like upper roof. The roof has stacked, dark horizontal tiers or vents near the center, creating a pagoda-like silhouette. The building façade includes arched windows and decorative circular designs, suggesting it may be a mosque, cultural building, or formal public structure. A band of script or ornamentation runs along the front below the roofline.

The foreground is filled by a very broad staircase stretching across the entire width of the image. The steps are reddish-brown with gray edges, forming strong horizontal lines that lead the eye upward toward the arch. The symmetry of the staircase and arch gives the scene a ceremonial or civic feel.

On both sides of the stairs are landscaped areas with red brick borders, flowering plants, shrubs, and tall palm trees. The palms vary in height, with slender trunks and leafy crowns, adding a tropical atmosphere. There are also decorative lampposts and small pavilion-like structures with white columns and dark roofs near the edges.

Several people are scattered across the steps and around the plaza. Near the center, two people stand facing each other on the upper steps, appearing to talk or pose for a photo. A few others are walking or standing near the sides. On the lower left, a woman sits or pauses on the steps holding items, while on the lower right a young girl in a bright yellow and blue dress stands near the edge of the staircase. The people appear small compared with the large scale of the stairs and arch, emphasizing the monumentality of the setting.

Overall, the image conveys a spacious, formal entrance to an important public or religious site, with tropical landscaping, monumental architecture, and a calm daytime atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座大型拱门和其下方的台阶的照片。拱门由两根粗壮的石柱支撑，顶部是一个金色屋顶的建筑，可能是某个宗教或纪念性建筑。周围种植着高大的棕榈树和其他热带植物，为场景增添了自然美。在台阶上，可以看到几位游客正在参观或行走，其中一位女士正推着婴儿车。天空是晴朗的，有几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows an urban streetscape viewed from below, looking upward at several older city buildings under a clear, vivid blue sky.

In the foreground, a tall black streetlamp curves in a large arch from the lower left upward and then down again, with its dark lamp head hanging near the center-left of the frame. Its silhouette stands out strongly against the bright sky.

The buildings are tightly packed and vary in age, color, and texture. On the left edge is a tall red-brick apartment building with small balconies and dark metal railings. Some rooftop greenery or shrubs are visible near the top. In the lower and central foreground is an older, darker stone or brick building with a weathered facade. It has many rectangular windows, some with window air-conditioning units, and a black metal fire escape running diagonally down the front. A rounded corner bay projects outward on the right side of this building, capped by a small conical, turret-like roof covered in bluish metal.

Behind and above the foreground building are larger, lighter-colored buildings with flat roofs. One broad white wall dominates the right-center of the image, with a few small windows and rooftop equipment. On the rooftops are several classic cylindrical wooden water towers mounted on metal support frames. Two prominent water towers stand near the center, and another is visible farther right. Their dark, weathered wood and metal bands contrast with the pale buildings and bright sky.

On the far right, another older building with decorative trim and a black metal fire escape is partially visible. The overall scene feels like a dense city neighborhood, with layered architecture, rooftop utilities, fire escapes, balconies, and water towers creating a distinctly metropolitan atmosphere. The strong sunlight illuminates the upper parts of the buildings, while the lower foreground remains in shadow, adding contrast and depth to the image.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，画面中心是一座老旧的多层建筑，其外墙覆盖着褪色的油漆和铁艺栏杆。建筑顶部有一个带有金属水箱的塔楼结构，与周围其他建筑物形成对比。在照片的左侧，可以看到一个经典的黑色街灯，而右侧则有一块大型广告牌。整个场景被一片晴朗的蓝天所包围，阳光照耀下，建筑物的细节清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a grand Gothic church or cathedral, focused on an extremely elaborate gilded altarpiece or retablo. The view is angled upward from below, emphasizing the height and richness of the structure.

At the center is a large, gold-covered religious altar screen filled with intricate carved figures, architectural tracery, niches, columns, and decorative foliage. The altarpiece is arranged in multiple vertical and horizontal sections, each containing sculpted biblical or saintly scenes. Many of the figures are painted and gilded, with expressive faces, robes, halos, and detailed gestures. The dominant colors are deep gold and dark blue, giving the whole structure a richly ceremonial appearance.

The central portion contains several prominent religious scenes. Near the upper center, a crucifixion scene is visible, with Christ on the cross set against a darker background. Below it are numerous sculptural groupings, including standing saints, angels, and narrative scenes framed by miniature Gothic canopies. In the middle, a large framed scene shows two robed figures facing one another, possibly a visitation or sacred encounter. Beneath that, there is a reclining figure, possibly part of a death, burial, or lamentation scene.

The side panels are also richly decorated. They have deep blue backgrounds covered with gilded ornamental patterns, heraldic shields, and framed emblems. The left and right wings of the altarpiece angle inward slightly, creating a chapel-like enclosure around the central altar. The gilded borders are dense with floral and vine-like motifs, small finials, pointed arches, and miniature spires typical of late Gothic or Renaissance church decoration.

Above the altarpiece is a large stone arch framing the upper section. The surrounding architecture is pale stone, with carved ribs, moldings, and decorative capitals. The stone vaulting and walls contrast with the shimmering gold of the retablo. On the left and right edges, the cathedral’s masonry is visible, including carved ornamental details and the underside of arches.

The lighting is warm and dramatic, catching the gold surfaces and making them gleam against the darker blue and shadowed recesses. The overall impression is one of immense craftsmanship, religious devotion, and opulence. The image captures a richly ornamented sacred space, likely a historic cathedral chapel, dominated by a monumental gilded altarpiece filled with Christian iconography and Gothic detail.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哥特式艺术风格的宗教雕塑的照片。图像中心是一个复杂的金色祭坛，其上雕刻着众多的人物和象征性的图案。祭坛上方装饰有精致的蓝色和金色装饰板，上面绘有圣徒形象和圣经故事场景。整个作品被放置在一个高大的拱形空间内，周围墙壁上有精美的石雕装饰。

caption:
The image shows a busy nighttime scene in Times Square, New York City, viewed from an elevated position looking down a brightly lit avenue.

On the right side, a massive black digital billboard dominates the frame. It reads “How to go LIVE in Times Square.” The word “LIVE” is highlighted in a red stamp-like box, and the rest of the text is in large white letters. The billboard includes playful space-themed graphics—stars, planets, a rocket-like icon, colorful social media-style reaction bubbles, and a blue “go live” button graphic. Smaller instructional text lists steps such as being in Times Square, taking out your phone, going to Facebook, and pressing a video icon. The Marriott Marquis logo appears near the top of the sign.

On the left and center, tall buildings rise into the dark evening sky, many with illuminated windows. Several stacked digital advertisements cover the facades. A prominent vertical sign near the upper left says “TOSHIBA,” with a bright blue “TDK” screen below it. Under that are colorful ads, including Dunkin’ Donuts-style coffee cup graphics and a Bud Light beer advertisement. Farther down the street, more neon and LED signs glow in pink, blue, white, and orange.

The street below is crowded with taxis, buses, cars, and pedestrians. Yellow cabs are visible among dense traffic, with red brake lights and headlights forming lines along the avenue. Steam rises from a street vent near the lower center, adding a hazy urban atmosphere. Crowds of people fill the sidewalks and crosswalk areas, suggesting a lively evening rush or tourist-heavy moment.

In the foreground at the lower right, part of a dark stone monument or statue base is visible, with engraved text partially cut off. Near the lower center, a statue or figure facing away from the camera stands above the street, silhouetted against the traffic and lights. Street signs, traffic signals, lampposts, banners, and construction-style barriers add to the dense visual clutter typical of Times Square.

Overall, the image captures the energetic, commercial, and crowded atmosphere of Times Square at night, with towering advertisements, heavy traffic, glowing signage, and a constant flow of people.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示时代广场夜景的照片，画面中心是一个巨大的电子显示屏，上面显示着关于如何在时代广场享受夜晚的指南和一些有趣的建议。街道上人来人往，人们似乎正在享受这个繁忙的城市环境。周围是高耸入云的摩天大楼，建筑上的灯光点缀着夜空。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit urban square under a clear, bright blue sky. The scene appears to be in a civic or administrative area, with large institutional buildings surrounding an open paved plaza.

On the left dominates a large, pale stone building with a formal, mid-20th-century architectural style. It has multiple stories, tall vertical window bays, and a slightly projecting upper section. The facade is beige or cream-colored, with rows of narrow rectangular windows separated by vertical columns. Several external air-conditioning units are mounted beneath or beside some of the windows. At the top is a dark greenish roof edge or mansard-like section, with antennas and communication equipment rising from the roof. A small Bulgarian flag is visible near the roofline, suggesting the location may be in Bulgaria. The building’s entrance is near the lower center, reached by a short set of steps, with a small balcony-like projection above it.

A large leafy tree partially obscures the left side of this main building, adding deep green foliage to the otherwise stone-heavy scene.

The foreground is a spacious paved plaza with a striking geometric pattern made from light and dark paving stones. The pattern includes large angular shapes, diagonal bands, and rectangular sections in gray, black, and off-white tones. The square looks mostly empty, with no visible pedestrians. Near the lower left foreground, there are a few low metal railings or frames, and one dark platform-like structure appears worn or damaged, with peeling material on its surface.

On the right side of the image is another large building, also institutional in appearance. It has a light lower facade with many evenly spaced windows, while the upper level is reddish-brown, possibly brick or tile-clad, with a sloped or mansard-style roof section. This building sits slightly farther back and is bordered by a raised terrace or wall. The Cyrillic letters “ПТТ” are visible on its side, suggesting it may be connected to postal or telecommunications services.

Between the two larger buildings, a row of older, lower residential or mixed-use buildings lines the street. These structures have colorful facades in muted yellow, pink, beige, and gray, with small balconies, shutters, and rooftop tiles. They add a more traditional urban texture behind the formal plaza.

In the right foreground, there is a planted area with low hedges and spiky green ornamental plants set into a raised rectangular planter. A few classic-style black street lamps are visible near the buildings and plaza edges.

Overall, the image depicts a quiet, open city square with monumental civic architecture, strong sunlight, sharp shadows, and a very clear sky, giving the scene a calm, spacious, and slightly formal atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的广场和建筑物的照片。在画面中央，有一座设计简约的多层建筑，其特点是大面积的玻璃窗和混凝土结构。建筑前是一个宽敞的广场，地面铺有黑白相间的几何图案瓷砖。广场周围种植着几棵树木，为这个城市空间增添了一丝自然气息。在建筑的背后可以看到其他低矮的建筑，它们的外观与前景的现代建筑形成对比。整个场景被一个晴朗的蓝天所覆盖，没有云彩，光线充足，使得建筑和广场细节清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor running event, likely a marathon or half-marathon finish area, captured in bright late-afternoon sunlight.

In the foreground, several runners are moving toward the camera on colored finish lanes laid over a paved road. There are three main carpeted lanes: a red lane on the left, a blue lane in the center, and a green lane on the right. Orange-and-white traffic cones divide the lanes and guide the runners. Silver confetti is scattered across the ground and carpets, suggesting a celebratory finish zone.

On the left foreground, a male runner in a blue sleeveless race shirt and black leggings is running along the red carpet. He wears a race bib and appears focused as he approaches the finish area. In the center, another runner in a white and red shirt with “CRRU Chiang Rai Half Marathon 2019” visible on the front is jogging on the blue carpet while holding a small bottle. On the right foreground, a female runner in an orange-and-white event shirt, black leggings, and a pink waist pouch is running closest to the camera on the blue/green side. She also has a race bib attached to her waist.

In the midground and background, many other participants and event staff are visible. Some runners are entering or leaving the finish area, while others gather near tents and barriers on the right side. There are sponsor banners, event boards, and metal barricades lining the course. A group of spectators sits or stands along the left side, watching and cheering from behind a barrier.

The setting appears to be a large open paved area, possibly a campus or sports ground. In the background, there are modern low-rise buildings with balconies and large windows, along with trees and faint hills or mountains in the distance. The sky is pale and clear, and the warm lighting casts long shadows across the road, giving the scene an energetic but relaxed post-race atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示马拉松比赛场景的照片，几位参赛者正在赛道上奔跑。最前方的参赛者穿着红色运动服和黑色帽子，紧随其后的是另一位穿着蓝色运动服的参赛者。他们正沿着彩色的跑道前进，跑道上有白色的起点线和终点线标记。背景中可以看到观众和其他参赛者，以及一些绿色的树木和建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban riverside scene at dusk, with a broad, rippling river running through the foreground and middle of the frame. The water is dark blue-gray with textured waves and reflections from the fading evening light.

Several boats are on the river. In the lower left, a dark riverboat with a canopy marked “CHATRIUM” moves across the water. Near the center is a smaller decorative wooden-looking boat with a reddish-brown roof and warm lights underneath, giving it a traditional or tourist-boat appearance. On the right edge, partially hidden by tree branches, there is another boat with a red-and-white structure, likely docked or moving close to the riverbank.

The background is dominated by tall modern high-rise buildings. Near the center-left stands a very tall glass-and-concrete tower with a sleek vertical design, many windows, and a reflective façade catching soft pink-orange tones from the sky. A construction crane is visible near its base, suggesting ongoing development. Farther left, another tall residential tower rises in the distance. Additional buildings and low riverside structures line the opposite bank.

The sky is pale and softly colored, transitioning from light blue to pastel pink and peach, indicating sunset or early evening. The lighting is calm and atmospheric rather than harsh.

On the right side, large dark green tree branches hang over the river, framing much of the scene and partially obscuring the buildings and boats behind them. On the far left, a series of tall streetlights or bridge-side lamp posts angle into the frame, adding to the urban setting. In the lower foreground, parts of a riverside platform or dock are visible, including railings, a blue roof, and a green cylindrical structure.

Overall, the image captures a lively but peaceful riverside cityscape: modern towers, boats moving along the water, construction activity, and lush greenery silhouetted against a soft evening sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸景观的摄影作品，图中河流上有多艘船只在航行，包括一艘大型红色船只和几艘小型船只。河岸边有建筑物，其中最显眼的是两座高耸的现代摩天大楼，它们的玻璃幕墙反射着夕阳的余晖。天空呈现出柔和的粉蓝色调，与河面的波光粼粼相映成趣。前景左侧有一片绿色植物的枝叶，为画面增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a beautifully decorated upscale shopping street at night, viewed from the center of a cobblestone pedestrian lane. The scene is framed symmetrically by elegant, cream and pale-yellow classical-style buildings on both sides, with tall windows, decorative molding, and bright exterior lighting that gives the façades a warm glow.

Across the street, dozens of shiny red heart-shaped balloons are suspended in the air at different heights, forming rows that recede into the distance. Their metallic surfaces reflect the surrounding lights, making them stand out vividly against the dark night sky. Above the balloons, many strands of tiny white fairy lights are stretched from building to building, creating a glowing canopy overhead. The lights form parallel arcs that draw the eye toward the far end of the street.

Luxury storefronts line both sides of the walkway. On the left, a large illuminated “CÉLINE” sign is visible above a bright display window. On the right, a “Chopard” storefront sign can be seen, along with other boutique entrances. Some shop windows are brightly lit, displaying fashion items and interiors, while the street itself remains relatively calm and spacious.

The ground is paved with small gray cobblestones, and a long dark red carpet or runner extends down the center of the street, adding to the festive and elegant atmosphere. Potted evergreen trees are placed along the sidewalks near the shop entrances, suggesting a holiday or winter-season decoration theme. In the distance, small groups of people walk along the street, appearing tiny beneath the large display of lights and balloons.

At the far end, a building with a small tower-like feature and illuminated triangular rooflines adds a focal point to the composition. Overall, the image has a romantic, festive, luxurious feel, with the red heart balloons and sparkling lights creating a celebratory nighttime ambiance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日装饰的商业街夜景照片。街道上方悬挂着一串串红色心形气球，营造出浪漫和温馨的氛围。建筑物的立面被温暖的灯光照亮，突出了其古典建筑风格的特点。商店的橱窗亮起，展示了各种商品，而街道中央铺有一条红色地毯，引导视线并增添了节日气氛。

caption:
The image shows a quiet railway area viewed from an elevated angle, likely on an overcast or misty day. Several sets of train tracks run diagonally across the foreground and middle of the scene, laid on a wide bed of pale gray gravel. The rails are rusty brown, with dark wooden sleepers spaced regularly beneath them. In the lower left foreground, there is a small railway signal or switch marker with bright orange and blue parts, standing out against the muted tones.

A narrow concrete walkway runs alongside the tracks near the center of the image. On it, a single person is walking away from the camera. They are wearing a dark blue hooded jacket, shorts or a skirt over leggings, boots, and a backpack. The figure appears small compared with the expanse of tracks and buildings, giving the scene a solitary feeling.

Behind the walkway is a low stone retaining wall made of irregular dark stones. Beyond the wall are old, weathered buildings with white or pale gray walls stained by age, moisture, and rust. The buildings have barred windows, peeling paint, corrugated metal roofing, and patches of moss or grime. One roof in the background is reddish metal, while another lower roof is gray and looks worn and uneven. A small security camera is mounted on a pole or wall near the buildings.

Utility poles and many black overhead wires crisscross the upper part of the image, adding a dense, tangled industrial feel. The background is hazy, with faint hills or trees barely visible through the mist. Along the right edge and lower foreground, there are drainage grates, a concrete curb, patches of green vegetation, and a rough wooden or bamboo fence-like structure.

Overall, the scene feels damp, quiet, and slightly worn down—an old railway district or station-side area with aged buildings, multiple tracks, and a lone pedestrian moving through the muted urban landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示铁路轨道和周围环境的现实主义风格照片。在画面中心，有两条平行的铁轨延伸至远方，而在铁轨上，一位穿着蓝色外套的人正在行走。背景中，可以看到几座老旧的建筑，它们的外墙剥落，显示出岁月的痕迹。图像的前景显示了铁轨旁的一块草地和一些小石子。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而略带荒凉的氛围。

caption:
The image is a wide, black-and-white photograph of a canal scene in Venice, Italy. In the foreground, two sleek black gondolas are moored close to a stone quay. Their long, curved hulls dominate the lower half of the frame, with the raised iron prow ornaments and elegant sweeping ends giving them a distinctive Venetian silhouette. One gondola sits slightly left of center, partially tucked among several tall wooden mooring poles, while another larger gondola extends diagonally from the middle-right toward the lower center, its bow curving upward prominently.

A gondolier or boat attendant in a striped shirt is seated or standing low inside one of the gondolas near the center, though the face appears blurred by motion. The gondolas contain decorative upholstery and patterned covers, adding texture despite the monochrome palette. Thick ropes and mooring lines loop around the weathered wooden posts, which rise vertically from the water and create a layered foreground.

At the far left, a small wooden dock projects into the canal. Two people sit on the edge of it, facing the water and looking across the canal. Nearby is a lamp post with a rounded white globe, along with signs or notices attached to posts, adding to the sense of a busy waterfront landing area.

The canal water fills the middle of the image, rippling with soft reflections of the boats, posts, and buildings. Across the canal, a row of ornate Venetian palaces and historic buildings forms the background. Their façades feature arched Gothic windows, balconies with railings, carved stone details, and weathered plaster over brick. Some buildings have tall narrow windows and decorative colonnades, while others show patches of exposed masonry and aged surfaces, emphasizing the city’s long history.

On the right side in the distance, another gondola moves along the canal with a standing gondolier at the stern and seated passengers inside. Small birds float on the water nearby. The overall atmosphere is calm and timeless, with the grayscale treatment highlighting the architecture, reflections, and elegant shapes of the gondolas rather than color. The scene captures a classic Venetian waterfront moment: historic palaces, still water, moored boats, and quiet activity along the Grand Canal.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的照片，捕捉了威尼斯大运河上的两艘贡多拉船。在前景中，一艘贡多拉船停靠在码头边，船上有一位穿着传统服装的船夫正专注地操作着船只。另一艘贡多拉船则位于画面的中央，船夫同样身着传统的服饰，静静地坐在船内。背景是典型的威尼斯建筑，其精细的立面和窗户细节在黑白色调下显得格外引人注目。

caption:
The image shows a broad urban street scene dominated by a white Orthodox-style church complex with bright blue roofs and gold onion domes. The church sits slightly left of center, elevated above a green grassy area. Its main building has a large blue dome topped with a gold cupola and cross, while a tall white bell tower with arched openings stands to the right, also capped with a blue roof and gold dome. Smaller chapels or gate structures with blue roofs and gold crosses surround the main church, creating a cohesive white-and-blue architectural ensemble.

Behind the church are several multi-story residential or mixed-use buildings. On the left is a long pale gray apartment block with many windows and balconies. Behind and to the right of the church are warmer-toned buildings in orange, brick red, and cream, with red roofs, chimneys, and varied window styles. These modern buildings contrast with the traditional religious architecture in the foreground.

The sky is dramatic and overcast, filled with heavy gray-blue clouds, though sunlight breaks through and brightly illuminates the church and parts of the buildings. This contrast gives the scene a vivid, almost stormy atmosphere. A small dark bird is visible in the sky near the right side.

In the foreground, a multi-lane road curves gently through the image. Several cars are traveling along it, including a large silver SUV closest to the camera and smaller vehicles farther ahead. White lane markings, arrows, and road signs are visible, including a pedestrian crossing sign and bus-stop signage. Decorative street lamps line parts of the road on the right.

On the left foreground, there is a landscaped green area with rows of leafy trees and trimmed grass. Sidewalks run through the park-like strip, and a few pedestrians can be seen near the road and walkway. Overall, the image combines an active city roadway, greenery, residential buildings, and a striking white-and-blue church under a moody, cloud-filled sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影图像，前景中有一条繁忙的道路，上面有多辆汽车正在行驶。道路两侧种植着整齐的树木和灌木，为街道增添了一丝绿色。在画面中央，可以看到一座具有俄罗斯传统建筑风格的教堂，其蓝色屋顶与周围的白色建筑物形成鲜明对比。教堂后方是多层住宅楼，颜色各异，从黄色到红色不等，显示了城市的居住区多样性。天空中的乌云预示着可能的降雨，但光线依然充足，使得整个场景看起来清晰而生动。

caption:
The image shows two young adults posing beside a black Suzuki motorcycle in an outdoor urban setting. Their faces are intentionally blurred, giving the photo a privacy-protected or promotional look.

On the left, a young man is leaning against or sitting partially on the motorcycle. He has styled light-brown hair and is wearing dark sunglasses. He wears a white graphic T-shirt with large text including “# SOAR” and parkour-themed imagery, along with light blue jeans. Over his shirt is a black backpack harness with visible shoulder straps and a chest strap clipped across the front. One of his hands rests near the motorcycle’s handlebar.

On the right, a young woman stands with her back and side partly turned toward the camera. She has dark, wavy shoulder-length hair, with sunglasses perched on top of her head. She wears a light beige or taupe short-sleeved T-shirt tucked into high-waisted denim shorts. She is carrying a large black backpack over both shoulders. The backpack has a prominent front compartment with printed graphics and text, including “FRANCE 1930,” “PARKOUR,” and “by Raymond Belle,” along with small action-photo panels and a small shield-like logo near the top.

The motorcycle is black with chrome and metallic details. The “SUZUKI” logo is clearly visible on the fuel tank. The bike has a round headlight, black mirrors, brown textured handlebar grips, and a long black seat. It appears to be a compact or retro-styled motorcycle.

Behind them is a metal railing with horizontal bars, suggesting they are on a bridge, balcony, or elevated walkway. The background is bright and softly blurred, showing a hazy cityscape or distant buildings with greenery below. The overall lighting is soft and bright, giving the scene a casual, airy, travel-oriented feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位年轻人在户外的现代摄影风格照片。男性站在一辆黑色摩托车旁，身穿带有图案的白色T恤和牛仔裤，戴着墨镜，显得休闲而时尚。女性站在他旁边，背对着镜头，穿着蓝色短裤和一件灰色上衣，背着一个黑色背包。他们似乎正在享受一个晴朗的日子，背景是模糊的城市天际线和远处的建筑轮廓。

caption:
