The image shows a sunlit canal scene in Venice, Italy, with a row of historic waterfront buildings lining the edge of greenish-blue water. The viewpoint appears to be from across the canal, looking directly at the façades and the boats moored in front.

In the foreground, the canal water fills the lower portion of the image. It is a pale turquoise-green with small ripples and bright reflections from the sunlight. Several wooden mooring posts rise vertically from the water, weathered and uneven, forming rows in front of the buildings. A number of small boats are tied up along the canal: white motorboats, a dark blue boat with a cabin, and a long red-and-white boat on the right. Some boats are covered with tarps, while others are open, with ropes and fenders visible.

Behind the boats is a narrow quay or dock area. A few people can be seen near the left-center dock area, appearing small in the scene. One person in blue stands near the water, while another in a bright yellow-green top is closer to the dock edge. The human figures emphasize the scale of the tall buildings.

The architecture is the main focus. The buildings are old, multi-story Venetian palazzi with a mixture of faded plaster, exposed brick, stone trim, and decorative Gothic-style windows. On the left, there are salmon-pink and reddish buildings with dark green shutters and arched window openings. Their façades are relatively plain compared with the central structure, but they still have traditional Venetian details such as narrow windows, small balconies, and tiled roofs.

The central building is the most ornate. Its façade is a weathered brownish-pink with pale stone framing and extensive Gothic decoration. The second level features a grand series of arched windows supported by slender columns. Above these arches are intricate quatrefoil and circular tracery patterns, giving the building a delicate, lace-like appearance. The lower level also has pointed arches and columns, along with dark doors or windows. The plaster is worn and patchy in places, revealing age and exposure to moisture.

To the right of the central palazzo is a large white or cream-colored building with dark green shutters. Its façade is stained and weathered, with vertical streaks and discoloration from age. It has arched windows on the middle level, small balconies with stone balustrades, and decorative medallion-like sculptural elements on the wall. Farther right, part of a brick building is visible, with narrow Gothic-style arched openings and small balconies.

The rooftops show terracotta tiles, chimneys, small dormer structures, and thin television antennas rising against the sky. The upper half of the image is dominated by a clear, pale blue sky with no clouds, suggesting a bright, calm day.

Overall, the scene captures a classic Venetian waterfront: old palaces with ornate Gothic details, weathered plaster and stone, wooden mooring poles, small boats, and shimmering canal water under strong daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示威尼斯运河边建筑和船只的摄影图像。图中可见多座风格独特的老式建筑，它们沿着运河排列，具有丰富的历史感和装饰性的细节。建筑前有几艘停泊在木桩上的船只，包括小型摩托艇和一些帆船。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而历史悠久的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an urban street scene in Sandakan, likely in Malaysia, with a mix of older commercial buildings, parked cars, and a green hillside in the background.

On the left side, a large multi-story building dominates the foreground. Its facade is weathered, with streaks of dark staining and patches of aging concrete. Large yellow letters near the top spell out “WISMA SANDAKAN,” and a vertical sign with Chinese characters runs down the front pillar. The lower floors appear to contain shops or retail units. Several brand signs are visible, including Nike, Adidas, Converse, Levi’s, Edwin, and others, suggesting a clothing or department-store area. A red awning or signboard stretches across the ground level with Chinese text and the name of a business; the storefront beneath it is open, with merchandise visible near the entrance.

In front of this building are steps, columns, a small driveway or passageway, and several parked vehicles. A black car is parked close to the curb, while a small silver car is stopped or parked near the center foreground. The road surface looks slightly worn, with visible patches, puddles, and yellow road markings.

To the right of the commercial building, the scene opens toward a hillside covered in dense tropical greenery. The trees are lush and layered, rising behind a small complex of buildings painted mostly white and green. One of these buildings has a distinctive green dome with a small yellow ornament on top, giving it a religious or civic appearance. A long, silver, tube-like covered walkway or slide-like structure descends diagonally from the hillside area toward the lower building. Green railings and stairways climb the slope, connecting the structures.

Further right, another older building stands partially visible, its facade heavily stained and weathered, with blue-tinted window coverings. A line of cars is parked along the road in front of the hillside area, including a noticeable bright yellow vehicle among darker-colored cars.

The sky is overcast with gray-blue clouds, creating a humid, tropical atmosphere. The lighting is bright but softened by cloud cover. Overall, the image captures a busy yet slightly aged urban district at the edge of a forested hillside, combining commercial storefronts, road traffic, parked vehicles, and a prominent green-domed structure nestled among trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，画面中心是一座装饰有绿色圆顶的建筑，其周围是商店和住宅。街道上停有多辆汽车，包括一辆黑色SUV、一辆白色轿车和一辆黄色出租车。建筑物上的招牌显示了商店名称，如'SANDAKAN'和'VISMA'。在照片的背景中，可以看到树木覆盖的小山丘，为这个城市场景增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a bright, whimsical indoor amusement or theme-park area with a playful, cartoon-like design. The space is filled with oversized colorful decorations, rounded shapes, and fantasy garden elements.

In the center foreground is a large decorative arch made of glossy tubular pieces in blue, green, yellow, orange, and purple. Beneath and around it are tall, curling green plant sculptures, like exaggerated vines or seaweed, rising out of a beige, textured base that looks like porous coral or sponge. A large smiling pink flower character with a yellow face stands prominently near the middle-left, giving the scene a cheerful, animated feel.

Behind the arch is a carousel-style ride with a striped canopy and rows of glowing lights. A sign on the ride appears to read “Buddy Go Round,” suggesting a children’s ride. The ride area is surrounded by fences and more colorful character figures. Several visitors, including adults and children, are visible near the ride, some standing with strollers.

The right side of the image features tall green cylindrical structures resembling giant plant stems or pipes. Attached to and around them are decorative insect-like and robot-like figures, including bee-shaped characters with striped bodies and wings. Near the bottom right, there is a large metallic purple robot or toy-like figure with round limbs and oversized feet.

Overhead, a large spiral hanging sculpture dominates the ceiling area. It is made of circular bands in green, yellow, orange, and black, resembling a giant suspended coil or whimsical UFO. The ceiling is high, with dark teal beams and many bright pendant lights illuminating the space.

The background shows multiple levels of the indoor complex, with white balcony railings and walkways around the perimeter. The polished floor reflects the colorful lights and decorations, adding to the lively, glossy atmosphere. Overall, the scene feels like a vibrant children’s entertainment zone, full of fantasy, movement, and playful oversized designs.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内儿童游乐场的照片，场地中心有一个色彩缤纷的拱门结构，周围装饰有各种卡通人物和动物形象。拱门上方悬挂着多彩的吊灯，营造出欢乐的氛围。地面上铺设有黄色和紫色的图案瓷砖，与整个场景的活泼主题相呼应。在照片的背景中，可以看到几位成年人正在观看或照顾孩子，而孩子们则在游乐设施上玩耍。

caption:
The image shows the interior of an ornate church or chapel viewed from the central aisle, facing the main altar.

In the foreground and middle ground are rows of polished wooden pews arranged symmetrically on both sides of a central walkway. The pews have a warm reddish-brown tone and glossy finish, contrasting with the pale stone interior. The floor is laid in a striking checkerboard pattern of large diamond-shaped tiles, alternating between reddish-brown and light cream or gray marble.

At the far end of the aisle is the sanctuary area, slightly raised and separated by a low wooden or marble communion rail. The altar is richly decorated, with gilded details and several tall gold candlesticks arranged symmetrically. A central gold ornament or monstrance-like cross form stands prominently on the altar. A white altar cloth hangs over the front, and a small floral arrangement sits near the center below it.

Behind the altar, the apse is darker and more shadowed. Two tall, narrow, arched windows glow with warm yellow-orange light, creating a soft illumination around the altar. Between and above the windows are religious paintings or frescoes, including a central image that appears to depict the Virgin and Child or another sacred figure. Higher up in the curved apse is a larger fresco showing seated holy figures, possibly Christ flanked by saints or apostles.

The surrounding architecture is elaborate and classical/baroque in style. A large arch frames the sanctuary, supported by tall pilasters with decorative capitals. The walls are pale cream or white, covered with carved moldings, relief panels, niches, and sculptural ornamentation. On both sides of the arch are large niches containing statues of robed religious figures, each set within ornate architectural frames. Small framed religious artworks or devotional objects are mounted on ledges near the statues.

The ceiling and upper walls are heavily decorated with stucco designs, scrollwork, medallions, and relief ornamentation. The overall space feels formal, symmetrical, and historic, with a quiet, reverent atmosphere. The lighting is subdued, with the brightest warmth coming from the windows and the polished wood of the pews.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂内部的照片，画面中心是一个装饰华丽的祭坛，其上方有金色的雕塑和壁画。祭坛前方是排列整齐的木质长椅，地面铺设有红白相间的菱形瓷砖。墙壁上装饰着精美的浮雕和画作，显示出教堂的艺术价值。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种庄严而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a nighttime street view of a luxury fashion storefront, specifically an Armani store along what appears to be an urban shopping street. The scene is photographed from a low, slightly angled perspective looking down the length of the building façade, creating a strong sense of depth as the storefront windows recede into the distance on the left.

The building exterior is dark and elegant, with heavy stone or concrete cladding and large rectangular window bays. Above the shop windows are black sign panels with illuminated white lettering reading **“ARMANI / MANZONI 31”** in several places. On the far right, another sign begins with **“ARMANI / …”**, partially cut off by the edge of the frame. The signage is crisp and high-contrast against the black background, giving the storefront a polished, upscale look.

The ground-floor windows display mannequins and fashion items. Many of the display cases are framed by bright red-orange neon rectangular outlines, which stand out vividly against the otherwise dark façade. Inside the windows, mannequins wear stylish clothing, including dark dresses, jackets, and patterned garments. Some displays feature large graphic panels with bold blue-and-white text, including visible words such as **“EMPORIO ARMANI”** and **“OROLOGI”**. One section near the right has an illuminated **“EMPORIO ARMANI”** logo on a dark panel beside a window display.

Black awnings extend outward above several of the display windows, angled downward over the glass. Their dark fabric blends into the nighttime environment but adds a layered, boutique-like appearance to the storefront. The upper floors of the building have tall windows glowing softly from within, with warm cream-colored light diffused behind curtains or frosted glass. This warm lighting contrasts with the cooler reflections and neon colors at street level.

The street in front of the store appears quiet and empty, with no pedestrians or vehicles visible. The pavement is dark and slightly reflective, suggesting it may be wet or recently cleaned. Metal grates and drainage channels run along the sidewalk and roadway, catching reflections from the storefront lights. The red neon frames cast faint reddish highlights onto the ground.

Overall, the image conveys a sleek, luxurious urban atmosphere: a high-end Armani retail location at night, illuminated by refined signage, warm architectural lighting, and striking neon-framed window displays.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示ARMANI/MANZONI 51品牌店铺外观的照片。照片中，商店的橱窗被明亮的灯光照亮，展示了多种服装和配饰。橱窗的设计简洁而现代，以黑色为主色调，并辅以红色和蓝色的边框。每扇橱窗内都摆放着不同的商品，从运动鞋到时尚服饰，展现了品牌的多样性和高端定位。街道上的路灯投射出柔和的光线，与商店内部的亮光形成对比，增强了夜晚的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a damaged residential area under a bright, partly cloudy sky. It appears to be a low-income or rural neighborhood with small, closely spaced houses made from a mix of wood, concrete, and corrugated metal.

In the foreground, there is extensive destruction and debris. Large sheets of corrugated roofing material have collapsed and are lying at an angle across the ground, with wooden beams and broken framing scattered on top of them. Pieces of concrete, rubble, cracked pavement, dirt, and fragments of building materials cover the area. On the far right foreground, the edge of a road or paved surface is broken and uneven, with chunks of asphalt and concrete displaced. A black plastic bag and other small debris lie among the rubble.

On the left side, a single-story wooden house with a blue corrugated metal roof is visible. The walls are weathered, with mismatched materials and faded boards. A small window and an open doorway can be seen; the number “612” is written in red on a wall near the entrance. In front of this house are scattered objects, including fabric or a striped cloth draped over something, wooden planks, metal sheets, and construction debris. The ground around the house looks muddy and disturbed, with exposed soil and broken pieces of material.

In the center of the image, several small trees and dense green plants grow between the structures, partially obscuring the buildings. Behind them are multiple tall utility poles, some made of wood and others of concrete. Numerous overhead electrical or communication wires stretch across the entire upper part of the image, crisscrossing in several directions. Some wires sag noticeably, giving the scene a cluttered and potentially unsafe appearance.

On the right side, there is another building made largely of corrugated metal panels in dark red, green, and rusted colors. Its roof is red metal, with an extended awning-like section. The walls look patched together and worn, with peeling paint and rust. A wooden support structure and poles stand around it. Behind and beside it, a pink building is partially visible.

Overall, the scene conveys the aftermath of significant damage, possibly from flooding, a landslide, construction collapse, or severe weather. The area is cluttered with broken roofing, damaged pavement, scattered household and construction materials, and exposed infrastructure, while the houses remain standing but appear weathered and vulnerable.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然灾害后废墟景象的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一座被严重破坏的房屋，其屋顶和墙壁部分倒塌，露出了内部结构。房屋周围散落着大量的瓦片、木材和其他碎片，显示出灾难的破坏力。背景中可以看到其他几座类似的房屋，它们的屋顶也遭受了损坏，但没有像中心房屋那样彻底坍塌。电线杆和多条电线横跨在这些房屋上方，突显出这个场景是在一个电力供应区域。天空是晴朗的，有少量云彩，为这个荒凉的场景增添了一丝生机。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor scene in a grassy field, likely during a historical military reenactment or staged combat display.

In the center foreground, a person wearing a khaki-colored military-style uniform is kneeling in tall grass. Their face is deliberately blurred, but their posture suggests they are focused forward. They are wearing a dark naval-style cap with a small emblem on the front and Cyrillic lettering around the band. The uniform includes a loose khaki tunic and trousers, with dark straps and a pouch or canteen hanging at the side. The person is holding and aiming a long firearm or light machine-gun-style weapon fitted with a support/bipod-like piece.

On the right side of the image, a second person is partially visible and cropped by the frame. They are also dressed in a similar khaki uniform and dark naval-style cap. This person is crouched low in the grass, looking downward, with an anchor-like insignia visible on the front of their clothing or gear, reinforcing the naval theme.

The setting is an open meadow with tall green grass. The background is heavily blurred, showing muted green and brown vegetation, possibly trees or brush in the distance. On the far left edge, there is a dark, out-of-focus object that could be part of a vehicle, equipment, or weapon emplacement. The overall color palette is natural greens and browns, with soft daylight and a shallow depth of field focusing attention on the reenactors in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示历史军事主题的摄影照片，两位身穿棕色制服的人物在草地上模拟战斗场景。左侧的人物站立着，手持一把黑色手枪，专注地观察前方。右侧的人物蹲伏在地上，头部低垂，似乎在寻找或准备攻击。他们身后的背景是模糊的草地和树木，强调了场景的户外环境。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, upward-looking view of the Leaning Tower of Pisa in Italy. The tower dominates nearly the entire frame, rising from the bottom center and extending toward the top, with its famous tilt visible as the cylindrical structure leans slightly to one side.

The tower is made of pale gray and off-white stone, with subtle bands of different tones running around its circular body. Its architecture is highly ornate, featuring multiple stacked levels of open arcades. Each level has rows of slender columns supporting rounded arches, creating repeating patterns all the way up the tower. The columns vary slightly in shade, from light gray to beige, giving the stonework a weathered, historic appearance.

Near the lower portion of the tower, decorative geometric panels are visible, including diamond-shaped patterns set within arched frames. The base also has larger columns and carved capitals with intricate details. The tower’s circular tiers become progressively smaller toward the top, where a small red flag can be seen fluttering on the upper railing.

The sky behind the tower is overcast, filled with pale gray clouds, which gives the scene a muted, soft lighting. At the bottom right, there is a blue “WC” sign indicating public restrooms, topped by a blank yellow sign. Some rooftops and buildings are partially visible along the lower edges of the image, suggesting the tower is photographed from ground level in an urban plaza or tourist area.

Overall, the image emphasizes the height, historic stonework, and distinctive leaning profile of the Leaning Tower of Pisa.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示比萨斜塔的摄影照片。塔身呈圆柱形，每层都有精美的拱门和装饰性石雕。顶部装有一个红色的旗帜，而天空中布满了云朵，为这座著名的建筑增添了一丝庄严与历史感。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit outdoor scene in a dry, open landscape. Two people are standing in a field of yellow-brown grass and dark, scorched-looking soil. The setting appears arid, with sparse vegetation, low shrubs, scattered trees, and hazy hills or tree-covered ridges in the far background.

In the foreground, the ground is mostly dark and ashy, with patches of straw-colored grass and exposed reddish-brown soil. Across the lower part of the image are faint, large geometric markings or outlines on the ground. They look like rectangular and linear patterns scraped or revealed through the darker surface layer, forming a grid-like or archaeological-looking design. The markings are subtle but occupy a broad area in front of the two people.

Near the center-left stands one person wearing a teal baseball cap, a red-and-blue plaid shirt over a dark T-shirt, blue jeans, and dark shoes. A small tan crossbody bag hangs at their side. Their posture suggests they are speaking or explaining something, with one hand raised in a gesturing motion.

To the right stands another person wearing a long-sleeved burgundy top, tan pants, and dark shoes. A patterned scarf is draped over their head and around their neck, likely for sun protection. They stand with one hand on their hip, facing the other person as if listening.

Behind them is a narrow paved road or path running horizontally across the scene. Beyond the road are more dry grass, low bushes, and scattered trees. The sky is very bright and washed out, suggesting strong midday sunlight. Long shadows on the ground indicate the sun is angled from the upper left or behind the camera. The overall atmosphere is dry, hot, and rural, with the two figures appearing to examine or discuss the ground markings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位女性在开阔田野上的照片。她们站在一个用干草堆成的图案上，图案中包含文字和符号，可能是某种艺术或文化表达。左侧的女性穿着格子衬衫、牛仔裤和运动鞋，戴着帽子，手里拿着手机。右侧的女性穿着深色长袖衫、棕色裤子和黑色鞋子，头发扎起，手插在口袋里。她们似乎正在交谈或观察这个图案。背景是广阔的草地，远处可见树木和低矮的建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a high, elevated view over a dense modern cityscape, likely in Bangkok, during late afternoon or early evening under a hazy, overcast sky.

In the center stands a tall, dark residential high-rise tower with many balconies and glass windows. It has a distinctive rooftop structure with vertical striped panels and what appears to be a small rooftop garden or terrace near the top. Surrounding it are numerous mid-rise and high-rise buildings in shades of white, gray, beige, and dark blue, creating a layered urban skyline that fades into haze in the distance.

On the right side, a large residential building with a grid of balconies dominates the edge of the frame. Its facade is partly covered by green vegetation near the lower levels. Nearby are other apartment and office towers, including a darker rectangular building and several white condominium blocks.

A prominent elevated rail line cuts diagonally across the lower half of the image from left to right. Beneath and alongside it is a busy road with many cars, including several brightly colored taxis. The rail tracks and traffic corridor add a strong sense of movement and urban infrastructure.

In the lower left area, there is a school complex with visible signage reading “St Andrews International School Bangkok.” The campus includes a green soccer field and a blue basketball or multi-sport court, both neatly marked. These bright sports surfaces contrast with the gray and beige tones of the surrounding buildings.

The foreground contains rooftops of low-rise buildings, including a large corrugated metal roof stretching across the bottom of the image. There are also smaller houses, service buildings, trees, and patches of greenery tucked between the urban structures. The mixture of high-rises, schools, homes, roads, rail lines, and vegetation gives the scene a dense but varied metropolitan character.

The sky is filled with soft gray clouds, and the light is diffused, giving the scene a muted, slightly humid atmosphere. The distant skyline appears washed out by haze, emphasizing the scale and depth of the city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的摄影图像，画面中心是一座高耸的摩天大楼，其周围分布着各种建筑和住宅区。在前景中，可以看到一条铁路轨道穿过城市，旁边是绿色的树木和草地。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，天空中有几朵云彩，整体给人一种宁静而有序的感觉。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a pair of hands holding and turning a colorful twisty puzzle cube, similar to a Rubik’s Cube. The cube is partially rotated, with several layers misaligned, suggesting it is being actively solved or scrambled.

The person’s thumbs and fingers grip the cube firmly from both sides. The right thumb presses near the upper-right area of the cube, while the left thumb rests near the lower-left front edge. The hands fill most of the frame, and the fingernails are visible in sharp detail.

The cube has bright plastic tiles with rounded edges and a glossy finish. Visible colors include neon green on the top face, blue on the lower front face, white or light gray on the front-center areas, orange along the left and upper-right edges, yellow on the right side, and a small glimpse of red near the lower-right side. The cube pieces appear slightly separated at one corner due to the twist, exposing a small internal mechanism or gap near the center.

The background is plain and softly blurred, likely a light gray or off-white surface, which keeps attention focused on the hands and puzzle. The lighting is even and soft, with mild reflections on the shiny cube surfaces. The overall image conveys the moment of manipulating a speed cube during solving.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示双手正在玩魔方的照片。魔方的每个面都涂有鲜艳的颜色，包括绿色、蓝色、橙色和白色。手指轻轻地抓住魔方的各个角落，显示出魔方正在被旋转或组装的状态。背景是模糊的白色表面，可能是桌面或其他平滑的表面。

caption:
The image shows a red-and-white helicopter flying low in a lush, mountainous forest valley. The helicopter is near the center-right of the frame, angled slightly upward and away from the viewer, with its underside and tail clearly visible. Its large black main rotor blades are blurred from motion, emphasizing that it is airborne and actively flying. The tail rotor is also visible near the rear, with red-and-white striping on the tail section. There appears to be white lettering and markings on the helicopter’s body, suggesting it may be an emergency, rescue, or official service aircraft.

The background is dominated by densely forested hills covered in many shades of green. The terrain rises on both sides, forming a broad valley, with thick trees and vegetation stretching across the entire lower and middle portions of the image. Some rocky areas are faintly visible through the forest on the hillside. The sky above is bright but overcast, with pale gray-white cloud cover taking up much of the top half of the photo.

In the lower-left foreground, a person wearing a light-colored cap and glasses is partially visible from behind. They appear to be holding up a smartphone or camera, photographing or recording the helicopter. Along the far left edge, there is part of a reddish-brown brick or stone structure, possibly a wall or building, which contrasts with the natural green landscape.

Overall, the scene feels dramatic and active: a helicopter hovering or passing close over a forested mountain area while an observer captures the moment from the ground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示紧急救援直升机在森林中飞行的现实主义风格照片。一架红色和白色的救援直升机悬停在空中，下方是茂密的绿色植被覆盖的山丘。图像前景左侧有一位戴着帽子的人正在用相机拍摄这一场景。

caption:
The image is a close-up collage of Turkish lira banknotes overlapping one another, filling the entire frame. The notes are arranged horizontally and diagonally so that only parts of each bill are visible.

Several denominations can be seen:

- A **200 Türk Lirası** note appears near the upper left and upper center, with the large blue “200” text and pink/purple coloring.
- A **10 Türk Lirası** note is visible in the upper right, marked “10 ON TÜRK LİRASI,” with reddish-purple tones.
- A prominent **100 Türk Lirası** note runs across the middle, featuring a large blue portrait of **Mustafa Kemal Atatürk** and the bold number “100.”
- A **20 Türk Lirası** note appears on the right side, with “20 YİRMİ TÜRK LİRASI” in brown lettering.
- A **50 Türk Lirası** note is partially visible near the bottom, showing orange and red tones and the number “50.”
- A **5 Türk Lirası** note is partly visible in the lower right with dark blue lettering.

The banknotes show typical Turkish currency design elements: star motifs, crescent-and-star symbols, fine security patterns, signatures, denomination numbers, holographic strips, and detailed engraved portraits. The colors are varied—pink, purple, blue, brown, green, orange, and red—creating a layered, textured appearance. Some parts of the notes, especially faces and certain areas, appear softly blurred or out of focus, while the central 100 lira note is more prominent and clearer. Overall, the image emphasizes Turkish money, currency value, and financial themes.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示不同面额的土耳其货币的照片，包括100、20和5土耳其里拉纸币。每种面额的纸币上都印有相同的男性肖像和文字，显示了其官方名称和发行年份。背景是单一色调，可能是为了突出纸币的颜色和细节。

caption:
The image shows a wide riverside cityscape under a bright, hazy sky. Most of the frame is dominated by pale blue-gray sky with thin, streaky cloud cover, creating a soft, slightly overexposed atmosphere.

On the right side stands a large industrial-style brick building labeled **“BALTIC FLOUR”** across its side. The building appears to be a converted flour mill, with tall vertical brick sections, narrow windows, and darker rooftop structures. It has a mix of red brick, tan brick, and modern additions, including a glass-and-metal section near the top right. Vertical teal banners on the building advertise the **Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art**, with readable text such as **“EXHIBITIONS SHOP FOOD & DRINK VIEWING BOX”** and **“FREE ENTRY OPEN 7 DAYS A WEEK BALTIC ART.”**

The building sits directly beside a calm river, likely an urban waterfront. The water fills the lower left and foreground, reflecting the dark tones of the riverside wall and buildings. Along the river’s edge is a stone and metal embankment with railings, walkways, and a darker tidal wall.

To the far right and behind the Baltic building are modern apartment or office blocks with white, gray, and red façades, balconies, and rectangular windows. A long, low glass-covered structure runs along the lower right foreground, possibly part of a riverside walkway or entrance area.

In the distance on the left, the river curves past a lower residential area with small buildings and greenery on a hillside. Near the center-left, a dark building with the word **“JURYS”** is visible, likely a hotel.

Overall, the scene combines historic industrial architecture with modern waterfront development. The lighting is subdued and backlit, leaving the buildings somewhat shadowed while the sky is bright and expansive.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸景观的照片，主要焦点是一座具有现代设计的大型建筑，其表面装饰有蓝色和白色的条纹。建筑前有一片宽阔的河流，河水平静地流淌着。在照片的背景中，可以看到更多的建筑物和一座桥梁，以及一个正在移动的白色巴士。天空是晴朗的，几朵白云点缀其中。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of a large historic building viewed from a low angle, emphasizing its height and ornate architecture. The building is constructed primarily of red brick with pale stone trim, giving it a formal, institutional appearance. Its façade features tall rectangular windows with white frames, arranged in regular rows and bordered by decorative stone blocks.

In the foreground, there is an imposing brick-and-stone perimeter wall with several large arched openings. The arches are made of red brick with pale stone accents, and beneath them are black wrought-iron gates and railings decorated with spear-like finials and curved ornamental patterns. Massive stone-and-brick pillars support the wall and arches.

Behind the wall, the main building rises several stories. The central section is taller and more elaborate, with large stone pilasters, carved decorative details, cornices, and a small triangular pediment above a lower doorway or window feature. Near the top, the structure has a mansard-style roof clad in dark slate, topped by a small domed cupola and a thin vertical spire or flagpole.

To the right, a long roofline extends across the image, with several dormer windows set into the slate roof. These dormers are framed in a reddish-brown color and topped with triangular pediments, adding rhythm and symmetry to the roof.

The sky behind the building is bright blue with scattered white clouds, suggesting a clear day. In the lower left corner, a street sign is partly visible, reading “Rue Camille Guérin.” The overall impression is of an elegant old European civic, academic, or institutional building with carefully detailed brickwork, stone ornamentation, and decorative iron fencing.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有历史感的建筑的照片。建筑物采用了红砖和白色墙面，窗户排列整齐，上方有黑色的屋顶和一个小型塔楼。建筑前有一个装饰性的铁艺大门，门上刻有'PLACE DE LA BASTILLE'字样。照片背景是晴朗的蓝天，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows an underground metro station with a train stopped at the platform. The scene is dominated by cool blue and teal lighting, giving the station a vivid, almost cinematic atmosphere.

A dark gray metro train with bright blue horizontal stripes runs diagonally from the lower right toward the center-left, partially entering or sitting beside a tunnel opening. The train’s ribbed metal roof is clearly visible from the elevated viewpoint. Several doors and windows line the side of the cars, with yellow-and-black caution markings around the door frames. Through some windows, seated passengers can be seen inside, though their faces are not clearly visible.

The station appears to be named **Franklin**, shown on signs along the platform wall on the right. A long overhead sign includes Spanish text such as **“Dirección Vespucio Norte”**, **“Salida”** with an arrow, and the station name **FRANKLIN**. The walls are painted in strong shades of blue, with tiled sections and a yellow trim band near the signage.

On the left side is a mostly empty platform with a glossy, reflective floor in blue-green tones. A bright yellow safety line runs along the platform edge. Above the platform are two hanging Samsung information screens displaying transit information and an advertisement. There is also a large sign in the foreground reading **“Salida”** and **“Exit”** with a left-pointing arrow, suggesting the direction to leave the station. Part of another sign above it appears to read **“Cambio de andén”**, indicating a platform change.

The tracks occupy the center of the image, with rails, concrete track beds, and a dark tunnel entrance visible in the background. Overhead pipes, cables, lights, and suspended fixtures add an industrial feel. The overall composition emphasizes the contrast between the bright blue station walls, the yellow signage and safety markings, and the dark, metallic train.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示地铁站内部的摄影照片，画面中心有一列停靠在站台上的地铁列车。列车呈现深蓝色调，车身上贴有广告和地图。站台上有一个指示牌，上面写着'Salida'（出口），旁边是黄色的安全线。整个场景被室内照明所照亮，营造出一种清晰而明亮的视觉效果。

caption:
The image shows a dimly lit museum gallery with a white stone or marble statue displayed behind glass at the center of the frame.

The statue is an ancient-looking, headless and armless torso, cropped from about the upper chest down to the lower body. It appears to depict a draped human figure wearing a robe or toga-like garment. The fabric is carved with soft, flowing folds that wrap diagonally across the body, creating a sense of movement. One arm seems to have once crossed the chest, but it is broken off, leaving a rough, eroded area where the forearm or hand would have been. The surface is worn and weathered, with darker pitted patches and rough abrasions visible especially across the chest and lower front.

The sculpture is pale, almost ivory-white, and stands out strongly against the dark background. It is lit from the front or above, giving it a faint greenish-white glow. The top of the statue is cut off flat where the head is missing, emphasizing its fragmentary condition.

Behind it, the museum space is mostly dark and out of focus. Glass reflections and display cases are visible on both sides, containing other small artifacts or sculptures arranged on shelves and pedestals. The room has a symmetrical, quiet atmosphere, with dark walls, reflective glass panels, and a faintly visible illuminated sign or display in the distance. The overall mood is solemn and contemplative, focusing attention on the damaged classical statue as an archaeological object.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在博物馆内的雕塑特写照片。图像中心是一个白色的雕塑，其特征是它覆盖着一块布料，布料的纹理和褶皱清晰可见。雕塑背后是一个深色的背景，可能是博物馆内部的照明。在模糊的背景中可以看到其他展品和展览柜，这些细节虽然不清晰，但为这个场景增添了一种文化氛围。

caption:
The image shows the front of a multi-story building, likely a café or shop, elaborately decorated with Christmas lights and holiday displays at dusk or early evening. The sky is pale blue-gray, and the warm glow from the decorations dominates the scene.

The building façade is gray with cream-colored architectural trim around the windows and ledges. Across nearly every level, there are large illuminated Christmas ornaments made from wire frames and strings of lights. The lights are mostly warm golden-yellow, with accents of bright white and deep red.

At the top of the building, a row of small icicle-style lights hangs along the roofline. Below it, on an upper balcony, there is a large Santa Claus figure made of glowing white lights, with a red hat and red accents. Santa appears to be standing with arms raised or spread outward, as if greeting people below.

On the upper and middle floors, oversized gift boxes are attached to the windows and balconies. These presents are outlined in golden lights and wrapped with glittering red bows and vertical red ribbons. Some appear flat against the windows, while others are three-dimensional, giving the façade a layered, festive look. Two very large hot-air-balloon-shaped decorations hang in front of the building, glowing with dense golden lights and decorated with red ornaments.

On the right side of the building, a tall Christmas tree stands on a balcony or terrace. It is decorated with small warm lights and shiny red and gold baubles. The tree reaches almost the height of the middle floors and adds a traditional holiday element among the illuminated gift boxes.

Across the lower façade, just above the café entrance, there is a large display of three leaping reindeer made from illuminated wire frames. Their bodies glow golden, while their antlers and outlines are highlighted with bright white lights. They appear to be in motion, as if pulling an unseen sleigh across the front of the building. Nearby, another large gift-shaped decoration glows in white, red, and gold.

At street level, the entrance and windows of the café are visible. A sign above the door reads “LUWI HOUSE COFFEE.” Menu boards are posted on either side of the entrance, and warm interior lighting can be seen through the windows. A few people are partially visible at the bottom of the image, standing near the entrance, but the focus is clearly on the holiday decorations.

Overall, the scene is extremely festive and bright, with the building transformed into a Christmas display full of glowing presents, reindeer, Santa, ornaments, and a decorated tree. The warm lights create a cheerful, celebratory atmosphere against the evening sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日装饰的建筑立面照片。建筑物上层装饰着一系列发光的礼物盒，下方是两棵点亮的圣诞树和几只由灯泡组成的驯鹿形状。建筑物底层是一家名为'LUWI HOUSE COFFEE'的咖啡馆，门口有两位顾客正在交谈。整个场景被温暖的灯光照亮，营造出一种温馨而喜庆的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, overhead view of a medical or clinical preparation scene. A person wearing a white lab coat or medical uniform is putting on or adjusting a pair of light-colored latex or nitrile gloves. Their forearms are visible, and one gloved hand is being pulled snugly over the other hand, suggesting they are preparing for a procedure.

The background is covered with a blue disposable medical drape or absorbent pad with a textured, ribbed surface. Scattered around the workspace are various sterile medical supplies, including several packaged syringe components or needles with green caps, a loose syringe or needle lying near the center, plastic packaging, gauze or cotton, and a small bottle that may contain antiseptic or medical solution. There is also a partially visible item with red coloring near the lower left, possibly part of a syringe or collection tube.

The lighting is bright and clinical, with reflections on the plastic packaging and the blue sterile surface. The overall scene conveys preparation for a medical task such as an injection, blood draw, vaccination, or sterile procedure.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示医疗用品使用的现实主义风格照片，其中一位身穿白色医服的医护人员正戴着乳胶手套，将红色液体倒入一个透明的小瓶中。在图片的背景中，可以看到几个空的注射器和药瓶，这些物品散落在蓝色的布料上，暗示着正在进行或即将进行的医疗操作。

caption:
The image shows a wide, scenic outdoor view from an elevated lookout point, likely in a cold mountainous region.

In the background, a vast range of snow-covered mountains stretches across the entire horizon. The peaks are bright white with deep gray-blue ridges and shadows, giving them a rugged, dramatic texture. The sky above is pale blue with a few soft clouds, and the overall light suggests a clear, sunny day.

Below the mountains is a broad valley with dry, muted earth tones. The landscape contains sparse trees—many tall and leafless—along with fields, roads, and clusters of low buildings. Some of the buildings are white with flat roofs and red or dark trim, resembling houses or small monastery-like structures. Near the bottom left, colorful vertical flags or banners are visible, adding bright touches of green, yellow, and red to the otherwise subdued landscape.

In the foreground, several people are gathered close together on the right side of the frame. Their faces are blurred. One person near the center is wearing a dark puffy jacket and holding a Canon DSLR camera with a large lens; the camera is pointed slightly downward, and the person’s hands are visible around it. To the right, another person is wearing a thick green winter coat with a fur-lined hood and a purple knitted beanie topped with a large pom-pom. A red scarf or tassel-like accessory hangs down from the hat. Between them, another person wearing sunglasses and a dark fur-trimmed hood is partially visible.

The composition contrasts the close, dark winter clothing of the people in the foreground with the bright, expansive mountain panorama behind them. The scene feels like a travel or sightseeing moment at a high-altitude viewpoint.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三位游客在户外活动的照片。前景中，一位男性正专注地操作着他的相机，另一位女性站在他旁边观看。背景是壮观的雪山和下方的城镇景观，阳光照耀下的山脉轮廓清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a scenic urban riverside view dominated by a grand historic stone building on the left, set beside a calm canal or river. The architecture is ornate and monumental, with a classical European style: tall arched windows on the lower levels, rectangular windows above, decorative columns, carved stone faces and embellishments, cornices, balustrades, and a large dark domed roof partially visible at the top. The façade is made of pale beige-gray stone with darker weathered patches, giving it an aged, stately appearance.

Near the center-left, the building projects outward with a rounded corner and a triangular pediment supported by large columns. Sculptural figures and decorative stonework appear along the roofline and around the entrance area. A flagpole rises from the roof area, with a red-and-white flag fluttering against the sky.

The river occupies the lower portion of the image, reflecting the building, bridge, sky, and clouds in rippled, slightly distorted patterns. On the right side, a light-colored arched bridge crosses the water. It has a stone railing and a few small figures visible on top, suggesting pedestrians. Beneath the bridge, the waterway continues into the distance, lined with buildings and urban infrastructure.

Beyond the bridge, there are additional buildings, including a distinctive structure with a steep red-tiled triangular roof and pale walls, giving the scene a layered historic-city feel. Farther to the right, more modern buildings can be seen, contrasting with the older architecture in the foreground.

The sky is vivid blue and filled with large, soft white clouds, creating a bright, pleasant daytime atmosphere. The overall composition combines ornate historic architecture, water, reflections, and a lively urban riverfront setting, likely in a European city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸风光的摄影作品，图中主要建筑是一座宏伟的古典风格建筑，其特点是精细的石雕装饰和多个拱形窗户。建筑前有一座优雅的桥梁横跨河流，连接着两岸。河水平静，反射出建筑和天空的倒影。背景是蓝天白云，为整个场景增添了宁静与和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a large, landscaped terraced hill or artificial mound in an urban park at night. The hill dominates the center and right side of the scene, rising in several broad, stepped layers covered with dark green grass. Each level appears to have a walkway or viewing path around it, bordered by tall, pale metal railings. Small warm yellow-green lights are embedded or placed along the edges of the terraces, forming thin glowing lines that trace the contours of the hill and emphasize its layered, spiral-like structure.

At the very top of the mound is a flat viewing platform with several trees clustered together. The trees are dark and dense compared with the bare branches of the smaller trees in the foreground. Near the top-left portion of the platform, a pale curved structure—possibly a slide, sculptural element, or stair feature—is partially visible behind the railings and trees.

The atmosphere is misty or foggy, giving the scene a soft, hazy quality. The sky is a uniform gray-brown, typical of a cloudy urban night with light pollution. The lighting is subdued but atmospheric: warm ground lights illuminate the grass terraces, while taller streetlamps in the foreground cast brighter white pools of light onto paths and lawns.

In the foreground, there is an open grassy park area with winding paved paths. Several modern lampposts stand along the paths, some with bright white lights. Thin, leafless trees are scattered across the foreground, their dark branches silhouetted against the lit grass and the glowing hill. A bench and a trash bin are visible near the lower right, beside a path. Low hedges and fencing run horizontally across the middle ground, separating the foreground park from the terraced hill.

On the far right in the background, part of an apartment or residential building can be seen, with a few illuminated windows. The overall mood is quiet, damp, and slightly surreal, with the illuminated green terraces resembling a modern landscaped pyramid or rooftop park rising out of the nighttime city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑夜景的照片，建筑物具有独特的多层结构，每一层都覆盖着绿色的植被。在前景中，几棵树木和草地被灯光照亮，而背景中的建筑物则被昏暗的天空所笼罩。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny public square or park-like plaza with a large decorative fountain system in the foreground. The sky is clear and deep blue, suggesting a warm, dry day with strong sunlight and crisp shadows.

In the foreground, there is a broad, shallow rectangular pool of greenish-blue water. The bottom of the pool is tiled in a grid pattern, visible through the water. Low stone walls with pale coping stones edge the water channels, and the water reflects nearby trees and the sky. The fountain layout appears geometric, with long straight basins leading toward a circular, tiered fountain on the right-middle side of the image.

The main fountain has several circular stone levels. Multiple water jets rise vertically from the upper basin, creating thin white streams and splashes. Smaller jets appear around the lower edges as well. The stone around the fountain is light beige and cream-colored, with some darker staining from water. Around the fountain and along the walkways are neat flowerbeds filled with vivid red flowers, adding bright color against the pale stone and green grass.

To the right, tall evergreen trees dominate the scene, including dense conifers with dark green foliage. One very large tree has drooping branches that hang down like curtains. Behind and between the trees, parts of a light-colored building are visible. A modern streetlamp with several angled light fixtures stands near the center-right, rising above the plaza.

On the left side, there is a covered stage or event platform with a black canopy roof supported by a metal truss frame. The front of the stage has colorful graphics and large white lettering; the word “TROY” is visible on banners or panels. A few people appear under or near the stage, and several pigeons are scattered across the paved square in front of it. Behind the stage is a modern civic-looking building with pale stone or concrete walls, rectangular windows, and a clock mounted high on the façade. Several vertical flags or banners hang near the building entrance.

Near the center of the image, in front of the building, there is a sculptural stone monument featuring carved human figures in a blocky, monumental style. It sits on a raised platform with steps and low landscaping around it.

In the background, beyond the buildings, a forested hillside rises across the horizon. The hill is densely covered with green trees, giving the urban square a scenic mountain-town feel. Overall, the scene is orderly and landscaped, combining civic architecture, public art, fountains, flowers, and surrounding nature.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园景观的照片，前景是一个由多个水池和喷泉组成的圆形广场。水池的水面清澈见底，反射着周围环境。喷泉中有一个高大的雕塑，四周环绕着红色花朵装饰的花坛。背景中可以看到几栋现代风格的建筑，它们的屋顶上覆盖着绿色植被。远处是茂密的树木和蓝天，为这个场景增添了宁静与和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a mosque or historic Islamic prayer space, photographed from a low angle close to the carpeted floor. The scene feels quiet and reverent, with several men engaged in prayer near the right side of the frame.

The foreground is dominated by a large, pale patterned carpet stretching across the prayer hall. Its design is subtle and slightly faded, with repeated floral and geometric motifs in soft beige, gray, and muted red tones. The low camera angle makes the carpet appear expansive, leading the eye toward the people and architectural features in the background.

On the right, several men are praying near a dark, ornate structure that appears to be a mihrab or a decorative prayer niche. One man in a white T-shirt and olive-green pants is kneeling closest to the camera, facing the wall. Another man in a teal vest and blue trousers kneels slightly behind him. A third man in blue clothing is bent forward in a bowing posture, while another person stands nearby. Their faces are blurred, and their attention is directed toward the prayer area.

The walls and columns are made of light-colored stone, giving the space an aged, historic character. Along the right wall is a decorative painted band with red and brown geometric and arch-like patterns. Above it, portions of the wall are plain stone, interrupted by architectural columns and niches.

On the left side, a row of intricately carved wooden screens or partitions lines the prayer area. These panels have repeating lattice patterns with floral and geometric cutouts, adding a rich ornamental texture. Behind and above them hangs a large framed piece of Islamic calligraphy, featuring bold black Arabic script on a warm tan background.

The ceiling area contains dark wooden beams running horizontally across the hall. Suspended from the beams and wires are numerous glass hanging lamps or oil-lamp-style fixtures. The lamps are bowl-shaped and transparent, arranged at different heights, creating a delicate web of lines overhead.

In the center background, a tall metal railing separates part of the interior space. Beyond it, there are arched openings, additional lights, and more architectural details. The arches are outlined with reddish trim, and the far area appears brighter due to daylight filtering through windows or openings.

Overall, the image captures a serene moment inside an ornate mosque, combining worshippers in prayer with historic Islamic architectural details: calligraphy, carved woodwork, stone columns, hanging glass lamps, patterned carpets, and decorative wall motifs.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伊斯兰宗教活动的摄影照片，画面中三个人物在一座装饰华丽的清真寺内进行祈祷。左侧的人物穿着白色T恤和深色裤子，正站立着，头部朝向一侧；中间的人物穿着蓝色上衣和黑色裤子，跪在地上，头低下，似乎在进行虔诚的祈祷；右侧的人物穿着浅色衣服，坐在地上，双手放在膝盖上，同样专注地进行祈祷。背景中的清真寺内部装饰精美，有金色的拱门、复杂的几何图案地毯和墙壁上的阿拉伯文装饰。

caption:
The image shows a single person kayaking on a broad expanse of choppy, blue-green water. The kayaker is positioned in the lower right portion of the frame, facing toward the left side of the image and slightly away from the viewer. They are seated in a long, sit-on-top kayak that has a bright gradient color: yellow at the front, transitioning into orange and then red toward the rear.

The person is wearing a black baseball cap, a gray long-sleeve top, dark pants, and a bright blue life jacket with yellow accents. Their hair is visible beneath the cap, and they appear to be looking out across the water rather than directly at the camera. A yellow paddle blade is visible near their lap, suggesting they are either resting or preparing to paddle. On the kayak behind them is a metal-framed carrier or support with small wheels, likely a kayak trolley or gear attachment.

The water fills most of the image and has a textured surface with small waves and ripples, indicating a breezy or lightly rough day. Sunlight reflects off the water in scattered highlights. The kayak sits low in the water, with gentle waves lapping against its sides.

In the background, far across the water, there is a hazy shoreline with low mountains or hills stretching across the horizon. The distant land is soft and out of focus, giving the image depth. On the far right side of the background, a faint sailboat with a tall mast can be seen. The sky is clear and pale blue, with no visible clouds.

Overall, the scene feels calm and recreational, capturing a kayaker enjoying open water with distant hills and boats in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外活动的照片，一位穿着救生衣的皮划艇运动员坐在一艘鲜艳的红色和黄色皮划艇上。他戴着黑色帽子，专注地望向远方，似乎在观察或等待着什么。皮划艇装备有用于稳定和导航的支架。照片背景是平静的海洋和远处轮廓分明的山脉，天空晴朗，几艘帆船点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows the top portion of a dark stone tower or fortification under a clear, bright blue sky. At the center-top of the structure stands a tall silver flagpole with a German flag attached. The flag has the horizontal black, red, and gold bands of Germany and is partially wrapped and rippling around the pole, suggesting a light breeze.

The building beneath is made of dark, almost black stone blocks with light mortar lines, giving it a rugged, historic appearance. The top edge of the tower is flat and slightly stepped, with angled corners. Some small patches of vegetation are growing out from cracks between the stones, adding a weathered look. Near the lower visible part of the image, arched window openings can be seen, framed by lighter stone outlines.

On the left side of the tower, two small white cylindrical fixtures protrude from the wall, possibly lights, cameras, or drainage pipes. The composition is dominated by the wide open sky, which occupies most of the frame, making the flag and tower stand out clearly. The lighting is strong and direct, with crisp shadows and high contrast on the stonework.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示德国国旗在晴朗蓝天背景下飘扬的照片。照片中，德国国旗被固定在一个高高的旗杆上，在一个古老石制建筑的顶部随风飘扬。旗帜呈现出典型的黑、红、黄三色条纹，旗杆顶端装有一个小型金属球形装饰。背景是清澈的蓝天，没有云彩，为图像增添了一种宁静和庄严的感觉。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a traditional wooden structure, likely Japanese, viewed from a high angle looking down a steep stairwell or passageway. The entire space is made of warm, polished wood in rich amber, honey, and dark brown tones, giving it an old, rustic, handcrafted feel.

A narrow wooden staircase descends diagonally from the lower center toward the right side of the image. The steps are made of closely spaced slatted boards, slightly curved or fan-shaped as the stairs turn. Wooden handrails run along the sides, and the railing on the right is supported by vertical bars, allowing bright daylight to stream in from outside. Through the slatted windows and openings, a pale, overexposed outdoor landscape is faintly visible, suggesting trees or mountains beyond.

The ceiling is low and heavily timbered, with thick exposed beams running lengthwise and crosswise. The beams and ceiling planks show knots, grain patterns, stains, and dark markings, emphasizing the age and character of the building. The warm sunlight highlights the texture of the wood and creates strong contrast between glowing surfaces and shadowed corners.

On the left side, there is a framed display or notice board hanging at an angle. It contains vertical Japanese writing on white paper, bordered by a red-and-black patterned frame. Nearby are other vertical signs and labels with Japanese characters attached to posts and beams. Some appear to be name plaques, prayer tags, or informational signs. Several handwritten or printed markings are also visible directly on the wooden beams and ceiling.

Below the framed notice on the left is a dark mesh-covered window or cabinet-like opening. It has a chicken-wire-style screen and a wooden frame, with darker objects or panels behind it. The surrounding wall is made of thick wooden posts and panels, all worn and glossy from age and use.

The composition has a slightly wide-angle or fisheye perspective, making the beams and stair rails converge dramatically. The overall impression is of an old wooden shrine, temple, mountain hut, or historic Japanese building, with a compact, enclosed stairway and many traditional inscriptions and signs. The scene feels warm, quiet, and atmospheric, with a strong sense of craftsmanship and age.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日式建筑内部的照片，焦点在木制的楼梯和栏杆上。楼梯由深色木材制成，沿着斜坡向上延伸，两侧是木质栏杆。栏杆上方悬挂着一块写有日文的牌子，而楼梯旁边则有一扇窗户，透过窗户可以看到外面的景色。整个场景被温暖的光线照亮，营造出一种宁静而古朴的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime urban waterfront scene, likely in a modern Middle Eastern city. The composition contrasts contemporary high-rise residential towers with a brightly illuminated mosque in the foreground.

At the center-right is a mosque with elegant Islamic architecture. It has several white domes capped in gold, with the largest central dome glowing warmly under the lights. Two tall, slender minarets rise above the building, each decorated with golden illumination around the balconies and pointed tops. The mosque’s façade is white and cream, with arched windows and doorways lit in vivid blue, green, and warm white tones. Decorative arches and patterned details line the lower level, giving the building a refined, ornate appearance.

Surrounding the mosque are tall modern apartment towers and hotels. On the left, a high-rise building with dark glass windows and stacked balconies dominates the frame. Many windows are lit, revealing interiors and creating a grid-like pattern against the night. On the right and behind the mosque are more skyscrapers with horizontal balcony lines, reflective glass, and scattered lights. One building in the background has a visible sign reading “Royal Meridien.”

The sky is a deep, nearly black navy blue, emphasizing the artificial lighting throughout the scene. In the lower part of the image, a waterfront promenade curves along the edge of a canal or marina. Metal railings follow the curve of the walkway, leading the eye into the scene. The water at the bottom reflects small streaks of light from the surrounding buildings.

Palm trees line the promenade, several wrapped with strings of small white lights, adding a festive atmosphere. Streetlamps and architectural lighting create a polished, upscale feel. At ground level, there are storefronts or commercial spaces with large glass windows and illuminated signs, including some red Arabic lettering on the left.

Overall, the image captures a striking blend of traditional Islamic design and modern luxury urban architecture, with the glowing mosque standing out as the visual centerpiece amid the tall residential towers and waterfront city lights.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，图中中心位置是一座装饰华丽、灯光璀璨的清真寺。清真寺的主体建筑呈白色，顶部和尖塔部分装饰有金色元素，窗户发出蓝色光芒，与周围的高楼大厦形成鲜明对比。左侧是现代风格的高层住宅楼，而右侧则是同样高耸的摩天大楼。在清真寺前的人行道上，可以看到几位行人正在夜间行走，为这个场景增添了生活气息。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a warm golden-yellow surface, possibly a painted wall, screen, or decorative panel. On it are bold red vertical markings that resemble stylized East Asian calligraphy or painted symbols. The most prominent red form is near the center-left of the image, with thick, elongated strokes and rounded, brushlike edges. Another similar red symbol appears partially cropped on the far right side.

The background is a rich mustard-gold color with subtle texture, faint scuffs, and slight variations in tone, giving it a painted or lacquered appearance. The lighting is warm and soft, creating a calm, atmospheric feel.

Near the lower center of the image, dark blurred shadows of thin plant stems or grasses rise upward against the golden surface. These shadows are out of focus and slightly streaked, adding depth and a sense of layering. The red painted characters are sharper than the shadows, though the overall image has a shallow depth of field and a soft, slightly dreamy quality.

The composition is minimalist and abstract: large areas of empty golden space surround the red calligraphic forms, while the vertical shadows below echo the vertical strokes of the red markings. The color contrast between the vivid red and the golden background is striking and gives the image a decorative, traditional, and contemplative mood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国文化元素的摄影作品，画面中心有两根绿色植物茎干从模糊的前景中伸展出来，背景是黄色的墙面，上面用红色的中国书法笔迹书写着“澄清”和“宁静”的字样。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor cultural performance scene in bright daylight. In the center foreground, two performers are kneeling or crouching on a pale concrete courtyard, facing away from the camera toward a raised area or stage. Their bodies overlap, with the nearer performer mostly visible from the back and the second performer partially hidden in front.

Both performers wear ornate traditional-style costumes dominated by black fabric covered in vivid beadwork and embroidery. The patterns are highly colorful, with bright yellow, red, green, pink, white, and blue motifs arranged in geometric and swirling designs. Long strands of beads hang from the shoulders, waist, and lower back, creating a layered, decorative fringe. They also wear matching headbands decorated with intricate bead patterns and small gold-colored accents. Their long black hair falls down their backs.

The nearer performer is barefoot, with one foot visible tucked behind while kneeling. In the right hand area, several long brown and cream feathers are visible, likely part of a dance prop or costume accessory. The posture suggests a choreographed dance moment, possibly a ceremonial or traditional performance.

The background contains a low stone wall with a red-painted ledge, separating the courtyard from a raised planted area. Behind the performers are green shrubs and purple-leaved plants. Further back, partially visible people stand near a building entrance or shaded area; some wear blue clothing, and one person in white is near the right side. On the far right, there is a table with electronic equipment, including a laptop and cables, suggesting music or sound control for the performance.

White and green painted poles stand on the left and right sides of the scene, possibly part of a covered walkway or school/public venue structure. The overall atmosphere is that of a formal or community cultural event taking place in an open courtyard under strong sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性表演者在户外进行传统舞蹈的照片。她穿着一件色彩鲜艳、图案复杂的服装，头戴与之相配的装饰性头饰，并手持一些可能用于表演的物品。她的姿态显示出一种专注和沉思的状态，整个场景传达了一种文化活动的氛围。背景中可以看到一些模糊的人群和建筑物，但它们并不是焦点所在。

caption:
The image shows a small, warmly lit artisan workshop filled with carved wooden crafts and tools.

In the foreground, a craftsman is seated at a worn worktable, leaning closely over a wooden plate or shallow bowl. He appears to be engraving or carving fine decorative lines into the piece. One hand holds a small tool near the surface, while the other steadies a wooden mallet or block-like tool close to his face. His posture is focused and intent, suggesting careful, detailed handwork.

The table is cluttered with woodworking tools and materials. A row of carving chisels and gouges with rounded wooden handles lies on a cloth near the front edge. There are additional tools scattered across the tabletop, including blades, scrapers, and small hand tools. A large curved wooden object—possibly a partially finished tray, instrument-like form, or decorative piece—rests beside the plate being worked on. The tabletop is stained and scratched from frequent use, with patches of green paint and sawdust or wood shavings visible.

To the left, a red-brown adjustable desk lamp bends over the workspace, providing task lighting. Behind it, shelves and surfaces hold more wooden items: small carved boxes, comb-like wooden pieces, decorative panels, and partially finished objects. A radio or small electronic device sits on a ledge among the tools and supplies.

The back wall is densely decorated with ornate wooden plates and panels. Many are circular and feature intricate carved or burned patterns—floral motifs, scrollwork, geometric borders, and central medallions. Some plates include small colorful painted scenes or illustrations in the center, framed by elaborate carved borders. The wood tones range from golden tan to deep brown, giving the wall a rich, traditional craft-shop appearance.

On the left wall, additional carved wooden boards and decorative pieces are stacked or mounted, many with repeating ornamental designs. The overall style suggests traditional woodcarving, pyrography, or hand-engraved decorative craftwork.

On the right side of the image, a red fire extinguisher is mounted near a window. The window ledge holds a jar and a mug, adding to the informal, lived-in feeling of the workspace. The walls and wooden paneling show signs of wear, and the warm yellow lighting gives the room a cozy, slightly golden atmosphere.

Overall, the scene captures a traditional wood artisan at work in a compact, tool-filled studio, surrounded by finished decorative wooden plates and handmade carved objects.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示手工艺人专注于木雕工作的照片。图像中，一位工匠正坐在工作台前，手中拿着一把雕刻工具，专注地雕刻着一块木质材料。他的周围摆放着各种木工工具和装饰品，包括一排排精心制作的金属盘子、一个大型的铜质灯具以及一些散落的纸张和图纸。整个场景被柔和的室内光线照亮，营造出一种温馨而专注的工作氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet urban street bathed in warm, golden light, likely early morning or late afternoon. The scene has a soft, slightly hazy atmosphere, with sunlight filtering through trees and casting orange highlights across the buildings.

On the right side, there is an old red-brick building with decorative brickwork around the windows and roofline. The low sun strikes its façade, making the brick glow in bright amber tones. Several tall rectangular windows line the building, some reflecting the warm light. Near the lower right, a person stands on the sidewalk by the building, looking down at something in their hands, possibly a phone. A dark bird is captured mid-flight near the brick wall, slightly blurred from motion.

In the center and background, mature trees with green and yellowing leaves line the street, their branches forming a canopy over parts of the road. The foliage suggests late summer or early autumn. Behind the trees, a lighter-colored building with pale cream or white walls is partially visible, also illuminated by the sun.

The street itself is broad and mostly empty, sloping gently into the distance. On the left side of the road, a street cleaner wearing a bright orange reflective uniform is sweeping near the curb. Farther down the street, a couple of pedestrians walk along the sidewalk, and a few parked cars are visible in the hazy background.

Several streetlights with long curved poles line the sidewalk. Road signs are visible near the right side: a blue circular “no stopping/no parking” sign with a red X, a white sign below it with a black vertical double arrow, and other smaller traffic signs farther down the street, including a pedestrian crossing sign and a yellow diamond priority-road sign. The curbs are painted yellow, and the overall street appears calm, orderly, and residential or historic in character.

The mood of the image is peaceful and nostalgic, with the warm sunlight, old architecture, quiet road, and soft haze creating a serene city-morning atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道在日落时分的摄影作品。图像捕捉了街道上的行人和车辆，以及两旁的建筑物。在画面左侧，一位穿着橙色上衣的人正在清扫街道，而右侧则有一位骑自行车的人。街道两侧是具有历史感的红砖建筑，其中一些建筑物上方有窗户亮着灯。在街道尽头，可以看到更多的树木和一个交通标志，上面写着'禁止停车'。整个场景被柔和的日落光线照亮，营造出一种宁静和平静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a young child standing outdoors in a sandy, sunlit yard. The child is near the center-right of the frame, facing slightly to the right, with their face blurred. They are wearing an oversized off-white T-shirt with a graphic of racing cars on the front, turquoise-green shorts patterned with dark stars, and simple flip-flops. One foot is partly bare or slipping out of the sandal, and there is a small puff of sand near their feet, suggesting movement.

The child is holding a thin wire or cord in one hand. The line trails diagonally across the sandy ground toward the lower left corner of the image, while another short piece hangs near the child’s hand. Their posture looks casual and active, as if they are playing or pulling something.

The setting appears rural and dry. The ground is covered in pale sand with scattered leaves, small stones, and bits of debris. Behind the child is a simple concrete-block building with a shaded porch area. The building has dark blue doors or shutters, and several pale blue vertical posts support the porch roof. A rough wooden bench or table sits against the wall under the shade.

On the left and right sides of the background are rustic fences made from sticks, branches, and dried vegetation. There are also tree trunks and wooden poles, giving the scene a handmade, village-like appearance. A corrugated metal sheet leans against the building near the doorway. The bright sunlight creates strong contrasts between the open sandy yard and the shaded porch, emphasizing the hot, dry atmosphere of the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个小孩在户外玩耍的照片。孩子穿着一件印有图案的白色T恤和蓝色短裤，正在跳绳。他站在沙地上，背景中有一座简陋的房屋和一些竹子。阳光从上方照射下来，为场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet mountain road after rain, winding through a small village or roadside settlement in a rugged alpine valley.

In the foreground, a wet asphalt road curves gently into the distance. The road surface is shiny and reflective from recent rainfall, with pale lane markings and small puddles along the edges. Metal guardrails run along parts of both sides, and the shoulder on the right is narrow, muddy, and scattered with rocks and gravel.

On the right side of the image, a large rectangular roadside sign dominates the scene. The sign appears blank or blurred, mounted on two metal posts, with a gray frame and a muted gray face. Beneath and around it is a rocky slope with broken stones, patches of grass, shrubs, and wet earth. Behind the sign stands a wooden building with a steep, green metal roof and warm-toned timber siding, giving it a chalet-like mountain style. A light-colored SUV is parked nearby.

On the left side of the road, several tall streetlights line the roadside, their slender poles leaning slightly over the road with rectangular lamp heads. Utility wires run along the slope. There are a few small houses or lodges with wooden facades and colorful roofs, including red and green roofing. One building has a balcony, and several parked vehicles are visible near the structures. The vegetation includes bright yellow and green autumn trees, adding color to the otherwise gray and rocky setting.

The background is dramatic: steep mountains rise on both sides of the valley, covered with patches of conifer trees, exposed rock, and autumn foliage. Low clouds and mist drift between the peaks, partially hiding the mountains and creating a moody, atmospheric scene. The sky is overcast with pale gray and bluish clouds, suggesting cool, damp weather.

Overall, the image conveys a peaceful, remote mountain village road after rainfall, surrounded by misty peaks, autumn colors, rocky terrain, and rustic alpine-style buildings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示山区小镇的自然风光照片。在画面中央，有一条笔直的公路穿过画面，路边停有几辆车。左侧是几栋具有传统风格的木制房屋，而右侧则是一座现代风格的建筑。背景中，连绵起伏的山脉被云雾缭绕，增添了一种神秘和宁静的氛围。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种平和与和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a slim fitness tracker or smart band lying diagonally across a dark, textured surface. The scene is low-lit and moody, with strong shadows and a shallow depth of field that keeps the main tracker face relatively sharp while the surroundings blur softly.

The main device is positioned slightly right of center, angled from the lower middle of the frame toward the upper right. It has a narrow, pill-shaped glossy black display set into a dark band. The screen is brightly illuminated with colorful fitness and status information. Large white numerals show the time as **11:10**, with smaller text above reading **6/1 TUE**. Near the top of the display, there are small activity/weather-style icons, including a sun symbol and a step count that appears to read **36127**. Around the top and sides of the screen are curved colored progress arcs in blue and orange. Near the bottom, a red heart icon appears above the number **83**, likely indicating heart rate, with additional purple and green progress arcs around it.

The strap extends upward and to the right in a soft gray or dark graphite color, with a row of circular adjustment holes visible along it. The lower part of the strap extends downward into shadow, appearing almost black.

In the upper left corner, part of another similar fitness tracker or band is visible but out of focus. Its screen or face shows a hint of green curved graphics, echoing the display style of the main device. The background appears to be a matte black or charcoal tabletop with subtle grain and texture. Overall, the image has a sleek, modern, tech-focused feel, emphasizing the glowing display against a dark, minimalist environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示智能手表的特写照片，手表放置在一个深色背景上。手表屏幕显示时间是10:11，同时还有其他健康和活动数据，如步数、心率等。表带为灰色，与黑色的表盘形成对比。

caption:
The image shows a modern urban plaza or building entrance on a bright, sunny day. The scene is dominated by contemporary architecture and strong geometric patterns.

In the foreground, the pavement is made of large gray stone slabs. Embedded into the ground are many thin metal strips that radiate outward from a large circular disk near the center of the image, creating a sunburst or fan-like pattern across the plaza. The metal lines stretch toward the edges of the frame, giving the ground a striking sense of perspective and drawing the eye toward the circular center. A few dry leaves are scattered on the pavement.

On the left and center is a distinctive building facade covered in shiny, irregular metallic panels. The metal surface is highly reflective and slightly warped, creating distorted reflections of the surroundings, sky, and trees. The facade has several rectangular windows framed in white; some windows are tall and narrow, with greenish glass or blinds visible inside. The building’s surface looks sculptural and textured rather than flat.

Near the left side, there is an entrance area with a glass door and a metallic mailbox or intercom unit. In front of it stands a dark vertical sign with a large white number “2,” indicating the building number. Behind and around it are metallic mailboxes or panels. A small metal bicycle rack sits along the wall near the center-left.

To the right, the shiny metal facade transitions into a rounded or curved white building section. This part has smooth white walls and multiple small rectangular windows arranged in rows, each with dark glass and small projecting frames or shutters. A cylindrical reflective metal column or tower-like element connects the metallic and white sections of the building.

The plaza extends toward the right side, where wooden bollards or low posts line the walkway. Farther back, several bicycles are parked, and a few people can be seen walking or standing near the edge of the scene. Bare trees are visible in the background, suggesting late autumn or winter. The sky is clear and deep blue, and the strong sunlight creates sharp shadows on the ground, especially along the right side of the image.

Overall, the image depicts a clean, modern architectural space with a dramatic reflective facade and a carefully designed plaza surface, emphasizing lines, reflections, and geometric patterns.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的广场的照片。广场中央有一个圆形的铺地图案，由多个平行的金属条组成，形成了一个辐射状的视觉焦点。在广场的后方是一座具有未来感设计的建筑物，其表面装饰着类似树木的纹理。周围有几根木制长椅和垃圾桶，为这个城市空间增添了一丝休闲氛围。阳光从画面右侧照射下来，在地面投下长长的阴影，增加了场景的深度和层次感。

caption:
The image shows a lively traditional Japanese storefront, likely a souvenir or specialty umbrella shop, set along a narrow stone-paved street.

The shop façade has an old-style wooden structure with beige plaster walls, dark timber beams, and a tiled roof with a gutter running along the edge. Above the main display window hangs a weathered wooden signboard with Japanese characters painted in pale lettering. The overall look suggests a historic shopping street, possibly in a tourist district.

A large number of umbrellas dominate the scene. On the left, a dramatic open umbrella in black and deep red is mounted high outside the shop, its bold pattern resembling sweeping brushstrokes or flames. Below it and across the storefront are many more umbrellas and parasols in bright colors: pink, turquoise, black, purple, blue, and patterned designs. Some are open and displayed on stands, while others are closed and grouped upright in racks. Several umbrellas have curved wooden handles, and some appear wrapped in clear plastic for sale.

The main display window is packed with Japanese goods. Inside and behind the glass are decorative folding fans in many colors and patterns, including floral and traditional motifs. There are also small packaged souvenirs, signs with Japanese writing, and neatly arranged items on shelves. The window reflects some of the street while still revealing the dense display inside.

To the right of the window, clothing is displayed outside: black and white T-shirts hang from hooks, one black shirt prominently showing a large white kanji character and the word “SAMURAI” near the bottom. A red cap with a rising-sun-style design and a black cap with Japanese text are also displayed above the shirts.

Farther right, another shopfront or adjoining section has a white fabric awning with Japanese characters. There is a menu or advertisement board showing food images, and near the entrance stands a colorful soft-serve ice cream display with green and yellow swirls. More umbrellas are lined up along the wall in a vertical rack, adding to the dense, colorful street-market feel.

The street itself is narrow and slightly elevated from the storefront by a curb and shallow step. The paving stones on the right are light gray and rectangular, giving the area a clean, traditional pedestrian-lane appearance.

Overall, the image is rich with color and detail: bright umbrellas, traditional fans, souvenir clothing, wooden architecture, and Japanese signage combine to create the atmosphere of a busy, charming tourist shopping street in Japan.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统商店外观的照片。商店的橱窗里陈列着各式各样的雨伞，包括黑色带有红色条纹的大伞和粉色的小伞。店外的人行道上摆放着更多的雨伞，其中一些是粉红色的，另一些则是黑色和白色的。店铺上方悬挂着日文招牌，而店内的商品则通过透明的橱窗展示出来。

caption:
The image is a very close-up portrait of an adult man outdoors in bright sunlight. His face fills most of the frame, cropped tightly so that the top of his hair, part of his chin, and the left side of his shoulder are partially cut off. He is turned slightly to the side but looking directly into the camera with an intense, serious expression.

He has dark, thick, wavy hair that falls forward over his forehead, with shorter hair along the sides. His eyebrows are prominent, and his eyes are sharply focused, catching small highlights from the light. His skin is strongly lit from the left side of the image, creating bright highlights on his cheek, ear, and neck, while the right side of his face is more shaded. Fine skin texture, pores, and slight facial hair are visible, including a faint mustache and stubble around the chin and jaw.
