One person stands closer to the center in dark clothing, while others cluster near the doorway on the right.

The ground is covered in uneven snow, with visible footprints and tracks leading toward the house. In the left portion of the image, a clothesline with hanging fabric or laundry is faintly visible, barely illuminated against the darkness. On the far right, there are dark silhouettes of fence posts or a gate, adding to the rural or village-like atmosphere.

Overall, the image has a cold, quiet, mysterious mood. The warm window light and bright doorway create small islands of illumination in an otherwise very dark winter night, while the costumed figures near the entrance make the scene feel unusual and slightly surreal.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在夜晚拍摄的自然光照下的照片，展示了一座绿色的乡村小屋和几位人物。小屋的窗户亮着暖黄色的灯光，给人一种温馨的感觉。一位男性站在房子前，背对着镜头，似乎正在观察或等待某人。另外两位女性则站在房子的一侧，其中一位正推着婴儿车，另一位则站在门边。他们身后是覆盖着雪的地面上留下的长长的影子，增添了一种静谧而神秘的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, elevated coastal city scene viewed from a hillside or mountain slope. In the foreground, partially framed by tall green trees and shrubs, several orange cable-car gondolas hang from thick black cables stretching diagonally across the image. The gondolas have rounded, glassy cabins with amber-tinted windows and metal orange support arms. Hebrew writing is visible on the side of at least one cabin, suggesting the location is likely in Israel, possibly Haifa.

Beyond the cable cars, the scene opens onto a wide view of the Mediterranean coastline. The sea fills much of the upper left and top portion of the image, with blue-gray water and gentle parallel waves rolling toward the shore. Along the coast is a narrow sandy and rocky beach, with small patches of surf breaking near the edge. A small stone breakwater or pier juts into the water on the left, enclosing a paved area with benches, shelters, a few palm trees, and light poles.

To the right of the beach is a dense urban strip of low- and mid-rise apartment buildings, many with flat roofs, balconies, and pale beige or white facades. Some buildings appear modern, while one near the center is covered in scaffolding or construction netting. Palm trees are scattered among the buildings and along the streets, adding to the coastal atmosphere.

Below the cable cars, several roads and highways run horizontally across the scene. Cars, buses, trucks, and other vehicles are visible traveling or parked along the streets. A green bus can be seen near the lower left, and there are parking areas with rows of cars near the beach and buildings. Railway tracks also run parallel to the road near the bottom portion of the image.

In the lower right, partly obscured by trees, there appears to be a gray naval or military ship displayed on land, possibly part of a museum or memorial site. Nearby, a large green sculptural or landscaped feature is visible, along with manicured grass and pathways.

The overall impression is of a sunny coastal city viewed from above, with cable cars descending from a hillside toward the sea, combining natural scenery, urban development, transportation routes, and recreational beachfront spaces.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的摄影作品，图像中心是三辆悬挂的缆车车厢，它们沿着高架轨道缓缓移动。缆车车厢呈橙黄色，顶部装有红色的支架和安全带。在缆车下方，可以看到郁郁葱葱的树木和绿色植被，为这个城市场景增添了一抹自然色彩。缆车轨道旁边是一条宽阔的道路，上面行驶着车辆，道路两旁分布着多层住宅建筑和商业设施。远处是平静的海洋，与天空相接，海面上点缀着几艘船只。

caption:
The image shows a quiet winter wetland scene beside a partially frozen lake or pond. In the foreground, a dense stand of tall, dry reeds and cattails dominates the left side of the frame. The grasses are golden tan and straw-colored, with many upright stalks and a few fuzzy cattail heads still attached. Some of the reeds lean and crisscross, creating a textured, tangled pattern. At their base, the ground is covered with a thin layer of white snow, scattered with brown fallen leaves and bits of exposed grass.

To the right of the reeds, the shoreline curves gently along the edge of the water. The water surface is mostly frozen, appearing smooth and pale gray, with subtle variations in tone that suggest thin ice, snow dusting, or partially thawed sections. Near the shore, the ice has a slightly darker, wet-looking edge, and a few reed stumps protrude from the frozen shallows.

Across the middle distance, a wide band of reeds lines the far shore, forming a horizontal strip of beige against the muted water. Behind them is a dense woodland of leafless deciduous trees. The trees are gray-brown, with bare branches forming an intricate web against the pale winter sky. Some branches and trunks appear lightly dusted with snow, emphasizing the cold, still atmosphere.

The sky is overcast and light gray, casting soft, diffuse light over the entire scene. The color palette is subdued and wintry: whites and grays from the snow and ice, muted browns from the trees, and warm golds from the dried marsh grasses. The overall mood is calm, cold, and quiet, with no people, animals, or movement visible.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季湖边自然景观的照片。前景中，金黄色的芦苇在雪地上生长，部分芦苇已经枯萎，而另一些则仍然挺立。湖面平静，上面覆盖着薄薄的冰层和一些未融化的积雪。远处可以看到树木的轮廓，它们被白雪覆盖，增添了画面的宁静感。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种寒冷而清新的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a rural farming scene in a plowed field under bright daylight. Two oxen are harnessed together and pulling a green agricultural implement, likely a traditional seed drill or plow attachment. The soil in the foreground is dark, dry, and freshly turned, with clumps of earth and small stones scattered across the field.

On the left and center of the image are the two cattle: one light gray/white and one reddish-brown. Their horns are painted in bright colors—green and red—with decorative cloth or ornaments tied near the bases of the horns. The animals are yoked together with a wooden beam and ropes around their heads and necks. The brown ox is prominent in the center, walking forward with its head slightly lowered, while the lighter ox is partly behind it on the left.

To the right, a man stands behind the oxen, holding a long wooden stick or guiding pole in one hand and the reins or rope in the other. He is wearing a light-colored long-sleeve shirt and appears to be guiding the animals as they move through the field. Beside him is a woman wearing a colorful sari in orange, pink, purple, and green tones, with the fabric draped over her head. She is standing near the green farming implement and appears to be assisting with the sowing or plowing process, possibly placing or managing seed through the funnel-like part of the equipment.

The background is filled with green trees and shrubs, suggesting a countryside or agricultural landscape. The sky is pale and clear, and the overall lighting is warm, indicating a sunny day. The scene conveys traditional farming practices using animal power, with both people and oxen working together in the field.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示印度农村耕作场景的照片。图中，一位男性农民正站在一辆由两头牛拉动的犁上，他穿着传统的服装，手持长柄工具，专注地进行着农活。旁边，一位女性也穿着传统服饰，她正在帮助推动犁。周围是典型的乡村环境，有树木和灌木丛，天空晴朗。

caption:
The image shows a busy beach scene on a bright, sunny day. The sky is a vivid, cloudless blue, and the strong sunlight creates high contrast and deep shadows across the pale sand.

In the foreground, slightly right of center, a shirtless person with dark skin sits on the sand with knees bent, leaning forward over a dark backpack. They appear to be looking down into or handling something inside the bag. They are wearing black swim shorts with white side stripes. Their posture is hunched and relaxed, suggesting they may be resting, organizing belongings, or taking a break from the water.

To the left foreground, near the shoreline, several beachgoers are standing or walking. A woman in a black one-piece swimsuit is looking down at an object in her hands, possibly a phone or small tablet, while holding a red item. Beside her, a shirtless man in dark swim trunks is walking away from the camera toward the water. A child sits lower left near an orange plastic beach chair. Some faces in the image appear blurred.

The middle ground is crowded with people scattered along the water’s edge and on the sand. Children and adults are wearing swimsuits, shorts, hats, and beachwear. A boy in a bright red top stands near an orange plastic chair on the right side, while another shirtless person sits nearby facing away. There are multiple colorful beach items: towels, bags, sandals, chairs, and umbrellas. A large white beach umbrella extends into the top right of the frame, and brightly patterned umbrellas appear farther right.

The shoreline curves across the left side of the image, where shallow turquoise water meets the sand. People are wading and swimming close to the beach. Farther back, a line of large pale rocks forms a breakwater or rocky barrier, with more people standing, sitting, and walking along it. A small object in the sky near the rocks appears to be a distant aircraft or possibly a kite.

Overall, the photo captures a lively, crowded seaside atmosphere: people relaxing, walking, swimming, and socializing under intense midday sun, with bright colors, beach equipment, and the sparkling blue sea creating a vibrant summer scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉了海滩日常生活的照片，画面中心是一位赤裸上身的男性坐在沙滩上，身穿黑色短裤和白色运动鞋，他的头部低垂，似乎在专注地做着什么。在他的左侧，一位穿着红色泳衣的女性站立着，背对着镜头，而另一位男性则站在她的旁边，也背对镜头。背景中可以看到其他游客散布在沙滩上，有的坐着休息，有的在水边玩耍。整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一个轻松愉快的夏日氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor pedestrian overpass or elevated walkway system on a sunny day. The scene is dominated by bright yellow metal railings, concrete bridge structures, and surrounding greenery.

At the top of the image, a wide elevated concrete walkway or bridge runs horizontally from left to right. It has a long yellow safety railing made of vertical bars and horizontal supports. The railing stretches across nearly the full width of the frame. Beneath it is the underside of the bridge, a dark gray concrete slab with visible weathering and stains.

On the right side, the elevated structure is supported by a large pale concrete pillar with a slightly flared, angular top. The pillar stands beside a paved pedestrian path that continues downward and out of view. Above the bridge near this pillar is a tall, reddish-pink lamppost with a round white globe light at the top and a smaller fixture attached below it.

In the middle and lower part of the image, a curved pedestrian ramp rises upward toward the bridge. This ramp also has bright yellow railings on both sides, matching the railings on the upper walkway. The ramp curves gently through the scene, creating a layered effect with the upper bridge crossing over it. A blue circular pedestrian sign stands near the center, showing white figures of an adult and a child, indicating a walkway or pedestrian path.

The foreground contains paved paths made of gray interlocking bricks or concrete pavers. Between the paths is a sloped patch of dry grass, weeds, small plants, and fallen brown leaves, suggesting late summer or early autumn. Some parts of the vegetation look dry and sun-exposed.

Behind and around the walkways are leafy trees with green and slightly yellowing foliage. The sky is clear and bright blue, with no visible clouds, giving the scene a warm, sunny atmosphere. Strong sunlight casts shadows under the bridge and along the paths, emphasizing the contrast between the shaded lower area and the brightly lit railings and sky.

Overall, the image depicts a pedestrian bridge and ramp system in a park-like or urban green area, with distinctive yellow railings, concrete supports, lampposts, signage, and surrounding trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市人行天桥的摄影图像。天桥由黄色栏杆和混凝土支柱构成，横跨在一条小径上。天桥的左侧有一个蓝色的自行车道标志，指示着该区域是自行车专用道路。天空晴朗，周围环境看起来宁静且整洁。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large modern public building, likely a transit hub, exhibition center, or convention space, dominated by a dramatic glass-and-steel roof structure.

The ceiling is the main visual focus. It is made of a geometric lattice of triangular glass panels supported by thick metal beams. The roof curves and twists across the space, creating a sweeping, wave-like form. The metal framework has a teal-green tint, and the glass panels allow pale daylight to filter through. The pattern changes across the image: on the left and upper areas the structure appears as repeated diamond and triangular modules, while toward the center and right it becomes a denser triangular grid, emphasizing the building’s complex engineering.

On the right side, a large dark curved architectural mass rises upward, also covered in a triangular panel pattern. It contrasts strongly with the lighter glass roof beside it. Below it, a rounded reddish-brown structure is partially visible, with a sign that appears to begin with “audit…,” suggesting an auditorium or similar venue.

The floor is broad, polished, and reflective, mirroring the roof, lights, windows, and warm sunlight. Golden reflections from the low sun stretch across the floor near the right side, while cooler greenish reflections from the glass roof spread across the center. The space feels very open and expansive, with high ceilings and a wide concourse.

At the far end, tall glass walls reveal an exterior urban scene, including distant buildings and a tower with an “NH” logo visible through the glass. A small group of people can be seen walking near the entrance area, appearing tiny compared with the monumental scale of the architecture. Along the left side, there are storefront-like or office-like areas with railings and signage, while the lower right includes part of an escalator or railing.

Overall, the image emphasizes futuristic architecture, structural geometry, and the interplay of light, glass, steel, and reflection. The mood is spacious, quiet, and slightly atmospheric, with cool green tones balanced by warm sunset light near the windows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑内部的摄影作品，其中心点是一个由蓝色玻璃构成的复杂几何结构屋顶，其设计精巧且具有未来感。阳光从屋顶透射下来，在光滑的地面上形成了明亮的反射和阴影。在远处可以看到几位行人正在室内行走，而右侧有一个红色的广告牌，上面写着'auditi'字样。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种宁静而高科技的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a group of school students seated closely together indoors, likely in a classroom, hall, or assembly area. Most of them are wearing matching light cream or pale beige short-sleeved school uniforms with dark trousers or skirts. Several students are holding small booklets with dark covers featuring a prominent golden/yellow illustration or design.

The students appear to be arranged in rows on white plastic chairs. Many have their hands pressed together in front of their chests while holding the booklet, suggesting they may be participating in a prayer, chant, reading, or ceremonial activity. A few students are looking down at their booklets, while others face forward. Their faces are intentionally blurred, making individual features unidentifiable.

In the foreground, a student on the left is partially cut off by the frame, with arms folded or hands near the chest. Near the center, a student in a cream shirt holds a booklet upright with both hands. Behind and around this student are several others doing the same. On the right side, a student with longer dark hair tied back is also holding a booklet with both hands while seated.

The background is softly lit and slightly out of focus. There are pale walls or columns and a bright outdoor area visible beyond the group, giving the scene a warm, naturally lit atmosphere. Overall, the image conveys a quiet, organized school gathering where students are engaged in a shared reading or devotional activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群学生坐在教室里的照片。学生们穿着统一的白色校服，专注地阅读手中的书籍或教科书。他们的表情集中而认真，显示出对学习内容的兴趣和投入。背景中可以看到教室内部的一些细节，如窗户和墙壁，但这些元素并不突出，因为焦点是学生们的学习活动。

caption:
The image shows a large flock of sheep being herded into or out of a wooden sheep barn in a rural setting.

In the center and left foreground, dozens—possibly hundreds—of sheep crowd together in a dense group. Most are cream or off-white with thick woolly coats, though a few have darker faces or black-and-brown markings. The flock is moving along a fenced path toward the open entrance of a barn. Their bodies fill much of the lower half of the image, creating a textured mass of wool, ears, legs, and heads.

The barn is a large, modern-looking wooden structure with vertical timber siding. It has a steep triangular roofline on the right side and a flatter green roof section extending to the left, covered with grass and patches of vegetation, blending the building into the surrounding landscape. On the front wall of the barn, large black lettering reads “Schaapskooi Bargerveen.” Next to the text is a green sign with a white plant-like logo. Several large wooden shutters and doors are open, revealing dark interior openings where sheep appear to be moving through.

To the right of the flock, a person stands near a gate and fence, wearing a dark green jacket and blue jeans. Their face is blurred. They appear to be watching or managing the movement of the sheep. Near the person is a small orange sign mounted on a post, and a large rounded boulder sits nearby on the grass.

In the lower middle-right foreground, a black-and-white herding dog stands alert, facing the sheep. Its posture suggests it is helping control or guide the flock. Another sheep stands near the gate on the far right, slightly separated from the main group.

The setting is outdoors in a grassy, slightly sandy enclosure bordered by wooden posts, wire fencing, and gates. Behind the barn and field is a line of dense trees with green foliage, suggesting a countryside or nature reserve environment. The light is warm and soft, possibly late afternoon or early evening, giving the wooden barn and sheep a gentle golden tone. Overall, the scene captures an active sheep-herding moment at a sheepfold or farm facility.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示农场生活场景的照片，一位牧羊人站在一群羊的前方，手中拿着一根木棍。一只黑白相间的牧羊犬在前景中，看起来正专注地观察着羊群。背景是一座现代风格的木质建筑，上面有绿色的标志和文字。周围环境是开阔的草地，远处可以看到树木和山丘。

caption:
The image shows a quiet suburban or residential street scene on a bright day, with a slightly warm, faded color tone.

On the left side, there is a beige multi-story house with a sloped red-tiled roof. The side of the building is visible, including a few rectangular windows with white trim. Below it runs a tall concrete wall along a sidewalk. The wall has a weathered, stained surface and is topped in places by dark green, dense shrubbery. A gray metal gate is visible near the far left edge.

A paved pedestrian path runs from the lower left foreground toward the middle distance, bordered by the concrete wall on one side and landscaping on the other. In the foreground and lower center of the image, there is a large mass of reddish-orange flowering shrubs, creating a strong color contrast against the muted buildings and cars. Behind the flowers are tropical-looking plants, including broad banana-like leaves. A slim black streetlamp stands near the center-left area, partly surrounded by greenery.

On the right side, there is a parking area filled with several light-colored cars, mostly silver and white. The closest car is cropped at the far right, showing its front corner and headlight. Behind it, more parked vehicles line up diagonally, facing toward the viewer. A tall gray metal signpost stands prominently in the right-center foreground, with the back of a road sign visible near the top.

In the background, a white two-story house with a red tiled roof sits across the parking area. It has dark window openings or shutters and small balconies with railings. More trees and palms surround the area, especially on the right, where a tall palm-like tree rises behind the cars.

The sky takes up much of the upper half of the image. It is pale blue with soft, scattered white clouds, giving the scene a warm, calm, slightly Mediterranean feel. The overall composition combines residential architecture, parked cars, tropical greenery, and colorful flowering shrubs in a peaceful neighborhood setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，画面中心是一个停车标志杆，其后是几辆停放的汽车。在照片的左侧，可以看到一座黄色的两层建筑，紧邻着一堵高高的石墙和一些绿色植物。右侧是一座带有红色屋顶的房子，与之相邻的是另一栋有着白色外墙的房屋。前景中有一丛鲜艳的橙色花朵，为这个宁静的城市角落增添了一抹生机。

caption:
The image shows a wide, rugged hillside landscape with large wind turbines rising against a dramatic sky.

In the foreground, there is a cluster of rough gray limestone rocks and boulders. They are jagged and irregular, with dark patches of lichen or moss on their surfaces. Around the rocks are dry grasses, small green ferns, low shrubs, and scattered vegetation, giving the ground a wild, natural look. The terrain appears uneven and rocky, with a mix of brown, straw-colored grass and green patches.

The middle ground slopes upward into an open hill. The hillside is sparsely vegetated, with low bushes and stones scattered across it. A small dark car is visible on the left side near the base of the slope, emphasizing the scale of the landscape. There is also a low rocky ledge or exposed stone layer running horizontally across the hill.

Dominating the scene is a tall white wind turbine near the upper center-right of the image. Its cylindrical tower stands on the ridge, and three long blades extend from the nacelle. The blade tips have red markings, and the blades appear slightly blurred, suggesting they may be turning. A second wind turbine stands farther back on the right side, smaller due to distance, also with white blades and red-tipped markings.

The sky occupies a large portion of the image. It is bright blue in places but filled with large, soft white and pale gray clouds. The clouds are expansive and textured, creating a sense of depth and movement. The lighting is natural daylight, with a slightly diffused quality from the cloud cover.

Overall, the scene combines natural rocky hillside terrain with modern renewable energy infrastructure, creating a contrast between the rugged landscape and the sleek, tall wind turbines.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示风力发电场的自然风光摄影图像。在画面前景，我们可以看到一些散落的岩石和草地，而在中景和背景中，可以看到几台风力发电机矗立在起伏的山丘上。天空是多云的，云朵散布在蓝天中，为这个场景增添了一种宁静而和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a wintry outdoor scene on a frozen lake or pond. Two people are kneeling on the ice near the shoreline, apparently ice fishing or preparing fishing gear. Their faces are blurred, and they are dressed warmly for cold weather.

In the foreground, dry tan reeds and grasses frame the bottom of the image, slightly out of focus. Beyond the reeds, the frozen surface is pale and bright, reflecting sunlight. Near the two people are several items: a black plastic bag, a white plastic bag, a small green tackle box or container, a turquoise cylindrical object lying on the ice, and a short fishing rod or tool placed flat on the surface.

The person on the left is wearing a dark winter jacket, dark pants, and a black knit cap. They are kneeling with one knee up and appear to be handling something in their hands. The person on the right is wearing a bright blue insulated winter suit, a gray knit beanie, and a vest or padded outer layer. They are kneeling beside the first person and looking downward toward the gear or ice.

The background is soft and blurred, showing a wide expanse of partially frozen water with a distant tree-lined shore. Snow patches are visible along the far bank. A few small dark shapes, likely ducks or waterbirds, can be seen on the open water in the distance. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting a cold but sunny day. The overall mood is quiet and calm, with the two figures focused on their activity in a frozen lakeside landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两个人在结冰的湖面上进行户外活动的照片。左侧的人物穿着棕色的冬季外套和黑色裤子，戴着帽子，正专注地查看手中的物品。右侧的人物穿着蓝色的冬装，头戴灰色的帽子，同样专注于自己的活动。他们周围是未被融化的雪和一些枯黄的植物，背景中可以看到远处模糊的树木和一座桥梁。

caption:
The image shows a busy roadway scene dominated by a large, highly decorated white Isuzu dump truck driving in traffic. The truck is viewed from the front-left side, so both its cab and the open cargo bed behind it are visible.

The truck’s cab is covered with colorful custom decorations. Across the windshield there is ornate Thai lettering in gold, and below it a large stylized graphic resembling fierce eyes or a face in bright green, blue, yellow, and red. The front grille has the “ISUZU” logo, with “FORWARD” marked on the lower left of the cab and “FRR 190” on the side. The license plate area at the front is blurred.

On top of the cab are two panda figurines, one on each side, along with several round auxiliary lights mounted on a metal bar. The truck also has multiple chrome light clusters and accessories mounted beside the windshield and mirrors. Small colorful ribbons, tassels, and dangling ornaments hang from the front and sides, including red plush-like figures near the windshield wipers and decorative fabric streamers along the lower front corners. The side window also has a gold graphic design, possibly a stylized character or deity.

The rear portion of the vehicle is a white dump bed with a dark gray or black tarp covering a load. The bed has signs of use, with dirt and wear visible around the edges. A red vertical panel is visible behind the cab, contrasting with the white truck body.

The truck is traveling on a multi-lane paved road. To its left is a white van partially visible, and to the right in the background there is a silver SUV. The scene appears urban or suburban, with many overhead utility wires crossing the sky and several tall concrete power poles. In the upper left background, part of a gas station canopy is visible with a sign that includes the word “Honda” and other text. Trees and greenery line the far side of the road.

The sky is bright and lightly cloudy, suggesting daytime. Overall, the image captures a colorful, personalized commercial truck moving through traffic in a busy roadside environment, with dense power lines and vehicles emphasizing the urban street setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆装饰有泰国文化元素的白色卡车的照片。卡车前部和侧面装饰着色彩鲜艳的图案，包括泰式传统图案和文字。车辆的后部装有一个开放式的货箱，上面也有类似的装饰。周围环境显示卡车正在一个繁忙的道路上行驶，背景中可以看到其他车辆和一些建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of an ornate building with Islamic-inspired architecture, set against a pale blue, partly cloudy sky.

On the left dominates a large rounded dome covered in patterned tiles or metal panels. The dome has a geometric lattice-like design in dark gray and bronze tones, with repeating angular shapes and decorative bands. Around the lower part of the dome is a ring of large white block letters spelling “YENIDZE,” partially cut off by the frame. Beneath the dome, the building façade is cream-colored with rows of arched windows, giving it a historic, decorative appearance.

At the top of the dome is a small gold-colored finial or turret with a thin vertical rod rising from it. The dome’s surface has warm brown, gold, green, and dark reddish accents, creating a richly patterned look.

On the right side of the image stands a tall cylindrical tower resembling a minaret. It is built with alternating horizontal bands of light cream and reddish-brown brick. Near the top is an ornate balcony or ringed platform with decorative railings and layered architectural detailing. Above that, the tower continues upward in a pale cylindrical section and ends with a dark metal openwork crown-like structure topped by a small crescent ornament.

In the lower foreground, there are light-colored patio umbrellas or canopies, including a folded pale yellow umbrella near the center-right. The perspective emphasizes the height of the dome and tower, making the building appear grand and monumental. The overall mood is architectural and slightly atmospheric, with soft daylight and clouds giving the scene a calm, urban feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示清真寺建筑的照片，其中包括圆顶和尖塔。圆顶上覆盖着金色的装饰，顶部有一个小型的圆顶和一个带有星月图案的尖塔。圆顶下方有'GENDZE JENI'的字样，表明了建筑的身份。照片背景是多云的天空，为这座宗教建筑增添了一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a weathered white religious statue, likely depicting the Virgin Mary. The figure is shown from about the knees or waist upward, centered in the frame, wearing a long flowing robe and a hooded veil that drapes over the head and shoulders. The garment has many carved folds and pleats, especially down the front of the torso and along the sleeves, giving it a soft, layered appearance.

The face of the statue appears smooth and blurred, with no visible facial features. The surface is off-white or cream-colored, with noticeable age marks: small rust-colored stains, dirt specks, and darker discoloration gathered in creases and along edges. The hands are extended outward and slightly downward in an open, welcoming gesture. The hands are much darker than the rest of the statue, with chipped paint revealing black or dark material beneath, especially on the fingers and palms.

Behind the statue is an outdoor setting. On the right side, there is a beige stone wall made of rectangular blocks. On the left, a gray, veined stone or marble-like structure appears, possibly part of a monument or architectural feature. In the background above the wall are green shrubs and trees, with a small section of a red-tiled roof visible on the upper left. The sky is pale blue-gray and slightly overcast.

Overall, the image has a quiet, aged, devotional atmosphere, emphasizing the worn texture of the statue and its serene, open-armed pose.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的宗教雕塑的照片。雕塑呈现为一位穿着传统长袍的人物，头戴面纱，双手合十，站立姿态庄重而神圣。雕塑表面有明显的风化痕迹，显示出岁月的侵蚀。背景中可以看到部分建筑物和树木，但它们模糊且不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a low-angle view of an old multi-story European-style building façade, photographed from street level looking upward. The building fills most of the frame, with a pale, overexposed sky occupying the top background.

The façade is beige or light tan, but it is heavily weathered. Large patches of plaster are peeling or missing, exposing reddish brick and rough gray underlayers beneath. The damage is especially visible around the windows and along the upper left and right portions of the wall, giving the building an aged, slightly neglected appearance.

Architecturally, the building has ornate classical details. The upper roofline features a prominent cornice with rows of decorative dentils or block-like brackets running horizontally beneath the eaves. The windows are arranged in vertical rows and have thick stone or stucco frames. Many of the windows are topped with decorative arched or triangular pediments, adding a formal historic character to the façade.

Several windows have white frames, while some have dark or wooden shutters. One window on the lower left has a white external air-conditioning unit mounted beneath it. A few windows are partially open or covered by blinds. Thin black utility cables run across the lower part of the building and vertically along the wall, adding to the urban street atmosphere.

On the right side, there is a large stone balcony with a balustrade. The balcony has thick, rounded stone balusters and heavy carved supports underneath. Small plants or greenery appear on or near the balcony, and a small tree with yellow autumn leaves rises from behind the balustrade near the center-right. Two flags hang from poles near the balcony; one appears to be the blue flag of the European Union, and another is a vertical tricolor in blue, yellow, and red, resembling the Romanian flag.

The perspective emphasizes the height and age of the structure. The building’s ornate details contrast with its worn, cracked, and patched surface, creating a sense of historic grandeur mixed with urban decay.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示老式建筑外观的照片。建筑物的外墙呈现出淡黄色调，上面装饰有多个带有白色窗框和栏杆的窗户。最显眼的是位于照片中央的阳台，阳台上悬挂着一面红色、蓝色和黄色相间的旗帜。阳台下方是两扇关闭的门，上方则是一个带栏杆的凸出部分。建筑的屋顶呈尖顶形状，边缘略显磨损。

caption:
The image shows a young child seated in a bright blue plastic chair, likely in a public seating area or event space with many similar chairs arranged in rows behind them. The child is leaning slightly to one side and appears relaxed.

They are wearing a gray camouflage-patterned baseball cap turned backward. The cap has dark gray, light gray, white, and black patches, with stitching and seams visible along the crown and strap area. A bit of short hair is visible near the side of the head and around the ear. The child’s face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial details.

The child is wearing a black T-shirt with a large graphic on the front. The design includes bright blue brushstroke-like shapes and several white musical notes, giving the shirt a music-themed look.

The chair is glossy, molded plastic, and deep blue, with a rounded back and a cutout near the lower center. Similar blue chairs fill the background, creating a repeating pattern. The background is heavily out of focus, but there appear to be people seated or standing farther back, along with warm-colored structures or decorations, possibly orange or yellow columns or tent-like elements. The lighting is bright, with a strong flash or direct light illuminating the child and chair in the foreground while the background remains darker and blurred.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个孩子坐在蓝色塑料椅子上的照片。孩子的头部被一顶带有图案的帽子遮挡，穿着一件黑色T恤衫，上面印有蓝色和白色的图案。背景中模糊地可以看到其他类似的蓝色塑料椅子和一些不清晰的人影。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic alpine glacier landscape under a partly cloudy blue sky.

In the foreground, there is a wide expanse of dark, rocky moraine terrain. The ground is gray-brown and barren, scattered with stones and boulders of many sizes, from small pebbles to large dark rocks. A few tiny human figures appear near the lower center-right, emphasizing the immense scale of the surrounding mountains and glacier. There are also a few small posts or markers near the lower left and right areas, possibly indicating a trail or viewing area.

Beyond the rocky foreground, a broad white glacier stretches across the middle of the scene. Its surface is mostly snow-covered but marked by long, shallow cracks and crevasse-like lines running lengthwise into the distance. The glacier appears to flow from a high mountain basin in the center background down toward the viewer, filling the valley between two massive mountain walls.

On both sides of the glacier rise steep, rugged mountains. The left side features a tall, snow-covered peak with exposed dark rock bands and cliff faces. Wisps of cloud drift around its lower slopes, partially obscuring the rock. On the right, another steep mountainside is visible, with alternating layers of snow and dark, jagged rock. Low clouds cling to the upper right ridge, softening the outline of the mountain.

The sky above is a deep blue with scattered white and gray clouds. Some clouds are thin and wispy, while others are thicker and hang low over the glacier and mountains, creating a sense of cold, high-altitude atmosphere. The central background is slightly hazy where the glacier rises into the mountain pass, giving the scene depth and a feeling of vast distance.

Overall, the image captures a remote, icy mountain valley with a large glacier, towering snow-covered peaks, drifting clouds, and a stark rocky foreground. It feels expansive, cold, and majestic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示壮观冰川景观的自然风光摄影。在画面前方，我们看到一片广阔的冰川表面，上面布满了纵横交错的裂纹和冰冻的痕迹。冰川两侧是陡峭的山峰，山顶被积雪覆盖，部分山体裸露着岩石。天空中飘浮着洁白的云朵，阳光从云层间透出，照亮了整个场景。在冰川的前景，可以看到几位游客正在探索这片寒冷而宁静的自然环境。

caption:
The image shows a cozy, festive indoor scene set up like a winter or Christmas photoshoot.

At the center is a small fabric teepee tent decorated in soft pastel colors. The tent has panels with star patterns in gray, white, black, and pale turquoise, and its entrance is open, revealing a gray-and-white chevron pattern inside. Draped around the tent is a string of large, warm glowing globe lights, giving the scene a soft golden glow.

Two young children are sitting in front of the tent on a light gray wooden floor. Their faces are intentionally blurred. The child on the left is wearing light blue pajamas with a cartoon-style animal design on the front and bright red socks. They are sitting with hands together, holding or leaning against a light blue star-patterned pillow. The child on the right is wearing a dark blue top and patterned winter-style pants, sitting on a small cushion with gray socks. Between them is a plush reindeer toy dressed in gray winter clothing, including a little hat with antlers and fluffy white trim.

Around the children are several decorative pillows in gray, white, and pale blue, many with star or chevron patterns. A wrapped gift box with silver snowflake designs sits near the lower left. On the right side of the image, part of a dark green Christmas tree is visible, decorated with white round ornaments. Another bit of greenery appears on the left edge, also suggesting holiday décor.

The background features turquoise-blue paneled shutters or doors, adding a bright, playful contrast to the soft gray and white decorations. The overall mood is warm, gentle, and festive, with a nursery-like winter holiday theme and soft lighting throughout.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在圣诞节装饰的室内环境中拍摄的照片，展示了两个穿着节日主题睡衣的孩子坐在一个装饰有灯泡和圣诞树的小帐篷前。左侧的孩子戴着一顶帽子，而右侧的孩子则没有戴帽子。他们周围摆放着各种节日装饰品，包括一只穿着圣诞服装的毛绒玩具、几个装满礼物的盒子以及一些星星形状的装饰物。背景中有一棵装饰华丽的圣诞树，增添了浓厚的节日氛围。

caption:
The image shows a **Rakuten Mobile retail display counter** inside what appears to be a shopping mall or electronics/mobile phone store.

At the center is a large wooden display table with a bright, eye-catching promotional banner attached to the front. The banner has a vivid **pink and purple radial “speed burst” design** and large white text reading **“Rakuten UN-LIMIT.”** The Rakuten logo is prominently centered.

On top of the counter are many **smartphones on display**, each mounted on clear security stands with charging/security cables attached. The phones are arranged in rows across the tabletop, showing different models and colors, including black, white, blue, pink, and other finishes. Some phones are tilted upright on angled stands, while others lie flatter on transparent mounts. There is also a white spray bottle with a red Rakuten label near the middle of the counter, likely sanitizer or cleaning spray.

Several promotional signs surround the display. On both the left and right front sides of the counter are posters advertising the **Rakuten Mini** for **“1円”** (1 yen), with images of small phones in different colors. Behind the table is a large dark blue sign advertising up to **15,000 Rakuten points** as a campaign reward. To the right, a tall acrylic brochure stand displays bright pink Rakuten Mobile materials, including a sign for **Rakuten UN-LIMIT 2.0** and a message indicating the plan is free for one year. Another poster on the far right mentions **5,000 points** and Rakuten card-related promotions.

On the left side of the image, there is a white sign about **COVID-19 infection prevention measures**, with red illustrations showing hand sanitizer and mask-related icons. A yellow pump bottle is visible nearby.

The store interior uses a lot of **light wood furniture**, with a wooden floor behind the display and glossy white tile flooring in the foreground. In the background, a few seated customers or staff members are partially visible at service counters with red chairs, but their faces are mostly out of frame or turned away. The overall scene is a busy, promotional mobile phone sales area with strong Rakuten branding and many signs advertising discounts, points, and service plans.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Rakuten UN-LIMIT服务的商业广告照片。图像中心是一个大型的紫色和粉色背景板，上面印有'Rakuten UN-LIMIT'的白色大字，以及一些较小的文字和图标。背景板周围摆放着各种手机模型，包括一款红色手机。在背景板前方，有一个价格标签显示为1日元，旁边是另一个较小的价格标签，显示了5000日元的优惠。整个场景被置于一个室内环境中，可能是商店或展览厅，周围有其他商品和顾客。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban cityscape under a dramatic, overcast sky. The most prominent feature is One World Trade Center near the center-left, rising tall and sleek with its reflective glass façade and long spire piercing into the dark clouds. Its blue-gray surface mirrors the muted light, giving it a cool, metallic appearance.

The sky dominates much of the scene, filled with thick gray storm clouds. There are brighter patches where sunlight is diffused behind the cloud cover, especially toward the upper right and center, creating a moody contrast between light and shadow.

In the foreground is a paved public plaza or park area with a geometric checkerboard pattern of light and dark tiles. Bare or nearly bare trees line the space, suggesting late autumn or winter. Some trees still have a few brown leaves clinging to their branches. The plaza feels open and quiet, with only a small number of people visible in the distance.

On the right side, there is a fenced playground area with a large blue climbing structure made of interconnected ropes and metal supports. Nearby are colorful trash and recycling bins—blue, green, and black—standing along the walkway. Planters with flowers sit near the fencing, adding small touches of color to the otherwise gray and brown palette.

Surrounding the plaza are various buildings of different heights and styles. On the far right is a tall residential building with a reddish-brown brick exterior and a rounded glass corner section. In the middle distance are mid-rise office or apartment buildings with grid-like window patterns. Lower brick and tan buildings occupy the foreground beneath the skyline, giving the image a layered urban depth.

On the left, there appears to be construction activity, including a partially built structure and a crane, reinforcing the city’s sense of constant development. The overall atmosphere is calm but slightly dramatic, with the imposing skyline, winter trees, and heavy clouds creating a distinctly New York City scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线的摄影作品，图像中心是一座高耸入云的摩天大楼，其独特的设计和玻璃幕墙在阴沉的天空背景下显得格外突出。周围是不同高度的建筑群，包括一些正在建设中的高楼和已经建成的商业大厦。前景中有几棵赤裸的树木，以及一个带有蓝色顶棚的游乐场设施。整个场景被一片厚重的乌云所笼罩，预示着可能的暴风雨。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, stage-side view of a laptop being used in a dark nightclub or concert setting. The laptop is open on a stand, angled slightly toward the viewer, with one hand resting on or manipulating the keyboard/trackpad area. The person’s arm is visible in a dark long-sleeved garment, but their face and body are mostly out of frame.

On the laptop screen is DJ or audio-mixing software. The interface appears dark, with multiple panels, colored waveform displays, track timelines, meters, and lists of tracks or settings. Bright red, orange, yellow, and green waveform bands stretch across the upper portion of the screen, suggesting music playback or live mixing. The lower portion contains rows of data and controls, resembling a playlist, cue points, or performance settings.

The laptop itself appears silver, similar to a MacBook-style design, with a black keyboard and a large trackpad. A small sticker resembling a vinyl record or DJ-themed graphic is placed on the lower-left palm rest area. The laptop is mounted on a black stand, indicating it is part of a DJ or live performance setup.

The background is heavily blurred with a shallow depth of field. It shows a large crowd or audience in a dim venue, illuminated by blue, purple, and white stage lights. Several bright rectangular light panels or screens glow in the distance, creating a vivid bokeh effect. The overall atmosphere feels energetic and performance-oriented, with the laptop in sharp focus as the main tool controlling the music while the audience and stage lighting create a dramatic club-like backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的图片，展示了一位DJ的手臂和笔记本电脑。DJ的手臂正专注地操作着键盘，而笔记本电脑屏幕上显示着音乐混音软件的界面，其中包含多个音频轨道和调整滑块。背景中模糊的人群坐在黑暗中的观众席上，为这个场景增添了一种现场音乐会的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, softly lit scene centered on a clear glass jar being used as a savings container. Inside the jar are visible U.S. currency and coins: a $100 bill is pressed against the front of the glass, with coins gathered at the bottom. Several credit or debit cards protrude from the top of the jar, including cards with visible “VISA” branding and an orange/red circular logo resembling a Mastercard-style mark.

The jar sits on a pale pink or blush-colored fabric surface, possibly a bedspread or blanket. To the right of the jar is a bright yellow sticky note or small paper card, slightly out of focus and blank from this angle. A few coins are also visible near the base of the note.

The background is intentionally blurred with a shallow depth of field. Warm white string lights create large glowing bokeh circles scattered across the scene, giving the image a cozy, decorative, and slightly festive atmosphere. The color palette is soft and warm: cream, gold, pale pink, and hints of teal in the upper-right background.

Overall, the image suggests themes of saving money, budgeting, personal finance, or holiday spending, with the jar of cash and cards standing out against the dreamy, softly illuminated background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示财务规划和储蓄主题的摄影棚照明风格照片。图中，一个透明玻璃罐子装满了美元纸币和硬币，罐子顶部插着一张信用卡，旁边放着一张黄色便签纸。背景模糊地展示了温暖的灯光和柔和的散景效果，营造出一种温馨而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, flash-lit shot of a person’s hands holding a small deck of rounded-corner cards. The cards are white or cream-colored and decorated with colorful star illustrations outlined in dark red. Some stars are filled pale pink, light green, or yellow, while others are just outlined. The deck appears to be split or fanned slightly between the person’s hands, with multiple card edges visible in layered stacks.

The person is wearing a blue-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt. The stripes are narrow and vertical or slightly diagonal depending on the folds of the fabric, giving the shirt a textured, casual look. Only the torso and hands are visible; the face is not shown. The hands are positioned centrally, with fingers curled around the cards. One thumb presses against the left stack, while the other hand supports the right stack, suggesting the person may be sorting, dealing, or playing with the cards.

The lighting is strong and direct, likely from a camera flash, creating bright highlights on the hands and cards and deep shadows in the background. The background is mostly dark and out of focus, making the hands and cards stand out sharply.

In the lower left corner, there is a bright red-orange object with a simple black cartoon-like face printed on it—curved lines and dots resembling eyes or facial features. It looks like it could be a toy, bag, or container. Its glossy surface catches the light, adding a bold splash of color to the otherwise dark scene.

Overall, the image feels intimate and candid, focused on the tactile action of holding or playing with a whimsical star-themed card deck.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示手持卡片的照片，卡片上印有红色的星星图案。照片中的人物穿着条纹衬衫，只露出双手和部分肩膀，手中紧握着一叠带有星形图案的白色卡片。背景是模糊的，可以隐约看到一个红色的物体，可能是某种装饰品或玩具。整体氛围显得轻松而随意，光线柔和，营造出一种家庭聚会或休闲时刻的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a lively indoor art scene with young children painting in a very messy, hands-on way.

In the foreground, a small blond child is standing beside a large sheet or surface covered in thick paint. The child is wearing a bright blue T-shirt and a turquoise apron decorated with colorful pirate-themed illustrations. Their hands are smeared with paint, and they are holding a white paint marker or tube in one hand while using the other hand to touch or spread paint on the surface. The child is looking downward, focused on the artwork.

The painting surface appears to be draped over something like a chair or table and is covered with broad, expressive strokes of black, teal, blue, and some purple paint. The paint looks wet and heavily applied, with large smeared areas and overlapping brush or hand marks. A small white cloth or paper towel with paint stains lies near the bottom center of the image.

Behind the child, another child is partially visible, wearing a green shirt and a similar colorful apron. Only the lower part of their face and torso are visible, but they appear to be smiling or laughing while participating in the activity. Their hands also look messy with paint.

On the far left edge of the image, part of an adult is visible holding a camera, suggesting someone is documenting the activity. In the background there is a wooden door or wardrobe, beige walls, and a wooden floor. On the right side, there is a child-sized table or play unit with turquoise trim and cartoon ice cream graphics. An orange bowl sits on top of it, with paint marks visible inside or around it, along with other art supplies nearby. There are also splatters of blue paint on the floor.

Overall, the scene feels playful, chaotic, and creative, capturing children deeply engaged in messy painting or an art project.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到两个小孩在室内进行绘画活动的照片。前景中，一个金发小男孩穿着蓝色带有卡通图案的围裙，专注地用手指涂抹着黑色颜料，他的表情显得非常投入和快乐。在他的背后，另一个小男孩同样穿着绿色带卡通图案的围裙，正从背后伸出双手帮助前者。周围散落着一些画笔和纸张，而房间的背景则相对简单，有门、墙和其他家具。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a cat lying down on a light-colored, probably white, surface. The cat is facing the camera, with its head centered in the frame and its body extending to the right side of the image.

The cat has a mixed tabby/tortoiseshell-style coat with warm shades of tan, orange, brown, cream, and darker gray-brown patches. Its fur looks soft and slightly fluffy, especially around the cheeks, chest, and ears. The face has distinct darker markings around the nose, eyes, and cheeks, with orange patches on the forehead and near the eyes. Its nose is pinkish-brown with a small dark mark below it.

The cat’s eyes are mostly closed or squinting, giving it a sleepy, relaxed, or mildly unimpressed expression. Its large triangular ears stand upright, with pale fur inside and fine hairs visible along the edges. Long white whiskers extend from both sides of its muzzle.

The cat’s front paw is visible near the bottom center of the image, curled close to its body. Its body fur on the right side shows irregular stripes and patches in orange-brown and darker tones.

The background is dim and slightly out of focus. Behind the cat there appear to be dark patterned fabrics or blankets, including some black, blue, red, and gray areas. The lighting is fairly direct on the cat’s face and body, making the cat stand out against the darker background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一只橘色和白色相间的猫的特写照片。猫咪的眼睛半闭，似乎在休息或打盹，它的毛发看起来有些凌乱，颜色由浅橙色过渡到深棕色。它躺在一个白色的表面上，背景模糊不清，但可以隐约看到一些家居用品。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit beach under a clear blue sky. The foreground is dominated by pale golden sand with small ripples, footprints, scattered pebbles, and faint kite lines stretching away from the camera. At the bottom center lies a kitesurfing control bar with white and black handles, attached to several thin lines that run across the sand toward a deflated kite in the midground.

Slightly right of center, a black-and-white kitesurfing kite is spread out and partially collapsed on the sand. Another bundle of black-and-white kite gear or fabric lies farther to the right in the foreground. The open beach is very broad and mostly empty, giving the scene a spacious, windswept feeling.

On the left side of the image, the turquoise ocean meets the sandy shore. The water is bright blue-green near the beach and deepens toward the horizon. A few small figures are visible near the shoreline, along with colorful beach or kite equipment, including orange and yellow items. Farther in the distance, tiny people and possibly kites can be seen along the coastline.

To the right, a large, dry, beige-brown mountain or volcanic ridge rises from the flat beach landscape. Its slopes have visible erosion lines and sparse vegetation, emphasizing the arid, desert-like environment. The sky is mostly cloudless, with only a few faint wisps of cloud high above.

Overall, the scene appears to be a quiet kitesurfing beach in a dry coastal landscape, with strong sunlight, open sand, calm sea colors, and rugged hills in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示沙滩风筝冲浪活动的自然风光摄影图像。在画面中央，可以看到一个风筝冲浪板和它的控制线横跨在沙地上，旁边散落着一些风筝冲浪装备。背景中，远处的山脉轮廓清晰可见，而近处的海水呈现出宁静的蓝色调。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为整个场景增添了活力与色彩。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit courtyard or narrow street in a Mediterranean/North African-looking setting, dominated by whitewashed architecture and vivid blue accents.

In the foreground, on the left, a white stucco wall and a low roof with scalloped, wavy tiles frame the scene. Red bougainvillea flowers climb along the wall and roofline, with green leaves and woody vines creating a colorful contrast against the white surface. A round exterior light fixture is partly visible under the roof edge.

At the center-right is a striking arched doorway painted an intense cobalt blue. The door is decorated with black studded patterns, including geometric motifs and a hand-shaped symbol reminiscent of the Hamsa. The doorway opens into a dark interior, creating strong contrast with the sunlit exterior. Around the entrance are potted plants, including tall, narrow shrubs in beige ceramic planters.

The walls are rough-textured and white, with a large blue-trimmed arch around the doorway. A small lantern is mounted near the entrance. On the far right, part of a black metal object, possibly a grill or cart, is visible in shadow.

Rising above the courtyard in the background is a tall white tower resembling a mosque minaret. It has decorative window openings near the top with patterned trim, small ornamental details along the roofline, and a finial topped with green spheres and a crescent. A wooden or metal utility pole stands in front of the tower, with wires stretching across the scene.

The sky is a deep, cloudless blue, emphasizing the brightness of the day. Strong sunlight casts crisp shadows on the white walls and ground, giving the image a warm, vibrant, coastal or old-town atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示摩洛哥风格建筑的照片，其中一座白色的建筑物的入口处有一个醒目的蓝色门。建筑物上方是一个带有尖顶和钟楼的塔楼，塔楼顶部装饰着金色的元素。门前有几盆盛开的红色花朵，为这个传统的白色建筑增添了一抹鲜艳的颜色。阳光下的蓝天与建筑的白色墙面形成鲜明对比，突出了建筑的轮廓和细节。

caption:
The image shows a colorful roadside fruit stall packed with fresh tropical produce. The stall is sheltered under a roof, with many bunches of ripe yellow bananas hanging overhead from wooden beams by purple strings. The bananas form a dense canopy across the top of the stall, some bright yellow and others slightly speckled or greenish.

In the foreground, a customer stands facing the display. They are wearing a light gray headscarf, a loose black outer garment, a black-and-white vertically striped skirt or pants, and black shoes. They appear to be looking at the fruit selection.

The fruit display is arranged on red, tiered shelves. On the right side, there are large yellow papayas lined up in rows, some with green patches. Above them are pale round melons stacked neatly, with a single netted cantaloupe-like melon nearby. In the center are several bright pink dragon fruits with green-tipped scales, a row of small orange fruits arranged in a pyramid, and sliced watermelon wedges showing vivid red flesh with green rinds. A few green vegetables or fruits are bundled in plastic bags near the center.

On the left side of the stall, coconuts sit on a wooden table, and several plastic-wrapped drinks or desserts hang from strings in cone-shaped bags, including pale green and pink ones. There are crates, coolers, and containers around the stall area, adding to the busy market atmosphere.

Behind the fruit display, a vendor is partially visible inside the shaded stall, though their face is blurred. Plastic bags hang behind the counter, and there are signs and banners partly obscured by the stall structure. The ground in front is gravel with patches of grass, giving the scene an outdoor roadside-market feel. Overall, the image is lively and abundant, dominated by the bright yellows of bananas and papayas, the pink dragon fruit, and the red watermelon slices.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示市场水果摊位的照片，一位穿着传统服装的女性顾客站在摊位前，背对着镜头。摊位上摆放着各种新鲜水果，包括挂在顶部的黄色香蕉、放在中间层的橙色和红色柑橘类水果以及放置在最底层的绿色和黄色芒果。整个场景充满了热带地区的日常氛围。

caption:
A wide panoramic winter scene shows a quiet, snow-covered urban park under a pale gray, overcast sky. The sky dominates most of the image, creating a cold, muted atmosphere with soft bluish tones throughout.

In the foreground, a broad open lawn is blanketed in smooth, undisturbed snow. Sparse blades of grass barely show through in a few places. Several leafless young trees stand across the snowy field, their thin trunks and bare branches dark against the white ground. On the left side, a dense cluster of taller bare trees frames the scene, their branches reaching upward and inward.

A row of black, old-fashioned streetlamps runs through the park, spaced at intervals from left to right. Their narrow poles and lantern-style tops add a decorative, historic feel. Near the lower right side, a bright red fire hydrant stands out vividly against the white snow and gray-blue surroundings.

In the middle distance, there are low shrubs and bushes dusted with snow, forming rounded, reddish-brown patches near the center of the image. Behind them, a black metal fence separates the park from a lower walkway or waterfront area. Several rocks and small landscaped features are scattered across the park.

To the right, a large steel truss bridge dominates the background. Its dark metal framework rises diagonally and horizontally, with crisscrossing beams and support structures. The bridge appears to be a movable or lift-style bridge, with a prominent raised section on the far right. Snow rests lightly on parts of the structure, and the bridge gives the scene an industrial waterfront character.

In the background toward the center and left, there are small buildings with snow-covered roofs, including a house-like structure with steep white roofs. A low modern building is partly visible on the far left behind the trees. Bare trees and faint structures continue into the distance, softened by haze or falling snow.

Overall, the image feels still, cold, and quiet—an empty winter park near a bridge, with muted colors, soft light, and a calm snowy atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季雪景的自然风光摄影图像。图中前景有一片被积雪覆盖的地面上，几棵赤裸的树木和灌木丛在雪地中显得格外突出。一座具有工业风格的铁桥横跨在画面中央，其复杂的金属结构在雪白的背景下显得尤为醒目。桥上没有车辆或行人，增添了一种静谧而孤独的感觉。远处可以看到一些低矮的建筑物，它们的屋顶也被积雪覆盖，与周围的环境融为一体。整个场景被一层薄雾笼罩，给这个冬日景象增添了一份神秘感。

caption:
The image shows the **Sagrada Família basilica in Barcelona, Spain**, photographed from street level on a bright, clear day. The sky is a deep, cloudless blue, making the pale stone of the basilica stand out dramatically.

The basilica dominates the scene with its towering, highly detailed spires rising upward in the center and right side of the image. Several tall, narrow towers have dark vertical openings and ornate sculptural tops decorated with colorful, floral-like forms. A large construction crane stretches horizontally near the upper left of the towers, emphasizing that the building is still under construction.

On the right side of the basilica is a large angular façade with many sculpted figures and geometric architectural elements. The façade has a dramatic, modern Gothic appearance, with slanted supports, deep shadows, and rows of statues near the base. The stonework is intricate and textured, with carved details covering much of the surface.

On the left side, another section of the basilica appears lighter and more decorative, with triangular shapes, patterned openings, and sculpted ornamentation. This portion has a softer, cream-colored stone and includes many irregular geometric forms, giving it an organic, almost fantastical appearance.

At street level, a dark construction fence runs along the front of the site, separating pedestrians from the basilica. Several people are walking on the sidewalk or standing nearby, giving a sense of the building’s enormous scale. A palm tree is visible near the base of the basilica, partially framed by the fence.

On the far right edge of the image, part of a red sightseeing bus is visible, suggesting a tourist area. In the foreground, there is a paved street with road markings and a bus or bike lane, along with pedestrians crossing or waiting near the curb. The overall scene feels lively and touristic, with the monumental architecture towering above everyday city activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示著名建筑的照片，建筑物具有独特的哥特式设计风格，尖顶和细长的拱门是其显著特征。在晴朗的天空下，建筑物的外观被阳光照耀得非常明亮。前景中，几位行人在街道上行走，其中一位女士正使用手机拍照。左侧有一个红色的公交车停靠在路边，而右侧则有建筑工地的围挡。

caption:
The image shows a broad, formal ornamental garden laid out in a highly structured, symmetrical style. In the foreground and middle ground are neatly maintained lawns, pale gravel paths, clipped hedges, and geometric planting beds filled with dense clusters of brightly colored flowers. The flowers are mostly pink, magenta, red, purple, and white, arranged in long borders and patterned beds that create a decorative, almost tapestry-like effect.

Several rounded and carefully pruned shrubs and small trees are scattered throughout the garden. Some are shaped into spheres or domes, while others have slender trunks with rounded canopies, giving the space a manicured, classical feel. Low hedges outline the flowerbeds and form curved and rectangular patterns across the grass. The pale gravel walkways wind and intersect through the garden, separating the beds and adding contrast to the greenery.

Across the back of the garden is a long stone or brick wall, weathered and slightly mottled with age. Along the top of the wall are evenly spaced white urn planters, each filled with pink flowers, reinforcing the formal symmetry. Small white balustrade sections appear at intervals along the wall, adding an architectural detail. Behind the wall rises a dense backdrop of mature trees in varying shades of green, with some hints of yellowing foliage, suggesting late summer or early autumn.

The sky above is overcast and pale gray, with soft, diffused light and no harsh shadows. The overall atmosphere is calm, elegant, and cultivated, with the vivid flowerbeds standing out against the muted sky and deep green woodland background. The scene looks like part of a historic estate or château garden, carefully designed and maintained for visual harmony.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示精心设计的花园景观的照片。前景是一个由多种花卉和灌木组成的多彩花坛，包括粉色、紫色和白色的花朵，以及修剪成球形的绿色植物。一条蜿蜒的小径穿过花坛，引导视线至背景中的更多花坛和树木。这些树木背后是更多的绿色植被，而天空中布满了厚重的云层，预示着可能的降雨。

caption:
The image shows the upper façade of an ornate historic building, photographed from a low angle so the structure rises dramatically against a wide expanse of pale blue sky.

At the center is a large round clock set into the stone façade. The clock face has Roman numerals in dark lettering on light panels, with a dark blue or black inner ring and metal radial supports. The hands are black and decorative, clustered near the middle, giving the clock a heavy, sculptural look. The clock is framed by elaborate carved stonework: floral garlands, scrolls, leaves, and ornamental reliefs surround the circular opening.

Above the clock is a large arched architectural crown with layered stone molding. The arch has dentil-like blocks and deep shadowed recesses, emphasizing the classical style. The stone appears light beige or gray, weathered slightly, with darker seams and shadows between the blocks.

Below the clock, the carved inscription “PARIS-ORLEANS” is clearly visible, suggesting a railway or station-related façade. On either side of the central area are decorative medallions with the letters “PO,” also surrounded by carved wreaths and foliage. Lower on the façade, partial place names such as “AGEN” and “ALBI” can be seen carved into the stone, reinforcing the train-station theme.

The building is richly ornamented throughout: rectangular stone courses, projecting cornices, carved brackets, pilaster-like vertical elements, and sculpted floral motifs fill the surface. Near the lower center is a dramatic carved face or mask-like ornament above an arched entrance, with flowing decorative forms extending downward.

At the bottom edge of the image, parts of colorful panels or banners are visible—one reddish panel on the left and a painted image on the right—though they are only partially shown. The overall impression is of a grand Beaux-Arts or classical railway-station façade, monumental, symmetrical, and highly decorative, viewed under a clear, softly lit sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示巴黎奥赛博物馆正面的照片。照片中心是一个大型的圆形时钟，其上方刻有'PARIS-ORLEANS'字样，下方是'ACÉN. A.L.E.'的铭文。建筑的顶部装饰着复杂的浮雕和雕塑，营造出一种古典而庄严的氛围。在时钟下方，可以看到一些红色的遮阳篷，为这个场景增添了一抹鲜艳的颜色。

caption:
The image shows a lively amusement park or fairground walkway on a sunny day, with rows of game booths and rides lining the street.

On the left side, there is a large carnival game booth with a bright orange facade and a bold sign reading “BALLBALL” in large yellow letters. Inside the booth, shelves are filled with plush teddy bears and other stuffed prizes arranged in rows. The booth is built into a gray, weathered-looking structure with tall shuttered windows above it. Near the top left, a decorative bird or eagle figure with spread wings is mounted on the building, adding to the carnival theming.

Moving toward the center, several colorful attraction signs and facades extend down the street. One sign is covered with rows of small light bulbs in red, yellow, blue, and white, typical of fairground rides. Another large sign has bright yellow lettering and a flashy, retro style. The storefronts and ride entrances have awnings, neon-like trim, and decorative panels, giving the area a dense, festive appearance.

In the background, parts of amusement rides are visible above the buildings and trees. There is a tall ride structure with a staircase or track-like framework, along with curved metal supports and colorful light poles topped with fan-shaped decorations. Farther right, more ride signage and bright blue and orange structures can be seen among the trees.

The street itself is wide and pedestrian-friendly, paved partly with smooth asphalt and partly with cobblestone-like stones in the foreground. Many people are walking through the scene, mostly dressed casually for warm weather—shorts, T-shirts, tank tops, backpacks, sandals, and sneakers. Some people walk in pairs or small groups, while others move individually toward the attractions. Several faces appear blurred, suggesting privacy masking or motion.

The lighting is warm and natural, likely late afternoon, with sunlight casting soft shadows and giving the scene a relaxed summer atmosphere. Trees with dense green foliage frame the background and right side, contrasting with the bright artificial colors of the rides and game booths. Overall, the image captures a bustling, colorful amusement park midway filled with games, prizes, rides, and visitors strolling through.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示游乐园入口区域的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，可以看到一个名为'BALLAN'的游乐设施，其上方装饰着多彩的彩带和旗帜。左侧是一个带有'JUNGLE'字样的建筑，门前有彩色图案的广告牌。右侧是另一个游乐设施，顶部有一个巨大的摩天轮模型。街道上行人众多，他们穿着休闲服装，有的背着背包，有的手拿手机，正在享受阳光明媚的一天。

caption:
The image shows a large **Aerolíneas Argentinas** wide-body passenger aircraft touching down on a runway at an airport.

The plane is seen from behind and slightly to the left, angled diagonally across the frame as it lands. Its fuselage is painted in Aerolíneas Argentinas’ light blue and white livery, with the large white text **“Aerolíneas Argentinas”** visible along the upper blue section of the aircraft. The tail is turquoise-blue with a pale white lower portion and the airline’s stylized markings. The registration **LV-CSX** is visible near the rear of the fuselage.

The aircraft has **four engines**, two under each wing, indicating a large long-haul jet. Its landing gear is down, and the main wheels have just made contact with the runway. A dramatic cloud of **white tire smoke** is rising from the wheels, showing the moment of touchdown. The wings stretch wide across the scene, with the left wing slightly lower in perspective and the right wing extending toward the edge of the frame.

In the foreground and midground, the airport environment is visible: runway and taxiway pavement, grassy strips, small blue-and-yellow runway edge markers, and a red taxiway/runway sign that reads **“Y1 25R”**. To the right of the aircraft, an orange-and-white **windsock** is extended, suggesting a noticeable breeze.

The background contains airport buildings, lighting masts, antennas, and heat shimmer rising from the runway, which slightly distorts the distant view. A partially visible **easyJet** aircraft can be seen in the far-left background. The sky is pale blue and hazy, giving the scene a bright, hot, midday airport atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a powerful and dynamic landing moment, with the aircraft’s size, motion, and tire smoke emphasizing the force of touchdown.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架商用喷气式飞机在机场跑道上降落的照片。飞机的机身主要是蓝色和白色，机身上有'Emirates'的字样，表明它属于阿联酋航空。飞机的起落架已经放下，准备着陆。背景中可以看到机场的部分设施，包括一个带有红色标志的塔台和一些模糊的建筑物。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a used postage stamp from **République du Tchad** / the **Republic of Chad**. It is shown against a dark, nearly black background, making the white perforated stamp edges stand out clearly.

The stamp has a **horizontal rectangular layout** with rough, fibrous white paper edges and rounded perforation holes along all sides. The paper texture is very visible, with tiny fibers and slight wear, especially along the top and left edges.

The central artwork shows **two yellow butterflies** with dark brown to black outlines and markings:

- On the left, a larger butterfly is shown with wings spread open. Its wings are mostly bright yellow, with black/brown borders, dark vein lines, and rows of pale yellow spots near the outer edges.
- On the right, a second butterfly is shown at an angle, partly side-on, with similarly yellow wings, orange vein-like markings, and dark spotted borders. It appears to be perched near faint green plant shapes.

The background is divided into pale and bright blue areas. The left side is a softer gray-blue, while the right side is a brighter cyan-blue with an irregular lighter shape between them, giving the design a layered, graphic look.

Text on the stamp includes:

- **“5F”** in large white letters at the lower left, indicating the denomination.
- **“POSTES”** beneath the value.
- **“REPUBLIQUE DU TCHAD”** in large dark letters across the bottom.
- Small designer/engraver names near the bottom: **“S. GAUTHIER”** on the left and **“DELRIEU”** on the right.
- Along the right side, vertical white text appears to name the butterfly species, partially visible as **“... KILL...”**.

There are black postal cancellation marks across the right and lower portions of the stamp, including curved ink lines and partial numerals or letters. The overall image is a highly magnified, detailed view of a colorful butterfly-themed Chadian postage stamp.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张邮票，展示了两只栩栩如生的蝴蝶图案。左侧的蝴蝶翅膀展开，呈现出明亮的黄色和黑色斑点，而右侧的蝴蝶则闭合了翅膀，同样拥有醒目的黄黑相间的图案。邮票背景是蓝色的山脉轮廓，下方有邮票面值'5 F'以及发行国家名称'Republique du Tchad'和地名'Delrieu'。

caption:
The image shows a bright, pastel-colored ice cream truck parked along a city street in daylight. The truck is viewed in profile from the side, filling most of the frame. Its body is painted mainly bubblegum pink with turquoise accents along the roofline, lower panels, bumper, wheels, and trim. The style is cheerful and retro, with riveted metal panels and rounded edges.

Large graphics decorate the truck: on the left side is a big soft-serve vanilla cone illustration labeled “FUN-TIME,” and another similar cone graphic appears near the front door. In the middle of the truck is a large serving window surrounded by colorful menu boards showing many frozen treats, including soft-serve cones, sundaes, dipped cones, slushies, shakes, and novelty ice creams. Near the center-right is a large illustration of a strawberry sundae in a yellow bowl with the “FUN-TIME” logo. Along the lower side of the truck, large pale turquoise lettering reads “CONES,” “SHAKES,” and “SUNDAES.”

The truck’s serving window is closed or partially covered by glass, and there are several laminated menu panels around it with bright blue backgrounds and small photos of desserts. The driver’s cab is on the right, with a large side mirror and a slightly reflective window. A small graphic of a drink or milkshake is painted near the front. The tires are black with turquoise-painted wheel rims, matching the truck’s trim.

The vehicle is parked over a crosswalk or white street markings. Behind it is an urban backdrop: a red-brick building with tall white columns and rectangular windows, suggesting an older civic or historic building. To the left and right are modern glass-and-steel office buildings with reflective windows. A streetlamp and a red vertical banner are visible on the right side, and a dark car is partially visible behind the truck. The lighting is strong and sunny, casting shadows and highlighting the glossy pastel paint of the truck.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示粉色冰淇淋车的摄影图片。车辆上清晰地印有'CONES SHAKES SUNDAES'字样，表明售卖的产品类型。车身侧面和前部装饰着与食品相关的图案，如冰淇淋蛋筒、勺子和雪糕杯。车辆停靠在城市街道上，背景中可见现代建筑和一些行人。

caption:
The image shows an action moment during a soccer match on a green grass pitch.

In the lower-left/center area, two players are tightly contesting the ball. One player is wearing a white jersey with red shorts and white socks with red bands; the number **16** is visible on the shorts. He appears to be leaning backward or bracing himself while the ball is very close to his upper body/arm area. An opposing player in a **blue kit** with red accents, wearing the number **10**, is pressing into him from the front/side, with one arm and shoulder making contact as they battle for position.

The soccer ball is suspended or bouncing just in front of the white-shirted player’s torso, near his left arm. Both players’ bodies are angled and tense, suggesting a physical duel for possession or a contested aerial/loose ball.

On the right side of the image, another player in a white jersey and red shorts—number **9** visible on the shorts—is running or reacting with both arms spread wide, as if appealing to the referee or expressing frustration. He is wearing a dark captain-style armband on one arm and light-colored boots.

The background is mostly open green field with a faint white boundary or pitch marking running diagonally near the top. At the very top edge, part of an advertising board or stadium display is visible but blurred. The image has a live sports-photo feel, with motion, contact, and strong focus on the clash between the two central players.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉足球比赛精彩瞬间的体育摄影照片。图中，一名穿着白色球衣和红色短裤的球员正在尝试用身体接触另一名穿着蓝色球衣和白色短裤的球员，以阻止他前进。第三名球员身穿红色球衣和白色短裤，似乎在观察并准备参与接下来的动作。球场上的草坪呈现出鲜明的绿色，而背景中的观众席则因为焦点在比赛中而显得模糊。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a street signpost at a residential intersection. Two green street-name signs are mounted perpendicular to each other near the top of a metal pole. The upper sign reads **“THAT ST”** in large white capital letters, and the lower sign reads **“THIS ST”**, also in white capital letters. The wording makes the intersection look humorous or intentionally quirky.

Below the street signs is an older, weathered white speed-limit sign. It says **“MAXIMUM 20 km/h”** in black lettering, though the sign is cracked, dirty, and chipped, with rust spots around the mounting holes and edges.

In the background is a light-colored house with cream or white horizontal siding, a sloped shingled roof, gutters, and rectangular windows. Several utility wires run diagonally across the left side of the frame, and a yellow protective sleeve or post is visible near the pole. The background is slightly out of focus, drawing attention to the street signs in the foreground. The scene appears to be in a quiet suburban or small-town residential area during daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示交通标志牌的现实主义风格照片。在图片中心，有一个绿色的街道名称指示牌，上面写着'THAT ST'和'THIS ST'，分别指向两个不同的方向。紧挨着这两个指示牌的是一个带有最大限速20公里/小时标志的白色路标，上方有黑色的文字和数字。背景中可以看到一栋白色的两层住宅建筑，其外观简洁，屋顶为灰色。

caption:
The image shows a quiet outdoor street scene in bright daylight. A long, low building fills most of the background. Its upper portion has a red-brown tiled roof, with rows of curved roof tiles running horizontally across the frame. Beneath the roof is a striped awning or overhang with alternating faded white, pink, and reddish vertical bands; the lower edge of the awning has a scalloped shape.

The wall of the building is largely covered by a large white sheet or tarp stretched across it. The fabric has visible wrinkles, folds, and slight sagging, with small fasteners or marks scattered along it. Below the tarp is a weathered concrete base, stained with dark moisture marks and grime near the ground. A narrow strip of grass and plants runs along the foot of the wall, separated from the asphalt road by a raised curb.

On the right side of the image, leafy green vegetation partly covers the wall. A small tree or shrub with broad leaves grows upward, overlapping the white tarp and casting shadows. A concrete utility pole stands near the right side, rising vertically in front of the building. There are also more dense, darker green plants at the far right edge.

In the lower right portion of the image, a young person is walking from left to right along the roadside. They have dark hair tied back and are looking down at a phone held in one hand. They are wearing a light gray long-sleeved top with darker sleeves, striped shorts, and black slide sandals. Their posture is slightly forward-leaning, focused on the device as they walk.

The foreground is a broad gray paved road with subtle cracks, patches, and tonal variations. The scene feels still and everyday, with strong sunlight creating high contrast between the white wall, the dark shadows under the awning, and the lush green plants. The composition is wide and horizontal, emphasizing the long facade of the building and the solitary walker near the right side.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现日常生活场景的照片，一位穿着休闲服装的人正在街道上行走。人物戴着帽子，身穿灰色长袖衬衫和深色短裤，脚穿拖鞋，手里拿着手机。背景中有一栋老旧的建筑，其外墙被白色布覆盖，周围有绿色植物生长。

caption:
The image is a close-up, portrait-oriented photograph of a vivid orange flower, likely a zinnia, being gently held in someone’s hand. The flower dominates the frame and is sharply focused compared with the softly blurred garden background.

The bloom has many rounded, overlapping petals arranged in layered rings around the center. The petals are a rich orange with subtle variations—some areas appear deeper reddish-orange near the base, while the outer edges catch bright sunlight and look almost golden. Fine petal veins are faintly visible, adding texture. The petals are broad, slightly curved, and arranged in a full, symmetrical daisy-like form.

At the center is a dense cluster of small yellow florets and curled pollen-bearing structures. The middle has a darker brownish-orange core beneath the bright yellow details, creating a strong contrast with the surrounding orange petals. The central area looks textured and intricate, with tiny curled filaments radiating outward.

A hand is visible at the lower left and bottom of the image, supporting or holding the flower. The fingers are out of focus due to the shallow depth of field, with warm skin tones and a hint of a ring near the lower left edge.

The background is blurred but shows a garden setting with green leaves, terracotta-colored plant pots, and a few small white star-shaped flowers behind the main bloom. There also appears to be another orange flower lower in the background, partially visible and out of focus. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the scene, giving the flower a warm, vibrant glow and creating a soft, summery garden atmosphere.
