metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示橙色花朵特写的自然摄影风格图片。图像中，一只人类的手正握着一朵鲜艳的橙色花朵，花瓣展开，中心有黄色花蕊和细小的花粉粒。背景模糊地显示了绿色植物和其他花卉，为这张照片增添了一丝生机与自然氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of a large KLM aircraft parked outdoors beside a maintenance or hangar building. The camera is positioned under and slightly in front of the aircraft’s wing, making the jet engine the central focus.

A large turbofan engine dominates the middle of the image. Its circular intake is clearly visible, with dark fan blades inside and a spiral marking at the center of the hub. The engine nacelle is light gray/white and bears the blue KLM logo. Above it, the underside of the aircraft wing stretches horizontally across the scene, extending far to the right toward a large gray corrugated metal building.

On the left and lower foreground, a bright blue KLM ground-service vehicle or maintenance truck is parked directly under the wing. It has white text on the side, including “131.625 MHz” and a phone number, and the KLM logo is visible near the cab. The truck appears to be supporting or positioned close to the aircraft, suggesting a maintenance or museum display setting.

Part of the aircraft’s vertical tail is visible in the upper left background, painted white with a blue KLM-style crown and dot design. The sky is overcast with pale gray clouds, giving the scene soft, diffused lighting.

To the right, a large industrial hangar-like structure with vertical metal siding stands close to the aircraft wing. A covered walkway or jet-bridge-like structure connects from the building area toward the plane. Beneath the wing and near the building are small service carts, equipment, and a paved area.

In the background, beyond the aircraft and equipment, there is a grassy area with trees and a few smaller aircraft or aviation exhibits visible, including what looks like a vintage propeller aircraft. A picnic table sits near the pavement in the lower right, reinforcing the impression that this may be at an aviation museum or maintenance display area rather than an active airport gate.

Overall, the image captures an up-close aviation maintenance scene centered on a KLM aircraft engine, with ground support equipment, a hangar, and aviation exhibits surrounding it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示飞机发动机维护场景的照片。在图像的中心，我们看到一架大型喷气式客机的蓝色引擎部分，其螺旋桨叶片清晰可见。引擎下方连接着一辆蓝色的卡车，车身上印有数字和文字标识。背景中，可以看到飞机的尾翼和一个带有窗户的建筑物，建筑前有一片绿色草地。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny urban square in front of a historic railway station building. The sky dominates much of the frame, a clear, deep blue with almost no clouds, giving the scene a crisp midday atmosphere.

On the right side is the main architectural focus: a large red-brick and pale-stone station façade with an ornate, early-20th-century appearance. A tall clock tower rises above the building, topped with a steep greenish copper roof and a small weather vane or finial. The tower has a round clock face set into the stonework, and decorative vertical windows below it. The main station building beside it has a curved, decorative gable with sculpted stone details and a large arched window. Near the entrance, the sign reads “GARE DE …,” indicating it is a train station, likely in France. An SNCF sign is visible near the doorway.

In front of the station is an open paved plaza with a low circular or oval fountain basin. The fountain area is bordered by planters filled with abundant white and purple flowers. Several trees with dense green foliage frame the square, especially along the lower left and right sides, partially obscuring some buildings behind them.

The foreground shows a street with cars parked or moving along the curb. A white Citroën car is prominent on the left, with other vehicles nearby. There are road signs, including a blue parking sign and circular speed/traffic signs. A pedestrian crossing is visible at the lower right, where a person in dark clothing is walking across the street; their face appears blurred. Another dark vehicle is partly cut off at the far left edge.

Overall, the scene feels like a calm European city center or station square on a clear day, with historic architecture, greenery, traffic, pedestrians, and decorative flower displays.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，焦点是一座具有哥特复兴风格的建筑，其特点是尖顶和装饰性的窗户。建筑前方是一个圆形广场，周围种植着整齐的花卉。街道上停放着几辆汽车，而背景中可以看到其他建筑物和行人。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为整个场景增添了明亮和活力。

caption:
The image shows a long, narrow underground corridor or tunnel carved through rough rock or salt-like mineral. The passage has an uneven, organic shape rather than straight architectural walls: the ceiling and sides curve and bulge irregularly, with wavy striations and rippled textures that look like layers formed by excavation or natural deposits.

The walls are dark gray to bluish-gray near the upper areas, with lighter whitish crusts along the lower sides. The lower wall surfaces have a heavily textured, crystalline or frosted appearance, almost like rough salt buildup. The floor is comparatively smooth and pale, forming a straight walkway that leads the eye toward a smaller, brighter opening in the distance.

Several bright fluorescent tube lights are mounted along the ceiling, creating strong white glare and cool illumination. The closest light is very bright and slightly overexposed, casting a bluish-white glow across the slick-looking ceiling and upper walls. Farther down the tunnel, warmer yellowish lighting appears, giving the midsection a golden tone and adding depth to the scene.

On the right side, a series of pipes, cables, and metal brackets run along the upper wall and ceiling. These are mounted on supports at intervals, suggesting the tunnel is maintained for industrial, mining, or utility use. A thinner cable or conduit also follows the left side near the ceiling. There are small boxes or fixtures attached to the walls, possibly electrical components or lighting controls.

The perspective is centered down the passage, creating a strong vanishing point. The tunnel narrows visually as it recedes, with multiple illuminated sections visible in the distance. The overall atmosphere is cold, subterranean, and industrial, with the rough mineral surfaces, artificial lighting, and exposed infrastructure giving it the feeling of a mine, bunker, or underground service passage.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示隧道内部的照片，隧道的墙壁和顶部覆盖着一层灰白色的涂层，显得有些磨损。隧道中央有一束明亮的光线从尽头照射进来，形成了一个引人注目的光带。两侧的墙壁上安装有几盏灯，提供了隧道内的照明。整个场景给人一种幽暗而神秘的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a large, flat, rectangular public art installation viewed from above at an angle. The central surface is a warm beige or brass-toned panel covered with hundreds of black line drawings of human faces. The faces are sketched in a loose, cartoon-like style, with varied hairstyles, glasses, expressions, ages, and facial features. Some drawings are simple outlines, while others have darker filled-in hair or heavier shading, creating a dense crowd-like pattern across the entire panel.

The panel appears to be protected by a glossy transparent covering, likely glass or acrylic. Reflections of vertical structures or nearby buildings streak across the upper half, giving the surface a shiny, slightly wet-looking appearance. A few small leaves, specks of dirt, and circular metal or glass fixtures are scattered on top or embedded in the surface.

The installation is bordered by a metal frame and set into a thick gray concrete base. Around the perimeter are short metal posts connected by thin cables, forming a low barrier to keep viewers from stepping onto it. The surrounding ground is urban: gray stone or concrete pavement, with a drainage grate visible along the upper left edge.

Overall, the scene feels like an outdoor memorial or community artwork, emphasizing a collective portrait of many different people. The repeated hand-drawn faces create the impression of a large crowd, while the protective casing and barrier suggest it is a permanent public display.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的现代艺术装置的照片，装置由一系列黑色轮廓线勾勒出的人物头像组成，这些头像被排列成一个大型的六边形结构。每个头像都以不同的表情和姿态呈现，给人以丰富的视觉效果。头像排列紧密，没有明显的间隔，整体给人一种密集且有序的感觉。背景中可以看到地面反射着光线，增加了照片的艺术氛围。

caption:
The image is a wide panoramic view over a large, busy body of water, likely a strait or harbor, with a city spread along both shores in the distance. The scene has a dramatic, open feeling because most of the frame is filled with sky and sea.

In the foreground, dark blue-gray water ripples across the entire lower half of the image. The surface looks choppy, with small waves catching the light. Near the lower left-center, a white passenger ferry is moving away across the water, leaving a bright foamy wake behind it. On the lower right, another larger ferry is docked beside a pier or terminal. The dock area is in shadow, with small groups of people visible near the waterfront.

The middle distance contains several boats and ferries scattered across the water, some appearing as small white shapes on the horizon. The shoreline stretches from left to right, with dense city buildings rising low along the coast. On the far right and center-right skyline, several mosque domes and slender minarets are visible, giving the cityscape a historic character. The left shore also has tightly packed buildings and a few taller structures, including what looks like construction equipment or a crane.

The sky dominates the upper portion of the image. It is pale blue with soft gray clouds and warm light near the right side, suggesting late afternoon or early evening. Dozens of seagulls are flying at different heights and distances, scattered across the sky. Some are close enough to show their dark wing tips and white bodies, while others appear as small silhouettes. Their movement adds energy and depth to the scene.

Overall, the image captures a lively coastal city atmosphere: ferries crossing the water, birds circling overhead, a historic skyline in the distance, and warm, hazy light over a windswept harbor.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市海港景观的摄影作品，画面中心是两艘船只在宽阔的海面上航行。左侧的船正从码头出发，留下一道白色的尾迹；右侧的船则停靠在码头旁，周围有几座小建筑。天空中飞翔着一群鸟儿，它们的影子在阳光下清晰可见。远处可以看到城市的轮廓和一些山丘，而天空则是多云的，预示着可能的天气变化。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of a modern office building photographed from a low angle, making the facade slope diagonally across the frame. The building has a clean, corporate look with light gray or off-white rectangular exterior panels arranged in a grid pattern. Between the panel sections are long horizontal bands of large teal-blue tinted windows, reflecting the sky and faint interior lighting.

Near the top center-right of the building facade is the **CenturyLink** logo and name. The logo consists of a circular emblem with alternating green and white radial segments, resembling a stylized sunburst or pinwheel. To the right of the emblem, the word **“CenturyLink”** appears in dark, three-dimensional lettering mounted on the wall. The letters cast subtle shadows, suggesting strong daylight.

The sky above the building is clear and pale blue, occupying much of the upper part of the image. On the far right edge of the building, a small dome-shaped security camera is mounted near the corner. A beige vertical structural section is partially visible on the right side, contrasting with the gray facade and blue glass. At the bottom corners, small bits of greenery from nearby trees appear, indicating the building is likely part of a landscaped office campus or commercial area.

Overall, the photo emphasizes the CenturyLink branding on a sleek, contemporary corporate building under bright, clear daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示CenturyLink公司标志的现代建筑的照片。建筑物顶部有一个绿色和黄色的圆形标志，下方是黑色的'CenturyLink'字样。建筑物由灰色的混凝土板构成，上面有规则排列的矩形窗户。照片在白天拍摄，光线明亮且均匀。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor football fan gathering on a sunny day, likely during the 2018 FIFA World Cup in Russia. The scene is viewed from the top of broad stone steps looking down toward a riverside fan zone.

In the foreground and midground, many spectators are seated or standing on the steps. A large number of them are wearing bright blue Iceland football jerseys, some with names and numbers on the back. Several people are draped in Icelandic flags, and one fan near the center-left wears a red, white, and blue Viking-style horned hat. The mood appears relaxed and festive, with fans watching, chatting, walking around, or sitting in groups. Some spectators wear casual summer clothing such as shorts, caps, sunglasses, and T-shirts, suggesting warm weather.

At the center in the distance is a large FIFA Fan Fest stage. The stage is decorated in red and blue World Cup branding, with visible text including “FIFA FAN FEST,” “VOLGOGRAD,” and “2018 FIFA WORLD CUP RUSSIA.” Above the stage is a huge screen showing a live football match on a green pitch. The word “VOLGOGRAD” appears at the top of the large red screen structure. The stage area itself appears mostly empty or between performances, with equipment visible beneath the screen.

The setting is an open plaza or embankment overlooking a wide river. Behind the Fan Fest stage, calm blue water stretches across the background, with a sandy or light-colored shoreline and greenery on the far side. Decorative streetlamps, trees, barriers, and event signage line the area around the stage. The sky is clear and bright, casting strong sunlight and distinct shadows across the steps and plaza.

Overall, the image captures an international football fan atmosphere: a public viewing area in Volgograd, Russia, with Iceland supporters gathered on the steps to watch a World Cup match on a giant screen beside the river.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉了体育赛事观众的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是几位身穿蓝色和白色队服的冰岛足球迷，他们坐在台阶上观看比赛直播。一位戴着圣诞帽的男子站在前方，背对着镜头，似乎在与其他人交谈。其他球迷分散坐或站立，有的手持国旗，表情专注地观看着屏幕上的比赛。背景中，可以看到一个大型的户外屏幕，上面显示着2018年世界杯的比赛信息，周围有树木、建筑和其他人群。

caption:
The image shows the front façade of an old historic church or chapel photographed from a low angle, making the building appear tall and imposing. The structure has pale cream or off-white plaster walls that are visibly aged and weathered, with many areas of peeling paint, exposed patches, cracks, and discoloration. The wear gives the building an antique, timeworn character.

At the center is a tall entrance section with a pointed Gothic-style arch. The main doors are muted turquoise-green double doors, set beneath a recessed archway. Above the doorway is a decorative star-shaped motif, dark green or black with gold rays radiating outward, forming a striking geometric ornament. The same golden star theme appears higher up on the façade, above the central upper window, where a sunburst-like golden emblem is mounted.

The architecture features several narrow, pointed-arch windows with dark framing and leaded glass panes. A prominent central arched window rises above the entrance, framed by layered curved plaster molding. On either side of it, taller narrow arched windows are set into the upper wall. The façade has a Baroque or Gothic Revival feel, with curved rooflines, pointed arches, and ornamental details.

Near the top of the building, a small greenish metal cupola or lantern rises from the roofline. It has a pointed roof and is topped with a gold sphere and a small weather vane or cross-like finial. Black gutters and downspouts trace the edges of the roof and walls, contrasting with the pale plaster.

The ground in front of the building is covered with a thin layer of snow, suggesting winter. The sky above is bright with patches of blue and large, soft clouds. Sunlight hits the right side of the image, creating slight lens flare near the building and adding a cold but luminous atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a weathered yet elegant church façade, rich with historic architectural details and decorative star symbols.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂正面的摄影作品，建筑风格具有哥特式特征，包括尖顶、拱形窗户和装饰性的门。建筑物的外墙呈浅色调，表面有轻微的磨损痕迹，显示出一定的历史感。门上方有一个星形图案，增添了宗教象征意义。背景中可以看到蓝天和散布的白云，以及部分积雪覆盖的地面上方。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit urban landscape in a dry, coastal city. A large expanse of clear pale-blue sky fills the upper half of the frame, giving the scene a bright, hot, midday feel.

On the right side, the most prominent structure is a tall brown residential apartment tower. It has a grid-like façade with many small rectangular windows and visible air-conditioning units installed below or beside many of them. The building’s side has rows of balconies or recessed openings, and the rooftop includes white cylindrical water tanks and small utility structures. Next to it is a narrower pink-and-cream mid-rise building with blue-tinted balcony openings and a more decorative façade.

Near the center are several beige and cream apartment buildings of varying heights. Some have arched window details and rooftop water tanks, typical of dense urban residential areas in hot climates. The buildings are closely packed, with small gaps between them, and there are scattered trees and palms at street level.

The foreground is busier and more rugged. At the bottom edge are low-rise commercial shopfronts with colorful signs, including Arabic and English text. Some signs appear to advertise restaurants, laundry services, groceries, and other small businesses. The roofs of these lower buildings are cluttered with satellite dishes, water tanks, air-conditioning units, and miscellaneous equipment. There are also rough, dusty lots, construction debris, temporary fencing, and unpaved roads.

On the left foreground, an unfinished concrete building is visible, with exposed floors, columns, and dark window openings, suggesting ongoing or halted construction. Around it are parked cars and small utility structures.

The lower right side contains a parking area and a dusty road with many white and light-colored cars, vans, and a few darker vehicles. The roads and open lots look sandy and unpaved in places, with tire tracks and patches of dirt.

In the distance, beyond the mid-rise buildings, there appears to be a waterfront or harbor area. A strip of water is visible to the right, with boats or docked vessels along the edge. Farther back, faint industrial structures, cranes, towers, and port equipment can be seen through a light haze, suggesting a working port or industrial zone. The atmosphere looks slightly dusty or humid, softening the distant skyline.

Overall, the scene combines residential high-rises, small commercial streets, construction sites, parking lots, and a distant harbor-industrial background, all under a bright, cloudless sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影图像，前景中有一栋正在建设中的建筑，其周围停放着多辆汽车。中景显示了两座相邻的高层住宅楼，以及一座较低矮的商业建筑。背景是城市的天际线，可以看到更多的建筑物和远处的水域。整个场景在晴朗的天气下被捕捉，阳光照耀下的城市生活氛围清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows the inside of a Claire’s-style accessories and jewelry store, brightly lit with a strong purple-and-white color scheme. The scene is packed with merchandise, especially jewelry, hair accessories, and piercing-related items.

On the left side, a large wall display is covered with rows of hooks holding lavender product cards, many branded “claire’s.” The cards display necklaces, bracelets, chokers, earrings, hair bands, chains, and decorative accessories. The jewelry varies in color and style: gold and silver chains hang in long clusters, black lace chokers and darker accessories appear in sections, and some items feature pearls, beads, charms, or small pendants. The wall behind the products is white with horizontal slats, allowing the hooks to be arranged in dense rows. Near the lower-left/middle area, a round hanging sign reads “GIVE THE GIFT PIERCING.”

In the foreground, slightly left of center, a shopper stands facing the jewelry wall. Their face is blurred, but they appear to have long dark hair and are wearing a gray coat with a high collar. They have a light-colored, fuzzy or textured backpack over one shoulder. One hand is raised toward the display as if examining or selecting an item, while the other holds a small product card.

The back wall and corner of the shop continue the purple theme, with purple trim and panels. More jewelry displays extend into the background, including long rows of dangling gold and silver necklaces and blue-backed display cards. There are framed promotional posters on the back wall showing close-up images of models wearing earrings and other jewelry. One poster advertises “body jewelry” with the phrase “wear it your way.”

On the right side of the image, a freestanding display rack is partially in focus in the foreground. It holds rows of small packaged items, likely earrings, studs, or body jewelry, mounted on gray and purple cards. Above it, a large white promotional sign reads “GIVE THE MOST” and “Absolutely Everything BUY 3 GET 3 FREE,” with “FREE” printed very large in black. The sign uses bright pink and green lettering for emphasis. Below the sign, another purple notice is partially visible, mentioning shoplifting prosecution.

The store feels crowded and visually busy, with merchandise covering almost every available surface. The lighting is warm from ceiling spotlights, and the wide-angle perspective makes the aisles and displays appear slightly stretched, giving the image an immersive retail-store feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内商店环境的照片，一位顾客正在查看挂在墙上的商品。商店内部装饰以紫色为主色调，墙上挂满了各种珠宝和配饰，包括项链、耳环和其他饰品。在图片的右侧，可以看到一个宣传牌，上面写着'BUY 3 GET 3 FREE'，暗示着商店正在进行促销活动。

caption:
The image shows a large, brightly lit exhibition booth at an indoor trade fair or design/products show. The booth has a clean, modern, mostly white design with glossy display platforms and tall white light poles rising above the counters. The lighting is strong and even, with multiple rectangular overhead fixtures illuminating the products.

In the foreground, a wide red carpet runs along the left side of the aisle, contrasting with the gray concrete floor on the right. A man in dark clothing is walking away from the camera on the right edge of the image, carrying something in one hand. Several other visitors and staff members are visible inside and around the booth, partly obscured by the displays.

The main booth appears to feature lifestyle and design products. Across the front counters are colorful items branded with **PANTONE**, including mugs, small containers, notebooks or trays, and rectangular color-swatch-like products arranged in bright rows of red, yellow, green, blue, purple, and orange. The word **PANTONE** is printed prominently in large black letters on the front of the display.

Behind the Pantone display, a wall section includes decorative clock-like objects and circular designs, with partial large lettering reading something like “INVOT…” or similar. To the right, there is a white wall with signage for **j-me**, with smaller text underneath reading “original d…” partially cut off. Nearby are posters and product displays labeled **“lunch box”**, showing images of food containers and accessories.

At the top of the booth, red square signs read **MORONI GOMMA**, mounted on the white walls. The booth structure includes metal trusses overhead, with hanging lights and rigging visible. Green emergency exit signs are also visible in the background.

The setting is a large convention hall with a high industrial ceiling, exposed beams, suspended lighting, and hall signage. A black sign on the left reads **Hall 13**, indicating the exhibition hall number. Other neighboring booths are visible in the background, including darker displays with clothing and decorative items. The overall atmosphere is professional, polished, and busy, typical of a design, home goods, or lifestyle trade show.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在室内展览空间内的照片，其中一位穿着深色西装的男性正从左侧走过。展览空间被分为多个展位，每个展位前都有一个白色的展台和展示架，上面陈列着各种设计产品，包括书籍、装饰品和其他创意物品。背景中可以看到其他参观者和更多的展位，整个场景由顶部的照明设备照亮，营造出专业而活跃的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a broad sunlit city square under a clear, vivid blue sky. The composition is dominated by a very tall stone column slightly left of center, rising from a stepped base. At the top of the column stands a dark bronze or green-patina statue of a robed religious figure, possibly a bishop or saint, with one arm raised in a gesture of blessing. The column itself is pale, cylindrical, and segmented with subtle reddish bands and weathering marks.

To the right of the column is an ornate historic building with a large arched entrance and decorative stonework. Its façade features classical architectural details: carved reliefs, columns, rounded niches, ornamental panels, and a balustrade above the entrance. Behind and beside it are beige stone buildings with rectangular windows, balconies, shutters, and rooftop antennas. A square tower-like structure rises behind the ornate façade.

In the right foreground, an elegant black streetlamp with elaborate scrollwork stands prominently. It has multiple hanging glass lamps, giving it an old-fashioned decorative appearance. Similar smaller lamps appear throughout the square.

On the left side of the scene, there is a red and beige historic building with symmetrical windows, decorative trim, and balconies. At street level, small shops or storefronts are visible, including signage and awnings. Near the center bottom, a kiosk or newsstand with a dark roof sits at the base of the column, surrounded by pedestrians and bicycles.

The square itself is paved with light stone and has scattered groups of people walking, standing, sitting, and gathering in the open space. Some people appear to be tourists, and there are bicycles parked near the kiosk. Trees and planters add greenery near the ornate building. The strong sunlight creates crisp shadows, emphasizing the warm stone textures and the bright Mediterranean atmosphere of the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场的摄影图像，中心位置是一个高耸的圆柱形纪念碑，顶端装饰着一个雕像。纪念碑前方是宽阔的广场，上面有行人和一些休息的人们。广场的一侧是一座具有哥特式风格的大教堂，其拱门上方有一个钟楼。在教堂旁边是一排传统的建筑，有着鲜艳的红色屋顶。整个场景被一片晴朗的蓝天所包围，阳光明媚，为这个城市空间增添了活力与色彩。

caption:
The image shows a busy, modern airport terminal viewed from behind a traveler standing in the foreground on the right side. The traveler appears to be walking or pausing while facing into the terminal, carrying a large black backpack with a water bottle in the side pocket and a small travel tag attached. They are wearing a blue long-sleeved top and jeans. Resting across their right shoulder is a long, cylindrical object wrapped in grayish protective material and secured with dark straps or cords, extending horizontally toward the center of the image.

The terminal is spacious and brightly lit, with a high industrial-style ceiling made of white metal beams and many recessed lights. Large windows line the upper right side, letting in natural light and giving the scene an airy, open feeling. The polished floor reflects the overhead lights and the movement of people.

In the background, many passengers are scattered throughout the hall, most slightly out of focus. Some are walking with rolling suitcases, others are standing near counters or moving through the central concourse. A woman pushing a luggage cart is visible near the middle, and several travelers with bags and suitcases move in different directions, creating a sense of airport activity and transit.

On the right side, there is a row of teal-colored service or check-in counters with illuminated screens above them. Farther back, additional signage and counters are visible but blurred. On the left, another row of counters or service areas stretches into the distance beneath a white overhang.

At the top of the image, a large overhead sign hangs prominently. It includes icons and text for “Rent a car,” “Uscita / Exit 4,” a parking symbol with a euro sign, and a large downward arrow or turn symbol, indicating directions for airport services and exits. The sign reinforces the setting as an airport or transportation hub.

Overall, the image captures the atmosphere of a crowded airport terminal: bright, busy, and full of travelers in motion, with the main focus on a backpacked passenger carrying an oversized wrapped item while navigating the space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示机场候机大厅内部的现实主义风格照片。在画面中心，一位背对镜头的人穿着蓝色上衣和黑色裤子，背着一个大型背包，正从左向右移动。他似乎正在使用手机或耳机，可能是通过无线耳机与他人交谈。周围是其他等待登机的旅客，他们中的一些人拖着行李箱，而其他人则在排队等候。整个场景被明亮的室内灯光照亮，营造出一种忙碌但有序的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an action shot of three touring-style race cars driving closely together on a racetrack, captured at a tilted angle that emphasizes speed and cornering.

In the foreground, the leading car dominates the frame. It is a white SEAT race car with bold red, yellow, and black graphics. Large sponsor text reading “LA TORRE” is printed across the hood and side, while “Hispakart” appears in red on a yellow windshield banner. The car has a low, aggressive front bumper, large air intakes, a black grille with the SEAT badge, and a wide racing body kit. Its gold-colored wheels and slick racing tires are visible, and the front splitter sits very close to the asphalt. Various sponsor decals, including Michelin and Valeo, are placed around the front bumper and fenders. The number “14” is visible on the side.

Behind it, two more race cars follow closely in line. The middle car is mostly white with red and blue accents, also featuring a windshield banner and racing livery. It is partially obscured by the lead car but appears to be taking the same racing line through the turn.

The third car, farther back on the right, has a red, white, and blue livery with bright lime-green side mirrors. It has a large rear wing and a wide, low front end, suggesting a high-performance touring or silhouette race car. A yellow banner stretches across its windshield, and multiple sponsor logos are visible on its front and sides.

The cars are on a dark asphalt racing surface, leaning into a bend. Red-and-white curbing runs along the lower edge of the track, with a green painted runoff area just beyond it. In the background, a white concrete wall and chain-link safety fence line the circuit, with a grassy embankment behind them. The entire composition conveys high-speed motorsport action, close competition, and aggressive cornering on a professional race circuit.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三辆赛车在赛道上激烈竞速的摄影照片。最前方的赛车是白色的，带有黄色和红色条纹，车身上印有'LA TORRE'字样，以及赞助商的标志。紧随其后的是一辆蓝色和白色相间的赛车，上面有'Hispanoart'的标志。第三辆车同样装饰着赞助商的标识，颜色为红色和白色。所有车辆都配备了专业的赛车轮胎，并且车身设计以提高空气动力学性能。背景中可以看到部分赛道围栏和草地，但焦点明显集中在这些高速行驶的赛车上。

caption:
The image shows a grand historic palace or classical building viewed from a low, angled perspective, emphasizing its long façade and ornate roofline. The architecture is richly decorative, with red brick walls contrasted by pale stone trim, columns, cornices, and sculptural details.

Along the front of the building are tall arched windows with white frames, set between vertical pilasters and elaborate carved capitals. Above some of the windows are sculpted busts or decorative reliefs. At ground level, a raised stone base supports a series of large classical statues standing on pedestals. These statues depict draped human figures and mythological-looking characters, some holding objects or posed dramatically.

The roofline is especially ornate. A balustrade runs along the top edge, and numerous dark stone sculptures sit or stand above it, including groups of cherub-like figures, seated figures, and dramatic allegorical statues. The sculptural decoration continues across the entire visible length of the building, giving it a highly theatrical Baroque or Rococo appearance.

On the right side, a domed tower rises above the roof. The dome has a weathered greenish-copper patina and is topped by a small open cupola. At the very top is a golden bird-like ornament, possibly an eagle, standing on a sphere and finial. More statues are arranged around the dome’s base.

On the left side of the image, part of the building is covered in scaffolding and translucent construction sheeting, suggesting restoration or maintenance work. Metal scaffolding poles and platforms are visible against the façade.

The sky is bright blue with faint wisps of cloud, and the sunlight casts crisp shadows on the building, highlighting the textures of brick, stone, and sculpture. The foreground consists of a pale gravel or sandy walkway, with a low stone wall and basement-level barred windows running along the base of the palace. The overall impression is of a monumental European palace façade, richly ornamented and partially under restoration.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座红砖建筑的摄影图像，建筑装饰着众多精致的雕塑和雕像。建筑的设计复杂而精美，包括多个圆顶、尖塔和精细的窗户。在建筑顶部，可以看到一些人物雕塑，它们似乎在进行某种表演或仪式。整个场景被蓝天和几朵白云衬托，营造出一种庄严而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, tropical architectural scene viewed from a low angle through lush greenery. In the foreground, out-of-focus green leaves and plants create a soft natural frame along the bottom edge, while a tree trunk and dense bamboo-like foliage fill the left side. The vegetation is vibrant and sunlit, with palm fronds and broad leaves emphasizing a warm, humid setting.

Behind the greenery are large traditional-style buildings with distinctive steep, sweeping roofs. The central building is tall and pale, with white or light gray wooden wall panels and intricate perforated latticework around its large arched opening. Its roof has a dramatic curved gable with dark gray edging and reddish-brown underside panels, giving it a grand, ceremonial appearance. A small triangular decorative panel with colored glass or patterned detail is visible near the top beneath the roof peak.

To the right, a second similar building is partially visible, also raised and featuring a sharply curved roofline, pale wall panels, and decorative lattice windows. Lower red-tiled roofs appear beneath and around the main structures, suggesting a larger complex of connected buildings or pavilions.

A raised walkway or terrace with a balustrade runs across the lower middle of the scene. It has vertical posts topped with rounded finials, and a few small human figures can be seen in the distance along the walkway, giving a sense of scale. Palm trees stand near the buildings, their fronds partly obscuring the architecture.

The sky above is a vivid blue with scattered white clouds, and the strong sunlight creates crisp highlights on the roofs, walls, and leaves. Overall, the image conveys a serene tropical heritage site or traditional palace-like complex surrounded by abundant greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示东南亚风格建筑的照片，前景中有茂密的绿色植物遮挡了部分视线。建筑物具有典型的木质结构和尖顶设计，屋顶上装饰有精美的雕花。在建筑前方，可以看到一个带有栏杆的露台，上面摆放着一些装饰品。背景中蓝天清澈，几朵白云悠闲地飘浮着。

caption:
The image shows a person standing near a waterfront, holding a camera as if preparing to take a photo or reviewing a shot. The person is positioned slightly right of center and shown in profile, facing left. Their face is intentionally blurred, while the surrounding objects are more visible.

They are wearing a dark baseball cap, over-ear headphones, and a dark jacket or fleece with a raised hood around the neck. The headphones appear to be black, with a visible brand marking on the earcup. The person is holding a mirrorless or DSLR-style camera with both hands. The camera has a large zoom lens attached, with a prominent front glass element and a red ring near the lens barrel, suggesting a higher-end lens. A small flip-out screen or accessory is visible near the back of the camera.

The background is softly out of focus, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect. Behind the person is a body of water, likely a harbor, bay, or river, with pale blue-gray tones. Across the water, there are indistinct shapes of buildings or hills, blurred by distance and haze. The lighting is bright but diffused, giving the scene a calm, slightly misty atmosphere.

On the far right side of the image, a large dark, bell-shaped object hangs in the foreground, heavily blurred. It may be part of a boat, dock structure, or hanging fixture. There is also a vertical dark frame or railing along the right edge, suggesting the person may be standing on or near a boat, ferry, or sheltered waterfront structure.

The composition emphasizes the photographer and their camera, while the blurred background and foreground create a layered, candid feel. The overall mood is quiet and observational, capturing someone focused on photography in an outdoor waterfront setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位摄影师在船上拍摄的现实主义风格照片。摄影师穿着深色外套，戴着帽子和耳机，专注地通过相机镜头捕捉着远处的景象。他的脸部被模糊处理以保护隐私。船上的铃铛清晰可见，位于图片的右侧边缘。背景是模糊的海面和陆地轮廓，暗示了摄影师可能正在航行中或靠近海岸线。

caption:
The image shows a bright coastal seascape on a clear day. Most of the frame is filled with vivid blue water and a pale, cloudless sky, creating a calm, open atmosphere.

In the foreground and lower half of the image, the sea is a striking turquoise-blue, becoming darker farther from shore. Small ripples and gentle waves texture the surface. A group of swimmers is scattered across the water near the bottom and center of the scene; only their heads, shoulders, and arms are visible above the surface. Some appear to be floating or treading water, while others are swimming leisurely. The people are spread out, giving the scene a relaxed beach or cove feeling.

On the right side of the image, a white sailboat is anchored on the deeper blue water. Its tall mast rises high into the sky, with thin rigging lines extending down to the deck. The sails are not raised; instead, the boat appears stationary and at rest. A dark canopy or cover shades part of the cockpit, and a few details such as ropes, railings, and small flags are visible. The boat’s hull sits low and stable on the water, adding a peaceful nautical focal point to the composition.

In the background, a large mountainous coastline stretches across the entire width of the image. The mountains are rugged and dry-looking, with a mix of gray rocky slopes, pale tan patches, and darker green vegetation. The terrain slopes down toward the sea, forming a long, uneven shoreline. The mountains appear slightly hazy in the distance, suggesting heat, humidity, or atmospheric perspective.

The sky above is a soft, even blue with no visible clouds. The lighting is strong and sunny, casting crisp highlights on the water and giving the scene a summery Mediterranean feel. Overall, the image conveys a tranquil vacation setting: clear water, swimmers enjoying the sea, a sailboat anchored nearby, and dramatic rocky mountains in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩活动的自然风光摄影图像。在清澈的蓝色海水中，多个人物正在游泳或玩耍，享受着阳光和海水的乐趣。一艘白色的帆船停泊在画面的右侧，船上似乎有几个人。远处是连绵起伏的山脉，山脚下可以看到一些低矮的建筑结构。天空晴朗，没有云彩，为这个宁静的场景增添了和谐与宁静的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a military-looking display or vehicle-mounted exhibit in an urban street setting. In the foreground, a large olive-green unmanned helicopter or drone-like aircraft is mounted on the flatbed of a heavy transport vehicle or trailer. The aircraft has a compact, rounded fuselage with camouflage-style darker green patches, a small tail fin at the rear, and a rotor assembly on top. The rotor blades are long, thin, and appear stationary, with a mechanical hub and support structure visible above the body. There are also landing skids or tubular supports beneath the fuselage.

Along the flatbed, several long cylindrical objects are mounted horizontally on both sides of the aircraft. They resemble military tubes or launch canisters, painted dark gray with reddish-orange caps or end sections. The platform itself is dark green and industrial, with brackets, tie-down cables, and small orange reflectors visible along the edge.

Behind the vehicle is a beige/yellow building façade with white-framed windows. The wall has some chipped paint and scuff marks, giving it a slightly worn appearance. A tall gray vertical pipe runs down the building near the center-right of the image. On the right side, there is decorative white architectural ornamentation around part of the building entrance or façade.

A leafy green tree partially obscures the building and overlaps the rotor area, adding a natural element to the otherwise mechanical scene. At the lower left, a storefront sign with Cyrillic lettering is partially visible, along with an advertisement that appears to show a wristwatch. Two people can be seen partially behind the mounted aircraft near the bottom center, but they are mostly obscured by the vehicle and equipment.

The lighting is bright and direct, suggesting daytime sunshine. Strong shadows fall across the building and the military equipment, emphasizing the shapes of the rotor mast, fuselage, and surrounding structures. Overall, the scene appears to depict a military parade, exhibition, or transport of an unmanned aerial system through a city street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在城市街道上的军事装备的照片。照片中心是一个绿色的军用无人机，其上装有多个天线和传感器。无人机被放置在一个卡车的平台上，车身上布满了各种管道和电线。在无人机的背后，可以看到一幢建筑物的一部分，上面写着'NACHTWEI'，表明这可能是一家商店或餐馆。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a textile or weaving workshop filled with colorful handmade fabrics. The scene is viewed from a slightly shadowed foreground, with a dark vertical area on the right partially framing the view and creating a sense of looking into the room from a doorway or side passage.

At the center is a traditional wooden loom made from simple, sturdy poles and beams. A woman sits behind it, partially obscured by the loom and the rows of fabric; her face is blurred. She is wearing a turquoise-blue top with patterned details and appears to be working at the loom or seated in front of it. Thin vertical threads and weaving components hang from the frame, suggesting an active hand-weaving setup.

The room is densely decorated with textiles. Across the top of the image hang rectangular woven pieces in muted but rich tones—brown, charcoal, teal, purple, red, and blue—many with small square cutout-like color blocks and fringed bottoms. Behind the loom, shelves or hanging displays show folded and draped fabrics in bright colors: pink, turquoise, red, purple, white, navy, and green.

In the foreground, a large display of scarves or woven cloths is arranged in neat horizontal rows. The fabrics are vivid and varied, featuring shiny and matte textures, stripes, geometric patterns, and fringed ends. Colors include bright red, orange, gold, turquoise, magenta, lavender, green, blue, and cream. The lower row especially stands out with saturated warm colors and decorative woven borders.

On the left side, more textiles hang vertically, including darker patterned pieces with intricate geometric and floral-like designs in yellow, red, teal, purple, and orange. Sunlight enters from the left, illuminating part of the concrete floor and highlighting the texture and sheen of the fabrics. The overall atmosphere is warm, artisanal, and vibrant, emphasizing traditional weaving craftsmanship and a rich variety of handmade textiles.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统手工艺的摄影作品，画面中心是一位正在织布机上工作的女性。她穿着蓝色衣服，专注地操作着机器。在她的背后和两侧，挂满了色彩鲜艳、图案各异的手工艺品，包括传统的地毯和纺织品。阳光从画面左侧照射进来，为整个场景增添了温暖而生动的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor display of colorful decorative parasols or umbrellas in a grassy park-like setting, likely at an art or cultural festival.

In the foreground, dominating the right side of the image, is a very large open parasol tilted toward the viewer. Its surface is elaborately hand-painted with a complex narrative design. The center is mostly sky blue with pale cloud-like shapes and a radiant sun motif near the middle, painted in cream, red, and gold rays around the umbrella’s central hub. Around the blue center are detailed illustrations: birds, flowers, tree branches, mythological or traditional figures, small red cherub-like characters, a temple or ancient structure, and a seated figure at the bottom wearing ornate clothing and a headdress. The outer border is black with decorative patterns in red, gold, brown, green, and cream, including repeating batik-like geometric bands and floral elements. The parasol’s ribs create visible panel divisions across the artwork.

To the left, several smaller umbrellas are displayed on a bamboo framework shaped like a low dome or arch. These umbrellas are brightly colored: one is green with concentric circles of purple, orange, and pink; another is red with a radial spoke pattern; others have yellow, orange, green, and multicolored designs. Some appear crocheted or lace-like, while others are painted or woven. Small tags hang from a few of them, suggesting they may be part of an exhibition or market display.

The setting is outdoors on a lawn with short green grass. In the background are tall trees with dense foliage, casting partial shade, and several vertical bamboo poles or scaffolding structures. A few people can be seen standing and walking behind the umbrella display, partly obscured by the parasols and bamboo frames. The scene is brightly lit by sunlight, giving the colors a vivid, festive appearance and creating strong shadows on the grass beneath the large umbrella. Overall, the image feels like a vibrant craft fair or cultural art installation centered on traditional decorated parasols.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统手工艺伞的照片，伞面绘有丰富的图案和色彩。伞的中心是一个太阳图案，周围环绕着动物、植物和其他装饰性元素。伞的边缘装饰有几何形状和复杂的线条图案。在伞的背景中，可以看到其他几把类似的伞，它们放置在一个户外草地上，背景中有树木和一些模糊的人影。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor riverside plaza on a bright, clear day. The sky dominates much of the scene, a vivid blue filled with large, soft white cumulus clouds.

On the left side stands a large dark metal monument mounted on a tall rectangular stone pedestal. The sculpture depicts two heroic-style figures in dramatic motion. One figure appears to be standing or stepping forward while holding a long flagpole with a large billowing flag that extends upward and to the right, creating a strong diagonal shape against the sky. Another figure is lower and slightly behind, leaning back or rising upward, adding to the sense of movement and struggle. The statue has a monumental Soviet-era style, with heavy drapery, strong forms, and expressive poses.

The pedestal is made of pale stone blocks and has large engraved numbers on the front, appearing to read “1905.” Wide stone steps lead up to the base of the monument. Around the steps and plaza, several people are gathered; some hold bright red flags on poles. The red flags stand out strongly against the gray stone and blue sky. Some faces in the crowd are blurred. One person in a yellow dress stands to the right, appearing to take a photo or look toward the group near the monument.

In the background to the right, a large steel truss bridge crosses a river. Its repeating arched metal framework stretches horizontally across the image, giving the scene an industrial and historic feel. Beneath the bridge is a calm river with green trees along the far bank. A decorative riverside railing runs along the promenade in front of the water.

There are also small landscaped flowerbeds, a tall streetlamp, and a large evergreen tree partly behind the monument. The overall atmosphere is sunny and open, with the monument, red flags, and bridge creating a strong civic or commemorative setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外雕塑和周围游客的摄影照片。在画面中央，一座巨大的雕塑占据了视觉焦点，它描绘了一个穿着军装的人物，右手高举旗帜，左手握着一把剑，姿态英勇。雕塑下方有几位游客正在拍照或观看，其中一位女士正举起相机拍摄。雕塑背后是一座现代风格的桥梁，以及蓝天和散布的白云。

caption:
The image shows a lively park scene in spring, dominated by large magnolia trees covered in pale pink blossoms. The flowering branches frame the scene on both sides: a dense cluster of blossoms fills the left edge, while a large, spreading magnolia tree with dark twisting branches and abundant pink flowers occupies the right side. More blooming trees line the middle of the park, creating a soft pink canopy across the grass.

In the foreground is a pond with dark greenish water, reflecting the trees, sky, and nearby people. The water surface has gentle ripples, scattered flower petals, and a few ducks swimming near the lower left and center. The pond is bordered by a low, light-colored edge, and on the right side there is a small white platform or decorative structure near the water, beside a seated stone figure or sculpture.

Many people are scattered throughout the park. Some sit on the grass in small groups, relaxing or talking, while others stand near the pond or walk along the paths. A few people appear to be taking photos, especially near the blooming trees. The mood feels leisurely and social, like a warm weekend afternoon. Families, couples, and groups of friends are visible, with some children near the center area.

The background includes a mix of leafless trees, evergreen trees, and urban buildings rising beyond the park. On the upper left, a modern building has large visible signage reading “BAU” and “Bahçeşehir University,” suggesting the park is near or in an urban university area. Behind the trees in the center are additional beige and cream-colored buildings on a slight hill.

The sky is pale blue and lightly hazy, with soft sunlight illuminating the blossoms and grass. The overall atmosphere is bright, peaceful, and festive, with the pink magnolia flowers giving the park a striking springtime beauty.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示春季公园景观的照片，图中粉红色的樱花树盛开，为这个场景增添了生机和色彩。在树木下，人们坐在长椅上休息或站立交谈，享受着温暖的阳光和宜人的气候。池塘中央有一个喷泉，水面上反射着周围的景象。背景中可以看到几座现代建筑，与自然环境形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows the glass pyramid entrance of the **Musée du Louvre** in Paris, viewed from a low, centered perspective that emphasizes its geometric symmetry and scale.

A large transparent pyramid dominates the frame, rising sharply toward the cloudy blue-gray sky. Its surface is made of many triangular and diamond-shaped glass panels held together by a dark metal framework. Through the glass, the intricate internal steel supports are visible, forming a dense lattice of diagonal beams and repeating triangular patterns. The structure reflects both the sky and warm interior lighting, creating a mix of cool blue tones and golden highlights.

At the base of the pyramid is the museum entrance. Above the glass doors, bold white capital letters spell **“MUSEE DU LOUVRE”** across a dark horizontal beam. Beneath the sign are several revolving and glass entry doors, with glimpses of the illuminated interior beyond. Metal queue barriers and stanchions are arranged inside and near the entrance, suggesting the controlled flow of visitors, though the area appears mostly empty.

The foreground consists of wide, dark stone paving slabs leading up to the entrance. On the lower left side, part of a bicycle is visible, leaning near the edge of the scene. The pyramid’s sloping glass sides extend outward to both edges of the frame, creating strong diagonal lines that draw the eye toward the center. Warm lights along the lower interior edges contrast with the cool evening or early-morning atmosphere outside.

The sky above is dramatic and overcast, with soft streaks of clouds in shades of blue, gray, and faint lavender. The overall mood is quiet, architectural, and slightly cinematic, highlighting the contrast between the modern glass pyramid and the historic museum it serves.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示卢浮宫博物馆入口的摄影作品，建筑采用了现代玻璃结构设计，其尖锐的几何形状在黄昏时分显得格外引人注目。图像捕捉了夕阳余晖下的场景，天空呈现出渐变的蓝色和橙色，为整个画面增添了一种温暖而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a polluted riverside or canal-side bathing area, likely at a stepped embankment or ghat. The water is murky greenish-brown and filled with ripples from people bathing or moving through it. Along the shoreline, there is a heavy accumulation of trash and debris: plastic bags, leaves, broken pieces of material, scraps of cloth, sticks, stones, and other waste. A large cardboard box or carton floats partly submerged near the bank.

On the right side, a set of concrete steps descends toward the water. The steps look worn and dusty, with litter scattered on them, including pieces of cloth and small trash items. The edge of the bank is broken and uneven, with cracked concrete slabs and exposed dirt leading down into the water.

Several people are in the water. Near the right side, a woman wearing a bright yellow sari with orange and pink accents stands waist-deep, holding her hands near her face as if praying, washing, or performing a ritual. Beside her is a shirtless man standing in the water, wearing a patterned cloth around his waist. A child or young boy stands nearby, also shirtless, holding what looks like a bundle of rope, reeds, or netting. In the lower part of the image, several other people are swimming or bathing, with only their heads and upper backs visible above the surface.

The contrast in the image is striking: people appear to be using the river for bathing or ritual purposes despite the visibly dirty surroundings. The scene conveys a mix of daily life, religious or cleansing practice, and severe environmental pollution.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现日常生活场景的照片，捕捉了四位成年人在河流中沐浴的瞬间。他们似乎正在享受河水带来的清凉和放松。河流两岸是杂乱无章的垃圾和建筑残骸，而河岸上的楼梯和台阶则显得有些荒凉。照片从高角度拍摄，展现了人们与自然环境的和谐共处。

caption:
The image shows a road-running event or fun run taking place outdoors on a bright sunny day. The scene is shot with a shallow depth of field, so the foreground runners are relatively clear while the background is softly blurred.

In the foreground, slightly right of center, a runner wearing a red sleeveless race shirt is jogging toward the camera. The shirt has yellow trim around the neck and arm openings and includes visible event text reading “MFU RUN 2024.” The runner is also wearing a patterned blue-and-white cap, pink wristbands, and a waist pouch or running belt in bright pink and neon colors. One hand is raised in a running motion near the chest. The runner’s face is intentionally blurred.

To the right, another participant is also moving forward. This person wears a red short-sleeved race shirt, a red visor, earphones, and a diagonal strap across the chest. A blue race bib with the large number “4154” is attached to the front of the shirt. This runner’s face is also blurred.

Behind them, several more runners in red shirts are visible along the course, but they are out of focus. A tall person in red appears directly behind the main foreground runner, and other participants are spaced farther back along the path.

The race course appears to be on a track or paved route with colored lane-like surfaces: a red strip on the left, a blue strip near the center, and a greenish-blue area on the right. Green traffic cones line the route, helping separate lanes or guide runners. On the left side, there are white barricades and multiple vertical event flags or banners in blue, red, yellow, and white, though the text is mostly unreadable due to blur.

The background is filled with lush green trees under strong daylight, giving the scene a warm, energetic outdoor atmosphere. The overall image conveys a lively organized running event, with participants wearing matching red race apparel and moving along a colorful, cone-marked route.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示马拉松比赛场景的照片，前景中有一位女性运动员身穿红色运动服，头戴带有数字'4154'的号码布，正在跑步并做出胜利的手势。她戴着帽子和太阳镜，看起来精神饱满。在她的背后，可以看到其他穿着相同服装的参赛者沿着赛道奔跑，赛道两旁摆放着彩色的旗帜和指示牌。

caption:
The image shows a festive nighttime city scene, likely during a Christmas or Advent celebration. In the foreground is a large holiday installation made of oversized red Christmas baubles piled together on a raised circular platform. The ornaments are dusted with artificial snow, especially along their tops and edges, giving them a frosty winter look. Several of the baubles have white decorative lettering and illustrations; one large ornament near the front reads “ti si MOJA sreća” with hearts, and the word “KONZUM” appears on some of the baubles. Another ornament on the right features an illustrated woman in a green sweater.

The platform beneath the ornaments is covered in red material and scattered with faux snow. Around its edge is a thick garland of snow-dusted evergreen branches. Warm spotlights at the base illuminate the display from below, creating a golden-orange glow on the red ornaments and surrounding snow.

To the right, there is a tall red-and-white striped structure resembling a giant candy cane or festive kiosk. A sign beside it reads “Advent Zagreb,” suggesting the scene is in Zagreb, Croatia, during the Advent season. A closed white patio umbrella stands nearby, and behind it are people walking through the square.

In the background, elegant historic buildings are warmly lit, with rows of illuminated windows and decorative holiday lights along the façades. A large digital billboard on a rooftop shows a close-up image of a wristwatch. On the left side of the street, tall lampposts and hanging Christmas light decorations shaped like sparkling trees or chandeliers line the avenue. The sky is dark, emphasizing the bright festive lighting.

Several pedestrians are visible in the lower left and middle distance, bundled in winter coats, hats, and scarves. Some appear to be passing by or looking at the display. The overall atmosphere is lively, warm, and celebratory, with a strong Christmas-market feel created by the glowing lights, snowy decorations, and oversized ornaments.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日装饰的照片，位于一个繁忙的街道上。照片中心是一个由多个大型圣诞球组成的装饰品，每个球体表面都覆盖着雪花效果，并且装饰有'VOLI MOJU SREĆA'（我的快乐）的文字。装饰品下方有一个绿色的基座，上面撒满了白色的雪花和红色的亮片。在背景中，可以看到人们正在走动，还有其他节日装饰，如彩灯和广告牌，营造出一种欢乐的节日氛围。

caption:
The image shows a tall telecommunications/observation tower rising vertically against a clear, pale blue sky. The tower is centered in the frame and photographed from a distance, emphasizing its height and layered structure.

At the bottom, a dense line of green trees fills the lower edge of the image, partially obscuring the base of the tower. From behind the trees, a thick, smooth, white cylindrical column extends upward. Near the upper portion of this column is a large circular observation or service deck with a rounded, saucer-like underside. Around its edge is a dark band of windows or panels, giving it a ringed appearance.

Above this main deck, the tower narrows and continues upward through several stacked circular platforms. These platforms vary in size and are arranged like discs around the central shaft. Some have dark window bands, railings, antennas, and small technical fixtures attached underneath or around their edges. One mid-level section appears partially wrapped or covered with light-colored material, suggesting maintenance or protective sheeting.

Higher up, the structure becomes more skeletal and industrial. A lattice-like metal framework surrounds the central mast, with red-painted structural elements and antenna equipment visible inside. Near the very top is a long, thin antenna mast painted in alternating red-orange and white horizontal bands. It extends sharply upward and ends with a small cap or fixture.

The overall look is modern and functional, with a futuristic, space-age silhouette created by the stacked circular platforms. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a clear daytime scene. The pale sky provides a minimal background, making the white tower and red-and-white antenna stand out clearly.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的高塔的照片。塔楼高耸，顶部装有天线和卫星接收器，底部是白色的圆柱形结构。塔楼的每个层次都装饰有圆形的平台，颜色从白色过渡到深色，形成鲜明对比。塔楼周围环绕着绿色的树木，与蓝天形成自然的背景。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of several dark granite gravestones in a cemetery, photographed at ground level with a shallow depth of field.

At the center is a rectangular black or dark gray polished stone marker with a speckled granite texture. Its engraved white lettering reads **“LUSZTIG GYÖRGY”**, with the date **“1944/45”** beneath it. Below the date, there is also a line of Hebrew lettering partially visible near the bottom of the stone.

On the left edge of the frame, part of another gravestone is cut off. Only fragments of text are visible, including the ending of a name, **“…NDOR”**, and a line that appears to include **“JANUÁR 18”**. On the right edge, another dark stone is also partially cropped, showing only the beginning of a name or word, **“STE…”**.

Behind the gravestones is a dense wall of glossy green ivy leaves. The leaves are broad, overlapping, and strongly lit by sunlight, creating bright highlights and deep shadows. A pale stone or concrete backing is visible in gaps between the gravestones and the ivy.

The foreground contains bright green grass, slightly out of focus, with a few small blades and light-colored debris or leaves near the base of the central marker. There is also a soft, blurred green haze across the left side and lower parts of the image, likely caused by foliage close to the camera lens.

The overall lighting is vivid and high-contrast, with strong sunlight reflecting off the polished stone and leaves. Some edges, especially along the tops of the gravestones, show a slight purple fringe, giving the image a saturated, almost film-like look. The scene feels quiet and intimate, focused on memorial stones surrounded by lush greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示墓碑的现实主义风格照片，前景中有一块黑色大理石墓碑，上面刻有'LUZSTIG GYÖRGY 1944/45'和'JANUARY 18'字样，以及日期'1944/45'。墓碑下方还用希伯来语写着'CHAI VADIM'。背景模糊地显示了绿色植物，为墓碑增添了一丝自然氛围。

caption:
The image is a black-and-white, wide-format photograph of a young child crouching low on a rough, rocky surface outdoors. The child is positioned slightly right of center, with most of the frame extending to the left as an empty, textured background. Their face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial features, but their head is tilted downward as if looking at the ground or reaching toward something among the stones.

The child has short dark hair and is wearing a light-colored short-sleeved shirt and matching shorts or pajamas printed with cartoon-like space characters, stars, and small figures. One arm reaches down toward the gravel, fingers extended near the stones, while the legs are bent tightly in a squatting posture. The child appears to be wearing simple flip-flops or sandals, one visible beneath the foot.

The foreground is filled with uneven gravel, small rocks, and dirt, giving the scene a rugged, gritty texture. Behind the child is a sloped earthen bank covered with tangled grasses, weeds, roots, and leaves. The background is slightly out of focus, creating depth and drawing attention to the child’s posture and the rocky ground.

The monochrome treatment emphasizes contrast and texture: the pale clothing and skin stand out against the darker, dense vegetation and shadowed earth. The overall mood feels quiet, contemplative, and somewhat somber, with the child appearing absorbed in the ground or in a small activity near their feet.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的照片，展示了一个小孩蹲在覆盖着碎石的地面上。孩子穿着印有图案的短袖上衣和短裤，专注地观察或探索着地上的东西。背景由模糊的灌木丛构成，为照片增添了一种自然的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque winter village scene centered on a pale cream-colored church set against a steep, snowy forested mountainside.

In the lower half of the image, the church stands prominently with soft beige and white walls and decorative trim. Its tall bell tower rises on the left side of the building, topped by a steep, dark brown wooden spire. Near the top of the tower is a small clock face beneath the spire, and below it are arched openings where bells would be housed. A small cross or metal finial sits at the very peak of the spire. Snow rests on the church’s rooflines, ledges, and surrounding structures.

The main body of the church has a steep, snow-covered roof and a front façade with arched architectural details. There are tall arched windows with dark glass or shutters, and a small entrance area at the base. A low fence surrounds the churchyard, partially buried in snow. Around the church are a few neighboring buildings or rooftops, also covered in thick snow, suggesting a small alpine village.

The background dominates the upper portion of the image: a dense forest of dark evergreen trees climbing a mountain slope. Snow lies heavily between the trees and on their branches, creating a high-contrast pattern of white snow and dark trunks and foliage. The slope is rugged and uneven, with vertical lines of trees and irregular snowy patches. The forest gives the scene a secluded, mountainous atmosphere.

The overall mood is calm, cold, and serene. The warm tones of the church’s cream walls and brown steeple contrast beautifully with the white snow and dark green-black forest behind it, making the church feel like a peaceful focal point in a quiet winter landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示雪中教堂的自然风光摄影图像。图中的教堂建筑位于画面中央，其白色外墙在白雪覆盖的地面上显得格外醒目。教堂的尖顶和钟楼清晰可见，顶部装饰着金色的十字架。教堂周围是被积雪覆盖的树木和山坡，为这座建筑增添了一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, shallow-depth-of-field shot of a person’s hands adjusting a piece of equipment outdoors.

In the foreground, a hand is gripping and turning or tightening a small red/orange plastic knob attached to a matching red mounting bracket. The bracket is connected to a light gray metal or aluminum tubular frame, suggesting the object could be part of a folding chair, stroller, carrier, backpack frame, or similar adjustable outdoor gear.

A black woven nylon strap runs vertically along the frame. The strap has visible texture and stitching, with small metal rivets or snap-like fasteners attached to it. One rivet is near the upper center of the image, and another is lower down near the red bracket. The strap appears to be secured around or alongside the gray frame.

Another hand, slightly farther back and more out of focus, steadies the strap or frame from the opposite side. The person is wearing a black wristwatch or fitness watch on the left wrist. Part of a dark shirt or clothing is visible on the left side of the image.

The background is blurred, showing green grass and patches of brown earth, indicating an outdoor setting such as a yard, park, or campsite. The focus is strongly centered on the red adjustment knob, the black strap, and the person’s hand, while the rest of the scene fades softly into the background. The overall impression is of someone assembling, tightening, or adjusting an outdoor item or piece of portable equipment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外活动准备的照片，特写拍摄了一位人物的手正在调整一个橙色的扣件。手部穿着黑色手表和戒指，手指上涂有白色指甲油。背景虽然模糊，但可以看出是在户外，周围是绿色的草地。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit hillside town with tightly packed historic buildings, likely in an old Italian city. The scene is dominated by warm earth tones—terracotta, ochre, peach, tan, and aged brick—contrasting with a vivid blue sky above.

Rows of multi-story buildings climb across the slope, their facades overlapping closely and creating a dense, layered urban texture. Many of the houses have traditional clay-tiled roofs in shades of orange, brown, and gray, with irregular rooflines, chimneys, small antennas, and weathered masonry. The walls vary between exposed brick, stucco, and stone, giving the scene an old, lived-in character.

Most windows are narrow and vertical, many fitted with dark green shutters, while others have pale shutters in cream, gray, or light blue. Some shutters are open, some closed, and a few windows have small balconies or railings. There are bits of everyday life visible: laundry hanging from a balcony, small plants on ledges, and shaded recesses beneath roof overhangs.

Near the center is a taller pale peach building with green shutters, rising above adjacent rooftops. Beside it, a vertical section appears covered in white construction sheeting or scaffolding, suggesting restoration work. To the right are older brick buildings with rough, uneven surfaces and deep shadows around the windows, emphasizing their age and texture.

In the upper right corner, part of a large cathedral or monumental church is visible. Its facade has pale stone with dark horizontal striping and Gothic-style details, including pointed architectural forms and decorative stonework. Only a portion of the structure is shown, but it towers above the surrounding residential buildings.

The light is bright and direct, casting strong shadows across walls and rooftops. The sky is clear and intensely blue, with only a few small white clouds. At the bottom right, green trees and vegetation soften the otherwise dense urban scene, suggesting gardens or a lower hillside area below the buildings.

Overall, the image captures the compact, historic charm of a Mediterranean hill town: crowded medieval-style architecture, terracotta rooftops, weathered walls, shuttered windows, and a dramatic church rising above the residential quarter.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲传统建筑风格的城镇街景照片。画面中，密集排列的房屋以暖色调为主，屋顶覆盖着石板瓦片，窗户和门框呈现经典的绿色木制设计。建筑物之间有狭窄的道路和楼梯，这些元素共同构成了一个充满历史感的居住区。在晴朗的天空下，阳光照耀下的建筑细节清晰可见，营造出一种宁静而古朴的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, atmospheric town square at night, dominated by a brightly illuminated historic church or monastery building in the background. The architecture appears old and ornate, with whitewashed walls, stone trim, arched openings, and a symmetrical bell-tower section rising above the main façade. The upper tower contains visible bells inside arched openings, and a round clock face is set into the stonework. Decorative pinnacles and small domed elements crown the towers, glowing warmly from floodlights placed around the roofline.

A broad stone staircase leads up to the building’s main entrance, which is framed by a series of arches and bathed in golden light. The lower façade stretches horizontally across the scene, with evenly spaced windows and doors, small balconies or railings, and cool white-blue lighting that contrasts with the warmer lights around the entrance and towers.

In the foreground, a large ornate metal bench sits diagonally across the bottom of the image. Its dark, intricate cast-iron frame features curved scrollwork and decorative patterns, creating a strong silhouette against the warm cobblestone ground. Another smaller bench is visible farther back near the center-left, and a trash bin stands near a tall streetlamp.

The streetlamp on the left glows intensely, producing a starburst effect and casting a warm amber light over the square. The cobblestone pavement is uneven and reflective, suggesting dampness or recent rain, and it catches the golden tones from the lighting beautifully. The sky is dark and hazy, with a soft mist or fog that diffuses the lights and gives the scene a calm, almost cinematic mood.

Overall, the image conveys a peaceful historic European plaza at night, combining warm street lighting, cool architectural illumination, ornate public benches, and old stone textures.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜晚城市街景的摄影作品，前景中有一条黑色铁艺长椅，其表面有复杂的花纹装饰。长椅后方是一个明亮的路灯，发出柔和的黄色光芒，为场景增添了一抹温暖的色彩。在远处，一座具有哥特式建筑风格的大教堂占据了画面的中心位置，其金色的尖顶和装饰性的立面在夜色中显得格外引人注目。教堂前的人行道上铺着鹅卵石，而整个场景被一种朦胧的雾气所笼罩，营造出一种神秘而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor parade or marching procession on a paved road, likely in Sabah, Malaysia. A group of uniformed cadets or participants is marching toward the camera in formation.

In the foreground, two uniformed marchers carry a decorated sign bordered with gold tinsel. The sign reads **“KOMANDER KESATRIA UiTM SABAH”**, indicating the group represents the Kesatria commanders of UiTM Sabah. The marchers wear dark green uniforms with white belts, white gloves, black boots, and dark berets or caps. Several have red neck scarves or red accents, and some wear tall red plume decorations on their headgear.

Behind the sign-bearers, more participants march in organized rows. Several large flags are being carried prominently above the group. The most visible flags include the **Malaysian national flag**, with red and white stripes and a blue canton containing a yellow crescent and star, and the **Sabah state flag**, featuring light blue, white, and red horizontal sections with a dark blue mountain silhouette. There is also a yellow flag being carried on the right side of the formation.

The background includes tropical palm trees, greenery, and a partly cloudy sky, giving the scene a warm, coastal or tropical atmosphere. On the right side of the road, a large red, white, and gray truck is parked near a low building with a green roof. A few people in military-style or event staff uniforms stand nearby, watching the procession. On the left side, more parade participants in blue uniforms and red helmets can be seen further back, along with spectators and organizers near the roadside.

Overall, the image captures a formal parade or ceremonial march with multiple groups, flags, uniforms, and coordinated movement, set in a tropical urban or campus-like environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示军事仪式的摄影照片，图中可以看到几位身穿制服的士兵在执行任务。他们手持着马来西亚国旗和一个装饰有金色边缘的标志牌，上面写着'KOMANDER KESATRIA UTMI SABAH'。背景中有一辆停靠的卡车和一些观众，整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一种正式而庄重的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a group of people walking in a parade or festival procession along a paved outdoor path. The setting appears leafy and park-like, with bright green trees overhead, dappled sunlight, and a white picket fence running along the right side. A white railroad-crossing-style sign is visible in the background on the left, adding to the outdoor public-event atmosphere.

The people are dressed in elaborate historical, Renaissance, Scottish, or fantasy-inspired costumes. Several wear tartan kilts, tall socks, boots, and decorative belts. Many are carrying long poles, staffs, spears, or ceremonial weapons. The faces are blurred, but the clothing and accessories are very detailed.

At the center front is a person in a Renaissance-style outfit: a brown hat, a brown and cream vest with gold trim, puffy white sleeves, a light-colored skirted tunic or doublet, black leggings, and tall black boots. They carry a tall staff or pole upright in front of them, topped with an ornate black-and-gold handle. A small dark leather pouch hangs at their waist.

To the left foreground, a person in a green shirt and dark green tartan kilt is playing or carrying bagpipes. The bagpipes have black pipes with silver accents and red tassels. Nearby, another person in a dark hooded outfit and kilt carries a long spear or polearm and wears layered necklaces and accessories. Behind them, a figure in a richly decorated red and gold gown or robe is partly visible, suggesting a royal or ceremonial costume.

On the right foreground, a person in a tan uniform-style shirt, green tartan kilt, white spats or gaiters, and black shoes carries another set of bagpipes with a green bag and blue-green cover. Their outfit includes a dark cap with colorful patches, medals or ribbons on the shirt, a wide belt with a large buckle, and a traditional sporran hanging at the front of the kilt.

Behind the central figure are more participants in black and green outfits, including one wearing a black tunic with silver decorative chains or badges. A dog is faintly visible near the lower center-right among the walkers, partially hidden by legs and costumes.

Overall, the scene has the feeling of a Renaissance fair, Celtic festival, historical reenactment, or themed parade, with participants marching together in coordinated traditional and fantasy-inspired attire under bright summer greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统苏格兰风格的户外活动的照片。在图像的中心，一位穿着棕色上衣和白色裤子的男子正拿着一把长枪，他旁边是一位穿着绿色格子裙和白色衬衫的男子正在吹奏风笛。在他们周围，其他参与者也身着传统的苏格兰服装，包括红色裙子、黑色上衣和白色裤子的女性以及穿着深色格子裙和白色衬衫的男性。背景中可以看到一些树木和一堵灰色的墙，但这些元素并不突出，它们为这个文化庆典提供了一个自然的环境。

caption:
The image shows a large yellow construction dump truck unloading a load of gray gravel or crushed stone onto a street in a residential area.

The truck’s dump bed is raised steeply, tilted upward so that the material slides toward the open rear end. A thick pile of loose aggregate fills most of the yellow metal bed, and a stream of gravel is actively pouring out from the back, falling in a scattered cascade onto the ground below. Some of the stones are midair, creating a spray-like effect as they drop into a growing pile on the road.

The vehicle is heavy-duty, with very large, deeply treaded tires covered in dust and dirt. The side of the raised bed has visible wear, scratches, mud stains, and construction grime. A “JCB” logo and the number “714” are visible on the side panel, indicating it is likely a JCB articulated dump truck. The cab is partially visible on the right side, with a black-framed windshield and side mirror.

The setting appears to be a narrow urban or residential street. On the left side, there is a multi-story apartment building with balconies, railings, windows, and shaded storefront-like shutters at street level. Green vines or leafy plants grow along the building frontage. On the right side, there are large leafy trees casting shadows onto the road and the truck. Behind the truck, parts of a fence, a small building with a tiled roof, and more greenery can be seen.

The lighting is bright and sunny, with strong highlights on the yellow truck and pale road surface. The scene suggests active roadwork or construction, with the truck delivering gravel or aggregate to be spread along the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黄色挖掘机在城市街道上倾倒混凝土的实景摄影图像。挖掘机的铲斗正从侧面倾倒出大量的混凝土，周围散落着一些小石块和碎屑。机器前方的地面上留有清晰的轮胎印迹，而背景中可以看到几棵树木和一些建筑物。

caption:
This is a wide aerial panorama of a large city spread across a hilly landscape under a bright blue sky.

In the foreground, there is a dense urban district with many mid-rise and high-rise apartment blocks. The buildings vary in color and style: gray concrete apartment buildings, white and cream towers, red-brick structures, pastel-colored facades, and some buildings with bright green, blue, orange, or red roofs. The architecture looks like a mix of older rectangular residential blocks and newer taller apartment towers. Streets run between the buildings in a grid-like pattern, with small parked cars visible along roads and courtyards.

Near the lower middle of the image, there is a rectangular sports field or small soccer pitch with dark green turf, enclosed by fencing. Around it are residential buildings, trees, and paved roads. Scattered patches of greenery and rows of trees break up the dense city blocks.

In the middle distance, the city becomes more varied and slightly less dense. There are clusters of smaller houses and low-rise buildings climbing the surrounding hills. Many rooftops are brightly colored—blue, red, orange, and green—creating a speckled pattern across the slopes. Roads wind through the hills, connecting neighborhoods that spread outward from the central urban area.

The background is dominated by rolling green-brown hills and low mountains. The hills are mostly open and grassy, with neighborhoods scattered across their lower slopes and valleys. Farther back, the hills fade into bluish tones, giving a sense of depth and distance.

The sky takes up a large portion of the upper image. It is vivid blue with numerous puffy white cumulus clouds scattered across it. The lighting is strong and clear, suggesting a sunny day with good visibility. Overall, the image shows a sprawling city nestled among rolling hills, combining dense apartment districts in the foreground with hillside residential areas and open landscapes beyond.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的航拍照片，图像中心是一个密集的城市街区，其中包含了多层住宅和一些低矮的建筑。在画面的远处，可以看到连绵起伏的山脉，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。整个场景被阳光照耀着，天空中散布着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows a busy Japanese-style street food stall or market stand, likely serving grilled seafood. A row of bright red-orange paper lanterns hangs across the top of the stall, creating a warm, festive atmosphere. Some lanterns have black-and-white Japanese writing on them, and their glow visually dominates the scene.

On the right side, a vendor wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and blue gloves stands with his back and side turned toward the camera, working over a rectangular metal charcoal grill. On the grill are several pieces of seafood, including large shrimp or prawns and shellfish, being cooked over the heat. The grill is darkened and stained from use, with metal tongs hanging nearby and cooking tools scattered around the work area.
