Across the middle of the image is a row of houses and structures built on stilts over the water. The buildings appear weathered and practical, with a mix of materials including wood, corrugated metal, and painted siding. On the left, a prominent house has bright blue walls and a rusty orange corrugated roof. It stands on wooden and concrete supports, with an open shaded area beneath and a small platform or walkway extending over the water.

Near the center, several connected stilt houses and decks form a busy waterfront cluster. One larger building has a reddish-brown roof and pale green lower walls, with a veranda or balcony facing the water. Laundry or fabric appears to be hanging along parts of the railing. Beneath and around the houses are many vertical support posts, ladders, steps, and small platforms. A small yellow boat is tied near the center-right, close to a wooden staircase descending toward the water.

To the right, a long wooden walkway or pier runs horizontally across the scene, supported by many evenly spaced posts. More low buildings continue along the waterfront, some with green trim and pale walls. Utility poles, wires, antennas, and small rooftop details are visible, emphasizing the lived-in nature of the settlement.

The upper half of the image is dominated by a bright blue sky with scattered fluffy white clouds. The clouds are soft and well-lit, suggesting a sunny day with good visibility. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and open, with the still water and expansive sky giving the scene a calm coastal or riverside village feeling.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示水上居民区的现实主义风格照片。在画面中，我们可以看到多座房屋建在水面上的木桩上，房屋以蓝色和白色为主色调，部分房屋的屋顶装饰着绿色植物。一艘黄色的小船停靠在最近的一栋房子旁边，而其他几艘小船则漂浮在远处的水域中。背景是晴朗的蓝天，点缀着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows an old cemetery filled with closely packed stone graves and monuments. The scene has a weathered, historic feel, with many gray and dark stone tombs showing age, staining, moss, and erosion.

In the foreground and midground are numerous gravestones and mausoleum-like structures of different shapes and sizes. Several prominent monuments feature Christian crosses, including a large Celtic-style cross on the right with circular ring details and carved symbols, and a simpler tall stone cross toward the left-center. There are also ornate Gothic-style grave markers with pointed arches, carved columns, and decorative stonework. Some tombs have black wrought-iron railings around them.

The graves are arranged tightly, creating a dense, layered view of headstones, slabs, pedestals, and crosses receding into the background. The stone colors range from pale gray to charcoal black, with many surfaces darkened by moisture, lichen, or age. A few monuments have rounded tops, while others are rectangular, column-like, or obelisk-shaped.

The ground is a mix of grass, gravel, and fallen leaves. A narrow gravel path appears along the right edge, winding between the tombs. In the background, tall leafless trees stretch upward, their bare branches forming a delicate pattern against the sky. On the far left, a large evergreen tree with dense dark foliage contrasts with the paler stone and sky.

Above the cemetery, the sky is partly cloudy, with patches of blue visible between broad white and gray clouds. The lighting is natural and slightly subdued, giving the scene a quiet, somber, and contemplative atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示墓地的现实主义风格照片，图像中心是一个显著的十字架墓碑，其周围散布着其他不同设计和大小的墓碑。墓碑上雕刻有各种宗教象征和人物形象，有的墓碑顶部装饰有雕塑或浮雕。背景中可以看到光秃的树木和多云的天空，为这个宁静的墓地增添了一丝肃穆的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of a large modern building, likely the Elbphilharmonie in Hamburg. The structure combines an older-looking red brick base with a striking contemporary glass extension on top.

The lower portion is a massive reddish-brown brick façade, almost warehouse-like, with many small square windows scattered across it in a sparse, grid-like pattern. Near the bottom edge there is a row of larger rectangular windows. The brickwork gives the building a heavy, solid, industrial character.

Above the brick base is a wide public terrace or observation level. A line of people can be seen standing along the railing, appearing very small compared with the scale of the building. The terrace forms a dark horizontal gap between the brick portion and the glass upper structure.

The top section is a gleaming glass façade made of many rectangular panels arranged in a grid. Each panel has a slightly curved or dimpled surface, creating a rippling, wave-like effect across the building. The reflective glass mirrors the sky and clouds, producing a shimmering blue, silver, and white appearance. Near the center, the sun reflects intensely off the glass, creating a bright star-like glare.

The roofline of the glass section is irregular and wave-shaped, rising and dipping rather than forming a flat top. The right side of the building recedes sharply into the distance, emphasizing its angular geometry and height.

The sky behind the building is pale blue with thin, soft clouds. A few streetlights and poles are visible at the bottom edge, reinforcing the sense that the photo was taken from street level looking upward. Overall, the image highlights the contrast between old industrial brick architecture and sleek, reflective modern design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的摄影作品，建筑物的上半部分由光滑的玻璃幕墙构成，反射着天空和云朵。下半部分则是传统的红砖结构，窗户排列整齐，与上方的玻璃形成鲜明对比。建筑位于一个开阔的场地上，背景是蓝天和散布的白云。

caption:
The image shows London’s Tower Bridge at night, dramatically illuminated against a very dark, almost black sky. The bridge’s two iconic Gothic-style stone towers dominate the scene, their turrets, pointed roofs, and decorative architectural details lit with warm golden and white lights. The lighting highlights the texture of the stonework and gives the towers a grand, historic appearance.

Suspended beneath the upper walkway between the two towers is a large set of Olympic rings. The five interlocking rings—blue, yellow, black, green, and red—stand out brightly against the illuminated bridge structure, suggesting the photo was taken during or in celebration of the London Olympics.

The bridge’s suspension elements stretch outward from the towers, with bright white and blue lights tracing the cables and steel framework. On the right side, the bridge deck extends across the frame, lined with glowing light strips and decorative panels. On the left, another section of the bridge slopes down toward the riverbank, also edged with blue-white illumination.

Below the bridge is the River Thames, dark and reflective. The lights from the bridge, nearby buildings, and city lamps shimmer on the water in streaks of blue, gold, white, and red. The reflections add a vivid, colorful texture to the lower part of the image.

In the background, faint outlines of buildings and city lights are visible along the river, but they are secondary to the brightly lit bridge. The overall mood is majestic and festive, combining historic architecture with modern lighting and Olympic symbolism.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伦敦塔桥夜景的照片，塔桥在夜晚被灯光照亮，桥梁的结构和装饰细节清晰可见。桥上悬挂着奥林匹克五环标志，表明可能与奥运会有关。照片背景是城市的轮廓和天空，而前景则是泰晤士河平静的水面，反射出桥上的灯光。

caption:
The image shows an industrial automation demonstration setup, likely at a trade show or factory exhibition. The display is built inside a rectangular aluminum-frame enclosure with clear structural posts and panels.

At the top is a large bright yellow sign with black text. It reads “iRVision” on the left, “3D Area Sensor” in the center, and “Bin Picking” on the right. Beneath the sign, mounted to the overhead frame, are several black vision/sensor units, including one central rectangular module labeled “FANUC 3D Area Sensor,” with smaller camera-like devices on either side.

Inside the enclosure is a yellow industrial robotic arm, typical of FANUC robots. The robot is mounted on a metal pedestal/table and has multiple articulated joints. Its arm extends downward and forward toward a picking area. Some gray protective cable sleeving is wrapped along part of the robot arm, and cables and pneumatic lines are visible around the robot’s wrist and tool area.

In the lower foreground are two gray plastic bins filled with many small round metal parts, resembling washers or machined rings. These parts are scattered loosely in the bins, indicating a bin-picking application where the robot uses 3D vision to identify and pick individual components from an unordered pile.

To the right of the bins is a metal fixture or tray with a few circular parts placed in defined positions, suggesting the robot transfers parts from the bin to a staging or placement area. The setup includes metal rails, mounting plates, cables, and industrial hardware throughout.

The background includes dark exhibition walls, orange panels, and the high ceiling of an indoor industrial hall with overhead lighting and structural beams. Overall, the image depicts a robotic bin-picking demonstration using a 3D vision sensor system to locate and handle randomly arranged metal components.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工业机器人和3D传感器技术的摄影图像。图中的机器人呈黄色，安装在一个带有'3D Area Sensor Bin Picking'标志的支架上，表明它被设计用于在仓库环境中拾取装有物品的箱子。机器人的手臂伸展着，准备进行拾取动作。背景中可以看到橙色的墙壁和一些模糊的展会环境细节。

caption:
The image shows a group of professional soccer players warming up or training on a grass field inside a stadium. The scene is shot with a shallow depth of field, so the central player is relatively sharp while the background and some surrounding players are blurred.

In the foreground, a player in a bright, patterned Real Madrid training shirt is controlling a soccer ball in midair with his raised leg. His shirt has a vivid camouflage-like pattern in turquoise, blue, purple, and pink, with the Adidas logo, Real Madrid crest, and “Emirates Fly Better” sponsor text visible on the front. He wears dark blue shorts, black socks, and neon yellow-green cleats with pink accents. The ball is just in front of his shin/foot, suggesting he is juggling or trapping it during a warm-up drill.

To the right, another player stands facing forward in the same colorful training top and blue shorts. The number “10” is visible on his shorts. He wears white socks and light-colored cleats with green accents. His posture is relaxed, as if waiting or observing the drill.

Behind the central player are two more players. One wears the same patterned training shirt, while another has a yellow training bib over it. They appear to be smiling or talking, though their faces are blurred. Additional players and staff are visible farther in the background, also out of focus.

The setting appears to be a stadium or training pitch, with green seating and spectators or staff blurred in the background. The overall atmosphere suggests a pre-match warm-up or team training session. The colors of the kits stand out strongly against the green field and muted stadium background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到足球运动员在训练场上的现实主义风格照片。图中，一名穿着带有数字'10'的蓝色和粉色队服的球员正专注地踢球，他的姿势显示出运动中的力量和技巧。在他的背后，可以看到其他几名队友，他们穿着与主球员相似的队服，但面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。场地周围有模糊的人群，表明这是一个公共场合或开放的训练环境。

caption:
The image shows a tall urban tower rising against a pale, hazy sky. The central feature is a distinctive tower with a narrow, light-colored shaft made of rectangular stone or tile panels. Near the top, the shaft widens into an octagonal observation or control-room-like structure with slanted lower panels and a band of dark tinted windows. Above that is a decorative, tiered roof resembling a pagoda, capped with a thin spire and stacked ornamental finials.

Below the tower, the upper portion of a modern building is visible. It has a blue glass or metal-paneled facade with large dark vertical window sections. On two sides of the building are large blue-and-white stylized logos that appear to be bank or corporate emblems. Around the base of the tower are rooftop railings, small antennas, satellite dishes, and telecommunications equipment.

The background is mostly open sky, light gray-blue with soft white clouds. To the right of the tower, a small passenger airplane is visible in the distance, flying across the sky; it has a white body with red markings on the tail and fuselage. Farther down in the background, faint mountain silhouettes can be seen through the haze, along with parts of other low-rise city buildings at the bottom edge of the frame.

Overall, the scene feels like a cityscape near an airport or flight path, with the ornate tower and modern office building dominating the composition while the airplane and distant mountains add depth.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示机场控制塔和飞行场景的摄影图像。在图片的中心，有一个高耸的现代化控制塔，其顶部装饰有尖顶结构，塔身由白色和灰色相间的建筑组成。塔的底部是几层带有窗户的楼层，上面有标志性的字母'P'。在控制塔的背景中，可以看到一架飞机正在空中飞行，其下方是城市建筑群，远处轮廓分明的山脉勾勒出地平线。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a large golden reclining Buddha statue, viewed from the side at a slightly low angle. The Buddha lies on its right side, with the head resting gently on one hand, conveying a calm, meditative, and serene expression. The face is smooth and softly rounded, with half-closed eyes, arched brows, a subtle smile, and elongated earlobes. The head is adorned with small rounded curls and a tall flame-like finial rising from the top, typical of traditional Buddha iconography.

The statue’s surface is a rich metallic gold, polished in some areas but also marked with darker patina, scratches, and age-worn patches, giving it a sense of history and sacred use. The body extends across the frame to the right, with the draped robe indicated by carved folds and raised borders along the torso and legs. The robe’s lines are simple but elegant, following the contours of the reclining form.

Behind the statue is a dim, ornate temple wall in muted brown and gray tones. The wall features carved or painted decorative panels with geometric border patterns and relief-like figures, though they are somewhat blurred and weathered. This background creates a strong contrast with the bright gold of the statue and adds an atmosphere of antiquity and reverence.

At the bottom foreground, a pale white flower with a green stem lies in front of the statue, likely an offering. It rests on or near a textured golden base with intricate repeating patterns. The flower adds a delicate, devotional detail to the scene.

Overall, the image feels peaceful, sacred, and contemplative. The warm golden lighting emphasizes the statue’s serene expression and the temple’s aged, spiritual atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一尊金色佛像的摄影作品，佛像呈现出安详的姿态，头部微微侧向，眼睛闭合，嘴角微扬，似乎在沉思。佛像的面部细节和身体线条被精细地刻画出来，显示出佛教艺术的传统风格。佛像的右手轻轻搭在身上，左手则伸展开来，手掌向上，仿佛在迎接世间的美好。佛像前方放置着一个绿色的蜡烛，增添了一丝宁静与神圣的气息。背景中可以看到模糊的建筑结构，但它们并不抢眼，使得观众的注意力完全集中在佛像上。

caption:
The image shows a large group of people posing for a photo on a rocky hillside or overlook, with a broad cityscape and dry mountains in the background. The scene appears to be in a sunny, arid region, with a clear blue sky and hazy distant ridgelines.

In the foreground, around eleven people stand in a loose line facing the camera. Their faces are blurred, but their postures suggest they are posing together for a group portrait. The group includes adults and younger males, with a mix of local traditional clothing and casual tourist-style clothing.

Several men are wearing traditional white garments resembling long skirts or robes, paired with jackets or sweaters. A few have ornate belts around their waists holding curved ceremonial daggers in decorative sheaths, known as jambiyas. These belts are richly patterned, with gold-colored and green details. One person near the center-right wears a more elaborate outfit: a dark jacket, a white lower garment, a green patterned sash or belt, and a green head covering. He is holding a long, gold-colored staff or sheathed object upright.

Other members of the group are dressed more casually. One person near the left-center wears a pale blue T-shirt and jeans, with a camera hanging around the neck or shoulder. Another person near the middle wears a light shirt and dark trousers, also with a camera strap. A person slightly right of center wears a white T-shirt and light jacket, with a camera hanging from the neck. A woman near the right side wears a teal long-sleeve top, black pants, and a necklace, standing with her hands near her pockets.

On the far left, a man in a patterned gray-and-black sweater stands with a white traditional garment below and a decorative belt with a dagger at his waist. On the far right, a young man in a dark jacket and white garment is partially cut off by the edge of the frame. Two younger males stand near the right side, both in darker jackets or shirts, also wearing belts with decorative dagger sheaths.

The ground is rough, dusty, and rocky, with cracks and uneven stone surfaces visible in the foreground. Behind the group, the city stretches across the valley with many low-rise, light-colored buildings clustered closely together. Beyond the city are barren, brownish mountains, softened by atmospheric haze. The strong sunlight creates sharp shadows on the ground, suggesting the photo was taken during a bright midday or afternoon.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群人在户外聚会的照片。在照片的中心，有两名身着传统服饰的人站在中间，他们身穿白色长袍和绿色腰带，头戴传统的帽子。周围是其他穿着现代服装的人，包括一名女性戴着太阳镜，一名男性手持金色饰品。背景中可以看到远处的城市景观，天空晴朗，阳光明媚。

caption:
The image shows three adults sitting in a small indoor room that looks like an office, studio, or casual workspace. Their faces are blurred.

On the left side of the image, there is a large hookah/shisha pipe placed on a wooden desk or cabinet. The hookah has a tall metallic stem, a black base, and a bright green hose extending across the room. The hose stretches in a long curve from the hookah toward the person seated on the right, who is holding the mouthpiece near his mouth.

Three people are seated in a loose semicircle:

- **Left person:** Sitting in a chair near the hookah, wearing a black polo shirt and blue jeans. He is holding a camera in his lap with one hand, suggesting photography equipment is being used or discussed.
- **Center person:** Sitting on a folding chair, wearing a light purple button-up shirt, black pants, and pink slip-on shoes. She is holding a white mug in one hand and appears relaxed, leaning back slightly with one arm raised.
- **Right person:** Sitting in a black office chair, wearing a dark T-shirt and patterned shorts with flag-like designs. He is holding the green hookah hose and appears to be smoking from it.

The room is fairly cluttered and decorated with photography-related items. On the back wall are several framed or printed images/posters, including artistic or conceptual photographs. A large wooden cabinet stands at the back right, with boxes and equipment stored on top. Next to it is a large dark backdrop or roll of studio paper leaning vertically, suggesting this may be a photography studio or workspace.

On the left desk, besides the hookah, there are various objects including cups, a plastic bag, a bottle with brown liquid, and miscellaneous items. The floor is covered with brownish ceramic tiles. The overall lighting is bright and indoor, likely from overhead fluorescent lights. The atmosphere appears informal and relaxed, with the group seated casually around the hookah in a compact, multi-purpose room.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三个人在室内环境中进行水烟活动的照片。左侧的男性坐在办公椅上，身穿黑色T恤和牛仔裤，正在操作一个大型的水烟壶。中间的女性穿着黑色上衣和白色短裙，脚踩一双粉色高跟鞋，正坐着享受水烟的乐趣。右侧的男性也坐在椅子上，身穿灰色T恤和深色裤子，似乎也在参与水烟活动。背景中可以看到墙上挂着的装饰品和其他家具，如书架和文件柜，营造出一种家庭式的休闲氛围。

caption:
The image shows a person in traditional Korean ceremonial guard attire standing in profile beside a stone building wall. The subject is positioned slightly left of center, facing to the right, with their face intentionally blurred.

They are wearing a vivid turquoise-blue robe with wide, flowing sleeves and subtle patterned fabric texture. Small dark red decorative knots or fasteners appear along the sleeve and upper garment. Around the neck is a white collar, visible beneath the blue outer robe. At the waist, the robe is tied, and a dark belt or sash is partly visible.

On the person’s head is a large black woven hat with a broad brim and a rounded crown, resembling traditional Korean official or guard headwear. The hat has a small red ornament on top. Hanging down from the hat near the person’s cheek is a strand of large beads in alternating reddish-brown and green tones, adding a ceremonial detail.

The person is holding or standing very close to a tall flagpole on the right side of the image. The flag is black, yellow, and red, with a bold vertical red pole and a yellow fabric section hanging down in soft folds. The fabric appears slightly translucent and worn or fluttered, with uneven edges at the bottom. Behind this flag, other colorful flags—red, blue, and multicolored—are visible but out of focus, suggesting a ceremonial or historical setting.

A sword or sheathed weapon is visible at the person’s left hip, angled downward behind them. It has a dark handle and a cord or tassel with small beads hanging from it, reinforcing the impression of a traditional guard or reenactment uniform.

The background consists of a pale gray stone wall on the left, with large rectangular stone blocks and a rough texture. The depth of field is shallow: the main figure and nearby flag are relatively sharp, while the background flags and walkway are blurred. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, creating strong highlights on the blue robe and soft shadows along the wall and clothing folds. The overall atmosphere suggests a cultural, historical, or ceremonial event, possibly at a palace or heritage site.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统服饰的摄影照片，图中的人物穿着鲜艳的蓝色长袍和黑色宽边帽，头戴绿色与红色相间的辫子。他站在一面装饰有彩色旗帜的墙前，旗帜色彩鲜明，包括黄色、红色和黑色。背景是简约的白色建筑结构，突出了人物和他的服饰。

caption:
The image is a wide panoramic view of a riverside cityscape on a clear day. A large, calm river occupies the middle and right side of the scene, curving gently into the distance. The water is smooth and pale blue-gray, reflecting the bright sky, with a low, wooded shoreline stretching across the far bank. Beyond the trees, faint low-rise buildings and industrial structures are visible on the horizon.

On the left side, several tall residential and commercial buildings stand near the riverbank. One is a rectangular high-rise apartment block with many repeating balconies and windows. Next to it is a more modern, taller white-and-blue building complex with curved glass sections and angular rooflines, giving it a distinctive contemporary look. At the base of these buildings are smaller structures, parking areas, and a riverside embankment.

In the foreground, a broad multi-lane road and bridge system crosses the lower part of the image. Cars, buses, and a truck are visible traveling in both directions. There are metal guardrails, light poles, pedestrian paths, and ramps leading down toward the riverfront. On the lower right, part of a bridge or overpass structure descends toward a road that curves beneath it. A small dock or river terminal area is visible near the water, with a moored boat or ferry and several flagpoles.

The lower left foreground includes grassy open land, scattered trees, sidewalks, and street intersections. The overall scene feels spacious and open, with the vast blue sky taking up much of the upper half of the image. The sky is mostly clear, with only a few thin, wispy clouds. The lighting suggests a bright midday or early afternoon, with crisp visibility and soft shadows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸景观的摄影图像。图中，河流宽阔，两岸有现代建筑群，包括多层住宅和商业建筑。一座桥梁横跨在河面上，连接着对岸。河岸边设有停车场、人行道和绿化带。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其中。

caption:
The image shows a large intercity coach bus driving along a smooth, paved urban road on a bright sunny day. The bus dominates the center-right of the frame and is angled slightly toward the viewer, as if it is approaching while traveling along a curved lane. It is silver and blue, with large tinted windows reflecting the surrounding trees and sky. The name “Sinar Jaya” is written prominently on the front and side of the bus in blue lettering. Along the side, there is a colorful stripe pattern made of blocks of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.

At the front of the bus, a sign above the windshield displays route information, including “Cipularang,” and large yellow letters appear behind the glass. The windshield is broad and slightly reflective, with windshield wipers visible at the bottom. The bus has rounded headlights, a yellow license plate that is blurred, and a roof-mounted unit near the rear that appears to be part of the air-conditioning system.

The road is divided by black-and-white painted curbs, which curve from the foreground into the distance on the right side of the image. The asphalt looks dark and well-maintained, with white lane markings. In the distance, other buses or large vehicles can be seen following the same road, giving the impression of a busy transport route.

The surroundings are lush and tropical. On the left side, there are palm trees and dense green foliage, with branches casting shadows onto the road. A yellow road sign with a black left-turn arrow stands near the curb, indicating a curve ahead. Tall green streetlights line the road, some with decorative details near the poles. The sky is clear and bright blue with a few small white clouds, suggesting warm weather and strong daylight.

Overall, the scene captures a public transport bus traveling through a clean, tree-lined roadway in a tropical urban environment, with vivid colors, bright sunlight, and a sense of motion along the curved street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆白色公交车在晴朗天气下行驶的照片。公交车的侧面印有'Sinar Jaya'字样，车身装饰着彩色条纹。它正沿着一条黑白色的路缘线行驶，周围环境由绿色植被和几棵树木组成，天空是清澈的蓝色。

caption:
The image shows a waterfront city scene, likely in Stockholm, Sweden. In the foreground, a white and gray passenger ferry is moving across calm water. Large black lettering on the side of the boat reads “DJURGÅRDEN 4,” and a sign on the upper structure says “Linje 85.” The ferry has rows of rectangular windows with warm wooden trim, red life rings attached along the sides, and a black smokestack with a red panel and anchor symbol. The water is lightly rippled, reflecting parts of the boat and the pale sky.

Behind the ferry, a second larger white vessel is docked near the quay. It has a Swedish flag flying from a mast near the front, and the name “MÄLARDROTTNINGEN” appears on its bow. Several white masts, flagpoles, and dock structures stand around it.

The middle ground features a waterfront promenade lined with green trees, stone paving, and lampposts. A few cars are visible along the streets near the water. The quay has concrete edging with black rubber tires used as bumpers.

The background is densely filled with historic and modern city buildings rising up a gentle slope. On the left is a large pale yellow building with a prominent greenish copper dome and smaller roof details, giving it a classical European appearance. Farther back are several church towers and spires, including dark domes, pointed steeples, and green copper-topped towers. A building near the center bears the sign “SÖDRA TEATERN,” while other visible signs include “Coca-Cola,” “Hilton,” and “Sveriges Kommuner och Landsting.” The architecture includes pastel facades in cream, yellow, salmon, and brick tones, with dark rooftops and many windows.

The sky is bright but overcast, creating soft, diffuse lighting. Overall, the scene has a calm urban harbor atmosphere, combining ferry traffic, historic architecture, greenery, and Swedish city landmarks.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示斯堪的纳维亚风格城市景观的照片，画面中心是一艘名为'DJURGARDEN 4'的游船，它停靠在河岸边。游船上挂有瑞典国旗和一个红色的救生圈。背景中是密集的城市建筑群，包括黄色、橙色和棕色的房屋，以及几棵绿色的树木。建筑物的设计风格多样，从古典到现代不等，展现了城市的多样性。天空多云，但光线充足，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a large modern shopping mall or entertainment complex, viewed from a low, wide-angle perspective that makes the building appear tall and expansive. The central façade is dominated by a curved wall of blue-tinted glass panels framed by white metal gridwork. Near the upper middle of the glass façade is a large stylized lowercase “e” logo with the word “Curve,” indicating the mall is likely “eCurve.”

At the very top of the central structure is a prominent circular rooftop feature: a white, ring-like canopy supported by vertical columns, giving the building a futuristic, open-air architectural look. The sky above is bright but overcast, creating soft, diffused lighting across the scene.

On both sides of the main glass entrance are tall vertical signboards listing various shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. On the left tower, readable signs include “epicentre,” “Subway,” “Digi,” “maxis,” and other restaurant or retail logos. On the right tower, there are signs for brands such as “Hip Hop,” “Fuel Shack,” “Watsons,” “Adidas,” and “World of Sports,” among others. These signboards emphasize that the location is a busy commercial mall with many outlets.

In the foreground, several palm-like trees with fan-shaped silver-green leaves line the plaza, softening the modern glass-and-steel architecture. The open paved area in front of the building has pedestrians walking casually, some in pairs or small groups. A few people are entering or leaving the mall, while others stand near the event area.

A large promotional setup for *Star Wars: The Last Jedi* occupies the center foreground. It includes black and red display panels with bold “STAR WARS” text and the subtitle “THE LAST JEDI,” along with movie artwork featuring characters and lightsabers. The display is surrounded by blue ropes and metal stanchions, with blue padded mats or cushions laid on the ground in front. The text indicates the film is “in cinemas” in December.

To the left side of the plaza, there appears to be a small event setup with a white tent canopy, black speakers, and stage equipment. On the far left, a huge digital billboard mounted on the building shows a bright teal advertisement with an image of a product and small text near the bottom. On the right side, part of another building section has red-and-white geometric decorative panels, adding contrast to the otherwise glass-and-metal exterior.

Overall, the scene captures a lively urban shopping mall entrance with modern architecture, retail branding, greenery, pedestrians, and a movie promotion event in front.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市商业区的摄影图像，图中中心位置是一座设计现代化的玻璃幕墙建筑，其上方有'City Walk'的标志。建筑前有一个宣传星战电影的广告牌，周围是行人和一些绿色植物。

caption:
The image shows the front façade of a large Gothic-style cathedral or church, photographed from street level looking upward. The building is made of pale beige-gray stone and is highly ornate, with many pointed arches, carved tracery, pinnacles, and sculptural details.

At the center is a very tall pointed arch containing a large stained-glass window. The window is divided into many vertical panels and topped with elaborate stone tracery forming circular and quatrefoil patterns, including a rose-like design near the upper portion. Above this main window, the façade rises into steep triangular gables filled with narrow arched openings and decorative stonework.

Below the window are three recessed entrance portals, each framed by pointed Gothic arches. The central doorway is the largest and has a dark wooden or metal door set behind a black wrought-iron gate. The side entrances are also gated. Above and between the portals are statues of robed figures standing in niches, along with intricate carvings and small ornamental spires.

On both sides of the central façade are tall vertical sections with narrow arched windows and sculpted columns, emphasizing the height of the building. To the right, part of a steep, patterned roof is visible, covered in blue-gray tiles arranged in a geometric design. A slender spire or tower edge appears on the far right.

The left side of the image is partly framed by leafy green tree branches, which contrast with the pale stone and add a natural border. The sky behind the building is light blue with patches of white cloud. At street level, the foreground shows a paved sidewalk or plaza, and on the far right near the building wall there are a couple of small electric scooters parked. The overall impression is of a grand historic church with intricate Gothic architecture and a quiet urban setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哥特式建筑风格的教堂正面的照片。教堂的设计精致，具有尖顶、复杂的石雕装饰和大型彩色玻璃窗。入口处有两个黑色铁栅栏门，上方是两扇拱形窗户，窗户周围有精细的石雕。教堂的立面由多个小尖塔和雕塑构成，整体呈现出一种庄严而神圣的感觉。在照片的左侧，可以看到部分绿色树叶，为这座历史建筑增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit coastal city viewed from an elevated vantage point, likely from a hillside or lookout above the urban area.

In the foreground, dense green pine trees fill the lower edge of the scene, their yellow-green needles glowing warmly in the sunlight. Just beyond the trees is a compact cityscape of mid- and high-rise apartment buildings, hotels, and residential blocks. The buildings are mostly light-colored—white, cream, beige, tan, and pale orange—with many balconies, flat roofs, terraces, and rooftop structures. The sunlight is strong and golden, giving the scene a warm Mediterranean feel.

Near the lower center-left is a large circular bullring or arena. It has a reddish-brown brick exterior with arched openings around its circumference and an open interior with tiered seating visible inside. The arena stands out clearly among the rectangular apartment blocks because of its round shape and historic architectural style.

Behind the city, the coastline opens onto a calm blue sea. The water is smooth and expansive, with subtle darker patches and gentle tonal variations. A white cruise ship or large passenger ferry is visible offshore to the left, leaving a faint wake behind it. Farther to the right, a harbor or breakwater extends into the water, with a small white sailboat or marker visible in the distance.

The upper half of the image is dominated by a vast blue sky. It is mostly clear, with a few wispy white clouds stretching across the left side and a brighter cloud formation on the right. The horizon is soft and slightly hazy, blending the pale blue of the sea with the lighter blue of the sky.

Overall, the scene feels warm, open, and summery, combining a dense urban Mediterranean waterfront, a historic circular arena, calm sea views, and a bright, cloud-dappled sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的摄影作品，图像中心是一个圆形的斗牛场，其周围是密集排列的现代建筑。建筑物以白色和浅色调为主，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。在斗牛场的背后，可以看到平静的海洋和一艘远处的船只。前景由绿色植被覆盖，为这个城市场景增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor public space on a sunny day, likely a park, garden, or landscaped area near a mall or attraction. The ground is covered in bright green artificial turf, with patches of sunlight and shade cast by nearby trees.

In the foreground, a young child is kneeling on the grass near the center of the image. The child is wearing a light striped T-shirt with large butterfly graphics on the front, dark shorts, white socks, and pale pink sneakers. Their face is blurred. To the left foreground, an adult stands partly blocking the view, wearing light blue jeans, a black shirt, and a dark blue backpack with bright pink straps. Near this person’s feet, another child appears to be lying or playing on the grass, partly obscured.

On the right side of the foreground, two seated adults are visible on the grass. One person in a dark patterned top sits cross-legged closer to the middle-right, while another person with a backpack sits at the far right edge, partially cropped out of the frame. A small child in light clothing is also partly visible near the standing adult on the right.

The middle ground contains a paved walkway running horizontally across the scene. Several people are walking or standing along it. Some are looking at phones, while others appear to be talking or moving through the area. A woman near the center wears a light top and dark skirt and carries a backpack with a water bottle attached. Another person nearby carries a checkered bag. On the right side, a child in a red sports-style shirt with a large white number on the back stands near another child in dark clothing. A tall adult in a plaid shirt and shorts stands nearby, looking down at a phone or camera.

The background is filled with greenery: trees with thin trunks, ferns, shrubs, and white flowering plants lining the walkway. There is also a glass railing or barrier behind the planting bed, suggesting the area may be part of a modern landscaped public complex. The overall scene feels busy, relaxed, and family-oriented, with many adults and children spending time outdoors in a shaded, well-maintained recreational area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示公园中活动场景的照片。在画面的中心，一个穿着白色T恤和黑色短裤的小女孩正坐在绿色的人造草地上，她的身体稍微前倾，似乎在专注地观察着周围的环境。她的头发扎成两个小辫子，表情平静。周围是其他游客，有的站立交谈，有的坐着休息，其中一位女士背对着镜头，正在使用手机。背景中有树木、灌木丛和一些建筑物，营造出一个宁静而活跃的户外空间氛围。

caption:
The image shows a group of people walking in a public march or community parade on a paved street in daylight. Most of the participants are wearing purple shirts, suggesting they may be part of an organized civic, school, municipal, or community group. Their faces are blurred, so individual identities are not visible.

At the front of the procession, several people are holding a large white banner stretched across the width of the group. The banner contains Thai text in large red and purple letters. The prominent phrase reads: “คิดดี...ทำดี ต่อต้านยาเสพติด,” which roughly means “Think good… do good, oppose drugs.” The banner also includes images of several people printed along the lower portion, a stylized Thai-flag-colored ribbon/logo, and several official-looking circular emblems along the bottom right, suggesting the event may be connected to a government or local anti-drug campaign.

The people in front appear to be of mixed ages, including older adults and middle-aged participants. A man on the left foreground wears a purple polo shirt, dark pants, sandals, and a bright blue cap, walking slightly ahead while holding part of the banner or a cord. On the right foreground, another person in a purple shirt holds the banner’s edge. Behind the banner, more participants continue down the road, many also wearing purple shirts, and some carry another sign or banner further back.

The setting appears to be an urban or civic area in Thailand. Along the right side of the road is a white metal fence and a green chain-link fence, with trees behind it. There are overhead utility wires and poles running above the sidewalk. A signboard in the background advertises a “Mid Year Grand Sale” with Thai text and dates. Farther down the street, there are small flags, including Thai flags, lining the route. The sky is bright but slightly overcast, and the overall scene has the feel of a daytime public awareness march, specifically focused on anti-drug messaging.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群人在户外行走的照片，他们正举着一块横幅进行宣传或示威。横幅上印有文字和图像，似乎在宣传某个活动或组织。参与者们穿着统一的紫色服装，并且有些人戴着帽子。背景中可以看到树木、围栏和一些不清晰的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor café or bar patio in warm late-afternoon sunlight. A small group of people is seated around a tall wooden table, likely socializing over drinks. Their faces are blurred, but the scene suggests a relaxed, casual gathering.

In the center-left, a man with his hair tied back in a bun sits on a high wooden stool. He is wearing a light-colored striped short-sleeve shirt and patterned shorts, and he appears to be holding up a smartphone while speaking or showing something to the others. Across from him and with their backs partly toward the camera are several other people: one person with bright reddish-orange curly hair wearing a very colorful patterned jacket, another with dark hair in a black top, and a younger-looking person partially visible between them.

The table is labeled with a small white number sign reading “14.” On the tabletop are several clear drinking glasses, including water glasses and what appear to be glasses with red or amber drinks. There is also a phone or small dark object lying near the table edge.

The patio is shaded by large white canvas awnings stretched overhead, supported by beige posts and metal framing. A string of exposed bulb lights hangs beneath the canopy, with one lit bulb visible near the upper left-center. On the right side, a tiki-style torch is mounted near a post; its flame is actively burning, adding to the warm outdoor ambiance.

The setting includes a mix of rustic and coastal décor: tall wooden stools, beige stucco-like walls, a chalkboard menu leaning against a post, rope details, a metal fence, and plants with long narrow leaves on the far right. In the background, beyond the patio, there are rooftops with blue-gray metal panels and storefront signage, including a visible sign reading “GIFTS.” A blurred blue vehicle passes or is parked in the street behind the patio.

The lighting is bright and golden, with strong sunlight filtering through the awnings and creating highlights on the people, table, and posts. Overall, the image captures a lively but intimate outdoor dining scene at a casual café or bar, with a summery, relaxed atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示几个人在户外餐厅用餐的照片。前景中，一位男性坐在桌子旁，正专注地使用手机。旁边是一位穿着多彩图案衣服的女性，她背对着镜头，正在与另一位女性交谈。她们周围摆放着木质桌椅和玻璃杯，营造出一种休闲的氛围。背景中可以看到其他顾客和餐厅内部的一部分，以及远处模糊的城市建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a close-up photograph of a rectangular medicine box placed on a flat surface against a dark, softly blurred background.

The box is mostly white on the upper portion and turquoise-blue on the lower portion, separated by a horizontal burgundy stripe. Large dark-blue text across the front reads **“Adco-Dapamax.”** On the right side of the burgundy stripe, white text reads **“30 TABLETS.”** In the lower-right corner of the blue section is the **Adcock Ingram** logo and name in white.

On the left side near the top front is a small outlined square containing **“S3,”** likely indicating a scheduling/classification mark. Near the lower-left/front area, partially overlapping the burgundy stripe, there is a circular burgundy emblem with a white curved arrow-like symbol inside.

The top flap of the box is visible. It has small printed text on the left listing active ingredients, including **indapamide 2.5 mg** and **bisoprolol fumarate 5.5 mg**. It also includes storage instructions such as storing at or below **25°C** and keeping out of reach of children. On the right side of the top flap is a barcode with the number **6004405006180** printed below it.

The box edges and folded cardboard flaps are visible at both ends, showing slight wear or creasing. Lighting is focused on the package, creating a mild reflection on the glossy cardboard surface and a shadow beneath it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Adco-Dapamax药片包装盒的图片。盒子正面印有药物名称和数量，颜色为蓝色、白色和红色。包装盒上方有一个圆形标签，上面印有药物的图标和品牌名。背景是均匀的灰色调，突出了药品包装盒的细节。

caption:

The most prominent vehicle is a large white FedEx Express delivery truck near the center-right of the image. Its box trailer fills much of the frame, with the large “FedEx” logo in purple and orange and the word “Express” beneath it. The truck is traveling alongside other vehicles, including a white bus partially visible on the right and a small white pickup truck in front of the FedEx vehicle.

In the lanes closer to the camera, several cars and vans are visible: a white van, a dark brown or black compact car, a white sedan, and a light-colored SUV. In the lane above the FedEx truck, there is a white pickup with decorative side graphics, along with portions of other cars at the frame edges. Farther back, another small flatbed or cargo truck with a metal cage-like rear structure is visible.

The road surface is dark asphalt with white lane markings. Long shadows fall across the lanes, suggesting low-angle sunlight, possibly early morning or late afternoon. The lighting is bright and warm, giving the scene a sunlit, slightly golden appearance.

Beyond the highway, the background contains a sandy construction or roadside area. There are pale sand piles, rough earth, and a narrow strip of dense green vegetation running horizontally across the image. Behind that is another sandy roadway or open dirt area with tire marks and uneven terrain. The overall setting appears to be an urban or suburban highway bordered by undeveloped sandy land, possibly in a dry coastal or desert-like environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常城市交通的摄影图像，捕捉了高速公路上繁忙的景象。图中可见多辆车辆在行驶，包括一辆显眼的FedEx快递卡车和几辆私家车。背景是沙漠环境，远处有沙丘和绿色植被。

caption:
The image shows two people dressed in graduation attire standing outdoors, posed close together as if for a celebratory photo. Both are wearing dark navy or black graduation gowns and square mortarboard caps with bright yellow trim or tassel accents. Their faces are blurred, so facial details and expressions are not visible.

The person on the left has straight, shoulder-length blonde hair and is wearing a bright yellow stole draped around the neck over the gown. Under the open gown, they have on a yellow plaid outfit with black-and-white grid lines. They are holding a smartphone in one hand, partially visible near their shoulder, and gripping the yellow stole with the other hand. Some printed text and the year “2018” can be seen on the stole.

The person on the right has long, dark brown hair and is also wearing a dark graduation gown with a yellow stole. Their mortarboard cap sits slightly angled, and they have a long dangling earring visible on one side. They are holding part of the yellow stole near the front of the gown, and a black outfit is visible underneath.

The background is softly blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field. It appears to be an outdoor campus or park-like setting with trees, greenery, a fence or railing, and several indistinct people in the distance. The lighting is natural and bright, giving the scene a warm, celebratory graduation-day atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到两位毕业生在户外庆祝毕业典礼的照片。左侧的女性戴着黑色学士帽，穿着黑色长袍和黄色学位服，正拿着她的学位服。右侧的女性也戴着同样的帽子，同样穿着学位服，但她的学位服上有文字装饰。她们站在一个模糊的背景前，周围有树木和其他人影，营造出一种轻松愉快的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of a car’s engine bay, photographed from above with the hood open. The most striking feature is a bright, glossy red valve cover dominating the center and lower half of the frame. Its smooth painted surface has raised ribs and reflective highlights, suggesting it has been freshly painted or well maintained. Near the upper-left area of the red cover is a round black oil filler cap marked with “OIL.”

Surrounding the valve cover is a dense arrangement of engine components, hoses, wiring, brackets, and metal lines. Across the upper portion of the engine runs a weathered metallic intake or fuel rail area with several electrical connectors clipped into place. Small orange/red connector plugs are visible along the top edge of the valve cover area, attached to black wiring harnesses.

On the left side of the image is a large black ribbed air intake hose leading toward the engine. Behind it, near the upper-left corner, there is a translucent plastic fluid reservoir with a light-colored cap, likely for brake or clutch fluid. Various black rubber hoses curve around the engine bay, some thick and some thin, secured with clamps and brackets.

At the bottom of the image, several black ignition or spark plug wires run across the front of the engine. Some white lettering is visible on the wires, including references to radio frequency interference suppression. Beneath the red valve cover is a dull, heat-stained metallic exhaust manifold or heat shield, showing discoloration, rust, and age compared with the freshly painted red cover.

The engine bay itself appears older and somewhat worn, with dusty black painted metal surfaces, aged brackets, oxidized aluminum parts, and grime in crevices. The contrast between the vivid red valve cover and the surrounding dark, gray, and weathered components makes the red engine cover the visual focal point. Overall, the image presents a detailed mechanical view of a car engine, showing both restored or customized elements and signs of regular use.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示汽车引擎内部的照片，焦点落在位于图片中心的鲜红色发动机缸体上。缸体表面光滑，装配有多个黑色的气门和连接管道。在缸体周围，可以看到复杂的金属零件、线束和其他机械部件，它们紧密地交织在一起，构成了一个充满机械美感的场景。

caption:
The image shows a sunny outdoor scene dominated by a historic stone castle or fortified building. The architecture appears medieval, with multiple round towers, thick stone walls, and steep conical roofs.

On the left side, a large cylindrical tower rises prominently from behind a row of leafy trees. Its walls are made of rough, light-colored stone with small variations in beige, gray, and tan. Near the top of the tower is a decorative ring of protruding stone supports or machicolations, giving it a fortified appearance. The tower has several narrow, vertical windows with dark metal grilles, reinforcing the impression of a defensive structure. At the very top is a dark, steeply pitched conical roof covered in aged tiles, with a small finial at the peak. A rectangular stone chimney rises behind the roof.

To the right, more of the castle complex extends into the background. There are additional round towers with similar conical roofs, along with connecting stone buildings featuring dormer windows and steep slate or tile roofs. The stonework throughout is consistent, giving the whole complex a cohesive historic character.

The sky is a vivid, cloudless blue, suggesting a bright, clear day. Strong sunlight illuminates the stone walls, casting crisp shadows, especially beneath the trees and architectural overhangs.

In the foreground, a row of trimmed green trees partially obscures the lower portion of the buildings. Their dense foliage creates a shaded area along the street or plaza below. On the far right, a few people are visible walking or standing near benches and a paved open space, which gives a sense of scale—the towers are very large compared with the pedestrians.

At the bottom left, there is a modern metal street fixture or signpost, contrasting with the old stone architecture. The overall scene combines historic castle architecture, bright summer-like weather, greenery, and a quiet public square or street setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座古老石制塔楼的摄影图像。塔楼位于画面中央，其特点是坚固的石材结构和一个显著的圆形顶部。塔楼旁边是几棵茂盛的树木，为这座历史建筑增添了自然美。在塔楼前方是一个平坦的人行道，上面有几位行人正在行走。天空呈现出晴朗的蓝色，没有云彩，衬托出建筑的轮廓。

caption:
The image shows an elevated view over a coastal hillside on a bright, clear day. A large expanse of turquoise-blue sky fills the upper half of the frame, with a few soft white clouds gathered low near the horizon on the left. Several dark utility wires cut across the scene horizontally and diagonally, creating strong lines against the sky.

Below the sky, the ocean stretches across the background in deep teal and blue tones. The water appears calm, with lighter shallows closer to shore and a faint coastline or beach partially visible through the trees. The horizon is low and slightly hazy, giving the scene a warm tropical feel.

In the foreground on the right is a building with a distinctive tiered, pagoda-like roof. The roof is muted gray-green, with broad sloping planes and a small raised central cap at the top. Some areas of the roof show weathering, patches, and discoloration. Beneath it, part of the building façade is visible: tan walls, a wooden door, and dark-framed windows.

The area around the building includes a paved walkway or terrace made of small, light-colored stone tiles. To the far right is a tall retaining wall built from dark, rounded stones, adding texture and contrast. A narrow path or stairway seems to descend through the trees toward the shoreline.

The lower and left portions of the image are filled with dense tropical vegetation—trees with mixed green, golden, and brownish leaves, likely tinted by the photo’s color grading. A streetlamp rises from the foliage near the bottom left. The overall color palette is stylized and high-contrast, with cyan skies and sea, warm bronze foliage, and cool gray architecture. The scene feels quiet, sunlit, and coastal, with a mix of natural ocean scenery and built hillside structures.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海边建筑和自然风光的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一座带有尖顶屋顶的建筑物，其屋顶覆盖着灰色的瓦片。建筑物周围是茂密的绿色植被，包括树木和灌木。在建筑物的背后，可以看到平静的海洋和远处模糊的山脉轮廓。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a modern campus building on a clear winter day. The building is labeled **“Ruth Stricker Dayton Campus Center”**, with the words **“CAMPUS CENTER”** prominently displayed above the main entrance.

The structure combines **red brick walls** with large sections of **white paneling** and extensive **glass windows**, giving it a contemporary institutional appearance. The central portion of the building features a tall, dramatic entrance façade with a peaked roofline. Above the doors is a large, multi-story arched window made up of rectangular glass panes separated by white framing. The glass reflects the bright blue sky and surrounding trees.

The main entrance has several glass double doors framed in white metal. Small notices or signs are posted on the doors. On the right brick wall near the entrance, there is a dark sign identifying the building. Slim vertical wall-mounted light fixtures are attached to the brick sections on either side of the entrance.

The surrounding environment suggests winter: **snow is piled along the edges of the walkway and around the base of the building**, and the nearby trees are mostly bare. A few leafless birch-like trees stand to the left, their pale trunks and branches contrasting with the red brick and white snow. The ground in front of the building is a wide **red-brick paved plaza or walkway**, with long shadows cast across it, indicating strong sunlight.

The sky is bright, cloudless, and intensely blue, giving the scene a crisp, cold, sunny atmosphere. The overall impression is of a clean, well-maintained college or university campus building, photographed from a slightly low angle to emphasize the height and symmetry of the entrance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示校园中心建筑的摄影图像。建筑物位于一个晴朗的日子里，阳光照耀下显得格外明亮。建筑的设计现代而简洁，以大面积的玻璃窗户和红砖外墙为特点。正门上方清晰地标注着'Campus Center'字样，表明这是校园中心的入口。周围环境被积雪覆盖，树木的枝条裸露，显示出冬季的气息。

caption:
The image shows a lively pedestrian street or town square on a bright, sunny day, likely in spring. The sky is a clear, vivid blue with no visible clouds, taking up much of the upper half of the scene.

In the foreground and middle ground, a broad cobblestone street stretches into the distance. The paving is patterned with curved, reddish-brown and gray stones on the main road area, while the pedestrian walkway on the right is made of lighter rectangular paving stones. Many people are walking, standing, or sitting, giving the scene a busy but relaxed atmosphere. Some faces appear blurred. Several people carry shopping bags, and others are gathered in small groups talking. On the left side, people sit on benches and low stone edges beneath trees.

A street musician stands near the center-left foreground, playing a violin. A small dark hat or case lies on the ground in front of him, likely for tips. Nearby, a few people sit and watch, and a child with a scooter can be seen farther back near the center. There is also a stroller in the central area, emphasizing the family-friendly, public-square feel.

The street is lined with historic-looking buildings. On the left, there is a pale cream or light yellow building with tall rectangular windows and classical proportions. In front of it are flowering trees with pink blossoms, suggesting springtime. A bronze or greenish statue of a seated or standing figure is partially visible among the trees and benches on the left.

In the center background, a light-colored building with a red-tiled roof and arched windows stands behind a small plaza area. Green café umbrellas are visible near it, suggesting outdoor seating or a café terrace. Behind and around this building are tall trees: some are covered in fresh green leaves, while one large tree is mostly bare, its branching silhouette standing out against the blue sky.

On the right side, a row of older buildings continues down the street. Closest to the viewer is a red-brown ornate façade with decorative architectural details, balconies, and window frames. Farther down, the buildings are lighter in color and closely packed, forming a traditional European streetscape. Street lamps are mounted along the right side, and a vertical green banner hangs from one building.

The overall mood is warm, social, and leisurely. The sunlight casts strong shadows across the pavement, and the combination of blooming trees, outdoor seating, musicians, and crowds suggests a pleasant spring afternoon in a historic town center.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的现实主义风格照片。阳光明媚，天空晴朗，街道两旁是具有欧洲传统建筑特色的房屋。人群在街道上行走，有的交谈，有的独自行走，穿着休闲服装。街道中央有几棵盛开的樱花树，为这个城市场景增添了春天的气息。

caption:
The image captures a fast-moving horse race in progress, with strong motion blur emphasizing speed and intensity.

In the foreground, a light gray or white racehorse is galloping from left to right. Its body is stretched forward in mid-stride, with its legs blurred by motion. The horse wears a blue saddlecloth marked with the large white number “10.” Its jockey is leaning low over the horse’s neck in a racing posture, wearing bright blue silks with bold red bands on the sleeves and a red-and-blue helmet. The rider’s face is blurred, likely due to the speed and camera panning.

Just behind the leading gray horse is another racehorse, darker brown in color, partially obscured by the front horse. Its jockey wears a colorful outfit: a red helmet with green spots, yellow sleeves, and a green-and-red racing top. This second rider is also crouched low, urging the horse forward.

The background is heavily blurred, suggesting the camera is tracking the horses at high speed. A large blue advertising board with big white lettering fills much of the left and lower background, though the text is not fully readable because of the blur. To the right, there is a dark green structure with a rectangular digital display showing yellow illuminated characters or numbers. Above it, pink flowers or foliage appear as streaks due to the motion. A white rail runs horizontally near the bottom of the frame, marking the edge of the racetrack, and the green turf beneath the horses is also blurred into horizontal bands.

Overall, the image has a dynamic, energetic feel, focusing on the rush of the race rather than crisp detail. The panning blur makes the horses and jockeys appear to be moving extremely quickly, with the gray horse in front clearly leading or closely contesting the race.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉赛马比赛瞬间的摄影作品，画面中心为两匹正在激烈竞速的赛马和骑手。前方的白色赛马上方有数字'10'标记，而另一匹棕色赛马则紧随其后。两位骑手都穿着鲜艳的比赛服装，其中一位身穿蓝色上衣，另一位身着黄色与绿色相间的服装。背景中模糊可见的是观众席和其他比赛设施，以及显示当前时间的计时器屏幕。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit view of an outdoor sculpture park or landscaped garden on a gentle grassy slope.

In the foreground, a large abstract sculpture stands near the center. It appears to be made of dark bronze or metal with a polished, slightly reflective surface. Its form is geometric and stacked, made of rounded rectangular blocks and hollowed-out shapes. The top portion is broad and horizontal, with a circular opening on one side; below it are layered block-like sections, including vertical cutouts and recessed grooves. It rests on a small square base set into the grass.

Several smaller sculptures are scattered across the lawn behind and to either side of the central piece. They share a similar dark, abstract, modernist style: upright column-like forms with rounded edges, circular holes, and blocky components. One stands to the left of the main sculpture, another farther back near the center, and several more are spaced out toward the right side of the scene.

The setting is expansive and park-like, with bright green grass covering a gently descending hillside. Large leafless deciduous trees frame the scene, especially on the left and right edges. Their bare branches stretch across the upper half of the image, forming a dense network of lines against a pale blue sky. The trees suggest late winter or early spring, while the grass is already vivid and fresh.

In the midground, beyond the sculptures, there are shrubs, smaller trees, and a low modern building partially visible through the branches. Farther in the background, rolling countryside can be seen: open fields in shades of green, patches of woodland, and low hills under a bright sky. The sunlight is strong and warm, casting long shadows from the trees and sculptures across the lawn.

Overall, the image has a calm, contemplative atmosphere, combining modern abstract art with a natural rural landscape. The dark sculptural forms contrast strongly with the bright grass, delicate tree branches, and distant pastoral scenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外雕塑艺术的摄影作品，画面中心是一个大型的黑色抽象雕塑，其设计简洁而现代。周围散布着几个较小的雕塑，它们与周围的自然环境和谐地融为一体。在雕塑的背后，可以看到树木和远处的住宅区，阳光透过树叶洒在草地上，营造出一个宁静而宜人的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a grand historic stone triumphal arch in a European city, photographed on a bright, clear day under a vivid turquoise-blue sky. A French tricolor flag—blue, white, and red—flies from a pole centered on the roof of the arch, confirming the setting as France.

The arch dominates the center of the scene. It is built from pale beige limestone with warm golden tones, especially where the sunlight hits it. The structure has a large central passageway at street level, through which a road continues into the distance. The lower part of the arch is heavily textured with rusticated stone blocks, giving it a strong, fortress-like appearance. On either side of the main opening are ornate sculptural decorations: gilded-looking relief panels and circular medallions with classical figures, cherubs, and allegorical scenes. Above the archway, a decorative crest or coat of arms sits prominently, topped with a crown and featuring a blue shield with golden fleur-de-lis, a symbol associated with French royalty.

Near the top of the monument is a large rectangular inscription panel in Latin. The text includes “LUDOVICO MAGNO” and a date, “1715,” suggesting a dedication to Louis XIV, also known as Louis the Great. The upper cornice is richly detailed, with carved friezes, dentils, and ornamental motifs running across the façade.

On both sides of the arch are elegant historic buildings in a classical architectural style. The building on the left has tall rectangular windows, pilasters, decorative cornices, and a rooftop balustrade. The building on the right is similarly refined, with symmetrical windows, carved stone ornamentation, small balconies with wrought-iron railings, and a triangular pediment near the roofline. The warm sunlight casts crisp shadows, emphasizing the depth of the carvings and the architectural relief.

At street level, pedestrians are scattered across the broad paved square. Some people are walking in pairs or small groups, and a few are near the edges of the frame. A small blue car is driving directly beneath the arch, while other vehicles and street details are visible farther down the road beyond it. The pavement in the foreground is made of large, neat stone slabs, and the road through the arch is lined with buildings and streetlamps that recede into the distance.

Overall, the image conveys a lively yet orderly urban scene centered on a monumental French landmark, combining classical architecture, royal symbolism, bright Mediterranean-like light, and everyday city activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示法国某城市中心广场的现实主义风格照片。图中央是一座宏伟的拱门，上面飘扬着法国国旗，并且装饰有金色浮雕和铭文。拱门两侧是两栋具有古典建筑风格的建筑物，它们的立面装饰精美，窗户排列整齐。在拱门下方，人们正在街道上行走，一些人正穿过拱门进入广场内。一辆蓝色汽车停靠在拱门旁，而另一辆黑色轿车则驶过拱门。阳光照耀下，整个场景显得生动而宁静。

caption:
The image shows the side of an old, low-rise house on a sunny day, viewed from a slightly uphill grassy yard. The building has a traditional, somewhat weathered appearance, with pale yellow-green plaster walls and a dark reddish-brown lower foundation section. The roof is covered with gray corrugated sheets, and a reddish-brown gutter and downpipe run along the right edge of the house. A brick chimney and a small rooftop wooden structure or dormer rise above the main roofline.

The facade has several tall rectangular windows with ornate white decorative trim. Some windows appear covered or shuttered from the outside with pale panels, while others on the left have glass panes visible. The white trim around the windows is thick and sculptural, with stepped decorative shapes at the corners and tops. The wall surface is slightly uneven, showing age and plaster texture.

On the right side of the wall is a blue address plaque with white Cyrillic text reading “ул. Набережная” and the number “7,” indicating the house is on Naberezhnaya Street. Below it, on the brown foundation area, there is a small reddish sign with the letters “ПГ.” Several utility wires, antenna cables, and metal TV antennas are attached to the facade, casting sharp shadows across the wall in the bright sunlight. More wires stretch across the sky and toward poles in the background.

The foreground is a grassy garden area with small decorative elements. There are flower beds, green plants, and handmade garden ornaments. Near the center bottom is a simple wooden frame or support with two small red hanging planters. A circular flower bed bordered by green edging sits beneath it. To the right, there is a rustic decorative windmill-like object made from slatted wood, leaning slightly against the slope. On the left, a large leafy tree partially covers the house and casts shade over the yard.

The setting appears to be on a hillside or elevated street. In the far right background, beyond the house, a road slopes downward with fences, rooftops, utility poles, and green hills visible in the distance. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, giving the scene a calm rural or small-town atmosphere. The overall impression is of an older, lived-in house with decorative historic details, surrounded by a modest but lovingly arranged garden.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乡村住宅的摄影图像。房子是两层楼高，外墙涂有黄色和棕色，屋顶为灰色瓦片覆盖。前院里种有一些绿色植物和一些装饰性物品，如风车模型、彩色灯笼和其他小物件。在房子旁边有一棵大树，树下有一个小小的花园。背景中可以看到蓝天和远处的山丘。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, top-down view of a smartphone lying horizontally on a dark wooden surface with visible grain patterns and warm brown streaks.

The phone appears to be a gold-colored Samsung device with curved edges and a glossy protective case or reflective border around it. Because the phone is rotated sideways, its physical home button is visible on the left side of the image, while the earpiece, front camera, and sensors are on the right side. The word “SAMSUNG” is printed vertically near the right edge of the phone’s front panel.

On the phone’s screen is a white background displaying the Huawei branding. The red Huawei flower-like logo is positioned toward the left-center of the screen, made up of several red petal shapes radiating upward and outward. To the right of the logo is the word “HUAWEI” in large, bold, black capital letters. The screen has slight edge shading and reflections, especially near the curved sides, giving it a glossy appearance.

The overall composition is somewhat ironic or notable because a Samsung phone is displaying the Huawei logo. The dark textured wooden tabletop contrasts strongly with the bright white phone screen and the red-and-black Huawei branding.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示华为手机的图片，手机放置在深色木质桌面上。手机屏幕清晰显示了华为公司的标志和品牌名称。

caption:
The image shows a large ancient Roman amphitheater at dusk or early evening, viewed from street level at a slight upward angle. The structure dominates the frame, curving from the left side toward the right, with multiple tiers of weathered stone arches and rectangular openings.

The stone facade is illuminated by warm orange and amber lighting from below, giving the ruins a dramatic glow against the deep blue twilight sky. The contrast between the cool sky and the warm-lit stone is striking. The masonry appears old and uneven, with blocks of beige, tan, and reddish stone showing cracks, erosion, and centuries of wear.

Several levels of arches are visible. Along the lower and middle sections, tall rounded arches are supported by thick stone columns. Above them are rows of rectangular window-like openings, many of them empty, revealing the blue sky through the structure. Some darker vertical sections and shadowed recesses break up the facade, emphasizing the building’s age and partially ruined condition.

At the bottom of the image, modern elements are visible: a paved road or plaza in the foreground, metal railings, gates, signs, and a small dark car parked near the entrance area. There are also temporary-looking barriers and information boards near the base of the amphitheater, suggesting this is a tourist site or historic monument open to visitors.

The sky is clear and richly saturated, transitioning from bright cyan near the horizon to deeper blue higher up. A faint pinkish blur or lens flare appears near the top center of the image. Overall, the scene has a vivid, atmospheric quality, combining ancient architecture with modern street-level surroundings and colorful evening lighting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黄昏时分的圆形剧场的照片。剧院由一系列拱形结构组成，每层都有大小不一的窗户和门洞。剧院被暖色调的灯光照亮，与周围的暗淡背景形成鲜明对比。在剧院前方，可以看到几辆汽车停放在路边，而天空中有一颗流星划过，增添了一丝神秘感。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor public square or park area featuring a large decorative city sign for **Dimitrovgrad**.

In the foreground, there is a paved pedestrian area made of rectangular stone tiles and a band of small cobblestones. Along the edge of the walkway is a low raised stone curb or planter border. Behind it stands a large, colorful sign spelling **“DIMITROVGRAD”** in oversized freestanding Latin letters. Each letter is a different bright color—red, orange, green, blue, turquoise, yellow, pink, and purple—giving the sign a cheerful, tourist-photo-spot appearance. The letters are mounted on metal supports anchored into the ground.

Above and slightly behind the colorful Latin sign is a long dark gray horizontal sign with large white Cyrillic letters reading **“ДИМИТРОВГРАД”**. This second sign is elevated on metal posts and stretches across much of the background, reinforcing the city name in Bulgarian/Cyrillic script.

The setting appears to be a landscaped urban park or plaza. There are leafless deciduous trees with brown remaining leaves, suggesting late autumn or winter. Several evergreen trees stand behind the sign, adding dark green color to the scene. The sky is overcast and pale gray, giving the image a cool, muted atmosphere.

On the left side, a black streetlamp with two round glass globes is visible. Behind it are notice boards or display panels, some appearing blurred or indistinct. A beige multi-story building with rectangular windows and a slightly older architectural style is partly visible through the trees on the left.

On the right side, behind the sign and trees, there is a small playground area with bright blue and yellow metal structures and a red slide, partially obscured by branches. The park paths and planting beds are visible around the sign, with low shrubs and bare soil.

Overall, the image captures a city landmark sign in Dimitrovgrad, likely intended as a welcoming or photo-friendly installation in a central public space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在城市街道上的迪米特罗夫格勒（Dmitrovgrad）标志牌的照片。标志牌由彩色字母组成，色彩鲜艳，与背景中的建筑和树木形成鲜明对比。照片拍摄于白天，自然光照下，细节清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a bright, clear harbor scene on a sunny day. A large blue-and-white vessel dominates the right side of the frame, moored alongside a wooden pier. Its hull is a deep vivid blue with a white superstructure rising above it, and the name “МУРМАНСК” (Murmansk) is painted in white on the side. On the upper front of the ship, the text “IMO 9658666” is visible. The vessel appears to be a large working ship or icebreaker-style ship, with a broad rounded bow, heavy black fendering around the front, and multiple decks, railings, antennas, radar domes, and communication equipment on top. Several ropes extend from the ship down to the dock, securing it in place.

In the foreground, the water is a rich blue with ripples and reflections from the sky and dock structures. Along the right and lower portions of the image is a long quay with wooden pilings, metal railings, ropes, utility boxes, and a small building with a blue metal roof. The pier leads the eye toward the center of the harbor.

To the left of the large ship, farther back, there is a tall sailing ship with multiple masts and rigging. Its sails appear furled, and colorful signal flags run along the rigging. A very large Colombian flag—yellow, blue, and red—hangs prominently near the stern or side of the sailing ship, standing out against the pale sky and harbor backdrop. The sailing vessel is docked near a floating platform or waterfront structure.

In the background, low city buildings line the waterfront, including pale classical-looking facades and industrial elements such as chimneys or smokestacks. A small chapel-like structure with a pointed roof is visible on the far left near the water. The sky is a clear, expansive light blue with almost no clouds, giving the scene a crisp, open, maritime atmosphere. The overall impression is of a busy but calm port, with modern service vessels and a traditional tall ship sharing the same waterfront.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在港口停靠的大型蓝色船只的照片。船体巨大，装备有多个烟囱和甲板上的设备。码头上有一些小型船只和起重机，背景中可以看到城市的轮廓和蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a commercial passenger airplane on approach for landing, flying low in front of a large, green mountain landscape.

In the foreground, slightly left of center, a blue-and-white narrow-body jet is facing toward the viewer. Its landing gear is down, with the nose wheel and main wheels clearly visible, indicating it is descending toward a nearby runway. The plane’s engines hang beneath the wings, and the winglets curve upward at the tips. The aircraft appears to have a bright blue nose and fuselage accents, with a red logo on the tail and lettering along the side.

Behind the airplane is a steep, densely vegetated mountainside. The mountain is covered in rich green shrubs, trees, and tall, dark cypress-like vegetation, with patches of exposed pale rock visible in several places. Near the summit, there is a communications or radio tower structure, along with several smaller antenna masts. A few small buildings are scattered on the hillside, including one near the right edge of the frame and another lower down among the trees.

The sky is clear and pale blue, occupying the upper half of the image and giving the scene a bright, sunny atmosphere. The lighting suggests daytime, with the aircraft and hillside illuminated by warm sunlight. Overall, the image captures a dramatic moment of an airplane descending against a mountainous coastal or island-like backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架蓝色飞机在晴朗的天空中飞行的照片。飞机正从画面左侧飞向右侧，背景是覆盖着绿色植被的山丘和山顶上的一个塔状结构。

caption:
The image shows two people standing close together indoors against a plain, light gray tiled or paneled wall.

In the foreground, slightly left of center, there is a child wearing a plaid baseball cap with blue, white, and red stripes. The child’s face is intentionally blurred. They are wearing a black T-shirt with a large skull graphic on the front and a small skull-and-text design near the upper chest. One arm is raised, with the hand near the face, as if touching or covering part of it. The child appears to be holding hands with the adult beside them.

Behind and to the right of the child is an adult woman, also with her face blurred. She has dark hair pulled back and is wearing a horizontally striped shirt in dark navy/black and light gray or white. The top of the shirt has white lace-like detailing around the shoulders. A tan crossbody bag strap runs diagonally across her chest, with a small gold-colored buckle visible near the center. She is holding the child’s hand with one hand, which also has a crumpled white tissue or napkin in it. In her other hand, she holds a clear plastic water bottle with a blue label that reads “Erikli.”

The scene has a candid, documentary feel. The background is simple and uncluttered, emphasizing the two figures. The lighting is soft and even, with no harsh shadows. Both faces are blurred, likely for privacy.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到两位女性在户外的日常场景的照片。前景中，一位年轻男性戴着一顶格子图案的帽子，穿着黑色带有白色图案的T恤和深色裤子，他的身体被模糊处理以保护隐私。旁边是一位年长女性，她手持一瓶水，并穿着黑白条纹的上衣和浅色裤子。她的脸部同样被模糊处理。背景是简单的灰色墙面，没有其他显著特征。

caption:
The image shows an ornate Baroque palace courtyard, likely the Zwinger palace complex in Dresden, Germany. The scene is dominated by a richly decorated pavilion or gateway crowned by a large dark, bulbous dome with striking gilded ornamentation. At the very top sits an elaborate golden crown finial, glowing against the blue-and-white sky.

The architecture is highly sculptural and decorative. The central structure has tall pale stone columns, arched openings, carved reliefs, and numerous statues placed along ledges and rooflines. Human figures, mythological sculptures, urns, and ornamental flourishes line the balustrades, giving the building a grand, theatrical appearance. The stone façade is cream-colored but weathered in places, with darker staining that emphasizes the age and texture of the structure.

On the right side, a long wing of the palace extends into the background. It has tall green-framed arched windows, a dark roof, and more statues and gilded accents along the roofline. A curved staircase descends near the far right, where a few small figures of people are visible, emphasizing the large scale of the building.

In the foreground and courtyard area, reddish-brown paths contrast with bright green rectangular lawns. Several tall, translucent, cone-shaped structures stand along the base of the building, possibly protective covers or modern installations. Benches and small architectural details appear near the walls.

Behind and around the palace, leafless or autumn-colored trees fill the background, suggesting late autumn or early winter. Their brown and rust-colored foliage contrasts with the pale stone and gold decoration. Above, the sky is expansive and dramatic, with streaky white clouds spread across a blue background and darker gray clouds gathering toward the right.

Overall, the image conveys a sense of historic grandeur and elegance, with the richly ornamented Baroque architecture, gilded crown, sculpted figures, and formal courtyard creating a majestic European palace setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲古典建筑风格的宫殿的照片。宫殿的屋顶装饰着金色的圆顶和雕塑，墙面则覆盖着精细的石雕。在宫殿前方的花园中，可以看到几棵赤褐色的树木和排列整齐的绿色草坪。天空中有散布的云朵，为这座宏伟建筑增添了一丝宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street on a bright, sunny day, viewed from road level as if from a vehicle or sidewalk looking down the street.

In the foreground and middle distance, several vehicles are traveling along a multi-lane road. There are multiple motorcycles, some with riders wearing helmets, a small white box truck in the center lane, and several cars, including a large black SUV on the right. The traffic appears moderate and moving forward through a slightly curving section of road.

Along the right side of the street, a long row of bright orange plastic traffic barriers separates part of the roadway, suggesting construction, lane control, or a temporary traffic diversion. Near the center of the image, there are several road signs clustered around a landscaped traffic island, including blue directional arrows and red prohibition signs.
