A yellow-and-black chevron sign indicates a curve or directional change.

The street is lined with lush greenery. On the left, leafy trees partially frame the scene, with some foliage blurred in the foreground. Palm trees and dense shrubs appear along the median and sidewalks, giving the area a tropical or warm-climate feel. Near the center background, a fountain sprays water upward in an arcing shape, partly hidden by plants and vehicles, adding a decorative civic element to the street.

Tall buildings dominate the background. A modern high-rise apartment or hotel tower stands prominently in the center-left, with a pale facade, many rectangular windows, and vertical architectural panels. On the right, an older white building with weathered walls, long horizontal rows of windows, and protruding ledges runs along the street. Its facade looks somewhat aged compared with the cleaner high-rise behind it.

The lighting is strong and slightly hazy, with bright highlights on the buildings and road surface. The overall image has a soft, slightly blurred look, especially around the edges and foliage, giving it a warm, humid city atmosphere. The scene feels like a lively downtown or commercial district with traffic, high-rise residences or hotels, greenery, and road management barriers all packed into a dense urban environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一辆白色卡车正行驶在道路上，其后是几辆停靠的汽车和摩托车。街道两侧是现代建筑，包括一栋白色的高层住宅楼和一栋有黄色招牌的商业建筑。街道旁边种植着绿色植物，为这个繁忙的城市区域增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a large ocean-going cargo ship docked at an industrial port, viewed from the front-left side. The vessel appears to be a car carrier or roll-on/roll-off transport ship, with a tall, boxy, enclosed hull and a broad, flat-sided superstructure. The ship’s name, **“AMERICAN HIGHWAY,”** is visible in dark lettering on the bow area near the lower left side.

The ship is painted mostly off-white or light beige, with a darker red-brown strip along the waterline. Its bow is rounded and massive, tapering down into the water. Several rectangular openings or service bays are visible along the forward side, some with railings and equipment inside. Thick mooring lines extend from the ship down toward the dock, securing it in place.

On the upper deck, there are numerous white rounded ventilation housings or covered structures arranged in rows along the length of the vessel. The bridge and navigation area sit toward the front-left upper section, with dark windows, antennas, radar equipment, masts, and communication arrays rising above it. An orange enclosed lifeboat is mounted high on the side near the center-top of the ship, standing out against the pale hull. A red-and-white funnel or exhaust structure is also visible farther back.

The ship is positioned beside a port facility with industrial structures surrounding it. On the right side of the image, there is a large yellow metal loading structure or gantry with ladders, platforms, and framework; a sign reading **“SAFETY FIRST”** is visible on it. Additional dock buildings, metal walkways, and warehouse-like structures appear in the background. The left edge also shows parts of yellow port equipment and a pier.

The water in the foreground is calm with small ripples, reflecting muted blue-green tones. The lighting is warm and low, suggesting early morning or late afternoon sunlight. The ship’s left side and bow are bathed in golden light, while portions of the hull fall into shadow. Above, the sky is mostly clear and pale blue-gray, taking up a large portion of the image and giving the scene an open, spacious harbor atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘名为'AMERICAN HIGHWAY'的大型货船停靠在港口的照片。货船的巨大船体占据了画面的大部分，其灰色的外壳上布满了白色的圆形标记和设备。船头部分装有多个用于装卸货物的吊车臂。在货船的背后，可以看到码头上的起重机和其他工业设施，以及一些船舶和码头工作人员。整个场景被温暖的日光照亮，营造出一种平静而忙碌的工作氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright urban riverside scene under a vast, cloudless blue sky. Most of the frame is dominated by the deep blue sky, giving the cityscape a clean, open feeling.

Along the lower portion of the image is a row of large waterfront buildings, likely hotels or high-rise residences, facing a broad river in the foreground. The water is dark blue-gray with small ripples, reflecting the daylight.

On the left is a tall white high-rise with a curved façade and many evenly spaced windows. Near the top, there is yellow signage with Thai text. The building has a clean, modern hotel-like appearance, with vertical rows of windows and rounded corner sections.

In the center stands the tallest and most distinctive building: a slim high-rise tower with a dense grid of balconies or windows. At its top is a prominent golden dome, capped by a small spire, making it stand out against the blue sky. The tower has a symmetrical, formal design and appears to be a major landmark.

On the right is another large hotel building with repeating rounded balconies across its façade. A yellow sign near the roof reads “Shangri-La hotel.” The building has a layered, horizontal look, with many balcony units stacked in rows. Satellite dishes or dark circular fixtures are visible on the rooftop.

At street level, there are trees, palms, and landscaped greenery lining the riverbank. A small pavilion-like structure with a dark roof and Thai architectural styling appears near the waterfront. Several boats are docked or moving near the shore, including a white-and-green riverboat in the center foreground.

Overall, the image captures a sunny riverside cityscape with luxury hotels, high-rise architecture, tropical greenery, and boats along the water, likely in a major Southeast Asian city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸线的摄影图像，图中可见多座现代建筑群耸立在河边，其中包括几栋高耸的商业大厦和一些较低矮的住宅楼。最显眼的是位于画面中央的一栋金色圆顶的高楼，其设计独特，与周围的建筑物形成鲜明对比。河水平静地流淌着，河岸边种植有绿色植被，为这个城市场景增添了一抹生机。天空呈现出晴朗的蓝色，没有云彩，强调了这是一个温暖的白天。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit urban plaza dominated by a large turquoise-green reflecting pool and a tall fountain jet rising near the center-right. The sky is clear and intensely blue, with no clouds, giving the scene a warm Mediterranean or subtropical feel.

In the foreground, the shallow pool stretches across the width of the image. Its water is pale aqua and green, with gentle ripples and reflections of the buildings and fountain. Near the center-right, a fountain nozzle sends a powerful vertical plume of white, misty water high into the air. The spray is bright and sparkling in the sunlight, partially obscuring the buildings behind it.

On the left side stands an elegant historic cream-colored building with a prominent clock tower. The tower has arched windows, decorative vertical elements near the top, and a round clock face. Below it, the façade includes classical architectural details and the words “Cabildo Insular,” suggesting an important civic building. Several flags fly nearby, including the Spanish flag and regional/local flags.

Just to the right of the clock tower is a tall rectangular monument or tower with a large cross-like design inset into its front. At its base is a sculptural monument with dark bronze figures. The monument appears formal and commemorative, with statues standing around a stone platform. Trees and lampposts line the plaza around it.

In the middle background, partly hidden by the fountain spray, is another older building with a symmetrical façade, arched central window, and decorative roofline. It has a more muted, grayish tone due to shadow and the mist from the fountain.

On the right side of the image are modern multi-story buildings with rounded balconies, dark window bands, and beige façades. At the top of one building is a large sign reading “UNITED COLORS OF BENETTON.” Lower down, commercial signs and storefronts are visible, including a blue star-shaped “la Caixa” sign. The buildings contrast with the older civic architecture on the left.

At street level, small figures of pedestrians can be seen walking around the plaza, sitting near the water, or moving along the sidewalks. There are also trees with dense green canopies, white lampposts, and hints of traffic or parked vehicles in the distance.

Overall, the scene presents a spacious, lively city square with a mix of historic monuments, civic architecture, modern commercial buildings, and a prominent decorative fountain under strong midday sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场的摄影图像，中心是一个喷泉，水柱高耸入云。喷泉周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和一些行人。背景中可以看到几座具有不同建筑风格的建筑物，包括一个带有钟楼的塔式建筑和一座现代风格的高楼。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为这个场景增添了活力与色彩。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic rural landscape under a vivid blue sky. In the foreground, tall green grass and wild vegetation cover a gently sloping hillside. Near the right side of the image stands a small, rustic stone building, weathered and partially overgrown. Its walls are made of rough beige-gray stone with patches of exposed red brick around the windows and doorways. The roof is covered with old terracotta tiles, many of them uneven and mottled with orange lichen or moss, giving the structure an aged, abandoned feel.

Several small openings are visible on the building: a dark rectangular window on the right, another smaller window lower down with a brick frame, and a boarded or shuttered doorway near the bottom right. Thin vines and climbing plants grow up the front of the structure. In front of it are a few pruned, leafing trees or vines with twisted trunks, suggesting an old vineyard or orchard. Low shrubs and yellow-green flowering plants surround the base of the building.

Beyond the cottage, the landscape opens into rolling green hills and valleys. The fields are a patchwork of different shades of green, suggesting farmland, meadows, and cultivated areas. Lines of trees, possibly cypress or other tall narrow trees, trace some roads and property boundaries in the distance. Small clusters of farmhouses and buildings are scattered across the hillsides. The terrain rises and falls softly, with darker wooded areas on some slopes and lighter grassy fields in others.

The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image and is a deep, saturated blue. Large white cumulus clouds dominate the scene, especially toward the center and right, where they form towering, billowing shapes with soft gray shadows underneath. Smaller puffy clouds float on the left side of the sky. The sunlight is bright and clear, casting crisp highlights across the grass, hills, and building, creating a peaceful countryside atmosphere.

Overall, the scene feels like a tranquil rural area, possibly in the Mediterranean or Tuscan countryside, with an old stone farm structure set against expansive green hills and dramatic springtime clouds.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乡村景观的照片，画面中心是一座老旧的石质建筑，其屋顶覆盖着红色瓦片。建筑周围生长着绿色植被和几棵树木，包括一棵枝条裸露的树干和一些低矮的灌木。在建筑的背后，可以看到连绵起伏的山丘和一片开阔的田野，天空中飘浮着几朵蓬松的白云。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit Mediterranean hillside town made up of tightly clustered whitewashed buildings. The architecture is layered and terraced, with homes stacked along a slope, creating a dense patchwork of flat roofs, balconies, arched openings, terraces, and small windows.

A large portion of the frame is filled with bright white façades, many slightly weathered with patches of exposed stone, pale beige staining, and uneven plaster textures. Some buildings have green or brown shutters, narrow doors, small balconies with railings, and rooftop terraces. Several satellite dishes, TV antennas, chimneys, and utility poles are visible, adding everyday detail to the historic setting.

Near the upper left stands a prominent old church bell tower made of warm, aged stone. It rises above the surrounding buildings and has an arched opening where bells can be seen. The tower has decorative stonework and a rounded top, contrasting with the simpler white houses around it. Part of a larger church façade is visible to its left.

In the middle of the town, a long row of arched porticos or covered balconies runs across the white buildings, creating rhythmic curved shapes. Below and between the houses are exposed rocky areas and retaining walls, suggesting the town is built directly into a rugged hillside. The buildings vary in height and shape, giving the scene an organic, historic feel rather than a planned grid.

The lower foreground is filled with dense green trees and vegetation, which frame the town and add contrast to the white architecture. At the bottom right, a small white car is partially visible near a road or parking area. The sky above is a clear, vivid blue with no clouds, occupying the upper half of the image and emphasizing the bright, dry, sunny atmosphere.

Overall, the scene feels like a picturesque old town in southern Italy or another Mediterranean region, with whitewashed walls, historic stone architecture, and strong sunlight creating crisp shadows and a warm, tranquil mood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示地中海风格小镇的摄影作品。图像中心是一座具有特色的白色建筑，其屋顶和墙壁上装饰着一些小型阳台和窗户。这座建筑位于一个较高的位置，周围是密集的白色房屋，形成了一个多层次的城市景观。在画面顶部可以看到一座显眼的钟楼，其独特的形状与周围的建筑形成对比。整个场景被阳光照耀，呈现出一种明亮而清新的氛围。

caption:
The image shows four young schoolgirls sitting close together on a grassy hillside in bright daylight. Their faces are intentionally blurred, but they appear to be posing for a group photo.

They are all wearing similar school uniforms: white long-sleeved shirts, white hijabs, and long red skirts. Some have red or dark-colored neck scarves or ties as part of the uniform. Their shoes vary—there are black sneakers, pink shoes, and white sneakers visible among the tall green grass.

The girls are seated in a relaxed row, leaning slightly toward one another, suggesting friendship or a casual school outing. The sunlight is strong, creating bright highlights on their white clothing and casting shadows in the grass.

The setting is outdoors in a rural or mountainous area. Behind them is a soft-focus landscape with green vegetation, dry grass, rocks, and terraced fields or hillside farmland. The background is blurred, emphasizing the group in the foreground while still giving a sense of a scenic countryside environment. The overall mood is warm, peaceful, and cheerful, like a school trip or outdoor break in nature.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示四名穿着传统服装的儿童坐在绿色草地上的照片。孩子们都戴着头巾，穿着红色的裙子和白色的衬衫，并且每个人都系着一条鲜艳的领带。他们的鞋子是黑色的运动鞋，与他们的白色袜子形成对比。背景中可以看到一片绿色的草地和远处的山丘，为这个场景增添了一种宁静而自然的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit traditional tannery courtyard, likely in an old North African or Middle Eastern medina. The scene is dominated by rows of large, circular stone-and-tile vats built into the ground, arranged tightly together in a honeycomb-like pattern. Many of the vats are filled with opaque liquids in earthy colors—muddy yellow, tan, brown, and several bright reddish-pink pools—suggesting different dyeing or tanning stages.

Across the vats are piles of pale, wet animal hides or leather skins, folded and draped over the rims. Some hides are smooth and cloth-like, while others are shaggy or fringed, hanging in thick, heavy masses. The entire work area has a reddish-brown, clay-stained appearance, with dark wet patches around the vat edges.

On the right side, several workers are visible. One person wearing a broad straw hat bends over a hide near a red-stained vat, appearing to handle or prepare the leather. Nearby, two other people stand beside stacked hides; one wears a greenish coat and another is partly covered by large bundles of pale hides. A green plastic bag sits on the edge of one of the vats, adding a small modern detail to the otherwise old-world setting.

In the background is a weathered ochre-colored building with rough plaster walls, dark wooden doors, small barred windows, and black wall-mounted lamps. A narrow stairway with worn reddish steps climbs diagonally up the wall to an upper walkway. The upper balcony has carved wooden posts and decorative black metal railings. A partially visible person stands on the balcony near a wooden door.

The lighting is strong and direct, casting sharp shadows and emphasizing the warm tones of the scene: terracotta reds, dusty oranges, beige plaster, and rust-colored masonry. The overall atmosphere is busy, textured, and traditional, capturing the labor-intensive process of leather tanning in an old urban workshop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统皮革制作工艺的摄影照片。图像中心是几个大型圆形皮革染缸，其中一些染缸中装满了棕色和红色的液体，而其他染缸则为空。在染缸周围，可以看到穿着传统服饰的人们正在忙碌地工作，他们的动作表明正在进行某种皮革处理或准备过程。背景中的建筑物具有典型的摩洛哥风格，有着拱形窗户和木制结构，与前景形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny beach scene with a wide view of the sea and distant mountains.

In the foreground, there is golden sand with several white plastic sun loungers, most of them topped with vivid blue cushions or towels. A few dark blue towels are spread directly on the sand. Two large straw parasols with conical, woven tops stand near the waterline; one is fully visible near the center-left, while another is partly cut off on the far left. Their dark support poles cast shade over the loungers below.

The shoreline is slightly rocky, with a band of dark stones and coral-like rocks separating the sandy beach from the shallow water. The sea near the shore is a pale turquoise and greenish-blue, clear enough to suggest shallow water. Farther out, the water deepens into a rich, dark blue, creating a strong horizontal color contrast across the image. Small ripples and glints of sunlight are visible on the surface.

In the middle distance, on the left side, there appears to be a floating dock or water activity platform with small figures and equipment, possibly for snorkeling, boating, or diving. A line of small buoys stretches across the water, marking off a swimming or activity area.

The background features a long, low desert coastline with beige hills and mountains rising on the right side. The land looks dry and rocky, with muted tan and gray tones. Above it, the sky is intensely blue and mostly clear, with a few thin, wispy clouds near the horizon.

Overall, the scene feels like a warm seaside resort or tropical/desert beach destination, with calm shallow water, beach furniture, straw umbrellas, and a striking blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩景观的照片，前景中有几把草编遮阳伞和蓝色的躺椅散布在沙滩上。清澈的海水呈现出深浅不一的蓝绿色调，与天空的颜色相呼应。背景中可以看到远处的山脉轮廓，以及一些水上活动的人们。整个场景被阳光照耀着，营造出一个宁静而放松的度假氛围。

caption:
The image shows a person dressed in an ornate historical military uniform, photographed outdoors against a clear blue sky. The person is shown from about the waist up, standing in profile and facing toward the left side of the frame. Their face is intentionally blurred, while the uniform and helmet are sharply visible.

They are wearing a dark, almost black, fitted military coat with bright red accents. The collar is high and red, wrapping around the neck, and the sleeve cuffs are also red with shiny metallic buttons. Down the front of the coat is a vertical row of polished silver-colored buttons, with a narrow red trim line running alongside the closure.

On the shoulders are elaborate epaulettes: large, rounded, gold-toned shoulder pieces with decorative braided trim. The right shoulder epaulette has a pale central panel with small star-like markings or symbols. A small medal or insignia shaped like a cross is pinned on the chest.

The person wears a glossy black helmet with a short front visor and a high metal crest. The helmet is decorated with bright silver-colored fittings, including a frontal plate with an eagle-like emblem and ornate scrollwork. A tall finial rises from the top of the helmet, ending in a flame- or plume-shaped metallic ornament. There is also a shiny metal side piece near the ear, possibly part of the helmet’s chinstrap or decorative hardware.

A white belt or sash crosses diagonally over the torso, supporting a ceremonial sword or sabre. The sword’s curved brass or bronze-colored guard and dark ribbed grip are visible near the waist, with part of the white scabbard hanging downward. Around the waist is a wide, pale decorative belt with a patterned, gold-toned surface.

The lower visible part of the uniform includes white trousers or a white lower garment, contrasting strongly with the dark coat and red trim. The overall appearance suggests a formal ceremonial or historical reenactment uniform, likely inspired by 19th-century European military dress. The background is simple and uncluttered, consisting mostly of bright sky with a faint, blurred horizon near the bottom of the image.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位穿着传统军装的人物的照片。人物站立，面向左侧，头戴一顶装饰有徽章的黑色头盔，并佩戴着红色领巾和肩章。他身穿一件深绿色上衣，胸前饰有金色的徽章和勋章，下身是白色裤子，腰部系着一条红色腰带。他的左手拿着一把剑，剑鞘上有银色的装饰。背景是一个清晰的蓝天，没有其他显著特征。

caption:
The image shows an ancient Buddhist temple complex, likely in Thailand, dominated by a tall central stupa or chedi rising dramatically into a cloudy sky. The structure is built mostly from weathered red-orange brick and aged plaster, with dark staining and erosion that give it a historic, centuries-old appearance.

At the center is a long brick staircase leading straight upward to a narrow dark entrance in the base of the main chedi. Several visitors are walking up and down the steps, giving a sense of scale—the monument is very large and imposing. The stairway has low brick side rails, worn and uneven from age.

The main chedi has a broad, rounded base that narrows upward into a tall, tapering spire. The lower part is mottled with black, gray, tan, and reddish tones from age and weathering. Near the top, the spire has ring-like bands before ending in a thin pointed finial.

On both sides of the main structure are smaller chedis with bright yellow cloth wrapped around their bases, a common devotional feature in Thai Buddhist temples. These smaller spires echo the shape of the central one but are shorter and more slender.

Large seated Buddha statues are partially visible on the far left and right, set behind broken brick walls. Both statues appear to be draped with yellow cloth. The statue on the right is more visible, showing a serene pale face and upper body emerging above the brick enclosure.

The foreground consists of a wide, open paved area of worn stone or concrete, leading toward the temple’s raised brick platform. A small child is walking near the lower left foreground, while a signboard stands to the right of the staircase. The surrounding brickwork is crumbling in places, with missing sections, exposed layers, and uneven surfaces that emphasize the ruin-like character of the site.

The sky above is bright but overcast, filled with soft white and gray clouds. The overall composition is symmetrical and vertical, with the central staircase and towering chedi drawing the eye upward. The scene feels historic, sacred, and monumental, combining active tourism with the quiet grandeur of an ancient religious site.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国古代寺庙建筑的照片。在画面中央，一座宏伟的寺庙塔楼耸立着，其顶端装饰有金色的尖顶和横梁。寺庙的入口处有一段宽阔的石阶，几位游客正在攀登。寺庙的外墙由红砖构成，部分墙面已经破损，显示出岁月的痕迹。在前景中，可以看到一位小孩站在地面上，而其他游客则沿着楼梯向上移动。天空中有散布的云朵，为这个场景增添了一丝宁静与庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit urban park with a city skyline rising behind it. The foreground is an open, pale grass or dirt lawn, broad and mostly flat, with scattered people relaxing, walking, and playing. Near the center foreground, two people stand facing the camera; one wears dark clothing and the other appears to be in a black dress, giving the scene a casual, candid feel. To the left, a small group of people gathers near the edge of the lawn, while farther right there are several tiny figures spread across the field, including people sitting on the ground and others moving about.

A line of dense trees forms a natural border between the park and the buildings beyond. The trees vary in color and shape: many are deep green and full, while others have warm autumn tones—orange, gold, and brown—suggesting late fall or early winter. Some trees on the right have sparse leaves and dark, twisting branches, adding contrast against the bright sky.

Behind the trees, a modern city skyline is visible. The most prominent structure is a tall, pale skyscraper slightly left of center, with a tiered, stepped top and a thin antenna or mast extending upward. Its vertical form dominates the scene. Other mid- and high-rise buildings appear to the right, including glassy office towers and rectangular white buildings, partially obscured by the treetops.

The sky takes up much of the upper half of the image. It is bright blue with soft, white clouds scattered across it, creating an airy and open atmosphere. The lighting is warm and gentle, casting long shadows on the lawn, which suggests the photo was taken in the afternoon. Overall, the image combines a peaceful park setting with a clean, modern metropolitan backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园景观的照片，前景中有一对穿着休闲服装的男女在草地上散步，他们身后是秋天的树木和一些坐在长椅上的人。背景中耸立着几座现代摩天大楼，它们的玻璃幕墙反射着阳光。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows the interior of an ornate Islamic architectural space, likely the entrance or alcove of a historic mosque, madrasa, mausoleum, or palace. The view is angled upward and centered symmetrically, emphasizing the richly decorated arch, ceiling, and tiled walls.

At the top is a large pointed arch framing a deep recessed niche. The arch and vault are covered in dense geometric and floral ornamentation. The ceiling features intricate muqarnas-like forms—small, tiered, honeycomb or stalactite-style architectural elements—arranged in layered patterns. These surfaces are decorated with vivid glazed tiles in cobalt blue, turquoise, teal, white, gold, orange, and green. The patterns include repeating stars, polygons, rosettes, arabesques, and interlocking geometric shapes.

The upper side walls are also covered with repeating tile motifs. Many of the tiles are set in hexagonal or star-like arrangements, creating a rhythmic mosaic across the curved surfaces. Large medallion-like floral patterns appear on both sides near the top, surrounded by smaller repeating motifs. The overall effect is extremely detailed and almost kaleidoscopic.

Across the middle of the image, below the vaulted niche, there is a horizontal band of blue tilework filled with Arabic calligraphy. The script is painted in white and golden-orange tones, flowing across rectangular panels. This calligraphic frieze stands out strongly against the deep blue background and separates the upper ornamental vault from the lower wall and doorway area.

Beneath the calligraphy is a doorway or window screened by a wooden or stone lattice. The lattice has a repeating honeycomb pattern made of interlocking hexagonal openings. Through the openings, daylight and greenery are visible outside, suggesting a courtyard or garden beyond. The warm beige color of the lattice contrasts with the cool blues and greens of the tiles.

On either side of the doorway are vertical decorative tile panels, each filled with symmetrical floral and geometric designs in blue, turquoise, green, white, and gold. Lower portions of the walls include pale stone or plaster panels with carved or inscribed details, including additional bands of calligraphy and geometric linework.

The image is dominated by symmetry, pattern, and color. The architecture feels highly ceremonial and sacred, with every surface treated as a canvas for ornament. The combination of Islamic calligraphy, geometric tiling, floral arabesques, muqarnas vaulting, and filtered light creates a richly textured, luminous, and reverent atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伊斯兰建筑风格的精美马赛克照片。图像中心是一个复杂的几何图案，由多种颜色和形状的瓷砖组成，创造出丰富的视觉效果。上方是一个半圆形的拱顶结构，同样装饰着精细的马赛克。在前景中，有一个带有复杂几何图案的木制格子窗，其设计与整个场景的风格相协调。

caption:
The image shows a bright, panoramic coastal scene viewed from an elevated hillside lookout. In the foreground and right side is a modern white building with a large glass-walled upper section, resembling a viewpoint café or restaurant. The glass structure has a slanted roof and a grid of metal framing, reflecting sunlight and revealing tables and seating inside. Attached to it is an outdoor terrace with many empty tables and chairs, partly shaded by a light-colored canopy.

A paved walkway and railings curve around the building, with a few people standing or walking near the entrance and on the terrace area. A tall, slim streetlamp rises prominently on the right side of the frame. In the lower foreground, dry reddish-brown shrubs and grasses partially frame the view, while a small evergreen tree and a lower patio area appear to the left.

Beyond the building, a wide blue fjord or harbor stretches across the middle of the image. The water is calm, with subtle ripples and faint boat wakes. Small boats and waterfront structures are visible along the shoreline. Across the water, low islands or peninsulas are dotted with houses and greenery.

In the background, large dark mountains form a dramatic horizon. The mountains on the left are broad and plateau-like, with steep faces and patches of sunlight and shadow. On the right, smaller rounded mountains rise behind a coastal settlement. The sky is clear and pale blue, with soft, even daylight suggesting a sunny day, possibly late afternoon due to the warm golden light and long shadows.

Overall, the image captures a scenic lookout terrace overlooking a Norwegian-style coastal town, fjord, islands, and surrounding mountains, combining architecture, tourism, and expansive natural scenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于山丘上的建筑的照片，建筑具有现代设计风格，顶部覆盖着透明的玻璃屋顶。建筑前方是一个开放的空间，供人休息和欣赏周围的自然景观。在建筑前，有几位游客正在散步或停留。背景中是宁静的湖泊和远处连绵起伏的山脉，天空晴朗，阳光明媚。

caption:
The image shows a quiet outdoor area in what appears to be a Japanese park or historic site, with a low, traditional-style building used for public facilities.

A long, single-story structure stretches across the middle of the scene. It has white plaster walls with dark wooden trim and a grey, gently sloping tiled roof made of curved ceramic tiles. The roofline is slightly uneven in sections, giving the building an older, traditional look. Above one doorway is a wooden sign with Japanese characters reading “御手洗,” indicating restrooms. Blue restroom signs with male/female icons are visible near the entrance, and there are also wheelchair-accessible signs on the left side.

Large leafy trees dominate the upper half of the image, their branches extending over the roof and casting shade. The foliage is dense and green, with a few yellowing leaves suggesting late summer or early autumn. Behind the building, more trees and a stone wall are visible, reinforcing the sense that this is within a garden, temple grounds, castle park, or historic public area.

Several people are present. On the left, a few visitors sit on a bench under the eaves, resting in the shade. One person wears a bright yellow hooded top and looks down, possibly at a phone. Others sit nearby with bags and umbrellas. Near the center and right, people stand or walk in front of the facility; some appear to be checking signs or vending/ticket-style boards posted on the wall. A stroller is visible on the far right beside an adult and a child.

The right side of the building has a more open frontage with many posters, notices, and informational signs displayed on the wall and windows. There is also a small signboard area, a traffic cone, and a blue “cool” sign or misting/cooling station near the entrance, with a faint mist or haze visible in front of the building.

The foreground is a wide, pale gravel or paved walkway, open and sunlit, contrasting with the shaded building and trees. On the far left, a bicycle is parked near a utility box and blue cones. Overall, the scene feels calm and practical—a shaded rest stop with restrooms and information services in a traditional Japanese setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统建筑风格的建筑外观的照片。建筑物有两层，底层为开放式的门廊，上面是黑色瓦片屋顶的传统日式屋檐。门前有几个游客在休息或等待，有的坐着，有的站着。建筑前有几棵茂密的大树，树叶呈现出深绿色，与建筑的白色和黑色形成对比。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large exhibition or trade fair hall, photographed from a central aisle. The space is defined by tall, clean white booth structures arranged in rows, forming a corridor-like passage. The floor is covered in a vivid pink or magenta carpet that runs throughout the scene, creating strong contrast with the white walls.

In the center foreground, three people are walking away from the camera down the aisle. They appear to be visitors or attendees at the event. The person on the left wears a dark green jacket and dark trousers, with their hands clasped behind their back. The middle person wears a light-colored suit or jacket and trousers, while the person on the right wears a bright blue jacket with jeans. They are walking toward a booth area in the distance.

The white exhibition booths are tall and rectangular, with smooth surfaces and sharp edges. Some have recessed entrances or display windows near the lower sides, and a few areas inside the booths are softly lit with warm recessed spotlights. On the right side, a narrow opening reveals hanging garments or fabric items, suggesting a fashion, textile, or design trade show.

The ceiling is high and industrial, with a grid-like pattern of square recessed panels. Several black pendant lights hang from above, along with long fluorescent light fixtures. Large structural columns and gray wall panels are visible in the background, emphasizing the scale of the convention hall.

At the far end of the aisle, there is a booth with signage and a red-and-white design. A sign appears to include the word “Sposaitalia,” suggesting the event may be related to bridal fashion or formalwear. A small red safety sign with icons is mounted near the center-right background.

Overall, the scene feels modern, spacious, and orderly, with a minimalist exhibition layout dominated by white booth walls, warm interior lighting, and the striking pink carpet guiding visitors through the venue.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示展览空间内部的照片，几位参观者正在粉色地毯上行走。他们穿着休闲服装，其中一位女士穿着蓝色上衣和黑色裤子，而另外两位男士分别穿着深色外套和浅色裤子。展览空间由白色的立柱和隔断构成，顶部有吊灯提供照明。整个场景显得干净且有序，光线均匀地照亮了整个空间。

caption:
The image shows an industrial storage yard filled with stacked cylindrical tank containers under a bright, expansive sky.

In the lower half of the scene, rows of white ISO tank containers are arranged in metal frames, stacked two to three levels high. Many of the tanks are branded with the logo “Stolt Tank Containers,” featuring a red “S” mark and yellow label. Several containers also have vertical blue labels reading “EXSIF.” The tanks are enclosed in rectangular steel frames, mostly painted dark blue or purple, which allow them to be stacked securely. Some tanks show small hazard placards, identification markings, warning symbols, and container numbers printed on their sides.

The containers stretch across the width of the image, forming separate blocks or stacks. On the left edge, a partial stack is visible, while the central and right sections show larger, more complete stacks. The ground appears to be a flat paved industrial surface, likely concrete or interlocking pavers, with a wide open area in front of the containers.

The upper portion of the image is dominated by a vivid blue sky with many white clouds. A large, bright cumulus cloud rises prominently near the center, towering above the containers and giving the scene a dramatic, open-air feeling. Around it are thinner, scattered cloud formations, especially across the top and right side of the sky. The lighting suggests a sunny daytime setting, with strong brightness and clear visibility.

On the right side behind the container stacks, some green trees are visible, adding a natural contrast to the industrial equipment. Overall, the image captures a logistics or chemical transport storage area, with neatly stacked tank containers beneath a broad, partly cloudy sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多组大型储罐的照片，储罐被堆叠在一起，每个储罐上都有公司的标志。照片的背景是蓝天和几朵白云，这些储罐位于一个开阔的户外区域。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit outdoor pedestrian promenade, likely in a beachside shopping and dining area. The scene has a warm, relaxed resort atmosphere with a vivid turquoise-blue sky and strong midday light.

Overhead, the most striking feature is a canopy made of many stretched fabric panels resembling sails or shade cloths. These panels are suspended on cables across the walkway in layers, creating a patchwork ceiling of beige, tan, cream, white, and occasional orange and reddish fabric. Some of the panels have printed markings, numbers, or partial text, including “JUMEIRAH BEACH.” Strings of hanging bulbs run between the canopies, with exposed glass light bulbs dangling at regular intervals. Large industrial-style lamps are mounted on tall wooden poles along the walkway.

The promenade itself is wide and paved, with embedded parallel track-like lines running down the center. People are walking, standing, and socializing throughout the scene. In the foreground, a couple stands near the center-left: one person wears a greenish top and light denim shorts, while the other wears a black sleeveless shirt, yellow shorts, sandals, and a black backpack. Their faces are blurred. Farther down the walkway, families and groups stroll in both directions; a person pushes a stroller, and several children are visible near the middle distance.

On both sides of the walkway are restaurants, cafés, shops, signs, seating areas, and decorative landscaping. To the right, there are outdoor café tables and chairs, a white patio umbrella, planters with grasses, and a building façade with glass doors and windows. A circular sign with a red rooster silhouette is mounted on the building. Nearby, a freestanding menu board advertises food, including “Buffalo Chicken,” with Arabic text and a price in AED.

On the left and center background, there are colorful storefronts and kiosks, including a sign that reads “EEKIN’ LICIOUS” or similar lettering. More Arabic and English signage appears in the distance. Turquoise-painted structural elements and railings add to the beachy, modern design. Wooden benches, posts, small barrels, banners, and decorative poles line the walkway.

The overall color palette is airy and summery: bright cyan sky, sandy beige canopies, warm wooden poles, pastel storefronts, and sunlit pavement. The layered shade sails create dynamic shadows across the ground, while the bustling pedestrian activity gives the scene a lively, leisure-oriented feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市街景的照片，画面中心是两位女性站在人行道上，她们似乎在交谈。街道两旁装饰着多彩的遮阳篷和树木，营造出一种休闲的氛围。街道上有其他行人和一些停靠的车辆，远处可见建筑群。阳光明媚，天空呈现出晴朗的蓝色，整个场景洋溢着活力与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a group of tourists gathered at an outdoor historical site, looking toward a famous-looking tree with a stone Buddha head embedded among its roots.

In the center background, a massive tree dominates the scene. Its thick, pale gray roots twist downward and outward in dense, tangled strands, wrapping around an old brick structure. Near the base of the roots, a weathered stone Buddha face is visible, partially enclosed by the roots as if the tree has grown around it over many years. The face is calm and worn, with closed or lowered eyes, creating a striking focal point.

Behind the tree is an ancient reddish-brown brick wall, uneven and partially ruined. Some roots crawl across the brick surface, emphasizing the age of the site and the way nature has merged with the ruins. The brickwork appears old, with darkened patches, gaps, and mossy areas. More low brick ruins and walkways extend into the background, where additional visitors can be seen.

In the foreground, many tourists stand closely together on a brick-paved walkway. Most are facing away from the camera toward the tree and Buddha head. Several are wearing sun hats or caps, suggesting a hot, sunny day. One person near the center wears a white baseball cap and carries a bright blue, yellow, and white patterned backpack. Another person nearby has a teal-and-green backpack. On the right, a person in a long white outfit and a wide-brimmed white hat stands near an informational sign. A few visitors appear to be holding up phones or cameras to take pictures.

The lighting is bright and warm, with patches of sunlight filtering through leafy trees overhead. The scene has a busy tourist atmosphere, but also a quiet sense of reverence because of the sacred-looking statue and ancient ruins. The combination of the large tree roots, the old brick wall, and the Buddha head creates a dramatic image of history, nature, and cultural heritage intertwined.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群游客在参观一个古老建筑的照片。他们站在一棵巨大的树下，树干上覆盖着藤蔓和绿叶。人群中，一些人戴着帽子，穿着休闲服装，有的背着背包，似乎正在聆听导游的讲解或欣赏周围的景色。背景中可以看到部分被风化的砖墙和红色的屋顶瓦片，增添了一种历史感。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit entrance to a historic fortress or architectural complex, framed by dense green trees. The scene is symmetrical and inviting, with a paved pedestrian path leading straight toward a large arched gateway.

At the center is a formal neoclassical-style gate built into red brick walls. The gateway has cream-colored columns and trim, with green-painted architectural panels that contrast strongly with the brick. Above the arch is a triangular pediment decorated with ornate white relief sculpture, including military or naval motifs such as flags, anchors, and shields. Near the top of the gate, the date “1787” is written in gold, suggesting the structure’s historic significance.

The central archway is tall and rounded, with a hanging black lantern suspended inside. Through the opening, a glimpse of another pale, stately building can be seen in the distance, giving the sense that the gateway leads into a larger historic courtyard or plaza. A number of visitors and tourists are walking toward and through the arch, dressed casually for warm weather. Some carry backpacks, and small groups are gathered near the entrance.

The foreground features a walkway made of smooth stone slabs bordered by cobblestones, creating a textured path that draws the eye toward the gate. On either side are patches of green grass and low shrubs. The top and sides of the image are filled with leafy tree branches, forming a natural frame around the architecture. The leaves are vivid green, suggesting late spring or summer.

On the right side of the gate, mounted against the red brick wall, there is a large poster with Russian text and an image of a sailing ship on rough seas. The visible writing includes “Виват флоту России!” which translates roughly to “Long live the Russian fleet!” This reinforces the naval or military theme of the site.

The sky above is clear and bright blue, and the overall atmosphere is cheerful, warm, and touristic. The combination of historic architecture, lush greenery, and strolling visitors gives the image the feel of a well-preserved cultural landmark on a pleasant summer day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影照片，画面中心是一座装饰华丽的拱门建筑，其上方有一个金色的浮雕。拱门两侧是红砖墙，墙上挂有宣传海报。在拱门下方，一群游客正在通过一条铺砌的小路进入或离开这个区域。周围环境由绿色的树木和草地组成，营造出一个宜人的户外氛围。

caption:
The image shows a street-side fruit vendor in a leafy urban area. On the right side, a person wearing a wide-brimmed woven sun hat and a bright red jacket is standing beside a fruit display. Their face is intentionally blurred. They are holding up a long, peeled yellow fruit slice sealed in a clear plastic bag—likely mango or a similar tropical fruit—and raising one finger as if explaining, signaling, or posing for the photo.

In the foreground, there is a street cart or basket setup filled with fruit. A large red plastic basin contains several pale green mangoes or guavas, along with cut yellow-orange fruit pieces. Some fruit slices are packaged in clear plastic bags and arranged upright near the front. Another red bowl to the left holds more prepared fruit portions, including pale yellow slices and orange pieces. Plastic bags and utensils are visible around the display, suggesting the fruit is being sold ready-to-eat.

The background is a shaded sidewalk lined with tall trees whose trunks have white-painted bases. Parked vehicles and scooters line the street, including a gray car on the left and several motorbikes behind the vendor. Farther back, there are green vehicles, road signs, and a café or storefront with umbrellas and outdoor seating on the right. The scene feels calm and slightly overcast, with soft light filtering through the dense green tree canopy. The overall setting appears to be a busy but relaxed roadside market or street food area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示街头水果摊贩的现实主义风格照片。图中，一位身穿红色夹克和宽边帽的人站在街道上，手持一袋黄色的芒果。摊位上摆放着各种切片的水果，包括柠檬、橙子和柚子。背景中有停放的摩托车、绿色树木和模糊的行人身影，营造出一个繁忙的城市街景氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, wide-angle view of a traditional Korean temple courtyard set against forested mountains under a clear blue sky.

In the foreground, a large open-sided pavilion dominates the scene. It has a dramatic curved tiled roof with dark gray ceramic tiles arranged in rounded rows, ending in decorative circular tile caps. The roofline sweeps upward at the corners, typical of East Asian temple architecture, and a small ornamental finial rises from the center ridge. Beneath the eaves, the pavilion is richly decorated with colorful **dancheong** patterns—intricate painted designs in green, teal, red, blue, cream, and gold. Floral motifs, geometric borders, and layered bracket structures cover the underside of the roof, giving the structure a highly ornate appearance.

The pavilion is supported by thick red wooden columns, slightly weathered at the base. Inside it stands a large stone lantern or pagoda-like monument, carved from pale stone. It has a broad, mushroom-like roof section, a hollow central chamber, and a rounded pedestal below, suggesting it may be an old ceremonial stone lantern. A small informational plaque and a standing stone marker with vertical Korean writing are placed to the right of the structure.

Several visitors stand in front of the pavilion, looking toward the stone lantern. One adult wearing a cap and backpack stands with two children, all seen from behind. Around the courtyard, other people walk, sit, or explore the temple grounds, giving the scene a calm tourist or pilgrimage atmosphere.

Behind the pavilion is a larger temple hall with green doors, red columns, and more colorful painted trim. A sign with Korean text is visible on the front of the building. Additional temple buildings appear on both sides, with dark tiled roofs and red-painted wooden walls. Low stone walls border parts of the courtyard.

The background is filled with leafless trees and evergreen-covered hills, suggesting late autumn, winter, or early spring. Rocky mountain slopes rise in the distance, framing the temple complex. The strong sunlight, crisp shadows, and cloudless sky create a peaceful, vivid scene emphasizing both the architecture and the natural mountain setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示韩国传统建筑风格的摄影照片，画面中心是一座装饰华丽、色彩鲜艳的亭子，其屋顶和柱子上都绘有精细的图案。亭子前有一对成人和两个小孩站在喷泉边，似乎在欣赏或准备洗手。周围环境宁静，远处可见其他游客和几座小屋，天空晴朗，阳光明媚。

caption:
The image shows a large, ornate Chinese ceremonial archway or paifang standing over a city street, likely marking the entrance to a Chinatown district.

The structure dominates the frame and is photographed from a low angle, making it appear tall and imposing against a pale blue, lightly clouded sky. It has multiple tiered roofs with dramatically upturned eaves, a hallmark of traditional Chinese architecture. The roof edges are decorated with gold-colored tiles and small sculptural ornaments, including dragon-like figures and decorative finials along the ridgelines. Beneath the roofs, the underside is densely detailed with layered wooden bracket sets painted in deep blue, green, red, and gold.

The arch is extremely colorful and elaborate. Its main pillars are bright red, while the decorative panels and beams are covered in vivid blue, green, gold, white, and red patterns. Many panels contain intricate relief designs, including stylized dragons, floral motifs, swirling clouds, and geometric borders. The gold ornamentation stands out strongly against the saturated blue and green backgrounds. Some panels feature framed scenes or symbols, giving the structure a richly handcrafted, ceremonial appearance.

There appear to be three main openings beneath the arch, with the central section taller and more prominent than the side sections. A hanging lantern or street lamp sits in the foreground near the center, partially obscuring part of the arch. The lamp post is green with a decorative lantern housing that echoes the traditional style of the gate.

Behind the archway is an urban street lined with older brick buildings. The buildings have sash windows, chimneys, and shopfronts at street level. Several signs are visible, including one reading “CHINESE RESTAURANT,” reinforcing the Chinatown setting. On the right side, part of a building façade includes green trim and red signage, matching the general Chinese decorative theme.

Overall, the image captures a vibrant, richly decorated Chinese gateway set within a British-looking urban streetscape. The contrast between the ornate, colorful arch and the more muted brick buildings behind it makes the gate the clear focal point of the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国风格的拱门的照片，位于一个城市街道上。拱门装饰着鲜艳的蓝色和红色图案，顶部有金色的龙形装饰，显得非常华丽。拱门两侧各有一个绿色的路灯柱，上面挂着灯笼。在拱门的背后可以看到一排红砖建筑，其中有一家标有'CHINESE RESTAURANT'字样的餐厅。天空是晴朗的，云朵稀疏，为这个场景增添了一丝宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up shot of a red Coca-Cola bottle positioned prominently on the right side of the frame. The bottle fills much of the foreground and is in sharp focus, while the background is heavily blurred, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect.

The bottle has the recognizable white Coca-Cola script logo wrapping across it, though only part of the lettering is visible due to the close crop. Near the lower portion of the bottle, there is a white polar bear illustration with a simple black nose, eyes, and mouth, suggesting a holiday or winter-themed Coca-Cola design. The red surface of the bottle is glossy, with bright white reflections from overhead lighting. There are also small specks or dust marks visible on the bottle’s surface, and faint black printed manufacturing or expiration-code text appears near the upper middle area.

Behind the main bottle, on the far right edge, part of another red bottle or container is visible, slightly transparent or reflective, with a tan string or rope-like band crossing it.

The background appears to be an indoor workspace or desk area. On the left side, there is a black office chair with a small bright label or sticker on the backrest. Behind it, a shelf or desk surface holds various indistinct items, including a green tray or shelf, a purple/blue rectangular object, and what looks like a black bag or helmet-shaped item. A white wall or partition forms the backdrop. In the lower left foreground, a dark computer mouse or device and a cable are visible on a desk surface. Near the center-bottom, there is a wooden or yellowish desk area with papers, a small metallic or brass-colored object, and other blurred office supplies.

Overall, the composition emphasizes the Coca-Cola bottle in the foreground, with the cluttered office-like background intentionally out of focus.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示可口可乐瓶的特写照片，瓶子上的品牌标志非常醒目。背景中模糊地显示了一个背包和一些办公用品，暗示了拍摄地点可能是一个办公室或工作场所。

caption:
The image shows a single metal combination wrench lying horizontally on a rough concrete floor.

- **Object:** A silver-colored spanner/wrench with an open-ended jaw on the left and a closed ring end on the right.
- **Orientation:** The wrench is positioned nearly straight across the lower half of the image, running left to right.
- **Size/markings:** The tool is marked **“14”** near both ends, indicating it is likely a **14 mm wrench**. The center of the handle has the brand text **“KINOtool”** engraved or printed on it.
- **Left end:** The open-end side has a U-shaped jaw with slightly worn, darkened edges. The metal around this end appears more scratched and tarnished than the handle.
- **Right end:** The ring end is circular with a multi-point inner profile, designed to fit around a nut or bolt head. It has a raised rim and reflects light strongly.
- **Condition:** The wrench looks used, with visible scratches, smudges, grime, and discoloration, especially near the open end.
- **Lighting:** There is a strong flash or direct light reflection across the handle, creating a bright white glare near the center-right portion of the tool.
- **Background:** The floor is gray-brown concrete with a rough, dusty texture. It has small dark specks, stains, scuffs, and faint marks scattered across the surface.
- **Composition:** Most of the upper part of the image is empty concrete floor, while the wrench occupies the lower third of the frame.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在灰色地面上的扳手的照片。扳手是开口式的，带有'KINO tool 14'的标记，表明其尺寸和制造商。背景简单，主要由地板的纹理构成，颜色为灰色调。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of a historic castle or fortress rising above dense green woodland. The foreground and lower half of the scene are filled with lush vegetation: thick shrubs, leafy undergrowth, and tall trees. On the left side, a large tree canopy creates a dark, shaded mass of leaves, contrasting strongly with the bright sky and sunlit castle wall.

The castle occupies the upper right portion of the image. A long, pale stone or plastered defensive wall runs diagonally upward from the center toward the top-right corner. Along the top of the wall is a half-timbered gallery with white panels and dark wooden beams, giving it a traditional medieval German appearance. Small projecting supports and narrow windows are visible beneath and along the gallery.

Near the center of the image, partially framed by trees, are taller castle structures with stone towers and arched openings. One tower has crenellated battlements and a flag flying from the top; the flag appears to have black, red, and gold horizontal stripes, resembling the German flag. The stonework has warm brown and gray tones, standing out against the white wall and greenery.

The sky is bright blue with a few faint wisps of cloud, suggesting a clear sunny day. Sunlight illuminates the upper wall and tower, while the forested slope below remains darker and shadowed. The composition emphasizes the height and imposing position of the castle, as if viewed from a path or hillside below, with nature surrounding and partially concealing the architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然与建筑和谐共存的摄影作品。图像前景是郁郁葱葱的树木，其枝叶在阳光下显得生机勃勃。中景是一座古老的建筑物，其部分被绿色植物覆盖，仿佛融入了周围的自然环境。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，几朵白云悠闲地飘浮着。

caption:
The image shows the upper façade of a grand, historic urban building photographed from street level, looking upward at an angle. The architecture is classical and ornate, with a pale stone exterior and strong vertical lines.

A row of tall, fluted columns dominates the lower central portion of the image. These columns have elaborate Corinthian-style capitals decorated with carved leaf-like details. Behind and between the columns are large, dark-framed windows with reflective glass, giving the façade a mix of traditional stonework and more modern-looking glazing.

The building’s corner is visible on the right, emphasizing its scale and depth. Along the edges of the façade are decorative bands, including dentil molding and carved friezes beneath projecting cornices. Near the lower edge, a Greek key pattern runs horizontally across the stonework, adding another classical decorative element.

Above the main façade, the building has a steep mansard-style roof covered in dark slate tiles. Several dormer windows protrude from the roof, some with rounded or arched tops and metal trim. Brick chimneys and sections of exposed brickwork are visible toward the upper left and right, contrasting with the pale stone façade below.

Black wrought-iron railings and small balconies appear in front of some of the lower windows, adding intricate detail. Two street lamps are partially visible near the bottom of the image, reinforcing the street-level perspective.

To the left, neighboring buildings are tightly packed alongside it, also featuring pale stone façades, tall windows, balconies, and ornamental architectural details. The sky is bright and overcast, giving the scene a cool, slightly washed-out tone. Overall, the image conveys an elegant city streetscape, likely in a historic district, with refined classical architecture and dense urban surroundings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑风格的摄影作品，特写拍摄了一栋建筑物的角落。建筑特征显著的是其精美的立柱和装饰性栏杆，以及窗户上方的拱形装饰。在建筑的一侧，可以看到一个黑色的路灯，增添了场景的细节感。

caption:
The image shows an opulent, dimly lit luxury lounge or hotel lobby with a dramatic, high-end interior design.

At the center-right is the main focal point: a large illuminated sculptural artwork made of multiple interlocking loops or ribbon-like rings. The sculpture is metallic and covered in many small reflective, crystal-like pieces, making it sparkle under warm lighting. It sits on a glossy black pedestal with a lighted base, giving it a jewel-like, gallery-display quality.

The room has a warm golden and amber color palette. Soft lighting comes from several elegant chandeliers and lamps. Two hanging chandeliers in the background have cylindrical, tiered shapes and glow warmly over a seating area. At the very top edge of the image, part of a large colorful chandelier or glass installation is visible, made of blue, gold, and multicolored pieces.

The seating area includes plush lounge chairs and sofas in beige, gold, and brown tones. In the foreground on the right are cream-colored upholstered armchairs with gold pillows, arranged around low tables. The floor is dark and glossy, reflecting the lights, and a patterned rug with flowing abstract lines covers part of the seating area.

In the background, there appears to be a reception or lounge desk area with people seated behind it. Large decorative vases filled with colorful branch-like floral arrangements stand on the counter. Behind them are vertical decorative panels, possibly metallic or textured, adding to the luxurious atmosphere.

The architecture is grand and contemporary. Tall dark curtains frame the left side, and the ceiling is very high. The walls on the right are clad in dark reflective materials with a mosaic-like texture in black, gold, and greenish tones. A glossy mirrored section reflects parts of the room, including another view of the glowing sculpture.

Overall, the space feels like an upscale hotel lobby, cocktail lounge, or luxury boutique interior—rich, polished, theatrical, and designed to emphasize warmth, sparkle, and sophistication.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示豪华室内环境的照片，中心位置是一个由多个金属环组成的大型装饰品，其表面镶嵌着无数小灯泡，发出柔和的光芒。周围摆放着各种风格的家具，包括黄色和米色的沙发、扶手椅以及一些装饰性的桌子和椅子。整个场景被温暖的灯光照亮，营造出一种奢华而舒适的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, slightly angled view of a computer screen displaying the Admiral insurance website in a web browser.

At the top is a browser window with a macOS-style title bar, including the red, yellow, and green window control buttons on the left. A tab is open with the title beginning “Admiral.com - Car, MultiCar and…” and the address bar shows a secure URL: `https://www.admiral.com`, marked with a green padlock icon. Standard browser controls are visible, including back, forward, refresh, and home icons.

The webpage itself features the Admiral branding prominently. On the left is the Admiral logo: a blue-and-red emblem with a stylized admiral figure looking through a telescope, followed by the word “Admiral” in large blue lettering. To the right is a large search field with the placeholder text “Search Admiral.”

Below the logo area is a dark blue navigation bar divided into large rectangular sections. The visible menu items include:

- “CAR INSURANCE”
- “MULTI-CAR INSURANCE”
- “HOME INSURANCE”
- “MULTICOVER INSURANCE”

The page background is primarily deep blue, consistent with the company’s branding. Lower in the image, part of a promotional graphic is visible: a person wearing a navy admiral-style hat with gold trim. The person’s face is blurred, and only the upper portion of their head and hat are clearly shown. There is also partial large white text on the right side, beginning with “One policy…,” suggesting a marketing message related to insurance coverage.

Overall, the image appears to be a close-up photograph of the Admiral.com insurance homepage or a related product page, emphasizing online insurance categories and the company’s nautical-themed branding.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示保险网站界面的图片，其中网站的标志位于屏幕顶部，下方是不同类型的保险服务的链接。图像中心是一个戴着黑色帽子的人物头像，其面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。整个画面背景为电脑屏幕的蓝色调，突出了网站内容和用户界面的设计细节。

caption:
The image is a styled product photo of a pair of high-top Under Armour basketball shoes, displayed against a dark, textured wall.

In the foreground, the right shoe is shown prominently in side profile, resting on a thick white shag carpet. The shoe has a bold black, white, and metallic gold color scheme. The front/toe area is mostly white with subtle perforations and light gray graphic detailing. Moving toward the midfoot and heel, the upper transitions into a busy black-and-white graffiti-style pattern filled with numbers, words, symbols, lightning-like shapes, and sketchy lettering. A large metallic gold Under Armour logo appears on the outer heel area.

The collar and tongue are black, with a padded, dimpled texture around the ankle. Near the top of the tongue is a gold “SC” logo, associated with Stephen Curry. The black laces have small gold flecks woven through them, matching the shoe’s gold accents. The midsole features a shiny metallic gold strip running along the side, with the word “CHARGED” printed near the heel, indicating Under Armour’s cushioning technology. The outsole and heel support area include black sculpted elements with a ribbed, wave-like design.

In the background, the other shoe sits elevated on a glossy black shoe box. It is angled slightly to the side, showing the same design elements: white forefoot, black-and-white graphic upper, gold Under Armour logo, black tongue, and gold accents. The box has a visible Under Armour logo on the front side.

The setting is dramatic and premium: the dark, rough-textured wall contrasts with the bright white carpet and the reflective gold details on the shoes. The lighting is soft but directional, highlighting the glossy surfaces, metallic accents, and layered textures of the sneakers. Overall, the image presents the shoes as a high-performance, collector-style basketball sneaker with a flashy, graphic-heavy design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一双设计独特的运动鞋的商业摄影风格图片。鞋子被放置在一个黑色的立方体上，背景是深色的墙面和白色的地毯。鞋子的设计以白色为主色调，上面印有金色和黑色的文字图案，整体造型现代而时尚。

caption:
The image shows the exterior entrance area of **Manchester Central**, a large events and conference venue.

In the foreground is a wide, open paved plaza made of pale stone tiles. Across the lower middle of the image is a broad staircase leading up to the entrance. The steps have bright yellow safety edges, and a series of shiny silver metal handrails run vertically up the stairs in evenly spaced rows.

On the right side, the main entrance is set beneath a large angular canopy clad in warm reddish-brown stone or metal panels. Below it are tall glass doors and windows. The glass reflects surrounding buildings and greenery, and the words **“Manchester Central”** are visible in large light-colored lettering across the windows, accompanied by a circular target-like logo.

On the left, a reddish-brown stone wall contains a mounted sign reading **“Manchester Central”**, also with the same circular logo. Above this wall, another sign on the building reads **“The Cobden Rooms.”** A tall black streetlamp stands near the left edge of the frame, with a slim white pole behind it.

The building facade combines modern glass and reddish-brown cladding, while the upper portion is covered in a large white construction wrap or protective sheeting. Scaffolding is visible along the upper middle section, suggesting renovation work. Near the top, a banner partially visible mentions **“Restoring 140 years of history”** and includes an image of a clock face, implying heritage restoration. A few green tree leaves hang into the upper right corner, adding a small natural element to the otherwise urban architectural scene.

The overall setting appears bright and sunny, with strong daylight, crisp shadows, and a clean, spacious public entrance area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示'Manchester Central'火车站入口的照片。照片中，火车站的建筑立面被巨大的广告牌覆盖，上面有彩色条纹和数字图案。入口处有一排金属栏杆，引导人们进入车站内部。在建筑前方，有一个刻有文字的石碑，上面写着'Greater Manchester'。照片拍摄于白天，阳光照射下，建筑物和周围环境清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a lively coastal harbor on a bright, clear day. In the foreground, a well-kept green lawn slopes down toward a waterfront road and parking area. Several pedestrians are walking along the sidewalks and near the harbor, some dressed casually in shorts and summer clothing, suggesting warm weather.

Along the lower left and center of the image is a parking lot filled with cars and SUVs parked in rows. Black lampposts line the waterfront walkway, and a few signs, railings, and low stone or concrete barriers separate the pedestrian area from the water.

The harbor itself is busy with boats. Dominating the center foreground are several large white vessels docked side by side. One large passenger-style boat has the name “NIAGARA PRINCE” visible along its side. In front of it is a sleek white yacht named “Sandrine,” with multiple decks, large tinted windows, radar domes, and tall antennae. To the right is another large sportfishing-style boat with a dark lower hull, white upper structure, and tall outriggers extending upward and outward.

Beyond the docked boats, the water is a deep blue with small ripples and scattered white buoys. Numerous smaller boats are spread across the bay, including fishing boats, sailboats, and small motorboats. Some are anchored while others appear to be moving slowly across the water.

In the background, a forested island stretches across the middle of the scene. It has rocky shoreline edges and dense green trees covering rolling terrain. Farther behind it, faint blue-gray hills or distant shoreline can be seen through a light haze.

The upper half of the image is filled with a wide pale blue sky dotted with soft white clouds. A single dark bird is visible flying high above the harbor near the center of the sky. Overall, the scene feels like a busy but relaxed seaside marina, with recreational boating, tourism, and scenic coastal views.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海港景观的照片，画面中心停靠着几艘大型游艇和帆船。码头上人们在散步或等待船只，一些车辆停靠在岸边。远处的海面上有几只小船，而天空中有一只鸟儿飞翔。整个场景被阳光照耀着，营造出一个宁静而活跃的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor architectural scene centered on a large white marble monument shaped like an open book. The book sculpture sits on a stepped marble pedestal in front of an ornate mosque façade.

The open book has thick, stylized pages with carved page edges on both sides. Its surface is white marble with gray veining, and the inscriptions are engraved or inlaid in a warm bronze-gold color. The left page reads in Azerbaijani:

“HEYDƏR MƏSCİDİ  
PREZİDENT  
İLHAM ƏLİYEVİN  
TƏŞƏBBÜSÜ İLƏ  
İNŞA EDİLMİŞDİR.  
2014”

The right page lists measurements and details of the mosque complex, including:

“KOMPLEKSİN ƏRAZİSİ — 20 ha  
MƏSCİDİN ƏRAZİSİ — 5.5 ha  
MİNARƏLƏRİN HÜNDÜRLÜYÜ — 95 m  
ƏSAS GÜNBƏZİN HÜNDÜRLÜYÜ — 55 m  
ƏSAS GÜNBƏZİN DİAMETRİ — 30 m”

Behind the monument is a grand beige stone mosque wall with elaborate decorative details. The façade features tall vertical panels, arched and lattice-like ornamental windows, carved geometric and floral patterns, and projecting architectural elements. The stonework is symmetrical and richly detailed, giving the building a monumental and formal appearance.

In the foreground, the book sculpture is surrounded by pale stone paving and broad marble steps. To the left and behind the monument is a shallow water feature or fountain basin with small vertical fountain nozzles visible in rows. On the right side there is a strip of green lawn bordered by a low beige stone wall with decorative relief patterns.

In the background to the left, beyond the mosque complex wall, there are residential or institutional buildings with cream-colored walls and red tiled roofs. A black wrought-iron railing runs along the upper wall, and a few trees and shrubs are visible. The sky is clear and blue, and the strong sunlight creates sharp shadows, emphasizing the bright white marble and the warm beige tones of the mosque exterior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的现代艺术雕塑的照片。雕塑是一个巨大的白色书本形状，上面刻有文字和日期，似乎在纪念某个事件或人物。书本放置在一个由多层台阶组成的基座上，周围环境是开阔的草坪和一些低矮的建筑。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque European riverside town nestled beneath a steep, forested hillside, with a dramatic castle crowning the ridge above.

In the foreground, a broad river fills the lower half of the scene. The water is slightly rippled and reflects bright sunlight in scattered silver highlights. Near the center of the river there is a small red buoy, and farther to the right a green marker buoy is visible. Along the left edge, a narrow concrete embankment or towpath runs beside the water, bordered by grass and small wild plants.

Across the river, a long stone retaining wall lines the opposite bank. Behind it stands a row of closely packed houses and buildings. Many of them have steep slate roofs, dormer windows, and traditional European façades. Several buildings are colorful—yellow, red, cream, gray, and white—while some feature distinctive black-and-white half-timbered patterns. The waterfront architecture gives the town a historic, old-world character.

Rising sharply behind the town is a lush green hillside covered with dense trees, shrubs, and patches of vegetation. The slope is quite steep, with rocky sections visible in places. A few houses and structures are scattered partway up the hill, partially hidden by greenery.

At the top of the hill, dominating the scene, is a large medieval-style castle or fortress. It has dark stone walls, tall towers, pointed roofs, turrets, and spires. The central tower is especially prominent, standing higher than the rest of the structure. The castle’s silhouette is dramatic against the pale blue sky, giving the scene a fairy-tale quality.

The sky is mostly clear and bright, with only faint wisps of cloud. The lighting suggests a sunny day, with strong daylight illuminating the hillside and town while the castle appears slightly darker due to distance and shadow. Overall, the image conveys a scenic, historic river valley with a charming town at the water’s edge and an imposing hilltop castle above it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示河岸风光的摄影作品，图中河流平静地流淌，河岸边排列着色彩鲜艳的房屋。在远处，一座宏伟的城堡坐落在山丘之上，其古老的建筑风格与周围的自然环境形成鲜明对比。整个场景被阳光照耀，呈现出一种宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright alpine mountain landscape under a vivid blue sky. In the background, a dramatic range of high, rugged mountains dominates the scene. The peaks and ridgelines are covered with large patches of snow and ice, suggesting a glacier or permanent snowfield spread across the upper slopes. Dark gray rock faces cut through the white snow, creating strong contrast and emphasizing the steep, jagged terrain.

Above the mountains, the sky is a clear, saturated blue with large, soft white clouds drifting across the top half of the image. Some clouds partially obscure the highest ridges, giving the scene a fresh, high-altitude atmosphere.

In the middle ground, a sloping hillside rises toward the mountains. It is covered with short green alpine grass, scattered rocks, and loose scree. The slope is uneven and rugged, with many gray stones and boulders of different sizes spread across it. The terrain transitions from lush green meadow in the foreground to rockier, harsher ground as it climbs upward.

The foreground is a vibrant grassy meadow, dotted with small yellow wildflowers. A narrow stream runs from the lower center of the image toward the middle distance, winding through the grass like a thin silver ribbon. Its water catches the light in places, creating small bright reflections. Around the stream, the grass appears slightly flattened and paler, suggesting damp ground or a natural drainage path.

Large boulders frame parts of the foreground and lower middle area, especially on the left and right sides. These rocks are rough, angular, and gray, with cracks and weathered surfaces. Their size adds a sense of scale to the landscape and makes the meadow feel wild and untouched.

Overall, the image conveys a peaceful but powerful mountain environment: lush alpine grass and flowers in the foreground, a small stream leading the eye inward, rocky slopes in the middle, and imposing snow-covered peaks rising beneath a bright, cloud-filled sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的摄影作品，画面中心有一条蜿蜒的小径穿过一片绿色的草地。草地上散布着岩石和黄色的野花，而小径两侧是未经修剪的草地。在远处，可以看到壮观的雪山，其顶部覆盖着积雪，山脚下则有一些裸露的土地。天空中飘浮着几朵白云，整个场景显得宁静而美丽。

caption:
The image shows the front area of a car dealership or used-car lot, likely in Thailand, with multiple vehicles parked under a large metal-roofed canopy.

In the foreground, several cars and pickup trucks are lined up side by side on a concrete lot. On the left is a dark pickup truck, and near the center is a black or dark gray Mitsubishi pickup. Beside it are a black Honda vehicle and a silver SUV, while a white sedan is parked on the right edge of the frame. The vehicles are closely arranged as if on display for sale.

A man stands near the center of the image with his back to the camera. He is wearing a bright red or magenta shirt, dark shorts, and sandals. He appears to be holding up a smartphone, possibly taking a photo or video of the cars or signage in front of him.

Above the vehicles is a large industrial-style roof structure with black metal beams, trusses, and supports. Beneath the roof, a long orange sign stretches across the lot. It has large blue Thai lettering and visible phone numbers, including “081-827-0887” and “088-630-1188.” The Thai text appears to advertise buying, selling, and exchanging cars, along with financing services.

On the right side of the image, there is a prominent red sign with large white Thai text. The biggest word reads “รถ,” meaning “car,” and the sign appears to indicate that the business buys cars and invites people to park there for evaluation or pricing. A white downward arrow points toward the parking area. Behind this sign is a building façade with glass windows tinted greenish-blue, and part of a larger pink-and-white sign is visible at the top.

The overall scene feels busy but orderly, with strong commercial signage, a covered vehicle display area, and a customer or staff member documenting the cars. The colors are dominated by the orange and blue dealership banner, the red sign, the dark metal roof framework, and the mix of black, silver, and white vehicles.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国某个停车场场景的照片。在画面的前景，一位身穿红色上衣和黑色短裤的人站在一辆黑色SUV旁，正专注地使用手机拍照或录像。停车场中停满了各种汽车，包括白色轿车、银色SUV以及黑色皮卡车。背景中可以看到一个带有泰文广告牌的建筑，上面写着'เช่า รถยนต์'（意为汽车租赁），并提供了电话号码。整个场景被自然光照亮，给人一种日常生活的即视感。

caption:
The image is a close-up view of a woven textile, likely a rug, mat, or heavy fabric with a thick, textured surface. It fills the entire frame, so no background or surrounding environment is visible.

The fabric is made up of many horizontal rows of rounded, padded-looking woven segments. These segments resemble small soft rectangular beads or loops arranged side by side in long bands. Thin vertical threads or stitches run between them at regular intervals, creating a subtle grid-like structure across the surface.

The color palette is muted and earthy. The dominant tones are beige, tan, oatmeal, pale cream, khaki, and faded olive green. Several horizontal stripes alternate between lighter cream-colored rows and more greenish or brownish rows. Some areas have darker mottled markings in gray, brown, and black, giving the textile a worn, natural, or slightly stained appearance.

The weave is irregular and handmade-looking. Some rows are thicker and more raised, while others are flatter or frayed. There are fuzzy edges, loose fibers, and uneven ridges running horizontally across the textile. The surface appears soft but coarse, with a tactile, nubby texture.

Overall, the image emphasizes texture and pattern rather than a specific object or scene. It has the appearance of a rustic woven rug or fabric panel with natural fibers, subdued colors, and visible craftsmanship.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示织物纹理的特写照片，图像中心为一排绿色和米色相间的条纹织物。每条条纹由多根细长的线组成，这些线交织在一起形成了丰富的纹理效果。在织物的表面可以看到一些磨损迹象，如颜色不均和轻微的污渍，这增加了织物的真实感和使用痕迹。

caption:
The image shows a backstage or studio makeup-preparation scene. In the foreground on the left, a young woman with long, light brown or blonde hair sits in profile with her eyes closed while makeup is being applied. Her skin is brightly lit, and her hair falls over her shoulder in soft waves. A makeup artist’s hand is close to her face, holding a small brush or pencil against her eyelid, likely applying eyeliner or eyeshadow. The artist’s fingers have rings, and the brush has a pale handle with a dark tip.

On the right side of the image, the makeup artist is partially visible from behind, with dark hair and dark clothing. They are holding another thin brush in one hand and a rectangular makeup palette or mirror in the other. The palette is angled toward the camera and reflects light, with smudges or powder visible on its surface.

In the background, another seated person is visible but heavily blurred, giving the image a shallow depth of field. This person appears to be facing forward and may also be getting makeup done. The setting is dim and dark behind the subjects, with strong, direct lighting focused on the foreground model’s face and hair. The overall atmosphere suggests a fashion show, photo shoot, theater preparation area, or professional makeup session.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示化妆过程的现场照片，一位女性模特正坐在桌子旁，由两位专业化妆师为她进行化妆。左侧的化妆师正在使用刷子在模特的眼部涂抹眼影，而右侧的化妆师则手持镜子和粉底刷，正在细致地涂抹粉底。背景中可以看到其他模糊的人物和一些化妆品，整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种专业的后台氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright outdoor city scene on a clear, sunny day, with a vivid blue sky filling most of the upper frame. In the background are historic Russian-style architectural landmarks: red-brick Kremlin-like walls and towers with steep, dark green tiled roofs. The central tower is large and prominent, with a red brick upper section, arched openings, decorative masonry, and a tall pyramidal roof topped by a small flag or finial. To the right, a smaller similar tower rises behind the trees. Behind the red walls on the left are white cathedral buildings with ornate arches and several onion domes, including shiny gold domes that catch the sunlight.

A row of leafy green trees runs along the base of the red wall, partially obscuring the lower parts of the buildings. The scene appears to be along a broad street or public square, with a curb, pavement, and some metal crowd-control barriers visible near the bottom.

In the foreground, several people are moving through the scene, many appearing to be participating in or watching a running event. A runner in the center foreground wears a bright neon yellow-green shirt, blue and red athletic shorts, a white cap, and a race bib with the number “9087.” On the far right, another runner in a neon green shirt has a visible race bib with the number “6726.” Other runners and pedestrians are scattered across the lower part of the image, including people in athletic clothing, casual jackets, and jeans. Some faces are blurred.

There are also spectators and bystanders: a person on the left in a mustard-yellow top holds up a phone as if taking a photo or video, and a child on a small pink bicycle is visible near the center bottom.
