A decorative streetlamp with multiple lamps stands on the right side of the image. The overall atmosphere is lively and festive, with a mix of tourists, runners, and pedestrians in front of a well-known historic architectural setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市生活场景的照片，前景中一位穿着黄色T恤和蓝色短裤的跑步者正在专注地跑动。背景是一座具有俄罗斯传统建筑风格的红砖塔楼，其顶部装饰着金色圆顶和十字架。周围有其他行人和跑步者在进行日常活动，有的拍照，有的行走。阳光明媚，天空呈现出一片清澈的蓝色。

caption:
The image shows the front interior of a Kia vehicle, viewed from the back seat looking forward toward the dashboard and windshield. The cabin has a dark gray and black color scheme with silver trim accents.

On the left side is a black leather-wrapped steering wheel with a large oval **KIA** logo in the center. The wheel has integrated control buttons: audio/phone controls on the left spoke and cruise-control-style buttons on the right. Behind it is the instrument cluster with three circular gauges framed by silver rings. The speedometer is in the center, with other gauges on either side, and a small red warning/display area is visible near the bottom.

The dashboard stretches across the image in a broad, slightly curved shape. It has a textured black upper surface and lighter silver/gray trim running across the passenger side. Air vents are located at both far ends of the dashboard and on either side of the center stack. The windshield area is very bright and overexposed, making the outside view mostly washed out.

In the center of the dashboard is a vertical control stack. At the top is a small digital display showing the time, **4:36**, in red. Below it is the main audio system with a dark rectangular screen, buttons labeled for radio/media functions, and two round knobs. Under the audio controls are hazard and vehicle function buttons, followed by the climate-control panel. The climate display glows red and shows dual-zone temperature settings around **18.0°C**, with fan and airflow indicators. Two circular climate knobs sit on either side of the lower controls.

Below the center controls is a manual transmission gear shifter with a black leather boot and a silver-topped knob showing the shift pattern. The shifter sits in a silver-trimmed console. A handbrake lever is positioned to the left of the shifter area, and a padded center armrest is visible in the foreground.

The front seats are upholstered in dark fabric with a textured, patterned center section and smoother side bolsters. The driver and passenger footwells are dark, with rubber floor mats visible. The passenger side includes a glove compartment and a subtle “AIRBAG” marking on the dashboard. Door panels on both sides show black trim with silver handles or accents. Overall, the interior appears clean, functional, and moderately modern, with a manual gearbox and red-lit dashboard displays.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示汽车内部的照片，从驾驶座的视角看去。车辆的仪表盘位于前方，显示着速度和转速信息，而中控台上方是一个大型的信息显示屏，下方是空调控制面板和其他功能按钮。方向盘在左侧，配有多个控制旋钮和拨杆。座椅为黑色织物材质，看起来柔软且舒适。整个内饰设计简洁实用，色调以灰色为主，营造出一种现代感。

caption:
The image shows three glass bottles of Mike’s Hard Lemonade products arranged closely together against a clean white background, like a studio product photo. The bottles are upright, capped with silver metal twist-off caps, and covered with condensation droplets, giving them a cold, chilled appearance. A faint reflection of the bottles appears on the glossy surface beneath them.

In the center foreground is a bottle of **Mike’s Hard Lemonade**. It contains a cloudy, pale white lemonade liquid. Its main label is black with a bright yellow band at the top and the large “mike’s” logo in white lettering inside a rough oval outline. Below it, the label reads **“HARD lemonade”** in yellow and white text, along with the phrase **“Cold. Hard. Refreshing.”** Near the bottom, small text indicates **5% alc/vol** and **11.2 fl oz**. Around the neck label, yellow text reads something like, “when LIFE gives you LEMONS make them HARD.”

Behind and slightly to the left is a bottle of **Mike’s Hard Blood Orange**, filled with a vivid orange-red liquid. Its black label includes the “mike’s” logo and the words **“HARD Blood Orange”** in orange lettering. A large band on the label says **“SEASONAL EDITION.”** The neck label also features the Mike’s logo and “RED Blood Orange” text. This bottle is slightly taller in the composition because it sits behind the center bottle.

Behind and slightly to the right is a bottle of **Mike’s Hard Strawberry Lemonade**, filled with a pink-orange liquid. Its black label has the Mike’s logo, with **“HARD strawberry lemonade”** written in pink and white. The neck label includes playful pink text reading **“LEMONADE just got caught RED handed.”**

The overall visual style is bright and high-key, with strong lighting that makes the glass and condensation sparkle. The three flavors are visually distinguished by their liquid colors: intense orange-red on the left, milky white in the center, and rosy pink-orange on the right.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三种不同口味的mike's HARD Lemonade饮料瓶的产品摄影图片。从左至右，第一种是血橙口味，第二种是草莓口味，第三种是原味。每种口味的瓶子都配有醒目的标签和品牌信息，如'Hard Lemonade'、'Cold Hand Refreshing'等。瓶子的设计简洁现代，以白色为主色调，并带有品牌标志和文字说明。背景为纯白色，突出了瓶子的颜色和设计细节。

caption:
The image shows a tall aluminum beer can photographed straight-on against a plain white background. The can is an **Ottakringer “Wiener Original”** beer can, with a predominantly **deep green** body and **yellow/gold** branding elements.

At the top, the can has a metallic silver rim and lid, with a gold band just below it. The main label is large and centered, shaped like a rounded badge with yellow and cream tones. Across the middle, the brand name **“Ottakringer”** appears in large, bold, black letters with a white outline, placed on a bright yellow banner. Beneath it, on a brown ribbon-style banner, the text **“Wiener Original”** is written in white cursive script.

The central badge includes decorative beer-themed imagery: wheat or barley stalks, a hop-like emblem, and a small illustration of a building or brewery tower near the top of the label. Around the lower part of the badge, the text **“OTTAKRINGER BRAUEREI”** appears, along with **“SEIT 1837”**, indicating the brewery’s founding year.

Lower on the can, more white script reads **“Wiener Biertyp”**, followed by **“SEIT 1837”** in block letters. There are additional decorative gold and green bands near the bottom, including a patterned strip resembling braided grain. A vertical barcode is visible along the lower left side of the can, and part of a dark graphic illustration appears on the left edge.

The can has a glossy, slightly reflective finish with visible highlights and subtle dents or texture on the green surface. The bottom rim is silver metal, and the can is centered with ample white space around it, giving it a clean product-photo appearance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Ottakringer啤酒罐的商业摄影图像。啤酒罐为标准铝制设计，顶部有绿色和黄色的品牌标志，中心是啤酒厂的名称'Ottakringer'以及'Still Life'字样，下方是啤酒的类型'Wiener Original'和生产日期'SEIT 1837'。罐身还展示了啤酒的酒精含量信息'4.6% vol.'。整体背景为纯白色，突出了啤酒罐的颜色和细节。

caption:
The image shows a row of modern multi-story residential buildings, likely townhouses or apartment units, photographed from a low, upward-looking angle. The architecture is contemporary, with clean geometric lines, large rectangular balconies, and a mix of white plaster, reddish-orange brick, dark gray metal trim, and glass.

On the left side, the nearest building dominates the frame. It has broad white balcony structures projecting outward, creating deep recessed spaces underneath. The facade combines warm brick panels with large floor-to-ceiling windows and sliding glass doors. Some of the glass appears covered or slightly opaque, possibly due to protective film or reflections. A bright burst of sunlight reflects off one of the upper balcony windows, creating a strong lens flare and rainbow-like streaks across the left-center of the image.

The buildings continue into the distance toward the right, forming a repeating rhythm of similar units. Each section has upper-level balconies with glass railings, dark metal window frames, and vertical dark gray cladding around the roofline or dormer-like upper portions. The roofs are flat or very slightly angled, with dark trim along the edges, giving the row a sleek urban appearance.

In the foreground, a dark metal fence with vertical bars runs horizontally across the image, separating the buildings from a small landscaped area. Behind the fence are ground-level windows and doors, suggesting private entrances or lower-floor living spaces. A low concrete retaining wall supports the fence, and below it is a strip of green grass with small shrubs and young, slender trees planted at intervals.

The sky is clear and bright blue, indicating a sunny day. The strong sunlight casts sharp shadows on the white balcony walls and emphasizes the crisp edges of the buildings. Overall, the scene presents a clean, newly built residential complex with modern design, fresh landscaping, and a quiet, orderly suburban or urban neighborhood atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代住宅建筑的照片，阳光从画面左侧照射进来，在建筑物的玻璃窗上形成了明亮的光斑。建筑采用白色和红色砖块相间的外墙设计，每层楼都有一个带有栏杆的阳台。前景是整齐的草坪和几棵小树，为这个居住区增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a pink, loosely knit sweater hanging outdoors against a white sheet or fabric backdrop, with a bright blue sky and soft white clouds visible above.

The sweater is centered in the frame and appears to be clipped to a horizontal clothesline or the top edge of the white fabric. Two clothespins hold it up: a yellow clothespin on the upper left shoulder area and a pale pink or peach clothespin on the upper right shoulder area. The sweater has a wide, rounded neckline and relaxed, loose-fitting sleeves that fall partway down, suggesting a casual oversized style. The sleeves are roomy and slightly draped.

The knit fabric is textured and chunky, with visible horizontal rows of stitching. Its main color is a warm coral-pink or rose tone, but it is flecked throughout with many small multicolored threads—blue, yellow, purple, green, and white—giving it a speckled, confetti-like appearance. The sunlight highlights the texture of the yarn, creating bright areas and soft shadows across the front of the garment.

Near the inside back of the neckline, a small white clothing label is visible. It appears to read “Byu” or something similar, though the text is partly small and not fully clear.

The white fabric behind the sweater looks like a bedsheet or laundry sheet, with visible folds, seams, wrinkles, and soft shadows. The upper edge runs horizontally behind the sweater. Above it, the sky is a vivid light blue with fluffy, diffuse clouds, giving the scene a fresh, airy laundry-day feeling. The overall mood is bright, clean, and summery, with strong natural daylight illuminating the sweater and backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示粉红色针织衫的摄影图片，衣物悬挂在户外的晾衣绳上。针织衫表面覆盖着细小的彩色颗粒，颜色从粉色过渡到白色，营造出一种温暖而柔和的感觉。背景是蓝天和几朵白云，为整个场景增添了一抹宁静与清新。

caption:
The image shows a broad coastal landscape under a bright, partly cloudy sky. The view appears to be taken from an elevated vantage point, looking across a sheltered bay toward a green, hilly shoreline.

The upper two-thirds of the image are dominated by a vivid blue sky filled with large, soft cumulus clouds. The clouds are bright white with subtle gray shading underneath, giving them a puffy, three-dimensional appearance. They are scattered unevenly across the sky, with some large cloud masses stretching across the center and right side, while patches of clear blue remain visible between them.

Below the sky, the land rises into lush, forested hills covered in dense green vegetation. On the left side, a steep, rounded hill is heavily wooded and casts darker green shadows. Across the middle and right portions of the hillside, small buildings and houses are scattered among the trees. Some structures have light-colored walls and red or pale roofs, creating small bright accents against the greenery. On the higher ridges, there are several tall communication towers or masts, especially toward the right side of the image.

At the base of the hills is a waterfront settlement. Houses and low buildings line the edge of the water, some built very close to the shoreline or on small piers. The buildings vary in color, including white, yellow, blue, and red-roofed structures. The shoreline curves gently around the bay, with clusters of palms and tropical vegetation mixed among the homes.

The foreground is occupied by calm, dark blue-gray water with gentle ripples. Reflections from the sky and shoreline subtly shimmer across the surface. Near the right-center shoreline, a large blue vessel or workboat is moored alongside a small dock area. In the lower center of the water, a striped buoy or mooring structure is visible, connected by a line extending toward the right. At the lower left edge, part of a road, waterfront walkway, or pier area can be seen with a few palm trees and man-made structures.

Overall, the scene feels tropical and tranquil, with the combination of calm bay water, lush green hills, scattered coastal homes, and expansive cloud-filled sky creating a peaceful harbor or island-town atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滨小镇的自然风光照片。在画面前景，可以看到平静的海水和几艘停泊的小船。中景是密集的建筑群，分布在海岸线上，房屋色彩鲜明，屋顶多为红色或绿色。背景是覆盖着绿色植被的山丘，天空中有散布的白云，整体呈现出宁静而和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunny outdoor road race taking place on a wide urban street. Multiple runners are spread across the roadway, moving toward the camera and away from it, suggesting a long-distance running event such as a marathon or half-marathon. Many of the participants are wearing race bibs, athletic shirts, shorts, running shoes, caps, and hydration gear.

In the foreground, a runner in a light blue shirt, black shorts, bright blue compression socks, and dark running shoes is centered in the frame, approaching the camera. He is running near a thin blue course marker pole on the right side of the lane, which has yellow tape or ribbon attached to it, likely marking the race route or separating lanes.

Behind him, several runners are clustered together. Some wear bright blue, orange, black, red, and white athletic clothing. A few runners have caps or sunglasses, and some appear to be carrying small bottles or wearing waist packs. Farther down the road, more runners continue along the course, creating a sense of depth and distance.

On the left side of the road, spectators stand and sit along the curb and grassy verge. Some people appear to be watching, clapping, or cheering. There are also a few children and casual onlookers near the sidewalk. A large white tent-like structure or temporary building sits to the left, with trees and parked or passing vehicles nearby.

The road itself is broad and mostly closed to traffic, with visible lane markings and a central seam in the asphalt. Tall streetlights line both sides of the street, receding into the distance. On the right side, there are tram or trolley tracks running parallel to the road, along with overhead electrical wires supported by tall poles. These wires and poles create a strong diagonal pattern across the sky.

In the background, there are low- to mid-rise buildings, construction cranes, trees, traffic signals, and urban infrastructure. The sky is clear and bright blue with a few thin clouds, indicating pleasant weather. Overall, the scene captures an organized city running event with runners, spectators, course markers, and urban transit elements under a sunny daytime sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外马拉松比赛的摄影照片。在图像的前景，一位穿着蓝色运动服和黑色短裤的男性跑者正领先于其他参赛者，他的表情专注而坚定。周围是其他身穿各种颜色跑步装备的参赛者，他们或快步前进，或休息调整，整个场景充满了活力与竞争的氛围。赛道两侧有观众和摄影师，他们的注意力都集中在跑道上。背景中可以看到一些现代建筑和电线杆，表明这个活动发生在城市环境中。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, upward-looking view of a large modern multi-story building under an overcast sky. The building façade is dominated by smooth gray cladding panels arranged in a regular grid, giving it a clean, geometric, institutional or office-like appearance.

Several rows of rectangular white-framed windows are visible. Many of the windows are divided into smaller panes, and some are set deeply into the façade, creating shadows around them. On the lower and middle sections, vertical yellow-gold accent strips run between the windows, breaking up the gray exterior and adding contrast.

A wide projecting roof or canopy spans across much of the image near the upper-middle portion. Its underside and front face are dark gray-green, with a thin purple horizontal stripe running along it. Along the top edge of this canopy are repeated metal brackets or rail-like fixtures, possibly for lighting, signage, or maintenance equipment.

In the upper center, a taller block of the building rises behind the lower roofline. This upper section has a flat, rectangular shape with more gray paneling and a row of small windows near the top. Thin antennas or poles extend upward from the roof, partially visible against the pale cloudy sky.

On the right side, there is a vertical tower-like section with stacked windows. Near its upper portion is a small glass-roofed structure, resembling a skylight or rooftop enclosure, with angled glass panels and white framing.

The composition emphasizes straight lines, grids, and vertical forms. The camera angle is from below, making the building appear tall and imposing. At the bottom right edge, leafy green tree branches are visible, adding a natural element to the otherwise urban architectural scene. The lighting is soft and diffuse due to the cloudy weather, with muted colors and minimal shadows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑外观的照片。建筑物的立面由灰色和白色相间的墙面组成，上面装饰有金色线条。每层楼都有整齐排列的窗户，部分窗户上方安装了通风设备。建筑物顶部装有一个大型的圆形结构，可能是用于天线或监控摄像头。

caption:
The image shows a street-side sidewalk scene with a large, bright yellow-painted pillar or wall occupying the left side of the frame. At the base of the pillar is a step or raised platform, also edged in yellow, with a worn gray surface.

Partially hidden behind the yellow pillar, a person appears to be lying or resting on the ground. Only part of their body is visible: an arm extends out onto the sidewalk, with the hand relaxed and slightly curled. A small portion of dark hair is also visible near the bottom-left area, mostly obscured by the pillar.

In front of the person, near the center-left of the image, there is a pair of worn flip-flops placed on the cracked concrete pavement. Nearby, closer to the curb, there is litter: a clear plastic bag containing food scraps or sauce-stained leftovers, scattered bits of white rice or crumbs, and a crumpled piece of packaging.

The sidewalk itself is rough and damaged, with multiple cracks, uneven concrete slabs, chipped edges, and a couple of small holes or broken patches. A curb separates the sidewalk from the asphalt road in the background. The road surface is gray and slightly out of focus, with a faint painted line visible near the top of the frame.

Overall, the scene feels quiet and somewhat neglected, with the bright yellow structure contrasting sharply against the muted gray pavement and street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道一角的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个黄色的交通信号柱，其旁边散落着一些垃圾和碎片，包括一只翻转的黑色拖鞋、几片白色塑料袋和其他小碎片。地面上有一个明显的裂缝，周围有少量的落叶和碎石。背景中可以看到模糊的道路和建筑物的一部分，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image is a high-angle view looking down into a forested area covered with dense autumn leaf litter. The ground fills almost the entire frame, textured with wet-looking brown, orange, yellow, and reddish leaves, small twigs, patches of moss, and clusters of green plants. The setting feels like a damp woodland or ravine floor, with natural debris scattered unevenly across the slope.

Near the bottom center of the image stands a person wearing outdoor climbing or caving gear. They have a bright blue helmet with small ventilation holes and a sticker or number label on the side. The person is dressed in a dark blue long-sleeved top and dark pants, with a harness and multiple carabiners or metal climbing devices hanging at the front. Several ropes are draped across their body, and they are holding a large coil of rope in both hands, suggesting they are preparing, organizing, or managing climbing equipment.

The person’s head is turned slightly to the side, so their face is partially visible but mostly shadowed by the helmet. Their stance is wide and stable, with climbing-style shoes or rugged footwear visible among the leaves. A rope or line extends off to the side, reinforcing the impression of technical outdoor activity such as climbing, rappelling, canyoning, or rescue work.

Green leaves from a nearby branch blur across the foreground on the right side, partially obscuring the person and adding depth to the image. The upper portion of the frame is mostly empty forest floor, emphasizing the steep overhead perspective and making the person appear small within the natural environment. The overall mood is earthy, quiet, and adventurous, with rich autumn colors contrasted by the vivid blue helmet.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位穿着蓝色头盔和全套攀岩装备的登山者在秋季森林中进行攀爬的照片。登山者站在满是落叶的地面上，四周被树木环绕，树叶呈现出秋天特有的金黄色调。阳光从上方照射下来，为整个场景增添了一丝温暖的气息。

caption:
The image shows a protected area on a sandy beach, marked off as a sea turtle nest. In the foreground, several rough wooden stakes are driven into the sand, with bright yellow caution tape wrapped and stretched between them. The tape reads “PRECAUCIÓN” in large black letters, and it forms a small barrier around the nesting site.

A white sign attached to the front stakes identifies the area. It includes Spanish and English text, including “H. Ayuntamiento de Tulum,” “NO MOVER,” “NIDO DE TORTUGA MARINA,” “SEA TURTLE NEST,” and “DON’T REMOVE.” The sign indicates that the marked spot is a protected marine turtle nest and should not be disturbed.

The sand is pale golden and textured with footprints, ripples, and small shadows. The lighting is warm and low, suggesting early morning or late afternoon sunlight. Long shadows from the stakes, tape, and nearby wooden structures stretch across the sand.

In the background, there are rustic beach elements: wooden posts, branch-like supports, benches or loungers, and a fence made of vertical sticks or reeds. Green vegetation lines the back of the beach, adding contrast to the tan sand and weathered wood. The overall setting feels like a natural, eco-conscious beach area, likely in Tulum, Mexico, where sea turtle nesting zones are being protected from human disturbance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩保护措施的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个黄色警告带，上面用黑色字体写着'PRECAUCIÓN'和'NO VER MARMA NO SEAGULLS NEST'，意为'小心，不要靠近海龟巢穴'。旁边附有一个白色标志牌，上面用西班牙语写着相同的警告信息，并且有文字说明这是加勒比海国家公园的区域。背景中可以看到沙滩上的木制结构和阴影，营造出一个宁静的海滩环境。

caption:
A black-and-white panoramic beach scene shows a quiet shoreline under a hazy, bright sky. The horizon sits low in the frame, leaving a vast expanse of pale, almost empty sky above the sea. The atmosphere appears misty or humid, softening distant details and giving the image a calm, muted feel.

In the foreground and lower right, a man is seen from behind walking along the wet sand near the edge of the water. He wears a light-colored short-sleeved shirt and a light wrap or shorts, and his feet are close to the foamy surf. His posture is relaxed, with one arm slightly extended as he moves forward along the beach. Because he is facing away from the camera, his face is not visible.

The shoreline curves gently from the lower left toward the center-right, creating a diagonal path that leads the eye into the distance. Small waves roll in from the sea, breaking into thin white lines of foam that spread across the smooth, reflective sand. The beach on the left is darker and more textured, with patches of uneven sand, footprints, and small debris.

In the middle distance, the ocean is calm with low, rolling waves. Several small boats are scattered across the water, appearing as dark silhouettes against the pale sea. One boat near the center is more visible, while others farther right are tiny and faint.

Across the far background, a long pier or bridge stretches horizontally from the left side toward the center-right. Its thin supports form a repeating pattern over the water. Near the end of the structure, there is a slightly larger platform or building-like section, and a vertical tower or marker rises nearby. The pier fades into the haze, emphasizing the distance and atmospheric depth.

The overall mood is quiet, contemplative, and solitary. The monochrome treatment enhances the simplicity of the scene, focusing attention on the textures of the waves, sand, distant pier, and the lone figure walking by the sea.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的照片，展现了一位男性在沙滩上行走的场景。男子身穿白色衬衫和短裤，头发整齐地梳理着，他的身体稍微前倾，似乎在专注地观察前方或是享受海风带来的凉爽。他的脚步轻快，沿着海岸线缓缓前行。海滩上的沙子细腻而湿润，海水轻轻拍打着岸边，形成细小的波浪。在远处可以看到一个长桥横跨水面，连接着对岸。天空晴朗，几只鸟儿在空中飞翔，为这个宁静的海滨景色增添了几分生动。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of an ancient stone structure, likely part of a Mesoamerican archaeological site. In the foreground, a large weathered stone serpent head projects outward from a carved stone base. The sculpture is heavily eroded, with softened features, cracks, chipped edges, and rough pitted texture. Its open mouth and rounded contours are still visible, suggesting it may represent a snake or feathered serpent motif.

Behind it rises a tall, massive wall made of rectangular stone blocks. The wall forms a sharp corner near the center of the image, with one side receding dramatically into the distance on the left, creating strong perspective lines. The stone blocks are tan, beige, and gray, but many are darkened by black staining, weathering, or biological growth, giving the wall a mottled, aged appearance. Mortar lines between the blocks form an irregular grid across the surface.

The lower portion of the scene includes additional carved stone elements running horizontally behind the serpent head, possibly part of a balustrade or decorative architectural feature. These stones are also worn and cracked, with layered carving patterns and erosion marks.

The camera angle is low and close to the sculpture, emphasizing the scale of the wall behind it. The background includes a pale blue sky with soft white clouds, contrasting with the heavy, ancient masonry. Overall, the image conveys the atmosphere of a historic ruin: monumental, weathered, and richly textured, with the foreground serpent carving serving as the focal point against the imposing stone wall.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古代建筑细节的照片，特写了一段雕刻精美的石栏杆。石栏杆的顶部和边缘装饰着复杂的几何图案和动物形象，如蛇、鸟和其他不知名的生物。这些雕刻展现了古代工匠的精湛技艺和对自然元素的崇拜。背景中，可以看到一个巨大的石墙，其表面布满了凹凸不平的纹理，与前景形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a Bulgarian postage stamp with perforated edges, set against a dark textured background.

The stamp has a pale, off-white paper base with a thin gold rectangular border. At the top, in stylized Cyrillic lettering, it reads “РИЛСКИ МАНАСТИР • X • В,” referring to Rila Monastery and likely the 10th century. The lettering and border are printed in a muted gold-brown color.

The central artwork is a religious icon-style depiction of a Christian saint or bishop. The figure is shown front-facing, wearing ornate clerical vestments. A large dark red or burgundy halo surrounds the head, and the figure’s face area appears blurred or softened. The clothing is richly patterned in warm tones—gold, cream, red, brown, and black—with visible red crosses on a white stole or vestment down the front. The saint appears to be holding or gesturing with one hand near the lower left portion of the image, while the other side shows additional folds of robe or possibly a religious object.

The printed image has a grainy, stippled texture typical of stamp reproduction, with strong yellow, red, and brown tones. Around the central icon is another gold rectangular frame.

At the bottom of the stamp, the denomination “1 ст.” appears on the left, and “БЪЛГАРИЯ” appears on the right, indicating Bulgaria. There are faint gray cancellation marks crossing the lower area, suggesting the stamp has been used. The perforations are visible along all sides, with slightly uneven paper fibers at the edges.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一枚保加利亚的邮票，展示了一幅风格化的宗教人物画像。邮票上的人物穿着金色和红色相间的服装，头戴光环，胸前装饰有十字架图案。邮票的边缘为深色，而邮票本身被放置在一个带有金色边框的黑色背景上。邮票上方印有'РИАСКИ МАНДСТВО ХБ'的文字，下方则印有'1 ст.'和'БЪЛГАРИЯ'，分别表示面值和国家名称。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of a Gothic-style stained-glass window set into an old stone wall, likely inside a cathedral or historic church.

Two tall, narrow stained-glass panels dominate the lower half of the image. Each panel has a pointed arch top and is framed by thick stone columns and carved capitals. The glass is richly colored, with deep cobalt blues, bright reds, yellows, greens, whites, and pinks. The borders are patterned with small flower motifs and geometric pieces, giving the windows a jewel-like appearance.

The left window contains several heraldic-looking sections. Near the upper middle is a crowned shield with a castle or tower emblem on a blue background. Below it is another shield-like design with red animal shapes, possibly lions or heraldic beasts. Near the bottom is a circular medallion with a small symbolic scene or emblem. The entire panel is surrounded by repeated decorative crosses and floral glass pieces.

The right window is similarly ornate. It includes a crowned crest near the upper portion, a green shield-like emblem with a tower or architectural symbol, and another larger shield below with diagonal green and white shapes and a red-and-white tower. At the bottom is a green circular motif containing pale vertical forms, possibly stylized figures, architectural elements, or symbolic objects. A small banner with text appears across one of the crests, though it is not fully legible.

Above the two tall windows is a smaller circular or quatrefoil stained-glass opening set within elaborate stone tracery. This upper window contains a compact design with blue, red, green, and white glass, including a green flower-like motif and a small castle emblem. Around it, the stone forms curved lobes and pointed arches, emphasizing the Gothic architecture.

The surrounding stone is dark, aged, and heavily textured, with a warm golden-brown tone from the lighting. Large rectangular stone blocks are visible at the top, while the arches and columns show worn surfaces, cracks, shadows, and carved details. The lighting creates a dramatic contrast: the stone appears dim and ancient, while the stained glass glows vividly, making the colors stand out against the dark interior. Overall, the image conveys a historic, sacred atmosphere with intricate medieval craftsmanship.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哥特式建筑风格的彩色玻璃窗的照片。窗户由两扇组成，每扇都有一个中央圆形图案，周围环绕着多彩的彩色玻璃。上方的窗户有一个较大的圆形图案，而下方的窗户则较小。窗户被精细的石制拱形结构所包围，营造出一种庄严和神圣的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a tall historic brick bell tower rising above a cluster of old tiled rooftops. The tower is centered in the frame and strongly illuminated by warm, low-angle sunlight, giving the brickwork a golden-orange glow. Behind it, the sky is filled with heavy, dark blue-gray storm clouds, creating a dramatic contrast between the bright architecture and the moody background.

The tower is built from narrow horizontal bands of reddish and pale brick, with decorative brick patterns around its arched openings. Several levels of arched windows and bell openings are visible. In one of the middle openings, a large bell hangs inside the tower, partially in shadow. Higher up, the tower transitions into a steep slate-covered roof with small dormer-like openings and weathered shingles.

At the very top is an ornate wooden or metal belfry structure, weathered and warm brown in color, with an onion-shaped spire. Above the spire sits a metal weather vane with an arrow and decorative elements, silhouetted against the dark sky.

The foreground and lower part of the image are filled with terracotta roof tiles, arranged in repeating ridges and rows. Surrounding buildings have pale yellow and brick facades, chimneys, antennas, and traditional red-tiled roofs, suggesting an old European town or historic district. The sunlight catches the rooftops as well, making them appear rich orange and copper-toned.

Overall, the scene has a striking late-afternoon or sunset atmosphere: warm golden light on aged brick and roof tiles, set against a turbulent, stormy sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哥特式建筑风格的钟楼的照片。钟楼高耸，顶部装饰有一个十字架，其设计细节精致，包括多个圆形开口和一个中央的大钟。塔身由石材构成，表面略显磨损，显示出历史的痕迹。在钟楼的背后，天空中布满了厚重的云层，而下方则是其他建筑物的屋顶，其中一些屋顶覆盖着红色瓦片。

caption:
The image shows a colorful railway station platform, likely in Thailand, with a traditional architectural style and ornate decorative details.

In the foreground, train tracks run horizontally across the bottom of the image, set in gravel and stones. Just beyond the tracks is a raised platform with a red-edged curb. A tall, vivid red lamppost stands prominently near the center-left of the frame. It is highly decorative, with gold trim and elaborate curling metalwork. At the top are two golden sculptural figures resembling mythical birds or serpents, each supporting a hanging, oval-shaped glass lamp. The gold ornamentation gives the pole a ceremonial, temple-like appearance.

Behind the lamppost is a station building painted mainly in deep red, cream, and gold. The roof is covered with red-brown tiles and has a central gabled section with layered decorative roofing. The building’s columns are red with gold accents, matching the lamppost. Intricate patterned panels and trim decorate the upper parts of the facade, giving the station a historic and elegant look.

Several Thai national flags are mounted along the platform, their red, white, and blue stripes adding more color to the scene. There are people waiting or resting on benches beneath the station roof; some sit with bags and luggage, suggesting travelers waiting for a train. A sign above the entrance includes Thai writing and the English name “HUA HIN,” identifying the station. There are also posters or portraits displayed near the entrance area.

The sky above is pale and cloudy, taking up a large part of the image and creating a soft, warm atmosphere. Overall, the scene feels calm and historic, with a strong blend of railway functionality and ornate Thai decorative design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国风格火车站的照片。在画面的前景，有一根装饰华丽的红色路灯柱，顶部有两个金色的飞鸟雕塑和两个圆形灯罩。背景中是一座具有传统泰式建筑特色的车站，其特点是红色屋顶、白色墙面和悬挂着泰国国旗的旗帜。站台上可见几位乘客正在等待或休息，而铁轨则横跨在画面前方。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, angled view of a gold Samsung smartphone lying on a light wooden tabletop. The phone is tilted diagonally across the frame, with the top of the device near the upper left and the screen extending toward the lower right.

On the screen, the Google Play Store page for **“Viber Messenger”** is open. A large purple banner dominates the upper portion of the display, featuring the Viber logo: a white phone handset inside a speech-bubble outline with signal waves above it. Below the banner, the app listing shows the name **“Viber Messenger”**, the publisher **“Viber Media S.à r.l.”**, and a green **“INSTALL”** button on the right. Smaller text beneath indicates that the app contains ads and offers in-app purchases.

Several app detail icons are partially visible lower on the screen, including a green rating badge showing **4.3**, a downloads indicator suggesting **500 million+**, and circular green icons for features such as communication and similar apps. The screen also shows typical Android status icons near the top, including battery percentage and connectivity symbols.

The phone itself has a curved-edge display and metallic gold frame. The **Samsung** logo is visible above the screen, along with the earpiece grille, front camera, and sensors. The wooden background has visible grain patterns, knots, and warm beige-brown tones, giving the image a casual tabletop setting. The photo is sharply focused on the phone and app page, with the edges and background slightly softened by depth of field.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三星手机屏幕的图片，屏幕上显示着Viber Messenger应用的安装页面。手机放置在木质桌面上，背景是深色木纹纹理。

caption:
The image shows a calm marina filled with moored boats and sailboats on a bright, clear day. The water in the foreground is very still, creating long, shimmering reflections of the boats’ white hulls, tall masts, and dock structures. The reflections stretch vertically downward across the blue surface, slightly softened by gentle ripples.

Across the middle of the scene, numerous boats are tied to floating docks. There are several white motorboats and cabin cruisers, along with sailboats whose masts rise high into the sky. Some boats have dark blue canvas covers, while others have accents in red, teal, wood tones, and black. Near the lower center-left, a distinctive red-and-white boat stands out among the mostly white vessels. Pink and red buoy-like floats are clustered near the dock in the foreground. A yellow metal ladder descends from one of the docks into the water near the center.

The sailboat masts form a pattern of thin vertical and diagonal lines across the image, giving the harbor a busy but orderly appearance. On the far right, a taller mast with dark rigging and a bright blue line or sail cover is especially noticeable.

Behind the marina is a row of modern apartment buildings. They are mostly low- to mid-rise structures with red brick facades, gray roofs, glass balconies, and large rectangular windows. The buildings stretch horizontally across the background, suggesting a waterfront residential area. Small trees and parked cars are visible between the marina and the apartments.

The sky occupies the upper portion of the image and is pale blue with scattered soft clouds. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a sunny morning or afternoon. Overall, the scene feels peaceful, urban, and coastal, with the quiet water and neatly docked boats creating a serene harbor atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示码头和船只的现实主义风格照片。在画面中，我们可以看到多艘帆船和游艇静静地停泊在平静的水面上，它们的倒影清晰地映照在水面上。背景是排列整齐的现代住宅建筑，其设计简洁而统一，颜色以橙色和灰色为主。天空呈现出晴朗的蓝色，几朵白云悠闲地飘浮着。

caption:
The image shows a festive, colorful holiday display featuring two plush toy animals posed in front of a decorated Christmas tree.

In the foreground, two stuffed toys sit on top of a shiny, metallic silver gift box or display surface. On the left is a large plush rabbit or mouse-like character with a pale pink-and-white face, long floppy ears, a round bright pink nose, black bead-like eyes, and a stitched smiling mouth. It is dressed in a shiny coral-pink satin dress with a blue ribbon tied at the front and a red collar around the neck. The toy also has soft pink legs and oversized pink plush shoes decorated with small ribbon bows.

Leaning close beside it on the right is a smaller gray plush mouse. This mouse has large rounded ears with pink inner fabric, a small pink nose, black eyes, and a subtle stitched smile. It wears a bright yellow dress with a gold sequined bodice and a full, fluffy yellow tulle skirt, giving it a princess-like appearance. A product tag with a barcode is attached near its head, partly covering the right side of the toy. The tag is white with a red border.

Behind the toys is a dense green Christmas tree with dark evergreen branches. The tree is decorated with multicolored lights, including glowing yellow, green, blue, red, and purple bulbs. In the upper-right background, a large reflective disco-ball-style ornament or mirrored decoration catches the light, creating a mosaic of blue, silver, gold, and multicolored reflections. There are also blurred, bright decorations in pink and orange tones, contributing to the festive atmosphere.

The overall scene is cheerful and whimsical, with saturated colors, soft plush textures, shiny fabric, sparkling sequins, reflective wrapping, and warm holiday lighting. The toys appear arranged as part of a Christmas or holiday gift display.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两个毛绒玩具鼠的图片，前景中有一个穿着粉红色连衣裙和蓝色领结的白色毛绒玩具鼠，它的旁边是一个穿着黄色蓬松裙子的灰色毛绒玩具鼠。背景模糊地显示了一棵装饰着彩灯的圣诞树，营造出节日氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor cultural parade or public celebration taking place in a large paved square, likely in Greece. The scene is bright and sunny, with strong daylight casting shadows across the stone plaza.

In the foreground and midground, several performers are dressed in traditional Greek-style costumes. Their outfits are vivid and ceremonial: red, blue, black, and white garments with gold trim, sashes, embroidered details, headscarves, and tall black boots. Some of the women wear red head coverings and long red tunics over white trousers, while several men wear dark or blue vests, wide trousers, waist sashes, and black boots. A few performers appear to be moving in formation or dancing, with arms raised or bodies turned toward one another.

On the right side, two people hold a large blue-and-white banner. The banner resembles the Greek flag, with a bold white cross on a blue field, and includes Greek lettering around a gold silhouette of an island or region. Nearby, there are also blue-and-white Greek flags visible among the crowd and on poles. Circular emblems with a Greek cross motif hang from lampposts or signposts along the parade route.

A large crowd lines the background behind temporary barriers draped with blue fabric. Many spectators are standing shoulder to shoulder, watching the performance, taking photos, or holding flags. The crowd extends up steps and along the side of a grand building, creating a dense, festive atmosphere. Some faces in the crowd appear blurred.

The setting has a Mediterranean feel: tall palm trees rise through the middle and right side of the image, with broad fronds spreading above the spectators. Behind the trees are historic-looking buildings with stone façades, tall windows, shutters, and classical architectural details. The square itself is paved with large gray stone tiles, giving the scene an elegant civic or ceremonial setting.

Overall, the image captures a colorful public procession or national/cultural celebration, with traditional dancers or parade participants performing before a large audience in a sunlit town square decorated with Greek symbols and flags.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统节日庆典的摄影照片，画面中心有几位身着鲜艳民族服装的人在进行舞蹈表演。他们穿着红色和蓝色的传统服饰，头戴装饰性的帽子，并且手持一面蓝底白字的旗帜。周围是观看表演的群众，他们站在广场上或坐在周围的长椅上。背景中可以看到棕榈树和其他绿色植物，为这个文化活动增添了自然氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large rocket standing vertically on a launch pad, photographed from a dramatic low angle looking upward. The rocket dominates the center of the frame, rising high into a pale blue sky. Its body is mostly white, with dark gray/black and orange sections around the upper stages. Near the top, there is a Russian flag and a circular mission-style emblem or logo on the rocket’s exterior.

Around the base and midsection are blue-gray metal support structures and gantry arms, made of triangular truss beams. Platforms with railings and ladders surround the rocket, suggesting it is being serviced or prepared for launch. The structures angle inward toward the rocket, emphasizing its height and creating strong diagonal lines across the image.

Thick white vapor or steam is venting from several areas, especially around the lower portion of the rocket and near a seam higher up. The vapor billows outward and partially obscures the base, catching the sunlight and creating a bright, misty glow on the right side. The sun appears to be behind or near the rocket, causing parts of the rocket and gantry to appear in shadow while the steam is brightly backlit.

Overall, the scene conveys a pre-launch or fueling moment at a space launch facility, with the rocket secured on the pad, surrounded by industrial support equipment, and venting clouds of cold vapor into the clear sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示火箭发射过程的摄影图像。图中，火箭被安装在复杂的金属支架上，正在从发射台上起飞。火箭顶部有标志性的橙色和白色条纹，以及一个蓝色的圆形标志。火箭周围是浓密的烟雾，显示出火箭发动机的燃烧情况。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，没有云朵，强调了火箭升空的动态场景。

caption:
The image shows a large group of primary school students seated on the ground in an outdoor school courtyard, apparently during an assembly or group activity. Most of the children are sitting cross-legged in rows, facing toward the left side of the image as if listening to someone or something off-camera. The students’ faces are blurred.

In the foreground, many boys are wearing matching school sports uniforms: red polo shirts with bright blue sleeves and collars, paired with dark navy pants. Some shirts have small initials or letters printed on them, and a school crest appears on the chest. A few students in the front are holding books, notebooks, or papers in their laps. On the right side, one boy is dressed more formally in a turquoise shirt, dark vest, tie, and a black cap.

Behind the front rows, there are many girls wearing headscarves in different colors, including white, pink, blue, and black. Some girls wear white school uniforms, while others wear dark blue or pink outfits. The students are gathered closely together, filling most of the lower half of the image.

The background shows a multi-storey school building with classrooms on both levels. The building has rows of windows, turquoise-blue doors, and pastel-colored walls, including pink and cream sections. Several classroom doors are open, and curtains are visible inside the rooms. Along the front of the upper walkway is a long cream-colored signboard with school mottos or values written in Malay, including phrases such as “Membaca Jambatan Ilmu” and “Rajin Usaha Tangga Kejayaan.” Small emblem-like signs are spaced between the phrases.

There are also Malaysian flags and decorative elements around the school building. Several cars are parked along the left and right sides of the courtyard, including blue, black, and silver vehicles. A few adults or staff members in blue attire can be seen standing near the building and vehicles.

Overall, the scene appears to be a busy school gathering or assembly in a Malaysian school courtyard, with students seated in organized groups in front of their classroom block.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群孩子在户外活动的照片。孩子们穿着统一的校服，包括红色上衣和深色裤子，并且大多数人都戴着帽子。他们坐在一个宽敞的场地上，背景中可以看到一座建筑物，上面有窗户和门。孩子们似乎正在参与某种集体活动或游戏，一些孩子手中拿着纸张。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of historic stone-and-brick ruins on a grassy hillside under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds.

At the center and upper portion of the scene is a large ruined structure, likely part of an old castle, fortress, or medieval church. The walls are built from a mix of reddish-orange brick and irregular gray fieldstones. A tall rectangular tower-like section rises on the left side of the main structure. It has a partially preserved arched opening framed in red brick, and the top appears broken and uneven, with exposed stone and brickwork indicating age and decay.

Extending to the right from the tower is a long wall made mostly of red brick with sections of rough stone. Several arched openings and recessed brick patterns are visible along the wall. On the far right, another smaller tower-like remnant contains a tall arched window or doorway outlined in brick. The structure looks restored in places but still clearly ruined, with missing roofs, incomplete walls, and exposed masonry.

In the foreground, there are multiple low stone walls and pathways made of rounded stones set into mortar. These walls form terraces and ramps leading upward toward the ruins. The stones vary in size and color—gray, tan, brown, and reddish tones—giving the foreground a rugged, textured appearance. A narrow stone path with a black metal handrail climbs up the slope on the left side.

The ruins sit on a green grassy hill. The grass is bright and well-kept, contrasting strongly with the weathered stone and red brick. A few visitors are visible: one couple stands near an arched opening in the main brick wall, while another pair stands lower in the foreground near the stone paths, apparently taking a photo. There is also a small figure on the left near the upper stone wall.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image, deep blue with large, soft white clouds drifting across it. The sunlight is strong and clear, casting bright highlights on the brick and stone and giving the scene a crisp, open-air feeling. Overall, the image conveys a historic, scenic site—ancient ruins preserved on a hillside, with visitors exploring the remains on a pleasant sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老城堡废墟的摄影图像。在画面中，我们可以看到一座红砖结构的建筑，其部分墙体和屋顶已经倒塌，露出了内部的石块和砖块。城堡周围是不规则的石墙，部分区域已经坍塌。在废墟前，有几个人正在参观，其中一位穿着蓝色上衣的人正站在城堡的一侧拍照。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，点缀着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of several **Suave Professionals** hair-care bottles on a store shelf.

In the center foreground is a large cream-colored plastic bottle with a translucent light green flip-top cap. The label reads **“Suave Professionals”** and identifies the product as **almond + shea butter moisturizing conditioner**. The label includes illustrations of green leaves and almonds, with a brown color block near the bottom. It also notes **“100% natural almond & shea butter”** and says the formula has **no parabens, phthalates, or dyes**. Near the bottom, it indicates the bottle is **28 fl. oz. / 828 mL**, is **PETA cruelty-free**, and the bottle is made from **85% recycled plastic**.

On both the left and right sides are similar Suave bottles, slightly behind the center one. These appear to be the matching **almond + shea butter moisturizing shampoo**, also in cream-colored bottles with translucent green caps and similar labels. The right bottle is angled slightly, while the left bottle is partly shadowed.

The bottles are sitting on a white or light gray perforated metal retail shelf. Behind them is a dark pegboard-style backing with rows of small holes. Additional greenish bottles are visible at the far left and far right edges of the frame, partially cut off and out of focus. The lighting is bright from the front, creating shiny reflections on the plastic caps and labels.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是三瓶Suave品牌Almond + Shea Butter系列的护发产品，排列在商店货架上。最前方的瓶子标签显示了产品的名称、成分和容量信息，而其他两瓶则略微模糊地出现在背景中。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large, modern multi-level shopping mall, viewed from an elevated balcony or upper floor. The space is bright, glossy, and spacious, with a very contemporary architectural design.

At the top of the image, there is an uppermost level with glass railings and several people walking or sitting along the edge. The ceiling above them has a striking futuristic design: smooth, curved, white forms with recessed glowing light strips that create organic, wave-like patterns. Small ceiling spotlights are scattered throughout, adding to the sleek, high-end atmosphere.

The mall has several open floors connected visually by wide atriums. Glass balustrades run along the balconies on each level, allowing clear views into the stores and down to the lower floors. Large white cylindrical columns support the structure, and many surfaces are reflective—glass storefronts, polished floors, and glossy walls.

On the right side, a large H&M store is prominently visible. Its bright red illuminated “H&M” logo stands out against the glass storefront. Inside the store, mannequins dressed in casual clothing are displayed near the entrance, with racks of clothes arranged neatly behind them. The store appears to span multiple visible levels or at least occupy a large corner area.

On the left and center portions, there are more fashion retail areas with clothing racks, mannequins, and warm-toned lighting. One store has a curved balcony-like façade and displays rows of hanging garments in neutral colors. Below it, another retail space features circular or layered wooden ceiling elements, adding a decorative accent to the otherwise white and glass-heavy interior.

Toward the lower left, a Bath & Body Works storefront is visible with its recognizable blue-and-white checkered design. Nearby, other shops and signs can be seen, though many are partially obscured by the mall’s architecture and distance.

The central atrium floor is made of polished white marble or marble-like tile with gray veining. It reflects the overhead lights and the movement of shoppers. Many people are scattered throughout the scene: some walking in pairs or groups, others browsing stores, standing near railings, or moving between levels. Their small scale emphasizes the vastness of the mall interior.

A decorative installation or chandelier-like feature made of many golden hanging elements appears near the middle-right of the atrium, suspended above a walkway. There are also glass elevator or escalator structures and transparent panels cutting vertically through the scene, contributing to the layered, open design.

Overall, the image captures a busy upscale shopping center with luxury-modern architecture: sweeping curves, bright lighting, glass railings, polished marble floors, large retail stores, and shoppers spread across multiple levels.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代购物中心内部的摄影图像。图中心是一个多层次的玻璃结构，顶部有拱形的天花板和悬挂的灯具。最显眼的是位于中层的H&M品牌店铺，其标志性的红色字母在白色背景上非常醒目。底层是各种商店和餐饮场所，顾客们正在购物或用餐。整个场景被明亮且均匀的灯光照亮，营造出一个活跃而现代的购物环境。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a large modern airport terminal building under a clear blue sky. The building has a long, gently receding façade made of teal-tinted glass panels arranged in a regular grid, separated by tall white vertical columns. The glass reflects nearby structures, light poles, and the surrounding airport environment.

Along the roofline is a grey metallic overhang with a rounded edge and underside panels containing recessed circular lights. On top of the roof are large red signs: at the far left is a prominent red Chinese character mounted on a white metal support frame, and farther along the roof are more red Chinese characters followed by large red English letters spelling “DALIAN.” The signage indicates this is likely Dalian airport, with both Chinese and English branding visible.

At ground level, the terminal entrances are visible beneath the glass façade. A blue sign above one doorway includes Chinese text, English text for an “International Hong Kong Macao Taiwan Departure” area, and the number “18.” Metal railings line the sidewalk in front of the building, separating pedestrians from the roadway.

In the foreground, there is a wide airport access road with marked lanes, arrows, and curb islands. A few cars and small groups of people can be seen near the entrance area toward the right side of the image. The perspective is angled from below and to the side, making the terminal stretch diagonally from the left foreground into the right background. The overall scene feels bright, clean, and spacious, with strong sunlight emphasizing the glass, metal, and white structural elements of the terminal.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的机场航站楼的照片。建筑物具有现代化的设计，以大面积的玻璃幕墙和简洁的线条为特点。在建筑物的顶部，有一个显眼的大红色标志，上面写着'DALIAN'，并配有一个类似太阳的图形元素。阳光照射下，建筑物的透明玻璃反射出周围环境的轮廓。照片背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，没有云朵，强调了建筑的清晰轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a bright, scenic waterfront view on a sunny day. In the foreground, there is a dense layer of glossy green leaves filling the lower portion of the frame. The leaves are vibrant and sunlit, with some reddish stems and small patches of shadow giving them texture and depth. On the left side, a shrub or small tree with mixed green and reddish leaves rises above the foreground foliage, while on the right side a larger leafy tree frames the scene with darker green branches.

Beyond the greenery, a stretch of blue water is visible, slightly rippled and reflecting the clear sky. Across the water sits a large, modern architectural building with a broad, flat, projecting roof and a glassy, layered façade. The structure appears sleek and contemporary, with horizontal lines across its front and a white rectangular block rising above the roofline. It resembles a major cultural building, possibly an opera house, positioned prominently on the waterfront.

Behind and around the modern building, lower historic-looking buildings with dark roofs and light-colored façades line the shore, creating a contrast between older architecture and the modern landmark. The horizon is low, allowing the sky to dominate much of the image.

The sky is a vivid, saturated blue with scattered white clouds spread across it. The clouds are soft and wispy in some areas and puffier in others, adding movement and openness to the scene. The overall atmosphere is calm, bright, and summery, with strong sunlight, lush greenery, blue water, and a striking architectural focal point in the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然与现代建筑和谐共存的摄影作品。前景是生机勃勃的绿色植物，包括多种树木和灌木，它们的叶片呈现出鲜亮的绿色，并且有些树叶上还带有红色果实。在这些植物的背后，可以看到一座现代风格的建筑物，其设计简洁而优雅，以白色为主色调，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。建筑物位于一片宽阔的水域旁，水面平静，反射着天空的蓝色。

caption:
The image shows an indoor volleyball match in progress, captured at a dramatic moment near the net.

In the center-right foreground, two players in dark navy-blue uniforms are jumping together to block an attack. Their arms are fully extended above the net, hands open and angled toward the opposing side. One blocker wears jersey number 9, while the other appears to wear number 5. Both are airborne beside the right-side net post, which is wrapped in bright red padding. The volleyball, colored yellow and blue, is blurred in motion just above and to the right of their hands, suggesting a fast spike or deflection.

On the opposite side of the net, a player in a yellow-and-navy uniform is also near the net, appearing to have just attacked the ball. Their body is partially obscured by the net and the blockers, but they are positioned close to the center of the action. Another yellow-uniformed player is visible at the far left edge, while a seated teammate or staff member in yellow sits on the bench area in the background.

In the foreground, a navy-blue player wearing jersey number 3 stands with knees bent and legs wide apart, ready to react defensively. This player is slightly out of focus compared with the action at the net, emphasizing depth and movement. The turquoise and salmon-colored volleyball court has crisp white boundary lines and sponsor markings on the floor.

To the right, a referee or official in a white polo shirt and dark pants stands near the scorer’s table, watching the play. A person seated at the table appears to be keeping notes or monitoring the match. Behind them are advertising boards, including visible text such as “PHISICAL PERFORMANCE is POWERED by” and a large “Ver…” volleyball-related sign.

The background shows rows of empty arena seats: dark red seats in the middle tiers and bright yellow seats higher up. Metal railings, stairways, and green-lit emergency exit signs are visible, giving the setting the feel of a professional or semi-professional indoor sports venue. The overall image is dynamic, with motion blur on the ball and some players, capturing the intensity and speed of a volleyball rally at the net.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到室内排球比赛精彩瞬间的照片。图中，一名身穿蓝色运动服的运动员正跳起准备扣球，他的动作专注而有力。另一名穿着黄色运动服的对手球员在网前做好了防守姿态。场地上的其他队员和观众都集中注意力于即将发生的击球。背景中的看台空无一人，只有少数工作人员和摄影师在场边忙碌。

caption:
The image shows a bright, wide-angle urban street scene in a Spanish city, likely in a central plaza or major intersection. The atmosphere is sunny and warm, with a pale blue sky filled with soft white clouds.

On the left and center of the image are several multi-story historic buildings with ornate façades. A prominent white building near the center-left has a rounded corner tower capped with a decorative domed roof. On top of this building is a large “CaixaBank” sign with the bank’s colorful star logo. The building has tall vertical windows, classical detailing, balconies, and a mix of curved and rectangular architectural elements, giving it an early 20th-century urban style.

To the far left, another older building has beige stone walls, dark wooden shutters, wrought-iron balconies, and decorative trim along the roofline. At street level, trees line the sidewalk, partially obscuring storefronts and entrances. People are visible walking, standing, and sitting on benches, suggesting a lively public area.

On the right side is a large, pale stone institutional building with a curved corner façade. The words “Banco de España” are visible near the top, indicating it is a Bank of Spain building. It has a formal, classical appearance with rows of shuttered windows, decorative columns, carved stone details, and flags hanging near the corner. In front of it are dense green trees and a modern angular streetlight or sign structure.

The road curves gently through the foreground and center of the image, with white lane markings and a pedestrian crossing visible in the distance. A red city bus occupies the lower right portion of the frame, partly cropped, with passengers visible through its windows and an advertisement along its side. Several cars, scooters, and pedestrians can be seen near the intersection. Traffic lights are present, and one appears green.

The overall scene feels busy but orderly, combining historic architecture, public transit, pedestrians, and leafy urban landscaping under a bright daytime sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的摄影照片，画面中心有一辆红色的公交车正在行驶，车身上有广告。街道两旁是多层建筑，其中一些建筑顶部装饰着圆顶和尖塔。人行道上有行人正在行走或休息，而一些人在路边的小摊位前停留。天空晴朗，云朵稀疏，为这个城市场景增添了一丝宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows an urban architectural scene viewed from a low, wide angle across a large open plaza.

In the foreground is a broad paved courtyard made of large, light-gray rectangular stone slabs. The paving lines form strong perspective lines that lead toward the center of the image, emphasizing the open space and the symmetry of the scene. The plaza is mostly empty, with no visible pedestrians or vehicles.

At the center and lower middle of the image is a modern building facade. The lower portion is a pale gray concrete or stone wall with tall, narrow rectangular windows and several green-framed glass doors. Some dark wall-mounted lights or fixtures are spaced across the facade. On the left side, a white temporary-looking construction barrier or partition partially blocks part of the building. A small green tree is visible behind or near this barrier.

Above the gray lower level is a darker, more dramatic upper structure. It has a black or very dark brown grid-like facade made of square panels, giving it an industrial or modernist appearance. In the center of this dark structure is a rounded, cylindrical section projecting outward, topped with a glass pyramid-like skylight. The dark panels and the blue-tinted horizontal windows create a strong contrast with the lighter lower building.

Behind and around the central building are taller city structures. On the right side, a large modern glass office building rises behind it, with a pale blue-gray facade and vertical lines running down the exterior. Its many windows reflect the bright sky. Farther right, a residential or office tower with rounded balconies is partially visible. On the left side, smaller office blocks and rooftops appear in the background, including a dark rectangular building and some lighter stacked structures.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image. It is bright blue with large white and gray clouds scattered across it. Some clouds are thick and shadowed, especially on the left, while others are thin and sunlit. The lighting suggests daytime, with bright sunlight illuminating the plaza and buildings, though the clouds create areas of soft shadow.

Overall, the image captures a quiet, spacious urban plaza surrounded by modern architecture, with a strong contrast between the pale open ground, the dark central building, and the bright cloud-filled sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的摄影图像，前景是一座灰色的建筑物，其特点是圆形的玻璃屋顶和大型的白色立柱。建筑物的入口处有几扇关闭的大门，周围是整齐排列的窗户。在建筑物的背后，可以看到其他高楼大厦，其中一些具有现代化的设计，如玻璃幕墙和直线形状。天空中散布着几朵白云，整体给人一种干净、开阔的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a white Thai police pickup truck driving or parked along a roadway in daylight. The vehicle is viewed from the rear-left side, taking up most of the frame. It appears to be an Isuzu D-Max pickup with a covered rear bed area and a red-and-clear emergency light bar mounted on the roof; the red lights on the right side of the bar are illuminated.

The truck has a broad maroon stripe running horizontally along the side, bordered by darker trim. On the front door there is a police emblem and the word “POLICE” in English. Thai script is printed prominently on the rear side panel and tailgate, including large black Thai lettering across the back. The license plate area is blurred. The rear tail lamps are visible, with an amber section lit on the left rear light cluster. A long thin antenna rises from the rear right side of the truck.

The windows are darkly tinted, reflecting nearby surroundings. The vehicle has silver steel wheels, black side mirrors, and a black rear bumper/step area. The truck’s body is slightly dusty, especially around the lower panels and wheel arches, suggesting regular road use.

In the background, there are leafy green trees, utility poles, and overhead wires, giving the setting an urban or roadside environment. A few other vehicles are partially visible to the left, including a light-colored van or truck and a smaller car. Bright orange traffic barriers or cones line part of the road in the lower-left area. The background is somewhat blurred, keeping attention focused on the police pickup in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国警车的现实主义风格照片。警车停在路边，车身为白色带有红色条纹和标志，车顶装有红色警示灯。车辆侧面清晰地印有'_police_ '字样，以及泰文文字。背景中可以看到绿色树木和部分模糊的建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image shows two plastic bottles of **OISHI Green Tea** standing upright on a glossy white surface against a very bright, almost completely white background.

On the **left** is a bottle with a **red cap** and a mostly **pink/red label**, indicating a **lychee-flavored** version. The label features images of pale pink lychee fruits and green tea leaves. The central branding includes the red circular Oishi logo above large black text reading **“OISHI”**, with **“Green Tea”** underneath. A badge on the front says **“100% Organic Tea Leaves.”** Near the lower label, small text suggests it is a **green tea lychee flavour** drink. The bottle contains a light amber tea-colored liquid visible at the bottom. Because the lighting is very bright, the upper part of the bottle is partially washed out, making the cap appear almost detached from the bottle body.

On the **right** is another OISHI Green Tea bottle with a **green cap** and a mostly **green label**, representing the **original flavor**. It also has the red circular Oishi logo, bold black **“OISHI”** branding, and **“Green Tea”** underneath. The label shows green tea leaves and a tea plantation-style pattern. A small badge says **“100% Organic Tea Leaves,”** and a handwritten-style label near the lower front reads **“Original.”** Around the upper neck label, there is a promotional banner mentioning a contest, with text such as **“Beli & Menang Emas”** and **“Berjumlah RM250,000!”** along with a gold-themed contest graphic.

Both bottles are positioned with some space between them, the red lychee bottle slightly to the left and the green original bottle slightly to the right. The scene is brightly lit with high exposure, creating a clean product-photography look, though many details in the upper bottle areas and background are blown out to white. Faint reflections of the bottles are visible on the shiny surface below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是两个OISHI品牌的饮料瓶，分别展示在白色背景上。左侧的瓶子是粉红色的，上面有绿色植物图案和品牌标志，标签显示它含有草莓口味。右侧的瓶子是绿色的，上面有黄色水果图案和品牌标志，标签显示它含有菠萝口味。两个瓶子都带有透明的盖子，顶部都有品牌商标。

caption:
The image shows a bright, expansive city square on a clear day, likely in a historic European setting. A vast blue sky dominates most of the frame, with a long, soft band of wispy white clouds stretching diagonally across the horizon.

In the foreground is a broad paved plaza made of patterned cobblestones and large rectangular stone bands forming a grid-like design. The sunlight is strong and crisp, casting long shadows across the square. Several pedestrians are walking through the open space near the center and right side, giving a sense of scale to the large plaza.

On the left side stands a grand pale yellow neoclassical building with white columns, ornate window frames, decorative cornices, and a balustraded roofline. In front of it is a low green metal fence and an elegant dark streetlamp with multiple lanterns, positioned prominently near the center-left of the image.

In the middle distance, a large domed cathedral rises above the surrounding buildings. Its golden dome catches the sunlight, with smaller architectural details and columns visible beneath it. To the right, partly framed by green trees, is a tall golden spire topped with a small ornament, rising from another classical yellow-and-white building. The trees add a lush green band between the architecture and the open square.

The overall atmosphere is open, sunny, and spacious, with a strong contrast between the vivid blue sky, golden architectural accents, pale classical façades, and the textured gray stone pavement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场的现实主义风格照片，阳光照耀下的广场上散布着散步和行走的人们。广场铺有规则的石砖，周围是装饰华丽的建筑，包括一个显眼的圆顶教堂和一座尖塔。天空呈现出晴朗的蓝色，几朵白云悠闲地飘浮在空中。

caption:
The image shows a busy bicycle parking area along the side of a large stone building, likely in an urban or university setting.

A long row of bicycles fills most of the foreground and right side of the scene, packed tightly into metal bike racks. The bikes are lined up diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right, creating a strong sense of depth. There are many different styles and colors: a bright turquoise/blue bicycle stands out in the lower left foreground, while nearby bikes include black, silver, pink, green, and red frames. Several bicycles have accessories such as front baskets, rear racks, mudguards, child seats, and pannier-style bags. The handlebars, wheels, spokes, and frames overlap densely, making the parking area look crowded and well-used.

The ground is a smooth paved surface, with a wide open walkway or driveway visible on the right side. The bicycle racks run parallel to a tall stone wall. The building has an older architectural style, with tan and gray masonry blocks, tall narrow windows, stone ledges, and vertical drainpipes. Some windows have decorative stonework and bars or mullions, adding to the historic feel of the setting.

There are several people near the bikes and building. On the left, a child or young person wearing a striped polo shirt and backpack is walking beside the row of bicycles. Next to them is another person wearing a light-colored bucket hat, a dark striped cardigan, and a lanyard. Near the middle, an adult is standing by a stroller while holding a small child. Farther back on the right, another person in a burgundy hoodie stands among the bicycles. In the distant background, more people and bicycles are visible near the end of the row. The faces of the people appear blurred.

Overall, the scene feels like a busy bike parking area outside a historic institutional building, with many bicycles clustered together and pedestrians moving through the space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多辆自行车整齐排列在建筑物前的街道上的照片。从左至右，可以看到不同款式和颜色的自行车，包括蓝色、红色、绿色和黑色等。几位行人站在自行车旁，有的正在交谈，有的似乎在等待或行走。背景中的建筑物具有古典风格的立面，窗户上方装饰有石雕。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of an airport terminal building on a bright day. Large dark letters mounted along the roofline read “LE TOUQUET,” and farther left along the same roofline another sign reads “AÉROPORT INTERNATIONAL,” indicating the building is Le Touquet International Airport.

On the left side is a green-and-white control tower structure rising above the terminal. The tower has a glassed-in observation/control room with green framing, topped by a flat roof surrounded by railings. Several antennas, masts, and two white satellite dishes are mounted on the roof, giving it a functional aviation/communications appearance.

The main terminal building stretches diagonally across the image from lower left to upper right. It has a long row of tall rectangular windows with white frames, reflecting trees and sky. The upper facade is mostly white, while green trim runs along parts of the lower roofline. Below the windows, a stone-clad wall section features an arrow-shaped sign reading “DOUANES - CUSTOMS,” pointing to the right.

At the bottom left, part of an entrance area is visible, with glass doors, a small sign that appears to reference terminal access, and a bright yellow wall-mounted box. A small satellite dish is attached near the lower roof edge. On the right side, leafless tree branches partially obscure the building, suggesting winter or early spring.

The sky is pale blue with light clouds, and the overall lighting is bright and crisp, making the white facade, green structural elements, and dark rooftop lettering stand out clearly.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示机场建筑的摄影图像，图中可见一座绿色和白色相间的建筑物，其顶部有'LE TOUQUET'的标识。建筑物的左侧是一个带有监控塔的控制塔台，而右侧是带有'DOUBLES-CUSTOS'字样的指示牌。整个场景在阳光下拍摄，天空呈现出晴朗的状态。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny village or small-town scene beside a narrow canal or pond. The foreground has a paved road at the bottom edge, bordered by a curb and a strip of well-kept green grass. Just beyond the grass is a low red-and-white metal railing running horizontally across the scene, separating the lawn from the water.

Near the center foreground stands a tall white flagpole, extending out of the top of the frame. At its base is a small paved circular area. Slightly to the right of the flagpole is a rough, upright commemorative stone with engraved Danish text. The visible inscription reads approximately: “DANSKE I SKOVBY REJSTE STENEN TIL MINDE OM GENFORENINGEN 1920,” indicating a memorial stone raised in memory of the reunification in 1920. Around the stone are decorative flower planters with purple and white blooms.

On the left side of the foreground is a large planter overflowing with vivid pink flowers, forming a tall, bushy floral display. Behind it is a white building with a red-brown roof edge and a small door or window. A wooden fence and more planters line the far side of the water.

The water in the middle of the image is calm and greenish, reflecting the railing, flowers, stone wall, and parts of the buildings. A low stone embankment runs along the far side of the canal, made of rounded rocks and masonry.

Across the water are several residential buildings and gardens. On the right is a white house with a dark tiled roof, skylight windows, and a small patio area with outdoor furniture and umbrellas. There are toys or colorful objects near the patio, suggesting a family home. Large leafy trees surround the houses, including a drooping willow-like tree on the far right and fuller green trees in the center background.

The sky is bright blue with large, soft white clouds, giving the whole scene a peaceful summer atmosphere. The lighting is strong and clear, with crisp shadows and vibrant colors, especially the green grass, pink flowers, and blue sky. Overall, it appears to be a quiet, picturesque Danish village setting with a waterside memorial and well-maintained gardens.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示宁静小镇一角的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个带有文字的纪念石，旁边是盛开的粉红色花朵和紫色植物。背景中有一条小河，河岸边有几座房屋和树木，天空晴朗，云朵稀疏。

caption:
The image shows a partially constructed two-story house under a bright blue sky. The building appears unfinished, with exposed concrete walls, unpainted plaster, and construction materials still visible.

At the top is a steep, dark gray tiled roof with a dormer-like upper section. Across the front of this upper roof section is a white metal railing or grille made of horizontal bars, with some diagonal supports behind it. The area behind the railing looks open and unfinished, suggesting it may be a balcony, loft opening, or roof ventilation space. The roof tiles are rectangular and arranged in neat rows, though some areas look dusty or incomplete.

Below the upper roof, the front façade has a large recessed opening or balcony area with unfinished gray concrete surfaces. The central front wall is rough and mottled, showing different shades of cement and plaster. A wide concrete overhang extends outward above the ground floor, forming a small covered area.

On the right side of the house is another sloped roof section, also covered with dark gray tiles. Beneath it is a light gray wall with a rectangular window that has a white frame and dark glass or an open dark interior behind it. The right wall looks smoother than the central unfinished concrete but still appears unpainted or in progress.

On the lower front center, there is a white-framed glass door or tall window with multiple panes. Nearby, construction materials such as boards, pipes, or frames are leaning inside the open doorway. A vertical pale pipe or bamboo-like pole runs down near the front right side of the central wall.

On the left lower side, a white column supports the front overhang. A motorcycle is parked partly under the covered area, close to the wall. The surrounding ground is rough and unfinished, with scattered blocks, debris, and construction materials.

In the background, there is an open landscape with dry grass, some greenery, and a distant communication tower. The sky is mostly clear with a few faint white clouds, giving the scene a bright midday appearance. Overall, the image depicts a modern-style house still in the construction or finishing stage.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示正在建设中的房屋的照片。房屋的主体结构已经完成，屋顶覆盖着灰色瓦片，而窗户和门尚未安装玻璃或门板。建筑前方有几根未完成的木梁和一些建筑材料散落在地面上。在房屋的左侧，可以看到一辆摩托车停放在屋外。背景中是晴朗的蓝天和远处轮廓模糊的树木，为这个工地场景增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a historic cobblestone street leading through a red-brick architectural complex, likely part of an old castle, palace, or monastery. The view is framed by tall brick buildings on both sides, creating a strong sense of depth as the street narrows toward the center.

On the right, a long red-brick building with a steep red-tiled roof runs diagonally into the distance. Its façade has arched windows with dark metal grilles, stone trim, and a few downspouts. The brickwork is varied in color, with deep reds, browns, and weathered patches, giving the structure an aged, textured appearance. Farther right, another brick wall and archway partially frame the edge of the scene.

On the left, a lower brick wall and building line the street. The roof is covered with reddish clay tiles, and a decorative black metal wall lamp protrudes from the brick façade. Above the left wall, dense green tree foliage overhangs the scene, adding contrast to the warm brick tones.

The street itself is paved with uneven cobblestones, with a narrow smoother stone strip running along the center. Several people are walking away from the camera toward an arched gateway in the distance. They appear to be tourists or visitors, dressed casually in jackets and long pants. Their small scale emphasizes the height and grandeur of the surrounding architecture.

Dominating the background are tall copper-green towers and spires. The largest tower rises near the center-right, with a square brick base topped by a large oxidized copper dome and an ornate multi-tiered spire. The patinated green metal contrasts strikingly with the red brick. To the left, another narrower tower with a similar green spire and decorative details rises behind the buildings. A small gilded detail is visible on one of the towers, adding a bright accent.
