At the far end of the street, an ornate stone gateway or portal sits beneath the towers, suggesting an entrance to a courtyard or important inner section of the complex. The sky is pale and overcast, producing soft, even lighting without harsh shadows. Overall, the image has a quiet, historic atmosphere, with rich textures of brick, tile, copper, and stone creating a strong sense of place and age.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老建筑和游客的摄影照片。在画面中，我们看到一条由鹅卵石铺成的道路，两旁是红砖墙的建筑。沿着道路行走着几位游客，他们似乎正在参观或游览这个历史悠久的地方。背景中的建筑具有哥特式风格的特点，包括尖顶塔楼和复杂的装饰细节。天空多云，为场景增添了一丝阴郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet suburban street bordered by green lawns, young trees, and modern houses under a dramatic cloudy sky.

In the foreground, there is a wide stretch of bright green grass occupying the lower part of the image. A dark asphalt road curves gently from the bottom right toward the center distance, bordered by pale concrete curbs and sidewalks. Near the center foreground stands a tall, dark green streetlamp with a curved, shepherd’s-hook-style top and a downward-facing lamp shade. Several similar streetlamps continue down the street, getting smaller with distance.

On both sides of the road are neatly planted trees. Some trees have dense green foliage, while others show reddish-brown leaves, suggesting early autumn or seasonal variation. The trees are evenly spaced along the sidewalks and grassy verges, giving the neighborhood a planned, landscaped appearance. On the left side, a pedestrian path runs through a grassy park-like area, lined with short black posts connected by chains. Beyond it is an open green space with more scattered trees.

On the right side of the image, modern suburban homes are partially visible. They have brick and light-colored exterior walls, dark tiled roofs, driveways, and small front gardens. A dark vehicle is parked in a driveway at the far right edge, and further down the street a white van and a small car can be seen. Some rooftops in the background have solar panels.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image. It is filled with large, layered clouds in shades of gray, white, and pale blue, creating an overcast but bright atmosphere. Patches of blue sky peek through in places, and the lighting is soft and diffused, with no harsh shadows.

Overall, the scene feels calm, clean, and residential, with well-maintained landscaping, broad sidewalks, and a peaceful suburban roadway stretching into the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示郊区住宅区的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一条弯曲的道路，两旁种植着树木和草地。道路的一侧是排列整齐的房屋，而另一侧则停有几辆汽车。在画面的前景，可以看到两个高大的路灯，它们位于草地上方，为街道提供照明。天空中布满了厚厚的云层，但光线依然充足，使得整个场景看起来非常清晰。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny waterfront scene at a marina, with a grand historic government building in the background—likely the British Columbia Parliament Buildings in Victoria, Canada.

In the center background is a large, ornate stone building with a prominent green-blue copper dome rising above the roofline. The architecture is symmetrical and stately, with arched windows, decorative columns, smaller domed towers, and an impressive central entrance reached by broad steps. The oxidized copper roofs and domes stand out vividly against the pale blue sky. A tall column or monument is visible near the front of the building, and there are several trees around the grounds, including a tall evergreen to the right of the main dome.

The middle ground contains a lively marina filled with sailboats and yachts. Numerous tall masts crisscross the scene vertically, creating a dense pattern of lines in front of the building. The boats are moored along wooden docks, with white hulls, rigging, and dark pilings. On the right side, a large white boat occupies the edge of the frame, while smaller sailboats and motorboats fill the harbor.

In the foreground, the harbor water reflects sunlight and parts of the docks and boats. A yellow-and-black harbor water taxi or small tour boat sits near the center-bottom of the image, with a bright yellow railing and a checkered black-and-white trim. Nearby, a white canopy tent is set up along the dock. Several people are walking or standing on the waterfront: a small group with children is gathered near the dock on the left, a person in a bright green jacket walks near the water on the right, and other visitors are scattered throughout the promenade and lawn.

The overall atmosphere is cheerful and busy, suggesting a pleasant day in a tourist-friendly harbor area. The combination of historic architecture, boats, waterfront activity, and clear daylight gives the scene a picturesque, coastal-city feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示码头活动的现实主义风格照片，前景中人们在码头上行走和交谈，一艘黄色的小船停靠在码头边。背景是一座宏伟的建筑，其绿色圆顶在阳光下闪耀，周围是排列整齐的帆船桅杆。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of several pink-toned souvenir or biscuit tins displayed on a dark shelf, likely in a shop.

At the center is a rectangular pale pink metal tin with rounded corners. It features a detailed magenta line drawing of the façade of the **Cathédrale de Reims**, including its twin towers, Gothic arches, rose window, statues, and intricate architectural decoration. Near the bottom of the tin, the text **“Cathédrale de Reims”** is written in elegant cursive script. A small white paper price tag is taped near the upper-left area of the tin, handwritten with **“7 €”** in dark ink.

On the left edge of the image, part of another tall pink tin is visible. It is designed to look like a stylized building façade, with black outlines, windows, shutters, and an awning. A white price label near its top reads **“12 €”**. Some partial printed text is visible, including fragments such as **“...MERE”**, **“...SIER”**, and **“BISCUIT ROSE”**, suggesting it may be packaging for pink biscuits.

On the far right, only a narrow portion of another pale pink box or tin can be seen, with partial text beginning **“BIS...”** and a large white number or letter partly cut off.

The background is very dark, almost black, which makes the pink packaging stand out strongly. The lighting is focused on the tins, creating a shop-window or display-case feel with glossy reflections along the metal surfaces.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示巴黎圣母院（Cathédrale de Reims）纪念品的图片，物品被放置在一个带有粉色图案的金属盒中。盒子上方有一个价格标签显示为4欧元。

caption:
The image shows a calm lake surrounded by dense, dark green forest, viewed from an elevated perspective. Several colorful tethered balloons float low over the water, their long strings extending down toward the lake and creating delicate vertical lines.

The most prominent object is a large yellow spherical balloon in the right-center foreground. It has bold horizontal bands around its middle in blue, red, and dark tones, with additional darker striping near the bottom. Sunlight catches the top of this balloon, making it glow brightly. Its reflection appears below it in the water, slightly distorted and darker due to the greenish surface.

To the left, there are two smaller balloons floating near the tree line. One has a patriotic red, white, and blue design with white stars on a blue band and red-and-white striping beneath. Nearby is another balloon with alternating dark blue, red, and white vertical scalloped patterns. Farther back near the center is a yellow balloon with dark vertical stripes, hovering close to the opposite shore.

On the right side, another smaller multicolored balloon floats above the water. It has vertical rainbow-like stripes and appears connected to a yellow, cross-shaped frame or structure below it, which is also reflected in the lake.

The lake itself is still and reflective, with muted green water mirroring the surrounding trees, balloons, and sunlight. The reflections are soft and slightly rippled. The far shoreline is shaded and wooded, with tall trees rising behind it. A small dock or walkway is visible near the upper center-right, along with a tiny yellow umbrella or canopy on the bank.

The lighting suggests early morning or late afternoon, with strong sunlight streaming from the upper right. There is a hazy glow over the trees and water, giving the scene a quiet, atmospheric quality. Overall, the image feels serene and whimsical, with the brightly colored balloons contrasting against the natural greens and shadowy forest backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示热气球在宁静湖面上空飞行的摄影作品。图像中，五只色彩鲜艳的热气球漂浮在清澈的水面上方，它们的倒影清晰可见。热气球的颜色包括蓝色、黄色和红色，其中一只较大的热气球上装饰着多彩条纹。背景是郁郁葱葱的树木和远处的山丘，营造出一种平和而美丽的自然氛围。

caption:
The image shows a broad, sunlit view of a historic palace or classical-style building set behind a green lawn and rows of trees.

In the foreground, there is a wide expanse of neatly kept grass, partly covered in soft, irregular shadows cast by nearby trees. The scene feels calm and park-like, with the lawn stretching across the entire lower half of the image.

At the center foreground stands a dark bronze or metal statue on a stone pedestal, surrounded by a low circular iron fence. The statue appears to depict a human figure in a dynamic pose, possibly holding or reaching upward with one arm. It is positioned directly in front of the building, acting as a focal point between the garden and the architecture.

Behind the statue is a row of trimmed trees with dense green canopies. Their trunks form a repeating vertical rhythm in front of the building, partially obscuring the lower façade. A low hedge and small fencing run along the base of the building, adding structure to the landscaped garden.

The building itself is large and elegant, painted in warm pale yellow or cream tones with white decorative trim. The right portion is especially ornate, featuring a series of tall arched windows with wooden frames. Each arch is surrounded by elaborate white plasterwork, including sculptural details, decorative reliefs, and classical motifs. Beneath the arches is a colonnaded walkway or portico with white columns and shaded openings. Inside the covered area, faint painted wall decorations and statues can be seen.

The left portion of the building is simpler and more rectangular, with a light-colored roof and rows of smaller windows. Its façade is also pale yellow, but less decorative than the arched section on the right. A small cupola or rooftop ornament with a tiny flag-like finial rises near the center of the roofline.

Large trees frame the scene on both sides and across the top edge of the image. Their dark green leaves create a natural border, especially dense on the left and upper right. The sky is clear and bright blue, with no visible clouds, suggesting a sunny day with strong but pleasant light.

Overall, the image presents a serene garden courtyard or palace park, combining manicured greenery, classical architecture, decorative sculpture, and warm afternoon sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑风格的庭院的照片。照片中心是一座装饰华丽的黄色建筑物，其特点是多个大型拱形窗户和白色的柱子。建筑前是一个宽阔的绿色草坪，上面有几棵树木和一些灌木丛。阳光从树叶间透射下来，在草坪上投下斑驳的阴影。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a tall, vertical outdoor sign or pillar with a bright blue face. On the sign, in white, is the Vattenfall branding: a stylized circular logo near the upper part and the word “VATTENFALL” running vertically down the sign. Because of the camera angle, the text appears rotated, with the letters stacked along the length of the pillar.

The sign has a smooth, slightly curved blue surface, with a light gray or metallic vertical border along the left edge. The white logo consists of abstract curved shapes and a star-like cutout, standing out sharply against the blue background.

The photo is taken outdoors in an urban or office-campus setting. In the background, there is a paved cobblestone walkway with dark and light stone patterns. To the right of the sign is a low stone or pebble-textured wall bordering a patch of dry grass and sparse shrubs or small leafless branches. Farther back, part of a modern building is visible, with pale exterior walls and rectangular windows. The overall lighting suggests daytime, possibly overcast or soft natural light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示蓝色立柱上的白色标志牌的照片。立柱顶部有一个白色的圆形图案，下方是白色的字母“VATENFALL”，表明这是一个与能源相关的标志。背景中可以看到部分建筑物和铺有石块的人行道。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of packaged padlocks on a retail display shelf, with the central product in sharp focus.

In the middle is a **Yale High Security Padlock** inside a clear plastic blister pack. The packaging has Yale’s distinctive **yellow, black, and gray** color scheme. A large yellow circle with the black **“Yale”** logo appears on the left side of the label, next to the words **“HIGH SECURITY PADLOCK”** in bold lettering. Near the upper right of the package is a large printed **“6”**, likely indicating a security rating or product series.

A white price sticker from **PARKSON** is attached over the upper-right portion of the packaging. It includes a barcode, product code text, and the price **RM 88.90** printed in green. The model line on the sticker appears to read **“P64-YALE (N)”**.

Inside the packaging, a shiny silver key is mounted across the front, with the Yale logo embossed on the key head. Below it is the padlock itself: a glossy black and chrome lock with a thick metallic shackle. The lock body has the text **“SERIES Y121/50”** printed vertically, and a small round yellow Yale badge near the lower right. On the right side of the packaging, small text indicates the **shackle size: 24mm x 23mm**. A feature list on the left mentions security details such as **solid brass body**, **boron steel shackle**, **double locking**, and a protective cover.

Surrounding the central product are other Yale padlocks in similar clear plastic packaging. On the left edge, part of another package is visible with a price sticker showing **RM 79.90** and a visible **“5”** rating. On the right, another Yale padlock package is partially visible, showing a silver lock and the words **“SOLID BRASS PADLOCK”** near the bottom. At the top, part of another circular package can be seen with text reading **“20mm SOLID BRASS PADLOCKS.”**

The overall setting appears to be a store hardware or department-store section, with the products hanging on metal display hooks against a light-colored background. The lighting is bright, creating reflections on the clear plastic packaging and the shiny metal keys and locks.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Yale品牌高安全等级挂锁的产品照片。挂锁被放置在黄色的塑料包装中，包装上印有产品名称、型号和价格标签。锁体是黑色的，带有银色的金属部件，包括钥匙孔和锁杆。锁杆上有一个明显的'YALE'标志。背景模糊地显示了其他类似产品的包装盒。

caption:
The image shows a grand, ornate waterfront palace or historic building viewed from across a body of water. The lower foreground is filled with rippling blue-green water, suggesting the building sits directly along a shoreline or quay. Along the edge of the water is a stone embankment with dark green algae or moss staining the base where it meets the waterline.

A long, pale stone wall runs horizontally across the scene. It is decorated with repeating arched recesses, carved details, and small ornamental lamp posts spaced along the top. Several white seagulls are standing on the walkway near the water, especially toward the right side, adding a sense of scale and liveliness.

At the center is an elaborate ceremonial gate. The gate is framed by white stone columns and topped with decorative finials. Its double doors are black and gold, richly patterned with gilded floral and geometric designs. Above the gate is a striking golden crest or sunburst-like ornament, with curling leaf shapes and a central circular emblem. The gate stands out brightly against the gray stone architecture behind it.

Behind the wall rises the façade of a large historic palace, built from gray and pale stone. The architecture is highly decorative, with tall fluted columns, arched window frames, carved moldings, pilasters, and sculptural details. The windows are tall and narrow with dark reddish-brown frames, many covered by light curtains. The façade has a formal, symmetrical rhythm, with repeating vertical columns and ornate stonework, giving it a majestic European Baroque or Ottoman imperial style.

On the left side of the image, partly hidden behind the wall and trees, there is a red building with a dark roof and arched windows. Behind it and above the palace grounds are dense green trees, including tall leafy trees and a dark evergreen. A stone retaining wall is visible in the background, separating the landscaped greenery from the lower buildings.

The lighting is bright daylight, casting clear shadows and highlighting the texture of the stone carvings. Overall, the image conveys the elegance of a historic waterfront palace, with luxurious gilded details, monumental architecture, calm water, and greenery surrounding the site.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑风格的图像，建筑物位于河流边，其精致的立面装饰和华丽的入口门廊在阳光下显得格外引人注目。河水平静，反射着建筑的轮廓。背景中可以看到树木和另一座红色建筑，为这个场景增添了一丝自然与和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of someone unboxing a Sony camera product on a light wooden tabletop. The main object is a glossy black retail box for a **Sony α7 III** camera. The large white **SONY** logo is visible on the front, along with the **α7 III** model marking and a partial printed image of the camera body on the lower right.

The box is open at the top, with several cardboard flaps folded outward. Inside, brown cardboard inserts and packaging dividers are visible. A person’s hands are reaching into the box; one hand is partly inside near the left side, while the other is holding or moving a crumpled white protective wrapping or pouch near the top opening. The person appears to be wearing a dark blue long-sleeved top.

On the front right side of the box are several small award and certification stickers, including labels resembling **EISA Awards**, **Best Product**, **TIPA**, and an **E-mount** label. A black plastic handle runs across the top-right portion of the box, suggesting it is a handled retail package.

In the lower left background, there are some out-of-focus printed papers or manuals lying on the table, likely instruction booklets or documentation from the box. The background is softly blurred, keeping attention on the unboxing process and the Sony camera packaging. The overall scene suggests a new camera being unpacked for the first time.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示相机包装盒的照片，其中一位人物正使用锤子打开一个黑色的Sony A7ii相机包装盒。盒子上有清晰的品牌标识和型号信息。在模糊的背景中可以看到一些散落的纸张和办公用品，暗示着可能是在办公室或家庭环境中拍摄这张照片。

caption:
The image shows an intense moment during a professional soccer match on a grass pitch. Two players are battling closely for possession of the ball near the bottom center of the frame.

One player, on the left, is wearing a red Bayern Munich kit with thin white horizontal stripes, white Adidas shoulder stripes, red shorts, and red socks. The Bayern crest and sponsor logo are visible on the front of the shirt. He is leaning forward and slightly off balance, with his upper body tilted left and one arm lowered as he tries to shield or control the ball. His bright green boots stand out against the turf.

The opposing player, on the right, is wearing Borussia Dortmund’s yellow-and-black kit. His shirt has bold vertical black stripes on a yellow background, the BVB crest, Puma logo, and a black sponsor panel across the chest. He is wearing black shorts with the number 6 visible, yellow socks with black bands, and mismatched-looking boots: one appears light/gold and the other bright green. He is pressing tightly from behind and to the side, with one arm raised and the other near the Bayern player’s body, trying to challenge for the ball.

The ball is in the foreground between their legs, just ahead of the Bayern player’s foot. It is a white Bundesliga-style ball with colorful panels in orange, pink, blue, and yellow. Small bits of turf and dirt are visible around the players’ feet, emphasizing the physicality and speed of the challenge.

In the background, there is a blurred stadium crowd behind advertising boards. A large blue advertising board with white “1&1” text is visible, matching the sponsor branding on the Dortmund shirt. The scene appears to be from a high-energy Bundesliga match, likely between Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund, with the focus sharply on the duel for the ball while the spectators and stands are out of focus.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉足球比赛精彩瞬间的体育摄影照片。图中，一名穿着红色球衣和绿色短裤的球员正专注地控球，而另一名穿着黄色球衣和黑色短裤的球员则在尝试抢断。两人都穿着专业的运动鞋，显示出比赛的激烈程度。他们身后是球场的草地和模糊的观众席，营造出一种现场观赛的氛围。

caption:
The image shows two people walking away from the camera along a pair of railway tracks in a lush, green outdoor setting. The scene is bright and sunlit, with dappled light filtering through dense foliage overhead and along the sides.

In the foreground and center, the railway tracks run diagonally from the bottom of the image toward the middle distance, curving slightly as they disappear into the greenery. The tracks are rusty-brown and set into a bed of reddish gravel and dry leaves. Metal fasteners and sleepers are visible, giving the rails a weathered, older look.

Two people are walking on or beside the rails. On the left is a person with reddish hair styled in two braids. They are wearing a white sleeveless top with ruffled shoulders and loose, striped pants in warm shades of pink, orange, purple, and brown. They are holding a camera in one hand, suggesting they may be sightseeing or taking photographs. On the right is another person wearing a black-and-white patterned short-sleeve shirt, light-colored shorts, sandals, and a crossbody strap or bag. Their face is blurred, and they appear to be looking toward the person beside them as they walk.

The right side of the image is dominated by a tall, sloped concrete or stone retaining wall covered with vines, roots, and patches of greenery. The wall is shaded in places, creating strong contrast with the sunlit vegetation. On the left side, the area is thick with bright green plants and trees, giving the scene a tropical or forested feel.

Overall, the image has a relaxed, exploratory atmosphere, like a walk through an overgrown railway corridor. The natural setting is vivid and peaceful, though the people are walking on railway tracks, which can be dangerous if the line is active.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现两个人在自然环境中沿着废弃铁轨行走的照片。左侧的人物穿着彩色条纹长裤和白色上衣，头发染成红色，背着一个黑色相机包；右侧的人物穿着带有图案的短袖衬衫和浅色短裤，背着一个黑色背包。他们正沿着铁轨前进，周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛，阳光透过树叶洒下斑驳的光影。

caption:
The image shows a small mountain railway station nestled in a dense, misty forest. A red-and-dark-green train is stopped on the tracks in the center of the scene, its rear end facing the viewer. The train has a rounded roof, cream-colored trim around the rear door and windows, and small red lights near the bottom. Several passenger cars extend forward along the track, partially hidden by trees and the station platform.

The setting is lush and damp, with tall evergreen trees rising on both sides. Many trunks and branches are covered with moss and hanging vegetation, giving the forest a cool, humid, almost cloud-forest atmosphere. The background fades into pale mist, making the distant trees look soft and hazy.

Wooden boardwalks and platforms surround the tracks. On the left, a wooden walkway runs beside a steep moss-covered hillside thick with shrubs, ferns, and vines. A few visitors in jackets and backpacks are walking along the platform, some appearing to take photos of the train. Near the train are signs with Chinese characters, including directional signs for passengers.

On the right, a wooden-railed walkway curves alongside the train and leads toward a small station structure or shelter with warm lights under its roof. The railings are weathered and dark, with moss and lichen growing on them, matching the damp woodland environment. The foreground includes steps, planks, railings, and a few visible narrow-gauge rails embedded in the ground.

Overall, the scene feels quiet, cool, and atmospheric—like a scenic forest railway stop high in the mountains, surrounded by thick greenery, mist, moss, and towering trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光与交通工具结合的摄影图像。图中，一辆红色和白色相间的复古风格火车停靠在木质栈道上，周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和雾气弥漫的森林环境。几位游客正在木栈道上行走或停留，享受着周围的自然美景。

caption:
The image shows a professional soccer player running on a green grass pitch during a match or warm-up in a large stadium.

The player is centered in the frame and wearing a gold/yellow FC Barcelona away kit. The shirt has the FC Barcelona crest on the left chest, a Nike logo on the right chest, and a large Spotify sponsor logo across the front. The kit has subtle patterned detailing throughout the fabric. The player is also wearing matching gold shorts with the Barcelona crest, gold socks with thin colored bands, and soccer cleats that appear mostly light-colored with orange accents. White athletic tape or wristbands are visible around both wrists. His face is intentionally blurred, but his body posture suggests he is jogging forward, with arms bent and hands relaxed.

The background is heavily blurred, creating a shallow-depth-of-field effect that keeps attention on the player. Behind him, a crowd fills the stadium stands, with many spectators wearing red, purple, and blue tones. Some fans appear to have their arms raised, suggesting cheering or celebration. Along the sideline are advertising boards, including visible branding such as Adidas logos, Audi, and GOAL. A red advertising board spans much of the background, and there are also Red Bull-style bull graphics visible behind the player.

The lower half of the image is dominated by the bright green, well-maintained soccer field. Stadium lighting gives the scene a nighttime or evening-match feel, with the player well lit while the crowd and signage remain soft and out of focus. The overall composition emphasizes motion, athleticism, and the atmosphere of a high-level football match.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张体育摄影风格的照片，展示了一名足球运动员在球场上奔跑的瞬间。运动员身穿黄色球衣和短裤，脚踩彩色运动鞋，表情专注而充满活力。背景中可以看到观众席上的观众们正注视着场中的比赛，以及一些赞助商的广告牌，如'Audi'和'Coca-Cola'。

caption:
The image shows a sunny urban street scene in Kyiv, Ukraine. In the foreground, a bright red double-decker sightseeing bus is stopped or moving slowly along the road. The bus is branded with large colorful text reading “City Sightseeing Kyiv” and “Hop On Hop Off,” along with “Official Tour” markings and decorative illustrations in yellow, blue, and white. The upper deck is open or partially open, and many passengers are seated inside; their faces appear blurred or indistinct. The bus has large black-framed windows and a front sign that reads “EXCURSIONS.”

Behind the bus is a large turquoise/teal historic building with white architectural trim. The façade features tall vertical white pilasters, rectangular windows with cream-colored frames, and decorative molding. On the left side of the building, there is a row of large classical columns supporting an upper structure, giving the building a grand, institutional appearance. A prominent Ukrainian sign across the front reads: “ЦЕНТРАЛЬНИЙ БУДИНОК ОФІЦЕРІВ ЗБРОЙНИХ СИЛ УКРАЇНИ,” which translates to “Central House of Officers of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.”

Several street details are visible: overhead wires cross the scene, a streetlight pole stands near the building, and there are glass awnings above entrances or storefronts. A yellow sign on the left reads “НОТАРІУС” (“Notary”). On the right side, there are posters or maps displayed in window panels, including what appears to be a network or route map.

In the lower left foreground, a silver car is driving or waiting on the road, partially cropped by the frame. The street is wide, with faint lane markings visible on the asphalt. Bright daylight creates strong highlights and shadows, giving the scene a clear midday feel. The overall impression is of a busy tourist area or central city street, combining historical architecture with sightseeing transportation.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的照片，主要焦点为一辆红色的双层观光巴士，上面有'City Sightseeing'的标志和彩色图案。巴士上坐着许多乘客，他们似乎在享受旅行。巴士前方有一辆白色轿车正在行驶，而背景中是一座装饰着蓝色和绿色条纹的建筑。

caption:
The image shows a young child standing on a raised wooden platform in an outdoor ropes/adventure course set among tall pine trees. The child’s face is intentionally blurred, but they appear to be looking toward the camera while standing upright near a large tree trunk.

The child is wearing a gray knit beanie, a colorful plaid padded vest in red, navy, white, and orange tones, a mustard-yellow sweater with elbow patches, blue jeans, and white-and-blue sneakers. Around their waist and legs is a black-and-orange safety harness. A thick safety rope runs upward from the harness and is clipped with metal carabiners to an overhead steel cable system.

Behind the child, a large pine tree trunk fills much of the center of the image, with rough textured bark. Around the tree are white wooden support blocks and metal cables secured with bolts and brackets, forming part of the ropes course structure. Several steel cables stretch horizontally and diagonally through the scene, and a rope hangs down on the right side of the frame.

The platform beneath the child is made of wooden planks and white-painted support beams. To the right, part of another suspended obstacle or platform is visible. The background is softly blurred, showing a green forest with tall tree trunks, giving the scene a natural, wooded setting. The overall mood suggests the child is participating in a supervised climbing or adventure activity, safely attached to the course’s cable system.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个小孩在森林中进行攀爬活动的照片。孩子穿着一件红色和蓝色的背心，戴着灰色帽子，站在木制平台上，正用双手握住绳索，准备开始或刚刚完成一次攀爬。他周围是模糊的树木和吊桥结构，给人一种户外探险的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a bright, elegant courtyard framed by two long, white, classical-style buildings on the left and right. The scene is highly symmetrical, with a long rectangular reflecting pool running from the foreground toward the center of the courtyard. The pool is filled with vivid blue water, and several small fountain jets rise from the center, creating ripples and splashes.

On both sides of the pool are neatly trimmed hedges and rows of low white flowers, giving the garden a manicured, formal appearance. The greenery is lush and intensely saturated, with clipped bushes forming clean geometric borders along the walkways and lawn areas.

The buildings have white-painted brick facades, tall rectangular windows, and black shutters. The right building features large white columns along its lower level, while the left building has a similar refined architectural style with dark doors and window accents. Black vintage-style lampposts line the pathways, adding to the courtyard’s classic, upscale atmosphere.

Several white wooden benches are placed along the garden, one on each side near the pool and others farther back, inviting quiet relaxation. Leafless or sparsely leafed trees stand throughout the courtyard, their twisting branches reaching upward and partially framing the view. Some trees have small fresh green leaves, suggesting early spring.

At the far end of the pool is a graceful curved colonnade with tall white columns, creating a focal point. Behind it are dense green hedges and a small fountain or sculpture centered in the distance. A few palm trees rise beyond the colonnade, hinting at a warm climate.

The sky is a clear, deep blue with no visible clouds, and the strong sunlight casts crisp shadows, making the white architecture, bright water, and greenery appear especially vibrant. Overall, the image conveys a serene, luxurious, and carefully maintained garden courtyard, likely part of a historic estate, hotel, university, or formal public space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示豪华住宅区庭院景观的照片。在画面中央，有一个被精心修剪的绿色草坪环绕的蓝色泳池，泳池边缘装饰着白色的花朵。泳池两侧是整齐排列的白色长椅和几棵赤裸的树木，这些树木位于泳池前方和左侧。右侧是一座两层高的白色建筑，其设计风格与周围的环境相协调，具有经典的柱廊和优雅的窗户。整个场景在晴朗的天气下拍摄，阳光充足，营造出一种宁静而优雅的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene centered on a public handwashing station set up on a sidewalk or curbside area.

In the foreground, there is a large, portable metal handwashing unit mounted on a blue-painted steel frame with small caster wheels. The station has two rectangular stainless-steel water tanks or dispenser boxes side by side, each with a small metal faucet near the lower front. Beneath each faucet is a small sink basin with drain pipes leading down into black flexible hoses and gray plumbing tubes. A green liquid soap dispenser sits on the right-side sink platform. The blue frame looks weathered, with rust and dirt visible near the joints and lower edges.

On top of the metal tanks sits a large black plastic water storage tank. A white label on the tank reads “PELINDO III” with smaller text underneath that appears to say “Beyond Port of Indonesia.” The front of each stainless-steel box has posters attached, including handwashing instructions with blue graphics and diagrams showing proper hand hygiene steps. There are also smaller sponsor or organization logos above the posters.

The handwashing station is positioned along a slightly raised curb, next to a paved sidewalk made of rectangular tiles. The surrounding ground is damp, with puddles and wet patches visible, suggesting recent rain or water use. An orange traffic cone stands in the street to the left of the station, and a blue cable or hose trails across the roadway behind it.

In the background, traffic and street activity are visible but slightly out of focus. Several vehicles are present, including a silver minivan on the left, a yellow car or taxi near the center, and a dark pickup truck to the right. On the far right, a person wearing a helmet is riding or sitting on a black scooter, carrying a bright red plastic bag. Another person stands near the yellow vehicle in the middle distance.

Behind the street, there are buildings with an urban Indonesian appearance. A prominent building has a large terracotta-red tiled roof, occupying much of the upper background. To the right, a white and blue canopy tent displays the text “MANDIRI TUNAS FINANCE” in large letters, with “mandiri insurance” branding visible on the tent fabric. The overall setting appears to be a roadside public area or parking area, possibly near a market, terminal, or commercial zone.

The image has a documentary feel, emphasizing the handwashing facility as a public health or sanitation installation amid everyday city traffic and activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道一角的现实主义风格照片，焦点是一个安装在街边的洗手台。洗手台由两个并排的水槽组成，上方有一个大型储水罐，周围有蓝色水管连接。背景中可以看到模糊的人行道、停放的车辆和一个带有'FELINDO TUNAS FINANCE'字样的白色帐篷，营造出一种日常生活的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a brightly lit casino floor filled with slot machines and vivid neon lighting. The scene is dominated by rows of electronic gaming machines in the foreground and background, creating a busy, colorful atmosphere.

In the foreground, several large slot machines are angled diagonally from left to right. Their screens display a game called “Diamond Storm,” with a diamond logo and jackpot-style payout amounts such as **$5,107.19**, **$2,506.73**, **$350.16**, and **$152.67**. The machines are framed with intense blue, red, and green LED borders, making them stand out sharply against the darker casino interior. Lower screens show traditional slot symbols like sevens, bars, cherries, bells, and bonus icons.

To the right, another slot machine has a red-lit frame and a bright top display showing **$114.32**. Its game screen features colorful graphics and jackpot amounts, with a black high-backed chair positioned in front of it. Several patterned casino chairs with curved backs and striped upholstery are visible around the machines.

The ceiling is elaborate and luxurious. A large decorative chandelier or hanging light fixture occupies the upper center of the image, made of many leaf- or petal-shaped pieces glowing warm gold. On the left side, another long decorative ceiling feature appears to be made of rows of glass or crystal elements, reflecting golden light. The ceiling panels curve and sweep across the image, with recessed lighting and purple, blue, and yellow illumination.

The background contains more slot machines stretching into the distance, their screens and LED borders forming a dense field of multicolored lights. A **KENO** sign is visible on the left side. The carpet has a patterned design typical of casinos, though it is partially obscured by the machines and chairs.

Overall, the image conveys the energetic, flashy atmosphere of a modern casino, with saturated neon colors, glossy surfaces, bright gaming displays, and ornate ceiling décor.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示赌场内部的摄影图像，其中几台彩色老虎机位于画面中央，每台机器上方都有一个明亮的显示屏。老虎机的设计现代而引人注目，配有蓝色和红色的灯光，营造出一种娱乐场所特有的氛围。天花板上悬挂着一盏大型的吊灯，散发出温暖的光线，与周围的霓虹灯形成对比。在背景中可以看到其他模糊的人影和赌场的一部分，但焦点主要集中在前景的老虎机上。

caption:
The image shows a sunny, picturesque street scene in what appears to be an old hillside town or village.

A large, leafy green tree dominates the left and center of the scene, casting shade over a small paved square or terrace. Beneath and around the tree are outdoor café-style tables and chairs, some under a green canopy. The ground is made of stone or cobblestone, with low stone walls and steps adding to the historic feel.

On the right side, there is a traditional whitewashed building with textured plaster walls, dark wooden trim, and overhanging upper floors. The roof has red tiles and wooden eaves. Several windows have wooden frames, and one window is protected by a curved black metal security grille. Electrical wires run along and across the building façade, adding to the lived-in character of the street. A red Toyota pickup truck is parked along the right edge of the narrow road.

The street slopes gently downward into the distance, paved with uneven cobblestones. A small yellow car is parked farther down the road, and two pedestrians are walking nearby. In the background, the town continues up a green hillside, with many white houses topped with red-tiled roofs. The hill is covered with trees, including tall dark evergreens near the top.

The sky is a vivid, cloudless blue, and the bright sunlight creates strong contrasts between sunlit walls, shaded streets, and the deep green foliage. Overall, the image has a warm Mediterranean or Balkan village atmosphere, with traditional architecture, stone streets, red roofs, and a relaxed outdoor setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲小镇街道的摄影图像。图中，一条石子铺成的道路穿过画面中央，两旁是具有传统特色的白色建筑和绿色植被。左侧有一棵茂盛的大树，其绿叶在阳光下显得生机勃勃。街道上停有几辆汽车，包括一辆红色轿车和一辆黑色SUV。远处可以看到一排房屋沿着山坡排列，形成了一个宁静而和谐的社区景象。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor bonsai garden on a bright, sunny day. In the center foreground is a large pine bonsai in a rectangular dark brown planter. The bonsai has a thick, rugged, dark trunk with rough bark and exposed roots at the base. Its branches spread outward in a broad, rounded canopy, covered with dense clusters of long green pine needles. Small tan-brown buds or cones appear at the tips of many needle clusters, adding texture and detail.

The planter sits on a pale stone display stand with two sturdy rectangular legs. The soil surface inside the pot is visible and contains bits of pine needles, small stones, and a few dark seed pods or cones. The front of the pot has decorative feet or carved geometric details.

Behind and around the central bonsai are several other bonsai trees displayed on similar stone pedestals. On the left, a smaller pine bonsai in a light-colored rectangular pot sits on another stand. On the right, another pine bonsai in a reddish-brown rectangular pot is partly visible, with its foliage forming rounded, cloud-like clusters. Additional bonsai and shrubs appear at the edges of the frame.

The background is lush and green, with climbing ivy or vine-covered foliage growing up a white wall on the right. There are also leafy bushes, grass, and garden plants throughout the scene. Bare tree branches and overhead utility lines are visible near the top, against a clear blue sky. Strong sunlight creates bright highlights on the pine needles and stone stands, while shadows from the foliage fall across the pedestals and ground. The overall atmosphere is calm, carefully maintained, and garden-like, emphasizing the sculptural beauty of the bonsai trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示盆栽松树的自然摄影风格图片。图中主要展示了一株成熟的盆栽松树，其根部裸露在外，枝条向四周延伸，呈现出典型的针叶状特征。松树放置在一个方形的花盆里，该花盆放在一个白色的长凳上。在松树后方，可以看到其他几株盆栽植物，它们被安置在不同的花盆和长凳上，与前景的盆栽形成对比。背景中的建筑物部分被绿色植被遮挡，仅露出屋顶的一部分。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a used Spanish postage stamp with perforated edges, set against a dark background. The stamp is predominantly pale green and white with dark blue-black printed details and cancellation marks.

At the top, in white capital letters on a green field, it reads **“CONMEMORACIONES CENTENARIAS”**. Along the left side, printed vertically, is **“SAN SEBASTIAN”**, and along the right side is the date range **“1813–1963”**, also vertical. This indicates a centenary commemoration related to San Sebastián.

The central design features two dark, circular medieval-style seals or medallions hanging from cords. They overlap each other slightly. The left seal appears to show a sailing ship or boat motif inside a circular inscription, while the lower-right seal contains a more figurative or heraldic scene, though the details are partly obscured by the postmark. The seals are rendered in deep blue-black with fine engraved shading.

Across the lower portion, large white lettering reads **“CORREOS ESPAÑA”**, identifying it as a Spanish postal stamp. On the lower right, the denomination is prominently printed as **“25 CTS.”** in large white numerals and letters.

At the very bottom margin, small text reads **“SELLO DEL CONCEJO”** on the left and **“F.N.M.T.”** on the right, referring to the Spanish national mint and stamp-printing authority.

The stamp is visibly used: a dark postal cancellation mark arcs across the right side and center, with additional smudged black marks near the bottom. The perforations around the edges are uneven and slightly fuzzy, with small paper fibers visible, especially along the top and sides. The overall look is that of a magnified vintage postage stamp, with visible printing texture and age-related wear.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张西班牙邮票，纪念圣塞巴斯蒂安100周年。邮票的主图是两个金属质感的纪念章，上面印有圣塞巴斯蒂安的城堡和船只图案。纪念章上方刻有'COMMEMORACIONES CENTENARIAS SAN SEBASTIAN 1893-1993'字样，下方则标注了'Sello del Concejo'以及'F.N.M.T.'，表明这是由Santiago de Compostela自治市发行的纪念邮票。邮票左下角标有面值为25分，右上角则印有发行日期'18.9.1993'。

caption:
The image shows a large, ornate church or cathedral viewed from across a road. The building is predominantly white and cream-colored, with classical architectural details and a grand, symmetrical appearance.

The main structure features several tall, fluted columns with decorative Corinthian-style capitals supporting a broad covered entrance canopy. Along the roofline and fascia are intricate floral and scroll-like relief patterns. The windows are tall and arched, many with stained-glass panels, adding color and religious imagery to the otherwise pale exterior.

On the left and center portions of the building are large dark-brown domes, each topped with a cross, emphasizing the Christian character of the structure. Smaller rounded cupola-like elements also appear on the roof. The facade includes multiple layers of balconies, cornices, and decorative trim, giving the building a grand and ceremonial look.

To the right of the church stands a separate clock tower. It has a square white base, a black-and-gold clock face, and a statue of a robed figure standing on top. Below the clock is another circular decorative feature, possibly a stained-glass or ornamental window. The tower matches the church’s white classical style.

In front of the church is a white perimeter fence with balustrades and square posts. Behind the fence are small shrubs and landscaped greenery. Near the left side, two tall carved pillars or sculptures with bird-like figures on top stand in the courtyard area, adding a distinctive decorative element.

A tall streetlight pole rises prominently in the foreground, partly blocking the view of the central dome and entrance. The road in front is wide and paved, with lane markings and a landscaped median containing low bushes. The sky is overcast with pale gray clouds, giving the scene soft, diffused lighting. Overall, the image presents an impressive religious building with elaborate classical details, domes, crosses, stained glass, and a separate clock tower.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座宏伟教堂的摄影图像。教堂拥有一个显著的圆顶和多个尖塔，以及装饰性的柱子和拱门。建筑前方有一个高大的雕塑，而背景中可以看到一片多云的天空。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, slightly overhead view of a cup of very dark coffee or hot chocolate sitting on a white saucer on a light wooden table.

In the lower center of the image is a white ceramic cup filled almost to the brim with a dark, glossy liquid. The surface reflects light in a couple of bright highlights, and there is a ring of brown residue or grounds around the inner rim of the cup, suggesting strong coffee, cocoa, or a thick brewed drink. The handle of the cup points to the right.

The cup rests on a matching white saucer decorated with colorful floral patterns. Pink and purple flowers with green leaves and dark brown stems are visible around the lower-left and right edges of the saucer. The saucer takes up much of the bottom half of the frame.

The background is a pale wooden tabletop made of planks, with visible grain lines, scratches, small marks, and a dark seam running diagonally near the right side. On the table are several worn, greyish paper fragments or laminated story pages. One piece in the upper left is torn and partially damaged, with a block of printed text and a small black-and-white illustration; part of the caption appears to read, “The man said, it is good.” Another page on the right is more readable and has the heading “6. Percy Buttons.” It contains a short passage of printed text, though parts are obscured by the cup and the worn condition of the paper.

Overall, the scene feels casual and slightly rustic: a hot drink on a floral saucer placed on a scratched wooden table with old, torn reading materials scattered nearby.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一杯咖啡和一张纸张的照片。咖啡杯是白色的，带有粉色花朵图案的边缘，内壁上覆盖着一层深色的咖啡泡沫。杯子放置在一个同样有花卉图案的白色碟子上，碟子则放在木质桌面上。在照片的背景中，可以看到几张折叠的纸张，上面似乎印有一些文字或信息，但具体内容不清晰。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of a lush mountain landscape under a bright blue sky. The scene is taken from an elevated viewpoint, looking down over a green valley with a calm, narrow lake winding through the center.

In the background, several forested mountains rise across the horizon. One prominent peak near the left-center has a rugged, slightly pointed summit, with smaller ridges extending around it. The mountains are covered in dense green vegetation, and their slopes fade into layers of darker and lighter greens. Above them, the sky is vivid blue and filled with large, soft white clouds, some stretched horizontally and others more puffy and rounded.

The middle of the image is dominated by a lake with muted turquoise-green water. It curves gently through the valley, bordered by dense pine forest on both sides. The lake surface appears mostly smooth, reflecting the bright daylight. A small bridge or floating walkway crosses part of the water near the lower center-left, and there are small boats or paddle boats gathered near the shoreline.

The surrounding hillsides are thick with pine trees, creating a rich green texture across the landscape. On the left side, a road winds through a landscaped park area with trimmed lawns, paths, and small structures. The park has decorative plantings and open spaces, suggesting a tourist or recreational area.

In the foreground, the scene becomes more colorful and detailed. There is a garden terrace with many decorative butterfly sculptures in various colors and patterns, placed along pathways and railings. Bright purple flowers bloom in the lower right and lower left areas, adding vivid color against the greenery. A pinkish-red railing follows a curved walkway, and visitors can be seen walking along the paths and viewing platforms.

At the lower right, there is a landscaped overlook with steps, benches or decorative seating, and vertical sign-like structures. The foreground also includes shrubs, ornamental plants, and a thatched-roof feature near the lower center. Tall pine trees frame the lake and partially obscure parts of the view, giving depth to the image.

Overall, the image has a bright, cheerful, and scenic atmosphere: a combination of mountains, pine forest, lake, landscaped gardens, colorful decorations, and tourists enjoying a sunny day in a highland park.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的摄影作品，画面中心是一个宁静的湖泊，湖水呈现出翠绿色，周围环绕着郁郁葱葱的松树。在湖边有一条蜿蜒的小径，引导视线深入画面。湖面上点缀着几座小岛和一些游客正在岛上休闲。前景中，紫色的花朵和多彩的花卉装饰了整个场景，为这个宁静的自然景观增添了生机。背景是连绵起伏的山脉，山顶覆盖着厚厚的积雪，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a crowded nightclub or dance floor captured with heavy motion blur and vivid colored lighting. The scene is dark overall, but splashes of neon blue, green, magenta, purple, and red light streak across the frame, creating a dreamy, energetic atmosphere.

A group of people are dancing closely together. Many figures are partially blurred from movement, suggesting fast dancing, swaying, or a long-exposure camera effect. Near the center foreground, two people appear to be embracing or dancing closely; one has long light-brown or blonde hair and is facing partly away from the camera. Their faces are blurred and indistinct.

On the right side, two people stand close together, possibly dancing or talking, one wearing a light-colored top and carrying a bright pink or coral shoulder bag. On the left and center-left, several people with long hair are gathered in small clusters, their outlines softened by the colored lights and motion. In the background, more figures are visible but mostly obscured by darkness and blur.

The lighting is the most striking feature: saturated blue and turquoise highlights wash over hair and clothing, while pink and red patches glow across bodies and the floor. The image has a chaotic, lively, party-like feel, emphasizing movement, music, and the crowded intensity of a night out rather than sharp detail.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在夜总会或舞会上拍摄的照片，具有强烈的动态模糊效果和彩色光晕。照片中心是一位长发女性，她身穿深色上衣，正与一位男性舞蹈。周围是其他舞者，他们的动作因快速移动而变得模糊不清，整个场景被蓝色、紫色和红色的灯光照亮，营造出一种充满活力的夜晚氛围。

caption:
The image is a wide, black-and-white frontal view of a grand traditional Chinese palace building, likely within the Forbidden City in Beijing. The composition is highly symmetrical, with the building centered and filling most of the frame horizontally.

The structure has a massive, sweeping tiled roof with upturned eaves at both ends. The roof dominates the upper half of the image, its surface covered in dense, evenly spaced rows of roof tiles that create a strong vertical ribbed texture. At the roof ridges and corners are ornamental figures and decorative elements, including small sculptural details along the eaves and larger finial-like ornaments near the top corners.

Below the main roof is an ornate band of architectural decoration. Intricate painted brackets, beams, and panels run across the façade, forming repeating geometric and floral patterns. A vertical plaque hangs at the center under the upper roof, with Chinese characters visible on it. Beneath this decorative band is a second, lower roof tier, also tiled and slightly projecting outward.

The front of the hall is supported by a row of tall cylindrical columns. Between the columns are dark doorways and window panels, giving the lower portion of the building a deep, shadowed appearance. The central entrance is open and darker than the surrounding areas, drawing the eye inward.

In front of the building is a broad stone terrace system with multiple levels, staircases, and carved balustrades. The central staircase rises directly toward the hall and is flanked by symmetrical stairways on both sides. The stone railings are pale and richly detailed, with regularly spaced posts and carved panels. Large bronze or stone vessels, possibly ceremonial incense burners or urns, are placed near the stairways and terrace edges.

Many visitors are scattered across the foreground and steps. They appear small compared with the enormous scale of the palace, emphasizing the monumentality of the architecture. Some people are walking up or down the stairs, others are standing in groups, taking photos, or looking toward the building. The crowd is dispersed rather than dense, creating a sense of an active tourist site.

The sky is bright and nearly blank, with no visible clouds, giving the image a clean, minimal background. The grayscale treatment emphasizes texture, symmetry, and architectural detail rather than color. Overall, the image conveys grandeur, order, and historical significance, with the palace’s monumental roofline and formal terraces dominating the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的图像，展示了一座宏伟的中国传统建筑。建筑具有典型的中国古典风格，屋顶装饰精美，屋檐翘起，呈现出典型的东方建筑特色。建筑前有宽阔的台阶和石栏杆，许多游客正在参观或上下台阶。整个场景在黑白色调中显得庄严肃穆，同时也展现了建筑与人之间的和谐共存。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban canal or river running straight through the center of a city, photographed from a bridge or elevated viewpoint. The composition is very symmetrical: the waterway begins at the bottom foreground and narrows toward the center of the frame, drawing the eye toward a cluster of buildings in the distance.

On both sides of the canal are sloped concrete embankments, slightly weathered and stained, with narrow strips of greenery above them. The water is calm with gentle ripples, reflecting the cloudy sky, the green trees, and the tall glass building in the center. The reflection of the central tower appears elongated and slightly distorted in the water.

Dense rows of leafy green trees line both banks, partially hiding the streets and sidewalks behind them. Along the roads on either side, many cars are parked or moving, and a few pedestrians can be seen near the sidewalks. Streetlights, traffic signs, and small urban details are visible among the trees.

The architecture is a mix of older and newer buildings. On the left, there is a large beige mid-century or older apartment/office building with rectangular windows, air-conditioning units, and a flat roof. Its façade looks somewhat worn, giving it a historic urban character. On the right, more beige and stone-colored buildings line the street, including larger apartment blocks with balconies and older decorative details.

At the center of the skyline stands a prominent modern cylindrical glass tower with blue-tinted reflective windows. At the top is a sign reading “BCR,” along with antennas and communication equipment. In front of it sits an ornate older building with classical architectural details, arched windows, and a decorative roofline, creating a contrast between historic and modern styles. Slightly to the right in the distance, a domed building with an elaborate roof rises above the surrounding structures.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image. It is filled with thick, layered gray clouds, suggesting an overcast day and possibly approaching rain. The lighting is soft and diffused, with no harsh shadows. The overall mood is calm, urban, and slightly dramatic because of the heavy cloud cover and the reflective waterway.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河流景观的摄影作品，画面中心是一条宁静的河流，其平静的水面反射着周围建筑和天空。河岸两侧是多层住宅楼和商业建筑，其中一些建筑顶部装饰有尖顶或圆顶结构。河岸边种植着整齐排列的树木，为这条城市通道增添了一抹绿色。在远处，可以看到一座现代风格的高楼大厦，其玻璃幕墙在阳光下闪耀。整个场景被一片多云的天空覆盖，云朵在天空中形成了丰富的纹理和层次。

caption:
The image shows a close-up product-style shot of a smartphone being held in one hand against a bright, colorful background.

On the right side, a black-framed smartphone is angled diagonally, with its top leaning toward the upper right. The phone has a large display with rounded corners and a small teardrop-style notch at the top center for the front camera. The screen is on, showing an Android home screen with a vivid blue and teal abstract wave wallpaper.

At the top of the screen, a Google search bar stretches horizontally, with the multicolor “G” logo on the left and a microphone icon on the right. Below it, the home screen displays the date and weather: “Thursday, Jan 9 | 33°C,” with a small sun icon. The status area shows the time around 10:25 and a battery indicator near the top right.

Several app icons are visible on the home screen, including a Google folder, Play Store, App Market with a notification badge, Clock, Tools, Phone, Messages, Chrome, and other icons near the bottom. The phone appears to have a dark protective border or case around it.

A hand is gripping the phone from the lower left and right edges, with fingers visible along the right side and the palm underneath. A green or dark teal watch strap is partially visible on the wrist at the bottom left.

The background is split into two bold colors: a bright yellow area on the left and a blue area on the right. On the left side, slightly out of focus, there is a yellow smartphone box. The box has a large “5i” printed on it, and the “realme” branding is visible near the bottom/side. The box is blurred, creating depth and emphasizing the phone in the foreground.

Overall, the image has a vibrant, promotional look, highlighting a Realme smartphone with its retail box in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示realme 5i手机的商业摄影风格图片。一只手正握着一部黑色边框的智能手机，屏幕上显示着天气预报和时间信息。背景是蓝色和黄色的渐变色块，营造出一种现代科技感。

caption:
The image shows a modern urban high-rise complex photographed from a low, upward-looking angle on a clear sunny day. A large portion of the left side of the frame is open blue sky, which emphasizes the height of the buildings.

The main building in the center has a bright white exterior with a strong geometric grid pattern. Its façade is made up of many rectangular window bays, with white vertical and horizontal structural frames creating a repetitive, orderly design. The windows are dark blue-tinted glass, reflecting the sky and nearby buildings. Near the top, the structure transitions into a glass-walled section with tall vertical panes and dark framing, giving it a more transparent, modern appearance. Japanese signage is visible on the building, including signs near the lower front that appear to read “港区立三田図書館” and “港区立産業振興センター,” indicating public facilities such as a library and an industrial promotion center. Higher up, another sign appears to reference “札の辻スクエア.”

Behind and above the main white building rises a taller tower with a darker façade, featuring rows of balconies or recessed window sections. On the right edge of the image, another sleek high-rise with reflective glass and a curved metallic vertical surface creates a contrasting modern look. Farther in the background, additional office towers and city buildings are visible, including a blue-glass building to the left and a white grid-like tower to the right.

At the base of the main building, there are darker panels, large ground-floor windows, and vertical strips of greenery climbing parts of the façade. A pedestrian deck or elevated walkway with pale glass railings runs across the lower foreground. The overall scene conveys a clean, contemporary business district with dense high-rise architecture, sharp lines, and bright daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市建筑的摄影图像，建筑物具有白色和灰色调的立面，设计简洁而现代。建筑的底层设有玻璃窗和绿色植物装饰，营造出一种生态友好的氛围。建筑顶部有明显的标识文字，表明其商业性质。在建筑物的背后，可以看到其他高楼大厦，以及一个晴朗的蓝天，为这座城市的天际线增添了活力。

caption:
The image shows a riverside scene viewed from inside a small wooden boat. In the foreground, a boy or young man sits on the pointed bow of the boat with his back turned to the camera, looking toward the shore. He is wearing a pale yellow T-shirt and loose blue pants. His dark hair is tousled by the wind, and he sits casually with one leg bent, creating a relaxed, contemplative posture.

The boat is painted in weathered blue and orange, with chipped paint and visible wooden planks. On the front panel of the boat there is writing in Devanagari script, painted in dark lettering. A wooden oar or pole lies along the right side of the boat. The water around the boat is calm, with small ripples reflecting the warm light.

Across the river in the background is a busy riverbank or ghat. There are many small figures of people gathered along the shore, some near the water and others moving among market-like stalls or shaded structures. Bright fabrics and colorful clothing appear scattered along the riverfront, adding liveliness to the scene.

Behind the riverbank stands an old stone complex, possibly a temple or historic riverside structure. A tall temple spire rises on the right side, partially surrounded by scaffolding, suggesting restoration or construction work. The buildings have an aged, earthy-brown tone, with domes, walls, and architectural details that blend into the natural surroundings. Trees with green and dry foliage frame the structures, especially toward the left and center.

The sky is wide, open, and clear, occupying much of the upper part of the image. The lighting is warm and low, likely from late afternoon or early evening, casting golden tones on the boy, the boat, and the riverbank. Overall, the image has a peaceful, observational mood, as if the viewer is traveling by boat and quietly approaching a historic, lively riverside settlement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男孩坐在船头，背对着镜头的摄影照片。男孩穿着黄色T恤和蓝色裤子，头发短而凌乱，他似乎在凝视远方。船是蓝橙色相间的，船头刻有文字。背景中，可以看到一个古老的寺庙建筑群，周围散布着树木和一些小船。整个场景被自然光照亮，给人一种宁静和平静的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a crowded marina packed with boats on bright turquoise water. Numerous sailboats and motorboats are moored closely together, creating a dense forest of vertical masts, rigging lines, ropes, and poles across the frame. Most of the boats are white, with accents in navy blue, beige, black, and occasional green.

In the foreground, several motorboats and yachts are visible at close range. On the lower left is a cream-colored inflatable dinghy or rigid inflatable boat with beige seating and registration markings on the side. Near the center foreground is a white-and-blue cabin cruiser with a dark blue hull stripe and a windshield framed by metal rails. To the right, another larger motorboat has a dark navy or black hull band, white upper structure, tinted windows, and fenders hanging along its side.

The middle of the image is dominated by sailboats. Their decks are cluttered with coiled ropes, railings, canvas covers, and folded sails. Many boats have blue or beige canvas biminis and sail covers. White cylindrical fenders hang over the sides to protect the hulls. A couple of people can be seen on one of the boats near the center-right, standing or sitting on deck among the rigging.

The background features more turquoise water and a large white yacht or catamaran moored near a concrete quay. The yacht is slightly out of focus, with rounded windows and several white fenders hanging from its side. Behind it is a pale stone or concrete harbor wall with steps and dock structures.

Overall, the scene feels busy and sunlit, typical of a Mediterranean-style harbor or marina. The water is vivid blue-green, lightly rippled, and the tightly packed boats and crisscrossing lines give the image a layered, intricate texture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示码头上停泊的游艇和帆船的照片。在画面中，我们可以看到多艘白色和灰色的游艇紧密排列，它们的桅杆高耸入云，部分船只上覆盖着蓝色的防水布。码头上还有几位人物，有的站在游艇旁，有的骑自行车经过。背景是平静的海面，与蓝天形成对比，营造出一种宁静而活跃的氛围。

caption:
This is an overhead aerial view of a shallow coastal shoreline where several small fishing boats are anchored near a pale sandy beach.

On the left side of the image, a curved strip of light beige-white sand forms a small beach or sandbar. The shoreline has a smooth, crescent-like edge, with darker wet sand tracing the waterline. The sand shows faint footprints, small scattered debris or rocks, and subtle rippled textures. Near the bottom-left, the beach narrows into a pointed, tapered shape where it meets the shallow water.

Most of the image is filled with clear, shallow water in green, teal, and brown tones. The water is transparent enough to reveal the seabed below, including darker patches that look like sea grass, algae, or submerged vegetation. There are gentle tonal gradients: darker green areas suggest deeper or more vegetated sections, while tan-brown areas near the sand indicate very shallow water over sandy bottom. Thin, faint lines stretch through the water, likely ropes or anchor lines extending from the boats.

Several narrow boats are scattered across the scene:

- Near the upper-left edge of the water, close to the beach, three boats sit side by side. They are long and slim, with pointed bows and small outboard motors. One appears blue, another gray/silver, and another has a mix of gray with a bright magenta or pink cover on top. They are clustered tightly near the shoreline.
- Slightly to the right of that group is another boat, positioned alone in clearer green water. It has a weathered, light-colored hull and visible gear on board, including boxes, containers, coiled rope, and possibly fishing equipment.
- On the right-middle side, a bright turquoise-blue boat floats by itself, angled diagonally from upper left to lower right. It contains colorful items, including a yellow rectangular object and red or dark gear near the stern.
- In the lower-right corner, two more boats are moored close together. One is gray-white with a covered section, and the other is a brighter turquoise boat with a blue net or tarp spread across part of it. Their anchor lines extend diagonally through the water.

The overall composition feels calm and quiet, with the boats appearing stationary in very shallow, still water. The top-down perspective emphasizes patterns: the curve of the beach, the mottled texture of the seabed, the dark thin mooring lines, and the scattered arrangement of fishing boats along the shore.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张从高角度拍摄的自然风光照片，展示了五艘船只静静地停泊在沙滩边缘。最左侧的船是白色的，紧随其后的是两艘带有彩色条纹的船和一艘蓝色的小船。这些船只似乎是在浅水区的浅滩上，与沙滩形成鲜明对比。沙滩的颜色由深到浅，呈现出自然的渐变效果。海水清澈见底，可以看到沙子和水下的植物。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of food on a wooden cutting board, lit by strong direct light against a dark, almost black background.

In the foreground is a grilled sausage or thick slice of sausage that has been cut open lengthwise. Its exterior is glossy reddish-brown with charred, blackened spots from grilling. The inside is pink and coarse-textured, with small air pockets and bits of seasoning visible. The cut surface looks juicy, with browned edges and a slightly crisp, seared crust.

Behind it sits a rustic bread roll or small baguette. The bread is golden tan with a flour-dusted, crusty surface. It has several cracks and raised, blistered areas along the top, suggesting a firm, crunchy crust. The loaf is placed horizontally across the back of the board and is slightly out of focus compared with the sausage.

The cutting board is rectangular and made of warm-toned wood, showing knife marks, grain patterns, and a few darker stains or crumbs. The bright sunlight creates strong highlights on the sausage and bread, while casting deep shadows around the edges, giving the scene a warm, rustic, freshly grilled-food appearance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示食物的摄影图像，前景中是一个切开的香肠，其内部可见到丰富的肉质和香料。香肠旁边放置着一个完整的长面包，表面撒有细小的颗粒状物质，可能是谷物或种子。两者都放置在一块木质砧板上，背景是模糊的黑色调，突出了食物的颜色和质感。

caption:
The image shows an urban waterfront or city-center scene dominated by a modern glass-and-steel high-rise building under a pale blue sky.

At the center-left is a tall contemporary tower with a distinctive rounded, cylindrical façade. Its exterior is mostly glass, with horizontal dark bands separating the floors, giving it a layered, curved appearance. The windows reflect the bright daylight, creating a silvery-blue sheen across the building. At the top, the tower has a rounded roofline and a transparent-looking upper section, possibly a rooftop terrace or mechanical level enclosed by glass.

Attached to the left side of the rounded tower is a narrower rectangular glass section. This part has stacked floors with visible horizontal balcony-like ledges or structural bands. It appears more angular and grid-like compared with the smooth curved tower beside it. Between the two sections, there is a vertical glass connector or atrium.

At the base of the main tower, a slanted glass structure rises diagonally upward, resembling an entrance canopy, atrium, or architectural support feature. The lower floors are also highly glazed, making the building look open and transparent at street level.

To the right of the tower is a lower, wide office building with a rectangular façade. It has many evenly spaced windows arranged in a strict grid pattern. The roofline has small poles or railings along the top, and the overall design is more boxy and utilitarian compared with the curved tower.

In the foreground, leafy green trees partially obscure the lower parts of the buildings, especially on the right side. On the far left edge of the image, part of an ornate dark streetlamp or decorative riverside lamp is visible, contrasting with the modern architecture. Behind it and lower in the frame are older, darker brick buildings with traditional rectangular windows, suggesting a mix of historic and modern city architecture.

The sky occupies much of the upper and right portions of the image and is bright, clear, and lightly hazy. The lighting is soft and slightly overexposed, giving the scene a washed, airy quality. Overall, the image presents a contrast between sleek modern glass buildings, older urban structures, and greenery along the street or riverside.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的摄影图像，图中主要是一座具有未来感设计的高耸建筑物。这座建筑以其独特的玻璃幕墙和流线型结构而引人注目，其顶部装饰着几个小型天线或装饰性结构。在建筑物的背后，可以看到其他几座不同高度和设计的建筑物，它们构成了一个典型的城市景观。图像左侧前景有一盏古典风格的街灯，为这个现代场景增添了一丝复古的气息。

caption:
The image shows a large coach bus traveling along a paved roadway beside a modern building or transport terminal.

The bus is a **Lufthansa Airport Bus**, painted mostly white with a wide bright yellow band along its side. Large lettering on the side reads **“Lufthansa Airport Bus”**, with the Lufthansa crane logo visible in a yellow circle. Additional route text on the windows includes destinations such as **Kaiserslautern**, **Saarbrücken**, and **Straßburg**, and German promotional text on the yellow panel mentions nonstop service to Frankfurt Airport and back. The bus has dark tinted windows with curtains inside, a white roof with roof hatches, and large side mirrors. The driver can be seen through the front windshield.

The bus is positioned in the lower half of the image, moving along a multi-lane road separated by concrete barriers and metal guardrails. The road surface is dark asphalt with white lane markings. In front of and around the bus are gray safety barriers with red reflectors.

Behind the bus is a tall building facade made of vertical dark wooden or metal slats divided by pale gray structural columns. On the left side of the facade, there is a narrow vertical window section with several horizontal panes; some graffiti is visible on the lower part of the glass. Reflections in the window show greenery and nearby outdoor elements. A blue handrail runs horizontally along a raised walkway or ramp behind the bus, rising upward toward the right side of the image. There is also a concrete retaining wall and a small strip of grass or weeds along the base of the building.

Overall, the scene appears to be near an airport, bus terminal, or transport interchange, with the Lufthansa-branded coach traveling through an urban roadway area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Lufthansa机场巴士在高速公路上行驶的照片。巴士的车身主要是白色，带有黄色和黑色条纹，车身上印有'Lufthansa Airport Bus'的字样以及目的地信息。巴士正沿着高速公路驶向右侧，背景中可以看到一些建筑物和天空。

caption:
The image shows a wide, open landscape under a heavy, overcast sky. Most of the frame is dominated by pale gray-blue clouds, layered and thick, suggesting humid or rainy weather.

Below the sky is a broad, flat expanse of dry or partially dried wetland or reservoir bed. The ground is mostly brown and muddy, with sparse patches of green grass and algae-like growth. A shallow stream or narrow pool of water winds through the middle of the scene, starting near the lower right foreground and stretching toward the center distance. There are also small reflective puddles scattered across the flat terrain, catching the gray light from the sky.

In the far background, a line of trees forms the horizon. The trees vary in height and density, with darker green foliage standing out against the muted sky. On the left side, there appear to be a few small structures or rooftops partially hidden among the trees.

The foreground on the right contains part of an old stone structure, possibly a temple terrace or historical railing. It has carved, dark weathered stone posts and balustrades, some shaped with decorative or serpent-like forms. The stonework looks aged, with rough textures, discoloration, and patches of restoration or lighter stone blocks. A small paved platform made of uneven stone slabs sits beside it.

The overall mood is quiet and subdued, with a sense of openness and stillness. The scene feels like a rural or historical site overlooking a seasonal pond or reservoir during a low-water period.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的照片，前景中有一座古老的石制结构，其上雕刻着精细的图案。背景是一个开阔的田野，中间有一条蜿蜒的小河，河水清澈见底。远处可以看到树木和低矮的建筑物，整个场景被一片多云的天空覆盖。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny urban square dominated by a large decorative fountain in the foreground. Multiple vertical jets of water shoot upward from a shallow rectangular pool, creating frothy white plumes and splashes. The water is clear enough to see the tiled or stone bottom beneath, with sunlight producing shimmering patterns and reflections across the surface. A row of flat stepping-stone-like slabs crosses part of the fountain on the right side.

In the background to the left stands a tall red-brick clock tower, likely part of a historic civic building. The tower has ornate architectural detailing, arched openings, decorative bands, and large round clock faces visible on two sides. At the very top is a dark metal spire or antenna-like structure. The warm red-brown brick contrasts strongly with the vivid blue sky.

Behind the fountain is a line of leafy green trees, suggesting a park or plaza setting. Small groups of people can be seen sitting, walking, and gathering along the edge of the square, giving the scene a relaxed public atmosphere. Near the center in the distance, two narrow church spires rise above the treetops.

The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image and is a saturated blue with scattered small white clouds. The overall mood is lively and summery, with strong daylight, crisp shadows, sparkling water, and a spacious city-square feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园中喷泉和背景建筑的摄影作品。在画面中央，一个由多个高高的水柱组成的喷泉正喷射着清澈的水流，形成了动态的水花和飞溅。喷泉后方是一座具有显著塔楼结构的红砖建筑，其尖顶上装饰有金色的十字架。周围环境被郁郁葱葱的树木环绕，而蓝天上飘浮着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows a toy store display packed with **Marvel Avengers: Endgame** merchandise, mostly action figures, arranged on two shelves.

At the top, a large printed backdrop features the **Marvel Avengers: Endgame** logo in the center, with character artwork around it. On the left side of the backdrop is a large image of **Hulk** in his white-and-black Avengers suit, and near the middle is **Thanos**. On the right side, part of **Captain Marvel** is visible flying or punching forward. The background has a light blue-gray tone, and above it there is a red decorative strip with white stars.

The upper shelf contains boxed, window-packaged figures from the Avengers line. The packaging is mostly white and blue with the Avengers “A” logo and the **Marvel Avengers** branding. Visible figures include **Hulk**, **Thanos**, **Ronin**, **Iron Man**, **War Machine**, **Captain America**, and **Captain Marvel**. Some boxes have bright orange price stickers attached to the plastic fronts. The figures are displayed in clear molded plastic, with illustrated character art on the cardboard backing behind them.

The lower shelf is filled with taller rectangular boxes labeled **“Titan Hero Series.”** These boxes have large character artwork on the front and clear plastic windows showing the figures inside. Visible characters include **Captain America**, **Ronin**, **Black Widow**, **Thor**, and **War Machine**. Several of the lower boxes also have orange sale or price stickers. The packaging uses a consistent Avengers design with white, gray, black, blue, and red accents.

A **Toys“R”Us** promotional flyer is propped diagonally across the lower-left portion of the display. It shows multiple Avengers toys with prices printed in red, along with the Toys“R”Us logo and Avengers: Endgame branding. The flyer partially covers some of the boxed figures behind it.

On the far left edge, other colorful toy packaging is partially visible, suggesting this is part of a larger toy aisle. The shelves are dark metal or black, and the display is tightly packed, giving the impression of a themed retail section dedicated to Avengers merchandise. Overall, the scene is bright, busy, and dominated by Marvel branding and superhero action figures.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示复仇者联盟主题玩具的照片，位于商店的货架上。照片中展示了多个复仇者联盟角色的塑料模型，包括钢铁侠、美国队长和黑寡妇等。每个模型都附有其特有的包装盒，上面印有角色的名字和形象。在货架顶部，有一个大型的复仇者联盟标志，背景是蓝色带有复仇者联盟成员的形象。

caption:
The image shows five rectangular product boxes lined up side by side on a dark wooden surface against a nearly black background. The boxes appear to be flavored nicotine vape/e-liquid products branded “SKWEZED,” with “100ML” printed near the bottom of each box.

Each package has a pale icy-blue design with fruit artwork and splashes of color, suggesting different fruit flavors. From left to right, the visible fruit themes appear to include:

1. A red/orange fruit design, possibly peach or mixed fruit  
2. A red spiky fruit design, resembling lychee or rambutan  
3. A citrus/grapefruit-like design with orange and red fruit slices  
4. A bright yellow tropical fruit design, possibly mango or pineapple  
5. A green fruit design, possibly green apple or kiwi  

At the bottom of every box is a large white nicotine warning label bordered in black. The warning reads:

“WARNING:  
This product contains nicotine.  
Nicotine is an addictive chemical.”

Above the products, in the upper-left area of the image, there is a glowing blue neon-style sign that reads “Drip Drip.” The sign is intentionally out of focus, creating a soft blurred glow against the black background. The rest of the background is very dark, making the illuminated blue sign and the colorful product boxes stand out strongly. The lighting is low and dramatic, with the boxes lit from the front and slight reflections visible on the surface beneath them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示电子烟产品包装盒的照片，背景为黑色，上方有蓝色的'Dry Drip'字样。五个包装盒并排摆放，每个盒子上都有警告标签，提示产品含有尼古丁和化学物质。

caption:
The image shows a grand historic stone building photographed from street level, looking slightly upward. The building is large, symmetrical, and richly ornamented, with a warm pinkish-brown sandstone or terracotta façade. Its architecture appears Victorian or classical revival in style, with elaborate carved details, pilasters, cornices, arched windows, and decorative pediments.

The central façade rises several stories and is flanked by two taller projecting sections on the left and right. Each side section has a steep dark slate mansard-style roof with a dormer-like upper structure, topped by ornate triangular pediments and decorative stonework. Across the upper middle section are several smaller dormer windows set into the roofline, each with curved tops and dark trim.
