The windows are tall and vertical, many with pale curtains visible behind them. On the lower upper floors, several arched windows are framed by columns and intricate carvings. A long black wrought-iron balcony runs across part of the façade above the lower level, adding a decorative contrast to the pale stone. The building’s surface is divided by pilasters and horizontal bands, giving it a formal, layered appearance.

On the right side of the building is a prominent entrance with a highly ornate stone archway and a dark double door. Above and around the doorway are carved figures and classical decorative elements. Signs near the entrance indicate the building is associated with “DoubleTree by Hilton” and “The Corinthian,” with “Liverpool” visible on the signage.

At street level, there are modern urban elements in front of the historic façade: a bus stop or advertising shelter with a bright red top, a grey litter bin, street signs, flagpoles, and road markings. A grey car is parked or moving at the far right edge of the image. The road in the foreground has yellow and red bus-lane markings.

Neighboring buildings are visible on both sides, also made of warm-toned stone, giving the street a cohesive historic city-center feel. The sky above is bright blue with scattered wispy white clouds and faint contrails, creating an open, airy backdrop that contrasts with the dense, ornate architecture below. Overall, the image captures an impressive historic urban building, likely in central Liverpool, blending classical grandeur with modern street life.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影照片，主要建筑是一座具有古典风格的三层楼建筑。建筑物表面由深色石材构成，窗户上方装饰有精致的铁艺栏杆。在建筑前方是一个带有红色电话亭和绿色垃圾桶的街道，街道旁边停放着一辆黑色轿车。天空晴朗，阳光照射下，建筑物的细节和色彩被清晰地展现出来。

caption:
The image shows an urban street scene with a food delivery rider standing beside a bicycle. The rider is seen from behind and slightly to the side, wearing a teal Deliveroo jacket and carrying a large square teal Deliveroo delivery bag mounted on or resting beside the bike. The Deliveroo kangaroo logo and the word “deliveroo” are visible on the bag, and a smaller logo is also visible on the back of the jacket.

The person is wearing a light pink or faded red baseball cap, over-ear Beats headphones, and a light blue surgical mask pulled down under the chin. They appear to be looking toward the right side of the frame, where part of a tram or bus is visible. The rider’s posture is relaxed, with one hand near the side or pocket area, as if waiting.

In the foreground on the left, part of a black bicycle is visible, including the handlebars, front wheel, and frame. A pale vertical pole cuts through the left side of the image. The ground is paved with reddish brick, suggesting a pedestrian street or transit area.

The background is softly out of focus, giving the image a shallow depth-of-field effect. Behind the rider are modern building façades with large windows, dark panels, and reflections. Several closed black patio umbrellas stand near what looks like an outdoor seating area. On the far right, the front edge of a tram or bus is visible with a lit display or advertisement panel. A digital sign appears high in the background, but the text is blurred and unreadable.

The overall mood is quiet and slightly cinematic, with muted lighting and cool tones. The teal delivery gear stands out strongly against the darker gray buildings and reddish pavement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市生活场景的照片，一位快递员背对着镜头站在自行车旁。他穿着带有公司标志的蓝色夹克和黑色裤子，头戴棒球帽，并且戴着耳机。他的自行车上装有一个醒目的绿色保温箱，上面印有公司的标志。在模糊的背景中，可以看到城市的街道、建筑物和一些行人。

caption:
The image is a dramatic close-up food photograph set against a mostly black background. In the foreground, a wooden serving board holds a cheeseburger, fries, onion rings, and fresh ingredients.

At the center-right is a burger with a glossy, toasted brioche-style bun. A decorative wooden skewer with a looped top is inserted through the bun to hold it together. The burger filling includes melted yellow cheese dripping over a dark grilled patty, a shiny sauce, slices of red onion, and a thick slice of tomato visible beneath the top bun.

To the left of the burger is a pile of golden French fries, some in sharp focus and others softly blurred. On the right side are several onion rings in the foreground, also golden-brown and crispy-looking, with a shallow depth of field making the closest pieces slightly out of focus. Behind them are whole ingredients: a white garlic bulb, a tan onion with papery skin and stem, and part of a bright red tomato.

In the background, centered behind the burger, there is a red Coca-Cola can, but it is heavily blurred due to the shallow focus. The white script logo and some small white text are partially visible but not sharp.

The lighting is warm and directional, coming from the front/right, creating strong highlights on the burger bun, melted cheese, fries, and onion rings while leaving much of the background in deep shadow. The overall mood is rich, appetizing, and restaurant-style, with a strong contrast between the warmly lit food and the dark backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示美食的摄影图像，主要呈现了一个丰盛的汉堡和它的配料。在木质切板上摆放着一个装满烤肉、生菜、番茄片和洋葱圈的汉堡，旁边是金黄色的炸薯条和一些新鲜的蔬菜。背景中有一罐可口可乐，为这个美食场景增添了一抹亮色。整个画面以深色调为主，营造出一种温馨而诱人的用餐氛围。

caption:
The image shows a person standing or working among dense green plants in an outdoor, garden-like or agricultural setting. The scene is dominated by soft, natural greens, with leafy shrubs and stems filling both the foreground and background.

The person is positioned slightly right of center and is partially obscured by vegetation. Their face is intentionally blurred, making facial details indistinct. They are wearing a light blue or gray zip-up hoodie over a pale plaid/checkered shirt. On their head is a cloth or headscarf: a muted pink fabric wrapped over the top, with a dark band visible across it. Draped behind their head and shoulder is a bright yellow-green cloth or sack-like fabric, which stands out strongly against the surrounding foliage.

The person appears to be looking downward, possibly focused on plants in front of them. Their posture is slightly bent or leaning forward, suggesting they may be tending, picking, or inspecting the vegetation.

The background is heavily blurred with a shallow depth of field, creating a soft bokeh effect. Tall, pale vertical shapes in the distance could be tree trunks or poles. The overall atmosphere feels calm and rural, with natural light illuminating the plants and clothing gently. The color palette is mostly green, with accents of yellow, pink, blue-gray, and pale plaid fabric.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在自然环境中工作的照片。她穿着蓝色的上衣和灰色的裤子，头戴粉色的帽子，并用黄色的布料遮挡脸部。她的姿态显得专注而忙碌，周围是绿色的植物，可能是茶园或农田。

caption:
The image shows the street-level façade of a large, elegant hotel or mixed-use building in an urban shopping district. The building is clad in light cream or beige stone panels, giving it a polished, upscale appearance. Its architecture is symmetrical and formal, with tall vertical window bays, decorative stone divisions, and slightly protruding curved bay-window sections on the upper floors.

At the center of the image is a grand hotel entrance with a large projecting canopy. The canopy has a dark metal frame and a glowing amber/yellow glass underside divided into rectangular panels, creating a warm, luxurious effect. Above it, large metallic capital letters spell out **“BREIDENBACHER HOF”**, prominently marking the building. Beneath the canopy are glass entrance doors, likely leading into the hotel lobby, with bell staff or doormen visible nearby. Luggage carts stand on both sides of the entrance, reinforcing the impression of a high-end hotel.

On the left side of the ground floor is a **Michael Kors** retail store. Its storefront has large glass display windows, blue awnings, and visible fashion advertising inside, including handbags and clothing displays. The store name “MICHAEL KORS” appears in white lettering on a dark sign panel near the bottom left. On the right side, there appears to be another luxury retail storefront, possibly a jewelry or watch shop, with glass windows and a sign partially visible.

The upper floors feature rows of tall rectangular windows with dark frames. Some windows reflect the blue sky and surrounding buildings, while others have pale blue curtains drawn inside. There are small metal railings or guard bars in front of several windows. The façade has a refined, modern-classical style with clean stonework and subtle decorative details.

At street level, several pedestrians are walking past the entrance. Near the center-left, a person pushes a stroller while another walks beside them. A shopper carrying bags passes in front of the Michael Kors store. On the right, a few people walk past the hotel entrance and nearby storefronts. The sidewalk is broad, paved with light gray stone, and the overall setting feels like a fashionable city shopping street.

The photograph is taken from across the street looking straight at the building, with the canopy and hotel sign forming the visual focal point. The lighting suggests daytime, with bright reflections in the windows and soft shadows on the pavement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示'Breidenbacher Hof'酒店入口的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是酒店的主入口，上方有一个大型的标志牌，上面写着酒店的名字和地址。入口处有几位行人正在进出，包括一位推着婴儿车的人、一对牵手的情侣以及一些单独行走的路人。酒店的建筑立面由浅色石材构成，窗户排列整齐，而入口上方是一个半透明的遮阳棚。在入口左侧，可以看到一个商店的橱窗，里面陈列着各种商品。

caption:
The image shows a daytime urban waterfront scene with a cluster of modern high-rise buildings, likely in Shanghai’s Pudong skyline, viewed from across or along the Huangpu River.

In the foreground, a white-and-blue passenger boat or river ferry is docked or moving slowly along the water. It has multiple decks, railings, windows, and a small red Chinese flag near the left side. A pier or waterfront structure is visible at the very bottom, with a large gray cylindrical post or bollard partly blocking the lower-right portion of the boat. A tall metal pole stands near the left foreground, also partially obscuring the view.

Behind the boat is a broad river with brownish water, and on the opposite bank stands a dense skyline of skyscrapers. On the left is a prominent gold-colored cylindrical building with reflective glass and horizontal bands; large red letters near the top spell “AURORA.” Near the center is a dark green glass office tower with a “citi” logo in white and red near its upper-right corner. Rising behind it is the tiered, pagoda-like top of the Jin Mao Tower, with a sharp spire and stepped silver-gray architecture.

To the right, the tallest and most distinctive building is the Shanghai World Financial Center, a sleek, tapering glass skyscraper with a large trapezoidal opening near the top, giving it a “bottle opener” shape. Construction cranes and partially built structures are visible near its base, suggesting ongoing development. Further right are beige residential or hotel towers with repetitive balconies and window patterns.

The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image and is pale blue with thin, hazy clouds. The overall lighting is bright but slightly muted, giving the scene a warm, lightly hazy city atmosphere. The composition emphasizes the contrast between the river activity in the foreground and the dramatic modern skyline in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市天际线的照片，前景中有一艘停靠在码头的游船。背景由多座高楼组成，其中最显眼的是两座尖顶塔楼和一座独特的三角形结构建筑。这些摩天大楼以其现代化的设计和玻璃幕墙在蓝天白云下显得格外引人注目。

caption:
The image shows a lively pedestrian street in a historic urban area, likely in a European city. The scene is viewed along a broad, brick-paved walkway lined with ornate multi-story buildings on both sides.

On the right side, tall cream, beige, and pale yellow buildings dominate the frame. Their facades feature decorative classical details: carved moldings, cornices, pilasters, wrought-iron balconies, tall windows, and textured brickwork. Some buildings have modern additions such as satellite dishes, drainpipes, and rooftop metal structures. At street level, there are shops and restaurants with bright signage, including red circular signs and yellow storefront elements. Outdoor café seating is visible under large cream-colored umbrellas, with planters and benches nearby.

On the left and center background, more pastel-colored buildings recede into the distance, including pale blue, greenish-gray, peach, and cream facades. A row of pink flowering trees lines part of the walkway, adding a springlike feel. The street is busy with many pedestrians walking in different directions; their faces appear blurred. People are dressed in casual clothing—jackets, jeans, backpacks, and colorful outfits—suggesting mild daytime weather.

Several decorative black street lamps with multiple white globe lights stand along the walkway, creating a repeating rhythm down the street. Thin overhead wires stretch across the sky and between buildings. In the distance on the left, a colorful decorative mural or sign is partially visible on a building, adding a playful accent to the scene.

The sky is dramatic, with large dark gray clouds mixed with patches of brighter light. Sunlight illuminates the buildings and parts of the crowd, producing strong contrast between the bright facades and the stormy-looking sky. Overall, the image captures a bustling, attractive pedestrian avenue with historic architecture, cafés, shops, flowering trees, and a lively urban atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。图像捕捉了一条繁忙的街道，人们在晴朗天气下行走和聚集。街道两旁是具有不同建筑风格的历史建筑，有的外墙涂有鲜艳的颜色，如黄色、蓝色和白色。街道上铺设有红色砖石，而天空中飘浮着几朵白云。在街道的一侧，可以看到一个开放的市场区域，人们在那里购物或闲逛。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor produce market on a sunny day. Several stalls are set up along a sidewalk or street, with tables covered in fresh vegetables and herbs. Large red-and-blue striped umbrellas provide shade over the vendors and produce, creating a colorful canopy across the market.

In the foreground, a vendor sits behind a table piled with leafy greens and bunches of spring onions or scallions, their white roots spilling over the table edge. Nearby are bunches of parsley or cilantro, other herbs, and plastic bags, including a bright blue bag on the left. A metal weighing scale sits on one of the tables, suggesting produce is sold by weight.

To the right, another stall displays a large assortment of vegetables: bright red tomatoes, radishes with leafy tops, carrots, cucumbers or zucchini, onions, and more green herbs. The produce is arranged in crates and on tabletop surfaces, giving the scene a dense, abundant look. Black plastic crates and wooden boxes are stacked underneath and beside the tables.

Several people are visible throughout the scene, including vendors seated behind the tables and shoppers walking or browsing. Their faces appear blurred. The atmosphere feels active and communal, with people moving through the market and interacting around the produce stands.

In the background, storefronts line the street. A prominent red sign reads “Mesnica BILIĆ,” indicating a butcher shop, and another vertical sign reads “BARTULOV.” There are also price boards and posters advertising food items. Buildings, awnings, a greenish canopy, and trees are visible further back, with strong sunlight casting shadows and highlighting the bright colors of the vegetables and umbrellas. Overall, the image captures a lively neighborhood farmers’ market or street market filled with fresh produce, shoppers, and vendors.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙市场场景的照片，阳光照耀下，摊位上摆满了新鲜的蔬菜和水果。在画面中央，一位穿着深色衣服的人坐在摊位前，似乎正在忙碌地整理商品。周围有其他顾客在浏览或挑选商品，而背景中可以看到其他的摊位和一些模糊的人物。

caption:
The image shows a bright outdoor scene featuring two historic stone buildings with distinctive conical roofs, likely mausoleums or tomb structures. They stand in the foreground under a vivid blue sky with a few soft white clouds.

On the left is the larger structure, made of weathered beige-gray stone blocks. It has a cylindrical base and a tall, sharply pointed cone-shaped roof built from stone slabs. Around the upper part of the cylindrical wall are decorative arched recesses, giving the building a medieval or Seljuk-style architectural appearance. A narrow, dark rectangular window with metal bars is visible on the front wall, and the stonework shows age, discoloration, and texture.

To the right and slightly behind it is a smaller but similar stone structure. It also has a round body and a conical roof, though its roof appears rougher and more uneven, with patches of grass or small plants growing between the stones. The smaller building has arched decorative panels around its walls and a dark doorway or window at the lower front.

In the foreground, the ground is dry and patchy, with sparse yellowed grass and dirt, suggesting a warm, arid climate. There are small green shrubs near the base of the buildings, adding contrast to the muted stone colors. Several black informational plaques with gold or light-colored writing stand near the structures, indicating the site may be a protected historical or tourist location.

On the right side, a short set of stone steps leads up to a slightly raised area with another information sign. In the background, beyond the historic site, modern apartment buildings and a small turquoise-topped minaret are visible, along with low, dry hills. The contrast between the ancient stone architecture and the modern urban background is striking.

The overall atmosphere is sunny, calm, and historic, with strong daylight casting shadows and emphasizing the texture of the old stone walls and roofs.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两座古老建筑的照片，位于一个开阔的场地上。左侧是一座圆顶塔楼，其表面由不规则石块构成，顶部覆盖着一块蓝色的瓦片。右侧是另一座类似的建筑，同样由不规则石块构成，并且也有一块蓝色的瓦片覆盖在顶部。两座建筑之间有几级石阶和一些绿色植被。背景中可以看到蓝天、散布的白云以及远处的城市轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic coastal scene with a broad sandy beach in the foreground, a lively city shoreline in the middle distance, and dry, rugged mountains rising behind it.

In the foreground, the beach stretches diagonally from the lower right toward the center-left, with smooth brown sand marked by scattered footprints. The wet sand near the waterline reflects pale blue and golden tones from the sky and buildings. Gentle waves roll in from the left, forming long white bands of foam as they break along the shore. The ocean is a vivid blue, textured with small ripples and whitecaps.

Across the middle of the image is a dense row of waterfront buildings. They vary in height and style, including modern apartment blocks, hotels, and commercial-looking structures. Many of the buildings are painted in bright colors—yellow, white, orange, red, turquoise, and blue—creating a colorful strip between the sea and the hills. Some taller buildings have balconies and horizontal bands, while smaller ones have flat roofs and simple facades. A few palm trees are visible near the promenade, adding a tropical feel. Along the shoreline there are small boats and beach facilities, with a narrow promenade separating the city from the water.

Behind the city, the landscape becomes arid and mountainous. The hills are brown, reddish, and rocky, with sparse vegetation. Several roads or tracks wind across the slopes. On the hilltops are communication towers and antenna structures, including a tall red-and-white mast near the center and another prominent tower on the right-hand mountain. There are also a few small buildings or utility structures scattered across the ridges.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image. It is mostly blue with large, soft, layered clouds stretching horizontally across the scene. The light appears warm and low, possibly late afternoon, illuminating the buildings and hills with a soft golden glow while leaving some mountain slopes in shadow.

Overall, the image captures a coastal urban beach at the edge of a dry volcanic-looking landscape, combining the movement of the sea, the color of the city, and the dramatic backdrop of rugged hills under a broad, cloud-filled sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩景观的摄影作品，前景是金色沙滩和轻轻拍打海岸线的海浪。中景显示了多彩的建筑群，它们沿着海岸线排列，与蓝天和远处轮廓分明的山脉形成对比。在画面的右侧，可以看到一艘白色的船只静静地漂浮在平静的海面上。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而放松的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of an industrial aggregate or gravel processing site, likely a quarry or sand-and-gravel plant. The scene is dominated by large pale beige and gray piles of crushed stone, gravel, or sand spread across the foreground and middle distance.

A network of bright yellow/orange metal conveyor belts runs across the site in multiple directions. Some conveyors are elevated high above the ground on trussed supports, while others slope upward or downward between different piles. Several tall support towers with cable bracing hold up the long conveyor structures, giving the scene a somewhat bridge-like appearance. One prominent conveyor rises steeply near the center-right, feeding material onto a large mound below it.

In the foreground, a broad gravel yard shows tire tracks and curved vehicle paths pressed into the dusty surface. Large conical and elongated stockpiles fill much of the lower half of the image, with different textures indicating varying sizes of aggregate. A long dark conveyor or covered belt runs low along the bottom left edge, partially hidden by the terrain.

Near the center and right side are pieces of processing equipment and industrial structures, including a green rectangular building or container-like structure, metal platforms, and machinery painted in the same yellow/orange color as the conveyors. In the central area, a small loader or construction vehicle is visible near the piles, emphasizing the scale of the operation.

The background contains a line of dense green trees and vegetation, separating the industrial site from the horizon. Beyond the conveyors and piles, the landscape appears flat and wooded. The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image and is mostly clear, pale blue, with only a few faint clouds. The lighting is warm and low, suggesting late afternoon or early evening, casting soft shadows across the gravel piles and highlighting the orange metal framework. Overall, the image captures a busy, expansive materials-handling facility with extensive conveyor systems used to sort, move, and stockpile aggregate.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示采石场作业的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个大型黄色机械臂，伸展在一堆沙子上，似乎用于搬运或分拣。周围是堆积如山的沙子和碎石，以及几个高大的圆柱形结构，可能是储存设施或机械设备。背景中可以看到一些树木和蓝天，表明这个采石场位于一个开阔的地区。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime fire performance against an almost completely black background. Two performers, mostly visible only as dark silhouettes, are positioned near the center and right side of the frame. Each appears to be breathing or projecting fire from a torch, creating huge, bright orange-yellow fireballs.

On the left side, a large plume of flame bursts outward horizontally from a torch held upright by the performer. The flame is intensely bright near the source, almost white-hot, then expands into a rounded, swirling orange fire cloud. The edges of the flame have detailed curling patterns, with waves and folds of fire that resemble rolling smoke or petals. Tiny sparks or droplets are visible around the flame, adding a sense of motion and heat.

On the right side, a second performer creates another large fire plume. This flame is slightly more vertical and rounded, blooming outward like a glowing fire cloud. It has rich layers of yellow, orange, and red, with darker smoky edges around it. A smaller, brighter flame stream connects the performer’s mouth or torch area to the larger fireball.

The performers themselves are underexposed and nearly black, making them blend into the dark surroundings. Their heads are tilted back, suggesting the act of fire-breathing. One person appears to be holding a torch or staff, while another hand near the lower right may be holding a bottle or fuel container. The bright flames are the main source of light, casting faint warm highlights on their arms and faces.

The composition is wide and cinematic, with the fire plumes balancing the left and right sides of the image. The contrast between the intense flames and the black background creates a striking, high-energy scene with a sense of danger, spectacle, and movement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜间火把表演的照片。图中，两个人物在黑暗的背景下手持两根燃烧着火焰的长杆，火焰从杆端喷射出来，形成了两个明亮的火球。人物的姿态显得专注而有力，他们的身体被火焰照亮，与周围的黑暗形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image is a top-down view of a desk setup. At the top of the frame is a black computer keyboard, showing the right side of the main letter keys and part of the numeric keypad. Visible keys include A through L, Z through M, punctuation keys, Enter, Shift, Ctrl, Alt Gr, arrow keys, and number pad keys such as 4, 1/End, and 0/Ins. The key legends are white, and the keyboard has a slightly glossy, well-used appearance with some dust or small specks visible between keys.

Centered in the lower half of the image is a transparent glass mug viewed from above. The mug has a clear handle extending to the right. Inside is a small amount of reddish-brown liquid, likely tea, coffee, or another warm drink. The surface of the liquid reflects light and the surrounding environment, creating a glossy highlight and a darker rectangular reflection near the bottom of the cup. The inner glass walls show faint streaks or residue, especially around the upper inside rim, suggesting the drink has been sitting or has been stirred.

The mug sits on a dark, fabric-textured desk mat or mouse pad. The surface is mostly black with subtle gray fibers and a few tiny dust particles. The lighting is fairly bright from above, producing reflections on the glass rim and the liquid, while the overall scene has a practical desktop/workspace feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常办公场景的照片，中心位置是一个透明的玻璃杯，里面装有红色液体，可能是茶或咖啡。杯子放置在一台黑色键盘上，键盘上的按键清晰可见，包括一些常用的字母和功能键。背景是深色的桌面，与键盘形成对比。

caption:
The image shows a white cabin boat moored beside a wooden dock in a marina or waterfront area. The boat dominates the foreground, angled slightly toward the viewer, with its bow pointing to the lower left and its cabin rising in the center. Its hull is mostly white with a dark maroon or burgundy lower section, and stainless-steel railings wrap around the front deck. Several thick mooring ropes secure the boat to the dock on the right.

At the front of the boat, there is a small bow platform and anchor assembly extending outward over the water. The deck has a few fittings, including ropes, a small hatch, and metal cleats. The cabin windows are large and slightly reflective, with clear panels framed in white and metal supports. Above the cabin is a hardtop roof with mounted equipment: floodlights, a radar dome labeled “Raymarine,” and other navigational hardware. A thin antenna rises high into the sky from the roof area, with a small reddish flag or cloth attached near its base.

To the right, a wooden pier runs from the foreground into the background. It has dark brown planks and square posts capped with polished wooden tops. Some of the posts are wrapped in thick white rope, giving the dock a nautical appearance. The boat is tied alongside this pier, close enough that the ropes stretch directly from the bow and side to the dock posts.

The water is dark greenish-blue with small ripples and glints of sunlight. The boat casts shadows on the water, and the surface looks calm, suggesting a sheltered marina or canal.

Across the water in the background is a long, low waterfront structure with a blue metal roof and dark shaded walls or windows. Behind it are palm trees and large residential-style buildings. One prominent building on the left has a beige, ornate façade and several rooftop satellite dishes. There are also red, white, green, and black flags visible in the background, suggesting a Middle Eastern or Gulf-region setting. On the far right rooftop, several dark water tanks can be seen.

The sky is pale blue and hazy, with strong midday sunlight creating bright highlights on the boat’s white surfaces and deep shadows under the roofed waterfront structure. Overall, the scene feels like a warm, sunny day at a marina, with a leisure or fishing boat docked beside a well-maintained wooden pier.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘白色和红色相间的快艇停靠在码头的照片。快艇的船头朝向观察者，船尾部分可见，船上装备有雷达和其他导航设备。码头由木制结构组成，连接着岸边。背景中可以看到一些低矮的建筑物和树木，以及天空中的云朵。

caption:
The image shows a close-up product-style shot of a pair of black FILA sneakers, positioned on a dark surface with a red FILA shoebox in the background.

The foreground shoe is angled slightly to the right, making the side, front, tongue, and laces clearly visible. It has a chunky, retro athletic design with a thick black sole and deep tread. The upper appears to be made from a mix of black suede or nubuck-like material and smoother black synthetic leather panels. The stitching is visible throughout, especially around the toe box, side panels, and lace area.

A large metallic silver oval-shaped accent is on the side of the shoe, and the FILA logo is embroidered above it in white with a small red detail. The tongue also features a prominent FILA logo patch in black, white, and red. The black round laces are threaded through black eyelets with small white accents visible along the lace loops.

The midsole is bulky and sculpted, with an embossed FILA logo on the side near the front. The outsole has rugged, ridged traction, giving the shoe a heavy, durable look.

Behind it, the second shoe is partially visible on the right, slightly out of focus but matching the same black design and branding. In the background, a red shoebox with large white and black FILA-style graphic elements adds contrast. The overall color palette is mostly black, white, silver, and red, emphasizing the brand’s classic styling.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黑色运动鞋的商业摄影风格图片。鞋子位于图像中心，背景是简单的白色墙面和深色地板。鞋子的设计包括一个显眼的品牌标志、品牌名称以及鞋带孔。鞋舌部分有品牌的红色和白色徽标，而鞋底则覆盖着厚实的橡胶材质。

caption:
The image shows a staged group performance or cultural presentation. In the foreground, a woman stands at center holding a black handheld microphone close to her mouth, suggesting she is singing or speaking. Her face, like the faces of the others in the image, is intentionally blurred.

She is dressed in an ornate traditional-style outfit. The main garment is olive green with a high, decorative collar featuring gold embellishments. Draped across her shoulder and torso is a patterned shawl or sash in deep purple, green, and reddish tones, with a subtle floral or woven motif. Around her waist is a shiny metallic-looking belt or trim in gold/bronze. She also wears a large decorative bracelet or cuff on her wrist.

Behind her is a group of performers arranged in rows. Many appear to be wearing colorful traditional costumes with bright fabrics—turquoise, red, pink, gold, and black are prominent. Several have elaborate gold-trimmed headpieces or collars with shiny sequins or embroidery. On the left side, a person in a white outfit stands slightly behind the group. On the right side, another person wears a bright red top with black sleeves and a patterned black-and-white outer layer.

The background consists of a woven or textured tan panel or partition, with a pale blue sky or light-colored upper background above it. The photo has a shallow depth of field: the central singer is the clearest subject, while the people behind her are more blurred. The overall impression is of a festive cultural event, performance, or ceremony with traditional clothing, music, and a group ensemble.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在表演或演讲的活动中的照片。她穿着一件绿色和金色的传统服装，佩戴着金色项链，并手持麦克风。她的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。在她的背后，可以看到几位穿着类似传统服饰的人，他们的脸部同样模糊。整个场景在一个室内环境中进行，背景中有一面蓝色的幕布。

caption:
The image shows a bright outdoor urban scene under a clear, deep blue sky. Beige, flat-roofed residential buildings fill the lower half of the frame, with many flags and pennants strung across the street and rooftops.

Several Palestinian flags—red triangle with black, white, and green horizontal bands—are visible, some mounted on poles and others hanging from lines. Numerous green flags with white Arabic writing are also strung diagonally across the scene, fluttering in the wind. On the upper right, yellow flags with printed emblems and Arabic text are attached to poles on a rooftop, also blowing strongly.

The buildings have a rough stucco texture and are topped with typical rooftop infrastructure: large white cylindrical water tanks, black water tanks, pipes, cables, and small metal structures. A man in a pink shirt is bent over on a rooftop near the center-right, appearing to adjust or secure something along the roof edge near the flags. In the lower middle-left, a few people, including children, are visible on a balcony or stairwell opening, looking outward.

Black utility wires cut horizontally across the scene, adding to the dense urban feel. A small minaret-like tower with a purple dome is visible in the background between buildings. Overall, the image conveys a lively street or neighborhood decorated heavily with political or national flags, with rooftops and balconies used as vantage points beneath a cloudless sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多面旗帜在建筑物上飘扬的现实主义风格照片。旗帜以绿色、黑色和红色为主色调，上面印有文字和图案，可能是某种政治或宗教组织的标志。建筑物的外墙呈浅黄色，顶部装有几个大型白色圆顶结构，可能用于通风或其他功能。在建筑之间，电线交错，悬挂着更多的旗帜。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，没有云朵。

caption:
The image shows two bright red modern trains facing each other nose-to-nose at a railway platform. They are positioned symmetrically, with the rounded front ends nearly meeting in the center of the frame, leaving a narrow gap through which the tracks and part of the station background are visible.

Both trains are painted in a vivid red-orange color with dark gray upper sections and black trim lines. The word “Ласточка” (“Lastochka,” meaning “Swallow” in Russian) is written in large white Cyrillic letters on the side of each train. The left train’s lettering is fully visible, while the right train’s word is partially cut off by the edge of the image. Each train has a small rectangular window with rounded corners on the side, bordered in black. The noses of the trains are sleek and aerodynamic, with curved red panels, dark windshield areas, and gray lower front details.

At the bottom of the image, the station platform runs horizontally across the foreground. It has gray paving stones and a yellow tactile warning strip with raised bumps along the platform edge, indicating the safe boundary for passengers. Below the trains, rails and coupling equipment can be seen in the narrow space between their fronts.

In the background, visible through the central gap between the trains, there is an old stone or brick building with a weathered roof and classical architectural details. A decorative streetlamp with multiple round globes stands in front of it. Some greenery and station fencing are also visible. The sky above is overcast, filled with pale gray clouds, giving the scene a soft, diffused light.

The composition is strikingly symmetrical, emphasizing the contrast between the bold, futuristic red trains and the older urban architecture in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代设计的红色和灰色火车头的照片。火车头部以流线型的设计，顶部有'Пасмоха'的文字标识，暗示它可能属于某个特定的铁路公司或线路。在火车头部后方，可以看到城市街道的一部分，包括行人、建筑和天空中的云朵。

caption:
The image shows a broad, sunlit European street or square paved with light-colored cobblestones. A row of elegant historic buildings fills the frame, viewed from a low, slightly upward angle so that the façades and red-tiled roofs dominate the scene.

On the left and center are large cream and pale ochre buildings with ornate classical architecture. They have tall rectangular windows with dark wooden frames, decorative molding, carved trim, cornices, pilasters, and sculpted details above several windows. Many of the windows are open outward, adding a lived-in feel. The roofs are steep and covered in bright terracotta-orange tiles, with a few small skylights visible near the top.

The warm, low-angle sunlight—likely from late afternoon or early evening—casts a golden glow across the façades. Strong diagonal shadows fall over the buildings, creating a striking contrast between brightly illuminated orange-yellow walls and shaded cream sections. The sky above is a vivid, cloudless blue, taking up a large portion of the upper right side of the image.

Several flags hang from poles mounted on the buildings. Some appear to be Croatian flags with red, white, and blue horizontal stripes and a central crest, while others are blue flags, likely European Union flags with yellow stars. The flags hang loosely, suggesting little wind.

Thin overhead wires stretch diagonally across the sky and horizontally across the buildings, likely tram or utility wires. Near the right side of the street stands an old-fashioned black streetlamp with a decorative base and glass lantern.

At street level, a few parked black cars line the curb in front of the buildings. On the far right, a pedestrian in dark outerwear is walking near the cars; the person appears slightly blurred, suggesting movement. Another partial figure is visible at the extreme right edge.

Overall, the scene feels like a historic city center in bright, clear weather, with warm sunlight emphasizing the architectural details and the vivid contrast between orange rooftops, pale façades, and the deep blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，阳光从画面的右侧照射下来，在建筑物上形成了温暖的光影效果。建筑物为古典风格，拥有多个窗户和一个拱形门廊。街道上有几位行人正在行走，其中一位穿着黑色外套的人站在人行道上，背对着镜头。街道两旁停放着几辆汽车，包括一辆蓝色轿车和一辆深色SUV。

caption:
The image shows a bright seaside café or beach bar terrace overlooking a busy coastal bay.

In the foreground is an open-air dining area furnished almost entirely in white. There are white wicker-style chairs and matching square tables arranged in rows, some with small ashtrays or menu holders on top. The furniture sits on a pale gray deck or platform. To the right, there is a white built-in bench or booth seating area, and a black speaker sits near the railing. The terrace is covered by a white wooden pergola with thick beams overhead. Blue fabric shade strips are woven or draped between the beams, creating alternating bands of blue and white and casting striped shadows across the floor and furniture.

Beyond the terrace railing, the sea is visible, calm and blue-green, with floating lane markers or buoys stretching across the water. Several large white beach umbrellas stand along the edge of the water and on the terrace below, their canopies matching the clean, bright aesthetic of the café.

Across the bay, a sandy beach is crowded with many sunbathers and swimmers. Rows of sun loungers, umbrellas, and beach structures line the shore. The beach curves gently around the water, backed by dense green trees and low coastal buildings. On the far left, a tall modern hotel or apartment building rises near the shoreline.

The background is dominated by lush green mountains under a clear blue sky. The hills surround the bay, giving the scene a sheltered, resort-like atmosphere. On the right side, the coastline becomes rocky and steep, with a pathway, stairs, and a retaining wall built into the hillside. A few small figures can be seen walking along the seaside path.

Overall, the scene feels sunny, relaxed, and summery: a clean white-and-blue terrace with shaded seating, looking out over a lively beach, turquoise water, and green Mediterranean-style mountains.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海边餐厅露台的现实主义风格照片。露台上摆放着白色的桌椅，配有遮阳伞和蓝色的屋顶结构。在露台的背景中，可以看到一片热闹的海滩，人们在沙滩上休闲或进行水上活动。远处是连绵起伏的山脉，为这个场景增添了宁静与和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a wide evening view of a riverside city scene, likely in Bangkok, Thailand. A broad river fills the lower half of the frame, its dark blue-brown surface reflecting the lights from boats, buildings, and the shore. The water has gentle ripples, causing the reflections to stretch vertically in shimmering streaks of gold, green, white, and faint purple.

On the right side, a large dinner-cruise boat is docked or moving slowly along the riverbank. It is brightly illuminated with warm yellow strip lighting outlining its decks and railings. The boat has large open dining areas with rows of tables and chairs visible inside, glowing under bright interior lights. A red canopy on its upper deck displays a Coca-Cola logo, and the side of the vessel includes Thai writing along the bow. The boat’s name appears to reference “Chao Phraya Princess,” a well-known river cruise line. Its bow points toward the right edge of the image, and its long, sleek form dominates the foreground.

Behind it, another lit cruise boat sits farther back to the left, also glowing with warm lights. Along the riverbank are low buildings with sloped roofs, wooden-looking structures, trees, and small waterfront lights. Some of the buildings have a traditional or old riverside warehouse appearance, with dark roofs and warm-toned walls.

In the distance on the left, a dramatic golden temple or palace complex rises above the darker shoreline. Its spires and ornate rooflines are brightly lit, standing out vividly against the deep blue evening sky. The golden illumination makes the structure look ceremonial and majestic, contrasting with the cooler tones of the surrounding cityscape. Nearby, a few modern high-rise buildings are visible, dimly lit in the background.

The sky takes up much of the image and is filled with layered, textured clouds in shades of deep blue, slate, and gray. It appears to be dusk or early night, with no direct sunlight visible, but there is still enough ambient light to reveal the cloud formations. The overall mood is calm, atmospheric, and cinematic, blending the glow of river nightlife with historic architecture and a moody twilight sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，画面中心有一艘装饰着灯光的游船停靠在河岸边。游船上写着泰文，表明它可能是在泰国水域中运营。河面上反射出游船和周围建筑的灯光，营造出一种宁静而温馨的氛围。背景中的建筑物灯火通明，与天空中淡淡的云彩形成对比，而远处的教堂塔楼则在夜空中显得格外引人注目。

caption:
The image shows a quiet small-town street on a bright, clear day, with a wide blue sky dominating the upper half of the scene. The viewpoint is from the middle of a gently curving road that leads toward a striking historic building in the center background.

At the center is a large, white, Victorian-style civic or church-like building with ornate architecture. It has a tall tower rising above the roofline, topped with a narrow conical metal roof and a weather vane. Below the spire is an open lantern-like section with decorative columns, and the tower itself features patterned trim in dark green, tan, orange, and red. The main building has steep gray roofs, a large arched window on the front, white siding, red trim near the base, and a stone foundation. Its design makes it the visual focal point of the scene.

In front of the building, near the middle of the intersection, stands a tall stone monument or memorial column with a small sculptural figure at the top. Around it are trees, shrubs, and landscaped areas. Several traffic lights are visible near the intersection, along with a yield sign and lane markings on the pavement, including a white “ONLY” marking with a directional arrow.

The street is fairly empty, with only a few vehicles visible. A black pickup truck drives away from the viewer toward the center-right of the road, and a white pickup is parked or moving farther up the street near the right side. The road surface has visible cracks and patch lines, and the double yellow centerline curves gently through the town.

On the right side of the image is a red brick building with a weathered wall and a flat roofline. In front of it are decorative black lampposts, hanging flower baskets overflowing with pink flowers, and American flags mounted on poles. One large American flag is prominently angled outward over the sidewalk, catching attention against the blue sky. A blue vertical street banner hangs from a lamppost nearby.

On the left side, a teal-green building sits close to the sidewalk, partly shaded by trees. More greenery fills the left and center background, including leafy trees and a bluish evergreen. The overall scene feels calm, clean, and distinctly “Main Street” in character, with patriotic decorations, historic architecture, and a peaceful small-town atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示小镇街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一座装饰华丽的教堂，其尖顶和彩色玻璃窗格外引人注目。街道两旁是多样的建筑，包括红砖墙的商店和带有美国国旗的路灯。一辆黑色轿车正沿着街道行驶，而路边停放着几辆自行车。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为这个宁静的小镇街景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image is a wide panoramic view from a hillside lookout over a town spread across a flat plain. In the foreground, a sloping grassy area with patches of bare earth and small white stones leads down toward a rustic wooden fence. The fence runs diagonally across the lower half of the scene, made of reddish-brown rails with crisscross supports, helping frame the overlook. There are shrubs and silvery-green trees, possibly olive trees, on the right and lower slopes, and a small bench is visible in the shaded lower-left area.

Beyond the fence, the town fills the middle of the image. It consists of tightly clustered low-rise buildings with warm-colored facades—cream, yellow, terracotta, and pale pink—and many red or brown tiled roofs. Near the center-right stands a church-like structure with a prominent domed roof and a tall rectangular bell tower, creating a focal point among the rooftops. Streets, small squares, and larger institutional-looking buildings are visible around it, with some parked cars and rows of trees lining roads.

Farther out, the urban area becomes more spread out, mixing residential neighborhoods, industrial or commercial buildings, open fields, and wooded areas. The land stretches toward a distant, flat horizon where a broad band of water—likely the sea or a large lake—reflects the pale light. A faint coastline or low landmass is visible beyond the water, softened by haze.

The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image. It is mostly clear and blue, with a slight gradient from deeper blue at the top to a hazier, lighter tone near the horizon. A thin white contrail crosses the upper-left sky. The lighting suggests a bright, sunny day, with long shadows and a slightly misty atmosphere over the town, giving the scene a calm, expansive, scenic quality.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的自然光摄影风格照片。前景中，一条蜿蜒的小径由金属栏杆引导，沿着绿色的草地延伸至远方。小径两旁是散布着树木和灌木的斜坡。背景中，城市的建筑群错落有致地分布着，从低矮的住宅区到高耸的教堂塔楼，构成了一个典型的城镇天际线。天空晴朗，没有云彩，为整个场景增添了一种宁静而和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a brightly lit retail display for the **vivo V9** smartphone, presented inside a glass or acrylic display case.

In the center-left is a white promotional product box/stand with the **vivo** logo and the **FIFA World Cup Russia 2018** logo, indicating vivo as an official smartphone partner. The text on the display reads **“V9”**, **“24MP Selfie”**, and **“Perfect Shot, Perfect View.”** A picture of the phone is printed on the lower part of the stand, showing the front screen and rear side of the device.

On the right side, a real **vivo V9 phone** is mounted at an angle on a transparent acrylic stand. The phone has a dark front with a notch at the top and a red or burgundy-colored frame around the edges. Its screen shows a blue gradient wallpaper with large white time text reading **“07:06”**, along with smaller text about the model and slogan, including **“Perfect Shot, Perfect View”** and **“vivo V9.”**

In front of the phone is a promotional cardboard cutout of a person in a blue suit holding a phone near their face. The face is blurred or out of focus. Below the cutout is a small blue sign that says **“vivo V9”** and **“Perfect Shot, Perfect View”**, with **“24MP Selfie”** underneath.

The whole display sits on a glossy transparent platform with visible acrylic supports and screws. Bright circular reflections from overhead lights appear on the glass and phone screen. In the background, a larger poster shows enlarged images of phones and partial text, including **“Perfect View”** and **“24MP Selfie.”** The overall color tone is cool, with bluish and purple lighting typical of an electronics store display.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示VIVO V9手机的商业摄影照片。在图像中，我们看到一个穿着正装的男性模特站在玻璃柜台上，手持一部VIVO V9手机，他的面部表情专注而平静。旁边是该手机的宣传海报，上面展示了手机的正面和背面设计以及相机镜头。海报下方清晰地标注了'Perfect Shot. Perfect View'的文字，强调了这款手机的拍照功能。整个场景被置于一个明亮且专业的展台环境中，背景中可以看到其他品牌的手机模型和品牌标志。

caption:
The image shows a tightly packed grocery store shelf filled with bottles of olive oil, photographed straight on at close range. The bottles are arranged in vertical rows, with their labels facing forward, and a metal shelf rail runs horizontally along the bottom foreground.

On the left side are dark green glass bottles of **Filippo Berio Extra Virgin Olive Oil**. These bottles have black caps and large cream-and-green labels with bold black “FILIPPO BERIO” text. The labels mention “Extra Virgin Olive Oil,” “For salad dressing and flavouring,” and “500 ml.” Several identical bottles are lined up behind and beside one another, creating a dense display.

In the center are slimmer, rectangular dark glass bottles of **ITLV Aceite de Oliva Clásico**. They have bright yellow caps and yellow labels with red-and-white ITLV logos. The labels include Spanish text such as “Aceite de Oliva” and “CLÁSICO,” along with images of olives, olive branches, and a countryside scene. Around the necks are decorative yellow collars with olive illustrations and some Russian text, including promotional phrases. These bottles stand out because of their vivid yellow packaging.

On the right side are more dark green glass bottles of **Borges Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil**. They have lime-green caps and cream-colored labels with orange-red Borges branding near the top. The labels prominently say “ORGANIC Extra Virgin Olive Oil,” with additional Russian text below, and show a sepia-toned illustration of an olive grove or harvest scene. The bottles are also 500 ml and are arranged in multiple rows, with some partially hidden behind the front bottles.

The lighting is bright and reflective, producing highlights on the glossy glass bottles and caps. The overall color palette is dominated by dark green glass, yellow and green caps, cream labels, and red/orange brand accents. The background is mostly obscured by the tightly arranged bottles, emphasizing the supermarket shelf display of different olive oil brands and varieties.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多种橄榄油瓶子的商业摄影图片。瓶子被整齐地排列在货架上，每瓶都有不同的品牌和标签设计。从左至右，我们可以看到'FILIPPO SERIO Extra Virgin Olive Oil'、'CLASICO Extra Virgin Olive Oil'、'ITALY Extra Virgin Olive Oil'、'ORGANIC Extra Virgin Olive Oil'、'BORGE'S Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil'以及'BORGE'S Extra Virgin Olive Oil'等品牌的产品。

caption:
The image shows a close, low-angle front view of a silver BMW sedan, likely an older 7 Series, parked on a dark asphalt road or driveway. The car fills most of the lower half of the frame, with the front end cropped so that the left side of the vehicle is partially cut off. The BMW roundel badge is visible on the hood above the signature twin kidney grille, which has chrome surrounds and vertical black slats.

On the viewer’s right side of the car, the headlight assembly is prominent: one amber-tinted light is illuminated, casting a warm orange glow that contrasts with the cool, bluish tones of the scene. The adjacent circular headlamp lens and turn-signal section are visible. A small lower light or reflector beneath the headlight also glows faintly. The front bumper is black and silver, and the lower lip has “ALPINA” embossed across it, suggesting an Alpina-styled or Alpina-modified BMW.

The windshield appears dark and tinted, with only faint interior shapes visible, such as the rearview mirror and seat silhouettes. The hood has smooth reflections and subtle curves, emphasizing the car’s broad, low stance. A side mirror protrudes on the right edge of the vehicle.

The background is intentionally out of focus, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect. To the right, a tall industrial-looking wall or building stretches into the distance, with a reflective or metallic surface and a long diagonal roofline. The road narrows alongside it, giving the scene a sense of depth and perspective. The sky is pale and overcast, with a cool gray-blue gradient, while the far background has a faint warm pinkish tint, possibly from sunset light reflecting on the building.

Overall, the image has a cinematic, moody automotive style: cool color grading, soft blur in the background, sharp emphasis on the car’s grille and headlight, and a quiet urban/industrial atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆银色宝马轿车正面特写的摄影作品。车辆停放在一个模糊的背景前，焦点集中在它的前灯和标志性的双肾形格栅上。图像通过使用浅景深技术，将前景的汽车细节清晰地展现出来，而背景则故意模糊处理，以强调车辆的轮廓和设计。

caption:
The image is a tight, close-up portrait of an older man shown from slightly below the forehead down to the upper chest, with most of the frame filled by his face, hair, and beard.

He has deeply weathered, medium-brown skin with prominent wrinkles across his forehead, around his eyes, and along his cheeks. His eyes are partly narrowed, as if squinting in bright sunlight, giving his expression a calm, contemplative, slightly intense look. The light catches the texture of his skin, emphasizing fine lines and the sheen on his forehead and nose.

His hair is long, thick, and very unruly, gathered loosely on top of his head in tangled curls and knots. It is mostly dark with many gray and white strands mixed throughout. Wisps of hair fly outward in different directions, creating a wild, textured halo around the top and sides of his head. A long curl falls down near the center of his forehead.

He has a very full, long beard and mustache. The beard is dense, tangled, and streaked with gray, white, brown, and black. It extends far down past his chin and fills much of the lower half of the image. His mustache is thick and blends into the beard, partially covering his mouth.

Only part of his clothing is visible near the lower right side of the frame. It appears to be a colorful, patterned garment with red, green, and dark tones, possibly textured or embroidered.

The background is out of focus, with warm yellow and muted neutral colors behind him. The blurred yellow area contrasts with his dark, gray-streaked hair and beard. The lighting is strong and natural, likely sunlight, producing sharp highlights on individual hair strands and strong facial texture. Overall, the image feels intimate and documentary-like, emphasizing character, age, texture, and the striking detail of his hair and beard.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位长发男子特写的照片。他的头发蓬松且部分编成辫子，脸部表情平静而深邃。男子的胡须浓密，呈现出自然的灰白色调，部分胡须纠结在一起。他穿着一件色彩鲜艳的传统服饰，上面有复杂的图案和装饰。背景模糊，无法辨认具体细节，但可以感受到一种温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of what appears to be an airport terminal or transit concourse, viewed mostly upward toward the ceiling.

A large black overhead wayfinding sign hangs in the upper-right portion of the scene. It has bright yellow text and arrows, with Thai writing above the English word “Gates.” The sign indicates gate directions: “22” with an upward arrow and “21” with a right-pointing arrow. The high-contrast yellow-on-black design makes it stand out clearly.

Bright rectangular fluorescent or LED lights are embedded behind or between the slats, producing glowing white patches and reflections on the metal. The lighting gives the scene a cool, slightly industrial feel.

A large white cylindrical support column rises from the lower center of the image toward the ceiling. Below and behind it are retail and service storefronts. On the lower left, a bright green-and-white illuminated sign reads “EXPRESS MASSAGE.” Farther back, another glowing sign appears to say “AMARA’S Café” or something similar. On the right side, a smaller hanging sign includes a no-smoking symbol and the words “Non-Smoking Area.”

caption:

They are wearing a black Adidas visor, a black Adidas short-sleeve sports shirt with white stripes down the sleeves, black athletic shorts, a gray wristband, and black running shoes. caption:
The image shows a bright red vintage Škoda car parked on a cobblestone street in a sunny outdoor setting. The car is photographed from the front-left side, filling most of the frame. It has a classic mid-20th-century design with rounded body lines, circular headlights, chrome trim, and a chrome front bumper. The front grille area bears the “Škoda” name, and the license plate below it is blurred. The windshield is large and slightly curved, with two windshield wipers resting at the bottom. A driver is faintly visible inside through the glass.

The car’s paint is glossy red, reflecting sunlight along the hood, roof, and doors. It has thin chrome strips running along the sides, small round side mirrors mounted near the front, and distinctive horizontal ventilation slats on the rear side panel. The wheels are narrow with simple hubcaps, reinforcing the old-fashioned look. The rear wheel and lower body show some darker wear and shadowing.

The setting appears to be a quiet town or park-side street. The ground is made of gray cobblestones arranged in curved patterns, with small tufts of grass growing between some stones. To the left of the car is a large wooden planter filled with leafy green plants and tall red, orange, and yellow flowers. Behind the car are trees and shrubs providing shade, with several people gathered in the background near another vehicle. A red Toyota pickup truck is partially visible on the right side of the image. There are also street poles, a curb, and a small railing in the background.

Overall, the scene has a warm, summery feel, with the vivid red classic car standing out strongly against the greenery and pale cobblestone street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆红色复古汽车停在铺砌石路上的照片。车辆的设计具有50年代的风格，车身流线型，车头部分带有圆形前灯和品牌标志。车内可见一位司机，他戴着太阳镜，专注地驾驶着这辆老式汽车。背景中可以看到绿色的树木、停放的其他车辆以及一些行人，他们似乎正在享受一个晴朗的日子。

caption:
The image shows a lively pedestrian market street in what appears to be a Himalayan town or high-altitude city. The street is paved with gray stone blocks and stretches into the distance, narrowing toward a backdrop of pale, rocky mountains under a partly cloudy sky.

On both sides of the street are multi-story commercial buildings with a mix of traditional and modern architecture. Many have large glass windows, wooden-framed balconies, decorative trim, and shopfront signs. On the right side, visible signs include businesses such as “Walk in Kids Wear,” “Desert Rain,” “Singay General Store,” “Fashion Shoppe Foot Wear,” and an “asian paints” sign above a hardware or construction-related shop. Several storefronts have shutters, striped awnings, and displays of goods near the entrances. On the left side, more shops line the street, including a blue sign that appears to read “Sama Studio,” along with other retail and service businesses.

The street is busy with pedestrians. Groups of people stand, walk, talk, and look around. Many are dressed casually in jeans, hoodies, jackets, T-shirts, and sneakers. Some people are gathered in the foreground, partly facing away from the camera, while others move along the center of the street. A few faces are blurred, giving the scene a documentary or travel-photo feel while preserving privacy.

Overhead, strings of small colorful prayer flags or bunting crisscross the street in multiple layers. They are mixed with black utility wires and cables that converge near a central utility pole in the distance. The flags add a festive, cultural atmosphere to the scene. Toward the left background, a white mosque-like structure with domes and a minaret rises above the buildings, standing out against the sky and mountains.

The lighting is bright but softened by clouds, casting gentle shadows and giving the street a crisp, open-air feel. Overall, the image captures a bustling urban shopping area with mountain-town character, a mix of local shops, pedestrians, overhead flags, and distant Himalayan scenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现繁忙城市街道的现实主义风格照片。街道上人来人往，人们穿着休闲服装，有的在行走，有的在交谈，还有的在商店前驻足观看。建筑物沿街排列，上面挂有彩色的装饰物和商业广告牌，营造出一种热闹而充满活力的氛围。天空中飘着几朵云彩，但整体天气看起来晴朗。

caption:
The image shows a wide rural landscape under an expansive, dramatic sky. The upper half is dominated by large, billowing cumulus clouds, bright white in places and bluish-gray in shadow, creating a sense of depth and movement. Patches of blue sky peek through between the clouds, especially toward the upper left and right, giving the scene a partly cloudy, sunlit atmosphere.

Below the sky, the land stretches in gentle horizontal layers across rolling farmland. The fields vary in color and texture: golden-brown strips of cultivated or harvested earth, pale green patches that look like flowering or grain fields, and darker green bands of grass and vegetation. The foreground is filled with dense, sunlit grasses and small white wildflowers, creating a soft, textured carpet that catches warm light.

Near the center-right horizon stands a large, broad-canopied tree with a dark silhouette against the bright clouds. Its spreading branches make it a strong focal point. Farther to the right is a cluster of taller, dense trees, forming a darker green mass at the edge of the field. Smaller shrubs and hedges line parts of the fields, breaking up the open farmland.

The lighting is warm and golden, suggesting late afternoon or early evening. Long shadows and glowing highlights bring out the contours of the rolling land. A few small animals—likely grazing livestock—are visible as tiny figures scattered across the middle ground, adding a quiet pastoral detail.

Overall, the image feels peaceful and spacious, with a strong contrast between the vast, cloud-filled sky and the gently patterned agricultural landscape below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乡村景观的自然风光摄影图像。前景是郁郁葱葱的草地，中景有不同颜色的耕地和几棵树木，而背景则是壮观的蓝天和厚重的白云。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a large turquoise-green sign mounted on the exterior wall of a building. The sign is rectangular and slightly tilted in the frame due to the camera angle. It appears to be fixed to the wall with visible dark screw heads at several points along the top and bottom edges.

On the left side of the sign is the white DEKRA logo: a stylized triangular arrow-like symbol followed by the word “DEKRA” in large, bold, white capital letters. On the right side of the sign is a white outline of a simple house shape. Inside the house outline, the text reads “Diagnostic” in a bold white rectangular label, with “immobilier” below it in spaced-out lowercase letters, and smaller text near the bottom reading “by DEKRA.”

The sign is attached to a beige or off-white building facade. The wall above and around it shows some weathering, including dirt streaks, cracks, discoloration, and darker grime along horizontal ledges. Below the sign, part of a dark-framed glass window or storefront is visible, reflecting trees and nearby buildings. The overall setting appears to be the exterior of a business or office, likely related to real estate diagnostics or inspections.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示DEKRA Diagnostik Immobilier标志的照片。标志位于建筑物的外墙上，采用绿色背景和白色文字设计，上方是一个白色的三角形符号，下方是矩形的公司名称和简介。

caption:
The image shows a broad, elegant city street in what appears to be an old European urban center, likely in Italy. The scene is framed symmetrically by tall historic buildings on both sides, creating a strong perspective that draws the eye down the road toward a distant church tower or bell tower at the far end.

On both sides of the street are long arcaded walkways supported by rows of stone columns. The buildings are several stories high, with warm beige and tan façades, classical architectural details, and repeating patterns of arched openings, pilasters, cornices, and decorative window frames. Many upper-floor windows have shutters, and some have small wrought-iron balconies. The façades feel formal and historic, with a uniform, refined style.

The left side of the image has a prominent corner building with heavy stonework and ornate detailing. A street sign on the corner reads “Via Cesare Battisti,” and another nearby sign appears to indicate “Via Roma.” Under the arches are shopfronts, including a partially visible Nike sign on the far left. Hanging lantern-style streetlights are suspended beneath the porticoes, adding to the old-city atmosphere.

The right side also has continuous arcades and large shop windows at street level. A sign on the corner reads “Via Monte di Pietà.” Several white delivery vans are parked along the right curb. Near the lower-right corner, a few people sit or rest beside electric scooters and bicycles, while another person is partly visible under the arcade. The street itself is relatively quiet, with very little traffic and only a few pedestrians.

The road is wide and mostly empty, with smooth pavement and a central lane leading into the distance. Large rectangular planters or barriers appear near the far end of the street, suggesting a pedestrianized or restricted-traffic area beyond. The sunlight is warm and low enough to cast long shadows across the road and columns, giving the scene a calm late-morning or afternoon feel. The sky is pale and clear, and the overall atmosphere is quiet, spacious, and stately, emphasizing the grandeur of the architecture and the long perspective of the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的摄影照片。图像中心是一条宽阔的街道，两侧是具有古典建筑风格的建筑，拥有精致的立柱和装饰性细节。街道上停有几辆白色货车，而远处可以看到更多的建筑物延伸至地平线。在街道的一侧，一位男性坐在地上休息，旁边放着一辆自行车。阳光从画面左侧照射下来，为整个场景增添了温暖的色调。

caption:
The image shows a wide, elevated view over a lush coastal town or small city nestled among steep, green hills. The scene appears to be taken from a hillside lookout, with dense tropical vegetation filling the foreground—dark green trees, shrubs, and leafy canopies partially obscuring some rooftops below.

In the middle and lower parts of the image, the town spreads across a valley and along a sheltered waterfront. There are many low-rise buildings with a mix of roof colors, including red, green, blue, gray, and white. Some larger institutional or commercial-looking buildings stand out, including long rectangular structures near the waterfront and a few multi-story buildings toward the right side. A prominent building with a red roof and a light-colored circular or polygonal roof section appears near the lower-right-central area.

On the left side, a small harbor or marina is visible. Calm water curves inland, with several boats and yachts anchored near docks. Along the shoreline are industrial or commercial buildings, including large white warehouse-like structures and a cluster of green cylindrical storage tanks. The waterfront is lined with trees and buildings, blending urban development with the natural coastline.

The background is dominated by steep, forested hillsides rising behind the town. Houses and small buildings are scattered up the slopes, but many are softened and partially hidden by mist. The entire upper half of the image is covered in thick haze or low cloud, giving the landscape a pale, washed-out, humid atmosphere. The sky is not clearly defined; instead, it merges with the foggy hills in a gray-blue veil.

Overall, the image conveys a tropical, mountainous coastal settlement on a misty or rainy day. The combination of dense greenery, colorful rooftops, harbor water, and fog-covered hills creates a quiet, humid, and scenic atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的自然风光摄影图像。前景是密集的绿色植被，中景是多层次的城市建筑群，包括住宅、商业建筑和一些突出的建筑物，如教堂和酒店。背景是覆盖着树木的山丘，部分被云雾遮挡，增添了一种神秘感。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，色彩鲜明且细节丰富。

caption:
The image shows a worker crouching beside a set of outdoor stairs, apparently in the middle of painting or maintenance work.

In the foreground, a freshly painted dark green ramp or stair-side surface occupies the lower left portion of the image. Two clean white painted lines run lengthwise along it, suggesting lane markings or accessibility guidance. A roll of masking tape and a small paintbrush or tool lie on the green surface, indicating recent or ongoing painting. The paint looks glossy and wet in places.

To the right, a man wearing a dark green work uniform is crouched on a concrete walkway. His face is blurred, and he appears to be giving a thumbs-up gesture with one hand while holding onto part of the railing with the other. He is wearing brown work boots with visible paint marks, and there are paint splatters on his pants. In front of him is an open can of bright yellow paint with a brush or stirring stick resting in it.

Behind him and across the stairs is a metal railing painted in two bright colors: the main handrails are vivid yellow, while the vertical bars and diagonal supports are reddish-brown. The railing runs alongside a concrete staircase, whose edges have yellow safety markings. Some of the steps appear weathered and stained, contrasting with the newly painted sections nearby.

In the background, there is greenery with plants and trees, giving the setting a park-like or outdoor public facility feel. A red-and-white traffic cone stands near the right side of the image, and a blue sign is partially visible behind it. The overall scene suggests public maintenance work, with the worker painting safety markings and railings around an outdoor stairway or ramp.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工人在户外进行涂鸦工作的照片。工人穿着绿色的工作服和深色裤子，正蹲在地上专注地用刷子在楼梯的台阶上画出黄色的线条。在他的旁边，有一个装有黄色油漆的大桶。背景中可以看到一些绿色植物和一个红色交通锥，暗示了工作地点可能是一个公共区域或公园。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit mountain landscape under a vivid blue sky. The lower portion of the scene is filled with tall grasses, shrubs, and wild vegetation in shades of green, yellow, and brown, suggesting a natural hillside meadow or open mountain slope. Some of the grasses have pale, feathery seed heads that catch the light.

In the middle ground, forested hills rise from left to right. The slopes are densely covered with green vegetation and scattered dark, slender trees, possibly conifers or eucalyptus-like trees. The left hillside is especially lush, with patches of darker tree clusters contrasting against bright green ground cover. Toward the center, a higher mountain ridge is visible in the distance, its surface textured with ridges and valleys.

On the right side of the image, a tall, thin tree stands prominently against the sky. It has a dark, narrow trunk and sparse, wispy branches with needle-like foliage near the top, giving it a delicate silhouette. Behind it, the hillside is more open and dry-looking, with fewer trees and more exposed grassy terrain.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image. It is a rich blue with large, soft white clouds drifting across it. A particularly large cloud mass stretches across the right-center portion, while smaller, scattered clouds appear toward the top and left. The lighting is bright and clear, suggesting midday or early afternoon in a mountainous outdoor environment.

Overall, the scene feels peaceful, open, and fresh, with a strong contrast between the vibrant sky, the soft white clouds, and the green mountain vegetation.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的摄影作品，画面中心有一棵孤独的树木矗立在前景，其周围是绿色的草地和一些稀疏的植被。背景中，一座覆盖着茂密森林的山丘延伸至远方，山顶上似乎有积雪。天空呈现出明亮的蓝色，几朵蓬松的白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a wide waterfront scene dominated by a large suspension bridge stretching across the upper right portion of the frame. The bridge has a tall, pale gray vertical tower with a rectangular opening near its center and massive suspension cables extending diagonally down toward the left. Thin vertical hanger cables descend from the main cables to support the roadway. The bridge deck runs horizontally across the scene, elevated above the shoreline, with small vehicles visible along it.

In the foreground, dark blue water fills the lower half of the image. The surface is textured with small waves and ripples, reflecting sunlight in shimmering silver and gold streaks, especially beneath the bridge tower.

Along the shoreline beneath the bridge are several buildings. Near the center-left is a prominent white waterfront building with classical architectural details, multiple windows, and a low, elegant façade. To the right of it, closer to the bridge tower, is a large plain white rectangular structure at the water’s edge. On the far left, a darker modern building sits partly in shadow. Farther right, additional low-rise buildings line the coast.

Behind the shoreline, a hillside rises upward, dotted with houses, trees, and urban structures. The hill has a mix of greenery and tightly clustered buildings, giving the scene a dense city feel. The lighting appears warm and low, suggesting late afternoon or early evening, casting long shadows and giving the bridge and buildings a golden tint.

The sky is clear and bright blue with no visible clouds, creating a clean backdrop for the bridge cables and tower. Overall, the image captures a calm waterside urban landscape with a major suspension bridge spanning above a coastal neighborhood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的摄影作品，画面中心是一座宏伟的悬索桥，其结构坚固且线条流畅。桥梁下方是宽阔的河流，河面上波光粼粼，反射着阳光。河岸两侧分布着多座建筑，包括一些具有传统特色的白色房屋和现代风格的高楼大厦。在远处可以看到连绵起伏的山丘，为这个城市场景增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban boulevard in Bangkok, Thailand, viewed from an elevated position looking down the road. It appears to be late afternoon or early evening, with clear pale-blue sky and soft sunlight hitting the buildings.

A wide multi-lane road fills the lower half of the scene, packed with traffic moving in both directions. There are many cars, taxis, buses, motorcycles, and tuk-tuks. Brightly colored Bangkok taxis stand out, especially pink and green-yellow ones. A large yellow bus is visible on the left, while another bus and many cars are clustered toward the center. Several tuk-tuks appear near the bottom and right side of the frame. The traffic is dense but still moving, with headlights and brake lights beginning to show.

Above the road are multiple elevated concrete structures, likely skytrain or pedestrian/roadway overpasses. One green sign across an upper structure reads “Bangkok City of Life.” Below it, a festive illuminated banner stretches across the street saying “HAPPY NEW YEAR @ RATCHAPRASONG,” decorated with blue and orange lights. This gives the scene a holiday atmosphere.

On the left side, a large commercial building bears the sign “GAYSORN VILLAGE,” indicating a shopping area. Behind it and dominating the skyline is a striking modern high-rise tower with a curved, twisting shape. The building has many horizontal white bands and blue-tinted glass windows, making it look sleek and futuristic. Its top curves inward, giving it a distinctive sculptural silhouette.

On the right side, there are more buildings, including one with Thai writing and English text indicating “Police General Hospital.” Trees line parts of the sidewalks, especially on the right, where a large leafy tree partially obscures the buildings and road edge. Pedestrians can be seen along sidewalks and near crossings, though they are small compared with the scale of the traffic and buildings.

Overall, the image captures a lively, dense, modern Bangkok city scene: heavy traffic, elevated transit infrastructure, high-rise architecture, shopping complexes, hospital buildings, colorful taxis, tuk-tuks, and New Year decorations in the heart of a busy commercial district.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的摄影图像。图中可见多条车道上车辆密集，包括轿车、摩托车和公共汽车等交通工具。道路两旁是高楼大厦，其中一幢大楼顶部有一个明显的圆顶结构。在街道上方有一座天桥连接着两侧的道路，上面有行人正在通行。整个场景被自然光照亮，天空呈现出晴朗的状态。

caption:

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张显示英国航空网站主页的图片。在图像的中心，有一个醒目的红色和蓝色标志，上面写着'British Airways plc (GB)'，旁边是网址'www.britishairways.com'。页面顶部显示了浏览器的标签栏，包括打开的网页名称'Tickets'、'Flights and holidays'以及'My Booking'。页面下方是广告区域，宣传着前往荷兰的航班。整个页面背景为浅蓝色，给人一种清新简洁的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a large, dark earthenware or metal-looking pot sitting on sandy ground in bright sunlight. The pot is positioned slightly off-center to the right and viewed from above at an angle, so its wide circular opening is clearly visible. Its interior appears very dark, almost black, with a few lighter specks or dust marks inside. The rim is thick, rounded, and grayish, catching the sunlight along its upper edge.

The vessel has a rounded, bulbous body with a narrow neck and a wide mouth. Its surface is dark gray to black with a slightly metallic or fired-clay sheen. Subtle horizontal ridges and uneven texture run around the body, suggesting it may have been handmade or shaped on a wheel. There are areas of wear, scratches, and dusty residue, especially near the lower portion and around the neck.

The pot rests directly on tan sand. The surrounding ground is covered with fine grains, small pebbles, and scattered debris. There are visible footprints and shoe tread marks in the sand, especially toward the top and upper-right areas of the image. A small crumpled white or translucent piece of litter lies near the upper right, and more scraps of plastic or string-like material appear near the lower right side of the pot.

Strong sunlight comes from the upper left, creating bright highlights on the pot’s rim and shoulder. A large, dark shadow from the pot stretches to the lower left, emphasizing the vessel’s rounded shape and the intensity of the midday light. The overall scene feels dry, outdoor, and rustic, with the pot appearing abandoned or placed casually on a sandy surface.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个黑色陶瓷容器在沙地上的照片。容器的表面有光泽，呈现出深灰色调，并且边缘略显粗糙。它位于画面中央偏下位置，而周围是细腻的沙子和一些散落的小石块。阳光从上方照射下来，在容器上投下了清晰的阴影，增加了场景的深度感。

caption:
The image shows a large bascule-style drawbridge raised to allow boat traffic to pass through a waterway. The bridge is painted bright yellow, with heavy steel beams, cross-bracing, and dark decking visible underneath. One span on the left is lifted steeply upward at an angle, exposing its underside and structural framework. The other span on the right is also raised but appears closer to horizontal, extending out from a large concrete support tower.

On both sides of the bridge are massive pale concrete bridge piers and control structures. The buildings are light yellow or cream-colored, with small rectangular windows and weathered concrete bases stained by age, moisture, and rust. Metal railings run along the edges of the bridge decks, and small traffic signal lights are visible near the raised spans.

Below the bridge is a broad body of water with gentle ripples. In the center foreground, a small colorful fishing boat with red, blue, green, and white trim sits near a series of rust-stained vertical pilings. More boats and harbor structures are visible in the background, suggesting a busy coastal or river port area.

The sky is mostly cloudy, with large gray and white cloud formations behind the bridge. The overall scene feels industrial and maritime, combining heavy engineering infrastructure with small local boats and waterfront activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黄色吊桥在开启状态的摄影照片。桥梁两侧是混凝土结构，顶部有金属梁和黄色的横梁。在桥下，可以看到多艘船只停靠在码头上，其中一艘船上有几个人正在船上活动。天空中有散布的云朵，整体场景给人一种宁静而有序的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, slightly overhead view of a meal on a wooden restaurant table. The main focus is a large, shallow metal pot filled with a bubbling red-orange stew, set on top of a portable gas burner. The broth looks spicy and oily, with visible bubbles and steam suggesting it is actively boiling. Inside the stew are ingredients such as curly ramen noodles, tofu pieces, sliced green onions, cabbage or kimchi, and possibly slices of meat or sausage, giving the impression of a Korean-style hot pot or budae jjigae.

The pot has a worn metal rim and dark side handles. Under it is a black and orange portable butane stove with vents and a control knob, placed directly on the table. Around the pot are dining utensils and place settings: bright green speckled bowls or plates, metal spoons, and chopsticks.
