The front facade has arched stonework, decorative tracery, and a red door, but much of the structure is broken and surrounded by rubble and construction barriers. The ruins give a strong sense of earthquake or disaster damage. To the right of the ruined church stands a modern white office building with a grid of rectangular windows and a sign near the top reading “Distinction.” Bare tree branches frame parts of the scene on the left and right.

Overall, the image contrasts an active public square—children, pedestrians, market stalls, street art, and a giant chess game—with the dramatic ruined cathedral in the background, creating a mix of everyday city life, creativity, and visible urban recovery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外巨型国际象棋游戏的照片，位于一个广场上。在前景中，我们看到一个巨大的黑色和红色的棋盘，上面摆放着整齐排列的棋子。几位参与者站在棋盘前，有的在移动棋子，有的在观看。背景中是一座具有历史感的教堂建筑，其石质结构部分被毁，显示出地震的影响。周围还有现代风格的建筑物和一些行人。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor wedding ceremony taking place under a white canopy in a garden setting. The scene is bright and sunlit, with green grass, trees, and dense foliage surrounding the ceremony area.

At the center foreground is a rectangular table covered with a white cloth. It is decorated with white artificial or fresh flowers arranged along the front edge and around a tall white lantern centerpiece. The table appears to be part of the formal ceremony setup, with people seated on both sides facing one another.

On the left side of the table, two men are seated. They are wearing traditional-looking attire, including dark songkok-style caps. One man is dressed in a deep blue outfit, while the other wears a darker green outfit and appears to be holding or speaking into a microphone. On the right side of the table, several men are seated, mostly wearing white shirts and black caps. One man in the foreground wears a white traditional outfit with a patterned lower garment and sits with his hands clasped.

In the background, beneath a decorative floral arch, a bride and another woman sit on an ornate white-and-gold loveseat. The bride is dressed in white with a long veil covering her head and face, holding a bouquet of white flowers. Beside her is a woman in a reddish-brown hijab and a pink patterned outfit, seated close to her. Behind them is a white draped fabric backdrop with a row of white flowers and greenery hanging across the top, giving the area a formal wedding-stage appearance.

Guests stand and sit around the ceremony space. Many are watching attentively, and a few appear to be taking photos or recording with phones. Some women in the background wear hijabs in shades of grey, teal, and blue. White chairs are arranged around the canopy, and additional guests sit along the right side.

The canopy itself is cream or white, supported by metal posts with decorative circular scrollwork along the edges. The overall color palette is dominated by whites, greens, and soft floral tones, creating an elegant, garden-wedding atmosphere. The image has a wide panoramic composition, capturing the formal ceremony table in the foreground, the bride’s seating area in the background, and the surrounding family and guests.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到的户外婚礼场景，图中显示了两位穿着传统服装的新郎和新娘坐在装饰精美的桌子旁。新郎身穿深色长袍，头戴白色帽子，而新娘则身着白色的传统服饰，头戴与新郎相配的头巾。他们周围是宾客们，有的坐着，有的站着，大家似乎都在享受这个特别的日子。背景中的树木和绿色植物为这场婚礼增添了一抹自然的色彩。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor Christmas market scene set against a dramatic, overcast sky. Most of the frame is filled with dark gray-blue storm clouds, giving the scene a moody winter atmosphere. A few small birds are visible as dark silhouettes scattered across the sky.

On the right side is a tall, decorative wooden clock tower that looks like part of a festive market stall or carousel-style structure. The tower has a steep, shingled roof outlined with rows of small warm bulbs, creating a glowing border. Beneath the roof are several large bronze-colored bells mounted in open archways. A round clock face with Roman numerals is centered on the tower; its black hands and decorative trim stand out against the pale face.

The tower is richly ornamented with warm-toned wood, carved details, and many strings of small lights. Below the clock is a large painted yellow lion wearing a red Santa hat, holding or attached to a curling decorative ribbon shape. There are also white plush polar bears or teddy bears sitting on sled-like wooden decorations near the base of the tower, adding to the holiday theme.

Across the lower part of the image are market-stall roofs decorated with garlands and tiny lights. A sign reading “Glühwein” is visible, suggesting a mulled wine stand. On the left, a red-and-white striped tent canopy rises sharply into the frame, with more evergreen garland trimming its edge. Partial text on the stall below appears to advertise sweets or waffles.

In the background, modern rectangular office or apartment buildings with many windows line the square, contrasting with the rustic, festive market decorations. The overall scene feels like a European Christmas market in a city square, with warm holiday lights and decorations set beneath a cold, turbulent sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日气氛的摄影图像，前景中有一个装饰华丽的钟楼，顶部有金色的狮子雕塑和一个大型时钟。钟楼下方是一个带有红色条纹的帐篷，上面挂有'Glühwein'的标志，暗示着这是一个圣诞市场。背景是阴沉的天空和城市建筑群，营造出一种即将下雨的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a modern indoor architectural space dominated by two escalators cutting diagonally across the scene. The escalators have sleek dark metal side panels, reflective glass balustrades, and black handrails, creating strong diagonal lines from the lower right toward the upper left. Their glossy surfaces reflect the warm lighting and surrounding structure.

Behind the escalators is a large exposed brick wall in shades of orange, tan, and reddish brown. The bricks are unevenly textured, giving the space an industrial or renovated warehouse feel. Warm yellow lighting washes across the brick, emphasizing its rough surface and creating a cozy, golden atmosphere. Several black track lights are mounted high on the brick wall near the top right, aimed downward.

On the far left is a tall concrete wall or column with a raw, unfinished texture. It has circular construction marks or impressions arranged in horizontal rows, contrasting with the brick wall’s rough pattern. Between the concrete wall and the escalators, a large dark structural element or underside of another escalator forms a black angular shape, adding depth and shadow.

Near the lower left and center, a small landing or corridor area is visible with polished concrete flooring. There are black doors, one of which is open, revealing a lighter interior space. Above this lower area, a small mezzanine or balcony with a black railing can be seen, with some stacked or stored items behind it.

On the right side, through the glass and beyond the escalator, part of a retail area is visible. Shelves stocked with products and colorful signage can be seen faintly in the background, suggesting the location may be a shopping center, department store, or commercial interior.

Overall, the scene combines industrial materials—exposed brick, concrete, black metal, and glass—with warm lighting and contemporary design. The composition is highly geometric, with strong diagonal escalator lines intersecting the vertical brick and concrete walls.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑内部楼梯的摄影作品。图像中心是一个由金属扶手和台阶组成的自动扶梯，其设计简洁而现代。楼梯一侧是用砖块砌成的墙面，墙面上装饰有简单的线条图案。在楼梯下方，可以看到一个开放式的门廊区域，里面摆放着一些家具和装饰品。整个场景被暖色调的灯光照亮，营造出一种温馨舒适的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a traditional Chinese temple or ancestral hall, centered on an ornate altar area.

At the top center is a large rectangular gold plaque with bold black Chinese calligraphy. It is brightly lit and mounted above the main shrine, drawing the eye immediately. Around it are decorative painted panels with traditional landscape scenes—mountains, trees, figures, and architectural elements—running horizontally beneath the ceiling.

The architecture is symmetrical and richly decorated. Two large stone columns stand near the center-left and center-right, flanking the altar. Beside them are red vertical pillars or hanging couplet panels with gold Chinese writing. The columns and beams are dark wood, with carved brackets and painted ornamental details in green, red, gold, and black.

The main altar occupies the center of the image. It is a large black lacquered structure with gold trim and carved embellishments. Behind glass-fronted panels are rows of ancestral tablets or memorial tablets, arranged upright in dense groups. These tablets are mostly dark red and gold, giving the shrine a solemn, ceremonial appearance. Warm lighting from inside the shrine illuminates the tablets and creates a golden glow.

In front of the shrine is a black-and-gold altar table. Its panels are decorated with gold outlines and carved scrollwork. A small offering area sits on top, including what appears to be an incense burner or ritual vessel at the center. A vase with white flowers stands slightly right of center in front of the altar, adding a soft, bright contrast to the darker wood and gold surroundings.

On both sides of the central shrine, additional smaller shrine cabinets or tablet displays are visible. They are also filled with many memorial tablets and framed by black lacquer and gold detailing. The left and right areas are dimmer, creating a strong contrast with the illuminated central altar.

The floor has patterned tiles, and the overall lighting is low and atmospheric, with warm highlights on the gold surfaces. The scene feels reverent, historic, and ceremonial, emphasizing traditional Chinese religious or ancestral worship practices through its calligraphy, memorial tablets, carved woodwork, and richly ornamented altar design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国传统文化的室内环境照片，中心位置是一个装饰华丽的神龛，上方悬挂着金色的牌匾，上面用黑色楷书写着“堂隆张”四个大字。神龛前方有一张黑色的供桌，桌上摆放着一束白色的鲜花和一些香烛。两侧是精美的墙壁，装饰有传统的花纹和图案，墙上挂满了金色的牌匾。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种庄严肃穆的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor skatepark scene in soft daylight, likely late afternoon or early evening. In the foreground, a skateboarder is carving along the curved wall of a smooth concrete bowl or ramp. The skater is seen from behind and slightly above, leaning low into the transition with one arm extended for balance. They are wearing a loose white T-shirt with a colorful graphic on the back, black shorts, and black-and-white checkered slip-on shoes. The skateboard is angled on the sloped concrete surface, with the wheels visible as the rider moves along the curve.

The concrete skate bowl dominates the lower half of the image. Its pale gray surface is smooth but marked with faint scuffs and skate lines, showing frequent use. The ramp curves upward on the left side and dips down into a wider, open bowl on the right, creating a strong sweeping shape across the frame.

Behind the ramp, several objects sit on a flat ledge or platform, including what appear to be drink cans and bottles. A silver vehicle is parked beyond the skatepark, partially obscured by the ramp. There are patches of green grass, small trees, rocks, and a chain-link fence in the surrounding park area.

In the background, a large greenish bridge or elevated roadway stretches horizontally across the upper part of the image. Its metal structure and supports are visible but softly blurred. Farther beyond, there are hints of a city skyline, also out of focus. A tall black lamppost stands near the right side of the frame, and a sports field or fenced recreational area appears behind it.

The image has a shallow depth of field: the skateboarder and nearby concrete are relatively clear, while the background bridge, trees, fence, and buildings are blurred. The colors are muted and natural, with cool gray concrete, soft green grass and trees, and pale blue sky tones. The overall mood feels relaxed and urban, capturing a quiet moment of skateboarding in a park beneath a large bridge.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示滑板运动的现实主义风格照片，一位穿着白色T恤和黑色短裤的男性正在一个混凝土坡道上进行滑板动作。他的身体前倾，一只脚踩在滑板上，另一只脚在空中，表现出专注而熟练的动作。背景中可以看到一片绿色草地、几棵树木以及远处的桥梁结构，这些元素构成了一个典型的户外滑板场地环境。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a person working at a bright workbench, assembling or inspecting a long, narrow plastic component.

In the foreground, two hands hold a beige plastic strip at a diagonal angle from the lower right toward the upper left. The strip has a row of small circular holes and several white spherical pieces mounted on short pegs along its length, giving it the appearance of a manufactured part or assembly fixture. The person appears to be carefully adjusting or checking one of the white ball-like pieces near the end of the strip. Their fingernails are neatly trimmed, and they are wearing a silver metal wristwatch on the right wrist. A pink or coral-colored sleeve is visible on the right side.

The work surface is white and brightly lit. On the table are multiple similar beige plastic racks or trays filled with rows of white spherical components attached to thin stems. These trays are arranged in clusters, suggesting a production, assembly, or quality-control setting. The background is softly blurred, with more rows of similar parts visible, emphasizing the repetitive manufacturing process.

Near the center-left of the table, slightly out of focus, there is a small mobile phone or electronic device lying flat. Along the lower center of the image is a long green tray or channel containing narrow dark pieces or tools. A translucent plastic bag is partially visible near the person’s lap at the bottom right.

Overall, the scene appears to depict careful manual assembly or inspection of small plastic components in a clean workshop or factory environment. The shallow depth of field keeps attention on the hands and the long plastic strip being handled.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示手工艺制作过程的照片，一位工人正专注地操作着一串由白色珠子和绿色装饰条组成的长形物品。工人的双手紧握着这些珠子和条状物，显示出精细的手艺。在模糊的背景中，可以看到更多的类似物品整齐排列在桌面上，暗示这是一个手工制作的工作环境。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque nighttime cityscape along a river, dominated by a large illuminated Gothic-style cathedral with two tall, slender spires. The sky is a deep, rich twilight blue, creating a strong contrast with the warm golden lighting on the church towers.

At the center of the scene, the cathedral rises above the surrounding buildings. Its twin towers are made of dark brick or stone and are lit from below with warm yellow-orange lights, highlighting arched windows, decorative Gothic details, and vertical architectural lines. Each tower is topped with a steep, pointed spire in a pale greenish-gray tone, ending in a small finial or cross-like ornament. Between and below the towers, part of the main church façade is visible, also brightly illuminated.

In front of the cathedral are lower historic buildings with red-tiled roofs, pale walls, and a mix of architectural styles. Some houses have half-timbered façades, while others appear more formal and classical, with tall windows and symmetrical fronts. Trees and shrubs partially obscure the lower buildings, adding dark silhouettes and texture to the riverbank.

The foreground is dominated by a calm river or canal. The water reflects the blue of the sky and the warm lights of the cathedral, producing long, shimmering streaks of orange, gold, pink, and blue across the surface. A boat is moving across the water on the right side, captured with motion blur; its bright white and red lights form glowing horizontal trails. Near the left bank, another small boat or docked vessel has vivid pink and blue interior lighting, which also reflects in the water.

On the left side, a stone embankment and walkway run along the river. A few people can be seen gathered near a railing, suggesting an evening promenade or viewing spot. Dense trees frame the left edge, their leaves appearing dark against the illuminated city. On the right edge, part of a stone or brick bridge or riverside wall enters the frame, adding depth and framing the waterway.

Overall, the image has a serene yet lively atmosphere: the stillness of the historic architecture and twilight sky contrasts with the blurred motion of the boat and the sparkling reflections on the river. The combination of deep blue tones and warm architectural lighting gives the scene a dramatic, postcard-like quality.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜晚城市河岸景观的照片，画面中心是一座宏伟的教堂，其两个高耸的尖顶在夜空中闪耀着光芒。教堂前有一座石桥横跨河流，桥上有人行走。河面上有几艘船只，其中一艘正在经过，其灯光在水面上形成了美丽的倒影。河岸边的建筑和树木被夜色笼罩，而天空则呈现出深蓝色调，没有云彩。

caption:
The image shows a large Gothic-style castle complex perched dramatically on a rugged rocky hill, strongly resembling Hogwarts Castle from the Harry Potter films/theme park attractions. The view is taken from below, making the castle look imposing and monumental.

The castle is built from weathered tan-gray stone and features many tall, narrow spires with dark slate roofs. On the left side is a long rectangular hall-like building with rows of arched windows and ornate vertical buttresses, giving it a cathedral-like appearance. Several small dormer windows and pointed turrets line the roof. Near the center rises a massive round tower with a steep conical roof, surrounded by smaller towers and decorative crenellations.

To the right, another tall tower stands slightly separated from the main structure. It has a steep roof, pointed finials, arched openings, and a distinctive circular feature near its upper section. Additional smaller spires and towers appear behind and around it, creating a layered medieval skyline.

The castle sits on an artificial-looking but highly detailed rocky outcrop, with jagged gray-brown stone faces sloping down toward the foreground. At the base are dense green trees and shrubs, partially obscuring the lower portion of the rocks and castle. On the lower right, there is a black iron fence and a small group of visitors, suggesting this is part of a theme park or tourist attraction.

Near the right side of the rocky base are dark winged boar or gargoyle-like statues mounted on stone pillars, adding to the fantasy atmosphere. The sky above is overcast, filled with pale gray clouds, which gives the scene a moody, dramatic tone and enhances the old, magical, fortress-like feeling of the castle.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哈利波特主题公园中霍格沃茨城堡的照片。城堡建筑位于岩石上，具有哥特式和文艺复兴风格的特征，包括尖顶塔楼、石制外墙和复杂的屋顶结构。城堡前有绿色植被覆盖的岩石和树木，而背景是多云的天空。在城堡前方可以看到一些游客正在参观，增添了场景的活力。

caption:
The image shows a lively floating market scene on a river or canal. Several women are working and trading from narrow wooden boats packed with produce. Most of them wear traditional conical straw hats, long-sleeved tops, and patterned pants, suggesting a Southeast Asian setting, likely Vietnam.

In the foreground, a long, weathered wooden boat is filled with goods. There are pineapples piled near the front, blue plastic bags full of produce, green fruits, and other items wrapped in clear plastic. The boat’s wood is worn and stained from use, with water visible along the lower edge.

Three women are central to the scene:

- On the left, a woman sits low on a wooden dock or the edge of a boat. She wears a pink long-sleeved shirt, purple pants with white polka dots, and a conical hat. She is leaning forward with one arm outstretched, appearing to reach toward another person or an item in the boat.
- In the middle, another woman sits inside the boat wearing a red or coral jacket, blue floral-patterned pants, and a conical hat with fabric ties hanging down. She is holding several round green fruits in her hands, as if showing or handing them over.
- On the right, a standing woman wears a red jacket, blue patterned pants with large floral swirls, and a conical hat. She holds a bright green plastic shopping bag, possibly preparing to pack or receive produce.

Around them are plastic crates in blue and green, a metal bowl, bags, ropes, and other market supplies. The boats are close together, creating a crowded, busy trading environment.

In the background, larger boats and structures are visible. A large green-and-gray boat hull spans the rear of the image, and there are rusted blue metal poles and wooden beams crossing diagonally through the frame. Another person in a bright pink jacket is partially visible on the far right, standing on or near a boat. The overall atmosphere feels active and practical, with people buying, selling, sorting, and transporting fresh produce directly from boats on the water.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现东南亚水上市场的照片，图中三位身穿传统服饰的女性坐在装满水果和塑料袋的船上。她们戴着典型的锥形草帽，一位正在与另一位交谈，而第三位则在整理她的物品。船上的货物包括成熟的菠萝、香蕉和其他热带水果，以及蓝色和绿色的塑料袋。背景中可以看到其他船只和一些模糊的人物，但焦点集中在前景的三位女性身上。

caption:
The image shows a bright, picturesque harbor scene on a sunny day, likely in a historic waterfront district. A large white wooden sailboat dominates the foreground, moored alongside a quay. Its hull is painted white with a dark red band near the waterline, and the boat has tall wooden masts with ropes, rigging, and small flags fluttering near the tops. Blue canvas covers are draped over parts of the deck, and various nautical details—ropes, poles, railings, and equipment—are visible.

Behind the boat is a row of colorful, narrow buildings with traditional European architecture. The facades are painted in soft pastel and vivid tones, including light blue, deep red, gray-blue, orange, yellow, cream, and pale gray. Many of the buildings have white-framed windows arranged in neat rows, steep red-tiled roofs, dormer windows, and decorative trim. The buildings stand closely packed together, creating a lively and charming waterfront backdrop.

At the lower left, there are outdoor café umbrellas along the quay, with a few people seated or walking nearby. The waterfront edge is made of wooden pilings and decking, giving the scene a maritime feel.

The water in the foreground is calm but gently rippled, reflecting the boat, buildings, and blue sky in wavy, distorted patterns. The sky is clear and intensely blue, with no visible clouds, adding to the warm, summery atmosphere. Overall, the image conveys a scenic harbor setting full of historic charm, colorful architecture, and traditional sailing boats.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸风光的照片，画面中心有一艘大型的白色帆船停靠在码头上，船上挂有蓝色和白色的旗帜。船只后方是色彩鲜艳的建筑群，其风格多样，从古典到现代都有所体现。建筑物的外墙以红色、黄色、绿色等为主色调，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。码头上有几个人正在行走或休息，为这个宁静的场景增添了生活气息。

caption:
The image shows a modern public restroom or washroom with a clean, industrial-style design.

A long beige countertop runs from the foreground into the background, holding a row of white, round vessel sinks. Each sink has a shiny chrome faucet, and the sinks are evenly spaced in a straight line. Mounted on the wall beside each sink are rectangular soap dispensers with blue translucent reservoirs and white/gray casing.

Above the counter is a series of tall, rounded-rectangle mirrors with thick black frames. The mirrors are mounted along the left wall and reflect the sinks, lights, and tiled walls, creating a sense of depth and repetition. The nearest mirror is partially cut off at the left edge of the image, while several more mirrors continue down the row.

The walls are covered in glossy white subway tiles arranged in a brick pattern. The tiles reflect the warm lighting, giving the space a bright but cozy feel. The back wall also has the same white tile, with a small square ventilation grille visible near the center-right area. A small potted green plant sits on a ledge or shelf near the sinks in the background, adding a touch of color.

Hanging from the ceiling are several black pendant lamps with wide, dome-shaped shades. Their interiors appear warm cream or gold-toned, and the bulbs cast a soft amber light downward onto the sinks and counter. The lights are aligned along the row of sinks, reinforcing the repeating pattern of the room.

The ceiling has an exposed, industrial look, with visible pipes, ducts, and structural elements painted mostly white or gray. On the right side of the ceiling, there is a darker recessed area and a vent or grille. The floor is dark gray or black tile, contrasting with the bright white walls and sinks.

Overall, the space feels stylish, clean, and contemporary, combining glossy white tile, black-framed mirrors, black pendant lights, chrome fixtures, and a warm neutral countertop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代公共洗手间内部的照片。照片中，一排白色的洗手池整齐地排列在墙边，每个洗手池上方都装有一个黑色的灯具，提供柔和的照明。镜子被安装在墙上，反射出洗手间的光线和布局。墙面装饰着白色瓷砖，与洗手池的颜色形成对比。整个场景给人一种干净、整洁的感觉。

caption:
The image is a close-up, angled view of a computer screen showing a web browser open to **DHgate.com**, an online shopping marketplace. The screen is photographed at a diagonal tilt, with the browser window slanting from the lower left toward the upper right against a deep blue desktop/background.

At the top, several browser tabs are visible, including tabs with Chinese text and one partially showing “Watch…”. The address bar displays a secure URL beginning with **https://www.dhgate.com**, with a green lock icon. Standard browser controls such as the back arrow, refresh icon, download icon, and a search/address field are visible.

The DHgate webpage itself has a prominent red promotional banner near the top with large white text advertising **“SELECTED BRANDS FROM DHGATE.COM”** and **“UP TO 55% OFF”**. Beneath it, the DHgate logo appears on the left, with the slogan **“Buy Globally · Sell Globally”** underneath. A cursor shaped like a hand is hovering near the logo/slogan area.

Below the header is a shopping layout: a search bar in the center with placeholder text like “I’m shopping for,” category suggestions such as **Xiaomi**, **Cable TV**, **Luxury Watches**, and **Girls Dress**, and a yellow search button on the right. There are navigation links such as **Flash Deals**, **Superior Suppliers**, and **Coupon Center**, along with indicators like **Buyer Protection** and **Help**.

On the left side, a vertical sidebar titled **“ALL CATEGORIES”** lists product sections including **Toys, Hobbies & Baby, Kids**, **Electronics**, **Cell Phones & Accessories**, **Health & Beauty**, **Computers & Cameras**, **Jewelry & Watches**, **Weddings & Formal Events**, **Automobile & Motorcycle**, and **Apparel**. The main content area is partially visible, showing a large promotional graphic with pink floral imagery and large text beginning with **“EVERY GIRL…”**.

The overall image has a slightly pixelated, screen-photographed texture, with visible monitor pixels and mild blur from the close-up perspective.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张电子商务网站的截图，展示了该网站的首页。页面顶部有一个醒目的红色标题“STED BRANDS FROM DHgate.com”，宣传其提供的多品牌商品和高达55%的折扣优惠。网站导航栏清晰可见，包括'Home', 'All Categories', 'Shopping Cart'等选项。网页中部展示了一些热门搜索词，如'Toys, Mobile Phones & Accessories, Electronics, Fashion & Beauty, Home & Garden'。在页面底部，有广告推广语‘EVERY GIRL WANTS TO BE’以及一些促销信息，如‘100% GUARANTEE’和‘FAST DELIVERY’。整体上，这张图片传达了购物网站提供多种产品类别、促销活动以及方便的购物体验的信息。

caption:
The image shows the front facade of an old, weathered two-story building standing between more modern urban structures. The building has a rustic stone exterior, with rough, uneven masonry visible across most of the wall. Its architectural details are painted in a faded blue, including the window frames, vertical corner trim, horizontal bands, and the arch around the central entrance.

At the center of the upper floor is a projecting wooden bay window, enclosed with multiple tall glass panes. The wood is pale, worn, and peeling, giving it an aged appearance. Above the bay window is a decorative strip of carved wooden trim with a lace-like pattern. The glass panes appear dark due to shadow and reflection.

On both sides of the bay window are tall shuttered windows with white wooden shutters and blue frames. The shutters are closed and look old, with rust marks around hinges and weathering along the edges. Similar shuttered windows appear on the lower level, also framed in blue and white. The lower right window has noticeable staining and rust near the bottom.

The central entrance below the bay window is a large arched doorway, painted blue around the arch. The inside of the entrance is very dark, making it difficult to see details beyond the doorway. The underside of the bay window projects over this entrance and casts a deep shadow.

Strong sunlight strikes the upper right portion of the building, while much of the lower and central facade is in shadow. The shadows of nearby buildings or objects fall across the facade, creating high contrast. The top of the building has a pale yellow or cream-colored band, also weathered and slightly peeling.

There are signs of urban wear: posters pasted near the lower left, graffiti-like markings near the bottom, exposed wires, and a dark banner or sign hanging to the right of the entrance. On the far right, a black streetlamp with a round fixture is visible, along with part of a neighboring modern concrete building with rectangular windows and balconies. Near the bottom right, a street sign reads “CUMHURİYET BULVARI,” suggesting the building is on or near that street.

Overall, the image captures an old historic-looking building with distinctive blue-and-white trim, closed shutters, and a traditional wooden bay window, surrounded by a dense city environment and marked by age, neglect, and strong afternoon-like sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示老式建筑外观的照片。建筑物的外墙由蓝色和灰色的砖块构成，窗户上方有木制结构，部分窗户关闭，而另一些则敞开。在建筑物的一侧，有一个拱形入口，门上方悬挂着一个黑色的横幅广告牌。周围环境看起来是城市街道的一部分，可以看到其他现代建筑和一些生活设施。

caption:
The image shows a small stone memorial or shrine-like area, likely in Japan, enclosed by a low stone fence. The scene is outdoors in bright daylight.

In the foreground and center-right is a tall rectangular stone monument set on a square base. Its front face is carved with vertical Japanese characters, darkened by age and shadow. The top of the monument has a decorative, roof-like stone cap with a curved, wavy profile and carved ornamental patterns, giving it the appearance of a miniature shrine or traditional marker. The stone is weathered, speckled gray, with patches of moss or discoloration.

Surrounding the central monument is a fence made of many upright stone posts. These posts are square at the bottom and topped with rounded, stacked bulb-like shapes, resembling traditional Japanese stone railings or grave/temple boundary markers. Many of the posts also have vertical inscriptions carved into them. Horizontal stone rails connect the posts, forming an enclosure around the monument.

Bare tree branches cross through the upper part of the image, suggesting winter or early spring before leaves have grown. One thicker tree limb stretches diagonally across the top and right side, partially framing the stone structure. Shadows from the branches fall across the stones.

Behind the enclosure is a blue-gray wall topped with traditional dark roof tiles. The tiles have circular decorative end caps with spiral patterns, typical of Japanese architectural roofing. Beyond the wall, parts of modern apartment or office buildings are visible, creating a contrast between the old stone memorial and the urban surroundings.

The overall atmosphere is quiet and historical, with aged stone, carved inscriptions, traditional roof details, and leafless trees giving the scene a solemn, preserved character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统石灯笼和石碑的摄影图像。前景中，一排石灯笼以其圆润的球形顶部和细长的杆身引人注目，它们排列整齐，形成了一种宁静而庄严的氛围。在这些灯笼旁边，有一块刻有日文字符的石碑，上面的文字似乎是一种祈祷或纪念文字。背景中，可以看到一座蓝色的建筑，其传统的日式屋顶设计与前景形成了和谐的对比。

caption:
The image shows a person in a cozy indoor setting, likely a bedroom, dressed in a white bathrobe with a thick, textured terry-cloth appearance. Their hair is wrapped up in a large white towel, twisted and folded around the head in a spa-like style. The person’s face is intentionally blurred, but they appear to be seated or standing near a bed while drinking from a small white teacup.

They hold the teacup close to their mouth with one hand, as if taking a sip. The cup is delicate and porcelain-like, decorated with a subtle gold ornamental swirl pattern around the outside. In the other hand, they hold a matching white saucer with a thin gold ring near the center. Their fingernails are painted a dark reddish or burgundy color, adding a small contrast against the white cup and robe.

The robe is off-white or cream-colored, with wide sleeves and a belted waist. Its fabric looks soft and absorbent, reinforcing a relaxed, freshly bathed or spa-morning atmosphere. A small necklace or pendant is faintly visible at the neckline.

The background is softly out of focus. Behind the person is a bed with light-colored bedding, possibly white or pale gray. There are pillows on the bed, including one warm tan or beige round pillow on the right side and a mustard-yellow cushion toward the left. The wall behind the bed is a muted gray, decorated with framed artwork or photos in simple white frames. The overall lighting is soft and natural, giving the scene a calm, comfortable, and serene mood, like a quiet morning routine or self-care moment at home.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常生活场景的照片，其中一位女性穿着白色浴袍和头巾，正坐在沙发上喝着咖啡。她的右手拿着一个白色的杯子，左手拿着一个空的白色盘子。背景中可以看到一些家居装饰品，如挂在墙上的画作和沙发上的抱枕。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque riverside or lakeside scene at golden hour, with warm sunset light casting an amber glow over everything.

At the center-left is a large, historic-looking stone building, possibly a manor house or country hotel. It has a symmetrical façade, tall rectangular windows, and a dark roof with chimneys. The stonework is honey-brown, matching the warm tones of the sky. The building sits on a small landscaped island or raised embankment, bordered by a low stone wall that meets the water.

A large mature tree dominates the left side of the scene. Its branches spread widely across the sky, with autumn-colored leaves in shades of gold, brown, and orange. Some upper branches are bare, adding a delicate silhouette against the bright clouds. On the right side, more trees and dense greenery frame the scene, creating a lush garden-like atmosphere.

A graceful iron footbridge extends from the lower right foreground toward the building. The bridge has dark metal railings with wavy vertical bars and arched supports underneath. Its curve leads the eye into the image, toward the manor and the entrance area. Near the bridge and building, two flags fly from tall poles—one appears to be the Union Jack, while another blue-and-white flag hangs below or nearby.

The water in the foreground is calm and reflective, mirroring the bridge, trees, building, stone wall, and glowing sky. The reflections are slightly rippled, creating a painterly effect. The sky is filled with large, soft clouds illuminated in peach, pink, cream, and lavender tones, suggesting either sunrise or sunset.

Overall, the image has a romantic, tranquil, and elegant atmosphere, combining historic architecture, autumn foliage, still water, and dramatic warm light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光与建筑的摄影作品，画面中心是一座古典风格的两层建筑，其上飘扬着一面旗帜。一座拱形石桥横跨在平静的水面上，桥上的栏杆呈现出细腻的铁艺装饰。左侧有一棵高大的树木，树叶呈现出秋天特有的金黄色调。背景中天空被夕阳染成了温暖的橙红色，云朵被阳光照得格外明亮。水面平静如镜，反射出桥梁和建筑的倒影，增添了一份宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a young child standing outdoors on sandy ground in bright daylight. The child’s face is intentionally blurred, and they are centered in the frame, photographed from head to feet.

They are wearing a vivid, traditional-style outfit made from patterned fabric in bright blue, orange, green, black, and white. The clothing includes a loose short-sleeved top and a long matching skirt or wrap that reaches down to the ankles. The fabric has bold geometric and decorative motifs, including dotted blue sections, orange-and-black patterned panels, and green striped shapes.

Over the head and shoulders, the child wears a white head covering or veil. It has scalloped edges with blue embroidered floral and wave-like designs along the border. Small reflective embellishments or sequins are scattered across the white fabric. One hand is raised near the face, partly covering the blurred area, while the other arm hangs down naturally. The child wears small beaded bracelets on both wrists and dark flip-flop sandals.

The setting appears to be a sandy courtyard or open village area. The ground is pale tan with visible footprints, tire-like marks, and small bits of grass or debris. In the softly blurred background, there are beige buildings with doors and windows, a large tree trunk and branches, and indistinct objects that look like motorcycles or bicycles. A person in bright yellow clothing is also visible in the distance, but out of focus. The overall image has warm colors and a shallow depth of field, keeping attention on the child and their colorful clothing.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位穿着传统非洲服饰的女性的照片。她站在一个开阔的沙地上，身穿一件蓝色底色带有绿色和橙色图案的传统长裙，头戴白色头巾，并且戴着黑色的手镯。她的表情不可见，因为脸部被模糊处理了。背景中可以看到一些模糊的人影和远处的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows a moody, low-light close-up of a beer can and a glass on a dark tabletop, photographed with a shallow depth of field.

On the right side of the frame is a tall black aluminum beer can, sharply in focus compared with the background. The label reads **“SILVA”** in large cream-colored letters on a red rectangular band. Above it, the can says **“NEAGRĂ LEGENDARĂ”**, **“7% ALC. VOL.”**, and **“LAGER NEGRU PREMIUM.”** Near the bottom, it includes **“BERE CRAFT”** and **“AUTENTIC ROMÂNEASCĂ,”** suggesting a Romanian craft dark lager. The can has a worn, speckled graphic style with cream-colored line art and decorative framing. Small condensation droplets are visible on the can’s surface, adding to the cold, freshly opened feel. The pull tab at the top is visible, slightly catching the warm light.

To the left of the can, partially lower in the frame, is a short clear glass filled with a very dark beer or stout-like liquid. A thin beige foam ring clings to the inside of the glass near the surface, with streaks and bubbles visible along the glass walls. The glass is slightly out of focus compared to the can, but its thick base and transparent sides are still recognizable.

The background is heavily blurred, creating large circular bokeh lights in warm red and orange tones. Several bright red circles appear behind and above the can, while softer amber and dark brown areas fill the rest of the scene. This gives the image a cozy bar or nightlife atmosphere. The lighting is warm, dramatic, and cinematic, with strong contrast between the illuminated can label and the dark surroundings.

Overall, the photo emphasizes the beer can as the main subject, with the glass and red bokeh lights contributing to a rich, intimate, late-evening mood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Silva啤酒的摄影作品，焦点放在了啤酒罐上，其标签清晰地展示了品牌名称和一些文字信息。在罐子旁边是一个装有啤酒的透明玻璃杯，两者都放置在一个光滑的表面上。背景中模糊的红色光斑为图片增添了一种节日或庆祝的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunny seaside beach scene, likely at a Mediterranean-style resort or coastal town.

In the foreground, there is a wide stretch of sandy beach with visible footprints and patches of dry grass or seaweed scattered across the sand. Rows of blue lounge chairs are arranged facing the water, many of them paired beneath thatched straw parasols. Some people are sunbathing, sitting, or relaxing on the loungers, while others stand or move near the shoreline. The beach appears moderately busy but not overcrowded.

On the left side, the calm blue sea meets the sand with small waves lapping at the shore. Several straw umbrellas extend close to the waterline. Farther out and across the bay, a small marina or dock area is visible with boats and yachts moored along the coast.

The background is dominated by dry, rocky hills or low mountains. The terrain looks arid, with brown and beige tones, sparse vegetation, and exposed rock formations. A few thin structures or antenna-like poles can be seen on the hilltops. The sky above is clear and bright blue, suggesting a hot, sunny day with little to no cloud cover.

On the right side of the image, large green trees provide shade over a wooden beachside café or bar area. The structure has a wooden railing and seating underneath the trees, with people gathered inside or around it. A thatched roof or palm-frond covering is also visible near the café area. In the lower right corner, two bicycles are parked against or near the wooden structure, adding to the relaxed seaside atmosphere.

Overall, the image captures a warm, leisurely beach setting with sunbeds, umbrellas, calm water, a rugged hillside backdrop, and a shaded beachfront café.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩休闲活动的现实主义风格照片。前景中，沙滩上排列着多把遮阳伞和躺椅，人们在休息或晒太阳。一排树木位于画面右侧，而左侧则有一辆红色自行车靠在树旁。背景中，可以看到一座山丘和一片宁静的海洋，海面上有几艘船只。整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一个轻松愉快的度假氛围。

caption:
The image shows a covered outdoor corridor or veranda with two old public payphones mounted along a row of cream-colored square columns. The payphones are brightly colored, mainly green and orange, with large yellow front panels. Each phone has a black handset attached by a coiled metal cord, a keypad, a small display area, and a slot near the top for inserting a phone card. The visible branding on the phones reads “TOT,” indicating a Thai telecommunications company, and some of the instructions on the phone are in Thai with small English labels such as “insert TOT card here.”

The closer payphone dominates the left side of the image. It is mounted on a metal stand and has a worn, slightly weathered appearance, with scratches and dark marks around the card slot and handset area. A vertical metal tube or support with ribbed collars runs beside it. Below the main phone unit is a larger orange-and-green base section with a coin or access panel.

Farther down the corridor, a second similar payphone is mounted near another column. It is also green, orange, and yellow, with the handset hanging on the front. Beneath it is a small metal shelf or table attached to the structure, likely for placing belongings while using the phone.

Between the two phones, on the central column, there is a red-and-white “no smoking” sign with a cigarette symbol crossed out. The corridor has decorative elements: dark wooden railings with turned balusters on the right, patterned tile flooring in reddish and cream tones, and ornate gold trim visible along the ceiling edge.

Beyond the railing and columns, a street scene is visible in bright daylight. There are trees, utility poles, traffic lights, a road with vehicles, and a pedestrian walking in the distance. The overall setting appears to be a public building or station-like area in Thailand, with traditional architectural details and older public telephone equipment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两个公用电话亭的照片。左侧的电话亭颜色为绿色和橙色，顶部有泰文标识，而右侧的电话亭则呈现黄色和绿色。它们都安装在建筑物外墙上，旁边有一个禁止吸烟的标志。背景中可以看到一条街道和一些树木，表明这些电话亭位于一个开放的公共空间内。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a small, busy barbershop. A barber stands in the center with his back mostly turned to the camera, trimming a customer’s hair using electric clippers and a green comb. The customer is seated in a barber chair on the right side, covered with a white cutting cape that has pinkish stains or patterns on it. Only the back and side of the customer’s head are visible as the barber works carefully around the hairline.

The shop feels compact and crowded, with many objects packed into the space. In the foreground, slightly out of focus, there are several dark leather or vinyl barber chairs with metal frames and armrests. A blue cloth or towel is draped over one of the chairs. The perspective is partly obstructed by blurred vertical edges on the far left and right, making it feel as if the viewer is looking into the shop through a doorway or narrow opening.

Behind the barber, large mirrors line the wall, reflecting the shop interior and another person seated farther back. The mirrors are framed with ornate gold-colored trim, giving the shop a decorative, slightly old-fashioned look. Shelves above the mirrors hold hair-care products, including boxes with model photos on them, bottles, and other grooming supplies. Fluorescent tube lights are mounted above and reflected in the mirrors, creating bright white bands of light across the scene.

On the left side, a counter is cluttered with barber tools and products: spray bottles, containers, hair products, cords, and possibly an electric trimmer or clipper lying on the surface. There are also large plastic water bottles and metal containers visible on the shelves. A deep red curtain hangs near the center-left, adding a strong vertical color accent and partially dividing the workspace.

The overall atmosphere is practical and lived-in, with a mix of reflective mirrors, worn chairs, grooming tools, and product displays. The image captures a candid moment of everyday work inside a traditional neighborhood barbershop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示理发师在工作中的现实主义风格照片。理发师穿着深色上衣，正在专注地为一位顾客剪发。顾客坐在椅子上，头部被一块白色的布覆盖，似乎是在等待或刚刚完成理发过程。背景中可以看到理发店内部的环境，包括镜子、各种美发用品和挂在墙上的广告牌。

caption:
The image shows a wide, wintry outdoor scene on a large frozen surface, likely a lake or outdoor skating area. The ice stretches across the foreground and midground, covered with many pale skate marks and scratches that catch the sunlight. The surface looks mostly smooth but lightly frosted, with scattered small dark specks and bits of debris.

In the background, a dense line of leafless trees borders the ice. Many of the trees appear to be birches with thin, pale trunks, mixed with darker evergreens and tall pines. The sky above is clear and pale blue, suggesting a cold but sunny day. Long shadows on the ice indicate the sun is fairly low.

Several people are spread across the ice. Near the center and left foreground, a group appears to be preparing or adjusting skating equipment. There are bags, boots, clothing, and other gear placed directly on the ice. One person in dark clothing is bent over, possibly helping a child or tightening skates. Another person stands nearby holding what looks like a hockey stick or skating pole. A small child in a light blue helmet is seated low on the ice or on a small support near the gear.

In the middle of the image, a few skaters are moving across the ice. One person wears a bright blue jacket and dark pants, another is in darker clothing, and another wears a light-colored jacket with a helmet. To the right of center, a person in dark clothing sits or leans on a low bench or box. The box has visible text on its side reading “fenno” with smaller text underneath.

On the right side, a person in a bright pink jacket and pink helmet stands on the ice near several bags and equipment laid out on the ground. Farther in the distance, another skater in blue is visible near the right edge, and one more skater in blue appears on the far left.

Overall, the scene feels like a casual public skating outing on a frozen lake or outdoor rink, with people of different ages skating, resting, and putting on gear in a quiet forested winter setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季户外活动的照片，几位穿着冬季服装的人在结冰的湖面上进行滑冰。前景中，一位穿着黑色外套和裤子的人正在调整自己的滑雪装备，旁边放着几件衣物。其他人物分布在画面中，有的站立，有的行走，他们似乎都在享受这个寒冷天气中的娱乐时光。背景是覆盖着积雪的树木和一片开阔的天空，整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一个宁静而活跃的冬日氛围。

caption:
The image shows a classroom or robotics lab setting where children appear to be working with LEGO-style robotics kits at computer stations.

In the foreground on the right, a young child with long hair is seated at a white desk. Their face is intentionally blurred, and they are wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt. In front of them is a partially assembled small wheeled robot made from light gray and white plastic building pieces, with black rubber tires and visible axles/connectors. The child’s hands are near the robot, suggesting they may be assembling, adjusting, or testing it.

To the left of the child is a desktop computer setup. A large monitor, keyboard, and wired mouse sit on the desk. The monitor appears to display a robotics or programming interface with a graphic of a small vehicle/robot on the screen. A black keyboard is positioned diagonally in the foreground, and a smartphone with a red or pink case lies flat on the desk near the keyboard.

In the center of the table is a large red compartmentalized tray filled with assorted robotics parts—white beams, connectors, pins, small black pieces, and other mechanical components. The tray is organized into multiple sections, though some pieces are scattered within them.

In the background, another child wearing a dark hoodie is seated at a neighboring workstation. They appear to be reaching toward another red parts tray or working with components at the desk. Additional monitors, keyboards, wires, and robotics materials are visible, giving the impression of a hands-on STEM, coding, or robotics workshop.

The overall scene is brightly lit and slightly warm-toned, with a shallow depth of field: the foreground child, robot, and desk are clearer, while the background is more blurred. The image conveys an educational environment focused on building and programming small robots.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示科技教育活动的照片，前景中一个小孩正专注地操作一台电脑，旁边是一个由积木部件组成的机械车辆模型。在背景中，可以看到其他孩子也在进行类似的活动，他们坐在桌前，手中拿着各种电子设备和编程工具。整个场景传达出一种学习和创造的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the upper interior of an ornate church or concert hall, viewed from below and centered on a large pipe organ mounted on a balcony.

A dark wooden balustrade stretches horizontally across the lower third of the image, with many turned spindle railings and a slightly projecting curved central section. Behind it rises an elaborate pipe organ. The organ has multiple vertical silver-toned pipes arranged in groups, framed by carved dark wood. The central tower of pipes is taller, flanked by shorter pipe clusters on both sides. Decorative carved panels, scrollwork, and rounded wooden bases give the organ a historic, Baroque or classical appearance.

Above the organ is a high arched ceiling painted in muted gray-brown tones. The ceiling is richly decorated with raised gold ornamentation. Curving gilded borders form large sweeping arcs and oval shapes, framing symmetrical floral and vine motifs. Grape clusters, leaves, curling tendrils, and floral garlands appear on both sides, creating a balanced, ornamental design. Near the center of the ceiling is a circular medallion with concentric rings, floral detailing, and a small dark emblem or religious symbol at its center.

The side walls are pale yellow or cream, with classical architectural moldings and white decorative trim. Tall pilasters and cornices frame the space, and ornate capitals are visible near the bottom edge. Small wall-mounted speakers or fixtures appear on both side walls. The lighting is dim and warm, giving the scene a subdued, reverent atmosphere. The composition is symmetrical, emphasizing the grandeur of the organ and the decorative ceiling above it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂内部的摄影作品，焦点是一个位于房间中央的大型管风琴。管风琴设计精美，拥有多个层叠的键盘和复杂的机械结构，显示出其功能性和艺术性。它被安置在一个装饰华丽的栏杆上，栏杆的顶部是精美的雕刻和浮雕。背景中，天花板上的金色装饰品和墙面上的壁画增添了空间的艺术氛围。

caption:
The image shows a rustic alpine-style chalet set in a lush green mountain landscape. The house sits partially behind a sloping meadow in the foreground, so only the upper part of the building and balcony are fully visible.

The building is mostly made of warm brown wood, with a broad, steeply pitched roof that extends far outward on both sides. The front façade has decorative carved wooden details, including patterned trim under the roofline and diamond-shaped woodwork near the upper corners. A long wooden balcony runs across the front, decorated with several flower boxes filled with pink, purple, red, and white flowers. Beneath the roof peak are small square windows, and larger windows with curtains line the main floor.

On the right side of the chalet is a white plaster section with a bay-like projection and framed windows. Text on this white wall appears to read “Ferienwohnungen” above “BERGER HÄUSL,” suggesting it is a holiday apartment or guesthouse. At the top of the roof ridge is a small ornate wooden cupola or decorative turret, giving the chalet a traditional, picturesque appearance.

The foreground is a bright green meadow filled with tall grass, wild plants, and small flowers. A few weathered wooden fence posts stand unevenly across the field, and a pale wooden fence is partly visible on the left edge.

Behind the house is a dense wall of trees, mostly leafy green deciduous trees, with darker coniferous forest visible higher up the hillside in the background. The scene feels quiet, rural, and mountainous, with soft daylight and an overcast or lightly clouded sky giving the colors a muted, natural look.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于郁郁葱葱的自然环境中的传统木制房屋的照片。房屋具有典型的欧洲风格，拥有棕色的屋顶和白色的墙面，装饰有花盆和阳台栏杆。房屋前有一片绿色的草地，草地上散布着一些野花。在房屋的背后是茂密的树木，为这个场景增添了一种宁静而和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a transparent dome-shaped umbrella, viewed from slightly below or at eye level. The umbrella is made of clear plastic panels with visible seams and curved ribs running over the top. Across the center of the umbrella is a bold printed message: **“I ♥ RAIN”**. The letter **“I”** and the word **“RAIN”** are in large black serif lettering, while the heart symbol is bright red and placed between them.

The umbrella has a soft pink border or trim around the lower edge, giving it a playful, pastel look. The clear plastic surface reflects light and surrounding shapes, creating glossy highlights and subtle distortions. Some panels show faint wrinkles and reflections, emphasizing the flexible plastic material.

In the background, the scene is blurred with a shallow depth of field. There are hints of storefront or indoor/outdoor retail displays, including indistinct red and blue graphics on the left side. The overall color palette is light and cheerful, dominated by transparent blue-tinted plastic, pink trim, red lettering, and soft background tones. The image feels bright, whimsical, and rain-themed, focusing attention on the umbrella’s decorative message.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示透明雨伞的照片，伞面中央有一个红色的心形图案和黑色的文字“I love RAIN”，传达出对雨的喜爱。伞的边缘装饰着粉色的布条，整体设计简洁而现代。背景虽然模糊，但可以隐约看出是城市街道的一部分，有商店的招牌和其他模糊的人影。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor sculpture of the euro currency symbol (€) in a modern financial district. The sculpture dominates the foreground: it is a glossy, vivid blue euro sign mounted upright on two cylindrical metal supports. Around the symbol are several large, three-dimensional yellow-gold stars, arranged like the circle of stars on the European Union flag. Some stars are attached around the upper arc and sides of the euro sign, while others appear lower around the base, giving the monument a bold, emblematic look.

Behind the sculpture rises a cluster of tall office skyscrapers with glass-and-steel façades. The buildings have many repeating rectangular windows, reflecting the pale blue sky and creating a grid-like pattern. The tallest structures fill most of the background, emphasizing an urban financial-center atmosphere. On the left side, one tower has a rounded vertical section and a construction crane or antenna near the top. Other buildings vary in color from silver and light gray to darker blue glass and brownish façades.

At the bottom of the scene, there is a landscaped plaza with green grass, shrubs, and trees. A few small pedestrians can be seen walking along paths near the base of the sculpture, giving a sense of the monument’s large scale. There are also café or restaurant elements near the lower right, including umbrellas, outdoor seating, and signage partly visible behind the sculpture.

The lighting is bright and clear, suggesting daytime with good weather. The sky is mostly blue, and the sunlight reflects strongly off the glass towers and the polished blue surface of the euro symbol. Overall, the image conveys a strong association with European finance, banking, and the euro currency, set against a backdrop of modern high-rise architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于城市中心的欧元符号雕塑的照片。雕塑由蓝色和金色构成，呈现出显著的三维效果，并被放置在一片绿色的草地上。背景中是几座现代风格的高楼大厦，其中一座建筑顶部有一个突出的尖塔结构。阳光照耀下，整个场景显得生机勃勃且色彩鲜明。

caption:
The image shows a wide, open roadway in a lush urban park or recreational area. In the foreground, an elderly couple walks toward the camera in the middle of the road. Their faces are intentionally blurred, and both are wearing face masks.

The man, on the left, has short gray hair and is dressed in a short-sleeved, vertically striped button-up shirt with gray trousers and black shoes. He is using a walking cane in his right hand, suggesting he may need support while walking. The woman, on the right, is holding onto his arm. She is wearing a light pink headscarf, a pale long-sleeved tunic-style top, dark pants, and black shoes. She also has a greenish face mask.

They appear to be walking calmly together, close and coordinated, giving the scene a gentle, supportive feeling.

The background is filled with dense green trees and foliage, creating a park-like atmosphere. Several tall white lamp posts line the road. Many other people are scattered throughout the scene: some are walking, jogging, or standing in small groups, while others appear farther away along the road and near the trees. The road is broad and mostly free of vehicles, with white lane markings visible on the asphalt. Near the bottom right, partial white lettering is painted on the road, though it is not fully readable.

The lighting is soft and slightly hazy, suggesting an overcast day or early morning/late afternoon conditions. The background is somewhat blurred, keeping the focus on the elderly couple in the foreground while still showing the busy, green public space around them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位老人在公园中散步的照片。男性老人穿着淡色衬衫和深色裤子，戴着口罩，而女性老人则穿着格子衬衫、黑色长裤和粉色头巾，也戴着口罩。他们沿着公园的人行道行走，周围是其他行人和绿色的树木。阳光透过树叶洒在地面上，营造出一个宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, slightly diagonal photo of a computer screen showing a web browser window open to a Google OAuth/consent-related page for “rivals.”

Key details:

- The browser tab at the top says “Connecting…” with a small loading spinner, suggesting the page is still loading or redirecting.
- The address bar shows a secure Google URL beginning with `https://google-oauth.com/collectConsent?...`, with a green padlock icon indicating HTTPS.
- Browser navigation icons are visible, including a back arrow and other toolbar controls.
- The webpage itself has a bold blue header with the large white word “rivals” partially visible.
- Below the header is a consent screen starting with the large text “Before you continue…”
- The body text mentions that “Rivals is now part of the Oath family” and refers to cookies, ads, search, location data, data uses, and choices, suggesting a privacy/cookie consent notice.
- The image is photographed at an angle, making the browser window appear tilted.
- The screen’s pixel/grid pattern is visible, giving the photo a textured, close-up monitor appearance.
- The overall color palette is dominated by deep blue, white, gray browser chrome, and black text.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张显示Rivals网站主页的图片，页面顶部有品牌标志和导航栏。页面中央是蓝色背景上的白色文字，标题为'Before you continue... Rivals is now part of the Oath family. Due to EU data protection laws, we need to set cookies on your device to collect information about your interests and preferences, measure ads on our products, offer suggestions, and improve our services.'

caption:
The image shows an outdoor monument in a landscaped garden or courtyard on a bright sunny day.

At the center is a bronze-colored bust mounted on a tall white stone pedestal. The bust depicts a man in an ornate military-style uniform with epaulettes, medals, decorative cords, and a prominent star-shaped order on the chest. The face of the bust appears intentionally blurred or obscured, while the rest of the sculpture remains sharp and detailed. Below the bust is a sculpted ornamental crest or monogram.

The pedestal is clean, white, and classical in style, with a square base and decorative scroll-like supports near the lower sides. On the front of the pedestal is a gold-colored inscription in Cyrillic. It reads as a dedication to “Государь Император Святой Страстотерпец Николай II,” with dates “1868–1918” and reign years “1894–1917,” indicating it is a monument to Emperor Nicholas II.

The monument stands on a paved circular area made of stone tiles. The circular paving pattern is visible around the base, with lighter stone in the center and darker gray tiles forming an outer ring.

Behind the monument is a low stone retaining wall with steps or layered stonework. Dense greenery surrounds the area: leafy trees and shrubs fill most of the background, with some vines and bare branches visible on the right. The sunlight is strong, casting crisp shadows of leaves and branches across the wall and pavement. Patches of clear blue sky can be seen through the treetops, giving the scene a serene, well-maintained garden atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于户外的雕塑的照片。雕塑坐落在一个白色的基座上，基座上方刻有金色的文字和图案。雕塑本身是一个无头的人物形象，其姿态似乎在行走或跳跃。背景中有一堵石墙和一些树木，阳光透过树叶投射在雕塑和基座上，形成了树影。

caption:
The image is a close-up portrait of a young child with long, light brown hair, wearing a pale pink short-sleeved T-shirt. The child’s face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial details and expression, but the head is facing forward toward the camera.

The child is holding a bright red toothbrush in one hand, with the brush end positioned near the mouth, suggesting they may be brushing their teeth or posing with a toothbrush. The hand and toothbrush are in the lower-left area of the frame, with the toothbrush angled diagonally upward toward the face.

The background is a soft, out-of-focus green wall or surface, giving the image a calm, simple appearance. The lighting is bright and even, with a gentle natural look. The composition focuses mainly on the child’s upper body, face area, hand, and toothbrush, with the pink shirt and red toothbrush standing out against the muted green background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位年轻女孩手持红色笔的特写照片。女孩穿着一件粉色T恤，头发披肩，面部特征被模糊处理以保护隐私。背景是均匀的绿色调，为人物提供了一个简洁而不分散注意力的背景。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban intersection or traffic circle in a city, viewed from the middle of a broad roadway. The scene is dominated by an expansive cloudy sky, with thick gray-white cloud cover and a few patches of blue showing through near the horizon. Several overhead utility or trolley wires stretch across the sky, including long horizontal lines and vertical cables descending near the center.

In the foreground, there is a large asphalt road surface with multiple lanes, white lane markings, and a striped painted divider area. The pavement appears worn, with visible cracks and darker patches. Cars are moving through the intersection in different directions, including a dark red sedan in the lower right foreground, several black and gray cars near the center, and a small white vehicle farther right. Traffic appears moderate but orderly.

At the center of the intersection is a landscaped roundabout or island with grass, low flowerbeds, and curbs painted in alternating black and white. In the middle of this island stands a tall pedestal topped by a dark statue of a standing human figure. The statue faces slightly to the left and is positioned in front of a large pale building.

The central building in the background is a light pink or off-white historic-looking structure with a prominent arched opening through its middle. It has multiple arched windows on the upper floor, decorative trim, and a somewhat weathered façade. Behind and around it are other low-rise buildings in muted colors, including yellow and beige structures.

On both sides of the street are dense green trees, framing the intersection. To the left, there is a large rectangular digital billboard or signboard standing near the sidewalk. Numerous traffic signs are visible throughout the scene, especially pedestrian crossing signs with bright yellow-green borders. Streetlights with curved arms rise from the central island, and more cables crisscross above the roads, suggesting trolleybus or tram infrastructure.

The overall atmosphere is that of a busy city square on an overcast day, with a mix of historic architecture, public monuments, trees, traffic, and overhead urban wiring.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一座具有古典建筑特征的大楼，其立面装饰着精致的雕花和窗户。街道上车辆来往频繁，包括轿车、货车和公交车，它们沿着道路标线行驶。天空中布满了蓬松的白云，而几根电线横跨在画面上方，为这个城市场景增添了一些现代元素。

caption:
The image shows a busy entrance to a Japanese shrine, likely a Shinto shrine, on a bright sunny day. A large vivid vermilion-red torii gate dominates the foreground, with thick cylindrical pillars and a horizontal crossbeam spanning the top. Black Japanese characters are painted on the gate’s vertical supports. The glossy red surface catches the sunlight, creating bright highlights and shadows.

On both sides of the gate are stone fox statues, associated with Inari shrines. Each fox stands on a carved stone pedestal and wears a red bib-like cloth around its neck. The fox on the left is seen from behind at an angle, with its tail raised prominently, while the fox on the right stands elevated near the gate’s right pillar. The stone bases beneath them have engraved Japanese characters.

Beyond the torii gate, a broad stone staircase rises upward into a shaded, tree-filled shrine complex. Many visitors are walking up and down the steps. In the background, smaller shrine structures with orange-red and dark roof details are visible among dense green foliage. The trees surrounding the path are lush, with some leaves showing hints of yellow and orange, suggesting autumn.

The foreground is crowded with people, including several wearing colorful traditional Japanese kimono or yukata. Three people in the center foreground stand out: one wears a pale blue kimono with orange and white floral patterns, another wears a yellow kimono with large pink and white flowers, and another wears a red-and-white checkered kimono with floral accents and a green obi. Other visitors wear modern clothing such as jackets, skirts, backpacks, and casual shirts. A person on the far right appears to be wearing a pale pink kimono with decorative hair ornaments.

To the left of the walkway, many folded white paper fortunes, or omikuji, are tied to a rack or fence, forming a dense cluster of white strips. The ground is a mix of stone paving and gravel, with the main path leading directly through the torii gate and up the steps.

Overall, the scene is lively and festive, combining traditional shrine architecture, religious symbols, autumn greenery, and a crowd of tourists and visitors in both traditional and modern dress.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统节日或文化活动的摄影照片。图中，一群身着和服的人正从一个红色鸟居门前经过，鸟居上方悬挂着灯笼。人们穿着色彩鲜艳的传统服饰，有的还背着小包。他们似乎正在参加某种庆祝活动或仪式。在鸟居两侧，可以看到石碑上刻有文字，而背景中的树木为这个场景增添了一丝宁静与自然之美。

caption:
The image is a close-up, front-facing view of a vintage green car, likely a Soviet-era GAZ/Volga model, photographed outdoors in a parking area or car meet. The car dominates almost the entire frame, with the camera positioned low and slightly to the left, emphasizing the hood, windshield, grille, and left headlight.

The car is painted a muted dark green with a glossy but aged finish. The hood is broad and rounded, with subtle reflections and small marks or wear visible on the paint. At the front center of the hood is a chrome-and-red badge featuring the GAZ emblem, with a stylized deer inside a shield. Below it, the large chrome grille stretches across the front, made up of many vertical chrome slats set in a dark recess. The chrome bumper and trim pieces are visible along the lower edge, giving the car a polished classic look.

On the left side of the front end, a large round headlight sits in a chrome bezel. Beneath it is a rectangular turn signal or parking light with a clear lens and small fasteners visible. A chrome trim strip runs along the top of the front fender, pointing back toward the windshield. Near the headlight area, there is a small cursive-style chrome script badge on the fender.

The windshield is wide and curved, framed by thick chrome trim. Two windshield wipers rest horizontally near the base of the glass, with chrome arms. Inside the car, a pale steering wheel is visible on the right side of the image, suggesting the view is through the front windshield into the cabin. A small dangling ornament or tassel hangs near the rearview mirror. The glass has a slightly hazy reflection, softening the view of the interior.

The car’s roof is also green and rounded, with a thin antenna or rod rising near the center/top. Along the left side, the vehicle appears to have multiple side windows and doors, suggesting it may be a wagon or sedan variant. Chrome trim outlines the windows and runs along the body. The side mirror on the right side of the frame is small, round, and chrome, mounted on a thin stalk.

In the background, partially out of focus, other cars are parked nearby, including a dark modern-looking car and a white vehicle on the right edge. The sky is overcast and pale gray, giving the scene soft, diffused lighting. Overall, the image highlights the distinctive chrome detailing, rounded bodywork, and nostalgic character of a well-preserved classic green automobile.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆经典绿色汽车前部的摄影图像。汽车的前灯和格栅设计精致，车身线条流畅，车头中央有品牌标志。车辆停放在一个模糊的背景中，可能是停车场或展览场合。

caption:
The image shows a narrow old-city street with cobblestone paving, lined by tall historic buildings in warm earthy colors. The main building on the left has a muted orange plaster facade with a large, ornate stone doorway. The doorway is framed by pale gray, block-like masonry and topped with an arched decorative stone surround. Above the entrance hangs a black oval sign with gold lettering that reads “ADVOKAT,” indicating a lawyer’s office. Just to the right of the sign, a small glowing yellow plaque displays the number “15.”

The entrance itself has a dark wooden double door with a carved diagonal pattern, set beneath an arched transom window decorated with black wrought-iron scrollwork. Above the doorway, the stonework includes carved ornamental details and a curved metal or glass awning-like structure.

In the foreground, a black bicycle is parked leaning near the entrance and a metal utility box. The bike looks well-used, with a brown saddle cover, a rear rack, and reflectors or bright yellow bands attached near the back. Its front wheel is close to the metal box, and the frame stretches diagonally across the lower part of the image.

On the far left, there is a shop window with reflections and white text reading partly “STOCKHOLMS STADSMISSION” and “Second hand,” suggesting a secondhand store. A few candles or warm lights are visible near the bottom of the window.

The street continues into the background on the right, narrowing between tall buildings. The right-side building is also orange-toned, with gray-trimmed windows and a dark drainpipe running vertically along the facade. Farther down, the buildings become more gray and pale, emphasizing the tight, historic urban alleyway. The overall atmosphere feels European, quiet, and old-fashioned, with textured walls, worn stone, and uneven cobblestones adding character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，画面中心有一辆黑色的自行车停靠在街道旁。自行车旁边是一个带有'15'号门牌和'ADVOKAT'标识的拱形入口，上方有一个亮着灯的招牌。建筑物的外墙呈暖色调，与街道上的鹅卵石铺装形成对比。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, upward-angled view of a storefront on a city street. The main focus is a large dark green shop sign with raised pale cream lettering spelling **“HOLLAND & BARRETT”** in a bold serif style. The letters cast shadows, giving the sign a three-dimensional look, and there is an underline beneath parts of the name. The ampersand is decorative and curled.

Above the storefront is a cream or off-white stone building façade with textured masonry and rectangular window frames. A black horizontal trim or ledge separates the upper building from the shop sign. In one of the upper windows, there is a sign for **“BRITANNIA STUDENT SERVICES”**, with a small Union Jack-style logo and text including a phone number **“020 7436 7738”** and a website beginning with **“www.britanniatravel…”**.

Below the main sign, parts of the shopfront windows are visible. On the lower left, a bright poster or display includes another smaller **Holland & Barrett** logo and partial promotional text, along with the top of a person’s head or hair in an advertisement. On the right, a glass entrance or window reflects light, and inside there is a visible ceiling light fixture.

The photo is taken from below and at an angle, making the sign run diagonally across the frame from lower left to upper right. The lighting is bright daylight, with strong highlights on the cream building and shadows under the ledge and raised lettering.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示'HOLLAND & BARRETT'商店招牌的照片。招牌位于建筑物的外墙上，采用绿色背景和白色字体设计，上方还有一个较小的标志显示了店铺的名称。招牌下方是商店的玻璃门，透过门可以看到内部的一部分。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor display of military artillery pieces in a paved public area, likely part of a museum or memorial exhibit. In the foreground, several large dark green field guns or cannons dominate the scene. Their long barrels extend diagonally from the lower right toward the upper left, creating strong perspective lines across the image. The closest artillery piece has large rubber tires, a metal shield plate, exposed mechanical parts, and a towing arm extending toward the bottom right. Behind it, another similar gun is partially visible, aligned in the same direction.

A bright pink barrier tape runs around the artillery display, marking it off from visitors. Near the guns there is a small dark informational signboard with Cyrillic text, suggesting the equipment is labeled as part of an exhibit.

In the middle background stands a striking turquoise building with a rounded or polygonal shape and decorative vertical panels around its upper facade. On top of the building is a large sign in Russian/Cyrillic reading “КАФЕ” (“Cafe”) in big red letters. Above that, a smaller sign appears to read “VI КУРТИНА” or similar, also in Cyrillic. The vivid turquoise building contrasts strongly with the military equipment in front of it.

To the right of the cafe building, there is a white box truck parked near the curb. A green metal arch or framework structure is also visible nearby, possibly part of a walkway or decorative installation. A few people can be seen in the distance, appearing small compared to the foreground objects.

The setting is surrounded by green lawns, trees, and landscaped paths. The trees are leafy and springlike, with a mix of bright green foliage and darker evergreens. The sky is dramatic and bright, filled with large white and gray cumulus clouds against patches of vivid blue. The wide-angle perspective makes the artillery barrels appear especially long and imposing, while the colorful cafe and open park setting give the scene an unusual contrast between leisure space and military history.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的军事装备的照片，主要聚焦于两门并排放置的重型火炮。这些火炮位于一个开放空间内，周围有红色和白色的警戒线，可能表示这是一个军事展览或纪念场所。背景中有一座绿色建筑，上面有一个明显的红色标志写着'КАФЕ'（咖啡馆），表明这个地点可能是一个具有历史意义的公共场所。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor team-building or family-day activity on a sandy beach or open sandy ground. In the foreground, two people wearing matching dark green T-shirts are engaged in a close-up challenge. Both have bright light-green blindfolds tied around their heads; the person on the left also has a dark navy or black cloth covering their eyes, layered over the green band.

The person on the left is seen mostly from behind and in profile, with short dark hair and a green shirt. They appear to be holding or biting one end of a thin wooden stick or skewer. The person on the right, whose face is blurred, is leaning back slightly while also holding the other end of the stick near their mouth. Their hands are gripping the left person’s arm for balance or guidance. They are wearing a black wristwatch and a green T-shirt with yellow text that reads “It’s Family Day!” along with a sun and palm-tree style graphic.

The scene suggests a playful cooperative game, possibly involving blindfolded participants transferring or balancing an object using their mouths. The mood appears energetic and fun.

In the background, several other participants are visible but out of focus. They are also wearing dark green shirts, and some have colorful headscarves or blindfolds in green, orange, blue, or purple. A few people are standing and watching, while others appear to be taking part in similar activities. Behind them is a building with yellowish walls and a sloped roof, surrounded by trees. Farther back, green hills or mountains rise under a bright sky.

The lighting is strong and sunny, creating warm highlights on the sand and people’s clothing. The shallow depth of field keeps the two foreground participants prominent while the background is softly blurred. Overall, the image captures a lively outdoor group event focused on teamwork, games, and social interaction.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉户外活动瞬间的照片，显示了两位参与者在沙滩上进行某种团队协作游戏。一位参与者正用头巾遮住眼睛，另一位则伸出手臂协助他。他们身穿绿色T恤衫，上面印有'Its Family Day'的字样，表明这可能是一个家庭聚会或类似的集体活动。背景中可以看到其他穿着相同服装的人和一些山丘，营造出一种轻松愉快的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of the **Marina Bay Sands** hotel in Singapore, an iconic modern architectural landmark.

Three tall, rectangular glass towers dominate the scene. Each tower is covered in a grid of greenish-blue reflective windows, giving the buildings a sleek, metallic appearance. The towers rise vertically and are separated by open gaps, emphasizing their height and symmetry.

Resting across the tops of the three towers is a long, horizontal structure shaped like a massive ship or surfboard. This elevated deck extends beyond the towers on both ends, especially to the left, where it curves outward like the bow of a ship. The underside of the structure is smooth and rounded, with a silvery, patterned surface.

Along the top of this sky deck, small palm trees and landscaping are visible, suggesting a rooftop garden or pool area. There are also low white structures, railings, and terrace-like sections on the deck. Tiny silhouettes of people can be seen along the edge, helping convey the enormous scale of the building.

The background is filled with a pale, overcast sky with soft gray clouds, creating a muted atmosphere. At the bottom of the image, part of a lower convention or waterfront structure is visible, featuring white roof panels, angular canopies, and mast-like supports.

Overall, the image highlights the futuristic design of the Marina Bay Sands complex, with its three glass towers supporting a dramatic boat-shaped rooftop platform high above the city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的高楼的照片。建筑物具有独特的设计，由多个高塔组成，每个塔楼顶部都覆盖着绿色植被，给人一种自然与城市融合的感觉。塔楼表面反射出周围的环境，显示出玻璃幕墙的特点。照片背景是多云的天空和远处模糊的城市轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a quiet urban sidewalk or pedestrian corridor at night, lit by storefront lights and streetlamps. The scene is viewed from a low seated perspective, with the back of a wooden bench visible in the foreground at the bottom edge.

A long paved walkway stretches into the distance, creating strong perspective lines. Down the center-right of the walkway is a neat row of benches with black metal frames and wooden slats, receding toward the vanishing point. On the left side, more benches sit beneath dense trees with dark green leaves. A few people are seated there, including one person in a dark shirt leaning back on a bench.

The pavement is made of large dark gray tiles, slightly reflective in places as if damp or polished. A tactile guiding strip for visually impaired pedestrians runs along the walkway on the left side of the central path, made of raised parallel ridges.
