Near the right edge, a long drainage grate runs alongside the building frontage.

On the right side of the image is a row of buildings or shopfronts. The nearest storefront has bright blue textured pillars and walls, illuminated by cool white fluorescent lights mounted under the overhang. The lighting casts a bluish glow over the entrance area. Several carts and objects are parked or stored along the storefront: a large cart covered with orange tarp, another blue tarp-covered bundle, and a folded gray umbrella or canopy. Metal handrails lead up a small raised entrance area with wooden double doors farther inside.

The right side feels more brightly lit and commercial, while the left side is darker and shaded by trees. In the distance, small streetlights line the path, and warm lights from shops or vehicles glow further down the street. There are also several flags or banners along the walkway, some red and white, adding small vertical accents.

Overall, the image captures a calm nighttime city street scene: mostly empty, orderly, and quiet, with benches, trees, closed or partially closed storefronts, covered carts, and a long illuminated pedestrian path fading into the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道夜景的照片，画面中心有一排空无一人的长椅，排列在人行道上。左侧是一辆停靠的红色摩托车，右侧则是一辆装有橙色塑料布的蓝色货车。街道两侧是建筑物，其中一侧的墙面上涂有鲜艳的蓝色油漆。整个场景被夜晚的灯光照亮，营造出一种宁静而略带神秘的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene, likely in a market or commercial district. In the foreground, a truck or pickup bed is piled very high with large mesh sacks filled with garlic bulbs. The sacks are mostly purple netting with yellow bands, and they are stacked densely across the back of the vehicle, spilling visually across the lower half of the image. The truck’s side panels are bright yellow, with weathered wooden boards toward the rear.

A person wearing a light blue and white patterned head covering is partially visible behind the mound of garlic sacks, standing or sitting in the truck bed. Their face is blurred. Around the vehicle, parts of other cars are visible, including a dark car on the left and a dark green/blue vehicle on the right.

In the background are older shopfronts and building facades with metal shutters, awnings, and exposed utility wires running across the scene. One prominent sign on the right reads “hakiki” with smaller text underneath: “Jual Bahan Makanan & Minuman,” indicating a shop selling food and drink ingredients. There is also a blue tarp or canopy to the right, possibly covering a stall, with a beverage advertisement partially visible beneath it.

The lighting is bright and sunny, creating strong highlights on the garlic sacks and deep shadows under the awnings and vehicles. The image has a slightly tilted perspective, giving it a candid street-photography feel. Overall, it captures a market delivery or wholesale goods transport scene in a dense commercial area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道上日常生活的照片，焦点落在一堆紫色的货物上，它们被捆绑并堆放在一辆黄色的三轮车上。在车辆后方，一位穿着蓝色衣服的人正站在一排商店前，其中一家商店的招牌上写着'kakiki'。周围环境充满了各种广告牌和建筑结构，营造出一个典型的城市市场氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright urban residential scene, likely in South Korea, dominated by several tall apartment towers under a clear blue sky.

In the center and right of the image are large white and pale gray high-rise apartment buildings with many floors. The façades are lined with rows of rectangular windows, small balconies, railings, and numerous external air-conditioning units. The windows have a bluish-green tint, reflecting the sky. On the rightmost tower, the number “103” is visible near the upper side, suggesting a building number within the apartment complex. Another tower closer to the center appears to be marked “102.” Korean writing is visible vertically on some building sides.

Several black utility or power lines stretch horizontally across the upper and middle portions of the image, cutting across the buildings and sky. A streetlight extends in from the right side, and trees with green and slightly autumn-colored leaves frame the lower right and left edges.

At ground level, there is an entrance area to the apartment complex. A stone sign in the foreground reads in Korean, including “현대홈타운” (“Hyundai Home Town”), with “당산 2가” above it. Around the sign are landscaped shrubs, small trees, rocks, and flower beds with red and yellow flowers. A small guard booth or security kiosk with a green roof sits near the driveway entrance.

To the left, a driveway leads into the complex, with parked cars visible along the curb and a barrier gate at the entrance. On the lower right, there are low-rise commercial buildings with reddish-brown brick façades. Storefront signs in Korean are visible, including what appears to be an interior design shop. A blue bank ATM or small banking kiosk is also visible near the center-bottom area.

The lighting is strong and sunny, casting shadows on the buildings and ground. Overall, the scene depicts a clean, dense residential apartment complex with commercial shops and landscaped entrance features in a modern city neighborhood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市街景的照片，画面中心是一座多层的现代化公寓楼，其外观以白色和灰色为主色调。在公寓楼前方是一个带有红色屋顶的小型建筑，可能是一个商店或办公室。街道上有几辆汽车正在行驶，包括一辆红色的轿车和一辆白色的面包车。周围环境由绿色植被和一些树木点缀，为这个城市场景增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a wide, daylight view of a **Caltex gas station** with a large open forecourt and multiple fuel pumps under a red-and-gray canopy.

In the right half of the scene, the main station canopy dominates the view. It has a bright **red fascia** with large white **“CALTEX”** lettering near the front corner, and the underside is gray with evenly spaced lighting fixtures. Several cylindrical support columns hold up the roof. Beneath the canopy are red-and-white Caltex fuel pumps with hoses hanging neatly, pump-number signs, and small promotional displays. A white SUV is parked near one of the pumps, and there appears to be at least one person near the pump area.

To the left, there is a tall roadside Caltex sign with the red star logo at the top. The sign includes branding such as **Caltex**, **Techron**, **Delo**, and **LPG**, along with a digital fuel price board displaying several prices. Below and around it are many colorful promotional banners and signs, most of them written in **Thai script**. One sign advertises a **car wash**, and another nearby sign appears to mention **unique gas** or LPG. The station seems to be located in Thailand or a Thai-speaking area based on the lettering.

The forecourt is a large expanse of light-gray concrete with faint tire marks and painted curb edges. The curb in the foreground is painted alternating **red and white**, a common roadside marking. There are small landscaped areas with shrubs and greenery along the left foreground.

In the background, beyond the station, there are trees, low hills or mountains, and a pale blue sky filled with soft, scattered clouds. A large cylindrical water tank or tower is visible behind the canopy near the center-left. The overall atmosphere is bright, clean, and spacious, suggesting a modern highway or roadside service station on a sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Caltex加油站的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一个大型的红色屋顶结构，上方悬挂着Caltex的品牌标志。加油站内设有多个加油机和一些油罐，周围停放着几辆汽车。在加油站前方，有蓝色和白色的指示牌，上面写着'Pump 1'、'Pump 2'等字样，引导顾客到不同的加油区。背景中可以看到一片绿色植被和晴朗的蓝天，天空中有几朵白云。

caption:
The image is a very close-up, front-facing shot of a glossy racing helmet, likely a Formula 1-style helmet. The focus is on the helmet’s upper visor and forehead area, with a shallow depth of field causing the edges and lower portions to blur softly.

At the center is a transparent, slightly curved visor area with a frosted or speckled texture, covered in many tiny reflective droplets or glitter-like highlights. Behind or on the visor are sharp turquoise-blue angular graphics that form tall triangular streaks pointing upward and downward, giving the helmet a dynamic, aerodynamic look.

Near the top center, large stylized letters or numbers appear in metallic gold with a dark blue outline, resembling “S5” or “SS.” The gold finish is textured and reflective, standing out against the cool blue and silver background.

Across the middle of the helmet is a dark blue horizontal band. On this band is the Red Bull logo text: “Red Bull” in bold red letters with a white outline. Below that, in very large white block letters, the word “RENAULT” spans across the front of the helmet, though the bottom of the word is partially cut off and blurred by the framing.

The helmet has bright, colorful accent stripes around the upper edges—yellow and orange/red bands curve along both sides, adding warmth and contrast to the otherwise silver, blue, and white design. The glossy surface creates strong reflections and highlights, especially on the lower visor area, where the “Red Bull” text appears faintly reflected.

Overall, the image emphasizes branding, shine, and speed-oriented design, with a polished motorsport aesthetic dominated by metallic silver, deep blue, turquoise, red, white, and yellow-orange accents.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示赛车头盔特写的照片，头盔上印有'F1'字样和赛车手的编号'SS'。头盔表面覆盖着蓝色、白色和红色的图案，中间是'F1'标志，下方是'SS'数字和'Red Bull Renault'的品牌名称。照片通过鱼眼镜头拍摄，产生了明显的透视效果，使得头盔看起来更加突出且具有立体感。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of a modern city skyline beside a calm river, framed by lush parkland on both banks.

In the foreground, the river occupies much of the lower half of the scene. Its surface is gently rippled, reflecting the blue sky and the vertical shapes of the high-rise buildings in soft, wavy patterns. Along the near left bank, there is green grass and clumps of tall, dry reeds and rushes growing at the water’s edge.

On the left side, a sloping park area stretches along the river. Several people are visible in the distance, some walking on a path and others gathered or relaxing on the grass. Large leafy trees with dense green canopies provide shade, and branches partly frame the upper-left corner of the image.

Across the middle of the scene, a low bridge crosses the river horizontally. It has a simple, light-colored structure with evenly spaced supports underneath. Beyond the bridge, the skyline rises prominently, with a cluster of tall office and apartment towers. The buildings vary in design: some are blue-glass skyscrapers, others are beige or gray concrete towers, and one central building has a distinctive dark facade with vertical glass panels and antenna-like structures on top. Another building features a patterned, zigzag-like exterior.

On the right side, more trees and grassy areas line the riverbank, with sunlight illuminating the foliage in warm tones. A road or pathway is partially visible through the trees, with a few small signs and vehicles hinted at in the background.

The sky is clear and bright blue, suggesting a pleasant sunny day, likely in the late afternoon given the warm light and long shadows. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and scenic, combining urban architecture with natural riverside parkland.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线和河流景观的摄影作品。图像前景是郁郁葱葱的树木和草地，中景是一座桥梁横跨在平静的河面上，河水清澈见底，反射着对岸城市的高楼大厦。背景是现代城市的天际线，高楼大厦耸立，构成了一幅和谐的城市与自然共存的画面。

caption:
The image shows a pedestrian crossing road sign in the foreground, photographed from a slightly low angle. The sign is a square blue sign with a white border and a white triangular symbol in the center. Inside the triangle is a black pictogram of a person walking across stylized crosswalk markings, indicating a pedestrian crossing or zebra crossing area.

The sign appears slightly weathered, with a gray metal rim and a thick metal backing visible along the right edge. It is mounted on a vertical metal pole that extends downward out of the frame. The pole and sign have some minor dirt and wear, suggesting they are outdoors in an urban environment.

In the background, there is a large multi-story apartment or residential building. The building is out of focus, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect that emphasizes the road sign. The facade is light-colored, mostly beige or off-white, with many rows of rectangular windows. Some windows are darker, some reflect light, and a few appear to have curtains or colored panels. The repeated grid of windows gives the background a dense city-apartment feel.

The lighting is bright and natural, likely daylight. The overall composition centers attention on pedestrian safety, with the clear, bold blue sign standing out strongly against the softly blurred residential building behind it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示行人过街标志的照片，标志位于图像的中心，背景是模糊的城市建筑。标志为蓝色三角形，上面有一个白色的人形图案，代表行人过街的区域。

caption:
The image shows a bright indoor public transit or terminal area, possibly a ferry, bus, or train station. The scene is shot down a corridor with a shallow depth of field, making the foreground flags soft and blurred while the right side of the station entrance area is more visible.

On the left side, several flags are mounted along a metal railing. The closest flag is red and heavily out of focus, taking up a large portion of the foreground. Farther back, a Malaysian flag is visible, with its blue canton, yellow crescent, and red-and-white stripes, though it is also somewhat blurred. Another red flag hangs closer to the center-right, partially hidden by the bright light and railings.

The corridor has white walls, glass windows, and metal handrails, giving it a clean, institutional look. The lighting is very bright and slightly overexposed, especially on the left side, where sunlight or strong indoor lighting washes out some details. Reflections can be seen in the glass panels.

On the right side of the image, the station opens into a wider area with tiled flooring. A yellow tactile guidance strip runs along the floor, suggesting accessibility features for visually impaired passengers. There are metal queue barriers near an entrance or checkpoint area. Several people are gathered there; most appear to be wearing face masks. A few women are wearing hijabs and long dresses or robes, and one person in an orange shirt stands nearby. One woman in the foreground on the right appears to be walking while holding something in her hand.

Above the entrance area are blue signboards. One sign on the far upper right reads “Kodiang,” likely indicating a destination or platform/route. A green “KELUAR” sign, meaning “exit” in Malay, is mounted above a doorway. There is also a hanging electronic display board with red text, though the writing is too blurred to read clearly.

In the lower center of the image, a potted plant with long pale green leaves sits on the tiled floor, adding a small decorative element to the otherwise functional station environment. Another pot is partially visible at the bottom edge of the frame.

Overall, the image captures a quiet, bright station interior with flags along the walkway, signage in Malay, passengers near a gate or exit, and a clean modern transit-terminal atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常城市生活场景的照片，拍摄于一个室内公共空间。图像的前景中，有两面红色和黄色相间的马来西亚国旗在风中飘扬，旁边是一个装有绿色植物的棕色花盆。背景中，几位穿着休闲服装的人群正在通过一个旋转门进入或离开这个区域。他们似乎正在排队等待或交谈。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种平静而有序的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large, modern architectural building photographed from a low, wide-angle perspective, emphasizing its angular shape and scale. The structure appears to be a contemporary institutional, office, university, or medical/research building.

The building has a striking geometric design with several stacked and projecting volumes. Its façade is mostly composed of light gray and white rectangular panels arranged in an irregular, layered pattern. Many of these panels protrude slightly, creating a faceted, three-dimensional surface rather than a flat wall. The windows are rectangular and set into the façade in horizontal rows, with some recessed deeper than others. Small accent panels or window recesses in bright colors—especially orange and green—punctuate the otherwise neutral exterior, adding a playful contrast.

On the right side, a large upper block cantilevers outward over a glassy ground floor. Beneath it, the ground level is enclosed with tall, dark-framed glass walls, giving the lower portion a transparent, open appearance. A similar glass curtain wall extends along the front of the building, reflecting the surrounding trees and sky. Above the lower glass level is a terrace or balcony area with pale, translucent glass railings.

The central upper portion of the building is a long, horizontal volume that stretches diagonally from left to right across the image. It is clad in smooth metallic gray panels and has a long dark band of narrow horizontal windows or louvers running along its side. This upper section bridges or connects the two lower wings, giving the whole structure a dynamic, layered composition.

In the foreground, there is a broad paved walkway made of light gray rectangular paving stones. It curves gently through a landscaped area with grass on both sides. Several young trees with thin trunks and early spring buds are planted near the building. The lawn is mostly green with some brown patches, suggesting early spring or recently maintained grounds.

To the left, a smaller older-looking building edge is partially visible, contrasting with the modern architecture. In the background to the right, there are leafing trees and what appears to be an old brick or stone wall, adding a more natural and historical context around the futuristic building.

The sky is bright and partly cloudy, with soft white clouds spread across a pale blue background. The overall lighting is even and natural, suggesting daytime with mild sunlight. The scene feels clean, spacious, and contemporary, highlighting the building’s bold, modern design and its integration into a landscaped campus-like environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的图像，建筑物采用了几何形状和色彩块的设计，具有明显的现代感。建筑前有一片绿色草坪，旁边是人行道，而背景中可以看到一些树木和蓝天白云。

caption:
The image shows a large, traditional-looking monastery or historic building set in a sunny mountain courtyard. The structure stretches horizontally across most of the frame, with a long wooden balcony running along the entire upper level. The balcony has dark brown wooden railings, thick vertical posts, and a deep overhanging roof with exposed beams beneath it. Several blue vertical banners hang from the balcony area; they appear to feature religious icon imagery and decorative gold lettering or symbols.

The lower façade is richly decorated with painted panels and fresco-like designs. The wall is divided into many rectangular sections outlined in reddish-brown trim. Some sections imitate stone blocks or marble textures in muted grays, creams, pinks, and earthy tones. Others contain large geometric diamond patterns, ornamental borders, and small framed scenes. Near the center is an arched painted panel above a dark wooden doorway, showing a religious or historical scene with figures and architectural elements. Additional oval and rectangular painted scenes appear farther along the wall.

At ground level, the main entrance is a heavy dark wooden double door, set beneath a small wall-mounted lantern. Two tall potted evergreen shrubs flank the doorway. To the right of the entrance are several small wooden kiosk-like stands or display booths with pale roofs. The courtyard itself is paved with irregular cobblestones, giving the foreground a textured, old-world appearance.

On the right side of the image, a small landscaped garden area is bordered by a low stone wall. It contains bright green grass, trimmed shrubs, small palms or ornamental plants, and reddish foliage. A leafy tree partially frames the right edge of the scene. A few people are visible near the far-right side of the building, small in scale compared with the architecture.

Behind the building, forested mountains rise steeply, covered in dense green trees. The sky is clear and pale blue, and the strong sunlight creates bright highlights on the courtyard stones and the building’s painted façade. There is also a visible lens flare near the upper middle-right area, adding a warm, sunlit glow to the scene. Overall, the image conveys a peaceful, historic religious courtyard surrounded by lush mountain scenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示东正教修道院建筑的照片。建筑物的外墙装饰着色彩鲜艳且图案复杂的壁画，其中包括几何图形、花卉和宗教象征性图案。屋顶由木梁支撑，部分区域覆盖着瓦片。建筑前有一条石板铺成的小路，两旁种植着绿色植物和一些花朵。在建筑后方可以看到郁郁葱葱的山丘，为这个场景增添了一抹自然美。

caption:
The image shows an urban architectural scene under a vivid, cloudless blue sky. Most of the frame is dominated by open sky, with only a few faint wisps of cloud near the center. Along the lower portion of the image, several large buildings form a layered cityscape.

On the left and right sides are modern office buildings with reflective blue-glass façades. Their windows are arranged in regular grid patterns, with pale vertical and horizontal framing elements. The left building includes a rounded rooftop structure and white architectural panels, while the right building has a similar glass-and-metal appearance with rooftop equipment and antennas visible.

In the center is an older, ornate stone building façade, much more classical in style than the surrounding structures. It features decorative columns, arched window details, carved stone ornamentation, and a prominent round clock set into a curved pediment near the top. Behind this historic façade rises a large semi-circular glass structure, like a vaulted atrium or arched window, made of radiating panes and metal ribs.

In front of the older building stands a greenish bronze statue on a tall pedestal. The statue appears to depict a standing historical figure, facing forward, with smaller sculptural figures at the base. A blue flag is visible near the building, and there are hints of greenery at the bottom edge of the frame.

The overall composition contrasts old and new architecture: a historic stone building and statue are framed by sleek contemporary glass towers. The bright sunlight creates crisp reflections on the windows and gives the scene a clean, modern civic atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代与传统建筑风格对比的摄影作品。图像前景是一座装饰华丽、具有古典特征的建筑，其特点是精致的雕塑和一个显眼的时钟。在建筑物的背后，可以看到几座现代化的玻璃幕墙大楼，它们反射着蓝天并带有反光效果。整个场景被一片晴朗的蓝天覆盖，营造出一种和谐而对比鲜明的城市景观。

caption:
The image shows a spacious indoor dining and waiting area, likely inside an airport or large transit terminal. The scene has a bright, modern feel, with a high glass wall running along the left side and back, allowing a lot of natural daylight to enter. Through the large windows, a hazy outdoor view is visible, including part of a building or terminal structure and a distant, pale landscape.

A striking feature of the space is the row of tall indoor trees planted throughout the seating area. Their dense green foliage forms a canopy overhead, giving the otherwise modern interior a garden-like atmosphere. The trees are placed between tables and near the windows, softening the glass-and-metal architecture.

The seating area is filled with white square tables and a mix of modern chairs, especially bright red-orange molded chairs and some white or gray chairs. The chairs have slim metal legs, and the tables are arranged in clusters, creating a casual café or food-court layout. Many people are seated at the tables, eating, drinking, talking, or waiting. Several pieces of luggage are visible beside chairs and tables, reinforcing the impression that this is in an airport or travel hub.

In the foreground on the left, two people sit at a white table with bags and rolling luggage nearby. One person appears to be holding a cup, while the other sits across the table. In the center foreground, a black upright suitcase stands beside a table and chairs. Toward the right foreground, more empty tables and red-orange chairs are visible, with a few diners seated nearby.

The floor is made of warm reddish-brown wood or wood-look material, which contrasts with the cool glass windows and metal framing. The ceiling is high and industrial-modern, with exposed beams, panels, vents, and suspended acoustic or decorative elements. On the far right side, there are storefronts or restaurant entrances; one visible sign reads “SPAGEDDIES,” suggesting a dining outlet. Another illuminated shop or restaurant area is partially visible nearby.

Overall, the image captures a busy but relaxed indoor café area in a large public building. The combination of travelers, luggage, food-court seating, indoor trees, glass walls, and restaurant signs creates a comfortable, contemporary airport-lounge atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代室内环境的照片，具体为一个机场候机楼的休息区。照片中，多个人物坐在配有红色椅子和白色桌子的桌旁，似乎在等待或享受休闲时光。背景中有几棵高大的绿色植物，它们位于天花板上悬挂的结构内，为这个空间增添了自然元素。整个场景被明亮的自然光照亮，营造出一种宜人的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of the ornate roof and entrance structure of a Thai Buddhist temple or pavilion. The architecture fills most of the frame, rising upward against a bright, overcast white sky, which makes the gold detailing stand out strongly.

The roof is richly decorated with layered, steeply pitched gables. Along the edges are sweeping golden finials shaped like stylized serpents or birds, likely traditional Thai roof ornaments such as chofah and naga-inspired elements. These curved forms repeat rhythmically along the rooflines, giving the structure a sense of movement and elegance.

The color palette is dominated by gold, deep red, blue, and small accents of green and purple. The underside of the roof is a dark reddish-brown with subtle golden floral or vine-like patterns. The gable faces and roof edges are covered in intricate gold filigree, with dense carved patterns resembling leaves, flames, flowers, and mythological motifs. Blue trim lines and mosaic-like inlays run along the roof ridges and borders, adding contrast to the gilded surfaces.

At the center near the top is a triangular pediment packed with elaborate golden relief work. It appears to feature mythological or religious figures surrounded by curling decorative forms. Below it is a projecting horizontal canopy with scalloped gold trim and layered ornamentation. Beneath this, triangular hanging gold decorations form a fringe above the entrance.

Two tall vertical columns frame the central opening. They are heavily embellished with patterned panels, gold borders, and blue-and-purple mosaic designs. The columns have gilded carved edges and ornate capitals, making them appear almost jewel-like. Inside the shadowed central space, a ceiling painted deep red with gold floral medallions is visible, along with a small chandelier or cluster of hanging lights.

Overall, the image emphasizes the grandeur, symmetry, and craftsmanship of traditional Thai temple architecture. The upward perspective makes the building feel monumental, while the dense ornamentation conveys luxury, sacredness, and meticulous artistic detail.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国传统建筑风格的图像，特写拍摄了一座寺庙或神殿的屋顶部分。屋顶装饰着金色和蓝色的图案，包括精细的几何形状、莲花和鱼鳞状的纹理。每个尖顶都装饰有金色的雕塑，呈现出一种庄严而华丽的感觉。整个结构在白色背景前显得格外突出，突出了其精致的细节和丰富的色彩。

caption:
The image shows an indoor aviation trade-show exhibition booth for **Russian Helicopters**.

On the left side, a large white booth wall displays the red Russian Helicopters logo—an abstract circular shape with a wedge cut out—beside large illuminated silver letters reading **“RUSSIAN HELICOPTERS.”** Below the sign is a display area with a dark panoramic backdrop showing a forest or green landscape scene. In front of this backdrop are several scale helicopter models mounted on pedestals, including a small dark helicopter on the far left and a red-and-white helicopter model closer to the center.

In the foreground, there is a large white reception counter with the same red logo and the words **“RUSSIAN HELICOPTERS”** printed on it. Some brochures or papers are laid out on the counter. The exhibition floor in the center is especially eye-catching: it is made of glossy transparent panels with bright purple and white LED lighting underneath, forming a grid-like illuminated pathway.

Several people in business attire are visible around the booth. Two men in dark suits stand or walk near the center, one holding papers, while other visitors and staff are visible toward the right side.

On the right side of the image, more helicopter models are displayed on raised stands behind black rope barriers. These models are mostly white with red accents and have detailed rotors, landing gear, and windows. Small red information placards stand beside some of them. One large model helicopter is positioned prominently near the front right, with its long rotor blades extending across the display space.

In the background to the right, another large exhibition area is visible with a prominent sign reading **“Aviation Civile”** in large blue letters. Additional French text appears on banners behind it, suggesting the event may be taking place in a French-speaking venue or international aerospace exhibition. The surrounding hall has high ceilings, large structural columns, overhead lighting rigs, and other trade-show booths partially visible in the distance.

Overall, the scene looks like a professional aerospace expo display, with polished branding, illuminated flooring, scale helicopter models, and business visitors examining the exhibits.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示俄罗斯直升机公司（RUSSIAN HELICOPTERS）和民用航空部门（Aviation Civile）的展览摊位的照片。图像中心是一个大型模型，展示了两架直升机，旁边是两位穿着正装的男士正在交谈。背景中有一个显示屏显示着与直升机相关的视频内容。整个摊位设计现代且专业，以白色为主色调，并有紫色灯光装饰，营造出一种高科技的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a nighttime religious procession moving through a crowded city square or street. The scene is warmly lit by street lamps and the yellow façade of a large historic building in the background.

In the foreground and midground are many procession participants wearing long robes in cream and gold tones. Several wear tall, pointed conical hoods with eye openings, traditional-looking penitential garments often associated with Holy Week processions in Spain. Some carry long staffs or candles, and their figures partially blur together because of movement and low light, giving the scene a solemn, ceremonial atmosphere.

At the center rear of the procession is an illuminated religious float or platform. It carries a richly dressed statue of the Virgin Mary or a saint, surrounded by flowers and bright lights. The figure appears to have a radiant halo or ornate crown behind the head, making it stand out dramatically against the darker archway behind it. The float is decorated with red and white flowers and dark fabric with gold trim.

On both sides of the procession, crowds of spectators line the street. Some people are watching closely, while others appear to be taking photos or videos. The right side of the image shows several onlookers in dark clothing, including a child being held or standing close to an adult.

The background architecture features a yellow building with white trim, arched arcades at street level, wrought-iron balconies, shuttered windows, and hanging lanterns. The arches and balconies suggest an old European city center. The warm lighting, dense crowd, and ceremonial clothing create a striking, reverent, and festive nighttime atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉了宗教节日庆典的纪实摄影风格照片。图中，一群身着传统服饰的人们聚集在广场上，他们头戴高耸的白色尖帽，身穿金色和白色的长袍，背对观众站立。中心位置是一个装饰华丽的人物，他被抬在一个黑色的车上，周围有几位穿着相似服装的人伴随。背景是一座黄色建筑，其窗户亮起温暖的灯光，为这个夜晚的场景增添了温馨的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of an arid archaeological landscape filled with ancient brick temple ruins. The scene is dominated by a vast, deep blue sky that takes up most of the frame, with only faint wisps of cloud near the top. The strong sunlight and saturated colors give the scene a warm, dry, almost desert-like atmosphere.

On the left side stands a large, ornate reddish-brown brick temple structure. It has multiple tiered sections, decorative spires, stepped brickwork, and an arched entrance at the front. The façade is weathered but still richly detailed, with carved-looking patterns and layered architectural elements. The brick surfaces vary in tone from dark brown to orange-red, showing age, erosion, and soot-like staining. A small white-and-gold shrine or marker sits near the entrance, contrasting sharply with the dark brick. Behind and beside the temple, a tall, sparse tree with thin branches rises into the sky, adding a natural frame to the left edge of the image.

On the right side is a more block-like brick ruin, also reddish-brown and heavily weathered. It has a rectangular form with thick walls, horizontal decorative bands near the roofline, and several dark openings or arched recesses near the base. Parts of the exterior plaster or brick surface appear worn away, creating irregular patches and textures. Small shrubs and scrubby vegetation grow around its base and along the surrounding dry ground.

A dusty, pale tan dirt path runs from the foreground into the middle distance, curving gently between the two main ruins. The ground is dry and uneven, scattered with small stones, broken brick fragments, sparse grass, and low green plants. In the center distance, beyond the path, more temple structures and small stupas are visible, including a larger ruin on the horizon and a smaller pointed shrine closer to the path. These distant monuments give the impression of a broad historical temple plain.

The overall composition feels expansive and quiet. The ancient brick architecture, dry earth, scattered vegetation, and open sky create a sense of age, abandonment, and historical grandeur. The scene strongly resembles a temple complex or archaeological site in Southeast Asia, possibly a place like Bagan, with its distinctive brick pagodas and ruins spread across a sunlit plain.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古代寺庙遗迹的摄影作品，画面中心是一座破败的红砖建筑，其屋顶和墙壁部分坍塌，显示出历史的沧桑。在寺庙的左侧，可以看到另一座相似风格的建筑，而右侧则有一座较大的建筑，同样显得破旧但结构完整。周围环境由干枯的土地、稀疏的植被和几棵树木组成，天空呈现出清澈的蓝色，为这个场景增添了一丝宁静与庄严。

caption:
The image shows a person standing indoors in what appears to be a modern restaurant or dining space. They are centered in the frame and wearing a clean white chef-style jacket with long sleeves. Their face is intentionally blurred, making facial features unrecognizable.

The person is holding a large shallow bowl or platter with both hands at chest height. The bowl is filled with bright yellow-orange blossoms, likely edible squash or zucchini flowers. The flowers are piled generously and stand out vividly against the white clothing and the darker background.

The setting behind them has a stylish, contemporary restaurant atmosphere. The ceiling is dark and industrial-looking, with visible beams, ducts, and multiple hanging pendant lights. Some lights are cylindrical black fixtures, while others have decorative wire-frame or perforated shades. The walls are muted gray or concrete-like, giving the space a modern, slightly rustic feel.

In the background, there are dining tables and chairs, some set with glassware and blue-toned bottles. A softly glowing lamp or decorative light appears on the left side near a window or bright vertical panel. There are also decorative wall elements, plants, and warm accent lighting that add depth and texture to the space.

The overall composition places the person and the bowl of flowers as the focal point, with the restaurant interior softly blurred behind them. The lighting is warm and atmospheric, emphasizing the colorful blossoms and the crisp white chef’s jacket.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示厨师在餐厅内手持一盘炸南瓜花的照片。厨师穿着标准的白色厨师服，站在一个装饰现代且温馨的餐厅内部。背景中可以看到模糊的餐桌和椅子，以及一些悬挂的灯具，营造出一种舒适的用餐环境。

caption:
The image shows a crowded outdoor gathering or demonstration on a bright day. The foreground is dominated by the side profile of a middle-aged to older man with a bald head, light skin, and a thick gray-and-dark mustache. He is facing to the right, looking downward or toward something outside the frame. He wears a dark pinstriped jacket over a patterned brown sweater and a red knit collar. On his jacket lapel there is a small red pin resembling the Turkish flag, with a white crescent and star.

Behind him is a dense group of people, mostly out of focus, suggesting a public rally or protest. Several heads and shoulders are visible, including people in dark jackets. The background is intentionally blurred with a shallow depth of field, making the foreground man sharp while the crowd and signs are soft.

In the upper-right background, a large flag with horizontal blue, red, and green bands is being held up; it appears to be the Azerbaijani flag, though the crescent/star detail is not clearly visible due to blur and angle. There are also protest placards or posters mounted on sticks in the center background. One sign appears to contain a photo or graphic with red and green borders, while another darker poster includes imagery and possibly text, though the writing is too blurred to read. A white rectangular placard beneath it also has unreadable text.

The sky is clear and pale blue with a few soft white clouds. The lighting is strong and natural, casting sunlight across the man’s head and face. The overall atmosphere suggests a busy public event, possibly a political or cultural demonstration, with national symbols, flags, and signs visible in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张记录政治或社会活动的现场照片，主要聚焦于一位中年男性，他站在人群中，头发稀疏，留着浓密的胡子。他的表情严肃，目光朝向远方。在他的背后，可以看到其他参与者和一些带有文字的标语牌，这些标语牌上有不同的颜色和图案，表明了某种政治或社会运动的主题。整个场景在户外进行，天空晴朗，阳光明媚。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic upward-looking view of the Sagrada Família basilica in Barcelona, with its highly ornate stone towers rising on the right side of the frame. Several tall, narrow spires dominate the architecture, built in warm reddish-brown stone with deep vertical openings and intricate sculptural details. The tops of the spires have decorative, flower-like finials in lighter colors, giving them a distinctive organic appearance typical of Antoni Gaudí’s design.

Multiple bright orange construction cranes surround and tower over the basilica, emphasizing that the structure is still under construction or restoration. Their long horizontal arms stretch across the blue sky above the spires, creating a striking contrast between modern construction machinery and the richly textured historic architecture.

The right edge of the image includes parts of scaffolding, protective netting, and unfinished architectural sections, suggesting ongoing work on the building. The façade itself is covered with elaborate carvings, figures, arches, and sculptural forms, with many small details packed into the stone surface.

The sky occupies much of the image, especially the left and upper portions. It is pale blue with soft, thin white clouds, creating an open and airy backdrop. On the left side and along the bottom, dark silhouettes of leafy trees frame the scene, their branches contrasting with the bright sky and the sunlit stonework. The composition is asymmetrical: the basilica and cranes are concentrated on the right, while open sky and trees fill the left, making the towering structure feel especially tall and monumental.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示正在建设中的哥特式建筑的照片。建筑物的尖顶和塔楼在阳光下显得格外引人注目，而周围高耸的起重机则表明工程正在进行中。照片背景是蓝天和几朵散布的白云，以及一些树木的轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a broad, sunlit urban square paved with gray cobblestones, bordered by historic white buildings with steep red-tiled roofs. The scene appears to be in Munich, as signs on the buildings read “Münchner Stadtmuseum” and “Filmmuseum – Das Kino im Münchner Stadtmuseum.”

In the center and left of the image is a long, whitewashed historic building with a high, sloping red roof. Its façade has small, evenly spaced windows with dark frames and reddish trim. A prominent gabled end faces the square, rising to a pointed peak topped by a small decorative spire and weather vane. Near the middle of the building is a slender turret with a pale green copper roof, adding a churchlike or old civic character to the architecture.

On the right is another white building with a large triangular gable and red roof. It has dark-framed windows in irregular rows, some tall and arched near the upper floors. At street level, there are signs and posters, including a bright red “filmmuseum” sign on the lower right. Nearby are blue café umbrellas shading outdoor seating, where several people are sitting.

Several flags stand in front of the buildings, colored yellow, green, and orange, likely advertising an event. A large colorful banner on the right building reads “Sommer im Hof.” There are also freestanding information boards or exhibition panels placed around the square.

The foreground is an open plaza with scattered pedestrians, cyclists, bicycles, and a few people pushing strollers. A large leafy tree on the left casts shade over part of the square, while another tree frames the right side. Modern buildings are partially visible behind the tree on the far left, contrasting with the older architecture.

The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, and the strong sunlight creates crisp shadows across the cobblestones. Overall, the image captures a lively but relaxed public square in front of historic museum buildings, combining old architecture, cultural signage, outdoor seating, and everyday city activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场和其周围建筑的摄影图像。图中心是一座具有传统欧洲风格的白色建筑物，屋顶为红色瓦片，正面挂有绿色尖顶塔楼。建筑物前是一个开放的广场，上面有行人、骑自行车的人以及一些遮阳伞下的休息区。广场周围种植着几棵绿树，天空晴朗，阳光明媚。

caption:
The image shows a lively indoor concert or party scene, photographed from within the crowd. The lighting is dark overall, with a strong flash illuminating the people in the foreground and leaving the background dim and shadowy.

In the center foreground, a person’s arm is raised high, holding a smartphone horizontally to record the performance. The arm has a large, detailed black tattoo covering much of the forearm, and the person is wearing a light-colored wristband. On the phone screen, a small stage is visible with performers under warm red/orange lighting; the phone camera interface is visible, including a red recording button, suggesting video is being captured.

Around the raised phone is a dense crowd of young adults standing close together. Several people have their hands raised, as if dancing, cheering, or reacting to the music. Many faces appear intentionally blurred or out of focus. Clothing is casual and nightlife-oriented: denim, striped shirts, jackets, crop tops, and fitted tops. On the right side, a person with red hair wears a sleeveless gray crop top and holds a white smartphone. Beside them is another person with long blonde hair wearing a light gray shirt with a cursive “love” design and a dark jacket.

On the left side, several people stand shoulder to shoulder; one person wears a striped button-up shirt with a small crossbody bag strap, while another wears a white shirt under a dark jacket. Near the center, a person in a white blouse and black leather skirt stands partially obscured by the raised arm and phone.

The lower-right foreground shows the back and side of a man’s head and neck, very close to the camera, emphasizing how crowded the space is. The background appears to be a larger venue or hall, with dark architectural shapes and faint silhouettes of more audience members further back.

Overall, the image captures the energy of a live music event: a crowded audience, raised hands, phones recording, bright flash-lit foreground figures, and a warm, colorful stage visible through the smartphone screen.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影风格的图片，捕捉了一个热闹的社交场合。图中中心位置是一位男性，他戴着耳机，正在专注地使用手机拍照或录像。他的手臂上覆盖着复杂的纹身图案，显现出一种个性化的表达方式。周围的人群模糊不清，但可以看出他们也在参与活动，有的举起手来，有的在交谈，营造出一种轻松愉快的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close, upward-looking view of an ornate historic stone building, likely a grand European palace or museum facade. The architecture is highly decorative, with classical columns, carved reliefs, sculptural niches, and numerous statues integrated into the exterior.

On the right side and extending into the distance, the building’s facade is lined with tall fluted columns and pilasters in pale beige stone. The columns have elaborate Corinthian-style capitals with leafy carvings. Between and above them are richly carved panels, cornices, brackets, and ornamental moldings. Several white stone statues of robed human figures stand on projecting ledges and pedestals along the facade, giving the building a ceremonial, museum-like quality.

Near the upper center is a large arched window framed by intricate stonework. It has multiple panes and is surrounded by carved floral and scroll motifs. Beneath and around it are balconies, balustrades, and layered architectural details. The stone surface varies in texture: some sections are smooth, while others have rough, patterned blocks.

A row of black metal street lamps runs diagonally from the foreground into the background, creating a strong sense of depth and perspective. The nearest lamp on the far right is very large and partially cropped, showing its dark pole and circular lamp structure. Farther down the line, several smaller lanterns repeat at regular intervals, their glass housings and decorative crowns visible.

The left side of the image is mostly bright, overexposed sky, which contrasts with the darker, detailed building facade. In the lower left background, another part of the historic complex is visible, including additional statues, arched windows, and a slate-colored roof. The overall impression is of a majestic, richly ornamented classical building, photographed from street level along a colonnaded exterior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑细节的摄影作品，图像中有一排黑色的路灯和精致的立柱，以及一些建筑上的雕塑。建筑物的设计精美，立面上装饰有雕像和浮雕，显示出一种经典的欧洲风格。

caption:
The image shows a wide, low-angle view of a large urban concrete building on a sunny day. The building dominates the right and upper portions of the frame and appears to be a multi-level parking garage or government-center structure, with a heavy Brutalist architectural style. It is made of pale gray concrete with strong horizontal bands, exposed support columns, deep overhangs, and repeating geometric protrusions along the facade. Rows of teal-blue tinted windows run across the upper floors, contrasting with the light concrete.

A sign on the building reads “GOVERNMENT CENTER GARAGE” and includes the website “GOVERNMENTCENTERGARAGE.COM,” with text advertising that it is “CLOSE, QUICK AND EASY.” Beneath the building are open garage levels, shadowed areas, and large cylindrical columns supporting the structure. A glass-and-metal sloped canopy or skylight extends diagonally upward from near street level toward the building, adding a lighter, more transparent element to the otherwise massive concrete design.

At street level, there is a bus stopped near the entrance area, along with a few small figures of pedestrians. The foreground includes a paved roadway curving around the building, brick sidewalks, streetlamps, traffic cones, and landscaped areas with trees and low greenery. On the left side, a red-and-white traffic sign indicates restrictions, including “DO NOT ENTER” and “EXCEPT MBTA BUS,” suggesting a transit or bus-only access lane.

In the background to the left, other city buildings are visible, including a distinctive clock-tower-like structure rising above the skyline. The sky is bright and clear, with a strong cyan-blue tone, giving the scene a crisp, high-contrast look. The overall impression is of a downtown civic or transportation area, with the massive garage structure towering over the street and surrounding urban activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市街景的摄影图像，图中主要建筑是一座具有独特设计的多层停车场，其特点是多层次的混凝土结构和大面积的玻璃窗。建筑前方是一个宽阔的街道，街道上有交通信号灯、路标以及几辆汽车，包括一辆停在路边的消防车。远处可以看到其他建筑物和蓝天，为这个城市场景增添了活力与背景细节。

caption:
The image shows a bright urban shopping and transit area on a clear sunny day, likely outside a large mall complex. The sky occupies much of the upper right portion of the frame and is a deep, cloudless blue, emphasizing the openness and midday brightness.

On the left side is a tall, modern glass-fronted building with a curved façade. Its exterior is made of large blue-tinted glass panels framed by metal supports, reflecting sunlight and surrounding structures. Near the top, a large golden or bronze-colored curved canopy projects outward, giving the building a distinctive upscale architectural look. At street level, part of a sign reading “PARAGON” is visible, suggesting this is the entrance area of a major shopping mall. Large advertisements are mounted on the building’s side, including a colorful poster with a face and bold event-style graphics.

The foreground and center of the image feature a long rectangular fountain plaza. Dozens of small water jets shoot upward from circular grates embedded in dark stone tiles. The wet pavement reflects the water, sky, and nearby structures, creating a glossy surface. Some jets are higher and more forceful than others, producing a lively, sparkling effect. A person stands near the middle of the fountain area, barefoot or with feet in the shallow water, facing away from the camera with a backpack, as if enjoying or photographing the scene.

Along both sides of the fountain are neat rows of white rectangular planters filled with green shrubs. On the left side, palm trees line the walkway, adding a tropical feel. Many pedestrians are walking around the plaza—some in casual clothing, some carrying bags, and others gathered near the building entrance. The scene feels busy but relaxed, typical of a shopping district or public pedestrian area.

On the right side of the image, an elevated rail line runs diagonally into the distance. A train is visible on the track, partially cropped along the right edge. Below the rail structure is a glassy transit or walkway area, with purple flags fluttering in front of it. The elevated track contrasts with the sleek mall architecture on the left, reinforcing the image’s urban setting.

Overall, the photo captures a modern city plaza with luxury retail architecture, public fountains, landscaped walkways, pedestrians, and elevated mass transit, all under strong sunlight and a vivid blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市生活场景的照片，画面中心是一个喷泉区域，水柱在阳光下闪耀。喷泉两侧是购物中心的玻璃幕墙建筑，上面挂有各种广告牌和标识。人行道上散布着行人，有的在行走，有的在休息或拍照。远处可以看到更多的建筑物和蓝天，整个场景充满了活力与都市气息。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a small coastal fishing village beside a sandy beach on an overcast day.

In the foreground, large pale gray rocks fill the lower part of the scene, their surfaces rough, cracked, and streaked with white veins. Beyond the rocks is a broad sandy beach scattered with dark brown and green seaweed, suggesting the tide has recently gone out. Numerous seagulls are spread across the sand and near the waterline, with a few standing in the shallow surf on the right side. The sea is calm and gray-blue, just visible along the right edge where it laps gently against the beach.

Across the middle of the image, several small fishing boats rest on the sand. They are brightly painted—red, green, blue, and cream—and many are propped up on wooden supports. Nets, ropes, floats, and other fishing gear lie around them, adding to the working-harbor feel. Some boats have tall masts or antenna-like poles rising above them.

Behind the boats is a row of low seaside houses and sheds, tightly packed along the beach. The buildings are varied and colorful: whitewashed walls, weathered stone facades, bright blue doors and shutters, red trim, pastel pink and yellow walls, and many orange-red tiled roofs. A particularly vivid blue building near the center stands out, with large blue doors and graffiti on its lower wall. Farther right, a long line of narrow houses continues along a low seawall or promenade.

Several streetlamps and overhead wires run horizontally across the village, giving the scene a lived-in, practical atmosphere. A few small human figures can be seen near the boats and walkway, but they are distant and not central to the composition.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image, filled with thick gray clouds and soft, diffused light. The overall mood is quiet, cool, and slightly windswept, like a working fishing beach during a calm but cloudy day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩边渔村的现实主义风格照片。前景中，岩石和沙地占据了画面的左侧，而沙滩上散落着几艘渔船。在沙滩后方，可以看到一排色彩鲜艳的房屋，它们的屋顶呈现不同的颜色，如红色、黄色和蓝色等。这些房屋的外观多样，有的房子前面有小型的船棚。天空多云，为这个场景增添了一丝阴郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an interior wall in what appears to be a dining room or traditional restaurant. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with a cream-colored plaster wall framed by two tall arched windows on the left and right. The windows have dark wooden trim and horizontal bars, and the bright outdoor light makes the exterior mostly overexposed, though hints of greenery and potted plants are visible near the lower edges.

At the center of the wall is an ornate, dark wood wall-mounted light fixture. It has a vertical, turned-wood design with rounded bulbous shapes and a polished, antique appearance. Three curved black metal arms extend outward from the middle, each holding a candle-style electric bulb shaped like a small flame. The bulbs are exposed and give the fixture a vintage chandelier-like look. A small mounting bracket or hook is visible above the top of the fixture.

Below the light fixture hangs a large carved wooden decorative plaque or crest. It is richly detailed and resembles a heraldic or royal emblem. At the top is a carved crown, and below it is a shield-like central panel with ornamental symbols. Curving carved elements and leaf-like patterns flank the shield on both sides, giving it a grand, antique, handcrafted appearance. The wood has a warm reddish-brown tone with visible grain and polished highlights.

At the bottom of the image, part of a set dining table is visible. It is covered with a white tablecloth accented by pink stripes. On the table are neatly folded white napkins, a small plate, a spoon, a knife, salt and pepper shakers, an upside-down drinking glass or carafe, and a small brown ceramic pot or covered jar. The overall atmosphere feels traditional, rustic, and elegant, with warm wood details contrasting against the pale wall and bright natural light from the windows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内装饰的照片，中心位置是一个精致的木质壁灯，其设计复杂且具有复古风格。壁灯上方悬挂着一个带有三个蜡烛台和三支蜡烛的黑色金属吊灯。在壁灯下方，墙上挂着一个大型的木质盾牌，上面刻有文字和图案。壁灯下方的桌子上铺有一块白色的桌布，桌上摆放着一套茶具，包括一个茶壶、两个茶杯和一些茶碟。背景中可以看到两扇窗户，窗户上有半圆形的拱形窗框，透过窗户可以隐约看到外面的景色。

caption:
The image shows an urban downtown scene viewed from street level, looking upward at several modern high-rise buildings under a clear blue sky.

On the left edge, a large curved office building dominates the foreground. Its façade is made of reflective blue-tinted glass panels arranged in a grid, separated by light-colored horizontal and vertical framing. The building curves outward, giving it a rounded, cylindrical feel. Near the lower left, leafy green tree branches partially obscure the building, adding a bit of natural texture against the glass and concrete.

Near the center is a tall rectangular office tower with a beige or light stone-colored frame and many vertical rows of pale blue reflective windows. At the top of this building, a sign reads “FIFTH THIRD BANK.” The building has a stepped profile, with different sections rising to slightly different heights, and its windows catch bright sunlight.

To the right, a much taller, sleek glass skyscraper rises prominently. It has a cool blue-gray reflective exterior and a very modern design, with vertical dark recessed strips running down parts of the façade. The glass reflects nearby buildings and the sky, creating a shiny, mirrored surface. Its edges are sharp and clean, and the top appears slightly rounded or softened by the perspective.

Between the central and right towers, a smaller high-rise with turquoise-green glass and white structural details is visible. It has balconies or recessed sections, giving it a more residential or mixed-use appearance. Lower in the frame, older brick buildings and modern low-rise structures sit at street level, creating a contrast between historic masonry and contemporary glass architecture.

At the bottom of the image, there are flat-roofed structures, glass entrance areas, metal framing, and canopy-like elements, suggesting a plaza, transit entrance, or commercial frontage. A wooden fence or paneling appears along the lower right side, adding warm brown tones to the otherwise cool palette of glass, steel, and concrete.

Overall, the scene feels bright, clean, and urban, with strong vertical lines, reflective surfaces, and a wide open sky emphasizing the height of the downtown skyline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市景观的照片，画面中心是一座高耸的摩天大楼，其表面反射着蓝天和周围建筑的轮廓。左侧是另一座较高的建筑物，其玻璃幕墙在阳光下闪耀。右侧则有一座设计独特的高层建筑，其立面由多个几何形状组成。前景中有一个带有透明屋顶的现代建筑结构，其下方有树木和灌木丛。整个场景被晴朗的天空覆盖，营造出一种干净、明亮的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a healthcare procedure in a clinical setting. A medical worker wearing a crisp white uniform is attending to a patient’s arm, which is resting on a black padded armrest or chair support. The worker’s face is not visible; the frame focuses on their torso, hands, and the patient’s forearm.

The healthcare worker has an ID badge clipped to the front of the uniform in a pink badge holder, with a black name strip across the top and hospital-style identification details beneath it. One of the worker’s hands is bare and gently holding or stabilizing the patient’s wrist/forearm, while the other hand is wearing a light blue disposable glove and appears to be pointing toward or checking a spot on the patient’s inner arm.

The patient’s arm is positioned palm-down or slightly turned, with tubing visible near the wrist/forearm area. A transparent medical tube runs downward, connected to a small blue-green component, suggesting an IV line, blood draw setup, or donation-related tubing. On the right side of the image, a gray blood pressure cuff or monitoring cuff with white printed symbols is wrapped around or positioned near the patient’s upper arm.

The scene has a shallow depth of field: the hands, arm, ID badge, and medical equipment are relatively sharp, while the background is blurred. The background appears to be an indoor hospital or clinic environment with warm-toned flooring and indistinct figures or objects. At the lower left, a teal or green fabric—possibly the patient’s clothing, a medical drape, or a blanket—is partially visible.

Overall, the image conveys a moment of patient care, likely involving blood pressure monitoring, IV insertion, blood donation, or a similar medical procedure.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示医疗护理场景的照片，一位穿着白色医生制服的医护人员正在为一位患者进行静脉注射。医护人员戴着蓝色的手套，正专注地操作着注射器。患者的腿部被固定在黑色的支架上，上面贴有白色的贴片和一些医疗设备。背景中模糊可见其他人员和环境，但焦点集中在正在进行的医疗护理活动上。

caption:
The image shows a historic stone monastery or church complex on a bright, clear day. The scene is framed by large reddish-pink sandstone arches in the foreground, creating a layered architectural view into the courtyard beyond.

On the right side, a long ruined wall runs diagonally into the distance. It is made of weathered red sandstone blocks and features tall Gothic-style window openings, narrow vertical tracery, and heavy buttress-like stone supports. The wall is roofless, suggesting it is part of an old cloister or abbey ruin. Sunlight strikes the stone, highlighting its rough texture, pale mortar lines, chips, and age-darkened patches near the base.

On the left foreground, part of another massive arch curves out of frame, also made from the same reddish stone. Together with the arch on the right, it creates a dramatic frame around the central building.

In the middle distance stands a well-preserved church or chapel. It has steep red-orange tiled roofs, pointed Gothic windows, and a rose window visible near the lower front façade. A slim spire rises from the roof, topped with a small cross or weather vane. The church’s walls are also built from reddish sandstone, matching the ruins around it.

A leafy green tree partly obscures the lower central portion of the church, adding contrast against the warm stone and terracotta roof. Below, there is a neatly kept green lawn inside the ruins, with scattered stone paths and low remaining walls. A small modern lamp post is visible near the lower left-center, subtly contrasting with the historic architecture.

In the background, a densely forested hillside stretches across the image, with deep green trees under a vivid blue sky. The lighting is strong and crisp, suggesting midday or early afternoon sunshine. Overall, the image conveys a peaceful, historic setting—an old Gothic religious site or abbey ruin set within a green landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老教堂遗迹的摄影图像。图中，我们看到一座红砖结构的教堂，其哥特式风格的拱门和尖顶在蓝天的映衬下显得格外引人注目。教堂的建筑细节清晰可见，包括精细的石雕装饰和窗户上的玫瑰窗图案。周围环绕着郁郁葱葱的树木，为这座历史悠久的建筑增添了一抹生机。

caption:
The image shows a city skyline viewed from a slightly elevated, leafy vantage point, as if photographed from a hillside or park. Dense green trees and branches frame the scene in the foreground, with leafy shrubs on the left and pine-like branches crossing the lower right and bottom edge. The vegetation is somewhat closer and softer, creating a natural frame around the urban center.

In the middle distance, a cluster of high-rise buildings dominates the skyline. Near the center is a tall, rectangular tower with a light beige or golden facade, catching warm sunlight on its upper floors. Its exterior has many horizontal bands of windows, giving it a striped appearance. To its left are darker glass towers with reflective blue-gray surfaces, more modern and sleek in style. To the right stands another tall, older-looking high-rise with a gray facade and red Chinese characters illuminated or painted near the top. Several other apartment and office buildings of varying heights fill the lower skyline, in colors ranging from cream and tan to muted orange and gray.

At the base of the skyline, there are many mid-rise residential buildings packed closely together, with balconies, rows of windows, and flat or sloped rooftops. Some buildings have European-inspired roof shapes, while others are more utilitarian apartment blocks.

Behind the city, a hazy mountain range stretches across the horizon. The mountains are pale blue-gray and partially obscured by atmospheric haze, with faint, possibly snow-covered peaks visible near the center-right. Above them, the sky occupies most of the image: it is broad, pale, and softly lit, transitioning from light blue at the top to a warmer, whitish haze near the horizon. Thin, faint clouds are visible, but the sky is mostly clear.

The overall mood is calm and quiet, with warm late-afternoon or early-evening light giving the buildings a soft glow. The contrast between the natural greenery in the foreground, the dense urban skyline, and the distant mountains creates a layered composition.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线的照片，前景由几棵树木构成，它们的绿色叶子在画面中形成了一种自然的框架。通过这些树叶，可以看到背后的城市建筑群，其中包括多座高楼大厦和一些低矮的住宅楼。建筑物的颜色从浅黄到深蓝不等，形成了丰富的色彩层次。在远处，天空被云层覆盖，而地平线上隐约可见山脉的轮廓。整个场景在柔和的日落光线下显得宁静而和谐。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny urban coastal scene, likely in a Mediterranean city or resort area. The composition is dominated by tall residential and hotel-like buildings surrounded by lush greenery, with a clear blue sky overhead.

In the center stands a very tall beige high-rise apartment building. It has many stacked balconies running down one side, each with dark railings and recessed shaded spaces. A narrow vertical strip of reflective glass windows rises along the front-left portion of the tower, contrasting with the warm tan exterior. Near the top of the building, greenery and palm trees are visible on a rooftop terrace, giving the tower a luxurious, landscaped appearance.

Below and in front of the tower is a more modern building section with curved glass façades in pale blue tones. The reflective windows form rounded vertical shapes, adding a sleek, contemporary look. Around its base are palm trees and other ornamental plants.

On the right side of the image is a large, elegant, pale pink and cream building with a red-tiled roof. It has a classical resort-style design, with rows of arched openings, balconies, and decorative columns. The building appears to be part of a hotel or luxury residential complex. Behind and around it are more pastel-colored buildings, suggesting a dense upscale urban area.

The foreground is filled with greenery, especially large umbrella-shaped pine trees with thick green canopies. At the lower left, there is an outdoor café or snack bar with a sign reading “Da Caterina,” along with words such as “Pizza,” “Cafe,” “Snack,” and “Bar.” The café has green patio umbrellas, red planters, menu boards, and outdoor seating. Several people are visible sitting or walking around the terrace area.

A pedestrian walkway runs through the lower middle of the image, bordered by railings and leading toward the buildings. There are also white structures and railings in the lower right that suggest a marina, promenade, or waterfront area nearby.

On the left side, a rocky hillside rises behind the trees. It is covered with shrubs and greenery, and there are buildings perched on the slope. A construction crane is visible near the top left, indicating ongoing development. A road or elevated structure curves along the hillside.

The sky is vivid blue with wispy white clouds, and the lighting is strong and clear, creating a warm, summery atmosphere. Overall, the scene conveys a wealthy coastal cityscape with high-rise apartments, resort architecture, cafés, palm trees, and a polished promenade environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影照片，画面中心是一座高耸的现代建筑，其设计简洁而优雅。建筑前是一个繁忙的街道，街道两旁种植着整齐排列的松树和一些绿色植被，为这个城市场景增添了一抹自然色彩。街道上可见几位行人正在行走或停留，其中一位身穿深色衣服的人正走向左侧。在建筑前方，有一个带有遮阳伞的户外咖啡馆，几个人坐在那里享受阳光和休闲时光。远处可以看到更多的建筑物和一片开阔的天空，蓝天中飘着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit historic stone religious complex, likely a church or monastery courtyard, built from warm beige and honey-colored stone. The scene is viewed from an elevated walkway or terrace, looking across a series of stone walls, arches, rooftops, and towers under a clear blue sky.

On the left side, a large rough-stone wall rises vertically, its surface made of irregularly shaped stones and mortar. Below it is a shaded passageway or arcade with a broad stone arch. Inside the shadowed area, a staircase leads upward, partially hidden by the darkness. The floor in the foreground is paved with smooth rectangular stone tiles, contrasting with the rougher masonry of the walls.

Across the center of the image is a long, pale, sloping roof or dome-like surface, very smooth compared with the surrounding stonework. It stretches horizontally from left to right, bordered by low stone parapets. Behind and above this roof are two slender church towers. The smaller one stands near the center-right, topped with a metal cross. Farther to the right is a taller bell tower with arched openings; a dark bell is visible inside. This tower is also crowned with an ornate metal cross. Both towers are built from the same tan stone as the rest of the structure and have decorative carved details.

In the lower right, a courtyard area is visible with large stone arches forming a covered walkway or lower level. A small tree with silvery-green foliage grows near the corner, casting some shade onto the paving below. A vertical metal pipe runs down one of the stone walls. The bright midday sunlight creates strong contrast between illuminated stone surfaces and deep shadows beneath the arches.

Overall, the image conveys the atmosphere of an ancient Middle Eastern or Mediterranean religious site: quiet, sun-baked, and architectural, with heavy stone construction, arched forms, bell towers, and Christian crosses standing out against the open sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有中东特色的建筑的照片。建筑物由粗糙的石块构成，顶部装饰有尖塔和十字架，表明其宗教性质。阳光照射在建筑上，突出了其结构和细节。照片背景是晴朗的蓝天，为整个场景增添了宁静与庄严的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a luxury eyewear display, likely inside a boutique or optical shop, featuring **Cartier Lunettes** glasses.

At the center foreground is a clear acrylic display block with the text **“Cartier”** in large black cursive lettering and **“LUNETTES”** printed below in spaced capital letters. The clear block reflects the lettering faintly along its lower edge.

Behind it, slightly out of focus, is a glossy deep red Cartier display stand or box. On its front surface, the white cursive **Cartier** logo is visible. Resting across this red stand is a pair of thin, gold-rimmed eyeglasses with rounded rectangular lenses. The frame has delicate metal detailing, transparent nose pads, and a refined luxury look.

In the lower left foreground, a pair of dark black or navy rectangular eyeglasses lies partially cropped, with thick frames and tinted-looking lenses. Another partially visible frame appears at the extreme bottom left, darker and patterned or textured.

On the right side of the image, there are more eyeglasses displayed on clear supports. Near the upper right is a round, gold-rimmed frame with pale lenses, mostly cropped by the edge of the image. Below it, a pink-framed pair is visible on the right edge; it has a white price tag attached that reads **“750.-”**, and a small Cartier logo emblem can be seen on or near the lens area.

The overall scene has a cool, bluish lighting tone, with bright highlights and reflections on the glass tabletop and clear acrylic stands. The focus is shallow: the central Cartier branding and nearby display elements are relatively clear, while the background glasses and red display structure are softly blurred. The image conveys an upscale, elegant retail presentation of designer eyewear.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Cartier品牌眼镜的商业摄影风格图片。图像中心是一个透明的玻璃展示架，上面放置着几副不同款式和颜色的眼镜。最上方是一副金色边框的眼镜，下方左侧是一副黑色框架的眼镜，右侧则是一副粉色边框的眼镜。所有的眼镜都呈现出精致的设计和高品质的工艺。在图片的底部，有一个带有'Cartier Lunettes'字样的透明塑料牌匾，突出了品牌形象。背景是均匀的白色，使得眼镜的颜色更加鲜明突出。

caption:
The image shows a weathered stone monument or marker standing outdoors in a lush, overgrown setting. The structure is made of gray stone and has a tall, rectangular obelisk-like form with a pointed pyramidal top. It sits on a broader stepped base, also stone, which appears aged and stained from exposure to moisture.

The surface of the monument is rough and speckled, with visible discoloration, dark streaks, patches of moss, and possible lichen. The edges are fairly straight but softened by age and weathering. Ivy vines climb up and around parts of the stone, especially along the left side and near the base.

Behind and around the monument is a dense wall of green ivy and foliage. The leaves vary in shade from deep green to lighter yellow-green, creating a thick, textured background. Some vines hang down loosely, while others wrap around the stone and spread across the surrounding ground. At the bottom of the image, grass and low plants partially obscure the lower base, emphasizing the neglected, natural, and slightly hidden feel of the scene.

Overall, the image has the atmosphere of an old garden, cemetery, boundary marker, or historic site that has been overtaken by vegetation.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在自然环境中石制纪念碑的照片。纪念碑呈长方形，顶部有一个尖顶，表面看起来由灰色的石材制成，四周被绿色植物环绕。周围的植被包括各种藤蔓和树木，它们覆盖了纪念碑的大部分周围区域，营造出一种宁静而古老的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the lower façade of an old, weathered European-style building, photographed from street level and angled slightly upward. The wall is pale beige-gray plaster with visible cracks, stains, patches, and age-darkened areas, giving it a historic, worn appearance.

A prominent decorative theme on the façade is a series of sculpted trees. Three relief-like tree ornaments are set into arched recesses across the wall. Each tree has a textured trunk and dense, clustered foliage made of raised leaf and flower-like forms. The central tree is positioned between two arches and is topped by a carved ribbon banner reading “POD TRZEMA LIPAMI,” which appears to mean “Under the Three Lindens.” The trees are painted or finished in muted gray and off-white tones, with some reddish-brown exposed coloring on the trunks.

Below the arches are deep red or burgundy fabric awnings with thin vertical white stripes. They extend outward over storefront windows or entrances. The awnings look slightly faded and weathered, matching the aged character of the building.

On the left side, a black metal wall-mounted lantern projects from the façade. Beneath it is an oval hanging sign, dark reddish-brown with light lettering; part of the text appears to include “STASI.” Nearby, a round plaque or street marker is mounted on the wall, though it is worn and difficult to read.

The upper portion of the image shows darker stone or plaster panels separated by horizontal ledges and moldings. Two rectangular ornamental panels near the top contain carved floral scrollwork, with leaves and blossoms in a symmetrical pattern. These upper decorations are darker and more soot-stained than the lower wall.

Near the lower center-right, a small information plaque is mounted on the wall. It appears to identify the building as “Kamienica Pod Trzema Lipami” / “The Pod Trzema Lipami House,” with text below, though the smaller writing is not fully legible. On the far right, part of a window or door shows signage for “Pizzeria Cyklop.”

Overall, the scene depicts a historic urban building façade with ornate plasterwork, carved botanical motifs, arched architectural details, old signage, and red striped awnings, suggesting a restaurant or commercial space housed in a heritage building.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑细节的照片，特写了一栋建筑物的外墙。墙面装饰着两个拱形的窗户，每个窗户上方都有一块装饰性的横幅，上面写着'VÍŤKO VÍŤKO ČERNOVÉNÍ'。窗户下方是两扇关闭的门，门上方有红色遮阳篷，遮阳篷上有白色的字母和数字。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，呈现出一种历史感。

caption:
This is a sepia-toned historical panoramic photograph looking out over a broad harbor or inlet, likely the Golden Horn in Istanbul, viewed from a hillside cemetery.

In the foreground, dark cypress trees and numerous upright gravestones frame the scene. The grave markers vary in height and shape—some are narrow, leaning slabs, while others are thicker or rounded at the top. Their pale surfaces catch the light, contrasting with the deep shadows of the trees and hillside vegetation. The large cypress trunks on the left and right edges create a natural frame, making the view feel as though it is being seen from within a quiet cemetery or garden above the city.

Beyond the foreground, the water stretches across the center of the image. Its surface is lightly textured, with small boats scattered across it. Along both shores are piers, warehouses, waterfront buildings, and clusters of wooden or masonry structures. The harbor appears active but calm, with many vessels moored or moving slowly.

In the distance, a dense cityscape rises over low hills. The skyline is filled with rooftops, towers, and many slender minarets. Several large domed mosque complexes are visible, especially toward the right side of the horizon, reinforcing the impression of Ottoman-era Istanbul. The far background is hazy, giving the city a soft, atmospheric quality.

The photograph has a strong sense of depth: dark cemetery and trees in the foreground, bright open water in the middle, and a pale, sprawling city beyond. The overall mood is quiet, contemplative, and historical, with the graves overlooking a busy urban harbor below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线的复古风格照片，从一个高点俯瞰，可以看到城市的轮廓和河流。前景中，有几棵树木和一些墓碑，而背景则是城市的建筑群和远处的山丘。整个场景被一种历史感的色调所笼罩，给人一种时光倒流的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a winter urban scene centered on the entrance to a funicular station. The building has a large, elegant arched façade in cream and beige tones, with multiple rounded layers framing a tall glass entrance. The glass panels are divided by gold-colored metal trim in a decorative Art Deco-like pattern. Across the upper portion of the glass, white Cyrillic letters spell “ФУНІКУЛЕР” (“funicular”). A small Ukrainian flag is visible inside or reflected near the entrance area.

A broad set of wet stone steps leads up to the station, with patches and lines of melting snow along the edges of each stair. The pavement in the foreground is also wet and reddish-brown, suggesting recent snow or thawing conditions. Snowbanks are piled along the sides of the walkway and steps.

To the left of the station, two people walk across the scene in winter clothing, one holding an accordion-like instrument. Behind them are purple signs with Cyrillic text, including “КОФЕ” (“coffee”), indicating a café or coffee stand nearby.

The background is filled with leafless winter trees on a snowy hillside, their dark branches creating a dense pattern against the pale gray sky. A stone retaining wall runs along the left side, topped by railings. On the right, bare trees and shrubs frame the station entrance, and a tall metal pole stands near the edge of the image.

Overall, the scene feels cold, damp, and overcast, with the ornate funicular entrance standing out warmly against the snowy park-like surroundings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季城市街景的照片，画面中心是一座具有现代设计风格的拱形入口建筑。门前有几位行人正在经过，其中一位穿着深色外套和帽子的人正走在前面。建筑前的台阶上积满了雪，而周围的树木已经失去了大部分叶子，显示出冬天的气息。在建筑的一侧，可以看到一块紫色的横幅广告牌，上面写着'KOLLEKTIVNIY'字样。

caption:
The image shows a busy market or shop display filled with boxed sets of colorful bangles or bracelet-like accessories. The view is from above, looking down at many open cardboard trays arranged tightly side by side across a table or floor.

Each tray contains stacks of cylindrical bangle sets, mostly wrapped in clear plastic. The bangles are arranged in rows and grouped by color. There are many bright, shiny colors: vivid green, orange, red, pink, blue, turquoise, mint, peach, silver, gold, black, white, yellow, and bronze. Many of the bangles have glittering metallic or rhinestone-like accents, giving them a sparkling, textured appearance. Several sets have repeating dotted or striped patterns, with small reflective studs embedded along the surface.

Small yellow price labels are stuck on many of the bangle bundles. Some labels show handwritten numbers, though they are not fully legible. A few trays have labels or printed text on the outside; one floral-patterned box has text that appears to say “TIGER ZINDA HAI,” and another cardboard box near the bottom shows “OWN ACTIVE.” The boxes themselves vary in condition—some are neat black display trays, while others are worn cardboard boxes with floral prints, taped edges, or slightly bent sides.

The composition is very dense and colorful, with almost no empty space. The left side includes darker metallic bangles in black, bronze, and silver, while the center has prominent red, coral, mint, and green sets. The right side features more orange, peach, green, blue, and turquoise bangles. The overall impression is of a jewelry or accessory stall with a wide variety of traditional decorative bangles organized for sale.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种颜色和图案的手镯的图片。手镯被整齐地放置在打开的纸盒中，每个盒子上都有不同的标签，显示了产品的品牌或型号。从左至右，可以看到多种颜色如红色、绿色、蓝色、橙色等，以及不同图案如条纹、点状、几何图形等。这些手镯可能是为了节日或特殊场合而准备的装饰品。

caption:
The image shows two young children standing outdoors in a lush, green natural setting. They are positioned near the center of the frame, standing close together among large rocks and low vegetation.

The child on the left is wearing a red sweater with black horizontal stripes and several white bands across the chest and lower area. They also have on loose blue pants and sandals. One hand hangs at their side, holding a small colorful object. Their posture is relaxed, leaning slightly against a rock.

The child on the right is wearing a mustard-yellow/orange jacket with light-colored trim and button details, along with red pants. The jacket appears padded or thick, suggesting cool weather.
