This child is standing upright with both hands held together near the front of the jacket. They are wearing sandals with a small decorative pattern.

Both children’s faces are intentionally blurred, making their facial features indistinct. They have dark hair; the child on the left has short hair, while the child on the right has slightly longer hair swept to one side.

The setting appears to be a forested or rural area. The background is filled with dense green foliage, including leafy plants and trees, softly out of focus. Large gray-brown rocks surround the children, forming a natural boundary or low stone edge. The ground is covered with grass, small plants, ferns, dry leaves, and a few bits of debris. The lighting is soft and natural, giving the scene a calm, candid feel. The shallow depth of field keeps the children and nearby rocks more prominent while the forest behind them is blurred.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两个小孩在自然环境中的照片。左侧的孩子穿着红色和黑色条纹的长袖上衣，搭配灰色裤子，站立着，双手插在裤兜里。右侧的孩子身穿黄色长袖衬衫和红色裤子，脚穿棕色鞋子，手拿着一些小物品，看起来像是玩具或食物。他们站在绿色植被和几块岩石旁，背景是茂密的树木和灌木丛。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime cityscape dominated by the **Petronas Twin Towers** in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The two identical skyscrapers rise in the center of the frame, brightly illuminated in cool white and silver light against a very dark, almost black night sky. Their distinctive tiered, ribbed architecture is clearly visible, with many horizontal bands and stacked setbacks creating a shimmering metallic texture.

Each tower tapers upward into a pointed spire topped with a small glowing sphere and a thin antenna-like pinnacle. The towers are connected near the middle by the famous **skybridge**, which appears as a horizontal, brightly lit passage suspended between them.

At the base of the towers is a large, brightly lit commercial complex. In front of it, a plaza area is visible with a tall illuminated **Christmas tree** glowing gold and white, suggesting the photo was taken during a festive season. The plaza and surrounding streets are filled with small points of light from people, vehicles, and decorative lighting.

Between the lower portions of the twin towers, a shorter building with a striking **golden-yellow illuminated roof and façade** stands out warmly, contrasting with the cold white glow of the towers. Around the central towers are several other high-rise buildings: on the left, a modern rectangular office tower with horizontal bands of windows and greenish-blue lighting; on the right, a tall building with balconies or curved horizontal lines, plus other illuminated skyscrapers behind it. One building on the right displays a bright digital sign showing **“10:30”** in orange.

The overall scene is vibrant and urban, with strong contrasts between the glowing skyscrapers and the dark sky. The lighting gives the city a polished, futuristic appearance, while the busy streets and plaza below add a sense of activity and scale.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜晚城市天际线的摄影作品，其中最引人注目的是一座双塔结构的摩天大楼，其独特的设计和灯光照明在夜幕中显得格外耀眼。这座建筑被周围其他高楼大厦所环绕，其中包括一些装饰着霓虹灯的建筑，增添了城市的活力感。图像捕捉了这个场景的细节，包括建筑物的灯光、周围的树木和远处模糊的城市轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a row of Acer laptops displayed on a retail counter, likely in an electronics/computer shop. The laptops are open and angled toward the viewer, with bright promotional slides on their screens advertising Acer Spin convertible models.

In the foreground on the left is a dark gray Acer laptop, opened wide. Its screen displays a colorful gradient advertisement with the “mhi” logo on the left and a green “acer” logo on the upper right. The headline reads “ACER SPIN 3 2 In 1.” Below it are specifications including an Intel Core i3-8145U processor, 4GB DDR4 RAM, 256GB SSD PCIe NVMe storage, Intel UHD Graphics, a 14-inch FHD multi-touch screen flip design, Windows 10, and 2 years Acer warranty. A large price at the bottom reads “RM2599.” The screen has strong reflections from overhead lighting, including a bright diagonal white glare.

The laptop’s keyboard and touchpad are visible. It has a full-size black keyboard set into a gray chassis, a large centered touchpad, and a visible Intel Core sticker near the lower-left palm rest. A black power cable is plugged in on the left side and trails across the display area. There is also a product feature sticker on the right palm rest mentioning “Spin 3” and icons for features such as FHD display, touch, and HDMI.

To the right is another dark gray Acer laptop, also open. Its screen advertises “ACER SPIN 5 2 In 1,” with specifications such as Intel Core i5-8265U / i7-8550U, 8GB DDR4 RAM, 256GB SSD M.2, Intel UHD Graphics, 13.3-inch FHD multi-touch screen flip, Windows 10, and 2 years Acer warranty. The bottom shows prices “RM3299 / RM3899.” This laptop has a black keyboard, a large touchpad, and an Acer logo below the screen. A yellow “Full HD 1080” sticker is visible near the lower-left bezel area.

Further to the right, partially visible, is a rose-gold or pink Acer laptop. Its screen advertises “ACER SWIFT 5,” with a large price reading “RM3399 / RM3999.” The keyboard and trackpad are visible, and the machine appears thinner and lighter in color than the Spin models. Another laptop is barely visible even farther right.

The laptops sit on a light-colored wooden or laminate display counter with a white illuminated strip along the front edge. The background includes a teal wall panel on the left and a light gray wall behind the laptops. Overall, the scene looks like a showroom display featuring Acer laptops with promotional pricing in Malaysian ringgit.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三台不同型号笔记本电脑的照片，每台电脑都放置在木质桌面上。最左边的笔记本电脑是Acer Spin 3 12in 1，配置有Intel Core i5处理器、4GB RAM和580GB硬盘，售价RM2599，并附带两年保修期。中间的笔记本电脑是Acer Aspire E5-771G，配置有Intel Core i3处理器、4GB RAM和500GB硬盘，售价RM2699。最右边的笔记本电脑是Acer Aspire R3-131T，配置有Intel Celeron N2840处理器、4GB RAM和500GB硬盘，售价RM2499。所有笔记本电脑均配备有触控屏幕和键盘，以及各种接口如USB端口和HDMI端口。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, low-angle view of a sculpted ape or chimpanzee figure, likely made of bronze, stone, or another weathered outdoor material. The statue dominates the frame, rising against a pale, almost white-blue sky with no visible background details, which gives it a monumental, dramatic presence.

The ape’s head is turned slightly upward and to the right, with a calm but alert expression. Its facial features are carefully modeled: a broad muzzle, deep-set eyes, rounded ears, and a slightly open mouth. The surface is highly textured, with rough, flowing grooves representing fur across the face, neck, shoulders, and arms. The material has a gray-brown, weathered patina, with highlights catching on the raised ridges of the sculpture.

The camera angle is from below, making the figure appear large and imposing. The upper body and arms are visible, and the ape appears to be seated or leaning forward. In the foreground, partly out of focus, there is a cluster of sculpted skulls or bone-like forms. These rounded shapes and hollow eye sockets create a darker, more symbolic or dramatic element in the composition. The ape’s hands and arms seem to rest near or around these forms.

Bright sunlight from above or behind creates strong highlights along the top of the ape’s head, shoulders, and textured fur, while other areas fall into shadow. The overall mood is solemn and contemplative, with the statue’s rough detail and the skull-like shapes suggesting themes of evolution, mortality, intelligence, or reflection.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示雕塑艺术的摄影作品，特写拍摄了一尊猴子雕像。雕像细节丰富，表面呈现出深浅不一的灰色调，表面有明显的纹理和裂痕，表现出一种历史感。猴子的表情生动，眼神直视前方，嘴巴微微张开，似乎在发出声音或是在表达某种情感。它的手臂和身体姿态显示出力量和动态美。雕像背后是模糊的天空背景，突出了雕像的细节和质感。

caption:
The image shows a large group of students walking outdoors along a sunlit campus or school pathway. Most of them are wearing coordinated school uniforms: white button-down shirts, green ties, grey trousers or grey skirts, and black shoes. Some students also wear dark green sweaters or sleeveless sweater vests over their shirts. Several carry papers, rolled documents, notebooks, or exam sheets, suggesting they may be leaving a class, test, or school event.

The group is moving toward the camera, filling most of the frame from the foreground to the background. Faces are blurred, so individual facial features are not visible. In the foreground, a few partially visible heads appear out of focus at the bottom edge, adding to the sense of a crowded walkway. Near the center, students in white shirts and green ties walk closely together, while on the right side a student in a green sweater vest holds rolled papers. Another student on the far right wears a white shirt, tie, grey skirt, and carries items while walking.

The setting appears to be an outdoor school or institutional area. On the left side there is a concrete building wall with a doorway and a corrugated metal surface or shutter. Trees line the pathway, casting patches of shade across the scene. On the right side, there are more trees, greenery, and a few parked motorcycles or scooters partly visible behind the students. The lighting is bright and warm, indicating daytime, possibly midday, with strong sunlight illuminating the uniforms and pavement.

Overall, the image captures a busy moment of students dispersing or walking together in a school environment, with a lively, crowded atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群学生在校园内行走的照片。学生们穿着统一的校服，包括白色衬衫、深色领带和灰色或黑色的裤子。一些学生手持文件，而其他人则专注于前方。背景中可以看到学校的建筑和树木，营造出一个典型的学校环境。

caption:
The image shows a vivid, fairy-tale-like palace rising above a dense green forested hillside. The building appears to be the colorful Pena Palace in Sintra, Portugal, recognizable by its bright yellow and red walls, ornate towers, and romantic architectural style.

The palace sits slightly left of center, partially framed by trees in the foreground and background. Its most prominent feature is a large round yellow tower capped with a pale greenish-blue dome. The dome has a small decorative finial at the top, and the tower is encircled by crenellated battlements, giving it a castle-like appearance. The yellow walls are punctuated by small white-trimmed windows and decorative details.

Behind and beside the yellow section are contrasting red and gray portions of the palace. A red tower with white accents and pointed turrets rises behind the dome, adding to the layered, whimsical silhouette. To the right, more palace wings extend horizontally, featuring yellow facades, arched windows, balconies, crenellated parapets, and small domed or turreted elements. Some tiny figures appear along the terraces, suggesting visitors walking around the palace.

The lower part of the palace is partly hidden by lush vegetation. Deep green trees fill the foreground, including darker pine branches on the right and bottom edges, while lighter green deciduous trees cover the hillside below. The palace seems perched on rocky terrain, with a few pale stone outcrops visible near its base.

The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image. It is bright and hazy, with soft white and pale gray clouds against a light blue background. The overall lighting is sunny but slightly diffused, giving the scene a soft, pastel quality. The composition emphasizes the palace’s striking colors against the natural greenery, creating a dreamy, picturesque landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座位于山丘上的黄色建筑的照片。建筑物具有显著的哥特式风格，其特征包括尖顶、圆顶和复杂的装饰性元素。周围是郁郁葱葱的树木，为这座建筑增添了一抹自然色彩。在照片的背景中，可以看到一片广阔的天空和几朵散布的云彩，这些元素衬托出建筑的壮观与美丽。

caption:
The image shows a large public monument in an urban square, photographed from a low angle so it rises dramatically against the sky.

At the center is a tall stone pedestal topped by a bronze or dark metal statue of a winged female figure. She stands on a textured globe-like sphere decorated with floral or leaf patterns. One of her wings is visible, extending upward behind her shoulder. Her right arm is raised high, holding a circular wreath or laurel crown, while her other arm holds a small blue-and-yellow Ukrainian flag that extends outward in the wind.

The pedestal is broad and gray, with a decorative emblem on the front. The emblem includes the Ukrainian trident, surrounded by ornamental leaves and drapery-like elements. Below it is the inscription in Cyrillic: “СЛАВА УКРАЇНІ,” meaning “Glory to Ukraine.”

The background is dominated by a vivid blue sky filled with large, bright white clouds. The sun appears to be behind the clouds and statue, creating strong backlighting and making the statue appear partly silhouetted. Around the base of the monument are trees, paved areas, and low stone structures. In the distance, there are historic-looking buildings with classical facades, including one with columns and arched windows. On the left side, a church or cathedral with blue walls and golden domes is visible, adding a distinctive Ukrainian architectural element.

Overall, the scene feels patriotic and monumental, with the Ukrainian flag, national emblem, and inscription emphasizing national pride and resilience.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场上雕塑的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一个高耸的雕塑，其底座上刻有文字，顶端是一个手持花环的天使形象。雕塑背后是蓝天和洁白的云朵，阳光从云层间透出，照亮了雕塑和周围的环境。在雕塑的左侧，可以看到一座装饰华丽的教堂，其金色圆顶在阳光下闪耀。周围还有其他建筑和树木，为这个场景增添了层次感。

caption:
The image is a close-up outdoor portrait of a person, likely an athlete, shown from the upper chest upward. Their face is intentionally blurred, while the clothing and accessories are in sharp focus.

They are wearing a navy blue visor cap with a curved brim. The top of the visor has visible branding, including a partially visible “Red Bull” style logo and small decorative/metallic details near the brim. A pair of sunglasses or glasses appears to be tucked along the side of the visor. Their reddish-brown hair is pulled back into a ponytail, visible along the left side of the image.

The person is dressed in a white and light-blue patterned athletic polo shirt. The shirt has a navy collar and a grid-like blue pattern across the chest. A black Puma logo is embroidered on the right side of the chest. On the left side of the collar is a small pink ribbon pin, commonly associated with breast cancer awareness. There is also a small square pin or badge on the upper chest area with a dark animal-like silhouette.

They are wearing multiple pieces of jewelry: a small round earring featuring a red-and-black ladybug design, layered silver necklaces, and a prominent cross pendant hanging down the center of the chest. The sunlight highlights the side of the face, ear, hair, and shirt, creating a bright, high-contrast look.

The background is heavily blurred with a shallow depth of field. It appears to be an outdoor setting, possibly a golf course or sports venue, with soft green and gray tones suggesting grass, trees, or distant structures. The overall image has a bright, sunny atmosphere with the subject positioned slightly left of center and the open blurred background extending to the right.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性高尔夫球手的特写照片。她戴着一顶蓝色的帽子，耳朵上佩戴着耳环，并且脖子上挂着一条项链。她的衣着包括一件带有品牌标志的白色Puma运动衫和深色领口装饰。背景虽然模糊，但可以辨认出是在户外进行的活动场景中。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, outdoor portrait of a vintage film camera sitting on a rough stone or concrete ledge in a garden.

The camera dominates the lower half of the frame. It has a classic rangefinder-style body with a silver metal top plate and a black, slightly worn leatherette covering on the front. The surface shows scuffs, scratches, and signs of age, giving it a well-used vintage character. On the front, in white lettering, is the Cyrillic brand/model marking “ФЭД 5C” (FED 5C). To the left of the lettering is a rectangular textured light panel, and to the right is a small rectangular viewfinder window. The lens protrudes from the center-lower portion of the camera; around the lens ring are markings including “ИНДУСТАР-61Л/Д” and “2.8/55,” indicating a 55mm f/2.8 lens. The lens glass reflects light and appears dark and glossy.

Along the top of the camera are several mechanical controls: a large round dial on the left, a smaller metal button or post near it, a central dial with markings, a black hot shoe/accessory mount, and another large ridged dial on the right with a silver center. The metallic parts catch bright sunlight, creating sharp highlights.

The background is softly blurred, emphasizing the camera in the foreground. Behind it are fresh green leaves and stems, with clusters of small blue-purple grape hyacinth-like flowers scattered throughout. The garden soil and bits of brown earth are visible between the plants. The shallow depth of field gives the scene a warm, springlike atmosphere, with the camera appearing as a nostalgic object placed among blooming flowers.

Overall, the image combines the aged, mechanical look of an old Soviet-style camera with the bright, natural colors of a sunny garden setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示复古相机的摄影作品，相机放置在户外环境中，背景是绿色植物和紫色花朵。相机的设计细节清晰可见，包括黑色的机身、银色的镜头和品牌标志。

caption:
The image shows a wide coastal cityscape viewed from the water, likely from a moving boat or ferry.

In the foreground, dark blue-gray water fills the lower half of the frame. The surface is choppy, with many small waves and ripples catching faint light. Near the bottom center and left, white foamy wake trails across the water, suggesting the photo was taken from the rear or side of a vessel as it moves away from shore.

Across the middle of the image is a long shoreline lined with buildings. The city rises up over low hills, with dense clusters of houses and apartment blocks spread along the slopes. The buildings are mostly light-colored—white, beige, cream, and pale orange—with darker rooftops. Some windows or lights glow warmly, creating small bright points along the waterfront and hillside.

On the right side, the hill is darker and more prominent, with homes and larger structures scattered among trees. On the left, the land is lower and more distant, with a wooded hill and a few visible structures. The shoreline includes waterfront buildings close to the water, and there appears to be at least one small ferry or boat near the right-center of the scene.

The sky dominates the upper half of the photo. It is mostly clear and cloudless, transitioning from a pale blue-gray at the top to a soft peach and pinkish tone near the horizon, suggesting sunset or early evening. The overall atmosphere is calm and slightly hazy, with the city silhouetted gently against the fading light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黄昏时分海景的自然风光摄影。图像前景是波涛汹涌的大海，海水在阳光照射下泛着微光，波浪轻拍着岸边。背景中，天空由蓝色渐变为橙黄色，太阳即将落山，为整个场景增添了一抹温暖的色调。远处可以看到密集的建筑群，它们沿着山坡分布，形成了一幅宁静而和谐的城市轮廓。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large historic stone building, likely a church, chapel, or monastery, viewed from below looking upward into a high domed ceiling.

At the center is a tall cylindrical dome or drum made of dark, weathered stone blocks. The stonework is arranged in curved horizontal courses, giving the dome a layered, circular pattern. The ceiling surface is aged and textured, with mottled gray, brown, black, and reddish tones, suggesting centuries of wear, smoke staining, or patina. Near the upper center, the dome curves inward toward a circular cap, emphasizing the height and depth of the space.

Several narrow arched windows are set into the drum of the dome. Bright daylight pours through them, creating glowing white openings and casting angled beams of warm light across the stone. Dust or fine particles are visible in the light, giving the air a hazy, atmospheric quality.

Surrounding the dome are heavy stone arches and thick supporting walls. The walls are built from large rectangular blocks in alternating shades of reddish-brown, charcoal gray, and tan, creating a striped, patchwork appearance. The architecture feels massive and ancient, with rounded arches, deep recesses, and thick masonry typical of medieval or ecclesiastical construction.

Hanging from the center of the dome is a long chain that descends vertically into the foreground. Suspended from it is a large ornate chandelier made of dark metal, possibly wrought iron. The chandelier has a circular frame with decorative scrollwork and many small bulb-shaped lights around its perimeter. Its intricate silhouette contrasts against the warm stone background.

The composition is symmetrical and dramatic: the dome and chain align near the vertical center, while the arches frame the scene on both sides. The lighting combines cool daylight from the windows with warmer artificial or reflected light near the lower walls, enhancing the rich orange and brown tones of the masonry. Overall, the image conveys a sense of height, age, solemnity, and architectural grandeur.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂内部的摄影作品，从地面视角向上看，可以看到一个复杂的圆顶结构和悬挂的吊灯。圆顶由多个层叠的拱形组成，顶部装饰有精细的图案。吊灯位于图像中央，由多根金属杆支撑，下方是复杂的装饰性设计。墙壁上覆盖着深色瓷砖，与天花板上的浅色瓷砖形成对比。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种庄严而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, portrait-style photo of a person dressed in a striking black-and-white wedding outfit, standing in what appears to be a busy city street at night.

The subject is centered in the frame, with their face intentionally blurred. They are wearing a distinctive half-black, half-white bowler-style hat. The hat is divided vertically: one side is white and the other is black, matching the rest of the outfit’s contrasting theme. A white veil or draped fabric falls from the back of the hat over the shoulders.

Their clothing combines elements of a bridal gown and a tuxedo. On one side, there is a white wedding-dress-like garment with floral embroidery, subtle beadwork, and a soft satin-like sheen. The bodice has delicate decorative patterns, and the lower portion appears pleated. On the other side, the outfit resembles a formal black tuxedo jacket with a black lapel. A white tuxedo shirt with vertical pleats and a black bow tie is visible at the center, emphasizing the split formalwear design.

In the lower left of the image, the person is holding a bouquet of flowers. The bouquet includes white and deep red roses, small white filler flowers, green leaves, and sheer white wrapping, with a pinkish-red ribbon hanging down.

The background is heavily blurred with a shallow depth of field, creating colorful bokeh lights. There are bright yellow, blue, white, red, and orange light spots, suggesting illuminated signs, traffic, or street decorations in an urban nighttime setting. The blurred shapes and warm lighting give the scene a festive, lively atmosphere, while the subject’s outfit is the clear focal point.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的照片，展示了一对新人在婚礼上的特写。新郎穿着经典的黑色燕尾服和白色领结，而新娘则身着精致的白色婚纱，头戴与之相配的白色帽子。他们站在一个模糊的背景前，似乎是在一个户外活动中，周围有其他穿着传统服装的人群。

caption:
The image shows a colorful, crowded market stall filled with handbags and accessories. Dozens of bags hang from strings and rods under a pale blue tarp canopy, creating a dense overhead display that nearly fills the frame.

In the foreground and center, many handbags and purses in bright colors are suspended at different heights. There are large tote bags, quilted shoulder bags, backpacks, and smaller crossbody purses. The colors are vivid and varied: red, orange, pink, tan, beige, navy blue, black, olive green, purple, and teal. Several bags have decorative details such as metal studs, stitched diamond patterns, chain accents, buckles, floral appliqués, and shiny emblems. One red handbag near the top center has gold chain decoration and the word “Guess” on it. A large olive-green tote hangs near the upper right, while a shiny plastic-wrapped bag is visible at the far upper right.

On the left side, a row of brightly colored scarves or bandanas hangs vertically, featuring patterns in green, pink, orange, purple, black, and yellow. Beneath them are more textiles and merchandise spread across the floor. The stall appears packed tightly, with products displayed from the ceiling down to the ground.

At the bottom and lower left, trays and mats hold small goods such as combs, brushes, jewelry-like items, bottles, packets, hair accessories, and other market trinkets. The floor is covered with cloths and mats, and merchandise is arranged in boxes and trays.

Two people are partially visible near the bottom of the image. On the lower right-center, a seated vendor wearing a gray T-shirt sits among the goods, looking toward the side. On the lower left, another seated person is partly visible behind the merchandise and hanging bags.

The lighting is bright and slightly warm, making the colors of the bags and fabrics appear very saturated. The overall impression is of a lively outdoor bazaar or street market stall, densely stocked with affordable fashion accessories and small household or beauty items.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示市场摊位上各种手提包的照片。摊位上挂满了各式各样的包包，颜色丰富多样，从亮橙色到深蓝色再到浅粉色，每只包都带有独特的设计和装饰。一位男士坐在摊位前，身穿灰色T恤和棕色裤子，头戴橙色帽子，正在专注地查看手中的物品。他的周围摆放着各种小饰品、首饰和其他商品，营造出一种热闹的市场氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy indoor event scene, likely a book signing, meet-and-greet, or promotional booth.

In the foreground, a young girl is standing with her back to the camera at a white counter. She has light brown hair tied up in a bun or high ponytail, decorated with a large white hair accessory with small green accents. She is wearing a white long-sleeved top and a light-colored skirt. Her hands are extended toward the people seated or standing behind the counter, as if handing over or receiving a book, notebook, or signed item.

Behind the counter are several women, though their faces are blurred. One seated woman near the center-right is holding a purple-covered book or booklet and appears to be signing or returning it. She has dark shoulder-length hair and is wearing a light gray cardigan over a patterned blouse, along with a chunky necklace. A pen is visible in her hand or nearby, reinforcing the impression of an autograph or signing interaction.

To the right, a tall woman with long blonde hair leans forward over the counter, watching the exchange. She is wearing a dark burgundy top with metallic buttons or studs on the shoulders. On the far right edge, another person’s hands are visible resting near notebooks, pens, and a small clear display stand. The person has painted purple fingernails.

On the left side, another woman is partly visible holding a microphone, suggesting there may be announcements, interviews, or a hosted event taking place. A woman with long reddish-brown hair in a bright red outfit stands behind the child, partially obscured by her.

The background is dark and glossy, with repeated Cyrillic lettering that appears to include “БУКВО,” possibly part of a bookstore or publisher branding. A large screen or display behind the group shows a blurred colorful image with blue, green, and yellow tones. The setting feels like a public exhibition booth, bookstore event, or convention area.

The counter is covered with small objects: pens, notebooks, papers, a book or booklet being exchanged, and possibly a water bottle at the far right. The overall atmosphere is warm, crowded, and interactive, centered on the child receiving attention from the people behind the signing table.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影风格的图片，捕捉了一个室内活动场景。图中左侧有一位穿着灰色长袖上衣和白色裙子的小女孩，她的头发扎成一个高高的马尾辫，正专注地看着手中的物品。在她旁边是一位女性，身穿黑色上衣，正在使用手机。右侧有两位女性，一位穿着红色上衣，另一位穿着深色衣服，她们似乎在交谈或等待。背景中有一块显示屏，上面显示着一些文字，但具体内容不清晰。

caption:
The image shows a wide outdoor winter scene, likely in a park or public recreation area, under a clear blue sky with thin, wispy clouds.

In the foreground is a large frozen surface—possibly a pond, lake, or flooded skating area—covered with pale gray-white ice. The ice is heavily marked with dark curved lines, skate-like tracks, footprints, and scuffed patterns, giving it a textured, well-used appearance. Long shadows stretch across the ice from the left side, suggesting low winter sunlight, likely morning or late afternoon.

On the right side of the ice, several people are visible. A small tan dog, possibly a corgi or similar short-legged breed, runs or trots across the ice while attached to a long yellow leash. A person in a long black coat and white face mask holds the leash, walking behind it. Nearby, another person in a dark jacket with a yellow inner layer appears to be moving across the ice, and a child or smaller person in a black coat and white shoes stands farther left, also wearing a mask. There are a few more people scattered in the distance near the left edge of the frozen area.

Behind the frozen surface is a band of tall dry reeds in golden-brown tones, typical of winter vegetation. Beyond the reeds, the park contains landscaped elements: a wooden arched bridge with railings, a traditional-style pavilion with a dark tiled roof and wooden posts, and several carefully shaped pine trees. The pavilion and bridge give the scene a Korean garden-like atmosphere.

In the background, modern buildings rise behind the park. On the left is a low white building with blue Korean text on its facade. In the center and right are larger industrial or institutional-looking buildings with red brick sections, pale gray cladding, vents, roof equipment, and angular architectural forms. Dominating the right side of the skyline is a very tall cylindrical smokestack or chimney, mostly white with a pale green lower section, standing vertically against the blue sky.

The overall mood is calm and crisp: a sunny winter day where people are enjoying the frozen open space, while the combination of traditional park structures, dry reeds, modern buildings, and the tall smokestack creates a contrast between nature, recreation, and urban infrastructure.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季户外活动的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个结冰的广场，上面有几个人在进行滑冰或行走。最显眼的是一个穿着黑色冬装的人，正牵着一只狗在冰面上行走。广场上还有其他几位穿着冬季服装的人，有的在交谈，有的在滑冰。背景中是一座现代建筑和一座传统的亭子，以及一片金黄色的草地。天空是晴朗的蓝色，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a used postage stamp against a solid black background.

- The stamp is rectangular with perforated, scalloped edges on all four sides.
- Its paper is off-white or slightly cream-colored, with visible wear and irregular dark smudges from postal cancellation marks.
- The printed design is mostly a reddish-brown or burnt-orange ink.
- At the top, large numerals read **“45g”**, likely indicating a value of 45 groschen. Behind and above the number are several thin horizontal lines forming a decorative band.
- Across the lower portion, the country name **“Österreich”** is written in a large cursive-style script, identifying it as an Austrian stamp.
- Beneath the design, in small capital letters, is the name **“F. ZERRITSCH”**, likely the designer or engraver.
- The central illustration is stylized and somewhat abstract, printed in the same reddish-brown ink. It appears to depict a dynamic scene with angular shapes, possibly a figure, landscape, or symbolic motif, with sweeping lines and shaded hatching.
- Several black or dark purple cancellation marks cross the stamp, especially near the top and middle, partially obscuring the design and denomination.
- The stamp looks aged and used, with uneven ink coverage, small stains, and worn edges.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张奥地利邮票，面值为45g，发行于1972年。邮票的中心是一个棕色的鹰图案，周围环绕着山脉和树木的轮廓。邮票上方印有“AUSTRIA”字样，下方则是发行者“F. ZARRITSCH”的签名。邮票的边缘是典型的齿形设计，整体呈现出一种复古的风格。

caption:
The image shows a sunny urban square dominated by a tall brick clock tower standing in the middle of a shallow circular fountain. The tower is built from reddish-brown bricks and has an open arched base supported by four brick pillars. Around its middle and upper sections are large round clock faces set into decorative circular brick frames. Near the top, the tower has a wide overhanging roof with a gray, pyramidal metal cap, and at the very peak there is an ornamental weather vane or metal finial.

The fountain surrounding the tower has a low red-brick rim and turquoise-blue water. Several small jets of water are spraying upward around the base of the tower. In the foreground, a few people are sitting on a wooden bench near the fountain, including adults and a child. A stroller is parked beside them, suggesting a relaxed public plaza atmosphere.

To the right of the clock tower is a large white mosque with rounded domes and tall, narrow arched windows. A slender white minaret rises prominently behind it, topped with a pointed conical spire. Farther in the background on the left, additional minarets are visible, along with strings of decorative lights stretching across the street.

The plaza is paved with reddish tiles arranged in geometric patterns. Several vehicles are parked or passing nearby, including a red-and-white van on the left and a white van on the right. There are small trees and shrubs around the square, adding greenery to the scene. The sky is clear and deep blue, with bright sunlight casting sharp shadows, giving the image a warm, midday feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场的照片，中心是一个高耸的钟楼，其上装饰有四个时钟面。钟楼的设计简约而现代，顶部有一个尖顶和一个十字架。在钟楼前方，有一个喷泉，水柱从中心向上喷射，周围铺设有红色砖石。广场上有几个人坐在长椅上休息，享受着宁静的环境。背景中可以看到一座具有传统风格的白色清真寺，其尖塔直插云霄。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为这个场景增添了生机与活力。

caption:
The image shows a modern urban plaza in what appears to be a warm, upscale city district, with a mix of high-rise hotels, glass towers, palm trees, and pedestrian walkways.

In the foreground, a wide paved pedestrian area stretches into the scene. The pavement is made of small gray tiles, giving the walkway a clean, patterned texture. Several tall palm trees stand prominently on the left and center, their thick trunks rising from landscaped beds and their large green fronds spreading outward. Around the palms are low hedges and decorative black street lamps with multiple white globe lights. A few dark animal-like sculptures or statues are visible near the landscaped area.

On the left side, there is a large beige high-rise building with many balconies and rectangular windows. Its architecture has a resort-like style, with decorative details near the upper floors and a warm cream-colored façade. The building continues upward beyond the frame, emphasizing its height.

In the center background, a tall blue-green glass tower dominates the skyline. The building has a modern reflective façade with many windows and a slightly angular, slanted roofline. The text “DoubleTree by Hilton” is clearly visible on the front of the tower, identifying it as a hotel. In front of and below it are smaller white and glass buildings, including one with Arabic signage and another with a circular logo.

On the right side, a lower, modern building features a distinctive façade of rectangular white panels arranged in a grid-like pattern over dark glass. The sign “GODIVA LOUNGE” is visible on this building, suggesting a café or dessert lounge inside. Next to it stands a tall vertical digital signboard displaying “The Beach” and a “Courtesy Policy,” with icons and rules listed beneath, though the smaller text is not fully readable.

Near the middle of the plaza, there is a dark pergola or shaded walkway structure with vertical posts and a slatted roof. A few people are scattered through the scene: one person sits on a bench in the foreground near the center, while others walk or stand farther back near the buildings. The area feels calm and lightly populated.

The lighting is soft and warm, likely from late afternoon or early evening. The sky is clear and pale, with no visible clouds. Overall, the image presents a clean, polished urban leisure district with luxury hotels, restaurants, palm-lined landscaping, and modern architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市街景的照片，前景中有几棵高大的棕榈树排列在人行道旁，中景是一座装饰性的建筑入口，其设计简洁而现代。背景中耸立着多座高楼大厦，其中最显眼的是左侧的蓝绿色玻璃幕墙建筑和右侧的白色高楼，它们的窗户反射出天空的颜色。整个场景被柔和的日光照亮，营造出一种宁静的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a low, wide-angle view of a small outdoor car gathering in a grassy area, likely near a park or tree-lined roadside. The scene is warmly lit by late-afternoon or early-evening sunlight, with the sun shining through dense green trees in the background and creating strong golden lens flare across the frame.

In the foreground, soft, slightly out-of-focus grass fills the lower portion of the image, emphasizing the low camera position. Beyond the grass, several classic cars are parked side by side.

At the center is a bright red Porsche coupe viewed from the rear-left side. It has a large black rear spoiler, squared tail lights, wide rear tires, and a low, sporty stance. The “Porsche” branding is visible across the rear spoiler area, and the license plate area appears blurred. Its glossy red paint catches the warm sunlight.

To the right is a dark burgundy Porsche, also seen from the rear. It has the rounded rear shape of an older 911-style model, with “Carrera 2” lettering visible on the back. Its rear window and bodywork reflect the bright sky and trees, and its license plate is also blurred.

On the left side of the image, a red convertible Mercedes-Benz is parked with a dark soft top. The rear badge appears to read “450 SL.” It is partially obscured by the central Porsche and by a roped-off barrier with metal posts, suggesting the cars may be on display. A black car is cropped at the extreme left edge.

A few people are visible in the background near the cars, though they are small and partly hidden. Behind the vehicles are tall leafy trees, a lamppost, and a utility or communication pole. The sunlight filtering through the foliage gives the image a nostalgic, summery atmosphere, with warm highlights, soft shadows, and a relaxed classic-car meet feeling.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在自然光照下拍摄的汽车摄影照片，展现了三辆经典跑车停放在草地上。最前方是一辆红色的跑车，其后是两辆银灰色的跑车。这些车辆都呈现出复古的设计风格，车身线条流畅，车轮设计独特。在车辆的背后，可以看到几位观众和树木，而太阳从画面的上方照射下来，为整个场景增添了一种温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a badminton player captured mid-action against an almost completely black background, creating a dramatic, high-contrast sports scene.

The athlete is positioned on the right side of the frame, with a large amount of empty dark space surrounding him, especially above and to the left. He appears to be in the middle of a powerful shot or defensive return. His body is angled slightly to the left, and his head is tilted upward as if tracking the shuttlecock, though the shuttlecock itself is not clearly visible.

He is wearing a white short-sleeved athletic shirt with light blue trim around the collar and blue accents on the sides. There is dark lettering or branding on the shoulder and sleeve area, and a small logo near the chest. He also wears bright blue shorts with a small white logo near the lower leg. The clothing suggests professional badminton attire.

His right arm is extended forward and downward, gripping a badminton racket. The racket head is visible near the lower-left portion of his body, slightly blurred from motion, suggesting a fast swing. His other arm is bent tightly near his torso, with the fist clenched, adding to the sense of intensity and explosive movement. The muscles in his arms are sharply defined under the lighting.

The player’s face is blurred or out of focus, but his dark hair is visible, swept upward and back slightly, likely from motion. Strong overhead or side lighting highlights parts of his face, neck, arms, shirt, and shorts, while much of the surrounding scene remains in deep shadow.

Overall, the image has a cinematic, action-focused feel. The black background isolates the athlete, emphasizing his movement, concentration, and physical effort during a badminton match.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到羽毛球运动员击球瞬间的体育摄影照片。图像中，运动员穿着白色带有蓝色图案的运动衫和蓝色短裤，在黑色背景前做出挥拍动作。他的身体向前倾斜，右手握拍准备击球，面部表情专注而紧张。整个场景在低光条件下拍摄，突出了运动员的动作和姿态。

caption:
The image shows a busy market or communal workspace where several women are handling bundles of pale yellow-green flowering stems. The scene is tightly framed and crowded, giving the impression of active sorting, buying, or preparing plant material.

In the foreground, three women are most prominent. They appear to be wearing casual, patterned plaid or checkered shirts in earthy tones such as brown, purple, red, and cream. Their dark hair is pulled back neatly, and their faces are blurred. Each woman is focused on the plant bundles in front of her. The plants have long green stems topped with many delicate, branching, tiny blossoms or buds, creating a feathery texture across the image.

At the bottom center and lower right, woven baskets are visible, suggesting the flowers or stems are being collected, sorted, or sold. One woman on the right is holding a large bunch upright, while another near the center leans forward as if reaching into a basket or arranging the stems. On the left, another woman holds or gathers a similar bundle.

The background is softly out of focus but appears crowded with more people and market goods. There are hanging textiles or scarves in bright colors, including pinks and purples, near the top of the frame. A large woven hat or basket-like object is partially visible on the far right edge. Warm sunlight enters from the upper left, highlighting the women’s hair and the pale blossoms, creating strong contrast between the bright plant material and the darker, shaded background.

Overall, the image captures a lively, intimate moment in a traditional market setting, centered on the sorting or selling of fresh flowering branches.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示几位女性在户外活动中的照片。她们正聚精会神地处理一些黄色的植物，可能是某种农作物或花卉。其中一位女性穿着格子衬衫和棕色裤子，正在用手触摸植物。其他几位也穿着传统服装，有的戴着宽边帽，他们似乎都在参与这个过程。背景中可以看到模糊的人群和其他物品，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor monument sign for **Google**. The sign is rectangular and mounted on a black base. The upper portion is a light gray or off-white panel with the classic multicolored Google wordmark across the center: a large blue “G,” red “o,” yellow “o,” blue “g,” green “l,” and red “e.”

Below the logo, the black base displays the address in bold white block lettering: **“12396 GRANT ST.”** On the far left of the black base, there is a blurred rectangular area, likely obscuring additional identifying information.

The sign sits beside a roadway, with a curb and asphalt visible in the foreground. There is a strip of grass and some exposed dirt around the base, suggesting landscaping or recent ground work. In the background, there are out-of-focus trees, shrubs, and part of a light-colored building, giving the scene the appearance of a corporate campus or office entrance. The lighting suggests daytime, with bright natural sunlight and soft shadows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Google公司标志牌的照片。标志牌位于一个明亮的白色背景上，中心是公司的标志性字母组合“G”和“O”，以及一个彩色的“L”。下方有黑色的文字标识显示地址信息：“12396 GRANT ST.”。标志牌的设计简洁而现代，颜色对比鲜明，突出了其作为品牌识别的重要作用。

caption:
The image shows a front porch area of a house with two cardboard Amazon delivery boxes placed near the entrance.

In the foreground, there is a light-colored concrete porch or walkway with patches of dappled sunlight and shadow across it, likely from nearby trees. At the very bottom edge of the image, a strip of reddish-brown brick paving is visible.

Centered in the lower half of the image are two Amazon shipping boxes stacked on top of each other. The bottom box is larger and sits directly on the concrete. It has the Amazon smile logo printed in black on the side, along with shipping labels and handling symbols. The top box is smaller and rests horizontally on the larger one. It also has Amazon branding, black packing tape, labels, and a small bright pink sticker on the top surface. Both boxes appear unopened and slightly worn from shipping.

Behind the packages is the front entrance of the house. On the right side is a black front door with raised rectangular paneling. The door has shiny brass-colored hardware: a round deadbolt above, a keyed lock plate, and a curved handle below. A brass kick plate is mounted along the bottom of the door.

To the left of the black door is a white-framed sidelight window with glass panes. The trim around the door and window is bright white, contrasting with the dark door. Further left, the exterior wall is made of light gray and beige brick with some reddish variations and weathered texture.

At the base of the door, partially tucked under the packages, is a black doormat with an orange pumpkin design, suggesting a fall or Halloween theme. The overall scene suggests a package delivery left at the front door of a suburban home on a sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两个包裹盒子堆放在家庭前门台阶上的照片。包裹盒上印有亚马逊的标志，表明它们可能是通过亚马逊快递送达的。盒子放置在一块黑色的地毯上，地毯上有橙色的图案。背景中可以看到一扇半开的白色门和部分砖墙结构。

caption:
The image shows a large group of children gathered outdoors on a grassy field, likely during a school event, cultural program, or parade. The scene is bright and colorful, with many students dressed in uniforms and traditional clothing.

In the center foreground, a young girl stands facing the camera wearing a vivid red traditional outfit, possibly a sari or cultural dress. Her clothing has gold borders and decorative patterns. She is adorned with traditional jewelry, including a gold headpiece across her hairline, earrings, layered necklaces, red bangles, and a wide silver ornamented belt around her waist with dangling pieces. She wears sandals and stands upright, appearing to be posed for the photo.

To the left, several children are dressed in blue scout-style uniforms. The closest child wears a light blue shirt, navy trousers, a dark tie with “N.S.G.S.” visible on it, a belt, and a blue cap with colorful trim. Behind him, more children in similar blue uniforms stand in a line, also wearing caps and ties. Some have green ribbons or sashes visible.

Near the center-left, an adult woman stands among the children. She is wearing a bright yellow-green-orange sari with a floral or gradient pattern and carries a beige handbag and a red shopping bag. Her presence suggests she may be a teacher, guardian, or organizer.

On the right side of the image, many schoolgirls are dressed in green-and-white uniforms. They wear green pinafores or vests over white shirts, green skirts, white caps, ties, white socks, and sneakers. Some are standing in rows, and a few appear to be holding hands or waiting together. One girl on the far right is partly turned away, wearing a white cap and green uniform.

Behind the central girl in red, another child is partially visible in colorful traditional clothing, including green and red fabric, with orange floral decorations in the hair. This adds to the impression of a cultural or festive performance.

The background includes trees with dense foliage, a brick structure, and multi-story buildings with windows and balconies. The sunlight appears warm, suggesting daytime, possibly morning or afternoon. Overall, the image captures a lively school gathering where children are dressed either in uniforms or traditional attire, creating a vibrant mix of colors and textures.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示不同文化背景的儿童在户外活动中的照片。前景中，一位穿着传统红色和金色服装的小女孩成为了焦点，她戴着精致的头饰，并且身着一件装饰有白色珠子的红色上衣和金色腰带。她的周围是其他穿着绿色制服的孩子们，他们似乎正在参加某种仪式或活动。在图片的左侧，可以看到几位穿着深色制服的成年人，可能是组织者或监护人。背景中模糊地显示了建筑物和其他参与者，但它们并不是这张照片的主要焦点。

caption:
The image shows a seated person outdoors in strong sunlight, positioned on a wooden bench or chair against a red-brown wooden wall made of horizontal planks. The person’s face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial details.

They are dressed in a somewhat formal yet casual style: a light blue denim or chambray blazer, a pale striped button-up shirt, a purple bow tie, and light blue trousers with wide cuffs. A white pocket square is visible in the blazer’s breast pocket. They are wearing black leather shoes and light-colored socks.

The person is sitting with legs apart and hands resting near the lap. In one hand, they appear to be holding a cigarette or small smoking item. A compact black camera hangs from their hands by a strap, resting near the center of the image. The camera lens faces outward and the strap drops down toward a white plastic bucket or stool placed between their feet.

The setting appears to be a wooden deck or porch. The floorboards are weathered gray-brown wood, and the bench or chair is made of rough wooden planks. The background wall is painted a reddish-brown color, with black vertical trim and visible gaps between horizontal boards. On the right side of the wall there is a small metal hook or handle.

Lighting is dramatic: bright sunlight illuminates the person’s clothing, lap, and lower body, while large areas of the upper background and parts of the person’s face and shoulders fall into deep shadow. The overall atmosphere feels like a casual outdoor portrait taken in late afternoon or strong directional sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位穿着休闲装的男性坐在户外木制长椅上的照片。他身穿一件蓝色夹克，搭配白色条纹衬衫和浅色裤子，脚穿黑色皮鞋，并佩戴着领结。他的双手交叉放在膝盖上，面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。背景是红色的木质建筑墙面，与男性的休闲装扮形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a shaded historic courtyard or garden area centered on an Ottoman-style fountain pavilion. The structure is an open-sided canopy supported by slender white marble columns. It has a broad, dark gray, faceted pyramidal roof with raised seams, and a small cylindrical finial or vent at the top in a warm brown color.

Beneath the canopy is a pale marble fountain or ablution basin with several small black metal taps attached to its sides. The fountain has decorative arched paneling carved into the marble. Small rectangular marble stools or blocks sit around it, likely for people to sit while washing. Hanging from the front edge of the pavilion is a green sign that reads “ADİLE SULTAN ŞADIRVANI,” with smaller text below: “The Fountain of Adile Sultan” and the date “1846/47.”

The setting is lush and leafy, with large mature trees surrounding and overhanging the structure. A massive tree trunk rises just behind the pavilion on the right, its lower bark painted white. Dense green foliage fills most of the background, creating dappled sunlight and shade across the stone paving.

The ground is a raised stone terrace bordered by a low rough-stone wall. A few steps lead up to the fountain area in the foreground. On the left side of the scene there is a black lamppost, a wooden bench, and what appears to be a decorative metal frame or possibly a well-like feature with a white stone base. On the right edge, part of another carved marble structure with inscription-like markings is visible.

Overall, the image conveys a quiet, historic, garden-like atmosphere: an old marble fountain pavilion nestled among trees, with warm sunlight filtering through the leaves.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园中一座古典风格的喷泉的照片。喷泉位于一个石质基座上，由白色的圆柱支撑着一个带有装饰性顶部的半圆形屋顶。在喷泉前方，有一个小型的石制水池和两个水龙头。周围环境由绿树环绕，几盏路灯点缀其间，营造出宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large observation wheel rising against a clear, bright blue sky. The wheel has a white metal frame with a smooth circular rim and many thin support cables radiating inward toward the central hub, creating a delicate web-like pattern.

Around the outer edge of the wheel are multiple enclosed passenger capsules. The cabins are dark, cylindrical pods with large tinted blue-green glass windows, giving them a sleek modern appearance. Several capsules are clustered near the top of the wheel, while others are spaced evenly down the sides.

In the foreground, lush green trees partially obscure the lower portion of the structure. The foliage is dense and vivid, with different shades of green and varied leaf textures. A roadway or elevated bridge runs across the lower part of the image, visible behind the trees, with a guardrail and a small road sign on the left.

The scene is brightly lit, suggesting daytime with strong sunlight. The clean sky, white wheel structure, glass capsules, and greenery create a crisp urban-landscape view, likely of a major city observation wheel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示摩天轮的摄影图片，摩天轮高耸入云，其结构由多个连接的金属支架和悬挂的座椅组成。摩天轮位于画面中央偏上位置，背景是晴朗的蓝天。在摩天轮下方，可以看到几棵绿叶茂盛的树木，它们为这个城市景观增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor crowd gathered at what appears to be a public demonstration or rally. The scene is dominated by multiple blue-and-yellow Ukrainian flags waving on tall poles against a bright, partly cloudy sky.

In the upper center and right, several large Ukrainian flags are lifted high above the crowd. The fabric is translucent in the sunlight, with the blue upper halves and yellow lower halves glowing brightly as they ripple in the wind. One especially large flag near the top center is sharply visible, its edges folded and billowing. Another vertical blue-and-yellow flag stands along the right edge of the frame.

On the left side, a smaller Ukrainian flag is visible with a gold trident symbol on the blue section. Near the center and lower background, there are also several Georgian flags—white with red crosses—mixed among the Ukrainian flags, suggesting international solidarity or a multicultural gathering.

The lower half of the image is filled with people standing close together. Many are wearing jackets, hoodies, and casual outerwear, suggesting mild or cool weather. Some people are holding signs and banners, though most text is partially obscured or hard to read. A few placards appear handmade, and one sign near the lower middle seems to reference Ukraine. The faces of people in the foreground are blurred, but the crowd appears attentive and engaged.

The lighting is very bright, with strong sunlight coming through the clouds, creating a slightly overexposed glow in the sky. The sky takes up much of the composition, giving the flags a dramatic, elevated appearance. On the far right, palm fronds hang into the frame, indicating the event may be taking place in a warm or coastal location. Overall, the image conveys a peaceful public gathering centered around support for Ukraine, with flags, signs, and a dense crowd beneath a vivid sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外集会的现实主义风格照片，人群聚集在一起，手持乌克兰国旗和其他标语牌。天空中飘扬着几面乌克兰国旗，而一些标语牌上写着“自由”和“停止战争”。图像捕捉了人们在晴朗天气下的活动，周围环境由蓝天、白云和绿色植被构成。

caption:
The image shows a broad outdoor scene featuring a Russian Orthodox architectural complex in the background, viewed from a somewhat rough, semi-industrial foreground.

At the center of the image is a large red-brick church or cathedral with ornate white trim and tall arched windows. Its most striking feature is a cluster of onion domes: several deep blue domes decorated with small gold stars, each topped with a delicate Orthodox cross. Rising among them is a larger gold onion dome that catches the light and stands out against the pale gray sky. The building has a weathered but grand appearance, with scaffolding or dark roofing elements visible around parts of the upper structure.

To the left of the main cathedral is a tall bell tower painted mostly white and yellow, with a very slender golden spire. The tower has arched openings and layered architectural sections, typical of Russian ecclesiastical design. Smaller golden domes and crosses appear near its base. Farther left and right, additional white monastery-like buildings with green roofs are visible, partly obscured by trees and fences.

The sky is overcast and bright gray, giving the scene a muted, cool atmosphere. The trees in the image are mostly bare, suggesting early spring or late autumn. Their thin branches form dark silhouettes against the buildings and sky.

The foreground contrasts strongly with the ornate religious buildings. There is a cracked paved road curving through the lower part of the image, bordered by muddy grass and bare ground. A dark red-brown shipping container sits near the center foreground, with black trash bags beside it. On the right side, a large gray metal container or fence-like structure occupies the edge of the scene, with cardboard boxes nearby. A weathered wooden fence runs across the left foreground.

On the far right, a person in a blue jacket and dark pants walks away from the camera along the road, carrying a large clear plastic water bottle in one hand. The person appears small compared with the monumental church buildings in the distance.

Overall, the image juxtaposes the grandeur and colorful ornamentation of historic Orthodox architecture—blue star-covered domes, gold crosses, and white-red masonry—with a more ordinary, slightly run-down foreground of storage containers, fences, muddy ground, and a quiet road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影照片，画面中心是一座具有传统俄罗斯建筑风格的教堂，其金色圆顶和蓝色穹顶在阴天的背景下显得格外醒目。一位穿着深色外套的人正沿着小路行走，背对着镜头，似乎是在走向教堂的方向。周围环境由草地、树木和一些低矮的建筑物组成，整体氛围平和而宁静。

caption:
The image shows the entrance area to a **FIFA Fan Fest in Moscow** for the **2018 FIFA World Cup Russia**. The scene is outdoors, likely in a large paved event space or closed-off street.

In the center is a large, temporary entrance structure decorated in bright **blue and red** World Cup branding. The middle section has a red arch-like panel with the **Russia 2018 World Cup emblem** at the top and large white text reading **“FIFA FAN FEST MOSCOW.”** Below the text are cartoon-style graphics of the World Cup mascot, Zabivaka the wolf, along with colorful festive shapes and stars.

On the left side of the entrance, the blue signage contains Russian text: **“ДОБРО ПОЖАЛОВАТЬ,”** meaning **“Welcome.”** On the right side, a matching blue sign says **“WELCOME”** in large white letters. Both sides have a white map-pin style icon with the number **3**, suggesting this is entrance or gate number 3. The structure has several wide entry openings underneath, with fluorescent lights visible inside.

In the foreground, there are many **metal crowd-control barriers** arranged in rows and lanes, creating a queueing area for visitors. The paved ground has road markings, reinforcing that the space may normally be a street or parking area. The area appears mostly empty, with no visible crowds.

Above the entrance are utility wires and poles stretching across the sky. A tall gray pole stands near the center of the frame, partially blocking the signage. There is also an ornate streetlamp behind the entrance.

The sky is bright with soft clouds and patches of blue, giving the scene a daytime or early evening feel. On the far right in the background, a tall historic-looking building with a spire is visible, resembling one of Moscow’s Stalinist skyscrapers, possibly Moscow State University. To the far right foreground, there are colorful waste or recycling bins and more event-themed decorative panels.

Overall, the image captures a prepared but quiet entrance zone for the Moscow FIFA Fan Fest, with prominent World Cup branding, welcome signs in both Russian and English, and organized crowd barriers ready for attendees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示莫斯科世界杯球迷狂欢节入口的照片。图像前景显示了金属栅栏，背景是装饰有蓝色和红色主题的帐篷，上面印有'WELCOME'字样和其他足球相关的图案。在照片的远处可以看到一座建筑物的轮廓，天空中飘着几朵云彩。

caption:
The image shows a street scene during what appears to be a community running event or marathon in Thailand. Several runners are moving along a wide concrete road, most wearing blue event shirts with race bibs pinned to the front. A runner in the extreme foreground on the right is closest to the camera and partially cropped, wearing a bright blue shirt, dark shorts, earphones, and running shoes. Other participants are spread out across the road behind him, jogging or walking at different paces.

On the right side of the road is an ornate Thai temple entrance or gateway. It is richly decorated in gold and red, with intricate carved details, layered roof elements, and sculptural ornamentation. Two white guardian lion-like statues with gold and red accents stand on raised pedestals in front of the entrance. Behind and beside the gateway is a cream-colored temple or monastery building with red roof trim and dark-framed windows. A large white banner with Thai writing and a portrait hangs along the wall, suggesting a formal religious or commemorative event. The wall below the banner is decorated with black-and-white draped fabric.

The street itself is slightly damp, suggesting recent rain or humid weather. A motorbike passes on the right side near the temple wall, while cars are parked farther back along the curb. On the left side of the image, there is a utility pole crowded with many black electrical cables, giving the scene an urban feel. A blue-and-red no-parking or no-stopping sign stands beside the road, with Thai time restrictions written below it. Nearby are plants and flowers along the sidewalk, including green foliage and red blossoms.

In the background, there are leafy trees, a tall signpost with multiple directional signs, streetlights, and a pale overcast sky. The overall atmosphere is lively but calm, combining a local road race with the distinctive architecture and decorations of a Thai Buddhist temple setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群穿着统一蓝色运动服的人在城市街道上跑步的照片。他们正沿着一条宽敞的街道前进，背景中可以看到装饰华丽的建筑和悬挂着横幅的树木。街道两侧有车辆停放，远处可见更多的行人和建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit beach scene under a large, bright sky. Most of the frame is filled with blue sky and scattered white clouds, ranging from thin wisps to thicker patches, creating a soft, partly cloudy atmosphere. The lighting is bright and slightly hazy, giving the scene a washed, summery feel.

In the foreground, pale golden sand stretches across the bottom half of the image. The sand is uneven and textured with many footprints, small ridges, and disturbed patches, suggesting a busy beach. The camera is positioned low enough that the sandy surface is prominent, with the beach gently sloping toward the water.

Across the middle of the image, several beachgoers are spread out near the shoreline. On the far right, two people walk along the wet sand close to the surf; one appears to be an adult in peach-colored shorts, and the other is a smaller person in blue swim shorts. Near the center-right, a few people stand facing the ocean, watching the waves. One person stands alone near the waterline, while another pair or small group is gathered nearby. In the center foreground, a child is crouched or kneeling in the sand, seemingly playing or digging.

Farther left, more people are visible but smaller and partly obscured by haze and distance. One person walks across the sand near the left side of the frame, while others stand closer to the surf. The figures are casual beachgoers in swimwear, enjoying the shoreline.

The ocean occupies the right and middle background, with rolling waves breaking into white foam as they approach the beach. The surf looks fairly active, with a large wave crashing near the center-left where the water meets dark rocky cliffs. The water is blue-green with bright highlights from the sun.

On the left side of the image, rugged coastal cliffs and low hills run along the edge of the beach. The cliffs are dark, rocky, and uneven, with sparse vegetation. A small structure or pole-like feature is visible on the hilltop in the distance. The coastline curves away, adding depth to the scene.

Overall, the image captures a relaxed coastal day: a broad sandy beach, scattered people, foamy waves, rocky cliffs, and a dramatic open sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现海滩活动的自然风光照片。在画面中，沙滩上散布着几位游客和一个狗，他们似乎正在享受阳光和海风。海水在沙滩边缘形成波浪，而背景中的悬崖勾勒出海岸线的轮廓。天空晴朗，云朵稀疏，为这个宁静的场景增添了几分生动感。

caption:
The image shows an airport apron on a bright day, viewed from inside a terminal through a large window. A JetBlue aircraft is parked at gate **F9**, connected to a white jet bridge on the right side of the frame. The jet bridge has a blue **jetBlue** logo panel on its side and extends toward the front left door of the aircraft.

The plane is facing the viewer, with its rounded nose centered slightly right of the image. Its cockpit windows are clearly visible, and the front landing gear area is partly obscured by the jet bridge and ground equipment. The aircraft’s left wing stretches out across the left half of the image, with a tall upward-curving wingtip visible near the far left edge. One large engine is visible under the wing, with the dark intake facing forward.

Several pieces of ground service equipment surround the aircraft. In front of the plane are baggage carts, tow bars, and service vehicles. A white JetBlue ground vehicle or tug sits in the foreground with red-and-white striped markings and the JetBlue logo. A yellow-railed maintenance platform or service cart is positioned near the engine, and a ground crew worker wearing a high-visibility vest stands nearby. On the far right, dark baggage containers or carts are parked beside the jet bridge.

In the background, another JetBlue aircraft is parked or taxiing, with its fuselage and dark blue tail visible behind the main aircraft. Low airport buildings, light poles, and distant runways or taxiways stretch across the midground. The concrete apron is marked with red and yellow guide lines and parking boundaries.

Above the airport, the sky is filled with dramatic, thick cumulus clouds in shades of white, gray, and blue, with patches of deeper blue sky showing through. The lighting suggests a sunny but partly cloudy day, with strong shadows on the ground. The overall scene captures a busy airport gate area during aircraft servicing or boarding preparations.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示机场登机桥连接飞机的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一架大型商用喷气式客机停靠在登机桥上，准备接受乘客登机。登机桥位于图片的右侧，与飞机相连，其白色结构和蓝色标志清晰可见。左侧有几名工作人员正在操作地勤设备，包括拖车和其他辅助工具。背景中可以看到其他几架飞机和机场的部分建筑，以及多云的天空。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of a tall, historic brick tower rising into a cloudy sky. The camera is positioned close to the base and looking sharply upward, making the structure appear imposing and monumental.

The tower is built from reddish-orange brick or terracotta-colored masonry, with many layered, horizontal bands and stepped decorative details. Its surface has an aged, weathered look, with darker staining and patches of discoloration near some ledges. Along one horizontal section near the lower visible part of the tower, there is a row of small circular blue-and-white ceramic or tile ornaments embedded into the brickwork, adding contrast to the warm brick color.

Near the top, the tower transitions into an upper pavilion-like section with a large overhanging roof. The roof has dark wooden eaves and a traditional pagoda-style form, with layered rafters visible underneath. The roof edge is lined with rounded, tile-like elements, giving it a textured silhouette against the sky. Beneath the roof, a clock face is partially visible on one side of the tower, set into the upper structure.

A large dark shape occupies the upper left and top portion of the image, likely the underside of a nearby roof, archway, or overhang. It frames the tower diagonally and creates a strong contrast with the bright gray sky. The sky itself is overcast, filled with soft, pale clouds, giving the scene a muted, atmospheric quality.

Overall, the image emphasizes height, age, and architectural detail, with the tower’s warm brick tones standing out against the cool, cloudy background and the dark foreground framing.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座古老建筑塔楼的摄影作品。塔楼由红褐色砖石构成，顶部有一个黑色的屋顶结构，其上覆盖着茅草。塔楼的侧面装饰有圆形的窗户和一些小孔洞，这些细节增添了历史感。图像通过一个拱形框架捕捉了塔楼的一部分，形成了一个有趣的视觉效果，使观者仿佛站在一个拱门下仰望这座历史悠久的建筑。

caption:
The image shows a sunny beach scene viewed from slightly above, looking down over a stone or concrete edge toward a sandy area filled with many small sandcastles.

In the foreground, several people are sitting close together along the edge of a low wall or steps. On the left is an older woman with short gray hair wearing a black sleeveless top; her face is blurred. Beside her, a gray-haired man in a dark red/maroon shirt is seated and leaning forward, holding something in his hands, possibly food or a napkin. In the lower right foreground, a woman with reddish-brown hair tied back is seen from behind. She is wearing a bright turquoise swimsuit top with thin straps, and a tattoo is visible on her upper back/shoulder area. The people appear to be watching or resting near the sandcastle display.

The main background area is a broad patch of golden-brown sand covered with dozens of small sand structures. The sandcastles are simple bucket-shaped towers, arranged in loose rows and clusters. Some are taller cylinders, while others are shorter, partially collapsed, or connected by ridges and mounds of sand. The sunlight casts strong shadows to one side of the towers, making their shapes stand out clearly.

At the top left, only the lower legs and feet of another person are visible, standing barefoot on the sand. There are also shadows from people or objects stretching across the beach. The scene feels like a warm, busy seaside setting, with people gathered near a large collection of handmade sandcastles under bright daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三位成年人在沙滩上休息的照片。左侧是一位穿着黑色无袖上衣的女性，她的头发灰白，正在与另一位男性交谈。中间的男性穿着红色长袖衬衫和深色裤子，正坐在一块岩石上，似乎在观察或等待某人。右侧的女性背对着镜头，身穿蓝色带图案的泳装，她的皮肤上有晒斑。他们周围是沙地上排列整齐的小型沙堡，营造出一种休闲而放松的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an indoor automotive exhibition or car show, with a glossy deep-blue Mercedes-Benz sports car dominating the foreground. The car appears to be a Mercedes-AMG GT, viewed from the front-left three-quarter angle. Its long, sculpted hood, low stance, wide grille, and large Mercedes three-pointed-star emblem are prominent. The grille has a black mesh pattern dotted with chrome-like studs, and the front bumper includes large lower air intakes. The headlights are sleek and angular with detailed LED elements inside.

The car’s paint is highly reflective, catching bright overhead lights and colorful reflections from nearby displays and banners. The hood has subtle vents or sculpted openings, and the body lines flow smoothly along the side toward the rear. The front wheel is visible, featuring a multi-spoke alloy rim with a performance brake setup behind it, including a hint of red brake calipers. The side vent behind the front wheel is also visible, reinforcing the car’s sporty design. The windshield has several stickers near the top-left area, including a yellow label with the number “2086,” suggesting it may be an entry or display number.

In the background, several other modified or performance cars are on display. To the left, there is a white car with its hood open, showing the engine bay. Behind the blue Mercedes, a bright yellow car is parked with people standing nearby. Farther right, a gold or bronze-colored car also has its hood open, and its engine bay is illuminated by display lighting. There are red ropes or chains marking off the display areas, along with raised platforms and show signage. A red vertical banner with a large white graphic stands near the center-left background.

The environment is busy and colorful, with polished flooring, bright exhibition lights, and multiple cars arranged closely together. The overall scene conveys a high-performance tuning or luxury car showcase, with the blue Mercedes serving as the main focal point due to its size, shine, and central placement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在汽车展览会上的蓝色梅赛德斯-AMG GT跑车的照片。车辆位于展览馆内，周围摆放着其他各式各样的汽车模型和参展商。跑车的设计精致，车身呈现出深邃的蓝色调，并带有独特的AMG品牌标志和空气动力学套件。

caption:
The image shows two uniformed police officers standing in front of a marked police car with a red light bar on top. Both officers are wearing black tactical vests with visible “POLICE” patches and are aiming handguns forward toward the camera/viewer. Their faces are intentionally blurred, making individual facial features unrecognizable.

The officer on the right is positioned in the foreground and is more prominent. He stands with both arms extended, holding a pistol in a two-handed grip. He wears a black vest over a dark shirt, gray trousers, a duty belt with equipment, and a radio or communication device near his shoulder. A large white “POLICE” label is centered on his vest. The officer on the left is slightly behind and lower, also aiming a handgun with both hands. His vest has police markings and a patch with colors resembling the Thai flag.

Behind them is a light-colored police sedan. The windshield shows large white lettering spelling part of “POLICE,” and the red emergency light bar spans the roof. The car’s front passenger side and side mirror are visible on the right side of the frame.

The background is softly blurred, showing greenery, trees, overhead utility lines, and light-colored urban buildings. The lighting appears warm and natural, suggesting late afternoon or early evening. The overall scene has a tense, action-oriented law-enforcement training or staged tactical feel, with the officers posed in a ready-to-fire stance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两名警察在执行任务的现实主义风格照片。他们身穿标准的黑色制服，胸前印有'POLICE'字样，并佩戴着肩章和警徽。一名警察正用左臂持枪瞄准，而另一名则侧身站立，也持有枪械。他们的装备包括头盔、防弹背心和其他必要的执法装备。背景中有一辆标有'POLICE'字样的警车，以及模糊的城市建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a cluttered tabletop or open wooden drawer filled with Jewish religious items, likely in a synagogue, study hall, or prayer room.

In the foreground and across most of the lower half of the image are many sets of **tefillin**: black leather boxes with long black straps coiled and tangled around them. Several of the tefillin boxes have small white labels with handwritten Hebrew names or notes taped to them, suggesting they may belong to different people or are being organized for communal use. The glossy black leather straps overlap each other, creating a dense, busy pattern.

Near the center and upper part of the table are several **velvet tefillin or tallit bags**, mostly burgundy/maroon, decorated with gold embroidery and Hebrew lettering. One burgundy bag in the center has a pointed, folded shape and embroidered Hebrew text; another on the right has ornate gold designs and lettering. On the left, there is a dark navy or black fabric bag inside a clear plastic protective case, also decorated with gold Hebrew writing.

On the right side of the image is a stack of religious books. A large green hardcover book with gold Hebrew text and decorative borders lies on top of other volumes. Behind and above it are additional stacked books with white and reddish covers. Nearby is a small blue box with Hebrew writing and an illustration of a reddish-brown brick-like object on top or printed on the packaging.

At the far right edge, part of a black zippered bag or case is visible, with a folded white fringed garment resting on it—likely a **tallit** with its tzitzit fringes showing. A black strap with a metal buckle crosses over this area.

The background is slightly out of focus. There are dark chairs or benches, a wooden surface or cabinet, and what appears to be a tan or olive backpack resting against the back area. The overall scene feels informal and active, as though many prayer items have been placed together before or after services. The dominant colors are black leather, burgundy velvet, gold embroidery, warm wood tones, and the green of the book cover.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种宗教用品的照片，包括多条黑色的领带、几本装饰有金色图案和文字的书以及一些红色带有金色图案的布料。这些物品被整齐地摆放在一个木质桌子上，背景中可以看到部分家具和衣物。

caption:
The image shows a group of people working in an olive grove on a sunny day, apparently harvesting or gathering olives.

In the foreground on the left, a person wearing a red shirt, dark track pants with white stripes, yellow knee pads, gloves, and a cap is operating a backpack leaf blower. The blower’s long black nozzle is pointed toward the ground beneath an olive tree, likely being used to move fallen olives, leaves, or debris into a pile. The person is standing slightly bent forward, focused on the base of the tree.

At the center, partly hidden by the dense silvery-green foliage of an olive tree, two other workers are visible. One wears red trousers with yellow knee pads, while another person in brown pants stands close to the trunk. They appear to be working under or around the tree, possibly shaking branches, collecting olives, or managing harvesting equipment. The olive tree has a thick, gnarled trunk and many narrow, gray-green leaves typical of olive trees.

On the right side, another worker is using a large red rake-like tool to gather a spread of small dark olives scattered across the dry ground. This person wears a red cap, a striped long-sleeve shirt, blue track pants with white stripes, gloves, and light-colored boots. They are leaning forward slightly, pulling the olives into a more concentrated area.

The ground is dry, uneven, and dusty, with patches of green grass and many small dark olives scattered across it. A strip or pile of olives is especially visible near the worker on the right. Several olive trees extend into the background, arranged in rows across a gently sloping landscape.

Beyond the grove, the background opens into rolling green hills under a clear pale-blue sky. The bright sunlight creates strong shadows on the ground, emphasizing the midday outdoor setting. Overall, the scene depicts agricultural labor in an olive orchard, with workers using tools and machinery to collect olives from beneath the trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三个人在橄榄树下工作的现实主义风格照片。最左侧的人穿着红色和黑色的运动服，戴着帽子，正在用铲子清理地面上的碎石。中间的人穿着灰色裤子和红色上衣，弯腰在树下工作，手里拿着一个橙色的袋子。右侧的人穿着蓝色长裤和红色上衣，也在用铲子整理地面。他们周围是绿色的橄榄树，背景中可以看到远处的山丘和晴朗的蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a single bottle of **A.1. Original Sauce** standing upright on a glossy, reflective countertop.

The bottle is centered in the frame and photographed straight on. It is a tall, narrow glass bottle filled with a very dark brown sauce. The bottle has a **white ribbed plastic cap** at the top. Around the neck is a small white label with a gold band and a large red-and-black **“A.1”** logo.

The main front label is mostly white with gold trim and red/blue accents. Near the top it reads **“EST 1862”**, followed by a large red **“A.1.”** logo outlined in black. Beneath that is a blue panel with the word **“ORIGINAL”**, and below it the word **“SAUCE.”** The label also says **“SHAKE WELL.”** Along the vertical sides of the label, red text reads **“FOR STEAK, PORK AND CHICKEN.”** At the bottom, a red section lists **“NET WT 5 OZ (142g)”** and shows **“15 calories per 1 tbsp.”**

The bottle is placed on a gray-green marbled surface that reflects the lower part of the bottle and label. The background is a plain beige textured wall, softly lit. The overall composition is simple and product-focused, with the bottle sharply centered and a lot of empty beige space around it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示A1原味酱汁瓶的产品摄影图像。瓶子呈深棕色，带有红色和白色的标签，上面印有'A1'的标志、产品名称、重量（5盎司）以及生产日期（Est. 1862）。瓶子放置在光滑的表面上，背景是浅色的墙壁，整体光线均匀，没有明显的阴影或高光。

caption:
The image shows a fire station yard with several fire vehicles, dominated by a large, older red fire truck in the foreground.

In the front-left and center of the image, an old fire tanker truck is parked in profile, facing to the right. Its paint is faded red with noticeable wear, scratches, rust, and grime. The vehicle has a rounded, vintage cab shape, suggesting it is an older model. A broad yellow stripe runs across the tank section on the left side, and the front wheel arch and bumper area are painted bright yellow. The front tire is large, worn, and dirty, with a rusty metal wheel hub. The truck’s hood has visible latches and weathering, and the windshield and side window reflect the surroundings. A black side mirror extends from the driver’s door. The step below the cab is red and scuffed.

Behind the cab, the truck has a large cylindrical tank body, likely for carrying water. Near the lower rear portion, hoses or metal fittings are visible, adding to the impression that this is an older firefighting or service vehicle. The overall condition of the truck appears aged and heavily used, with chipped paint and dark stains around the lower body.

In the background, there is a long, white fire station or municipal building. The ground floor has several large gray metal roll-up garage doors. Some garage bays are open, revealing modern red fire engines inside.
