The people in the scene are a mix of vendors and customers. Many vendors wear traditional conical hats and patterned, colorful clothing. Some stand or crouch in their boats while sorting goods, rowing, steering, or passing items between boats. Several boats have long wooden poles or oars extending across the water, and many also have small exposed motor engines mounted at the back with long propeller shafts. A few people appear to be tourists or visitors sitting in a boat on the left side, looking around and taking photos.

The boats vary in size and condition: some are small, low wooden boats used for carrying produce, while others are larger and have simple canopies, tarps, or metal frames. Tires hang from the sides of some boats as bumpers. The water is choppy and reflective, with ripples caused by the constant movement of boats and motors.

The overall atmosphere is busy, colorful, and chaotic in an organized way. The scene feels like an active morning market, with people navigating through tight spaces, bargaining, transporting goods, and selling directly from their boats. The image is rich with texture: weathered wood, woven baskets, plastic sacks, striped tarps, metal engine parts, glossy fruit, and the soft shapes of flowers and vegetables.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现东南亚水上市场的现实主义风格照片。图中，多艘装满各种商品的船只在河面上漂浮，船上的人们穿着传统服装，正忙于交易和搬运货物。市场上的商贩们戴着典型的锥形帽子，与顾客进行交流。黄色的花朵装饰着前景，为这个繁忙场景增添了一抹鲜艳的颜色。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a used U.S. postage stamp with a white perforated border and an orange background visible around the edges. The stamp is slightly worn, with black cancellation marks running diagonally across the upper left and top portions.

The main design is a sepia-toned portrait of a man in a military-style uniform, shown from the shoulders up and facing to the right. He wears a dark peaked cap with light trim and a high-collared jacket. The portrait has a vintage photographic quality, with visible dot-print texture.

In the upper left corner, large yellow text reads “33,” followed by “USA,” indicating a 33-cent United States stamp. Near the bottom right, in large white serif lettering, the name “John L. Hines” is printed.

In the lower left portion of the stamp, there is a small tilted flag or insignia. It has a red field with green geometric symbols and a black edge, attached to a thin pole. At the very bottom left, just inside the border, the year “2000” is printed in small black text.

Overall, the stamp appears to commemorate John L. Hines, presented in a historical military portrait style, with muted browns and yellows dominating the design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张2000年发行的美国邮票，展示了John L. Hines的肖像。邮票上方印有'33 USA'和'2000'字样，下方是他的名字'John L. Hines'。邮票的背景为单色，邮票边缘装饰着精细的图案。

caption:
This image shows a wide nighttime panorama of a modern city skyline, likely Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The scene is dominated by a dark, hazy sky with low clouds glowing faintly in warm amber tones, probably reflecting the city lights below.

Near the center-left stand the illuminated Petronas Twin Towers, recognizable by their twin spires and tiered, tapering structure. They glow in bright white and gold light, standing taller than most of the surrounding buildings. To the right, the KL Tower rises prominently with a long, slender shaft lit in cool blue-white tones and a brightly illuminated observation deck near the top. Its antenna extends upward into the dark sky.

Across the lower half of the image is a dense cluster of high-rise buildings, office towers, hotels, and commercial structures. Many windows are lit, creating a mix of yellow, white, blue, red, and green points of light. Several building logos and signs are visible, including bright red and neon accents scattered throughout the skyline. The city appears slightly softened by mist or humidity, giving the lights a diffused glow.

The foreground is much darker, filled with silhouettes of trees and foliage, suggesting the photo was taken from an elevated park or hillside overlooking the city. The contrast between the shadowy natural foreground and the illuminated urban skyline creates a dramatic atmosphere.

Overall, the image feels moody, cinematic, and atmospheric, with the city’s landmark towers piercing through a humid, clouded night sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，图中主要建筑包括位于左侧的双子塔和右侧的电视塔，它们在夜幕下发出明亮的光芒。其他高楼大厦也点缀着城市的天际线，而天空中的云彩则呈现出一种神秘的深色调。

caption:
The image shows an ornate Buddhist temple complex dominated by a large golden stupa or chedi rising from the center of the frame. The stupa has a broad, tiered square base with multiple stepped levels, each edged with thin horizontal bands of gold and orange-gold trim. Its surface is reflective and slightly textured, catching bright sunlight and giving it a warm metallic glow. As it narrows upward, the structure transitions into a more cylindrical, bell-like section topped with a slender spire and an intricate decorative finial.

The sky behind it is a vivid, cloudless blue, creating a striking contrast with the rich gold of the architecture. The photo is taken from a low angle, making the stupa appear tall and monumental.

On the right side of the image is part of a highly ornate temple building or gateway, decorated in red and gold. It features elaborate carved patterns, floral motifs, layered roof details, and a tall golden ornamental finial shaped like a stylized tree or flame. The craftsmanship is dense and intricate, with many small gilded details.

On the left lower side, there are additional golden ceremonial structures, including an umbrella-like decorative canopy with dangling ornaments. A red-roofed building is partially visible behind it. Along the bottom foreground is a gold-colored fence with pointed spear-like finials, enclosing the sacred area around the stupa.

Overall, the scene is bright, richly colored, and opulent, emphasizing traditional Southeast Asian Buddhist temple architecture with heavy use of gold, ornate carvings, and ceremonial decorative elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国传统寺庙建筑的照片，主要是一座金色的多层宝塔。宝塔顶部装饰着精致的尖顶和金色的饰品，而其基座则由复杂的图案和雕刻构成。在宝塔的左侧，可以看到一座较小的红色屋顶建筑物，同样装饰有金色的元素。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，为这座宏伟的建筑增添了宁静与庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor walkway in a shaded, tree-filled tourist area. The scene appears to be at or near a lookout or attraction, with dense greenery and large overhanging branches creating patches of shade across the brick and asphalt ground.

On the far left, a tall vertical signboard is attached near a utility pole. It advertises **“BEAUTIFUL PORTRAITS”** by **A. Rashid**, with text saying portraits are **“Drawn in 10+ Mins.”** The sign displays several sample pencil portrait sketches arranged in a grid, along with contact/social media details near the bottom. A metal railing runs behind it, suggesting the walkway borders a drop-off, garden, or scenic area.

In the center-left, a street portrait artist is seated on a folding chair under a large pale green-and-white umbrella. He is working at an easel, drawing or sketching a portrait on a board. A small red plastic stool sits in front of him, holding supplies such as bottles and drawing materials. Nearby, another umbrella shades a small gathering area where several people are seated on benches or low stools, possibly waiting for portraits or resting.

Behind the artist area, there is another small sign that reads **“CARICATURES,”** indicating there are also caricature artists set up in the same spot. A second umbrella, tan or light brown, and a third blue umbrella with a pattern provide shade over the crowd.

On the right side of the image, many pedestrians are walking along the paved road. The crowd includes adults and children, some wearing hats or head coverings, and one child is seated in a stroller. People are dressed casually in T-shirts, shorts, jeans, and light clothing suitable for warm weather. A small kiosk or booth stands in the background to the right, partially hidden by the crowd and trees; a sign on it appears to reference **Penang Hill**.

The lighting is bright and sunny, with strong contrast between sunlit areas and deep shadows from the trees. Overall, the image captures a lively tourist walkway with portrait artists, shade umbrellas, benches, and a steady flow of visitors.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外艺术市场活动的照片。在画面的左侧，有一个醒目的广告牌，上面写着'BEAUTIFUL PORTRAITS'和'Drive in Art Market'，旁边是一个红白相间的立柱。一位艺术家正坐在他的画架前作画，他穿着深色衣服，专注地绘画。周围聚集了多位顾客，他们有的打着伞遮阳，有的站立交谈，还有的推着婴儿车。背景中可以看到树木和一些建筑物，整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一个充满活力的户外艺术市场氛围。

caption:
The image shows a crowded street demonstration in a French urban square under a clear, deep blue sky. Many people in the crowd are wearing fluorescent yellow safety vests, strongly suggesting a “gilets jaunes”/yellow-vest style protest. The photo is taken from within the crowd, looking forward over people’s shoulders and heads.

In the center-right foreground, a large handmade protest sign is being held up. It is tall, rectangular, and decorated with black, red, white, and yellow elements, including dangling yellow ribbons tied along the top and sides. The sign contains large handwritten French text in stacked sections. The most legible parts read:

- “GRAND DEBAT!!!!”
- “BLABLABLA!”
- “LA FRANCE”
- “ATTEND”
- “VERDICT” partially visible near the bottom

The sign appears to criticize political discussion or debate as empty talk, with “blablabla” emphasized in large letters.

Several French tricolor flags are visible. One large flag on a pole waves high near the top center-left, with red, white, and blue bands catching the sunlight. Another French flag is visible lower left, and a person in the foreground has a blue-white-red flag draped around their shoulders like a cape. A dark blue or purple flag appears on the right edge.

The setting appears to be a broad city street or square lined with historic European buildings. On the right, a large cream-colored building has many tall windows with shutters and balconies; its facade bears the sign “Grand Hôtel Beauvau.” Other ornate buildings line the left side, with classic stone architecture, balconies, and decorative details. A “Brasserie” sign is partially visible at street level on the right.

The atmosphere is bright and busy. Sunlight creates strong contrasts, with vivid yellow vests standing out against darker coats and the blue sky. The crowd is dense, with people facing toward the demonstration’s center. Some faces in the lower portion are blurred, while most visible individuals are seen from behind. The overall mood is that of a large public protest or political gathering in France, with flags, slogans, and handmade signage dominating the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这张照片捕捉了一场户外集会的场景，焦点是一个手持标语牌的人。标语牌上用黑色和白色字体写着'GRAND DEBUT BLABLA BLABLA LA FRANCE ATTEND VERDICT'，意为'伟大的开始 嘈杂的声音 法国在等待判决'。标语牌被彩色条带装饰着，增加了视觉吸引力。背景中可以看到其他参与者，他们穿着反光背心，一些人举着法国国旗，表明这可能是一场政治或社会运动。建筑物和蓝天构成了活动发生的城市环境。

caption:
The image is a wide, black-and-white photograph of the front façade of the Reichstag building in Berlin, Germany. The composition is highly symmetrical, with the camera positioned low and centered in front of the building, emphasizing its monumental scale and classical architecture.

In the foreground, a broad paved plaza stretches across the bottom half of the image. The ground is made of large rectangular stone slabs interspersed with bands of smaller cobblestones arranged in curved and linear patterns. The low angle makes the paving lines lead the eye toward the building and its central staircase.

A wide flight of stone steps rises from the plaza to the main entrance. At the top of the stairs, small groups of people are visible near the doorway, appearing tiny compared with the massive architecture. Metal crowd-control barriers line parts of the entrance area.

The building itself is grand and ornate, with a central portico supported by tall Corinthian columns. Above the columns is a triangular pediment filled with sculptural reliefs of figures and decorative motifs. Just below the pediment, the inscription “DEM DEUTSCHEN VOLKE” is clearly visible, meaning “To the German People.” Behind the columns, large glass doors and windows form the main entrance, contrasting with the older stone façade.

On both sides of the central section, the building extends outward with rows of arched and rectangular windows, decorative pilasters, carved stone details, and statues along the roofline. The left and right wings each rise into square corner towers with arched openings and flags flying on top. Additional flags are visible at the far left and right edges, their shapes slightly blurred by movement or wind.

The sky above is mostly clear, with a few small, soft clouds scattered near the top center. The monochrome treatment gives the scene a historic, formal, and dramatic feel, highlighting the textures of the stone, the depth of the columns, and the architectural details of the façade. The overall impression is one of grandeur, civic importance, and strong symmetry.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的图像，展示了一座宏伟的古典建筑。建筑正面有多个圆柱和装饰性的屋顶结构，中央是一个宽阔的台阶通向入口。在台阶上，可以看到几位行人正在参观或等待。图像的前景是铺砌整齐的石板地面，而背景则是蓝天和几朵飘浮的白云。

caption:
The image shows a vintage streetcar or tram displayed outdoors in a leafy urban setting. The tram is painted in two tones: a deep green lower half and a pale cream upper half, with large rectangular windows running along its side. Its front is rounded and slightly protruding, with tall glass panels and the number “381” painted prominently in white on the green front section. A circular headlight sits below the number, and there is also a small decorative emblem on the front.

The tram appears stationary on short rail tracks, likely as part of a museum display, historical exhibit, or park installation. A dark wooden or metal platform runs along the right side, suggesting an accessible viewing or boarding area. Through the front windows, hanging hand straps and interior details are faintly visible, reinforcing the impression of an old public transit vehicle.

The scene is surrounded by abundant greenery. Tree branches with bright green leaves hang across the top of the frame, partially shading the tram and creating a canopy-like effect. Tall pine trees and dense shrubs fill the right side and background, giving the area a park-like atmosphere despite the urban surroundings.

On the left side of the image, a paved pedestrian walkway runs beside the tram. Near the tram’s side are two light-colored statues of children or figures reaching upward, adding a playful or commemorative element to the space. Farther left, there are street signs, bollards, and glimpses of a city street. A modern building is faintly visible in the background through the trees, indicating the location is within or near a city.

On the right side, partially hidden among the trees, a few people are sitting on a bench. The lighting is very bright, with some areas slightly overexposed, especially in the sky and pavement, giving the image a soft, summery feel. Overall, the picture captures a nostalgic historic tram nestled among trees in a calm urban park setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆复古风格的绿色有轨电车的照片。电车停靠在轨道上，车身前方标有数字'381'和一个圆形标志。周围环境由郁郁葱葱的树木、一些行人以及远处现代建筑构成，营造出一种宁静的城市公园氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide agricultural field during a machinery demonstration or planting operation. Several tractors are lined up across the field, each fitted with large green and red farming implements used for preparing ridges or planting crops.

In the foreground, dark, freshly worked soil forms raised ridges running toward the camera. Between and beside the ridges are thick bands of pale yellow straw or mulch, creating a strong contrast with the nearly black earth. The soil looks moist and heavy, suggesting recently tilled farmland.

At the center is a large blue tractor viewed from the rear. It has wide rear tires, a cab with large windows, mirrors on both sides, and an orange beacon light on top. Attached behind it is a broad green implement with metal shaping plates or furrow-forming blades along the bottom. These blades are creating or refining multiple raised beds in the soil.

To the left is another tractor with a red cab roof pulling a green machine with red and yellow components. This machine appears to include hoppers or planting units, likely for depositing seed or tubers into the prepared rows. The brand name “Baselier” is visible on the green equipment. Behind it, the field extends into flat farmland with rows of green crops in the distance.

On the right side, more tractors and implements are partially visible, including green equipment with a red reflective slow-moving-vehicle triangle mounted on the back. A red tractor is cut off at the far right edge of the frame, showing only part of its cab, wheel, and attached machinery.

The overall scene feels industrial and agricultural, with multiple machines working in parallel on a large open field. The sky is overcast with thick gray clouds, giving the image a muted, cool tone. The horizon is low and flat, with distant utility poles and farmland visible, emphasizing the openness of the rural landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示农业作业的现实主义风格照片，前景中有一台绿色拖拉机正在犁地，其后是两台不同型号和颜色的拖拉机。每台拖拉机都装备有不同的耕作工具，如耙子、铲子或播种器。犁过的土地上覆盖着一层新鲜的黑土，而背景中可以看到更多的耕地和阴云密布的天空。

caption:
The image shows the **NEMO Science Museum** in Amsterdam, a striking modern building beside the water. The structure dominates the scene with its distinctive **ship-like, sloping form**, rising high on the left and tapering downward toward the right. Its exterior is clad in **greenish-copper panels**, giving it a teal, oxidized-metal appearance. The façade is covered with narrow vertical and rectangular metal panels, creating a textured, ribbed pattern across the surface.

The building has an unusual curved roofline and tilted walls, making it look as if a large vessel or wedge is emerging from the waterfront. Small, dark rectangular windows are scattered across the green façade in irregular groups. Near the lower right side, large white letters spell **“NEMO”** above the entrance area.

In the foreground is a broad stretch of water, slightly rippled, reflecting muted tones of the sky and the green building. Along the edge of the water is a stone quay or seawall, with a few small details such as railings, lamps, and a yellow-and-black buoy floating near the center-right. On the far right, part of a light-colored pedestrian bridge or ramp structure crosses into the frame.

The sky above is filled with **thick, gray-white clouds**, giving the scene an overcast but bright atmosphere. To the left of the museum, there are leafy green trees and a few smaller buildings, including a distant tower-like structure with a pale dome or steeple. Overall, the image captures a dramatic piece of contemporary architecture set against a calm urban waterfront.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的图片，其中一座具有独特绿色金属质感外观的建筑物位于画面中央，其设计新颖且引人注目。建筑物下方是一个平静的水面，反射着天空和建筑的轮廓。在建筑物的背后，可以看到一片树木和一个桥梁结构，为这个场景增添了一些自然元素。

caption:
The image shows a busy indoor trade fair or exhibition hall with booths lining a wide aisle. The scene is split visually between a walkway on the left and a booth meeting area on the right.

On the left, a green carpeted aisle runs into the distance. Several attendees in business or smart-casual clothing are walking through the exhibition space. A woman in the foreground wears a blue coat, dark pants, and black boots, carrying a black handbag and a bright green shopping bag. Beside her is another woman holding a phone and carrying a camel-colored coat over her arm. Other visitors, including men in suits and coats, are walking or standing nearby. The people’s faces appear blurred.

Above the aisle are industrial ceiling structures, metal trusses, and rows of exhibition lighting. Various booth signs and panels are visible in the background, including a large white sign with “ITALIA” on the left and a booth sign reading “PES2.” The exhibition stands have colorful graphic panels in red, green, and white, giving the space a professional trade-show atmosphere.

On the right side is a clean, modern booth with white walls and light wood trim. A circular sign with a blue logo and red text hangs near the booth entrance. Inside the booth, four people are seated around a small white table having a business discussion. They are dressed formally, including suits and a bright red blazer. A black bag rests on the floor near the table.

The booth wall displays product-related promotional material. A large poster shows a lineup of packaged food products—jars, bottles, and containers—suggesting the company deals with food products, sauces, oils, or packaged goods. Text on the poster includes categories such as “Food Service,” “Consumer Food,” “Industrial Products,” and “Private Label.” Below the poster are two small wooden shelves holding bottles, likely oil or condiment samples.

The overall mood is professional and commercial, typical of a business expo where companies showcase products and attendees network, browse booths, and hold meetings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示商业活动的摄影照片，具体为一个室内展览或会议场景。图像中心是一个展位，展位上摆放着多种商品和信息板，几位参展者正坐在桌旁交谈。展位左侧有一位穿着蓝色西装的男士正在走动，而右侧则有两位女士在交谈。整个场景被绿色地毯覆盖，营造出一种专业的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a winter scene centered on a striking Orthodox-style church or monastery building. The main structure is painted a vivid red with crisp white trim, creating a strong contrast against the pale blue-gray sky and the snow-covered ground.

On the right side of the image, the church dominates the scene. It has ornate architectural details: white pilasters, arched windows, decorative cornices, and red-and-white geometric trim. The roof sections are dark, almost black, and slightly dusted with snow. Above the main body of the church rises a large golden onion dome, gleaming warmly even in the soft, cold light. The dome is topped with an elaborate Orthodox cross, supported by thin cables or rods. Beside it is a tall bell tower with red-and-white walls, arched openings, a dark domed roof, and a very tall golden spire ending in another cross.

The building’s facade includes multiple rectangular and arched windows with white frames. A low black metal fence with white posts runs in front of the church, separating it from the snowy foreground. Snowbanks line the bottom of the image, and the ground appears icy and packed with snow, suggesting a cold, quiet winter day.

To the left of the church are smaller buildings, likely part of the same religious complex. One is a pale cream-colored building with a red-brown snow-covered roof and warm yellow light glowing from a few windows, giving a sense of warmth inside. Between the buildings stands a leafless tree, its bare branches silhouetted against the sky.

On the far right, another white building with a dark roof and a projecting enclosed balcony is partially visible. The entire scene feels calm and still, with no visible people or movement. The wide sky takes up much of the upper portion of the image, softly lit with pale blue tones and thin cloud cover, emphasizing the height of the church towers and the peaceful winter atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季雪景中的教堂的照片。教堂的主体为鲜艳的红色，装饰有金色圆顶和十字架，周围是被雪覆盖的地面和几棵光秃的树木。在教堂的背后可以看到其他建筑，包括一座较小的白色建筑物和一些房屋。天空呈现出淡淡的蓝色调，与教堂的红色形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a classroom or daycare setting with several young children gathered around a table. The focus is on two children in the foreground, seated side by side and holding a large colorful toy vehicle or playset.

In the foreground:

- On the left is a child wearing a dark navy-blue long-sleeve shirt with a graphic design on the front, including a red vehicle-like image.
- On the right is a child wearing a light pink long-sleeve shirt with a large outlined diamond or gem graphic on the chest.
- Both children’s faces are intentionally blurred, but they appear to be looking toward the camera.
- They are holding or presenting a large toy that looks like a boat, rescue vehicle, or action playset. It has a black base, gray railings, bright pink and purple parts, blue sections, and small molded details. One side includes a bright pink raised piece, and the front/side has orange accents.

In the background:

- Several other children are visible but out of focus, reinforcing the classroom/playroom environment.
- A child in the center background appears to be standing and wearing a blue-and-yellow plaid/checkered shirt.
- To the left, more children are seated or standing near tables.
- The room has pinkish walls and shelves filled with toys or classroom materials.
- On the right side, there is a large tan teddy bear sitting on or near a shelf.
- Green storage bins or cabinet doors are visible behind the children.

The photo has a shallow depth of field: the two children and toy in front are the clearest parts, while the background is softly blurred. The overall atmosphere feels playful, warm, and child-centered, likely in a kindergarten, preschool, or playroom.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在室内环境中拍摄的照片，展示了两个孩子坐在桌子旁，他们手中各自拿着玩具。左侧的孩子穿着蓝色上衣和深色裤子，头发为浅棕色，正专注地看着手中的玩具。右侧的孩子穿着粉红色的长袖衣服，头发为淡黄色，同样专注于手中的玩具。背景中模糊地可以看到其他孩子们和一些玩具，但焦点集中在前景的两个孩子身上。

caption:
The image shows the finish area of a running event on an outdoor athletics track, likely at a school or university sports ground.

A large horizontal finish banner stretches across the track near the top-middle of the image. The banner has pale pink and lavender tones with decorative geometric patterns and line-art drawings of traditional-style buildings. It contains Thai/Lao-style script across the top and a large red word in the center that appears to read “FINISH,” stylized in rounded letters. Several official-looking circular logos or seals are printed beneath the word. The banner is tied up with visible metal grommets along its edges.

In the center foreground, a runner is crossing under the banner with arms extended outward in a celebratory pose. The runner wears a yellow sleeveless running shirt with Thai text, dark blue shorts, black socks, and running shoes with yellow accents. A race bib is pinned to the front, showing the number “0326.” The runner’s face is blurred, as are some other faces in the scene.

Behind the leading runner, another participant in a white sleeveless top and black shorts is jogging toward the finish line. Farther back on the track, a few more runners are visible, including one in purple. The track surface is gray with multiple white lane lines converging toward the distance, giving a strong sense of depth.

On the left side, a photographer wearing a yellow-and-black shirt is standing near the edge of the track, holding a camera up to capture the finish. Nearby is a low cream-colored building with stairs, railings, and a shaded area. On the right side in the background, there is a multi-story building with many windows, separated from the track by a green fence and grassy area.

Above the banner, a tall stadium floodlight tower rises into the sky. The sky is bright and partly cloudy, suggesting a sunny daytime event. In the far background, faint hills or mountains can be seen beyond the sports complex. The overall mood is energetic and celebratory, centered on the moment of a runner finishing a race.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示马拉松比赛终点线的现实主义风格照片。在图片的前景，一位穿着黄色T恤和黑色短裤的运动员正以兴奋的姿态穿过终点线，双臂张开，似乎刚刚完成了一次长跑。在他的背后，可以看到其他几位运动员也正在接近终点。终点线上方悬挂着一个带有泰文文字的横幅，上面写着'FINISH'，表明这是比赛的结束点。场地周围有观众和其他参赛者，而远处则是一座体育场的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows a narrow, rustic passageway between traditional wooden houses during rain. The scene has a damp, cool, greenish atmosphere, with water dripping from the roofs and everything appearing wet and weathered.

On the left side, there is a wooden house with pale, aged timber walls, glass-paneled windows, shutters, and a slightly raised porch. Leaning against the base of this house is a striking bright red paper or fabric umbrella, opened and propped upright. Its vivid color stands out strongly against the muted browns, grays, and greens of the surroundings. Around it are miscellaneous items: pieces of cardboard, sacks, sticks, and other stored materials.

The center of the image is dominated by a narrow muddy drainage channel or footpath, bordered by rounded dark stones. Rainwater runs through it, creating small puddles and reflective wet surfaces. The stones are slick and blackened by moisture, with patches of moss or green algae visible in places. The path curves slightly and leads the eye deeper into the village.

Along the left building, various everyday objects are stored under the shelter of the roof: a turquoise plastic bucket, baskets, a broom, stacked wooden crates, and bundles of sticks or firewood leaning against the wall. The house walls include woven bamboo or textured panels, wooden doors, and shuttered windows, giving the place a handmade, rural feel.

On the right side, another long wooden structure runs parallel to the path. It is darker and more shadowed, with a raised wooden bench or platform along the wall. The overhanging roof creates a tunnel-like effect, making the passage feel enclosed and intimate. The far end of the lane is brighter, where daylight enters, revealing more wooden fencing and a faint silhouette of a person standing or walking in the distance.

The roofs are low and sloping, with moss, plants, and small ferns growing along the edges. Rain falls in visible streaks from the roofline, emphasizing the wet weather. The overall mood is quiet, rural, and atmospheric—an old village lane during a rainy day, filled with signs of daily life, natural decay, and shelter from the elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乡村生活场景的摄影作品，画面中心有一把鲜艳的红色雨伞靠在木质建筑的一侧。建筑物的木制结构和屋顶上的茅草表明这是一个传统的乡村环境。街道上散落着一些物品，如桶、盆和其他杂物，而街道两旁堆放着整齐的石块。整个场景被一种柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种宁静而略带忧郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a vintage passenger railcar parked on railroad tracks at what appears to be a historic rail station or yard. The main subject is a long maroon coach car with a black, slightly rounded roof and gold lettering along the upper side reading “NEW HOPE & IVYLAND.” Near the left upper side of the car, the word “COACH” is painted in small gold letters, and the car number “1127” appears in gold near the lower side panels.

The railcar has a classic riveted metal exterior, with many visible rows of rivets and panel seams. A thin yellow stripe runs horizontally along the length of the car below the windows, adding contrast to the dark red body. The windows are rectangular and evenly spaced, with dark glass reflecting the surroundings. At the far left end, an open vestibule or doorway area is visible, with steps leading up into the coach and a small sign near the bottom that says “WATCH YOUR STEP.” Chains hang across part of the open end, emphasizing the old-fashioned railcar design.

The car sits on dark metal wheels and suspension components, which are partly in shadow beneath the body. To the right, part of another matching maroon railcar is visible, connected behind it.

In the foreground, multiple railroad tracks run diagonally across the image, set in gravel and darker ballast. The rails are shiny in places, catching sunlight, while wooden ties and track hardware are clearly visible. A small yellow post or marker stands near the right side of the tracks.

Behind the train is a station-like building with pale yellow siding, dark trim, and a gray shingled roof. It has multiple windows and a classic railway-depot appearance. Utility poles and overhead wires cross the upper left portion of the scene, and a few leafing trees rise behind the building. The sky is bright blue with only a few small clouds, suggesting a clear, sunny day. Overall, the image has a historic railroad atmosphere, highlighting a preserved or heritage passenger train at a station.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆停靠在铁轨上的红色复古火车车厢的照片。火车车厢的侧面印有'NEW HOPE & IVYLAND'字样，车号为1127。车厢的设计显得古典而优雅，窗户排列整齐，车身呈现出深红色调。背景中可以看到一些低矮的建筑物和清晰的蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, low-angle view of a soccer or sports field. Most of the frame is filled with bright green grass, which appears slightly wet or glossy, with small sparkling highlights scattered across the surface. The grass is in relatively sharp focus in the foreground, while much of the background is blurred, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect.

On the far right side of the image, only the lower legs of an athlete are visible. The person is wearing bright orange socks and white soccer cleats with dark detailing and studs. Their legs are partially cut off by the edge of the frame, suggesting they are either running, standing, or moving just outside the main focus of the shot.

The upper background is heavily out of focus but appears to include colorful advertising boards or stadium signage, with red, orange, blue, and purple tones. The overall scene feels like it is taking place during a professional soccer match or training session, with the camera focused near ground level on the pitch rather than on the players.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示足球场草地的特写照片，焦点落在了运动员的脚和穿着橙色袜子的白色运动鞋上。草地上散布着小石子，而背景则模糊地显示了其他足球场地的一部分。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large department store or retail space in the middle of a closing or liquidation sale. The store looks mostly emptied out, with fixtures, display tables, and loose materials scattered across the floor.

In the foreground, several round white display tables are grouped together. They have small red price stickers or tags on their tops, suggesting they are being sold as store fixtures. Some tables are upright, while other flat round tabletops and parts are stacked or lying nearby. Long black metal poles or rails are spread across the floor in front of and behind the tables, adding to the dismantled, warehouse-like feel.

Across the ceiling, many bright yellow, red, and black sale signs hang from wires. The signs advertise phrases such as “Everything Must Go!”, “Store Closing Sale!”, “Everything at least 40% to 80% off lowest ticketed price,” “Nothing Held Back!”, and “Fixtures, Furniture and Equipment For Sale.” The bold colors and hazard-stripe borders make them very eye-catching. Smaller versions of the same sale signs are visible farther back in the store.

The store itself is large and open, with a grid of white acoustic ceiling tiles, fluorescent light panels, and track lighting. Some ceiling panels appear slightly misaligned or worn. The lighting is bright but the space feels vacant and transitional.

In the middle distance, there are empty clothing racks, display stands, counters, and shelving units. Many areas that would normally hold merchandise are bare. A tall square column with a light wood finish stands near the center of the image, and behind it are partially dismantled display areas.

On the back wall, a dark navy-blue section is labeled “LANDS’ END” and “LANDS’ END MEN,” indicating this was likely a department store section for Lands’ End clothing. Most of the merchandise has been removed from this area as well. White wall panels, empty racks, and a few tables remain.

On the right side, a large wooden display structure or kiosk appears to be partly dismantled. A long piece of wood or support beam leans against it, and pieces of cardboard, paper, and debris are scattered around the floor. A small gray trash can sits near the center-right area. The tiled floor in the back section is visibly littered with packaging, scrap material, and store fixture remnants.

Overall, the image captures a department store in its final stages of closure: bright liquidation signs overhead, empty sales floors, dismantled fixtures, scattered debris, and only the infrastructure of the store remaining.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示商店内部正在装修的照片。图像中心是一个空旷的区域，周围摆放着几组白色的圆桌和椅子。天花板上悬挂着几个黄色和红色的广告牌，上面写着'COME IN'和'LAND END 2 MEN'等字样。商店内部装饰正在进行中，可以看到一些货架和拆卸的物品散落在地面上。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an old stone slab or wall covered with rows of carved writing. The surface is rough, weathered, and mottled in shades of gray, beige, black, and pale yellow, suggesting age, mineral staining, lichen, or erosion.

The inscription is arranged in many horizontal lines across the stone. The characters are deeply incised but softened by time, with rounded, looping, and curling shapes. Many symbols have spiral-like ends and flowing curves, giving the writing an ornate appearance. The script appears to be an ancient or traditional South Asian script, though the exact language is not identifiable from the image alone.

The stone face is uneven and pitted, with darker patches where grime or moisture has accumulated. Some parts of the carving are clearer, especially near the upper and middle left areas, while other sections are faint and difficult to distinguish because of erosion and discoloration. Thin horizontal guide lines or natural strata run across the slab, helping separate the rows of text.

At the top, the stone edge is irregular and chipped. Behind it is a darker rock surface, also aged and stained, with patches of moss or lichen. On the far left, another rough stone block is visible, lighter in color and protruding slightly, suggesting the inscription may be part of an archaeological site, temple ruin, or historic stone structure.

Overall, the image conveys a sense of antiquity: a weathered carved inscription preserved on stone, with its decorative script still visible despite centuries of exposure.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老石刻文字的照片。石碑表面刻有精细的图案和文字，显示出一种历史的痕迹。石碑上的文字是用某种古代语言书写的，虽然无法辨认具体含义，但可以感受到其古老的魅力。石碑周围环境显得荒凉，与石碑本身形成鲜明对比，强调了其作为历史遗迹的重要性。

caption:
The image shows a military fighter jet flying through a clear, bright blue sky. The aircraft is seen in a side profile, moving from left to right, with its pointed nose facing the right edge of the frame. It appears to be an F-16-style single-engine fighter with a sleek fuselage, bubble canopy, single vertical tail fin, and sharply swept wings.

The jet is painted in dark gray camouflage tones, with lighter gray panels visible along the upper fuselage and tail. On the vertical tail fin there is a blue-and-white national marking that resembles the Greek flag, and the number “539” is visible on the tail section. A roundel marking is also visible on the wing, reinforcing the impression that it belongs to the Hellenic/Greek air force.

The cockpit canopy is tinted and slightly reflective, and a pilot can be seen seated inside. The aircraft carries external stores: there are missiles or missile-like pods mounted near the wingtips or wing stations, and a large external fuel tank or pod is attached beneath the fuselage. The underside of the aircraft is darker due to shadow, while the upper surfaces catch the sunlight.

The background is completely uncluttered—just a smooth, cloudless blue sky—making the fighter jet the central and only subject of the image. The photo captures the aircraft in flight with a crisp, aerodynamic silhouette and a sense of speed and altitude.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架喷气式战斗机在晴朗蓝天中飞行的照片。飞机涂装为深色迷彩，机身上有希腊国旗的标志。它装备了导弹和机炮，正在执行一项军事任务或演示。

caption:
The image shows a nighttime urban street scene in a dense downtown area, likely Toronto, with tall illuminated office towers rising in the background. The viewpoint is from the middle of a wide road looking straight ahead toward the city skyline.

The sky is very dark blue and cloudy, giving the scene a moody, cinematic atmosphere. The city lights create a strong contrast against the night sky, with cool blue and teal tones dominating the buildings and street, while warm orange streetlights glow along the sidewalks.

In the center background, several high-rise buildings are lit with many small office windows. One of the tallest towers has a bright green “TD” logo near the top and a lit architectural crown. To the left, another building displays a “BMO” sign. Farther left, a red neon sign for the Fairmont Royal York is partially visible. The skyline is layered, with multiple towers of different heights and window patterns.

The street in the foreground is broad and mostly empty, with only a single car driving away from the camera near the center of the road. The asphalt appears slightly wet or reflective, catching blue, red, and amber light from traffic signals and streetlamps. Red traffic lights hang above the intersection, and there are several road signs, including “Harbour St” and directional signage for the Air Canada Centre.

On the right side of the image, a tall modern residential or hotel building lines the street. It has glass windows, vertical architectural strips, and protruding balconies stacked floor by floor. At street level, there are storefronts or restaurant entrances, including a visible sign for “Miller Tavern.” Warm light spills from this side, making the right edge of the frame glow orange.

On the left side, there is a lower structure or overpass/railway-like elevated section crossing the scene horizontally. Below it are construction-style barriers, black-and-orange bollards, fencing, and a small shelter-like structure. Streetlights and traffic poles are scattered throughout, some producing bright halos due to the night exposure.

The composition feels urban, quiet, and slightly cinematic: a nearly empty downtown street framed by high-rises, traffic lights, construction barriers, and glowing signs. The color palette is especially striking, blending cool blue city light with warm amber street illumination.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，画面中心是一条宽阔的道路，路面反射着周围的灯光。道路两侧是高楼大厦，其中一些建筑物的顶部亮起了灯光，营造出一种繁忙都市的氛围。天空中云层较厚，但仍然可以看到远处城市的轮廓。道路上有几辆汽车和一个红色交通信号灯，而路边则有行人正在行走。整个场景被夜晚的光线所照亮，给人一种静谧而又充满活力的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of an urban aerial cable car system on a green hillside, likely part of the Medellín Metrocable network in Colombia.

In the foreground, a gondola cabin hangs from the cable line on the left side of the frame. The cabin is white and dark-tinted, with a broad front window. On the glass is the logo and text for **“Metro de Medellín”**, along with the phrase **“Calidad de vida”**. The cabin is marked with the number **4** near the top. A horizontal stripe in yellow and green runs across the lower front of the gondola, and the bottom has vent-like gray panels. The cabin is suspended from a large metal grip and wheel assembly that connects it to the overhead cable.

Dominating the upper half of the image is a large steel support tower and pulley structure. The tower is gray, industrial, and highly detailed, with multiple rollers, wheels, beams, platforms, safety railings, and maintenance walkways. A vertical ladder runs down the central support column, and there are electrical boxes and warning signs attached to the structure. A blue-and-white sign with the number **10** appears on the right side of the overhead framework.

The cable system extends into the distance, with additional gondola cabins visible lower left, following the cable line down the hillside. The perspective suggests the viewer is either inside another cable car or very close to the station or support structure, looking past the machinery.

Below and around the cable system is lush green vegetation: dense trees, shrubs, and grassy slopes. On the right side, partly hidden by trees, there is a brick building with a reddish tiled roof, suggesting a residential neighborhood built into the hillside.

In the background, through a hazy atmosphere, a sprawling city fills the valley below. Tall buildings and urban blocks are faintly visible, softened by mist or smog. Behind the city are distant mountains or hills under a cloudy, pale sky. The overall scene combines heavy transportation infrastructure with steep green terrain and a dense urban landscape, emphasizing a cable car network used to connect hillside communities with the city below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示缆车系统的照片，前景中有一个悬挂的缆车车厢，车厢上方有电缆和支撑结构。缆车车厢为深蓝色，侧面带有绿色和黄色条纹，上面印有'JAMAICA'字样。背景中可以看到郁郁葱葱的树木和远处的城市建筑轮廓，天空中有散布的云朵。

caption:
The image shows a motorcyclist aggressively cornering on a paved road or racetrack. The rider is leaned far over to the left, with the motorcycle tilted at a dramatic angle, suggesting high speed and precise control through a turn.

The motorcycle appears to be a Suzuki sport bike, with visible “Suzuki” branding on the front fairing and “GSX-R” style graphics on the side. Its bodywork is mostly black, white, and blue, with aerodynamic fairings and a bright headlight illuminated at the front. The front wheel is turned slightly as the rider tracks through the curve, and both tires look wide and performance-oriented, gripping the asphalt closely.

The rider is wearing full protective gear: a black leather racing suit, armored gloves, boots, and a full-face helmet. The helmet is white and black with neon yellow accents, and the brand “Bell” is visible on the forehead area. The visor is darkly tinted, obscuring the rider’s face. Neon yellow details also appear on the gloves and boot/slider areas, standing out against the black gear.

The rider’s body position is very dynamic: they are tucked low behind the windscreen, with their torso shifted inward toward the corner. One knee is extended outward and appears close to the road surface, a typical sport-riding technique used during aggressive cornering. The right arm is bent and close to the body, while the left arm reaches across the handlebars as the bike leans.

In the background, there is a blurred guardrail running horizontally across the scene, with dry, tan hills and scattered green vegetation beyond it. The background blur emphasizes motion and keeps attention on the motorcycle and rider. The lighting is bright and sunny, creating sharp highlights on the bike’s glossy surfaces and helmet. Overall, the image captures a high-performance motorcycle rider in a fast, controlled lean through a turn.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示摩托车手在公路上进行高速行驶的摄影作品。摩托车手穿着全套黑色骑行装备，包括头盔、手套和护具，正以弯曲的姿态驾驶着一辆蓝色的运动型摩托车。摩托车前方的灯光亮起，显示了其正在高速行驶的状态。背景是模糊的道路和远处的山丘，强调了摩托车的速度感和动态美。

caption:
The image shows a calm seaside beach bordered by rugged, layered cliffs under a pale blue, cloudless sky. The composition is wide and panoramic, with the ocean occupying the lower left and center, the sandy beach stretching across the lower right, and dramatic rock formations rising along the background.

On the left, a large eroded rock outcrop juts into the water, its horizontal sediment layers clearly visible. The cliff face has beige, tan, and gray tones, with darker shadowed bands emphasizing its stratified texture. Below it, a line of rounded rocks forms a breakwater along the shoreline.

Across the middle and right side of the image, the cliffs continue in a sweeping slope upward, forming a natural backdrop behind a developed beachfront area. At the base of the cliffs there is a landscaped resort-like space with green grass, rows of palm trees, and several shade structures with beige canopy roofs. A large inflatable snowman decoration stands among the palms, creating an unusual festive contrast with the warm beach setting.

The sea is calm, with small ripples and gentle waves lapping onto the sand. The water is a muted blue-green, reflecting the bright daylight. The beach itself is light-colored and wide, with scattered footprints and small bits of seaweed or debris near the waterline.

On the right side near the shore, two people in swimwear walk along the wet sand, their figures small compared with the expansive landscape. Farther in the distance, a few other tiny figures are visible near the water. The overall mood is peaceful and sunny, suggesting a quiet coastal resort or sheltered bay with dramatic desert-like cliffs behind it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩景观的照片，画面中心有两座独特的岩石结构，它们的形状类似于天然形成的蘑菇或层状物。沙滩上散布着一些游客和度假者，他们似乎在享受阳光和海风。背景中可以看到郁郁葱葱的棕榈树和一些建筑物，这些元素共同构成了一个宁静而放松的海滨环境。

caption:
The image shows a large commercial passenger airplane in flight against a clear, bright blue sky. The aircraft is painted in WOW air’s distinctive vivid magenta/pink livery with white accents.

The plane is viewed from the side and slightly below, with its nose pointing to the right and its tail to the left. It appears to be either approaching for landing or shortly after takeoff, as the landing gear is extended: the nose wheel is visible under the front of the aircraft, and the main landing gear is lowered beneath the wings.

Key visible details include:

- **Airline branding:** The tail fin has a large white circular logo reading “WOW air.” The fuselage also displays “wowair.com” near the front.
- **Color scheme:** Most of the aircraft is bright magenta, with large white graphic shapes across the middle section of the fuselage.
- **Registration:** The text “TF-MOM” is visible near the rear side of the fuselage.
- **Promotional text:** Near the engine area, the phrase “Going to Iceland?” can be seen.
- **Wings and engines:** The main wing extends from the center of the aircraft, with a dark underside and visible flap mechanisms. A magenta engine is mounted beneath the wing.
- **Tail and winglets:** The vertical tail is magenta with the WOW air logo, and the wingtip has a matching magenta-and-white design.
- **Windows and doors:** Rows of small passenger windows run along the side, and several outlined doors are visible.

The background is simple and uncluttered, consisting entirely of blue sky, which makes the bright pink aircraft stand out strongly.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架粉红色的客机在晴朗蓝天中飞行的照片。飞机的机身主要为鲜艳的粉红色，机翼和尾翼上印有大型白色'WOW'字样，下方是公司的标志。飞机的起落架已经放下，准备降落或刚刚起飞。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor butchering or meat-preparation scene, likely at a public event, market, or rural gathering.

In the foreground, a man wearing a gray knit beanie, dark fleece jacket, and a white butcher’s apron is working at a large wooden table covered with raw meat. He is leaning forward, focused on cutting and handling a long strip of pale pink fatty tissue and meat. In one hand he holds the hanging piece of meat upright, while in the other he holds a large knife near the table surface. His apron is stained from the work.

The table is crowded with large cuts of raw pork or similar meat, including fatty slabs, ribs, and exposed red muscle tissue. The meat is spread across the dark wooden planks, with visible fat, bone, and connective tissue. A black container or bin sits at the right edge of the table.

Behind the butcher, several people are gathered outdoors. Their faces appear blurred. Some are standing in line or watching, dressed in winter or cool-weather clothing such as heavy jackets, hats, and scarves. A person in a bright yellow coat stands out in the background, along with a child in a blue hat. On the right side, a man in a brown jacket stands near a small red-yellow-blue flag or cloth draped over a barrier or object.

The setting appears to be a wooded area or park, with leafless trees in the background, suggesting late autumn or winter. The lighting is bright and natural, with sunlight illuminating the meat and the people, creating strong highlights and shadows. Overall, the image conveys the atmosphere of a traditional outdoor meat-processing demonstration, market stall, or communal food-preparation event.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示屠夫在户外环境中切割猪肉的现实主义风格照片。屠夫穿着灰色帽子和黑色上衣，专注地处理着一块大块的猪肉。他的右手握着刀，左手拿着一块肉，准备进行下一步操作。猪尸体被放置在木制桌子上，周围散落着其他未加工的猪肉片。背景中可以看到模糊的人群和其他活动参与者，他们似乎正在参加一个户外活动或集会。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny urban street scene, likely in a European city, with a pedestrian-friendly area framed by lush greenery and older apartment buildings.

In the foreground, a paved road with a faded zebra crossing runs horizontally across the bottom of the image. On the right side, part of a silver car is parked along the curb, partly cropped by the edge of the frame. A low white metal barrier separates a small sidewalk or pedestrian island from the street. Near it are two rounded green-and-white bollards.

The center of the image opens into a tree-lined pedestrian walkway or small plaza. Several people are walking away from the camera down the path. The walkway is shaded by large, mature trees with dense, vivid green leaves. Their branches spread widely across the upper half of the scene, creating a leafy canopy. Sunlight filters through the foliage, casting dappled shadows on the pavement.

On the left side, beneath the trees, there are small outdoor kiosks or café stalls with awnings and signage. Some signs contain Cyrillic lettering, suggesting the location may be in an Eastern European or Ukrainian-speaking area. A planter box with colorful flowers sits near the base of a large tree trunk, adding a decorative touch to the pedestrian zone.

On the right side, a row of older multi-story buildings lines the street. The façades are warm-toned—peach, beige, and orange—with decorative trim, balconies, and large windows. Some balconies are enclosed with glass, while others have black metal railings. The buildings show a mix of historic architectural details and modern additions such as air-conditioning units, shopfronts, and signage. One storefront sign reads “Miracoli,” and there is more Cyrillic text advertising delivery.

Near the center-right is a blue circular pedestrian sign showing an adult and child walking, with the word “ЗОНА” underneath, indicating a pedestrian zone. A decorative streetlamp stands nearby, with a curved metal arm and a round lamp hanging from it.

The background continues into a shaded pedestrian corridor filled with more trees, small shops, and outdoor seating areas. Above, the sky is a clear, saturated blue with a few soft white clouds visible through gaps in the foliage. Overall, the scene feels calm, green, and summery, with a relaxed city-neighborhood atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中，我们看到几棵郁郁葱葱的大树位于人行道旁，为这个城市场景增添了生机。街道上有多位行人正在行走，其中一位穿着深色衣服的人正从左侧走向右侧。街道两侧是色彩鲜明的建筑，包括一家带有遮阳篷的咖啡馆和一家装饰有绿色植物的商店。一辆银色轿车停靠在路边，而远处可以看到一个带有'Bus'标志的公交车站。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，整个场景显得宁静而有序。

caption:
The image shows an indoor ceremonial setting, likely a funeral or memorial service, with two men in white shirts exchanging or presenting a folded orange cloth or package.

In the foreground, two men stand facing each other. Their faces are blurred. The man on the left is younger-looking, wearing a white long-sleeved button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up and dark trousers. He is slightly bent forward, holding the orange item with both hands in a respectful manner. He has short dark hair and a small earring. The man on the right appears older and is also dressed in a white button-up shirt tucked into black trousers. He wears a wristwatch and is receiving or helping hold the orange item.

Between them and slightly lower in the frame is a small round pedestal or tray holding several similar orange folded packages stacked neatly. The orange cloths have black decorative patterns and Thai writing printed on them, suggesting they may be ceremonial robes or ritual offerings.

The background contains many floral wreaths and arrangements, mostly in white, yellow, orange, and red flowers. Several wreaths have white ribbons with Thai text, typical of condolence or memorial displays. On the left side, there is a framed portrait placed among flowers, reinforcing the impression of a memorial or funeral environment. Some decorative lights are visible around the floral display.

The room has a polished patterned floor, reddish-brown columns, and partially closed metal shutters in the back. There is also a blue awning or dark blue area visible through an opening behind the men. A standing fan can be seen near the center background. The lighting is bright indoors, with a slightly warm tone, while the background is somewhat darker and softly blurred.

Overall, the scene feels formal and solemn. The two men appear to be participating in a respectful ritual or presentation of ceremonial cloths during a memorial service.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位男性在室内场合交换物品的照片。左侧的男性穿着白色衬衫和深色裤子，正在向右侧的男性递送一个橙色的文件夹。右侧的男性穿着白色衬衫和黑色裤子，他正接过文件夹并准备查看。他们周围摆放着鲜花、照片和其他装饰品，营造出一种庄重而正式的氛围。背景中可以看到一扇关闭的门和一些模糊的文字标识，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a silver pickup truck driving along a paved road in bright daylight. The truck appears to be a Mitsubishi pickup with an extended cab and a short open cargo bed. It is photographed from the side at a slight front angle, with the front of the vehicle facing left. The vehicle has tinted side windows, chrome side mirrors and door handles, black wheel arches, a side step, and alloy wheels. The tires and lower body have some visible dirt or dust, suggesting normal road use. The front license plate is blurred.

In the background, there is a large commercial building or service-station-like structure with a wide canopy supported by cylindrical columns. The canopy has a clean gray underside and a red-and-blue trim line along its edge. Behind and around the building are shrubs, trees, and a roadside hedge. A colorful sign with Thai writing is visible on the left side, including a small logo and large red and white Thai text, suggesting the setting may be in Thailand.

A prominent feature of the scene is the dense network of overhead utility wires stretching horizontally and diagonally across the upper portion of the image. Several concrete utility poles stand near the building, with cables bundled and looping around them. The sky is clear and blue, and the strong sunlight creates sharp shadows beneath the vehicle and canopy.

The road in the foreground is smooth and gray, with faint lane markings visible. Overall, the image captures an everyday urban or roadside scene: a silver pickup truck passing in front of a commercial area with signage, utility poles, and many overhead cables.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆银色皮卡车在加油站前行驶的照片。车辆位于画面的中心，其外观为典型的双门皮卡设计，车身干净且保养良好。背景中可以看到加油站的白色建筑和多根电线杆，以及一些广告牌，如'Khanom'品牌的标志。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a public bus or tram, photographed from a seated passenger’s perspective with a wide-angle view down the aisle.

In the foreground on the right, a woman is seated beside a large window. Her face is blurred, and she appears to be wearing a light-colored face mask. She has a patterned headscarf in beige and pink tones wrapped around her head and neck, and she is dressed in a dark burgundy or maroon outfit. A black handbag with a gold chain strap rests on her lap or beside her arm, and her hands are folded over it. She is sitting upright, turned slightly toward the camera, near the side wall of the vehicle.

In the center foreground, an empty seat dominates the frame. The seat has dark blue fabric with a colorful abstract pattern of red, green, white, and blue squiggles. A bright yellow grab handle curves over the top of the seatback. Hanging or resting against the front of this seat is a translucent plastic shopping bag containing indistinct items.

Behind the empty seat, an older man stands in the aisle. He is wearing a black face mask and a light gray jacket over a collared shirt. He is holding onto a vertical yellow pole with both hands, bracing himself as the vehicle moves. Only part of his face is visible because of the mask and the angle.

On the left side of the image, another passenger stands near the aisle. This person wears a pale beige headscarf and a long light-colored coat or dress, with a blue jacket layered over it. They also appear to be wearing a face mask. A black shoulder bag hangs at their side. Farther back, another masked passenger is partially visible near the front section of the vehicle.

The bus interior features bright yellow poles, handles, and grab rails throughout, contrasting with the darker seats and walls. Long fluorescent-style ceiling lights run lengthwise overhead, casting a strong, cool light. The windows on the right show blurred reflections and purple-pink tones from outside lighting, suggesting it may be evening or nighttime in an urban area. The overall atmosphere is that of a crowded public transit ride, with passengers quietly standing and sitting while wearing masks.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现公共交通场景的照片，其中一位女性乘客坐在公交车上，她戴着头巾和围巾，穿着紫色的服装，并且手中拿着一个黑色的手提包。在她的背后，可以看到另一位男性乘客站立着，他身穿粉色衬衫和深色裤子，手里拿着手机。车厢内还有其他几位乘客，但他们的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。整个场景给人一种日常生活的即视感，捕捉了城市交通中的一个瞬间。

caption:
The image shows a long, elegant row of neoclassical-style townhouses or apartments, viewed from the sidewalk at an angle that emphasizes their repeating architecture. The buildings have a pale cream or off-white façade with tall, fluted columns running along the front, creating a covered portico-like walkway. Each column has a simple classical capital and sits on a glossy black rectangular base, producing a strong contrast against the light exterior.

A black wrought-iron fence with pointed spear-like finials runs along the lower front of the buildings, enclosing basement-level areas and small entry spaces. On the right side, a short set of light stone steps leads up to an entrance area, with a low cream balustrade beside it. Large rectangular sash windows are set into the façade; some reflect green trees and sunlight, giving the glass a warm, leafy glow.

The perspective draws the eye down the row of columns toward the left, where the building continues into the distance. Above, there are decorative railings or parapets and small, neatly trimmed green shrubs visible along the upper level. The sidewalk in the foreground is gray and slightly worn, with paving seams, utility covers, and small cracks.

Overall, the scene feels quiet, upscale, and urban—likely a residential street in a historic city district. The composition highlights symmetry, repetition, and the refined classical details of the architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑细节的摄影图像，具体为一排具有传统英式设计风格的房屋。每栋房子都有一个白色的门廊和黑色的铁艺栏杆，以及白色的立柱。在最前方的房子上，可以看到标有数字'10'的黑色号码牌。整个场景被拍摄在一个晴朗的日子里，阳光照射下，建筑物的细节清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a rustic stone entrance or passageway in a sunny outdoor setting, likely in a rural or historic area.

In the foreground, rough dry-stone walls made of irregular gray and pale limestone blocks run across the left and right sides of the frame. The stones vary greatly in size and shape, with jagged edges, cracks, patches of lichen, and faint pinkish or reddish staining. Near the center is a tall, upright rectangular stone slab or gatepost, weathered and mottled with white lichen, standing like a threshold marker. On the right, another thick stone pillar and stacked wall form the opposite side of the opening. A low stone step or slab lies at the base of the entrance, with loose gravel, dry leaves, and sparse grass around it.

Through the opening, a person is seen from behind walking away uphill on a grassy, uneven path. The person appears to be an older adult wearing a light-colored cap, a pale blue or white long-sleeved shirt, and tan trousers. Their posture is slightly forward-leaning as they move into the shaded area beyond the wall.

On the left side in the background, partially hidden behind the stone wall and tree branches, there is a small stone building with a roof of curved terracotta tiles in warm red, orange, and beige tones. Rising above it is a narrow stone tower or chimney-like structure, weathered and pale against the sky.

Large trees frame the scene from above, with dark trunks and dense green foliage spreading across the top of the image. The leaves create patches of shade over the stone walls and ground, while the open sky visible in the middle is a clear, bright blue. The overall atmosphere is quiet, warm, and Mediterranean-like, with strong sunlight emphasizing the textures of the ancient stonework and the dry, natural landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的摄影图像，画面中心是一位穿着休闲服装的人站在两块巨大的石墙之间。左侧的石墙由不规则的石头堆砌而成，而右侧的石墙则显得更加坚固和古老。在石墙后方，可以看到一片绿色的草地和几棵树木，以及一座带有红色屋顶的小屋。阳光照耀下，整个场景显得宁静而古朴。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a grand Gothic cathedral viewed from a very low angle, looking upward toward the ceiling. The perspective emphasizes the immense height and scale of the architecture.

The ceiling is made of warm golden-brown stone blocks arranged in ribbed vaults. Thick stone ribs curve across the ceiling in sweeping arcs, meeting at circular carved bosses or medallions. These ribs divide the ceiling into triangular and fan-like sections, creating a complex geometric pattern typical of Gothic architecture. The warm amber lighting gives the stone a glowing, almost honey-colored appearance.

A massive fluted stone column dominates the right side of the image, rising vertically from the bottom edge and disappearing into the vaulting above. Its surface is divided into many narrow vertical shafts, giving it a clustered appearance. Similar columns and arches appear throughout the scene, supporting the vaulted ceiling and framing the space.

Around the upper walls are arched openings, decorative galleries, and small circular stained-glass windows. The stained glass appears in bright colors—blue, red, green, and white—contrasting with the golden stone. Some larger stained-glass windows are partially visible at the far right and lower left, glowing with daylight.

Several hanging chandeliers or lamps are suspended from the ceiling by long chains. One chandelier is visible near the top left, with circular lamp elements, while another hangs lower near the center bottom of the frame. Thin cables or support wires stretch across parts of the scene, adding fine diagonal lines against the stonework.

The architecture is highly ornate: carved capitals top the columns, decorative arches line the upper walls, and the vault intersections feature sculpted circular details. The overall atmosphere is majestic, historic, and reverent, with the dramatic upward perspective making the cathedral feel vast, intricate, and awe-inspiring.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哥特式建筑内部的摄影作品，图像中心是一个宏伟的拱顶结构，其上覆盖着金色和棕色的装饰板。拱顶由多个细长的石柱支撑，这些柱子表面刻有精细的花纹。天花板上的窗户透过光线照亮了整个空间，而墙面则被各种大小和形状的彩色玻璃窗点缀，为教堂增添了一抹色彩。

caption:
The image shows two cosplayers posing outdoors in a shaded park or event area. Both are wearing white outfits and long blonde wigs styled with braids, giving them a coordinated fantasy or anime-inspired look. Their faces are blurred.

The person on the left is slightly behind and turned in profile. They have a blonde wig pulled back into a ponytail with a braided section across the top. They are wearing a white sleeveless or low-cut costume and holding a large decorative staff or spear upright. The weapon has a black-and-silver shaft, gold accents near the handle, and an ornate metallic silver blade at the top with engraved-looking patterns and curved edges. A strip of yellow fabric or ribbon hangs near the lower part of the prop.

The person on the right stands closer to the camera, also wearing a white sleeveless dress or costume with a fitted, pleated bodice. Their blonde wig is styled with a thick braid running along the side and loose, shoulder-length waves. They are holding another tall prop weapon upright: a black staff with gold-wrapped sections, silver bands, and a large axe- or halberd-like head at the top. The top piece has a circular metallic section and decorative engraved details.

The background is busy but out of focus, with several people sitting or standing under trees, suggesting a convention, cosplay gathering, or outdoor festival. The lighting is dappled, with patches of bright sunlight falling across the costumes and shadows from the surrounding trees. The overall scene has a candid, event-photo feel, centered on the two white-clad cosplayers and their elaborate fantasy weapons.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉了两位女性cosplayer在户外活动中的照片。她们穿着白色的服装，一位手持一把装饰华丽的长矛，另一位则拿着一个类似权杖的武器。背景中模糊地显示着其他参与者和树木，营造出一种轻松愉快的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, high-resolution portrait of an adult man looking directly into the camera. His face fills much of the right half of the frame, while the left side is mostly an out-of-focus background in muted beige and gray tones.

He has medium-brown skin, warm brown eyes, and a serious, steady expression. His face is lit by strong natural sunlight coming from the upper left, creating bright highlights on his forehead, cheeks, nose, and lips, while also casting deeper shadows along parts of his face and under his chin. Fine details are visible: wrinkles around his eyes and forehead, skin texture, small marks and pores, and a short, sparse mustache with gray stubble around the chin.

He is wearing an olive-brown hood or cloth wrapped around his head, framing his face closely. The fabric looks worn and slightly dusty, with folds and seams visible near the top and sides. A matching or similarly colored shirt is visible at the bottom of the frame, with a loose neckline. The earthy colors of his clothing blend with the warm, sandy tones of the background.

The composition is intimate and intense, with a shallow depth of field that keeps his face sharply in focus while blurring the surroundings. The background appears outdoors, possibly a sunlit street, wall, or open area, but it is too blurred to identify clearly. The overall mood is raw, direct, and contemplative, emphasizing the person’s gaze, weathered features, and the harsh warmth of the sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现一位男性特写的照片，他的面部表情平静而深邃。男子戴着一条绿色的头巾，脸部和衣服上沾有泥土，显示出一种朴素的生活气息。他穿着一件棕色的衣物，领口处略显磨损。背景模糊，无法辨认具体细节，但可以感受到是在户外拍摄的自然光照下。

caption:
The image shows a large gray stone or concrete statue of a human figure viewed from a low angle, making it appear tall and monumental. The figure stands upright with both arms raised high above its head, palms facing outward or slightly inward, as if reaching toward the sky. The hands are near the bright area of the sun, which is partially obscured by thick clouds, creating a faint halo of light behind the raised arms.

The statue’s surface is rough and weathered, with visible texture, seams, and sculpted folds suggesting clothing. The figure appears to be wearing a long-sleeved outfit or uniform, with broad sleeves and a simplified torso. The face is indistinct and blurred, while the head and neck are visible between the two raised arms. The overall color of the statue is pale gray, blending somewhat with the muted tones of the sky.

The sky dominates most of the background. It is overcast with heavy gray-blue clouds, giving the scene a cold, somber, and dramatic atmosphere. The lighting is subdued, with the brightest point directly above and behind the statue’s hands.

At the bottom of the image, there are hints of an urban or industrial landscape: leafless or early-spring trees, utility poles and wires, a tall smokestack or chimney, and block-like apartment buildings on the right side. The statue is centered in the composition, towering over the surrounding environment, with the low perspective emphasizing its scale and symbolic presence.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个巨大人体雕塑的摄影作品。雕塑位于画面中央，其上半身被阳光照亮，下半身则在阴影中显得更加暗淡。雕塑的细节非常清晰，包括肌肉线条和皮肤纹理。背景是阴天的天空和几栋低矮的建筑物，这些元素构成了一个简单的城市环境。

caption:
The image shows a grand historic railway station building in winter, under a clear blue sky. The architecture is classical and monumental, with beige-gray stone façades, tall arched windows, columns, cornices, decorative sculptures, and domed roof sections dusted with snow.

A large blue Cyrillic sign on the roof reads **“КИЕВСКИЙ ВОКЗАЛ”**, meaning **Kievsky Railway Station**. The letters are mounted along the upper edge of the main building and stand out brightly against the pale structure and sky.

On the right side is a tall clock tower with a square base and an ornate upper section. The tower has large clock faces on its sides, arched windows above, decorative trim, and a small domed cupola at the top. Snow rests along ledges, rooflines, and the tower’s architectural details.

The central part of the station features a large rounded dome with patches of snow on its dark roof. Below it are sculptural figures and decorative panels, including a colorful mosaic or painted icon-like panel set into the façade. The main entrance area includes tall arched openings and classical columns, giving the building a formal, civic appearance.

In the foreground, large mounds of bright white snow dominate the lower portion of the scene, partially obscuring the street level. Several ornate streetlamps with multiple globe-shaped lights stand in front of the station. A few vehicles and small human figures are barely visible near the bottom, emphasizing the scale of the building.

The overall atmosphere is crisp and sunny, with strong winter light illuminating the station’s façades and casting subtle shadows. The scene conveys a cold, snowy urban setting centered on an elegant, historic transport landmark.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示俄罗斯圣彼得堡的'Севастопольская'火车站的照片。建筑呈现出经典的欧洲风格，具有精细的装饰和复杂的立面设计。屋顶覆盖着雪，突显了冬季的季节特征。照片背景中可以看到被雪覆盖的树木和远处模糊的城市轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of Niagara Falls and the surrounding river gorge under a dramatic, overcast sky.

In the foreground, a broad expanse of dark green-gray river water fills the lower half of the scene. The surface is textured with ripples, currents, and streaks of white foam, suggesting strong, fast-moving water flowing away from the falls. Near the center in the distance, a small tour boat is visible on the river, dwarfed by the enormous scale of the landscape and the falls.

On the left side, a cliff edge drops sharply into mist, with part of a waterfall plunging down from the top. Farther toward the center-left, the main curtain of the falls is visible as a wide, pale, vertical sheet of water pouring over the cliff. Thick mist rises from the base, softening the view and creating a hazy white glow around the falls.

The right side of the image is dominated by the rocky gorge wall, layered with dark horizontal strata. Above the cliff is a strip of greenery with trees and parkland. Behind the trees rises a cluster of tall buildings, including hotels and observation towers. One building has a visible vertical red “CASINO” sign, and another tower-like structure resembles an observation tower. The urban skyline contrasts strongly with the natural force of the falls below.

The sky takes up a large portion of the image and is filled with towering, billowing clouds in shades of white, gray, and muted beige. The lighting is soft and diffused, with no strong direct sunlight, giving the scene a moody, slightly dramatic atmosphere. The overall color palette is subdued: gray-green water, pale mist, dark cliffs, muted city buildings, and a cloudy sky.

Overall, the image captures the immense scale and power of Niagara Falls, combining natural drama—water, cliffs, mist, and clouds—with the nearby city skyline and tourist infrastructure.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示尼亚加拉瀑布和城市天际线的自然风光摄影。图像前景是尼亚加拉河，其表面波光粼粼，水流湍急。中景是壮观的尼亚加拉瀑布，水花四溅，形成了一道白色的水幕。背景是城市的高楼大厦，包括几座突出的摩天大楼，它们在云层的映衬下显得格外引人注目。天空被厚重的云层覆盖，但光线依然可以穿透云层照亮场景。

caption:
The image shows a traditional wooden Orthodox church or chapel standing in a snowy winter landscape under a clear blue sky.

The building is constructed from thick, rounded logs stacked horizontally, with the log ends visibly interlocking at the corners. The wood has a warm, weathered tone, ranging from golden brown to grayish-brown, giving the structure an aged, rustic appearance. The church has multiple tiered sections and projecting volumes, creating an asymmetrical but carefully crafted silhouette.

At the top are three dark, shingled onion-shaped domes, each capped with an Orthodox cross. The central dome is the tallest and largest, flanked by two smaller domes on either side. The crosses are tall and slender, with additional angled crossbars typical of Eastern Orthodox design. Snow rests lightly on the domes, roof ridges, and ledges.

The rooflines are steep and layered, with decorative trim beneath the eaves. Colorful painted ornamentation—mainly in red, blue, and green—runs along the upper edges of the structure, adding intricate folk-style patterns to the otherwise natural wood exterior. A small arched gable or dormer-like feature is visible near the front, framing a recessed wooden section. Below it, there is a small square window with a simple frame.

The lower part of the building is massive and solid, with rounded log walls rising from a low stone foundation. On the right side, a projecting wooden section extends outward, supported by a post near the corner. Its planks appear more weathered and gray than the main logs.

The ground is covered in bright white snow, with long blue-gray shadows stretching across it. In the background, leafless winter trees and a dark wooden fence are visible, emphasizing the cold season. The sunlight is strong and crisp, illuminating the wood and casting sharp shadows, while the vivid blue sky gives the scene a calm, clear winter atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统木制教堂的摄影图像。教堂位于一片雪地上，其建筑风格和装饰细节清晰可见。教堂的屋顶由多个圆顶组成，每个圆顶上都装饰有十字架。教堂的外墙由棕色的木板构成，上面绘有宗教图案和文字。在蓝天的映衬下，教堂显得格外突出，周围环境被积雪覆盖，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide street-level view of a busy urban roadside, likely in a Southeast Asian town, with low-rise shopfronts and older wooden-style buildings under an overcast sky.

In the foreground is a wet asphalt road, suggesting recent rain. Faint yellow lane markings are visible near the bottom of the frame. Along the curb, several motorbikes and scooters are parked in a row, mixed with a dark sedan and a white sedan on the right. A few orange traffic cones and small roadside items sit near the vehicles.

The middle of the scene is dominated by two adjoining buildings. On the left is a two-story cream or pale yellow building with green trim around the windows and roofline. It has multiple rectangular windows, some with bars or shutters, and a row of colorful shop signs and banners at street level. The signs include Thai script and promotional graphics, giving the impression of small local businesses, possibly shops or eateries. Beneath the awnings, people can be seen near the storefronts, and there are more scooters parked close to the entrances.

On the right is a taller, dark gray wooden building with a steep gabled roof and a large covered balcony on the upper floor. The balcony has wooden railings and appears shaded, with dark interior space behind it. The lower level has glass-fronted areas that look like a café, gallery, or small business, with warm lights glowing inside. A short exterior staircase leads up to the entrance area, and decorative objects or planters are placed nearby.

A major visual feature is the dense web of overhead utility wires stretching horizontally across the entire image. Several thick black cables run through the center, while thinner lines crisscross near utility poles. A utility pole stands near the center with a lit streetlamp attached, casting a warm yellow glow despite the daylight. On the rooftops to the left are tall TV antennas, adding to the older, urban residential feel.

There are trees and potted plants between the buildings and vehicles, softening the scene with greenery. The sky is pale gray and cloudy, creating a muted, humid atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a lively, slightly cluttered streetscape with traditional architecture, small businesses, parked vehicles, overhead cables, and signs of everyday local activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一座两层高的传统建筑，其上半部分为木质结构，下半部分为砖石结构，并且有阳台和一些窗户。建筑前停放着几辆摩托车和一辆汽车，街道旁边有一些商店和摊位，出售各种商品。电线横跨在建筑物上方，而天空呈现出阴天的灰色调。

caption:
The image shows a rack of elegant women’s dresses hanging on white wooden hangers from a shiny metal clothing rail. The scene appears to be backstage, in a showroom, or at a fashion event, with a dark black curtain in the background and soft indoor lighting highlighting the garments.
