The dresses are formal and highly decorative, mostly in pale blush, champagne, beige, ivory, and soft pink tones. Many of them feature intricate embellishments such as sequins, beads, pearls, embroidery, lace, and sheer fabrics.

On the far left is a particularly ornate rose-gold or champagne-colored dress with long sleeves. It has dense beadwork and sparkling embroidery throughout, with large pearl-like decorations along the shoulders and neckline. The upper back or bodice area includes a cutout detail, and the fabric glitters under the light.

Next to it are several soft pink dresses made from delicate tulle, chiffon, or lace. One has wispy, frayed lace details over the bodice and skirt, giving it a romantic, ethereal look. Another has a translucent floral overlay with pale pink and green accents, suggesting a light garden-inspired design.

Toward the center and right side are more embellished gowns, including one with heavily embroidered lace in a champagne or muted gold shade. Its bodice and skirt are covered in ornate patterns, giving it a luxurious couture feel. Another dress nearby has pearl and bead accents along the neckline and shoulder area.

On the far right is a sleeveless dress with a cream or white base and a bold floral print in shades of pink, red, and purple. It has a deep V-shaped back or neckline visible from the angle and a softer, more colorful appearance compared with the heavily beaded dresses.

The hangers are evenly spaced but the garments overlap slightly, creating layers of texture—sparkling beadwork, sheer mesh, lace, embroidered appliqué, and flowing fabric. The overall mood is refined, feminine, and glamorous, suggesting a collection of evening gowns, bridalwear, or high-fashion dresses prepared for a runway show or photoshoot.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多件精美晚礼服的摄影棚照片。每件礼服都悬挂在衣架上，呈现出不同的设计和颜色。从左至右，可以看到一件金色亮片装饰的深色礼服，其上半身装饰有复杂的刺绣图案；紧邻着是一件粉色的长裙，上面点缀着精致的蕾丝和亮片细节；第三件是浅粉色带有花卉图案的礼服，其领口和袖子同样装饰有精美的蕾丝；最后一件是白色带花卉图案的礼服，领口处装饰有粉色花朵。这些礼服均以优雅的姿态悬挂，背景为模糊的黑色幕布，突出了服装的细节和质感。

caption:
This is a wide panoramic view of a lush, green park landscape centered around a calm pond or small lake. The scene is bright and sunlit, with a clear pale-blue sky visible through a large opening in the tree canopy.

In the foreground, the water fills much of the lower half of the image. Its surface is mostly still, creating mirror-like reflections of the surrounding trees, sky, and parts of a building on the far bank. Numerous round lily pads float across the water, especially concentrated toward the left and center foreground, with smaller clusters scattered to the right. The water has a greenish tint from the reflected foliage and aquatic plants.

The pond is bordered by dense vegetation and gently sloping grassy banks. On the far side, tall trees in many shades of green form a thick wall of foliage. Some trees are broad and leafy, while others are more slender or conifer-like. The sunlight highlights parts of the leaves, giving the scene a vivid, summery appearance. On the right side, a dirt path or bare earth bank curves along the edge of the water, partly shaded by trees.

Overhead, large oak-like branches frame the top of the image from both left and right, creating a natural arch. The leaves are sharply defined and deep green, with dark branches stretching across the upper corners. This framing draws attention toward the open sky in the center.

In the middle distance, partially hidden among the trees, there is a warm yellow-orange building with a classical or manor-like appearance. It has multiple windows and a veranda or colonnaded porch facing the pond. The building is partly obscured by tree trunks and foliage, but its reflection is faintly visible in the water below. To the left of it, low roof structures or glasshouse-like roofs can be seen near the bank.

Overall, the image conveys a peaceful, secluded garden or estate setting. The combination of still water, dense greenery, lily pads, tree reflections, and the hidden building gives it a serene, picturesque quality.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示宁静自然风光的摄影作品，画面中心是一个平静的湖泊，湖面上漂浮着许多睡莲。湖边长满了郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木，形成了一个绿色的屏障。在远处可以看到一座红顶建筑，它坐落在一片开阔的土地上，周围环绕着更多的绿色植被。整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一种平和与和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image is a high, aerial view of a compact Himalayan-style village or monastery settlement set in a dry, rocky landscape with dense greenery around it.

In the foreground and middle ground, there are many flat-roofed buildings clustered closely together. Most of the structures are whitewashed, with thick walls, small rectangular windows, and dark red or brown wooden window frames. Some buildings have black and red trim along the roof edges, a style often seen in Tibetan or Ladakhi architecture. Many rooftops are used for storage: piles of straw or hay, stacks of wood, branches, construction materials, and small household items are visible on top of the buildings.

Several Buddhist stupas or chortens stand out prominently. They are bright white, with tiered square bases and rounded domed forms, topped by red spires. A row of white stupas appears on the left side of the image, arranged in an open courtyard-like area. More stupas are visible on the right, lined beside a paved road that curves through the settlement. Near the bottom center, a large white stupa with a vivid red conical top sits inside a walled area, partially cut off by the edge of the frame.

The settlement is divided by low stone walls and narrow paths. Some walls are made of rough tan earth or stone, giving parts of the village an older, partially ruined appearance. There are small courtyards, enclosed plots, and uneven open spaces filled with rocks, wood piles, and debris. A few small vehicles are visible, including a dark car parked near the lower left and another vehicle near the upper left buildings.

A smooth paved road winds through the scene from the upper left, curves around the central buildings, and continues toward the right side. Alongside the road are boundary walls, utility poles, and occasional prayer flags strung across buildings or pathways. Tiny human figures can be seen near the upper left, emphasizing the scale of the buildings and open spaces.

The background is lush compared with the dry village terrain. Tall, slender poplar-like trees rise vertically behind and around the settlement, mixed with dense green and yellow foliage. The trees create a vivid contrast with the pale buildings, beige earth, and white stupas. The overall scene feels like a traditional mountain village or monastery complex, combining religious architecture, residential buildings, cultivated courtyards, and a surrounding oasis of trees in an otherwise arid environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示亚洲某个地区传统村庄的航拍照片。图像中心是一个被树木环绕的白色建筑群，周围散布着几座具有尖顶和红色装饰的佛教寺庙。村庄的屋顶大部分是灰色的，与周围的绿色植被形成鲜明对比。一条蜿蜒的道路穿过村庄，连接着各个部分。

caption:
The image shows a close view of a traditional Chinese palace or temple courtyard, emphasizing ornate architectural details.

In the upper portion, a sweeping tiled roof dominates the scene. The roof is covered in weathered yellow-orange glazed tiles arranged in curved rows, with decorative round tile ends along the eaves. Along the roof ridge are small sculptural figures, including animal-like guardians and a larger dragon or mythical beast ornament, typical of imperial-style Chinese architecture. The roof edges curve upward slightly, and the underside of the eaves is richly painted in faded greens, blues, reds, and cream tones with intricate geometric and floral patterns.

Beneath the roof are tall cylindrical red columns supporting the structure. The paint on the columns and beams shows signs of age, with scuffs and fading, giving the building a historic feel. Between the columns are carved wooden window panels with elaborate latticework and floral motifs. The walls and beams are decorated with layered painted brackets and carved supports, adding depth and complexity to the structure.

In the foreground, a white stone balustrade runs diagonally across the image, creating a sense of depth. The railing is carved with traditional cloud-like and floral patterns, topped by rounded lotus-bud finials. Some parts of the railing are softly out of focus, drawing attention toward the temple building behind it.

Near the center-right, behind the railing, there is a dark bronze or iron incense burner standing on legs, with a small roof-like top and decorative handles. It sits in the courtyard area in front of the building.

In the background, leafy green trees partially obscure another traditional building with a grey tiled roof and red-and-blue painted details. The sky is bright and overcast, making the colors of the architecture appear soft and slightly muted. Overall, the scene feels quiet, historic, and ceremonial, with a strong emphasis on imperial Chinese design, symmetry, carved ornamentation, and aged craftsmanship.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国古典建筑风格的摄影作品，画面中心是一座红墙金顶的亭子，其屋顶装饰着金色的脊兽和飞檐翘角。亭子周围有精美的石栏杆，栏杆上雕刻着复杂的花纹。在画面左侧，可以看到几根红色的柱子支撑着亭子的结构，柱子顶部装饰有绿色的植物图案。背景中模糊地显现出树木和另一座建筑物的轮廓，为这座亭子增添了一丝自然与历史的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet winter landscape under a wide, pale blue sky. Most of the frame is filled with open sky, giving the scene a spacious, calm feeling.

In the foreground, the ground is covered in bright white snow. Numerous footprints and small depressions are scattered across the snow, especially toward the lower left and center, suggesting people or animals have walked through the area. Dry, tan reeds and grasses poke up through the snow near the right side and along the edge of a partially frozen river or stream.

The water runs horizontally through the lower-middle portion of the scene. It is dark and reflective in places, with snowy banks and patches of ice along its edges. The river curves gently, helping lead the eye toward the buildings in the distance.

On the left side, tall leafless trees stand with dark, twisting trunks and branches. Some trees have clumps of mistletoe or dense growths high in their branches. More bare trees and shrubs line the riverbank across the middle of the image, creating a natural frame around the architecture beyond.

In the background, slightly right of center, there is a large white historic-looking building complex, likely a monastery, palace, or church complex. Its roofs are covered with snow, and several dark towers and domes rise above the main structure. The central tower is the tallest, topped with a narrow spire and a small cross. Smaller domed towers with crosses are visible nearby, giving the building a religious or ecclesiastical character. The white walls contrast sharply with the dark roof elements and bare trees in front.

The light appears soft but clear, as if taken on a cold sunny winter day. The overall mood is peaceful, crisp, and serene, with the snow, bare trees, still water, and distant church-like architecture creating a picturesque winter scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季雪景的自然风光摄影图像。前景是被积雪覆盖的地面上留下的脚印，以及一些裸露的树枝和灌木丛。中景显示了一条蜿蜒的河流，河面部分结冰，而另一部分则保持流动。背景是一座古老的教堂建筑，其白色墙面在蓝天的映衬下显得格外醒目。周围还有几座较小的建筑物，它们的屋顶同样覆盖着白雪。整个场景传达出一种宁静而寒冷的冬日氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large military-style marching drum corps moving in formation during a formal parade. The scene is crowded with rows of uniformed drummers, all dressed in matching black ceremonial uniforms with vivid red and gold accents.

The performers wear tall peaked caps with black tops, red bands, and gold details. Their jackets are black with red collars and shoulder boards, gold buttons, braided gold cords, medals, and decorative insignia on the sleeves and chest. Many have white gloves, black trousers with red side stripes, and highly polished black shoes. The repeated colors—black, red, gold, and white—create a very coordinated, ceremonial appearance.

Most of the visible participants are carrying silver snare drums strapped to their waists with white harnesses. They hold white drumsticks, many raised or angled in mid-motion, suggesting they are actively playing while marching. Their posture is upright and synchronized, with legs stepping forward in a disciplined cadence. The formation is dense, with several ranks visible from the foreground into the background.

The foreground focuses on the drummers, while the background contains more uniformed personnel, including some in green military uniforms and berets. There are also flags and banners visible toward the upper right, adding to the sense of an official parade or state ceremony. White tent-like structures and trees appear in the distant background, slightly out of focus.

The image has a dynamic, processional feel: the repeated drums, matching uniforms, angled caps, and synchronized marching create a strong sense of rhythm, discipline, and pageantry.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一支军乐队在户外行进的摄影照片。乐队成员穿着统一的黑色制服，装饰有红色和金色条纹，头戴带有徽章的黑色贝雷帽。他们手持鼓槌，敲打着大型鼓，步伐整齐划一。背景中可以看到其他行进中的队伍和观众，但焦点集中在前景的军乐队上。

caption:
The image shows a quiet street-side market scene in front of a decorative iron fence and a white gate pillar. Two older adults are seated in the foreground, their faces blurred.

On the left, an elderly man sits on a small wooden stool. He wears a gray cap, a blue-and-black plaid long-sleeve shirt, loose light-colored trousers, and dark lace-up shoes. His legs are crossed, and one hand rests near his knee while the other hangs loosely at his side. A small black-and-white item lies on the ground near his stool.

On the right, an elderly woman sits on a low wooden chair or cart-like seat. She wears a salmon-orange hijab and matching long-sleeved top, patterned black-and-white trousers, and light flip-flops. A patterned shoulder bag rests across her lap, and her hands are folded loosely over it. Her posture is relaxed, with one leg extended forward.

Behind them is a display of merchandise attached to the green wrought-iron fence. Several children’s T-shirts and outfits hang on white plastic hangers, including bright teal, pink, black, gray, and burgundy garments. Some shirts have cartoon-style graphics and large printed text. To the right, folded stacks of fabric or clothing are arranged on shelves or a makeshift stand. On the left side of the image, rolled patterned mats or textiles with dark gray and beige designs are stacked horizontally behind the fence.

The fence itself is ornate, painted dark green, with vertical bars, curled scrollwork, and small gold-colored finials along the top. A large white pillar divides the scene near the center-left. The background beyond the fence is soft and slightly out of focus, with greenery visible.

The overall color palette is muted and slightly desaturated, giving the photo a subdued, documentary feel. The setting appears to be an outdoor sidewalk market or informal stall, with the two seated people likely resting or watching over the displayed goods.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张纪实摄影风格的照片，展示了两位坐在户外的人。左侧的人物穿着蓝色格子衬衫和白色长裤，脚穿黑色鞋子，头戴一顶浅色帽子，身体稍微前倾，似乎在休息或等待。右侧的人物穿着橙色上衣和灰色裤子，脚穿棕色鞋子，头部被一件深色衣物遮挡，同样坐着，姿态放松。他们背后是一个铁艺栅栏，上面挂着各式各样的衣服和装饰品，包括T恤、围巾和其他小饰品。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit view of ancient stone ruins set in a lush tropical landscape.

In the foreground, a broad expanse of uneven stone paving stretches across the bottom of the scene. The stones are large, flat, weathered slabs with irregular shapes and gaps between them, partly filled with sandy soil. Their surfaces are dark gray to brown, worn smooth in places, with patches of dust and small bits of vegetation.

Across the middle of the image stands a low, ruined stone structure. The walls are made of stacked rectangular blocks, many of them darkened by age, moss, and weathering. Some sections are partially collapsed, with stones missing or leaning out of alignment. There are pale patches on some blocks, suggesting lichen or mineral staining. Several upright pillars and broken columns rise from the ruins, and near the center a horizontal stone lintel rests across two tall supports, forming the remains of a doorway or gateway. Other lintels and partial wall segments appear to the right and left, giving the impression of an old temple or archaeological site.

The ruins are surrounded by dense greenery. Tall trees with thin trunks and spreading leafy canopies rise behind and around the stonework. On the left side, a striking palm tree with a tall gray trunk and large fan-shaped green leaves towers above the ruins. More palms are visible in the background, including one near the center and another to the right. The vegetation is vibrant, with different shades of green filling the spaces behind the stone walls.

The upper half of the image is dominated by a bright blue sky streaked with thin, wispy white clouds. The light is warm and clear, suggesting a sunny day. The contrast between the ancient, dark, crumbling stone and the fresh green trees gives the scene a quiet, atmospheric feeling—like a historic ruin slowly being reclaimed by nature. No people or animals are visible, making the place feel still, open, and timeless.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老遗迹的摄影图像，具体是一座位于热带地区的古代建筑遗址。在画面中，我们可以看到一排石柱和部分倒塌的墙壁，显示出历史的痕迹。周围环绕着绿色的树木，其中一棵高大的棕榈树特别引人注目，它的叶子在阳光下显得格外鲜亮。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，几朵白云悠闲地飘浮着。

caption:
The image is a close-up, slightly blurred view of a computer screen showing a web browser open to an automotive website. A large magnifying glass dominates the composition, with its circular lens centered over the browser window and its black handle extending diagonally toward the upper left corner. The lens enlarges and sharpens part of the page beneath it.

Inside the magnified area, the top-left corner of a browser window is visible. It has the familiar macOS-style window controls: a red, yellow, and green circular button. To the right are navigation icons, including back and forward arrows, and a small window/layout icon. Below the browser toolbar, a page title line reads partially: “Online Car Buying is Here | As…”.

The main content visible through the lens shows the logo text “ASBURY” in large white capital letters, with “AUTOMOTIVE GROUP” beneath it in smaller white text. The website background appears gray or muted green, giving it a subdued, professional look.

Outside the magnifying glass, the rest of the screen is heavily out of focus. On the right side, there appears to be part of a vehicle image—possibly the rear or side of a car—suggesting the page is related to car sales or dealership services. The overall image has a soft, macro-photography feel, emphasizing online car buying, web browsing, and close inspection of the Asbury Automotive Group website.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张通过放大镜拍摄的网站截图，显示了ASBURY AUTOMOTIVE GROUP的官方网站。网站的标题和品牌名称清晰可见，而背景中的其他网页内容则被模糊处理。放大镜的边缘在图片中形成了一个明显的圆形轮廓，为这个商业宣传场景增添了一种专注和探索的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a spacious, modern transit-station concourse, likely in a subway or rail station. The viewpoint looks down a long, wide corridor with strong perspective lines leading toward a brighter, busier area in the distance.

On the left side, there is a large escalator or stairwell structure descending or rising behind glass railings. The escalator area is enclosed by angular metallic wall panels and transparent glass barriers with polished metal handrails. A green line or stripe runs horizontally along the glass above the escalator area, adding a strong accent color to the otherwise neutral scene.

The floor is made of large, glossy stone or terrazzo tiles in light gray tones. It reflects the overhead lights and faintly mirrors the shapes of people moving through the space. The corridor is very clean and open, with a broad empty foreground that emphasizes the scale of the station.

The ceiling is distinctive: much of it is covered with closely spaced, parallel wooden or wood-toned slats running lengthwise across the image. Rectangular fluorescent or LED light panels are embedded at intervals, creating bright white strips of light. The ceiling transitions in places to smooth white panels along the edges.

A row of large cylindrical columns runs down the middle and right side of the concourse. The columns are white with black horizontal bands near the top and dark bases, giving them a polished, modern look. Some columns have small blue signs attached near the top, and there are overhead directional signs with yellow text and arrows, suggesting platform or exit information. The signage appears to include Korean characters, reinforcing the impression of an urban rail station in Korea.

Several glass partitions and platform-style barriers line the central area, separating the walkway from entrances or ticket/platform zones. Behind them, more people and signs are visible.

The people in the scene appear blurred and semi-transparent because of long exposure or motion blur. This gives the image a dynamic feeling, suggesting constant movement through the station. In the foreground near the center-left, a walking figure is especially ghostlike, with faint outlines of legs and shoes visible. On the right side, multiple blurred figures move along the corridor, some appearing as pale streaks. Farther down the hallway, a denser cluster of passengers can be seen near the bright end of the concourse.

Overall, the image conveys a clean, efficient, busy public transportation environment. The architectural lines, reflective surfaces, repeated columns, and motion-blurred commuters create a sense of depth, speed, and urban routine.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代室内环境的照片，具体为一个宽敞的地铁站或机场候机厅。照片中，乘客的身影因快速移动而呈现出动态模糊的效果，他们沿着光滑的大理石地面行走。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，天花板上的灯具发出温暖的光线，与金属结构和玻璃栏杆形成对比。在画面左侧，可以看到一个自动扶梯，其上方有绿色的指示灯显示方向。背景中，可以隐约看到一些人影和指示牌，但它们因为快门速度的原因而变得模糊不清。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of an urban riverfront under a bright, partly cloudy sky. A broad expanse of greenish-blue water fills most of the foreground, textured with small wind-driven ripples and shimmering highlights from the sunlight. Near the lower left, a small colorful motorboat—painted in bright blue, orange, and black—moves across the water, leaving a pale foamy wake behind it. A single person wearing a vivid red or pink shirt sits in the boat, making the vessel stand out against the muted water.

On the left side, the riverbank curves gently into the scene. It is lined with a low decorative railing in warm tones and shaded by leafy green trees. Behind the trees are several buildings: one has a historic-looking façade with white and bright green trim and a red-tiled roof, while neighboring structures are more modern, with beige walls and large glass windows.

Across the middle distance, a long low bridge spans the river from left to right. It has reddish-brown supports and a railing with repeating decorative panels. Beyond the bridge is a dense city skyline made up of mixed architectural styles: older low-rise buildings, pastel-colored façades, mid-rise apartment or office blocks, and several taller towers. Two slender high-rise towers stand near the center-left background, while on the right side there are taller, more weathered buildings, some topped with antennas and communication equipment.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image. It is bright blue with large, soft white cumulus clouds scattered across it. Sunlight appears strongest from the right side, slightly washing out the sky there and creating bright reflections on the water. Overall, the scene feels warm, open, and lively—a riverside cityscape with a mix of historic architecture, modern buildings, greenery, bridges, and everyday river activity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河流景观的摄影作品。在画面前景，一艘蓝色的小船正驶过河面，船上有一位穿着红色上衣的人正在操作船只。河水呈现出深绿色，波光粼粼。背景中，一座桥梁横跨河面，连接着两岸的城市建筑群。建筑物色彩丰富，风格多样，从传统的低矮房屋到现代高层建筑都有所展现。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间，为这个城市场景增添了几分宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit wetland landscape viewed from the start of a wooden boardwalk. The perspective is centered and symmetrical, with the walkway leading the eye straight into the distance.

In the foreground, there is a wooden deck or bridge with warm brown railings on both sides. The railings are made of vertical slats and horizontal beams, casting long striped shadows across the planks. Beyond the wooden deck, the path continues as a light gray paved walkway made of rectangular bricks. It runs through dense greenery and then crosses a small wooden footbridge.

To the left of the path, a calm narrow water channel reflects the pale sky and nearby plants. The water is bordered by low vegetation and a dark earthen bank. To the right and stretching far into the distance are thick fields of bright green plants, interspersed with clusters of small yellow flowers. The vegetation appears lush and dense, creating a vivid contrast with the pale walkway and wooden structures.

In the middle distance, a small wooden bridge crosses part of the wetland path. Farther back, near the center of the image, stands a multi-level observation tower with a pointed roof. It has a red-and-white or brown-and-white structure and rises above the flat fields. Around it are more wooden fences and walkways.

On the right side of the horizon, a longer elevated wooden boardwalk or bridge curves across the landscape, supported by posts and lined with railings. It appears to span over the wetland area, offering a raised walking route.

The background is soft and hazy, with a line of trees fading into the mist. The sky is very bright and pale, almost white near the top, suggesting early morning light or humid atmospheric conditions. The overall mood is peaceful, open, and pastoral, with golden sunlight illuminating the greenery and giving the scene a fresh, tranquil feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的摄影作品，画面中心是一条蜿蜒的木制小径，两侧是郁郁葱葱的绿色植被。小径上覆盖着一层薄雾，增添了一丝神秘感。在远处可以看到一座独特的建筑，其结构和色彩与周围的环境形成鲜明对比。整个场景被清晨或傍晚的柔和光线照亮，营造出一种宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a Formula 1 car, likely a Red Bull Racing car, driving through a wet corner on a racetrack. The car is mostly dark navy/black with Red Bull’s distinctive red, yellow, and orange livery, including a bright yellow nose and orange air intake above the driver. Sponsor logos such as Oracle, BYBIT, Mobil 1, Tezos, and Red Bull are visible on the bodywork and wings.

The car is positioned toward the right side of the frame, angled slightly as it exits or clips a right-hand bend. Its tires are on a damp racing surface, and water spray is being thrown up behind the rear wheels, especially on the right side, indicating the track is wet or recently rained on. The tires appear to be grooved wet or intermediate tires rather than slicks.

The driver is seated low in the cockpit beneath the black halo structure. The front wing, suspension arms, large exposed tires, and rear wing are all clearly visible. The rear wing has large white lettering, and the car’s aerodynamic surfaces are prominent.

The track surface is dark gray and glossy from moisture. On the inside of the corner, there is a painted curb and run-off area in green, white, and red—the colors commonly seen at Italian circuits. The car is close to the white line and curbing, using the edge of the track through the turn.

In the background, there is a grassy embankment, gravel runoff, and a black advertising wall with large white text reading “#ImolaGP,” suggesting the scene is from the Emilia Romagna Grand Prix at Imola. A chain-link fence runs behind the barrier. The overall atmosphere is overcast and damp, with muted lighting and a sense of speed and control as the car navigates the wet corner.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示F1赛车在赛道上行驶的照片。赛车的前轮与地面接触，产生了飞溅的水花，显示出高速行驶时的动态效果。车身上的赞助商标志清晰可见，而背景中可以看到绿色的草地和一个带有'IMOLA GP'字样的广告牌，暗示了比赛的地点和名称。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor shopping and dining promenade beneath a large, dramatic canopy structure. The canopy dominates the scene: it is made of pale, translucent white fabric stretched overhead, with fine gray seam lines radiating and curving across it. Supporting it is an intricate network of golden-brown metal or bamboo-like beams, arches, and woven lattice panels. The structure has an organic, flowing design, with curved ribs and crisscrossing supports that resemble vines, branches, or a sculptural tree canopy.

Several tall column-like supports rise from the ground and flare outward near the top, connecting to the overhead framework. Some sections include narrow mesh or woven strips running along the beams, adding texture and a handcrafted look. Small mounted spotlights hang from the canopy structure in places, aimed downward toward the walkway.

Below the canopy is a crowded pedestrian area with many people walking, standing in lines, or gathering near food stalls. Some people are wearing face masks, and many faces appear blurred. There are families with children, adults pushing strollers, and groups waiting near kiosks. The ground is paved with light gray tiles, giving the area a clean, modern appearance.

On the left side, storefronts line the walkway. A large sign reads “MINISO” with “COMING SOON” underneath. Nearby, another shop sign partially reads “SUSHI,” and there is also a sign for a “THAI RESTAURANT & BAKERY.” In front of the shops are small vendor carts or booths, including a blue-and-white cart and an orange-and-white stall. A red-and-white traffic cone stands near the storefront area.

Toward the right and background, the promenade opens into a brighter outdoor plaza with more people, trees, and additional canopy structures visible farther away. A colorful decorative figure or sculpture appears in the far right background, adding a festive atmosphere. Overall, the scene feels like a lively commercial plaza or lifestyle mall, with modern architecture, food vendors, shops, and a large crowd enjoying the space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙市场或购物中心入口的照片。照片中心是一个由竹子制成的复杂结构，为人们提供遮蔽，并在顶部悬挂着许多灯泡。人群密集地聚集在这个区域，有的人在交谈，有的人在行走，还有的人正在使用手机。背景中可以看到商店和广告牌，如MINISO和Gucci，以及一些装饰性的气球和横幅。

caption:
The image shows a large, elegant indoor shopping or transit concourse, likely in Japan, with a busy pedestrian flow. It has a grand, upscale atmosphere, combining modern brightness with decorative Art Deco-style architectural details.

The ceiling dominates the upper half of the scene: it is very high, cream-colored, and patterned with a grid of recessed rectangular panels. Dozens of small, bright downlights are evenly spaced across it, creating a sparkling effect. Near the top left is a large illuminated skylight-like panel with a geometric grid pattern, adding a soft white glow. Long strips of indirect lighting run along the edges where the ceiling meets the walls.

On the left side, there is a storefront or building entrance labeled “HANKYU GRAND BLDG.” with Japanese text above it. The façade has tall windows with dark metal frames and warm lighting inside. Below, people are walking in many directions, some carrying shopping bags, backpacks, or umbrellas.

On the right side, the architecture is more ornate. Large arched entrances feature decorative black metalwork with intricate geometric and floral patterns. One of the entrances has “Hankyu” written above the doorway, suggesting a Hankyu department store or station entrance. Warm wall-mounted lanterns flank the arches, giving the area a refined, classic look. The walls are pale stone or tile, contrasting with the dark metal grilles.

The floor is made of large, light-colored tiles arranged in a grid, with darker lines forming rectangular patterns that emphasize the depth of the long corridor. The perspective draws the eye toward the center background, where more signs and entrances are visible.

The concourse is crowded with many pedestrians: commuters, shoppers, families, and groups moving through the space. Some people wear business attire, while others are casually dressed. A few children are visible near adults. Several overhead directional signs hang in the middle distance, with Japanese and English text, indicating this is likely part of a major transit or shopping complex.

Overall, the image captures a lively urban interior: bright, spacious, polished, and busy, with a mix of grand architecture, retail entrances, and constant foot traffic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙商场内部的现实主义风格照片。图中可见多个人物在宽敞的大厅内行走，他们穿着各式各样的服装，有的交谈，有的专注于自己的活动。大厅的设计现代而优雅，天花板上装有多个照明灯具，发出柔和的光线。两侧是商店和店铺，其中一家店铺的橱窗设计独特，吸引了行人的目光。整个场景充满了活力与商业气息。

caption:
The image shows a large white Jayco travel caravan hitched to a dark gray Toyota SUV, parked on a paved road in a wooded, natural setting.

The caravan dominates the left and center of the frame. It is long and rectangular with a clean white exterior, black lower trim, and gray/black diagonal graphic accents along the side. Several dark-tinted rectangular windows are visible on its side, along with small vents, access panels, utility hatches, and exterior fittings. Near the roofline are rooftop fixtures such as an air-conditioning unit and other camping equipment. The caravan has a dual-axle setup with four visible black alloy wheels, giving it a heavy-duty touring appearance. The Jayco logo is visible toward the front side of the caravan.

At the front right of the caravan, it is connected to a dark gray Toyota SUV, likely a large four-wheel-drive vehicle suitable for towing. The SUV is parked facing to the right, with its rear close to the caravan hitch. Its rear lights, roof rails, side windows, and silver wheels are visible.

The setting appears to be a quiet roadside or campground area surrounded by dense trees. Tall eucalyptus-like trees with twisting trunks and green foliage fill the background. The sky is pale and overcast, creating soft, diffuse lighting with minimal shadows. The ground is an asphalt or gravelly paved surface with scattered dry leaves and small debris. On the far right in the background, there is a yellow bin near the edge of the road, adding to the impression of a park or camping area.

Overall, the scene suggests a caravan road trip or camping stop in a bushland environment, with the vehicle and caravan parked safely along a wide road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆黑色SUV和拖车的照片。SUV停在一条柏油路旁，旁边是茂密的树木。拖车上有一个白色带有灰色条纹的设计，看起来像是一个现代风格的露营拖车。车辆被固定在一个拖车支架上，准备进行旅行或露营活动。

caption:
The image shows a wide coastal city scene viewed from a sandy beach. In the foreground, a broad stretch of golden-brown sand fills the lower half of the frame, with scattered beachgoers sitting, lying down, walking, or standing near the shoreline. Some people are close to the water, while others are farther back on the sand. Gentle waves roll in from a bright turquoise-blue sea, creating a thin line of white foam along the shore.

Across the middle of the image is a waterfront lined with many colorful mid-rise buildings. The architecture is dense and urban, with apartment blocks and hotels standing close together. The buildings are painted in vivid shades of yellow, white, red, orange, pale blue, and gray. Many have balconies, large windows, awnings, and glass-fronted sections. A few palm trees are visible along the promenade, adding a tropical feel. On the far right, larger hotel-like buildings dominate, including one with repeated horizontal balcony lines and another with bright red and white upper structures. Small boats are pulled up or floating near the waterline, and a busy beach area with lounge chairs and umbrellas appears in front of the buildings.

Behind the waterfront rises a large, dry, rocky mountain or volcanic-looking hill. It is brown and reddish in tone, with sparse vegetation and visible roads or tracks cutting across its slopes. The mountain has a broad, flat-topped ridge and forms a dramatic backdrop behind the city. A communications tower or red-and-white mast stands partway up the slope near the center.

The sky is partly cloudy, with soft gray and pale blue tones. The lighting is bright but slightly diffused, suggesting sun filtered through clouds. Overall, the scene has the feel of a warm seaside resort town: colorful buildings, a sandy urban beach, calm blue water, and rugged volcanic hills in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩和城市景观的摄影照片。前景是金色沙滩，上面散布着休闲的人们，有的坐着休息，有的在水边玩耍。中景是多彩的城市建筑群，包括多层住宅楼和酒店，它们沿着海岸线排列，色彩鲜艳，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。背景是一座山丘，山顶覆盖着绿色植被，而天空则是晴朗的蓝色。

caption:
The image captures an intense nighttime beach volleyball moment at the net.

In the foreground, a male volleyball player wearing a white sleeveless jersey with “NZL” printed on the back and the number “2” is jumping with both arms fully extended above his head. He appears to be attempting a block. His back is toward the camera, showing his shoulders and arms, and he is facing the opposing player across the net.

On the opposite side of the net, another player is partially visible, wearing a bright yellow top and red shorts. He is also airborne, reaching high with one arm extended toward the ball. His hand is close to a yellow, blue, and white Mikasa volleyball, which is suspended just above the top of the net. The ball is near the center-right of the frame and appears to be at the peak of a spike or tip attempt.

The volleyball net stretches horizontally across the image, with a bright yellow top band labeled “Mikasa” in several places. The mesh of the net is clearly visible, and on the left side there is a red-and-white striped antenna attached to the net, marking the boundary for legal play.

The background is very dark, suggesting an evening or night match under stadium lighting. Out-of-focus blue and purple lights appear in the upper-right background, creating a bokeh effect. The court area behind the net is dim, with a few blurred figures visible near the bottom, including someone in red and another in white.

Overall, the photo emphasizes a dramatic contest at the net: the New Zealand player is trying to block while the opponent attacks the ball, both players fully extended in a high-energy athletic moment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到沙滩排球比赛精彩瞬间的照片。图中，两名运动员在网前激烈争夺一个彩色的排球。一名穿着白色运动服和带有数字'2'的背心的运动员跳起尝试阻挡对方球员，而另一名穿着红色运动服的运动员则伸展双臂准备扣球。背景中可以看到模糊的观众席和一些广告牌，但焦点清晰地放在了两位运动员的动作上。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of Sydney Harbour on a bright, clear day.

In the foreground, the harbor water fills the lower half of the scene. It is a deep blue-green color with small ripples and gentle waves catching the sunlight. A few small boats and sailboats are visible in the distance, leaving thin white wakes across the water.

Dominating the left and center of the image is the Sydney Harbour Bridge. Its massive dark steel arch stretches from the far left across the frame toward the city on the right. The bridge’s lattice-like metal trusses, vertical supports, and roadway are clearly visible. Near the center-right, one of the bridge’s large stone pylons rises from the shoreline, anchoring the structure. Tiny flags can be seen atop the bridge, emphasizing its scale.

Below and to the left of the bridge, the Sydney Opera House is visible along the waterfront. Its distinctive white, sail-like roof shells stand out against the darker shoreline and blue water. The building appears smaller because it is set back in the distance, but its iconic shape is unmistakable.

On the right side of the image, Sydney’s central business district skyline rises behind the bridge. There are many tall buildings of varying heights and colors, including glass towers, beige and brown office blocks, and modern high-rises. Several construction cranes are visible among the buildings, suggesting ongoing development. Along the waterfront beneath the skyline are piers, low buildings, and ferry or dock structures.

The sky occupies a large portion of the image and is bright blue with thin, wispy white clouds spread across it. The overall lighting is warm and clear, giving the scene a sunny, open atmosphere. The composition captures several major Sydney landmarks at once: the harbor, the Harbour Bridge, the Opera House, and the downtown skyline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示悉尼海港大桥和悉尼歌剧院的摄影作品。在图像的前景，我们看到波光粼粼的海水，中景是著名的悉尼海港大桥，其设计独特，结构坚固，连接着城市的两岸。背景是悉尼歌剧院，以其标志性的帆顶和独特的建筑风格而闻名于世。远处的城市天际线由多座高楼组成，构成了一个繁忙都市的轮廓。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间，为这个城市景观增添了一抹宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor rail or metro/tram station on a bright, clear day. The sky is pale blue and cloudless, giving the scene a sunny, open feeling.

In the foreground and right side of the image, several parallel railway tracks run diagonally from the lower left and lower right toward the distance on the right. The rails are set into concrete track beds with metal fasteners and raised service strips between them. Long shadows fall across the tracks, likely from poles and overhead structures.

Above the tracks is an extensive network of overhead electrical wires. Tall green metal poles support the catenary system, with horizontal and angled metal arms extending over the rails. Some poles also have double-headed streetlamp-style fixtures at the top, with curved arms and round lamp shades. The wires stretch across the frame, creating strong diagonal lines against the sky.

On the left side is a wide station platform with a pale gray tiled surface. Along the platform edge is a yellow tactile warning strip for visually impaired passengers. The platform appears mostly empty, with no visible passengers or trains. There are metal railings and glass panels along the far edge of the platform.

Several station elements are visible on the platform: a tall advertisement board with a prominent red-and-white “BAUHAUS” ad, a vertical station sign or information pillar, and a small glass shelter with a roof and seating area. A station name sign appears to read “Vatan,” suggesting the location may be a stop on an urban rail line. There is also a route/map board near the tracks in the lower middle portion of the image.

Beyond the platform, there are trees and shrubs, some with autumn-colored foliage in shades of green, yellow, and brown. In the background are additional poles, fencing, low buildings, and distant infrastructure. The overall scene looks like a clean, modern, elevated or open-air urban transit station, quiet and still, with no train currently present.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示火车站台的现实主义风格照片。在画面中，可以看到多条平行的铁轨延伸至远方，铁轨两侧设有站台和安全护栏。站台上没有乘客或列车，显得空旷。图像左侧有一个带有红色文字的指示牌，而右侧则有一盏亮着的路灯。背景中可见一些树木和远处模糊的城市建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a staged bedroom display in a modern furniture showroom, likely a store setting. The room is arranged symmetrically around a large bed at the center, with warm lighting and a mix of contemporary materials.

In the middle is a neatly styled double bed with a dark upholstered base and headboard. The bedding is layered in soft cream and beige tones, with a slightly rumpled duvet, striped pillows, and patterned throw pillows featuring muted circular designs. A price or product tag is attached to the front of the bed base, reinforcing that this is a showroom display.

Behind the bed, the wall is divided into sections. The central backdrop is a textured stone or stacked-tile feature wall in shades of gray, beige, and tan. On either side of it are dark brown accent walls. Above the bed hangs a large cylindrical pendant light made of many thin vertical strips, giving it a sculptural, warm, slightly dramatic look.

On both sides of the bed are white nightstands with open shelves. Small lamps, framed photos, candles, and product tags sit on the surfaces. Above each nightstand is a glossy white wall-mounted cabinet with closed upper doors and open lower compartments. Small under-cabinet lights illuminate the bedside areas.

To the left side of the room, there is a light wood dresser with wide drawers. On top of it are a table lamp with a rectangular white shade and a small round mirror. Above the dresser hangs a black-and-white landscape photograph featuring trees in a misty scene. Nearby stands a black clothing rack holding a light blue shirt and a blue garment or bag.

At the foot of the bed is a large upholstered bench or ottoman in gray fabric, placed on a patterned area rug with muted blue, gray, beige, and brown tones. The floor is dark wood, adding contrast to the lighter furniture and bedding.

On the right side, there is a tall black-framed standing mirror with a small shelf or rack at the bottom. Next to it is a woven laundry hamper or basket with a lid. Farther back on the right is an open closet or storage display with cubbies and hanging compartments, filled with folded items, boxes, bags, and accessories. A wall-mounted light glows above this area.

The ceiling is open and industrial, with visible concrete, ducts, cable trays, and white structural beams, making it clear this is inside a large retail showroom rather than a private home. The overall style is modern, cozy, and carefully staged, combining warm textiles, glossy white storage, dark accent walls, stone texture, and soft ambient lighting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代室内设计的摄影图像，中心为一张大床，床上铺有白色和灰色的床单，并配有多个枕头。床头有一个木质床头柜，上面摆放着一些装饰品和书籍。房间的一侧是一个白色的衣柜，而另一侧则有一排悬挂式的衣架。房间的照明由一个大型吊灯提供，其下垂的灯罩散发出温暖的光线。墙上挂着几幅艺术画作，为空间增添了个性化的触感。整个房间以中性色调为主，营造出一种温馨舒适的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large pale stone statue of a robed figure with both arms extended horizontally, palms facing slightly upward/outward in an open, welcoming gesture. The viewpoint is from below, making the statue appear monumental and imposing against a clear, bright blue sky.

The figure wears a long, heavy robe with broad sleeves. The fabric is carved with visible folds and drapery lines, especially across the chest, under the arms, and down the front of the body. The sleeves flare outward near the wrists, and the lower portion of the robe hangs in vertical pleats. The surface of the statue has a light gray, slightly weathered stone texture.

The head is centered above the shoulders, covered by carved hair or a hood-like outline, though the facial details are blurred and indistinct. The arms stretch nearly the full width of the image, with the hands visible at both edges; the fingers are carved in long, flat shapes.

The composition is symmetrical and dramatic, with the statue dominating the frame and no other objects, buildings, or landscape visible. The cloudless blue sky provides a simple backdrop that emphasizes the statue’s scale and iconic outstretched pose.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示基督山救世主雕像的摄影图像。雕像位于画面中央，其背后是晴朗的蓝天。雕像呈现为一个站立的人物形象，头戴光环，身穿长袍，双臂张开，象征着拯救和宽恕。雕像的设计细节精致，包括衣褶、头饰和手指的雕塑，以及背后的云朵装饰。

caption:
The image shows an indoor Buddhist ceremony or religious gathering inside a temple hall or prayer room.

Across the back of the room, a row of Buddhist monks in bright orange robes sit elevated on a long red-covered platform. They are seated cross-legged on individual cushions, facing the congregation. Several of the monks sit on ornate gold-and-red chairs or backrests, while others sit on simpler mats. In front of each monk are small ceremonial items, including bowls, bottles of water, and possibly ritual offerings. Some monks hold or rest their hands near yellow cloth bundles.

Behind the monks is a plain white wall with several circular ceremonial fans mounted on stands. Some of the fans are black with Thai writing, while others are red with decorative insignia. Wall-mounted fans and ventilation fans are visible on the wall, and a ceiling fan hangs from the pale tiled ceiling. The room has white pillars and a simple, bright interior.

In the foreground and middle ground, laypeople sit or kneel on the red carpet facing the monks. Many are dressed in white, which is common for Buddhist ceremonies, while a few wear darker clothing. Some people are kneeling with heads bowed or hands together in prayer-like posture, suggesting a moment of chanting, blessing, or offering. The attendees sit on rugs and mats laid over the red carpet.

Along the front edge of the monks’ platform are several colorful standing electric fans decorated with large ribbon bows. Small offering trays or flower arrangements are placed near the fans. On the far left, there is a small ornate table or altar with flowers and ceremonial objects. A large red and gold structure, possibly part of a temple altar or decorative shrine element, is partially visible in the foreground.

The overall atmosphere is formal, quiet, and reverent. The dominant colors are red, orange, white, and gold, emphasizing the ceremonial and religious setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示佛教仪式的照片，图中可见多位僧侣坐在红色地毯上，身穿橙色的僧袍，正专注地进行宗教活动。他们面前是几排整齐摆放的圆形佛像和一些宗教用品。在僧侣前方，有几位世俗人物坐着观看，他们的表情平静而虔诚。整个场景被布置在一个宽敞明亮的室内空间内，墙壁简洁，天花板上有几个圆形装饰物。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a large modern stadium complex viewed from across a wide, mostly empty parking lot. The building is labeled **“RENTSCHLER FIELD”** in large letters along the top of a central glass-fronted section. On the left side of the facade, a sign reads **“Pratt & Whitney Stadium”** with an emblem beneath it, indicating the stadium’s full naming association.

The stadium architecture is dominated by cool tones: light gray concrete or metal panels, bright turquoise-blue glass, and deep blue ribbed siding. The central portion has a long wall of teal-tinted windows, arranged in a grid, with exposed structural supports and open bays below. To the right, a large white section of the building displays the **UConn Huskies** logo—a husky dog face—on a dark rectangular panel. There are multiple tiers, balconies, railings, and utility structures on the roof, including lighting rigs and communication equipment.

In the foreground, the parking lot stretches across most of the image, with numerous white painted parking lines and no visible cars. The lot surface is dark asphalt with some cracks and patches, emphasizing the emptiness and scale of the space. Near the building are ticket windows marked **“TICKETS”**, along with light poles, signs, bollards, and small entrance structures.

The sky takes up a large portion of the scene and is filled with dramatic gray and white clouds, with patches of blue visible between them. The lighting suggests a bright but partly cloudy day. On the far right in the background, there are trees with autumn colors—greens, yellows, and oranges—adding warmth to the otherwise blue-gray stadium setting. The overall impression is of a large sports venue on a quiet day, likely outside of game time, with no crowds or vehicles present.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示'Centennial Field'体育场的现实主义风格照片。体育场位于一个宽敞的停车场前，其蓝白相间的外墙在阳光下显得格外醒目。体育场的入口处装饰着标志性的徽章和文字，表明了它的官方名称和位置。停车场上空无一人，几辆车辆停放在远处，而天空中飘浮着几朵云彩，为这个场景增添了一丝宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor urban plaza or sidewalk area with a bronze statue positioned on the right side of the frame. The statue depicts a seated person in a chair, wearing formal or old-fashioned clothing such as a jacket, skirt, and lace-up shoes. The figure’s hair is sculpted in a neat, combed-back style, and the face area appears intentionally blurred or obscured. The statue’s hands rest in its lap, holding or cradling a small animal that looks like a cat. The figure sits in a simple chair with thin metal arms and legs.

The ground is paved with red brick laid in a herringbone pattern, covering most of the foreground. Near the lower right corner, there is a dark rectangular plaque embedded in the brick pavement, likely identifying the statue or memorial. To the left, a curved concrete border surrounds a small patch of soil and grass.

Behind the brick plaza is a light-colored concrete sidewalk or driveway that appears damp, suggesting recent rain. Beyond that is a strip of grass and a low brick retaining wall. Several thin trees and palm trunks are visible along the grassy area. In the background, a row of parked cars—mostly white and silver SUVs and vans—lines the street or parking area. The setting feels like a public square, park entrance, or streetside memorial space in a warm climate, emphasized by the palm trees and lush greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在红砖铺就的广场上的雕塑的照片。雕塑描绘了一位坐在椅子上的人物，其面部被模糊处理以保持匿名性。人物穿着深色衣服，双手交叉放在膝上，姿态显得沉思或等待。背景中可以看到绿色的草地和停放的汽车，这些元素表明雕塑位于一个公共空间内。

caption:
The image shows a wide view inside a train or railway station, focused on a row of automatic ticket machines against a gray paneled wall.

Across the lower half of the scene, several self-service ticket kiosks are lined up evenly from left to right. Each machine has a lit display screen, a ticket/payment interface, and signage in Chinese above it. The machines appear to support ticket purchasing or collection, with text mentioning services such as automatic ticketing, internet ticket pickup, and payment options like Alipay and WeChat. Blue circular number labels are mounted above the machines, including visible numbers such as 55, 56, 57, 58, 59, 60, and 52. Between some machines are tall white vertical signs in Chinese, likely indicating ticket collection limits or usage instructions.

On the far left, a blue sign reads “Automatic Ticket Machine” in English beneath Chinese characters, confirming the function of the area. The wall behind the machines is made of large vertical gray panels, giving the station a clean, utilitarian appearance.

Above the machines, a long red LED information strip spans the wall. It displays bright Chinese text, likely train service notices or ticketing information. Higher up on the left side, there is a larger electronic board with a grid of red-outlined rows and columns filled with glowing numbers, resembling a train schedule, ticket availability board, or departure information display. The top right area has horizontal brown slatted panels, possibly part of the station’s ceiling or upper wall design.

The foreground is an open, polished station floor with pale tiles and a yellow guideline running horizontally near the machines. There are no people in the image, making the ticketing area look quiet and orderly. The overall lighting is bright, with a warm red glow from the electronic signs reflecting slightly across the upper wall and floor.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自动售票机的室内照片，机器排列在墙边，每个机器上方都有一个红色的显示屏。背景中可以看到一排数字指示牌，显示着不同的车次信息。整个场景被暖色调的灯光照亮，营造出一种温馨而有序的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up street view of several tall, narrow apartment buildings in bright sunlight, likely in a Mediterranean or southern European town. The façades are colorful and closely packed together, creating a dense urban streetscape.

On the left is a peach-pink building with white architectural trim. It has multiple small balconies stacked vertically, each with ornate white wrought-iron railings decorated with curls and floral-like patterns. The balconies are supported by decorative white brackets. The windows behind them have shutters or blinds, some closed, and the frames are painted in dark blue or gray tones. A pale drainpipe runs vertically down the wall near the edge of the building, and there are visible utility cables and pipes along the lower portion. At street level, arched doorways with white trim are partially visible.

Next to it is a vivid yellow building, slightly narrower, with simpler black wrought-iron balconies. One balcony has a small flower box with greenery and reddish flowers. The yellow wall is sunlit and textured, with some scuffs and weathering. A vertical pipe runs down the façade, and the lower windows and doors have white arched trim. Near the top, the building has a projecting roof or terrace canopy with dark underside panels and visible support posts and drainage pipes.

To the right, more buildings recede into the background in muted peach, gray, and beige tones. These structures appear older and more weathered, with exposed stone or rough plaster walls, small balconies, metal railings, antennas, and a tangle of overhead wires. Some windows have shutters, while others are open or darkened.

The sky is a clear, deep blue with no clouds, and the sunlight is strong, casting sharp shadows across the façades. The overall scene feels warm, lively, and residential, with a charming mix of pastel colors, ornate balcony ironwork, aging plaster, pipes, wires, and layered architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影图像，画面中两栋色彩鲜明的建筑相邻而立。左侧的建筑物外墙涂有粉色和白色，配有多个带有栏杆的阳台。右侧的建筑物则呈现出鲜艳的黄色，同样配备了阳台，并且在阳台上可以看到晾晒的衣物。街道上空无一人，阳光照射下，建筑物的细节清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows two people posing on a motorsport pit lane in front of a modern race control building at the Pertamina Mandalika International Street Circuit.

In the foreground, two men stand on dark asphalt next to a red-and-white painted lane marking. Their faces are blurred. The person on the left is wearing a white graphic T-shirt, light blue jeans, black sneakers, and a black crossbody bag worn across the chest. The person on the right is wearing a light gray T-shirt, dark pants, and black low-top sneakers with white laces and soles; he stands with his arms crossed.

Behind them is a large, angular building with a bold red, blue, gray, and white facade. A prominent white sign on the lower right side reads “RACE CONTROL” in large black capital letters. Above, a red sign displays the text “PERTAMINA MANDALIKA INTERNATIONAL STREET CIRCUIT” along with a stylized outline of the circuit. Next to it is a logo and text that appears to read “ITDC” with the slogan “Creating Destinations.” The building features perforated red metal panels, geometric blue cladding, tall vertical windows, and several air-conditioning units at ground level.

On the far right, a vertical sign reads “WAITING ZONE / START” with a downward arrow, and smaller text referencing the pit building media area. In the left background, there are low structures, fencing, and distant hills, suggesting the circuit is set in an open landscape. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, and strong sunlight casts clear shadows on the track surface. The overall scene looks like a sunny day at a professional racing circuit, with the two people posing for a souvenir photo outside the race control area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位男性站在赛车控制中心前的照片。左侧的男性穿着蓝色上衣和牛仔裤，脚穿黑色运动鞋，头戴白色帽子，背着一个黑色背包。右侧的男性身穿灰色T恤和深色裤子，脚穿棕色鞋子，头发被剃得很短。他们站在一个有着红色跑道线条和蓝色屋顶的建筑物前，建筑物上方挂有'ITDC RACE CONTROL'的标志。背景中可以看到蓝天、几朵白云以及一些远处的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor festival or street fair stall set up in a public square or pedestrian area. The main focus is a white canopy tent with a blue-and-white vertically striped side panel on the right. Across the front of the tent is a large decorative sign in Russian. The top word reads “Масленица” (Maslenitsa, a traditional Slavic holiday/festival), written in large ornate red-and-gold letters. Beneath it, smaller red text says “вместе с кафе” (“together with the café”), followed by “Казачий Дворъ” (“Cossack Courtyard”) in large red lettering.

Several people are gathered around the stall. Their faces are blurred, but they appear to be women working at or visiting the booth. One person in the foreground wears a white traditional-style blouse with red embroidery on the sleeves and a red woven belt, suggesting folk or festive attire. Others wear modern jackets, including a purple vest and a bright red coat.

The stall is decorated with folk-themed items. There are bouquets of yellow and white flowers displayed on the table, sunflowers attached near the sides of the sign, and strings of dried vegetables or decorative food items hanging along the edge of the booth. The table is covered with bright red cloth and patterned woven runners with red-and-white designs. Plates and other serving items are visible on the tabletop, suggesting food or refreshments may be offered.

On the right side, in front of the tent, there is a colorful seated statue or figure of a smiling Cossack-like man with a mustache, wearing red trousers and holding a mug. Nearby are rustic wooden stools and a small wooden table, adding to the traditional village or folk atmosphere.

In the background, the setting appears urban: leafless trees line the street, cars are parked along the road, and there are buildings or storefronts partially visible behind the trees. A bench with a seated person can be seen to the left. The lighting is bright and sunny, indicating daytime, likely in early spring or late winter given the bare trees and the Maslenitsa theme.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示街头摊位的现实主义风格照片，摊位上挂有俄文标识牌，表明这是一个名为'Казанька Пироги'的小吃摊。一位穿着传统乌克兰服装的女性站在摊位前，她旁边是一位穿着深色衣服的女性和一个穿着红色衬衫、黑色裤子的小孩。摊位后方摆放着一尊雕刻精细的雕像，周围装饰着鲜花。背景中可以看到其他行人和停放的车辆，以及树木和建筑物，营造出一个活跃的城市街道氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively urban sidewalk scene outside a row of colorful buildings. The focus is on a person standing with their back to the camera near the right side of the frame. They have shoulder-length dark wavy hair and are wearing a bright yellow jacket over a blue-and-teal checkered shirt, dark cuffed jeans, burgundy socks, and red sneakers. Their posture suggests they are talking or interacting with people seated nearby.

To the right, the building facade is painted in warm tones—yellow walls with large coral-red shutters and doors. The shutters are wooden, with visible panels, hinges, latches, and weathered paint, giving the setting an older, historic feel. Several similar red shutters and doors continue down the street, creating a strong repeating pattern and perspective line.

At the bottom center and right, a couple of people are seated on a low step or stoop. One person’s legs and arms are visible, and another person in a dark shirt sits close to the wall. In front of them on the sidewalk are shallow aluminum trays filled with bright red food, likely boiled crawfish or seafood, with one open tray lid lying nearby. The standing person appears to be part of the same casual gathering.

The left side of the image fades into a softly blurred background, showing more storefronts or building fronts, tall windows, and a few seated people farther down the sidewalk. The shallow depth of field keeps the main group and the colorful shutters sharp while the background becomes hazy and atmospheric.

Overall, the scene feels relaxed and social, like people sharing food on a city street. The image has a vibrant, warm color palette dominated by reds, yellows, and soft greens, with the architecture and street life creating a distinctly lively neighborhood atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉城市生活瞬间的摄影作品，画面中一位穿着黄色夹克和黑色裤子的人站在街道上，背对着镜头。他旁边是一个坐在地上的人，腿上放着一盘红色的食物。在他们身后是建筑物的彩色门面，其中有一扇关闭的橙色门。在远处可以看到几位坐着的人，似乎是在休息或交谈。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic panoramic view from a high hillside overlooking a sprawling city and coastline beneath a heavy, stormy sky.

Most of the frame is dominated by thick gray-blue clouds, with a brighter, glowing patch near the top center where sunlight is diffused through the cloud cover. The sky feels moody and atmospheric, with darker rain-like cloud masses hanging low over the horizon. On the far left, near the horizon, there is a warm orange-yellow glow, suggesting either sunset light or sunlight breaking through storm clouds.

On the right side of the image stands a tall communications tower on a green hill. The tower has a narrow central mast rising high into the sky, with a wider, multi-level structure near the lower part of the mast. It appears metallic and modern, with circular details and platforms visible. Several long support cables extend diagonally from the tower down to the ground, anchoring it to the hillside.

Below and around the tower are lush, dark green wooded hills with scattered buildings and roads. The foreground includes treetops and a few rooftops, including a reddish tiled roof near the lower left. In the distance, the city spreads across the lower half of the image, appearing hazy and softened by mist or rain. Farther left, the coastline and water are faintly visible, catching small strips of light.

The overall mood is quiet, expansive, and slightly ominous, with the sleek tower standing prominently against a vast, cloud-filled sky and the city fading into the mist below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的摄影作品，画面中心是一座高耸入云的通讯塔，其设计现代且结构复杂。塔身由多个金属结构组成，顶部装有天线和接收器。塔周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛，为这座城市的山丘增添了一抹绿色。在远处可以看到密集的城市建筑群，它们在多云的天空下显得有些朦胧。整个场景被一种柔和而略带阴沉的光线所笼罩，营造出一种宁静而又稍显忧郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, colorful city-themed scene under a clear blue sky, likely at the New York-New York Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas.

On the right side, a large green replica of the Statue of Liberty dominates the frame. Only the upper and midsection of the statue are visible, with her arm raised high holding the torch. The statue has the familiar oxidized copper-green color and detailed folds in the robe. The crown spikes extend outward, and the tablet is partly visible near her side.

Across the middle and left of the image is a stylized New York skyline made up of several tall, closely packed buildings. The architecture includes replicas or inspirations of well-known New York landmarks. Near the center is a silver Art Deco-style skyscraper resembling the Chrysler Building, with its tiered, metallic spire catching the sunlight. Around it are beige, pink, cream, and glassy blue buildings with rectangular windows and decorative facades.

A red roller coaster track curves dramatically through the scene, weaving in front of the buildings and behind some of the structures. The track is supported by pale yellow beams, creating a busy lattice of vertical and diagonal supports. The bright red rails stand out sharply against the blue sky and neutral-toned buildings.

In the lower left, there is a white domed structure with classical columns, and beneath it a sign reading “NEW YORK NEW YORK.” The sign has a decorative, marquee-like appearance. In the lower center and right are additional building facades with brick, white trim, arched windows, and greenish-blue rooftops, giving the area a theatrical, theme-park-like quality.

The overall scene is sunny, vivid, and highly saturated, with strong contrasts between the turquoise sky, red coaster, green Statue of Liberty, and pastel city buildings. It feels like a miniature or themed recreation of New York City landmarks integrated with amusement-park elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示纽约市主题公园的现实主义风格照片，图像中心是一个巨大的自由女神像模型，其背后是模拟的纽约摩天大楼和著名的埃利斯岛。在雕像前方，有一个红色的过山车轨道蜿蜒而上，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。左侧是一座装饰性的白色建筑，顶部有'New York New York'的标志。整个场景被阳光照耀着，营造出一个充满活力和色彩的娱乐场所氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, peaceful landscape dominated by a vast, clear blue sky. The sky occupies most of the frame, with a smooth gradient from a deeper blue at the top to a paler blue near the horizon. There are no visible clouds, giving the scene an open and calm feeling.

Near the lower center of the image stands a white Orthodox-style church or cathedral. It has multiple onion-shaped domes, several of them dark green or black with golden highlights, each topped with a thin Orthodox cross. The building is bright white with arched windows and decorative architectural details. To the right of the main church structure is a tall bell tower, also white, with stacked levels, arched openings, and a dark roof beneath a green-gold onion dome and cross.

The church sits slightly elevated on a grassy rise. In front of it are utility wires stretching horizontally across the scene, along with several streetlights and poles. Some young trees and shrubs partially frame the church, especially on the left and right sides.

The foreground is a lush green field with tall grass, small bushes, and scattered young trees. The grass is uneven and natural-looking, with areas of shadow suggesting low-angle sunlight, likely from morning or late afternoon. The overall lighting is bright and crisp, emphasizing the white church against the blue sky and green landscape.

The composition feels spacious and serene, with the small but ornate church placed low in the frame beneath an expansive sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座白色教堂在蓝天和绿色草地背景下的照片。教堂的建筑风格具有东正教特征，包括圆顶、十字架和塔楼。教堂前方是郁郁葱葱的草地，几棵新发芽的小树点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a large roadside historical marker, photographed straight on in bright daylight. The marker is dark blue or black with raised white lettering and a decorative arched top. At the top is a white emblem resembling a classical pediment above three palm trees, suggesting a Florida heritage symbol.

The main title, in large capital letters, reads:

**WORLD WAR II D-DAY  
TRAINING SITE**

Below the title is a block of historical text explaining that in late 1943, Carrabelle Beach and Dog Island, as part of Camp Gordon Johnston, were used by the U.S. Army 4th Infantry Division to train for the Normandy Invasion on D-Day, June 6, 1944. It says the Amphibious Training Center had been officially closed but was reopened and staffed for this mission. The sign notes that this amphibious training was the troops’ final step before shipping to England for the invasion, and that on D-Day the first amphibian infantry assault teams to arrive on French soil were from the 4th Infantry Division at Utah Beach.

The marker also mentions that on June 6, 2000, the Camp Gordon Johnston Association collected soil from the site and delivered it to the National 4th Infantry Division Association for placement in a monument in Arlington, Virginia. It further states that the U.S. Department of Defense’s World War II Commemoration Committee named the Camp Gordon Johnston Association an official “Commemorative Community” in 1995.

Near the bottom, smaller text reads:

**FLORIDA HERITAGE LANDMARK**  
**SPONSORED BY THE CAMP GORDON JOHNSTON ASSOCIATION  
AND THE FLORIDA DEPARTMENT OF STATE**

The lower corners show **F-427** on the left and **2001** on the right.

The sign has visible weathering: small chips, scuffs, and worn spots along the border and bottom edge. It is mounted on a metal post. Behind it is a paved road with a guardrail, green trees and palm foliage, and a clear blue sky, giving the scene a coastal or warm-climate roadside setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示二战时期D日训练场地的历史标志牌的照片。标志牌位于一个开阔的户外环境中，背景是蓝天和几棵树木。标志牌上方有白色的标题文字“WORLD WAR II D-DAY TRAINING SITE”，下方则是详细的历史信息，包括训练地点、时间、参与单位以及官方纪念活动的名称。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor festival or public gathering in a sunlit plaza or garden square. A large crowd fills the foreground and midground, with people standing close together, talking, drinking, and moving through the space. Many are dressed in warm-weather clothing—short sleeves, dresses, sunglasses, hats, and colorful accessories—suggesting a festive summer event. Several faces appear blurred, giving the scene a candid but anonymized look.

At the center of the image is a circular tiled fountain with pale blue-green water. People are gathered all around it, using the fountain as a central meeting point. The fountain’s outer wall has decorative tile panels, and the water catches the sunlight, adding brightness to the middle of the scene.

Above the crowd is a striking decorative installation: many small wooden chairs painted in bright shades of pink, red, purple, and lavender are suspended upside down or at angles from overhead wires. Some chairs hang in clusters beneath a long cream-colored canopy or fabric shade, while others are visible higher up near the top edge of the image. The chairs create a whimsical, festive ceiling over the plaza.

Behind the fountain are two white pointed canopy tents, likely vendor stalls or event booths. One tent appears to have a decorated counter or signage, with people gathered in front of it as if ordering drinks or food. The tents are partially shaded by dense green trees.

The setting is lush and leafy, surrounded by tall trees and tropical-looking plants, including large banana-like leaves on both sides. Black metal poles and overhead wires frame the decorated area, supporting the canopy and hanging chairs. Traditional-style lamp posts are also visible among the greenery.

The lighting is bright and warm, with strong sunlight filtering through the trees and casting patches of shade across the crowd. The overall atmosphere feels busy, cheerful, and social—like a fair, street festival, or cultural celebration in a park or plaza.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到户外聚会活动的照片，人群聚集在一个装饰有粉色和白色挂饰的区域。在照片的中心是一个带有透明顶棚的舞台，周围摆放着多个白色的帐篷，营造出一种节日庆典的氛围。人们穿着各式各样的服装，有的正在交谈，有的在跳舞，整个场景洋溢着欢乐与活力。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor scene in a grassy, wooded area, likely during autumn. In the foreground, a person wearing a gray-green historical military-style uniform is caught mid-motion, as if stumbling, jumping, or climbing out of a large canvas sack or bedroll. Their face is intentionally blurred, making facial features indistinct.

The person wears a peaked field cap with small metal buttons or insignia on the front and side. Their jacket is heavy wool, gray-green in color, with large flap pockets, dark buttons, shoulder straps, and a belt or fitted waist detail. One sleeve has a small patch or emblem. Their arms are raised forward for balance, with one hand higher than the other, suggesting quick movement or surprise. Around their legs is a large beige or tan fabric covering, like a blanket, sack, or sleeping bag, bunched up around the knees and lower legs.

To the left and behind the person is a large olive-green canvas tent. The tent has a sloping roof and taut guy ropes tied to wooden stakes in the ground. The canvas looks weathered and slightly shiny, with creases, seams, and darker worn patches. A small rectangular window with a simple frame and translucent panes is visible on the tent wall. There are also rope knots, loops, and a small circular opening or vent near the window.

The setting is sunlit, with strong daylight casting shadows across the grass and tent. In the background, out of focus, are trees with brown, orange, and yellow autumn foliage, giving the scene a reenactment or historical camp atmosphere. The overall composition captures a dynamic moment beside a military-style field tent, with the person appearing to be in the middle of an awkward or hurried movement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外活动的照片，其中一位穿着复古军装的人正在跳过一个绑在地上的木箱。人物的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。背景中有一顶绿色的帐篷和一些树木，营造出一种历史重现的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an urban street scene centered on a large cylindrical concrete or metal pillar in front of closed metal roll-up shutters. The overall atmosphere feels gritty and industrial, with layers of street art, posters, grime, and official signage.

In the middle of the frame is a thick gray column, slightly reflective and weathered. It is covered with torn paper remnants and graffiti. A large white poster or sticker wraps around the upper-middle portion of the column; it has intricate pale blue line drawings with decorative, almost mandala-like or architectural patterns. The poster is ripped at the top and sides, exposing the gray surface underneath. Across this decorative paper, a bold black graffiti tag has been sprayed, partially obscuring the design.

Attached to the lower middle of the column is a rectangular official notice printed in Japanese. It is neatly formatted like a permit or construction announcement, with a grid of rows and columns. The heading reads “建築計画のお知らせ,” meaning a notice of construction or building plans. The text includes details such as location, building use, structure, height, floor count, dates, and contact information. The clean, bureaucratic appearance of this notice contrasts sharply with the rough graffiti and torn posters around it.

The base of the column is dirty and marked with additional black and gray tags, smudges, scratches, and remnants of older stickers. Some pale blue and white scraps of paper remain near the bottom, while the lower edge of the pillar meets a concrete sidewalk or curb.

Behind the column are two dark gray corrugated metal shutters, one on each side, both closed. They are heavily spray-painted. On the left shutter, large colorful graffiti fills much of the lower half, with turquoise, blue, green, yellow, orange, red, and black shapes layered over the horizontal ridges of the shutter. On the right shutter, there is a larger gray-and-white graffiti piece with black outlines and touches of green, yellow, and pink. The shutters’ horizontal lines create a striped texture across the background.

The composition is symmetrical, with the column occupying the center and the shutters forming a textured backdrop on both sides. The image conveys a dense urban environment where official construction notices, street art, vandalism, and decay overlap on the same surfaces.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街头艺术的照片，特写了一根柱子上的涂鸦。柱子的表面覆盖着多种颜色和风格的涂鸦，包括黑色、白色和彩色的图案以及文字。在涂鸦的下方，柱子上贴有一张白色的公告牌，上面印有日文字符和一些数字。背景中，可以看到另一面涂鸦墙，上面也有类似的涂鸦作品。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor swimming pool at night, likely in a resort or hotel setting. The scene is illuminated by numerous warm and cool lights, creating vivid reflections across the dark blue water.

In the foreground, the pool dominates the lower half of the image. The water is calm with gentle ripples, reflecting bright streaks of yellow, white, and blue light. A metal pool ladder is visible at the lower right edge, descending into the water. The pool has a curved, irregular shape, with pale stone or tile edging around it.

On the left side, there is a long shaded lounge area with a dark canopy supported by metal frames. Beneath it are rows of sun loungers arranged neatly, suggesting this is a daytime relaxation area that is currently empty. Warm lamps under the canopy cast golden light onto the deck and nearby plants.

In the center background, a tall streetlamp or poolside light shines brightly, producing a starburst effect. Its cool white reflection stretches down the pool’s surface. Behind it are trees, shrubs, and low buildings partially hidden in the darkness.

On the right side, the scene becomes more architectural and landscaped. A raised terrace with white balustrades and stone walls overlooks the pool. Several bright lamps line the terrace, casting strong warm light and producing glowing reflections in the water. There are stairs with white railings leading up from the pool area to the elevated patio. Large trees with dense foliage surround the terrace, their trunks and branches silhouetted or softly lit by the lamps. A building or restaurant area appears behind the railing on the far right, brightly lit from within or by exterior lights.

The sky is completely dark, emphasizing the nighttime atmosphere. The overall mood is quiet, elegant, and relaxing, with the contrast between the dark sky, deep blue pool, warm golden lighting, and lush greenery giving the scene a luxurious resort-like feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜晚泳池景观的照片，照片中泳池水面平静，反射着周围灯光的温暖光芒。泳池边缘装饰有木制栏杆和躺椅，而背景中的树木在夜色中显得格外宁静。远处可以看到一些建筑结构，它们的轮廓在夜空中若隐若现。整个场景被柔和的灯光照亮，营造出一种宁静而放松的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dark, atmospheric indoor scene lit mainly with deep blue and purple lighting. In the lower-left foreground, two people are seen from behind or in partial profile. They appear mostly as silhouettes because the lighting is low. The person nearer the center has short hair and is wearing a dark puffer-style jacket with a hood; they are holding a smartphone in one hand, angled slightly upward as if taking a photo or recording. Another person stands to the far left, also in dark clothing, with their face mostly obscured by shadow.

The background is dominated by a large, blurred architectural or sculptural structure on the right side. It has layered, angular, horizontal forms that look somewhat futuristic or industrial, almost like stacked panels or parts of a large installation. Purple light glows behind and beneath these shapes, creating strong contrast with the darker blue area on the left. There is visible haze or fog in the air, which softens the edges and makes the colored lights appear diffused.

The top right portion of the image shows a ceiling with rectangular panels, suggesting this is inside a venue, exhibit space, club, or immersive installation.
