The overall mood is moody, cinematic, and futuristic, with the people appearing to observe or document the illuminated installation in front of them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位男性在室内环境中使用手机的现代摄影风格照片。他们站在一个被蓝色灯光照亮的空间里，背景中有一面巨大的黑色横幅，上面有类似美国国旗的设计元素。左侧的男性穿着深色衣服，头发短而整齐，正在专注地查看他的手机屏幕；右侧的男性也穿着深色衣服，头发较长，同样专注于自己的手机。整个场景营造出一种神秘和专注的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large, brightly lit festival monument or parade float displayed at night in a city square. The background is mostly a deep black sky, which makes the colorful sculptures stand out dramatically. On the right side behind the installation, a multi-story building with balconies and shuttered windows is visible, suggesting an urban plaza setting.

At the center of the scene is an enormous stylized female figure, likely a singer or performer. She wears a pale blue and white outfit with decorative gloves, large sparkling earrings, and a jeweled blue headpiece. She holds a large retro-style silver microphone close to her mouth. Behind her spreads a huge fan of vivid peacock feathers in turquoise, green, yellow, and blue, forming a dramatic backdrop.

Above the central figure is a dynamic cluster of animal-like acrobatic characters, posed as if leaping or dancing in midair. They resemble fantasy cats, foxes, or musical-theater creatures, with painted bodies, tails, fur-like costumes, and exaggerated theatrical expressions. Their colors include bright yellows, oranges, reds, blacks, and whites. One yellow-and-black figure with a long striped tail dominates the upper center, reaching upward with one arm while balancing above the singer. A red figure appears to be springing through the air near the top, while orange and white animal performers twist around the sides.

The monument is packed with many smaller whimsical scenes. On the lower left, there is a cartoonish figure near a wooden piano or music stand with an open book of sheet music. Nearby are other small characters, some dressed like musicians or performers. On the lower right, additional sculptural figures include pale, tree-like or skeletal forms and more theatrical characters. Near the base, a Cinderella-like figure in a blue and white dress appears to be posed gracefully, adding to the fairytale and stage-performance theme.

In the foreground, a group of spectators stands facing the monument, seen from behind. They are wearing jackets and casual clothing, suggesting cool evening weather. Some people appear to be taking in the display closely, while others are talking or standing in small groups. There is also a stroller at the far left edge. Signs and placards are scattered around the base of the installation, some with Spanish text, indicating this may be part of a public festival or competition.

Overall, the image captures a spectacular nighttime festival sculpture filled with music, fantasy, theatrical animals, peacock imagery, and fairytale references. The monument is highly detailed, colorful, and energetic, towering over the crowd below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在夜晚的街头狂欢节上的场景，中心是一个巨大的彩色马戏团风格的装饰物，上面装饰着各种动物和人物形象。人群围绕着这个装饰物，有的拍照留念，有的观看。背景中可以看到城市的建筑轮廓和路标，为这个节日活动增添了都市氛围。

caption:
The image shows an interior brick wall covered with numerous mounted sculptural heads or bust fragments, arranged irregularly in vertical and diagonal clusters. The wall is made of warm yellow-brown bricks with darker, weathered patches and visible mortar lines, giving it an aged, historic feel. Strong warm lighting from the upper right creates bright highlights on the bricks and deep shadows behind the sculptures, emphasizing their relief and texture.

The mounted pieces appear to be carved stone or terracotta architectural fragments, many resembling medieval or Gothic-style human heads. They vary in size and style: some have crowns or caps, some have curly hair, beards, or expressive features, and others appear more worn or damaged. Several heads are shown in profile, while others face forward or at slight angles. Many are attached to small backing pieces or brackets, suggesting they are displayed as museum or architectural salvage objects.

A number of the faces are deliberately blurred or obscured, creating smooth oval patches where facial details would normally be. The unblurred sculptures show detailed carving: wavy hair, beards, headbands, crowns, and expressive mouths or noses. Some fragments look broken at the neck or around the edges, reinforcing the sense that they were once part of a larger building or decorative structure.

The composition is angled upward along the wall, making the display seem tall and immersive. The warm golden lighting, rough brick background, and aged sculptural fragments together create the impression of a historical exhibit, possibly in a museum, cathedral, or heritage building.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一系列陶瓷头像雕塑的摄影作品，它们被精心地安装在一面红砖墙上。这些雕塑呈现出不同的表情和姿态，有的似乎在微笑，有的则显得沉思或严肃。每个头像都具有独特的设计，有的头部装饰有羽毛状的细节，而其他的则更加简约。阳光从上方照射下来，使得墙面和雕塑的阴影交错，增加了作品的立体感和深度。

caption:
The image shows an opulent historic interior, likely a formal study, library, or display room in a palace or grand mansion. The space is richly decorated in warm golden-brown tones, dominated by polished wood, glass-fronted cabinets, and elaborate architectural ornament.

At the center of the room is a large wooden writing desk with carved details and paneled sides. On top of the desk sits a decorative lidded vase or urn. Two elegant chairs with curved wooden frames and green upholstered backs and seats are positioned around the desk, suggesting a refined office or consultation setting.

The walls are lined with tall, built-in wooden display cabinets. These cabinets have glass doors and contain porcelain or ceramic tableware: plates, serving dishes, covered tureens, bowls, and small decorative vessels. The woodwork is deeply carved, with pilasters, floral motifs, and ornamental moldings framing each cabinet section. Some cabinet bays are labeled with letters such as “B,” “C,” “D,” “E,” and “F,” implying an organized collection or museum-like display.

Above the lower cabinets is a second-level gallery or balcony that wraps around the room. It has an intricate metal railing with gilded decorative elements, including floral garlands, circular patterns, and a central medallion-like ornament. The balcony is backed by more glass panels and wooden framing, reflecting the ornate ceiling and lights.

The ceiling is especially elaborate. It is covered in sculpted plasterwork with floral scrolls, geometric panels, and decorative reliefs. A large arched or domed central section glows brightly from overhead lighting, highlighting the pale cream and gold tones of the plaster. The lighting around the upper perimeter adds a warm, museum-like illumination.

At the back center of the room is a richly carved wooden door, partially open. The door includes decorative swags, floral carving, and an oval lattice or grille detail. Above and around it are more carved wooden elements, including a fan-like shell ornament.

The floor is a striking parquet pattern made from contrasting wood tones. It forms large geometric star and polygon shapes, adding to the sense of craftsmanship and luxury. Overall, the room feels highly ornate, symmetrical, and carefully preserved, with a strong 18th- or 19th-century aristocratic European character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典风格室内环境的照片，中心是一个大型木质书桌，配有两把绿色扶手椅。书桌上摆放着一些书籍和装饰品。书桌后方是高高的玻璃橱窗，里面陈列着精致的瓷器和艺术品。整个房间被木制的天花板和墙壁包围，墙壁上装饰有复杂的浮雕和雕刻。地板由几何图案的深色木材构成，与室内的暖色调相得益彰。

caption:
The image shows a wide outdoor plaza in front of a large, formal stone building with tall columns, rectangular window bays, and a curved façade. The architecture looks monumental and museum-like, with beige stone walls and a symmetrical, classical style. The sky is partly cloudy, and the lighting is natural daylight, slightly subdued.

In the center foreground, two people stand very close together with their backs mostly turned to the camera. They appear to be embracing or posing together. The person on the left has curly dark hair and wears a black-and-white horizontal striped shirt, white shorts, and dark sneakers. Their arm is wrapped around the waist of the person beside them. The person on the right has shoulder-length light brown or blonde hair and wears a loose, light blue striped shirt-dress or long shirt, black socks, and dark shoes. They carry a large gray patterned tote bag over one shoulder. Their pose suggests affection or companionship, and they are the main focus of the image.

Around them are several other people scattered across the plaza. On the left side, a small group stands and talks; some faces appear blurred. One person wears a light blue shirt and dark pants, another wears a black top and jeans, and another has a cap and a dark athletic-style outfit. Farther left, a person in dark clothing stands near the edge of the frame. In the background, there are people walking near steps and low walls.

On the right side, a man wearing a face mask stands looking down at a phone. Farther right, a child or young person in a yellow shirt kneels on the ground and appears to be photographing or looking through a camera. Other people are seated or standing near the edge of the plaza, including someone with a stroller or wheelchair visible in the background.

The ground is a large expanse of smooth stone or concrete paving, with subtle seams and color variations. Low hedges and patio umbrellas are visible near the building, suggesting a public or tourist area. The overall atmosphere is that of a busy cultural landmark or museum plaza, with visitors milling around while the central pair stands intimately in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到两个人在户外拥抱的照片，背景中可以看到其他游客和一座古典风格的建筑。两人站在广场上，男性穿着蓝色条纹T恤、白色短裤和黑色运动鞋，而女性则穿着浅蓝色连衣裙和白色高跟鞋。他们的姿态亲密，似乎正在享受彼此的陪伴。周围的人们似乎在等待或观看，其中一些人拿着相机，准备记录这一刻。建筑物的柱子和装饰性细节表明这是一个有历史意义的地方，可能是一个博物馆或文化遗址。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a modern urban shopping or commercial complex, dominated by dramatic angular architecture and reflective dark glass.

At the center-left, a large faceted wall made of pale gray stone or metal panels forms a sharp geometric surface. Mounted on it is the sign **“STARHILL GALLERY”** in large metallic letters, with the word “STARHILL” stretched across the upper portion and “GALLERY” smaller beneath it. Strong sunlight hits this sign and casts a distinct shadow of the lettering onto the wall, making the text appear doubled.

The building’s design is highly contemporary, with irregular triangular and polygonal planes. Dark, glossy black glass panels cover much of the lower and central façade, reflecting cars, street activity, and surrounding buildings. On the left side, large glass windows reveal part of an interior retail space; the faint word **“ROLEX”** can be seen inside, suggesting luxury shops.

To the right, another tall dark reflective wall rises vertically, while a narrow passage or open walkway runs between the structures. Farther back, a taller rectangular high-rise building with a grid of windows is visible against a bright blue sky. The contrast between the angular low-rise façade and the more conventional tower creates a layered city scene.

Near the bottom right-center, two people stand in the shade close to the building entrance area, appearing very small compared with the massive architectural forms around them. The ground is paved with large, light-colored stone tiles, and the sunlight creates sharp shadows across the plaza.

Overall, the image captures a luxury shopping district or gallery entrance with bold, sculptural architecture, reflective surfaces, strong midday light, and a sleek urban atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的摄影作品，图中呈现了一个名为'STARHILL GALLERY'的黑色几何形状建筑。建筑的设计独特，以直线和尖角为特点，表面反射着周围环境的光线。在建筑前的人行道上，有两个人物站立，他们的身影与建筑形成对比，增加了画面的深度感。背景中可以看到其他建筑物和蓝天，但它们相对模糊，突出了前景的建筑和人物。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban shopping street in front of a large glass-fronted retail store, likely a Uniqlo, with bright red-and-white branding visible inside and on signs. The storefront spans most of the frame and is made of large, reflective glass panels held together by dark metal framing and circular metal fasteners. The glass reflects surrounding brick buildings, scaffolding, and the street scene, creating a layered effect where the inside of the store and the exterior reflections overlap.

Inside the shop, warm lighting illuminates neatly arranged clothing displays. Mannequins in casual outfits stand near the entrance and in the display areas, with shelves of folded clothes and racks of garments visible deeper inside. Sale signs and red promotional graphics can be seen throughout the store. A long red LED-style sign runs across the upper interior area with scrolling text that appears to reference Manchester.

The foreground is a pedestrian area paved with light gray cobblestones and larger stone slabs. Several people are walking in different directions, suggesting a lively shopping district. A bald man in a dark T-shirt and blue jeans stands or walks near the center foreground, seen from behind. To the left, a woman in a denim jacket is walking while holding a phone to her ear. On the right, another pedestrian in dark clothing carries a white-and-red shopping bag. Other shoppers, including people with backpacks, shopping bags, and casual clothing, move in and out of the store entrance.

At the top left, leafy green tree branches hang over the scene, softening the modern glass facade with natural texture. The overall atmosphere is that of a busy city-center retail street, with a mix of modern architecture, reflected older buildings, and constant foot traffic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的现实主义风格照片。图像捕捉了多位行人，他们穿着休闲服装，在铺有石块的地面上行走。街道两旁是现代建筑，其中一些建筑上装饰着红色和黄色的广告牌。建筑物的设计简洁而现代，玻璃幕墙反射出周围环境。在画面左侧，一位男性行人背对着镜头，他身穿黑色T恤和蓝色牛仔裤，手里拿着一个绿色购物袋。另一位女性行人穿着深色衣服，正从画面右侧走过。整个场景充满了都市生活的活力与节奏。

caption:
The image shows a person standing on a wide, pale sidewalk beside a quiet urban street. The scene has a stylized, cinematic color grade with cool teal tones in the pavement and sky, contrasted by warm yellows and oranges in the clothing and trees.

The person is positioned slightly right of center, facing partly toward the camera with their body turned sideways. Their face is intentionally blurred. They have a styled updo hairstyle, with the hair gathered high and swept back, and one side appearing closely cut or tightly styled.

They are wearing a short, colorful dress with a bold zigzag or chevron-like pattern. The dress features many bright colors, including orange, turquoise, green, black, pink, and yellow. In one hand, they hold a small orange handbag with a rounded handle and textured or fringed-looking trim. The bag’s bright color matches their orange ankle socks.

On their feet, they appear to be wearing orange socks with high-heeled shoes; one beige-and-brown high heel is on the ground in the foreground, suggesting they may have stepped out of it or removed it. Another heel is still near or on one foot. The pose feels fashion-oriented and slightly playful, as if part of a staged street-style photoshoot.

To the right, there is a tall black wrought-iron fence with decorative scrollwork running along a raised wall. Behind it is part of a brick or stone building. A staircase or sloped railing structure is visible along the fence. In the background, a blue pedestrian crossing sign can be seen near the building, and another similar road sign appears farther left near the street.

The street on the left is empty and curves gently into the distance. A low curb separates it from the sidewalk. The background is softly out of focus, with trees showing autumnal yellow and green foliage. The overall atmosphere is quiet, polished, and slightly surreal due to the strong color treatment and shallow depth of field.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张复古风格的摄影作品，展示了一位女性站在城市街道旁。她穿着一件多彩条纹连衣裙和一双橙色高跟鞋，手持一个黄色手提包，并且脚边放着一只棕色的鞋子。她的头发被梳成一个优雅的发髻，面部特征因模糊处理而不可辨认。背景中可以看到一条安静的道路、路边的树木和一些建筑物，营造出一种宁静的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright yellow Chevrolet Corvette, likely a C6 Z06, parked at an outdoor car meet on a sunny day. The car dominates the foreground, photographed from a low front-left angle that emphasizes its long hood, low stance, and aggressive sports-car shape.

The Corvette has a glossy yellow paint finish with strong reflections from nearby trees across the hood and windshield. The front end features the Corvette crossed-flags emblem on the nose, large oval headlights with multiple projector elements, a wide lower grille opening, and a black carbon-fiber-style front splitter along the bottom edge. The hood has sculpted creases and a small vent near the front-left side. The windshield and side windows are heavily tinted, appearing almost black.

On the side, a small “Z06” badge is visible behind the front wheel, confirming it as a performance model. The car has black multi-spoke wheels with low-profile tires, giving it a modified or track-focused appearance. The side mirror is yellow to match the body, and the side skirt appears dark, continuing the black trim theme.

Behind the yellow Corvette, a black sports car is parked with its hood raised high, exposing part of the engine bay. Farther back to the right, another yellow car is partially visible. The background includes a parking lot filled with various vehicles, including compact cars, motorcycles, and other sports cars. Several people are walking around casually, suggesting a car show or weekend meet.

The setting is shaded by large green trees, whose branches and leaves stretch across the top of the frame. Sunlight filters through the foliage, casting dappled shadows on the Corvette and pavement. The sky is clear and blue, and the overall scene feels warm, bright, and lively, with the yellow Corvette serving as the main focal point.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆黄色跑车的现实主义风格照片。跑车停在一个户外停车场，阳光下车身反射出光泽。车辆的设计流线型，配有黑色轮毂和运动型后视镜。背景中可以看到其他停放的汽车和一些模糊的人群，他们似乎在享受一个晴朗的日子。

caption:
The image shows an urban roadside scene in late-afternoon or early-evening light. The main subject is the rear and side of a small white box truck parked along the curb on the right side of a multi-lane road. Attached to the back of the truck is a large protest-style banner.

The banner is white with a bright green horizontal band across the middle. At the top, in large black capital letters, it reads: **“MINISTRZE KLIMATU”**. In the green band there is a graphic of two large stylized eyes staring outward. Beneath the eyes, the banner says **“PATRZYMY!”** in widely spaced black letters. Near the bottom are two Extinction Rebellion hourglass symbols, one on each side, with a green-and-white **“extinction rebellion”** logo between them. The Polish text roughly means: **“Minister of Climate, we are watching!”**

The truck itself looks somewhat worn, with a white cargo box and a darker blue cab partially visible on the right. The top of the cargo area has loose or folded white material bundled along the roof edge. A rear license plate is visible near the bottom, and the truck is parked beside a narrow sidewalk and a strip of low, leafless bushes.

The road is broad and busy, with several lanes and white lane markings visible in the foreground. To the right, traffic is moving or stopped, including a yellow-and-red city bus in the distance and several cars. A blue roadside sign on a pole shows a tire symbol and the text **“300m”**, indicating a tire-related service or location ahead.

The background contains rows of tall, leafless trees, suggesting winter or early spring. Behind the trees are low urban buildings, streetlights, and a green pedestrian overpass or bridge farther down the road. The sky is bright blue with scattered pale clouds, and warm sunlight casts golden highlights on the trees, buildings, and truck, giving the scene a crisp, cool-weather atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在城市街道上的宣传卡车的照片。卡车的侧面贴有绿色背景和一只眼睛图案的标语，上面写着'PATRZYMY!'（我们抗议）以及一些其他文字。卡车顶部覆盖着白色的布料，可能是为了遮挡或装饰。照片捕捉了车辆停靠在路边的瞬间，周围是行驶中的汽车和其他道路标志。

caption:
The image is a close-up of an electric vehicle’s charging port while a charging cable is plugged in.

At the center is a recessed, hexagonal charging socket surrounded by glossy black trim set into a white car body. A thick black charging connector is inserted into the port, with the cable extending downward and curving toward the lower right side of the frame. Around the socket is a bright turquoise-blue ring, which stands out against the otherwise dark plastic components. Above the connector, the label “Z.E.” is visible in light lettering, suggesting an electric-vehicle charging system.

The charging flap or cover is open and hangs to the lower left, partially visible and slightly out of focus. The surrounding trim has a dark, shiny, V-shaped styling element stretching horizontally across the front of the car, contrasting with the smooth white paint. There are small specks of dust and reflections on the glossy black surfaces, indicating outdoor lighting. The composition is tightly cropped, focusing almost entirely on the charging inlet, plug, and surrounding bodywork.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示电动汽车充电插头的特写照片。充电插头位于图像中心，由一个黑色塑料保护罩和一个蓝色圆形标记组成，上面标有'ZE'字样。插头通过一根黑色电线与车辆相连，而背景则模糊地显示了车辆的一部分。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic mountain landscape under a vast, cloudy sky. The lower half of the scene is dominated by a rugged alpine ridge with steep gray limestone cliffs, dark green forested slopes, and patches of lighter rock faces. On the left side of the ridge, a summit rises with a small antenna or communications tower visible on top.

Across the middle of the image, four bright red jet aircraft fly in formation in front of the mountains. Their vivid red color stands out sharply against the muted blues, grays, and greens of the background. The jets appear to be aerobatic planes, each marked with white details, and they are flying close together in two pairs. Thin white smoke trails extend behind them, forming horizontal streaks that stretch across the left side of the scene and partially overlap the mountain ridge.

The sky takes up most of the frame and is filled with large, layered clouds in shades of gray, white, and pale blue. Some areas of blue sky peek through, especially toward the upper right and left edges, but the overall atmosphere feels overcast and moody. The combination of the massive clouds, towering mountains, and small red jets creates a sense of scale and motion, as if the aircraft are performing an airshow over an alpine landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示飞机特技飞行的摄影作品，一架红色的飞机在蓝天和多云的天空中进行表演，留下了一条清晰可见的白色烟雾轨迹。飞机下方是一座壮观的山峰，其轮廓在云层的映衬下显得格外突出。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an ornate reddish-brown stone architectural surface, likely a carved wall or doorway panel made from red sandstone. The entire surface is divided into rectangular panels by thick vertical and horizontal stone borders, giving it a structured, symmetrical appearance.

At the center is a large recessed rectangular panel featuring delicate carved floral decoration. A vertical seam runs down the middle, suggesting two adjoining door-like slabs or paired stone panels. Within this central panel, a stylized plant rises from the bottom, with a central stem branching outward into curling vines, leaves, and flower buds. The design is symmetrical, with the left and right sides mirroring each other. Around the floral motif is an arched, scalloped outline resembling a Mughal-style arch, carved in shallow relief.

Above the central panel is a smaller horizontal rectangular panel decorated with a more compact floral design. It has a central flower, curling stems, and a scalloped ornamental frame. The panel is bordered by multiple thin incised lines, adding depth and refinement.

On both sides, partial vertical panels are visible, each with similar carved floral and arabesque patterns. These side panels are framed by raised borders and contain curling vine motifs and small flowers, continuing the decorative theme across the wall.

The stone surface has a warm terracotta to rust-red color with lighter speckling scattered across it, possibly from mineral deposits, weathering, or age. There are visible cracks, chips, worn edges, and uneven patches, especially along the borders and seams. The carvings are shallow but intricate, with soft shadows emphasizing the grooves. Overall, the image conveys an aged, historic architectural detail with refined floral ornamentation and a weathered red sandstone texture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示印度传统建筑装饰风格的图片，特写了一块雕刻精美的红褐色石板。石板上刻有复杂的花卉图案和几何形状，这些图案以精细的线条勾勒出来，并在石板表面形成了阴影效果，增强了立体感。石板四周的边框也装饰着类似的图案，整体设计体现了印度建筑的传统工艺水平。

caption:
The image is a high-contrast black-and-white photograph of an old architectural courtyard or passageway, dominated by weathered masonry and strong geometric forms.

On the left side, a tall, dark, textured wall runs diagonally from the foreground toward the center of the image. Its surface is heavily stained and worn, with streaks, patches, and rough plaster giving it an aged, almost fortress-like appearance. Several wall-mounted lamps project outward from it, their shapes silhouetted against the dark façade. Near the lower left are rectangular utility panels or electrical boxes set into or placed against the wall. A small cabinet-like structure sits on the rooftop at the upper left edge.

Toward the center-right rises a distinctive cylindrical tower, resembling a small minaret or decorative turret. It has a smooth, tapering body, a ribbed domed top, and a small pointed finial at the peak. Near the upper part of the tower are small arched openings or speaker-like circular features, adding to its Islamic or Middle Eastern architectural character. The tower stands behind lower parapet walls, partially obscured by surrounding structures.

On the right side, a lighter building façade catches more sunlight. It has a flat roofline and a row of decorative arched openings or balcony cutouts with ornamental shapes beneath them. Above these openings are several small fixtures or protrusions on the wall, possibly lamps, hooks, or water spouts. The plaster here is also worn and mottled, but much brighter than the shadowed wall on the left.

The foreground is an open paved courtyard or walkway, made of large rectangular tiles. The ground is mostly empty, emphasizing the stillness of the scene. Near the center foreground stands a dark signpost with multiple horizontal directional arrows, silhouetted against the lighter background. On the far right edge, a few chairs and possibly a table are partially visible, suggesting an outdoor seating area just outside the main focus.

The lighting is dramatic: the left side is in deep shadow, while the right side and the tower are brightly lit. The sky is nearly blank white, creating a stark contrast with the dark architecture. Overall, the image has a quiet, historic atmosphere, with strong contrasts, aged textures, and architectural details suggesting an old urban district, fort, market, or traditional courtyard.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的图像，展示了一座具有历史感的建筑。建筑物的外墙表面显得有些磨损和斑驳，而一端则有一个尖顶结构，其设计简约且具有时代感。在建筑物前方，有一条宽阔的人行道，两旁摆放着一些路灯和指示牌。整个场景被一种柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种静谧而沉思的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the richly decorated interior of a large Baroque church, viewed from the central aisle looking toward the main altar. The scene is highly symmetrical, with rows of dark carved wooden pews leading the eye toward an elaborate sanctuary at the far end.

The architecture is grand and ornate. Tall pale stone or plaster columns rise on both sides, supporting high arches and a vaulted ceiling. Between the columns are tall windows with pale blue light filtering through, contrasting with the warm gold and dark wood tones throughout the church. The ceiling and arch above the altar are painted with large religious frescoes, showing figures in dramatic poses among clouds and architectural illusionistic elements.

The main altar at the center is extremely elaborate, covered in gilded ornamentation, sculpted scrollwork, carved angels, and religious figures. A large framed painting sits in the center of the altar, surrounded by a gold, oval-like decorative frame. Below it is a richly carved tabernacle or altar structure with candles, statues, and decorative panels. Red marble-like columns frame the central sanctuary area, adding deep color among the gold and white surfaces.

On both the left and right sides are large side altars or devotional structures. These are made of dark polished wood with extensive gold decoration, twisted columns, framed religious paintings, and sculpted saints and angels. The side altars are stacked vertically with multiple painted panels and niches, making them look almost like architectural towers. Several gilded statues stand at the edges, including robed saintly figures and cherubic heads with wings.

The foreground contains intricately carved wooden pews and choir stalls, with swirling ornamental patterns on the sides and backs. A central aisle of patterned stone flooring runs down the middle, ending at a small freestanding sign or lectern before the steps to the altar. Red carpeting highlights the altar steps.

Overall, the image conveys a sense of opulence, sacred grandeur, and theatrical Baroque design. The dominant colors are warm gold, amber wood, cream-white walls, red marble accents, and cool blue window light. The space feels majestic and ceremonial, filled with religious art, gilded carvings, and dense decorative detail.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示巴洛克风格教堂内部的照片。图像中心是一个装饰华丽的祭坛，其上方悬挂着一幅宗教画作。两侧的墙壁上装饰有金色的雕像和精美的浮雕，而前方则有一排雕刻精细的木制长椅。整个场景被金色的光线照亮，营造出一种庄严神圣的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a white maxi-scooter or sport-style scooter parked at night on a paved sidewalk or plaza. It is photographed from a low, front-left three-quarter angle, making the front fairing and side profile prominent.

The scooter has glossy white bodywork with sharp, angular styling. Its front end is tall and aerodynamic, with a dark tinted windscreen rising above the handlebars. The headlight assembly is large and modern-looking, with multiple clear lens sections and chrome-like reflectors integrated into the front fairing. A small colorful sticker or emblem is visible near the upper front center beneath the windscreen.

The seat is long and black, shaped for rider comfort, with a slightly raised passenger section toward the rear. The body panels flow smoothly from the front fairing through the footboard area to the rear tail section. Black trim pieces contrast with the white panels, especially around the lower side fairings and footwell. The rear suspension is visible on the left side, featuring a bright red coil spring that stands out against the dark mechanical parts.

The front wheel is turned slightly to the right. It has thin spokes and a dark rim with subtle colored highlights, possibly purple or blue reflections. The front fork and brake components are visible, and the front fender is also white, matching the body. The rear wheel and exhaust area are partly visible in shadow near the back of the scooter.

The scene is set outdoors at night. The background is very dark, with only a few distant streetlights, building lights, and faint silhouettes of structures visible. A warm orange streetlamp glows in the distance on the right side, and there are blurred lights from buildings or vehicles behind the scooter. The ground is made of rectangular paving stones, with some darker stains and patches visible. The lighting appears to come from a camera flash or strong artificial light, illuminating the scooter brightly while leaving the surroundings mostly dim. Overall, the image emphasizes the scooter’s clean white finish, sporty design, and custom-looking details against a dark nighttime urban backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆白色摩托车的夜间摄影照片。摩托车停放在铺有石块的地面上，车身干净闪亮，前灯和转向灯在夜晚发出柔和的光芒。背景中模糊可见一些灯光和建筑轮廓，但它们并不抢眼，确保了对摩托车的关注。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, narrow pedestrian street in a historic-looking district, likely in a Mediterranean or Turkish old town. The scene is framed by traditional buildings, stone walls, greenery, and café seating.

On the left side, a rough beige stone wall runs along the street, topped and surrounded by plants. Behind it are several tall trees, including a large palm tree with wide fronds and a very tall, dark, slender cypress-like tree. A white domed structure is partly visible behind the wall, suggesting an older architectural feature. Farther back, a low building with a red-tiled roof and a gray plaster facade appears to be under renovation; scaffolding stands across its front, and part of the wall shows exposed brick and peeling plaster.

The street itself is paved with light gray stone blocks and gently curves or narrows into the distance. Black metal streetlamps line both sides, giving the area a decorative, old-town atmosphere. There are also red-and-white “no entry” traffic signs near the foreground.

On the right side, traditional buildings with white or pale yellow walls, wooden window frames, balconies, and red clay tile roofs line the street. Some have exposed stone or brick details. A café or restaurant occupies the right foreground, with many dark wooden or black chairs and tables arranged outside along the sidewalk. A black signboard with white lettering hangs above one storefront, though the full text is not completely clear.

Several people are visible. Near the center foreground, a worker wearing an orange reflective vest is standing beside a green wheeled trash bin, holding cleaning tools and appearing to sweep or collect litter. Farther down the street, a person in dark clothing walks toward the camera. Another person stands near the café area on the right.

The sky is overcast and pale, creating soft, diffuse lighting with minimal shadows. Overall, the image feels calm and slightly early-morning-like, with historic architecture, local businesses, street maintenance, and lush greenery combining to create an old urban Mediterranean street scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的摄影照片，画面中心是一条铺有石板的道路，两旁是具有地中海风格的建筑。左侧有一棵高大的棕榈树和一个垃圾桶，而右侧则是一排摆放着桌椅的户外餐厅。街道上有几位行人正在行走，其中一位穿着橙色上衣的人正走向镜头方向。建筑物的外墙装饰着传统的白色窗框和红色屋顶瓦片，一些窗户上方还挂着白色的窗帘。整个场景在阴天的自然光照下被捕捉下来，营造出一种宁静而悠闲的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor food stall or market barbecue setup under blue canopy tents. In the foreground, a large rectangular charcoal grill is packed with grilled chicken pieces—mostly whole or halved portions—browned and slightly charred from cooking. Thick white-gray smoke rises heavily from the grill, drifting across the left and center of the scene and partially obscuring the person standing behind it.

A vendor in a dark shirt stands behind the grill with one hand on their hip, surrounded by smoke. A pair of metal tongs is visible near the grill, suggesting active cooking or turning of the chicken. The grill itself is blackened from use, with a metal grate and a sturdy frame.

To the right, another person is working at a red-covered table, handling food items and a pink plastic bag. On the table are metal trays containing prepared items, including small brown sauce packets or wrapped portions and skewered food. A large metal tray in the lower right contains white items, possibly napkins, rice packets, or wrapped food. The setup looks like a street food vendor preparing and serving grilled meals.

The scene is shaded by bright blue pop-up tents with black metal support frames. A vertical tent pole runs near the center-right of the image, dividing the grill area from the serving table. In the background, there are more people, red plastic chairs, greenery, parked cars, and a sunny street or park-like area beyond the stall. The lighting suggests daytime, with strong sunlight filtering in from outside the tents.

Overall, the image captures the lively atmosphere of an outdoor barbecue stall: smoky grilled chicken in the foreground, vendors preparing food, customers or helpers nearby, and a colorful market environment with tents, tables, and food trays.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外烧烤活动的照片，焦点落在一位正在烤制多块肉的男性上。他穿着黑色T恤和短裤，专注地操作着烧烤架。烟雾从烤架上升腾，显示出食物正在烹饪中。在他的旁边，另一位顾客正站在摊位前，似乎在等待食物准备就绪。周围环境是一个带有遮阳篷的户外市场，可以看到其他摊位和一些顾客。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene in Times Square, New York City, viewed from the upper deck of an open-top sightseeing bus. The perspective is elevated, looking straight down a broad avenue lined with tall buildings, digital billboards, advertisements, and dense traffic.

In the foreground on the left, several tourists are seated on the open-air bus. Only the backs and partial profiles of people are visible, including a person with long blonde hair and others wearing caps or jackets. The bus’s cream-colored railing and red seats frame the lower-left edge of the photo, emphasizing that the viewer is riding along with the crowd.

The street stretches into the distance through a canyon of skyscrapers. The roadway is filled with vehicles, including a silver SUV in the center foreground, yellow taxis farther ahead, and another double-decker sightseeing bus on the right. That bus is maroon and cream-colored with large yellow lettering reading “BIG BUS NEW YORK” and “BIG BUS,” suggesting a tourist route through the city. Traffic appears moderately heavy, with cars, taxis, buses, and pedestrians moving through the intersection.

Both sides of the street are packed with tall buildings of different styles. On the right, modern glass-fronted towers reflect neighboring buildings and sunlight, creating a patchwork of mirrored windows. Beside them are older stone buildings with ornate façades, warm golden highlights, and decorative architectural details. On the left, more high-rises rise above storefronts and signage, including rounded glass towers and older brick or stone structures.

The scene is dominated by large advertisements and billboards. On the right side, a prominent white billboard shows two butterflies and the text “CHANGE FOR PROGRESS #NEXT100YEARS,” with “FactCheckArmenia.com” beneath it. Below and nearby are other large signs, including a dark billboard for “Avengers 2” and a fashion-style advertisement featuring two models. Farther down the street, smaller signs and bright displays stack vertically along the buildings, contributing to the unmistakable Times Square atmosphere.

In the distance, a narrow slice of the avenue continues toward a bright horizon, with more signage, traffic lights, pedestrians, and illuminated panels visible. The sky above is partly cloudy and bright, allowing sunlight to reflect off the glass towers and create strong contrasts between shaded street areas and glowing building façades.

Overall, the image captures the energy of Midtown Manhattan: crowded sightseeing buses, dense traffic, towering architecture, reflective glass buildings, colorful advertisements, and the bustling commercial character of Times Square.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现纽约时代广场的现实主义风格照片，画面中心是一条繁忙的城市街道，上面有行驶中的车辆和行人。左侧有一辆停靠在路边的观光巴士，车上可见乘客的头部轮廓。街道两侧是高耸的建筑物，其中一面墙上挂满了广告牌，展示着各种商业信息和品牌标志。天空中云层较厚，但阳光透过云隙照射下来，为整个场景增添了一丝温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an elegant outdoor swimming pool area, likely at a hotel or resort, surrounded by landscaped gardens and Mediterranean-style buildings.

In the foreground, a wide stone-tiled pool deck stretches from the bottom of the image toward the center. The paving is made of pale rectangular slabs with subtle gray veining and seams, giving it a clean, upscale look. On the left side of the deck are several white plastic lounge chairs arranged in rows, some reclining and some upright. Many have small wheels at the back. Closed white sun umbrellas with brown trim stand among the loungers, evenly spaced along the poolside.

To the right, a large rectangular swimming pool occupies much of the frame. The water is bright turquoise-blue with gentle ripples, reflecting the trees and sky. A pale stone coping runs along the pool edge, forming a raised border between the deck and the water. Across the far side of the pool, more white lounge chairs and closed umbrellas are lined up neatly.

The middle ground is lush with greenery. A dense hedge borders the left side of the pool area, and behind it are manicured shrubs, flowering plants, and ornamental trees. Near the center is a striking red-leaved shrub, contrasting strongly with the surrounding green foliage. A large evergreen tree with drooping branches rises prominently in the center-right, partially obscuring the buildings behind it. To the far right are tall, dark cypress-like trees and a few pruned, bare-branched trees with small clusters of foliage.

In the background are warm-toned buildings with peach, beige, and salmon-colored walls. They have terracotta-tiled roofs, dark-framed windows, balconies, railings, chimneys, and rooftop antennas, giving the scene a distinctly European or Mediterranean atmosphere. A balustrade terrace runs horizontally behind the garden area. On the left, a long peach-colored wall slopes upward, topped with railings and flower boxes filled with red and pink flowers. Beneath it, white arched awnings cover part of a lower structure.

The sky is overcast, pale gray-blue, and softly lit, creating a calm atmosphere without harsh shadows. Overall, the scene feels quiet, well-maintained, and peaceful, with no people visible—just an inviting poolside resort area surrounded by carefully landscaped gardens and classic architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示豪华度假村泳池区域的照片。在画面中央，有一个清澈的蓝色游泳池，边缘铺有浅色石板。泳池周围摆放着多把白色遮阳伞和配有白色躺椅的休息区。左侧有一排高大的绿色灌木丛，而右侧则有几棵红叶树和一些修剪整齐的树木。背景中可见两座风格相似的建筑，它们的外墙呈暖色调，与周围的自然环境和谐相融。整个场景显得宁静且优雅，是休闲度假的理想选择。

caption:
The image shows an elaborate indoor, nautical- or exploration-themed display inside a large venue, possibly a restaurant, hotel lobby, or themed attraction.

At the center is a huge antique-style globe or spherical map sculpture, colored in metallic gold and copper-brown tones. The surface is decorated like an old maritime map, with painted sailing ships, stylized waves, compass imagery, and handwritten-style map text such as “Here be dragons.” The globe appears aged and weathered, with raised darker landmasses and a shiny golden ocean surface. A dark band wraps diagonally around it, resembling a structural belt or equator-like support.

On either side of the globe are large bronze-colored sculptural human figures, posed as if straining to hold or support the globe, reminiscent of Atlas figures from classical mythology. Only portions of the figures are visible because the globe and surrounding architecture partly obscure them.

In the foreground, a black lamppost with a round white globe light stands in front of the display. The lamp has a decorative black grid pattern and gold trim, reinforcing the old-world travel theme. Below and across the lower middle of the image are two bright red directional signs with gold lettering: one points left and reads “Aft,” while the other points right and reads “Forward,” using nautical directional terms.

The lower portion of the scene includes dark wood architectural elements—columns, trim, and a façade that looks like part of a ship or vintage building. A brick wall section is visible at the bottom right, adding to the staged, themed environment. There are also artificial topiary trees and greenery placed around the display.

The background features a modern interior wall with large rectangular windows framed in white. Behind the windows are pale curtains. The wall surface has a wavy, textured pattern in gray tones, and colored accent lighting—purple and warm amber—casts a theatrical glow across the scene. A purple stage light is mounted high on the right side, aimed toward the display.

Overall, the image combines maritime navigation, antique cartography, classical sculpture, and theatrical indoor design, creating a dramatic “old world exploration” atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内装饰的照片，中心是一个巨大的金色地球仪，上面绘有帆船和地图。在地球仪的前方，有两个红色箭头指示牌，分别指向'Aft'（向后）和'Forward'（向前）。整个场景被温暖的灯光照亮，营造出一种温馨而邀请的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an ornate mythical creature sculpture, likely a Southeast Asian temple guardian figure such as a naga, dragon, or makara-inspired serpent. The sculpture is photographed from the side against a plain, bright white sky, which makes the intricate colors and details stand out dramatically.

The creature’s head faces left, with a long, upward-curving snout and large ivory-white tusks. One tusk extends forward from the upper mouth, while another curves outward from the lower jaw. Its open mouth reveals rows of sharp, white, fang-like teeth set against a deep red interior, giving the figure a fierce, protective expression.

The head and body are richly decorated with elaborate swirling patterns, flame-like ornaments, and layered scales. The dominant colors are turquoise blue, teal, gold, red, and dark metallic tones. Gold accents outline many of the carved flourishes, especially along the brows, jawline, and crest. The surface appears weathered, with patches of patina and darker staining that add texture and age.

A large rounded eye sits prominently near the center of the head, framed by raised golden and teal ornamentation. Above the head are multiple curling, horn-like crests and flame-shaped spires, each carved with spirals and ridges. The creature’s long snout curls upward into a spiral-tipped form, adding to its fantastical appearance.

Along the neck and body, overlapping scale patterns are visible in deep blue and teal, edged with gold and black shadowing. The sculpture has a dynamic, flowing design, with every part covered in carved waves, curls, and pointed decorative elements. The overall impression is of a majestic, fearsome guardian figure from a temple or ceremonial structure, combining dragon, serpent, and elephant-like features in a highly detailed traditional style.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国传统雕塑艺术风格的图像，特写拍摄了一尊色彩丰富的蓝色和金色的龙雕塑。雕塑的头部细节非常精致，包括精细雕刻的鳞片、锋利的牙齿和夸张的眼睛。它的头部装饰着金色的饰品，如头冠和耳饰，这些都呈现出复杂的几何图案和曲线。背景是均匀的白色，突出了雕塑的色彩和细节。

caption:
The image shows a broad city square or overlook at dusk, with a dramatic skyline and monuments silhouetted against a fading sky.

On the right side, dominating the foreground, is a large equestrian statue: a rider seated upright on a horse, both rendered mostly in dark silhouette. The horse has one front leg raised, giving the statue a poised, ceremonial feel. The statue stands on a massive pale stone pedestal with decorative carved details, though many of the lower features are in shadow.

In the background, across the middle of the image, a historic hilltop district is illuminated in warm golden light. The most striking feature is a tall Gothic church spire near the center-left, glowing amber against the evening sky. Around it are ornate rooftops, towers, and castle-like structures, including what appears to be the Fisherman’s Bastion/Matthias Church area in Budapest. The architecture has pointed roofs, turrets, and intricate stonework, creating a fairy-tale silhouette.

The sky takes up much of the upper frame and transitions from pale blue-gray at the top to a warmer yellow-orange glow near the horizon, suggesting sunset or early evening. The city lights are beginning to come on: streetlamps and building lights create small bright points of orange and yellow throughout the lower half of the scene.

In the foreground, the plaza is mostly dark, with several pedestrians visible as silhouettes. Some people stand or walk near the left side, and a few smaller figures appear near the center and right. A row of short, dark rectangular bollards or blocks lines the lower portion of the frame. Tall modern streetlights with glowing vertical panels stand throughout the square, adding contrast to the historic skyline behind them.

Overall, the image has a calm, atmospheric mood, emphasizing the contrast between the dark foreground silhouettes and the warmly lit historic buildings in the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的照片，前景中有一座骑马雕塑，其轮廓在黄昏的天空下显得格外突出。雕塑背后是城市的天际线，其中最显眼的是一个尖顶建筑和一座金色的塔楼，它们在暮色中被灯光照亮，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。街道上的人们似乎在享受这个夜晚的时光，一些人正在散步，而其他人则坐在长椅上休息。

caption:
The image shows a bright, scenic park landscape under a wide blue sky. The scene is dominated by a tall, ornate stone tower standing on a grassy rise toward the right side of the frame. The tower appears historic, built from warm brown and golden stone, with decorative architectural details near the top, including arched openings, small sculptural elements, and a pointed roof or spire capped by a small finial. Sunlight strikes the tower strongly, making it glow against the sky.

In the foreground, there is a curved pond or small lake with dark, reflective water. The pond is bordered by a pale stone or concrete edge, and its surface reflects some of the greenery and sky. A low black metal fence runs along the grassy bank in front of the water. Near the right edge of the pond, there are clumps of tall grasses and reeds, while rocks and low plants form a landscaped edge.

The middle ground is lush and varied, with rolling green grass, shrubs, bushes, and a mixture of evergreen and leafless deciduous trees. A large dense evergreen tree occupies the center of the image, partially blocking the lower part of the tower. Behind and above it, bare tree branches spread out intricately, suggesting late autumn or winter. On the left, more leafless trees rise above a small building or cottage with a sloped roof, a chimney, and green trim, partly hidden by hedges and vegetation.

To the right of the pond, a small rocky cascade or garden feature descends through the slope, surrounded by plants and shrubs. A bench is visible on the hillside near the tower, placed among the landscaped greenery. A narrow path or steps appear to wind up the slope on the far right.

The sky takes up much of the image and is a vivid blue with thin, wispy white clouds stretching across it. The lighting is warm and low, likely from late afternoon sun, giving the grass, trees, and stone tower a golden tone. Overall, the image conveys a peaceful, well-kept public garden or park with a historic tower as its focal point.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光与建筑的摄影作品，画面中心是一座高耸的钟楼，其尖顶和石制结构在蓝天白云下显得格外引人注目。钟楼周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛，其中一棵树的枝条裸露，显示出冬季或早春的季节特征。前景是一个宁静的小池塘，水面平静，反射着周围的景色。池塘旁边有一座小屋，其绿色屋顶与周围的自然环境和谐相融。整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一种平和而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a vast, brightly lit shopping mall atrium viewed from a high vantage point, looking down into a circular open space. The composition is almost symmetrical, with multiple curved balcony levels wrapping around a large central column-like structure.

At the center is a tall cylindrical elevator or service core clad in gray panels and glass, with rounded metal railings encircling each level. Several glass elevator cabins or lobby landings are visible inside it, illuminated with warm orange light and patterned floors. Around this central core, the mall opens into several stacked floors, each lined with metal-and-glass railings.

The atrium floor below is spacious and polished, made of pale cream tiles with a pattern of small reddish-brown square insets. Many shoppers are scattered across the floor, appearing small from the overhead perspective. Some walk in groups, others stand near the railings or gather around the base of the central structure. The people add a sense of scale, emphasizing how large the mall interior is.

Surrounding the atrium are wide, curved walkways on several levels. Shops line the outer edges, with bright storefronts and display windows. Luxury and fashion store fronts are visible, including a clearly lit “Dior” sign on the right side and other boutique-style windows with mannequins and warm interior lighting. On the left, another storefront sign appears to read “Christian Dior,” with large display windows showing clothing.

Large vertical advertising banners hang down through the open atrium on either side of the central column. The banners feature close-up images of faces, likely beauty or fashion advertisements. Their tall, narrow shape emphasizes the height of the mall.

The architecture is clean and modern, dominated by white structural columns, cream marble-like floors, curved balconies, and metallic railings. Massive white cylindrical columns frame the lower foreground and continue upward through the levels. The lighting is warm and even, reflecting off the glossy floors and giving the mall a luxurious, polished feel.

Near the bottom center, a Malaysian flag is visible hanging or standing near the railing, adding a strong splash of blue, red, white, and yellow. Overall, the image captures a busy, upscale, multi-story shopping mall with grand architecture, open vertical space, luxury retail stores, and many shoppers moving through the atrium.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代购物中心内部的摄影图像。中心是一个圆形的中庭，周围是多层的购物区和休息区。在中庭上方悬挂着几面旗帜，包括马来西亚国旗和其他国家的国旗。中庭中央有一个大型的信息显示屏，显示着商店信息和广告。商场内有多个楼层，每层都有不同的商店和餐饮设施。人们在各个楼层间穿梭，有的人在店铺前驻足，有的人在休闲区休息。整个场景被柔和的人造光线照亮，营造出一个温馨而活跃的购物环境。

caption:
The image shows an airport apron on a bright, sunny day, viewed from an elevated position, likely through a terminal window.

In the foreground, a commercial passenger jet is parked at a gate and connected to a glass-sided jet bridge. The aircraft has a sleek gray fuselage with red and dark accent stripes, and a crown logo on the tail, suggesting Royal Jordanian branding. The nose of the plane is visible at the lower left, with the cockpit windows catching the sunlight. The front landing gear is down, and ground service cables or hoses are connected near the aircraft’s nose area.

The jet bridge dominates the lower right portion of the image. It has teal-tinted glass panels, metal framing, and an enclosed accordion-style connector attached to the aircraft door. Beneath and around the jet bridge are airport service units, including air-conditioning or power equipment, ducts, carts, and cables. A few orange traffic cones are placed around the aircraft and service area.

The aircraft’s tail rises prominently near the center-right of the image. It is dark gray with a red tip and a pale crown emblem, with diagonal darker striping running down the vertical stabilizer. The rear fuselage and part of the wing are visible, stretching across the apron.

In the midground, the wide concrete tarmac is marked with yellow and black taxiway lines, stand markings, and painted guidance lines. There are mobile stairs parked on the far right side, along with scattered ground-service equipment and small carts. Several signs with stand or gate numbers are visible, including signs labeled “S 21” and “S 23.”

Beyond the apron are taxiways and service roads separated by strips of dry grass and low vegetation. The background opens into a flat, arid landscape with beige fields, sparse trees, and a few distant structures. The overall scene feels hot and dry, with strong sunlight, pale concrete, and muted desert colors contrasting with the dark aircraft livery and the greenish glass of the jet bridge.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示机场登机桥连接到一架大型客机的现实主义风格照片。飞机停靠在跑道上，机身呈现银灰色调，并带有红色和蓝色的标志。登机桥已经与飞机相连，准备迎接乘客上下飞机。背景中可以看到其他几架飞机和机场的部分设施，以及远处的地平线和稀疏的植被。

caption:
The image shows a bronze or dark patinated metal statue of a crowned, robed female religious figure, likely the Virgin Mary, standing outdoors in a wooded setting.

The statue is centered in the frame and depicted full-length. She wears a long flowing gown with deeply carved vertical folds and a draped cloak that wraps over her shoulders and falls down both sides. Her arms are extended slightly outward and downward, with open palms facing forward in a welcoming or blessing gesture. A small decorative clasp or star-like ornament appears at the center of her chest where the cloak gathers. Around her waist is a subtle belt or sash.

On her head is a crown with raised points, giving the figure a regal appearance. The head is covered by a veil that frames the face and flows into the cloak. The face area appears intentionally blurred or out of focus, while the rest of the statue is sharp enough to show texture, weathering, and highlights on the metal surface. The bronze finish has warm brown, reddish, and golden tones, with darker areas in the folds and creases.

The statue stands on a rectangular pedestal set among pale rocks. On the front of the base is a metal plaque with raised lettering. The text is partially readable and appears to say: “MÈRE MONÉ MARIE / LEUR GARDIENNE / 1867” or something similar, though some letters are difficult to make out due to weathering and angle.

Behind the statue are large, rough-barked tree trunks with knots and hollows, suggesting an old olive or similar tree. The background is a natural woodland or garden area with shrubs, dry branches, green foliage, and soft daylight filtering through. A green bench is partially visible to the left in the background. The overall scene feels quiet and devotional, like a small outdoor shrine or memorial in a Mediterranean-style garden.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一尊位于自然环境中的宗教雕塑，其表面呈现出深棕色的金属质感。雕塑描绘了一位女性形象，她身穿长袍，头戴装饰性的帽子，并且双手张开，似乎在欢迎或祈祷的姿态中。她的姿态显得庄严而神圣。雕塑背后是树木和灌木丛，营造出一种宁静祥和的氛围。

caption:
The image is taken from inside a coach or long-distance bus, looking diagonally forward and out through the large right-side window.

On the left side of the image, the bus interior is visible. There are rows of dark seats with bright green headrest accents, and a few passengers are partially visible from behind. Near the bottom foreground, the back of a passenger’s head fills part of the frame. Farther forward, another passenger with longer hair is seated. Overhead, the bus has dark ceiling panels and storage compartments, with a small “no smoking” style sign visible near the front. A blank rectangular monitor or screen is mounted near the aisle toward the front of the bus.

Along the window, thick green curtains hang in folds, matching the green accents on the seats. One curtain is pulled to the side near the center of the image, creating a vertical strip of fabric between the interior and the view outside. The window glass reflects some of the interior and slightly tints the outdoor scene.

Outside the window, the bus appears to be traveling along a road bordered by a metal guardrail. The scenery is bright and sunny, with dense green trees and bushes rushing past. The leaves are mostly green with hints of yellow, suggesting late summer or early autumn. There is noticeable motion blur in the trees and roadside, reinforcing the sense that the bus is moving. A tall streetlight or utility pole stands near the road, visible against a clear blue sky.

The overall mood is that of a daytime bus journey through a leafy roadside area, with strong sunlight outside contrasting against the darker, shaded bus interior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张从公交车内部拍摄的照片，展示了乘客的头部和窗外快速移动的树木。乘客坐在车厢内，头靠在车窗旁，身体部分被绿色窗帘遮挡。通过窗户可以看到外面阳光明媚，树木呈现出动态模糊的效果，表明车辆正在高速行驶中。

caption:
The image shows a supermarket shelf stocked with **Tiger brand biscuits**, mostly in bright red packaging. The main visible products are **Tiger Chocolate** biscuits, with large white-and-blue “TIGER” logos printed across the front. Each pack features a cheerful cartoon tiger mascot holding or standing near a chocolate biscuit, along with text highlighting **“Vitamins”** and **“Minerals.”** The chocolate flavor packaging includes images of wheat, chocolate splashes, and rectangular embossed biscuits.

Several packets are stacked horizontally and tightly packed on a black metal shelf. The largest packs are on the middle shelf, with more red Tiger biscuit packs visible above and below. Some packs on the lower shelf appear to be **Tiger Original** flavor, also in red packaging but with “ORIGINAL” printed on them.

There are prominent promotional price tags hanging from the shelf edge. One large sign at the bottom center reads **“PROMOSI”** and lists **“TIGER BISCUIT ORIGINAL/ CHOCOLATE FLAVOURS 198G”** priced at **RM 2.65 per pack**. Another large sign at the upper left also shows **RM 2.65**, mentioning **“TIGER BISCUIT MILK FLAVOUR 175G.”** Smaller shelf price labels are visible along the rail, including one showing **3.15**.

The overall scene is a close-up retail display, with the bright red biscuit packaging dominating the image and promotional Malaysian Ringgit pricing clearly emphasized.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Tiger巧克力饼干的货架照片，饼干包装上印有醒目的卡通老虎形象和品牌名称。货架上的价格标签显示着265泰铢的价格，旁边有一个促销标志，上面写着'PROMOSI TIGER BISCUIT ORIGINAL CHOCOLATE FLAVOURS 100g RM 265'，表明这是原味巧克力口味的促销活动。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene in what appears to be a historic British city center. The view is looking down a street lined with older commercial buildings, with a prominent stone church tower rising in the middle distance.

On the left side, the foreground is dominated by dark, ornate storefront architecture. There are black-painted metal supports and decorative brackets, giving the building an old-fashioned character. Hanging above the sidewalk is a large black sign reading “Jones Bootmakers since 1857,” with a boot silhouette at the top. Below it is a red “Pizza Hut” hanging sign, and near the sidewalk there is also a Pizza Hut menu board or entrance sign. A small “SECOM” security sign is visible on the wall. The left side is quite shadowed compared with the bright sky.

In the center background, a Gothic-style church tower stands out. It has tall narrow openings, stone tracery, and decorative pinnacles along the top. The church building below is partly hidden by leafy green trees. The sky behind it is very bright and overcast, causing the tower and nearby buildings to appear somewhat silhouetted.

The street itself is active with pedestrians and cyclists. Several cyclists are stopped or gathered near traffic lights in the middle of the road, wearing helmets and casual cycling clothing. A red double-decker bus is partly visible further down the street on the left. Traffic lights show red, and there are various street signs, including one about “traffic enforcement cameras.” People are walking along both pavements, and a few pedestrians are crossing or waiting near the junction.

On the right side, there is a row of tall red-brick commercial buildings with large vertical windows. A large storefront sign reads “MARKS & SPENCER” in black letters on a white fascia. Below and nearby are blue “Halifax” bank signs. One striking building near the center-right has a rounded red-brick corner with decorative bands and a grey conical roof, adding to the historic architectural feel.

In the immediate foreground at the bottom right, two men are walking toward the camera; their faces appear blurred. One wears a dark purple shirt, and the other wears a pink shirt. The perspective and wide framing make the street feel lively and slightly crowded, with a mix of modern shops, historic architecture, cyclists, buses, and pedestrians all sharing the same city-center space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的照片，画面中心是一座具有哥特式尖顶的教堂，其高耸的钟楼在周围建筑中显得突出。街道两侧是商店和餐馆，招牌清晰可见，如'Marks & Spencer'和'Jones's'。人们在街道上行走，有的步行，有的骑自行车，营造出一种日常生活的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the exterior façade of a building, photographed from a low, upward-looking angle. The building is a pale cream or off-white color, with a slightly aged surface showing cracks, stains, and weathering.

Across the middle of the image is a large dark blue or nearly black sign reading **“Société Marseillaise de Crédit”** in raised, serif-style letters. To the right of the lettering is a large blue five-pointed star logo mounted on the wall. The sign appears to belong to a French bank or financial institution.

Above the sign, a long white horizontal light fixture or awning runs across the façade. Higher up, there is a narrow balcony with a rusted metal railing. The railing has a decorative crisscross pattern, but it is heavily weathered with orange-brown rust marks. Behind the balcony are closed metal roller shutters covering tall windows; the shutters are grey-white and appear dirty or streaked from age and exposure.

Small anti-bird spikes are visible along the ledges and balcony edge. Below the sign, part of a recessed entrance can be seen, including a dark, decorative metal doorway or grille with geometric patterns. The overall impression is of an older urban building with elegant architectural details, but with noticeable wear, rust, and grime from age.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示'Marseillaise de Crédit'公司标志的摄影图像。标志位于建筑物的一侧，采用黑色字体和蓝色背景，上方装饰有一个星形图案。建筑本身是白色的，有几处明显的磨损痕迹，显示出一定的历史感。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an ornate historic building façade, likely in a European or Russian city. The architecture is richly decorated in a classical or neo-baroque style, with cream and beige stonework, sculptural details, and elaborate molding.

Across the upper center of the façade is a long rectangular gold mosaic sign. It has dark reddish-brown Cyrillic lettering reading: **“Первое Общество Взаимнаго Кредита.”** This translates roughly to **“First Mutual Credit Society.”** The spelling uses an older Russian form, suggesting a pre-revolutionary or historically styled inscription. At both ends of the sign are small colorful floral mosaic ornaments, including blue and red flower motifs with green accents.

Below the sign is a large arched window framed by heavy decorative stonework. The window has warm brown wooden frames and reflective blue glass, mirroring the sky or surrounding buildings. Around the arch are sculptural figures and ornamental carvings. Two pale stone female figures flank the arch: one on the left leans inward near the top of the arch, while another on the right holds what appears to be a cornucopia or cluster of fruit, symbolizing abundance. Their faces are softly rendered or weathered, giving them a classical statue-like appearance.

On either side of the arch are vertical decorative panels with intricate reliefs, including scrolls, floral garlands, shields, and crown-like forms. The façade features strong horizontal bands of rusticated stone blocks, adding depth and texture. Above the sign is a projecting cornice supported by many small ornate brackets with curled volute-like details. There is also a balustrade visible near the top right.

The color palette is warm and refined: beige stone, white sculptural ornamentation, gold mosaic, dark red lettering, and amber-brown window frames. The overall impression is of a grand, prestigious financial or institutional building from an earlier era, carefully restored or well preserved.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示俄罗斯建筑细节的照片，特写了一栋建筑物的精致立面。图像中心是一个装饰性的拱门，上方悬挂着金色的俄文铭牌，上面写着'ПЕРВОЕ ОБЩЕСТВО ВЗАИМНОГО КРЕДИТА'（第一共和国信用合作社）。拱门两侧各有一个雕塑，左侧的雕塑呈现一个男性形象，右侧的雕塑则描绘了一个女性形象。建筑物的立面上还有其他精细的装饰元素和窗户，整体上呈现出一种古典而优雅的风格。

caption:
The image shows an elegant museum or gallery room displaying metalwork—likely silver and gilded decorative objects—inside tall glass display cases.

The space has deep blue walls, a light wooden parquet floor, and high ceilings with track lighting. Multiple spotlights are mounted overhead, aimed down at the exhibits. Large windows on the left allow bright daylight into the room, creating strong reflections across the glass cases.

The displays are arranged in a grid-like layout, with many black-framed glass vitrines of different sizes. Some are tall, rectangular cases enclosing individual objects, while others are lower black plinths with glass covers or open glass boxes above them. The dark frames and glossy black bases contrast with the reflective metallic objects inside.

Several gold and silver-toned objects are visible:

- In the left foreground, a small polished gold vessel or decorative pitcher sits on a black pedestal inside a glass case. Its curved shape catches the light brightly.
- Near the center, a larger ornate gold or brass urn-like piece with handles is displayed in a tall case.
- In the lower right foreground, a small lidded gold cup or pot rests on a square black display base, with a museum label panel attached to the front.
- Farther back and to the right, more metal objects—possibly trays, candlesticks, bowls, cups, and ceremonial vessels—are arranged on pedestals.
- On the far right, a silver tray or shallow dish with gold details is visible inside another display case.

Black information labels with white text are attached to many of the plinths, though the text is mostly too small to read clearly. The glass surfaces create layered reflections, so the cases, frames, and objects repeat visually throughout the scene, giving the room a dense, mirrored appearance.

A white doorway with decorative molding is visible toward the back of the room, with a green emergency exit sign above or near it. On the far left, there is a partial reflection or silhouette of a person standing near the displays.

Overall, the image captures a refined museum exhibition of precious metal objects, with a calm, formal atmosphere shaped by blue walls, polished wood flooring, black display furniture, and the shimmering reflections of glass and metal.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示博物馆内部的摄影照片，其中多个透明玻璃展柜内陈列着精致的文物。每个展柜都装有照明设备，使得展品在柔和的灯光下显得更加引人注目。展览空间由深蓝色的墙壁和木质地板构成，营造出一种庄重而专业的氛围。通过玻璃窗可以看到外面的自然光线，为室内提供了额外的照明效果。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a modern multi-level building, photographed from a low angle looking upward through an open stairwell or atrium. The perspective is tilted, giving the scene a dynamic, geometric feel.

In the foreground, a wide staircase with polished wooden steps rises diagonally from the lower right toward the center. The wood has a warm brown tone with visible grain and a glossy finish. Alongside the stairs are white metal railings made of closely spaced vertical bars or mesh panels. A light-colored wooden handrail runs along the top of the railing.

Bright linear lights are integrated along the railings and edges of the walkways, creating strong white glowing outlines. These lights emphasize the angular shapes of the staircases, landings, and balconies. The railings form repeated patterns of fine vertical and horizontal lines.

Above the stairs, several levels of balconies and walkways are visible. The upper levels have more white metal guardrails and mesh-like barriers, giving the space an industrial or institutional architectural style. At the very top, a grid of square ceiling or wall panels is lit with warm amber light, contrasting with the cooler white lighting on the railings below.

The ceiling areas are painted in neutral beige or gray tones. Exposed pipes and conduits run across the ceilings and walls, adding to the modern industrial look. A green illuminated emergency exit sign is visible near the center-right, mounted under a landing. There are also small circular ceiling fixtures, possibly smoke detectors or lights.

On the right side, dark glass windows or interior glass panels reflect some of the light. The entire scene is dominated by diagonals, layered railings, stair flights, and glowing edges, creating a sense of depth and height. There are no people visible, and the space appears clean, quiet, and contemporary, possibly inside a university, office building, museum, or public facility.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑内部楼梯的摄影作品。图像中心是一个木质楼梯，其表面呈现出温暖的棕色调，与金属栏杆形成对比。楼梯两侧是黑色的玻璃墙，反射出周围的光线和结构。楼梯上方的天花板上安装了白色的LED灯条，它们在楼梯间投射出明亮的线条状光斑。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而现代的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a high-angle, overhead view of a busy urban temple entrance area, likely in Asakusa, Tokyo. Dominating the center is a large traditional Japanese gate or temple structure with a broad gray tiled roof. The roof has tightly arranged cylindrical tiles running vertically down the slope, with decorative ridge tiles and slightly upturned eaves at the corners. The sunlight is strong, creating sharp shadows and emphasizing the texture and pattern of the roof.

Beneath the roof are vivid red-orange pillars supporting the structure, with green fence-like panels along the lower sections. A large red-and-black lantern is partially visible hanging under the gate, suggesting a famous temple entrance. Stone guardian figures or carved architectural ornaments appear near the base of the structure on either side.

At street level, many people are gathered around the gate and walking through the surrounding plaza. The crowd includes tourists and visitors in dark coats, casual clothing, and a few brighter outfits; some appear to be taking photos or waiting near the entrance. Long shadows stretch across the pavement, indicating bright sunlight and possibly a low sun angle.

Behind and around the traditional gate are dense modern commercial buildings. On the right side of the image, a huge billboard advertisement features a can of Asahi Super Dry beer. The ad includes English and Japanese text, with prominent words such as “Asahi,” “SUPER DRY,” “KARAKUCHI,” and “350ml.” The silver beer can graphic contrasts sharply with the historic architecture beside it. A yellow portion of the advertisement continues off the right edge.

In the background, narrow shopping streets and rooftops are visible, including another long building with a pale green roof and storefront signs with Japanese characters. The overall scene captures a striking contrast between old and new Japan: a traditional temple gate crowded with visitors, surrounded by modern signage, advertisements, and commercial buildings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统建筑和现代广告牌的摄影图像。图中，一座具有鲜明红色屋顶和白色墙壁的传统日式建筑位于画面中央，其屋顶上覆盖着典型的黑色瓦片。周围是熙熙攘攘的人群，他们似乎在参观或行走于建筑前。建筑物左侧有一块巨大的啤酒广告牌，上面印有Asahi品牌的标志和文字。整个场景被拍摄在一个晴朗的日子里，阳光照耀下，色彩对比鲜明，营造出一种热闹而传统的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright outdoor scene on a sunny day, photographed from a low angle on a grassy hillside. Most of the frame is filled with a wide, clear blue sky, creating a strong sense of open space.

Near the lower center-right of the image, a person is standing or leaning on the slope with their back turned to the camera. They are wearing a green long-sleeved shirt, a tan or light-brown cap, and grayish pants. Around them or in front of them is a large, crumpled black plastic sheet or bag, possibly a tarp or trash bag, spread over the grass.

The foreground and lower portion of the scene are covered in dense, vivid green vegetation, with clover-like plants and small wildflowers scattered throughout. The slope rises from the bottom of the image toward the person, emphasizing the low viewpoint.

In the background to the right, a tall metal electrical transmission tower stands against the sky. Multiple power lines extend diagonally across the upper-right portion of the image, adding strong geometric lines that contrast with the natural greenery. The lighting is harsh and direct, suggesting midday sun, with crisp colors and minimal cloud cover. Overall, the image combines rural or open-land scenery with utility infrastructure and a lone worker-like figure on a grassy embankment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外清洁活动的照片，一位穿着绿色上衣和深色裤子的人站在覆盖着绿色植被的山坡上，正弯腰处理一个黑色的大垃圾袋。背景中可以看到几根高耸的电线塔和清晰的蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a lush vertical garden wall densely covered with many kinds of green plants. The surface is packed with foliage of different textures and shades: long grass-like clumps with thin arching blades, broad rounded leaves, small fern-like plants, variegated yellow-green shrubs, and patches of reddish or purplish leaves. The vegetation forms a rich, uneven tapestry across the entire frame, suggesting a living wall or planted façade.

Mounted over the greenery is a bright red tubular outline, like a neon sign or painted metal piping. The red line creates a stylized, abstract drawing. On the right side it resembles the outline of a standing human figure with a rounded head, a face profile, a narrow body, and legs. In the center-lower area, the same red line forms a heart shape inside or near the torso area. To the left, another large curved red outline sweeps outward in a broad loop, adding to the decorative, graphic quality of the installation.

At the bottom left corner, partially cropped, there is a vivid red waste bin or trash container with a dark green lid. Its color closely matches the red outline mounted on the wall, creating a strong contrast against the surrounding greens.

The overall scene feels like an urban environmental installation: a living plant wall combined with a bold red graphic element and a recycling or waste bin below. The composition is visually striking because of the contrast between the organic, dense plant textures and the smooth, artificial red linework.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代艺术风格的垂直花园的照片。图像中心是一个由红色金属丝制成的心形和公鸡形状，它们被设计成一种装饰性图案，悬挂在覆盖着各种绿色植物的墙面上。墙面由不同类型的绿植组成，包括常青树、草本植物和一些小型花卉，呈现出丰富的绿色调和自然美。在图片的左下角，有一个醒目的红色垃圾桶，为这个绿色空间增添了一抹鲜艳的颜色对比。

caption:
The image shows three horses grazing in a green pasture on a farm or ranch.

In the foreground, two horses are closest to the camera, both with their heads lowered as they eat grass. The horse on the left is mostly dark brown with a glossy coat, black lower legs, and a long dark mane that falls down the side of its neck. Its tail is long and dark, hanging nearly to the grass. It is standing side-on, facing slightly right, with its neck bent down into the grass.

The horse on the right is a dark brown-and-white pinto-patterned horse. It has large white patches across its neck, shoulder, and legs, with darker brown areas over much of its body. Its mane is mostly dark with lighter strands near the top, and it also has its head down grazing. One of its front legs is bright white, standing out against the green grass.

In the background to the left, a third horse is partially visible, facing away from the camera near the fence line. It also has a brown-and-white coat pattern, with a white patch across its back and darker brown hindquarters. Its head is obscured by greenery and distance.

The pasture is filled with tall, fresh green grass covering most of the frame. Behind the horses is a fenced area with vertical posts and wire fencing, and farther back there is a white wooden rail fence running horizontally across the scene. Trees and leafy shrubs provide a green backdrop, with a few dry, tan patches of ground visible beyond the fence. The lighting suggests a bright outdoor day, and the overall mood is calm and pastoral.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两匹马在绿色草地上吃草的自然摄影风格照片。前景中，一匹全棕色的马和一匹带有白色斑点的棕白相间的马正在低头吃草。背景中，可以看到另一匹马和白色的围栏，以及一些树木。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit historic fortress or city gate built from pale beige brick and earthen materials, set against a clear, vivid blue sky. The architecture has a distinctly Central Asian/Islamic character, with two large cylindrical towers flanking a central entrance. Each tower is topped with a rounded, dome-like cap made of the same light brick, and the brickwork forms horizontal bands and subtle decorative textures across the surfaces.

Between the towers is a crenellated wall section with small ornamental merlons along the top, shaped almost like repeated finials. Below them are tall pointed arch openings and recessed panels, creating a rhythmic pattern across the façade. The main doorway at the center is framed by a large pointed arch and a richly decorated wooden or golden-toned entrance frame. Inside the shadowed doorway, a small shop or stall is visible, with colorful items hanging or displayed near the entrance.

On the left side of the image, an older-looking mud-brick defensive wall or bastion rises beside the more refined gate structure. It has a rougher texture, sloped sides, and simple crenellations along the top, suggesting an ancient fortification.
