Nearby is a shorter, rounded, reflective blue-glass building marked **“AECOM”** in large white letters near the roofline.

On the left side of the central cluster, several mid- and high-rise buildings display corporate signage, including **“Deloitte”** on a dark glass building and **“Aon”** on a smaller tower behind it. Farther left near the lower edge, a white building labeled **“ONE WILSHIRE”** is visible. There are also cranes and construction elements near the lower-left area, suggesting ongoing development.

In the foreground and lower portion of the image, shorter apartment and office buildings fill the frame, with balconies, flat rooftops, mechanical equipment, and varied façades in white, beige, gray, and reddish tones. The overall composition is slightly tilted, making the buildings appear to lean diagonally, which adds a dynamic, panoramic feel. The lighting is strong and even, with minimal shadows, emphasizing the glass reflections and the geometric patterns of windows across the skyline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市天际线的摄影图像，画面中心是几栋高耸入云的摩天大楼，它们的玻璃幕墙在阳光下反射出耀眼的光芒。最左侧的大楼顶部装有卫星天线，而右侧则有一座独特的塔楼，其设计简约且线条流畅。在这些建筑之间，可以看到一些较低矮的建筑群，颜色较为柔和，与周围的高楼形成对比。整个场景被晴朗的蓝天和少量的云朵所环绕，营造出一种宁静而繁忙的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque street scene in what appears to be an old European town, featuring traditional half-timbered buildings under a clear blue sky.

The architecture is the main focus. Several adjoining buildings fill the frame, with dark wooden beams forming decorative geometric patterns across cream and pale-colored plaster walls. The façades have a distinctly historic Alsatian or Germanic style, with many shuttered windows, small wrought-iron railings, and steep tiled roofs.

On the right-hand building, a sign on the wall reads **“Chez Hansi Restaurant”** in ornate lettering. The restaurant occupies the lower level of a warm ochre-colored building with arched stone-framed windows. Beneath the windows are flower boxes with small red and pink flowers. Two black wall lanterns hang near the sign and windows, adding to the old-town atmosphere.

Above the restaurant, the upper stories feature dark timber framing and pale infill panels. Several windows have gray-brown wooden shutters, some open and some closed. The roof has reddish-brown tiles, and small dormer-style windows are visible near the top.

On the left side, a neighboring half-timbered building has a prominent projecting bay window with multiple panes and lace curtains. The bay is dark wood with cream decorative panels and triangular motifs. Above it is a small balcony or terrace with a metal railing, and several antennas rise from the rooftops.

Near the top right, part of a large decorative hanging sign is visible, with a curved metal structure and a bright white oval or shield-like panel. It is partly cropped by the edge of the image.

At street level, a large planter filled with colorful flowers sits near an arched doorway on the left. In the lower right corner, a man in a dark hoodie is walking past or gesturing toward the building, partially cropped by the frame.

The overall scene feels sunny and lively, with strong daylight casting shadows on the façades and emphasizing the textures of the timber, stone, shutters, and old plaster.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲传统建筑风格的照片，建筑物具有典型的半木结构设计，外墙装饰着深色的百叶窗和浅色的木板。建筑物的一侧有一个大型的圆形时钟，下方有'Chez Hansi Restaurant'的标识，表明这是一个餐厅。在照片的前景中，可以看到一位男性行人正在经过，他穿着休闲服装，正从画面左侧走向右侧。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor themed food stall or restaurant area set against a large Egyptian-style facade, likely in an amusement park, fair, or themed entertainment venue.

In the background, a massive tan and sandstone-colored wall is decorated to resemble ancient Egyptian architecture. It features large panels filled with hieroglyphic-style symbols, painted relief scenes, and murals of ancient Egyptian figures. On the upper left portion, the word “EGYPT” appears in red letters, and near the center top there is Arabic text in red, likely meaning “Egypt.” A large pharaoh mask or sarcophagus headpiece, resembling Tutankhamun’s golden mask with blue stripes, projects from the facade. The wall also includes tall rectangular architectural columns and cutout shapes, giving it a temple-like appearance.

On the right side of the mural, several painted Egyptian figures are shown in profile, wearing traditional ancient Egyptian-style clothing and wigs. Some appear to be holding objects or performing ritual actions. The entire wall has a weathered, sandy texture meant to imitate carved stone or papyrus.

In the foreground is a brightly lit food kiosk with a large sign reading “TURKISH ENERGY” in big red letters on a dark blue fascia. Around the sign are illuminated food photos advertising items such as fried shrimp, fish and bread, calamari rings, and other seafood dishes. Smaller menu boards and food posters cover the lower front of the stall, showing plates of fried seafood, sauces, wraps, and drinks.

The kiosk roof is decorated with rounded dome-like structures painted in warm orange-brown tones with dark bands, echoing Middle Eastern or North African architectural styles. A string of colorful bulbs—green, red, blue, orange, and white—hangs across the front and above the kiosk, creating a festive atmosphere. More hanging white bulbs are arranged under the awning.

Several people are visible near the lower center and right of the image, seated or standing around the food stall area, though their faces are blurred. There are railings, posts, fans, and small tables or counters in front of the kiosk. A palm tree is partly visible on the far left, reinforcing the outdoor, tourist-attraction feel.

The sky is clear and pale blue, suggesting daytime or early evening. Overall, the scene combines an Egyptian-themed architectural backdrop with a lively food-court stall selling Turkish-style or seafood fast food, decorated with colorful lights and large, eye-catching signage.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示埃及风格主题餐厅外观的照片。餐厅的正面装饰有大型壁画，描绘了古代埃及的建筑和人物，营造出一种异国情调的氛围。餐馆的名字'TURKISH ENERGY'以红色字体突出显示在门面上方，下方是各种食物的图片广告。一位工作人员站在门前，身穿蓝色上衣，正忙于准备食物或饮料。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，给人一种温馨而欢迎的感觉。

caption:
The image is taken from inside a building, looking outward through a large open doorway into a sunlit courtyard or garden. The doorway dominates the frame and acts like a strong visual border around the outdoor scene. On both sides are tall, heavy-looking doors made of dark olive or bronze-colored metal, covered with rows of round rivets or studs. The doors are opened outward, creating a symmetrical frame. The interior walls around the door are pale blue-white, and the inside floor is darker, with irregular stone-like patterns. Small wooden benches or tables are partially visible in the lower left and lower right corners.

Outside, the light is much brighter. A stone-paved courtyard stretches from the doorway toward a central monument. The paving consists of light-colored rectangular and irregular stone slabs, with some scattered leaves or small debris on the ground.

At the center of the outdoor view is a white stone statue on a tall pedestal. The statue appears to depict a robed figure standing upright, one arm raised high holding a sword or similar object. The figure’s other arm extends outward. At the base of the statue there are sculptural elements, possibly smaller figures or symbolic forms. The pedestal has inscriptions on it, including several lines of text in different scripts, though the words are not clearly readable from this distance.

Behind and around the statue are tall evergreen trees with dense green foliage, creating a shaded, park-like background. Their trunks and branches frame the statue, and patches of bright blue sky peek through the leaves. Low stone walls, plants, and garden features are visible around the base of the trees.

Several people are walking or standing in the courtyard. On the left, a person in a striped red, white, and blue shirt walks across the scene. Near the center foreground, an older woman with light hair, wearing light-colored clothing and carrying a dark shoulder bag, walks past the statue. On the right, a man in a light shirt and cropped pants stands facing the monument, possibly looking at it or taking a photo.

The overall composition is very balanced: the dark interior and heavy doors frame the bright outdoor courtyard, drawing attention toward the white statue in the center. The contrast between the shaded doorway and the sunlit garden gives the image a sense of depth and quiet observation, as if the viewer is standing just inside a chapel, museum, or historic building looking out onto a memorial garden.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外雕塑和周围环境的照片。图像中心是一座高耸的白色雕塑，位于一个开阔的空间中，背景是茂密的树木。雕塑前方有三个人物：最左边是一个穿着条纹衣服的人正在走路，中间是一位女性游客正站在雕塑前拍照，而右侧则有一位男性游客在观看雕塑。照片通过一扇半开的木门拍摄，门的颜色与周围的墙壁形成对比，为场景增添了一种邀请参观的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a quiet urban street during light snowfall, likely in a Japanese town or city. The scene is viewed from the side of a road, with the foreground in sharper focus and the background softly blurred.

In the lower-left foreground stands a narrow, weathered brown metal sign mounted on a pole. It has large white Japanese characters written vertically: 「駐車禁止」, meaning “No Parking.” The sign is rusty and damp, with dark speckles and streaks from moisture, giving it an aged appearance.

To the right of the sign is a low hedge or planted area covered in fresh snow. The snow lies unevenly across green and yellowish leaves, creating a textured white layer with bits of foliage peeking through. A large tree trunk rises from this snowy planted strip, supported by wooden braces or ropes near its base. More trees with snow-dusted branches line the area, adding to the wintry atmosphere.

The road on the left is wet and dark, reflecting the cold weather and recent snowfall. It curves or slopes gently into the distance, where a crosswalk, pedestrians, and a small vehicle can be seen. Several people are walking along the sidewalks and crossing the street, bundled in winter clothing, though they are blurred due to the depth of field.

In the background are red-brick and dark-colored buildings, parked vehicles, and rooftops lightly covered with snow. A red traffic light is visible in the distance on the right side. Snowflakes are falling throughout the frame, visible as small white streaks and dots against the darker trees and buildings.

Overall, the image has a calm, chilly, overcast mood, capturing a snowy day in a Japanese urban neighborhood with a focus on the “No Parking” sign and the snow-covered landscaping beside the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本街道的照片，画面中心是一个标有日文的停车标志牌，旁边是被新雪覆盖的绿色植被。街道上可见几位行人和停放的车辆，远处是传统的日式建筑群。整个场景在冬季的氛围中显得宁静而美丽。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit countryside road curving through a lush green landscape. The road bends gently from the foreground toward the middle of the scene, with pale asphalt and faint white lane markings following the curve. Grassy banks line both sides, with some freshly cut or dry grass along the right shoulder.

Near the center-right of the image, a small vintage open-top red sports car is driving around the bend. It has a rounded, classic racing shape with prominent front fenders, circular headlights, a vertical silver grille, and a low windshield. A yellow race number “155” is visible on the front side panel, and a white number marking is painted on the hood. Two people are seated inside, both wearing dark caps; the passenger appears to be holding up a small camera or phone on a stick, as if recording or taking a photo.

The setting is very green and rural. Dense bushes, trees, and hedges surround the road, especially on the right side where the vegetation rises steeply. Some shrubs have clusters of small white flowers, and on the left side there are yellow wildflowers mixed into the greenery. In the background, a gated entrance or metal fence is partially visible at the end of a small dirt or gravel path. A small roadside sign stands near the bend behind the car.

The lighting suggests a bright, pleasant day, with sunlight illuminating the road and parts of the vegetation while deeper shadows fall under the trees. The overall scene feels like a countryside rally or classic car event taking place on a scenic rural route.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆红色复古跑车在蜿蜒的乡村道路上行驶的照片。车辆前方有两位穿着休闲装的乘客，他们似乎正在享受驾驶的乐趣。道路两旁是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛，营造出一种宁静而自然的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor event or festival on a sunny day, likely in a park or public plaza. A crowd of adults and children fills the background, moving between vendor tents and activity booths. Many faces appear intentionally blurred.

In the foreground, a child is balancing on a slackline or narrow strap stretched horizontally over a padded setup. The child is wearing a bright blue sleeveless shirt with a large shark graphic on the front, blue-and-white plaid shorts, white socks, and an orange wristband. He is holding hands with a woman standing to the right, who appears to be assisting or steadying him. She has long dark hair and is wearing a dark sleeveless top and dark shorts, also with an orange wristband. Her arm is extended toward the child, and their hands are clasped for balance.

The slackline area appears to be set up on top of mats or low platforms: there are black and yellow padded surfaces beneath the child, with a thin strap running across them. Some partial printed text is visible on the yellow mat near the lower right, though it is cut off by the frame. A pink rope or boundary line runs across the lower left portion of the scene, separating the activity area from the surrounding crowd.

Behind them, there are several white and dark canopy tents. Some branding is visible on banners and tents, including “lapierrebikes” and tall black flags with “RALEIGH” printed vertically. This suggests a bike-related event or expo, though the foreground activity is balance-oriented rather than cycling. People in casual summer clothing—T-shirts, shorts, hats, and sunglasses—stand and walk around the booths. A boy in a blue shirt in the mid-right background has one arm raised near a white tent.

The lighting is bright and natural, with strong sunlight and dappled shadows from nearby trees. The background is filled with green foliage, indicating the event is taking place in a leafy outdoor setting. Overall, the image captures a lively community fair or sports demonstration, with a child trying a balance activity while being helped by an adult amid a bustling crowd.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉户外活动场景的照片，一位穿着蓝色T恤和格子短裤的男孩正在跳过一根绳子。他的表情专注而坚定，身体微微前倾，双脚分开站立，准备起跳。旁边是一位女性，她身穿黑色无袖上衣和牛仔短裤，正伸手帮助男孩跨过绳子。周围是其他参加活动的人群，他们站在不同的摊位前或在交谈。背景中可以看到几个带有标志的帐篷和其他参与者，营造出一种热闹的社区活动氛围。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a modern café entrance, branded as **“the fab4 cafe”**, associated with **The Beatles Story**. The building façade is made up of large, dark-framed glass panels set into a pale stone or tiled exterior wall.

A prominent feature is the large graphic display on the upper glass panels: four stylized black-and-white portrait illustrations of The Beatles, arranged in a two-by-two grid. Each portrait is simplified, using bold black hair shapes and pale faces against alternating black and light horizontal bands. The top-left face appears partially blurred or obscured, while the other three portraits are clear.

Below the portraits, on the lower-left window, large white lettering reads **“the fab4 cafe”**, with the number **4** in bright red. Beneath that, smaller text reads **“@ THE BEATLES STORY”**. The typography is modern and rounded, standing out sharply against the dark reflective glass.

In the center lower portion is a glass entrance door with a black vertical handle. Reflections in the glass show parts of the street and surrounding area. Inside or just behind the glass, café furniture is visible, including metal chairs and tables.

Outside on the pavement are several silver metal café chairs and small round tables, suggesting outdoor seating. The ground is paved with large rectangular stone slabs. The overall setting feels like a contemporary urban attraction or museum café, with the Beatles-themed graphics serving as the main visual identity.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的咖啡馆外观的照片。照片中心是一个带有四个圆框图案的大型玻璃窗户，每个圆框内都描绘了一个男性头部的轮廓，每个头部旁边都有一个黑色的“4”字。窗户下方是店铺的入口，上方有黑色字体写着'fab 4 cafe'。在图片的前景，可以看到几把白色的金属椅子和桌子，它们被放置在一个开放的空间里，等待顾客使用。

caption:
The image shows a close-up outdoor portrait of a person sitting on grass in a sunny area. Their face is intentionally blurred, but the rest of the scene is clear.

The person has a short, partially shaved hairstyle with green-dyed hair on top and a longer thin green strand falling to one side. Some lighter/blond hair is visible near the back/side. They are wearing a sleeveless black shirt with a large rectangular black-and-white graphic on the front. Around their neck are several accessories, including a black choker-like band, cords, beads, a triangular pendant, and two round bell-like ornaments. A tan/brown fabric bag or pouch with rope-like straps crosses their chest and rests in the foreground.

The setting appears to be a park or garden. Behind the person are two tall palm tree trunks with textured gray bark. The ground is covered in green grass, with bright sunlight creating patches of light and shadow. In the background there is an old-looking brick or stone wall in warm beige and reddish tones, slightly out of focus. To the right behind the person, a dark backpack and a pair of teal-and-white sneakers are partially visible.

The photo has a shallow depth of field: the person’s upper body and accessories are the main focus, while the background wall, trees, and objects are softly blurred. The lighting is natural and bright, suggesting it was taken during the day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性坐在户外的照片。她穿着一件黑色背心，上面印有白色图案和文字，脖子上挂着一条蓝色的项链。她的头发是绿色的短发，并且在头部周围扎着几根小辫子。她的一只手拿着一个旧式的棕色皮包，另一只手放在腿上。背景中可以看到一些树木和岩石，以及远处模糊的草地和天空。

caption:
The image shows the finish area of an outdoor running event or marathon. A wide race lane is set up on a paved road, divided into two carpeted sections: a red carpet on the left and a pale white or light-gray carpet on the right. Rows of small traffic cones line the route—orange cones along the sides and blue cones separating the lanes.

At the top of the scene, two large digital race clocks hang from a white overhead structure. The left clock displays red LED numbers reading approximately **01:07:17**, while the right clock displays blue/white LED numbers reading approximately **00:46:54**. Behind the clocks is a large leafy tree canopy, providing shade over much of the finish area.

Several runners are visible. In the foreground, a runner in a bright, multicolored shirt and black shorts is walking or jogging toward the camera on the red carpet. Their race bib is visible, and their face appears blurred. On the right lane, a few runners in light blue and green event shirts are approaching the finish area, also with race bibs. One runner in the right foreground wears black shorts and red running shoes.

On the far left, there is a tall vertical event banner or arch panel with Thai text and logos, including medical or hospital-style symbols. The panel has a turquoise and green design with illustrated building graphics near the bottom. Metal barricades, gates, and fencing appear around the course edges, helping guide participants through the finish zone.

In the background, beyond the cones and open gate, there are parked vehicles including a black pickup truck and a light blue car. A few people stand or move near the course, possibly volunteers, staff, or other participants. The overall setting looks like a community sports event held near a gated outdoor facility, with trees, open space, and a bright daytime atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外跑步活动的照片，一位女性跑者正穿过终点线，她穿着彩色图案的运动装备，表情专注。在她的后方，可以看到其他几位穿着运动服的跑者正在继续他们的比赛。终点线旁边有一块红色地毯和蓝色的路障，背景中有一些树木和停放的车辆。整个场景被阳光照耀着，营造出一种积极和活力的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a cozy, modest indoor seating or reading area, possibly in a small office, community room, waiting area, or café-like space.

In the foreground, there is a long rectangular table covered with a green-and-white checkered plastic tablecloth. On top of it are several reading materials: an open book with dense Korean text, a folded newspaper, and another open book or magazine near the bottom edge. A small glass or plastic vase holding dark burgundy artificial flowers sits near the center-left of this table. Around the table are low bench-style seats with thick yellow-green cushions decorated with large circular floral patterns.

To the left and slightly farther back is another matching table, also covered in the same green checkered cloth. It has more magazines, brochures, and open printed materials spread across it. Another small vase with dark red flowers sits on this table as well. Beneath and beside the tables are more cushioned bench seats, suggesting a low, informal seating arrangement.

The back wall is cream-colored with a dark gray lower panel running horizontally along it. Several framed items hang or lean against the wall. Near the center are two framed certificates or awards with Korean writing, mounted side by side in light wooden frames. To the right, a large framed floral picture leans against the wall; it shows a basket or arrangement of flowers in soft colors. Farther right, part of another framed landscape painting is visible, showing a green meadow and distant mountains. A smaller framed blue-toned floral or decorative print hangs above the floral picture.

On the left side of the image is a large gray metal cabinet or utility unit with panels, vents, and compartments. It has a somewhat worn, industrial look. Mounted on or near it is a bright yellow electrical box with cables running down and along the wall. Next to this area is a green wall-mounted brochure or magazine rack filled with pamphlets, some of which appear to have Korean text and colorful covers.

The floor is a warm-toned wood or laminate, giving the room a slightly homey feeling despite the utilitarian elements like the metal cabinet and exposed wires. Overall, the space feels like a small public or semi-public room arranged for reading, waiting, or casual conversation, with simple furnishings, Korean-language materials, framed decorations, and a lived-in, practical atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内环境的照片，其中包含一张长形的绿色格子桌布桌子，桌上摆放着几本打开的杂志和一本报纸。桌子上还有一盆红色花朵装饰品。在桌子旁边，墙上挂着多幅画作和一个绿色的文件柜。房间内还有几个黄色的椅子和一些靠垫，整个场景显得温馨而舒适。

caption:
The image shows a long, rustic red-brown brick or laterite stone wall running diagonally from the lower left foreground toward the upper right, creating a strong sense of depth and perspective. The wall is very tall and textured, with rough, porous blocks laid in horizontal courses. Pale mortar lines form an irregular grid across the surface, and the lower portion of the wall is darker, almost blackened in places, suggesting age, moisture staining, or weathering.

Near the upper part of the wall, a decorative horizontal band projects outward slightly, made up of layered ridges that run the length of the structure. Above this, the wall continues up to a sloped roof edge. The roof has a traditional appearance, with dark wooden rafters or beams visible beneath the overhang and a line of small roof tiles along the top. The underside of the eaves is shadowed, contrasting with the warm reddish wall.

On the left side of the image, a narrow dirt pathway runs alongside the wall. It is shaded in patches by nearby trees, with scattered leaves and small debris on the ground. At the far left, partially visible, there appears to be a small entrance or doorway area with a reddish door or panel and a few steps leading up to it. A low raised curb or drainage channel follows the base of the wall, bordered by a smooth reddish-brown ledge. Small green plants and moss grow along the base, especially in damp-looking areas.

The upper left corner is filled with leafy green tree branches extending into the frame. The leaves cast dappled shadows and add a lush, natural contrast to the heavy, earthy architecture. The sky above the wall is bright and mostly washed out, suggesting strong daylight. Overall, the scene has a quiet, historic, tropical feel, emphasizing the age, craftsmanship, and weathered texture of the long red wall.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老红砖墙的摄影图像。墙壁表面粗糙，由大小不一的红砖组成，砖缝中可见绿色植物生长。墙面呈现出自然的风化痕迹，如剥落和侵蚀。在墙的右侧，可以看到一段小路，两旁有树木和灌木丛，阳光透过树叶洒在地面上，营造出一种宁静而古老的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an old stone church in a rural or village setting on a bright, clear day. The building is made of pale flint and stone, giving the walls a mottled beige, cream, and brown texture. On the left side is a square church tower with a crenellated parapet at the top, resembling battlements. Near the upper part of the tower is a tall Gothic arched window with decorative tracery, and below it is a smaller quatrefoil-style opening.

The main body of the church extends to the right, with a dark slate roof and several arched windows set into the stone walls. The entrance is visible near the center-right, framed by a pointed Gothic arch, with wooden double doors. Above and around the doorway are additional stone details, including a small gabled porch-like structure and decorative masonry. A wooden bench sits against the church wall near the base of the tower.

In the foreground, there is a churchyard with green grass and several gravestones, especially clustered on the left side and near the lower edge of the image. Some graves have flowers placed beside them. A low boundary wall made of brick and flint runs across the front of the scene, with a small wooden picket gate or fence section near the center. On the right side near the wall is a noticeboard or signboard with a dark wooden frame.

Large leafless trees dominate the scene, particularly a tall tree in the foreground on the right with a thick trunk and many twisting branches spreading across the upper half of the image. Another smaller tree stands on the left, with sparse red berries or remaining leaves on its branches. The bare branches cast shadows across the church walls, adding texture and pattern.

The sky is a deep, clear blue with no visible clouds, and the sunlight appears low and warm, illuminating the church from the left and creating strong shadows. In the background, beyond the churchyard, there are hints of houses and hedges, suggesting the church is located within a small village or residential area. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, historic, and quiet.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座传统风格教堂的摄影图像。教堂拥有一个高耸的尖顶塔楼，其石质结构在阳光下显得格外坚固和庄严。教堂前有一棵大树，树叶呈现出深秋的颜色，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。周围环境由修剪整齐的草坪、一些墓碑以及远处模糊的房屋构成，营造出一种宁静而历史悠久的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a traditional Japanese temple complex viewed from a wide, frontal perspective under a dramatic cloudy sky.

At the center is a large wooden temple hall with a broad, sweeping grey tiled roof. The roof has layered ceramic tiles and gently curved eaves, typical of classical Japanese Buddhist temple architecture. Along the upper ridge are small gold emblems or crests that stand out against the dark grey roof. The roofline is elegant and slightly upturned at the edges, giving the building a graceful, balanced appearance.

The front façade is richly detailed. Dark wooden pillars support an ornate entrance canopy with carved decorative panels. The carvings appear intricate, with flowing motifs and possibly dragons or floral designs. White and gold accents highlight some of the relief work. Beneath the eaves, small structural brackets and decorative elements create a rhythmic pattern. The building’s walls combine dark timber framing with pale panels and sliding-style windows or doors, including wooden latticework and translucent panels.

A set of wide stone steps leads up to the temple entrance. In front of the building is a clean courtyard, with a pale stone-paved walkway running from the bottom foreground directly toward the central hall. A narrow drainage channel with a metal grate runs along the right side of the walkway, emphasizing the symmetry and perspective.

On the right side of the image is another traditional wooden building, smaller but similarly styled, with a grey tiled roof and a prominent triangular gable. Its roof is also highly detailed, with layered tiles and decorative ridge ornaments. A low wooden fence runs in front of this structure, separating it from the gravel courtyard.

The courtyard itself is mostly covered in small grey and tan gravel, giving the scene a calm, orderly atmosphere. Near the center-right, a leafy green tree grows beside the main hall, softening the architectural lines and adding a fresh natural element.

On the far left foreground, there is a decorative metal or stone fixture with roof-tile-like ornamental forms and a gold crest, possibly part of a water basin, lantern, or temple ornament.

The sky dominates the upper part of the image, filled with heavy grey clouds. The overcast lighting gives the scene a subdued, serene mood, while also emphasizing the textures of the tiled roofs, weathered wood, stone paving, and gravel. Overall, the image conveys a peaceful, historic temple setting with refined craftsmanship and a dignified atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统建筑风格的寺庙的照片。寺庙位于画面中央，其木制结构和屋顶装饰精美，屋檐上饰有金色的装饰品。前方有一条由石板铺成的小径，引导视线至寺庙的大门。两侧是两座较小的建筑，它们的设计与主建筑相呼应，同样展现出传统的日式建筑风格。整个场景被阴云密布的天空覆盖，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street corner in what appears to be a dense city environment, likely Manhattan, with multiple layers of signage, billboards, street hardware, and tall brick buildings.

In the foreground, a dark green metal streetlight pole dominates the center of the frame. It has two rounded, dome-topped lamp fixtures with translucent glass covers, one higher and one lower, attached by curved metal arms. Various cables and support rods run from the pole across the scene, adding to the cluttered city-street feel.

Attached to the pole are several street and traffic signs. A black-and-white “ONE WAY” sign points to the right. Below it is a blue street sign reading “Seventh Ave,” mounted at an angle. Another blue street sign below reads “West 3…” with the rest partially obscured, likely indicating West 3rd Street. To the right are red and white parking regulation signs, including a prominent “No Standing” sign with hours listed, and a smaller “No Parking” sign with overnight restrictions.

Behind the pole, a large white billboard fills much of the upper background. It advertises GNC with bold text: “RESPECT YOURSELF” in gray, “GNC” in large red letters, and “LIVE WELL” below in red. Beneath that, another large billboard is partially visible, also for GNC, showing a black-and-white image of a muscular shirtless man flexing, with the text “ME ON…” and “RESPECT YOURSELF” partly visible on the right.

The billboards are mounted on or in front of tan and brown brick buildings with many rectangular windows, some with dark frames and decorative brickwork. On the far left, blue scaffolding runs vertically along the side of a building, suggesting construction or maintenance work. A “Van Wagner” sign is visible on the billboard structure, indicating the advertising company.

Overall, the image captures a layered New York-style streetscape: crowded signage, traffic rules, advertising, older brick architecture, scaffolding, and streetlights all compressed into a vertical urban view.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，前景中有一个绿色的路灯杆，上面装有多个交通标志和一个大型广告牌。广告牌上印有红色的文字“RESPECT YOURSELF GNC LIVE WELL”，下方是一个穿着运动服的男性形象，似乎在进行拳击动作。街道名称为'West 3rd St'，指示方向，而一个红绿灯显示着禁止左转的信号。背景中可以看到建筑物的一部分，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a bright, panoramic view of a picturesque historic European town, likely in Central Europe, nestled among green hills under a vivid blue sky.

In the foreground, a river curves along the lower left side of the scene, its dark blue-green water reflecting sunlight and bordered by trees and stone embankments. Along the riverbank are outdoor café terraces with rows of white umbrellas and red seating, suggesting a lively, tourist-friendly area. Dense green trees frame parts of the lower scene, adding contrast to the warm colors of the town.

The town itself is packed with closely clustered buildings, most of them painted in pale tones such as white, cream, peach, yellow, and soft pink. Nearly all the rooftops are covered in red or orange clay tiles, creating a striking, unified pattern across the cityscape. Many roofs have small dormer windows, chimneys, skylights, and steep gables, giving the town a historic, old-world character.

At the center of the image stands a large church with a tall, narrow spire. The church has a steep dark reddish-brown roof, pale walls, and a white tower with decorative details and a pointed steeple. It rises prominently above the surrounding rooftops, serving as the architectural focal point of the town.

Behind the town, rolling hills covered with forests, fields, and scattered houses stretch across the background. The hills are lush green with patches of golden sunlight, suggesting a warm, clear day. A few larger buildings and small residential clusters are visible on the slopes.

The sky occupies the upper half of the image and is bright turquoise-blue with large, soft white clouds drifting across it. The lighting is warm and saturated, making the red roofs, green hills, and blue sky appear especially vivid. Overall, the scene feels charming, historic, and peaceful, with a strong sense of European medieval or Renaissance town architecture set in a scenic natural landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲小镇风光的高分辨率摄影图像。图中，一条蜿蜒的河流穿过城镇中心，河岸两侧是色彩丰富的建筑群。最显眼的是位于画面中央的一座具有尖顶和红色屋顶的教堂，其周围分布着各种风格的房屋。远处的山坡上覆盖着绿色植被，与蓝天白云形成鲜明对比。整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一种温暖而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a small flower vendor’s vehicle parked along the edge of a park or garden area. The scene is framed in a wide, horizontal composition, with the vehicle and its attached trailer stretching across most of the lower half of the image.

In the foreground, there is a compact beige or dusty pink mini-van facing left. It has a slightly worn, utilitarian appearance, with small wheels, sliding side windows, and a boxy shape. Through the side windows, crates and produce boxes are visible inside, including red tomatoes and packaging with banana branding. On the roof of the van is a black metal rack loaded with plastic crates filled with flowers. The flowers are arranged in dense bunches, mostly chrysanthemums or similar blooms, in rich autumn colors: bright yellow, deep burgundy, red, white, and some orange tones.

Attached to the back of the van is a small blue trailer with a gray tarp-covered side panel. The trailer also has a metal roof rack holding more crates of flowers, dominated by vivid red and dark burgundy blossoms. Along the front side of the trailer, several stacked cardboard produce boxes are visible. Many are labeled “Premium Bananas,” with brands such as “derby” and “Bonita,” suggesting the vendor may reuse fruit boxes for transporting flowers. The trailer is connected to the van with a visible tow hitch and support jack.

Behind the vehicle is a park-like setting with grass, low hedges, and a black metal fence running horizontally. Tall trees fill the background, some evergreen and others with bare or sparse branches, giving the scene an autumn or early winter feel. Fallen leaves are scattered across the paved ground in the foreground. A large dark tree trunk rises near the right side of the image, partly obscuring the background.

In the distance, softly out of focus, there appears to be a pale stone statue or monument standing in the park. Behind it is a warm-toned building with classical architectural details, partially hidden by tree branches. There are also old-fashioned lamp posts and white tent-like structures in the background, suggesting a public square, market area, or landscaped urban park.

The overall atmosphere is calm and slightly misty, with soft natural light and muted colors. The bright flowers provide the strongest color contrast against the subdued tones of the van, pavement, trees, and overcast background. The image has a quiet, everyday market-street feeling, capturing a flower delivery or mobile flower stall paused beside a park.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆棕色小型货车和其拖车的摄影图像。货车顶部装有黄色和红色的鲜花，而拖车上则放着一些紫色的花朵。货车停在一个铺有石板的地面上，背景中可以看到树木和一些建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a live rock concert performance on a stage lit with intense blue and purple lighting.

In the foreground, a guitarist dominates the right side of the frame. He is wearing a plain black T-shirt and blue jeans, with a dark guitar strap over his shoulder. His face is deliberately blurred, making facial details unrecognizable. He is holding and playing a cream or off-white electric guitar with a light-colored fretboard. His left hand is positioned on the neck of the guitar, pressing the strings, while his right hand is near the body of the guitar, likely strumming or picking. The guitar body has a simple, rounded shape with chrome hardware and a visible control knob near the lower portion.

Behind him, slightly left of center, a drummer is partially visible at a drum kit. The drummer is seated and appears to be mid-performance, with arms raised near the cymbals or drums. The drum kit includes black toms and a white bass drum head with the “Pearl” logo clearly visible. Cymbals and microphone stands are also visible around the kit.

The background is dark and saturated with blue stage lighting, giving the entire scene a strong concert atmosphere. A large backdrop or banner is visible behind the musicians, though it is partly obscured by lighting and the performers. It appears to contain bold, blocky lettering and graphic shapes, possibly the name or logo of the band or event. On the right side behind the guitarist, there is an amplifier or speaker cabinet with a light-colored grille.

Overall, the image captures an energetic moment during a live music performance, with the guitarist in sharp focus in the foreground and the drummer and stage equipment adding depth and context in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张现场音乐会的摄影照片，主要展示了一位吉他手在舞台上的表演。他穿着黑色T恤和牛仔裤，正专注地弹奏着一把黄色的电吉他。他的姿态显示出演奏时的投入和专业性。背景中可以看到鼓手正在打鼓，而舞台上布满了蓝色的灯光，营造出一种充满活力的演出氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet landscaped park or church grounds on an overcast day. A paved driveway or walkway curves gently through the scene, leading toward a small wooden Orthodox-style chapel near the center-right. The chapel is built from reddish-brown logs and has a steep, conical roof topped with a shiny golden onion dome and a cross. Several smaller golden domes with crosses are visible around the roofline, partly obscured by bare tree branches.

The foreground includes neatly maintained grass borders and curbs along the pavement. On the lower left, there are decorative flower or mulch beds arranged in bold colored sections—red, blue, and green—forming curved patches around a small leafless tree. Short cream-colored bollards line parts of the path.

Tall trees dominate the scene, many of them leafless, suggesting late autumn, winter, or early spring. Their dark branches stretch across the pale blue-gray sky, creating a web-like pattern. Some evergreen trees and shrubs add green color around the chapel and along the left side of the park.

On the right side, there are ornate black streetlamps with multiple lanterns, giving the area a formal, historic feel. A small white security or guard booth sits near the right edge, and behind it are tall conical evergreen shrubs. In the far background, portions of city buildings and a street with traffic signs are visible, indicating that this peaceful chapel garden is located within an urban setting.

Overall, the image has a calm, orderly atmosphere, with the wooden church, bare trees, decorative lamps, and manicured grounds creating a serene park-like religious setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有传统木制建筑风格的教堂的照片。教堂位于一个公园内，周围环绕着光秃的树木和整齐排列的路灯。教堂前有一条铺有红色和蓝色砖块的道路，引导视线至教堂入口处。天空中散布着几朵云彩，为这个宁静的场景增添了一丝生动感。

caption:
The image shows a sunny outdoor road scene in a green, rural-looking area. In the foreground, a black motorcycle with a sidecar is driving toward the camera along a paved road. Two people are riding it: the driver sits on the motorcycle itself, while the passenger sits low in the sidecar. Both are wearing white T-shirts with small printed text/logos on the front and dark motorcycle helmets with visors, making their faces hard to see.

The driver is wearing a full-face dark helmet, black shorts, and dark sneakers. One hand is on the handlebar and the other is raised in a friendly wave. The motorcycle has round mirrors, chrome handlebars, a front number plate or rally badge marked “75,” and a visible license plate near the sidecar reading “UBN 483” with an “H” marking on the left side. The sidecar is glossy black, rounded, and reflects the light; its passenger is also waving with one hand raised above the sidecar edge.

The road curves gently through a bright landscape. On the left side, there is a sloped grassy embankment filled with tall green grass and wild plants. Behind it are leafy trees, and a low fence or barrier runs along the top of the slope. The sunlight is warm and strong, creating vivid greens and bright highlights on the grass and vehicles.

In the background to the right, two classic-looking cars are visible on the road. One is a light blue vintage car farther back, with people inside, and closer to the right edge is a white Volkswagen Beetle approaching in the opposite lane. The Beetle’s rounded headlights and curved hood are clearly visible. The overall scene feels like a cheerful vintage vehicle rally or casual road event, with riders waving as they pass through a scenic countryside road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位骑手在乡村道路上骑行的照片。前方的骑手戴着黑色头盔，身穿印有文字的白色T恤和深色短裤，正驾驶一辆带有侧边车的摩托车。后方的骑手也戴着头盔，穿着相似的服装，坐在侧边车上，似乎在挥手致意。背景中可以看到绿色的草地、几辆停放的汽车以及远处的树木，营造出一种宁静的乡村氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright orange-and-blue rescue boat moored indoors in a sheltered dock or boathouse. The vessel dominates the lower half of the scene and sits on calm greenish water, which reflects the hull and the large white lettering.

The boat’s hull is a vivid deep blue with large white text on the side reading **“SNS 242.”** Above the hull is a white deck edged with black railings. The cabin is painted bright orange with several rectangular windows framed in white and gray. On the cabin side, white lettering reads **“LES SAUVETEURS EN MER,”** indicating it belongs to the French sea-rescue organization. An orange covered life raft or equipment bundle is secured on top of the cabin.

Rising from the roof is a metal mast structure carrying antennas, lights, radar or navigation equipment, and small flags, including a French tricolor flag. There are also various marine fittings, ropes, rails, and deck hardware visible along the boat. At the rear right, part of an additional inflatable or smaller rescue craft can be seen, colored orange and blue, with an outboard motor attached.

The background is an old industrial concrete wall, weathered and stained with cracks, rust marks, holes, patches of moss or algae, and exposed seams. There are several rectangular openings or doorways in the wall, plus mounted lights and cables running horizontally. On the right side stands a tall orange vertical banner with French text, likely related to **“Les Sauveteurs en Mer.”**

The overall setting feels like a rescue station, harbor shelter, or historic dock facility. The contrast between the clean, brightly colored rescue vessel and the rough, aging concrete interior is striking. The water is still enough to create a clear upside-down reflection of the boat’s blue hull and white lettering.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘蓝色和橙色的船停靠在码头的照片。船体上清晰地标有'SNS 242'，并附有一个小型的红色救生艇。船后方有一名穿着深色衣服的人站在码头上，旁边是一个带有文字的红色旗帜。背景是一座老旧的建筑结构，墙壁上有涂鸦和剥落的油漆。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit historic square in Florence, Italy, likely Piazza della Signoria, framed dramatically by large sculptures in the foreground.

On the left side, very close to the camera, there is a monumental stone statue seen from behind and partly in shadow. The sculpture dominates the foreground: a curly-haired male head and shoulder appear low on the left, while the nude torso and legs of another figure rise vertically near the center-left. Because it is so close and shaded, the stone appears dark gray and heavily textured, with weathered marks and softened details.

Beyond the statue, the square opens into a broad public plaza filled with tourists and pedestrians. Small groups of people are scattered across the paved ground, walking, taking photos, talking, and gathering near the center. Their colorful summer clothing adds movement and contrast against the pale stone architecture.

Across the middle and right side of the image are elegant Renaissance-style buildings with warm yellow, cream, and tan façades. They have rows of tall windows with dark brown wooden shutters, arched doorways, stone trim, balconies, and red-tiled roofs. One large yellow building on the right has prominent stone corner blocks and repeated shuttered windows, giving it a stately, historic appearance. At street level, signs and shopfronts are visible, including a “BANCA TOSCANA” sign.

On the far right, part of an ornate fountain or sculptural group is visible. A tall white marble male figure stands on a pedestal, while a greenish bronze figure and other decorative elements surround the fountain base. The fountain area is bordered by railings, and its sculptural forms echo the large statue in the foreground.

The upper half of the image is dominated by a brilliant, cloudless blue sky, creating a strong contrast with the warm-toned buildings and the shadowed stone sculpture. The lighting suggests a bright afternoon, with sunlight illuminating the façades and plaza while the foreground statue remains in deep shade. The overall scene feels lively, historic, and architectural, combining classical sculpture, Renaissance urban design, and modern tourism in a famous Italian square.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场的摄影作品，前景左侧是一个古典风格的雕塑，其细节精致，包括肌肉线条和复杂的装饰。中景是繁忙的人群在广场上散步或聚集，而背景则是典型的欧洲建筑，有着统一的立面和窗户排列。整个场景被温暖的日光照亮，营造出一种宁静而活跃的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a marina waterfront under a wide, clear blue sky. The composition is panoramic, with the lower third filled by dark blue, gently rippling seawater and the middle band occupied by moored boats and modern pier buildings.

In the foreground, numerous small boats are docked side by side along the quay. They include white sailboats with tall masts, small motorboats, fishing boats, and cabin boats. Many have colorful details such as blue covers, red and orange buoys, ropes, railings, and painted trim. On the far right, larger green-and-white fishing boats are tied up, with equipment and rigging visible on their decks. The water reflects the boats and structures in broken, shimmering patterns.

Behind the boats is a long elevated pier or boardwalk supported by white columns. It connects several boxy, modern buildings with white metal frames, large glass windows, and industrial-looking diagonal braces. The buildings appear to be restaurants or commercial spaces situated directly over the marina.

On the left building, a sign reads “THE STEAK HOUSE” with a cow silhouette logo, and nearby text says “original steak house.” The structure has a terrace with chairs and tables visible through or behind the glass, suggesting outdoor or waterfront dining. Below it, another dark sign with a cow graphic is visible near the lower level.

In the center, another building has a prominent blue sign reading “DIAMANTE blu,” with a diamond icon at the left. This building also has large windows and a terrace-like walkway in front. Beneath it, small signs and storefront details are visible near the dock level.

To the right is a similar glass-and-white-frame building connected by the same elevated walkway. It has large windows, structural beams, and a stair or ramp system extending toward the far right, leading down toward the marina area.

In the background, beyond the pier, the open sea is visible as a thin blue strip. A few larger ships or ferries can be seen far out on the horizon, including a blue-and-white vessel on the left and other red or dark-colored ships near the center. The overall scene feels calm and coastal, with warm sunlight illuminating the buildings and boats, suggesting a clear day at a harbor or seaside marina.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示码头活动的摄影图像，前景中停泊着多艘船只，包括帆船和小型渔船。在图片的中部有三个带有现代设计风格的建筑结构，其中最左侧的建筑上写着'original rock bar'，中间的建筑上方标有'DIAMANTE'字样，而右侧的建筑则有一个楼梯通向一个开放的空间。整个场景被晴朗的蓝天覆盖，阳光照耀下，水面波光粼粼。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor car repair scene in front of an automotive tire and wheel shop.

In the foreground on the left is a dark blue sedan parked in a marked parking space. The car’s rear-left side is closest to the viewer, showing a tinted rear window reflecting tree branches and nearby buildings. The rear wheel has a sporty alloy rim, and the car body appears slightly dusty with some scuffs and wear.

The front passenger-side door of the car is open wide. A person is crouched beside the open door, working on the inside panel of the door. The inner door trim has been removed, exposing the metal and internal mechanisms. The person is wearing a dark shirt, jeans, black shoes, and a head covering or bandana. Their face is blurred. They appear to be holding a small part or tool, focused on repairing or adjusting something inside the door.

On the ground near the worker is an open red-and-blue metal toolbox filled with tools and parts. A few small items are scattered on the concrete nearby. There are stains, leaves, and worn patches on the pavement, suggesting a busy workshop area. In the lower right foreground, part of a blue floor jack or lifting tool is visible, with a long black handle rising vertically through the frame.

In the background is a row of orange-fronted shop lots. The shop directly behind the car appears to sell tires, rims, and auto accessories. Large stacks of used or new tires are piled high outside the shop entrance on the right side. Inside the shop, more tires, boxes, and automotive products are visible. A display window on the upper right shows several shiny alloy wheels mounted on the wall. There are also signs and banners inside, including one green banner, though most text is not fully readable.

The overall scene suggests a roadside or parking-lot automotive repair taking place outside a tire shop, with the mechanic working on the car door while the shop and tire stacks form the backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示汽车维修场景的照片。图中，一位穿着黑色T恤和牛仔裤的男性正蹲在一辆蓝色轿车旁，专注地检查或更换车轮。车辆停在一个带有白色停车线的停车位上，周围堆放着多层轮胎。在他的左侧，可以看到一些工具散落在地上，包括一个红色的工具箱和其他一些设备。背景中的商店门面上有'BIKIN AUTO'的标志，表明这是个汽车修理店。

caption:
The image is a close-up, shallow-depth-of-field shot of a citrus drink served in a clear glass tumbler. The glass sits on a brown, woven-textured tabletop or placemat. It is filled with a pale yellow, slightly cloudy liquid that resembles lemonade or a citrus-infused beverage. Inside the drink, a large yellow citrus slice—likely lemon—is visible near the lower right side of the glass, partially submerged and pressed against the inside wall.

The glass has a thick, transparent base and rounded sides, with the rim sharply in focus near the upper center of the frame. The liquid surface is calm and reflects soft light, giving the drink a fresh, cool appearance.

In the blurred background, there are additional citrus elements: a halved lemon with its cut face turned upward sits toward the upper left, showing its yellow rind and pale pulp. Part of an orange fruit is visible at the far left edge. Beneath and behind the fruit is a colorful cloth or napkin with bright green, blue, red, and cream tones, adding a summery, kitchen-table feel.

The overall color palette is warm and vibrant, dominated by yellows and greens. The focus is primarily on the drink in the foreground, while the background fruit and fabric are softly blurred, creating a cozy, refreshing still-life composition centered on citrus flavors.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一杯柠檬水的摄影图片，杯子放置在带有彩色图案的桌布上。杯子中的液体呈现出淡黄色，顶部装饰着一片新鲜的柠檬片。背景中模糊地可见一个完整的柠檬和几个橙子，增添了生活气息。

caption:
The image shows a uniformed soldier standing outdoors, photographed from a low angle against a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. The soldier’s face is intentionally blurred, but they are wearing a camouflage military uniform and a matching helmet. A pair of dark protective goggles rests on top of the helmet.

The soldier is positioned beside or partially behind a large green military vehicle or equipment structure on the left side of the frame. They are holding and operating a large, upward-pointing tube-like weapon or launcher mounted near the vehicle. The device has a wide open cylindrical barrel at the top, angled steeply upward, with various metal brackets, handles, and adjustment mechanisms visible along its body. The soldier grips part of the mechanism with one hand while the other arm rests near the vehicle structure.

Several details of the uniform are visible: a camouflage jacket and pants, a dark wristwatch, and shoulder patches. One patch on the upper arm appears to include a small red-and-white flag stripe, suggesting a national military insignia. Another patch lower on the sleeve has a dark emblem or crest.

In the background, there is a white multi-story building with decorative architectural trim and a flat roofline. Green trees partially obscure the lower part of the building. The overall scene appears to be in an urban or ceremonial outdoor setting, possibly during a military display or public event. The lighting is bright and natural, with strong sunlight highlighting the soldier’s gear and the metal surfaces of the equipment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一名身穿迷彩军装的士兵的照片，他戴着头盔和护目镜，正专注地操作着一个大型的瞄准器。士兵站在一辆绿色车辆旁，背景中可以看到蓝天、几棵树以及一栋白色的建筑物。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor running race finish area on a tree-lined road in daylight. A large inflatable arch spans the road overhead, with bold white text reading “START - FINISH” across a blue section. The arch is yellow on the right side and includes several circular logos; parts of the arch are partially covered or obscured by black plastic sheeting draped across a horizontal support bar.

Several runners are crossing or approaching the finish line. In the foreground, three participants are most prominent:

- A runner in the center wears a green cap, blue shirt, teal hydration vest, dark shorts, tall blue compression socks, and trail shoes. They are holding trekking poles and a water bottle, suggesting a long-distance or trail-style event. Their race bib reads “B2-212.”
- To the right is another runner wearing a green-and-white shirt, dark shorts, a black visor, and a race bib that reads “B2-103.” They are holding a bottle while moving forward.
- Between them is a runner in a light cap and green top with dark leggings, also wearing a race bib beginning with “B2.” They appear to be walking or jogging with the group.

The road is marked with orange traffic cones forming a lane toward the finish. White sponsor barriers line both sides of the route, with printed logos and Thai text visible along the fencing. On the right side, there is a colorful umbrella in pink, yellow, blue, and gray shading part of the finish area. A checkered black-and-white pattern appears on a vertical inflatable or banner near the right edge, reinforcing the finish-line theme.

On the left, a photographer stands on or near a winners’ podium block marked with large purple numbers, including “3,” “5,” “4,” and “2.” They are holding a camera up to their face, taking photos of the runners. More runners and event staff are visible farther back along the road, slightly out of focus. Tall blue event flags line the course in the background, and large green trees provide a leafy canopy over the area.

The overall atmosphere is that of a casual but organized race event, likely near the end of a long run, with runners arriving at the finish under bright, warm outdoor conditions.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示马拉松比赛终点线的摄影照片。在图片中，几位穿着运动装备的参赛者正从终点线前经过，其中一位男性选手戴着绿色帽子，手持水瓶，显得轻松愉快。他们身后是蓝色和黄色的拱形标志牌，上面写着'SHART FINISH'，表明这是比赛的终点。周围有橙色交通锥和一些观众，为场景增添了活力。

caption:
The image is a wide, sepia-toned landscape photograph of a rocky hillside rising above a waterfront.

In the foreground, along the bottom edge, there is a body of water with several boats docked at a small marina or landing area. On the left are multiple moored boats with tall railings and cabin-like upper structures, packed closely side by side. Toward the right, a larger white passenger-style boat is tied along a narrow pier that extends out from shore into the water. The boat has a long covered cabin area, railings along the roof and sides, and a pointed bow facing right. The pier and marina structures include metal railings, ramps, and platforms.

Behind the boats, the shoreline is edged with rocks and low retaining walls. There are several trees and shrubs clustered near the waterfront, partially obscuring buildings and paths. A small two-story house or cabin sits on the lower slope just above the marina. It has a porch or balcony with vertical railings, a small front staircase, and a compact, rustic appearance. The building is nestled into the hillside, surrounded by rocky ground and sparse vegetation.

The hillside dominates most of the image. It is dry, uneven, and covered with exposed pale rock formations, patches of grass, scattered bushes, and a few small trees. The terrain rises steeply from the shore, with layered rock shelves and boulders spread across the slope. There are faint paths or terraced lines cutting across parts of the hill. Near the upper areas, the rock face becomes more rugged and cliff-like, with large outcrops and eroded textures.

The entire scene has a warm brown monochrome or sepia filter, giving it an aged, historical, or nostalgic feel. The lighting appears hazy, especially toward the upper left, where the sky or bright sun washes out part of the hillside. Overall, the image conveys a quiet waterfront settlement at the base of a barren, rocky mountain slope, with boats docked below and a small dwelling perched above them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张复古风格的自然风光照片，展示了一片宁静的水域和停靠在码头上的几艘船只。在画面中央，有一座小屋坐落在岩石山坡上，周围是郁郁葱葱的树木。背景中，一座陡峭的山峰延伸至天际线，为这个场景增添了一份庄严与神秘感。整个图像采用了棕褐色调，营造出一种时间流逝的感觉，仿佛将观者带入了一个久远的时代。

caption:
The image shows a bright urban scene in Seoul, South Korea, combining historic architecture with modern high-rise buildings.

In the foreground and lower right is a traditional Korean stone gate structure, likely **Sungnyemun (Namdaemun Gate)**. It has thick pale stone walls and a central arched entrance at the base. Above the stone foundation sits a dark, ornate wooden pavilion with a traditional tiled roof. The roof has sweeping, slightly upturned eaves, layered grey tiles, and decorative painted details beneath the eaves. A second smaller roof tier is visible below, giving the gate a layered, fortress-like appearance. Several colorful flags or banners stand near the entrance, and a small figure in traditional-looking clothing appears near the base, emphasizing the scale of the gate.

The gate is surrounded by a neatly maintained landscaped area with trimmed grass, low shrubs, ornamental plants, and a gently sloping embankment on the right side. In the lower left, there are roads, cars, sidewalks, small trees, and a few pedestrians, indicating this historic site is embedded directly within a busy city environment.

Behind the gate, modern office towers dominate the skyline. The most prominent building on the left-center is a large beige and glass high-rise with horizontal dark window bands. At the top, Korean text reads **“신한은행”** with the Shinhan Bank logo. Its façade has rounded corners and repeated horizontal stripes. Behind it is a reddish-brown cylindrical or rounded office tower with dark horizontal window bands and Korean signage near the top. To the right are additional white and glass office buildings with grid-like window patterns. Farther right, a large yellow-and-red **DHL** billboard is visible on a building, adding a commercial element to the scene.

The sky occupies much of the upper half of the image and is a clear, vivid blue with no visible clouds, suggesting a sunny day with good visibility. The lighting is strong and crisp, casting defined shadows and making the contrast between the pale stone gate, dark roof tiles, and reflective modern buildings very clear.

Overall, the image captures a striking contrast between Korea’s historical heritage and contemporary urban development: a centuries-old traditional gate standing prominently amid dense modern skyscrapers and commercial buildings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市与传统建筑和谐共存的摄影图像。图中，一座古老的石制城门位于前景，其古典的设计与周围现代化的高楼大厦形成鲜明对比。背景中的高楼大厦以玻璃幕墙和钢铁结构为主，显示出城市的商业气息。在晴朗的天空下，这些建筑的轮廓清晰可见，而城门则以其古老和历史感吸引着视线。

caption:
The image shows a small group of people gathered indoors, likely during an interview, recording, or community discussion. The faces of the people are blurred, making individual identities indistinguishable.

In the foreground, slightly left of center, a man appears to be speaking or presenting. He is wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt under a black sleeveless vest. A rectangular label or badge is pinned to the front of his vest with text in a South Asian script and some smaller English lettering, though it is not fully readable. He is holding what looks like a wired microphone or recording device in one hand, with the cable hanging downward. His other hand is raised slightly, suggesting he may be gesturing while talking.

Around him are several other people dressed in warm clothing. On the left edge, a person wearing a green-and-white cap is partially visible. Behind the main speaker, another person is wearing a light blue knit cap and a cream-colored scarf draped around the neck, holding a wooden walking stick or cane upright. To the right, another person wears a tan cap and a white scarf, with a green cloth or garment visible behind or above them.

On the far right foreground, the back and shoulder of another person are visible. This person is wearing a patterned sweater with a dark teal or green vest over it. In front of them, a smartphone is mounted horizontally on a small tripod or clamp, facing the group. The phone screen shows a live view of the people being recorded, indicating that the scene is being filmed or streamed.

The background includes a large blue tarpaulin or plastic sheet hanging behind the group, with a beige or brown structural wall or doorway visible above it. The lighting is warm and indoor, and the image has a candid, documentary-like feel. The overall scene suggests a local media interview, public announcement, or informal gathering being recorded on a phone.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这张照片捕捉了一群人在一个室内场合的场景，其中一位身着黑色上衣和蓝色背心的人手持麦克风，似乎在进行演讲或主持活动。其他人物穿着传统服装，包括头戴绿色帽子的人物和一位拿着拐杖的人物。背景中可以看到蓝色布幔和其他模糊的人物轮廓，暗示这可能是一个正式的公共活动或仪式。

caption:
The image shows a densely packed cemetery viewed from a slightly elevated position, looking out over rows of graves and mausoleums beneath tall trees.

In the foreground and middle ground, there are many different styles of tombs and grave markers arranged closely together. Some are flat, rectangular stone slabs in polished black, gray, reddish-brown, and pale granite; others are upright headstones, crosses, small family vaults, or miniature chapel-like mausoleums with doors and peaked roofs. Several graves have carved crosses on their surfaces, and a few have small plaques, inscriptions, or family names visible. Some tombs are decorated with flowers—red, pink, white, and purple arrangements—either in pots, planters, or small bouquets placed on the stone.

A prominent pale stone cross stands near the center foreground on a raised base, surrounded by darker graves. Nearby are small mausoleum structures with dark metal doors and stone facades. On the right side, a larger pale stone tomb or mausoleum wall occupies the edge of the frame, its roof surface weathered and speckled with dark stains and lichen. Throughout the cemetery, the stone surfaces show age: moss, discoloration, chipped edges, and worn inscriptions.

The graves extend far into the background, creating a crowded, maze-like pattern of monuments, slabs, crosses, and crypts. Narrow pathways and gaps between the tombs are visible, with fallen leaves scattered on the ground, suggesting early autumn. The overall palette is subdued—grays, blacks, beige stone, muted browns—contrasted by the green foliage and occasional bright flowers.

Large mature trees dominate the upper half of the scene. Their thick trunks rise among the graves, and their leafy canopies spread overhead, filtering the light. The leaves are mostly green, with some hints of yellow and brown, reinforcing the seasonal feel. In the upper right, patches of blue sky and soft white clouds are visible through the branches.

The atmosphere is quiet, historic, and contemplative. The mix of elaborate old mausoleums, simple modern slabs, weathered stone, and dense greenery gives the cemetery a layered, aged character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示墓地的现实主义风格照片，画面中充满了整齐排列的墓碑和一些树木。墓碑以不同的大小、形状和装饰品为特征，有的顶部有十字架，有的则装饰着雕塑或花岗岩。墓地被树木环绕，树叶呈现出秋天的黄色调，而天空是晴朗的蓝色。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of a modern glass high-rise building set against a wide, clear blue sky. The building occupies the left half of the frame, while most of the right side is open sky, giving the composition a spacious, minimal look.

The structure has a reflective glass façade divided into a neat grid of rectangular window panels by white or silver metal framing. The windows reflect pale clouds and the bright daylight. Near the center of the building is a tall, narrow cylindrical glass tower or elevator shaft running vertically upward, with curved glass panels and metal ribs. At the top, this cylindrical section rises slightly above the rest of the roofline and has a rounded cap-like architectural feature.

The roofline of the building is asymmetrical: one section slopes upward diagonally toward the central tower, creating a triangular glass-and-metal form. Another rectangular section sits to the right of the tower, also covered in a grid of reflective windows.

On the lower-left visible portion of the building is a large vertical sign with stylized dark lettering spelling “Radisson,” mounted on the façade. Beneath it is a blue square sign with the word “BLU” in light-colored letters, indicating the Radisson Blu hotel branding. Part of the sign extends out from the building, supported by metal brackets.

The sky is a deep, even blue with only faint wisps of cloud on the left side. The lighting is bright and crisp, suggesting a sunny day, and the glass surfaces catch highlights from the sun. Overall, the image emphasizes sleek modern architecture, clean geometric lines, and a strong contrast between the reflective building and the expansive blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑的照片，建筑物的玻璃幕墙在阳光下闪耀着光芒。建筑顶部有一个独特的设计，类似于一个巨大的金属结构，其表面反射出周围环境。建筑物上部有一块蓝色的标牌，上面写着'Radisson Blu'和'BLU'字样，表明了该建筑的品牌。背景是晴朗的蓝天，几朵薄云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a medical procedure being performed on a person’s arm. A healthcare worker wearing a red uniform shirt and bright blue disposable gloves is inserting or positioning a small needle/cannula into the inner forearm of a patient. The worker’s face is not visible; the focus is mainly on their gloved hands and the patient’s arm.

The patient is lying or reclining, wearing a pink top and dark blue pants. A gray blood pressure cuff is wrapped around the upper part of the patient’s arm near the foreground, suggesting vital signs are being monitored during the procedure. The patient’s hand is relaxed and slightly curled in the background.

The healthcare worker has a red ID badge or lanyard hanging from their shirt, and there appears to be white lettering on the sleeve, though it is blurred and not fully readable. The background is out of focus, giving the scene a clinical or emergency-care feel. The overall image has a shallow depth of field, with the blue gloves and needle area drawing the most attention.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示医疗场景的照片，其中一位穿着红色制服的医护人员正在为一位躺在担架上的患者进行静脉注射。医护人员的手戴着手套，正专注地操作着注射器。患者的上半身被黑色的衣物覆盖，而下半身则裸露在外。在模糊的背景中可以看到一些室内环境和医疗设备。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of a grand stone building photographed from a low, upward-looking angle, making the architecture appear tall and imposing. The structure is likely part of Saint Joseph’s Oratory of Mount Royal, suggested by the visible inscription near the lower edge reading “SAINT-JOSEPH DU MONT-ROYAL.”

The building is made of pale, cream-colored stone blocks arranged in a regular masonry pattern. Its façade is highly ornate, with classical and ecclesiastical architectural details. A large arched window dominates the center-right portion of the image; within the arch is decorative geometric tracery, including repeated star-like and cross-shaped patterns. Surrounding the arch are multiple layers of carved stone molding, giving the window a deep, recessed appearance.

Above the arch is a triangular pediment with rows of dentil-like stone blocks and projecting ornamental brackets. The pediment contains carved relief details, including a central crest or shield-like emblem. On either side of the upper façade are decorative religious-looking stone motifs, each featuring a prominent cross framed by scrollwork and carved embellishments.

Lower on the façade, there are carved panels, small sculptural faces or figures, and a projecting cornice supported by dense rows of decorative blocks. At the bottom right, part of a column with an elaborate Corinthian-style capital is visible, decorated with leafy carvings.

The sky occupies much of the left side of the image and is a clear, rich blue with a few faint wisps of cloud near the lower left. The sunlight strikes the stone façade strongly, creating sharp shadows under the moldings and emphasizing the depth of the carvings. The composition is diagonal, with the building rising from the lower right toward the upper right, while the open sky balances the image on the left.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑细节的摄影作品，图像捕捉了一座建筑物的一部分，其特征为精致的石制立面和装饰性元素。建筑物的顶部有一个半圆形的窗户，周围有复杂的雕花和装饰性的浮雕。在建筑物的上方，可以看到两个金色的装饰性徽章，增添了建筑的艺术感。整个场景被一片清澈的蓝天所衬托，几朵轻盈的白云点缀其间，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor Buddhist ceremony or offering ritual in a residential neighborhood.

In the foreground, three Buddhist monks are seated with their backs to the camera on simple white wooden chairs. They are wearing bright orange and saffron robes, which dominate the lower part of the image with vivid color. Their heads are shaved, and one monk on the left appears to have his hands pressed together in a prayer gesture. The chairs look slightly worn, with visible scuffs and horizontal slats.

Facing the monks, in the background, is a group of laypeople seated in a semicircle on plastic stools and chairs. Many of them are wearing yellow shirts, a color often associated with Thai Buddhist ceremonies or royal/religious occasions. Several people have their palms pressed together in a wai/prayer gesture, suggesting they are participating respectfully in the ritual. Some hold or sit near woven baskets and trays, likely containing offerings such as food, flowers, or ceremonial items.

There are tables set up in front of the seated group, holding baskets, wrapped packages, and colorful offerings. A large green-and-blue umbrella stands near the center, shading part of the area. On the far right, there is another table with a basket and more offering items, decorated with pale blue and yellow colors.

The setting appears to be a quiet street or courtyard outside homes. Behind the participants are lush green plants and bushes, residential buildings with tiled roofs, fences, and utility boxes. The background is softly out of focus, giving the scene a gentle, candid feel and emphasizing the monks in the foreground.

Overall, the image conveys a calm, communal religious gathering, with monks receiving respect or offerings from local residents in a peaceful neighborhood setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国文化场景的照片，前景中有三位身穿橙色僧袍的和尚坐在户外的白色椅子上，背对着镜头。他们似乎在进行某种宗教仪式或活动。背景中，一群穿着传统服装的人正围坐在一起，有的人在交谈，有的人在吃东西，还有的人正在祈祷。周围环境看起来像是一个社区聚会场所，有树木和一些简单的建筑结构。

caption:
The image is a high, centered telephoto view of the Eiffel Tower in Paris, seen from the direction of the Champ de Mars. The tower dominates the composition, rising vertically through the middle of the frame with its iron lattice structure clearly visible from the broad arched base up to the narrow antenna at the top.

The scene is bathed in soft, hazy light, giving the city a pastel, slightly dreamlike quality. The left side of the image is especially bright and washed with warm sunlight, while the right side fades into cooler bluish-gray tones. A layer of atmospheric mist or pollution softens the distant buildings and reduces contrast, especially in the background skyline.

At the base of the Eiffel Tower, the large arch frames a roadway and pedestrian area where tiny figures and vehicles can be seen. Extending outward from the tower toward the bottom of the image are the formal gardens and lawns of the Champ de Mars, laid out symmetrically with long rectangular green spaces, paths, rows of leafless trees, and scattered pedestrians. The bare trees suggest winter or early spring.

In the lower foreground sits a grand historic building with a classical façade, slate roofs, dormer windows, and a central pediment—likely the École Militaire. Around it are streets, smaller buildings, construction cranes, and parked or moving vehicles, adding an urban, lived-in feel to the scene.

Behind the Eiffel Tower, the dense cityscape of Paris stretches across the frame. Mid-rise Haussmann-style buildings fill the lower background, while farther back, modern office towers appear through the haze. On the right side, the skyscrapers of La Défense are visible, including tall glass buildings with geometric shapes and reflective façades. Their modern silhouettes contrast strongly with the historic iron structure of the Eiffel Tower and the older Parisian architecture below.

Overall, the image captures a grand panoramic view of Paris, emphasizing the Eiffel Tower as the central landmark, surrounded by formal gardens, historic buildings, and a misty modern skyline in the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示巴黎埃菲尔铁塔的城市景观照片。图像中心是埃菲尔铁塔，其独特的三角形结构在阳光的照射下显得格外引人注目。铁塔周围是密集的建筑群，包括多层住宅和一些古典风格的建筑。背景中可以看到更多的现代高楼大厦，与前景形成鲜明对比。整个场景被一层轻薄的雾气笼罩，增添了一种朦胧而神秘的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a charming outdoor restaurant or café set along a narrow pedestrian alley, likely in a Mediterranean or Greek town.

On the right side, the restaurant façade is covered with lush green climbing plants and leafy vines that spill around the windows, signage, and walls. A large round beer sign hangs prominently near the upper-right area; it reads “Mythos” with “Hellenic Lager” underneath, framed in green and gold with a rooster logo at the top. Behind and around it are rustic wooden signs and decorative lettering, partially obscured by foliage.

The building itself has an old-world feel: rough stone sections, cream-colored plaster, wooden-framed windows, and weathered awnings. Several decorative hanging lamps with bell-shaped shades extend from curved metal arms above the tables. There are also framed menus or posters mounted on the wall, suggesting a traditional taverna-style restaurant.

Along the alley, small square dining tables are arranged closely together. They are covered with white tablecloths and blue table skirts or overlays, with black metal chairs around them. On the tables are typical dining items such as plates, glasses, bottles, condiments, napkins, and small menus. Some tables are occupied by diners, and a few people are standing or seated in conversation, giving the scene a relaxed lunchtime atmosphere.

The alley continues into the background on the left, lined with more awnings, greenery, and restaurant seating. Overhead, utility wires stretch between buildings, and the sky is bright and clear blue. The lighting suggests a sunny day, with soft shadows falling across the stone-paved walkway.

Overall, the scene feels cozy, historic, and inviting—an intimate outdoor dining area tucked into a narrow old street, full of greenery, rustic textures, and Mediterranean character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示着一家餐厅外部环境的照片。餐厅的外墙被绿色植物覆盖，墙上挂着一个大型的圆形招牌，上面印有'Meze'字样和餐厅名称。餐厅内部可以看到几位顾客正在用餐，桌上摆放着整齐的餐具和桌布。在画面左侧，一位女士正从餐厅内向外走动，她的身影映衬在窗户上。整个场景营造出一种宁静而温馨的氛围，让人感受到地中海风情的舒适与放松。

caption:
The image shows a vibrant nighttime city scene dominated by a brightly illuminated historic market building, likely Bến Thành Market in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The composition is wide and panoramic, capturing both the architecture and the busy traffic in front of it.

At the center-right is a tall, pale-colored clock tower with a red-tiled roof and a thin spire rising into the dark blue evening sky. The tower is outlined with vivid blue neon lighting, while pink and magenta lights wash across its walls, giving the building a colorful, almost theatrical appearance. Large circular clock faces are visible on the tower, glowing warmly against the cooler blue lighting. Below the tower, the market façade stretches horizontally across the frame, featuring a series of arched openings lined with bright blue-white illumination. Red neon strips trace the rooflines, creating sharp triangular accents along the building’s roof.

In the foreground, a broad multi-lane road is captured with long-exposure photography. Instead of individual vehicles, the traffic appears as continuous streaks of white, yellow, orange, and red light sweeping across the bottom of the image. These light trails create a strong sense of motion and energy, contrasting with the solid, stationary architecture behind them. A few vehicles and motorbikes are faintly visible near the curb, but most of the movement has blurred into luminous bands.

Several streetlights glow with starburst effects, especially one on the left and another on the right, adding warm golden points of light to the scene. In the background, modern buildings and hotel signs rise behind the market. Readable signs include “A & EM Hotel,” “Song Anh Hotel,” and other brightly lit Vietnamese storefront or hotel signs. On the right side, a tall building displays a large illuminated sign, while nearby trees are lit with greenish light.

The sky is a deep, rich navy blue, suggesting early night or twilight. The overall atmosphere is lively, urban, and colorful, with the historic market building serving as a glowing landmark amid the fast-moving traffic and dense city signage.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，画面中心是一座装饰着霓虹灯和灯光的建筑，其设计独特，顶部有一个显眼的时钟。周围是繁忙的城市街道，车辆在道路上留下了一道道明亮的光线轨迹，这些光轨在夜晚中形成了流动的艺术效果。建筑物前的人行道上有一些行人，而背景中的高楼大厦则点缀了城市的天际线。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a city at dusk, taken from an elevated hillside or lookout point. The foreground is filled with dark, slightly blurred trees and shrubs, suggesting either wind movement or a long-exposure photograph.
