On both the left and right sides are tall vertical bands of Arabic calligraphy. The script is written in gold against a deep blue background, framed by decorative borders. The calligraphy is large, flowing, and elegant, with elongated vertical strokes and sweeping curves. These inscriptions run from top to bottom along the sides of the architectural opening, acting like monumental textual pillars.

The outer edges of the image show additional tilework in geometric patterns, including angular motifs and mosaic-like arrangements in gold, blue, turquoise, black, and earthy tones. The entire surface is richly decorated, leaving almost no blank space.

Near the lower center is a bright illuminated section, possibly a mihrab, doorway, or smaller decorative niche. It is much brighter than the surrounding areas, with white light reflecting off blue-and-white tilework. This lower niche has its own miniature arches, floral panels, and lattice-like patterning, echoing the larger architectural forms above it.

The overall impression is one of grandeur, precision, and spiritual opulence. The dominant colors are deep cobalt blue and radiant gold, accented by turquoise, white, and black. The image emphasizes the hallmarks of Islamic decorative art: calligraphy, geometry, vegetal arabesques, symmetry, and intricate muqarnas craftsmanship.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伊斯兰建筑风格的室内装饰的照片。图像中心是一个精致的拱形结构，其内部装饰着复杂的几何图案和蓝色调的瓷砖镶嵌。天花板上覆盖着金色的装饰板，与墙面和拱门上的图案相呼应。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，突出了细节和色彩的丰富性。

caption:
The image shows a group of people working in a vineyard on a sunny day, likely harvesting grapes.

Rows of grapevines fill the scene, stretching into the background on both sides of a narrow dirt path. The vines are dense with green leaves and are supported by wooden posts and horizontal wires. The sunlight is strong and warm, casting deep shadows on the ground and on the workers’ clothing, suggesting it may be morning or late afternoon.

In the foreground, a worker stands near the center wearing a light beige button-up shirt, a pale baseball cap, dark pants, and thick dark protective arm coverings or gloves. Their face is blurred. They are holding a white plastic bucket by the handle; the bucket appears to contain dark grapes or grape clusters. The person also seems to be holding a small harvesting tool or shears in one hand.

To the left, another worker is seen mostly from behind, wearing a bright purple shirt, dark trousers, and a light-colored cap or head covering. This person is standing beside the vines and appears to be working with a bucket near their side. Part of another worker in a white hat and patterned clothing is visible at the far left edge.

On the right side, two more workers are partially visible among the grapevines. One wears a headscarf with a patterned cloth wrapped around the head and neck, a light blue shirt, and a darker vest. Another person farther back wears a pale hat and greenish shirt. They appear to be picking or sorting grapes from the vine rows.

The overall setting is agricultural and active, with several workers spread across the vineyard. The image has a documentary feel, focusing on manual grape harvesting, protective clothing, buckets, and the lush vineyard environment under a clear blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示葡萄园劳作场景的照片。在画面中心，一位穿着黄色上衣和黑色裤子的工人正背对镜头，手持一个白色塑料桶，似乎正在搬运或检查葡萄。在他的左侧，另一位工人穿着紫色上衣和深色裤子，同样背对着镜头，但头部朝向相机方向。周围是郁郁葱葱的葡萄藤，阳光从上方照射下来，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic twilight view of Sydney Harbour, with the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge in the distance.

In the foreground, large dark sandstone rocks dominate the lower half of the scene. Their surfaces are rounded, weathered, and uneven, with small hollows and tide pools catching faint reflections of the sky. The rocks appear wet in places, suggesting waves have recently washed over them. Around and between the rocks, the water has a soft, misty appearance, likely due to a long-exposure photograph that blurs the motion of the waves into smooth, pale blue and white streaks.

Beyond the rocks, the harbor stretches across the middle of the image. The water is calm-looking because of the exposure effect, with gentle lavender, gray, and bluish tones. On the left side of the horizon sits the Sydney Opera House, its iconic white sail-shaped shells silhouetted softly against the glowing sky. The building is partially shadowed, but its layered, curved roof forms are clearly recognizable.

Spanning the background from the center toward the right is the Sydney Harbour Bridge. Its large steel arch is silhouetted against the sunset, with the latticework and vertical supports visible as dark lines. The bridge’s massive stone pylon stands on the right, and small buildings and city structures can be seen clustered along the far shoreline beneath it.

The sky is the most colorful part of the scene, filled with a warm gradient of sunset tones. Near the horizon it glows orange and coral, fading upward into pink, mauve, and dusky purple. The soft light outlines the bridge and Opera House while giving the whole scene a calm, atmospheric quality.

Overall, the photograph combines rugged natural shoreline textures in the foreground with two famous architectural landmarks in the background, creating a peaceful yet iconic view of Sydney at sunset.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示悉尼海港大桥和歌剧院的长时间曝光摄影作品。图像前景中，岩石被水冲刷得湿漉漉的，岩石表面呈现出丰富的纹理和色彩。背景中的海港大桥和歌剧院在日落时分的暖色调天空下显得格外壮观，它们的轮廓清晰可见，与水面的波纹形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a plated dish in a restaurant-style setting. In the foreground, several rolled slices of grilled eggplant or similar thin vegetable are arranged on a white plate. The rolls are pale golden-beige with browned edges and small char marks, giving them a lightly roasted appearance. They sit on a bed of bright red tomato sauce that looks thick and glossy, with visible texture suggesting crushed tomatoes.

A fresh sprig of rosemary is placed diagonally across the rolls as garnish. Its deep green needle-like leaves stand out sharply against the warm tones of the eggplant and red sauce. The dish is presented on a wide, shallow white plate with a curved rim, emphasizing the clean, elegant plating.

The background is softly blurred with shallow depth of field. On the left, there appears to be another white plate or bowl, and toward the back there are indistinct glassware and a bottle, possibly olive oil or wine. The table underneath has a patterned lace or decorative tablecloth. The lighting is warm and focused, highlighting the glossy sauce and the texture of the grilled vegetable rolls while leaving the background softly out of focus.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示精美食物的摄影图像，主要呈现了一盘装有几片卷起的食物，可能是某种肉类或蔬菜，它们被一层层地包裹在类似薄面皮中，并淋上了红色的酱汁。食物上方装饰着几根绿色的迷迭香枝条，为整个画面增添了一抹自然的色彩和香气。食物放置在一个白色的圆盘上，背景模糊地显示了餐厅内的其他餐具和环境细节，如餐巾纸和玻璃杯，但这些元素并不抢眼，确保观众的注意力集中在食物本身。

caption:
The image shows a view from inside an old stone archway looking out toward a bright outdoor waterfront area. The foreground is dominated by the rough, weathered masonry of the arch and walls, made of tan and ochre stone blocks with pitted textures, cracks, and uneven surfaces. The arch curves across the top of the frame, creating a natural frame around the scene beyond.

On the left side, there is a tall metal gate or door set into the stone opening. It has a decorative lattice or diamond-patterned grille, painted in a muted gray-blue tone. The right wall is also made of aged stone, with visible block lines, erosion marks, and small holes. The passage floor slopes slightly outward and includes a long dark metal grate ramp running down the center, bordered by simple metal handrails on the right.

Outside the arch is a sunlit stone-paved terrace. At the center stands a modern metal sculpture on a square base. The sculpture consists of several stacked, rectangular, box-like vertical forms, with thin rods and spherical joints running along the front, giving it a geometric, industrial appearance. It is mounted on two tall tapered supports.

Behind the sculpture, lush greenery and palm trees fill the lower background. Beyond the trees, numerous thin sailboat masts rise from a marina, suggesting the scene is near a harbor. The sky is a vivid, clear blue with very little cloud cover, adding a strong contrast to the warm, ancient stone.

The image combines old and new elements: the ancient-looking stone arch and historic walls frame a contemporary sculpture, with a Mediterranean-like harbor landscape beyond. The lighting is bright and high-contrast, emphasizing the warm stone texture and the saturated blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示通过石拱门看到的现代艺术雕塑的照片。石拱门结构坚固，以深灰色石材建造，其上方有精细的石雕装饰。通过拱门可以看到一个由金属制成的高耸雕塑，它被放置在一个开放的空间中，周围环绕着绿色植物和远处的帆船。阳光从画面右侧照射进来，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor market stall set beneath a rustic thatched-roof shelter. The roof is made from dried palm or straw, with many thin, uneven strands hanging down along the edges. It is supported by rough wooden posts and beams, giving the stall a handmade, rural feel.

In the foreground, a woman vendor is bending over a low wooden table, arranging small floral offerings. She wears a dark shirt with a colorful floral apron or patterned cloth tied around her waist. Her attention is focused on the items in front of her. Hanging above her are several decorative flower garlands: clusters of small white blossoms, bright yellow marigold-like flowers, and long red and pink ribbon streamers. The garlands are suspended from hooks or cords under the shelter, creating a vivid focal point against the earthy background.

On the table and bamboo bench in front of the vendor are baskets of fruit and market goods. A pink basket holds bright red dragon fruit with green-tipped scales. Nearby, a large pile of small round brown fruits, likely longans, spills across the table. Another blue basket contains pale pink foam-netted fruit, possibly apples or pears. There are also plastic bags, trays, and smaller floral arrangements placed on the table.

The stall has a simple, improvised setup: bamboo benches, wooden planks, plastic baskets, and a woven mat. The ground is bare dirt with patches of grass. To the left, there are more goods and a partially visible sign or cloth with red writing, possibly in Thai script. A few green bananas can be seen on a lower surface.

In the background, several people sit or stand under and around the shelter. A man sits on a motorbike near the road, and other people are seated with their backs turned, suggesting a casual gathering place or roadside market. Additional scooters and umbrellas are visible outside the stall. The scene feels warm, colorful, and informal, with the bright flowers and fruit contrasting strongly against the muted browns of the thatched roof, wood, and dirt ground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示当地市场场景的照片，画面中心是一位穿着传统服装的女性摊主，她正坐在一个简易的竹制摊位上，周围摆放着各种水果和鲜花。在她的摊位后方，可以看到其他顾客正在挑选商品或与摊主交流。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种热闹而真实的市场氛围。

caption:
The image shows a small, picturesque church set in a green churchyard on a bright, clear day. The sky is a vivid, cloudless blue, taking up much of the upper portion of the image and giving the scene a calm, open feeling.

At the center is a pale cream or light yellow wooden church with vertical siding. It has a steep, arched gable roof trimmed in white, and a glowing white cross mounted at the peak. The front façade includes a dark double wooden door with diagonal planks, reached by a short set of steps. Metal handrails run along both sides of the entrance ramp and stairs. Above the door is a small round window, and higher up near the roofline are small decorative windows and vents. The building has a simple, traditional rural design, clean and well maintained.

A gravel path leads straight from the foreground through an open wooden gate toward the church entrance. The gate is made of dark weathered wood and is attached to a low wooden picket fence that stretches across both sides of the scene. The open gate creates a welcoming frame around the path.

On either side of the path are grassy lawns dotted with small yellow spring flowers, possibly daffodils. Several leafless or early-spring trees stand around the churchyard, their bare branches silhouetted against the blue sky. A black lamppost is visible to the left of the church, and another is partly visible among the trees on the right.

To the right of the church is a cemetery area with gravestones of different shapes and sizes. Behind the graves stands a red wooden bell tower or small belfry with a dark roof and a pointed finial. The red tower contrasts strongly with the pale church and the blue sky. A wooden fence and stone base surround parts of this area.

The overall scene feels peaceful, rural, and well cared for, with strong sunlight casting crisp shadows across the gravel path and grass. It appears to be a spring day at a historic countryside church and cemetery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂建筑的摄影图像，画面中心是一座白色的木制教堂，其入口处有一个显眼的十字架。教堂前有一条通往入口的小径，两侧是绿色的草地和一些树木。在教堂右侧，可以看到一个红色的塔楼，可能是消防站或信号塔。整个场景被一片清澈的蓝天所环绕，阳光明媚，为这个宁静的宗教场所增添了一抹温暖的色彩。

caption:
The image shows a person sitting outdoors in a wooded, grassy area, photographed from behind. They are wearing loose, pale lavender or very light purple clothing that looks like a robe or uniform, with a flap or folded panel draped over the upper back. Their dark hair is tied back in a ponytail, and their head is turned slightly to the left, so only the back of the head, ear, and neck are visible.

The person is seated low on the ground, likely on a blue mat or cloth, with one leg bent and visible in the lower left of the frame. Around them are patches of grass and a few personal items: near the bottom right there is a gray bag or container with a strap, and in front of it a rolled or folded red-and-yellow woven-looking item.

A large tree trunk fills the right side of the image, with textured brown bark running vertically. The background is heavily blurred, creating a soft bokeh effect with green foliage, tree trunks, and bright spots of sunlight filtering through leaves. The scene feels quiet and shaded, like a park, garden, or forested area on a sunny day. The focus is mainly on the seated person and their clothing, while the surrounding trees and greenery provide a calm natural setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在户外冥想的照片。她穿着一件白色的长袖上衣，头发扎成马尾辫，坐在草地上，身体前倾，双手合十放在膝盖上，闭着眼睛，显得非常专注和放松。她的背后是郁郁葱葱的树木和一片宁静的自然环境，阳光透过树叶洒在她的身上，营造出一种平和与宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a low-angle view of traditional Korean-style wooden buildings, likely hanok houses, under a bright blue sky with soft, scattered clouds.

On the right side, the closest building dominates the frame. It has warm honey-brown wooden walls and doors with visible wood grain, knots, and polished texture. The façade includes a row of traditional lattice doors or windows, made from narrow wooden strips forming square grid patterns. Dark metal hinges and round decorative studs accent the panels.

The roof is especially prominent. It has layered, curved dark gray roof tiles with white plaster-like edging between and along the ends of the tiles. The eaves sweep upward gracefully at the corners, a characteristic feature of traditional Korean architecture. Beneath the roofline are exposed round wooden beams and logs projecting outward, their cut ends clearly visible. The sunlight casts warm golden highlights across the wood, emphasizing the texture and craftsmanship.

To the left and farther back, more similar traditional buildings recede into the distance, creating a layered street scene. Their tiled roofs overlap, with repeating curved silhouettes and decorative ridge-end tiles. Some signs and small architectural details are visible near the lower left, suggesting this may be a historic village or cultural district with shops or preserved homes.

The sky takes up much of the upper half of the image, giving the scene an open, airy feeling. The overall mood is warm, calm, and picturesque, with strong contrast between the golden wooden architecture and the cool blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统韩式建筑的摄影作品，图像捕捉了木制结构和瓦片屋顶的细节。建筑物的屋顶由多个交错排列的瓦片构成，呈现出典型的曲线形状，瓦片上装饰有精致的花纹。屋檐下方是木质的门窗，窗户上有复杂的格栅设计，透过这些格栅可以看到内部的房间。整个场景在阳光照耀下显得格外生动，天空中散布着几朵白云，为这个宁静的场景增添了一丝柔和的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide riverside scene under a pale, hazy sky. The lower half of the frame is filled with broad, rippling water in muted gray-brown tones, suggesting a river or lake. Near the far bank, a long, narrow motorboat is moving from left to right, sitting low on the water. It has a colorful hull with red, yellow, and green accents and a long, slightly raised prow. A blue canopy or long fabric covering stretches over much of the boat. At the rear, a motor churns the water, leaving a bright white splash and wake behind it. A person appears to be seated near the back of the boat, partially shaded.

The shoreline behind the boat is dense with vegetation. A strip of floating or shoreline plants forms a bright green band at the water’s edge. Behind it are layers of trees and shrubs in many shades of green, from dark, rounded bushes to taller trees with thinner branches and lighter leaves. On the left side, broad banana-like leaves are visible near the water. Toward the center, partly hidden by foliage, there is a small gray structure with a steep, gabled roof and an open front, resembling a shrine or small pavilion. Decorative lamp posts or finials stand nearby.

On the right side, more buildings are partially obscured by trees, including a reddish roof and a structure with ornate golden trim that resembles part of a temple. A large dark tree dominates the upper right area, and a small blue-topped tower or roof peeks out at the far right edge. The overall atmosphere is quiet and tropical, with the boat providing the main sense of motion against the still, lush riverbank.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示河流和船只的自然风光照片。在画面中央，一艘色彩鲜艳的长尾船停靠在河岸边，船上有一位穿着黑色衣服的人正在操作。河水平静，波纹轻微。两岸覆盖着茂密的绿色植被，包括树木和灌木丛。在远处可以看到一些低矮的建筑物，可能是住宅或商店。整个场景被一片宁静而自然的氛围所包围，给人一种平和与宁静的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a bright, tropical residential lane under a clear blue sky. The scene is framed by dense greenery and tall palm trees, giving it a warm island or coastal feel.

On the left side, there is a mint-green building with white-framed windows and a curved roofline. The windows reflect the surrounding palm leaves. A blue door and blue vertical pipe stand out against the pale green walls. In front of the building, a black scooter is parked at an angle in the shade, partly leaning toward the wall. A low green boundary wall runs along the lane, decorated with repeating curved patterns.

The center of the image is a narrow concrete road stretching into the distance. A person is riding a motorcycle away from the camera, positioned near the middle of the lane. The rider wears a dark blue shirt with white lettering on the back and dark shorts. The motorcycle’s rear license plate is visible but small. Farther down the road, more scooters and small buildings can be seen, with a glimpse of bright blue water or sky at the end of the street, suggesting the lane may lead toward the sea.

Tall coconut palms dominate the middle and upper parts of the scene. Their long fronds arch over the road, casting broken shadows on the ground. The sunlight is strong, producing sharp contrasts between bright, sunlit areas and deep shade.

On the right side, thick tropical foliage fills the frame: large glossy leaves, shrubs, and palm fronds crowd over fences and walls. A wooden fence runs along part of the right side, beside a light-colored utility box. In the lower right corner, another scooter or motorbike is parked close to the fence, with its red rear light and chrome details visible.

The overall atmosphere is calm, sunny, and lush, with pastel-colored houses, sandy concrete pavement, parked scooters, and abundant palm trees suggesting a quiet tropical neighborhood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示热带风情的街道照片，阳光明媚的一天里，一位骑摩托车的人正沿着一条狭窄的道路前行。道路两旁是色彩鲜艳的房屋和茂密的绿色植被，包括高耸的棕榈树和其他热带植物。在道路的右侧，停放着几辆摩托车，而左侧则有一扇半开的窗户。整个场景传达出一种宁静和悠闲的生活氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of an ancient Buddhist temple or shrine, lit with warm, muted golden light. On the left side, two large seated Buddha statues dominate the space. They sit on a raised, tiered platform decorated with worn carved patterns and faded red-and-cream paint. The statues themselves are weathered, with chipped surfaces, peeling pigment, and an aged patina that suggests great age. The larger Buddha on the far left has a serene expression, downcast eyes, elongated ears, and one hand resting downward over the knee in a traditional gesture. The smaller statue beside it is similarly seated, though its face appears softened or blurred in the image.

Behind the statues are rounded, reddish-brown backdrops and pointed architectural forms, possibly stupas or decorative temple elements, rising above their shoulders. At the base of the statues are small offerings, including a vase or container with yellow and white flowers, along with a few small ritual objects.

On the right side of the image, a person in dark maroon robes, likely a Buddhist monk or devotee, kneels on the floor facing the statues with hands pressed together in prayer. The figure is small compared with the monumental sculptures, emphasizing the scale and solemnity of the shrine.

The temple interior is old and textured: the walls are rough, stained, and mottled with age, with patches of dark discoloration and eroded plaster. A large arched passageway curves overhead on the right, richly framed with faded decorative bands and carved details. Soft daylight enters from an opening beyond the arch, creating a bright vertical glow along the far wall and casting gentle shadows across the stone floor.

The overall atmosphere is quiet, reverent, and historical, with a strong sense of devotion, age, and sacred stillness.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示佛教文化的照片，画面中心是一位僧侣正跪在一座宏伟的佛像前进行祈祷。佛像被安置在一个高台上，周围装饰着精美的壁画和雕塑。光线从窗户射入，形成了美丽的光束，给这个宁静的场景增添了一种神圣而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime scene at a large ornamental fountain complex, captured with a long exposure that turns the moving water into smooth, glowing arcs and veils.

On the right side, the main fountain dominates the view. Multiple jets of water rise and curve in layered patterns, forming tall white plumes and looping streams. The fountain is lit with vivid colored lights—blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, and purple—creating a rainbow-like glow across the spraying water. The brightest area is near the center-right, where tall vertical streams shoot upward and dissolve into a misty, luminous haze against the black sky.

In the foreground, a wide pool reflects the lights from the fountains and surrounding lamps. The water surface appears dark but glossy, with streaks of blue, gold, orange, and white shimmering across it. Near the lower left corner, decorative golden sculptural elements—possibly fish or dragon-like fountain ornaments—extend into the frame, adding an ornate, classical feel.

Toward the center background stands a grand illuminated building or pavilion. It has a formal, symmetrical façade with tall columns and decorative architectural details. At the top is a crown-like circular structure with a spire and a small golden emblem or sculpture, glowing warmly. The building’s warm amber lighting contrasts with the cool, colorful fountain lights.

On the left side, there are landscaped areas with low stone borders, flowerbeds, trees, and warm streetlamps. The lamps create starburst effects due to the long exposure. A few blurred figures appear near the benches or walkways, suggesting people are present but moving or out of focus. A construction crane or tall structure is faintly visible in the dark background on the far left.

The sky is almost completely black, making the illuminated fountains and architecture stand out strongly. Overall, the image has a festive, elegant atmosphere, emphasizing light, water, color, and monumental architecture in a nighttime public square or park.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜间喷泉和建筑的摄影作品。在画面中央，喷泉以其绚丽的色彩和动态的水柱成为焦点，其中最显眼的是一个高耸的彩色喷泉，其顶部喷射出明亮的蓝色光线。喷泉周围有多个较小的喷泉，它们以不同的颜色和形状呈现，营造出一种活泼而梦幻的效果。背景中是一座宏伟的建筑，其圆顶和拱门结构在夜色中显得庄严而神秘。周围的灯光和建筑轮廓为这个场景增添了层次感和深度。

caption:
The image shows a wide, calm river landscape under a pale, hazy sky. Most of the upper half of the frame is filled with open gray-blue sky, creating a spacious, quiet feeling.

Across the middle of the scene is a dense line of riverside trees. The forest is thick and varied, with many tall deciduous trees in muted green, olive, and yellowish tones, suggesting late summer or early autumn. The treetops form an uneven natural skyline, with some taller, narrow poplar-like trees rising above the rest. The foliage is dense enough that the trunks and interior of the woodland are mostly hidden in shadow.

Below the trees is a sandy riverbank. The bank is light beige, with patches of low grass, reddish-brown plants, and sparse scrub scattered across it. A thin strip of green vegetation separates the sand from the forest behind it.

In the lower portion of the image, the river stretches horizontally across the frame. The water is gray-green and gently rippled, reflecting the subdued colors of the sky, trees, and boat. Near the lower right side of the river is a flat wooden boat or raft carrying several people. The passengers appear to be wearing bright orange life jackets, which stand out strongly against the natural muted colors. The boat has a low rectangular platform and railings, with some folded chairs or equipment on board. A pale blue dome-shaped tent or canopy sits toward the right side of the boat, and there is a small outboard motor at the stern. The side of the boat has the name “BASONIA” written on it, and a small registration marking is visible near the motor.

The boat’s reflection appears faintly in the water, especially the bright orange of the life jackets. Overall, the scene feels peaceful and outdoorsy, like a river excursion or ferry ride through a quiet, wooded natural area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示河流上的休闲活动的自然风光照片。在河面上，一艘小船装载着几位乘客和一个蓝色的帐篷，正缓缓行驶。船上的人们似乎正在享受户外时光，而帐篷则为他们提供了一个休息的地方。背景中，茂密的树木覆盖了岸边，与蓝天形成对比，营造出一种宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, windswept beach under a heavy, overcast sky. The shoreline stretches diagonally from the lower right foreground toward the hazy distance on the left, creating a strong sense of depth. The sea occupies the right side of the scene, with choppy, gray-green waves rolling toward shore and breaking into white foam along the wet sand.

The beach itself is broad and mostly empty, covered in smooth brown sand scattered with small stones, shells, and bits of dark debris. Near the foreground, shallow pools and reflective patches of water mirror the pale sky. A darker piece of driftwood or seaweed lies on the sand slightly left of center.

On the left side, low dunes rise gently above the beach. They are covered with sparse grasses and vegetation, muted in color by the misty atmosphere. Farther down the coast, the land fades into a soft haze, suggesting sea spray, fog, or rain in the distance.

The sky dominates the upper half of the image, filled with thick gray clouds. Some brighter, diffused light breaks through in places, especially toward the right, giving the scene a silvery glow. Overall, the mood is calm but bleak and atmospheric, evoking a cool, windy day at the coast with rough surf and unsettled weather.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩景观的照片，画面中沙滩呈现出金黄色的色调，波浪在沙滩上轻轻拍打。天空多云，阳光从云层间透出，形成一道道耀眼的光束。远处可以看到一片绿色的植被覆盖的丘陵，与海洋和天空形成了自然界的宁静对比。

caption:
The image shows a wide, elevated panoramic view of a modern waterfront city at dusk or early evening. The sky is a cool blue-gray, suggesting twilight, with low clouds stretching across the horizon. The city lights are already on, creating a strong contrast between the soft, darkening sky and the warm glow of buildings, streets, and reflections on the water.

In the foreground, a broad river dominates the lower half of the scene. Its surface is textured with ripples and subtle waves, reflecting the city lights in streaks of gold, orange, white, pink, and purple. A faint light trail from a moving boat cuts across the water on the left side, indicating a long-exposure photograph. Along the very bottom edge, there are dark silhouettes of leafless trees and patches of parkland, with small pathway lights glowing among them. A lit building with long horizontal rows of windows sits near the lower left, partly obscured by trees.

Across the river, the city skyline rises densely along the waterfront. On the left and center-left are several tall modern high-rises. One prominent tower has a stepped, crown-like top with many warm-lit windows and a red aircraft warning light glowing at its peak. Next to it stands a broad office tower with bright horizontal bands of illuminated floors, giving it a striped appearance. Near the center is a tall rectangular building with a large illuminated “M” sign on its roof; its façade is a mix of white grid-like windows and darker red-brown sections.

At the base of these towers, older lower-rise buildings with ornate façades and warm lighting line the waterfront, adding historic character beneath the modern skyscrapers. Streets and quays are brightly lit, with lights tracing the edges of the water and roads.

To the right, the city continues around a harbor inlet or canal, where the water bends inward and reflects clusters of bright yellow and pink lights. A bridge or quay structure crosses part of this inlet. Farther right, there are more mid-rise buildings, construction cranes, industrial-looking structures, and a brightly lit urban district. One building glows vivid green, standing out sharply among the warmer lights. In the far background, a large bridge-like structure and many small city lights stretch toward the horizon.

Overall, the scene feels vibrant and metropolitan: a busy modern port city at twilight, with illuminated skyscrapers, waterfront architecture, harbor activity, and shimmering reflections creating a dramatic urban nightscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，图像中心是几座高耸入云的摩天大楼，它们在夜晚被灯光照亮，反射出耀眼的光芒。河面上映照着建筑物和桥梁的倒影，增添了画面的美感。河岸边有几艘船只静静地停泊，而对岸则是密集的城市建筑群。天空呈现出深蓝色调，与城市的灯光形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a large group of cyclists riding down a city street on a bright, sunny day. The camera is positioned low and close to the road, facing the riders as they approach, which makes the cyclists in the foreground appear large and prominent.

In the foreground, several adult cyclists dominate the scene. On the right, a man in a vivid red cycling shirt and black shorts rides closest to the camera. He is wearing a bright neon-green helmet, red gloves, a backpack or hydration pack, and neon-green socks. His bicycle’s front wheel is partly cropped by the bottom edge of the frame, emphasizing how near he is. In the center, another cyclist wears a sleeveless gray top, dark shorts, fingerless gloves, and a backpack, riding a red-and-black bike. To the left, a cyclist in a gray striped polo shirt and shorts rides a mountain bike; he also appears to be wearing gloves and a backpack.

Behind them, many more cyclists fill the street, riding in a loose group. Some wear helmets and sportswear, including bright colors such as turquoise, lime green, and black. A few riders have backpacks, and one cyclist near the center appears to have a small action camera mounted on their chest or bike. The group looks like it may be part of a recreational ride or cycling event.

The setting is an urban area with older, ornate European-style buildings on both sides of the street. On the left, a gray stone building has decorative architectural details, arched windows, and a hanging sign that reads “MTB Bank.” Parked cars line the curb, including a dark red SUV and several silver or gray vehicles. On the right, a pale cream building with tall windows, balconies, and decorative molding faces the street; a couple of people can be seen standing on a balcony above. There are also shopfronts at street level.

In the background, leafy green trees rise between the buildings, adding a summery feel. Overhead wires stretch across the street, and traffic signs are visible near the center-left. The road is wide and mostly clear for the cyclists, with small speed bumps or road dividers visible near the bottom and middle of the frame.

The overall mood is energetic and communal, with the cyclists moving together through a sunny city environment. The strong daylight creates sharp shadows beneath the bikes and riders, highlighting the clear weather and midday atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道上自行车骑行活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有几位骑自行车的人沿着街道前进，他们穿着休闲服装和头盔，显得轻松愉快。街道两旁是建筑物，远处可以看到行人和其他车辆。阳光明媚，为这个户外场景增添了活力。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a modern commercial building labeled **“CHAMCHURI SQUARE”** in large metallic, serif-style letters across the front facade. The building has a broad, slightly curved frontage with a beige stone or tile surface and extensive rows of rectangular glass windows framed in white or light-colored metal.

In the foreground on the left, large palm fronds hang into the frame, partially covering the upper-left portion of the building and adding a tropical feel. The palm leaves are dense, long, and green, with some yellowish tones.

Above the main sign, there is another level of the building with pale green-tinted windows. On the rooftop or upper terrace, there is a landscaped area with shrubs and several trees planted in a row. The trees vary in size and shape: some have small rounded canopies, while one on the right is larger and darker with a fuller crown. A flowering tree or shrub with pink blossoms appears near the far right.

The sky in the background is cloudy and gray, suggesting overcast weather. The glass windows reflect nearby high-rise buildings and the surrounding urban environment.

At the lower part of the image, an entrance canopy projects outward from the building. Beneath it, there are signs with Thai text and English labels, including **“OUT”** and **“IN,”** indicating entry and exit points. Several black streetlamp-style fixtures are visible near the entrance area.

Overall, the scene depicts a clean, contemporary shopping or office complex in an urban setting, softened by greenery, palm trees, and rooftop landscaping.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Chamchuri Square建筑外观的照片。建筑物的正面由大面积的玻璃窗构成，上方有大型的白色字母标识“CHAMCHURI SQUARE”。建筑的顶部覆盖着绿色植被，周围环境中有几棵高大的棕榈树和一些低矮的灌木丛。天空多云，为场景增添了一丝阴郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, elevated view of a busy urban highway at night, captured with a long-exposure effect. Multiple lanes of traffic stretch diagonally from the lower foreground toward the upper right, creating bright continuous light trails instead of clearly visible cars. White and bluish-white streaks mark headlights, while red and orange streaks mark taillights, giving the scene a strong sense of speed and movement.

The road is divided into two main directions by a low concrete median with sparse, dry-looking plants. Lane markings and large white directional arrows are visible on the asphalt, especially in the foreground. The pavement appears worn in places, with cracks, patches, and rectangular repair marks. On the far right edge, there is a raised sidewalk or overpass railing with planted greenery and tall grasses.

Overhead streetlights line the roadway, glowing intensely and creating halos against the dark sky. Several green highway signs hang above the lanes. The signs are in Portuguese and point toward places such as “Av. Ibirapuera,” “Congonhas,” “Interlagos,” “Pq. Ibirapuera,” and “Av. Brasil,” suggesting the scene is in São Paulo, Brazil. A small sign near the median reads “Bairro km 4.4.”

On the left and center background, dark trees partially obscure city buildings. Some buildings have illuminated windows, while others are mostly shadowed. One older, narrower building near the center has graffiti on its upper facade and walls, contrasting with the taller modern buildings behind it. Far in the right background, a tall, pale obelisk-like monument rises against the night sky, with faint city lights around it.

The overall atmosphere is urban, fast-paced, and slightly cinematic. The long-exposure light trails dominate the image, turning ordinary traffic into flowing ribbons of light across a nighttime cityscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜间交通流的长时间曝光摄影作品。图像捕捉了车辆在道路上留下的红色和白色光轨，它们沿着道路蜿蜒延伸，形成了一种动态而抽象的视觉效果。道路两侧是城市的建筑群，灯光点缀其中，与夜空中的星星相映成趣。路边有绿色植被和路标，为这个繁忙的城市场景增添了一些自然元素。

caption:
The image shows the corner of a tall urban office building, likely in a dense city center. The building façade is made of stone or concrete panels with rows of tall rectangular windows rising upward, surrounded by other high-rise buildings with glass and vertical architectural lines.

A large, curved blue LED news ticker wraps around the corner of the building near street level. The ticker displays bright white scrolling text. Visible portions read something like: “NYPD says the 28-year-old suspect may be behind two similar acts at two other Manhattan churches...” The sign bends smoothly around the building’s corner, creating a prominent marquee-like effect.

Below the ticker are large promotional window graphics for Fox News’ election coverage. Several panels feature patriotic imagery in red, white, and blue. One central poster reads: “Your Freedom. Your Vote.” above a circular emblem that says “FOX NEWS DEMOCRACY 2022,” with stars and vertical red stripes resembling an American flag. Another large wall graphic to the right shows the word “DEMOCRACY” in oversized blue letters, set over a grayscale image of a classical government building with columns, likely meant to evoke the U.S. Supreme Court or Capitol architecture. A flowing red-and-white flag-like ribbon graphic stretches across the lower part of the display.

On the left side, another vertical display includes a grayscale close-up of the Statue of Liberty’s face and crown, reinforcing the patriotic theme. The same “Fox News Democracy 2022” branding appears again above it.

The street scene is relatively quiet, with no pedestrians visible. Black metal crowd-control barricades line the sidewalk in the foreground. The lighting suggests daytime, with sunlight and shadows falling across the building and pavement. The overall impression is of a major media headquarters or broadcast studio exterior decorated for 2022 election coverage, combining news headlines, patriotic visuals, and large-scale digital signage.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在城市街道上的政治广告牌的照片。广告牌上印有大型的蓝色文字“DEMOCRACY”和一个红色背景上有白色星星的美国国旗图案，以及一个蓝色圆形徽章，上面写着“FOX NEWS DEMOCRAT 2022”。广告牌上方还有一段文字：“WHO is the 28-year-old suspect may be behind two or more of these attacks?”，暗示了正在进行的调查或案件。整个场景被一些现代建筑和街景所包围，但焦点明显集中在广告牌上。

caption:
This is an old, sepia-toned photograph with a thick off-white border, showing signs of age such as faded color, soft focus, worn corners, and slight creases or discoloration along the edges.

In the center foreground are three people posing outdoors in a grassy or brushy area. Two of them are seated on the ground, while a third person is positioned slightly behind them, either kneeling or sitting higher up. Their faces are blurred, but they appear to be looking toward the camera. The two seated figures are close together, suggesting a posed group portrait.

The person on the left in front wears a darker outfit, possibly a zippered jacket or sweater with dark pants. One leg is bent outward, and a light-colored shoe is visible near the lower left. The person on the right wears a lighter shirt and light trousers, sitting with legs bent and hands resting near the knees. The person behind them wears a light-colored top and is partly obscured by the two in front.

The setting appears rural or wooded. Behind the group is a sloped area covered with dry grass, weeds, and low brush. Farther back, a line of thin tree trunks forms a darker vertical background. A long branch or stick lies diagonally from the left side toward the group, adding to the natural, informal outdoor setting.

The photograph is somewhat overexposed in places, especially on the clothing and faces, and the overall image is soft and faded, giving it the look of a family snapshot from several decades ago. The composition is slightly tilted, with the printed photo not perfectly aligned inside the border. The overall mood is casual and nostalgic, like a candid outdoor memory preserved in an aged print.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张复古风格的黑白照片，展示了三个人坐在草地上。最左边的人穿着深色上衣和浅色裤子，中间的人穿着白色T恤和深色裤子，而右边的人则穿着浅色上衣和深色裤子。他们似乎在享受户外时光，背景是模糊的树木和草地。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic coastal beach scene on a bright, clear day.

In the foreground, there is a line of weathered wooden posts driven vertically into the sand, forming a rustic barrier or breakwater. The posts vary in height and thickness, with rough, gray, sun-bleached tops and darker, sea-stained lower sections. Some are clustered closely together, while others stand apart, creating an irregular rhythm across the bottom of the image. Their shadows stretch across the pale sand, and scattered pieces of seaweed lie around their bases.

Beyond the posts is a broad expanse of smooth, light-colored sand, exposed by the tide. The sand has subtle wet and dry areas, with darker patches near shallow pools and tidal channels. A curving inlet of calm, shallow water sweeps from the left foreground toward the center, reflecting the blue of the sky. The water is clear turquoise near the shore and deepens to richer blue farther out.

To the left, rocky outcrops break up the beach, forming jagged brown and gray formations that extend into the water. In the middle distance, small groups of people are walking across the sand and along the waterline. They appear tiny compared with the vast beach and sky, emphasizing the scale of the landscape. Some people are near the shoreline on the right, where gentle waves meet the sand.

Near the center-right of the horizon, a stone fort sits on a rocky tidal island. It has thick, pale stone walls and a compact, fortress-like structure. A small flag flies above it. The fort is surrounded by rugged rocks, and a sandy path or exposed tidal area appears to connect it to the beach at low tide.

The sea stretches across the background in bands of vivid turquoise and deep blue. On the far horizon, low islands or headlands are visible on both the left and right sides. A few small boats can be seen offshore.

Above, the sky dominates much of the image. It is a bright, saturated blue with scattered white cumulus clouds. The clouds are soft and puffy, with some larger formations especially on the right side, adding depth and movement to the scene. The overall mood is open, breezy, and peaceful, with strong natural light and crisp coastal colors.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩景观的自然风光摄影图片。前景中，沙滩上排列着一些古老的木桩，它们在退潮时被海水冲刷得略显磨损。沙滩延伸至画面中央，那里有几个人在享受阳光和海风。在远处，可以看到一个孤立的小岛，上面建有一座古老的建筑，它坐落在蔚蓝的海洋之中，显得格外引人注目。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间，为这个宁静的场景增添了几分生动的气息。

caption:
The image shows the entrance sign and grounds of the **Montfort Youth Training Centre – Skills Development Campus** on a bright, sunny day.

In the foreground is a long, pale cream-colored boundary wall with raised lettering and a large logo mounted on it. The main text on the wall reads:

**“Montfort Youth Training Centre”**  
**“Skills Development Campus”**

Below that, in smaller stylized text, is the slogan:

**“Montfort Builds Youth Builds Nation”**

On the left side of the wall is the centre’s emblem: a circular blue-and-white logo with red abstract human-like figures or initials in the middle. Around the lower part of the circle, the words **“Montfort Youth Training Centre”** are visible.

The wall is topped with a metal security fence made of vertical pointed bars. At both ends of the visible wall are decorative pillars with white spherical lamps mounted on top. There are also black metal light fixtures attached to the wall.

Behind the wall stands a large industrial or institutional building with grey corrugated siding and a striking bright turquoise-blue metal roof. The roof slopes steeply and extends across much of the right side of the image. The building has rectangular windows and appears to be part of a campus workshop or training facility.

In front of the wall is a landscaped strip with low reddish shrubs and a grassy area dotted with many small yellow flowers. The ground is partly sandy or patchy near the grass.

The background is filled with dense green trees and foliage, giving the campus a lush, tropical feel. Above everything is a wide, clear blue sky with only a few faint clouds, emphasizing the bright daylight and open outdoor setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示'Montfort Youth Training Centre Skills Development Campus'的入口照片。在图片的前景，有一个带有文字和标志的墙面上方，上面写着'Montfort Youth Training Centre Skills Development Campus'，并附有口号'Montfort Builds Youth Double Nation'。墙面上方是一个红色的图标，代表了中心的三个主要目标：健康、教育和技能发展。背景中可以看到一片绿色植被和一个蓝色屋顶的建筑物，表明这是一个户外环境。

caption:
The image shows an ornate stone entrance gate to what appears to be a traditional Balinese/Hindu temple or sacred compound. The gate is tall, weathered, and richly decorated, with layered stone tiers rising upward like a small temple tower. Its gray-brown stone surface looks aged, with patches of dark staining, moss, lichen, and small plants growing in crevices, giving it a historic, tropical feel.

The structure is covered in carved details: floral motifs, geometric bands, and small relief ornaments run horizontally across the tiers. Near the top is a small vertical niche or opening, and the uppermost section has a worn, blocky crown. The entrance passage is narrow and framed by thick stone pillars. Beneath the upper lintel, there is a decorative golden carved panel above the doorway, contrasting with the muted stone.

At the base of the gate, several pairs of sandals and flip-flops are scattered on the stone steps and ground, indicating that visitors are expected to remove footwear before entering. On the right side of the entrance, a black sign with Indonesian text reads “SEPATU / SANDAL HARAP DILEPAS,” meaning shoes/sandals should be removed. Another sign on the left reads “LESTARIKAN BUDAYA BANGSA,” roughly meaning “preserve the nation’s culture.” There is also a smaller sign with a name and phone number on the right pillar.

To the right foreground stands a small shrine-like stone pedestal or altar. It has a miniature roof-like top and is draped in ceremonial cloth: mostly white fabric with a yellow-gold band and an ornate golden cloth over the top. This kind of dressing suggests ritual or religious use. On the left side, there is a green cloth draped over an object, possibly a chair or ceremonial item.

Through the open doorway, a stone courtyard and more temple architecture are visible inside, including low walls and another small shrine or tower in the distance. The passage leads inward along a slightly curved stone path.

The scene is surrounded by lush tropical vegetation. Dense green leaves frame the left and right edges, and pink flowers appear near the upper right. A tall, slender pole wrapped with strips of material stands on the left, resembling a ceremonial bamboo pole. The sky above is bright blue with light wispy clouds, and sunlight casts strong shadows across the stone, emphasizing the texture of the carvings and the uneven ground. Overall, the image conveys a quiet, sacred, and traditional atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统建筑入口的照片。照片中心是一座具有巴厘岛特色的石制拱门，其顶部装饰有精细的雕刻和石雕图案。拱门两侧是两根高耸的石柱，上面悬挂着一些宗教用品。在拱门前方，有一块绿色布料覆盖的祭坛，旁边摆放着一顶金色头饰。周围环境由树木、灌木和几座小型建筑物组成，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a stylish indoor or semi-outdoor space with a decorative wall feature and a view of greenery outside.

At the top is a mustard-gold ceiling made of parallel ribbed metal or wooden slats running diagonally across the frame. The ceiling has a warm, matte finish and gives the space a modern architectural look. Hanging from it on the upper right is a black cylindrical pendant lamp. The lampshade has a perforated geometric pattern—small repeated chevrons or arrow shapes—and the light inside glows warmly, creating an orange-gold shine along the inner surface of the shade. A partial second lamp is barely visible at the far left edge.

Behind the main wall feature is a large glass window or partition. Through the glass, dense green bamboo-like plants can be seen outside, filling much of the background with leafy texture. The glass panels have visible vertical seams and reflect some indoor light.

The main focal point is a large rectangular ceramic tile mural occupying the lower half of the image. It is made up of many square cream-colored tiles painted in blue, resembling traditional Portuguese or Delft-style azulejo tiles. The mural has an ornate blue border with scrollwork, floral flourishes, and corner decorations. Inside the border are detailed blue illustrations of cherubs, birds, vines, fruit, flowers, and decorative foliage. Several cherub figures appear among grape clusters and leafy garlands, giving the mural a classical, pastoral feel. The glossy tile surface reflects light in places, especially near the center.

On the left side of the image, the space becomes darker, possibly an interior corridor or restaurant area, with a black reflective ceiling and small warm lights in the distance. Overall, the scene combines modern design elements—glass, metal ceiling slats, and patterned pendant lighting—with traditional blue-and-white tile artwork and lush greenery outside.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内装饰的照片，焦点在于一块悬挂的蓝白相间的瓷砖艺术作品。瓷砖上绘有精细的植物和水果图案，色彩鲜明且细节丰富。上方有一个金属吊灯，发出温暖的黄色光芒，与瓷砖上的蓝色形成对比。背景中可以看到一些绿色植物，为这个室内空间增添了一抹自然气息。

caption:
The image shows an overhead, close-up view of a person using a Dell laptop on a light-colored desk. The person is seen from behind and slightly to the side; their head and shoulders are out of focus in the foreground, while the laptop screen and keyboard are more clearly visible. They appear to have short light or gray hair, and their hands are positioned over the keyboard as if typing or navigating.

On the laptop screen, a web browser is open to a dark-themed map of the northeastern United States and parts of eastern Canada. City and region labels such as Chicago, Detroit, Toronto, Montreal, New York, Boston, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia are visible. Large red circular markers of varying sizes are scattered across the map, especially clustered around New York and nearby northeastern areas, suggesting a data visualization such as case counts, incidents, or population-related statistics.

The laptop has a black keyboard with blue backlighting, and some keys include Cyrillic characters in addition to Latin letters. The Dell logo is visible below the screen. Along the bottom of the display, the Windows taskbar can be seen with several application icons, and the clock/date area appears on the lower right.

The photo has a warm, slightly soft lighting style, with shallow depth of field: the person’s head and part of the foreground are blurred, drawing attention to the laptop screen and the map visualization. The overall impression is of someone closely monitoring geographic data or an online dashboard.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男性在使用笔记本电脑的现实主义风格照片。男性坐在桌前，专注地看着屏幕上的地图界面，屏幕上显示了多个城市的名称和红色标记点。他的右手握着手机，似乎在与人通话或查看信息。背景是室内环境，光线柔和，营造出一种工作氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lush, green garden in what appears to be a quiet park or landscaped outdoor area. The foreground is filled with dense rose bushes and leafy plants, creating a thick layer of greenery that dominates most of the frame. Scattered among the leaves are several bright pink and magenta roses, some fully open and others still in bud form. A few pale or white blossoms are also visible deeper in the garden.

In the background, partially obscured by foliage, there is a wooden gazebo or pavilion. It has warm orange-brown wooden posts and railings, with diagonal support beams forming triangular patterns beneath the roof. The roof is broad and pyramidal, covered in a muted gray-brown material, and it casts shade over the seating area inside. Within the gazebo, a bench or table-like structure can be faintly seen, though it is softened by the depth of field and surrounding plants.

The garden is surrounded by tall trees and dense shrubs, giving the scene a secluded, natural feeling. Sunlight filters through the tree canopy, creating dappled patches of brightness on the leaves, gazebo, and ground. The overall color palette is dominated by vivid greens, with the pink roses adding strong accents of color.

The image has a soft, slightly dreamy quality, with the gazebo in the background somewhat out of focus and the vegetation in the foreground creating a layered, immersive view. The atmosphere feels peaceful, summery, and shaded, like a quiet rose garden tucked away beneath mature trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的照片，前景充满了生机勃勃的玫瑰花丛，其中粉红色和红色的花朵在绿色叶片中显得格外鲜艳。背景中是一个木质结构的凉亭，位于一片繁茂的树木和灌木之间，为这个宁静的花园场景增添了一抹人类活动的气息。

caption:
The image shows a shirtless male performer on stage, photographed from about the waist up against a hazy, smoke-filled background. His face is intentionally blurred, but he appears to have short dark hair and is wearing dark sunglasses. He is holding a black wired microphone close to his mouth with one hand, suggesting he is singing or speaking during a live performance. The microphone cable loops across his torso and down toward the bottom of the frame.

His upper body and arms are heavily covered in colorful tattoos. Across his chest are large lettering tattoos, including “YOU NEED ME” near the collarbone area and a large stylized word across the center of his chest. There are many traditional-style tattoo designs: skulls, flowers, birds, a yin-yang symbol, a large eagle or bird across the stomach, a portrait-like figure, and other bold graphic imagery in black, red, blue, yellow, and green tones. His arms are also densely tattooed from shoulder to wrist.

He is wearing dark pants with a brown belt, and the waistband of his underwear is visible above the pants. A small blue item, possibly part of a stage pack or accessory, is clipped or tucked near his right hip. The lighting is dramatic and subdued, with grey-white smoke or fog filling the background and creating a concert atmosphere. The overall mood is intense and performance-focused, with the performer centered prominently in the frame.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位全身覆盖着纹身的男性在舞台上表演的照片。他戴着墨镜，手持麦克风，正专注地唱歌。他的上半身和手臂上的纹身非常醒目，包括复杂的图案、文字和符号。背景中可以看到舞台灯光产生的模糊效果，为照片增添了一种现场音乐会的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a busy commercial street in what appears to be Bangkok, Thailand, packed with signs, vehicles, pedestrians, shops, and street stalls.

In the foreground, traffic is moving slowly down a narrow road. A white Toyota SUV is centered prominently, seen from the rear, with a Thai license plate. To its right is a white van, and more cars are lined up ahead, creating a congested city-street feeling. Pedestrians walk along both sides of the road and between market stalls; several faces appear blurred. On the right edge, a few people are walking past clothing displays and street vendors.

The street is lined with dense signage and storefronts. On the right side, a large red-and-white KFC sign dominates the upper portion of the image, with another KFC storefront sign lower down. Nearby are signs for “Jewellery Land,” “99 FAS,” “Boston” custom tailoring, and an ATM. A McDonald’s sign with “24” is visible farther down the street, suggesting a 24-hour location. On the left side, a large green Subway sign reads “OPEN 24 hrs.” Below it are signs for Kodak “Digital Services,” travel bookings, bus/train/air tickets, and hotel reservations. Higher up on the left is a weathered sign pointing toward a “Hostel.”

Both sides of the street are crowded with small businesses, awnings, racks of clothing, souvenir items, umbrellas, and market goods. On the left foreground, colorful merchandise and hanging shirts are visible, including printed T-shirts. On the right, green umbrellas shade street stalls and clothing displays.

The scene feels warm and slightly hazy, with golden sunlight illuminating the buildings and signs. The sky is bright and mostly washed out, making the colorful advertisements and storefronts stand out strongly. The composition emphasizes the visual clutter and energy of a tourist-heavy shopping street, with international chains, local shops, travel services, jewelry stores, tailors, food outlets, and street vendors all packed tightly together.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的照片，画面中心有一辆白色SUV汽车正在行驶，周围是行人和各种商店。左侧有'OPENWAY'的招牌，右侧则有'KFC'、'BOSTON LADIES & GENTLEMEN'S CLOTHES'等店铺的招牌。街道上还有穿着各式服装的人们在行走或购物。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny outdoor scene in a park-like area with a wide grassy field and a pale gravel walking path in the foreground. Several people are scattered across the scene, walking casually in small groups or alone.

In the background, a row of large tour buses is parked along a road or parking area behind a low stone embankment. The buses are mostly white with dark tinted windows; one on the right is a double-decker coach with red lettering and striping. Another bus near the center-left has bold text on its side. A small sign near the buses appears to mark a bus stop or parking area. Behind the buses is a dense wall of tall green trees, creating a leafy forest backdrop. The sky above is clear and pale blue, suggesting warm weather.

The foreground is dominated by a gravel path curving or stretching forward through the grass. A group of four young people walks away from the camera near the center: two have light-colored hair, and two wear dark hoodies or darker clothing. To their right, an adult walks with a small child wearing a bright blue sunhat. Farther right, near the edge of the image, there is a souvenir or toy stand displaying colorful items, including plush toys, bright fuzzy objects, and hanging trinkets.

On the left side, more people walk across the grass, including a small group near a tall vertical pole. Another person in the lower-left foreground walks away from the camera carrying a light-colored bag or backpack over one shoulder. A few other figures are spread across the midground, giving the scene a relaxed, touristy atmosphere.

The lighting is strong and direct, casting distinct shadows on the grass and path. Overall, it appears to be a busy but calm recreational or tourist area, possibly near a bus drop-off point, with visitors walking through a green park under clear summer skies.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常户外活动的摄影照片，画面中有多个人物在阳光明媚的一天里沿着一条小径行走。前景左侧有一位穿着黑色连帽衫和牛仔裤的女性，她正从左向右走着。紧随其后的是两位年轻女性，一位穿着白色上衣和浅色长裤，另一位穿着黑色T恤和深色短裤。他们似乎正在享受一个轻松的下午时光。在他们的右侧，可以看到一群人在草地上散步或玩耍，而更远处则停有几辆大型旅游巴士，准备迎接更多的游客。背景中的树木为这个场景增添了一抹自然的绿色。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large, historic church or cathedral, viewed from the back of the nave looking toward the main altar. The space is grand, symmetrical, and richly architectural, with a strong sense of age and weathering.

A long central aisle runs straight down the middle, flanked by rows of simple wooden chairs arranged in neat blocks. Several visitors and worshippers are scattered throughout—some seated, some standing, and a few gathered closer to the altar. Their small scale emphasizes the immense height and volume of the building.

The architecture is dominated by massive stone columns and elaborate side arcades on both the left and right walls. The stone surfaces appear worn, cracked, and mottled, with gray, beige, and faded reddish tones. Many of the columns and decorative moldings have a distressed, aged texture, suggesting centuries of use or partial restoration. Along the side walls are arched niches and chapels, some containing religious statues, candles, and small altars. Red-carpeted steps lead up to side devotional areas, where candle stands glow softly.

The ceiling is striking: a series of high barrel vaults and arches painted in warm terracotta, rose, and orange hues. The curved ceiling surfaces contrast with the cooler gray stone below, creating a dramatic visual effect. The arches repeat rhythmically toward the altar, drawing the eye forward and upward.

At the far end is an ornate Baroque-style altar area. It is richly decorated with carved stone, gilded elements, statues, columns, and religious imagery. A central golden tabernacle or altarpiece stands out, with a prominent cross visible near the middle. Sculptural figures flank the altar, and decorative scrollwork and reliefs fill the upper section. Warm spotlights illuminate the altar and lower side walls, adding golden highlights to the otherwise weathered stone interior.

Natural light enters from tall arched windows high along the side walls, especially on the right, creating bright patches and emphasizing the texture of the old masonry. The overall atmosphere is reverent, historic, and slightly solemn, combining grandeur with visible decay. The scene feels like a functioning sacred space inside an ancient or heavily aged church, where visitors quietly admire the architecture and devotional objects.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂内部的照片，教堂的天花板高耸，拱形结构与复杂的石雕装饰相映成趣。中央位置是一个金色的祭坛，周围摆放着红色和棕色的长椅供信徒们使用。墙壁上挂有宗教画作，而柱子则显得坚固且装饰性。在照片的前景中，可以看到几位信徒正在参观或祈祷，他们坐在长椅上或是站立。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a tall, glossy black rectangular sign or pillar standing outdoors in an urban setting. Centered near the upper portion of the sign is a shiny silver Mercedes-Benz emblem: a three-pointed star enclosed within a circular ring. The metallic logo reflects light and stands out sharply against the deep black surface.

Behind the sign are several multi-story buildings. On the left side, there is a modern glass building with a blue-tinted grid of windows, giving it a sleek corporate look. Farther left, a pale pink building edge is visible. On the right side, a white or light-gray residential or office building fills much of the background, with rows of rectangular windows, some covered by curtains or blinds.

The lower part of the image is filled with lush green trees and foliage, suggesting the sign is located near a landscaped street, courtyard, or business entrance. A few leafy branches frame the right and lower edges of the scene. The background buildings are slightly out of focus, emphasizing the Mercedes-Benz sign as the main subject. The overall atmosphere feels like a city business district or dealership entrance surrounded by greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示奔驰汽车品牌标志的照片，标志位于图像的中心，背景是现代城市建筑和绿色植被。标志的设计简洁而优雅，以银色为主色调，并在黑色背景上呈现出金属质感。标志下方是茂密的树木，为这个商业场景增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows the upper exterior of a large modern stadium, viewed from below at an angle. At the top of the structure is a prominent bright blue sign in Cyrillic reading “ГАЗПРОМ АРЕНА” (“Gazprom Arena”), accompanied by the Gazprom flame logo on the left. The letters are large, three-dimensional, and mounted on a metal framework of silver trusses and supports.

The stadium roof curves upward across the lower half of the image, with a metallic, ribbed underside visible in shadow. Along the roof edge there is a rounded silver fascia and a narrow railing or maintenance walkway. Beneath the roofline, glass panels and structural beams are visible, suggesting a contemporary arena façade.

The background is a clear pale blue sky, taking up much of the upper part of the frame and giving the scene a bright, open feel. The lighting appears to be daylight, with warm sunlight illuminating the blue signage and parts of the metal structure. The composition emphasizes the scale of the stadium and the bold branding at the top.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑顶部的摄影图像，建筑物的屋顶部分被蓝色的广告牌所覆盖。广告牌上印有'ENERGY FUTURE'的字样，字体设计简洁而醒目。整个场景在晴朗的天空背景下拍摄，阳光照射下，广告牌和建筑物的轮廓清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a TAP Portugal commercial passenger jet in flight against a clear, pale blue sky. The aircraft is photographed from below and slightly behind, at a diagonal angle, making it appear as though it is climbing or banking.

The plane has a mostly white fuselage with TAP Portugal’s distinctive red and green livery. Large black lettering spelling “PORTUGAL” is visible along the side of the fuselage near the front, and the vertical tail fin is bright red with white vertical text reading “TAP PORTUGAL.” A green triangular section extends forward from the tail area, blending into the rear fuselage. Near the rear of the aircraft, the registration “CS-TTI” is visible, along with markings indicating it is an Airbus A319.

The landing gear is extended, with the main wheels and nose gear clearly visible beneath the aircraft, suggesting the plane is either taking off or preparing to land. The engines are mounted under the wings, and the left engine is prominently visible. The wings stretch across the image, with the nearer wing running diagonally upward to the left and the far wing extending toward the lower right edge of the frame. The flaps and wing details are visible, giving the aircraft a dynamic, mechanical look.

The composition emphasizes motion and scale: the plane fills most of the frame, tilted dramatically, with no ground or clouds visible—only open sky surrounding it. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the white body and the vivid red and green airline branding.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架商用喷气式飞机在晴朗的蓝天中飞行的照片。飞机的机身上有明显的绿色和红色条纹，尾翼上印有'TAP Portugal'字样，表明其所属航空公司。飞机的起落架已经放下，准备降落或刚刚起飞。

caption:
The image shows a colorful wooden passenger boat cruising along a river in bright daylight. The boat is viewed from the side, moving across greenish water and leaving a small wake at the bow and along its hull.

The vessel has a traditional, polished wooden cabin with large rectangular windows and open seating areas. Its hull is dark brown with a bold yellow stripe running along the side, and the bow is painted green with red and white trim. Black rubber tires are attached along the side as bumpers, and several red round fenders hang from the cabin. The marking “RC 35” is clearly visible on the yellow side panel, and the number “35” appears near the rear. A lifebuoy is mounted at the back right side of the boat. Small triangular bunting flags—red and white, resembling Singapore-themed decorations—are strung along the roofline.

There are many passengers on board, including adults and children. Some sit inside the cabin looking out through the windows, while others are gathered in the open rear seating area. A few people appear to be taking photos or looking at the scenery.

In the background, a stone embankment lines the river. The wall is made of pale rectangular blocks and includes a small set of steps descending toward the water. A vertical water-level gauge with black markings and a yellow lower section is mounted on the wall. Above the embankment is a riverside promenade with black posts and chain barriers, potted plants, neatly trimmed hedges, and decorative lamp posts with globe lights.

Behind the promenade stands a large, elegant, light-colored building with classical architectural features. It has tall white-framed windows, stone columns and panels, a glass canopy extending over part of the walkway, and what appears to be an outdoor dining or café area with tables and chairs. On the left side, leafy green trees provide shade and soften the urban riverside setting.

Overall, the scene feels lively and touristic, with the traditional-style riverboat passing in front of a refined waterfront building on a sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘装饰有红色和黄色条纹的船在河中航行的照片。船上有多位乘客，他们似乎正在享受水上旅行的乐趣。背景是一座现代风格的建筑，其白色立面与周围的绿色植被形成对比。

caption:
The image shows a modern architectural entrance or covered walkway at night, likely outside a museum, gallery, visitor center, or cultural building.

A large canopy dominates the scene, stretching across the top of the image. Its underside is a warm golden-orange color and is covered with a dense pattern of irregular black and pale cutout shapes, resembling scattered leaves, birds, or camouflage-like fragments. The pattern continues across the ceiling and is reflected in the glass façade on the right, creating a layered, almost kaleidoscopic effect. Several recessed spotlights are embedded in the canopy, casting warm pools of light onto the walkway below.

On the right side is a tall glass wall forming the exterior of the building. The glass panels are framed with dark metal mullions and reflect the patterned canopy, columns, and surrounding lights. Through the glass, the interior appears brightly lit and modern, with display cases, shelves, signs, and exhibition-like objects visible. Orange bird silhouettes or decals appear on the glass, reinforcing the nature-inspired theme.

The walkway itself is broad, smooth, and pale concrete, curving gently through the space. Circular ground lights are set into the pavement, adding subtle illumination. Several cylindrical gray columns support the canopy, spaced at regular intervals and receding into the background, giving the scene depth.

On the left side, there is an upright informational sign mounted on a base. It contains diagrams and text, though most of the writing is too small to read clearly. Behind it are young planted trees supported by wooden stakes, low landscaping beds, and bare winter trees. Farther back, a softly lit park-like area and dark silhouettes of larger trees are visible against a deep blue night sky.

The overall atmosphere is calm, polished, and contemporary. The combination of warm lighting, reflective glass, organic ceiling pattern, and nighttime setting gives the space a dramatic and inviting appearance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的夜景照片，建筑物由玻璃和金属构成，顶部装饰有抽象图案。地面铺设有混凝土材料，两侧是带有反射效果的玻璃幕墙。在建筑前方，有一块白色标牌立于地面上，旁边是一些裸露的树木和灌木丛。远处可见城市的灯光点缀着夜晚的天空。

caption:
The image shows a person standing on a tropical beach, pulling or handling a large fishing net. The figure is positioned slightly right of center and is seen in profile, leaning back with both hands gripping the net as if applying steady force. The net stretches diagonally across the foreground from the lower left toward the right side of the frame. It is dark green or black mesh, with bright blue ropes running through it and several pale round floats attached along its length.

The person is wearing a wide, woven conical hat that shades most of their face, making their facial features not visible. An orange cloth or scarf is wrapped around the head and neck beneath the hat, with a bit of lighter fabric visible near the face. They are dressed in a loose, pale green long-sleeved shirt or tunic with a slightly wrinkled texture and decorative cutwork near the hem. Dark trousers are visible below. Their posture suggests physical effort, with the body angled backward and the arms extended downward toward the taut net.

The background is lush and tropical, filled with tall coconut palm trees. The palm fronds dominate the upper and middle portions of the image, creating a soft green backdrop with yellowish highlights. The background is somewhat blurred, giving the photo a shallow depth of field and drawing attention to the person and the net.

At the bottom of the image, the sandy shoreline is visible, with calm water on the left side and scattered debris or natural beach material along the shore. Fallen palm trunks, roots, and dark piles of organic material appear near the base of the trees. The overall mood is quiet and documentary-like, capturing a moment of coastal labor in a warm, humid, tropical environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位亚洲渔民在海滩上工作的照片。渔夫穿着绿色的长袖衬衫和橙色的围巾，头戴传统的圆锥形草帽，脸上戴着口罩以保护自己免受海洋生物的影响。他正拿着一条粗大的渔网，准备进行捕鱼活动。背景中，可以看到郁郁葱葱的棕榈树和一些散落的海藻，营造出一种宁静而自然的海边氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large sightseeing riverboat moving or moored along a riverside quay on a sunny day. The boat dominates the lower half of the scene and is painted mostly white with a bold red band along the hull and black trim around the windows. It has two levels: an enclosed lower deck with long rectangular windows, and an open upper deck filled with rows of red seats. Many passengers are standing and sitting on the upper deck, some gathered near the railings as if boarding, disembarking, or sightseeing.

Striped red-and-white canvas awnings cover parts of the upper deck, giving the boat a festive tour-boat appearance. At the front-left section of the boat there are orange life rafts or safety equipment stacked near the bow. The stern area on the right has visible text including “CAPTAIN J…” and a small sign that appears to reference a boat company. Water churns near the rear of the boat, suggesting the engine or propeller is active. The river surface in the foreground is dark and rippled, reflecting the red and white colors of the boat in broken, shimmering patterns.

Behind the boat is a stone embankment with steps descending to the water. A black metal fence runs along the top of the quay, separating the riverside walkway from a lush green area beyond. Several people stand along the railings and on the pavement, some watching the boat, others walking or sitting on benches. On the far left, a few people are seated under trees near the riverside path.

The background is filled with dense greenery—large leafy trees, shrubs, and hedges—creating a park-like setting. Partially hidden among the trees are old brick buildings or walls with arched details and tiled roofs, giving the scene a historic riverside atmosphere. The lighting is bright and natural, with sunlight illuminating parts of the boat, passengers, stone wall, and foliage. Overall, it appears to be a busy tourist boat scene on a river in a leafy, historic urban area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘红色和白色相间的游船在河中行驶的照片。船上挤满了乘客，他们似乎正在享受河岸的景色或进行观光活动。河岸边有绿色的树木和一些建筑，以及几位站立的人们。阳光照耀下，河水波光粼粼，为这个场景增添了生动的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor road-running or walking event on a broad city street during daylight. The scene is photographed with a shallow depth of field: the foreground participant is relatively sharp while the background is softly blurred.

In the foreground, slightly right of center, a participant is walking toward the camera. Their face is intentionally blurred. They are wearing a white athletic event shirt with green trim around the collar and sleeves, light blue side panels, and colorful runner silhouettes printed on the chest. A race bib is pinned to the front of the shirt; the large red number reads **“A-0056”**, with additional Thai text and sponsor logos below it. The participant is also wearing purple athletic shorts and appears to be moving casually rather than sprinting.

The road is lined with bright orange traffic cones, creating a controlled route or finish-area lane. Near the center foreground, a tall pole or barrier marker wrapped in black-and-white spiral tape stands among the cones. A light-colored strip or mat stretches across the road near the bottom of the image, possibly part of an event checkpoint, finish line, or timing area.

Several other people are visible in the background and along the sides of the street. Many wear similar white event shirts with green and blue accents, suggesting they are part of the same organized event. On the left, a few participants stand or walk near the curb; one person in black shorts faces away from the camera. Farther back, more people gather near parked vehicles and event equipment.

On the right side of the road, a dark blue sedan is parked along the curb. Behind it, there are additional vehicles, orange cones, and a uniformed traffic or security person directing activity. The street is bordered by dense green trees on both sides, giving the area a leafy, park-like or urban boulevard feel. Utility poles, overhead wires, signs, and distant structures are visible in the blurred background.

The overall atmosphere suggests a community race or charity run, with participants, traffic control, event signage, and a relaxed post-race or mid-event environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外活动的摄影照片，前景中有一位男性跑者正从画面左侧走向右侧，他穿着白色带有绿色和蓝色图案的跑步T恤、紫色短裤和运动鞋。他的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。背景中可以看到其他参与者和观众，他们站在街道两侧，周围有橙色交通锥标示出比赛区域。远处停有一辆深色轿车，整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，营造了一种轻松愉快的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor street event or parade in an urban setting, with a crowd of people gathered around a truck-mounted sound or staging area. The scene is brightly lit by warm sunlight, giving it a late-afternoon, festival-like atmosphere.

In the foreground, several people stand close together, many of them dressed in expressive or alternative styles. On the left, a person wearing a black top hat, a dark T-shirt, khaki shorts, white socks, and sneakers stands near the edge of a dark vehicle or platform. Their shirt has large pale text and a checkerboard-style graphic. Near the center, a person in a bright red outfit with black trim stands beside others in patterned clothing. A person in a sleeveless patterned dress holds one hand near their face and carries a small woven purse. Another person in a plaid shirt stands close behind them, with one arm around their waist.

Toward the right side, a tall person in a black sleeveless top stands in profile, while another person nearby wears a strapless black dress with long black gloves, facing away from the camera. A figure in a bright pink garment is partially visible at the far right edge, adding a vivid splash of color.

In the middle and background, there is a white truck or stage vehicle with large black speakers mounted around it. A green generator or equipment unit sits on the back of the vehicle. Behind the crowd, a red-and-white banner is visible with partially readable text that appears to include “GLBTIQ” and “Jesus,” suggesting a social, political, or community-themed event. Another hand-painted sign in the background includes partially visible words such as “support,” “freedom,” and “community,” though much of it is obscured by people and equipment.

At the upper left, a traffic light shows red lights illuminated, reinforcing the city-street setting. The background consists of tall brick buildings with many rectangular windows, giving the area an older industrial or downtown feel. Trees on the right cast some shade over the scene. The overall impression is of a lively public gathering with music, banners, and a diverse crowd, possibly part of a parade, protest, pride event, or street festival.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到城市街头活动的纪实摄影照片。在画面中央，一对男女正在拥抱，男子穿着黑色背心和牛仔裤，女子则穿着图案连衣裙。周围的人群中，一位女士身穿红色上衣和黑色裤子，另一位男士穿着条纹衬衫和深色裤子。背景中可以看到一个带有旗帜的卡车和一些城市的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor display or installation shaped like a small house or shed, constructed almost entirely from Coca-Cola plastic bottles. The structure has a steep, pitched roof and rectangular walls, with rows of bottles arranged horizontally and vertically in dense, repeating patterns. The red Coca-Cola labels dominate the scene, creating a strong red-and-black visual texture across the walls and roof. Red framing beams and supports outline the building, reinforcing the Coca-Cola color theme.

The roof is especially striking: it appears to be made from neatly aligned rows of bottles or bottle-like pieces, laid in overlapping bands so they resemble roof tiles. The side wall and front-facing sections are packed with full bottles placed in racks, their labels facing outward. The gable end on the left shows bottles stacked in triangular rows to match the roofline.
