In front of the structure is a light wooden picket fence made of vertical slats. The fence encloses the display and is decorated with dried corn stalks tied to several posts, giving it a rustic or harvest-festival look. Some orange pumpkins are visible near the right side behind the fence, adding to the autumnal decoration. The ground is paved, suggesting the display is set up in a public outdoor area, possibly at a fair, park, festival, or promotional event.

Behind and around the structure are leafy green trees, filling much of the background. On the right side of the image are several closed red patio umbrellas, also branded with Coca-Cola logos, reinforcing the commercial or promotional setting.

At the far right, an older man with short white hair is standing beside or holding a blue bicycle. His face is blurred. He is wearing a dark polo shirt with thin red horizontal stripes, dark trousers, and casual shoes. He appears to be looking toward the display or preparing to move with the bicycle. The bicycle has a classic upright frame and light-colored handlebar area.

Overall, the scene is colorful and unusual, centered on a creative Coca-Cola-themed “house” made from hundreds or possibly thousands of bottles, enclosed by a rustic wooden fence and decorated with seasonal elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外活动场景的照片，中心是一个用大量可乐瓶搭建的创意小屋，屋顶和墙壁由红色和白色相间的可乐瓶组成。小屋前有一个穿着条纹衫的男性骑着自行车经过，旁边摆放着几个红色的遮阳伞。周围环境被木栅栏围绕，背景中可见绿色树木。

caption:
The image shows a busy tourist approach to Borobudur Temple in Indonesia, framed by lush greenery and a bright daytime sky.

In the distance, centered in the background, is the dark gray stone structure of Borobudur, partially obscured by trees. Its stepped, layered architecture is visible, with rows of small arched niches and pointed stupas along the upper levels. A large central dome-like stupa rises above the temple, topped by a narrow vertical spire. The temple appears weathered and monumental, standing at the end of a long, gently rising pathway.

A dense crowd of visitors fills the lower half of the image and continues up the path toward the temple. Many people are wearing sun hats or carrying umbrellas, suggesting strong sunlight and heat. The umbrellas are colorful—white, yellow, green, red, blue, and multicolored—creating a lively foreground. Some tourists are walking, while others appear to be pausing or looking toward the temple.

The setting is very green and tropical. Large trees with thick foliage frame both sides of the scene, especially on the right, where broad leafy branches hang over the walkway. On the left are trimmed hedges and tall trees, while the center path is bordered by manicured grass and shrubs. The vegetation gives the scene a shaded, garden-like atmosphere despite the bright sun.

Near the lower right, there is an informational sign with Indonesian text. The heading reads “ALUR KUNJUNGAN DI CANDI BOROBUDUR,” indicating visitor flow or visiting procedures for Borobudur Temple. The sign includes a diagram or map-like graphic.

Above the temple and trees, the sky is pale blue with large white clouds. Overall, the image captures a vibrant, crowded tourist scene at a famous historic monument, combining ancient stone architecture, tropical greenery, and the movement of many visitors under a hot, sunny sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示游客参观历史遗迹的摄影照片。在画面中，众多游客正在一个绿色植被环绕的区域前行，其中一些人打着彩色雨伞以遮挡阳光。他们似乎正前往一座宏伟的圆顶建筑，该建筑位于树木繁茂的环境中，周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛。

caption:
The image shows a woman posing at what appears to be a promotional or red-carpet style event. She is standing full-length in front of a step-and-repeat backdrop on the left and a deep red wall on the right. Her face is intentionally blurred, but her outfit and surroundings are visible in detail.

She is wearing a knee-length, wrap-style dress made from a sheer or lightweight fabric. The dress has a beige/taupe base with a busy floral and botanical print in gray, white, orange, brown, and hints of pink. It has short, loose sleeves and a plunging V-neckline, with the fabric crossing over at the front and tying or gathering at the waist. The hem falls around the knee and has a soft, draped shape.

Her hair is long, brown, and styled in loose curls with lighter highlights, parted near the center and falling over her shoulders. She wears a decorative necklace with multiple small flower-like or daisy-shaped pendants, small earrings, and several bracelets on one wrist. She is holding a light-colored, textured clutch purse that appears to have a snakeskin or woven pattern. Her nails are painted a dark color.

She is wearing dark, glossy open-toe high heels, likely black or deep brown patent leather. One arm hangs relaxed at her side while the other holds the clutch. A small tattoo is visible on one forearm near the wrist.

The background includes a white promotional banner with logos and text, including “PAYMENT Data Systems,” “Carmen Electra,” “MasterCard,” “Debit,” “green dot,” “Outside the Box,” “Red Pearl Kitchen,” and the website “www.carmencard.com.” To the right is a red wall with a planter or greenery partially visible, along with a pipe or railing-like fixture. The floor is dark, giving the image the feel of an indoor event entrance or media photo area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的照片，展示了一位女性站在一个红墙前的黑色地毯上。她穿着一件带有花卉图案的短袖连衣裙，裙子下摆呈半透明状，露出她的双腿。她的头发是波浪形的长发，披肩而下。她佩戴着一条细长的项链和一对金色耳环，脚踩一双棕色高跟鞋。背景中可以看到一些模糊的广告牌，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a bright, panoramic view over a historic European town, likely taken from an elevated vantage point such as a church tower or hilltop. The scene is filled with old town architecture, red-tiled roofs, half-timbered houses, a market square, and rolling countryside in the distance.

In the foreground, the lower half of the image is dominated by tightly packed historic buildings. Many have steep roofs covered in reddish-orange clay tiles, while others have darker slate roofs. On the left is a large civic or religious-looking building with a broad dark slate roof, arched windows, and a small clock set into a dormer-like feature. Rising from this roof is a small bell-tower structure with a rounded, dark dome and a tall finial topped with a decorative ornament.

To the right and center are several traditional half-timbered buildings, with white façades crisscrossed by dark red or brown wooden beams. Some of the houses have ornate gables, multiple small windows, and decorative trim. A prominent cream-colored building with red window frames and red corner accents stands near the center-right, its large sloped roof catching the sunlight. Beside it are more timber-framed buildings, including one with a vivid red-and-white façade.

At the bottom right is a busy cobblestone market square. Several market stalls with cream-colored and beige canopies are set up, and groups of people are walking, browsing, or gathering around them. The square has a lively but relaxed atmosphere, with pedestrians scattered across the sunlit paving. A few vehicles are visible near the edge of the square, including parked cars and a red container or kiosk-like structure.

The middle ground contains more houses, small streets, trees, and a mix of older residential buildings and modern commercial or industrial structures. A church or tower with a pointed dark roof is visible slightly left of center, rising above the surrounding rooftops. Farther back, the town transitions into flatter industrial areas, open fields, and clusters of buildings.

In the background, green fields and gently rolling hills stretch across the horizon. The hills are partially wooded, with patches of farmland and small settlements visible along their slopes. The atmosphere is slightly hazy, giving the distant landscape a soft bluish tint. The sky is clear and pale blue, and the sunlight is strong, suggesting a bright spring or early summer day.

Overall, the image captures a picturesque old town with traditional German-style architecture, a bustling marketplace, and a scenic rural backdrop of hills and fields.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲小镇的高角度摄影图像。图中心是一座具有尖顶和塔楼的传统建筑，其周围是色彩鲜艳的半木结构房屋。广场上铺满了行人，一些摊位正在营业，营造出一种热闹的市场氛围。在远处可以看到连绵起伏的山脉和清晰的蓝天，为这个场景增添了一抹宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of an old, rough stone structure, likely part of a vaulted ceiling, archway, or ruined masonry interior. The composition is dominated by layered, curved stone arches that recede diagonally through the frame, creating a repeating pattern of semi-circular forms.

The stones are irregular in shape and size, with a very rugged, weathered texture. Many pieces appear cracked, chipped, and partially eroded, giving the surface an ancient, crumbling quality. The masonry is made up of earthy tones: browns, ochres, tans, rust-reds, grays, and muted greens. Some areas have pale whitish patches, possibly lime mortar, mineral staining, or worn plaster residue. There are also hints of greenish discoloration that could be moss, algae, oxidation, or light reflecting off damp stone.

The arches are built from wedge-like stone blocks and rubble, with mortar filling the gaps. The central arch is most prominent, curving from the lower left toward the upper right. Behind it, additional arched openings or recessed layers are visible, making the structure feel deep and cavernous. The stones within the arches are uneven and protruding, creating strong shadows in crevices and giving the image a highly tactile, three-dimensional appearance.

The focus is sharpest near the center, where the rough stones and fractured mortar are clearest. The edges of the image are softer and slightly blurred, especially on the left and right sides, which draws attention inward toward the central arch. The lighting is warm and natural-looking, highlighting the golden and reddish tones of the stone while casting darker shadows into the recesses.

Overall, the image conveys age, decay, and craftsmanship. It feels like a detail from an old ruin, cellar, tunnel, or historic stone building, emphasizing the texture and layered geometry of weathered masonry.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然岩石纹理的特写摄影图像。图像中心是一个具有丰富层次和色彩的岩石结构，其表面覆盖着斑驳的绿色苔藓和地衣，显示出一种自然而原始的美感。岩石的质感粗糙而多变，从深棕色到浅黄色不等，其中夹杂着一些小石子和裂缝，增加了视觉上的复杂性。

caption:
The image shows a large multi-level car transporter trailer parked outdoors, loaded with several Toyota Hilux pickup trucks. The scene is brightly lit under a clear blue sky with only a few faint clouds, suggesting daytime in an open vehicle storage or transport area.

The transporter is painted mainly yellow and blue, with heavy steel beams, ramps, hydraulic-looking supports, cables, chains, and tie-downs holding the vehicles in place. It has two visible levels: an upper deck carrying pickup trucks and a lower deck carrying more pickups. The trailer’s frame includes vertical support columns, railings, wheel tracks, and a sloped ramp section toward the rear/right side.

On the upper level, there is a prominent gray-green Toyota Hilux pickup on the right, positioned facing left. It has dark-tinted windows, black wheel arch trim, black alloy wheels, and a visible rear taillight. Behind or beside it on the left is a white pickup truck, also secured on the upper deck. The trucks appear new and clean, with protective coverings on some wheels, suggesting they may be in transit from a factory, port, or dealership.

On the lower level, several white Toyota Hilux pickups are visible. They have red and gray decorative side graphics, and one clearly shows “2.7 VVT-i” text near the rear side panel. Their windows are tinted, and the vehicles are tightly packed nose-to-tail on the carrier. The Toyota badge and front grilles are visible on some of the trucks.

The bottom of the transporter shows large dual wheels, metal decking, and shadow patterns cast by the frame. The ground appears to be a paved lot or transport yard with painted green and white lane markings. On the far right edge, part of another vehicle transporter or truck is visible, indicating this is likely a logistics or vehicle distribution area.

Overall, the image captures a shipment of new pickup trucks being transported on a heavy-duty car carrier in a bright, open industrial setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两辆汽车被装载在黄色拖车上的照片。最上面的车辆是银色，而下面的车辆是白色带有红色和黑色图案。两辆车都装有四个轮胎，并且都配备了车轮保护套。拖车上还有其他几辆汽车，但它们都被遮挡了。背景是一个晴朗的天空，可以看到远处模糊的建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an ancient Egyptian-style statue or bust displayed against a dark, nearly black background. The sculpture appears to be made of dark stone or bronze-like material with a worn, aged surface.

The figure is shown from the upper torso upward, facing slightly toward the viewer’s right. It wears a large striped nemes-style headdress, the traditional pharaonic headcloth that falls down on both sides of the head and over the shoulders. The headdress has many fine horizontal ridges along the side panels and more vertical or fan-like ridges across the top. At the front center of the headdress is a raised decorative element, likely representing a cobra or royal emblem, though it appears damaged or eroded.

The face area of the statue is blurred, obscuring the facial features. One ear is visible on the left side of the head, carved in a stylized but recognizable form. Below the face, the statue has a long, narrow false beard extending down the chest, with a textured, ribbed pattern typical of Egyptian royal imagery.

The shoulders and upper chest are visible, smooth and rounded, with the torso partially lit. The sculpture has signs of age and wear: chipped edges, rough patches, scratches, and areas where the surface looks cracked or eroded, especially around the crown and forehead region. The lighting is dramatic and directional, highlighting the ridges and contours of the headdress while leaving much of the background in shadow. The overall mood is museum-like, solemn, and historical.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一尊展示在黑色背景前的古埃及风格雕塑。雕像呈现为一位男性，具有典型的埃及特征，如宽大的头巾和复杂的装饰品。他的面部细节被模糊处理，以保护其历史价值。整体上，雕像呈现出深褐色调，表面有明显的岁月痕迹和磨损，传达出一种古老而庄严的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a person standing outdoors on a city street or sidewalk, photographed from about mid-thigh upward. Their face is intentionally blurred, but the rest of the outfit and surroundings are clear.

The person is wearing a loose, long-sleeved olive-green or chartreuse dress with subtle embroidered floral/vine patterns across the chest and sleeves. The dress has a gathered seam below the bust, giving it a flowing shape. Around the neck is a striking, colorful beaded necklace or collar made with bright blue, green, yellow, orange, and white beads in a layered, scalloped pattern. Matching beadwork appears on the wrist as a bracelet or cuff, and there is also a turquoise bead bracelet on the other wrist.

They have light-colored hair pulled back, with a large green bow or headband positioned near the top/side of the head. A long woven shoulder bag crosses diagonally over the body. The bag is cream-colored with bold black geometric or stripe-like patterns, and it hangs at the person’s hip. In one hand, they appear to be holding sunglasses.

The background is softly out of focus. On the left side, there is a street kiosk or shop display with hanging items, packaged goods, and possibly magazines or small accessories. Behind the person are leafy green trees, a building facade with large gridded windows, and a shaded storefront sign that is not fully legible. The lighting suggests a sunny day, with warm natural light and dappled shadows from the trees. The overall impression is colorful and expressive, with the vivid beadwork and green dress standing out strongly against the urban background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在户外的照片。她穿着一件鲜艳的黄色长袖连衣裙，脖子上戴着一串多彩的项链和耳环。她的头发被扎成一个绿色的发带，并佩戴着多色的手镯。她的左手拿着一个黑白条纹的包，右手自然下垂。背景中可以看到一些模糊的人群和商店，但焦点明显集中在前景的人物身上。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a dark, speckled crustacean partially submerged in shallow water beside a rough rock surface. The animal appears to be tucked into a crevice or pressed against the stone, with much of its body hidden by the angle and the water.

Its shell and legs are mostly dark bluish-black to deep purple, covered with irregular yellow or tan mottled markings that create a camouflage-like pattern. Several long, slender legs extend across the frame, especially toward the left side, where two narrow appendages stretch out over the rock. The joints and tips of the legs have reddish-brown accents, and some of the leg edges show small spines or bristles.

On the right side, more upright appendages or antenna-like limbs are visible, also patterned with yellow patches. Near the lower right, one rounded eye can be seen protruding from the body, pale and glossy with a reddish tint at its base. The body itself is broad and textured, with a dense pattern of small spots and ridges.

The surrounding environment looks like a tide pool or rocky shoreline. The rock is gray-green and wet, with algae or dark organic growth in crevices. Clear water covers part of the animal and creates bright white reflections and rippling distortions, especially along the bottom edge of the image. The overall scene feels like a natural marine habitat, with the crustacean blending into the slick, uneven rock and shallow water.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一只螃蟹在岩石上的特写照片。螃蟹的壳呈深褐色，上面散布着黄色和白色的斑点，它的八条腿伸展开来，部分腿上覆盖着细小的水珠。螃蟹似乎正停留在一块不规则的灰色岩石上，岩石表面粗糙且有苔藓生长。

caption:
The image shows a busy street-market scene in what appears to be Thailand, with several small food and retail stalls packed closely together along an urban sidewalk.

At the center is a colorful fruit shake and juice stand under a bright orange canopy. A lit sign across the front reads “SHAKE,” “JUICE,” and “SALAD,” with smaller menu items and prices beneath it. Two lamps attached to the stall shine warmly onto the counter. In front of the stall, crates and trays are filled with fresh fruit: bananas, pineapples, watermelons, dragon fruit, apples, oranges, mangoes, rambutans, longans, mangosteens, and other tropical fruits. There are also plastic bags, baskets, and stacked crates underneath the display, giving the stall a dense, improvised market feel.

Several customers stand in front of the fruit stall. On the left, a person in an all-white outfit with a white bucket hat and crossbody strap faces the stall. Next to them is a woman wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat, a navy dress with a white pattern, and black sneakers; she appears to be holding or looking at a drink or fruit item. Beside her, a man in a turquoise shirt and white cap stands near the fruit display with shopping bags in hand. On the right, another man in a turquoise shirt and dark shorts, wearing a black Adidas cap, stands with his back to the camera at a neighboring food stall.

To the far left, a separate market stall sells electronics and phone accessories. There are rows of packaged headphones, earphones, and phone cases hanging on display, with a blue-topped awning and bright fluorescent lighting. On the right side, another food stall has Thai-language signage and pictures of dishes, including rice or noodle meals; some menu images have large black X marks over them, suggesting they are unavailable.

The background is visually busy and urban. Above the stalls are older building facades with shutters, signs, and balconies. A large banner high up reads “FOR SALE” in English, alongside Thai text and phone numbers. Thick bundles of black electrical cables crisscross chaotically overhead, running between poles and buildings. The buildings look worn, with aged walls, metal shutters, exposed pipes, and a red awning along the upper right.

Overall, the scene feels lively, crowded, and informal, typical of a dense street-food area: bright stall lights, colorful fruit displays, tourists or shoppers browsing, Thai signage, and tangled overhead wires creating a vibrant city-market atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国街头食品摊位的现实主义风格照片。在画面中心，有一个橙色遮阳篷下的摊位，上面写着'SHAKE JUICE SALAD'，顾客正在挑选和购买食物。左侧有一位戴着白色帽子、穿着浅蓝色上衣的人，而右侧有两位身穿蓝色T恤的人站在摊位前。背景中可以看到其他小贩的摊位和悬挂的广告牌，营造出一个典型的市场氛围。

caption:
The image shows an old stone passageway or fortified gateway, likely part of a historic castle, city wall, or medieval/ancient structure. The scene is dominated by rough, weathered masonry made from irregular pale beige and gray stones, with patches of reddish brick used to form and reinforce arches.

At the center is a large arched opening spanning most of the image. The arch is built with narrow brick and stone voussoirs arranged in a semicircular pattern, creating a strong visual curve. Beneath it is a vaulted tunnel-like space, dimmer than the exterior, with stone walls and a cobbled or worn stone floor. Farther through the passage, another smaller arch is visible, framing a glimpse of the outside: a bit of greenery, a wooden railing, and a distant building or street area.

On the left side, there is a smaller arched alcove or side passage set into the stone wall. Its interior is shadowed, emphasizing the thickness of the old masonry. The walls throughout are uneven and textured, with stones of different sizes and shapes embedded in mortar. Some red brick fragments are scattered through the construction, suggesting repairs or mixed building phases over time.

On the right side, a narrow stone ramp or walkway slopes upward alongside the main passage. It is bordered by a low stone wall. At the top right, part of a taller stone building or tower is visible, with a rectangular doorway or opening framed by large cut stones. Above and beside it are decorative or structural brick arches incorporated into the stonework. A small modern metal lamp or fixture is mounted near the wall, contrasting with the ancient masonry.

The ground is paved with worn stones and cobbles, sloping gently downward into the archway. Small patches of grass and weeds grow at the edges, especially near the lower right and along the base of the walls. The upper portion of the image shows a pale blue sky with soft white clouds, adding light and openness above the enclosed stone architecture.

Overall, the image conveys the atmosphere of a historic fortified passage: massive stone walls, layered arches, aged textures, and a sense of depth leading through the gateway to the outside beyond.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老石拱门的摄影图像。石拱门由粗糙的石头构成，上面有砖砌的装饰和一个圆形的入口。拱门两侧是石墙，顶部有一层较小的结构。在拱门后方可以看到一些现代建筑，与古老的石拱门形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows an industrial production or packaging area viewed through transparent safety panels. The setting appears to be a clean, controlled manufacturing environment, possibly for food, pharmaceuticals, or another product requiring hygiene and careful handling.

At the center is a worker wearing full protective clothing: a white lab coat or cleanroom smock, a hairnet or hood, and blue disposable gloves. The person is standing behind a conveyor or worktable, handling or monitoring rows of small rectangular items arranged neatly on flat trays. The worker’s face is blurred, and they appear to be focused on the production line in front of them.

The conveyor area runs horizontally across the middle of the image. Several trays or panels are laid out side by side, each containing many evenly spaced, pale yellow or beige rectangular pieces. The machinery is made mostly of stainless steel, giving the scene a clean, industrial appearance.

On both sides of the conveyor are clear plastic or glass safety guards with bright orange vertical supports. Some of the panels have black-and-yellow hazard striping near the bottom, indicating caution zones or moving machinery. Door handles and hinges are visible on the protective enclosures, suggesting the guards can be opened for maintenance or access.

In the background, the wall contains various industrial fixtures and equipment. There is a control cabinet with a small digital screen and a yellow electrical hazard warning symbol. Nearby are wall-mounted holders or document dispensers, and several dark hanging items, possibly protective gear or covers. A small angled device or scanner is mounted near the right side of the worker, aimed toward the conveyor area.

On the left side, another worker or the reflection of a worker is visible through the transparent guarding. This person also appears to be wearing white protective clothing and a hair covering, reinforcing the controlled, sanitary nature of the space.

The foreground contains a large reflective metal or plastic surface, possibly another cover or part of nearby equipment, slightly out of focus. Overall, the image conveys a highly organized production line with safety barriers, hygienic protective clothing, and automated or semi-automated handling of small packaged or processed items.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示食品生产线上操作员的现实主义风格照片。在图像中心，一位穿着白色防护服和蓝色手套的工人正站在传送带旁，专注地操作着设备。传送带上摆放着整齐排列的食物产品，可能是饼干或类似的小吃。背景中可以看到其他几位工人和一些工业设备，如控制面板和机器手臂，这些元素构成了一个典型的食品工厂工作环境。

caption:
The image shows a bright, modern airport terminal with a polished, reflective floor and high ceilings. In the foreground, a woman in what appears to be an airline or airport staff uniform is walking while pulling a black rolling suitcase. She is dressed in a light blue blazer over a white shirt and scarf, paired with light-colored trousers and black heels. She has an ID badge on a lanyard around her neck and is holding a smartphone in one hand. Her hair is neatly tied back in a bun, with a blue pen or hair accessory tucked into it. Her face is blurred.

The black suitcase she is pulling is soft-sided, with multiple compartments and a telescoping handle. The floor beneath her reflects her legs, shoes, and luggage, emphasizing the glossy surface of the terminal.

In the background, the airport interior is softly out of focus. There are large windows or bright panels letting in strong daylight, creating a cool blue-white glow. Several people are visible: one person on the right wears a blue jacket and stands near a silver hard-shell suitcase; another person is further left near what looks like a kiosk or check-in machine. Their faces are also blurred or indistinct.

The setting includes structural columns, overhead beams, signage, and what appear to be airport counters or information displays. The overall color palette is cool and bright, dominated by whites, light blues, grays, and metallic tones. The image has a shallow depth of field, keeping the foreground subject relatively prominent while the busy airport environment behind her remains blurred.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示机场环境中的女性工作人员的照片。她穿着标准的航空公司制服，包括一件浅蓝色上衣和白色裤子，以及黑色高跟鞋。她的头发被整齐地盘起，并佩戴着工作证。在模糊的背景中，可以看到其他乘客和机场的设施，如自动售票机和指示牌。

caption:
The image shows a bright, colorful street scene centered on a large retro-style sign for the **“18b Arts District.”** The sign stands tall on a vivid blue pole and has a mid-century neon aesthetic. Its main circular face is white with a diamond-patterned texture, bordered by bold red trim. Large turquoise-and-white lettering reads **“18b,”** with small round bulb lights around parts of the letters. Beneath it, individual circular red-and-white letter panels spell out **“ARTS”** and **“DISTRICT.”**

Around the circular sign are dramatic decorative elements: a sweeping yellow crescent-shaped form on the right, lined with small light bulbs, and additional yellow and red fins and rods extending outward, giving it a dynamic, vintage Vegas look. The colors are highly saturated—bright yellow, red, blue, turquoise, and white—standing out sharply against an intensely clear, deep blue sky.

Tall palm trees frame the scene on both sides, with green fronds reaching into the sky. Below the sign are low buildings covered in colorful graffiti and murals, reinforcing the arts-district setting. Utility poles and power lines are visible in the background, along with hints of distant mountains. In the foreground, there is a sidewalk with metal benches, a curb with a yellow tactile strip, desert landscaping with shrubs and grasses, and part of a road.

Overall, the image feels sunny, urban, and energetic, combining desert vegetation, street art, and bold neon-inspired signage in a lively arts district setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于晴朗天气下的城市街道上的霓虹灯广告牌的照片。广告牌以鲜艳的蓝色和黄色为主色调，上面用白色字体写着'180'，并装饰有红色的圆点和箭头图案。广告牌下方是一个蓝色的支撑结构，周围摆放着几辆自行车。在广告牌的背后可以看到几棵棕榈树和其他绿色植物，以及一些低矮的建筑物。

caption:
The image shows two public warning/information signs mounted on a rough, dark grey concrete wall, likely near a coastal or cliffside area.

On the left is a tall, white rectangular sign with rounded top corners. It is partly cut off by the left and bottom edges of the image. Near the top is a small green-and-grey emblem, likely associated with Pembrokeshire County Council. The sign is bilingual in English and Welsh and gives dog-control information:

- A large red arrow-shaped section points to the right and says:
  - “NO DOGS”
  - “1st MAY - 30th SEPT”
  - “MAXIMUM PENALTY £500”
  - Welsh text below: “DIM CŴN,” “1af MAI - 30ain MEDI,” and “DIRWY UCHAFSWM £500”
- On the right side of this red section is a circular no-dogs symbol: a black dog silhouette crossed by a red diagonal line.
- Below it is a green arrow-shaped section pointing left, with a white dog pictogram and the text:
  - “DOGS ALLOWED”
  - “CANIATEIR CŴN”

The left sign looks worn and weathered, with visible scratches, dirt marks, and some bending or damage, especially near the middle-right area.

To the right is a separate red warning sign with a thin white border and white lettering. It is mounted with visible screws in the corners. The text is bilingual, with Welsh at the top and English below:

- “Perygl”
- “Creigiau’n disgyn o’r clogwyni”
- “Cadwch yn Glir”
- “Danger”
- “Rock falls from cliffs”
- “Keep Clear”

The red sign warns people to stay away because of falling rocks from cliffs. It appears cleaner and more intact than the dog sign, though it is also mounted on the same weathered concrete surface.

The overall scene suggests a beach, coastal path, or cliffside access point where dog restrictions and cliff-fall hazards are being communicated to visitors. The lighting is bright, with a pale strip at the very top of the image that may be sky or a sunlit surface above the wall.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在混凝土墙面上的两个警示标志的照片。左侧是一个红色和白色相间的警告标志，上面用黑色字体写着'DANGER ROCK FALLS FROM CLIFFS'以及'KEEP CLEAR'的提示，并且有'DIM CWN'的绿色标签。右侧是一个绿色和白色的禁止狗进入标志，上面用黑色字体写着'DOGS ALLOWED CANIATEIR CWN'，并有一个狗的图标。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sun-drenched Mediterranean seaside scene with an almost dreamlike, layered quality.

In the foreground and lower half, a crowded sandy beach curves along shallow, crystal-clear turquoise water. Many beachgoers are scattered across the sand and wading in the sea—some lying on towels, others sitting under umbrellas, swimming, standing in groups, or walking along the shoreline. The beach is dotted with colorful umbrellas in blue, turquoise, pink, red, striped navy-and-white, and multicolored patterns. Towels, beach bags, inflatable toys, coolers, and lounge chairs create a busy, festive summer atmosphere. The water is calm and transparent near the shore, with gentle ripples and small waves lapping at the sand.

A series of concrete steps or terraces extends into the water near the middle of the image, dividing small beach areas and creating a layered shoreline. Farther back, a stone pier or harbor wall stretches horizontally, with small figures walking or standing on it. The sea beyond is a deeper blue, forming a strong horizontal band before the town rises behind it.

In the background, an old coastal town climbs upward from the waterfront. The buildings are tightly packed and stacked on a hillside, with pale cream, beige, white, and weathered stone façades. Many structures have green shutters, small balconies, terracotta roof tiles, and aged plaster walls, giving the town a historic Mediterranean character. Some lower waterfront walls and arches look like old fortifications or harbor structures.

The upper portion of the image is dominated by a vivid, saturated blue sky filled with soft, fluffy white clouds. The scene has a surreal or double-exposure effect: parts of the hillside town appear semi-transparent and seem to float among the clouds, while cloud layers pass in front of buildings. This makes the architecture look as if it is suspended in the sky or dissolving into it. The overall impression is bright, lively, and dreamlike—a bustling beach resort beneath an old seaside town under a brilliant summer sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙海滩活动的摄影图像。在画面中，众多游客和当地居民正在享受阳光下的乐趣。沙滩上散布着多彩的遮阳伞和休息的人们，一些人正站在清澈的海水里游泳或嬉戏。背景中的建筑物沿着海岸线排列，与蓝天白云形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a man standing outdoors in what appears to be a historical reenactment or period-costume setting. He is centered in the frame and dressed in a military-style uniform reminiscent of Napoleonic-era cavalry or infantry attire.

He wears a dark navy-blue jacket with bright red cuffs, red piping, and red fringed epaulettes on the shoulders. Across the front of the jacket are decorative brass or gold-colored straps and plates, giving the uniform a formal, ceremonial appearance. The jacket has a row of large light-colored buttons down the chest. His trousers are high-waisted and off-white or cream-colored, tucked into tall black leather boots that reach nearly to his knees.

The man is holding a metal helmet or piece of armor at waist height. The helmet is silver-gray with brass-colored fittings and red-and-white fabric trim or padding visible around it. His hands are positioned as if adjusting or carrying the helmet. His face is intentionally blurred, while his short hair is visible above the blur.

Behind him are several horses standing near or inside a pale wooden fenced area. On the left, a light gray or white horse is partly visible, with its long pale tail hanging down. Farther back, another horse with a dark mane and a red halter or decoration can be seen. On the right side of the image, two dark horses, one black and one possibly dark brown, stand close together with bridles or harnesses on. A large white or light-colored horse body is also visible behind the man.

The setting appears rural or wooded. The background is filled with dense green foliage with hints of yellow, suggesting late summer or autumn. The ground is grassy but patchy, with dry straw or hay scattered around. A pile of hay sits in the lower right foreground, and the pale wooden fence forms diagonal lines behind and around the man.

The image has a shallow depth of field: the man and nearby horses are relatively prominent, while parts of the background foliage are soft and blurred. The overall scene feels like a historical camp, stable area, or reenactment event involving horses and period military dress.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位身着18世纪风格军装的人物的照片。人物站在户外，背对着镜头，正低头调整他的腰带。他穿着一件蓝色上衣，装饰有金色的肩章和腰带扣环，下身穿白色长裤，脚踩黑色皮靴。在他的背后，可以看到几匹马，一匹白色的马和两匹黑色的马，它们似乎在吃草或休息。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny harbor scene dominated by a tall historic lighthouse or harbor tower near the center-right. The tower is cylindrical and pale cream-colored, with narrow arched windows, small circular porthole-like windows, and a large clock face set into its side. Near the top, the structure widens slightly into a darker stone band, above which is an ornate red/pink railing encircling a viewing platform. At the very top is a glass lantern room with greenish window frames and a small antenna or mast rising from the roof.

To the right of the tower, several tall metal flagpoles stand close to the camera. One prominent flag is blue and white, likely Bavarian, hanging vertically and partially wrapped around the pole. Below it are red and dark-colored flags, also hanging downward in the light breeze. These flags create a strong vertical foreground element and partly overlap the view of the tower.

The sky is a vivid, cloudless-looking blue with a few small, soft white clouds scattered across it. The clear weather gives the scene a crisp, summery feel.

In the lower portion of the image, a marina or harbor is visible. Several sailboat masts rise upward, with rigging lines and blue-and-white boat covers visible in the foreground. A narrow stone walkway leads toward the tower, with many people strolling along it. Some visitors are walking toward the camera, while others are near the base of the tower, suggesting a busy tourist area.

On the left side, a stone monument topped with a seated lion statue is partly visible, reinforcing the harbor’s grand, historic character. The stonework around the harbor appears old and substantial, with walls, steps, railings, and piers. In the background beyond the water, low green hills or mountains can be seen, adding depth to the lakeside setting.

Overall, the image captures a picturesque European waterfront—likely a lakeside harbor—with historic architecture, sailboats, flags, tourists, and a striking lighthouse under a brilliant blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于港口的灯塔的照片。灯塔高耸，顶部装饰有绿色和红色的图案，塔身呈白色，中间镶嵌着一个圆形时钟面。灯塔旁边是几根蓝白相间的旗帜，随风飘扬。在灯塔前的人行道上，可以看到几位游客正在行走或停留，享受着晴朗天气下的海滨风光。背景中，蓝天清澈，几朵白云悠闲地漂浮着，而远处轮廓分明的山脉增添了画面的层次感。

caption:
The image shows a cozy, softly lit bedroom with a calm, neutral color palette and a slightly rustic, cottage-like style.

At the center is a large double bed made up in crisp white bedding. The bed has a textured white coverlet draped over the sides, two white pillows, and a tall upholstered headboard in a warm beige fabric. The headboard is divided into two large vertical panels and sits against a pale beige wall. The bed appears to be made from two joined bases, visible beneath the cover, with small caster wheels at the bottom.

On both sides of the bed are white bedside tables with a slightly distressed or vintage finish. Each table holds a slender table lamp with a beige lampshade, casting warm yellow light onto the walls. The right bedside table is placed in front of a recessed window, while the left one is near another window set deeper into the wall. Both windows are open inward, letting in daylight and offering a glimpse of an outdoor view with water and green hills or trees in the distance.

The room has a sloped ceiling, suggesting it may be in an attic or upper floor. The ceiling and walls are painted in soft cream or light beige tones, creating a warm and airy atmosphere. A small recessed ceiling light is visible near the upper left side.

On the left side of the image, there is a built-in shelving niche containing decorative items. The shelves display blue-and-white ceramic plates, small bowls, turquoise glass or ceramic pieces, a framed picture, and a few books on the lower shelf. In front of this area is a white railing or partition, possibly indicating a stair opening or a small split-level section. Nearby, a tall narrow mirror is mounted on the wall, reflecting part of the bedside lamp and bed.

The floor is light-colored, matching the soft, minimalist feel of the room. Two woven rugs add texture: one larger pale rug with subtle stripes lies in the foreground, while another striped rug with dark navy or black lines is placed near the right side of the bed. A wicker basket or chair edge is partially visible in the bottom left corner.

Overall, the room feels serene, elegant, and comfortable, with natural light, warm lamps, white linens, vintage-style furniture, and coastal or countryside touches.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代室内设计的卧室照片。卧室内有一张大床，床上铺着白色的床单和被子，床头有两个带有灯罩的床头柜。床的一侧是一个开放式的书架，上面摆放着几本书和一些装饰品。房间内还有一盏落地灯和一个挂墙镜，墙上挂着几幅画作。地板上铺着一块条纹地毯，而窗户旁边则放置了一个小桌子和椅子，提供了额外的工作或阅读空间。整个房间以柔和的灯光照明，营造出温馨舒适的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright tropical beach scene on a clear sunny day. In the foreground, a person is standing behind a small coconut stall or table set up right at the edge of shallow seawater. They are wearing a red sleeveless sports-style shirt with yellow trim and side panels, blue shorts, and a black crossbody bag. Their face is blurred, and they appear to be preparing a coconut with a knife.

The table in front of them is covered with coconut husks, shells, and chopped pieces. Several large coconuts are piled on the right side, some orange-brown and others green. One coconut has been opened and is being used as a holder for a bundle of white plastic straws. Small palm-like decorative fronds are stuck into coconuts or husks on the table, adding a tropical presentation.

Above the stall, part of a large beach umbrella is visible, with bold sections of green, red, and yellow fabric. The umbrella casts shade over the coconut area.

Behind the person, the shallow ocean water is very clear and pale turquoise near the shore, gradually deepening to richer blue farther out. Gentle ripples cover the surface. To the left, several small boats are pulled up near the shoreline or floating close by; one has a blue canopy, and there are colorful flags nearby. A sandy, narrow beach runs along the left side with trees and a few people in the distance.

In the far left background, a dramatic green mountain or cliff rises steeply beside the coast. The sky is vivid blue with only a few small clouds near the horizon. Overall, the image has a relaxed seaside market feel, centered on fresh coconuts being prepared on a tropical beach.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩上椰子摊贩的现实主义风格照片。图中，一位身穿红色背心和黑色短裤的人站在沙滩上，正用刀切开一个椰子。他戴着一顶帽子，背着一个黑色背包，并且旁边放着一些未被处理的椰子。在摊位上方，有一把五彩缤纷的遮阳伞为摊贩提供阴凉。背景中可以看到平静的海水、几艘停泊的船只以及远处的山脉轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a compact action camera positioned against a plain white background, photographed from the front with a slight view of the top surface.

The camera body is rectangular and silver/white, with a black circular lens assembly on the upper-right side of the front face. The lens sits inside a thick black bezel, giving it a rugged, wide-angle action-camera appearance. The glass of the lens is dark and reflective, with a small reddish reflection near the top center.

On the upper-left front of the camera is a round button labeled with a power symbol and the word “mode” underneath. Below that, large black text reads “HD,” followed by “1080P,” then “4K,” and “Ultra HD” near the bottom-left area of the camera face. Near the bottom-right front corner is the brand name “kogan,” with the “o” stylized as a power icon.

The top of the camera has a black-and-white textured or patterned surface, resembling a grid or checker-style grip. On top, near the left side, there is a circular button with a red ring, likely the shutter/record button. Next to it is a small oval or pill-shaped button/indicator.

The camera appears slightly worn, with minor scratches or scuff marks visible on the front surface. It is centered horizontally but placed in the lower half of the image, leaving a large amount of empty white space above it. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean product-photo style with minimal shadows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Kogan品牌运动相机的产品摄影图像。相机正面朝上，放置在纯白色的背景上。相机的正中央是一个圆形的镜头，上方有一个圆形的电源按钮和一个方形的模式选择按钮。摄像头下方是品牌的名称和产品型号'4K Ultra HD 1080p'。整体设计简洁，以白色为主色调，突出了产品的现代感和专业性。

caption:
The image shows a lush, mountainous landscape under a heavy, overcast sky. The scene appears to be taken from an elevated viewpoint, looking across a green valley and forested hills.

In the foreground, there is dense vegetation with many leafy trees and shrubs. The leaves are dark green and slightly blurred in places, suggesting the photo may have been taken through a window or from a moving vehicle. On the far left, a tall tree with thin branches and feathery leaves frames the edge of the image.

Across the middle of the image, several thin black power lines run horizontally from left to right, cutting across the cloudy sky and the mist-covered hillside.

The main focus is the misty mountain ridge in the background. The hills are covered with dense forest, including darker evergreen-looking trees and lighter green patches of grass or farmland. Thick white and gray fog hangs low over the slopes, drifting between the trees and partially hiding the tops of the hills. The mist gives the landscape a cool, damp, and atmospheric feeling.

Below the hills, the valley contains scattered houses and small buildings. A few homes are visible on the right side, including a larger light-colored building with a reddish roof and another smaller structure nearby. There are also patches of cultivated land or open fields in varying shades of green, separated by trees and natural slopes.

The sky is filled with pale gray clouds, with no direct sunlight visible. The overall mood is calm, fresh, and rainy, like a mountain area after or during light rainfall. The combination of fog, forest, and rolling green hills creates a peaceful rural landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的照片，前景是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛，中景是覆盖着绿色植被的山坡，而背景则是被云雾缭绕的山丘。天空中布满了厚重的云层，使得远处的山峰若隐若现。

caption:
The image shows a festive nighttime city square decorated for the holidays and New Year celebrations. A large historic building dominates the background, with classical architecture: tall arched windows, decorative cornices, pilasters, and a prominent clock or tower-like structure rising above the right side. The building is dramatically illuminated with cool blue-white exterior lighting, while many of its windows glow warmly in amber and yellow tones, creating a contrast against the dark black sky.

In the foreground, there is a large illuminated “2019” installation made of metal frames and warm white lights. The number “2” stands on the left, followed by a tunnel-like circular “0” structure covered in blue and white fairy lights. The “1” and “9” are also outlined in bright warm lights. The light installation forms a walk-through display, and a couple of blurred figures appear to be moving through or near it, suggesting a lively public space.

To the right, a tall Christmas tree is covered densely with blue and multicolored lights, topped with a glowing blue star. The tree stands near the front of the building, adding to the holiday atmosphere. Across the square and along the building façade, strings of blue lights are draped, and red-yellow-blue bunting or decorative banners hang in several places, adding bright national-color accents.

Several people are visible in the lower right foreground. Two women stand facing each other, one in a light-colored puffy jacket and jeans, the other in a red coat, appearing to talk or pose near the festive scene. Streetlamps with round glowing globes add warm points of light around the square. The pavement looks slightly reflective, possibly damp, which enhances the glow from the decorations.

Overall, the scene feels celebratory and wintry, with a mix of grand architecture, holiday lighting, a large New Year display, and people enjoying the illuminated public square at night.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日装饰的夜晚城市街景照片。图像中心是一个巨大的数字'2019'，由蓝色和白色的灯光串成，营造出节日气氛。在数字前方，有两位女性站在人行道上交谈，她们穿着冬季服装，一位身穿红色外套，另一位身着深色衣物。背景是一座装饰华丽的建筑，其立面被圣诞树和彩灯点缀，顶部有一个显眼的时钟。街道上的其他行人模糊地穿行于这个节日场景中。

caption:
The image shows a large, dark gray artillery cannon displayed outdoors on a concrete pad beside a grassy area. The gun dominates the foreground, positioned diagonally from the lower right toward the left side of the frame, with its long barrel extending almost the full width of the image.

The cannon has a heavy wheeled carriage with large spoked metal wheels, mechanical gears, levers, support arms, and recoil or elevation components visible near the rear. The barrel is cylindrical and matte gray, with a bulky breech and mounting hardware near the right side. At the far left end of the barrel is a distinctive muzzle device or brake with large oval side openings and rounded end plates, giving the front a boxy, reinforced appearance.

Behind the cannon is a black metal fence with vertical bars and pale square posts. Beyond the fence, there is a sloped grassy area with a wide staircase leading upward. A person can be seen walking on or near the stairs in the distance. At the top of the hill, small construction or maintenance vehicles and equipment are visible, including orange machinery. There are also overhead utility wires crossing the sky and a tall lamppost or pole near the center-left.

On the left side of the background, there are dense trees, including evergreen branches, creating a darker green backdrop. On the right side, part of a modern building is visible, clad in beige rectangular panels. Near the building are air-conditioning units and a small fenced or railed area. A camouflaged, tarp-covered object or vehicle sits behind the cannon near the fence, partly obscured by the gun barrel.

The scene appears to be a museum, military display, or outdoor exhibit area. The lighting is soft and overcast, with no strong shadows, and the overall color palette is muted: gray metal, green grass and trees, black fencing, and beige building panels.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的军事装备的照片。装备由两根并排的黑色金属炮管组成，每个炮管上方都装有一个黑色的瞄准器。炮管下方是两个灰色的圆形车轮，支撑着整个装置。背景中可以看到一堵铁栅栏和一些绿色植被，以及远处模糊的建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a narrow old stone street or plaza beside a massive historic building, likely a church or cathedral, with two classic cars parked close to the walls.

In the foreground, dominating the lower half of the frame, is the front end of a dark, glossy vintage Jaguar. Its hood is highly reflective, mirroring patches of pale sky and the tall stone wall beside it. The car has chrome trim, a rectangular headlight visible on the right edge, part of another headlamp on the left, and a wide black grille with thin horizontal chrome bars. A small central badge on the grille appears to read “Jaguar” with a “12,” suggesting a V12 model. The windshield, wipers, side mirror, and polished chrome details reinforce the classic luxury-car look.

Behind and to the right, partly tucked along the building, is a red vintage coupe with chrome bumpers and wire-spoke wheels. It sits farther back in the scene, angled slightly toward the viewer, with its front end facing right. Its bright red paint contrasts strongly with the muted gray-brown stone architecture around it.

The architecture is the most imposing part of the image. On the left and center are enormous vertical stone buttresses or wall sections made from large, dark, weathered blocks. The masonry is rough and uneven, with visible mortar lines, small holes, stains, and age marks. The walls rise out of the frame, making the building feel monumental. Along the right side, a recessed section of the building includes decorative stonework and a chain barrier attached to stone posts, hinting at an important historic or religious site.

The perspective is low and close to the cars, looking upward slightly along the stone walls. This creates a strong sense of depth: the foreground Jaguar feels large and imposing, while the red car and distant buildings recede into the background. The sky is overcast and pale, casting soft, subdued light over the scene. In the far background, across the open paved area, there are additional old buildings with tiled roofs and small windows, adding to the historic European atmosphere.

Overall, the image combines elegant classic automobiles with heavy medieval or historic stone architecture, creating a moody, timeless street scene with muted colors, strong textures, and a quiet, refined atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两辆经典汽车停靠在一座古老建筑前的照片。前景中，一辆黑色的汽车占据了画面的大部分空间，其光泽的表面和清晰可见的车窗反射出周围环境。背景中，另一辆红色的汽车部分隐藏在黑色汽车后方，同样展现出复古的设计风格。这两辆车都显得十分突出，与它们背后那座历史悠久、石墙高耸的建筑形成了鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit beach scene with an urban coastline.

On the left, a steep reddish-brown cliff rises from the sand, covered in patches of low green vegetation and scrub. At the top and along the edge of the cliff are several tall modern apartment or hotel buildings, mostly white, gray, and beige, with balconies and flat rooftops. The buildings continue into the distance, becoming hazier as they recede along the coast.

The sandy beach stretches broadly across the foreground and into the distance. The sand is smooth in places but marked with footprints, tire-like tracks, and shallow ripples. Near the center foreground, a long, shallow stream or tidal pool snakes across the sand toward the ocean, reflecting the sky and the nearby high-rises like a mirror. Low stone retaining walls line part of the beach at the base of the cliff, and small blue trash bins or beach containers are spaced along the sand.

On the right side, the ocean runs parallel to the beach, with gentle waves breaking close to shore. The water is pale blue with white foam, and the wet shoreline reflects the bright sky. Several people are scattered along the beach: some walking in pairs, some standing near the water, and a few wading or swimming farther out. In the foreground near the right, a man in red swim briefs stands on the wet sand facing the sea, holding something near his face with one hand and carrying a dark bag in the other.

Farther down the beach, palm trees, light poles, beach umbrellas, and small structures appear in the hazy distance, suggesting a developed seaside promenade or resort area. The sky dominates the upper portion of the image, clear and pale blue with only faint wisps of cloud. The lighting is warm and low, likely early morning or late afternoon, creating long shadows, soft haze, and a calm coastal atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海滩日常活动的摄影照片。在画面前景，一位身穿红色上衣和黑色短裤的人站在沙滩上，背对着镜头，似乎正在享受阳光或整理衣物。沙滩上有其他游客在散步或休息，而海水轻轻拍打着海岸线。背景中，可以看到一排高楼大厦，与蓝天形成鲜明对比，营造出一个典型的城市海滩环境。

caption:
The image shows an old urban street scene dominated by historic brick architecture under a bright, partly cloudy sky.

On the right side and center of the image is a large, aged red-brick defensive-looking structure or wall. The most prominent feature is a square corner tower with thick brick walls and a steep, pyramidal roof covered in reddish-brown metal or tile roofing. The roof has a pronounced central ridge running down to the corner, and a small vertical finial or rod at the peak. The brickwork is weathered, with many irregular patches, missing bricks, darker stains, and rough stone or brick repairs near the base. Small rectangular openings are visible along the upper part of the walls, suggesting old ventilation slits or defensive loopholes. A small barred window appears low on the tower wall.

Extending left from the tower is a long brick wall, also old and worn, with a sloping top edge and areas of crumbling masonry. Some sections near the base are reinforced with rough stone buttresses or stonework. Behind this wall, partially visible on the left, are ornate church domes: white architectural bases topped with gilded onion-shaped domes and small crosses. The gold domes contrast strongly with the rough red brick and the blue sky.

In the foreground, a paved street curves or slopes slightly along the wall. Two cars are parked along the curb: a red SUV farther left and a smaller gray hatchback closer to the center. A red “no entry” traffic sign stands near the wall on the left side of the foreground. At the bottom right, part of a pedestrian crossing or road marking is visible.

The lower right corner contains a makeshift construction or repair area. Corrugated metal panels form a temporary fence or barrier, with wooden planks and posts leaning against it. One beige panel has red spray-painted graffiti. Behind and around the barrier are bits of debris, weeds, and rough stone foundation material, reinforcing the impression of renovation or decay around the old structure.

Vegetation appears in several places: leafy trees on the left partly obscure the church domes, and small shrubs and weeds grow along the base of the brick walls and near the fence. The sky is bright blue with large soft white clouds, giving the scene daylight clarity and making the warm tones of the brick and roof stand out. Overall, the image combines historic religious architecture, old fortified brickwork, modern street elements, parked cars, and signs of ongoing urban repair or neglect.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，前景中有一座老旧的红砖建筑，其屋顶覆盖着红色瓦片。建筑旁边停放着两辆汽车，一辆黑色轿车和一辆银色SUV。在建筑的背后，可以看到一座金色圆顶的教堂，与周围的现代建筑形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a stylish clothing retail store, photographed from very close to a textured wall on the left. The wall has a terrazzo-like surface with a beige-gray base and many embedded black, dark green, and lighter stone chips scattered throughout.

Mounted on the wall is a large illuminated sign reading **“initial”** in bold, lowercase, blocky letters. The letters glow bright white from within and have dark side edges, creating a three-dimensional effect. Beneath it, in raised pale lettering, is the phrase **“THE UNUSUAL EXPERIENCE”**, with part of another line below showing **“GENTLEMAN”**. A thin decorative horizontal line runs under the slogan.

The camera angle is diagonal and close-up, making the sign dominate the left and center of the frame while the store interior recedes into the background on the right. In the background, there are clothing racks and display tables with folded garments, shirts, jackets, trousers, and shoes. A sale sign is visible on one of the tables, showing **“20”**, likely indicating a discount.

The store has warm, modern lighting. Two large cream-colored paper lanterns hang from the ceiling on the right side—one round and one tall cylindrical lantern with a ribbed texture. Recessed ceiling lights are also visible. The overall atmosphere feels upscale, contemporary, and boutique-like, with neutral colors, soft lighting, and neatly arranged menswear displays.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一家名为'Initial'的男士服装店内部的照片。照片中心是一个大型的白色字母标志，上面写着'THE UNUSUAL EXPERIENCE GENTLEMAN'，下方是店铺名称'INITIAL'。背景中展示着各种男士服装和配饰，包括衬衫、裤子和帽子。店内装饰简约而现代，墙壁上覆盖着不规则的石块纹理，地板为浅色大理石。右侧有一个巨大的白色圆柱形装饰物，与整个空间的色调相协调。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor press event or public gathering taking place on a cobblestone plaza in front of the historic **“STOCZNIA GDAŃSKA”** sign, associated with the Gdańsk Shipyard in Poland. The large white letters of the sign span the upper background, mounted on a metal frame, with some visible weathering and rust. Beneath it, there is a blue kiosk or entrance building with the word **“souvenir”** written in large cursive letters across the front. A partly cloudy sky fills the background, and construction cranes are visible in the far right distance.

In the foreground, a group of people is gathered, many of them wearing bright **yellow shirts or yellow accessories**, suggesting a coordinated campaign, organization, or event. Several people hold yellow folders or placards; one visible folder appears to have the number **“2050”** printed on it. Most faces are blurred, giving the image a privacy-protected or anonymized appearance.

At the center front stands a woman in a dark blue dress, facing the camera with her hands clasped or gesturing in front of her. To her right, a man in a navy blazer and light trousers stands near a cluster of microphones on stands. He appears to be speaking or preparing to speak, holding a red folder and gesturing with one hand. Another man in a light gray checked blazer stands behind him.

On the right side of the frame, media personnel are present. A camera operator or journalist in a dark jacket holds equipment toward the speakers, while another person in a red-and-black jacket appears to be handling a phone or recording device. Several microphones with colored foam covers are aimed at the speakers, indicating a formal media interview or press conference.

A tall yellow-and-white vertical flag or banner stands near the speakers, matching the yellow theme of the group. The ground is made of uneven stone paving, adding a historic or industrial waterfront feel. Overall, the scene looks like a political or civic press briefing held at a symbolic public location, with supporters standing behind the speakers and journalists recording the event.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张记录公共活动的现实主义风格照片，展示了一群穿着统一黄色上衣的人聚集在户外。他们站在一个带有文字的拱门下，似乎正在参加某种集会或宣传活动。一位男性站在麦克风前，正对着镜头讲话，而另一位男性则手持麦克风准备采访。周围有几位摄影师和记者，他们的注意力都集中在演讲者身上。背景中可以看到一些建筑工地和起重机，表明这个活动可能与城市发展或社区建设有关。

caption:
The image shows a richly decorated interior, likely inside an Eastern Orthodox church or chapel. In the foreground is an ornate, gold-colored religious stand or shrine with embossed decorative metalwork and a deep burgundy velvet covering. Resting on top is a glass-covered frame or reliquary, bordered by gold trim, partially hidden beneath a large floral garland.

The flowers are the main visual focus. A lush arrangement of greenery and blossoms drapes across the top and sides of the shrine. The bouquet includes yellow roses, small yellow button-like flowers, pale pink carnations, bright pink blooms, and large white flowers resembling chrysanthemums or dahlias. Fern fronds extend upward and outward, adding height and softness to the arrangement. The glossy green leaves contrast with the warm gold metal and the rich red fabric.

On both sides of the image, blurred candle stands or lamps are visible, with small warm points of flame creating a soft, devotional atmosphere. The background is intentionally out of focus, showing tall windows, pale walls, wood furnishings, and gold-toned architectural details. This shallow depth of field gives the scene a quiet, reverent feeling and emphasizes the decorated shrine in the foreground.

At the lower right, there is a wooden donation box or sign with a cross and Cyrillic text reading “ЖЕРТВА НА ХРАМ,” which translates roughly to “donation/offering for the church.” The overall mood is solemn, ceremonial, and peaceful, with warm lighting, religious ornamentation, and abundant flowers suggesting a place of worship or a special feast-day display.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂内部装饰的照片，焦点是一个装饰华丽的讲坛，上面摆放着一束色彩丰富的鲜花。讲坛上铺有绿色植物和黄色、粉色的花朵，营造出一种庄严而温馨的氛围。背景中可以看到金色的烛台和模糊的教堂内部细节，如椅子和窗户，这些元素衬托出了讲坛作为宗教仪式中心的地位。

caption:
The image shows a quiet residential street or private lane in bright daylight. The road is made of light-colored concrete, with a darker, freshly repaired rectangular section running down the center foreground into the middle distance. This darker area has visible horizontal texture lines, suggesting recently finished or resurfaced concrete.

Several orange traffic cones with white reflective bands are placed along and around the repaired strip to block vehicles or warn people away. Two large cones are very close to the camera at the bottom left and bottom right edges, partially cropped. Farther ahead, three more cones are spaced across the road near the middle of the image, marking the continuation or boundary of the work area.

On both sides of the road are raised curbs and sidewalks. The left side has a tall black metal fence and gate in front of a residence, with stone or brick-faced columns and walls. The right side also has modern residential walls and black metal gates, with white pillars and some greenery climbing or growing near the fences. The street appears clean, wide, and empty, with no pedestrians or vehicles visible.

Strong sunlight casts sharp shadows across the road. A large rounded shadow, possibly from a streetlamp or sign, falls across the repaired concrete in the foreground. The overall scene suggests recent road or driveway maintenance in a gated residential neighborhood, with cones temporarily marking the fresh concrete surface.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的照片，街道中央铺有新铺设的灰色混凝土路面。在照片的前景中，可以看到几个橙色和白色相间的交通锥排列成一排，它们沿着道路的一侧延伸，形成了一条清晰的视觉引导线。街道两侧是建筑物，其中一侧建筑的窗户上安装了防护栏。阳光照射下，地面的阴影投射在地面上，为这个场景增添了一些动态感。

caption:
The image shows a coastal lighthouse complex under a gray, overcast sky. The main building is a large, whitewashed structure with dark gray or black trim around the windows, corners, and roof edges. It has red-brown clay roof tiles and a classic lighthouse lantern room rising from the top: a cylindrical glass enclosure capped with a red dome and topped by a small weather vane or antenna-like fixture.

The architecture has a clean, traditional look, with thick white walls, rectangular windows, and decorative trim along the roofline. A tall white chimney stands on the left side of the main roof. Several connected building sections extend toward the right, forming a small compound. The windows are narrow and framed in dark stone or painted trim, giving strong contrast against the white façades.

In the foreground there is a well-kept green lawn bordered by low white walls and a short stone edging or pathway. A small young tree or shrub stands near the center-right of the lawn. The grounds are enclosed by white masonry walls, and there is a low stone wall segment near the middle of the scene. A red gate or railing is visible near the buildings.

On the far left, a flagpole holds a red-and-green flag, likely the Portuguese flag, blowing lightly in the wind. Beyond the walls on the left side, the horizon suggests the complex is near the sea or on a coastal headland.

To the right, there is another white wall and a utility pole with overhead wires crossing the scene diagonally. A smaller white building with a red-tiled roof appears in the distance beyond the main compound.

The sky dominates much of the upper image, filled with layered gray clouds, creating a subdued, slightly dramatic atmosphere. The lighting is soft and diffused, with no strong shadows, emphasizing the white buildings and the green grass. Overall, the scene feels quiet, maritime, and historic, centered around a traditional lighthouse facility.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座白色灯塔建筑的摄影照片。灯塔建筑位于画面中央，具有一个红色圆顶和白色的外墙，周围有绿色草坪和一些低矮的植被。在灯塔的背后可以看到其他几座建筑物，以及飘扬着旗帜的旗杆。天空多云，给整个场景增添了一种宁静而略带忧郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively historic European city square paved with gray cobblestones, viewed from a low street-level perspective. The scene is dominated by a row of tall, narrow, colorful townhouses on the right side, each with ornate façades and decorative gables. The buildings are painted in vivid shades of green, orange, yellow, cream, and pastel pink, with white-trimmed windows arranged in neat vertical rows. Several roofs have red clay tiles, and many façades feature sculpted details, curved pediments, and historic architectural ornamentation.

On the far right, a larger, more weathered stone building has elaborate carved decorations around its windows and a modern storefront at street level. A sign reading “empik” is visible above a glass entrance, and there are posters displayed in the windows. A tall streetlamp stands in front of this building, with additional decorative lamps visible farther into the square.

Toward the left-center background rises a tall brick church or tower with a dark, rounded, coppery-black roof and a small spire at the top. Its aged brickwork contrasts with the brightly painted houses nearby. Near the base of the tower, part of a building appears to be covered in scaffolding, suggesting restoration or construction work.

The foreground contains an outdoor café area with large cream-colored umbrellas, wooden tables and chairs, and branded signs on the fencing and umbrellas. A potted evergreen shrub sits near the café seating. The square itself is open and spacious, with people walking in small groups across the cobblestones. Some pedestrians wear coats, suggesting cool or mild weather. A shallow puddle or wet strip along the pavement reflects some of the buildings, indicating recent rain.

The sky is overcast and pale gray, giving the scene soft, diffused light. Despite the cloudy weather, the bright façades make the square feel cheerful and vibrant. Overall, the image captures a picturesque old-town market square with historic architecture, cafés, pedestrians, and a mix of everyday urban activity and tourist-friendly charm.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲城市街道的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个繁忙的广场，铺有鹅卵石，周围是色彩鲜艳的建筑，包括一个醒目的绿色立面和一个带有尖顶的白色塔楼。广场上人们在散步或坐在户外咖啡馆里享受休闲时光。天空多云，但光线充足，为这个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a small LEGO-style toy figure posed against a plain, pale white background. The figure is dressed like a colorful firework or rocket.

It has a bright blue cylindrical body with a red cone-shaped top, resembling a rocket nose. On the front of the blue costume is a comic-style burst graphic with the word “BANG” in bold letters, surrounded by starburst shapes and small yellow star decorations. Near the bottom of the costume, red and yellow flame graphics suggest an exploding firework or rocket blast.

The figure’s face is visible through a small rectangular opening in the costume. It has a yellow LEGO-like face wearing dark sunglasses and a wide, toothy smile, giving it a cheerful, celebratory expression. The arms are blue with red hands, and the legs are gray.

In its raised right hand, the figure holds a white pole with a square cardboard sign attached at the top. The sign is made of tan, textured paper and is tilted slightly to the right. Written on it in black, handwritten-style lettering are the words:

“happy  
new year  
2023”

The number “2023” appears large near the bottom of the sign, with a small red mark near the “2.” The overall composition is festive and playful, suggesting a New Year celebration theme.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乐高风格玩具的数字艺术图像，其中包含一个穿着蓝色和红色服装的乐高火箭人模型。火箭人戴着一副黄色太阳镜，头戴一顶红色尖顶帽，并且手持一块写有'Happy New Year 2023'字样的纸板。背景是纯白色，突出了主体元素。

caption:
The image shows a large industrial warehouse or factory yard under a bright blue sky.

The upper two-thirds of the image are dominated by a vivid sky with thin, wispy white clouds spread across it. The light is strong and clear, suggesting daytime, possibly midday, with high visibility and bright sunlight.

Across the middle of the image is a long, low industrial building. The building has a blue corrugated-metal exterior and a wide turquoise-blue roof. The roof stretches almost the entire width of the frame and is fitted with multiple small rooftop ventilation units or exhaust caps spaced along its length. Several lighter-colored roof panels or skylight-like strips run vertically down parts of the roof, creating pale yellowish accents.

The front wall of the warehouse is mostly blue, with sections of beige or light gray blockwork and vertical beige columns. There are large open bay doors at both the far left and far right, appearing as dark rectangular openings into the building. Near the right side, a smaller blue-roofed guard booth or office structure sits in front of the main building.

The foreground is a wide, open concrete yard with tire marks and faint surface stains. Various industrial materials are scattered and stacked around the yard. On the left side, there are long stacks of rusty-brown metal pipes or beams. Near the center and right, there are stacks of metal sheets or rectangular panels, long steel beams, and other construction or manufacturing materials. A long red industrial platform or trailer-like structure sits horizontally in front of the warehouse.

Several vehicles are visible near the building, including small white trucks parked in front of the warehouse. There appears to be a forklift or industrial vehicle near the right side, along with additional equipment and material stacks. A few tiny human figures can be seen near the trucks and yard area, giving a sense of scale to the large building and open space.

Overall, the scene depicts a spacious industrial storage or manufacturing facility, with a large warehouse, loading bays, construction materials, trucks, and heavy equipment arranged across a broad concrete yard beneath a bright, partly cloudy sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工业建筑的照片，建筑物为蓝色屋顶和白色墙面的大型结构，入口处有多个门和窗户。在建筑物前方的地面上堆放着各种建筑材料，包括木材、金属板和其他材料。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，云朵稀疏散布在蓝天中。

caption:
The image shows the side of a tall apartment or condominium building on the right, with multiple curved balconies stacked vertically. The building has pale yellow and white walls, white balcony railings, and prominent teal-green vertical columns running down its exterior. Several balconies contain outdoor furniture, plants, air-conditioning units, and household items, giving the building a residential feel.

Near the top of the building, a maintenance or construction worker is positioned on the very edge of a roof overhang. The worker is wearing high-visibility clothing, including a bright yellow-green shirt, and appears to have a hard hat or helmet. They are bent forward, working close to the gutter or roofline. Safety ropes or harness lines are visible, extending from the worker toward the building, suggesting they are secured while performing high-altitude maintenance. A ladder is also visible on the upper roof area, leaning upward near the edge, with tools or equipment nearby.

The background is a broad, hazy coastal cityscape filled with lush tropical greenery. Palm trees and dense foliage cover much of the lower half of the scene, with houses and low buildings scattered among the trees. Farther back, the horizon fades into a pale blue-gray haze, suggesting water or coastline in the distance. The sky is very bright and washed out, creating a hot, sunlit atmosphere.

The composition emphasizes height and risk: the worker is small compared with the building and appears precariously positioned at the roof’s edge, while the expansive view below reinforces how high above the ground they are. The overall scene feels like a warm tropical urban environment, possibly near the ocean, with a focus on building maintenance at a significant height.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的照片，画面中心是一位穿着黄色上衣和黑色裤子的人站在一栋多层建筑的边缘。该人物似乎在进行一项高空作业或摄影活动，他正专注地观察着下方的景象。建筑物为现代风格，拥有多个阳台和白色外立面。背景中可以看到一片绿色植被覆盖的区域，以及远处轮廓分明的城市天际线。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene on a bright day, likely near a transit stop or station.

In the foreground, there is a large, crowded bicycle parking area filled with many bicycles packed closely together. The bikes vary in style and color—black, silver, red, green, pink, and others—with visible handlebars, baskets, rear racks, fenders, reflectors, and locks. They are parked in green metal racks on a cobblestone surface, with some fallen leaves scattered between the stones.

On the right side of the image, a person is walking away from the camera along a paved sidewalk. They are wearing light blue jeans, white sneakers with blue and red accents, an olive-green jacket, and a large black backpack. Their head is turned slightly to the left, as if looking toward the street or bus stop.

To the left edge of the frame, part of a large blue truck cab is visible. It has a shiny dark windshield and side mirror, with yellow lettering on the front side. Above the bicycles, there are several road signs: a blue circular sign with a white upward arrow indicating traffic should go straight, pedestrian crossing signs with a white triangle and walking figure, and circular red-bordered restriction signs. One sign appears to indicate a height limit of 3.0 meters.

In the middle and background, there is a multi-lane street with red buses stopped or moving near a bus stop. A red city bus is visible on the left side of the road, while another red bus is near the bus stop on the right. The bus stop area includes shelters, signage, and several people waiting or walking nearby. There are also cars on the road, including a dark vehicle near the center-left.

The scene is lined with many trees, some with green leaves and others beginning to show yellow and brown tones, suggesting late summer or early autumn. A large leafy tree overhangs the upper-right portion of the image, casting some shade over the sidewalk and bicycle area. In the far background, there are streetlights, a building facade on the right, and a red construction crane or tower-like structure.

The sky is partly cloudy with patches of blue, and the sunlight is strong enough to create clear shadows on the sidewalk and brighten the scene. Overall, the image conveys a lively city environment with heavy bicycle use, public transportation, pedestrians, traffic signs, and urban greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市生活场景的照片，一位年轻男性背着黑色背包正从左向右走过自行车停放区。他穿着休闲服装，包括一件绿色夹克、蓝色牛仔裤和白色运动鞋。在照片的背景中，可以看到一排整齐排列的自行车，它们停放在一个带有指示牌的自行车停放区域。远处是城市的街道，有几辆红色的公交车正在行驶，以及一些行人和建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a tall roller coaster at or near the top of a steep drop, photographed from far below against a bright blue sky with large, soft white and gray clouds.

On the right side of the frame, a roller coaster train is packed with riders seated in several rows. The train is positioned high above the ground, just over the crest of a track, suggesting it is about to descend. The riders appear small because of the height and distance, but many are visible with their legs hanging down, indicating this may be a floorless or dive-style coaster. The seats and restraints are dark, with teal and purple elements matching the ride’s color scheme.

The coaster structure is prominent and vertical. A tall teal support column rises from the bottom of the image toward the train, while a purple vertical track section drops down beside it. To the left of the train is a steep lift hill or maintenance stairway structure, with black or dark metal stairs and railings running diagonally upward. Near the top is a platform-like section with curved safety railings and mechanical equipment.

The composition emphasizes height and suspense: the coaster train sits near the upper-right portion of the image, while the majority of the frame is open sky. The low-angle perspective makes the ride look extremely tall and dramatic. The colors are vivid, with turquoise supports, purple track components, and the bright sky creating a strong amusement-park atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示过山车在蓝天白云背景下运行的照片。过山车的轨道呈现出深蓝色和绿色，而车厢则以红色为主色调。乘客们穿着各式各样的安全装备，包括头盔、护目镜和救生衣，他们正享受着刺激的旅程。

caption:
The image shows a soccer player in action on a rain-soaked grass field. Heavy rain is falling across the entire scene, visible as countless bright white streaks and droplets against the green pitch. The wet conditions give the image a misty, slightly hazy look.

The player is positioned slightly right of center and appears to be running or dribbling forward. Their face is blurred, but they have short dark hair and are wearing a red-and-white vertically striped soccer jersey with black trim around the collar and sleeves. The shirt has a visible sponsor logo across the chest and small club/sponsor patches on the upper chest and sleeve. They are also wearing white shorts with the number “33” printed on one leg, white socks, and brightly colored cleats with neon green and blue tones.

A soccer ball is directly in front of the player’s feet near the bottom center of the image, suggesting they are controlling or about to touch the ball while moving. The player’s posture is athletic, with one arm bent near the torso and one leg stepping forward while the other trails behind.

The background is mostly the green soccer pitch, with a white field marking line running diagonally behind the player. The grass appears slick and saturated from the rain, and the intense rainfall dominates the atmosphere, making the scene feel dramatic and energetic, like a match continuing despite difficult weather conditions.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到足球运动员在雨中比赛的瞬间的照片。运动员穿着红白相间的球衣，专注地控制着足球，他的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。球场上的草地因雨水而显得湿润，周围飘落的水珠增添了照片的真实感和紧张气氛。

caption:
The image shows a striking scene in a suburban neighborhood: a white utility van is positioned at a steep diagonal angle, almost standing on its front end, as if it has driven nose-first into the pavement or is part of a dramatic display.

The van dominates the left and center of the image. It is a white service-style vehicle with bold blue racing-like stripes running lengthwise along its side.
