On the upper side panel, large blue lettering reads **“HAWKINS”**, with smaller text underneath saying **“POWER AND LIGHT.”** The van has multiple side doors and panels, chrome door handles, and rugged tires with visible white lettering. A spare tire is mounted on the rear side of the vehicle. The front of the van points downward toward the street, while the back end rises high into the air, creating a dramatic tilted composition.

Behind the van is a quiet residential street lined with modest brick and siding houses. One house on the right has a gray roof, green shutters, neatly trimmed bushes, and an American flag near the front. A concrete driveway curves up toward the house, and a satellite dish is visible near the center background. On the left, part of another house or porch can be seen beneath the raised rear of the van.

Tall trees with dense green foliage fill the background, and bright sunlight creates strong highlights and shadows across the scene. The sky peeks through the trees in patches of blue. There is also a slightly reflective or glassy quality over the image, with faint glare and reflections visible, suggesting the photo may have been taken through a window or protective display glass.

Overall, the image has a surreal, cinematic quality: the ordinary suburban setting contrasts sharply with the impossible-looking angle of the “Hawkins Power and Light” van.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆白色货车的创意摄影作品，货车被置于一个虚构的场景中，看起来像是从地面垂直升起。背景是一个典型的住宅区，包括有树木和房屋的绿色草坪。

caption:
The image shows a sun-bleached archaeological ruin in a desert setting, dominated by a long row of ancient stone columns. The columns are tall, cylindrical, and pale beige, with weathered surfaces marked by cracks, chips, stains, and erosion. Many are made from stacked drum-like sections, with visible horizontal seams. Some columns have simple projecting bands or partial capitals, while others are plain and worn smooth by age.

The composition is strongly linear: the colonnade runs diagonally from the right foreground toward the left background, creating a deep sense of perspective. On the right side, several massive columns stand close to the viewer, filling much of the frame. Behind them, additional columns recede into the distance, forming a rhythmic pattern of vertical shapes. Above part of the colonnade, broken entablatures and remnants of roof-like stone beams remain, though much of the upper structure has collapsed or crumbled.

The ground is dry, dusty, and uneven, scattered with fallen stone blocks, fragments of carved masonry, and rubble. In the foreground, large rectangular and irregular stone pieces lie piled near the bases of the columns. Some fragments appear to have once been decorative architectural elements, now worn and broken.

To the left, there is a partially visible ruin with carved details, possibly a capital or section of a decorative façade. Farther in the background, low barren hills stretch across the horizon. A thin metal tower or antenna rises in the distance on the left, contrasting sharply with the ancient stone architecture.

The color palette is mostly warm and muted: sandy beige, ochre, pale tan, and dusty brown, with a hazy light blue-gray sky above. The lighting is bright and diffuse, suggesting harsh desert daylight softened by haze. Overall, the image conveys the grandeur and decay of an ancient city or temple complex, with the surviving columns standing as imposing remnants of a once monumental structure.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古代柱廊遗迹的摄影图像。图像中，一排高大的圆柱沿着一条宽阔的石质道路排列，形成了一个宏伟的结构。柱子表面略显磨损，显示出历史的痕迹。在远处可以看到一些现代建筑的轮廓，与古老的遗迹形成鲜明对比。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively, narrow pedestrian shopping street at night, decorated with abundant festive lights. Warm white string lights are draped overhead in long curtain-like strands, stretching from building to building across the walkway. Several glowing spherical ornaments hang at different heights, resembling illuminated moons or snowballs, adding a soft golden glow to the scene.

On both sides of the street are tall building façades with shopfronts, balconies, and architectural details in cream, beige, and pastel tones. The right side has a bright, elegant storefront area with large windows and decorative molding, while the left side includes a vintage-style black lamppost adorned with hanging baskets of red and green flowers. Red floral garlands climb vertically along parts of the buildings, reinforcing the festive atmosphere.

Trees line the walkway, and their trunks and branches are wrapped densely in tiny white lights. The greenery contrasts with the warm lights and the stone-paved street below. The pavement is made of patterned cobblestones arranged in circular and fan-like designs, giving the walkway a polished, upscale feel.

A crowd of people fills the street. Some are walking deeper into the illuminated passage, while others stand in small groups talking or looking around. In the foreground on the right, a woman in a tan coat and tall black boots appears to be holding up a phone, possibly taking a picture of the decorations. Nearby, a man stands facing a flower display outside a shop. In the center-left foreground, two women stand together with shopping bags, while more visitors gather along the sides.

The background narrows into a brightly lit perspective, with more strings of lights and people receding into the distance. The overall mood is festive, elegant, and bustling, likely during a holiday or special seasonal event in an upscale shopping district.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日氛围的街道夜景照片。街道两旁装饰着繁茂的绿植和五彩缤纷的花卉，以及串连的白色灯光串，营造出一种温馨而喜庆的气氛。行人们在街道上行走或停留，有的在交谈，有的在欣赏周围的美景。街道中央有一名女性正在拍照，她身穿棕色大衣，黑色长靴，正专注地用手机捕捉这一刻。

caption:
The image shows a lively Pride parade or LGBTQ+ celebration taking place on a city street lined with historic European-style buildings. The camera is positioned very low, almost at the level of a huge rainbow flag that fills most of the foreground and lower half of the image. The fabric stretches wide across the street and is being held by many people along its edges. Its bright stripes—purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, and red—curve and ripple slightly, creating a wavelike pattern across the frame.

On both sides of the flag, a dense crowd of participants and spectators is visible. Many people are wearing colorful clothing, rainbow accessories, and pride flags draped over their shoulders. Some have brightly dyed hair, including pink and blue, adding to the festive atmosphere. The crowd appears cheerful and engaged, with people walking, talking, holding the flag, and watching the event.

The setting is an urban pedestrian street with tall, ornate buildings on either side. The architecture features decorative facades, large windows, stone details, and pastel-colored walls. Storefronts and signs are visible along the street, including shop signs such as “Falcone,” “Humanic,” and other retail signage. Overhead, thin wires for street lighting or tram infrastructure crisscross the cloudy sky, and a hanging streetlamp can be seen in the distance.

The perspective emphasizes the scale of the rainbow flag, making it the dominant visual element. The street narrows toward the center background, where more buildings and people continue into the distance. The overall mood is vibrant, inclusive, and celebratory, with the rainbow colors contrasting strongly against the muted tones of the historic city architecture and overcast sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示LGBTQ+骄傲游行的现场照片。图像中心是一条巨大的彩虹色横幅，它在街道上展开，成为了游行活动的焦点。彩虹旗的颜色鲜艳，从左至右依次为红、橙、黄、绿、蓝和紫色。旗帜下方是穿着各式服装的人群，他们聚集在一起，有的佩戴着彩虹色的装饰品或服饰，表达了对LGBTQ+群体的支持和尊重。背景中可以看到城市建筑，其中一些建筑物上有阳台和窗户，而街道两旁则有商店和其他建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic nighttime view of a large city skyline from a high vantage point. Most of the frame is dominated by a very dark, hazy night sky, with only faint cloudiness or atmospheric glow visible above the city.

Across the lower half of the image, a dense urban landscape stretches from left to right. The buildings are mostly dark silhouettes, but many windows and signs are lit in scattered patterns of warm yellow, orange, white, red, and occasional blue or green. The city appears expansive, with high-rise towers, apartment blocks, office buildings, and smaller structures packed closely together.

Near the center-right, a tall dark building with a distinctive pointed or slanted roof stands out against the skyline. Around it are clusters of other towers, some with illuminated rooftop signs or decorative lights. The far distance is hazy, causing the buildings and lights on the horizon to appear softened and slightly blurred.

A bright line of traffic runs from the lower center of the image toward the middle distance, forming a diagonal corridor of white and red lights. This road or elevated transit route draws the eye into the city. Near the lower left-to-center area, an elevated rail or roadway structure is visible, cutting diagonally upward through the scene.

The overall mood is quiet, atmospheric, and subdued. The image is quite dark, with the city lights providing small points of brightness against the heavy black sky and shadowy buildings. It conveys the scale of a modern metropolis at night, seen from above, with a sense of depth created by the receding lights and skyline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，图像中心有一条繁忙的道路，两侧是密集的建筑群。道路上车辆的灯光在黑暗中形成了一道光带，而远处的建筑物则被夜色和灯光点缀，营造出一种繁华都市的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a peaceful coastal scene with a sailboat anchored on calm, rippling water in front of large, hazy mountains.

In the foreground, the sea fills the lower portion of the frame. The water is a deep blue-green with small, wind-made waves and gentle texture across the surface. Light reflects subtly off the ripples, giving the water a slightly shimmering appearance.

On the right side of the image, a white sailing yacht sits on the water. Its long hull is visible in profile, with several white cylindrical fenders hanging along the side. The boat has a tall mast rising high into the sky, with thin rigging lines extending down toward the deck. The sail appears to be furled along the boom rather than raised. A dark canopy or bimini covers part of the rear cockpit area. There are small details on deck, including ropes, equipment, and a small blue flag or pennant hanging near the mast. At the stern, a flag is visible, though the exact design is not fully clear.

Behind the sailboat, the shoreline curves around a bay. The hills closest to the water are covered with patches of green vegetation, shrubs, and trees, mixed with dry, sunlit earth. The warm light catches the slopes, giving them a golden-green tone.

In the background, much larger mountains dominate the scene. They appear bluish-gray and softened by atmospheric haze, creating a layered effect. The mountain ridges stretch across the entire width of the image, with the highest peak toward the upper left. The haze makes the distant terrain look muted and calm, emphasizing depth and distance.

The sky is pale and bright, almost white near the top, with no distinct clouds visible. The overall mood is serene and quiet, suggesting early morning or late afternoon light in a sheltered Mediterranean-like bay. The composition feels spacious, with the sailboat positioned off-center to the right and the expansive mountains and water giving the scene a tranquil, open atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示帆船在宁静海面上航行的自然风光照片。一艘大型帆船在画面中央，船上挤满了乘客，他们似乎正在享受航行的乐趣。背景是连绵起伏的山脉和一些绿色植被覆盖的小山丘，阳光从山坡上洒下，给整个场景增添了一抹温暖的色调。

caption:
The image shows a decorative tabletop arrangement on a white, weathered wooden surface with visible plank lines and light gray grain marks. The scene is brightly lit, especially on the right side, where the surface becomes almost overexposed.

On the left side, part of a black laptop is visible, with its keyboard and screen edge partially covered by a large red plush heart-shaped cushion. The cushion has colorful embroidered detailing on it, including a yellow and blue outlined heart-like design and gold lettering or decoration.

Near the center-left are several artificial flower decorations. There are red-and-cream rose-like flowers arranged with dark brown polka-dotted ribbon or fabric beneath them. A small round tabletop mirror with a shiny silver metal frame stands upright behind the flowers. Its reflective surface has a warm yellowish tint and faintly reflects nearby objects.

In the lower center, a black-handled magnifying glass lies on the table. Its lens reflects a grid-like pattern of light and colored shapes, including green and red tones. Around it are scattered fuzzy pom-poms in bright colors: red, sky blue, dark blue, and lime green. Some pom-poms are grouped closely around the magnifying glass, while others are spread across the table toward the right and top areas.

A pink artificial rose with pale cream edges sits near the bottom left-center, next to a small cluster of green artificial leaves and stems with tiny yellow-green buds. The rose and greenery add a floral, craft-like feel to the arrangement.

The background is simple: a plain light-colored wall meets the tabletop at the back. The overall composition feels playful and decorative, combining craft supplies, artificial flowers, mirrors, and soft plush objects in a colorful still-life setup.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种物品的静物摄影图像，包括一个红色心形枕头、一朵粉红色玫瑰花、一个小巧的圆形镜子和一些彩色毛球。这些物品被摆放在一张白色的木质桌面上，营造出一种温馨而有创意的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an indoor scene with an adult woman and a young child sitting together on a red upholstered couch or chair. They are facing each other closely, suggesting they are having a conversation or sharing a moment.

The woman is on the left side of the image. She has light blonde hair pulled back and is wearing a bright red long-sleeved top decorated with colorful, shiny embellishments near the chest area. She is holding a smartphone in both hands, with bright orange-red painted fingernails visible. Her body is angled toward the child, and her head is turned to look at them.

The child is seated on the right side, facing the woman. The child has short dark hair and is wearing a short-sleeved plaid shirt in shades of gray, white, and blue, along with dark pants. One arm rests down near their lap, and they appear to be sitting on or next to a large plush tiger toy, which is visible across the lower part of the image with orange, black, and white fur.

The background features pale beige wallpaper with a subtle floral and leafy pattern in soft cream and light pink tones. A white vertical doorframe or wall edge is visible on the far left. Near the left edge, part of an orange plastic toy with purple details can also be seen.

The lighting is warm and bright, likely from a camera flash, giving the image a slightly overexposed look in some areas. The faces of both people are blurred, but their posture suggests a calm, attentive interaction between the adult and child.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现家庭温馨时刻的照片，一位成年女性坐在红色沙发上，穿着红色上衣并佩戴着珠宝，正在使用手机。旁边是一个小男孩，他正专注地看着手中的玩具，可能是泰迪熊。他们周围是典型的家居环境，包括带有花纹的墙纸和部分可见的家具。

caption:
The image shows a broad, elevated view over a lush urban park surrounded by dense city buildings.

In the foreground and lower half of the scene, there is abundant greenery: large leafy trees, palms, shrubs, and landscaped lawns. The park appears very well maintained, with winding pedestrian paths, benches, lampposts, and small groups of people walking or sitting. Near the lower center-right is a pond or small lake with pale greenish water, bordered by a curved paved walkway. A few people are visible along the water’s edge and on the paths, appearing tiny from the high vantage point.

On the left side of the park, there is a decorative garden area with a geometric hedge pattern. At its center stands a dark pyramid-shaped monument or sculpture with a gold-colored triangular top. Nearby, an open grassy lawn and scattered trees create a calm, garden-like atmosphere. The park feels tropical, with dense foliage and a variety of tree shapes and shades of green.

The upper half of the image is filled with high-rise residential and commercial buildings. On the left are apartment towers with balconies, pale blue and cream façades, and a distinctive yellow-and-white building with vertical decorative elements; one building has a visible sign reading “THE CREST.” In the center and background, more towers and mid-rise buildings recede into a hazy skyline. On the right is a large modern building with glass windows and horizontal bands, plus a lower section covered with greenery and vertical architectural fins. Some parts of the buildings include rooftop terraces and planted areas.

The lighting is bright but slightly hazy, suggesting an overcast or humid day. The overall impression is of a dense modern city built around a green park oasis, where urban high-rises and tropical landscaping sit side by side.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园景观的摄影图像，前景是郁郁葱葱的树木和草坪，中央有一个宁静的小湖，湖中有几只鸭子在水中游弋。湖边有一座雕塑，周围环绕着蜿蜒的小径。背景中，高楼大厦错落有致地排列着，形成了城市的天际线。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a gray stone architectural facade or monument surface. The stone has a mottled, speckled texture, with blue-gray and darker charcoal tones, giving it the appearance of polished or weathered granite or marble.

Near the upper-middle portion, raised dark metal letters spell out:

**“PIAZZA  
DELLA SCALA”**

The lettering is in uppercase serif type, evenly spaced, and mounted directly onto the stone. The words are centered, with “PIAZZA” on the top line and “DELLA SCALA” below it.

Above and below the inscription are horizontal decorative stone moldings or ledges, creating layered bands across the facade. These bands have darker edges and shadows, emphasizing the relief and depth of the stonework.

Below the inscription is a pale rectangular plaque or sign mounted on the stone. It appears light gray or off-white and is somewhat blurred or washed out, making any text on it difficult to read. A faint “201” is visible near the upper-left corner of this lower plaque.

The overall image has a vertical composition, tightly framed on the stone surface and signage, with no people or surrounding street scene visible. The mood is formal and architectural, suggesting a sign marking Piazza della Scala, a public square likely in an Italian urban setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑细节的照片，特写了一块灰色的石板，上面刻有'Piazza della Scala'的文字。石板位于建筑物的一部分上，其表面看起来光滑且具有一定的纹理。

caption:
The image shows a neatly arranged workspace photographed from above on a light wood-grain desk.

On the left side, a black computer keyboard sits diagonally, partly cropped out of the frame. The visible section includes navigation and number-pad keys such as Insert, Delete, Backspace, Enter, Shift, Ctrl, Alt Gr, Home, End, Pg Up, Pg Dn, and number keys. The keyboard’s dark color contrasts strongly with the pale wooden surface.

Near the lower center is a smartphone placed vertically. It has a black case and a notched screen, resembling an iPhone. The screen is mostly white and displays the Google Drive logo in the middle: a triangular icon in green, yellow, and blue, with the word “Google” faintly visible near the bottom. The phone status bar shows the time as 19:35.

To the right is an open paper planner or diary, angled slightly. The page is dated “30” in large type, with “Luni / Monday / Montag” and “Martie / March / März” printed beside it. The planner page contains hourly lines running down the page, marked from morning through evening, along with a pinkish section near the bottom for important notes. A red pen lies partly visible at the top-right edge of the planner.

At the bottom left, near the phone, there is a crumpled ball of bright red paper, adding a messy, casual element to the otherwise organized desk setup.

Overall, the image suggests a work or productivity theme, combining digital tools—keyboard and phone with Google Drive—with traditional planning materials like a dated paper agenda. The warm lighting and wooden background give the scene a calm office or study atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示办公环境的照片，中心位置是一个黑色的智能手机，屏幕上显示着Google Drive的图标。手机左侧是一个黑色键盘，右侧是一部白色日历本，上面有红色标记和日期。在手机前方，有一个红色的皱巴巴纸团，增添了一丝生活化的细节。整个场景被放置在一个木质桌面上，给人一种整洁有序的工作氛围。

caption:
The image shows the front entrance of a large white Orthodox-style church or cathedral, photographed straight on in bright daylight. The architecture is dominated by white brickwork, rounded arches, and layered decorative moldings.

At the center is a tall, dark wooden double door set inside a deep arched doorway. The door is black or very dark brown and decorated with rows of gold-colored studs or floral metal ornaments, with long vertical handles near the middle. Several red-brown stone steps lead up to the entrance.

Above the doorway is a large arched mosaic panel made of square tiles. The mosaic depicts a religious scene: a central haloed figure, likely the Virgin Mary, standing on clouds with arms extended outward and holding or spreading a long white veil. She wears deep red and blue robes with gold trim. Around her are several angels with golden wings, floating against a blue sky with clouds. Some angels gesture toward her, while others appear in prayerful or reverent poses.

The lower part of the mosaic shows stylized church buildings and domes, including white churches with golden onion domes and crosses, as well as green and dark domes on other structures. These buildings sit on a rocky or earthen landscape with water or blue decorative bands near the bottom.

The mosaic is framed by a large white pointed arch with a dark trim along the upper edge. On either side of the entrance are thick white architectural supports and pilasters, with layered cornices and rounded column-like details. Higher up, narrow arched windows are visible in the white wall behind the mosaic. Strong sunlight creates crisp shadows across the white façade, emphasizing the depth of the arches and brick texture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示俄罗斯东正教风格的教堂入口的照片。教堂的白色墙壁上装饰着一幅色彩鲜艳的宗教壁画，描绘了圣母玛利亚和天使群在蓝天白云下飞翔的场景。壁画上方是一个拱形结构，与下方的金色大门形成对比。门上方有一个圆形的装饰性元素，而楼梯则引导人们进入这个神圣的空间。

caption:
The image shows a group of five men walking toward the camera on a wide urban street, apparently during or after a running/walking event. Their faces are blurred, and each person is wearing a race bib with Thai text and numbers, suggesting an organized local race or charity walk.

In the foreground, on the far left edge, there is a partially visible out-of-focus person wearing a sleeveless athletic top with orange, navy, and white colors. This person is very close to the camera and blurred, creating a sense of depth.

The main group is centered across the road:

- The man on the left wears a navy sleeveless sports jersey with white and red accents, black shorts, black running shoes, and a headband. He has a tattoo on one arm and is walking with his arms relaxed.
- Next to him is a man in a black T-shirt with a printed design, dark shorts, and a small crossbody bag. A race bib is pinned to the front of his shirt.
- In the middle is a man dressed mostly in black, wearing a black athletic shirt, black shorts over leggings, and running shoes. He appears to be touching his face or holding something near his mouth while walking.
- To his right is a larger-built man in an olive-green T-shirt, navy shorts, white socks, and running shoes. He is also wearing a race bib and holding something in one hand.
- On the far right is a man wearing a black Adidas-style tracksuit jacket with white stripes, black pants, and bright red shoes. He also has a race bib pinned to his jacket.

The street is broad and mostly empty of vehicles, with the group walking down the center. In the background, there are additional participants, including a person in a white and orange shirt, also wearing a race bib.

The left side of the image is lined with dense green trees and a grassy area, giving that side a park-like feel. On the right side, there are buildings, shopfronts, utility poles, wires, and multiple signs in Thai. One prominent sign has a large blue “B” or similar symbol, while other signs include Thai lettering and colorful storefront advertisements.

The lighting is soft and bright, likely early morning or late afternoon, with an overcast or hazy sky. The overall scene feels casual and communal, capturing participants walking together during a local road event in a Thai urban neighborhood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群跑步者在城市街道上进行跑步活动的照片。最前方的跑步者穿着橙色和黑色的运动装备，而其他几位参与者则穿着各种颜色的运动服，他们都佩戴着号码布。他们沿着道路前进，背景是模糊的城市街景，包括路边的商店和其他建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban street scene in a city square or pedestrian plaza on an overcast day. The sky is pale gray and cloudy, giving the scene a muted, cool tone.

On the left side, there is a large beige/yellow building with a rounded, cylindrical corner section and a curved roofline. Its facade is fairly plain, with narrow vertical windows and horizontal trim bands near the lower floors. The building’s scale dominates the left side of the image.

On the right side, older mid-rise apartment or mixed-use buildings line the street. They have pale cream facades, many rectangular windows, balconies, rooftop railings, pipes, and visible air-conditioning units. The architecture looks dense and urban, with shops or entrances at street level. A small kiosk or storefront with a green-and-yellow diamond sign reading “T&C” is visible on the far right, and nearby signage includes Cyrillic text, suggesting the location is in a Russian-speaking city.

Near the center-right is a prominent red “M” metro sign mounted above a station information board. Below and around it are other signs, including advertisements and street information panels. One billboard-like sign in the middle distance contains Cyrillic text and appears to advertise an event or performance. Several black decorative street lamps stand around the plaza.

The foreground is a broad paved pedestrian area made of large gray stone slabs. There are multiple people walking or standing. In the lower left foreground, a small group of young adults in winter jackets walks together; their faces are blurred. A man in a dark blue puffer vest walks across the center foreground carrying a shopping bag. On the right, a person sits on a circular stone bench or low monument base, while other pedestrians stand or walk nearby. Most people are dressed for cool weather, wearing coats, jackets, hats, or scarves.

In the middle distance, the pedestrian plaza transitions into a road with traffic. Cars are visible waiting or moving along the street, and there are construction-style barriers, bollards, and traffic signs separating pedestrian and vehicle areas. Crosswalk signs and road markings are visible near the street.

Overall, the scene depicts a busy city square near a metro station, with a mix of pedestrians, traffic, older residential buildings, commercial signage, and subdued overcast lighting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，几位行人正在步行，其中一位穿着蓝色夹克和牛仔裤的人正快步走过镜头。街道两侧是多层建筑，包括一个黄色的圆顶建筑和一些带有绿色屋顶的住宅楼。建筑物的设计简洁，色调以浅色为主。在远处可以看到更多的行人和车辆，而天空则显得有些阴沉，可能预示着天气的变化。

caption:
The image shows a bright outdoor gathering or ceremony on a paved street or courtyard, with people arranged in two facing lines as if welcoming or greeting visitors.

In the center foreground stands a man wearing a light pink short-sleeved button-up shirt, black trousers, and black shoes. His hands are clasped in front of him, and he appears to be speaking with or observing a group of children standing to his right. Around him are several adults dressed formally or in festive clothing.

On the left side, a group of adults wear vivid red traditional-style Chinese outfits. One woman in the front wears a long red embroidered dress with gold floral and bird designs, a high collar, and a side slit. Behind her are men in red patterned shirts with gold motifs, including dragon-like and circular designs, paired with black trousers. Their clothing suggests a cultural celebration, possibly connected to a Chinese festival or performance.

On the right side, many children stand in a line wearing colorful performance costumes. Some are dressed in black outfits with yellow sashes, holding red-and-yellow flags or props. Others wear bright blue satin-like costumes with red diagonal straps and decorative details. A few children further back wear pale blue or pink costumes, including one with a light blue dress and another holding or standing near pink decorative branches resembling cherry blossoms. Several children have their hands together in a respectful greeting gesture.

The background includes a gated entrance with red and cream-colored walls, gold decorative elements on top of posts, leafy trees, and overhead utility wires. Thai flags are visible above the wall, suggesting the scene may be taking place in Thailand. The lighting is very bright, with strong sunlight causing some overexposure in the upper left and background areas. Overall, the scene feels like a formal cultural welcome or school/community celebration with traditional costumes, flags, and organized participants.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统节日庆典的摄影照片，图中一位穿着粉红色衬衫和黑色裤子的男性站在中心，他手持一个金色物体，似乎在与周围的参与者交流。周围的人们身着各式各样的服装，包括红色的传统中国服饰、蓝色和黄色的装饰性服装以及其他多彩的服装。他们排成一列，有的佩戴着头饰，有的手持旗帜或饰品，整个场景充满了庆祝的氛围。背景中有绿色植物和一些现代建筑结构，但它们并不抢眼，为这个文化活动提供了一个自然的环境。

caption:
The image shows a tense outdoor scene in a dusty, open area under a clear blue sky. A line of uniformed security forces or soldiers occupies much of the left and center of the frame. They are wearing tan camouflage uniforms, helmets with visors, protective pads, and tactical vests. Several are holding large transparent riot shields; one shield has the word “JANDARMA” visible on it, suggesting gendarmerie or military police. Some faces appear blurred or indistinct.

In the foreground, a middle-aged man with curly gray hair stands slightly left of center, wearing a blue-and-white striped button-down shirt. A large camera with a telephoto lens hangs from his shoulder, indicating he may be a photojournalist. He is turned to the side, looking toward the cluster of soldiers and civilians. Next to him, a younger man in a gray T-shirt and jeans stands with his back to the camera, also watching the activity.

On the right side, a group of civilians and uniformed personnel are gathered closely together. Some men wear casual clothing such as caps, button-down shirts, jeans, and hats, while others wear military gear. The crowd appears to be in motion or engaged in discussion, with people facing different directions.

In the background, there are military or armored vehicles partially visible, including one with a person standing or sitting on top. A tall wooden utility pole rises near the right side of the frame, with power lines stretching across the sky. The ground is dry, uneven, and littered with small debris, bottles, and scraps, reinforcing the impression of a rough roadside or field location.

Overall, the scene conveys a moment of confrontation, crowd control, or security presence, with journalists and civilians observing or interacting with heavily equipped gendarmerie forces in a hot, arid environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这张照片捕捉了一群穿着制服的士兵在户外集会或训练场景中。前景中，一位长发男子背对着镜头，身穿蓝色衬衫和黑色裤子，手持相机，似乎在记录事件。旁边是一位穿着灰色T恤和牛仔裤的年轻人，他面向镜头，看起来像是在等待拍照或观看。背景中，其他参与者和装备齐全的士兵们站立着，一些人交谈，而其他人则专注于他们的任务。整个场面被阳光照耀，天空晴朗，给人一种紧张但有序的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a dry, desert-like wildlife enclosure set against a dramatic backdrop of pale, rocky mountains. The scene is sunlit with a warm, dusty atmosphere and a clear, light-blue sky.

In the foreground, the ground is sandy and uneven, scattered with white and tan rocks of various sizes. Several larger stone piles and low boulders sit near the bottom and right side of the frame. Two small antelopes or gazelles stand near the center-bottom area; they have slender bodies, tan coats with white underbellies, dark side markings, and curved black horns. One is walking left, while another stands closer to the giraffes.

The main subjects are two giraffes on the right half of the image. One giraffe, slightly smaller and lighter in color, is positioned near the center, walking from right to left with its long neck stretched forward. Its coat has a golden-brown pattern with lighter patches. The second giraffe, taller and darker, stands to the right, facing left. Its bold, dark brown patches contrast sharply with the pale background. Both giraffes have long legs, small horn-like ossicones on their heads, and dark tails hanging behind them.

Behind the animals is a fenced compound with metal railings, gates, and greenish panels, suggesting a zoo, safari park, or managed wildlife reserve. There are shade structures with thatched or reed-like roofing, as well as leafless and scrubby trees typical of arid environments. Some additional animals can be seen faintly in the background behind the fencing and among the trees.

The mountains dominate the upper half of the image. They are rugged, beige-gray, and heavily textured, with ridges, slopes, and eroded formations. Their dry, barren appearance matches the sandy enclosure below. Overall, the image captures a desert wildlife habitat with giraffes and antelopes moving calmly in a spacious, rocky enclosure beneath arid mountain scenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在自然栖息地中的长颈鹿和羚羊的野生动物摄影。图像中，两只成年长颈鹿站立在沙地上，一只长颈鹿面向镜头，另一只则转过头来望向远方。它们身后是几只羚羊，其中一些正在移动。背景中可以看到若干树木和一座山丘，以及一些建筑物，可能是动物园的一部分。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban cityscape at dusk or early night, viewed from an elevated position. The sky dominates the upper half of the frame, transitioning from a deep navy blue at the top to softer blue, violet, pink, and orange tones near the horizon. Long, dark, layered clouds stretch horizontally across the sky, creating a dramatic twilight atmosphere.

On the right side of the image, a very tall modern high-rise building occupies the edge of the frame. Its façade is partially visible, with brick or stone-colored walls, large dark window panels, and strong vertical architectural lines. Bright white exterior lighting outlines the building’s columns, edges, and horizontal bands, making it stand out sharply against the dark sky. The lighting gives the building a polished, upscale appearance.

Across the middle and lower portions of the image are several older mid-rise apartment blocks. These buildings are rectangular, beige or gray, and filled with many small windows and balconies. Numerous apartment windows are lit in warm yellow, white, and orange tones, suggesting evening activity inside. The balconies vary in appearance, with some enclosed and others open, creating a dense, lived-in residential texture.

In the distance, additional high-rise buildings and construction cranes are visible along the skyline. Some buildings on the left side are decorated with bright outline lighting, similar to the tall building on the right, while others are darker silhouettes. The horizon glows faintly with city lights and the last colors of sunset.

At street level, the scene is busy with roads, streetlights, trees, parked cars, and commercial buildings. Warm streetlights create starburst effects, especially near intersections and along the roads. A lit sign reading “HARAT’S PUB” is visible near the lower left-middle area. Near the lower right, there is a brightly lit entrance or commercial frontage at the base of the tall high-rise, with parked cars arranged along a driveway or parking area.

The foreground includes rooftops, utility structures, antennas, and a tall red-and-white industrial chimney or mast. Trees with dark green foliage line parts of the streets, softening the dense urban environment. Overall, the image captures a modern city at twilight, mixing older residential blocks, newer luxury high-rises, street-level activity, and a dramatic evening sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，图像中心是一座高耸的现代建筑，其顶部灯光在夜空中闪烁。周围是多层住宅楼和一些商业建筑，它们的窗户亮着温暖的黄色灯光。天空呈现出深蓝色到橙色渐变的晚霞，云朵被夕阳染成了金色。街道上的车辆留下了光轨，为这个夜晚的城市增添了一丝动感。

caption:
The image shows the exterior façade of a Honda dealership or showroom, photographed from a low, upward-looking angle.

Across the middle of the image is a large horizontal sign. On the left side of the sign is a bright red rectangular panel featuring the Honda wing logo in dark/black relief, with the word “HONDA” beneath it in smaller dark letters. To the right of this panel, on a light gray background, large three-dimensional red capital letters spell “HONDA.” The letters are bold, glossy, and cast dark shadows, giving them a raised, sculptural appearance.

Above the sign is a large white or off-white wall made of smooth rectangular panels separated by thin dark grid lines. The panels are clean and minimalist, creating a modern architectural look. The top portion of the image is mostly this pale wall, emphasizing the geometry of the building.

Below the sign are large glass window panels with a bluish-green tint. The windows are divided by dark vertical frames, and their reflective surface shows subtle shadows and light variations. Two cylindrical concrete columns are visible in front of the windows—one near the left edge and one on the right side—supporting the overhang or upper façade.

The overall color palette is dominated by red, gray, white, black, and cool blue-green glass tones. Strong sunlight creates sharp shadows and high contrast, making the red Honda branding stand out prominently against the modern building exterior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Honda汽车品牌标志的照片。标志位于建筑物的外墙上，上方是红色背景上的白色文字'Honda'，下方则是一个带有翅膀图案的红色徽章。整个标志设计简洁而显眼，背景为现代建筑风格的墙面和几根白色的立柱。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a large European public square, likely Praça do Comércio in Lisbon, Portugal, photographed in warm late-afternoon or early-evening light.

In the center background is a monumental white triumphal arch, the Rua Augusta Arch, richly decorated with columns, sculpted figures, reliefs, and statues on top. The arch is illuminated by golden sunlight, making its pale stone stand out against the darker blue-gray sky. Through and around the arch, smaller buildings and streets can be seen. On top of the arch are allegorical statues and carved inscriptions.

To the left of the arch is a long, yellow-and-white neoclassical building with a red-tiled roof. It has repeated rows of tall windows with dark shutters or frames and arched arcades at street level. In front of this building, a line of flagpoles displays many colorful national flags. The flags are blowing in the wind, with one prominent blue-and-yellow flag near the top left and several red, white, blue, and multicolored flags below it.

On the right side of the image is a large equestrian statue on an ornate pedestal, depicting a rider on horseback. The statue is dark bronze or greenish from patina and stands prominently above the square. The pedestal is decorated with sculptural figures and elaborate stonework. Nearby are old-fashioned street lamps and groups of people gathered around the base.

The foreground is a vast open paved plaza, mostly empty, with geometric bands in the pavement creating subtle diagonal and rectangular patterns. Scattered pedestrians walk across the square: small groups, couples, and individuals. Near the center foreground, a small child in bright pink pants and a blue top stands out against the neutral pavement. On the left foreground, an adult stands watching the square, holding a bag. The scale of the people emphasizes the enormous size of the plaza and surrounding architecture.

Behind the arch and to the right, part of a building appears covered in scaffolding or construction netting, and yellow construction cranes rise above the rooftops. Further in the background, a hillside is visible with tightly packed buildings, red roofs, and a line of green trees along the top, adding depth to the urban scene.

The lighting is dramatic: much of the square in the foreground is in shadow, while the buildings, arch, statue, and hillside are warmly lit. The sky is mostly clear and expansive, occupying a large portion of the image and giving the scene an open, spacious feeling.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场的摄影照片，阳光从画面右侧照射下来，给广场和建筑物投下了柔和的阴影。在广场中央，有一个穿着蓝色上衣的小孩正在奔跑，周围是散步的人群。广场的一侧是一座装饰华丽的拱门建筑，其上方飘扬着几面彩旗。另一侧则是一个雕塑和一些树木，为这个开放空间增添了自然元素。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor Mercedes-Benz dealership lot in an urban setting, photographed in bright daylight.

In the foreground, several Mercedes-Benz cars are parked in a neat row facing the camera. Most are sleek coupes or convertibles in black, silver, white, and gray. Their prominent Mercedes star emblems are centered on the front grilles, and several cars have dealership plates reading “Junge Sterne,” suggesting certified pre-owned Mercedes vehicles. Some cars have information sheets displayed inside their windshields, indicating they are for sale. The vehicles are parked on a paved asphalt surface with painted parking spaces and low landscaping strips with shrubs behind them.

Above the cars is a large metal canopy or roof structure supported by columns. The underside of the canopy has an intricate geometric framework of white or cream-colored metal beams forming triangular and crisscross patterns. This structure casts partial shade over the cars while sunlight creates bright highlights and reflections on the polished vehicle bodies.

In the midground to the left is a modern commercial building with large reflective glass windows and white paneling. More Mercedes vehicles are visible under or beside the building, suggesting an extended showroom or dealership display area. The windows reflect trees, sky, and nearby structures.

In the background, across the street, there are residential or office buildings with light-colored facades, rows of windows, and trees lining the road. A small McDonald’s sign is visible near the center-right background, partially framed by trees and street signs. There are also traffic lights, road signs, parked cars, and a street running behind the dealership lot.

The overall atmosphere is clean, polished, and commercial, with the focus on luxury cars displayed under a modern architectural canopy. The lighting is warm and sunny, with strong reflections on the cars and dappled shadows from the surrounding trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多辆奔驰汽车停放在户外停车场的照片。照片中，车辆整齐排列，包括不同型号的轿车和SUV。每辆车都展示了其独特的设计和品牌标志。背景是一个现代风格的建筑，具有大面积的玻璃窗户和金属结构屋顶。周围环境看起来干净整洁，有树木和草地点缀其中。

caption:
The image shows an old, overgrown cemetery set within a dense wooded area. The scene is dominated by deep green vegetation: ivy carpets the ground, climbs over mounds and low walls, and wraps thickly around several tree trunks. The trees are tall and mature, with dense canopies that create a shaded, enclosed atmosphere.

Scattered throughout the cemetery are numerous weathered gravestones in different shapes and sizes. Many are upright, rectangular or rounded at the top, while others lean at angles or are partially hidden by plants. The stones appear aged, with pale gray and beige surfaces, worn edges, and faint inscriptions that are difficult to read. Some of the inscriptions look like they may be in Hebrew or another script, suggesting a historic burial ground.

On the right side of the image, a large, pale stone grave marker stands prominently in the foreground. It has an arched top with decorative side elements and a broad rectangular body covered in faded writing. Nearby, several smaller headstones lean forward among the ivy and grass. In the middle distance, more gravestones rise from the greenery, some almost swallowed by the surrounding foliage.

The ground is uneven and thickly covered with ivy, grasses, and fallen leaves. In the background, more gravestones are visible on a slight slope, partly obscured by vines and shrubs. The overall mood is quiet, old, and slightly melancholic, with nature reclaiming the cemetery and soft daylight filtering through the trees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示被自然环境包围的墓地的照片。照片中，多块石制墓碑和墓穴散布在覆盖着绿色植被的地面上，其中一些墓碑上刻有文字。墓地被树木和藤蔓植物所环绕，营造出一种宁静而古老的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide rural farming scene under a bright blue sky filled with large, soft white clouds. Most of the frame is dominated by the expansive sky, giving the scene an open, spacious feeling.

Along the bottom portion of the image is a freshly worked agricultural field with dark brown, uneven soil. A large green John Deere tractor with yellow wheels is positioned on the right side, moving across the field from right to left. It has oversized black tires with deep treads, a tall enclosed cab, and a powerful front hood. A driver can be faintly seen inside the cab.

Attached behind the tractor is a large green-and-yellow agricultural implement, likely a seed drill or planting/seeding machine. It includes a central yellow hopper or tank with John Deere logos and a wide set of metal arms, hoses, wheels, and discs extending behind it. The equipment is stirring up a low cloud of dust as it moves over the dry soil.

In the background, a line of leafless or early-spring trees stretches along the left side of the horizon, with more distant greenery and low hills or a settlement faintly visible on the far right. The overall scene conveys active field preparation or planting on a clear, breezy day in a rural landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示农业活动的现实主义风格照片，其中一辆绿色的拖拉机正在一片开阔的土地上进行耕作。拖拉机前部装有一个黄色的圆柱形装置，可能用于播种或施肥。拖拉机后方尘土飞扬，显示出其在土地上的移动速度。背景中可以看到几棵树木和蓝天白云，天空中有散布的云朵，为这个农事场景增添了宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of grilled seafood—likely squid or cuttlefish—spread across a metal wire rack over charcoal. The seafood pieces are reddish-brown and glossy, with visible charred edges and grill marks. Some pieces are curled into loops or tentacle-like shapes, and several are tied together with thin strands, suggesting they may have been bundled before grilling. The texture looks chewy and slightly caramelized, with a seasoned, smoky appearance.

In the background, out of focus, there is a person standing behind the grill. They are wearing a deep blue or purple wide-brimmed hat and a matching blue/purple long-sleeved checkered shirt. One hand is raised near their chest, and a ring is visible on one finger. The person’s face is blurred and indistinct due to the shallow depth of field.

The setting appears to be an outdoor market or food stall. A turquoise canopy or tent roof covers the area, and behind the person are bright, colorful structures—possibly vendor counters or display cases—with blue, red, and white tones. The overall image has warm lighting in the foreground from the grilled food, contrasted with cooler turquoise and blue tones in the background. The focus is strongly on the grilled seafood, while the vendor and surroundings remain soft and blurry, giving the scene a lively street-food atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影技巧-街头摄影风格的照片，展示了一个穿着蓝色衬衫和帽子的人站在户外摊位前。人物的面部被模糊处理，无法辨认其身份。在前景中，有一堆晒干的鱼片整齐地摆放在金属网格上，颜色呈深褐色，表面略带焦黄色。背景虽然模糊，但可以隐约看到一些蓝色和白色的物体，可能是其他摊位或市场的一部分。

caption:
The image is a black-and-white, tightly framed view of a crowded marina filled with sailboats and catamarans moored close together. The scene is visually dense, dominated by overlapping masts, rigging lines, railings, ropes, booms, fenders, and hulls.

In the foreground, a large catamaran occupies most of the lower half of the image. Its twin bows are visible, with a broad central deck and a cabin with dark, tinted wraparound windows. The name **“IMAGINE”** is clearly written on the starboard hull near the front, and the brand name **Broadblue** appears toward the right side. Several cylindrical fenders hang along the hull, and mooring lines stretch diagonally from the boat to the dock and surrounding fixtures. The catamaran’s rigging and mast rise upward through the center-left of the frame, adding to the vertical pattern of lines.

Behind and around it are many other yachts packed into slips. Some boats have sails furled tightly around their booms or masts, while others have canvas covers over cockpits and equipment. A stern on the left reads **“Kelebek London”**, and another boat to the right shows partial markings including **“Oceanis”**. The boats overlap so closely that their decks, railings, lifebuoys, winches, ladders, and ropes blend into a complex nautical texture.

A wooden dock or pier runs horizontally through the midground, with mooring numbers visible, including **39** and **23**. White-topped marina posts and bollards appear near the waterline. The water is calm, with soft reflections of hulls, dock edges, and vertical posts visible near the bottom of the image.

The background is filled with more boats and masts, creating a forest of thin vertical and diagonal lines. The monochrome treatment emphasizes contrast, shapes, and patterns rather than color, giving the marina a layered, almost abstract quality. The overall impression is of a busy, well-used harbor packed with leisure sailing vessels, ropes, and equipment in a quiet, still moment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的图像，展示了一个繁忙的码头场景。图中主要显示了一艘双体帆船，其特征是两个并排的船体和一个明显的船名'MARIA'。帆船停泊在码头上，周围散布着其他各式各样的船只，包括帆船、游艇和其他小型船舶。这些船只通过它们的桅杆和绳索紧密相连，构成了一个充满活力的海上生活画面。

caption:
The image shows a bright outdoor courtyard in front of an ornate Islamic-style monument, likely a mausoleum or historic religious complex. The scene is sunlit under a clear blue sky, giving the white stone building and pale paving a crisp, bright appearance.

In the foreground are two tall, weathered cylindrical stone columns. They are made of stacked circular stone sections, with rough, textured surfaces and worn capitals at the top. One column stands near the center-left and the other dominates the right side of the frame, partially blocking the view of the building behind it. Their age and roughness contrast with the polished, decorative architecture in the background.

Between the columns, a person stands in the courtyard wearing a long, hooded robe with bold vertical stripes in dark magenta, black, and purple tones. They are looking downward at something in their hands, possibly a phone. Their figure adds a strong vertical accent and a vivid color contrast against the pale stone surroundings.

The main building in the background is white or light cream stone with elaborate carved ornamentation. Its facade features intricate geometric and floral patterns typical of Moroccan or Islamic architecture. Several large arched openings are visible, with scalloped or horseshoe-shaped arch details. The wall surfaces are richly decorated with repeating lattice-like reliefs and carved borders. Near the top is a band of ornamental carving and a small rectangular panel that appears to contain Arabic calligraphy.

The roof is a steep, pyramidal green-tiled structure, made of small glossy tiles arranged in a regular pattern. At the peak is a decorative finial with stacked spherical elements, giving the roof a ceremonial appearance. Along the roofline and upper walls are crenellated details, adding a fortress-like silhouette.

A broad staircase on the right leads up toward the building, where several visitors are walking or standing. White railings border the steps and terraces. Decorative black streetlamps with multiple lanterns appear near the stairs, and a few palm trees are visible in the distance on the right, reinforcing the warm, North African setting.

In the lower left, there is a richly decorated wall section with mosaic tilework and arched niches, including circular and geometric patterns in blue, gold, and white. The courtyard paving is made of large rectangular stone slabs, and shadows from the columns and people stretch across the ground, indicating strong midday or afternoon sunlight.

Overall, the image captures a historic monumental site with a mix of ancient stone columns, refined Islamic ornamentation, green-tiled roofing, and visitors moving through a spacious ceremonial plaza.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中东或北非风格建筑的照片。在画面中，一座装饰华丽的白色建筑物占据了中心位置，其特点是具有几何图案和拱形入口的设计。建筑物前有两个巨大的石柱，其中一个柱子顶部有类似装饰性的结构。在建筑物前方的广场上，一位穿着传统服饰的人正在行走，而其他几位游客则在建筑物周围活动。背景中的蓝天和几棵棕榈树为这个场景增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a dense urban streetscape viewed from ground level, looking sharply upward between tall buildings. The composition emphasizes vertical height and perspective, with skyscrapers rising along both sides of the frame and a pale, overcast sky filling the open space in the middle.

On the left, a very tall modern residential tower dominates the scene. It has a blue-tinted glass façade with many stacked balconies projecting outward in regular horizontal layers. The balconies have glass or translucent railings, giving the building a sleek, contemporary look. The tower’s façade alternates between reflective glass panels and darker structural bands, and near the top there is a darker mechanical or rooftop section with railings and protruding antenna-like elements. The building narrows visually as it rises, accentuated by the low-angle perspective.

In the center background, more high-rises are visible, packed closely together. Some are dark, narrow towers with grid-like window patterns, while others have curved glass surfaces and lighter-colored balcony structures. A prominent cluster of towers on the right-center includes white, gray, and dark façade elements, with multiple balconies and rooftop mechanical structures. One rounded glass building has a small red marking or logo visible on its side.

On the far right, a brown or tan mid- to high-rise building runs diagonally along the edge of the frame. It has a more traditional rectangular window pattern compared with the glassier towers, with evenly spaced windows set into a warm-toned façade. A dark horizontal structure or overhang cuts across the upper right portion of the image, adding a strong diagonal line.

At the bottom edges, there are hints of street-level greenery: leafy tree branches appear on the lower left and lower right, softening the otherwise hard architectural scene. In the lower left corner, part of an older-looking building with a darker roof and dormer-style windows is visible, contrasting with the surrounding modern towers.

The overall mood is cool and urban, with muted colors—gray sky, blue glass, white and black building accents, and subdued brown tones. The upward angle and tight spacing between buildings create a canyon-like feeling, emphasizing the scale and density of the city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市建筑群的照片，画面中心是一座高耸的玻璃幕墙摩天大楼，其旁边是几栋不同高度和设计风格的建筑物。天空呈现出阴沉的灰色调，与建筑物形成对比。

caption:
The image shows a live soccer match being played in a large stadium, with the camera positioned at field level and aimed toward the stands. The scene appears to be from an International Champions Cup match, with teams wearing Tottenham Hotspur’s white-and-navy kits and AS Roma’s dark red/maroon kits with yellow lettering.

In the foreground and lower half of the image, several players are in motion on the grass pitch. A Tottenham player in a white shirt and navy shorts is controlling or challenging for the ball near the right-center of the frame, while a Roma player in maroon is very close to him, stepping in to contest possession. The ball is on the ground near their feet. Another Roma player nearby has one arm raised, possibly signaling or calling for the ball. A Tottenham player with “Alderweireld” and the number 4 on his back is visible on the left, while another Tottenham player with “Dier” and the number 15 stands more centrally with his back to the camera. A Roma player with “Džeko” and number 9 is also visible near the center, facing the play. On the far right foreground, a Roma player with “J. Jesus” and number 5 is partially out of focus, standing with his back to the camera.

A referee in a bright yellow shirt and black shorts is positioned on the right side of the image, watching the action. The players’ movement and body language suggest an active midfield or attacking-phase challenge, with both teams converging around the ball.

Behind the players, bright turquoise LED advertising boards run along the edge of the pitch. The boards display “Visit Orlando” in large white text. Above them, there are additional banners and signage, including an International Champions Cup logo and a red-and-white banner partially reading “...SPURS.” In the upper right area, a large stadium sign reads “NEW YORK Red Bulls,” indicating the venue is associated with the New York Red Bulls.

The background is filled with spectators seated in blue stadium seats. Many fans are wearing soccer jerseys, including Tottenham shirts, Roma colors, and other club shirts. The crowd is slightly blurred compared with the players, emphasizing the action on the field. Metal railings, stairways, and stadium seating structures are visible, adding to the sense of a professional venue under stadium lighting. Overall, it captures a competitive moment during a high-profile soccer match, with the crowd closely watching the play unfold.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张体育摄影风格的照片，捕捉了一场足球比赛的精彩瞬间。在照片中，一名身穿白色球衣和黑色短裤的球员正准备用脚控球，而另一名穿着红色球衣和黄色短裤的球员则似乎在防守。场边站着两名裁判员，他们穿着统一的制服并专注地观察着比赛。观众席上的人群密集，他们的注意力都集中在球场上的动作上。背景中的广告牌显示了赞助商的名字，如'New York Red Bulls'和'Visit New York City'，为场景增添了商业氛围。

caption:
The image shows a colorful autumn-themed garden display set up like a rustic harvest scene.

In the center, there is a small wooden stage or platform beneath a slanted wooden roof made of brown planks. Under the roof are two large white silhouette cutouts of a dancing couple. The figure on the left appears to be a woman wearing a hat and skirt, standing with one hand on her hip. The figure on the right appears to be a man in a hat, leaning forward and holding his hand near his face as if playing music or bowing in a folk-dance pose. The cutouts are simple, flat, and bright white, standing out strongly against the warm wood and colorful flowers.

Around the stage are many autumn decorations: rectangular hay bales, baskets, and clusters of chrysanthemums in rich fall colors. The flowers are mostly deep burgundy, red, yellow, cream, orange, and pale green, arranged in dense rounded mounds. In the foreground, the flower beds are especially lush, forming curved bands and clusters that fill the lower half of the image. There is also a silvery-blue leafy plant border along the left side, adding contrast to the warmer flower colors.

On the right side of the stage, a vertical wooden post is decorated with hanging dried corn cobs, corn husks, rope, and a straw hat. More baskets of flowers sit nearby, including orange and yellow blooms. Thick ropes are draped across the display and along the front edge, enhancing the rustic country-fair feeling.

Behind the stage, there are trees and greenery, with some foliage turning autumnal shades of brown and gold. A low stone wall is visible in the background. Overall, the scene feels like a festive harvest or fall flower exhibition, combining folk-dance silhouettes, wooden structures, hay, corn, baskets, and abundant chrysanthemums in a warm seasonal display.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日装饰的摄影作品，画面中心是两个巨大的白色剪影人物雕塑，一个戴着帽子，另一个穿着牛仔装。他们被放置在一个由木头搭建的结构上，周围摆放着丰富的花卉和秋季植物。前景主要是五颜六色的菊花，颜色从深红到浅黄不等，营造出一种温暖而庆祝的氛围。背景中可以看到一些黄色的玉米棒子和绿色的叶子，为场景增添了丰收的感觉。

caption:
The image shows the rear view of a white Honda Accord sedan parked on a snowy, icy residential street. The car is centered in the frame and photographed from slightly above trunk height, emphasizing the rear windshield, trunk lid, taillights, bumper, and dual exhaust pipes.

The car has a glossy white finish with darkly tinted rear glass. The Honda emblem is mounted in the middle of the trunk, with the “Accord” badge on the lower left side. The license plate area is blurred. The taillights are large and red with clear sections, wrapping slightly around the sides of the vehicle. Along the lower bumper are small circular parking sensors, and at the bottom there are two round chrome-trimmed exhaust outlets, one on each side.

The setting appears to be a winter urban courtyard or apartment-block street. Snowbanks line both sides of the road, and the ground is covered with packed snow, slush, and icy patches. On the right side of the image is a red brick residential building with windows and a raised entrance area. In the background, the scene is softly out of focus: another white car is parked directly ahead, other vehicles are visible farther back, and a person wearing a bright red jacket stands or walks near the buildings. The shallow depth of field keeps the Honda sharply prominent while the background appears blurred and bright.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆白色Honda Accord轿车停在雪地上的照片。车辆的后部清晰可见，包括尾灯、排气管和车标。背景中可以看到部分被积雪覆盖的道路和一些建筑物，但它们模糊且不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a small classroom during a lesson or presentation. The room has pale mint-green walls, a light-colored ceiling, and a tiled floor. Students are seated at rows of light wood desks with bright green plastic chairs, facing the front of the room.

At the front, a large white projection screen is pulled down. A slide is projected onto it, though it appears faint because of the room lighting. The slide is in French and appears to be about **“Les pronoms démonstratifs”** (“demonstrative pronouns”), with a table showing masculine and feminine forms such as *celui*, *celle*, *ceux*, and *celles*. There are also example sentences below the table.

A person seated at the teacher’s desk near the screen has a laptop open in front of them, along with papers and other teaching materials. To the right of the screen, another person stands near a door, wearing a white polo shirt with blue trim, possibly speaking or presenting to the class.

Most of the students appear to be young adults. Many are viewed from behind or in profile, sitting attentively and looking toward the front. Some have notebooks open on their desks, and one student near the left has a small water bottle. The students’ faces are blurred, but their posture suggests they are listening to the lesson.

The classroom has several visible fixtures: an air-conditioning unit mounted high on the left wall, a fluorescent light above the projection screen, a green chalkboard or notice board set into a wooden-framed door on the right, and a blank tan notice board mounted high on the wall. Overall, the scene looks like a language class or training session taking place in a compact, brightly lit classroom.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教育活动的摄影照片，一位男性讲师站在教室前方，面向一群坐在绿色椅子上的学生。他面前的投影屏幕显示着课程内容和时间表。教室内部装饰简洁，墙壁上贴有几幅画作，房间内安装了空调。学生们专注地听着讲师讲课，一些人正使用笔记本电脑。

caption:
The image shows a sunny urban street scene dominated by a small white minibus or shuttle bus parked or moving along the road. The bus fills most of the lower half of the frame and is viewed from the side, slightly angled so its front is toward the left and rear toward the right.

The bus has large dark-tinted windows and a white roof with a raised rooftop unit, likely air conditioning. Along the lower side of the bus is a colorful advertising wrap for a street food market. The ad includes large Thai text, Chinese characters, and some English phrases such as “one Street Food Market,” “50 famous ‘Street Food’,” and “Live band and drinks.” The artwork features food imagery: vegetables, bowls of food, rice or dessert, mango-like cubes, purple flowers, and brown eggs on the rear section. There are also small signs inside or on the window with Chinese text and Thai place names.

Behind the bus is a low-rise building with a pale cream or yellow facade and a light greenish metal roof. Part of the building has large windows and an entrance area. Numerous black electrical and communication wires run horizontally across the scene, creating a dense web overhead. Several utility poles and a streetlight are visible, emphasizing the busy roadside environment.

On the left edge of the image, a yellow-and-blue vehicle, likely a taxi, is partially visible, along with several parked motorcycles or scooters lined up near the curb. On the right side in the distance, there are more motorcycles and a few people near another building. The road surface is wide and sunlit, with strong shadows under the bus.

The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, suggesting midday or early afternoon in a hot, sunny city. The overall setting appears to be in Thailand or a Thai-speaking area, given the Thai script on the bus and the style of the street scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在城市街道上的公交车的照片。公交车的侧面和后部被用于广告，宣传着'one band and drinks'的产品和服务。车辆停靠在一个有建筑物、电线杆和路标的城市环境中，周围环境看起来像是一个日常的商业区。

caption:
The image shows a close-up side view of an old black steam locomotive, focusing on the cab and boiler area.

Most of the frame is filled with dark, riveted metal panels painted black. The surface looks rough, slightly glossy, and weathered, with many visible rivets, dents, seams, and uneven patches in the paint. On the right side is the locomotive cab, with a tall rectangular doorway or opening; inside it is very dark, though a cylindrical component can be faintly seen. Several vertical metal handrails and small handles are attached to the cab panels.

Near the center-lower portion of the black side panel is a rectangular red plate or sign, but its text or details are blurred and unreadable. The bottom edge of the locomotive is painted red, forming a horizontal band across the image, with additional rivets and structural metal visible beneath.

On the left side, part of the rounded boiler is visible, curving outward and painted black. A smokestack or chimney rises near the upper left edge, partially cut off by the frame. A small circular window with a light-colored rim appears near the upper left-center area of the cab/boiler section.

The background is mostly out of focus and partly obscured by the locomotive. A pale blue sky is visible at the top, and on the far right there is a glimpse of a building with windows and a reddish roofline. The lighting suggests daylight, with sunlight reflecting off the glossy black paint and casting shadows across the metal surfaces. Overall, the image emphasizes the heavy industrial texture and construction of a vintage steam engine.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示蒸汽火车机车部分的特写照片。图像中，黑色的机车外壳上覆盖着锈迹和磨损痕迹，显示出它的历史使用情况。机车的侧面有一个红色的矩形警告标志，上面写着'CAUTION'字样，提醒人们注意安全。在机车的前部，可以看到一个圆形的通风口，以及连接到机车顶部的管道。整体而言，这张图片捕捉了蒸汽火车的工业美学和历史价值。

caption:
The image shows a broad, tree-lined urban street in daylight, viewed from behind as if from a vehicle or another rider following traffic.

In the foreground, centered slightly left, a man is pedaling a three-wheeled cycle rickshaw or pedicab. He is seen from behind, wearing a black cap, a short-sleeved shirt with gray and white panels, light beige pants, and dark footwear. His hands rest on the handlebars as he rides. The rickshaw has a large rear passenger carriage with a white frame, red wheels, and a purple canopy or fabric cover visible over the seat area.

Ahead and to the right of him, several motorcyclists and scooters move along the road. One prominent rider near the center-right wears a red outfit and a red helmet while riding a black scooter. Farther ahead are more scooters, a white car, and other vehicles traveling in the same direction. The road is wide and mostly clear, with traffic spread out rather than congested.

The street is lush with greenery. Large trees with thick trunks and dense canopies line the left side, casting shade over the sidewalk and part of the road. Their trunks have markings or bands near the lower sections. On the right side, there is a landscaped median or sidewalk area with trimmed shrubs, small plants, and decorative black streetlamps with curved arms. The curb on the right is painted in alternating blue and white stripes.

On the left edge of the image, partially hidden by trees, there is a bright yellow-orange wall or gate. The sidewalk beside it appears quiet, with a few posts and chains along the edge. The road surface is gray asphalt, with soft shadows from the trees. In the distance, the street continues under more greenery, with a traffic sign and additional lampposts visible.

Overall, the scene feels like a calm, leafy city avenue in a warm climate, with a mix of traditional pedal-powered transport and modern motorbikes sharing the road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的照片，画面中心是一位骑着三轮车的男性，他穿着白色和灰色相间的衣服，戴着黑色帽子。在他的后方，可以看到一辆红色摩托车和几辆汽车在道路上行驶。街道两旁有茂密的树木和一些低矮的建筑物。

caption:
The image shows a spacious, modern interior atrium or lobby with a dramatic architectural design. The space is dominated by tall gray stone or concrete-clad walls, large white structural beams, and extensive glass elements that allow bright daylight to filter in.

In the foreground, a curved upper-level walkway sweeps from the lower left toward the center-right. It has transparent glass panels and polished metal handrails that reflect the light. The floor is made of large, smooth, beige stone tiles, giving the area a clean, refined appearance.

On the right side, a wide curved staircase descends to a lower level. The staircase has dark steps and a rounded wall, with a shiny chrome handrail following its curve. At the base of the stairs, there is a potted plant or small tree, adding a bit of greenery to the otherwise stone-and-metal setting.

Near the center of the image stands a tall white column supporting a large abstract hanging sculpture. The sculpture is made of geometric shapes—curved arcs, flat panels, cubes, and triangular forms—in white, black, gray, yellow, red, and dark blue. It appears suspended or mounted high above the walkway and has a playful, modernist style, contrasting with the rigid architecture around it.

The background includes tall vertical windows with grid-like framing, especially on the right, bringing in strong natural light. There are also slanted skylight-like window structures behind the sculpture, adding depth and brightness. Warm wall-mounted lights with golden curved covers appear along the gray walls, creating small pools of warm illumination against the cool stone surfaces.

Overall, the scene feels like an upscale public building—possibly a museum, hotel, corporate lobby, or cultural center—with a grand, airy atmosphere and a strong emphasis on curves, geometric forms, and modern design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑内部的摄影作品，图像中心是一个优雅的曲线楼梯，其金属扶手和台阶在光滑的大理石地板上形成鲜明对比。楼梯上方悬挂着一系列抽象艺术作品，它们以几何形状和色彩块为特点，为空间增添了活力和视觉兴趣。两侧的墙壁由灰色石材构成，与白色窗框形成对比，透过窗户可以看到外面的光线。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种宁静而高端的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively street parade or cultural festival performance taking place on a broad paved road. In the foreground, a line of dancers is moving in formation from left to right. They appear to be wearing traditional-style costumes: black long-sleeved tops, deep burgundy wrap skirts, black flat shoes, and brightly colored woven sashes across their chests in red, orange, pink, and gold patterns. Many of them also wear silver-toned necklaces or chest ornaments, decorative belts with hanging metal elements, and red headpieces or ribbons in their hair.

Each dancer carries a large folded parasol or fan-like umbrella hanging at the front of the body, with wooden ribs and painted decorative patterns. Their arms are extended gracefully, palms turned outward or downward, suggesting a choreographed traditional dance. Several dancers are captured mid-step with one foot lifted, giving the scene a strong sense of movement and rhythm. Their faces are blurred, but their body language appears poised and coordinated.

Behind the dancers, a large crowd of spectators fills tiered seating along the roadside. Many audience members wear colorful hats, especially bright green and orange ones, and some hold umbrellas or cameras. Above the seating are dark blue canopy awnings stretched in a row, providing shade. Long banners with Thai writing and advertisements hang along the stands; one visible brand name is “Electrolux,” and another banner includes “instax,” suggesting sponsorship or festival promotion.

The background is dense with green trees, making the parade route feel shaded and tropical. Overhead utility wires run diagonally across the sky, and there are tall poles, streetlights, and a metal lighting rig near the center-left. Large framed portraits or ceremonial images are mounted high above the crowd on the right side, partially visible behind the canopies. The sky is overcast, with soft gray clouds diffusing the light.

Overall, the scene is vibrant and festive, combining traditional dance, ornate textiles, a large public audience, and the atmosphere of an organized cultural procession or celebration.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统舞蹈表演的摄影照片，几位身着红色和黑色服装的舞者在街道上进行表演。他们头戴装饰性的头饰，手持鼓和其他打击乐器，随着音乐节奏跳舞。观众们站在路边观看，有的坐在折叠椅上，有的站着。背景中可以看到一些摊位和悬挂的横幅，表明这是一个公共活动或节日庆典。

caption:
The image shows a quiet temple courtyard viewed from inside a richly carved wooden doorway or pavilion. In the exact center foreground hangs a large bronze or brass bell, suspended from a heavy metal chain and ring. The bell is dark, aged, and slightly reflective, with a wide flared rim and a small hanging clapper or finial beneath it. Around its upper band there appears to be decorative script or inscription.

On both the left and right edges of the frame are ornate wooden pillars or door frames. They are deeply carved with traditional patterns—floral motifs, rounded bead-like bands, layered moldings, and intricate relief work. The warm brown wood catches golden light, especially on the right side, emphasizing the texture and craftsmanship. These carved structures create a symmetrical frame around the bell and the courtyard beyond.

Beyond the bell is an open brick-paved courtyard laid in geometric patterns. The ground is made of reddish and pale bricks arranged in rectangular and herringbone-like designs. Near the lower right of the bell, a small round bowl or vessel sits on the ground, possibly used for offerings.

In the middle background stands a small shrine or ceremonial structure with a decorative, tiered top. It has a gilded or weathered metallic appearance, with a lotus-like base and a pointed finial. It sits on a raised stone platform, slightly left of center behind the hanging bell.

The far side of the courtyard is lined by an old brick building with dark wooden doors, arched openings, and carved supports beneath a long sloping tiled roof. The roof is covered in small reddish-brown tiles and stretches horizontally across the image. The façade has a weathered, historic appearance, with faded brick, shadowed alcoves, and ornamental wooden brackets.

The lighting is warm and low, suggesting early morning or late afternoon. The bell is mostly in shadow, appearing as a dark silhouette against the brighter courtyard, while the carved doorway glows softly at the sides. The overall mood is serene, sacred, and historic, with a strong sense of traditional craftsmanship and stillness.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示佛教文化元素的摄影图像，前景中有一个大型的铜质钟悬挂在两个装饰性的木制柱子之间。钟体表面有精细的雕刻和装饰，显得庄严而古老。在钟的后方，可以看到一个带有传统图案的石制宝塔，其上覆盖着一层薄薄的灰泥。整个场景被拍摄在一个宽敞的庭院内，庭院地面铺满了鹅卵石，周围环绕着其他类似的建筑结构，营造出一种宁静祥和的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a supermarket aisle shelf stocked with boxed UHT milk and flavored milk products. The shelves are tightly packed and arranged in neat rows, with multiple brands and varieties displayed side by side.

On the left side are **Goodday** cartons, mostly **chocolate flavoured milk**, with a light blue top, green pasture imagery, and a chocolate splash graphic on the lower half. Some yellow promotional price tags are visible below these cartons.

The central section is dominated by **Fernleaf** milk cartons. These are arranged in repeated blocks across several shelves. The packaging is mostly yellow at the top with the Fernleaf logo, and the cartons vary by type:
- **Full Cream** cartons in blue-and-white packaging, showing milk being poured over a green pasture scene with cows.
- **Low Fat** cartons with lighter blue packaging.
- **Chocolate** cartons with brown chocolate splash graphics.

To the right of the Fernleaf section are **Enrico’s Full Cream Milk** cartons. These are white with green accents, a large green milk splash design, and a black-and-white cow illustration near the bottom.

Further right are **Anlene** milk cartons. These have a white-and-green design for plain milk varieties, with text and graphics suggesting nutrients like protein, collagen, vitamin C, and calcium. Some Anlene cartons are chocolate-flavored, shown with brown chocolate imagery and chocolate pieces near the top.

There are several horizontal shelves visible, each with orange or yellow price labels attached to the front edge. The labels include product names, barcodes, and prices, though most small text is difficult to read. The products appear to be mostly 1-liter cartons. The overall scene is well-lit, orderly, and typical of a grocery store dairy or long-life milk section.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示超市货架上各种牛奶包装的照片。货架上整齐地排列着多种品牌的牛奶，包括Ferndale、Goodday和Anlene等品牌。每种牛奶都有其独特的包装设计，有的是白色的纸盒，上面印有牛奶的图片和品牌名称；有的则是绿色和棕色的塑料瓶装，同样带有品牌标志。这些牛奶被放置在货架的不同层面上，以便顾客能够轻松找到他们想要的产品。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of an elegant European city street or square at golden hour, shortly after rain. The pavement is wet and glossy, reflecting the warm sunlight, buildings, vehicles, and streetlights.

On the right side dominates a grand cream-colored building with classical architecture. It has ornate horizontal stonework, tall windows, decorative cornices, small wrought-iron balconies with flower boxes, and many black fabric awnings. The upper floors have a gray mansard-style roof with arched dormer windows, and a large rounded dome-like corner tower rises above the building. The warm sunlight hits this façade strongly, giving it a golden glow. Several black awnings near the entrance display the name “Hotel de Paris,” suggesting the building is a luxury hotel. Red patio umbrellas line the sidewalk in front, likely covering an outdoor café or restaurant area.

In front of the hotel are parked vehicles, including a dark car and a silver van, also reflecting the sunlight. Decorative street lamps and small metal barriers stand along the curb. A few flags hang near the hotel entrance, adding color to the lower right area of the scene.

The street slopes or curves gently into the distance on the far right, where the hotel façade continues with repeating windows, balconies, and awnings. The wet stone roadway creates mirror-like reflections of the red umbrellas and golden building lights.

On the left side, the scene opens into a broader square. There are older ornate buildings in pastel colors, including a pink and white building with decorative trim and a pale cream building beside it. A monument or statue stands in the middle distance, framed by the surrounding architecture. A leafy green tree adds a natural accent near the left edge. Traditional black street lamps and a parking sign are visible in the foreground.

The sky is large and clear, taking up much of the upper half of the image. It is a soft blue with faint wisps of cloud, creating a calm atmosphere. The overall mood is elegant, quiet, and refined, with warm evening light enhancing the historic architecture and the rain-washed street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影图像，捕捉了一座具有古典建筑风格的建筑物在阳光下的宁静景象。建筑物位于画面中央，其立面装饰精美，窗户排列整齐，屋顶呈圆顶状，显得十分优雅。街道上反射着阳光的水坑和停放的车辆增添了生活气息。背景中可以看到其他几栋建筑，而天空呈现出清澈的蓝色，没有云彩。

caption:
The image shows a bright, modern bedroom with an open ensuite and wardrobe area.
