A large bed dominates the foreground and left-center of the room. It is dressed in a pale blue and white patterned quilt with several matching pillows in soft blue, white, and patterned fabrics. A teal-blue throw blanket is folded over the foot of the bed. In front of the bed is a large, plush, light-blue shag rug that adds softness to the space.

To the left of the bed is a dark wooden bedside table with two drawers and small silver handles. On top sits a cream-colored table lamp with a stacked oval base and a fabric shade, giving off warm light. There are also a couple of framed family photos and a small object on the tabletop. Behind this area is a tall window covered by a white roller blind, keeping the room bright but diffused.

Above the bed, mounted on the wall, is a white split-system air conditioner. Beneath it hangs a rectangular abstract artwork in black, white, gray, and beige tones, adding a contemporary accent to the otherwise soft and neutral room.

On the right side of the image is the ensuite bathroom area, partially integrated into the bedroom. A freestanding white bathtub sits against a wall clad in light beige vertical-textured tiles. Above the tub is a modern circular pendant light made of glowing ring shapes suspended by thin wires. The tiled wall includes a horizontal recessed niche with warm underlighting, holding a few decorative or toiletry items. A chrome wall-mounted faucet is positioned above the tub.

Beyond the bathroom wall, on the far right, is an open wardrobe or closet area. It has shelving and drawers in a light wood finish. The shelves contain bags, boxes, folded items, and storage baskets. Some tall mirror or glass-fronted wardrobe panels are visible along the side.

The room has polished dark timber flooring, white walls, and a white ceiling with recessed downlights. The overall style is clean, contemporary, and cozy, with a calming color palette of white, pale blue, beige, and dark wood tones.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代风格卧室的照片。卧室内有一张大床，铺有蓝色和白色图案的床单和枕头，床头有一个黑色边桌，上面放着一个台灯。床对面是一个白色的浴缸，旁边是带有玻璃门的淋浴间。房间的一侧是一个衣柜，其内部装满了衣物。整个房间以木质地板为基调，墙壁上挂着一幅抽象艺术画作，而天花板上安装了一个现代风格的吊灯。

caption:
The image shows a city street filled with a line of vehicles, many of them pickup trucks and SUVs, moving through or waiting in traffic. Several vehicles have large American flags mounted on them, creating the impression of a flag convoy or street demonstration.

In the foreground on the right, a dark SUV is very close to the camera, partially cropped, with reflections of nearby buildings visible along its glossy side. Just behind it is a black pickup truck or SUV with a large American flag attached near the rear. In the center lane, a blue Chevrolet pickup truck faces the camera with its headlights on and a yellow license plate. Behind and around it are more vehicles, including a gray sedan and other trucks, some also displaying flags.

On the left side of the street, a gray Ford pickup truck is prominent, also flying an American flag from its front area. More cars stretch into the background, suggesting a slow-moving procession or heavy traffic. The road has multiple lanes, white lane markings, and a crosswalk or stop line visible near the bottom of the image.

A notable feature near the center-right is a tall blue flag mounted on a pole, with red and white lettering partially visible; it appears to be a political or campaign-style flag. Several American flags are waving throughout the scene, their red, white, and blue colors standing out against the muted gray surroundings.

The setting appears to be downtown or in a civic/business district. On the right side, there is a large stone building with tall, classical columns and ornate architectural details, resembling a courthouse or government building. Behind the vehicles are modern office buildings with glass and metal facades. Farther left, leafless trees and older buildings are visible, suggesting a cool season or early spring. The sky is overcast, giving the image a subdued, gray tone overall.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道上行驶的车辆的照片，其中几辆汽车的车窗上挂有美国国旗。在照片的背景中，可以看到现代建筑和一些树木。

caption:
The image shows a large white Volvo FH tanker truck parked or moving slowly along a roadside in daylight. The truck occupies most of the frame, viewed from the front-left side, with the cab on the left and the long cylindrical tank trailer extending to the right.

The cab is white with black trim around the windshield, grille, and front fascia. The Volvo logo is visible on the front, and “FH” and “440” markings can be seen on the cab area. The front license plate is yellow but blurred. There is Thai writing printed on the driver-side door, suggesting the truck is operated by a Thai company or authority. The windshield is darkly tinted, reflecting nearby power lines.

Behind the cab is a large tanker trailer painted mainly white with green lower and upper sections. A red stripe and a thin yellow stripe run horizontally along the side of the tank. Large red lettering on the tank begins with “NAKRON…” and more Thai text appears along the green band near the top. A metal ladder and safety railing are visible near the front of the tanker, indicating access to the top of the tank. The rear portion of the trailer shows multiple wheels, mudguards, and red-and-white reflective safety markings.

The background includes a utility pole with brown ceramic insulators and many overhead power lines stretching diagonally across the sky. A streetlight extends in from the upper right. On the left side, leafless tree branches with a few reddish leaves frame the scene. The sky is pale and hazy, giving the image a warm, dry roadside atmosphere. The ground in the foreground looks dusty or unpaved, with a curb and roadside vegetation visible behind the truck.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆大型白色油罐卡车的摄影图像。卡车停靠在一个有电线杆和路灯的城市环境中，车身侧面印有'NAKONSHA'字样，表明它可能属于某个特定的公司或品牌。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a large red roadside sign mounted on a metal pole, set against a dense background of bright green leafy trees.

The sign is rectangular with slightly rounded corners and a thin white border running near its edges. Its surface is vivid red, and it contains large, bold, uppercase white lettering in Polish. The text reads:

**“STREFA  
NADGRANICZNA”**

This translates to **“Border Zone”** or **“Border Area.”** The word “STREFA” appears centered on the upper line, while “NADGRANICZNA” is much larger and stretches across the lower portion of the sign.

Below the main sign, attached to the same post, there is a smaller, weathered rectangular metal plate with raised yellowish numbers reading **“088.”** The plate looks rusty and aged compared with the bright main sign.

The background is filled entirely with lush green foliage, suggesting the sign is located outdoors, possibly near a rural road or border-region entrance. The image is brightly lit, with strong contrast between the red sign and the surrounding greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示红色交通标志牌的照片，上面用白色字体写着'STREFA NADGRANICZNA'。标志牌的背景是绿色的树叶，而标志牌下方是一个棕色的金属支架和一个数字088的标牌。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of an arid desert badlands landscape filled with tall columnar cacti and deeply eroded earth formations.

In the foreground on the left, several tall green cacti dominate the scene. They are upright, ribbed, and covered with small spines, with multiple vertical arms clustered together. Some of the cactus columns are very tall, reaching high into the frame, while smaller cacti and desert shrubs grow around their base. The foreground ground is dry, sandy, and cracked, with patches of sparse green vegetation clinging to the edges of the eroded soil.

Across the middle and lower portions of the image, the terrain is highly sculpted by erosion. The earth is a warm ochre-brown color, forming a maze of ridges, gullies, ravines, and rounded mounds. The surface looks dry and crumbly, with narrow channels carved through it by water runoff. These badland formations stretch far into the distance, creating a textured, almost labyrinth-like pattern.

Scattered throughout the landscape are more cacti, many of them standing upright like dark green spires among the brown hills. Low shrubs and small trees appear in pockets where vegetation has managed to grow. The combination of cactus-filled desert and eroded land gives the scene a rugged, semi-arid character.

In the background, the land gradually transitions into greener rolling hills and distant low mountains. The horizon is soft and hazy, with bluish tones suggesting distance. Above the landscape, the sky is bright and mostly overcast, filled with pale white and gray clouds. The lighting is diffuse, with no harsh shadows, suggesting a cloudy day.

Overall, the image captures a dramatic desert environment: towering cacti in the foreground, intricate eroded badlands across the center, and distant green hills beneath a broad cloudy sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示沙漠景观的自然摄影风格图片，前景中有一株高大的仙人掌植物，其周围散布着一些低矮的植被。背景是起伏的沙丘和远处连绵的山脉，天空中有几朵云彩，整体画面呈现出一种荒凉而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit archaeological or historical stone ruin built into a dry, mountainous landscape. The scene is viewed from an elevated position, looking down into a maze of low, rough stone walls made from irregular rocks of different sizes and colors—gray, tan, reddish-brown, and pale beige. The walls form small enclosed rooms or terraces, with open dirt floors and scattered loose stones.

On the far left foreground, a large out-of-focus stone structure or wall dominates the edge of the frame, creating a dark, shaded vertical border. This close stone surface contrasts with the bright, detailed ruins in the middle and right side of the image. The lighting is harsh midday sunlight, producing strong shadows inside the stone enclosures and along the wall edges.

In the lower and central part of the image, the ruins appear partially collapsed, with piles of loose rocks resting on top of the walls and along narrow passages. Some stones have patches of lichen or pale mineral staining, and small tufts of grass and weeds grow between rocks and in cracks. The masonry looks dry-stacked rather than mortared, giving the structures an ancient, rugged appearance.

Near the upper right, a person is sitting on or beside one of the stone walls. They are wearing a broad-brimmed hat, a light blue long-sleeved shirt, and dark pants. Their posture is relaxed, and they appear to be resting while looking toward the ruins or down the slope. Near the center-lower area, another person is partially visible, mostly hidden behind the stone walls; only a light-colored hat and a garment with red and dark stripes can be seen.

Beyond the ruins, the background opens into a steep, arid hillside covered with sparse shrubs, scrubby vegetation, and terraced or naturally banded patches of earth. The terrain is dry and rugged, with muted browns, tans, and olive greens. The hillside rises diagonally across the image, emphasizing the highland setting and the exposed, remote feel of the location.

Overall, the image captures a rocky ruin site in a dry mountainous environment, with human figures providing scale against the rough stonework and expansive hillside.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老石墙和一位坐在其上的人物的自然风光照片。石墙由不规则的石头堆砌而成，颜色以灰色和棕色为主，显示出岁月的痕迹。在石墙的左侧边缘，可以看到部分石制结构的一部分，它的表面粗糙且有磨损。在石墙的右侧，有一位身穿深色衣物的人静静地坐着，似乎在欣赏周围的景色或沉思。背景中是起伏的山丘，覆盖着绿色植被，为这个场景增添了一丝宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a quiet rural or historical setting on a sunny autumn day. At the center is a long, old wooden building made from dark, weathered logs. It has a low, broad green metal roof with several white brick chimneys rising from it. The roof has visible seams running downward, and its muted green color contrasts with the dark brown timber walls. The front façade has a row of tall, narrow windows with aged wooden frames, giving the building a historic, preserved appearance. On the left side there appears to be a small entrance area or porch with a darker overhang.

In front of the building is a neatly trimmed hedge running horizontally across the scene, partially obscuring the lower part of the structure. A narrow path or paved walkway curves along the foreground, separating the hedge from a grassy lawn. The grass is sunlit and slightly uneven, dotted with small fallen leaves, reinforcing the autumn atmosphere.

Behind and around the building are many trees in fall colors. Some trees have golden-yellow leaves, while others are orange, reddish, or still green. Large mature trees rise on the right side, their branches spreading widely and forming a leafy backdrop. The warm sunlight illuminates the foliage and the roof, creating a calm, nostalgic mood.

The sky occupies a large portion of the upper image and is pale blue with no visible clouds, giving the scene an open and peaceful feeling. Near the left-front area of the building there is a small signpost and possibly a person standing in shadow near the entrance, though they are not the focus. Overall, the image feels like a preserved historic wooden house or museum building set in a landscaped park during early or mid-autumn.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示秋季自然风光的照片，画面中心是一座传统的木制建筑，其屋顶覆盖着绿色的瓦片。建筑周围是修剪整齐的草坪和几丛黄色及红色的树木，这些树木的叶子在秋天的颜色中显得格外鲜艳。阳光从画面上方照射下来，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a packaged cooling towel product standing upright against a plain white background.

At the center is a tall, narrow, semi-transparent plastic retail package with a rounded hanging tab at the top. The packaging is mostly white and frosted, allowing the orange towel inside to be visible. The towel appears folded and has a textured, ribbed or waffle-like fabric pattern.

Near the top of the package is the brand logo: a red square with a white owl-like icon, followed by the text “NATURAL SPIRIT” and the brand name “N-rit.” Below that, the product name is printed in large lettering:

- “ICE MATE” in thin black letters  
- “COOL” in very large blue letters  
- “TOWEL” in bold blue letters beneath it  
- “SINGLE” in smaller black text below  

The orange towel fills much of the visible package area behind the text, emphasizing the product color.

Lower on the package, there is small promotional text that reads: “Simply ‘Wet it’ ‘Wring it’ and ‘Snap it’.” Under that are bullet points describing features, including:

- Cooling scientific fabric  
- Long-lasting cooling effect  
- Not chemically treated  
- Machine washable  

At the bottom right of the packaging is a printed photo of a woman demonstrating the towel around her neck; her face appears blurred. Near the lower left is a small blue thermometer-style icon with the words “COOL DOWN.” At the very bottom of the package, the website “www.n-rit.com” is printed.

The overall image is clean, product-focused, and shot in bright lighting with minimal shadows. The package is centered, with a slight perspective angle showing the curved top and front-facing label clearly.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示N-fit品牌冰凉毛巾的包装盒的产品摄影图像。包装盒的设计简洁，以橙色为主色调，并带有蓝色的文字和图案。盒子顶部有一个透明的塑料盖子，下方是白色的背景，突出了产品的视觉效果。

caption:
The image shows a person walking through a grassy field while wearing a full-body ghillie suit, a camouflage outfit designed to blend into natural vegetation.

The suit is covered in many long, ragged strips of fabric in earthy colors—greens, browns, tans, beige, and muted yellow tones. These strips hang loosely over the person’s head, torso, arms, and legs, creating a leafy, grass-like texture that breaks up the outline of the body. The head and face are almost completely obscured by the hooded camouflage, making the person’s identity and facial features impossible to see.

The person appears to be holding a rifle or long firearm with an optic/scope attached. The weapon is carried close to the body, angled forward, with a visible dark barrel, a wooden or brown-toned grip/stock area, and a sling hanging down. One gloved hand is visible near the weapon, and black footwear can be seen at the bottom beneath the camouflage.

The setting is an open outdoor area with tall, uneven green grass covering the ground. The background is softly blurred and consists mostly of more grass and vegetation, reinforcing the natural field environment. The overall scene suggests a military, hunting, airsoft, or camouflage demonstration context, with the person’s ghillie suit blending closely with the surrounding meadow.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一名身穿迷彩服的狙击手在草地上行走的照片。狙击手穿着全身迷彩服，头部被伪装网覆盖，只露出眼睛和部分面部。他右手持有一把狙击步枪，左手佩戴黑色手套。狙击手的姿态显得专注而沉稳，周围是开阔的草地，背景中可见一些绿色植物和远处模糊的树木。

caption:
The image shows an equestrian rider on a bay horse moving across a grassy outdoor course or arena. The horse is captured in motion, likely at a canter or gallop, with its legs extended and its body stretched forward. It has a reddish-brown coat, a dark mane and tail, and is wearing black protective boots on its legs. The tack includes a black bridle, reins, and saddle, with a white quilted saddle pad underneath.

The rider is seated upright in an English riding position, holding the reins with both hands. They are dressed in formal riding attire: a black helmet, black fitted riding jacket, white breeches, and tall black riding boots. The rider’s face is blurred, but their posture appears focused and balanced.

The setting appears to be an outdoor equestrian competition or training area. In the background, there are white railings and course markers, including visible letter signs such as “E” and “M” on the left and a numbered marker “2” on the right. Several tall colored flags—red, green, and blue—stand around the course, adding to the competition-like atmosphere. Behind the arena are trees with light green and yellowish foliage, suggesting a mild autumn or late summer day. The lighting is bright and natural, with soft shadows on the grass. Overall, the image captures a dynamic moment of horse and rider moving confidently through an outdoor riding course.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示马术运动的现实主义风格照片，一位穿着正式骑师服装的人正骑在一匹棕色的马上。骑手身着黑色的上衣和白色的裤子，头戴安全帽，并佩戴着护目镜。他们正在一个户外场地中，背景中有树木、草地和一些模糊的围栏标志。阳光从上方照射下来，为场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a warmly lit, cottage-like restaurant or café at dusk or early night. The sky is a deep, saturated blue with dark cloud shapes overhead, creating a dramatic evening backdrop.

At the center is a charming two-story building painted in a pale gray-green or muted sage color with crisp white trim. It has a steep, dark shingled roof, a prominent white chimney, dormer-like rooflines, and several white-framed windows. A small weather vane sits near the roof peak. The architecture feels cozy and slightly Victorian or country-house inspired, with decorative gables, a circular attic vent, and classic lantern-style wall lights.

The building is glowing with warm yellow-white light from many fixtures. Along the front façade are multiple black lantern sconces, and the windows give off a soft indoor glow. A covered patio or veranda extends across the lower level, supported by white posts and beams. Beneath it, diners are seated at tables, suggesting the place is open and busy. The atmosphere feels relaxed and inviting.

In the foreground are wooden benches and tables, their glossy surfaces reflecting the ambient lights. A railing runs diagonally through the lower left side, guiding the eye toward the restaurant. Several tall white streetlamps with curved necks and round downward-facing shades stand around the scene. Their lights are bright and slightly overexposed, creating glowing halos. Smaller spherical lamps near the front add to the decorative garden-like setting.

On the right side, dense green foliage partially frames the building, with trees and shrubs surrounding the patio area. A white metal garden chair and table set is visible near the right edge. On the left, tall dark trees form silhouettes against the blue sky, adding depth and contrast.

The overall mood is cozy, elegant, and atmospheric—an outdoor dining spot illuminated at night, with a quaint house-like restaurant, warm lights, wooden seating, and lush greenery under a moody evening sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示夜晚户外餐厅的摄影照片。图中的建筑物是一座两层高的传统风格建筑，外墙装饰着白色窗框和门廊。餐厅外有几张木质长椅和桌子，上面摆放着餐具和饮料。餐厅上方悬挂着几盏复古风格的街灯，发出柔和的光线照亮了整个场景。周围的树木在夜幕下显得格外宁静，而天空中散布的云朵为这个场景增添了一丝神秘感。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of a historic stone monument in an outdoor public square, likely the carved marble base of an ancient obelisk. The main focus is a large, pale gray-white stone pedestal covered with detailed relief carvings. The carvings depict rows of human figures, some seated and some standing, arranged in ceremonial or historical scenes. The figures appear worn and softened by age, with many facial and clothing details partially eroded, but the overall composition is still clear.

At the top of the stone base, a large tan-colored obelisk rises upward, only partially visible in the frame. The obelisk has ancient carved markings or hieroglyph-like inscriptions on its surface. It is supported above the pedestal by darker metal or bronze-looking blocks at the corners, which have a weathered greenish patina.

The stone base itself is multi-layered. The upper section has a projecting ledge, beneath which the relief panels wrap around the monument. On the visible corner, the carvings continue across two sides, showing crowded scenes with figures, architectural elements, and decorative patterns. Dark vertical stains run down parts of the marble, emphasizing its age and exposure to weather. Lower sections of the pedestal include additional carved panels and architectural motifs, though some are partly obscured by the angle and foreground railing.

In the foreground and around the monument is a decorative black wrought-iron fence with swirling patterns, set between pale stone posts. A low pinkish wall surrounds the monument’s sunken or protected area. The fence separates the historic structure from the surrounding pedestrian space.

The background is bright and lively. To the left, several tourists and pedestrians walk through a paved plaza. There are benches, lampposts, and neatly maintained greenery. Tall, dense trees with vivid green leaves line the square, especially on the right side, where they fill much of the background. In the far left distance, slender mosque minarets rise above the trees, suggesting a historic urban setting, possibly Istanbul.

The lighting is warm and sunny, with strong golden highlights on the stone and trees. The sky is clear blue with a few small clouds, giving the scene a bright, summery atmosphere. Overall, the image captures the contrast between an ancient, weathered monument and a busy, well-kept public square filled with visitors and greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示历史建筑细节的照片，具体为一个装饰精美的石制柱子。柱子上雕刻着复杂的图案和浮雕，展示了古代艺术的精湛技艺。柱子的底部有两根支撑结构，上面覆盖着一些磨损痕迹。在柱子的背后，可以看到模糊的人群和树木，以及一些建筑物，这些元素构成了一个典型的户外环境背景。

caption:
The image shows a lively outdoor community event in a large urban park on a bright, sunny day. In the foreground, a group of children and adults are gathered around a rectangular table set up on the grass for an arts-and-crafts activity. The table is covered with drawing and coloring materials, including colored pencils, markers, papers, scissors, water bottles, and small containers. Several children are seated in striped lounge-style chairs around the table, many wearing white shirts and colorful baseball caps. They appear to be drawing or coloring, while adults stand nearby supervising or helping.

At the center-right, a woman wearing a wide straw hat and a camouflage-patterned sleeveless top holds up a sheet of paper with several animal illustrations on it, possibly showing examples for the children. Next to her stands a child in a gray shirt, and nearby another woman in a red polka-dot blouse leans forward toward the children. On the far right, another adult in a white T-shirt bends over the table, assisting with the activity.

The setting is a spacious green lawn with many people scattered throughout the background. Some are sitting on the grass, others are walking or standing in groups. The park has gently sloping grassy areas and wide steps or terraces. The atmosphere feels festive and family-oriented, with balloons visible in the distance and many people enjoying the day.

In the background, modern high-rise apartment buildings and urban structures line the horizon. A construction crane is visible among the buildings, suggesting an active city environment. On the right side, there is a large modern building with a curved white roof or arch-like architectural feature. The sky is clear and blue, and the strong sunlight creates sharp shadows, emphasizing the warm, cheerful outdoor setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张记录户外活动的照片，展示了一群孩子和成年人围坐在一张桌子旁，参与手工艺制作。孩子们戴着各式各样的帽子，有的还戴着眼镜，显得活泼可爱。成年人则在旁边指导或观看，营造出一种轻松愉快的氛围。背景中可以看到其他参与者、草地和远处的城市建筑，表明这个活动可能在一个公园或类似的公共空间举行。

caption:
The image shows a group of people walking down a long, narrow enclosed corridor, likely an airport jet bridge or transit walkway. The photo is taken from behind the group, giving a sense of moving forward through the passage.

The corridor has deep blue/purple wall panels on both sides with metallic gray trim along the bottom and edges. Overhead, a series of round recessed ceiling lights runs down the center, creating a tunnel-like perspective toward the far end. The lighting is cool and slightly greenish, and the image has noticeable motion blur, making the scene feel hurried or in motion.

On the left wall are large framed advertisement panels. One ad appears to show shelves or books and a display-like scene, with Thai text in white and orange on a dark blue background near the bottom. Farther down the left side there are more poster-style images, including one with a person or mannequin in warm colors. On the right wall are additional blue advertising panels, one with orange text that appears to read “THK” or similar, plus smaller white text below. Another right-side panel shows a blurry gray-toned cityscape or abstract urban image framed in white.

Several travelers are visible ahead. Closest to the camera is a woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a light-colored top and blue jeans, carrying a large black shoulder bag on her right side. In front of her are multiple people: one person in a yellow or mustard shirt, another in a patterned dark shirt, and a man wearing a bright light-blue baseball cap, green shirt, shorts, white sneakers, and a black backpack. They are all walking away from the camera toward the brighter end of the passage.

Overall, the image has a busy travel atmosphere, with strong perspective lines, cool-toned artificial lighting, and blurred movement suggesting people boarding or leaving a plane or moving through a terminal connection.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内走廊的现实主义风格照片，几位行人正在沿着蓝色墙壁和天花板装饰的通道行走。最前方是一位背对镜头的女性，穿着白色上衣和牛仔裤，背着黑色背包。在她的后方，可以看到其他两位行人的模糊身影，他们似乎也在快步前进。走廊两侧装有宣传海报，上面印有文字和图像，为这个场景增添了一些文化氛围。

caption:
The image shows a weathered stone statue set into a tall arched niche in a pale beige masonry wall. The niche has a rounded top with layered molding, creating a recessed alcove that casts deep shadows behind the figure. Strong sunlight from the upper left illuminates the front of the statue and the surrounding stone, while the interior of the arch is much darker, emphasizing the depth of the recess.

The statue depicts a robed, bearded figure in a classical or religious style. The face appears intentionally blurred or obscured, but the figure has long hair and a full beard. The person is dressed in heavy, flowing drapery with deeply carved folds across the torso and legs. One hand holds a sword with an ornate cross-shaped hilt, positioned vertically downward along the figure’s left side. The other hand is held near the chest, gripping what looks like a rolled scroll or cylindrical object.

The statue stands on a rectangular pedestal within the niche. The stone surface is aged, with discoloration, dirt, and worn edges visible throughout. The surrounding wall is made of light-colored stone blocks with horizontal striations and small dark grooves, giving it a textured, weathered appearance. At the bottom of the niche, there are faint stains and signs of water runoff. Overall, the image has the feel of an old church or historic building façade, with a devotional or saintly figure displayed in an architectural recess.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一尊位于建筑窗户凹槽中的雕塑，呈现古典风格。雕塑描绘了一个身着长袍的人物，手持一个类似权杖的物体，面部表情庄重而沉思。人物站立姿态显得庄严，似乎在注视远方或沉思。雕塑背后是建筑物的墙面，墙面质感粗糙，颜色为淡黄色调。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a river or broad waterway at sunset or sunrise. The scene is dominated by a dramatic gradient sky: deep blue at the top, fading into pale blue and then warm yellow, orange, and gold near the horizon. The sun itself is not visible, but its glow spreads across the left side of the image, creating a bright golden band above the distant hills.

The river occupies much of the lower half of the frame. Its surface is calm with subtle ripples, reflecting the warm orange and yellow tones of the sky on the left and cooler blue tones toward the foreground and right. The reflection gives the water a smooth, luminous quality.

On the right side, a dark, tree-covered hillside rises steeply beside the river. The hill is mostly in shadow, appearing as a dense mass of dark green and blue-black foliage. At the base of the hill, a multi-lane road curves along the riverbank. Traffic is visible, with many cars and buses traveling in both directions. Their headlights and taillights form small bright points and streaks, suggesting motion and the low-light conditions of early morning or evening. A sound barrier or wall runs alongside part of the road, and there are streetlights lining the roadway.

Below the main road, closer to the water, there appears to be a narrower riverside path or service road following the curve of the shoreline. The riverbank is edged with grass and a retaining wall, creating a clear boundary between land and water.

In the middle distance, a long bridge stretches horizontally across the river, connecting the two sides of the landscape. Its low, linear structure is silhouetted against the glowing water and hazy background. Beyond the bridge, a faint city skyline is visible through atmospheric haze, with several high-rise buildings and towers rising softly from the horizon. On the far right, a row of tall apartment buildings stands near the base of the hill, partially lit by the fading light.

The left side of the horizon features low, dark hills, including a visible vertical tower or chimney-like structure silhouetted against the orange sky. The entire image has a tranquil yet urban atmosphere, combining natural elements—water, hills, sky—with infrastructure such as roads, bridges, apartments, and distant city buildings. The composition leads the eye from the glowing sunset on the left across the river and bridge toward the busy road and wooded hillside on the right.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日落时分城市景观的摄影作品。图像捕捉了河流上空的日落，天空由橙色渐变至深蓝色，云朵在夕阳的映照下呈现出金色边缘。河面上反射着天空的颜色，形成了美丽的倒影。左侧有一条公路沿着河岸蜿蜒而行，车辆在道路上行驶，留下了一串尾灯轨迹。右侧是覆盖着树木的山丘，与远处的城市天际线形成对比。整个场景被柔和的光线所笼罩，营造出一种宁静和平和的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a live music performance on a dark stage, lit with dramatic colored lighting. In the foreground, a musician stands slightly right of center wearing a loose, flowing white outfit with wide sleeves and a draped scarf-like layer around the neck. Their face is blurred, but they appear focused on playing a black electric guitar with a white pearloid pickguard. The guitar’s neck extends toward the right edge of the frame, and one hand is positioned on the fretboard while the other rests near the strings and pickups.

A microphone on a black stand angles diagonally from the lower left toward the upper center of the image. The microphone is positioned above and slightly in front of the guitarist, suggesting it is set up for vocals or announcements. A cable runs from the microphone and curves downward along the stand.

In the background, partially obscured and out of focus, another performer is visible. This person appears to be wearing a similar light-colored outfit and a yellow or cream head covering. They are holding what looks like a saxophone or another brass/woodwind instrument, catching the stage lights with reflective highlights.

The lighting is a mix of green, teal, red, and warm yellow tones, creating a vivid concert atmosphere. The right side of the frame glows with green haze or stage fog, while red and green light spill across the performers’ white clothing. The background is mostly black, with faint structural shapes or stage equipment barely visible, making the musicians and instruments stand out strongly. The overall mood is energetic, atmospheric, and theatrical, capturing a moment during a live performance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的现场音乐会照片，主要展示了一位男性吉他手在舞台上的表演。他穿着一件白色的传统服装，正在专注地弹奏着一把黑色电吉他。在他的背后，另一位穿着鲜艳传统服饰的男性鼓手正站在鼓前准备演奏。整个场景被聚光灯照亮，营造出一种充满活力和激情的演出氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a large supermarket or hypermarket, likely a Big C store in Vietnam, with many promotional signs hanging above the shopping area.

At the top, the photo captures a high industrial-style ceiling with cream-colored metal roofing panels, white steel beams, pipes, hanging wires, and long fluorescent tube lights running horizontally. A security camera is mounted near the center, attached to a pole or bracket above the aisle.

Dominating the middle of the image are two large turquoise-blue hanging promotional banners. Both have the headline in Vietnamese: **“TIẾT KIỆM MỖI NGÀY VỚI Big C!”**, meaning “Save every day with Big C.” The design includes bold white and yellow lettering, blue geometric accents, and product photos.

The left banner advertises **G7 3-in-1 coffee**. It shows a black-and-red coffee package and a large red price box with bright yellow numbers: **39.900 VND/bịch**. Below, the text mentions **“Cà phê G7 3 trong 1, 20 gói * 16g”**, and the promotion dates: **“Từ 04.02.2020 đến 13.02.2020.”**

The right banner advertises **Ngôi Sao Phương Nam sweetened condensed milk** in a green-and-white carton. Its large red price box reads **53.500 VND/hộp**. The product description says **“Sữa đặc Ngôi Sao Phương Nam xanh hộp giấy 1,284kg”**, with the same promotion dates: **04.02.2020 to 13.02.2020**.

Below these large banners are more sale signs in red, yellow, and white. One yellow sign repeats the G7 coffee promotion with a large **39.900 VND** price. Another yellow sign on the right promotes the condensed milk for **53.500 VND**. Several smaller promotional signs hang deeper in the store, with prices such as **134.900**, **129.900**, and **18.800** visible.

At the bottom of the image are stacks of boxed and packaged goods, including green-and-white cartons arranged in rows, likely the condensed milk products. There are also cardboard boxes in the foreground. In the background, the store continues with more displays, hanging signage, and a visible café or food-service area sign reading **“HIGHLANDS COFFEE.”**

Overall, the image presents a busy retail promotion area inside a Vietnamese supermarket, with bright lighting, large overhead advertisements, and prominently displayed discounted prices.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示超市内部的商业摄影照片，图中可见两个大型广告牌悬挂在天花板上，上面印有商品名称和价格信息。左侧的广告牌宣传的是'CA PHE 97 STRONG'咖啡，标价39.90元，而右侧的广告牌则展示了'AGA Sao'咖啡，标价53.90元。在广告牌下方，可以看到其他商品的价格标签，如'KUWAIT COFFEE'的价格为39.90元。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一个清晰且实用的购物环境。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street in what appears to be Istanbul, Turkey, viewed from a slightly elevated or telephoto perspective looking downhill through a corridor of buildings. In the far distance, framed by the street, is a large Ottoman-style mosque with multiple domes and tall slender minarets—likely one of Istanbul’s historic mosques. Its pale stone domes and spires stand out against a clear blue sky.

The foreground is crowded with traffic: several cars fill the lower part of the frame, their roofs and windshields reflecting sunlight. A blurred pedestrian’s head and shoulders appear near the bottom left, suggesting movement and a busy street environment. Farther down the road, more cars and taxis are visible, compressed by the long-lens perspective.

On both sides of the street are older multi-story buildings with worn facades, barred windows, balconies, and external air-conditioning units. The right side has many shopfronts and signs, including Turkish text such as “AKEM KİMYA” and “SU ARITMA.” There are awnings, storefront displays, stacked goods, and pedestrians walking along the narrow sidewalk. One person in a light shirt is visible on the right side walking away from the camera.

A large leafy tree dominates the left-center of the image, partially obscuring buildings and adding shade. Tall streetlights run along the road. Across the street, strings of red-and-white triangular pennant flags hang overhead, creating a festive or civic atmosphere. Several advertising boards in Turkish read “BU PANOYA REKLAM VERMEK İÇİN” with a phone number, indicating available billboard space.

The lighting is bright midday sunlight, producing strong contrasts between sunlit building fronts and shaded areas. The overall scene feels dense, lively, and distinctly urban, with a mix of historic architecture in the distance and everyday commercial street life in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道日常生活的照片。在画面的前景，我们看到一辆蓝色的汽车停靠在路边，其后方是几位行人正在穿行。街道两旁排列着各式商店和餐馆，招牌上用多种语言写着'Open'字样，表明这是一个多文化区域。街道上方悬挂着红色和白色的旗帜，增添了节日气氛。在远处，可以看到一座具有独特建筑风格的清真寺，它的尖塔高耸入云，成为这个场景中的一个显著地标。

caption:
The image shows a group of people walking along a city street during what appears to be a public martial arts event, parade, or demonstration. Most of the visible participants are wearing judo or martial-arts uniforms, known as gis.

In the foreground, near the center, a young man is walking from left to right. He is wearing a white gi with a black belt tied around his waist, suggesting an advanced rank. The gi has dark stripes on the shoulder and an Adidas patch on the sleeve. He is also wearing gray athletic sneakers with bright orange socks, rather than being barefoot. His posture is relaxed, with one foot stepping forward and one arm hanging naturally by his side.

To the left, another participant in a white gi is visible, wearing an orange belt. This person is also walking in the same direction and wears black sneakers. Behind them, a person in a blue gi stands out among the mostly white uniforms. Several other participants in white gis are scattered through the middle and right side of the frame, some with colored belts such as yellow or white. A partial figure in a white gi is cut off at the far right edge of the image.

The setting is an urban roadway, with the participants walking on dark asphalt marked by faint lane lines. The background is intentionally blurred, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect that keeps attention on the people in the foreground. Behind them are multi-story buildings, signs, storefronts, and a white van. There are also traffic lights and indistinct pedestrians or spectators in the distance. Large signs and billboards with red, white, and blue colors add to the busy city atmosphere.

Overall, the scene feels like an outdoor martial arts gathering or parade in a metropolitan area, with participants of different ranks and ages moving together through the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示街头活动的摄影照片，前景中一位穿着白色柔道服和黑色腰带的人正走在街道上。他脚穿灰色运动鞋，显得专注而从容。在他的背后，可以看到其他穿着类似服装的人们，他们似乎在进行某种集体活动或表演。背景中的城市街景包括建筑物、路标和行驶的车辆，为这个场景增添了都市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a person sitting cross-legged in a light beige upholstered armchair in a bright, airy indoor room. They are wearing blue jeans, a white T-shirt, and an open blue-and-white checkered button-up shirt. Their long light-blonde hair falls over their shoulders, and their face is intentionally blurred. They are holding a pair of black over-ear headphones against their ears with both hands, suggesting they are listening to music or audio.

The setting appears calm and modern, with lots of natural light coming from large windows in the background. Behind the chair is a large green monstera plant with broad, split leaves, placed near the window. The room has white walls, pale flooring, and a soft neutral-colored rug, giving it a clean, cozy, Scandinavian-style feel. A patterned cushion is partly visible on the right side of the chair. The overall mood is relaxed, comfortable, and peaceful.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内环境中的女性的现代摄影风格照片。女性坐在一个米色的沙发上，穿着格子衬衫和牛仔裤，脚上穿着一双蓝色拖鞋。她的双手放在头上，遮住了面部，似乎在思考或休息。背景中有一盆绿色的大叶子植物，为这个温馨的室内场景增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a cluster of modern apartment buildings under a wide, clear blue sky. The sky occupies most of the frame, creating an open, minimalist feel, with no clouds visible.

Along the bottom portion of the image are several light-colored residential buildings, likely apartment blocks. Their façades are mostly white or pale beige, with clean, rectangular lines and a contemporary architectural style. The buildings have flat roofs, sharp edges, and a modular appearance, with large panel-like sections across the exterior walls.

Rows of windows run horizontally across the façades. Many windows are fitted with gray metal shutters or blinds, some fully closed and others partially open. The window frames are dark gray, contrasting with the pale walls. Several balconies project outward from the buildings, especially on the right side and near the center-left. These balconies have dark, semi-transparent glass or tinted railing panels, giving them a sleek modern look.

The central building is the most prominent, rising higher than the others and positioned slightly to the right of center. It has multiple levels of evenly spaced windows and a few recessed balcony areas. On the far right edge, part of another apartment building is visible, with stacked balconies and darker glass panels. On the left, additional building sections overlap, creating a layered urban residential scene.

Small rooftop details are visible, including antennas and a few utility fixtures. The lighting is bright and direct, suggesting a sunny day; shadows fall sharply along balcony edges and recessed areas, emphasizing the geometry of the architecture. The overall mood is clean, calm, and urban, with a strong contrast between the crisp white buildings and the saturated blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代住宅建筑的摄影图像，建筑物具有简洁的设计风格和统一的色调。建筑表面以白色为主，辅以灰色的窗户框架和阳台栏杆。每栋楼都有多个楼层，顶层设有凸出的阳台。整个场景在晴朗的蓝天背景下显得格外清晰和宁静。

caption:
The image shows a busy airport check-in area with a line of travelers waiting with their luggage. The scene is viewed from behind, focusing on people standing in a queue facing airline counters.

In the background, there is a dark green overhead sign that reads “CHECK-IN,” with the number “124” visible, and an “Alitalia” logo on the signage. A small display screen is mounted near the counter, though its text is not clearly readable. The setting has the polished floors, metallic wall panels, and bright overhead lighting typical of an airport terminal.

Several passengers are visible, most dressed casually for travel. On the left, a man in a navy-and-white striped polo shirt and white pants wears a gray backpack with blue straps and an orange front pocket. Near him are large suitcases wrapped in bright neon-green protective plastic, standing upright on wheels. Another man in a blue polo shirt stands nearby holding a luggage handle.

In the center, a traveler wearing a white patterned T-shirt and black shorts has a navy and red backpack with a star design and the word “Soviet” on it. Their hands are clasped behind their back as they wait. Around them are more suitcases, including a bright pink rolling suitcase and a blue suitcase.

On the right side, a tall man in a red-and-blue striped polo shirt stands with one hand on his hip. A blue sweatshirt is draped over his shoulders, and he carries a light gray crossbody bag. Next to him are more passengers with backpacks and rolling luggage, including a large black suitcase in the foreground and a turquoise backpack on another traveler.

The overall mood is one of waiting and travel preparation: people are standing close together, facing the counters, with many bags and suitcases lined up around them. The image captures the crowded, organized bustle of an airport check-in queue.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多个旅行者在机场候机区等待的现实主义风格照片。人群中有男性和女性，他们穿着休闲服装，并携带着各种颜色和大小的行李箱。一些人背对着镜头，而其他人则面向相机，表情自然。背景中可以看到指示牌和排队等候的人群，营造出一种忙碌的旅行氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, panoramic urban square on a sunny day, dominated by a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. The composition is wide and low, with much of the upper frame filled by open sky, giving the scene an expansive, airy feeling.

In the foreground, there is a landscaped flower bed filled with dense yellow blossoms, mixed with patches of purple flowers and green foliage. Behind the flowers is a neatly trimmed hedge, separating the garden area from a large fountain.

The fountain occupies the center-right of the image. Water jets rise in multiple streams, creating white sprays and mist above a broad circular basin. Around the fountain are classical stone statues of human figures. One prominent statue on the left depicts a standing nude or semi-draped figure on a pedestal, while another near the center shows a female figure with one arm raised over her head. The sculptures give the square a formal, historic character.

On the left side of the image stands a large cream-colored building with a classical façade. It has several rows of rectangular windows, decorative cornices, columns, and a balustrade along the roofline. The building’s pale stone contrasts strongly with the deep blue sky.

In the background, several ornate buildings and rooftops are visible. Near the center-left, golden domes and towers rise above the surrounding structures, adding a decorative, historic skyline. On the right, there is a building with a clock tower, its pale stone façade and greenish clock face standing out. Nearby, a pointed purple-gray roof and other architectural details add variety to the skyline.

Small people can be seen near the fountain and along the lower edge of the square, giving a sense of scale. The overall atmosphere is lively, elegant, and Mediterranean, with bright sunlight, historic architecture, fountains, statues, and colorful spring flowers creating a picturesque city scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市广场景观的照片，中心是一个喷泉，周围种植着黄色的花朵。喷泉前方有两位雕塑人物，一位站立在左侧，另一位坐在右侧。背景中可以看到几座具有欧洲古典建筑风格的建筑物，其中一座顶部装饰着金色圆顶。天空是晴朗的蓝色，云朵洁白且分布均匀。

caption:
The image is a close-up portrait of an elderly woman outdoors. She is wearing a bright blue disposable surgical mask that covers her nose and mouth, with the white elastic straps looped around her ears. The mask has visible pleats and small dotted texture along the edges.

She has thin, rectangular eyeglasses with a metallic frame resting low on her face, just above the mask. Her eyes are partially narrowed, giving her a serious, tired, or contemplative expression. Fine wrinkles are visible around her eyes and forehead, emphasizing her age.

Her hair is gray-white and somewhat tousled, with loose strands blowing across her forehead and to the side, suggesting wind. The sunlight catches her hair, creating bright highlights and a slightly silvery glow. She is wearing a beige or taupe coat with a soft, heavy-looking fabric, wrapped around her shoulders and neck.

The background is very dark and blurred, making the woman’s face, mask, and hair stand out strongly. The lighting is dramatic: strong sunlight illuminates the front and side of her face, while the background remains in shadow. The overall mood feels quiet, intimate, and somewhat solemn, with the mask adding a sense of caution or vulnerability.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位老年女性的特写照片。她的头发呈现出自然的灰色，眼神深邃而专注。她戴着一副圆形眼镜，并且脸上还覆盖着一个蓝色的口罩，以保护自己免受病毒或污染的影响。她穿着一件棕色的外套，颈部线条清晰可见。背景是模糊的，无法辨认具体的细节，但可以感受到是在户外拍摄的。

caption:
The image shows a light blue/silver compact sedan driving along a paved road, captured in a side-profile view. The car occupies the lower-right portion of the frame and is moving from left to right. Only most of the vehicle is visible, with the front and side clearly shown and the rear near the right edge of the image. Its wheels appear slightly blurred, reinforcing the sense of speed and motion.

The road surface in the foreground is dark asphalt with bold white painted lane markings, including diagonal or boxed striping that stretches across the bottom of the image. A metal guardrail runs horizontally behind the car, separating the roadway from the landscape beyond.

In the background, there is a lush green mountainous or hilly landscape covered with dense vegetation. The hills are heavily motion-blurred, suggesting the camera was panning with the moving car or that the vehicle is traveling quickly. Farther back, softer blue-toned mountains are faintly visible, adding depth to the scene. Near the top of one hill, there appears to be a small blurred structure or tower.

The sky is pale blue with thin, wispy clouds, giving the scene a bright daytime atmosphere. Overall, the image has a dynamic, travel-oriented feel, emphasizing movement on a scenic mountain road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆蓝色汽车在高速公路上行驶的动态模糊摄影图像。汽车呈现流线型设计，车身颜色为鲜艳的蓝色，车窗反射着周围的光线。背景中，山丘和天空呈现出一种动态模糊的效果，给人一种汽车正在快速移动的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a quiet cemetery on an overcast day, viewed from a low angle among several tall, white grave markers. The graves are arranged in neat rows, each outlined by low rectangular stone borders set into the ground. The headstones are narrow, upright, and obelisk-like, with sloped shoulders and rounded caps on top. Some have carved inscriptions and decorative symbols, including a fleur-de-lis-like motif and Arabic script near the bottom.

In the foreground, a prominent white headstone stands slightly right of center. Its inscription is partially visible, with raised lettering and dates, and a bouquet of red and pink artificial flowers lies at the base of the grave. To the left, another tall marker bears similar carved text and Arabic writing. Smaller white markers recede into the background, emphasizing the orderly layout of the burial ground.

The ground is a mix of paved stone walkways, soil, fallen brown leaves, and patches of grass. Low, dark green hedges border parts of the cemetery. In the background, leafless trees with dense, twisting branches rise high into the frame, creating a stark silhouette against a gray, cloudy sky. Several clusters of mistletoe or dense foliage are visible high in the bare branches.

Beyond the trees, a few buildings can be seen, including a yellow house with a reddish roof, adding a muted splash of color behind the cemetery. The overall mood is solemn and subdued, with the white gravestones contrasting strongly against the dark trees, damp earth, and heavy winter sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示墓地的现实主义风格照片，前景中排列着多个白色墓碑，每个墓碑上都有刻有名字和日期的信息。墓碑之间摆放着红色的花圈，为这个纪念场所增添了一丝哀悼的氛围。背景中的树木已经失去了叶子，显示出冬季或早春的季节特征。在远处可以看到一些现代建筑，与古老的墓地形成对比。

caption:
The image shows a lively European city square or pedestrian street during what appears to be a Christmas market season. The scene is set on a broad cobblestone plaza with curved stone paving patterns, surrounded by older multi-story buildings.

On the right side, a row of bright red market huts with pitched roofs is decorated with white trim and small lights, resembling festive wooden stalls. In front of them are several small Christmas trees in burlap-wrapped bases, strung with warm white lights and a few ornaments. Behind the stalls, a colorful carousel canopy with pink, turquoise, yellow, and white panels rises above the market area.

Further right, partially visible above the stalls, is a large greenish-bronze equestrian statue on a stone pedestal. The horse and rider have a weathered patina, suggesting an older public monument. Behind it stands a large brick building with many rectangular windows and a steep gray-tiled roof with small dormer windows.

The left side of the image is lined with narrow, older buildings in cream, beige, white, and muted pastel tones. They have tall windows with decorative trim, shopfronts at street level, and some flags hanging from poles. A traditional streetlamp stands near the foreground, and there are road signs and storefront signs along the street. The buildings create a corridor leading toward the center background, where a pinkish building with a decorative roofline is visible.

Many people are walking through the square, dressed in winter clothing such as coats, scarves, hats, and boots. Some are strolling in groups, others appear to be shopping or moving through the market. A child with an adult is visible near the left foreground, and several people stand near the Christmas trees and stalls on the right. The crowd gives the scene a busy but relaxed holiday atmosphere.

The sky is overcast, casting soft, cool daylight over the scene. Bare trees in planters and along the square suggest winter. Overhead wires stretch across the sky, and festive decorations or lights can be seen in the distance down the street. Overall, the image captures a bustling historic town center with seasonal market decorations, holiday greenery, and pedestrians enjoying the public space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙圣诞市场场景的照片。照片中，人们在铺有鹅卵石的街道上穿行，周围是装饰着节日彩灯和绿色植物的小摊位。背景中的建筑物具有传统的欧洲风格，而天空中飘浮着几朵云。

caption:
The image shows a busy nighttime city street in front of an elaborately lit historic building. The main building is the TSUM department store in Moscow, with a large illuminated sign on the roof reading “ЦУМ” and “TSUM MOSCOW” beneath it. The sign has a bright orange border and stands out strongly against the dark night sky.

The building itself has ornate, Gothic-style architecture, with pointed roof turrets, decorative stonework, tall arched windows, and many vertical architectural details. Its façade is brightly lit with warm white lights, making the pale stone exterior glow. Many of the windows are illuminated from inside with red-toned lighting, adding a festive, upscale atmosphere.

In front of the building, a tall orange decorative column or holiday installation rises from the street level, topped or accented near the bottom by a large glowing red bow. The orange color matches the branding and lighting of the TSUM sign above.

The foreground is filled with motion-blurred traffic. A large white bus dominates the lower left side of the image, blurred from movement, with its headlights and side lights streaking across the scene. Several cars pass quickly on the right, creating long horizontal streaks of white, blue, and red light. The blur suggests a long-exposure photograph capturing the energy of the busy street.

To the right of the main building is a yellow classical-style building with white columns and bright façade lighting. Streetlamps, parked vehicles, and bare winter trees are visible along the sidewalk. The overall scene feels lively, urban, and festive, with a strong contrast between the sharp, illuminated architecture and the dynamic motion of nighttime traffic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，画面中心是一座装饰华丽、灯光璀璨的建筑，其立面被红色和白色灯光照亮。在建筑前方，一辆巴士以模糊的速度经过，而背景中则有其他车辆快速移动，营造出一种动态的城市生活氛围。

caption:
The image shows a construction worker at an outdoor building site, bent over while working inside or beside a shallow excavation.

In the foreground, the worker is wearing full high-visibility safety gear: an orange hard hat, an orange reflective vest with silver reflective stripes, dark work clothing, gloves, and black safety boots. Their face is not visible because they are leaning forward and looking down toward the work area. They appear to be using a hammer or mallet near a vertical steel reinforcing bar or formwork element.

To the left of the worker is a rectangular foundation or formwork area. It contains a grid of steel rebar tied together, suggesting preparation for reinforced concrete. Wooden boards and dark form panels line the edge of the structure, forming a mold or support around the foundation. Several vertical rebars protrude upward along the edge.

The ground is rough, dry, and uneven, covered with loose soil, rocks, and construction debris. A trench or excavated section runs behind and around the worker, with compacted dirt walls visible. Across the upper part of the image, red-and-white striped caution tape stretches horizontally, marking off the work zone. There are also loose cables or hoses lying on the ground, including a thick dark hose snaking across the top of the scene and a thin white cable running down near the worker.

The overall setting looks like an active construction or foundation site, with temporary safety barriers, exposed earth, rebar, wooden formwork, and scattered tools or materials. Bright sunlight casts clear shadows, emphasizing the dusty, rugged texture of the ground and the worker’s reflective safety clothing.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工人在户外建筑工地工作的照片。工人穿着橙色的安全背心和安全帽，正在使用锤子和电钻进行工作。他站在一个混凝土结构旁，周围是未完成的钢筋网和散落的碎石。阳光下，工人的动作显得专注而熟练。

caption:
The image shows a wide view of an ancient archaeological site, likely the Roman Forum in Rome, filled with ruins, columns, stone fragments, and historic structures under a cloudy sky.

In the foreground, a dark metal railing with crisscross patterns runs horizontally across the bottom of the scene, separating the viewer from the ruins. Behind it are patches of green grass, low brick walls, broken marble blocks, and scattered stone remains. A paved walkway runs from the lower right toward the center of the image, with several visitors walking through the site, giving a sense of scale to the massive ruins around them.

On the far left, a very tall, solitary ancient column rises prominently into the sky. It stands on a weathered base made of stone and brick, and its top is damaged but still decorated with remnants of a capital. Nearby, lower rows of columns and a rectangular ancient building with a classical façade stretch into the middle distance.

The center of the image contains a mix of ruins and surviving monuments. There are upright columns, partial arches, and fragments of old walls. In the distance, a pale stone triumphal arch stands along the central path, framed by greenery and other ruins. Behind it, more historic buildings and towers are visible, including a church-like structure with a bell tower.

On the right side, the landscape rises into a hillside covered with large brick and stone ruins. These walls are reddish-brown and heavily weathered, with arched openings and uneven surfaces. Trees and shrubs grow along the top and around the ruins, including umbrella-shaped pine trees typical of Rome. A smaller building with a tiled roof sits near the base of the hill.

The sky takes up much of the upper half of the image. It is overcast with soft gray and white clouds, with some pale blue visible between them. The lighting is subdued, creating a calm, slightly dramatic atmosphere that emphasizes the age and texture of the stone. Overall, the scene conveys a sense of history, grandeur, and decay, with modern tourists moving among the remains of an ancient city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示罗马论坛的摄影照片。图像中心是一座高耸的圆柱，周围散布着残破的建筑遗迹和雕塑。在前景中，可以看到几位游客正在参观这些历史遗址。天空多云，为这个古老场景增添了一丝神秘感。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a lush, hilly agricultural landscape, likely a tea plantation. The foreground is filled with dense, low-growing tea bushes forming a textured green carpet that stretches across the lower half of the scene. The plants are arranged in neat, gently curving rows, following the contours of the slope.

In the middle ground, the land dips into a wooded valley. There are many trees of different sizes and shades of green, creating a layered, tropical look. Some areas are thick with forest, while others are more open and cultivated. Narrow dirt paths wind through the plantation, including a visible light-brown track near the center-right that curves between the tea fields.

On the left and right hillsides, terraced rows of crops are clearly visible. These terraces create horizontal bands across the slopes, emphasizing the steepness of the terrain. The right side has especially prominent, evenly spaced green rows climbing the hillside. In the lower left, darker, rounded rows of tea bushes form strong curved patterns.

The background consists of rolling hills covered with a mixture of tea fields, trees, and scattered buildings. Small houses and larger structures sit along the ridgelines near the top of the hills, partially softened by distance and haze. The sky is very bright and overexposed, washing out much of the upper portion of the image and giving the scene a hazy, sunlit atmosphere.

Overall, the scene feels peaceful, rural, and verdant, with a strong sense of depth created by the layered hills, terraced plantations, winding paths, and dense greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示茶园景观的自然风光摄影图像。前景是整齐排列的茶树，形成了一片绿色的波纹状图案。中景是一条蜿蜒的小路穿过茶园，引导视线深入画面。背景由起伏的山丘组成，山上点缀着树木和灌木，营造出一种宁静和谐的氛围。整个场景在阳光照耀下显得生机勃勃，色彩鲜明。

caption:
The image shows a preserved biological specimen displayed in a museum-like setting. At the center is a glass cylindrical jar filled with a pale yellowish preserving fluid, likely formalin or alcohol. Suspended inside is a small two-headed kitten specimen.

The kitten’s body is positioned upright, facing forward, with its front legs bent and slightly raised at its sides and its hind legs extended downward. It has orange-brown fur, a lighter cream-colored chest and belly, and a long tail hanging straight down. The most striking feature is that it has two heads joined side by side on a single body. Both heads resemble newborn kittens, with closed or partially closed eyes, small noses, folded ears, and soft facial fur. The heads are pressed closely together, creating a symmetrical but unusual appearance.

The jar has a thick glass rim at the top and bottom, and condensation or residue is visible near the upper edge. The liquid inside is slightly cloudy, giving the specimen a muted, aged look. The background is a gray-blue textured wall, and the jar appears to be sitting on a glass shelf or inside a display case.

At the bottom of the image, a white label with Ukrainian text is partly visible. The large heading reads “ДВОГОЛОВЕ КОШЕНЯ,” which translates to “two-headed kitten.” The smaller text below says “Наслідок порушення ембріонального розвитку,” meaning “a consequence of a disturbance in embryonic development.” Another partial label is visible on the right edge, suggesting this is part of a collection of anatomical or developmental abnormality specimens.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在玻璃罐中的动物标本的照片。标本被放置在一个透明的玻璃容器中，容器内部装有清水以保持标本的湿润状态。动物标本看起来像是一个小型哺乳动物，它的身体部分可见，包括头部、四肢和腹部。背景是灰色的墙壁，上面有一个白色的标签，但内容不清晰。

caption:
The image shows the front of a large, elegant yellow building photographed from a low angle on a bright, sunny day. The building has a grand, classical style with vivid yellow horizontal siding and crisp white trim. A prominent triangular gable dominates the center, framed by decorative white molding and dentil-like detailing. Near the middle of the gable is a small arched window with a dark fanlight design.

Below the gable are tall white columns with classical capitals, supporting a covered portico. White railings run along balconies and walkways, including a decorative rooftop railing visible near the top right. The roof is covered in light wood-toned shingles, with some reddish metal trim along the edges.

An American flag hangs from a flagpole in front of the building, positioned slightly right of center. The flag is partially unfurled, with red and white stripes and a blue field visible against the yellow façade. The flagpole extends vertically down through the scene.

The lower portion of the building features large rectangular windows and glass doors with dark frames. White railings, steps, and porch elements add to the formal, resort-like appearance. In the foreground, there is a lush green lawn with tall grass and small wildflowers, suggesting a natural, landscaped setting.

The sky takes up much of the upper background and is a deep, cloudless blue, emphasizing the bright colors of the building. On the far right edge, dark green pine branches partially frame the scene. Overall, the image has a cheerful, summery feel, with strong sunlight casting crisp shadows across the architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座黄色建筑的摄影图像，建筑具有经典的美国乡村风格，特征包括白色圆柱和装饰性的檐口。建筑前方有一面飘扬的美国国旗，背景是晴朗的蓝天。

caption:
The image is a festive Christmas flat-lay arrangement on a gray, weathered wooden surface with visible grain and plank lines. The composition is clustered mostly along the left and center, leaving a large open area of textured wood on the right.

At the center is a rectangular Christmas card or gift card placed diagonally. It has a glittery deep red background with a pale beige border. On top of it is an elegant cream-and-gold Christmas tree design, decorated with ornate swirling floral patterns, tiny red gem-like accents, small stars, and a red ribbon bow near the bottom. The card gives the scene a handmade, decorative feel.

Surrounding the card are many Christmas ornaments and decorations:

- In the upper left is a large glittery silver snowflake ornament with intricate cutout arms.
- In the upper right, partly overlapping the card, is a glittery gold snowflake ornament with star-shaped tips.
- Several gold baubles are scattered around the scene, including matte and glittered ones with thin gold hanging strings.
- On the left and lower areas are clusters of pinecones, some painted or dusted with gold and red glitter, mixed with artificial evergreen branches.
- Two small holiday candle arrangements appear among the pinecones, each holding a blue candle in a small cup-like holder.
- Near the lower left is a red, green, and white Christmas tree-shaped decoration with painted snowflake details and white trim.
- At the lower right is a small bundle of dark green artificial pine needles with pinecones and shiny gold bells.

The color palette is rich and traditional: red, gold, green, silver, and cream, contrasted against the cool gray wood background. The lighting is even and soft, highlighting the glitter textures on the ornaments, snowflakes, pinecones, and card. Overall, the image feels like a carefully arranged holiday tabletop scene, suitable for a Christmas greeting card, seasonal invitation, or festive background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示圣诞节装饰品的图片，其中包括一个红色背景上的白色圣诞树剪影卡片、金色和白色的雪花装饰物、红色和绿色的圣诞球以及松果。这些物品被摆放在木质桌面上，营造出节日气氛。

caption:
The image shows the upper interior of an ornate historic building, photographed from below at a steep upward angle. The scene is dominated by a large glass-and-iron roof structure, suggesting a covered arcade or gallery. The roof is made of pale blue, translucent glass panes arranged in a curved grid, supported by dark metal ribs and riveted beams. A heavy vertical iron support runs down near the center of the frame, intersecting with arched metal framing above.

Below the glass ceiling is a richly decorated architectural façade in warm beige and cream tones. The upper portion features intricate metalwork and carved ornamentation: a band of repeating spiral motifs runs horizontally beneath the roof, and below it are delicate lattice-like patterns with geometric and floral shapes. On both diagonal sides, there are decorative borders filled with circular rosette designs and small square panels.

At the center, just under the ironwork, is a large sculpted eagle with wings spread wide. The eagle appears to be perched above a shield or crest, giving the façade a heraldic, monumental quality. Beneath the eagle, carved into the building façade, are classical-style statues: a standing female figure in draped clothing, wearing a crown or headpiece, and another partially visible figure beside her. Their stone surfaces match the surrounding warm, aged architectural decoration.

The lower portion of the image includes elaborate cornices, window frames, and relief carvings. There are shell-like motifs, bead-and-reel borders, floral patterns, and a Greek key frieze. A framed window sits on the left, surrounded by sculpted ornamentation. The overall impression is of a grand 19th-century or early 20th-century interior, combining classical sculpture, decorative stonework, and industrial iron-and-glass construction. The lighting is bright and diffuse from the glass roof above, giving the scene a soft, airy atmosphere despite the dense architectural detail.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑细节的摄影作品，图像中心是一个精致的雕塑，它位于一个装饰华丽的建筑角落。雕塑呈现了一只展翅欲飞的鹰，其羽毛和翅膀的雕刻细腻而生动。在鹰下方，有一尊手持花瓶的女性雕像，她的姿态优雅，面部表情平静。背景中，可以看到一个半透明的玻璃穹顶，其结构复杂，由许多细长的金属条构成，与周围复杂的建筑装饰相映成趣。

caption:
The image shows the entrance to what appears to be a Japanese shrine, dominated by a large red torii gate in the center. The torii has two tall red vertical pillars supporting a broad horizontal crossbeam with a dark, almost black cap along the top. A decorative plaque with Japanese characters hangs from the middle of the upper beam, framed in an ornate border.

The scene is outdoors on a bright, sunny day. The sky fills much of the upper half of the image and is a clear blue with scattered white clouds, including a large fluffy cloud directly above the gate. Sunlight creates strong highlights on the trees and shrine structures, giving the scene a warm, vivid look.

Lush green trees frame the gate on both sides. On the left, a tall tree with thin branches and bright green leaves rises into the sky, partially surrounding the torii. On the right, dense foliage from another tree partly overlaps the gate and casts dappled shadows. The greenery gives the setting a peaceful, garden-like atmosphere.

Below the torii is a stone stairway leading upward, suggesting the shrine or sacred area lies beyond the gate. The steps are flanked by small red railings or bridge-like structures further back. At the base of the gate and stairs, there are stone elements, including low stone walls or fences and lantern-like structures. A tall vertical sign with Japanese writing stands near the right pillar of the torii.

On the far right, there is a notice board or information display with Japanese text and images, protected under a small roofed frame. The lower foreground includes neatly maintained shrubs and stone paving, reinforcing the orderly shrine grounds.

Overall, the image has a serene and inviting feel: a traditional red torii gate set amid greenery, stone steps, and a bright blue sky, capturing the entrance to a tranquil Japanese religious or cultural site.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统风格的红色鸟居的照片，位于一个宁静的环境中。鸟居上方悬挂着一个金色的钟铃，其背后是蓝天和几朵洁白的云彩。鸟居两侧有绿色的树木和灌木丛，而前方则有一段石阶通向一个带有日文铭牌的小亭子。整个场景在阳光下显得格外和谐与宁静。

caption:
The image is a close-up, softly focused photograph of a sleeping newborn baby lying on a light-colored blanket or towel. The baby’s face fills most of the frame, shown from the side at a slight angle. Their eyes are closed, their lips are gently pursed, and their expression is peaceful and relaxed. Fine details of the baby’s skin, nose, cheeks, eyelashes, and tiny ear are visible, giving the image an intimate, tender feeling.

The baby has very fine hair along the scalp and soft, warm-toned skin. One arm is partially visible in the foreground, blurred due to the shallow depth of field. The baby appears to be resting comfortably, wrapped or surrounded by pale fabric.

Near the baby’s mouth and cheek area, there are shiny decorative objects—possibly metallic ribbons or party-style decorations—with pink, purple, and silver colors. These decorations are out of focus but catch the light, creating sparkly highlights and circular bokeh effects. A pink glittery or sequined-looking strip runs diagonally in the background, adding a festive or celebratory feel.

The background is heavily blurred, with soft cream, pink, purple, and dark tones. The lighting is warm and gentle, emphasizing the baby’s calm face while keeping the overall mood soft, cozy, and affectionate.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示新生儿睡眠状态的特写照片。婴儿闭着眼睛，面部表情安详，皮肤细腻光滑，头发稀疏且呈自然黑色。婴儿被包裹在柔软的白色布料中，而其头部则靠在一个装饰性的物体上，该物体的细节因焦点在婴儿身上而显得模糊不清。背景虽然模糊，但可以隐约看出一些粉色和白色的物品，可能是婴儿床或周围的环境。

caption:
The image shows an ornate historic building photographed on a bright, clear day under a vivid blue sky. The architecture is highly decorative, with a white façade, arched windows, patterned trim, and small domed towers that give it a churchlike or grand civic character.

At the center of the composition is the building’s upper façade. It features a tall, curved gable with a silver cross at the very top. Just below the cross is a circular medallion or crest containing painted figures, framed by decorative blue-and-white ornamentation. Beneath it are three narrow arched openings with dark patterned grilles, set into a white wall with layered moldings and pointed arch details.

On either side of the central gable are small cylindrical towers capped with metallic ribbed domes. The roof below is covered in reddish-orange tiles, contrasting with the pale façade and the blue sky. The building’s lower visible section includes elaborately framed arched windows, ornamental panels, and repeating geometric motifs in blue, white, and beige. Several black streetlamps appear along the bottom edge, adding an urban square or plaza feeling.

In the foreground on the right, a large stone statue is partially visible and out of focus. The figure appears to be a robed person holding a long staff or pole, with weathered beige stone texture. The statue and its carved pedestal occupy a significant portion of the right side, creating depth and framing the architectural background.

Overall, the image combines crisp historic architecture with a soft, sculptural foreground, emphasizing decorative detail, religious or ceremonial symbolism, and a bright Mediterranean or Central European atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑细节的摄影作品，前景中有一尊手持长矛的雕塑，其背后是一座装饰华丽的教堂。教堂的屋顶和钟楼在阳光下闪耀着光芒，而周围的建筑物则呈现出一种古典风格。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, European-themed amusement or entertainment street, decorated with ornate architecture and oversized festive ornaments.

On the right side, a large pastel building dominates the scene. Its façade is covered in pale peach, cream, and pinkish square tiles, with Gothic-inspired details along the roofline: pointed arches, small circular blue accents, decorative columns, and a small turret topped with a blue spire. The windows are tall and arched, framed in beige trim, with teal-blue glass and matching teal railings. Along the lower level are dark green awnings and kiosk-like counters with decorative panels labeled “Venezia,” suggesting an Italian/Venetian theme.

In front of this building stand several tall golden poles topped with giant crown-shaped decorations. Beneath each crown hangs a dense, upside-down cone of silver tinsel, resembling inverted Christmas trees. These are heavily decorated with shiny ornaments in silver, blue, purple, and white, along with strands of beads. The gold crowns have colorful jewel-like circles around their rims, giving the decorations a royal, fantasy-like appearance.

On the left side is a theater building with a classical façade: columns, a triangular pediment, brick walls, and a dark domed roof. Large red signage on the front reads “Live HOLOGRAM THEATER.” Near the theater entrance are posters, ticket signs, and several colorful character statues or mascots. A small group of visitors stands in the lower-left corner, bundled in coats, emphasizing that the area is mostly empty and likely photographed during a cool season or early in the day.

Behind the theater and extending across the left background is a large painted or printed scenic backdrop resembling a Mediterranean hillside town. It shows cream-colored buildings with red-tile roofs climbing a green hillside, with a large fortress-like structure at the top. This backdrop blends into the themed street, creating the illusion of a distant European cityscape.

The ground is a smooth, wide pedestrian walkway in muted blue-gray tones, with lots of open space and very few people. The sky is pale and overcast, giving the scene soft, diffuse lighting. Overall, the image has a whimsical theme-park atmosphere, combining Venetian-style architecture, theatrical façades, fantasy decorations, and holiday ornamentation.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示主题公园入口区域的照片，具有童话风格的建筑和装饰。在前景中，我们看到几个装饰华丽的路灯柱，上面挂有金色的皇冠形状装饰品，并且灯柱顶部装有发光的LED灯。这些灯柱排列在一条宽阔的人行道上，街道两旁是色彩鲜艳的商店和餐厅。背景中是一座模仿城堡的建筑物，其设计与前景中的建筑相呼应，增添了整个场景的奇幻氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunny coastal scene with a rocky shoreline in the foreground and a row of low, white seaside buildings behind it.

In the foreground, the coast is made up of rugged, uneven rocks in warm tones—rusty red, tan, gray, and off-white. Some of the rocks appear porous and weathered, with patches of dried seaweed or dark organic material spread across them. At the bottom right, clear shallow seawater laps against the rocks, reflecting blue and green tones.

Beyond the rocks is a band of Mediterranean-looking vegetation: low shrubs, silvery-green plants, grasses, and small yellow wildflowers. The vegetation grows densely in places, forming a natural barrier between the shore and the buildings.

Across the middle of the image is a long, white wall or row of beach huts/garages. The doors are painted bright turquoise-blue, creating a strong contrast with the white walls. Each door appears to have small decorative square details or vents near the top. Along the upper edge of the wall is a long inscription in red capital letters, resembling Latin; visible fragments include phrases such as “SIT FAVSTA,” “LABITVR,” “OMNES,” “VLTIMA,” and “NECAT.” The lettering runs continuously across the façade, separated by dots.

Several tall palm trees rise behind and in front of the white wall, spaced across the scene. Their slender gray trunks and green fronds give the area a warm, coastal, Mediterranean or island atmosphere. Some palms have full crowns while others look slightly wind-worn, with drooping or dry fronds.

Behind the wall are white houses or villas with flat or low-pitched roofs. One central building has a tiled roof partially covered by greenery or vines, while another larger white building on the right has wooden shutters and a clean, bright façade. Darker green trees and shrubs form a backdrop behind the buildings.

The sky takes up much of the upper half of the image. It is pale blue with thin, diffuse clouds, giving the scene a bright but slightly hazy daylight quality. Overall, the image feels quiet and seaside-residential, with a mix of natural rocky coast, tropical palms, and whitewashed architecture accented by vivid blue doors.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海岸线景观的自然风光摄影图片。前景是岩石和植被覆盖的地面，中景是几棵高耸的棕榈树，背景则是排列整齐的蓝色门面建筑，这些建筑上有白色的装饰文字。整个场景被一片晴朗的天空所笼罩，阳光照耀下，色彩鲜明且生动。

caption:
The image shows a busy tropical street scene, viewed from behind traffic and pedestrians. The road is narrow and slightly worn, with vehicles moving slowly in both directions.

In the center-left foreground is the rear of an old yellow/orange school-bus-style vehicle with its red brake lights illuminated. The bus has rounded rear windows, faded paint, and a sign near the top that appears to reference a resort or transportation service.
