To its left, partly hidden, is a large white coach bus coming from the opposite direction or parked along the side. In the center foreground, a silver Kia sedan is stopped or moving slowly, also with its rear lights on. Other vehicles, including a dark car and a white van, are visible farther ahead and along the right side.

On the right side of the street, several pedestrians walk away from the camera. A man in a white T-shirt and red shorts walks near the road’s edge, while another person in a black shirt walks beside a woman in a white top and shorts. The woman appears to be pulling or pushing luggage, suggesting tourists or travelers. Near the center-right, a motorcyclist wearing a helmet is positioned between the cars.

The setting feels warm and tropical. Tall palm trees and dense green foliage line the street, and a large bougainvillea bush covered in bright magenta-pink flowers dominates the right side of the frame. On the left, behind the vehicles, there is a thatched-roof structure, possibly part of a resort, restaurant, or beachside building. Utility poles and overhead wires run through the scene.

The lighting is soft and warm, likely late afternoon or early evening, giving the image a relaxed vacation-town atmosphere despite the congestion. The overall impression is of a lively resort or coastal area with buses, tourists, cars, motorcycles, tropical plants, and colorful flowers all crowded into a narrow street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常城市街道生活的照片，画面中心有一辆黄色的校车停在路边，车上写着'JAY'字样。旁边是一辆银色轿车和一辆黑色摩托车。在街道上，有三个人物：一个穿着白色T恤和红色短裤的年轻人正从右侧走来；一对年轻夫妇站在左侧，男子身穿灰色T恤和深色裤子，女子穿着浅蓝色无袖上衣和黑色短裤，他们似乎正在交谈或等待过马路；还有一个小女孩推着婴儿车站在他们旁边。周围环境由绿色植被、粉色花朵和棕榈树组成，营造出一种热带地区的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, upward-looking view of a grand neoclassical stone structure, likely an entrance or monument at Hyde Park Corner in London. The perspective is dramatic, looking up from near ground level, which makes the building’s tall columns and heavy stone blocks appear imposing.

On the right side, a rectangular stone archway or gateway is visible, with the words “HYDE PARK CORNER” carved into the horizontal stone lintel. The lettering is partially shadowed and weathered, blending into the pale gray stone. The stone surfaces show age, with dark streaks, stains, small chips, and patches of discoloration.

In the foreground, ornate green-painted iron gates run across the lower portion of the image. The gates have decorative spear-like finials at the top and intricate scrolling floral patterns below, giving them a historic, ceremonial appearance. The green color stands out strongly against the pale stone.

To the left, the main building façade features tall classical columns with fluted shafts and decorative capitals. Above them are detailed cornices and friezes, including rows of carved ornamental patterns. The underside of the portico is visible, showing darker, shadowed stone panels and signs of weathering. The architecture includes scroll-like Ionic details and layered moldings, emphasizing the classical style.

The sky in the background is bright blue with only a few faint clouds, and sunlight strikes the stone from the right, creating strong highlights and shadows. Overall, the image conveys the grandeur and age of a historic London landmark, combining monumental stone architecture with elegant green ironwork.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Hyde Park Corner建筑入口的摄影图像。图像中心是一个装饰性的绿色铁栅栏，其上方是建筑物的白色立柱和墙面，上面刻有'HYDE PARK CORNER'的字样。阳光照射下，建筑细节清晰可见，背景中蓝天与建筑形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a close-up street-side scene centered on a person sitting next to or working on a motorcycle/scooter.

In the foreground, a person is seated in profile facing right. Their face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial details. They are wearing a dark mesh baseball cap with a curved brim, and some curly dark hair with gray strands is visible beneath it. They have on a long-sleeved gray textured shirt with faint lettering and a small graphic on the chest. Their hands are visible near the lower right, resting on or handling a black curved motorcycle part, possibly part of the wheel or bodywork. The hands look dusty or dirty, suggesting mechanical work or outdoor labor.

To the right of the person is a black scooter or motorcycle, very close to the camera. The seat is large, black, and textured, stretching across the middle-right of the frame. Below it, the side panel is glossy black with red angular graphics and the number “125” visible. A rear suspension spring and parts of the bike frame can be seen near the bottom right. Another motorcycle is partially visible behind the person on the left, with dark bodywork and red accents.

The background is out of focus, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect. It appears to be an urban or residential street. Across the road there are walls and buildings, including a pink-toned building and yellow-and-white wall sections. A parked car is visible on the far left, and another motorcycle with a person nearby appears on the far right background. Trees and utility poles add to the street setting.

The overall mood is candid and documentary-like, with natural daylight and muted colors. The composition emphasizes the person and the motorcycle work area, while the blurred background gives context without distracting from the foreground subject.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男性在户外修理摩托车的现实主义风格照片。他戴着一顶灰色棒球帽，穿着一件带有文字图案的灰色长袖衫，正在专注地检查或修理摩托车的前轮。背景中可以看到停放的摩托车和一些模糊的建筑物，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a historic riverside cityscape, likely Cologne, Germany, along the Rhine River.

In the foreground and lower right, the Rhine River fills much of the scene, its surface textured with small waves and reflecting greenish-gray tones. Several riverboats and passenger ferries are docked along the quay. A gangway with a visible “KD” logo leads down toward a mooring area, suggesting a tourist or sightseeing boat terminal. On the far right, a white passenger vessel is tied up near the riverbank.

Along the river’s edge, a broad promenade runs parallel to the water. It is busy with many pedestrians—tourists and locals—walking in small groups, standing near the railings, and gathering by the boat landings. A line of leafy green trees shades parts of the walkway, and their spring-green foliage contrasts with the stone embankment and the water. Near the center bottom is a small cylindrical white structure marked “PEGEL,” likely a river level gauge building.

To the left, a cluster of old-town buildings with steep gabled roofs lines the waterfront. The façades are mostly light-colored—white, cream, pale gray—with some darker timber-framed or brick details. Their pitched roofs and narrow profiles give the area a traditional European character. Green parkland and trees occupy the lower-left corner, adding a soft, natural foreground.

Rising behind the old town are two prominent church landmarks. On the left-center, the dark, twin spires of Cologne Cathedral dominate the skyline. The spires are tall, intricate, and Gothic, with pointed pinnacles and elaborate stonework, appearing almost black against the bright sky. Slightly to the right stands the Romanesque church of Great St. Martin, with a large central tower capped by a steep gray roof and four smaller corner turrets. Its lighter stone façade and rounded arches distinguish it from the cathedral’s darker Gothic silhouette.

On the right side of the image, a large arched steel bridge spans the Rhine. Its pale green-gray metal framework stretches across the river, connecting the city center to the opposite bank. Beyond the bridge and river are modern buildings and distant urban structures, including a few taller blocks and rooftops.

The sky occupies a large portion of the image and is bright blue with dramatic white and gray cumulus clouds. Sunlight illuminates the buildings, trees, and promenade, creating a lively daytime atmosphere. Overall, the scene combines historic architecture, river traffic, tourists, greenery, and expansive sky, presenting a vivid view of Cologne’s old town waterfront.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸景观的现实主义风格照片。图像前景是河岸边的人行道，上面有散步和休息的人们，以及一些树木和建筑物。中景显示了河流上的桥梁，桥上有行人和车辆正在通过。背景中，可以看到一座高耸的哥特式教堂塔楼和其他建筑，它们构成了城市的天际线。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其中。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny Mediterranean-style street scene under a large expanse of deep blue sky. Most of the frame is filled with sky, with scattered small, wispy white clouds concentrated toward the middle and lower portions.

Along the bottom third of the image is a row of pale stone buildings. The architecture looks historic, with light beige and cream-colored masonry, weathered surfaces, and traditional shuttered windows. On the right, a prominent corner building has a patterned stone façade made of rectangular blocks, vivid blue shutters, white-framed windows, and a small blue-painted balcony with decorative metal railings. Some windows have arched brick detailing above them in red and white. The roofline includes antennas, poles, and a small dome-like structure with a bright turquoise-blue top, adding to the coastal Mediterranean feel.

To the left are older, more worn stone buildings with faded shutters and rougher, aged façades. At street level, there are café or restaurant terraces with awnings, outdoor tables, and white chairs. A few people are visible walking or sitting near the cafés, giving the scene a relaxed urban atmosphere.

In the foreground near the center stands a large palm tree with a thick textured trunk and broad green fronds spreading outward. Beneath and around it are café seating areas, umbrellas, signs, and small street fixtures. A bus stop or sheltered bench area appears on the right side of the foreground, with a person seated inside. A turquoise umbrella or kiosk canopy is partially visible at the far right.

The bottom of the image shows a paved road running horizontally across the scene, separated from the sidewalk by a curb. There are street posts, a traffic cone near the lower edge, and a few traffic signs, including a red circular no-entry or restriction sign near the café area. The lighting is strong and warm, casting clear shadows and emphasizing the bright blue shutters, pale stone buildings, and vibrant sky. Overall, the scene feels like a coastal town square or waterfront street on a clear summer day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，画面中心有一棵茂盛的棕榈树，其旁边是一个带有蓝色百叶窗和白色栏杆的建筑。建筑物前有一个开放式的咖啡馆，顾客们坐在户外座位上享受阳光。街道上有一辆停靠的汽车和几个行人，其中一个行人在路边行走。背景中可以看到更多的建筑物和一个蓝天白云的晴朗天空。

caption:
The image shows a large, ornate Eastern Orthodox-style church photographed on a bright sunny day. The building is predominantly white with deep red trim and decorative accents, creating a strong contrast against the vivid blue, cloudless sky.

The church has multiple rounded and arched architectural forms. On the left side is a square bell tower with tall arched openings fitted with dark louvers. Above it, a metal cross rises from a small dome-like finial. On the right side, a taller cylindrical or octagonal dome tower dominates the roofline. It has narrow vertical arched windows, red columns between the white wall sections, and a greenish metal dome topped with another cross.

The façade is richly decorated with repeated arches, circular windows, and layered molding. Red bands run horizontally around the building, while red outlines emphasize the arches and columns. Several small circular windows with red-and-white frames are visible along the side walls. The roof sections are curved and stepped, with green metal coverings on some lower rounded roof areas. Small religious cross motifs appear near the tops of arches, and there are decorative reliefs or icons above some entrances.

In the lower foreground, there is a partially built or unfinished gray concrete block wall, with hollow cinder blocks visible along the top. Behind it is a taller stone retaining wall made of irregular tan and gray stones. A paved road or driveway runs along the very front of the scene.

To the left and behind the church, dense green trees cover a hillside, suggesting the church is located in a semi-rural or hillside setting. The sunlight is strong and direct, casting crisp shadows on the church’s white walls and highlighting the red trim and sculptural details. The overall impression is of a recently maintained or restored religious building with striking Byzantine/Orthodox architectural features.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有传统欧洲风格的教堂的照片。教堂以白色为主色调，装饰有红色的线条和圆顶，其上方装有一个十字架。教堂前有一排整齐的石块，而背景则是蓝天和树木。

caption:
The image shows a wall-mounted liquid soap or sanitizer dispenser attached to a light cream-colored, textured wall.

The dispenser is mostly white plastic with a glossy finish and a tall, narrow, rounded rectangular shape. On both the left and right sides are transparent smoky-gray plastic reservoirs, allowing the liquid level inside to be seen. These clear panels appear scratched, scuffed, and slightly cloudy, suggesting the dispenser has been used for a while. There is some dark residue or remaining liquid visible near the bottom of the reservoirs.

The center front section is a solid white vertical panel. Near the upper-middle part of this panel is a small circular button or decorative circular indentation. Toward the lower front is a small triangular/rounded viewing window, also transparent, likely used to check the soap level. Beneath it, the brand name “CASTELLI” is printed in dark letters.

At the bottom front, there is a protruding white push lever or pump button with rounded edges. This is likely pressed inward to dispense soap or sanitizer from the unit. The lower housing curves outward slightly, giving the dispenser a rounded base.

The lighting is soft and natural, with mild reflections on the glossy plastic surfaces. The overall condition of the dispenser appears functional but somewhat worn, with visible scratches, smudges, and discoloration on the transparent side panels.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在墙面上的皂液分配器的照片。皂液分配器是白色的，顶部有一个透明的盖子和一个圆形的开关按钮。分配器上印有品牌标识“CASTELLI”。背景为浅色墙面，整体光线均匀，没有明显的阴影或反射。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, picturesque stone village lane with an old rustic building dominating the left and center of the scene. The building is long and low, constructed from irregularly shaped stones in warm gray, tan, and reddish-brown tones. Its steep pitched roof is covered in weathered orange-brown tiles, but much of the roof is heavily overgrown with lush green moss and fern-like vegetation, giving it an aged, almost fairytale quality. The roof texture is especially striking: rows of tiles peek through the dense greenery, with patches of lichen and moss creating a mottled, natural pattern.

On the front of the building are white-painted doors and shutters, which contrast sharply with the rough stone walls. A large white double door sits near the center, and smaller white doors and windows continue along the façade. Thin vines and climbing plants grow up the wall around the doors, adding more greenery and softening the hard stone surfaces. White drainpipes run vertically and horizontally along the building, following the edge of the roof.

At the far left, a small entrance with glass-paned doors is set into the gable end of the stone building. Stone steps and a narrow path lead up to it, bordered by low greenery and small plants. A dark evergreen tree branch partially frames the left side of the image, adding depth.

To the right of the building, the road curves gently through a stone gateway. The gateway is made of the same rough, weathered stone and features two rounded arches, one larger and one smaller. Moss and lichen cover parts of the stones, emphasizing the age of the structure. Beyond the arches, a sandy path and hints of more garden or village space are visible. A small trash bin stands near the base of the gateway.

The lane itself is pale and smooth, with darker damp patches scattered across it, suggesting recent rain. Along the left side of the road is a narrow sandy walkway bordered by a line of rounded cobblestones. On the right edge of the image, a high stone wall runs toward the foreground, topped and surrounded by plants, including long green leaves and small flowering groundcover.

In the background, there are leafless trees and dense shrubs, indicating a cool season such as autumn or winter. The sky is overcast with thick gray clouds, casting soft, diffused light over the scene. The overall atmosphere is calm, historic, and slightly damp, with a strong sense of age and rural charm.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一座古老石屋的摄影作品，石屋的屋顶覆盖着绿色植物，墙面和门上爬满了藤蔓。房屋位于一条蜿蜒的小路上，旁边是一座拱形石桥，连接着两侧的石墙。小路两旁是茂密的树木和灌木丛，而天空中布满厚重的云层，给整个场景增添了一种历史沉淀的感觉。

caption:
The image shows an urban street scene outside a large bus terminal or transit building. The building dominates the background, with a long, pale mint-green/turquoise facade and dark lettering in both Arabic and English. On the left side of the facade, the English words “BUS TERMINAL” are partially visible, while large Arabic text spans the upper and middle portions of the structure.

The architecture has a slightly older, functional look: broad horizontal concrete bands, recessed shaded walkways, large window panels, and brown vertical columns near the entrance area. The upper level has an overhanging roof or canopy, creating a shaded balcony-like space underneath. The warm sunlight gives the scene a golden tone, suggesting late afternoon or early evening.

In the foreground, several pedestrians are walking near the curb and sidewalk. One man in a striped shirt walks toward the camera, while another person with a backpack walks away toward the terminal. A few other people stand or move near the building entrance. Some faces appear blurred or out of focus due to depth of field.

Several street poles and traffic signs are visible, including circular signs seen from the back, a red-and-white “no entry” sign on the left, and tall metal lamp or sign poles in the foreground. A red car is partially visible on the left side of the street. The curb is painted in alternating yellow and white, and the road and sidewalk areas appear clean and orderly.

Overall, the image captures a busy but calm transit area, with people moving around a bus terminal in warm urban light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的现实主义风格照片，画面中心有一栋具有中东特色的建筑，其外墙装饰有阿拉伯文字。在建筑前的人行道上，可以看到几位行人正在行走，包括一位穿着红色衣服的男性和一位背着背包的女性。阳光从左侧照射下来，给整个场景增添了一种温暖而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy airport departure area, likely inside Singapore Changi Airport, with several large overhead electronic flight information displays dominating the upper half of the scene.

Across the ceiling, multiple rectangular departure boards hang in a row, angled slightly downward for travelers to read. The boards are color-coded by terminal: blue boards for “Terminal 1 Departures,” yellow/green boards for “Terminal 2 Departures,” and red boards for “Terminal 3 Departures.” Each screen lists flight times, destinations, airlines, flight numbers, gates, and remarks such as “Gate Closing,” “Gate Open,” “Boarding,” “Delayed,” and “Re-timed.” Visible destinations include places such as Phuket, Semarang, Shenzhen, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Jakarta, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Penang, Kolkata, Dubai, Hanoi, Bali, and others. The date shown on the boards appears to be “13 Jan 2017,” with the time around 15:07.

The airport interior has a cool, modern look, with blue-tinted lighting reflecting off glass walls and a metallic ceiling. The ceiling panels are long and ribbed, with recessed lights and vents. Behind the travelers, large glass partitions and windows allow bright daylight to flood the space, giving the image a cyan-blue glow.

The lower half of the image is filled with passengers waiting, walking, and checking their phones. Some people are standing beneath the departure boards, looking down at phones or holding luggage, while others sit in rows of airport chairs in the background. Several travelers have backpacks, rolling suitcases, tote bags, and duffel bags. A man near the center stands with a backpack and a phone in his hand; another person nearby wears a cap and stands with luggage at his feet. On the right, a group of travelers stands with bags, including a person in a bright pink top and scarf holding or carrying a large yellow-brown tote. Another traveler holds a takeaway coffee cup beside a rolling suitcase.

In the foreground on the left, a woman stands near a red suitcase while looking at her phone, carrying a large white shopping bag and wearing a backpack. Around the seating area, passengers appear relaxed or tired, with bags placed on the floor around them. The carpet has a patterned design in warm beige, brown, and muted red tones, contrasting with the cool blue lighting overhead.

Overall, the scene captures the atmosphere of an international airport departure hall: bright, crowded, organized, and full of travelers monitoring flight information, waiting for boarding, or moving toward their gates.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙机场候机区的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是多个显示航班信息的电子显示屏，屏幕上列出了不同的航班和到达时间。在显示屏下方，可以看到多位旅客正在等待或坐着休息，他们中的一些人正在使用手机或其他电子设备。整个场景充满了旅行者的忙碌氛围，体现了现代航空旅行的一个典型瞬间。

caption:
The image shows a rustic, old-fashioned interior room, likely in a traditional or historic house. The space has a warm, antique atmosphere, dominated by natural wood, embroidered textiles, and vintage furniture.

The ceiling is made of exposed wooden beams and planks, darkened with age and arranged in a grid-like structure. Hanging from the center is an ornate suspended lamp with a bright green glass shade and decorative brass-colored metalwork, giving the room a distinctive vintage character. A small modern-looking ceiling fixture or detector is also visible on the ceiling, contrasting with the otherwise traditional setting.

The walls are plain and light-colored, possibly whitewashed plaster, which helps brighten the room despite the dark wood. On the left side is a large wooden wardrobe with carved decorative details and a polished brown finish. Near the back wall, a window with wooden frames lets in soft daylight. The window is dressed with sheer white curtains decorated with red embroidery and geometric folk patterns; the curtains are tied back, allowing light to enter.

In the center of the room stands a small round or oval table covered with a white lace or embroidered tablecloth with fringe. On top of it is a dark metal candelabrum with multiple arms. Beneath the table lies a woven rug with muted gray and beige geometric patterns, adding texture to the wide-plank wooden floor.

At the back right is a dark wooden dresser or vanity with an oval mirror framed in carved wood. On or near it are decorative items, including a white ceramic pitcher and a basin, suggesting an old washstand setup. A small cloth with similar red-and-white folk embroidery is draped nearby, matching the curtains.

On the right edge of the image, part of a doorway or wooden partition is visible, framing the view into the room. In the foreground to the right, there is a wooden chair with a red patterned upholstered seat, partially cut off by the frame. A dark curved piece of furniture, possibly another chair or stove-like object, sits near the right wall.

The floor consists of wide, weathered wooden boards, emphasizing the age and rural character of the room. Overall, the image presents a carefully preserved traditional interior, with folk textiles, antique wooden furniture, and a cozy, museum-like historic ambiance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统风格室内环境的照片。房间内部装饰着木制家具和复古灯具，营造出一种温馨而古典的氛围。一张木质餐桌位于房间中央，上面铺有白色桌布，并摆放着一些餐具。对面是一个带有红色花纹窗帘的窗户，窗台上放着一个绿色台灯。房间的一侧有一把高背椅，旁边是一个带抽屉的木制衣柜。墙上挂着一幅画作，而地板上铺着一块图案复杂的地毯。整个场景通过柔和的自然光照亮，给人一种宁静舒适的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a covered outdoor café or seaside restaurant patio with a strong nautical/fishing theme.

The space is enclosed by deep blue vertical wooden paneling, giving it a coastal cabin feel. Across the ceiling are blue beams with translucent corrugated panels that let in soft daylight. Wooden planks run along the top edges of the ceiling structure. The floor is paved with reddish-brown brick tiles.

Several square tables with light, wood-grain or wicker-patterned tops are arranged throughout the seating area. Around them are many matching wicker café chairs with rounded backs and curved arms, supported by pale yellow-green metal or bamboo-like frames. The seating is empty, and the arrangement suggests a casual dining terrace.

The back wall is decorated with maritime objects and painted cutouts. On the left, a large fishing net hangs from a wooden pole, with a painted blue fish attached in front of it. Nearby is a vertical white pipe or chimney with a darker curved pipe leading upward near the ceiling. A small framed painting of a boat at sea hangs on the wall.

In the center-right, there is a large decorative mural or cutout scene showing fishermen and seafood. It includes painted figures in white and blue clothing, stacked fish crates, rows of orange fish hanging or displayed, and a grill or smoking rack. One figure has “Christian” written on the clothing, and another has “Hans” written on the chest. The faces are stylized and blurred-looking as part of the decoration.

To the right, a large triangular maritime flag or pennant is mounted diagonally on the wall. It is mainly dark blue with yellow and red sections, and a small striped emblem near the hoist. Painted fish cutouts appear on both sides of the flag, reinforcing the seafood theme.

There are several wall-mounted lamps or heaters along the blue wall—small metal fixtures with rounded shades—and two long rectangular heater-like units near the ceiling. On the far left edge, part of a yellow-trimmed window or doorway is visible, contrasting brightly with the blue walls.

Overall, the image depicts a cozy, colorful seaside café terrace decorated with fishing nets, fish illustrations, boat imagery, and fisherman-themed artwork, creating a relaxed coastal dining atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室外餐厅区域的照片，其中包含木质桌椅和蓝色墙面。墙上挂着几幅描绘海洋主题的画作，包括一个穿着传统渔民服装的人物和一些海鲜罐头。在画面右侧，有一面飘扬的彩色旗帜，增添了一丝活泼的气息。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种温馨而放松的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a busy Apple Store, likely inside a mall or shopping center. A large, glowing white Apple logo hangs prominently near the top center of the image, suspended in front of a dark metallic storefront beam. The store has Apple’s typical minimalist design: clean lines, neutral gray tones, bright lighting, and uncluttered display areas.

The ceiling is covered with long, parallel strip lights running horizontally across the store, creating an evenly lit, modern atmosphere. Large square gray columns stand throughout the space, dividing the open retail floor. Along the back wall are display panels and promotional graphics, including colorful Apple-related signage and large product images, such as iPads and other devices.

Several wooden display tables stretch across the store floor, holding rows of Apple products—likely iPhones, Apple Watches, iPads, and accessories. On the right side, a long table appears to display multiple small devices in a neat line, possibly Apple Watches or iPhones. Toward the left and back, shelves contain boxed accessories or cases.

The foreground is crowded with customers waiting in a queue formed by black stanchions and belt barriers. Many people are wearing face masks, suggesting a health-conscious or post-pandemic retail environment. Some customers carry backpacks, handbags, or shopping bags. A person near the center foreground wears a black backpack and cap, while another nearby has a black Nike drawstring bag. On the right, a staff member or customer in a green outfit stands near the queue holding a device or paper.

Apple employees are visible in dark blue shirts, assisting customers and managing the flow of people. One employee near the center-left appears to be standing behind a small check-in or service station. Another employee is partially visible on the far right in a bright blue shirt.

Overall, the scene feels active and organized, with customers lined up for service or entry while employees help manage the store. The combination of the glowing Apple logo, sleek architecture, display tables, and busy crowd clearly identifies the location as an Apple retail store.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Apple Store内部的照片，顾客们在商店的入口处排队等待进入。照片中的人群穿着休闲服装，有的背着背包，有的戴着口罩。商店内部装饰现代简约，墙壁上挂有苹果公司的标志和一些宣传海报。

caption:
The image shows the front entrance of a public building or transit-related facility. At the top, a large white signboard displays the words **“Selamat Datang”** in big blue cursive letters, meaning “Welcome” in Malay.

Below the sign is a glass-fronted entrance with sliding or hinged glass doors. The windows and doors are covered with large decals and logos, including **“UTC Pahang”** and references to **Pusat Transformasi Bandar**. A smaller sign near the upper middle glass panel shows the logo and text for **Majlis Perbandaran Kuantan** / **Kuantan Municipal Council**, suggesting this is a public service center or municipal facility in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia.

The building façade has a modern look, with blue-tinted glass panels on both sides and metal framing. The entrance is reached by a set of wide gray steps, with a ramp and metal handrail visible on the right side. Inside the glass entrance, there are striped blinds or frosted horizontal bands on the windows, and a red-and-blue service counter or kiosk is visible on the left interior side.

Several people are in front of the entrance. A few adults stand near the doors, some appearing to wait or talk. On the right, a man walks up the steps while a small child in an orange shirt follows nearby. Another person is entering or standing near the ramp on the far right. A woman wearing a headscarf stands close to the doorway holding a bag. The faces appear blurred or indistinct.

In the foreground, an orange-and-white traffic cone stands on the paved walkway. On the far left, part of a red-and-white recycling or waste bin is visible, with text and icons including **“PLASTIK / PLASTIC.”** The scene is brightly lit by daylight, with strong shadows on the steps and pavement, suggesting a sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一家名为'Selamat Datang'的商店入口的照片。商店位于一个现代化的建筑内，其玻璃门上贴有蓝色和白色的广告牌。几位顾客正在通过玻璃门进入或离开商店，其中一位穿着黑色衣服的男性正引导着一个小男孩，而另一位女性则站在门口等待。商店外有一个橙色的交通锥，指示着安全区域。

caption:
The image shows a flat-lay arrangement of music and audio-related items on a rustic wooden tabletop with a reddish-brown, heavily grained texture.

On the left side, there is a black smartphone placed diagonally, with its top angled toward the upper left and its bottom toward the lower center. The phone screen is bright blue and displays the word “Calm” in large, white, handwritten-style script, suggesting the Calm meditation or relaxation app. The phone has a dark bezel and a visible notch at the top.

Around the phone are two white wireless earbuds. One earbud sits near the bottom-left corner, partly cropped by the edge of the image. Another single earbud is near the center, above the phone and between the phone and the tuner. Both earbuds are glossy white, resembling in-ear Bluetooth earbuds.

On the right side is a black electronic metronome and tuner, angled slightly. It is labeled “musedo METRONOME & TUNER MT-40” across the top. The device has several gray buttons on the left side, including buttons marked with a power symbol, “M/T,” and a musical note icon. On the right side are up and down arrow buttons. The display glows orange and shows tuner markings, including “Tuner,” “Metronome,” note indicators, cent markings from -50 to +50, and a large “460 Hz” reading. Small red and green indicator lights appear above the display, suggesting tuning feedback.

Scattered across the lower and middle-right area are several black guitar picks. They are triangular with rounded corners and gold lettering that reads “Ibanez SAND GRIP,” with “MEDIUM JAPAN” printed near the bottom. The picks have a textured, sand-like surface and are arranged loosely, with one near the center, two along the lower middle, and another partially visible on the far lower right.

The overall scene has a warm, music-practice atmosphere: a tuning/metronome device, guitar picks, earbuds, and a phone with a calming app all placed on a textured wooden background. The contrast between the modern electronics, white earbuds, black accessories, and the rustic wood gives the image a cozy, creative feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示音乐设备和配件的摄影图片。在木质桌面上，有一部智能手机屏幕显示着'Calm'字样，旁边是一个便携式调音器，其显示屏上清晰地显示着45.0赫兹的频率。手机下方散落着几个吉他拨片，其中两个是黑色的，一个带有黄色边缘，而一个则是白色的。此外，还有一对白色耳机放置在调音器旁边。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a computer screen being viewed through a magnifying glass. The magnifying lens dominates the center of the image, enlarging part of a web browser page for “Hitachi Global.”

Inside the magnified area, a browser tab shows the title “Hitachi Global” with a small circular site icon to the left. Below it are typical browser navigation controls: a back arrow, a refresh/reload icon, a bookmark-like icon, and a padlock icon near the address bar, indicating a secure website. Part of the URL area is visible, ending with “.com.”

The webpage itself shows the Hitachi corporate branding. The large black “HITACHI” logo appears prominently, with the slogan “Inspire the Next” underneath. A thin red horizontal line runs across the page just above the logo area. Below that, a dark/black navigation section is visible with white text, including “Corporate Information,” and partially visible menu items such as “News Releases” and “Investor Rela…”

The magnifying glass creates a circular enlarged region with a soft, darker rim around the edge. Its black handle or frame crosses diagonally from the upper left toward the center. Outside the lens, the browser and webpage appear blurred and less legible. The screen’s pixel structure is visible throughout, giving the image a textured, electronic display look.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张通过放大镜拍摄的电脑屏幕截图，显示了Hitachi Global网站的首页。在放大镜的中心位置，可以看到' Hitachi Global '的标题和'Inspire the Next'的标语，以及一个红色的图标。网站的导航栏清晰可见，包括'Corporate Information'、'Investor Relations'等选项。整个场景被放大镜聚焦，使得网页上的文字和图像细节更加突出。

caption:
The image shows a broad urban square in a European city, likely Berlin’s Alexanderplatz area, on a clear day with bright blue sky. The scene is framed by tall commercial buildings on both sides, creating a wide corridor that opens toward the center.

In the foreground, a large paved plaza stretches across the bottom of the image. The paving stones are arranged in rectangular patterns, and the low sunlight creates warm golden reflections and long shadows on the slightly glossy surface. The space feels open and pedestrian-oriented, with scattered people walking, standing, or waiting around the square.

On the right side, a red tram is stopped or moving slowly along tracks embedded in the pavement. Overhead, a dense network of tram power lines and support poles crosses the scene diagonally, adding an intricate web of cables above the street. The tram’s bright red color stands out strongly against the neutral tones of the buildings and pavement. Nearby, pedestrians gather along the edge of the tram stop area.

Also on the right is a large building with a beige and stone-like facade, many rectangular windows, and a ground-level storefront area. A blue sign reading “POLIZEI” marks a police station entrance. Above and behind it, part of a large red sign with the letters “ALEX” is visible, suggesting the name of a nearby shopping or commercial complex. A modern glass-and-white building sits farther back, with large window panels and clean contemporary lines.

In the center-left of the square is a cylindrical information or event display column with a circular band of numbers and text around it. Above it rises a sculptural metal framework with looping rods and small globe-like elements, resembling a public clock or urban installation. Several bicycles are parked near the base of this structure, forming a cluster in the middle of the scene.

Behind the column, a red-brick tower with a clock face is visible, topped by a small spire and a flag. This older architectural element contrasts with the modern glass and concrete buildings surrounding it. Nearby signage includes a vertical “RATHAUS” sign on a building, adding to the civic and commercial atmosphere of the area.

On the left side, a large building with a grid of windows and a glassy lower facade borders the plaza. At street level, there appear to be shopfronts or café areas, with a few people standing or seated nearby. The left edge of the scene is partly shaded, while the central and right areas are more brightly lit.

Overall, the image captures a lively but not overcrowded city square with pedestrians, bicycles, tram infrastructure, shops, civic buildings, and a mix of historic and modern architecture. The clear weather, open space, and visible public transit give the scene a busy metropolitan feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一辆红色的有轨电车正驶过一个宽敞的广场，周围停满了自行车和行人。广场上的人们似乎正在享受晴朗天气下的休闲时光。两侧是现代建筑，其中一些建筑顶部装饰着灯饰。远处可以看到更多的建筑物和蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a wide, dusty roadway at what appears to be a controlled industrial or border-area checkpoint, photographed in low evening light.

In the center foreground is a large white Volvo FH16 cargo truck facing the camera at a slight angle. The truck has a tall cab with red and amber warning lights mounted on the roof. The front windshield area has “NAFCO” written in several places, and the front panel has large Arabic writing, along with “VOLVO” branding and decorative eye-like graphics. Attached behind the cab is a long, high-sided white cargo trailer with vertical ribbing.

The road is unpaved or heavily dust-covered, with tire tracks and scattered debris along the edges. On the left side, a long line of large concrete blast barriers forms a wall. The barriers are weathered, cracked, and stained, with exposed wire or rebar loops visible along the tops. A metal utility pole rises behind them, with power lines stretching diagonally across the pale sky.

Several men stand near the barriers to the left of the truck, some grouped together and others standing separately. They appear to be waiting or watching the truck pass. Their clothing is casual and dark-toned.

On the right side of the image, there is a small checkpoint or guard booth-like structure with Arabic writing on it. Near it, more people are gathered, some wearing reflective vests. Behind them are additional trucks, including an orange truck and a darker truck with text visible on its front. A concrete block in the near right foreground has blue Arabic writing painted on it and appears to serve as a barricade.

The lighting suggests late afternoon or early evening, with a pale sky and warm light near the horizon. The overall atmosphere is dusty, utilitarian, and controlled, with heavy vehicles, concrete barriers, people waiting, and checkpoint infrastructure dominating the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黄昏时分的街道场景的照片，一辆大型卡车停在道路中央，车身上有阿拉伯文和英文标识。几位行人站在卡车旁边，似乎在等待或交谈。背景中可以看到一堵高高的混凝土墙，上面有电线杆和一些模糊的建筑结构。天空呈现出淡蓝色到橙色的渐变，暗示着日落即将来临。

caption:
The image shows the grand exterior façade of a large bullring, identified by the prominent tiled sign near the top reading “PLAZA DE TOROS,” with “AÑO 1929” above it. The building appears to be the Plaza de Toros de Las Ventas in Madrid, recognizable by its red-brick Neo-Mudéjar/Moorish Revival architecture.

The façade is richly decorated with patterned brickwork, horseshoe arches, geometric reliefs, and colorful ceramic tile panels in blue, white, green, and yellow. A large central arched entrance dominates the lower middle of the image, set within an ornate frame of mosaic tilework. Above it are balconies and smaller arched openings, including a deep recessed arch supported by columns. The upper sections include crenellated parapets, decorative towers, and symmetrical architectural details. A small flag is visible flying from the roofline.

On both lower sides of the façade, tiled signs read “DESPACHO DE BILLETES,” indicating ticket offices. Posters are mounted near the bottom of the building, likely advertising bullfighting events.

The scene is busy at street level: a large crowd of people is gathered and walking across the plaza in front of the bullring. The people are dressed casually, many in shirts, jackets, and trousers, suggesting a public event or tourist activity. Some stand in groups while others move across the open paved area. A white van is parked toward the right side, and there are hints of vendors or shaded stalls near the far right edge.

The sky above is bright blue with scattered white clouds, and sunlight illuminates parts of the brick façade, emphasizing the warm reddish tones of the building. The photo is taken from a low angle, making the structure look imposing and monumental, with the ornate upper façade rising dramatically above the crowd.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示西班牙巴塞罗那著名斗牛场Plaza de Toros的照片。照片中，斗牛场的红砖建筑立面装饰着精美的瓷砖和雕塑，上方挂有'PLAZA DE TOROS'的标牌。建筑前的广场上聚集了众多游客和当地居民，他们或站立交谈，或行走观光，为这个场景增添了活力。天空是晴朗的，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a large green tracked armored fighting vehicle parked or moving slowly along a wide city street. It occupies the center of the frame in profile, facing to the right. The vehicle has a low, boxy hull with heavy side armor panels, visible road wheels and continuous tracks along the bottom. On top is a turret fitted with a long cannon pointing slightly upward toward the right, along with smaller equipment, hatches, antennas, and lights. A crew member in camouflage gear is partially visible in the open turret area.

A prominent marking is painted on the side of the vehicle: a red star outlined in white, centered over a horizontal orange-and-black striped ribbon motif. This gives the scene the appearance of a military parade, rehearsal, or public display.

The setting is an urban boulevard lined with pale beige and peach-colored buildings. Behind the vehicle is a large decorative arched gateway between buildings, with ornate classical-style details: carved floral reliefs, round medallion-like ornaments, columns, and decorative capitals. Through the arch, leafless or early-spring trees are visible, suggesting a park or courtyard beyond.

On the right side of the image, a building façade has rectangular stone-like paneling, several windows, wall-mounted air-conditioning units, and a blue street number plaque reading “5.” A leafless tree stands in front of the building. On the left side, another blue plaque shows the number “3,” and part of a Cyrillic street sign or storefront sign is visible.

Several pedestrians and uniformed personnel stand on the sidewalk watching or photographing the armored vehicle. Some people are holding up phones. A red-and-white tape barrier runs along part of the sidewalk, separating onlookers from the street. The foreground shows multiple lanes of asphalt road with white lane markings and large directional arrows painted on the pavement. The overall atmosphere is calm and orderly, with the military vehicle displayed in a city setting under soft daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示军事装备的现实主义风格照片，具体为一辆绿色的装甲车停在城市街道上。装甲车前部装有炮塔和机枪，车身侧面带有醒目的橙色条纹。周围是几位穿着制服的人，他们似乎在进行某种军事活动或演示。背景中是一座装饰华丽的建筑，其古典式的拱门设计与现代的军事装备形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a busy indoor trade fair or exhibition hall, likely related to real estate, construction, or property services. The scene is brightly lit by long fluorescent ceiling fixtures arranged in rows across a high, grid-patterned ceiling.

In the foreground, several people are gathered around a white exhibition counter. On the visitor side of the counter, a woman wearing a black-and-purple striped sweater stands facing the booth staff. She has a shoulder bag with a brown strap and is holding a white plastic shopping bag. Behind her, a man in a plaid shirt and vest is holding promotional bags or brochures. Other visitors are partially visible nearby.

On the booth side of the counter, two women appear to be representing the exhibitor. One is seated or leaning forward behind the counter, wearing a white blouse and a wristwatch, with long blonde hair. Another woman to the right is dressed in a black blazer with a white shirt and a blue-red scarf, resembling a uniform or branded event attire. A small desk flag on the counter reads “ВТБ24,” suggesting a Russian bank or financial services presence. The counter surface is covered with brochures, flyers, printed floor-plan-like materials, and promotional leaflets. A computer mouse and other small office items are also visible on the right side.

Behind the booth staff is a large, modern display structure with white framing and big photographic panels showing close-up architectural imagery, including building facades and window-cleaning or construction-related elements. Above the booth is a hanging sign with Russian text, though it is partially blurred and difficult to read.

The background contains many other exhibition stands, banners, and displays. Several signs feature Cyrillic writing, reinforcing that this is likely an event in a Russian-speaking setting. One booth in the distance has a colorful illuminated skyline-style graphic, while another features large vertical panels and architectural imagery. There are small seating areas, tables, and groups of people talking throughout the hall.

Overall, the image captures an active business expo environment, with visitors collecting information and speaking with representatives at a professional exhibition booth.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的照片，捕捉了一个室内展览场景。在图像的前景中，一位女士站在展台前，穿着紫色和黑色条纹的衣服，正专注地查看展台上的宣传册。展台上摆放着各种旅游宣传材料，包括地图、小册子和海报。背景中，两位女性工作人员坐在展台后方，她们身穿职业装，正在与参观者交流。整个场景被明亮的人工照明照亮，营造出一种活跃而专业的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a narrow, steep alleyway or stair passage between closely packed buildings, likely in a Mediterranean or North African old-town setting. The walls are painted in a striking two-tone scheme: bright cobalt-blue on the lower portions and white on the upper portions. The paint has a textured, hand-applied look, with uneven edges, patches, chips, and areas where the plaster underneath shows through.

A flight of tiled stairs rises up the center of the image. The steps are made of small rectangular tiles in alternating dark reddish-brown and off-white squares, creating a worn checkerboard-like pattern. The stair edges are rough and slightly uneven, suggesting age and frequent use. The passage is quite tight, with blue-painted walls pressing in on both sides.

On the right, the wall catches strong sunlight, creating a sharp diagonal shadow across the white and blue plaster. Black electrical cables run along the upper part of this wall, bundled and fixed with clips. Similar cables and pipes are visible on the left wall, where a small cylindrical fixture or lamp hangs near the top. There is also an open utility box or panel low on the left side, partially visible.

At the top of the stairs, the alley narrows further and turns into a small landing or recess. Potted plants sit in the shaded area, adding greenery among the blue walls. A small window with decorative black metal bars is visible on the back wall, framed by the same blue-and-white color palette. Above, portions of neighboring buildings overlap, with small roof tiles, ledges, and balconies jutting into the tight space. A green cable or line stretches horizontally across the alley near the top.

The overall atmosphere is intimate and old, with bright sunlight, deep shadows, weathered plaster, exposed wiring, and vivid blue walls giving the scene a distinctive historic charm.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示狭窄街道的照片，楼梯由深色和浅色的方块瓷砖铺成，沿着墙壁向上延伸。两侧的墙面涂有鲜艳的蓝色，与白色建筑形成鲜明对比。墙面上挂有几盏灯具，增添了一些生活气息。在楼梯尽头，可以看到一扇关闭的窗户和一些绿色植物，为这个蓝白相间的场景带来一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a dense urban landscape filled with tall residential high-rise apartment blocks, viewed from an elevated vantage point looking slightly downward.

In the foreground and middle ground, several very tall apartment towers dominate the scene. Many of the buildings are painted in pale mint green, turquoise, white, and light gray, with repetitive grids of windows, balconies, and air-conditioning units. The façades are tightly packed with small residential details: window frames, laundry hanging in some places, external AC boxes, narrow balconies, and service ledges. The buildings are so close together that only narrow gaps and small internal courtyards are visible between them.

On the right side, there are white and gray residential towers with a more uniform, modular appearance. Their façades are covered with rows of identical windows and air-conditioning units, emphasizing the scale and density of the housing estate. Several rooftops are visible, showing flat concrete surfaces, utility structures, railings, ventilation equipment, water tanks, and dark weathered patches.

In the center and lower portion of the image, the mint-green towers are especially prominent. Some sections have blue panels near the lower floors, adding contrast to the otherwise pale color palette. Between the towers, a small landscaped area and pathways can be glimpsed far below, including patches of trees and greenery.

In the background, the city continues with many more high-rise buildings packed tightly together. These towers are taller and more distant, appearing slightly softened by haze. Some are beige, pinkish, gray, or glassy blue, creating a layered skyline. On the far left, a green hillside rises behind the buildings, providing a strong contrast to the dense urban development. The hill is covered with vegetation, and faint outlines of more distant buildings and mountains appear through the mist.

The atmosphere looks overcast or humid, with a pale gray sky and hazy visibility. The overall impression is of an extremely dense metropolitan residential district, likely in a large Asian city, where towering apartment blocks fill nearly every part of the view.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示密集高层住宅区的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是几栋高耸入云的住宅楼，其设计简洁现代，以白色和浅绿色为主色调。建筑之间有明显的空隙，显示出城市的规划和人口密度。在远处可以看到更多的建筑物，它们的轮廓在雾气中若隐若现，增添了一种朦胧而神秘的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up outdoor portrait of three children standing very close together, with their arms around each other’s shoulders in a friendly, affectionate pose. Their faces are intentionally blurred, but their heads and upper bodies fill most of the frame.

All three children have closely cropped hair. The child in the center is slightly taller or positioned higher and wears a bright blue collared shirt. Their arms appear to be draped around the shoulders of the children on both sides, creating a tight group pose. The child on the left wears a light olive or khaki-colored jacket with visible seams and buttons. The child on the right wears a vivid blue collared shirt or jacket, and a dark-skinned arm rests across their shoulder and upper chest, emphasizing the group’s closeness.

The photo is taken in bright daylight, with strong sunlight highlighting the tops of their heads and shoulders. The background is softly out of focus, suggesting a shallow depth of field. Behind them are pale, beige-colored buildings with light roofs, possibly in a rural or school setting. There are also blurred trees or greenery in the distance and dry, dusty ground visible behind the children. A partial top of another child’s head appears at the bottom left foreground, cropped by the frame.

Overall, the image conveys a warm, candid moment of companionship among children in an outdoor community or school-like environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三名年轻男孩在户外的现实主义风格照片。他们似乎是在一个乡村或小镇环境中，背景中可以看到模糊的建筑和树木。最左边的男孩穿着绿色上衣，中间的男孩穿着蓝色衬衫，而右边的男孩也穿着蓝色衬衫。他们的表情被模糊处理，无法辨认具体情绪。

caption:
The image shows a lively nighttime holiday scene, likely at a Christmas festival or parade. The photo is taken from a low, tilted angle, giving it a dynamic, slightly chaotic feel.

On the right side dominates a large beige cone-shaped structure, resembling an oversized stylized Christmas tree or tower. It is wrapped in looping strands of silvery wire or barbed-wire-like garland, with small metallic ornament-like objects hanging from it. Some of these objects look like gray bulbs or canisters. Near the top of the structure are several oval cutouts glowing warm orange from inside, and a red illuminated circular ring sits above it like a halo. The structure’s surface is faceted and textured, catching strong light and casting dramatic shadows from the wire loops.

In the foreground, several people are dressed in bright red Santa Claus outfits with white trim and black belts. One person wears a Santa hat and a fake white beard, and appears to be reaching upward with a hooked tool or cane toward the wire or decorations on the large cone. Another Santa-costumed person stands close beside them, partly hidden. Their shiny red costumes stand out strongly against the dark night background.

To the left, a tall Christmas tree covered in colorful lights rises in the distance. It is decorated with blue, red, yellow, and white lights, including glowing star shapes and other festive ornaments. The tree appears slightly blurred compared to the foreground, enhancing the sense of depth. Around it are leafless trees wrapped with warm white string lights, adding to the festive atmosphere.

The background includes a crowd of spectators standing behind barriers, many wearing dark winter clothing. On the far right, there is a blue-lit structure or stage area with bright lights, suggesting an organized public event. Overhead, wavy strands of yellow and red lights stretch across the dark sky.

Overall, the image captures a busy, theatrical Christmas celebration with performers in Santa costumes, illuminated decorations, crowds, and dramatic nighttime lighting. The tilted composition and wide-angle perspective make the scene feel energetic and immersive.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日庆祝活动的摄影照片，图中两位身着圣诞老人服装的人正在装饰一个巨大的圣诞树模型。他们站在一个充满节日气氛的户外场所，周围有其他装饰精美的圣诞树和一些模糊的人物身影。夜幕下，灯光点缀了整个场景，营造出温馨而欢乐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a commercial passenger airplane flying through a pale, overcast sky. The aircraft is positioned mostly in the lower-right portion of the frame, leaving a large expanse of empty light gray-blue sky across the top and left side.

The plane is viewed from below and slightly in front, so the underside, nose, wings, engines, and landing gear are visible. Its nose is angled upward and toward the left, giving the impression that it is either climbing or approaching for landing. The landing gear is extended: the front wheels are down beneath the nose, and the main landing gear is also visible under the fuselage.

The aircraft has a striking color scheme. The underside and nose are a bright turquoise or teal, while a bold red-orange section runs along the side of the fuselage and continues around parts of the engines and tail area. Rows of small passenger windows are visible along the red-orange side of the plane. The two large jet engines hang beneath the wings, with dark circular openings facing the viewer. The wings stretch outward, with visible flaps and small red-tipped winglets at the ends.

The tail fin, partially visible on the right, matches the turquoise color and appears to have a small red marking. The overall composition emphasizes the airplane against a simple, uncluttered sky, with the aircraft’s vivid colors standing out strongly against the muted background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架商用喷气式飞机在飞行中的照片。飞机的机身主要涂装为绿色和红色，机翼上有着蓝色和橙色的图案。飞机的起落架已经放下，准备着陆或刚刚起飞。背景是均匀的灰色天空，没有其他显著特征。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a historic fortified town wall under a clear, bright blue sky. The long defensive wall stretches diagonally from the left foreground toward the far right background, creating strong perspective and depth. It is built of reddish-brown brick mixed with pale stone, giving the surface a mottled, weathered texture. Along the top of the wall are regular crenellations—rectangular battlements with raised merlons—typical of medieval fortifications.

Several square towers punctuate the wall at intervals. The nearest prominent tower, slightly left of center, is tall and rectangular with crenellated battlements at the top and narrow vertical slit windows. Farther along the wall, more towers recede into the distance, becoming smaller as they follow the line of the fortification.

Behind the wall, near the center-right, rises a tall church bell tower. It has a square brick base with arched openings near the top and a very steep, dark, conical spire that tapers to a fine point. The spire stands out dramatically against the cloudless sky. A small pale moon is visible high in the sky to the left of the bell tower, adding a subtle detail to the scene.

In the foreground is a broad grassy embankment or moat-like green area sloping gently upward toward the wall. The grass is sunlit in places, while large dark shadows stretch across the lower portion of the image, suggesting low-angle sunlight, likely from morning or late afternoon. The warm sunlight highlights the brickwork and emphasizes the aged, rough textures of the masonry.

Overall, the scene conveys a well-preserved medieval or Renaissance fortified settlement, with massive defensive walls, towers, and a church rising behind them, set in a calm open landscape under exceptionally clear weather.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中世纪城堡防御工事的摄影图像。在画面中央，有一座高耸的钟楼，其上方可见一个较小的月亮。城堡由坚固的城墙组成，墙上有多个小型塔楼和炮眼。城墙前方是一片绿色草地，而背景则是一个晴朗的蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a stormy coastal scene in a city, with rough sea conditions dominating the foreground. Large grey-green waves are crashing violently against a stone seawall and concrete breakwater blocks, sending white spray high into the air. The water is turbulent and foamy, with swirling whitecaps and churning surf filling much of the lower half of the image.

In the foreground and center-left, a stone pier or sea defense wall juts out into the water. At its base are large cubic concrete blocks arranged as wave breakers. The waves are striking these blocks and spilling over them, creating cascades of water and heavy spray. The atmosphere appears wet and misty, likely from sea spray and wind.

Along the top of the seawall are old-fashioned black street lamps, giving the waterfront a historic promenade-like appearance. To the left, pale yellow and cream-colored buildings line the coast, with a few palm trees partly visible at the edge of the frame. The architecture looks Mediterranean or coastal European, with flat roofs, light-colored facades, and decorative details.

In the middle distance, more buildings stretch along the waterfront, including white and beige structures with red-tiled roofs. A long seawall separates the city from the rough ocean. The water is breaking repeatedly against this barrier, producing white foam all along the coast.

In the background, the skyline is hazy and muted by mist or rain. Several industrial cranes are visible near the harbor, and farther to the right there are two tall bridge pylons rising into the grey sky, suggesting a large modern bridge nearby. A few birds can be seen flying above the city, silhouetted faintly against the overcast sky.

The overall mood is dramatic and stormy. The colors are subdued—mostly greys, pale yellows, whites, and muted blues—conveying strong wind, sea spray, and rough weather along an urban shoreline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到暴风雨天气中海浪冲击海岸线的现实主义风格照片。在画面前景，巨大的波浪拍打着岩石和混凝土结构，形成飞溅的水花。背景中，可以看到城市的建筑群，包括黄色的建筑物、一排树木和远处的塔尖，这些元素构成了一个典型的海滨城市景观。天空阴沉，似乎预示着恶劣的天气条件。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a small potted succulent, likely a Haworthia-type plant, sitting on a polished wooden surface.

The plant has a dense rosette form with many thick, pointed, triangular leaves radiating outward from the center. The leaves are dark green to bluish-green and have a rough, ridged texture, with raised horizontal bands running across them. Many of the leaf tips are sharp and slightly browned or dried, giving the plant a rugged, spiky appearance. Some older, dried leaves or plant debris are visible near the base inside the pot.

The succulent is planted in a round terracotta clay pot with a warm orange-brown color. The pot has a rounded, bulbous shape and several subtle horizontal grooves around its body. Its surface looks slightly dusty and weathered, with some pale mineral marks near the rim. The soil inside appears dry and compact.

A thin, pale flower stalk or stem rises upward from the plant near the back, extending out of the top of the frame. The main subject is in focus, while the background is blurred. Behind it, there appears to be a wooden railing or bench, a turquoise-blue wall or curtain, and hints of other household or garden objects. The lighting is natural and soft, highlighting the plant’s textured leaves and the warm tones of the clay pot and wooden tabletop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一株多肉植物的摄影图像，植物被种植在一个棕色陶瓷盆中。多肉植物拥有细长、尖锐的绿色叶片，排列成放射状，中心部分有一些干燥的叶子和土壤。盆栽放置在木质桌面上，背景模糊地显示了室内的环境。

caption:
The image shows a bright urban city scene under a clear, deep blue sky with a few small white clouds. The viewpoint is from street level looking upward, emphasizing the height of the surrounding buildings.

At the center is a tall modern high-rise tower with a pale beige and gray facade. It has many evenly spaced rectangular windows and darker vertical glass sections running up the corners and sides. The building rises far above the surrounding structures and appears to be part of a large commercial or transportation complex.

On the left side, a large multi-story building stretches diagonally across the frame. Its facade is made of light gray panels, rows of windows, and recessed sections. A distinctive round blue clock with white markings is mounted on the front of this building, suggesting it may be a station or civic complex. Below it, there is a large glass-covered entrance or atrium with a slanted roof, greenish-tinted glass panels, and visible metal support beams. The entrance signage includes “APIA,” indicating a shopping or underground mall area.

On the right side, another large white commercial building is visible. Near the top is a prominent colorful sign reading “ESTA.” Below and along the side are multiple vertical signs and advertisements, including Japanese text and recognizable retail branding such as “BIC CAMERA,” “UNIQLO,” and “GU.” This gives the scene a busy shopping-district feel.

In the lower part of the image, there are small figures of pedestrians near the buildings and plaza area, though they are not the focus. Bare trees are visible near the bottom right, suggesting the photo may have been taken in a colder season or early spring.

Overall, the image depicts a clean, modern Japanese urban center—likely around a major train station—with tall office/hotel towers, department stores, shopping mall entrances, and bright midday sunlight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市街景的照片，画面中心是一座高耸的摩天大楼，其玻璃幕墙在阳光下反射出耀眼的光芒。左侧是一栋多层建筑，表面装饰着一些大型广告牌和招牌。右侧是另一座现代化的高层建筑，其外观设计简洁而现代。在前景中，可以看到一个带有透明屋顶的广场，里面有人在行走。整个场景被一片晴朗的蓝天所覆盖，几朵白云悠闲地飘过。

caption:
The image shows a flooded urban intersection on an overcast day. A large portion of the roadway is covered with shallow, muddy water, creating ripples and reflections of traffic lights, signs, cones, vehicles, and people.

In the foreground, a person wearing a bright red hooded jacket stands on a patch of grass, facing away from the camera and looking toward the flooded street. They are holding a dark bag at their side. To the right, another person sits on a bicycle at the edge of the sidewalk near the water. This cyclist wears a red helmet or cap, a dark jacket, gray pants, and bright orange rubber boots, suggesting they may be preparing to cross or are observing the flooding.

In the middle of the scene, a white and yellow municipal-style dump truck is driving through the water. The truck creates splashes around its wheels as it moves through the flooded lane. Orange and white construction barrels, along with a few green-and-orange barrels, form a temporary barrier or work zone on the right side of the road. A black hose or pipe lies on the wet pavement among the cones. There is also an orange “DÉTOUR” sign with a black arrow pointing left, indicating a traffic diversion.

Traffic lights hang above the intersection, and several appear red or inactive-looking from this angle. On the left side, a road sign shows a bicycle symbol, and below it there is a yellow pedestrian crossing sign. Another nearby sign indicates a school zone or pedestrian area with a speed limit of 30.

Across the street is a row of low commercial buildings. One long building has a red facade and storefront windows. Visible business signs include a restaurant sign reading “Saveurs Thai,” and another sign on the right for “ACCESS” above what appears to be an alcohol or beverage-related store. A tall roadside plaza sign lists several businesses, including “Golden Paws,” “VEER BAGEL,” and “Fresh Colonnade,” among others. To the far right is a building with a stone exterior wall and a dark roof.

The overall atmosphere feels like the aftermath of heavy rain, snowmelt, or a water main issue. The sky is gray and hazy, the pavement is soaked, and small piles of snow or slush are visible along the storefronts, reinforcing a cold, wet, early-spring or late-winter setting. The scene captures a disrupted intersection where pedestrians, cyclists, municipal workers, and traffic are all navigating around standing water and roadwork barriers.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道洪水情况的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一辆黄色的卡车正通过被水淹没的道路，周围放置着橙色交通锥以确保安全通行。一位穿着红色外套的人站在路边，似乎在观察洪水的情况或等待过街。另外，还有一位骑自行车的人穿过积水，尽管他戴着头盔并穿着保暖的衣服。背景中可以看到商店和建筑，它们的外观因洪水而显得模糊不清。天空阴沉，整个场景给人一种紧迫感和紧急氛围。

caption:
The image is an extreme close-up, macro-style photograph of a decorative beaded object, likely a bracelet, charm, tassel, or hanging ornament. The focus is very shallow, creating a soft, dreamy blur across much of the frame while a few central details are sharp.

Near the center-right is the clearest element: a cluster of small white cowrie shells. They are rounded, glossy, and ridged, with narrow slit-like openings and faint beige grooves. One shell in the foreground is especially prominent, tied with thin golden thread or cord at one end.

Surrounding the shells are colorful beads. Several dark blue beads have an “evil eye” design: deep cobalt or navy blue glass with white circular rings and small black centers. These beads appear glossy and reflective. A bright yellow bead sits near the middle-left of the focused area, adding a vivid contrast against the blue and white. Farther upward, turquoise-blue beads and small gold-toned metal pieces form a line that recedes into the blurred background.

At the lower left and center, strands of tan or golden-brown tassel fibers hang loosely. They look slightly frayed and wispy, with individual threads visible. Some thin threads or hairs extend outward across the frame, adding to the delicate, handmade feel of the object.

The background is mostly out of focus and softly colored, with pale cream, beige, and faint lavender tones. On the right side, blurred shapes suggest more beads or ornaments in purple, teal, black, and gold. The lighting is warm and gentle, producing soft highlights on the glossy beads and shells.

Overall, the image has a handcrafted, bohemian or protective-charm aesthetic, emphasizing texture, color, and detail through a very narrow depth of field.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示串珠项链的特写照片，焦点落在了几个具有特色的珠子上。这些珠子以蓝色、黄色和白色为主色调，其中一些珠子表面装饰有黑色的眼睛图案。珠子之间连接着一根细绳，绳子末端挂着金色流苏。背景模糊，使得观众的注意力集中在珠宝的细节上。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a historic, Middle Eastern or Islamic-style architectural complex, viewed from a shaded corridor looking out into a bright courtyard.

In the foreground, the viewer stands beneath a dark wooden ceiling supported by thick, round timber beams and vertical wooden posts. The ceiling is rustic, made of closely spaced wooden planks and large natural logs, giving the space an old, hand-built feel. Because the foreground is in shadow, the wooden posts and the interior walls appear dark brown and silhouetted against the bright exterior.

Dominating the center of the image is a large pointed archway with thick plastered edges. The arch has a smooth, cream-colored surface with slightly worn and uneven plaster, suggesting age and restoration. On both the left and right sides, partial matching arches are visible, creating a rhythmic arcade effect. The walls are mostly earth-toned—beige, tan, and pale clay—typical of mudbrick or adobe construction.

Beyond the central arch is a sunlit courtyard. The courtyard floor is very bright, almost washed out by the strong sunlight. Across the courtyard stands an ornate façade with multiple pointed arches, recessed alcoves, and decorative brickwork. The central upper section has intricate geometric or floral patterned ornamentation, with small patches of blue tile accents embedded in the design. The façade appears weathered, with exposed brick, worn plaster, and areas that look partially restored.

Several architectural layers are visible: a large central iwan-like arched recess, smaller arched openings on either side, and a second-level or raised façade with decorative panels. The structure has a warm sandy color palette, blending brick, plaster, and sunlight.

Modern scaffolding cuts through the historic scene: a vertical metal pole stands almost exactly in the center of the main arch, with horizontal metal bars crossing the view. Additional scaffolding appears on the right side, and a long angled pole or ladder leans across the sunlit courtyard. These elements suggest that the building is under repair, conservation, or restoration.

The contrast between the dark shaded interior and the intensely bright courtyard emphasizes depth and frames the ornate building outside. Overall, the image conveys the atmosphere of an old Islamic courtyard complex—possibly a madrasa, caravanserai, mosque, or historic house—currently undergoing preservation work.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中东或中亚风格建筑内部的照片。图像中心是一个由木梁支撑的拱形门廊，其上部装饰有精细的几何图案和雕刻。通过拱门可以看到外面的庭院，庭院内有几座带有拱门的建筑物，墙壁上同样装饰着复杂的瓷砖和图案。阳光从画面顶部照射进来，在拱门和地面上投下阴影，营造出一种宁静而古老的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a smartphone being held horizontally, showing a news article on its screen. The phone has a light-colored, possibly pale blue or lavender protective case and a black bezel around the display. The right edge of the phone has a visible notch/cutout area, suggesting the device is rotated sideways.

On the screen, the article appears to be from a news or business website. Near the top, a blue navigation/category line reads:

**“NEWS > RETAIL & FINANCIAL”**

Below that, in large black headline text, the visible headline says:

**“UNFI CEO: Recession, new consumer habits could last 24 months”**

Further down, a subheadline or related text is partially visible:

**“Company puts sale of Cub Food and Shoppers stores on hold”**

The screen background is white, with clean, large typography. The lower-right corner of the phone screen appears cracked or damaged, with visible fracture lines spreading inward from the corner. There are also small scuffs or marks along the phone’s edges.

The background is dark and heavily blurred, making the phone and article text the main focus. A hand is faintly visible holding the device at the lower left and bottom edge. The lighting is somewhat dim and warm, with the bright phone screen contrasting strongly against the dark surroundings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张手持手机的照片，屏幕上显示着新闻标题“UNFI CEO: Recession, new consumer habits could last 24 months”，以及相关的财经和零售新闻。手机的屏幕是白色的，上面的文字清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban roadway at an intersection, viewed from behind a police vehicle. In the foreground on the right side of the frame is a silver Polish police car, a Kia, marked with blue-and-white striping and the word “POLICJA” across the rear and on the roof light bar. Its blue emergency lights are flashing, creating bright blue highlights on top of the vehicle and reflecting slightly in the rear window. The license plate is blurred.

Ahead of the police car, several other vehicles are stopped or moving slowly in the same lane, including another police vehicle with flashing blue lights farther up the road. The street has multiple lanes with white dashed lane markings and directional arrows painted on the asphalt.

Above the roadway, a row of traffic lights hangs from a horizontal metal gantry. The signals are red, indicating traffic is stopped. Beneath or near the lights are blue lane-direction signs: one indicates a left turn, others indicate straight ahead, and one on the far right shows a right-turn lane combined with a bicycle symbol, suggesting a bike route or cyclist movement.

In the midground, a group of pedestrians is crossing the street at a crosswalk. They are dressed in winter or cool-weather clothing—dark coats, hats, scarves, and some brighter jackets such as red and pink. One person appears to be pushing or walking beside a small bicycle or scooter-like object. The pedestrians and background are slightly blurred, giving the scene a sense of distance and motion.

The background features leafless trees lining the street, suggesting late autumn or winter. There are urban street signs, including a pedestrian crossing sign and a yellow diamond priority-road sign on the right. Buildings are partially visible behind the trees. The overall atmosphere is that of a busy city intersection under overcast or cool daylight conditions, with police presence and controlled traffic at a red light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一辆银色警车停在交通信号灯前，车顶装有蓝色警示灯，车身侧面印有'POLICIA'字样和车辆编号'8068'。背景中，一群行人正在过马路，其中一些人正穿过斑马线，而其他人则在等待信号灯变绿。街道两旁是树木和建筑物，天空阴沉，可能预示着天气的变化。

caption:

- The jars are arranged side by side, filling most of the frame.
- Each jar contains a dark amber-brown jam visible through the clear glass.
- The jars have yellow-and-white checkered metal lids. One lid has a printed date/time visible: **01.10.2017 15:56**.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是超市货架上摆放的三罐Steffi's Choice品牌的杏仁酱。每罐都有一个带有标签的透明玻璃瓶，标签上清晰地展示了产品名称、成分和价格信息。瓶子被放置在货架上，背景是模糊的其他商品和货架结构。

caption:
The image shows a busy outdoor religious worship scene, likely at a Hindu shrine or temple courtyard. Several people are gathered around a cluster of red-stained stone altars and small shrine structures covered with offerings.

In the center is a prominent rounded stone pedestal or shrine base coated in red/orange vermilion powder. A bright yellow cloth is draped over the top, and the surface is sprinkled with flower petals, especially yellow marigold petals, along with red powder and ritual residue. Around it are several smaller upright stone objects, also covered in vermilion and decorated with flowers, suggesting devotional offerings.

In the foreground, a woman wearing a beige kurta and a deep red scarf stands with her back and side to the camera. She appears to be holding ritual items or money in her hands. To the left, another woman in a maroon sweater and a black patterned headscarf is looking down at something she is holding, possibly offerings or a small plate. A person in a pink sweater and patterned skirt stands partially visible at the far left.

On the right side, more worshippers are gathered close to the shrine. A man in a black puffer jacket leans forward with his hands extended, appearing to take part in the ritual. Beside him, women in colorful clothing—reds, pinks, and blues—stand near another small decorated shrine. Some faces in the image are blurred, but the group’s posture and attention are directed toward the offerings and sacred objects.

Several small oil lamps are burning near the lower right and center foreground. Their flames add warmth to the scene, and there is visible soot and ash around the lamp holders. A brass bell hangs from a black metal frame near the bottom right, suggesting a temple ritual setup. The stone platform is darkened and stained from repeated offerings, oil, smoke, flowers, and vermilion powder.

The background is softly out of focus, showing reddish walls and more people standing further back. Sunlight falls across the scene, creating a warm, lively atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a moment of communal prayer or ritual devotion, with worshippers offering flowers, powders, lamps, and other sacred items at a heavily used shrine.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到宗教仪式现场的纪实摄影照片。在画面中心，一位穿着传统服饰的女性正站在一个装饰华丽的祭坛前，她手持一瓶绿色液体，似乎正在进行某种宗教仪式。祭坛上点燃了多支蜡烛，周围摆放着各种供品和香炉。背景中可以看到其他参与者，他们也在进行各自的仪式活动。整个场景充满了宗教氛围和文化特色。

caption:
The image shows a formal military parade or ceremonial guard procession taking place outdoors in bright daylight.

In the foreground, several uniformed honor guards march in formation from left to right. They wear dark navy-blue dress uniforms with crisp white belts, white gloves, white shoulder cords, and polished silver helmets that reflect the surrounding plaza and buildings. Each guard carries a rifle held upright or diagonally across the body in a ceremonial marching posture. Their uniforms include red-and-blue shoulder patches and small name or insignia plates, giving the scene a highly disciplined, official appearance.

Behind the front row are additional personnel in white uniforms and helmets, suggesting multiple branches or units participating in the ceremony. The formation is tightly organized, with the soldiers aligned in rows and moving in synchronized fashion.

In the background, several flags are mounted on tall poles and fluttering in the wind. The most prominent are red flags with a blue canton containing a white sun, the flag of the Republic of China/Taiwan. Other ceremonial flags in blue, yellow, and red are also visible, likely unit or service flags, with decorative fringes and emblems.

The setting appears to be a large ceremonial plaza in front of an ornate white archway or monumental gate. The structure has intricate carved patterns, relief designs, and traditional architectural details, including blue-tiled roof elements near the top right. Palm trees and modern buildings are faintly visible beyond the arch, adding depth to the scene.

Overall, the image conveys a sense of national ceremony, military precision, and formal pageantry, with polished uniforms, reflective helmets, flags, and monumental architecture creating a dignified and patriotic atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示台湾仪仗队的摄影照片，队伍成员穿着统一的深蓝色制服和白色手套，头戴银色头盔，并手持长枪。他们整齐地站立在一座装饰华丽的建筑前，该建筑上有中国古典风格的雕刻。在他们的背后，可以看到几面飘扬的旗帜，包括台湾国旗、中华民国国徽旗以及其他可能代表不同国家或组织的旗帜。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a honey-colored wooden sculpture outdoors. It focuses on the torso and hands of a carved human-like figure, with the arms wrapped around and cradling a rounded object or bowl-like form. The carving is made from polished wood with a warm golden-brown finish, and the surface shows visible wood grain, chisel marks, knots, dark specks, and several natural cracks running vertically through the material.

The figure’s hands are prominent on the right and lower center, with simplified carved fingers gripping the object. In the center is a rounded, apple-like carved shape with a small raised stem or peg at the top. Around it are other curved forms, possibly part of a basket, fruit, or decorative elements. On the lower left, there appears to be a smaller carved face or animal-like shape with an eye and rounded features integrated into the composition.
