To the left of the Colosseum stands a large Christmas tree covered in dense white lights. A bright star-shaped decoration sits at the top, giving the scene a festive holiday atmosphere. The tree’s sparkling lights contrast strongly with the ancient stone architecture behind it.

On the right side, ornate streetlamps glow intensely, creating starburst flares. Below them are sidewalks, railings, signs, and a small kiosk or booth. Several people are visible as dark, slightly blurred figures along the sidewalk, likely due to the long exposure. A brick wall and metal fence run along the right edge, with greenery behind them.

Overall, the image combines historic architecture, festive Christmas lighting, and modern city traffic. The warm artificial lights, deep blue sky, and motion-blurred car trails create a dramatic, energetic nighttime view of the Colosseum.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示罗马斗兽场夜景的摄影作品，图像捕捉了这座历史建筑在夜晚被灯光照亮的壮观景象。在前景中，一辆车辆留下的红色尾灯轨迹穿过画面，为这个场景增添了一种动态感。背景中的斗兽场以其经典的圆顶和拱门结构成为焦点，而一棵装饰着白色圣诞灯饰的巨大圣诞树则位于斗兽场前方，为节日氛围增添了温暖的色彩。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a Buddhist shrine or temple filled with many Buddha statues in different sizes, colors, and finishes. The scene is very ornate and densely arranged, with a strong emphasis on gold, red, and dark wood.

In the foreground, several seated Buddha statues dominate the view. On the right front is a large gold Buddha statue seated cross-legged on a decorated lotus-style pedestal, with one hand resting downward over the knee and the other in the lap. Behind and around it are more gold statues, including a taller seated figure with an elaborate pointed flame-like halo or crown detail around the head. On the left front is a bright red seated Buddha statue on a red pedestal, facing forward. Another red statue sits on the far right. Their glossy surfaces reflect the temple lighting.

Near the center-left is a shiny yellow-orange Buddha statue seated in meditation, also highly polished. Behind it, several older-looking bronze or dark gold statues stand and sit against the back wall. These statues appear more weathered, with mottled surfaces, suggesting age or layers of gold leaf. Some are standing upright, while others are seated in traditional meditation postures.

The background wall is richly decorated with a black fabric or painted surface covered in gold motifs. There are repeated floral patterns, stylized leaves, and small figures in traditional Thai or Southeast Asian decorative style. Along the upper wall are rectangular golden ornamental panels with intricate cutout-like designs. The ceiling is made of polished wooden planks, with warm lights shining down and creating bright highlights on the statues.

The shrine area is framed by dark, glossy wooden pillars and side panels. The lower platform is made of white or gray marble, supporting the statues and pedestals. Red bases with gold trim appear beneath many of the figures, adding to the vivid color contrast.

A tall yellow cylindrical pillar or candle-like object stands on the left side in the foreground. At the base of the statues, there are several plastic water bottles placed as offerings or supplies. A cloth or rag lies on the marble step near the front, and newspapers or papers are visible on the floor at the bottom edge of the image.

A person is partially visible near the center bottom, crouched or seated among the statues, appearing to work or tend to the shrine area. The person’s face is not clearly visible. Overall, the image conveys a sacred, richly adorned temple space filled with Buddhist devotional objects, gilded statues, and intricate traditional decoration.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示佛教艺术的照片，画面中心为一尊金色的佛像，其周围排列着多尊同样金色的佛像。这些佛像姿态各异，有的坐着，有的站立，每尊都显得庄严而神圣。在佛像前方，有一位身穿红色衣服的人正在跪拜，表现出对宗教信仰的虔诚。背景中可以看到金色的装饰和雕塑，营造出一种庄严肃穆的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a mosque during a gathering or prayer session, photographed from a very low angle close to the carpeted floor.

In the foreground, a patterned prayer rug dominates the lower part of the frame. It has beige, black, white, and brown designs, with a fringed edge visible near the center. Beyond it is a turquoise-blue carpet that covers the prayer area.

Several men are seated on the floor facing away from the camera, looking toward the front of the mosque. Most are wearing white robes and white skullcaps or turbans, while one man near the center wears a purple shirt, making him stand out among the mostly white clothing. The men are sitting cross-legged or kneeling in rows, suggesting they are listening, praying, or attending a religious talk.

At the front of the room, there is a large arched opening decorated with Arabic calligraphy across the top. On either side of the arch are circular dark plaques with Arabic script, one of which appears to contain the word “Allah.” Beneath or near the arch is an ornate wooden pulpit or minbar with carved details, positioned slightly left of center.

The walls are painted a light cream color. Several practical fixtures are visible: wall-mounted fans, fluorescent tube lights, speakers, clocks, and an air-conditioning unit. A digital display board on the left wall shows red numbers, likely prayer times. On the right side, there are windows or doors letting in bright daylight, creating a contrast between the sunlit side of the room and the softer interior lighting.

The overall atmosphere is quiet, communal, and reverent, with the focus on worshippers gathered together inside the mosque.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示宗教活动的摄影照片，画面中多位男性穿着传统的白色长袍和头巾，正坐在室内进行祈祷。他们围成一个半圆形，面向一个装饰华丽的拱门，拱门上挂有阿拉伯文书法的装饰品。在前景可以看到一块带有复杂图案的地毯，其色彩鲜艳且设计精美。整个场景传达了一种宁静而庄重的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a brightly colored Nike sneaker on display, likely in a shoe store. The main shoe is in sharp focus on the right side of the frame, while other shoes and shelves in the background are softly blurred.

The sneaker has a vivid rainbow gradient upper that transitions from orange and red near the toe area, into yellow across the middle, then green, teal, and darker blue-gray toward the heel. It has white laces, white trim around the collar, and a small white Nike swoosh on the side near the heel. A green tongue with a small label is visible near the top, and a white pull tab rises from the back of the shoe.

The side of the shoe features glossy, translucent plastic overlays that curve across the upper in a wavy cage-like pattern. The midsole is mostly white, with a small yellow translucent accent on the side. The outsole is made of clear, rounded air-cushion pods, giving the bottom of the shoe a transparent, futuristic look.

In the background, another similar sneaker is visible to the left but out of focus, showing hints of white, red, yellow, and green. The shoes appear to be sitting on a wooden or brown display shelf. Behind them are dark vertical shapes and warm indoor lighting, creating a retail-display atmosphere with a shallow depth of field that emphasizes the colorful shoe in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一双运动鞋的商业摄影风格图片。鞋子具有鲜明的颜色渐变，从白色过渡到绿色、黄色和橙色，设计上模仿了火焰的效果。鞋子放置在木质货架上，背景模糊地显示了其他运动鞋和货架上的商品。

caption:
The image shows a bright red Ferrari race car speeding along a racetrack, captured in a side profile from a low, trackside angle. The car dominates the lower half of the frame and is moving from left to right. It has a sleek, aerodynamic racing body with a large black rear wing, low front splitter, side air intakes, and wide racing slick tires.

The car’s livery is mostly Ferrari red with white accents on the front bumper, hood, and lower side panels. A large racing number **81** is displayed on the door in black on a white square panel. Around the car are multiple sponsor decals, including **Shell**, **Pirelli**, **UPS**, **Brembo**, **IVECO**, and others. There is also a “70” anniversary-style marking near the side window, suggesting a Ferrari anniversary racing event or series. The side window appears to have racing hardware and a visible driver inside, wearing a helmet.

The wheels are silver multi-spoke racing rims, and the front brake disc is glowing orange, suggesting intense braking or heat buildup from high-speed driving. The car’s stance is very low, with the front splitter close to the track surface. The large rear wing and aggressive bodywork emphasize that this is a purpose-built track car rather than a standard road car.

The racetrack surface is visible at the bottom, with green painted runoff, red-and-white curbing, and a strip of gravel in the foreground. Behind the car is a black safety barrier topped by a wire fence. Beyond the fence, the background consists of a grassy hillside with a narrow dirt or service road running diagonally across it. The background is slightly blurred, helping convey speed and keeping the focus on the race car.

Overall, the scene captures a high-performance Ferrari race car in action during a circuit event, with strong colors, racing details, and a sense of motion and speed.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆红色赛车在赛道上行驶的照片。赛车的车身涂装以鲜艳的红色为主，配有白色的条纹和赞助商标志。车身上有数字'81'和'470'，表明了它的比赛编号。赛车的设计细节包括前翼、侧裙和尾翼，都显示出其作为高性能赛车的特点。背景中可以看到一片绿色草地和部分围栏，暗示着这是在一个户外赛车场进行的比赛或训练。

caption:
The image shows a bright, open-air railway station with multiple platforms and tracks stretching into the distance. The viewpoint is from a platform on the left side, looking down along the tracks toward the far end of the station.

A large curved canopy roof covers the platform, creating shade over the waiting area. The ceiling is pale beige and supported by square stone or concrete columns arranged in a long row. Blue platform signs hang from the ceiling and columns, including a prominent sign reading “3 A” near the upper left-center, another “3 B” farther down the platform, and signs for other platforms such as “4 B,” “4 C,” and “6 C” visible across the tracks.

On the left edge of the image, part of a yellow and white train is stopped at the platform. Only a portion of its side is visible, with windows and doors partly cropped by the frame. Near the train are seated passengers on dark benches. A few people are waiting: one person in a long pink patterned dress stands near the benches, others sit with bags at their feet, and a man in a blue shirt stands near a luggage cart or service area.

The platform surface is wide and clean, paved with gray tiles. A white safety line runs parallel to the tracks near the platform edge, and tactile guiding strips for visually impaired passengers run down the platform. There are benches, vending or service machines, signage panels, and small utility fixtures along the platform.

To the right, several railway tracks run through the station, curving slightly as they recede into the background. Overhead electric lines, metal poles, insulators, and support structures form a dense geometric pattern above the tracks. The opposite platforms are also covered by similar curved canopies and supported by columns. A few benches and signs are visible on the far platforms, but they appear mostly quiet and empty.

In the distance, more tracks, signals, poles, and station infrastructure converge, giving a strong sense of depth and perspective. Beyond the station, faint hills or mountains can be seen through a hazy, bright sky. The lighting suggests a sunny day, with strong daylight illuminating the tracks and platforms while the canopy casts soft shadows over the waiting area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示火车站台的现实主义风格照片。在画面左侧，一位穿着粉色长裙的女士站在站台上，背对着镜头，似乎在等待火车的到来。站台上还有其他几位乘客，有的坐着休息，有的站着观望。站台上方悬挂着蓝色和白色的指示牌，显示了不同的车厢编号。轨道两侧设有安全栏杆，确保乘客的安全。背景中可以看到站台的屋顶结构，以及连接站台的天桥。

caption:
The image shows a quiet rural resting spot beside a stone wall in a grassy countryside setting.

In the foreground, there is a weathered wooden bench painted pale green. It has three long horizontal planks forming the backrest and seat, supported by dark metal legs with decorative curved shapes. The paint on the bench is slightly worn and chipped, giving it an aged outdoor look. It sits on a small paved or stone base, partly surrounded by long, damp-looking grass.

To the left of the bench stands a blue litter bin. The bin has a square, boxy frame with a dark top and open sides near the upper section. The word “LITTER” is visible on the front/side in small lettering. Inside or on the front is a lighter-colored panel with several triangular cut-out shapes arranged in rows, likely ventilation or design openings. A short chain is attached to the bin.

Behind the bench and bin is a low dry-stone wall made of irregular gray stones stacked without visible mortar. The stones vary in size and shape, with patches of green moss and lichen, making the wall look old and rustic. Above and behind the stone wall are wooden fence posts connected by strands of barbed wire, running horizontally across the scene.

Beyond the wall is a wide, bright green field that gently rises into the distance. Farther back, another stone wall or boundary line can be seen along the horizon. On the right side in the background, there is a cluster of trees with autumnal colors—some bare branches, some brownish-orange foliage, and some darker evergreen trees.

The sky takes up much of the upper half of the image and is overcast, filled with pale gray and white clouds. The lighting is soft and diffuse, with no strong shadows, suggesting a cloudy day. Overall, the scene feels peaceful, rural, and slightly windswept, like a countryside walking path or rest area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外环境的摄影图像，图中有一条绿色长椅和一个蓝色垃圾桶位于一片草地上。长椅靠在由石块砌成的矮墙上，而垃圾桶则紧邻着长椅。背景是开阔的草地，远处可见树木和多云的天空。

caption:
The image shows a smartphone lying diagonally on a rustic wooden tabletop. The phone has a light-colored, possibly white or silver, front bezel and appears to be in a slim transparent or pale case. Its screen is on, displaying an Android-style home screen with a bright blue-to-turquoise gradient wallpaper.

At the top of the phone screen is a Google search bar with a microphone icon on the right. The status bar shows the battery at about 97%, along with small signal and notification icons. The main clock widget in the center reads “15:02,” with Thai text below it indicating the date. Many of the app labels are also in Thai. Visible icons include weather, gallery/photos, settings, themes, Play Store, Chrome, camera, phone, security, tools, and a Google folder with a red notification badge.

The phone is positioned from the lower right toward the upper center of the image, with its top edge near the middle. Its earpiece speaker, front-facing camera, and sensors are visible above the display. The screen is clean and vivid, contrasting strongly with the dark, textured wood beneath it.

On the left side of the image, partially cropped, there is a small potted cactus or succulent in a light beige ceramic pot. The plant itself is out of focus, with dark soil visible around it. In the upper left corner, there is a piece of soft gray fabric with a white star pattern, also partially cropped and slightly out of focus.

The wooden surface has a worn, natural look, with visible grain lines, scratches, knots, and darker marks. The overall scene feels casual and cozy, like a phone placed on a café table or a home desk next to a small plant.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示智能手机的现代摄影风格图片。手机放置在木质桌面上，屏幕显示着桌面设置界面，时间显示为15:02。手机右侧是一个带有白色网状装饰的小盆栽，增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a glossy white payment acceptance sign, photographed at a slight angle so the right side recedes into the background. At the top, large bold black text reads **“ACCEPTED HERE”**, with a black underline running beneath it.

Below the heading are several recognizable payment method logos arranged in a grid-like layout:

- **American Express** logo on the left, in a blue square with white text.
- **JCB** logo near the center, with three vertical colored panels in blue, red, and green.
- **MasterCard** logo on the right, showing overlapping red and orange circles with white “MasterCard” text.
- **Samsung Pay** logo in large blue lettering on the lower left.
- **UnionPay** logo near the lower center, with red, blue, and green vertical blocks and Chinese characters beneath the English name.
- **Visa** logo on the lower right, with dark blue “VISA” text and colored bars above and below.

The sign appears to be laminated or covered with plastic, as there are bright reflections and glare spots on its surface. The background is mostly out of focus, suggesting an indoor retail or checkout environment. The overall purpose of the sign is to inform customers which credit cards and digital payment systems are accepted.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多种信用卡和支付方式标志的商业广告照片。图像中心是一个大大的白色背景，上面印有'ACCEPTED HERE'的字样，下方排列着多个彩色的信用卡和支付方式图标，包括AMERICAN EXPRESS、JCB、Mastercard、Samsung Pay、UnionPay以及Visa等。这些标志以黑色边框突出显示在白色背景上，清晰地传达了接受这些支付方式的信息。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of airplane tail fins on an airport apron or taxiway area.

In the foreground, dominating the right side of the frame, is the vertical stabilizer of a KLM aircraft. The tail is mostly white and features the large light-blue “KLM” lettering near the bottom, partially cropped by the edge of the image. Above the letters is KLM’s blue crown logo, made of four blue circles, a cross above the center circle, and a horizontal blue bar beneath. Fine panel lines, rivets, access panels, and seams are visible across the tail surface, giving it a detailed metallic aircraft texture.

Behind it on the left is another aircraft tail, dark navy blue, bearing the white SkyTeam alliance logo. The word “SKYTEAM” curves around the top of the logo, with a stylized white ribbon-like emblem in the center and a partial circular arc around it. This aircraft appears to be a KLM-operated plane in SkyTeam livery; part of the fuselage is visible below the tail, including the registration “PH-BXO,” a small Dutch flag, an EU flag, and faint text indicating it is a Boeing 737-800.

The background is softly out of focus and shows airport infrastructure: gray taxiways or runways, patches of green grass, painted pavement markings, and several yellow-and-black airport direction signs. The shallow depth of field keeps the aircraft tails sharp while the runway environment behind them appears blurred. The overall scene suggests parked or taxiing commercial aircraft at a major airport, with the KLM tail in the foreground and the SkyTeam-branded aircraft behind it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两架飞机尾翼的照片，左侧的飞机尾翼上印有'SKY TEAM'和一个星形标志，而右侧的尾翼则展示了'KLM'的品牌标识，包括一个蓝色背景上的皇冠图案。这两架飞机都停靠在机场的跑道上，背景中可以看到部分地面设施和跑道。

caption:
The image shows a silhouetted person standing indoors in front of a large arched opening, likely in a mosque or similarly designed building. The person is seen in profile, facing to the right, with both hands raised near the face in a gesture that suggests prayer or supplication. Because of the strong backlighting, the figure appears almost entirely black, with only the outline of the head, hands, long clothing, and bare feet visible.

The architecture frames the scene dramatically. A tall, rounded arch dominates the upper part of the image, with dark interior columns or wall edges on both sides. Below the arch is a decorative railing or screen featuring geometric cutout patterns, including star-like and polygonal shapes. These cutouts allow glimpses of the outside scenery and create a patterned contrast against the silhouette.

Beyond the balcony or window, the background is softly lit and slightly out of focus. There are distant green hills or mountains, a cloudy pale-blue sky, and a tall communications tower on the right side of the frame. The outdoor light is bright compared with the dim interior, giving the image a calm, contemplative mood.

At the bottom, the polished floor reflects parts of the railing’s geometric openings and the person’s feet, adding depth and symmetry. A prayer mat or cloth appears on the floor near the person’s feet, reinforcing the quiet devotional atmosphere. The overall composition is serene, centered on stillness, silhouette, and the contrast between dark interior space and bright open sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位穿着传统服饰的男性在户外祈祷的照片。他站在一个装饰性的木制阳台栏杆前，双手合十，头微微下垂，显得虔诚而专注。背景中可以看到远处轮廓分明的山丘和天空中的云朵，以及一座高耸的通信塔，这些元素共同构成了一个宁静而宗教氛围浓厚的画面。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor shop sign for **Kodak Film** photographed from below at an upward angle.

The sign is rectangular and projects outward from a building. It has a **yellow illuminated-looking face** bordered by a **silver-gray metal frame**. The lower portion of the sign casing is a dull gray metal box with visible dirt, wear, small screws or rivets, and dark grime along the edges, suggesting it is old or weathered.

On the yellow panel, the **Kodak logo** appears on the left in faded red/pink: a stylized blocky “K” shape with horizontal stripe elements beneath it. To the right, the word **“Kodak”** is printed in large, bold, dark navy or black lettering. Below and extending toward the right is the word **“FILM”** in large italic red/pink letters, with additional horizontal red/pink stripe graphics running underneath and behind the text.

The background is mostly a pale blue-gray sky. On the right edge of the image, part of the building is visible: a weathered exterior wall with pipes, metal railings, and some mounted hardware. The perspective makes the sign dominate the frame, with the top edge slightly angled and the building receding along the right side. The overall feel is slightly nostalgic or retro, due to the Kodak branding and the aged condition of the sign.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Kodak品牌标志的照片。标志位于图像的中心，背景为淡蓝色天空和建筑物的一部分。标志由一个黄色底板、红色斜条纹和黑色文字组成，文字上方是公司的名称“Kodak”。

caption:
The image shows a bright urban street scene dominated by a large, elegant corner building under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds.

The building is cream-colored with warm brown sections that look like horizontal wooden or brick cladding. It has multiple stories, tall rectangular windows, and many small black wrought-iron balcony railings. The corner of the building is rounded and slightly protruding, with stacked bay-window sections. Near the top, a prominent red “Kodak” sign is mounted on the cream facade. Above it is a distinctive rooftop pavilion or lookout structure with white columns, a balustrade, and a broad flat roof, giving the building a historic or Art Deco feel.

At street level, the building contains shops with large glass storefronts. Several shop windows display clothing, mannequins, and sale signs; one storefront sign appears to read “1-2-3.” The lower floors are shaded compared with the sunlit upper facade.

In the foreground, the street is paved with stone or cobblestone-like surfaces. There are metal bollards, traffic posts, and urban fixtures. A red fire hydrant or emergency utility fixture is protected by a red metal guard near the bottom center. On the right side, a black traffic light pole stands next to a metal protective railing. A red octagonal stop sign is visible near the center-right, along with a pedestrian crossing sign below it and a red “no entry” sign farther right.

Several pedestrians are walking through the scene, including adults and a child crossing the open area in front of the building. Their faces are not clear. Hanging flower baskets with greenery and colorful flowers decorate the street near the shopfronts.

The overall atmosphere is sunny, clean, and lively, with strong daylight, crisp shadows, and a mix of historic architecture and modern city street elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，焦点是一座现代风格的建筑，其外墙装饰有红色的品牌标志。建筑物的设计简洁而优雅，拥有多个阳台和白色的立柱。街道上，几位行人正在穿行，其中一位穿着蓝色上衣的人正从左侧走来，另一位穿着浅色衣服的人则在右侧行走。街道旁边有一个红色的自行车停车架，以及一个黑色的交通信号灯杆。背景中蓝天白云清晰可见，为这个城市场景增添了一抹宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a sandy beach area with several large public waste/recycling bins placed near a wooden boardwalk.

In the foreground and center, a weathered wooden walkway made of narrow planks runs diagonally from the lower middle of the image toward the right side. It lies directly on the sand and appears to provide access across the beach. The surrounding sand is uneven, with footprints, tire-like tracks, and smoothed areas.

On the left side of the image, there is a bright blue cylindrical trash bin standing alone. It has a rounded top, a black base, and a rectangular opening near the upper front. A white label on the front displays the logo and text “Comunitat Valenciana,” along with smaller official markings near the bottom. The bin shows some dirt and wear near its lower section.

On the right side, there is a cluster of three similar bins positioned beside the boardwalk. The front bin is bright yellow, with a rounded lid, black base, and a rectangular disposal opening. Behind it is a green bin, and farther back is a dark blue bin. These bins also have white labels with the “Comunitat Valenciana” logo and text, suggesting they are part of a beach waste-sorting or recycling system. The yellow bin is the most prominent because it is closest to the camera and brightly colored.

The background consists of more sand, small dunes, and sparse beach vegetation such as grasses and low shrubs. The scene feels like a maintained public beach access point, likely in the Valencian Community in Spain. There are no people visible, and the overall atmosphere is quiet and practical, focused on beach infrastructure and waste collection.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在沙滩上的三个不同颜色的垃圾桶的照片。最左边是一个蓝色的垃圾桶，紧挨着它的是一个黄色的垃圾桶，而第三个是绿色的垃圾桶。这些垃圾桶上都有白色的标签，上面印有文字和标志。它们位于一条由木板铺成的小径旁边，这条小径通向一片沙地，背景中可以看到一些植被和天空。

caption:
The image shows a modern urban business district on a bright, sunny day. Several contemporary office buildings dominate the scene, with large glass façades reflecting the pale blue sky. The architecture is distinctive: the buildings feature repeating angular, triangular metal frames or fins mounted over the windows, creating a geometric pattern across the exterior. These protruding shapes give the façades a sculptural, almost folded appearance.

On the left, a large building fills much of the frame, seen from a low angle so it rises diagonally upward toward the top left. Its exterior is made of dark-tinted glass panels divided by metal mullions, with the triangular grey structural elements arranged in rows across multiple floors. A similar building appears farther back toward the center-right, creating a sense of a coordinated office complex. Another glass building is visible between them, with a smoother, more conventional curtain-wall façade.

The lower part of the scene includes landscaped greenery. A neatly trimmed hedge runs horizontally across the foreground, separating the buildings from a dusty, unfinished-looking area of pale sand and gravel. Several palm trees stand near the buildings, adding a warm, desert or Gulf-region feel. On the far right foreground, there is a large rounded concrete planter containing a tall, slender tree with light green leaves. A black irrigation hose or cable trails from the planter across the ground.

Near the street on the right, a few vehicles are visible, including a white van and a light-colored car. There are also traffic signs near a small intersection, including triangular yield signs. In the mid-ground, shaded outdoor seating or café umbrellas appear near the base of one of the buildings.

The sky is clear and hazy blue, with strong sunlight casting crisp shadows. Overall, the image presents a clean, modern commercial area with striking glass-and-metal architecture, manicured landscaping, and signs of ongoing ground work or construction in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的摄影图像，图中建筑物具有透明的玻璃幕墙和几何形状的设计元素。在建筑前方有一排整齐的绿色植被，包括棕榈树和其他树木，为这个现代空间增添了一丝自然气息。图像前景显示了几个大型花盆，里面种植着一些植物，而背景则是一个晴朗的蓝天。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor scene in Moscow, with the Kremlin area in the background. The background is intentionally soft and out of focus, but several recognizable architectural elements are visible: a tall red-brick Kremlin tower on the left with a green spire topped by a star, another smaller tower near the center, and part of a pale building with a green roof and yellow-white detailing on the right. The sky is clear and pale blue, giving the scene a bright daytime atmosphere.

In the lower right foreground, two uniformed officers stand side by side near a light gray stone barrier or parapet. They are wearing dark navy formal uniforms with peaked caps, white shirts, ties, and shoulder insignia. One officer’s sleeve patch appears to include the Russian tricolor and Cyrillic text, indicating a Russian police or interior ministry uniform. Their faces are blurred, making them unidentifiable. One officer has long dark hair tied back, while the other appears shorter and stands slightly behind.

The middle ground is filled with lush green trees, suggesting a spring or summer setting. A few streetlights and urban elements are visible among the greenery, including a red rectangular object near the lower left-center. The composition contrasts the sharply colored uniforms in the foreground with the softly blurred historic architecture behind them, creating a sense of official presence near a prominent governmental or historic landmark.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两名穿着制服的警察站在桥上的照片，背景是莫斯科克里姆林宫的尖塔和宫殿。照片在白天拍摄，使用了自然光照，并且没有明显的艺术滤镜效果。

caption:
The image shows a large rustic hut or barn-like structure made almost entirely from dried palm fronds or thatch. The building has a long, steeply sloped roof covered in dense layers of gray-brown dried leaves, giving it a rough, shaggy texture. The thatch hangs down over the sides in uneven strands, especially along the roof edge, creating a thick fringe.

The structure appears rectangular and elongated, with a high gabled end on the left side. The walls are also made of woven or layered palm leaves, supported by horizontal and diagonal wooden poles. Several rough wooden beams are visible across the exterior, reinforcing the walls. Near the lower left is a weathered wooden door made from vertical planks, partly shaded by the overhanging thatch. There are also dark openings or gaps in the wall that look like doorways or windows.

The hut stands beside a dirt path or road, with patches of green grass along the base. The ground is reddish-brown earth, suggesting a rural or tropical setting. In the background, a green hillside or mountain is faintly visible on the left, while the upper part of the image is filled with a bright blue sky and large white clouds. A thin utility wire stretches diagonally across the upper right corner.

Overall, the scene feels warm, rural, and traditional, emphasizing natural materials and handmade construction. The most striking feature is the massive textured thatched roof, which dominates the image and gives the building a weathered, organic appearance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统建筑的照片，建筑物由茅草覆盖，呈现出典型的乡村风格。茅草屋顶覆盖着大片的干枯植物叶片，形成了一种自然的绿色调。建筑的外墙由木板构成，部分墙面被茅草遮挡。在建筑前方有一条小路，旁边是绿色的草地和一些树木。背景中可以看到蓝天和几朵白云，以及远处轮廓模糊的山丘。

caption:
The image shows a wide riverside settlement built around a broad, muddy brown river or flooded waterway. The scene has an overcast, humid atmosphere, with a pale gray-blue sky and thick clouds suggesting recent or approaching rain.

In the foreground, the water has risen high around wooden walkways and docks. Several weathered planks form uneven platforms, some partly submerged or tilted, with gaps, broken boards, and loose debris scattered across them. Green vegetation grows along the edges where the muddy water meets the bank. Ropes stretch diagonally across the scene, likely used to secure boats or floating structures.

On the left side is a large wooden houseboat or riverside house painted warm brown with green trim. It has decorative railings, a covered balcony area, and a red cylindrical water tank on the roof. A bright blue tarp is tied over part of the lower section, standing out strongly against the natural wood tones. An orange life ring hangs on the side, reinforcing the waterside setting.

Near the center-right, a gray, weathered wooden house sits very close to the water, likely on stilts or a floating platform. Its boards are faded and rough, and a narrow platform beside it holds a couple of people near a small boat. The water around the house is calm but high, reaching almost to the base of the structures.

In the lower right foreground, a colorful narrow boat is moored beside the wooden dock. It is painted bright blue, green, and white, with a covered cabin-like structure and open seating inside. The bow points toward the viewer, and the boat sits in shallow, muddy water near the platform.

On the far right edge, two children are walking along the wet wooden planks near the water. They appear barefoot and are dressed casually, adding a sense of everyday life in the riverside community.

Across the river in the background, a dense cluster of houses and buildings lines the opposite bank. Many of them have tin or metal roofs, and some are raised above the water on stilts. A green-domed building is visible among the rooftops, along with several tall antennas or masts. Trees and patches of greenery are mixed among the houses.

Overall, the image depicts a waterside village or floating-river community dealing with high water or flooding. The scene feels lived-in and practical, with boats, makeshift docks, wooden homes, tarps, ropes, and people moving through a landscape where water is central to daily life.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示河流沿岸生活的现实主义风格照片。在画面的前景，有两个人物站在木制码头上，一个穿着红色短裤和黑色背心的人正在引导另一个穿着蓝色衣服的人。背景中，可以看到几艘不同大小和设计的船只停靠在岸边，包括一艘带有绿色屋顶的大型船只和一些小船。河面上漂浮着几只水鸟，而远处则是更多的房屋和建筑，营造出一种宁静而又繁忙的生活氛围。

caption:
The image shows a tranquil lakeside landscape with a warm, slightly vintage tone.

In the foreground, there is a yellow-orange house with a terracotta red tiled roof. The roof has several TV antennas mounted on it, and the house has dark shutters on its windows. A small balcony or stair railing is visible on the right side of the house, leading down through a garden area. Surrounding the house are dense green hedges, shrubs, and a sloping lawn.

On the left side of the image, tall palm trees with fan-shaped leaves rise above the roof, giving the scene a Mediterranean or subtropical feel. More leafy vegetation fills the lower and right portions of the frame, including a large tree or bush near the lake.

Beyond the house, a calm lake stretches across the middle of the image. A small ferry or passenger boat is crossing the water, leaving a faint wake behind it. The lake surface appears smooth and pale, reflecting the muted light from the overcast sky.

In the background, large mountains dominate the scene. The peaks and ridges are partly obscured by mist or haze, creating a soft, atmospheric effect. One prominent mountain on the left has a snowy or lightly snow-dusted peak, while the lower slopes appear rocky and gray. Additional hills and mountains extend across the right side of the image, fading into the hazy distance.

The sky is cloudy and bright, with a pale cream-gray color. The overall mood is peaceful, quiet, and slightly misty, suggesting a cool morning or overcast day in a scenic lakeside village.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张具有复古风格的自然风光照片，展示了一座黄色的房子坐落在郁郁葱葱的植被中。房子位于画面的左侧，其橙红色瓦片屋顶在灰蒙蒙的天空下显得格外醒目。在房子的背后，可以看到一片宁静的湖泊和远处轮廓分明的山脉。湖面上有一艘白色的船只静静地漂浮着，为这幅宁静的画面增添了一丝生动的气息。整个场景被一种柔和而略带朦胧的光线所笼罩，营造出一种静谧而神秘的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunny harbor scene with a wide expanse of bright blue sky filling the upper half of the frame. The sky is vivid and mostly clear, with scattered soft white clouds stretched across it, especially toward the left and middle.

In the foreground on the right, a paved waterfront promenade runs diagonally from the bottom right toward the middle distance. It is lined with tall reddish-brown street lamps with circular, flat-topped fixtures. One large lamp dominates the right side of the image, extending almost from the bottom edge to near the top. Several smaller matching lamps continue down the walkway, creating depth and perspective.

To the left of the promenade is turquoise-green harbor water with gentle ripples. Several small boats are visible. Near the center-bottom, a small white sailing dinghy with a triangular sail is moving across the water; the sail has markings including “ESP” and numbers printed in red and black. A person wearing a bright red top appears to be seated in the boat. Farther left, another small sailboat is closer to the opposite quay, and a red rescue-style boat is partly visible near the lower-left edge. On the right, a small white motorboat is moored beside the stone quay wall under the promenade.

Across the harbor, a long low building stretches horizontally along the waterfront. It has a pale façade with evenly spaced doors, windows, and decorative railings along the roofline. Some signage is visible on the building, though not fully readable. A blue-and-white crane or boat-lifting apparatus stands near the center, with red inflatable boats nearby on the dock.

Behind the waterfront buildings, wooded hills rise in the background. The hills are covered with a mix of dark green trees and brownish vegetation, suggesting late autumn or winter foliage. A few houses and structures are scattered on the hillside, including a small white building that stands out against the darker trees.

Overall, the scene feels bright, calm, and coastal, with a mix of leisure sailing, harbor infrastructure, and a scenic hilly backdrop under clear daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市海港景观的照片，画面中心有两艘帆船在平静的水面上航行。左侧的帆船上有一位穿着红色上衣的人正在操作帆具，而右侧的帆船则显得较小。船只后方是一座石质码头，上面停靠着几辆汽车和一辆红色的巴士。码头旁边是几座现代风格的建筑，其中一座顶部装饰着蓝色的灯塔形状。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间，为这个宁静的场景增添了几分生动性。

caption:
The image shows the façade of an old half-timbered building, likely in a historic European town. The architecture is dominated by exposed, weathered wooden beams set into yellow plaster walls, creating a distinctive medieval or Tudor-style appearance.

At the center is a large yellow façade framed by dark, aged timber. The wood is rough, uneven, and visibly worn, with cracks, discoloration, and a silvery-brown patina that suggests great age. Vertical, horizontal, and diagonal beams form irregular geometric patterns across the wall. Some beams appear slightly warped, adding to the handcrafted, historic character of the structure.

Several windows line the upper level. Most have wooden shutters in faded gray-brown tones, many of them closed or partly closed. The shutters are old and peeling, with visible streaks and weather stains. The central windows have small rectangular panes arranged in grids, giving them a traditional leaded-glass look. The glass appears slightly cloudy and reflective, catching hints of the surroundings.

On the left edge of the image, part of a neighboring building is visible. It has a similar half-timbered style but includes a window with muted reddish-pink shutters opened outward. This splash of color contrasts with the more subdued gray and yellow tones of the central building.

On the right side, another adjoining façade appears, with darker timber and a brown wooden shuttered window. A narrow window with blue reflections is also visible, adding a cooler tone among the warm yellows and browns.

The building’s upper floor projects outward over the lower level, supported by heavy wooden brackets and joists. Beneath it is an arcade-like ground level with thick, rustic timber posts and angled braces. These large support columns stand on stone bases and hold up the overhanging structure. Behind them, the ground floor is darker and recessed, with stone walls, shopfronts, doorways, and shadowed archways.

A large dark doorway or arched entrance sits near the center-bottom, set into a stone wall. To the left, there is a storefront with cream and brown trim and glass windows. On the far right, under the covered walkway, a couple of people sit near a café-like area, partially hidden in shadow.

The foreground shows a cobblestone or pebble-textured street edge and a paved walkway beneath the wooden arcade. Downpipes and gutters run vertically along parts of the façade, adding modern functional details to the otherwise ancient-looking structure.

Overall, the image captures a richly textured historic streetscape: aged timber, yellow plaster, shuttered windows, heavy wooden supports, and deep shadows under the arcade. The scene feels old, atmospheric, and full of architectural character.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲传统木结构建筑的摄影作品。图像中心是一座具有鲜明历史感的建筑，其黄色外墙和木质框架结构清晰可见。建筑的底层是一个开放式的拱廊，上面有商店和行人。阳光从画面左侧照射进来，为整个场景增添了温暖的色调。

caption:
The image shows an opulent, marble-clad bathroom with a warm, upscale hotel-like atmosphere.

The walls are covered in large polished stone tiles in shades of gray, taupe, and brown, with dramatic natural veining in reddish and cream tones. The stone continues across multiple wall sections, creating a cohesive, luxurious look. The ceiling is painted a warm gold or beige color and has recessed lights that cast a soft yellow glow, reflecting off the glossy marble surfaces.

On the left side is a frosted glass door, likely leading to a shower or toilet area. The glass has decorative swirling etched or sandblasted patterns, with clear sections forming abstract curves. The door is framed with metal hinges and a curved metal handle.

In the center-right is a vanity area. It has a marble countertop and a sculptural stone vessel sink shaped like a rounded bowl, matching the dark, veined stone palette of the room. Above the sink is a large mirror with beveled edges and a mirrored frame, reflecting more of the marble walls and ceiling lights. Beneath the counter is a dark drawer or cabinet section, and two beige towels hang neatly below the vanity.

The floor is highly decorative, made of large marble slabs bordered by smaller peach-toned mosaic tiles. The floor pattern forms rectangular and square sections, mixing gray-green marble panels with warm peach and beige accents. The polished surface reflects the lighting and adds to the elegant feel.

On the far right edge, part of a dark vertical marble column or wall edge is visible, and beside it there appears to be a brown leather or trunk-like furniture piece with metal corner hardware and rivets, adding a slightly vintage or travel-inspired detail. At the bottom right, the bathroom floor transitions to a carpeted area outside the tiled space.

Overall, the bathroom feels luxurious and richly finished, with extensive marble, warm lighting, decorative glass, and refined details that give it a high-end spa or boutique hotel aesthetic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代浴室内部的照片，整个空间以大理石瓷砖装饰，营造出豪华而精致的氛围。左侧是一个带有独特图案的玻璃门淋浴间，其设计简约而现代。正中是一个带有深色木质台面和镜子的洗手池区域，上方悬挂着一个长形的照明灯具。右侧是一个带有棕色毛巾的储物柜，与整体的灰色调形成对比。地面铺设了与墙面相呼应的大理石瓷砖，增添了空间的统一感。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a bright shopping mall with several adjacent storefronts for **Tchibo**, a retail chain. The storefronts are lined up along the right side of the corridor, each with a large glossy **blue sign** featuring the **yellow Tchibo logo and script lettering**. The signs repeat across multiple shop entrances, creating a strong visual rhythm down the mall walkway.

The main Tchibo store entrance is on the right. It is open and brightly lit, with warm wooden flooring contrasting with the pale tiled mall floor outside. Inside the store, shelves and display stands are filled with assorted retail products, including packaged goods, clothing, household items, and accessories. Near the entrance there are promotional displays, product racks, and a shopping cart filled with items. A mannequin wearing clothing stands near the right edge of the store entrance. A person is visible inside or near the entrance, but their face is blurred.

The shopping mall itself has a clean, modern appearance. The floor is made of large cream and beige tiles arranged in a striped pattern. Tall rectangular columns in a muted gray-green color separate the storefronts. The ceiling is high and industrial-modern, with exposed beams, ducts, lighting fixtures, and large skylight panels that allow natural light to flood the corridor. Sunlight creates bright patches and shadows across the floor.

On the left side of the image, there are seating areas with red upholstered benches or chairs, a small round table or kiosk-like stand, and a freestanding advertisement sign with German text. A shopping cart and some plants are also visible nearby. In the background, more mall signage can be seen, including a directional sign pointing upward and a small sign for **Saturn**, suggesting other stores are located further down the corridor.

Overall, the scene depicts a clean, well-lit indoor shopping center with a prominent Tchibo storefront, retail displays, promotional signage, and a spacious pedestrian walkway.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一家位于购物中心内的Tchibo商店的外观。商店的入口处有蓝色和黄色的品牌标志，上方写着'Tchibo'。店铺内部展示着各种商品，包括书籍、文具和其他小物件。在商店前的过道上，可以看到几位顾客正在浏览或购物。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a Japanese restaurant at night, dominated by a huge three-dimensional red crab sculpture mounted high on the building façade. The crab is bright orange-red with cream-colored undersides on its claws and legs, and it has raised black eyes on stalks. Its large claws are spread open, and its long legs extend dramatically across the front of the building, making it look like the crab is crawling over the storefront.

The building façade behind it is mostly white or cream, with vertical decorative panels and traditional-style architectural trim. Several spotlights are aimed upward at the crab, illuminating it strongly and making its glossy surface shine against the dark night sky. The crab’s shell and legs have textured bumps and ridges, giving it a realistic, sculptural appearance.

Below the crab is a wide sign with large black Japanese characters on a pale background. The characters appear glossy and raised, likely spelling the restaurant’s name. On the left side of the image, a tall vertical sign with red Japanese writing runs down the side of the building; it includes food imagery near the bottom and appears to advertise crab dishes. The sign’s text includes “かに” and “宴会席,” suggesting a crab restaurant and banquet seating.

The perspective is angled upward from street level, emphasizing the size of the crab and the height of the building. The surrounding area is dim, with a dark sky and nearby building silhouettes, while the restaurant front is brightly lit, creating a lively nighttime urban atmosphere. The overall impression is of a famous or attention-grabbing seafood restaurant entrance, using an oversized crab display as its landmark feature.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本某个地方的商业广告牌的照片，其中一个巨大的红色螃蟹模型被安装在建筑物的外墙上。这个巨型蟹模型位于图片的中心，占据了大部分的画面空间，其鲜亮的颜色和逼真的细节让整个场景显得生动而引人注目。建筑物的外墙是白色的，上面有黑色的装饰线条，增添了传统日式建筑的特色。图像的底部可以看到店铺的招牌，写着'知床酒造本店'，表明这是一个与海鲜相关的场所。

caption:
The image shows a person working in a lush green rice field or grassy agricultural area. The scene is outdoors in bright daylight, with a soft, blurred background of dense greenery and possibly trees in the distance.

In the foreground, the person is partially turned away from the camera and is bending or crouching among tall rice plants. They are wearing a wide-brimmed woven sun hat in a pale pink or peach color, with visible circular stitching and a slightly floppy brim that shades their face. The face is intentionally blurred, making facial features indistinct. The person is dressed in a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt with subtle gray stripes or a plaid-like texture, suitable for sun protection while working outdoors.

Their right arm is extended downward into the plants, suggesting they may be harvesting, inspecting, or cutting rice stalks. The hand is visible near the lower right portion of the image, surrounded by mature rice heads that are bending under the weight of grain. The rice plants in the foreground are a mix of bright green leaves and pale golden seed heads, indicating a field close to harvest time.

The image has a shallow depth of field: the worker and nearby rice plants are relatively sharp, while the background is softly out of focus. The overall mood is calm and rural, emphasizing agricultural labor, nature, and a warm, sunlit farming environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示农业活动的现实主义风格照片，一位农民戴着宽边帽，在稻田中弯腰劳作。他穿着一件格子衬衫和黑色裤子，手中拿着一把农具。周围的稻谷已经成熟，呈现出金黄色调，而背景则是一片广阔的绿色稻田。

caption:
The image shows a white Mitsubishi pickup truck, likely a Triton model, viewed from the side while on a paved road in daylight. The truck dominates the foreground and is captured in profile, facing left. It has a double-cab design with four doors, tinted black windows, chrome door handles, chrome side mirrors, and dark alloy wheels with silver accents. The front grille and headlights are partially visible on the left, and the rear bed extends toward the right. A red-and-black “Triton Plus” badge is visible near the rear side of the truck bed.

Behind or attached near the pickup is a blue metal structure that looks like part of a tow truck, carrier, or roadside service vehicle. It extends diagonally across the upper-right portion of the image above the pickup bed. At the far right edge, part of another vehicle or service body is visible, with large blue and red Thai lettering on a white surface.

The setting appears to be an urban or roadside area. The background contains many overhead utility wires running horizontally across the frame, supported by concrete utility poles. There are also transformers or electrical equipment mounted on the poles. Behind the wires are leafy green trees, including a large tree trunk and canopy near the center-right. A low building or canopy roof is partially visible on the left side, and a red Honda sign can be seen in the distance near the middle-right background.

The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting midday sun. The road surface is gray asphalt with lane markings faintly visible near the bottom. The overall scene feels like a busy roadside environment, with the pickup either parked, stopped in traffic, or moving slowly past utility infrastructure and greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆白色皮卡车的现实主义风格照片。车辆停在街道上，周围环境包括电线杆、树木和一些模糊的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows a small cosmetic dropper bottle standing upright against a dark, matte background. The bottle is positioned slightly right of center and is photographed close-up, with a lot of empty dark gray/black space around it.

The product appears to be **Catrice Cosmetics “Galactic Highlighter Drops.”** The bottle is made of frosted or semi-opaque glass and contains a pale, pearly, off-white liquid with a subtle shimmer. The front label is faint but readable in parts: “Catrice,” “GALACTIC,” “HIGHLIGHTER,” and “DROPS” can be seen. Near the bottom, the volume marking appears to read **14 ml / 0.47 fl. oz.**

At the top is a dropper-style cap: a shiny metallic silver collar with a black rubber bulb above it. The black rubber top is rounded and glossy, reflecting a bright highlight near its upper left side. There are small white specks or dust particles visible on the rubber bulb and metal collar, as well as on the surface around the bottle.

The lighting is soft but creates strong reflections on the metal cap and the rounded rubber dropper. The background has a slight gradient, darker toward the lower area and lighter gray toward the top, giving the product a studio-shot appearance. The image overall has a muted, slightly grainy look, with the product standing out due to its pale bottle and reflective silver cap against the dark backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示化妆品瓶的产品摄影图片，瓶子是透明的，顶部有一个黑色的旋盖。瓶子上印有'Galactic Highlighter'的文字和一个白色的品牌标志。背景是均匀的深色调，以突出产品的细节。

caption:
The image shows a supermarket or store shelf stacked tightly with multiple orange Sunquick drink cartons, likely a multipack display.

Most of the packaging is bright orange, decorated with images of sliced oranges, whole oranges, green leaves, and splashes of orange juice. The large vertical “sunquick” logo appears repeatedly in dark blue letters with a white outline. Near the bottom of several cartons is the word “OREN,” indicating orange flavor, along with a green circular badge that says “Vitamin C.”

Several of the packs have a large promotional wrapper across the front. This wrapper has a light blue sky background with small clouds, green grass at the bottom, and a cartoon yellow school bus. The text reads “JOM KEMBALI KE SEKOLAH,” suggesting a back-to-school promotion. A red-and-green sign on the wrapper says “PEK PROMOSI 5+1 PERCUMA,” meaning a promotional pack offering 5 plus 1 free. There is also a barcode printed prominently on the front of the promo panels.

The cartons are arranged in rows and columns, filling almost the entire frame. Some boxes are front-facing, while others are turned sideways, showing nutrition or ingredient information along the side. The display appears slightly compressed, with the plastic wrapping around the cartons reflecting light. On the far right edge, part of another dark or grey product is visible, but the main focus is the bright orange Sunquick display. The cartons sit on a light-colored metal shelf.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Sunquick橙汁包装盒的照片，盒子堆叠在货架上。每个盒子都印有品牌名称和产品信息，包括'5+1 PERIODES'字样，意为每周的五天加一天，以及一个黄色的小巴士图案。背景是模糊的，突出了前景中的产品。

caption:
The image shows a wide outdoor street or pedestrian path in a residential neighborhood, likely during spring or early summer. The scene is framed by greenery on both sides, with bushes, trees, and grass lining a paved walkway or quiet road. In the background, pale apartment buildings with multiple windows are visible, softly out of focus.

At the center of the image is a woman walking toward the camera. She has light blond hair and is wearing a black jacket over a light blue-green dress with white polka dots and a ruffled hem. She also wears black tights and black shoes. A small black crossbody bag hangs at her front. She is looking down at a smartphone in her hands and appears to be holding a small red retractable leash handle. A thin leash extends diagonally down toward the lower-right corner of the image.

At the bottom right, a small brown dog—possibly a Yorkshire terrier—is walking on the grass beside the path. The dog appears to be wearing a light blue garment or harness and is connected to the leash held by the woman.

Several other pedestrians are visible in the background, all somewhat blurred due to depth of field. On the left, an older-looking man walks toward the camera carrying a colorful shopping bag. Farther back, a few people are walking along the path or standing near the greenery. On the right side, two people walk away from the camera: one in a greenish jacket and another in a black-and-white checkered coat.

The overall atmosphere is calm and everyday, showing people strolling through a leafy residential area. The focus is strongest on the central woman and the small dog, while the background buildings and passersby are softly blurred.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现日常生活场景的照片，捕捉到了一位穿着时尚的女性在公园小径上行走的瞬间。她身穿黑色夹克和蓝色带有图案的裙子，脚踩黑色高跟鞋，并佩戴着红色手套。她的手机紧紧握在手中，似乎正专注地查看屏幕上的内容。在她的前方，一只棕色的小狗正在草坪上自由奔跑。背景中，其他行人沿着小径走动，其中一些人携带着购物袋，而另一些则专注于自己的步伐。周围环境由绿色的树木、灌木丛和远处的建筑物构成，营造出一个宁静的社区氛围。

caption:
The image shows a narrow, historic pedestrian street in a warm-toned urban area, likely in a Mediterranean city. The scene is lined with old stone buildings featuring ornate architecture, enclosed wooden balconies, and projecting window structures typical of traditional streetscapes.

On the left side, there is a café or restaurant with a modern glass storefront. The sign above and on the window reads “Fellini,” suggesting the establishment’s name. A cream-colored awning extends outward over the entrance and outdoor seating area. In front of the café are several metal-framed chairs and small tables arranged on the pavement, along with large rectangular planters containing green shrubs. One planter prominently displays a Coca-Cola logo. A chalkboard menu sign stands nearby, advertising a special of the day and a price of €10.50.

The street itself is paved with dark stone slabs and stretches into the distance, narrowing visually as it leads toward a brighter sunlit area at the far end. The lighting is warm and golden, especially on the buildings farther down the street, while the foreground remains partly shaded.

The architecture is a major visual feature: the buildings are made of beige limestone or similar stone, with carved decorative details and protruding balconies. Several enclosed balconies are painted in deep green, cream, and reddish tones. On the right side, a long stone wall and ornate building façade run parallel to the street, adding to the sense of depth.

A person is walking away from the camera on the right side of the street. They are wearing a dark jacket, dark pants, red shoes, and a cap. Farther down the street, a few more people can be seen near outdoor café tables and umbrellas.

Overall, the image captures a quiet, atmospheric city street with a blend of historic architecture, café culture, outdoor dining, and warm late-afternoon light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的摄影图像，画面中一位穿着休闲服装的人正沿着铺有石板的道路行走。街道两侧是具有传统欧洲建筑风格的商店和餐馆，其中一家商店的橱窗上写着'Suljola'，而另一家餐厅则有一个黑色的菜单牌立在人行道旁。阳光从画面右侧照射下来，给整个场景增添了一种温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a brightly lit retail display shelf filled with AERIN fragrance products. The shelving unit is white with glossy, glass-like shelves and a pale blue-white illuminated backing, giving the display a clean, luxury boutique feel. Gold-toned vertical trim frames the sides.

Several rows of perfume boxes and bottles are arranged in small grouped sets:

- **Top shelf:**  
  On the left are blue-and-white patterned boxes labeled **AERIN Mediterranean Honeysuckle**, with a matching clear glass perfume bottle in front. The bottle has a gold collar and a rounded blue cap. On the right are floral boxes labeled **AERIN Iris Meadow**, decorated with large purple and pink flowers, with a matching bottle placed in front.

- **Middle shelf:**  
  On the left are **AERIN Waterlily Sun** products in white boxes with green and turquoise botanical patterns. A clear bottle with a green cap sits in front of the boxes. On the right are **AERIN Hibiscus Palm** products, with colorful tropical floral packaging featuring orange, pink, green, and blue leaves and flowers. A matching perfume bottle with a coral-pink cap stands in front.

- **Lower middle shelf:**  
  On the left are **AERIN Gardenia Rattan** boxes, decorated with soft pink, yellow, and green floral designs, with a perfume bottle in front that has a pale mint-green cap. On the right are **AERIN Evening Rose** boxes with bold red, pink, purple, and dark floral patterns. A clear bottle with a muted purple cap is placed in front.

- **Bottom visible shelf:**  
  Only the upper part of this shelf is visible. It contains additional boxed items with patterned packaging, including beige and blue designs on the left and gray-and-white geometric patterned boxes in the center. On the right there is a dark gray rectangular box or container next to more products.

Overall, the display is organized by fragrance collection, with each scent represented by matching decorative boxes and a coordinating perfume bottle. The packaging is colorful, floral, and elegant, contrasting with the minimalist white shelving and soft lighting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种香水瓶和包装盒的商业摄影照片。图片中，货架上摆放着多个不同设计的香水瓶和装饰性盒子，每个瓶子和盒子都精心设计，色彩丰富且图案多样。货架被分为几层，每层都有不同的产品展示。背景是白色的墙壁，与货架上的商品形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a serene bamboo forest, viewed from a low-to-mid perspective looking through many tall, vertical bamboo stalks. The bamboo trunks are pale green to gray-green, with visible segmented nodes, and they rise high out of the frame, creating a dense, column-like pattern across the scene. Sunlight filters through the canopy, casting bright patches and soft shadows on the trunks and forest floor.

In the foreground, leafy branches hang across the upper part of the image, adding a layer of green foliage in front of the bamboo. On the far left, there is a thicker brown tree trunk that contrasts with the smooth green bamboo stems. The ground is covered with dry leaves, small plants, and bamboo debris.

Near the lower center-right of the image, a traditional rickshaw is visible on a path. It has large spoked wheels and a black seat or canopy structure, with red fabric or trim around the passenger area. A person is seated in the rickshaw, wearing dark clothing and facing toward the rickshaw puller. The rickshaw puller stands in front, wearing a light-colored hat and a vest or layered clothing, holding the shafts of the rickshaw.

Behind them, a low bamboo fence runs horizontally across the scene, separating the path from the dense undergrowth. The background is filled with more bamboo, creating a deep, layered forest effect. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and scenic, with the tall bamboo and dappled sunlight giving the image a calm, natural, almost cinematic quality.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示竹林中人物的自然风光照片。在画面中央，一位穿着传统服装的人正坐在一辆红色的三轮车上，车上有一个人物。他们被高耸的竹子环绕，这些竹子形成了一个密集的绿色隧道，为这个场景增添了一种宁静和和谐的感觉。阳光透过树叶洒下，给整个场景增添了温暖的光线效果。

caption:
The image shows a riverside ritual scene, likely an idol immersion ceremony for a Hindu festival such as Ganesh Chaturthi. Several men are standing at the muddy edge of a body of water, carefully carrying a brightly decorated idol of Lord Ganesha on a flat platform. The idol is covered in vivid pink, orange, red, and gold decorations, with garlands around it and a tall ornate crown. Pink colored powder is visible on the idol and on the men’s clothing and faces, suggesting a festive or ceremonial atmosphere.

Three men are closest to the idol: one in a blue shirt stands with his back to the camera, another in a striped T-shirt supports the platform from the front, and a third in a light pink shirt leans in from the right side to help. Their pants are partly in the shallow water, and they appear to be lowering or positioning the idol for immersion. The lighting is warm and low, possibly late afternoon or early evening, casting a golden glow on the scene.

The water is calm but cluttered with floating leaves, flower garlands, debris, and ritual remains. Bright orange marigold flowers are scattered in clumps near the shore and in the water. In the foreground, slightly out of focus, another Ganesha idol is visible, with a blue halo-like backdrop and gold ornamentation. This foreground idol suggests that multiple idols are being immersed or prepared for immersion.

The riverbank is messy, with broken materials, plastic bags, pieces of wood, clay fragments, and discarded offerings. In the background, long wooden or bamboo rafts or planks lie across the water’s surface, and patches of floating vegetation drift nearby. The overall scene combines devotion and celebration with the aftermath of ritual activity, showing both the colorful beauty of the ceremony and the environmental clutter left around the water.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉宗教节日庆祝活动的纪实摄影照片，显示了几位参与者在河流或湖泊边进行一种宗教仪式。他们正站在水中，周围散布着五颜六色的鲜花和祭品。一位穿着粉红色衬衫的人正在用水桶装水，而其他几位则在处理一些宗教物品。背景中可以看到平静的水面和远处模糊的陆地轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic, low-angle view of camels silhouetted against a soft pastel sky, likely at sunrise or sunset.

A large camel dominates the left side of the frame. Its long neck rises upward from the lower-left corner, and its head is tilted slightly back, giving it a proud, statuesque appearance. Because the light source is behind it, the camel appears mostly in shadow, but fine details are still visible: the fuzzy outline of its ear, the curve of its muzzle, the dark eye, whiskers around the mouth, and the shaggy texture of fur along its neck.

The sky fills most of the background and has a gentle gradient, shifting from warm pale yellow and peach near the horizon to cool lavender and blue higher up. The sun or bright glow is positioned behind the main camel’s neck, creating a backlit effect and soft halo around parts of the animal.

On the right side and lower portion of the image, several other camels are visible in darker silhouette. One camel on the right has its head raised, with what looks like a rope or reins hanging near its face. Another camel’s hump and back occupy the lower center of the frame. The animals appear to be part of a group or caravan.

In the far background, faint shapes of trees, distant hills or mountains, and atmospheric haze can be seen, adding depth to the scene. The overall mood is calm, atmospheric, and cinematic, with the camels appearing as dark, textured forms against the glowing early-morning or evening sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示骆驼剪影的自然摄影风格照片。图像中，一只骆驼的头部和颈部在夕阳的柔和光线照射下显得轮廓分明，它的耳朵向后伸展，似乎是在倾听周围的声音。背景是渐变的天空，从橙黄色到淡蓝色，以及远处若隐若现的山脉轮廓。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a grand historic shopping arcade or gallery, viewed from a low angle looking upward and outward through a monumental archway. The architecture is highly ornate, with a strong classical and Renaissance-revival character.

A large glass-and-iron vaulted roof dominates the upper half of the scene. The roof is made of curved metal ribs and rectangular glass panes, forming a bright arched canopy that lets in soft daylight. Hanging from the metal structure are round pendant lamps. Beneath the glass roof is a richly decorated semicircular lunette with sculptural reliefs: pale stone figures reclining and grouped in classical poses against a warm gold background. Below it, a fan-shaped window with decorative ironwork echoes the curve of the roof.

The surrounding walls are covered in elaborate carved ornamentation. There are rows of columns with Corinthian-style capitals, framed panels filled with floral and figurative reliefs, gilded decorative accents, cornices, medallions, and sculpted garlands. The stonework is mostly beige, cream, and gray, with patches of gold and warm ochre marble. On both sides, tall multi-story façades rise upward with arched windows and deeply carved frames, giving the arcade the feeling of an indoor palace street.

In the center lower portion, a massive archway opens to the outside. Its underside is heavily decorated with relief carvings, and through it a bright exterior building is visible. The building across the way has classical columns and a sign reading “REAL TEATRO DI S. CARLO,” indicating the view is toward the San Carlo theater. Below that, another façade with dark gray rusticated stone and arched openings can be seen.

The floor is polished stone or marble, laid in geometric patterns, reflecting some of the light from above. Several people are walking or standing in the arcade, giving a sense of scale to the towering architecture. Some appear to be tourists or shoppers; one person carries a helmet, others carry bags, and a group on the right walks together, including children. On the right side, a storefront sign advertises “OUTLET” and a red “50%” discount.

Overall, the image conveys a spacious, elegant, historic urban interior: a richly ornamented gallery with a luminous glass ceiling, classical sculptures, marble surfaces, and people moving casually beneath the grandeur.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑内部的摄影作品，图像中心是一个装饰华丽的大拱门，上方覆盖着一个大型玻璃穹顶。拱门两侧是精致的墙面和柱子，上面装饰有复杂的浮雕和雕塑。拱门下方是宽敞的通道，通道上铺设有大理石地面，并且可以看到几位游客在其中行走。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一种庄重而优雅的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a woman standing outdoors at night in front of a brightly lit pool or water feature. The scene has a party or nightlife atmosphere, with colorful lights, blurred people, and decorative structures in the background.

She is centered in the frame and photographed from about mid-thigh upward. Her face is intentionally blurred, but she has long, straight-to-wavy hair with light brown and blonde tones, parted near the middle and falling over her shoulders. She is wearing a vivid red sleeveless dress or top-and-skirt outfit. The outfit has a shiny, satin-like texture and is accented with wide silver rhinestone or sequin bands—one across the waist and another visible near the hem. The neckline is straight and fitted.

She is holding a red clutch purse in front of her with both hands. The clutch has a textured leather-like surface, a flap, a zipper detail, and a strap/buckle feature. On one wrist she wears a wide, sparkling silver cuff bracelet made of multiple rows of rhinestones or crystals, matching the silver embellishments on her outfit.

The background is softly out of focus, creating a bokeh effect. Behind her is a blue-lit pool occupying much of the lower background, with reflections of pink, purple, and white lights on the water. Farther back, there are silhouettes of people, white draped cabana-like structures, string lights, and large curved architectural or decorative elements illuminated in blue and purple. The overall lighting is colorful and dramatic, with cool blue tones from the pool contrasting against the bright red of her outfit.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张摄影棚照明风格的照片，展示了一位女性站在户外的蓝色泳池边。她穿着一件红色无袖连衣裙，裙子前面装饰有银色亮片，腰间系着一条白色腰带。她的左手拿着一个红色的手包，右手自然下垂。她的头发是棕色的，披散在肩上。背景中可以看到模糊的人群和一些夜晚活动的灯光，营造出一种轻松愉快的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the back of a Buddhist monk or robed devotee standing or sitting in a richly decorated temple courtyard. The person is centered in the lower half of the frame, wearing a deep reddish-orange robe draped over the shoulders. Their head is shaved, and a pair of eyeglasses rests near one ear, visible from behind.

In front of the figure is an ornate golden structure, likely part of a pagoda or shrine. The background is dominated by warm gold tones: gilded walls, carved decorative trim, and reflective surfaces. The architecture has layered horizontal bands and raised ornamental details, giving the scene a sacred and ceremonial feel.

Surrounding the figure are elaborate decorative tree-like structures. These have dark reddish-brown stems and branches, with many metallic gold leaves or flower-shaped ornaments attached. Some of the ornaments resemble blossoms, while others look like stylized leaves. Several umbrella-like elements with red-brown tops appear among the branches, adding to the temple’s ritual aesthetic. Large gold vase-like bases support these decorative trees on both sides of the frame.

The foreground includes pale stone or marble elements, including rounded, weathered stone forms and low white bases. The surface beneath appears smooth and light-colored, possibly a temple floor or courtyard paving. The image uses a shallow depth of field: the monk and some nearby elements are clearer, while much of the golden shrine and decorations behind are softly blurred. This creates a calm, contemplative atmosphere and draws attention to the person gazing toward the sacred golden structure.

Overall, the scene feels serene, devotional, and visually luxurious, with strong contrasts between the monk’s red robe and the glowing gold of the temple surroundings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位僧侣在寺庙前沉思的照片。僧侣身穿传统的红色僧袍，背对着镜头，坐在一块石头上，似乎在进行冥想或祈祷。他戴着一顶棕色的僧帽，面部表情平静而专注。在他周围是金色的佛教建筑，装饰着复杂的图案和雕塑，营造出一种庄严神圣的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a quiet road bridge stretching forward into a hilly, wooded landscape. The bridge has a distinctive pale cream or off-white metal arch structure, with large curved beams and triangular cross-bracing along the sides. The arches rise prominently over the roadway, giving the bridge an old but sturdy industrial appearance.

On the left side is the asphalt road, divided by a white center line. The road surface looks slightly worn, with visible cracks and patches near the foreground. A metal crash barrier runs along the near edge of the road, bolted into concrete supports. There are no cars, cyclists, or pedestrians visible, making the scene feel still and empty.

On the right side of the bridge is a raised pedestrian walkway paved with square gray tiles. It is bordered by mustard-yellow metal railings that continue into the distance. A small yellow gate-like section of railing stands near the entrance to the walkway. Dry leaves, twigs, and dirt have collected along the edges of the path and near the foreground, suggesting the area is exposed to wind and seasonal debris.

At the far right foreground, part of a white concrete bridge marker or plaque is visible. It has raised lettering, though only some of it can be read clearly; it appears to identify the bridge and possibly includes a date. The side of the marker has green and yellow painted stripes.

Beyond the bridge, the background is dominated by hills covered in dense green vegetation and rows of tall, slender trees along the ridgelines. Some exposed earth and rocky cuttings are visible on the slopes, especially near the center-right, where the hillside has a rough, excavated look. A roadway with a few signs runs along the hillside in the distance.

The sky is pale and partly cloudy, with soft gray and white clouds spread across it. The lighting is gentle and diffuse, possibly from late afternoon or an overcast day, giving the scene muted colors and a calm atmosphere. Overall, the image depicts a rural or semi-rural bridge crossing through a green valley, with strong geometric bridge elements contrasting against the natural hills behind it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代桥梁结构的摄影图像。桥梁是一座白色的金属拱桥，其设计简洁而坚固，具有典型的现代建筑特征。桥梁两侧设有黄色的安全护栏，以确保行人和车辆安全通行。在桥梁的右侧，有一条人行道，上面安装有警示标志和栏杆。背景中可以看到郁郁葱葱的树木和一片开阔的土地，天空中有散布的云朵，整体画面给人一种宁静和平静的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a large historic red-brick building viewed from street level at an angle, emphasizing its long façade and ornate architecture. The building has a grand, institutional appearance—possibly a town hall, courthouse, university building, or civic office.

The façade is made primarily of reddish brick, with contrasting pale stone trim around the windows, corners, cornices, and decorative elements. The architecture is elaborate and old-fashioned, with arched windows, carved stone details, and a steep dark tiled roof. Several tall windows have rounded arches and decorative stone frames; some include circular or oval upper sections, giving the façade a formal, Renaissance or neo-Gothic character.

Near the center is a prominent entrance with a carved stone portal. The doorway is set beneath an arched decorative frame and flanked by columns or pilasters. Above the entrance is a small balcony with a stone balustrade, and behind it are tall arched windows. The entrance is reached by broad stone steps and a gently sloped ramp or raised walkway. The stonework around the doorway is especially detailed, with sculptural ornamentation and a formal crest-like feature.

The roofline includes dormer windows and small towers or decorative roof structures. On the right side of the building, a taller projecting section has a stepped or gabled top with ornamental stone accents and a small tower-like feature rising above it. The dark roof tiles contrast strongly with the warm brick and pale stone.

In the foreground on the left, a leafless tree stands close to the building, its bare branches spreading across the upper part of the façade. This suggests the photo may have been taken in late autumn, winter, or early spring. The lower foreground includes a paved pedestrian area, stone steps, low brick-and-stone retaining walls, and a cobbled or textured walkway.

On the right side of the scene, there are decorative black street lamps on stone bases near the steps. Farther right, beyond the historic building, a more modern rectangular building is visible, pale in color with rows of windows. A line of parked cars and blue metal railings can also be seen along the street.

The sky is clear and bright blue, and the sunlight gives the scene a crisp, cool atmosphere. The overall impression is of a well-preserved historic urban building in a European-style city setting, combining ornate masonry, civic grandeur, and a quiet street environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影照片，画面中心是一座红砖建筑，其特点是装饰性的拱形窗户和突出的阳台。建筑前有一棵赤裸的树，街道上停有几辆汽车，而背景中可见其他现代风格的建筑物。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，呈现出宁静的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a low-angle view of an ornate historic building façade against a vivid blue sky. The left two-thirds of the frame are mostly open sky, bright and clear, with a few faint wisps of cloud near the lower center. The building occupies the right side of the image, rising vertically and slightly receding into the distance, which emphasizes its height and grandeur.

The façade is made of pale beige or cream-colored stone, warmly lit by sunlight. It is highly decorative, with elaborate carved details typical of Baroque or Renaissance-inspired architecture. There are tall rectangular windows with dark shutters and wooden frames, set within richly ornamented surrounds. Many of the window frames are topped or flanked by sculptural elements, including scrollwork, floral motifs, shells, and carved figures.

Several protruding balconies or ledges are supported by ornate brackets. These brackets include sculpted human-like figures and decorative masks, giving the building a theatrical, heavily embellished appearance. Vertical columns and pilasters run between the windows, some with fluted shafts and carved capitals. The stonework includes layered moldings, curved pediments, and relief panels with repeating patterns.

Near the center-left edge of the building is a rounded corner section or turret-like bay, capped by a curved roofline. This rounded portion softens the otherwise vertical, structured façade and adds depth to the architecture. A narrow drainpipe runs down part of the wall, contrasting with the historic stone details.

The sunlight creates strong highlights on the projecting carvings and deep shadows in the recesses, making the façade’s texture and depth stand out. Overall, the image conveys the elegance and craftsmanship of a grand historic urban building, photographed on a clear, sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑细节的摄影作品，图像捕捉了一栋装饰华丽的建筑物的一部分。建筑的立面装饰着精细的雕塑和浮雕，呈现出巴洛克或新古典主义风格。阳光照耀下，建筑的白色墙面在蓝天的映衬下显得格外明亮。

caption:
The image is a very low-angle, ground-level view of an urban street or parking area. The camera is positioned almost on the pavement, making the rough asphalt surface dominate the foreground. Small stones, pebbles, cracks, and bits of aggregate in the road are visible in detail, with a gray-brown, gritty texture. The closest foreground is slightly soft, while the mid-foreground pavement is the sharpest part of the image.

The background is heavily out of focus, creating a strong shallow-depth-of-field effect. Blurred buildings line both sides of the street. On the left, there appears to be a multi-story structure with balconies or dark horizontal architectural elements. In the center and right background are storefront-like buildings with signs, though the text is unreadable due to the blur. A red-toned sign or building facade is visible on the far right, and a darker rectangular sign appears near the center.

Several vehicles are faintly visible in the background, including a light-colored car on the left and darker cars on the right. There are also indistinct street signs near the upper-right area, including shapes resembling traffic or yield signs. The sky above is pale blue and clear, suggesting daylight.

Overall, the image emphasizes perspective and texture rather than identifiable subjects. It has a cinematic, low-to-the-ground composition, with the rough road surface in focus and the urban environment reduced to soft, abstract shapes and colors in the distance.
