The overall atmosphere feels like a high-end sports hall, arena entrance, museum-style exhibit, or event installation celebrating ONE Championship titleholders.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示体育赛事宣传的摄影棚照明风格照片，图像中有一排大型广告牌，上面印有多个穿着运动服的人物形象和他们的名字。每个人物都戴着头盔，背后是模糊的背景，而广告牌上方则清晰地写着'ONE World Champions are made here'。

caption:
The image shows the entrance to an old historical stone structure, likely a mosque, palace, fort, or heritage monument. The architecture is weathered and ornate, with carved stone details framing a large doorway.

In the foreground, a man stands on the right side of the entrance, leaning casually against the stone wall with his arms crossed. He is wearing a deep red long-sleeved shirt and light blue jeans. His face is blurred, and he is positioned partly in shadow near the doorway.

The doorway itself is large and rectangular, framed by thick, aged stone blocks. On both sides of the entrance are decorative carved pillars or jambs with worn geometric and floral-like patterns. The stone surface is rough, stained, and discolored from age, with patches of black, beige, and gray. Above the entrance is a projecting stone lintel or cornice with carved elements and a slightly broken, uneven top edge.

Two tall blue-green metal gates are open inward on either side of the entrance. The gates are made of vertical bars and solid lower panels, showing signs of rust and wear.

Through the doorway, the interior courtyard or hall is visible. Inside are rows of stone columns supporting arches and upper walkways. The architecture features pointed arches, carved column bases, and layered stonework. The floor appears to be made of rectangular stone or brick tiles, dusty and uneven. Farther inside, a small figure can be seen standing or walking in the distance, emphasizing the depth of the structure.

At the top inside the building, a corrugated metal roof or canopy is visible, supported by columns, suggesting restoration or later protective covering. Natural light filters in from the open spaces, creating a warm glow on the beige stone surfaces and highlighting the arches and columns.

Overall, the scene has a strong sense of age and history, with the worn textures, carved stone details, open gates, and deep architectural perspective drawing attention into the monument’s interior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男性站在一座古老建筑入口处的照片。男性身穿红色长袖衬衫和蓝色牛仔裤，站立姿态自然，双臂交叉在胸前。他位于画面的右侧，面向左侧，与观众形成对话。背景中，可以看到一系列拱形门廊和石制结构，这些元素构成了一个典型的古典建筑风格。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种宁静而历史悠久的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the richly decorated interior of a Gothic chapel or cathedral, photographed from a low angle looking upward toward the vaulted ceiling.

The ceiling is a deep royal blue, covered with repeated gold fleur-de-lis motifs, giving it a regal, medieval appearance. From a circular carved boss near the top center, numerous gilded ribs radiate outward like the spokes of a fan or the rays of a sun. These ribs curve gracefully into pointed Gothic arches, creating a complex web of vaulting. The gold surfaces catch the dim interior light, contrasting strongly with the dark blue ceiling panels.

Large pointed arches frame the scene on all sides. They are painted and gilded, with bands of red, green, and gold ornamentation running along their edges. The architecture feels tall and vertical, with slender columns and clustered supports rising toward the ceiling. Several dark vertical columns or supports cut through the foreground, emphasizing the height and depth of the space.

Below the vaulting are vibrant stained-glass windows. The windows glow with intense blues, reds, greens, and yellows, depicting religious figures and decorative patterns. Some windows show full-length saints or biblical figures beneath small architectural canopies, while others contain circular rose-like designs. The stained glass adds bright jewel-toned color to the otherwise shadowed interior.

The overall atmosphere is dramatic and reverent. The combination of gold ribbing, blue fleur-de-lis ceiling, pointed arches, and luminous stained glass creates a highly ornate Gothic sacred space, likely part of a historic royal chapel or cathedral. The image emphasizes craftsmanship, symmetry, verticality, and the lavish decorative style of medieval ecclesiastical architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示哥特式建筑内部的摄影作品，图像中心是高耸的拱形天花板，其上装饰有金色的十字架和蓝色背景。两侧墙壁上镶嵌着色彩斑斓的彩色玻璃窗，透过窗户可以看到外面的光线。整个场景被柔和而均匀的光线照亮，营造出一种庄严而神圣的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large historic brick building set in a landscaped garden, viewed from a low, slightly angled perspective. The structure has the appearance of a palace, manor, or old institutional building, with ornate architectural details and a strong medieval or neo-Romanian style.

The building is made primarily of reddish-orange brick, with weathered areas and lighter stone or plaster accents. Its walls are massive and rectangular, giving it a fortress-like presence. Along the upper portion of the façade runs a decorative band of repeating arched brick openings and pale stone corbels, creating a rhythmic pattern just below the roofline.

The roof is dark gray, steeply pitched, and covered with slate or tile. It has broad overhanging eaves supported by exposed wooden brackets painted in a dark reddish-brown tone. The roofline forms several intersecting volumes, suggesting a complex, multi-wing layout.

On the visible front and side walls are tall, narrow windows with arched tops. Many of the windows have decorative brick arches above them and dark frames, with some appearing to have patterned or leaded glass. The windows are spaced evenly, reinforcing the formal symmetry of the architecture.

One of the most striking features is a white stone balcony or loggia on the right side of the building. It projects outward from the brick façade and is supported by slender columns with carved capitals. The balcony has ornate arches and a richly decorated balustrade with floral or geometric relief patterns. Its pale stone contrasts strongly with the red brick walls, making it a focal point of the image. A staircase descends from the balcony area toward the garden on the far right.

The building is surrounded by mature evergreen trees. On the left, a large bluish-green conifer with dense, sprawling branches partially obscures the façade. On the right, tall trees frame the building vertically, their trunks and foliage creating a natural border. Some leaves appear brown or dry, adding variation in color and texture.

In the foreground is a manicured garden with trimmed hedges, grass, and low shrubs. The hedges form neat horizontal lines across the lower part of the image, while a small bush stands near the center in front of the building. The grounds look maintained but natural, with a mixture of formal landscaping and mature vegetation.

The sky above is bright but overcast, filled with pale gray and white clouds. The soft, diffused light reduces harsh shadows and gives the scene a calm, slightly subdued atmosphere. Overall, the image conveys the grandeur of an old architectural landmark nestled among greenery, combining historic craftsmanship, red-brick masonry, ornate stonework, and a peaceful garden setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑风格的图像，建筑采用红砖结构，具有多个拱形窗户和一个带有柱子的阳台。建筑前有修剪整齐的草坪和几棵高大的树木，包括一棵松树和一棵橡树。天空多云，但光线充足，为整个场景提供了自然光照。

caption:
The image shows the upper façade of a grand, historic hotel set against a dramatic alpine mountain backdrop.

In the foreground, a large pink-and-white building fills most of the frame. The façade is elegant and ornate, with pale pink walls, white decorative trim, and rows of tall rectangular windows. Many of the windows have deep red shutters, some open and some closed, giving the building a classic European resort-hotel appearance. Several small wrought-iron balconies project from the façade, with dark railings and delicate metalwork.

Near the top of the building, large red lettering is painted across decorative white panels. The central sign reads “BAGNI NUOVI”, while smaller curved panels on either side read “GRAND” and “HOTEL,” together forming “Grand Bagni Nuovi Hotel.” The roofline is elaborately decorated with sculptural flourishes, curved pediments, ornamental shells, and classical-style detailing. Decorative streetlamps with curved black metal arms and cream-colored globe lights rise above the roof and in front of the building.

A prominent covered balcony or veranda extends from the middle of the hotel façade. It has a dark metal canopy with decorative trim and ornate railings, suggesting an old luxury spa or resort hotel. The building’s mansard-style roof sections have patterned gray-green tiles and dormer windows.

Behind the hotel, steep rocky mountains rise sharply. The peaks are rugged, partly covered with snow, and dotted with dark evergreen trees. The mountains create a dramatic contrast with the refined pastel architecture of the hotel. Above everything is a bright blue sky with scattered soft white clouds, giving the scene a crisp, sunny alpine atmosphere.

Overall, the image conveys the feel of a historic luxury hotel in a mountain resort town, combining ornate European architecture with a striking snowy mountain landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一座粉色建筑的摄影照片，建筑上方有'GRAND BAGNI NUOVI HOTEL'的字样。建筑物的设计精美，有多层阳台和红色百叶窗，阳台上装饰着花卉。在建筑物的背后，可以看到一座壮观的山脉，山顶覆盖着积雪，而天空是晴朗的蓝色。

caption:
The image shows the front window of a warmly lit bakery or pâtisserie, viewed from outside through a green-painted window frame. The scene has a cozy, amber glow, with reflections of interior wall lamps and dark wood paneling giving the shop an old-fashioned, elegant atmosphere.

Behind the glass is a multi-level display case filled with baked goods and prepared foods. On the upper shelf are French viennoiseries and pastries: flaky palmiers, raisin pastries, apple turnovers, chocolate-hazelnut pastries, brioche, and almond chocolate breads. Small printed price cards in French sit in front of each item, with headings like “LES VIENNOISERIES” and prices in euros.

The middle shelf contains savory items: croissant sandwiches with ham and cheese, pretzel-style sandwiches with lettuce and sausage, and a stack of square puff-pastry or quiche-like items on the right. More labels identify items such as “croissant jambon fromage,” “petit bretzel,” and other snack or catering products.

On the lower shelf are desserts and sandwiches. To the left are pastries such as chocolate éclairs, raspberry tartlets, and strawberry tartlets, with glossy red fruit visible. To the right are long sandwiches or toasties labeled with fillings like tuna, goat cheese, beef, and chicken, along with a flatbread or pizza-like item at the far right.

A vertical green mullion divides the image down the center, emphasizing that the viewer is looking through a storefront window. The glass adds soft reflections and slight blur, while the warm interior lights create a golden, inviting mood. The overall impression is of a charming French bakery display, full of pastries, sandwiches, and desserts arranged neatly behind glass.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种糕点和面包的橱窗摄影图像。橱窗内部装有多个玻璃隔层，每个隔层上都摆放着精心制作的食品。从左到右，可以看到多种类型的面包、蛋糕和其他甜点，如羊角面包、长棍面包、草莓派等。这些食品被摆放在透明的玻璃柜中，透过玻璃可以清晰地看到它们的细节。背景中的灯光为整个场景增添了一种温馨而诱人的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a crowded outdoor scene at sunset, photographed from within a group of people. The lighting is dramatic and backlit: the sun is low on the horizon, partly hidden behind clouds, creating a warm golden-orange sky and turning many of the people into dark silhouettes.

In the foreground, several people are wearing light-colored clothing, mostly white or pale garments. Many have their heads covered with wide-brimmed hats, scarves, or wrapped cloths, suggesting strong sun protection in a hot environment. On the left-center, a person in profile wears a large white sun hat with a cloth drape around the neck and face, a pale long-sleeved garment with lace-like cuffs, and a dark backpack. Their face is mostly in shadow because of the backlighting.

On the right side, very close to the camera, another person is mostly silhouetted. They appear to be wearing a textured hood or towel-like head covering, dark clothing, and a backpack with visible straps. This figure blocks a large portion of the right side of the frame, adding depth and the feeling of being in a dense crowd.

In the middle and background, more people in similar white clothing and head coverings are visible, some wearing backpacks or small bags. A few red or orange tags or pouch-like items hang from people’s shoulders, possibly identification or travel accessories. The crowd seems to be moving or standing closely together in an organized area.

Behind the people are large white tent-like structures with tall, pointed peaks. Several of these peaks rise into the sky, with small openings or framework visible near the tops. The tents create a repeating architectural pattern across the background. A fence or barrier runs horizontally near the lower middle of the image.

The overall mood is atmospheric and slightly solemn or contemplative, with the warm sunset, silhouettes, and tightly packed crowd giving the impression of a large outdoor gathering or pilgrimage-like event. The contrast between the glowing sky and the darkened figures makes the scene feel both intimate and expansive.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示黄昏时分户外活动的摄影作品，图中的人物穿着传统服饰，背对着镜头站立。他们的帽子和服装细节在柔和的夕阳光线下显得格外醒目。背景中的帐篷结构在天空的映衬下轮廓分明，而远处的云朵被夕阳染成了金色，为整个场景增添了一抹温暖的色彩。

caption:
The image shows a bright winter mountain resort scene under a clear, deep blue sky. A large chalet-style building dominates the center, with steep sloping roofs heavily covered in thick white snow. The architecture combines white plaster walls with warm wooden beams, balconies, trim, and decorative carved details, giving it an alpine lodge appearance.

The main building has multiple dormer windows protruding from the snowy roof, each framed in wood. A central gabled section features a balcony with wooden railings, and below it a long balcony stretches across the front. A green banner with Cyrillic text hangs along the railing, reading something like “С праздником, дорогие мужчины!” (“Happy holiday, dear men!”). Icicle-like decorations or white trim hang from the roof edges and balcony areas.

In front of the lodge is a wide, groomed snow-covered area, likely part of a ski resort or mountain hotel grounds. Several wooden lounge chairs are lined up near the front of the building, facing the open snowy space. There are also benches, small tables, and ski or snowboard equipment near the entrance area. A person in a bright blue winter outfit stands near the lower left foreground, adding scale to the large building.

On the far left foreground, a tall black lamppost with a lantern-style light stands beside a snowbank. To the right of the main building are smaller wooden structures with snow-covered roofs, including an open-sided pavilion or shelter. Near the far right edge, a skier or person in dark clothing appears to be moving across the snow.

The background is filled with forested hills or mountains covered in dark evergreen trees, contrasting with the bright white snow and vivid blue sky. The sunlight is strong and crisp, casting defined shadows and giving the scene a clean, cold, peaceful winter atmosphere. Overall, it looks like a scenic alpine lodge or ski resort on a sunny winter day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季山地度假村的摄影图像。图中的建筑具有传统的木制结构和雪覆盖的屋顶，显得格外温馨而宁静。建筑前有几盏明亮的路灯和一些木质座椅，供人休息。背景中，连绵起伏的山脉被厚厚的积雪所覆盖，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。整个场景在阳光照耀下显得非常宁静和美丽。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a casual fast-food or café-style restaurant, viewed from inside looking out through a large front window onto a rainy urban street.

In the foreground, a large rectangular communal wooden table dominates the right half of the scene. It has a dark, worn wood-grain top and bright red legs, with a circular red table number marker labeled “103” near the near edge. Several black wooden chairs with curved backs are arranged around it, some tucked in and others slightly angled outward. The floor is covered in beige square tiles with dark grout lines.

On the left side, three customers sit around a small round table near the window. They are wearing winter coats, suggesting cold or wet weather outside. Their faces are blurred. One person in a black puffer jacket sits facing inward, while two others in tan or beige coats sit with their backs or sides to the camera. Above them hangs a decorative pendant light with an exposed glowing bulb inside a wire cage shade. The wall behind them has a repeating pattern of small red and black symbols or logos.

On the far right, another seated customer is visible near the window, dressed in a striking outfit with red, yellow, green, and dark colors, including a red hat or headwear. They appear to be looking down at a phone. A leafy green plant partially fills the upper-right corner near the glass.

The large window spans most of the background and has bold red lettering applied to it, visible backward from inside. The text reads “ADDITIONAL SEATING UPSTAIRS.” Outside, the street is wet from rain, with reflections on the pavement and droplets on the glass. A red double-decker bus is passing on the left side of the window, and a white van is parked or moving across the center. A bright orange rental bicycle is visible outside near the window, and blurred pedestrians and cyclists pass by.

Across the street are brick-fronted buildings with shopfronts. One visible sign reads “Chick Filler,” and other storefronts and upper-floor windows line the street. The overall atmosphere feels busy and urban, with the warm interior lighting contrasting with the gray, rainy scene outside.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内咖啡馆环境的照片。在画面中央，有一张大型的木质桌子和四把黑色椅子，桌子上贴有红色标签。桌子后方是玻璃窗，外面可以看到街道上的行人和一辆停靠的白色货车。店内有几位顾客坐在桌旁或站立交谈，其中一位穿着红色外套的人正使用手机。墙上挂着一块带有文字的横幅，而背景中则是一家商店的橱窗，里面陈列着各种商品。

caption:
The image shows a peaceful coastal bay framed by nature. In the foreground, large rugged gray rocks jut out from the shallow, clear water. The water near the shore is transparent enough to reveal dark green and brown tones beneath the surface, gradually shifting into brighter turquoise and deeper blue farther out.

On the left side, dense evergreen pine trees lean over the rocky shoreline. Their green needles fill much of the upper-left portion of the scene, with twisting brown branches visible among the foliage. A small stone wall or rocky embankment sits at the far left edge near the water, blending into the natural shoreline.

The center of the image opens onto a calm sea with gentle ripples. A small rock protrudes from the water near the middle distance. Farther out, low islands or landforms stretch along the horizon, appearing pale and sunlit against the blue water.

On the right side of the bay, several small boats are anchored near the shore. There are white motorboats, a sailboat with a tall mast, and a few brightly colored boats, including red and yellow accents. The shoreline in the distance is dotted with low greenery and rocky terrain.

The sky is wide and bright, mostly pale blue with soft, thin white clouds spread across it. Pine branches also frame the upper-right corner, creating a natural border around the open water. Overall, the scene feels quiet, scenic, and Mediterranean-like, with a balance of rocky coastline, green pines, calm blue sea, and anchored boats.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示宁静海景的自然风光摄影图像。前景中，岩石和松树紧密相连，树木的枝叶部分遮挡了视线，而清澈的海水在阳光下波光粼粼。中景是平静的海面，上面散布着几艘船只，包括帆船和游艇。远景则是一个小岛，与天空相接，形成了一幅和谐的自然画面。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of a crowded classroom, likely in a school setting in Senegal, based on the French sign on the wall that reads “ensemble pour les enfants du SENEGAL” alongside a red circular logo.

The room is filled with many children seated at individual desks arranged in rows. The students appear to be school-age children, and many are wearing colorful clothing, patterned dresses, backpacks, and casual shirts. Some children are facing forward toward the camera, while others are turned sideways or looking around the room. Their faces are intentionally blurred.

The classroom has a distinctive two-tone wall design: the lower half of the walls is painted bright turquoise-blue, while the upper half is off-white. The white upper walls show visible wear, including stains, cracks, discoloration, and patches of dampness or mold, especially near the back wall and ceiling corners.

The ceiling is made of corrugated metal sheets supported by exposed wooden beams running lengthwise across the room. There is also a long metal support beam crossing the ceiling horizontally. The ceiling and beams give the room a simple, utilitarian construction style.

Several windows with blue-painted frames and metal bars are visible along the side and back walls. Sunlight enters through these windows, creating bright patches of light and giving the room a warm, naturally lit atmosphere. On the right side, there is a blue-framed open doorway or storage alcove with shelves inside. A long white board or plank is leaning near it.

The desks are light-colored wooden tabletops with dark metal legs, paired with small chairs. Many desks are occupied, but a few in the foreground are empty, making the classroom feel both busy and spacious. Some students have notebooks, bags, and water bottles on or near their desks.

On the right wall, part of a large poster or teaching chart with a red border is visible. On the back wall, a few small sheets of paper are taped up, possibly student work or classroom materials.

Overall, the image captures a lively classroom environment: many children seated in a modest but functional schoolroom with bright blue walls, worn plaster, barred windows, wooden desks, and a corrugated metal roof supported by exposed timber beams.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示非洲某地学校教室内部的照片。照片中，孩子们坐在他们的课桌前，一些孩子面向镜头，而其他孩子则背对镜头。教室的墙壁被粉刷成蓝色和白色，天花板由木梁支撑，显示出一种简朴的建筑风格。在教室的一侧，墙上挂着一个带有文字的标志牌，但具体内容不清晰。教室内的光线柔和，整体氛围显得宁静且有序。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny marina filled with many docked boats and sailboats. The water is calm and turquoise-blue, creating long, wavy reflections of the boats, hulls, and tall masts. The marina is densely packed, with vessels moored side by side across the scene.

In the foreground on the left, part of a white motorboat is visible, with the name “FAETON” printed on its dark side panel. Its bow extends into the frame, and its reflection appears in the greenish-blue water below. Across the middle of the image are numerous small yachts and motorboats, many with white hulls, canvas covers, railings, lifebuoys, ropes, and fenders. Some boats have blue or beige sunshades, and one boat on the right has the name “Eva” written on its stern.

The most striking feature is the forest of tall sailboat masts rising vertically into the clear blue sky. The masts vary in height and are connected by thin rigging lines, creating a delicate pattern against the sky. Several boats have folded sails or sail covers in blue, white, or dark colors. A few small flags are visible among the boats, including a red-and-yellow flag on the left side.

On the right edge of the image, a concrete dock or walkway runs along the water, bordered by a metal edge. A small patch of green leaves enters the frame near the upper right, suggesting nearby landscaping or a tree. In the distance, a low breakwater or harbor wall stretches horizontally, separating the marina from the open sea or harbor beyond.

The lighting is strong and crisp, suggesting midday or early afternoon. The sky is mostly clear with only a few faint clouds, and the overall atmosphere feels warm, calm, and coastal.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示码头上停泊着多艘帆船和游艇的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，有一艘蓝色的帆船突出于其他船只之上，其帆杆高耸入云。周围是各种大小和颜色的船只，它们静静地停靠在平静的水面上，反射出清晰的倒影。码头上有几个人在进行日常活动，有的人在船上，有的在岸边。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively park scene centered on a pond or small lake. In the foreground, a large swan-shaped tour boat is moving across the water. The boat has a white sculpted swan body at the rear/left side, with a black neck and red beak visible above the passengers. The seating area consists of rows of wooden benches with red metal frames, filled with people of different ages. At the front of the boat there is an orange panel decorated with red, white, and blue bunting, giving it a festive or patriotic look. A staff member or operator appears to be standing near the swan figure at the back.

The water is calm with small ripples, reflecting the green surroundings and the red/orange colors of the boat. A few small dark objects, possibly ducks, birds, or protruding tree stumps, are visible in the water.

Above the boat, a pale blue or light gray pedestrian bridge spans horizontally across the image. The bridge has an ornate metal railing with a crisscross lattice pattern and circular decorative joints. A solid concrete or stone base supports the bridge, forming a strong horizontal band across the middle of the scene.

Behind and around the bridge is lush greenery. Large trees fill the background, including a prominent weeping willow on the right with long, drooping branches hanging down toward the water. Through the gap beneath the bridge, a park lawn and walking paths are visible. Several people can be seen strolling, standing, or sitting in the shaded grassy area. There are also black lampposts and benches scattered through the park.

The overall atmosphere is relaxed and summery, with people enjoying a recreational boat ride in a green urban park. The composition has layered depth: water and boat in the foreground, the decorative bridge across the middle, and trees, paths, and park visitors in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在公园湖泊上的游船活动的照片。一艘装饰有美国国旗的绿色和橙色小船正搭载着一群游客，其中包括一位穿着白色婚纱的女士和几位戴着帽子的人。船上还有几个小孩，他们似乎正在享受划船的乐趣。湖面上漂浮着几只鸭子，而背景中可见其他游客在树木环绕的公园里散步或休息。一座蓝色的桥梁横跨在湖上，连接着对岸。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit scene of several elephants wading through a broad body of water, likely a river or lake, with riders sitting on their backs.

In the foreground on the right, a large elephant is closest to the camera, seen mostly from behind and slightly from the side. Its gray, wrinkled skin is clearly visible, and its legs are partly submerged in the shallow, greenish-brown water. A young rider sits bareback near the elephant’s shoulders, wearing blue shorts and a dark sleeveless shirt. A chain hangs down along the elephant’s side.

In the middle of the image, two more elephants are walking through the water in a loose line. One has a rider in a bright red-orange long-sleeved shirt, sitting upright with bare feet resting along the elephant’s side. Another person, partly hidden, sits ahead on a neighboring elephant and wears a hat. The elephants’ backs and heads rise above the water, while their legs stir up small splashes and ripples.

On the left, another elephant faces toward the open water. It has long, pale tusks curving forward and upward, and its trunk is lowered near the water’s surface. A rider wearing a light-colored wide-brimmed hat and long-sleeved shirt sits near its neck, holding a stick or tool. Chains and simple riding gear are visible on several of the elephants.

The water occupies most of the frame, with gentle ripples spreading outward from the elephants’ movements. The far bank stretches across the background as a sandy, eroded shoreline topped with dense green vegetation and scattered trees. A few small structures or huts with metal roofs can be seen on the far right, along with what appears to be another elephant and people near the shore. The sky is pale and hazy, and the overall lighting suggests a warm, bright day in a rural or natural setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三头大象和它们的骑手在河中洗澡的照片。最左边的大象背上坐着一位穿着深色衣服的骑手，他戴着帽子，专注地望向前方。中间的大象背上是一位穿着红色上衣的骑手，她正用双手触摸大象的耳朵。最右边的大象背上坐着一位穿着蓝色衣服的骑手，他似乎正在观察周围的环境。河水清澈见底，周围是绿色的树木和岸边的岩石。

caption:
The image shows a bright, clear day on a waterfront bridge or pier, likely in Istanbul. A row of fishermen stands along a pale blue metal railing with decorative geometric latticework, casting long fishing rods out over the water. The rods angle dramatically upward and outward, creating diagonal lines across the open blue sky.

In the foreground, several men are gathered close together at the railing. They wear jackets, caps, and casual trousers, suggesting cool but sunny weather. One man in a white cap leans forward over the railing, while another in a black leather jacket bends beside him, appearing to look down at the water or tend to fishing gear. Multiple fishing rods are propped against the railing, some extending far into the frame. On the ground to the right are small stools, buckets, bags, and fishing supplies.

Below the bridge, the water is a deep blue with small waves. Several white passenger boats or ferries are moving through the water, and one large boat is visible in the lower left. In the distance, the shoreline is packed with buildings climbing up a hillside. A prominent stone tower with a conical roof—resembling the Galata Tower—stands on the right side of the skyline. The cityscape includes dense apartment blocks, older buildings, and a few construction cranes.

The sky takes up much of the image and is almost cloudless, giving the scene a spacious, airy feeling. The overall atmosphere is lively but relaxed: people fishing, boats passing, and the urban waterfront stretching behind them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示几位钓鱼者在城市桥梁上进行户外活动的照片。他们站在桥的栏杆旁，手持钓竿，似乎正在享受垂钓的乐趣。背景中可以看到一座具有历史特色的桥梁和远处的城市建筑群，包括一座高耸的塔楼。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为这个场景增添了宜人的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up display of colorful handmade crochet crafts, likely at a market or craft stall. The focus is on two small crocheted drawstring pouches or bags in the center: one deep burgundy red and one bright golden yellow-orange. Both bags have intricate openwork crochet patterns with floral or lace-like motifs, ruffled tops, and small wooden beads attached to their drawstrings near the bottom.

The yellow bag on the right is especially bright and textured, with visible loops and knots forming decorative holes across its surface. The red bag on the left has a similar structure but appears slightly darker and denser because of its rich color.

To the far right, partially visible, is a crocheted doll or animal figure. It has a tan face, black hair or hat, large shiny eyes, a pink nose or cheek area, and a green patterned scarf around its neck. It sits beside or inside a light-colored woven basket with a pink-and-white gingham fabric lining.

On the left edge, there are crocheted flowers in warm colors—yellow, cream, and green—clustered together, possibly in a basket. In the foreground and background, more crocheted textiles are visible, including a multicolored mat or blanket with pastel squares and a green-and-white crocheted flower near the bottom. A pink crocheted or fabric item hangs softly blurred in the background.

The overall scene is vibrant, cozy, and handmade, with many yarn textures, warm colors, and craft details creating a cheerful artisan display.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示手工编织物品的照片，主要聚焦在两个色彩鲜艳的钩针编织袋上。左侧是一个深红色的袋子，右侧是一个明亮的黄色袋子。它们放置在一个多彩的布料上，背景中模糊地可见其他颜色和形状的物品。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny street scene in what appears to be an old Italian town or city, likely near Florence/Fiesole, given the sightseeing bus sign.

In the foreground on the left is a large red open-top double-decker tour bus parked along the curb. The bus has a black upper front panel and an uncovered upper deck where several tourists are seated, some wearing hats and sunglasses. Along the front upper section, colorful text reads “City Sightseeing Firenze,” and on the lower front there is a sign indicating route “B Fiesole.” The bus also displays “Official Tour of Florence” and ticket information on its red front panel. Its windshield is large and reflective, catching the bright sunlight.

Behind the bus and stretching across the center of the image is a historic stone church complex. The building is made of pale beige stone with a long tiled roof in warm terracotta tones. The church has narrow arched windows and simple Gothic-style details. Rising prominently above it is a tall square bell tower or clock tower built of darker, rougher stone. The tower has arched openings near the top, a crenellated battlement-like crown, and a large round clock face on one side. The clock is white with dark Roman numerals and hands, standing out clearly against the stone.

The sky dominates much of the image, taking up the top half or more of the frame. It is a clear, vivid blue with no visible clouds, suggesting a warm, pleasant day. The strong sunlight creates sharp shadows and makes the red bus and pale stone buildings appear very crisp and bright.

On the street in front of the church, there are several vehicles: a beige coach or minibus parked near the center-right, a white van farther right, and a few smaller vehicles or scooters near the edge of the square. The road is broad and gently curving, with painted lane markings and a roundabout or traffic signs visible on the far right. Streetlamps line parts of the sidewalk, adding to the historic town-square atmosphere.

To the far right, there are additional buildings with yellow and cream façades, shuttered windows, and terracotta roofs. Some scaffolding or construction material is visible near one of the buildings, and a few pedestrians can be seen in the distance.

Overall, the scene combines tourism and historic architecture: a modern red sightseeing bus in the foreground contrasts with the old stone church, clock tower, and traditional town buildings under a brilliant blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，前景中有一辆红色的双层观光巴士停在街道上，车顶上有游客。背景是一座具有哥特式建筑风格的教堂，其尖塔高耸，时钟清晰可见。街道上还有其他车辆和行人，包括一辆白色的货车和几辆小型汽车。整个场景被阳光照耀着，天气晴朗。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of a historic stone bridge spanning a calm river, likely in a European city. The bridge is built from pale, weathered stone and features a series of large rounded arches—five are visible—supported by thick rectangular piers that descend into the water. The arches create strong symmetrical shapes, and their reflections shimmer softly on the river surface below.

Along the top of the bridge is a balustrade with many pedestrians walking across it. Several classical statues stand on pedestals at intervals along the bridge, giving it an ornate, monumental appearance. The stonework looks old and slightly worn, with darker staining near the waterline and patches of vegetation growing around the bases of some supports.

The river occupies much of the foreground. Its surface is greenish-blue and gently rippled, reflecting the bridge, trees, and sky in blurred vertical streaks. Small clumps of reeds or aquatic grass emerge from the water in the lower foreground, adding texture and a natural element to the scene.

On both sides of the river are stone embankments and walkways. To the right, a sloped stone wall runs along the riverbank beneath dense green trees. A few small figures can be seen walking near the water’s edge. On the left, a grand historic building with an ornate façade is partly visible behind trees. It has classical architectural details, columns, decorative stonework, and a pale exterior. A sculptural group or statue appears on the roofline.

Behind the bridge, lush green trees form a thick canopy, framing the river and softening the urban architecture. In the distance, more low buildings and rooftops are visible between the trees. The sky is bright blue with scattered soft white clouds, suggesting a sunny, pleasant day. The overall mood is calm, scenic, and historic, with the bridge serving as the central architectural feature against the tranquil river and greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示河流和桥梁的自然风光摄影图像。图中，一座古老的石桥横跨在平静的河面上，桥上有几尊雕像装饰。河水清澈见底，反映出天空和桥梁的倒影。河岸两侧长满了绿色植被，背后是蓝天和散布的白云。

caption:
The image shows a snowy urban square in what appears to be a historic European city. Heavy snow is falling across the entire scene, with large white flakes streaking diagonally and partially obscuring the buildings in the background. The atmosphere is cold, wet, and wintry, with muted light and a pale gray sky.

At the center is a large old brick church or historic religious building. It has dark reddish-brown walls, tall arched windows, and a steep red-tiled roof dusted with snow. The roofline is complex, with multiple gables and small decorative finials. Several greenish copper domes or cupolas sit on parts of the structure, their oxidized patina contrasting with the red roof. Behind it, rising higher in the background, is a pale stone clock tower with a green roof and a visible round clock face near the top. The tower is softened by the snowfall, making it look slightly hazy.

In the foreground and lower part of the image, the street level is busy with shops and pedestrians. The base of the church building contains storefronts or arched entrances with warm yellow-orange lights glowing from inside, creating a cozy contrast against the snowy weather. Red awnings or banners hang along the lower façade. A few people are walking through the square, bundled in winter clothing; some carry umbrellas or hunch against the snow. Bicycles are parked near a cluster of street signs on the right side.

On the left, a pale yellow building with a sloped roof bears the large text “HAUS NEUMAYR” across its façade. Its windows are arranged in a simple grid, and the roof is lightly covered in snow. On the right, a peach or salmon-colored building with many white-framed windows stands prominently. At street level, several signs read “BASE,” suggesting retail shops or a mobile phone store. Farther right, a stone building edge with large dark window panels frames the scene, adding a vertical border.

Several traffic and pedestrian signs are visible near the center-right, including blue circular signs and white information signs, though much of the text is hard to read through the snowfall. The wet pavement reflects some of the shop lights, and the overall scene feels lively despite the harsh weather. The combination of historic architecture, modern storefronts, pedestrians, bicycles, and dense falling snow gives the image a vivid winter city-center atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道在降雪中的照片。图像中心是一座红色的教堂，其尖顶和绿色圆顶在白雪覆盖的背景中显得格外突出。教堂前的人行道上，几位行人正在行走，其中一些人穿着冬季服装，如围巾和帽子。街道两旁是现代建筑，包括商店和办公楼，它们的玻璃窗反射着雪花。天空中飘落的雪花给这个场景增添了一种宁静而祥和的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, festive street scene featuring a traditional horse-drawn carriage.

In the foreground, two light gray/white horses are pulling a vivid red carriage. The horses are elaborately decorated with garlands of orange and yellow flowers around their heads, bridles, and harnesses. Their tack includes red accents, leather straps, metal fittings, and decorative tassels. One horse is stepping forward with a raised front leg, giving the scene a sense of movement.

The carriage is ornate and polished, painted mostly red with black seating and trim. It has large red spoked wheels, a black upholstered passenger bench, and brass-colored lamps mounted near the front. Two men sit on the carriage seat, both dressed in traditional-looking formal attire: beige jackets, striped trousers, white shirts, and wide-brimmed brown hats. One appears to be holding the reins while the other sits beside him, holding a small object near his mouth. Their faces are blurred.

The background is filled with striped green-and-white festival tents or booths. One tent has a sign reading “BOMBEROS PREVENCIÓN,” suggesting a fire brigade or prevention station. Above the tents, strings of paper lanterns or rosette decorations in orange and white are hung across the street, creating a festive canopy. Green garlands wrap around some of the poles.

On the left side, several pedestrians stand near the tents, dressed in smart or colorful clothing, as if attending a fair or celebration. The ground is sunlit, and the strong daylight makes the colors very vivid—especially the reds of the carriage, the orange decorations, and the turquoise-green tent stripes. In the distance, leafy trees and an apartment building frame the scene, giving it the feel of a city festival or traditional parade.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日庆典的摄影照片，画面中心是两匹装饰华丽的马匹，它们被鲜艳的橙色花朵和金色饰品所点缀。一匹马正拉着一辆红色的马车，车上坐着两位穿着传统服饰的男士，他们看起来正在享受这个活动。背景中可以看到挂有绿色和白色条纹的旗帜，以及周围聚集的人群，这些细节表明这是一个热闹的户外场合。

caption:
The image shows a wide, panoramic view of a large industrial harbor at sunset or sunrise, bathed in warm pink, orange, and peach light.

In the foreground, there are urban residential and commercial buildings along the lower edge of the frame. Some apartment blocks have lit windows, and a few streets and rooftops are visible. Trees with autumn-colored foliage line parts of the waterfront area. A tall, narrow construction crane or mast stands near the lower left, silhouetted against the glowing water.

A broad river or harbor channel runs horizontally through the scene. The water reflects the soft orange-pink sky, giving it a muted rose color. Several boats and ships are moving along the waterway: a long, blurred vessel crosses the lower center, suggesting motion during a longer exposure, while smaller boats and barges appear to the right. On the far right, a larger ferry or ship is visible near the harbor entrance.

Across the middle of the image is a dense industrial port area. There are warehouses, docks, cranes, storage buildings, and piers. Many small yellow-white lights are scattered throughout the port, creating a sparkling effect in the haze. Large rectangular industrial buildings sit close to the water, and cranes and loading equipment are visible around them.

The background is dominated by a vast refinery or petrochemical complex. Numerous tall chimneys, smokestacks, towers, and industrial columns rise into the sky. Some stacks emit smoke or steam, which blends into the misty atmosphere. The industrial skyline stretches across the entire horizon, partially obscured by haze and low clouds, giving the scene a layered, atmospheric look.

The sky is one of the most striking elements: it is filled with horizontal bands of soft orange, salmon, pink, and pale yellow. Thin clouds stretch across the frame, and the warm light creates a dramatic contrast with the darker silhouettes of chimneys and cranes. The overall mood is both beautiful and industrial—an urban harbor landscape softened by mist, glowing lights, and a vivid sunset sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市工业区在日落时分的摄影作品。图像捕捉到了夕阳的余晖映照在城市的天际线上，天空呈现出橙红色调，而地平线上的建筑群和工业设施则被柔和的光线所笼罩。河流平静地流淌着，几艘船只静静地停泊在河上，而远处的山丘轮廓在天空中若隐若现。整个场景营造出一种宁静而又充满活力的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor crowd scene photographed with a shallow depth of field. In the center-left foreground, an adult is holding a small child close against their chest. Both faces are intentionally blurred, but the adult has short dark hair and is wearing a light purple or lavender button-up shirt. A light blue surgical mask appears to be pulled down or resting under the adult’s chin.

The child, positioned slightly to the right of the adult, has light brown hair and is turned in profile toward the right side of the frame. The child is wearing a mint-green shirt under a shiny dark navy puffer jacket. The child’s posture suggests they are being carried or held securely, with their body nestled against the adult.

Several long, narrow yellow ribbons or streamers hang vertically in the foreground, partially obscuring the subjects. One prominent yellow strip runs down the left side of the frame, out of focus, creating a soft blurred band. Additional yellow strands appear near the center and far right, suggesting flags, decorations, or event markers.

The background is also heavily blurred, with warm beige tones suggesting a sunlit wall or building. On the right side, the back of another person’s head is visible, showing short gray hair and a light blue shirt collar. A dark triangular or canopy-like shape appears in the upper right background, but it is too out of focus to identify clearly.

The lighting is bright and natural, indicating daytime. The overall impression is of a public gathering or event, with the camera focused on the adult and child amid a softly blurred crowd and yellow decorative elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到的日常生活场景，图中主要显示了两个模糊的人物。左侧是一个穿着紫色衬衫的人，而右侧是一个背着深色外套的孩子。他们被黄色的物体遮挡，可能是某种装饰或标志物。背景虽然模糊，但可以辨认出是在户外，可能是一个公共场合。

caption:
The image shows a wide coastal seascape under a bright, open sky. The lower half of the frame is filled with deep blue ocean water, textured with small rolling waves and ripples. The water appears slightly choppy, with scattered white flecks of foam catching the light.

Across the middle of the image is a long, low breakwater or artificial rock jetty made of large, pale concrete wave-dissipation blocks. The structure stretches horizontally from left to right, separating the open sea in the foreground from the calmer horizon behind it. Small waves break against the rocks, creating thin white lines of surf along the base.

On the left side of the breakwater stands a tall, slender white navigation beacon or lighthouse. It has a narrow, slightly curved tower shape that widens subtly near the top, with small platforms or fixtures attached near its upper section. Its clean white color contrasts with the darker rocks and blue sea.

On the right side of the breakwater is a much brighter yellow navigation marker. It is shorter and more industrial-looking, mounted on a broad base among the rocks. The top section includes red horizontal arms or rail-like elements, making it visually prominent against the sky. Its vivid yellow and red colors stand out strongly in the otherwise blue and neutral-toned scene.

The sky dominates most of the image, occupying a large expanse above the breakwater. It is a soft, pale blue with a few faint, wispy clouds near the horizon and a larger, diffuse cloud mass toward the left. The lighting suggests a clear daytime scene, with sunlight illuminating the rocks and towers from the side.

Overall, the image has a calm but windswept maritime atmosphere: open water in the foreground, a protective stone barrier in the distance, and two navigational beacons marking the ends or sections of the breakwater beneath a vast sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海中灯塔的自然风光摄影图像。在画面中央，可以看到两个灯塔分别位于岩石堆砌的平台上，左侧的灯塔为白色，右侧的灯塔为黄色，它们是船只航行时的重要导航标志。背景是蔚蓝的天空和海洋，几朵白云点缀其间，营造出一种宁静而广阔的视觉效果。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a person holding a smartphone in one hand. The phone fills most of the frame and is slightly tilted, with its screen facing the viewer. On the screen is the Instagram app logo: a rounded square icon with a colorful gradient of pink, purple, orange, and yellow, containing the familiar white outline of a camera with a circular lens and small dot in the upper right.

The phone appears to have a light-colored or metallic edge, possibly silver or white, visible along both sides. A thumb and fingers wrap around the device, with the thumb prominent on the left side and other fingers visible on the right, slightly out of focus. The skin tones are softly lit, and the shallow depth of field blurs the background.

The background is an abstract teal-blue surface, heavily blurred, giving the image a cool-toned atmosphere. The screen itself has a dark gradient behind the Instagram icon, transitioning from warm orange near the top-left area to deep blue and purple toward the bottom. The overall composition emphasizes social media and mobile app use, with the Instagram logo as the central visual focus.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示社交媒体应用Instagram图标的照片。一只手紧握着手机，手指轻触屏幕上的图标，而背景是模糊的蓝色调，突出了前景中的图标和手机。

caption:
The image shows a lively nighttime street scene in Akihabara, Tokyo, filled with bright storefronts, illuminated signs, and pedestrians.

On the left side is a large red SEGA building. A prominent sign near the upper left reads “SEGA VR AKIHABARA,” accompanied by a dramatic close-up graphic of an eye with “SEGA” reflected in the iris. Below it, a huge glowing SEGA logo in blue and white dominates the façade. The entrance area beneath is brightly lit, with posters and displays visible inside and around the doorway. Several people are gathered near the entrance, some walking past and others appearing to look into the shop.

On the right side is another brightly lit building with a large yellow sign for “Mulan” / “ムーラン AKIBA,” surrounded by orange-red lights. The storefront below is packed with colorful merchandise and posters, giving it the look of an anime, games, collectibles, or hobby shop. A large banner above the store includes Japanese text and mentions “BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!” along with colorful vertical stripes and flower-like designs.

Dark tree silhouettes occupy much of the center and right of the frame, partially blocking the signs and buildings. Their leaves create strong contrast against the neon and fluorescent lighting behind them. The trees make the scene feel layered, with the bright commercial district visible through gaps in the foliage.

At street level, pedestrians move along the sidewalk. Some are in business attire, while others are casually dressed. Bicycles are parked along the railing near the curb. A pedestrian crossing sign and street barriers are visible near the center-bottom area. In the foreground, a dark roadway stretches across the image, with white lane or crosswalk markings visible near the bottom right.

The overall atmosphere is urban, energetic, and colorful, with the glow of red, yellow, blue, and white signage standing out against the dark night. The scene strongly conveys the dense commercial entertainment feel of Akihabara, with gaming, anime, and electronics-related storefronts lining the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本城市夜景的照片，捕捉到了街道上的霓虹灯广告牌和繁忙的人流。在照片的左侧，可以看到一个亮着红色灯光的SEGA Akihabara标志，下方是其他商店的招牌，如Mula和Akihabara Bettei。街道上聚集了众多行人，他们或是在行走，或是在人行道上停留交谈。街道两旁的树木在夜晚的照明下显得格外茂密，为这个充满活力的城市角落增添了一抹绿色。

caption:
A wide panoramic landscape shows a peaceful alpine lakeside scene on a bright, clear day.

In the foreground, there are vivid green rolling meadows dotted with a few rustic buildings. A large wooden barn with a sloped, weathered roof sits on the right, surrounded by farm equipment, fencing, and small patches of cleared ground. To the left are smaller houses and farm structures with red or brown roofs, connected by narrow paths and a road. Trees and shrubs frame parts of the meadow, giving the scene a rural, pastoral feeling.

Beyond the fields lies a calm, broad lake with deep blue-green water. The surface is mostly smooth, reflecting subtle vertical shapes and muted colors from the mountains and shoreline. A thin strip of land and tiny buildings are visible along the far shore, emphasizing the scale of the landscape.

The background is dominated by a dramatic mountain range rising steeply from the lakeside. The lower slopes are covered in dense dark-green forest, interrupted by pale gray rock faces and cliffs. Higher up, the mountains become more rugged and exposed, with massive layered limestone formations, sharp ridges, vertical walls, and striated rock patterns. Patches of grassy alpine terrain appear between the cliffs, especially near the upper slopes.

At the top of the image, the sky is a clear blue with a few soft white clouds drifting near the mountain peaks. The sunlight is strong and warm, making the grass appear bright and saturated while casting gentle shadows across the buildings and terrain. The overall mood is serene, scenic, and idyllic, suggesting a Swiss or alpine countryside setting beside a mountain lake.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示瑞士阿尔卑斯山脉的自然风光照片。图像前景是郁郁葱葱的绿色草地，上面散布着几座传统的木制小屋和一座较大的房屋。这些房屋位于画面的中下方，与周围的环境和谐相融。在图片的中部和背景部分，可以看到宁静的湖泊，其水面平静如镜，反射出周围山峰的轮廓。湖对岸覆盖着茂密的树木，形成了一个天然的屏障。远处的山峰被白雪皑皑的冰川所覆盖，显示出一种壮观而纯净的美。天空呈现出晴朗的蓝色，云朵稀疏地分布在天空中。

caption:
The image shows a striking architectural contrast between an old church façade and modern high-rise buildings behind it.

In the foreground, on the left side, is a historic stone church structure. It is built from gray and beige masonry blocks with pale stone trim. The façade has Gothic Revival details: tall pointed-arch windows, decorative carved stonework, narrow columns, and ornate tracery. Several arched openings are visible, some dark inside, giving depth to the façade. Near the upper portion is a circular louvered opening set into a decorative frame, and above that are smaller pointed windows with black louvers.

Rising from the church is a tall, slender white steeple. It has steep triangular faces, layered trim, and small louvered vents. At the very top is a metal cross-like finial or spire ornament, silhouetted against the sky. The white steeple stands out sharply against the darker glass building behind it.

Behind and around the church are sleek contemporary office towers. The main background building is covered in blue-tinted reflective glass panels arranged in a precise grid. The windows vary slightly in color, with some panes appearing darker blue and others turquoise or greenish. To the right is another modern façade with light gray panels and a large section of horizontal dark louvers. Lower on the right, glass walls reflect light and show hints of interior lighting.

The perspective is looking upward from street level, emphasizing the height of the buildings. The church appears compressed against the towering glass structures, creating a visual juxtaposition of old and new architecture: ornate stone craftsmanship in front of clean, geometric, modern materials. The sky is clear and bright blue, and the lighting suggests a sunny day with crisp shadows and strong reflections on the glass.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑与传统教堂尖塔对比的摄影作品。图像前景中，一座古老的石制教堂尖塔高耸入云，其精细的雕刻和历史感强烈的设计与背景中的现代玻璃幕墙建筑形成鲜明对比。现代建筑以其光滑的表面和直线设计彰显了未来主义风格，而教堂则代表了过去时代的艺术和工艺水平。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime scene featuring large, brightly lit skeleton figures in a Día de los Muertos–style display or parade. The background is almost completely black, making the figures stand out under intense purple, pink, and ultraviolet lighting.

At the center is the most prominent figure: a tall skeletal character dressed in a shiny, vivid pink and orange gown. The dress has a layered skirt, ruffled trim, bows, and a bright yellow-orange panel down the front. The figure’s skull-like head is tilted upward with its mouth wide open, giving it an expressive, theatrical look. One skeletal hand is raised near the face, while the other extends outward, as if dancing or gesturing. The figure also appears to have a tall, dark, glossy headdress or backdrop behind the head, adding height and drama.

To the left stands another tall skeleton figure dressed in a dark purple suit or long coat. Its oversized skull head has black eye sockets, painted teeth, and decorative linework on the face. The skeleton’s posture is upright, with one arm bent across the torso and a white skeletal hand hanging down. The coat has gold or copper cuffs and small decorative white patterns along the front edge.

To the right of the central figure is a third skeleton wearing a deep blue suit jacket and patterned trousers. Its skull face is more front-facing, with large dark eye sockets and a toothy grin. Its arms are crossed or posed in front of the body, with white skeletal hands visible against the blue clothing.

On the far right foreground is a huge decorative skull, partially visible, topped or accompanied by a large bright pink flower with pointed petals. The skull has oversized black eye sockets, a large nose cavity, painted teeth, and decorative markings. The flower and skull are illuminated in hot pink and purple light.

Behind and around the figures are floral decorations and parade-like structures, including white and colored flower arrangements. At the bottom and in the distance, a crowd of spectators can be seen behind barriers, though they are mostly dark and indistinct. The overall atmosphere is festive, theatrical, and slightly eerie, with saturated neon colors and skeletal imagery creating a vibrant celebration-of-the-dead aesthetic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示墨西哥亡灵节庆祝活动的夜间摄影图像，图中展示了三个穿着传统服饰的人偶，每个都装饰有骷髅头面具和发光的细节。左侧是一个穿着紫色服装、戴着白色骷髅头面具的人偶，中间是穿着粉色和金色服饰、同样戴着白色骷髅头面具的人偶，右侧是穿着蓝色服装、戴着白色骷髅头面具的人偶。他们站在一个亮着灯光的场景中，背景中有模糊的人物轮廓和灯光。

caption:
The image shows a busy indoor fresh market, specifically a meat stall in a large covered market hall.

In the foreground, several customers are gathered around a butcher’s counter. Two people wearing red shirts stand on the left side, one with a ponytail and a face mask hanging near the chin/ear area. Another customer in a green head covering is partly visible behind them. On the right side, a man in a cap stands near the counter, while another person in blue appears to be working behind the stall.

At the center of the scene, large cuts of raw red meat are hanging from several metal hooks attached to a horizontal metal rail. The meat pieces vary in size and shape, with visible fat and muscle texture. Some empty hooks hang beside them. A black garment or cloth is draped over part of the rail, and a white plastic bag hangs from another hook near the right.

Below the hanging meat is a tiled butcher’s counter. There are red plastic trays filled with smaller pieces of meat or scraps. A large, old-fashioned metal weighing scale sits on the counter to the right, with a round metal bowl on top. The counter and surrounding surfaces are white tile, typical of a wet market or butcher section.

The background shows rows of market stalls, some with shutters down, and several signs or banners with Indonesian/Malay-looking text. One sign on the right reads “DE DIMSUM,” suggesting nearby food or prepared goods stalls. The market hall has a high ceiling with metal beams, long fluorescent light fixtures, ventilation grilles, and translucent roof panels that let in sunlight. Bright sunlight enters from above, creating strong highlights on the people and meat area, while other parts of the market remain more shaded.

Overall, the image captures a lively traditional market environment with customers purchasing fresh meat from a butcher stall.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示市场内部的现实生活摄影图像，图中一位女性顾客站在肉摊前，正在与摊主交谈。摊位上挂着几块红色的牛肉，旁边摆放着一些包装好的白色塑料袋和一个金属秤。摊主穿着蓝色工作服，正专注地处理商品。在背景中可以看到其他顾客和摊位，整个场景充满了市场的繁忙氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide canal or river running through a historic urban area, viewed from a slightly elevated position along the water. The water fills the lower half of the scene, with small ripples reflecting the pale sky, the buildings, and patches of color from the riverfront.

On the left side, a row of older colonial-style buildings lines the waterfront. They have white and cream façades, arched ground-floor openings, tall rectangular windows with wooden shutters, and reddish-orange clay-tile roofs. One prominent building has a long sloping terracotta roof and a façade with brick and plaster details. Red lanterns hang near some of the arches, suggesting a heritage or tourist district. A small landscaped area with palms and shrubs sits in front of the nearest building.

Farther down the left bank, the architecture becomes more varied. There are narrow shop-house-style buildings with weathered walls, tiled roofs, balconies, and awnings. One building near the center stands out because its wall is covered in a bright, colorful mural with bold geometric shapes in red, yellow, blue, green, and pink. Several pedestrians are visible along the riverside walkway, some gathered near the mural and others strolling beside the canal.

The right side of the image is dominated by a large leafy green tree whose branches extend over the walkway and partly frame the scene. Beneath it is a paved riverside path with steps descending toward the water. Farther along the right bank, more buildings and railings continue into the distance.

In the background, modern high-rise buildings and construction cranes rise above the older rooftops, creating a contrast between historic low-rise architecture and contemporary city development. The sky is bright but slightly hazy, with soft cloud cover and strong light washing out the upper right portion of the image.

Overall, the scene has a calm, leisurely atmosphere: a historic riverside promenade with colorful street art, colonial-era buildings, pedestrians, and reflective water leading the eye into the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河流沿岸风光的摄影图像。图中，河流平静地流淌，河岸边排列着色彩鲜艳、风格独特的建筑，其立面装饰有各种图案和颜色。河边的人们在休闲散步或进行其他活动，为这个场景增添了生活气息。远处可以看到现代高楼大厦与古老的建筑形成鲜明对比，展现了城市的多元文化。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间，整个画面给人一种宁静和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows an interior stone wall in what appears to be a historic Gothic or cathedral-like setting. The scene is symmetrical and architectural, with a long wooden bench placed against a pale limestone wall.

At the center is a large, plain section of light beige stone blocks. The wall is made of rectangular masonry slabs with visible seams, subtle stains, vertical weathering marks, and variations in tone from cream to tan. This central blank area contrasts strongly with the elaborate carved stonework on both sides.

On the left and right edges are highly ornate Gothic-style stone columns or niches. They feature intricate carved foliage, tracery, pointed arches, small decorative panels, and sculptural details. Near the upper corners, partial stone statues are visible standing in niches; only portions of the figures can be seen because they are cropped by the image. The carvings include layered moldings, leafy vines, small architectural canopies, and pedestal-like bases, giving the space a cathedral or cloister atmosphere.

Along the bottom center is a long bench with a vivid red upholstered backrest and seat cushion. The red fabric is rich and striking against the muted stone background. The bench has wooden arms and dividers, suggesting multiple individual seats joined together. Small dark nailheads or studs line the front edge of the upholstery, and the lower wooden frame has decorative cutout shapes. The wood is medium brown and slightly worn, matching the historic feel of the room.

The floor is made of large gray stone slabs laid in irregular polygonal patterns, with dark grout lines and signs of age and wear. The overall composition feels quiet, formal, and historic, with the bright red bench serving as the main visual focal point amid the pale, intricately carved stone architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑风格的室内环境的照片，画面中心是一排三把并排放置的长椅，每把椅子都有一个红色的坐垫和木制扶手。长椅背后是装饰华丽的石墙，上面雕刻着精细的浮雕图案，显示出一种庄严而历史悠久的感觉。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，细节清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a wide street-level view of the Palais Garnier, the famous Paris opera house, seen from across a busy road. The building dominates the frame with its grand, ornate Second Empire architecture and richly decorated façade.

The opera house is made of pale stone and features rows of tall columns, arched entrances, sculpted figures, decorative reliefs, and gilded accents. Along the upper façade, the inscription “ACADÉMIE NATIONALE DE MUSIQUE” is visible in gold lettering. On the left pediment, the word “CHORÉGRAPHIE” can be seen, while another pediment on the right is partly visible. The roofline is lined with elaborate gold ornamentation, and large gilded sculptural groups sit at the corners and top of the building, including winged figures that stand out against the pale sky.

Two flags fly above the central roofline: the blue European Union flag and the French tricolor. Below them are multiple circular medallions and sculptural panels, adding to the building’s highly decorative appearance. The façade includes several large arched openings at ground level, with steps leading up to the entrances. Statues and carved figures flank the lower sections, and ornate black-and-gold gates are visible behind the arches.

In front of the opera house, people are walking, standing, and sitting on the steps. Some appear to be tourists, and others are crossing the street or gathered near the entrance. A black car is moving through the foreground, slightly blurred from motion, emphasizing the active city setting. There are streetlamps, traffic signs, railings, bicycles, and crosswalk markings along the road.

The sky is bright and lightly overcast, giving the scene soft, even lighting. Surrounding Parisian buildings with classic mansard roofs are visible on the left and right edges of the image, reinforcing the urban setting. Overall, the scene captures the grandeur of the Palais Garnier amid everyday Paris street life.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示巴黎歌剧院的现实主义风格照片。歌剧院位于街道的一侧，其古典建筑风格和装饰性的金色雕像在蓝天的映衬下显得格外引人注目。前方是繁忙的人行道，人们正在穿行，而一辆黑色轿车正驶过路口。在建筑物的顶部飘扬着法国国旗，增添了地域文化的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the upper corner of a historic stone building, photographed from below against a bright, nearly white overcast sky. The architecture appears Indo-Islamic or Mughal/Rajasthani in style, with red sandstone walls, carved details, projecting balconies, and a large pale dome on top.

At the top center is a broad, cream-colored dome with a weathered surface. The dome is slightly stained and mottled from age, with vertical discoloration marks and patches of darker grime. A small finial rises from the dome’s apex, made of stacked rounded elements tapering upward to a thin point. Around the base of the dome is a raised parapet or drum with angular, stepped edges.

Below the dome, the building’s roofline has layered horizontal cornices in beige and reddish stone. The eaves project outward, creating deep shadow beneath them. Decorative brackets support the overhangs, especially at the corner, where carved red stone elements form a dense cluster under the roof.

The main structure is built from red and reddish-brown sandstone blocks, interspersed with lighter beige stone panels. The corner of the building is prominent, forming a vertical edge in the center of the image. The stone blocks show signs of age: faded patches, stains, chips, and uneven coloration.

On either side of the corner are small projecting balconies or jharokha-style windows. These balconies have carved stone railings with intricate lattice-like patterns and are supported by ornate brackets and slender columns. The openings behind them appear dark, emphasizing the depth of the windows. The undersides of the balconies are richly carved with curved supports and decorative motifs.

Along the wall below the balconies runs a band of repeating carved ornamentation, resembling pointed arches or floral shapes. A similar decorative parapet with repeating crest-like shapes is visible along the left and right roof edges.

A few small green birds, possibly parakeets, are perched on the ledges near the dome and cornice, adding small touches of bright color to the otherwise earthy red and beige palette.

Overall, the image focuses on the detailed upper architecture of an old monumental building, highlighting its domed roof, carved sandstone balconies, layered cornices, and weathered historic surfaces.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示印度传统建筑风格的摄影图像，特写拍摄了一座具有复杂雕刻装饰和圆顶结构的建筑。建筑的顶部是一个精致的圆顶，上面有一个小尖塔，周围有精细的石雕装饰。建筑的正面展示了两个带有拱形窗户的阳台，阳台下方是用红色砖块砌成的墙面上的精美雕刻。整个场景在白色背景下显得格外突出，突出了建筑的细节和设计。

caption:
The image shows a group of children indoors, gathered closely around what appears to be an arm-wrestling match or playful strength contest.

In the foreground, two boys are the main focus. The boy on the left is wearing a bright red long-sleeved shirt and a white embroidered cap with Arabic-style writing and a small decorative emblem on the front. He is turned sideways, facing the boy on the right. The boy on the right is wearing a blue long-sleeved top and a dark green-and-black patterned cap with geometric designs around the sides. Their hands are clasped together at the center of the image, elbows bent, as if they are arm wrestling or testing strength.

Between and behind them are several other children, slightly out of focus. One child in the middle wears a pale yellow shirt, while another in the background appears to be wearing a white cap similar to the one on the left. Their faces are blurred, and the background is softly focused.

The setting appears to be a modest indoor room. There is a vertical concrete or plaster pillar near the center-right, partially dividing the scene. Behind the children are hanging clothes or fabric, including towels and colorful garments, suggesting a lived-in domestic or communal space. A doorway or wooden doorframe is visible on the far right. The lighting is natural and warm, coming from the right side, illuminating the boy in blue and creating softer shadows on the left.

The overall mood of the image feels casual, playful, and social, with the children engaged in a friendly activity while others watch nearby.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两个孩子在室内互动的照片。左侧的孩子穿着红色上衣和白色头巾，正在与右侧的孩子击掌。右侧的孩子穿着蓝色上衣和黑色头巾，他的脸部被模糊处理以保护隐私。背景中可以看到其他穿着传统服装的人们，他们似乎也在进行某种宗教或文化活动。

caption:
The image shows a sleek white private aircraft parked on a concrete airport apron under a clear blue sky. The plane appears to be a twin-engine turboprop business aircraft, recognizable by its unusual configuration: a pointed, aerodynamic nose, a small forward wing/canard near the nose, a main wing mounted farther back, rear-mounted engine nacelles, and a tall T-tail.

The aircraft is viewed from the front-left side, with the nose dominating the foreground. Its glossy white fuselage reflects sunlight, and a thin dark stripe runs horizontally along the lower side of the body. The cockpit windows are large, dark-tinted, and wrap around the front upper section, giving the nose a streamlined, almost futuristic look. Along the side of the cabin are several small oval passenger windows.

The landing gear is down, with the front nose wheel visible near the bottom center of the image and the main landing gear visible farther back under the fuselage. Red protective covers or streamers appear attached to parts of the aircraft, including near the nose and around the propeller area, indicating it is parked and secured. The right-side rear engine nacelle is clearly visible, with a propeller positioned at the back in a pusher configuration; the propeller blades are stationary and angled upward and outward.

The tail rises high at the rear, with a horizontal stabilizer mounted at the top, forming a T-tail. Part of a registration marking beginning with “M-” is visible on the rear fuselage near the tail, though the full text is partly obscured.

The aircraft sits on a large paved apron made of square concrete slabs with expansion joints. Red painted lines and parking markings are visible on the ground. In the background, there are airport light poles, distant buildings, trees, and stacks of materials or wooden pallets to the left. The lighting suggests a bright sunny day, with strong shadows cast beneath the aircraft and across the pavement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架白色商务飞机停靠在机场跑道上的照片。飞机的机身流线型，机翼平直伸展，尾翼高耸，整体设计显得简洁而现代。飞机前方设有登机梯，准备供乘客上下飞机。背景中可以看到其他飞机和一些低矮的建筑物，但它们并不是焦点所在。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, sunlit street corner in what appears to be an older urban neighborhood, with a prominent historic wooden building occupying the right side of the frame.

The building is large and multi-story, with a distinctive mix of white-painted lower levels and weathered dark-gray wooden upper floors. The upper facade has aged timber siding, dark shutters, and enclosed projecting sections that resemble traditional bay windows. Several tall windows are fitted with louvered shutters, some closed and some partially open. The wood looks worn and faded, giving the structure an old, historic character.

On the ground floor, the facade is painted white and features decorative architectural details. There are arched windows and doorways with ornate, carved trim, including scalloped and Moorish-style arch shapes. Some windows have gridded panes, and one large arched window appears partly covered or boarded behind the glass. The lower storefront-like area includes recessed entrances, small display windows, and decorative wooden panels. A small red street sign on the wall reads “Amiral İhsan Özel” or something similar, suggesting the street name.

A tall gray utility pole stands near the corner of the building, with cables running upward. A white drainpipe runs vertically down the upper facade. The sidewalk curves around the corner, and the building sits directly at the edge of the street.

The street itself is paved and mostly empty of vehicles. In the foreground, the asphalt road is shaded in places by surrounding trees. On the left side, a pedestrian walkway or side street extends into the distance. Several people can be seen walking or standing farther down the street, appearing small in the frame. The area feels calm and residential or lightly commercial.

There is abundant greenery. Large tree branches stretch across the top left of the image, casting shade and framing the scene. Smaller trees line the street, including one directly in front of the building and another near the corner on the right. In the distance, leafy trees and flowering plants add color, with some purple blossoms visible.

The lighting suggests a bright, clear day. The sky is blue, and strong sunlight illuminates parts of the building and street while deep shadows fall across the road and sidewalk. Overall, the scene has a quiet, historic atmosphere, combining ornate old architecture, mature trees, and a peaceful pedestrian street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道一角的摄影照片，画面中心是一座具有传统风格的建筑。建筑物的设计细节包括装饰性的窗户和门廊，以及木质外墙上的白色装饰线条。在建筑前的人行道上，有几位行人正在行走，而右侧则有一棵树木。阳光从画面上方照射下来，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor aviation display in a bright desert setting under a clear, deep blue sky. The main subject is a white U.S. Navy jet aircraft displayed on a sandy/gravel surface, viewed from the front-left side. It has a sleek, pointed nose with a long, thin probe extending far forward toward the lower left edge of the image. The nose and upper fuselage feature vivid red-orange striping, and the cockpit canopy is tinted a striking blue, giving the aircraft a polished, museum-display appearance.

The jet has U.S. military markings, including a large U.S. Navy star-and-bar insignia on the side of the fuselage and the word “NAVY” near the rear. Its vertical tail is white with a red-orange tip and a yellow band near the top, with serial numbers printed below. The aircraft rests on its landing gear, and a chain appears to secure the front wheel area to the ground. The wings extend horizontally, with the right wing visible stretching toward the right side of the frame. Shadows from the aircraft fall sharply across the ground, suggesting strong midday sunlight.

Behind the main aircraft, another military jet is displayed farther back on the left. It is also painted mostly white with blue and yellow accents and sits near a paved road or parking area. Several tall light poles are scattered around the display area, and a large American flag flies from a tall flagpole on the left side of the scene.

The background consists of a flat desert landscape with low shrubs, distant brown mountains, and a few trees near the horizon. The overall setting appears to be an outdoor aircraft museum, airpark, or military aviation display area, with the aircraft arranged as static exhibits in a dry, open environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架编号为61-750的美国空军飞机的照片。飞机停放在一个开阔的场地上，背景中可以看到另一架类似的飞机和一些树木。阳光明媚，天空晴朗，场地上的阴影表明拍摄时间是在白天。

caption:
The image shows a quiet village or small-town street set at the foot of dramatic, forested mountains.

In the background, steep rocky hills rise sharply behind the buildings. The slopes are covered with dense evergreen forest, with tall pine-like trees climbing up the hillside. Pale gray limestone or rocky outcrops protrude from the greenery, forming jagged peaks and cliffs near the ridge. The left side of the mountain is slightly hazy or misty, giving the scene a soft morning or late-afternoon atmosphere.

Above the mountains is a vivid blue sky filled with wispy, streaked white clouds. The light is bright and warm, illuminating the trees and buildings and creating a peaceful, scenic feeling.

In the foreground is a paved street or parking area. Several cars are parked along the right side, including a gray SUV, a small dark car, and a few white vehicles farther back. A row of neatly pruned plane trees with thick pale trunks and rounded green canopies lines the right side of the street. Their foliage is dense and sunlit, casting shade onto the pavement.

On the left and center are low buildings with light-colored stucco walls and terracotta-tiled roofs. One building has a sign reading “École maternelle,” indicating a preschool or nursery school. In front of it are metal crowd-control barriers and a small entrance area with notice boards or posters. Another larger building to the right has a wooden upper facade and a row of rectangular windows, suggesting a public or school facility.

Near the center foreground is a small landscaped traffic island bordered by a low stone wall. It contains shrubs, flowers, and trimmed bushes. In front of it stands a blue-and-white road sign with a downward/right-pointing arrow, directing traffic around the island.

Overall, the scene combines a village school or civic area with an impressive natural mountain backdrop. It feels calm, clean, and picturesque, with the bright greenery, warm roofs, and rugged cliffs creating a strong contrast against the expansive blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光与城市建筑和谐共存的现实主义风格照片。图像前景显示了一排停放着汽车的停车场，旁边是一个装饰有石墙和绿植的小花园。中景是一座具有传统欧洲风格的建筑物，其外观以浅色木结构为主，窗户上挂着窗帘。背景是壮丽的山脉，山峰在阳光照耀下显得格外清晰，山顶覆盖着茂密的树木。整个场景被一片晴朗的蓝天所环绕，天空中飘浮着几朵轻盈的云彩。

caption:
The image shows a vintage military vehicle displayed outdoors on dry grass, likely at a historical reenactment or military vehicle exhibition.

The main subject is an olive-tan and dark green camouflage-painted 4x4 military car, viewed from the rear-left side. It has an open touring-car body with four doors and a black canvas soft top stretched over a metal frame. The rear portion of the canvas top includes a small cloudy plastic window and two small rectangular red panels, possibly reflectors or signal patches. The canvas appears weathered, with scuffs, dust, and faded streaks.

At the back of the vehicle, a large spare tire is mounted vertically on the rear, with a beige-painted wheel rim and thick off-road tread. On either side of the rear are beige storage boxes or jerry-can-style containers attached to the body. A small white placard hangs from the left rear area; it appears to identify the vehicle as a German light cross-country passenger car, with text resembling “le. gl. Einh. Pkw. 4x4 (1938).”

The vehicle has rounded fenders, simple steel wheels, and rugged tires. The bodywork is angular but softened by curved wheel arches. The camouflage pattern consists of pale sand-colored paint with irregular dark green patches. The front passenger compartment is partly open, showing the black dashboard, steering wheel, and bench-style seating. The doors have exposed hinges and simple rectangular recessed panels.

The vehicle’s front right fender and headlight assembly are visible on the far side. There are also military-style accessories mounted near the front, including poles or brackets and possibly convoy or blackout lighting equipment. The overall look suggests a World War II-era military staff or utility car.

In the background, there are trees and bushes forming a dense green backdrop.
