In the foreground, the gondola dominates the lower half of the image. It has a sleek black hull with dark blue upholstery and trim, and the metal prow ornament is visible at the front. Several passengers are seated inside; their faces appear blurred. One passenger near the front is holding up a small camera or phone, as if taking a photo. At the rear of the gondola, a gondolier stands in a striped sweater, using a long wooden oar to steer the boat through the narrow canal.

The water is calm but rippled, reflecting the buildings in wavy patterns of blue, green, white, and peach. Sunlight makes the canal glow with a saturated aqua color.

On the left side, a row of Venetian buildings rises directly from the water. The closest building has a faded pink plaster exterior with exposed brick and stone along the lower level, showing age and water staining near the canal. It has green wooden shutters, small balconies with green railings, and flower boxes with plants. Clotheslines or wires stretch across part of the façade, and shadows from balconies and railings fall sharply on the wall.

Farther down the canal, more narrow buildings line the waterway, with similar pastel walls, green shutters, small balconies, and aging brickwork. In the background, another building has arched Gothic-style windows and a terracotta-tiled roof. On the far right, part of a stone building is visible, including a balcony and a hanging banner or sign with handwritten text.

The sky is clear and bright blue, suggesting a sunny day. Overall, the scene feels lively, historic, and distinctly Venetian, combining old architecture, reflective canal water, and the classic sight of a gondola carrying tourists through the city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示威尼斯运河上典型活动的照片。一艘黑色的贡多拉船正缓缓地穿过一条狭窄的水道，船上坐着三位乘客和一位划船者。船上的乘客似乎在享受着阳光明媚的一天，而船夫则专注地驾驶着船前进。两侧是典型的威尼斯建筑，粉红色和白色的墙面以及装饰性的阳台，阳台上挂有绿色植物。水面平静，反射出周围建筑的轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a wide, open view of **Trafalgar Square in London** during what appears to be early evening or late afternoon, with soft daylight and a pale, slightly overexposed sky.

At the center-left of the scene rises **Nelson’s Column**, a tall stone column topped with a statue of Admiral Nelson. The column stands prominently against the bright sky, with its base surrounded by the square’s paved plaza and clusters of people. To the far left is a large **equestrian statue** on a stone pedestal, silhouetted somewhat by the light, showing a rider seated on a horse.

The square is busy but not overcrowded. Many pedestrians are walking across the broad stone pavement, some alone and others in small groups. In the foreground, two people cross from left to right very close to the camera; one wears a dark hoodie and shorts and is looking down at a phone, while another nearby person has a large backpack. Their movement gives the scene a candid, street-photography feel.

Near the center of the image, a person sits on the ground beside a traffic cone and some bags or colorful items laid out on the pavement. A patch of bright, multicolored light or chalk-like color appears on the ground nearby, standing out against the otherwise gray paving stones. Other people are scattered around the square—some walking, some standing, and some appearing to watch or pass by.

On the right side of the image, there is a grand, pale stone building with classical architectural details and a Canadian flag flying on top, likely **Canada House**. The building has large windows, decorative stonework, and a formal façade. Trees line parts of the square in front of the buildings, and traditional black street lamps are visible throughout the plaza.

The overall atmosphere is urban, open, and lively. The large expanse of gray stone pavement, historic monuments, and surrounding elegant buildings create a recognizable central London setting, while the pedestrians and street activity make the scene feel active and contemporary.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伦敦特拉法加广场的现实主义风格照片。在画面中心，一位街头艺术家正在用彩色粉末创作艺术作品，其粉末在地面上形成了一条多彩的轨迹。广场上散布着众多游客和当地居民，他们或行走或停留，享受着傍晚时分的宁静氛围。背景中，可以看到著名的纳尔逊纪念柱矗立在广场的一侧，而周围的建筑物则衬托出这个历史悠久的城市景观。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, outdoor winter scene in a snowy forest. A person is positioned on the left side of the frame, partially cropped so only the upper body and part of the head are visible. Their face is intentionally blurred, making facial features indistinguishable.

They are wearing a bright turquoise-blue winter jacket zipped up to the neck, with a light-colored zipper running down the front. A dark navy or black neck gaiter/scarf with small speckled patterns is wrapped around the lower face and neck. They also appear to be wearing a light blue winter hat. Bright reddish-orange hair is visible on both sides of the head, blowing outward slightly, suggesting wind or movement.

The person’s right arm is visible near the lower right, wearing a black glove or mitten. The jacket looks lightweight but insulated, suitable for cold weather or outdoor activity such as hiking, skiing, or walking in snow.

The background is a dense forest of evergreen trees heavily covered in snow. The trees are softly out of focus, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect that emphasizes the person in the foreground. Snowflakes or small white particles are visible in the air, adding to the wintry atmosphere. The overall color palette is cool and muted—icy blues, whites, and dark green forest tones—contrasted strongly by the person’s vivid blue jacket and orange hair. The image has a cinematic, slightly soft-focus look, with the subject off-center and lots of snowy forest filling the right side of the frame.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在雪地中的特写照片。她穿着一件蓝色的户外运动夹克，搭配黑色手套和一条图案围巾。她的头发被风吹得凌乱，部分遮住了面部。背景中，可以看到覆盖着厚厚积雪的树木，营造出一种寒冷而清新的冬季氛围。

caption:
The image shows the richly decorated interior of an Eastern Orthodox church, viewed from the nave facing the sanctuary. The entire scene is highly ornate, symmetrical, and saturated with gold, painted icons, and religious frescoes.

At the center is a large gilded iconostasis—the ornate screen separating the nave from the altar area. It is covered in intricate gold carving, with multiple tiers of framed icons depicting Christ, the Virgin Mary, saints, apostles, and biblical scenes. The central royal doors are especially elaborate, densely decorated with gold relief work and small icon medallions. On either side of the central doors are tall, full-length icons of holy figures in deep reds, blues, whites, and golds. Smaller icons continue in a long horizontal row across both the left and right wings of the iconostasis.

Above the iconostasis, the walls and curved vaults are covered with vivid frescoes. Angels with large multicolored wings appear across the arches and ceiling, along with saints and scenes from scripture. The upper left wall includes a dramatic scene with a rider on a white horse, while other areas show groups of haloed figures standing on clouds or in architectural settings. The ceiling is painted in bright blues, golds, reds, and soft pastels, creating a sense of heavenly space.

Several large gold chandeliers hang from the ceiling. The central chandelier is especially prominent, with many candle-like lights arranged in circular tiers and decorated with intricate metalwork. Smaller chandeliers hang to the left and right, echoing the same ornate style. A large spherical hanging ornament or lamp is suspended above the main chandelier near the ceiling.

The architecture features white columns and arches with decorative carved capitals. The columns are painted with patterned red, gold, and white geometric designs, matching the decorative borders around the frescoes. The arches frame the sanctuary and emphasize the central axis of the church.

In the foreground, the polished marble floor has geometric patterns in cream, brown, red, and dark stone. There are two white lectern-like stands with glass-topped icon cases placed before the iconostasis, one near the center-left and one near the right. A small table covered with a white cloth stands on the right side, holding books or liturgical items. Near the bottom center is a metal basin or vessel, and behind it stands a small cross-shaped candle stand. Low gold posts connected by dark ropes form a barrier in front of the iconostasis.

Overall, the image conveys a sense of sacred grandeur: gold ornamentation, luminous icons, painted biblical narratives, and elaborate chandeliers combine to create a visually overwhelming and reverent church interior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示东正教教堂内部的照片，中心位置是一个金色的祭坛，上面装饰着复杂的图案和宗教象征。两侧是装饰华丽的墙壁，挂满了色彩鲜艳的壁画和金色的圣像。天花板上绘有宗教主题的壁画，与整个室内设计融为一体。教堂内还摆放了几盏大型吊灯，增添了神圣氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit urban park or garden scene framed by dense tree foliage. The top and sides of the image are filled with leafy branches, creating a natural canopy around a bright, clear blue sky in the center. Most of the leaves are vivid green, though some are turning yellow, orange, and brown, suggesting early autumn. Sunlight filters through the leaves, producing strong highlights and deep shadows, especially on the large dark tree trunk on the right.

Near the center of the image stands an ornate vintage-style street lamp. It has a tall greenish metal pole with decorative curved arms and multiple hanging lanterns with rounded glass shades. The lamp rises above the lower foliage and is silhouetted partly against the open blue sky.

In the background, partially hidden by the trees, are elegant older buildings with pale cream and beige facades. One building has a dark gray sloped roof with chimneys and white-trimmed windows. On the right side, another building with classical architectural details is visible through the branches. The lower edge of the scene contains more shrubs and tree growth, adding depth and making the buildings appear tucked behind the park greenery.

The overall atmosphere is calm, warm, and picturesque—an urban European-looking setting where nature and historic architecture meet. The composition emphasizes the contrast between the lush leaves, the bright sky, the decorative streetlight, and the refined buildings in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，前景中有一棵郁郁葱葱的树木，其枝叶在阳光下呈现出生机勃勃的绿色。树干粗壮，树枝向四周伸展，形成了一片自然的框架。透过树叶的缝隙可以看到一个古典风格的路灯，它的设计简洁而优雅，灯罩上反射着天空的蓝色和周围环境的色彩。背景中是几座具有欧洲传统建筑特色的房屋，它们的屋顶装饰着红色瓦片，墙面涂有淡黄色调，窗户上方装饰有白色的窗框。整个场景被温暖的日光照亮，营造出一种宁静和谐的城市生活氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dense urban cityscape at dusk or sunset, framed by tall buildings on both sides. The sky dominates the scene, filled with dramatic clouds tinted in soft gold, peach, lavender, and gray tones. The sun is low behind the buildings, creating a bright, glowing area near the horizon and backlighting much of the city into dark silhouettes.

On the left side, several high-rise buildings rise vertically, their façades mostly in shadow. The nearest tower has a grid of rectangular windows and a darker glass strip running down part of its face. In the center-left, a large rectangular office or apartment building stands with many horizontal rows of windows, some faintly lit. Farther back, more towers recede into the distance, adding depth to the skyline.

On the right, a curved glass high-rise with dark reflective windows occupies the edge of the frame. Near the center-right, another tall building has a distinctive open framework or decorative structure at its roofline. The buildings appear mostly dark because of the strong backlight, giving the scene a moody, silhouetted look.

Across the lower right portion of the image, an elevated rail or transit line cuts diagonally through the scene. A blue train or transit vehicle is visible on it, decorated with advertisements and text, including what appears to be Thai writing. Beneath the elevated structure, the street level is much darker, with a line of car headlights and red taillights visible in traffic, suggesting a busy city road below.

Overall, the image captures the contrast between a glowing, colorful evening sky and the shadowed geometry of modern high-rise buildings. The mood is atmospheric and urban, with the warm sunset light softening the otherwise dark, crowded city environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市黄昏时分的摄影作品，画面中心是一座蓝色地铁列车正在穿越桥梁，周围是几座高楼大厦。天空被夕阳染成了橙黄色调，云朵在天空中缓缓移动，营造出一种宁静而温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, overcast harbor scene dominated by the bow and superstructure of a large gray naval warship docked at a pier.

In the foreground and center, the warship faces directly toward the camera, giving a symmetrical view of its sharp bow and tall mast. The ship is painted light naval gray, with the hull number “39” visible on the front. Its angular, modern superstructure rises steeply from the deck, with flat radar panels, antennas, platforms, and sensor equipment mounted high above. The central mast is very tall and intricate, with multiple horizontal crossbars, radar arrays, communication antennas, and small platforms stacked vertically. Large spherical radar or communication domes sit on either side of the upper structure.

The ship is moored alongside a concrete pier that extends from the bottom left toward the center of the image. The pier has bollards, fenders, small utility buildings, light poles, railings, and a few visible people in orange safety clothing near the ship. Large black rubber fenders line the dock edge to protect the vessel. On the right side of the warship, a smaller blue-and-white service vessel or tugboat is tied alongside, with ropes connecting it to the larger ship.

The harbor water is calm, with gentle ripples and a muted blue-gray tone reflecting the cloudy sky. Scattered across the middle and far distance are many small boats, sailboats, buoys, and larger cargo ships. Several sailboats with dark triangular sails are visible to the left, while large container or cargo vessels sit farther out near the horizon. A red lighthouse or navigation beacon stands on the right side of the frame, and smaller red and green buoys mark channels in the water.

The background is hazy, with a pale, misty horizon and faint outlines of distant shoreline structures or industrial buildings. The sky is mostly cloudy, with a long band of darker gray clouds stretching across the top of the image. The overall atmosphere feels cool, quiet, and maritime, with the imposing naval ship contrasting against the broad, open harbor and distant commercial traffic.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示军舰停靠在港口的照片。军舰位于画面的中心，其上装备了多个天线和雷达装置，船体呈现灰色调，并带有美国海军的标志。前方有一艘蓝色的小型拖船正在牵引军舰。海面上散布着其他船只，包括几艘大型货船和一些小型帆船。天空多云，但光线充足，为场景提供了清晰的视觉效果。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a used postage stamp from the **République de Guinée** (Republic of Guinea). The stamp has a white perforated border around all sides, with the black background visible beyond the stamp edges.

At the top is a wide **magenta/pink banner** containing large white uppercase text: **“RÉPUBLIQUE DE GUINÉE.”** On the right side, below the banner, the word **“POSTES”** appears in red. The denomination **“0.50 F”** is printed in large red numerals and letters in the lower-right corner.

The main design area has a bright **yellow-orange background** with a fine printed dot pattern typical of older stamps. In the center is an illustration of an aquatic animal, likely a fish, colored mostly in **blue, dark teal, gray, and reddish tones**. It is shown horizontally, facing left, with a slender body and flowing fins or tail shapes extending to the right. On the left side, printed vertically in red, is the species name **“Aphyosemion coeruleum.”**

A black postal cancellation mark crosses the stamp diagonally and partially obscures the text and illustration. The cancellation includes curved lines and partial letters, giving the stamp a used, postmarked appearance. The paper texture is visible, with slight wear and fuzzing along the perforated edges. Overall, the stamp uses bold tropical colors—magenta, yellow, red, and blue—and has a vintage printed look.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张几内亚共和国的邮票，展示了两条色彩鲜艳的鱼在黄色背景上。邮票上方印有'République de Guinée'和'POSTES'字样，下方是邮票面值'0.50F'以及发行日期'1976'。邮票的设计风格简约而现代，使用了鲜明的颜色对比来突出主题。

caption:
The image shows a highly ornate ceremonial sculpture or shrine centerpiece, photographed from a low angle against a bright sky filled with large white and gray clouds with patches of blue.

At the center is an elaborate golden structure rising upward like a crown or tiered spire. It has tall pointed elements, decorative blue-and-gold medallions, and intricate gilded detailing. Beneath it is a large lotus-shaped base with layered pink-and-white petals, giving the impression that the crown is emerging from a lotus blossom.

Surrounding the central pillar are several white elephant figures, richly decorated in a Southeast Asian/Thai ceremonial style. The elephants have soft pink shading on their ears, trunks, legs, and faces, with small dotted patterns painted across their skin. Their trunks curve inward toward the center, creating a symmetrical, almost circular composition. Some tusks are visible, adorned with gold bands. Each elephant wears ornate golden headpieces, anklets, and decorative coverings on its back, featuring turquoise, red, green, and gold patterns.

Below the elephants, at the center, hangs a large golden ornament shaped like a jeweled urn or pendant, covered in red and green gem-like accents and lattice-like gilded patterns. The entire sculpture is full of intricate textures: carved floral motifs, pointed finials, gold trim, and colorful enamel-like designs.

In the foreground, lush greenery and flowers frame the base of the display. There are clusters of bright yellow marigold-like flowers, white blossoms, leafy shrubs, and hanging gray-green moss. A black-and-white draped fabric border with rosette decorations runs behind the flowers, suggesting a formal or ceremonial installation.

In the background, partially visible below the sculpture, is a long yellow-and-white building with rows of windows and a pale roof, adding architectural context. The overall impression is festive, sacred, and ceremonial, with a strong emphasis on gold ornamentation, elephant symbolism, lotus imagery, and Thai-style decorative art.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国文化特色的雕塑艺术照片，图中主要是一个大型的粉红色大象雕塑，其背上装饰着金色的莲花和云朵。大象雕塑位于画面中央，背后是蓝天和散布的白云。在雕塑前方，有一片盛开的黄色花朵，为整个场景增添了生机与色彩。

caption:
The image shows a large industrial facility, likely part of a refinery, chemical plant, water-treatment plant, or processing site. The scene is dominated by tall metal storage or processing tanks mounted on a steel support framework.

At the center and right are two large cylindrical tanks with conical lower sections, elevated above the ground on a lattice of dark steel beams. The tanks are weathered and stained, with brown rust streaks running down from the upper rims and darker discoloration on the metal surfaces. Their upper bands are tan or beige, while the lower sections appear grayish and aged.

A complex network of industrial infrastructure surrounds the tanks: metal catwalks with railings, staircases, ladders, pipes, ducts, and vertical support columns. A prominent zigzagging metal staircase climbs up the front-left side of the structure toward the top platform. Several small industrial lights are mounted on poles and railings around the upper deck, some appearing illuminated.

On the roof-level platform, there are multiple pipes running horizontally across the tanks, along with valves, fittings, and mechanical equipment. Near the top right is a yellow overhead jib crane or hoist structure, with a horizontal beam extending outward and a vertical support dropping down to the platform. Near the upper center-left, a red windsock or warning marker is mounted on a tall pole, standing out against the pale sky.

The background is a flat, overcast gray sky, giving the scene a muted, industrial atmosphere. At the lower left, a small white utility building is visible, with a door and weathered patches on its exterior. A few palm trees stand nearby, contrasting with the heavy industrial machinery. In the lower and mid-background, conveyor belts or elevated industrial walkways run diagonally through the facility. On the lower right, another large rectangular or box-like industrial tank or container is partially visible, also stained and weathered.

Overall, the image conveys a dense, functional industrial environment with aged metal structures, extensive piping, elevated platforms, and heavy processing equipment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工业设施的照片，具体为一个大型的金属储罐结构。储罐位于图像中心，由多个相互连接的圆柱形部分组成，表面有明显的锈迹和磨损痕迹。顶部装有一个黄色的吊车臂，似乎用于移动或操作容器内的物品。周围环境包括绿色植被、其他建筑和一些管道设备，这些元素构成了储罐周围的背景。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of an ancient-looking stone wall or carved masonry surface, photographed at a tilted angle. The wall is made of large, irregular rectangular and polygonal blocks of gray limestone or weathered stone, fitted together in horizontal courses. Many of the blocks are heavily eroded, chipped, and cracked, giving the surface a rough, pitted texture.

Across the stones are shallow relief carvings and incised patterns. The designs include curved scroll-like shapes, angular geometric lines, stepped motifs, and possible stylized figures or glyph-like symbols. Some carvings appear as raised outlines, while others are recessed grooves worn down by age and exposure. The relief is uneven: certain sections are clearer, with distinct curved forms and borders, while others are faded and almost blend into the stone’s natural texture.

The stones vary in color from pale whitish gray to darker charcoal gray, with patches of black staining, mineral deposits, and lighter weathered areas. Small cracks between the blocks reveal bits of reddish mortar or underlying material in a few places. Tiny green plants and moss-like growths are visible in some gaps between stones, especially near the upper left and lower areas, suggesting the wall is outdoors and exposed to moisture and vegetation.

At the bottom left edge of the image, a strip of bright green grass is visible, contrasting with the muted gray stone. The lighting appears natural and fairly bright, highlighting the rough surface and casting small shadows into the carved grooves and holes. Overall, the image captures the texture and detail of an old carved stone structure, possibly part of an archaeological ruin or historical monument.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古代石刻艺术的照片，具体为一系列精细雕刻的图案和符号。这些石刻位于一面粗糙的灰色岩石墙上，每个图案都具有独特的设计，包括螺旋形、圆形和其他几何形状。这些图案可能代表着某种文化或宗教意义，但具体的含义由于缺乏上下文信息而难以确定。

caption:
The image shows a large traditional wooden church or chapel, likely in an Eastern Orthodox architectural style, photographed from a low, front-left angle under a pale gray overcast sky.

The building is constructed mainly from dark, weathered logs and timber, with a prominent central tower rising above the main structure. At the top is a tall, steep wooden spire with aged gray planks, capped by an onion-shaped dome and an Orthodox cross. Two smaller side spires, also topped with onion domes and crosses, flank the central tower. The domes have a patterned, shingled texture that gives them a scale-like appearance.

The main body of the church has a mix of dark log walls and a lighter, box-like upper section that appears to be clad in pale, weathered wood or plastered timber. Small narrow windows are visible on the tower, and the lower level has rectangular windows with wooden frames, some with decorative lattice patterns. A covered wooden entrance porch with exposed beams, railings, and a steep roof extends from the front-left side. Flower boxes with red and pink flowers decorate the porch area.

The church sits elevated on a mound covered with rounded stones and gravel. A short stairway leads up toward the building from a gate in a metal fence. The fence in the foreground is greenish and rusted in places, with an open gate leading to the church grounds. To the right of the church are several tall flagpoles carrying flags, including one with the Russian tricolor and others with multicolored designs.

In the foreground, there is a paved parking area with white road markings and a curb, transitioning into gravel and dirt near the entrance. The surrounding landscape includes low grass and a line of green trees in the background, suggesting a rural or semi-rural setting. The overall atmosphere is quiet, cool, and slightly damp, with muted colors and soft lighting from the cloudy sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座传统木制教堂的摄影图像。教堂位于一个开放的场地上，周围有绿色植被和草地。教堂由多根立柱支撑，顶部装饰有一个尖顶和十字架。在教堂前方，有一条通往教堂的小路，旁边是几面不同国家的国旗。天空阴沉，可能预示着即将下雨。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of an ornate traditional building viewed from a low angle, emphasizing the roofline against a vivid blue sky.

A large expanse of bright turquoise-blue sky fills most of the frame, with a few thin, wispy white clouds scattered across it. On the left side, a tall, pale flagpole leans diagonally upward, carrying a bright orange-red flag with a yellow central section. The flag appears slightly worn or frayed at the edges and is hanging loosely in the breeze.

Below the sky is the roof of an old, decorative structure. The roof is covered in rows of reddish-brown curved clay tiles, arranged in tight, repetitive lines that run downward toward the viewer. The tiles look aged and weathered, with darker shadows between the ridges and some pale debris or discoloration in the grooves.

Along the top edge of the roof is an elaborate ornamental ridge. It is decorated with sculptural details, including dragon-like figures at both ends and curling, cloud-like motifs. In the center of the ridge is a circular turquoise or blue-green ornament surrounded by radiating spikes, giving it a sunburst-like appearance. The ridge is painted in faded colors—blue, white, yellow, red, and gold—but much of the paint is chipped and weathered, revealing the age of the building.

Beneath the decorative ridge are rectangular panels and lattice-like sections. Some panels contain worn painted designs or characters, while others have patterned ventilation screens. The colors are still vibrant in places, especially the blue trim and yellow panels, but the overall surface has a timeworn, historic quality.

The composition contrasts the rich textures of the old tiled roof and carved ornamentation with the smooth, open brightness of the sky. The scene suggests a traditional temple, shrine, or historic architectural site in a sunny climate.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示亚洲传统建筑风格的照片，特写了一座屋顶的精美装饰。屋顶由红色瓦片构成，上面雕刻着复杂的图案和雕塑，包括一个突出的装饰性尖顶。在照片的上方，可以看到一面鲜艳的橙色旗帜，在蓝天的映衬下显得格外醒目。

caption:
The image shows a freestanding sidewalk chalkboard sign advertising a **“Mau’s Wine & Cheese bar.”** The sign is framed in warm, honey-colored wood with visible grain, small scuffs, and slightly worn edges. It stands on two wooden legs on a gray stone-paved pedestrian street.

The main surface is a black chalkboard filled with decorative hand-lettering in white chalk. The word **“Mau’s”** is written large across the upper middle in ornate, flowing script with dramatic loops and flourishes. Below it, **“WINE”** appears in tall, block-style letters with decorative curved accents around it. Under that, **“& CHEESE”** is written in thinner white lettering, and near the bottom the word **“bar”** appears in large, loose lowercase letters.

The board is decorated with chalk illustrations of **purple grapes and green grape leaves** in the corners and along the top. There are clusters of grapes in the upper left, upper right, lower left, and lower right, drawn with purple circular outlines and green leafy shapes. White starbursts, dots, curls, and ornamental swirls are scattered around the text, giving the sign a handcrafted, artistic look.

In the background, the street scene is softly out of focus. There are pedestrians walking, parts of shopfronts, a bicycle or cart wheel on the left, and another sign farther back. The overall setting suggests a busy shopping or café area, with the chalkboard placed outside to attract passersby.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外菜单板的现实主义风格照片。黑板上用白色粉笔手绘了'MAUI WINE & CHEESE BAR'的文字，周围装饰有葡萄和叶子图案。黑板被一个木制框架支撑，立于人行道上，背景中模糊可见行人和商店的一部分。

caption:
The image shows a bright, picturesque European village street on a sunny day, likely in a wine-growing region. The scene is filled with warm colors, traditional architecture, and rolling vineyard-covered hills in the background.

On the left side, a row of historic buildings lines the street. The nearest building has a warm ochre-orange façade with dark timber trim, red-brown shutters, and steep tiled roofs. Many of the windows have open shutters, and several are decorated with overflowing flower boxes full of vivid pink, red, white, and green plants. A vertical turquoise sign hangs from the building, adding a splash of blue against the orange wall. Below it, part of a sign with dark letters is visible on the façade.

Next to it stands a more ornate pale stone building with a tower-like section and a steep slate roof topped with small decorative finials. Its architecture has a slightly medieval or Renaissance feel, with carved stone details and tall windows. Farther down the street are additional traditional houses with cream, beige, red, and timber-framed façades, many with steep roofs covered in reddish or brown tiles. Some buildings have colorful shutters, including green and red ones, contributing to the charming village atmosphere.

The street curves gently through the foreground and includes a zebra crossing, road signs, a blue directional traffic sign, and a few cars parked or driving in the distance. A couple of pedestrians or cyclists can be seen near the lower right area, giving the scene a sense of everyday village life. Planters with small trees and greenery line parts of the sidewalk, and neatly trimmed bushes sit near the road.

In the background, the landscape rises into terraced vineyards covering the hillside. The rows of grapevines form regular green patterns across the golden-brown slopes, with a band of trees along the crest of the hill. Above everything is a vivid blue sky with thin, wispy white clouds, creating a bright, clear summer atmosphere.

Overall, the image captures a charming old wine village with colorful historic buildings, abundant flowers, tidy streets, and sunlit vineyards rising behind it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲小镇街道的摄影图像，画面中心是一条笔直的道路，两侧是具有传统欧洲建筑风格的房屋。最左侧的建筑物上挂有'PAIN DE MIEUX'的招牌，窗户上方装饰着鲜艳的花朵。街道上有行人正在行走，而路边则摆放着鲜花和植物。在远处，可以看到郁郁葱葱的葡萄园沿着山坡延伸，为这个宁静的场景增添了一抹生机。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit view of a historic church complex and surrounding plaza, likely in a tropical or subtropical setting. The scene is captured from the middle of a broad, dark asphalt road that leads toward large white colonial-style buildings in the background.

On the left side is a long white building with a dark reddish-brown tiled roof. It has an old, weathered appearance, with tall rectangular windows, decorative pilasters, and several tower-like structures rising above the roofline. One prominent tower at the far left has narrow vertical sections and small spire-like details at the top, giving it a church or monastery-like character. Another square tower rises nearer the center of the building.

Farther back and slightly to the right is a larger, more ornate white church façade. It features classical architectural elements: a triangular pediment, arched openings, decorative moldings, and symmetrical towers. The right tower is tall and rectangular, with layered sections and small ornamental details along the top. The building’s white walls contrast strongly with the deep blue sky.

The foreground is dominated by a wide empty road, bordered by raised sidewalks on both sides. The road surface is dark and slightly rough, with patches of dust and wear. The sidewalks are paved with light beige tiles and edged by black curbs. On the left, there is a fenced garden area with black metal railings, red flowers, trimmed grass, and several trees, including tall, narrow conifer-like trees. Trash bins are visible near the fence.

There are a few pedestrians scattered throughout the scene. On the left sidewalk, a person in dark clothing walks near the garden fence. Near the center, a woman wearing a bright pink sari and a face mask stands out vividly against the pale buildings and neutral pavement. On the far right sidewalk, a small group of people walks near a line of trees and railings; some appear to be wearing masks as well.

The landscaping around the church includes potted plants, flower beds, and neatly arranged greenery. Tall trees frame the right side of the image, adding dense green foliage. The sky is clear, pale blue, and cloudless, suggesting a bright, warm day. Overall, the scene feels spacious, calm, and historic, with the monumental white church architecture serving as the main focal point.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一座宏伟的白色教堂建筑的照片，位于一个宽阔的广场上。教堂前有几棵高大的树木和一些绿色植物，为场景增添了自然美。在教堂前方的人行道上有几位行人正在行走，其中一位穿着鲜艳的粉红色衣服格外显眼。阳光明媚，天空呈现出一片清澈的蓝色，为整个场景增添了一份宁静与和谐。

caption:
The image shows a busy street-food stall scene, focused closely on a cooking station.

In the foreground, there is a metal muffin-style cooking tray with multiple round wells. Each well contains a golden-brown, fried or baked snack that appears to be made with macaroni pasta mixed into an egg or batter base. The tops are browned and slightly crispy, with bits of pale macaroni visible inside and around the edges. Some of the pieces look puffed and uneven, suggesting they are being cooked fresh in oil or on a heated mold.

To the left of the tray is a large white plastic basket with holes in the sides, filled with cooked elbow macaroni. A light blue plastic serving spoon rests inside the basket. The pasta is pale yellow-white and piled high, ready to be portioned into the molds.

A person, likely the vendor, stands behind the cooking area wearing a long-sleeved white shirt and a wristwatch. Only the torso and hands are visible. The person is holding or stirring something in a bright green plastic cup, possibly sauce, seasoning, or batter. The cup has some reddish-brown residue inside near the rim, suggesting it may contain a condiment or spicy mixture.

At the lower left corner, there is a container packed with many wooden skewers or sticks standing upright. A red-topped bottle is partially visible nearby, likely holding sauce or seasoning. The cooking surface and surrounding metal frame look well-used, with rust, grease marks, and browned residue from repeated cooking.

In the background, there are people walking around, suggesting this is an outdoor market or street vendor area. Some clothing and crates are visible in the distance, adding to the busy marketplace atmosphere. The overall scene feels lively and informal, centered on freshly prepared street food being cooked and served.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示街头小吃摊位的现实主义风格照片。在图片中，一位穿着白色长袖衬衫和黑色裤子的人正用绿色塑料杯装着食物，可能是准备出售给顾客的。摊位上摆放着多个金属烤盘，里面装满了金黄色的炸物，看起来像是油炸食品。在摊位的一侧，可以看到一些散落的食物残渣和一个蓝色塑料容器，里面装有白色的食材。背景模糊地显示了其他摊位和人群，但焦点集中在前景的烹饪活动上。

caption:
The image shows a large-scale construction site, likely a stadium, arena, or major structural project, viewed from below at an upward angle. The scene is dominated by massive white steel trusses and multiple tower cranes against a pale, overcast sky.

In the foreground, a huge white lattice truss extends diagonally from the lower left toward the upper center of the image. It is made of thick steel beams arranged in triangular patterns for strength. Along the underside of this elevated section is a large sheet of blue safety netting, stretched and draped beneath the structure to catch debris or protect workers below. Yellow mechanical components and platforms are attached near the top and side of the truss, adding bright accents to the mostly white and grey construction materials.

Below the upper truss, another long white steel truss runs horizontally across the middle and lower right portion of the image. It also has blue protective netting underneath and appears to be part of a roof or large-span support system. The repeated triangular geometry of the steel members creates a dense, patterned framework.

On the right side, a tall white tower crane rises vertically through the frame. Its mast is made of a lattice structure, and parts of its boom stretch across the upper background. A hanging cable with a hook or lifting attachment dangles near the center-right, suspended in the open space between the trusses and cranes. Another yellow crane boom extends diagonally from the right toward the center, crossing behind the main steel structure. Additional crane arms are visible in the background, emphasizing the scale and complexity of the construction operation.

The lower portion of the image shows a partially built concrete structure with exposed floors, beams, and columns. There is extensive metal scaffolding around the building, especially on the left and lower center, forming a grid of vertical and horizontal poles. Some stair-like concrete seating or stepped structural elements are visible, reinforcing the impression that this could be a stadium or large public venue under construction.

The overall scene feels industrial and busy, though no workers are clearly visible. The color palette is mostly white, grey, and concrete beige, punctuated by bright yellow crane parts and platforms and vivid blue safety netting. The perspective emphasizes height, engineering complexity, and the enormous scale of the steel framework being assembled.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑工地的现实主义风格照片，图中可见多台塔式起重机和脚手架围绕着正在建设中的建筑物。最显眼的是一个大型黄色塔式起重机，其吊臂伸展至空中，下方是蓝色的安全网。在起重机周围，可以看到其他较小的起重机和密集的脚手架结构，这些都覆盖了施工现场。天空中有云彩，但整体天气看起来晴朗。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque old church or monastery building set in a lush, rocky forest landscape. The scene is photographed from a low angle, looking upward toward the roofline, bell tower, trees, and sky.

On the right side stands a tall stone bell tower made of rough, light-gray masonry. Near the top, the tower transitions into a white belfry with arched openings, dark trim, and a small clock face beneath the roofline. Above it is a steep, dark metal spire topped with a small ornamental cross or finial. The tower rises against dense green foliage and a dramatic rocky cliff face in the background, suggesting the building is nestled at the base of a mountain or limestone outcrop.

Across the lower half of the image is the main church structure with a reddish-brown tiled roof. The exterior wall is richly decorated with faded painted murals and ornamental patterns. There are arched decorative panels, floral motifs, religious-style imagery, and several windows with diamond-patterned metal grilles. A blue door is visible near the base of the tower, partly tucked into the shadowed corner of the building.

The surroundings are very natural and verdant: tall leafy trees fill the middle and right portions of the frame, with bright spring-green foliage catching the sunlight. Behind the trees, the rugged cliff surface adds texture and height to the scene. In the foreground on the right, a large gray rock partially blocks the lower part of the church and tower area.

The sky is clear and bright blue with a few soft white clouds. Sunlight creates strong contrasts, illuminating the tower and treetops while leaving parts of the painted wall and roof in shade. Overall, the image conveys a quiet, historic religious site tucked into a forested mountain setting, with ornate architecture blending into the natural landscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座古老教堂的摄影图像。教堂位于一片郁郁葱葱的树木和岩石之间，其哥特式风格的钟楼高耸入云，塔尖上装饰着一个十字架。教堂的外墙装饰有精美的壁画，显示出历史的痕迹。阳光从树叶间透射下来，给这个宁静的场景增添了一抹温暖的色彩。

caption:
The image is a black-and-white street portrait of a person seated in front of a shop window. The composition is vertical and tightly framed, with the person centered and occupying most of the image from head to knees.

The person’s face is intentionally blurred, obscuring their identity. They are wearing a thick knitted beanie with a patterned design and what appears to be lettering or symbols across the front. Strands of light-colored, wavy hair fall out from beneath the hat on one side. Their clothing is layered and heavy: a dark puffy vest with a fleece-lined collar over a bulky sweatshirt or jacket, with additional fabric layers visible at the cuffs and waist. The textures of the clothing look worn and rugged, with creases, dust, and fraying visible.

Around their neck are several necklaces, including large bead-like pieces and a rectangular pendant hanging at the center of the chest. Their hands are prominent in the lower half of the image. One hand rests loosely on their lap, showing a ring on a finger, while the other holds a small piece of food or object near a shallow cup or bowl. A cloth or scarf hangs from one hand. The person is seated with legs bent and spread outward, wrapped in or covered by heavy fabric that drapes across the foreground.

Behind them is a storefront window filled with printed advertisements for seafood. Text such as “PRAWNS & FISH,” “Fresh,” “Prawns,” and “Last day to Buy” can be made out. The posters show images of fish, prawns, shellfish, and prepared seafood dishes. The shop window has a metal or plastic frame, and the lower background includes vertical paneling beneath the glass.

The overall mood is gritty and documentary-like. The high-contrast monochrome treatment emphasizes texture: the knitted hat, the fleece collar, the wrinkled hands, the layered clothing, and the printed halftone seafood posters in the background. The image feels candid and urban, capturing a quiet moment on the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张黑白摄影风格的照片，展示了一位坐在户外的老人。老人穿着一件厚重的外套和帽子，脸上戴着围巾遮住脸部，手中拿着一个物品。他的姿态显得沉思而放松，背景中有一块写有'PRAWNS & FISH'字样的广告牌，以及一些模糊的食物图片。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic upward-looking view inside an opulent historic church or cathedral, likely a Baroque or Renaissance interior. The camera is angled steeply upward and slightly tilted, creating a sweeping, almost vertiginous perspective that emphasizes the height and grandeur of the architecture.

The central focus is an elaborately decorated vaulted ceiling covered in white and gold ornamentation. The ceiling is divided into a dense geometric pattern of coffers: octagons, rectangles, crosses, and smaller framed panels. Many of the octagonal panels contain large golden rosette or flower-like medallions, while the rectangular and cross-shaped sections are filled with gilded floral motifs, scrollwork, and relief carvings. The gold detailing stands out brightly against the white plaster, giving the ceiling a richly illuminated, jewel-like appearance.

Around the ceiling, dark and reddish-brown marble arches frame the space. These marble sections have a polished, veined texture that contrasts with the crisp white-and-gold decoration above. The arches curve across the image, guiding the eye toward a dome visible in the lower right portion of the frame. The dome area is also richly decorated, with gilded moldings, painted frescoes, columns, and architectural panels. A blue-toned window or opening is visible in the dome, adding a cool color accent.

On both sides of the image are sculptural elements and architectural walls in cool gray-blue tones. Several statues appear along the edges, partially in shadow. On the right, a large white or gray marble figure is seen close to the camera, its draped clothing and body partially visible, creating a sense of depth. Nearby are sculpted cherubs or putti clustered around decorative stonework. On the left side, more cherub figures and ornate sculptural details appear, including a richly carved, darker gilded or bronze-looking structure.

The lighting creates a strong contrast between the bright, warm gold ceiling and the cooler, shadowed stone statues and walls. The overall atmosphere is grand, sacred, and highly ornate, with intricate craftsmanship everywhere: gilded reliefs, marble arches, classical statues, frescoes, and decorative coffering. The wide-angle perspective makes the space feel immense and immersive, as if the viewer is standing beneath the ceiling and looking straight up into a lavishly decorated cathedral interior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示教堂内部装饰的照片，从地面向上拍摄，捕捉了天花板上的金色和白色图案以及周围雕塑的细节。天花板上的图案复杂而精致，以金色为主色调，辅以白色的线条和几何形状，营造出一种庄严而神圣的氛围。雕塑位于画面的右侧，其表面覆盖着蓝色大理石般的纹理，与周围的环境形成对比。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，突出了建筑的宏伟和艺术性。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of Singapore’s Marina Bay at sunset or early evening.

In the foreground, the bay’s water fills much of the lower half of the scene. The surface is textured with small ripples, catching muted reflections of the golden sky and the darker silhouettes of the surrounding buildings. The water appears calm, with subtle bands of light and shadow stretching toward the viewer.

On the left side is the distinctive ArtScience Museum, recognizable by its large white lotus-flower shape. Its curved “petals” fan upward and outward, creating a sculptural form that contrasts with the straight lines of the city skyline behind it. Around its base are waterfront walkways, railings, landscaped areas, and parts of nearby structures.

Across the center of the image is Singapore’s dense downtown skyline. Tall glass-and-steel skyscrapers rise closely together, forming a varied silhouette of rectangular towers, rounded façades, and reflective office buildings. Some buildings have dark blue or green-tinted glass, while others are lighter and more metallic. The towers are backlit by the low sun, which is partially hidden behind the skyline, giving the buildings a dramatic silhouette and producing a warm glow around their edges.

The sky dominates the upper portion of the image. It is expansive and dramatic, with a mixture of soft blue tones and warm golden-orange light near the horizon. Large dark clouds hover above the skyline, especially near the center, with their edges faintly illuminated by the sunset. Wispy, lighter clouds spread across the right side, creating streaks and layered textures in the sky.

On the right side, the waterfront continues with floating platforms, docks, railings, and a few tall poles or light masts. Farther right, a large low, curved structure with a ribbed roof is visible, likely part of the Esplanade area. There are also smaller buildings and construction-like elements near the shoreline.

Overall, the image captures a calm but dramatic urban waterfront scene: modern architecture, reflective water, and a richly colored sunset sky over Marina Bay. The mood is serene, cinematic, and slightly grand, emphasizing both the scale of the city and the beauty of the evening light.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线的摄影作品，图像捕捉了日落时分的城市景观。在画面左侧，一座独特的建筑物以其巨大的白色花瓣形状结构成为焦点，与背后的高楼大厦形成鲜明对比。天空中散布着几朵云彩，呈现出橙黄色调，而太阳即将沉入地平线下方。水面平静，反射出天空和建筑的轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an old, rough stone or plaster wall containing two human skulls set into small recessed niches. The scene has the appearance of an ossuary, crypt, archaeological display, or historical burial site.

On the left side, a skull sits in a rectangular recess beneath a bright arched window reflection. This skull is more damaged: much of the front facial structure is broken away, leaving a dark, hollow opening where the nose and upper face would be. The lower jaw is still present and hangs slightly open, with several teeth visible. The bone is aged and discolored, with beige, gray, and brown tones.

On the right side, another skull is embedded in a similar niche. It is more intact and faces forward. Its eye sockets are deep and dark, the nasal cavity is clearly visible, and the upper teeth and lower jaw remain in place. The skull has a weathered, slightly yellowed surface, contrasting with the gray, dusty wall around it.

Between and around the skulls, the wall is uneven and crumbling, with rough mortar, exposed stone, cracks, and small ledges. The niches look handmade or eroded over time, with irregular edges and layers of plaster or masonry. Along the bottom is a horizontal wooden or stone beam-like ledge, aged and stained.

A vertical glass panel or display case edge is visible along the left side of the image, suggesting the remains are behind protective glass. Near the top left, a bright arched window shape is reflected in the glass, with pale daylight and faint tree shapes visible outside. The lighting is soft but uneven, with cool daylight from the reflected window and warmer shadows across the wall, giving the scene an old, museum-like, somber atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在石质结构中的三个头骨的照片。最左侧的头骨位于一个较深的凹槽中，中间的头骨被放置在一个稍浅的凹槽里，而最右侧的头骨则放在一个更深的凹槽中。每个头骨都呈现出清晰的人类特征，包括眼睛、鼻孔和牙齿。背景由粗糙的石墙构成，上面有一个小窗户，透过窗户可以看到外面的光线。

caption:
The image shows a close-up view of an entryway with a distinctive, artistic front door and surrounding glass block panels.

At the center-left is a large wooden door with a warm, light-brown wood grain finish. The door is framed by worn, off-white trim with visible chips, scratches, and signs of age. Near the top of the door, the number **“7”** is mounted in a pale color. Running vertically down the middle-left portion of the door is a narrow decorative panel framed in metal. This panel contains an abstract, relief-like design in gray, black, cream, and muted blue tones, with swirling ribbon shapes, circles, dots, textured patterns, and curved geometric forms.

On the right side of the door is a black electronic lock or access device mounted at about waist height, with a small screen or sensor area and buttons below. A simple white vertical handle is mounted higher up near the right edge of the door.

To the right of the door is a tall wall of square glass blocks arranged in a grid. The glass blocks are bluish-gray and semi-translucent, with wavy, distorted patterns that create a rippled, frosted effect. The metal or painted framing between the blocks is weathered, with peeling paint and darkened edges.

In the lower-right foreground stands a large decorative ceramic vase. It is tall and amphora-like, with a narrow neck, flared rim, and curled side handles. The vase has a rustic, weathered finish in reddish-brown, ochre, cream, and green, with raised decorative patterns including leaf-like or geometric shapes. Its worn surface echoes the aged look of the doorway.

The floor appears to be light stone or tile, and the entire scene has a slightly weathered, vintage character. The color palette combines warm wood and terracotta tones with cool blue-gray glass and faded white trim, giving the entrance an artistic, Mediterranean or mid-century feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示室内装饰的照片，中心为一扇木制的门，门上装饰着一幅具有现代艺术风格的抽象图案。门的右侧是一个带有复杂几何图案的玻璃窗，而左侧则放置了一个大型陶瓷花瓶，其表面有着复杂的纹理和色彩。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，呈现出一种温馨而精致的家居氛围。

caption:
The image shows a group of young schoolchildren lined up outdoors, apparently during a formal school event or ceremony. They are standing on a paved walkway in front of a black metal fence with decorative arched patterns. Behind the fence is a dense crowd of adults, likely parents or spectators, many holding phones or watching the children. Some greenery and tree leaves are visible in the background, suggesting the event is taking place near a school courtyard or entrance.

The children are dressed in formal school uniforms, mostly in dark navy, black, and white. Many of the girls wear white blouses with lace collars, dark pinafore dresses or skirts, white knee socks or tights, and black dress shoes. Several girls have large white hair bows or ribbons, a common ceremonial school accessory. Some boys wear dark suits or vests with white shirts and ties; one boy near the center wears a blue suit with a matching tie. Another boy on the right wears a navy suit with a striped tie.

The children appear to be standing in a loose line, facing forward or slightly turned toward one another. Some are holding hands or standing close together, while others look distracted or are interacting quietly. Their posture varies—some stand straight with hands clasped in front, while others lean, turn, or look to the side. A few children are wearing name tags or lanyards around their necks.

The adults in the background form a packed audience behind the fence. They are dressed casually or semi-formally, and several are holding smartphones as if taking photos or videos. The crowd gives the scene a celebratory, public-event feeling. The lighting is bright and natural, with sunlight illuminating the children’s uniforms and casting soft shadows on the pavement.

Overall, the scene appears to depict a school gathering, possibly a first-day-of-school ceremony, graduation-style event, or formal assembly, with children in traditional uniforms standing before a crowd of family members and onlookers.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群穿着校服的学生的照片。学生们站在户外，他们的表情和动作被模糊处理以保护隐私。他们中的一些人戴着领结，而其他人则没有。孩子们的服装包括深色的西装外套、白色衬衫、黑色裤子和配有白色袜子的鞋子。在他们的背后，可以看到一些模糊的人群和一个金属栅栏，这些元素表明他们可能在一个公共场合或活动上。

caption:
The image is a wide panoramic view of a mountainous section of the Great Wall of China, seen from an elevated vantage point on the wall itself.

In the foreground, the Great Wall runs diagonally across the lower half of the image, its pale stone base and gray brick parapets following the steep contours of the dry hillside. The wall has crenellated battlements on both sides and a walkway along the top. Several tourists are visible walking along the wall and pausing near watchtowers, giving a sense of scale to the massive structure. A prominent square watchtower with arched openings stands on the right side, while another tower and winding wall sections descend toward the center.

Below the wall, in the valley, there is a large greenish body of water or reservoir bordered by stone embankments. Around it are paved roads, parking lots with scattered cars, and visitor facilities. Traditional Chinese-style buildings with green tiled roofs and red-painted structural elements sit near the base of the wall, forming an entrance or scenic-area complex. A long bridge-like section of wall or walkway crosses over part of the water and connects to gates and towers.

The surrounding landscape is rugged and dry, with brown hillsides, exposed rock faces, and sparse vegetation. Across the upper slopes, the Great Wall continues in long, snaking lines, climbing ridges and dipping through passes. Small watchtowers punctuate the wall at intervals. The hills are dotted with pale pink and white flowering trees, suggesting early spring blossoms, mixed with darker evergreen patches and leafless deciduous trees.

In the distance, terraced or cultivated fields appear as golden-brown rectangular patches on the right. Roads curve through the valley, and there are a few small buildings and service areas near the parking lots. The lighting is bright and clear, with strong sunlight casting defined shadows, emphasizing the texture of the stone walls, rocky cliffs, and winding pathways.

Overall, the scene combines historic architecture, dramatic mountain terrain, spring blossoms, and modern tourist infrastructure, capturing the Great Wall as both a monumental ancient fortification and a busy scenic destination.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国长城及其周边环境的高分辨率摄影图像。图像中心是著名的长城，它沿着山脊蜿蜒而上，两侧是郁郁葱葱的树木和开阔的草地。在长城前方，可以看到一些游客正在行走或拍照。左侧有一片盛开的樱花树，为画面增添了春天的气息。背景中，可以看到一条通往远方的道路，沿途有几座亭子和建筑物，这些都与长城一起构成了一个充满历史感的场景。

caption:
The image shows a nighttime outdoor winter or holiday event in a city square or street. The scene is wide and slightly panoramic, with bright decorative lighting and illuminated ice sculptures as the main focus.

On the left foreground is a large translucent ice sculpture made of stacked rectangular blocks. It is lit from below or within by vivid green light, making the ice glow brightly and showing cloudy textures, bubbles, and frozen patterns inside. The sculpture sits on a dark raised base. Behind it, slightly farther back, is another illuminated ice sculpture glowing white and bluish-purple; it appears to be shaped like an animal or bear-like figure.

The background is filled with warm golden string lights wrapped around trees, creating a festive holiday atmosphere. The lights form many small glowing dots and trails against the dark night sky. In the center distance, there is a large historic-looking building with columns, arched windows, and statues or sculptural figures on top, softly lit in warm tones.

On the right side, a crowd of people stands behind metal barriers, watching the display. In the foreground, a child wearing a patterned winter coat and a light-colored knit hat with small decorative studs is visible, seated or held close to an adult. The adult beside them wears a dark hooded coat. Several other spectators in winter hats and coats line the barrier, suggesting cold weather.

The pavement is wet and reflective, catching the green, purple, blue, and golden lights from the sculptures and decorations. A thin purple light line stretches across the upper right portion of the image, possibly part of the event lighting. The overall mood is festive, wintry, and lively, with a strong contrast between the glowing ice sculptures, warm tree lights, and the dark night surroundings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日庆典活动的照片，前景中一个小孩穿着粉色和黑色的外套，戴着灰色帽子，专注地观看前方的冰雕。冰雕发出绿色光芒，显得非常引人注目。背景中，人们聚集在装饰着彩灯的街道上，营造出一种温馨而欢乐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the front glass entrance of a Starbucks café, photographed from outside looking in. A large circular green-and-white Starbucks siren logo dominates the center-left of the frame, adhered to the glass door or window. Because the surface is highly reflective, the scene blends the café interior with reflections of the outdoor surroundings, including trees, a waterfront or open outdoor area, railings, and passing silhouettes.

Inside the café, the lighting is warm and dim compared with the bright exterior. Several ceiling lights and an air-conditioning unit are visible overhead. On the left side, a decorative orange-red mottled pendant lamp hangs near the window, next to a tall colorful wall art panel with abstract coffee-themed shapes. On the right, part of the service area and merchandise shelving can be seen, including cups, bottles, and promotional displays.

Several signs and notices are stuck to the glass near the entrance. A small sign reads “Free Wi-Fi,” and below it there is an “Operating Hours” notice. Other posted notices include a “We’re Hiring” sign, a “No pets allowed” notice, and a reminder about no outside food and drinks. Near the right side of the window is a large promotional decal advertising drinks with the phrase “DELICIOUS #METIME IN EVERY SIP.”

People are visible through the glass inside the café and in reflection. On the lower right, a person wearing a yellow shirt and blue jeans stands near the entrance, looking downward, possibly at a phone or something in their hands. Other figures are seated or moving in the background, partially obscured by glare and reflections. The overall atmosphere is busy but calm, with the layered reflections giving the image a slightly complex, urban storefront feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示星巴克咖啡店内部的照片。在画面的中心，有一个巨大的绿色标志，上面印有星巴克的品牌标志和文字信息。通过玻璃门可以看到店内的人们，包括一位穿着黄色上衣的女性顾客正在使用手机。店内装饰以木质元素为主，营造出温馨舒适的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an old stone ruin or historic wall under a clear blue sky. The structure is made from irregular, rough stones in shades of gray, tan, brown, and greenish slate, stacked together with mortar. The wall is weathered and uneven, with a jagged top edge and small plants and grasses growing out of cracks and crevices.

Near the center-bottom of the wall is a narrow arched doorway or opening. It is framed by larger, upright stones forming a rough arch, and the opening is closed off by a black metal gate with vertical bars. The space behind the gate appears dark, suggesting an interior chamber or passage.

On the left side, a lower section of crumbling stone wall extends forward, creating a layered ruin-like appearance. A small dark bird, possibly a jackdaw or crow, is perched on the top of this lower wall near a tall gray metal pole that rises vertically out of the frame. The bird stands in profile, adding a small point of life to the otherwise still scene.

At the base of the wall there is grass, weeds, and wildflowers, including small yellow flowers and clusters of pink blossoms. The foreground is a grassy lawn with tiny white flowers scattered throughout. A flat, dark rectangular slab or stone lies in the grass near the bottom center of the image.

On the far right edge, part of a more modern light-colored building is visible, with a roofline and a white wall contrasting with the ancient stonework. The lighting is bright and direct, casting strong shadows in the stone textures and emphasizing the rough, aged surface of the ruin.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古老石墙和铁门的摄影图像。石墙由不规则的石头堆砌而成，顶部有一层薄薄的砖块覆盖。在石墙的右侧，有一个半圆形的入口，上方装有黑色金属栅栏。石墙前的草地上生长着一些野花和绿色植物，而背景中可以看到部分现代建筑的屋顶。

caption:
The image shows an urban streetscape on a wide downtown street, with a row of older low-rise commercial buildings squeezed between taller modern structures. The scene appears to be in a busy entertainment or shopping district, though the street itself is relatively quiet at the moment.

At the center is a distinctive yellow-beige building with a flashy retro façade for the **Zanzibar** club. A tall vertical red sign spelling **“ZANZIBAR”** runs down the front of the building, and the façade is decorated with many large colorful star-shaped signs in blue, pink, green, and black. Near the top right of the building, there is a stylized figure of a dancer or performer attached to the wall. The entrance canopy below is turquoise-green and bears the word **“Club”** above a large angled **Zanzibar** sign. A marquee beneath it has small white lettering advertising shows, including phrases such as “ENJOY NON STOP SEXY DANCERS” and “RAPTORS GONNA FIXER THE SIXERS.” The building has several narrow upper-floor windows with small balcony-like railings.

To the left of Zanzibar is a two-story brick restaurant building with red signs reading **“BUFFET PALACE”** and “Fine Indian Cuisine.” The restaurant has a second-floor balcony or patio with railings and colorful round lights. A vertical sign on the façade repeats **“BUFFET”** in large white letters on red. Below, there are storefront windows and food images near the entrance. Next to it is a storefront labeled **“SPORTS CENTRE”** with a large red-and-white sign and sports brand logos such as Nike, Reebok, adidas, Puma, and others. The shop appears closed or gated at street level.

On the far left is part of an older red-brick building with arched upper windows and decorative brickwork. Many of its lower windows are covered with plywood, giving it a worn or vacant appearance. At street level, a black sign with Chinese characters and the word **“BEAUTY”** is partially visible.

On the right side of Zanzibar, there are more storefronts and signs. A large red-and-white leasing sign reads **“Cushman & Wakefield”** and “Retail for Lease,” with a phone number. Next to it is a storefront for **Cash Money**, advertising a “LINE OF CREDIT” up to **$10,000**, with yellow and purple signage for cheque cashing and payday advances. Farther right is an **Ali Baba’s** food sign, featuring a large image of a wrap or shawarma on a black background. There are also colorful vertical signs for nearby businesses, including a purple sign with a dancer silhouette.

Behind and above these older storefronts, a tall modern glass building dominates the right side of the image. Its façade is covered in a repeating geometric pattern of white and gray shapes over blue-tinted glass, creating a sharp contrast with the older brick and neon-style signage below. Another taller building is partly visible in the background behind the Zanzibar building, with only the letters **“RY”** visible near the top.

The foreground shows a broad, mostly empty street with asphalt lanes and a curb. The sidewalk is also fairly empty, though a couple of pedestrians are visible near the right side. Street poles, signs, and a few small barriers or bike racks line the sidewalk. The lighting suggests daytime, with strong brightness in the sky and some shadows on the buildings. Overall, the image captures a dense, eclectic city block mixing older entertainment venues, restaurants, retail storefronts, and newer glass high-rise architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的摄影图像，画面中心为一座装饰有星星和彩旗的黄色建筑，上方挂有'BUFFET PALACE'的招牌。左侧是一家名为'Sports Centre'的商店，其招牌上写着'FACIAL HAIR REMOVAL'等广告语。右侧是一家名为'Zanzibar'的酒吧，其招牌上有'JAMAICA'字样。建筑物之间，街道上有行人正在行走，而天空呈现出晴朗的状态。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, upward-looking view of a small bronze fountain statue mounted on an ornate stone wall. The statue appears to be a child figure standing on a dark pedestal, with its face blurred. It is dressed in a bright outfit: a vivid blue long-sleeved top, light blue shorts or trousers, and a red scarf tied around the neck. The figure has dark curly hair and is posed in the characteristic fountain stance, with a thin stream of water arcing outward from the front of the body.

The background is a grey stone architectural setting with elaborate carved decoration. Above and below the statue are large curved, scroll-like ornamental stone elements with layered molding and floral or shell-like relief patterns. The stone surface has a weathered texture, with visible vertical striations, chips, stains, and darkened areas from age and water exposure.

Strong sunlight illuminates the scene, creating sharp shadows behind the statue and emphasizing the rough grain of the stone carvings. The contrast between the muted grey stone and the statue’s bright blue-and-red clothing makes the dressed figure stand out prominently. The composition is tightly framed, focusing on the statue and the surrounding decorative fountain niche.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在建筑墙面上的雕塑特写照片。雕塑呈现一个穿着蓝色上衣和红色领带的小孩形象，小孩站立着，双手交叉放在胸前，头部略微倾斜，表情平静。雕塑下方是一个复杂的装饰性图案，中间有一个圆形开口，周围有波浪形的装饰线条。背景是墙面的一部分，上面有磨损的痕迹和一些细小的裂纹。

caption:
The image shows a storefront or display window photographed from outside, with strong reflections on the glass.

In the foreground, a bright yellow cardboard cutout of Pikachu is propped up on a large red cushioned seat or sofa. Pikachu is shown in a cheerful pose with wide black eyes, rosy cheeks, long pointed ears, an open smiling mouth, and its lightning-bolt-shaped tail extending to the left. The cutout has a white border around it, making it stand out against the red background.

Behind the Pikachu cutout, the upper part of a person or mannequin is visible, but the face is heavily blurred. Only some hair and shoulders/neck area can be faintly seen. The figure appears to be positioned behind or above the red couch, partially obscured by the Pikachu cutout.

The glass window creates layered reflections: on the left side, cars parked or passing on a street are visible, including a light-colored sedan and a white van. There are also reflections of buildings, street lights, and dark urban shapes. Snow or slush appears along the curb and sidewalk outside, suggesting cold weather. On the right side, the reflection includes a blue-tinted area with dotted texture and some indistinct shapes, possibly signage or interior lighting.

The overall color palette is dominated by the saturated red of the couch and the bright yellow of Pikachu, contrasted with cool blue-gray reflections from the street outside. The image feels like a playful shop or pop-culture display viewed through a reflective city window.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在商店橱窗中的3D卡通风格的皮卡丘模型的照片。皮卡丘模型位于画面中央，其特征性的黄色身体和大耳朵清晰可见，表情活泼可爱。背景中模糊地显示了城市街道的一部分，包括建筑物、行人和车辆，但这些元素并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a bright, lush formal garden with a long rectangular reflecting pool running from the foreground toward the center background. The pool’s water is greenish and sunlit, with ripples spreading across the surface. Several small fountain jets rise at intervals along the length of the pool, each bubbling upward from dark fountain heads and creating circular disturbances in the water.

On both sides of the pool are paved walkways made of light-colored brick or stone in a patterned layout. Low, neatly trimmed hedges border the paths and garden beds, giving the space a structured, symmetrical feel. The landscaping is dense and varied, with large leafy shrubs, palms, conifers, and tall trees. Some trees have fresh green foliage, while others have warm autumn tones—orange, rust, and brown—suggesting a seasonal transition. Sunlight filters through the trees, casting soft shadows across the paths and water.

In the background, partially framed by the trees, is an ornate building or wall decorated with blue and turquoise tilework. It features arched panels and intricate geometric or floral designs, resembling traditional Persian or Islamic architecture. A pale roof and chimney-like structure are visible behind it. The tiled facade forms a decorative focal point at the end of the garden axis.

There are several people scattered through the scene. A few visitors walk along the paths near the far end of the pool, while others stand or stroll in small groups. On the right foreground, two women are seated on a green-painted bench with ornate metal arms. One wears a bright yellow headscarf and light-colored clothing, and the other wears a black head covering and dark clothing. They appear to be talking or resting; one is holding a bottle or small object. Their faces are blurred. On the left side near the pool edge, two birds—possibly ducks or pigeons—stand close to the water.

The overall atmosphere is peaceful and leisurely, like a historic garden or palace courtyard. The wide-angle perspective emphasizes the long pool, the symmetrical landscaping, and the contrast between the vivid greenery, autumn-colored trees, and the richly decorated tiled architecture in the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示伊朗传统园林景观的照片。在画面的前景，一位穿着黄色头巾和黑色服装的女性坐在绿色长椅上，旁边是一位穿着深色服装、戴着黑色头巾的女性。她们似乎正在享受周围的环境，可能是在交谈或休息。中景是一个充满活力的喷泉区域，水池中的水呈现出鲜艳的绿色，周围有几只鸭子在水中游动。背景中可以看到修剪整齐的草坪和一些树木，以及远处模糊可见的建筑轮廓。阳光透过树叶洒下，为整个场景增添了一抹温暖的色调。

caption:
The image shows a large, multi-story red-brick institutional building set on a green, landscaped campus. The building is viewed from a low angle at a front corner, so two sides are visible: the main façade on the left and a longer side extending back to the right.

The structure has a traditional academic or civic architectural style, with deep red brick walls, light stone or concrete trim, and tall rectangular windows arranged in regular vertical rows. Many of the windows are large and divided into multiple panes by white or light-colored muntins, giving them a classic grid pattern. A broad horizontal band of pale stone runs across the building between the lower and upper floors, adding contrast to the brick. Near the center of this band is a black sign with white lettering that reads “TYSON BUILDING.”

The upper portion of the building includes a modern-looking rooftop addition or mechanical penthouse, finished in light gray panels. This section rises above the brick roofline and has a simpler, boxier appearance than the older brick façade below.

The foreground is filled with well-maintained landscaping: a wide green lawn, dense shrubs, small ornamental trees, and darker evergreen bushes clustered around the base of the building. A concrete sidewalk curves along the bottom left edge of the image. Large leafy trees frame the scene on both sides, especially a prominent tree with bright green foliage on the right that partially overlaps the building.

The sky is pale blue with soft, light clouds, and the overall lighting suggests a bright but slightly overcast day. The scene feels quiet and campus-like, with no people or vehicles visible.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座红砖建筑的照片，建筑位于一片绿色草坪上，周围环绕着各种树木。建筑的正面有多个大型窗户和一个带有黑色标志的白色门廊。建筑的屋顶是平滑的，顶部有一个白色的烟囱。在建筑前方，可以看到一条小径通向建筑入口。

caption:
The image shows a crowded livestock pen inside a barn or market-like enclosure. Several cattle are packed closely together behind red-brown metal railings.

In the foreground on the right is a large light-colored cow or bull, likely white or pale gray, standing very close to the camera. Its head dominates the right side of the image, with one dark eye visible, a large floppy ear extending outward, and a broad pale muzzle partly cut off by the edge of the frame. It has prominent upward-curving horns that are dark and weathered toward the tips. Its coat is dusty and slightly marked with dirt, especially along the neck and body. The animal’s loose skin and folds around the neck are clearly visible.

To the left and lower foreground are brown cattle, partially cropped by the frame. One brown cow’s back and side fill much of the lower-left area, while another brown animal stands behind it, showing a hind leg, belly, and udder. The animals appear tightly confined, with little space between them.

In the middle and background, more cattle are visible, including pale cream or white animals lying or standing behind the railings. Their horns and backs can be seen through the bars. The pen floor appears dirty and muddy, covered with straw, manure, and damp patches typical of a livestock holding area.

The setting includes red-painted metal fencing and posts, some worn and chipped. On the left side, there are stacked hay bales behind the railings, along with farm or market equipment. In the upper background, a silver van is parked inside or just beyond the covered structure. Farther back, through the open or bright entrance area, cars are visible, including a blue vehicle facing forward.

The lighting is mixed: natural daylight streams in from the open background, creating bright highlights and glare, while the interior pen area is more shaded. The photo has a slightly wide, panoramic feel, and the close-up perspective makes the nearest white cow appear large and imposing compared with the background animals. overall, it depicts a busy cattle holding area, likely at a farm, livestock market, or transport facility.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示牛群在室内环境中的摄影照片。前景中，一头白色带有棕色斑点的牛直视着镜头，它的角弯曲且向上，表情似乎好奇而警觉。背景中，其他几头牛散布在不同的区域，有的低头吃草，有的休息，整个场景给人一种农场生活的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, shallow-depth-of-field shot of an old bicycle handlebar area outdoors.

In the foreground, the main subject is a round metal bicycle bell mounted on a handlebar. The bell is heavily weathered: its surface is brown with rust, oxidation, and pale speckled corrosion, giving it a rough, aged texture. At the center of the bell is a small circular badge or cap with decorative markings and a brand-like emblem; the lettering appears to read something like “SHYH” or similar, though it is partly worn and difficult to make out. Around the badge is a ridged circular border.

To the right of the bell, part of the bicycle’s handlebar is visible. The chrome or metal surface is dull and tarnished, with patches of rust and grime. A dark brake lever curves downward from the handlebar, also showing signs of age and wear. A clamp or grip component near the right edge has faint raised markings.

On the left side of the frame, a vertical wooden or bamboo post runs from top to bottom. It has a natural beige-brown color with darker knots and small marks. On the right side, another vertical tan plant stem or bamboo-like piece is visible, blurred and close to the lens.

The background is out of focus, showing an outdoor garden or yard setting. There is brown soil, dry leaves, bits of straw or plant debris, and green leafy plants growing near the ground. The upper background has a soft band of bright green vegetation, suggesting grass or low plants. The lighting appears natural daylight, with soft highlights on the metal bell and handlebar.

Overall, the image has a rustic, abandoned feel, emphasizing the old, corroded bicycle bell against a natural, earthy garden backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个金属物体特写的摄影图像，物体表面有锈迹和污渍，放置在自然环境中。

caption:
The image shows a group of school students walking together outdoors, likely on or near a school campus or street.

At the center and right side of the frame, several students are wearing matching uniforms in muted green-gray tones. Their uniforms include striped light-colored shirts, gray-green trousers, ties, and sleeveless sweater vests with yellow and green trim around the V-neck and hem. Some students also wear green blazers. Many are carrying black backpacks over both shoulders.

The group appears to be walking toward the camera in a loose formation. One student near the left-center wears a knitted beanie in gray-blue with green and yellow stripes, along with a white face mask. Another student in the front center wears a sweater vest and tie, walking slightly ahead of others. A student to the right wears a blazer and tie, with long dark hair, and appears to be looking to the side while walking. On the far right, another student in a sweater vest walks with hands near the pockets or straps of a backpack.

The students’ faces are intentionally blurred, making individual facial details indistinct. Their posture and movement suggest a casual walk, possibly between classes or after school.

In the foreground on the far left, a partially visible person in a dark jacket and green hood is walking away from the camera or across the frame. This figure is out of focus, adding depth to the image.

The background is softly blurred and includes a beige building wall, railings or fencing along an upper level, and a green structure or canopy on the right. The setting appears urban or institutional, with a paved ground surface and muted colors. The photo has a shallow depth of field, keeping the students relatively prominent while the background and foreground figures remain blurred.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展现一群学生在校园或类似场所行走的照片。学生们穿着统一的灰色校服，包括长袖衬衫、背心和裤子，并且有些人戴着帽子。他们的表情自然，步伐轻松。背景中可以看到建筑物的一部分和一些模糊的人物轮廓，但焦点集中在前景的学生群体上。

caption:
The image is a close-up, wide-format shot of a musician positioned behind a drum or percussion setup. The person’s face is intentionally blurred, but they appear to have short, light blond hair with wispy bangs and slightly tousled layers. They are wearing a black shirt and a headset microphone that curves from the right ear toward the mouth, suggesting they may be singing or speaking while playing.

The foreground is dominated by out-of-focus drum hardware and percussion instruments. Several metallic rims, lugs, clamps, and chrome mounting bars are visible, reflecting light. The drums appear to have a decorative, colorful finish with warm gold tones and red, orange, and purple swirling patterns near the lower edge of the frame. A small red component or clamp is visible near the right side of the central drum hardware.

The composition places the musician in the upper center-right of the frame, partially obscured by the drum kit in front. The background is very dark, almost black, with soft blur, making the lighter hair and shiny drum hardware stand out. The shallow depth of field gives the image a concert or stage-performance feel, emphasizing the atmosphere more than sharp detail. Overall, it looks like a live performance moment focused on a drummer or percussionist using a headset microphone.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张使用浅景深摄影技巧拍摄的鼓手特写照片。图像中心聚焦于一位模糊的鼓手，他穿着黑色上衣，金色耳环，头发呈金黄色。鼓手位于画面前景，而背景则被故意虚化以突出主体。鼓手面前的鼓组部分是清晰可见的，包括有红色和蓝色条纹装饰的鼓面、一对银色的鼓槌以及一些鼓架上的金属部件。

caption:
