The image shows a wide, straight-on view of a brick wall covered with a large, colorful graffiti mural. The upper half of the wall is mostly exposed red brick with light mortar lines, while the lower half is densely painted with layered street-art lettering and abstract shapes.

The graffiti is highly dynamic and angular, with thick black outlines and sweeping white borders that create a sense of motion across the wall. The main colors are bright turquoise, teal, cyan, gray, white, deep navy, magenta, lime green, and touches of orange/yellow. Many of the shapes resemble stylized letters, but they are heavily abstracted and interlocked, making the words difficult to read. There are sharp arrows, curved strokes, blocky segments, drips, dots, and overlapping panels throughout.

On the left side, a vertical corner of the building interrupts the mural, with graffiti wrapping around it. A dark metal pipe runs down near the far left edge. The graffiti there includes large turquoise and navy forms with white and lime green highlights. In the center, the mural becomes more layered: gray and cyan backgrounds sit behind white-edged shapes, with black sweeping curves and drips. There are small blue dots and a large rounded blue form near the upper middle-right.

On the right side, the design includes a large dark navy and gray angular shape outlined in white and black, cutting across teal and gray backgrounds. A small white graffiti tag appears near the upper-right area on a magenta patch. Near the bottom-right corner, the artist signature or tag reads “SYD 2015” in white paint on a magenta background. There is also a small circular wall vent or drain cover near the lower-right portion of the wall.

The bottom of the image shows a concrete sidewalk with cracks, dirt, and scattered paint marks. Bright sunlight casts strong shadows and highlights the texture of the brick and the glossy spray paint. The overall mood is urban, energetic, and expressive, with the mural adding vivid color and movement to an otherwise plain brick exterior.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一面展示街头艺术风格涂鸦的砖墙。涂鸦由多种颜色和形状组成，包括蓝色、绿色、白色和黑色等，创造出一种充满活力且具有视觉冲击力的效果。在涂鸦的右下角，可以看到一个红色的“eYdONtS”字样，可能是艺术家的名字或作品的标题。

caption:
The image shows a close-up scene of a small crowd gathered outdoors around a telescope or optical viewing device, likely during a solar eclipse observation.

In the foreground, a person’s outstretched hand is held palm-up in front of the telescope. On the palm is a bright, sharply visible crescent-shaped patch of sunlight, suggesting the image of a partially eclipsed sun being projected onto the hand. The crescent is glowing white with a warm halo, standing out strongly against the skin. The person’s fingers are extended together, and the hand is positioned horizontally, as if being used as a projection screen.

At the lower left and center of the image is the front portion of a telescope or similar optical instrument. It has a large black circular opening, with visible internal supports and reflective components inside. A cylindrical eyepiece or focusing attachment extends from the side near the hand. The telescope appears to be angled toward the light source, probably the sun, while the projected crescent lands on the palm.

Behind the hand and telescope is a group of people standing closely together. Their faces are blurred or out of focus, but they appear to be observing the demonstration. Several people are wearing casual clothing: a bright pink jacket on the left, a checkered shirt in the center, and scarves or head coverings on some individuals. One person in the middle has a light gray garment draped around their shoulders or head. Another person on the right wears a patterned scarf with dark, white, and yellow details.

The lighting is bright and direct, with strong sunlight illuminating the hand and parts of the crowd. The background is softly blurred, emphasizing the hand, the crescent of light, and the telescope. The overall scene conveys a public science or astronomy demonstration, with people gathered to safely view or observe a partial solar eclipse through projection rather than looking directly at the sun.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张记录天文观测活动的照片，焦点落在一位手持望远镜的人的手上。他的手部被太阳光照射，形成了一个明亮的光圈，突出了观察者对科学的兴趣和参与。背景中模糊地可见其他参与者，他们似乎在等待或观看这个过程。

caption:
The image shows a group fitness class taking place in a bright, spacious exercise studio. Several participants are standing in staggered rows, each holding small, bright green weight plates or hand weights. They appear to be performing a synchronized strength or aerobics movement, with one arm raised or bent upward and the other lowered, while leaning slightly to the side.

The studio has a light wood floor and a high ceiling with rectangular fluorescent light panels. Large windows line the left side of the room, letting in natural daylight and revealing the exterior of nearby buildings. Along the left wall, there are racks holding large exercise balls in various colors, including green, blue, orange, and yellow.

In the foreground, multiple gray-and-black aerobic step platforms are placed on the floor, suggesting the class may involve step aerobics combined with weight training. Some black exercise bars or poles are lying on the floor near the steps.

The participants are dressed in workout clothing: tank tops, T-shirts, leggings, track pants, shorts, and athletic shoes. The closest person on the left wears a coral-pink tank top and dark pants, holding a green weight in each hand. Near the center, another participant in a white tank top and black leggings mirrors the same movement. On the right, a participant in a black top and purple shorts leans sideways while holding the green weights.

The back wall includes a large mirror, reflecting more of the class and the equipment behind them. Orange structural columns add color to the otherwise neutral room. The overall scene conveys an energetic group exercise session in a modern gym or fitness studio.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群人在健身房进行有氧运动的照片。照片中，参与者们穿着各式运动装备，正站在踏板上，手持绿色的哑铃，进行有节奏的上举动作。他们位于一个宽敞明亮的健身室内，背景中有悬挂的彩色球和墙上的镜子，反射出室内的景象。整个场景充满了活力与健康的生活方式氛围。

caption:
The image shows a black cylindrical trash bin or container lying on its side on a grassy lawn. The bin is positioned diagonally, with its rounded body extending toward the upper right of the image and its open mouth facing the viewer. Its hinged lid is flipped downward onto the grass, acting like a small tray.

Scattered across the open lid and nearby grass are various items: many euro coins in copper and gold tones, a visible €50 banknote, and what appears to be another small euro note partially underneath. A clear wine glass lies tipped over on the lid and grass, with its stem angled outward. In front of the bin, two translucent green plastic bottles are lying on the grass; one is closer to the bin and the other stretches toward the bottom left foreground. The bottles look empty or partially crushed.

The surrounding area is a lush green lawn with uneven grass, clover-like leaves, small yellow flowers, and patches of sunlight and shadow. The scene gives the impression that the bin has been knocked over and its contents—money, bottles, and a glass—have spilled out onto the grass. The black bin contrasts strongly with the bright green lawn and the colorful euro currency.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示垃圾和回收物品的现实主义风格照片。在绿色草地上，一个黑色的垃圾桶打开着，里面装满了各种硬币和纸币。旁边散落着一个空塑料瓶、几个塑料包装袋以及一些其他小物件。这些物品可能表明了当前的垃圾分类或回收活动。

caption:
The image shows a wide-angle view from pitch level inside a large football stadium, likely Wembley Stadium. The scene is mostly empty, with vast tiers of bright red seats curving around the field in a sweeping bowl shape.

In the foreground is the edge of the green football pitch, with neatly cut grass and faint white field markings. Several small yellow training cones are spaced across the grass, suggesting pre-match preparation or warm-up setup. Near the bottom left, a small pitch-side microphone with a furry windscreen is mounted on a short stand, indicating broadcast or event coverage.

The stadium seating rises in multiple levels around the field. Most seats are red, with some white seating patterns visible in the lower central section. Around the perimeter of the pitch and along the stands are advertising boards and digital banners. Some readable text includes “NON-LEAGUE FINALS DAY 2022,” and on the large central screen in the far stand it says “THE BUILDBASE FA VASE FINAL 2022.” There are also green safety-message banners around the seating area.

The roof dominates the upper half of the image. It is a complex structure of steel trusses, beams, and translucent panels, with sections of the roof extending inward over the stands. The left side appears darker and more shaded, while the right side is brightly lit by sunlight filtering through the roof panels. A large opening in the roof reveals a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds.

The lighting is dramatic: part of the stadium and pitch is in shadow, while the far-right seating and roof area are washed in strong sunlight. A few small figures can be seen around the pitch and lower seating areas, but the stadium is largely empty, giving it a quiet, anticipatory atmosphere before an event.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示足球场内部的照片，从球场的视角看去，可以看到场地中央的绿色草坪和两侧整齐排列的红色座椅。体育场的屋顶结构复杂，由多个交错的金属梁构成，顶部覆盖着透明的屋顶材料。整个场景在自然光的照射下显得明亮且清晰。

caption:
The image shows a tall, historic white building photographed from a low angle, making the structure appear imposing against a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. The architecture is ornate and classical, with decorative columns, carved capitals, arched windows, cornices, and curved façade elements.

At the top is a multi-sided clock tower with a round clock face set into the wall. Above it is an open belfry-like section with arched openings and a black wrought-iron balcony railing encircling the tower. The upper edges are embellished with detailed molding and small decorative domes or finials. Some areas of the white exterior show weathering, dark staining, and age marks, especially along ledges and cornices.

The middle and lower portions of the façade feature large arched windows with dark wooden frames. On the front of the building, bold black lettering reads “PALACIO CONSISTORIAL” and below it “MUSEO DE LA VILLA DE SANTO DOMINGO,” indicating it is a municipal palace and museum in Santo Domingo.

Two flagpoles stand in front of the building. One flag appears to be the Dominican Republic flag, with red, white, and blue sections, while another white flag bears an emblem or logo. Near the bottom edge, there is greenery and a decorative railing or balcony area. Bright sunlight enters from the upper right, creating lens flare and a slightly washed-out glow in parts of the image. The overall impression is of a colonial-era civic landmark, elegant but visibly aged, set in a sunny urban environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多米尼加共和国圣多明各宪法宫（PALACIO CONSTITUCIONAL）的照片。建筑的塔楼部分在阳光照射下显得格外引人注目，其上有一个显眼的时钟和一个带有文字的横幅。塔楼顶部装饰着铁艺栏杆，而下方则悬挂着多米尼加共和国国旗。天空中飘浮着几朵白云，为这座历史建筑增添了一抹自然美。

caption:
The image shows an urban electric-vehicle charging area on a sidewalk beside a city street. In the foreground, a large black-and-white ChargePoint fast-charging station dominates the left side of the frame. Its front panel is branded with “evergy” and the words “clean charge network,” along with a large green plug graphic and vertical text reading “fast charger.” The top of the unit says “chargepoint” in red and gray lettering. Several thick black charging cables hang from the unit and loop down toward the pavement.

Parked next to the charger is a bright blue compact electric hatchback/crossover, positioned side-on, with its front end facing right. It is in a marked curbside charging space. Behind it, a white Toyota Tacoma pickup truck is also parked near the charging area. On the far right, another slimmer EV charging pedestal stands under a dark overhead structure, and a charging cable stretches from it toward the white truck area.

A tall perforated metal signpost stands near the center-right foreground, partially blocking the view of the vehicles. The sidewalk is made of pale concrete slabs, with a mulched planting bed in the lower right corner and a few scattered leaves on the ground.

Across the street in the background are older commercial buildings with brick facades, arched windows, awnings, and signage. One building has a sign reading “Tucker’s” near the roofline. Farther back, a parking structure and a rooftop sign with the word “TOWER” are visible. The scene appears to be in a downtown or mixed-use district, likely photographed in early evening or overcast light, with soft shadows and muted sky brightness.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示充电站的现实主义风格照片，位于一个城市街道上。充电站前方有一辆蓝色电动汽车正在使用充电枪进行充电，旁边停着一辆白色皮卡车。充电站的设计简洁现代，以绿色和黑色为主色调，并带有'evergy fast charger'的标识。背景中可以看到其他车辆和建筑物，但它们模糊且不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a bright, wide-angle view of an ornate Venetian-style plaza, likely at The Venetian resort. The scene is dominated by elaborate pale pink, cream, and white architecture inspired by Venice.

On the left and center is a long façade resembling the Doge’s Palace, with a diamond-patterned wall in soft pink and white tones. The building has rows of arched windows, small circular windows, gothic quatrefoil openings, and decorative columns. Near the upper middle of the façade is an ornate sculptural section featuring statues and a winged lion relief, adding to the Renaissance/Venetian theme. Along the lower level, a long arcade of pointed arches and slender columns creates a covered walkway.

Behind and above this older-style façade rises a much taller modern hotel tower. It has salmon-pink stonework and many vertical rows of reflective blue glass windows. On the right side of the tower, the word “VENETIAN” appears vertically in large letters. The contrast between the historic-inspired palace architecture and the modern glass hotel tower is very noticeable.

The foreground is a broad, open paved plaza made of large gray stone tiles. Several teal-green decorative streetlamps with multiple lanterns stand throughout the square, matching the ornate European styling. On the right, a couple walks hand-in-hand down a shallow ramp or stepped walkway bordered by a white balustrade. The woman is wearing jeans, ankle boots, and a sleeveless patterned top, while the man is dressed in a black graphic T-shirt and jeans. A few other small figures are visible in the distance under the arches.

The lighting is very bright and slightly overexposed, giving the image a soft, airy feel. The sky is pale blue and mostly empty, and the overall atmosphere suggests a clean, spacious tourist destination with grand decorative architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一对情侣在威尼斯酒店前的广场上散步的照片。他们穿着休闲服装，男性身穿深色衬衫和牛仔裤，女性则穿着浅色连衣裙和白色上衣。他们正从左向右走过，面向相机方向。背景中，威尼斯酒店以其独特的建筑风格和装饰性细节著称，包括精细的窗户、拱门和柱子。酒店的外墙呈现粉红色调，并带有典型的意大利文艺复兴时期的建筑特征。照片的光线柔和，为场景增添了一种温暖而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a close-up side view of a large Singapore Airlines passenger aircraft on an airport taxiway or apron.

The white fuselage dominates the frame, with the large blue “SINGAPORE AIRLINES” title painted across the upper side in bold, italicized letters. Near the front of the aircraft, the cockpit windows are visible, tinted dark blue-green, set into the rounded nose section. Just behind the cockpit area is a forward passenger door, and nearby there is a small Star Alliance logo printed on the fuselage.

A row of small oval passenger windows runs along the side of the plane beneath the airline name. Below the windows is Singapore Airlines’ distinctive livery: a dark blue band with a thin yellow-gold stripe and a broader gold-toned section lower on the fuselage. Part of an engine nacelle is visible at the lower left, indicating the aircraft’s wing is just out of frame.

The landing gear is extended. The main landing gear, with multiple black tires, is visible under the fuselage toward the center-left, while the nose landing gear appears at the lower right. A white panel near the nose gear shows the letters “YG,” likely part of the aircraft’s registration or gear door marking.

In the background, airport infrastructure can be seen: concrete buildings, a covered elevated structure or jet bridge-like walkway, fencing, greenery, and paved service areas. The aircraft appears to be moving slowly or positioned on the ground, with painted taxiway lines curving beneath it. The overall image has a slightly cool, bluish tone and looks like it was taken from a distance with a zoom lens.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示新加坡航空公司飞机的摄影图片。飞机停靠在机场的滑行道上，机身主要为白色，带有蓝色和黄色条纹装饰，并清晰地印有'SINGAPORE AIRLINES'字样。机身上方可见部分机翼和发动机，而机尾则装有一个大型的红色标志。背景中可以看到机场的部分建筑结构，但它们模糊且不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows an open courtyard of a Chinese-style temple or shrine set within a dense urban environment.

In the foreground and along the left side, there is a covered walkway supported by large cylindrical columns. The columns are reddish-brown with gold bases and capitals, and the beams above them are painted in bright pink, red, green, blue, and gold. The underside of the roof and beam panels contain decorative paintings, including birds and landscape-like scenes, as well as vertical red plaques with gold Chinese characters.

Across the center of the image is the main temple building. It has a traditional green-tiled roof with curved ridgelines and ornate ceramic decorations. The roofline is covered with colorful sculptural details, including dragons and other mythical figures. The façade below is decorated with red-framed doorways and vertical signboards bearing Chinese writing. Several columns near the entrance are wrapped or painted with vivid dragon motifs in gold, green, blue, and red, giving the building a richly ornamented appearance.

The courtyard itself is mostly empty and paved with concrete, with some tiled flooring along the covered walkway. There are a few scattered objects: a small metal frame or stand near the center, a tipped-over rectangular container or cabinet in the foreground, a red cart or bin near the left columns, and a yellow trash bin on the right side. The space looks quiet and somewhat utilitarian despite the ornate architecture.

In the background, the temple is surrounded by modern city infrastructure. A large elevated roadway or rail structure cuts across the upper right side of the image, partially blocking the view. Behind it rises a tall modern high-rise building with a distinctive repeating balcony pattern. Another building in the background has a large advertisement showing a smartphone, likely an iPhone. The bright sky behind the buildings creates a strong contrast with the shaded temple courtyard.

Overall, the image captures a striking contrast between traditional Chinese temple architecture—colorful, ornate, and symbolic—and the modern urban landscape of high-rises, advertising, and elevated transport infrastructure surrounding it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国风格建筑内部的照片，建筑的屋顶装饰着鲜艳的彩带和金色的装饰物。柱子上绘有传统的图案，而天花板则绘有色彩丰富的壁画。在照片的背景中，可以看到现代摩天大楼与传统建筑形成鲜明对比，突显了古老文化与现代都市生活的融合。

caption:
The image shows a grocery store shelf stocked with containers of **Clabber Girl double acting baking powder**. The products are arranged in rows on a beige metal shelf, with several smaller cylindrical cans in the foreground and background, plus a large white plastic tub on the right.

The branding is prominent: the words **“CLABBER GIRL”** appear in large red letters with a dark outline on the white containers. Beneath the logo is a small vintage-style black-and-white illustration framed in turquoise. The smaller cans read **“DOUBLE ACTING BAKING POWDER”** and list a net weight of **8.1 oz (230 g)**. The large container on the right is labeled **5 lb (2.27 kg)** and also notes that it is a **gluten free product** with **0g trans fat**.

There are yellow and white shelf price labels below the products. One visible price tag near the smaller cans shows **$2.79**, while a hanging sign near the top left shows a larger price, **$10.99**, likely for the bulk container. The image is taken at a close angle, with a shallow depth of field: the large tub on the right and some front cans are relatively sharp, while the background containers and shelf signage are slightly blurred. The lighting is bright and warm, typical of an indoor supermarket aisle.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Clabber Girl品牌双作用烘焙粉的货架照片。在图像中，多个白色塑料桶装着这种产品，每个桶上都有一个红色和黑色的品牌标签，上面印有产品的名称、重量（8.1磅）以及'GLUTEN-FREE'字样，表明这是一种无麸质的烘焙粉。这些产品被整齐地排列在超市的货架上，价格标签显示它们的价格为每磅2.99美元。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit seaside pier or promenade with a slightly vintage, film-like look. The scene is framed by white-painted wooden structures and ornate metalwork, giving it a classic British pier atmosphere.

On the left is a small kiosk or shop selling donuts. Its signage reads “American” and “Mini DONUTS,” with large bold lettering for “DONUTS.” On the shop window, blue lettering says “HOT FRESH DONUTS” and underneath, “watch them being made!” Inside the window display are rows of colorful drink cans lined up along the bottom. The kiosk is painted cream or white, with horizontal wooden paneling below the window.

Across the top of the image runs a decorative white railing or roof trim made of looping, scroll-like metal patterns with fleur-de-lis-style ornaments at intervals. Beneath it is a covered walkway with a glossy white ceiling, dark support brackets, and white columns with black bases.

In the center foreground, a white wooden bench with dark metal armrests sits on the wooden deck. The pier floor is made of long brown planks, with visible gaps and shadows emphasizing the texture.

Behind the bench is a white wall or partition with two arched window openings. Through and reflected in these windows, several people are visible as dark silhouettes or partial reflections. One person in a hat stands near the left window, while a small group appears gathered near the right window. Their reflections overlap with the bright outdoor scene, creating a layered effect.

Through the openings and gaps beyond the structure, the background reveals a beach and seafront town. There are pale buildings along the shoreline, a sandy beach with small figures, and a blue sea or coastal horizon to the right. A blue railing with white decorative patterns runs along the edge of the pier.

The lighting is strong and directional, casting deep shadows under the roof and bright highlights on the white-painted surfaces. The overall mood is calm and nostalgic, suggesting a sunny day at a seaside amusement pier or boardwalk.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海边码头上一家甜甜圈店的摄影照片。店铺前有一个白色的长椅，上面没有人坐。店铺的橱窗上方有'American Donuts'的标志，橱窗内展示了各种甜甜圈和价格信息。商店内部可以看到几位顾客正在点餐或等待服务。背景中，可以看到码头上的栏杆和远处的建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image is a close-up, macro-style photograph of a piece of tree bark or weathered wood. The camera is positioned very low and close to the surface, emphasizing the layered, flaky texture of the bark.

The central area shows thin, peeling sheets of bark stacked in irregular horizontal layers. These layers are rough, brittle-looking, and slightly curled at the edges, with cracks and gaps running between them. The surface has a mix of muted gray, pale beige, brown, and reddish-brown tones, with small hints of greenish lichen or moss in some crevices. The bark appears dry and aged, with a dusty, fibrous quality.

The sharpest focus is along the middle foreground, where the ridges and raised flakes of bark are most visible. Toward the top and bottom of the image, the scene becomes increasingly blurred due to a very shallow depth of field. This creates a soft, abstract background and draws attention to the tactile details of the bark’s surface.

The lighting is soft and natural, without harsh shadows. It gently highlights the raised edges of the bark, making the layered structure stand out. The background is mostly out of focus and dark gray-brown, giving the image a quiet, earthy mood. Overall, the photo feels intimate and textural, focusing on the natural patterns, decay, and rugged beauty of wood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张微距摄影风格的图片，特写展示了一块粗糙的木头表面。木头的纹理清晰可见，颜色为深棕色和浅灰色相间，显示出自然的木质特征。背景模糊，使得观众的注意力集中在木头的细节上。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of an old Brazilian postage stamp against a solid black background. The stamp is rectangular and vertically oriented, with rough, perforated edges on all sides. The paper is off-white and visibly aged, with discoloration, smudges, and small stains around the margins.

The printed design is in a faded reddish-orange or rust color. Near the top, large bold text reads **“BRASIL”**, and directly underneath it is **“CORREIO”**, indicating Brazilian mail/postage. The letters are blocky and somewhat worn, with areas where the ink has faded or been rubbed away.

A thin rectangular border frames the main design, with another inner border around the artwork. The central illustration is detailed but heavily worn and partially obscured by age and printing degradation. It appears to depict a stylized scene with an allegorical or classical figure on the left and landscape-like or architectural elements across the middle and lower portions. Fine engraved lines create shading and texture throughout the image.

At the bottom is a denomination panel containing **“Cr$ 0,20”**, indicating a value of 20 centavos/cruzeiros. The denomination is printed in large, bold numerals and letters, though the ink is uneven and faded in places.

The stamp looks used or heavily handled: there are dark cancellation-like marks, smudges, and worn patches across the surface. The perforations are irregular, with some torn or frayed sections, especially along the top and side edges. Overall, it has the appearance of a vintage, circulated Brazilian postage stamp printed in orange-red ink on aged paper.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张巴西邮票，展示了橙红色调的图案和文字。邮票中央是棕榈树和建筑物的插图，上方印有'BRASIL CORREIO'字样，下方标注了面值为'0,20'。邮票边缘略显磨损，显示出使用过的痕迹。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime cityscape centered on a large steel truss bridge stretching diagonally across a wide river. The bridge enters from the lower left and rises toward the upper right, creating a strong sense of depth and perspective. Its underside is a dense lattice of dark metal beams, cross-bracing, and repeating triangular supports, all highlighted by pinkish-white illumination.

Along the top of the bridge, a row of warm amber streetlights runs into the distance. Each lamp produces a starburst glow against the deep blue evening sky. Small red banners or flags hang from poles along the bridge, adding bright accents among the lights. The bridge deck itself is lined with continuous white lighting, making its edge appear like a glowing ribbon.

Beneath the bridge are massive rectangular stone or concrete piers rising from the river, supporting the structure at regular intervals. The water below is smooth and slightly blurred, likely from a long exposure, reflecting muted bands of pink, orange, purple, and gold from the bridge and city lights.

In the background to the left of center, a tall communications or observation tower glows in vivid magenta. It has a slender spire and stacked circular observation decks near the middle, standing out sharply against the dark sky. Farther to the right, modern high-rise buildings with neon outlines and pink lighting form part of the skyline.

The overall color palette is striking: deep navy-blue sky, magenta and pink architectural lighting, warm yellow streetlamps, and soft multicolored reflections on the river. The scene feels urban, vibrant, and carefully lit, with the bridge dominating the composition and the illuminated tower serving as a prominent landmark in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市夜景的摄影作品，画面中心是一座巨大的桥梁，其结构由金属梁和桥墩组成，上面布满了灯光。桥梁上方是城市的天际线，其中一座塔楼在夜空中特别显眼，它的顶部发出粉红色的光芒。水面平静地反射着桥梁和天空中的光线，而远处的城市灯光点缀了整个场景，营造出一种宁静而又充满活力的夜晚氛围。

caption:
The image shows a flooded residential area, likely a rural or semi-rural street that has been submerged by high water. The water covers the roadway completely, turning it into a canal-like passage. Its surface is mostly calm, with gentle ripples and clear reflections of fences, utility poles, trees, and buildings.

On the left side, there is a long, weathered wooden fence running along the edge of the flooded street. Behind it stands a wooden house or outbuilding with vertical plank walls and a rust-colored metal roof. Tall trees with thick trunks rise above the structure, their branches and green leaves extending across the upper left portion of the scene. Several utility poles stand close to the waterline, with overhead wires stretching across the image.

In the middle foreground, a person sits in a small flat-bottomed boat, using an oar or pole to move through the floodwater. The boat is low in the water and positioned near the left side of the flooded lane. Farther to the right in the background, another person is also in a small boat, rowing through the submerged street near low houses, sheds, and fences.

The right side of the image shows more utility poles and wires receding into the distance, emphasizing the line of what would normally be a street. There are small homes, sheds, gates, and trees partially surrounded by water. The water level appears high enough to reach fences and yards, though the buildings themselves seem mostly above the surface.

The sky is overcast and pale gray, giving the scene a muted, quiet atmosphere. The overall mood is somber and still, with the boats suggesting that residents are navigating the neighborhood because normal roads are inaccessible due to flooding.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张显示洪水影响的现实主义风格照片。在画面中，一条街道被洪水淹没，水面平静地反射着周围的环境。左侧有一排木制房屋和一个带有窗户的车库门，而右侧则有几栋低矮的建筑。树木的倒影在水面上形成了斑驳的图案。一名男子坐在街道中央的一块平台上，似乎在观察周围的情况或等待救援。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque old European street, likely in a historic German town, with a narrow cobblestone road curving gently downhill between traditional buildings.

On the left side, a tall, weathered stone or stucco building dominates the frame. Its façade is reddish-brown and aged, with visible cracks, uneven texture, and stone-framed windows. The windows are tall and white-framed, some set deeply into the wall. Several wrought-iron sign brackets project from the building, including a decorative hanging sign that appears to advertise a museum. A black lantern-style light fixture hangs near an arched doorway, adding to the historic atmosphere.

The street itself is paved with gray cobblestones and bordered by slightly raised sidewalks. The road curves through the scene, leading the eye toward a cluster of half-timbered houses in the middle and background. These houses have white walls crossed with red or dark wooden beams, steep red-tiled roofs, and many rectangular windows. One prominent half-timbered building on the right has red beams, white infill panels, green trim, and a large orange-red tiled roof with dormer windows.

Near the center foreground, a bright red vintage convertible car is driving along the cobblestone street. It has a low, classic shape, round headlights, chrome details, and an open top, giving the scene a nostalgic feel. To the right of the car, two pedestrians—an older man and woman—walk along the sidewalk. The man wears a light pink shirt and dark trousers and appears to be using walking poles or a cane-like aid, while the woman wears a light top and dark skirt or pants and carries a red bag.

On the right side, there are café or shop fronts with green awnings, potted plants, and outdoor seating areas. A tourist information sign with a large yellow “i” is mounted near the sidewalk. The scene feels lively but relaxed, with a few small signs, shopfronts, and architectural details suggesting a historic town center.

In the background, beyond the lower rooftops, the street rises toward a hillside covered with trees and additional houses. The sky is bright blue with soft white clouds, and sunlight illuminates the buildings and street, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a charming, old-world townscape with medieval-style architecture, red tile roofs, cobblestones, and a classic car adding a striking focal point.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲小镇街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中心，一辆红色复古汽车停靠在鹅卵石铺就的街道上，周围是传统的半木结构房屋和一些现代建筑。街道两旁有行人正在行走，其中一位穿着浅色衣服的人正从左侧走向右侧。街道尽头可以看到树木覆盖的小山丘，而天空中飘着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows a group of rescue or emergency-response personnel working on an elevated metal scaffolding structure, likely during a training exercise or demonstration involving rope rescue.

In the center, several responders are clustered around a horizontal metal pipe wrapped in gray padding. Orange straps and ropes are looped over the pipe, and multiple carabiners, safety lines, and harness connections hang from it. The setup suggests a technical rescue system, possibly for lowering, lifting, or securing someone at height.

One responder on the left wears a bright orange rescue uniform with reflective yellow bands, gloves, a helmet, and a full-body safety harness. They appear to be reaching upward toward the rigging, adjusting or holding a rope or strap. Another responder in beige tactical-style clothing and an orange helmet leans forward, focused on equipment near the platform. On the right, a person in beige uniform and harness stands beside the rigging with one arm raised, also handling a rope or attachment point. Below them, another rescuer in orange gear and a yellow helmet marked with rescue-related text is crouched or seated, working with equipment near the floor of the platform.

The scaffolding is made of rust-colored metal pipes and platforms. Safety ropes, hooks, pulleys, and clipped gear are visible around the workers’ waists and hanging from the frame. Their posture and equipment indicate coordinated technical work in a controlled high-angle rescue environment.

Large printed banners or tarps hang on both sides of the frame, partially obscuring the scene. These banners show blurred, dark-toned photographic imagery, possibly related to disaster or rescue scenarios. At the top left, a blue flag is visible, while at the top right there is a red, white, and blue striped flag. The background includes a pale concrete or building surface, giving the impression that this is taking place outdoors in an urban or institutional setting.

Overall, the image captures a focused rescue team performing rope-rigging or height-rescue operations on a scaffold, surrounded by safety equipment and event-style banners.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示救援人员在紧急情况下的现场照片。图像中，几位穿着橙色和绿色工作服的救援人员正在操作一个大型的机械装置。他们似乎正在进行某种复杂的救援任务或维修工作。背景中可以看到一面飘扬的旗帜，但焦点主要集中在救援人员的动作上。

caption:
The image shows a bright, colorful spring garden in full bloom, likely a landscaped public flower park. The scene is wide and panoramic, filled with tulip beds, green lawns, trees, and decorative sculptures.

In the foreground, several ceramic or sculptural art pieces stand on the grass. They resemble stylized flowers or organic forms, with textured surfaces and colors such as blue, turquoise, beige, and earthy brown. Some are mounted on tall pedestal-like bases, while others have rounded, clustered tops. Around them are dense flower beds, including pink hyacinths, purple blooms, and rows of tulips with long green leaves.

The most striking feature is the abundance of tulips. On the right side and across the lower half of the image, there are large groups of pink and red tulips, many with soft white edges. Farther back, there are bright orange, yellow, red, white, and purple tulips arranged in sweeping bands and clusters. The flower beds curve through the garden, creating a layered, flowing composition.

A narrow waterway or pond runs along the lower left and right portions of the scene. On the right, a dark wooden walkway or bridge borders the water, partially shaded by nearby plants. The water reflects some of the greenery and flowers.

In the middle distance, several visitors are walking and standing along a garden path. They are dressed in jackets and coats, suggesting cool spring weather. One person in a bright red coat stands out near the center-right, while others wear darker or neutral clothing. A green trash bin and a simple bench are also visible near the path.

The background is filled with tall, slender trees, many of them still mostly bare or just beginning to leaf out, suggesting early spring. Some trees have fresh yellow-green foliage, while others have pale trunks and delicate branches reaching upward. Dense shrubs and bushes form a lush green backdrop beneath the trees.

The sky is blue with large white clouds, and strong sunlight illuminates the flowers and grass, making the colors vivid and saturated. Overall, the image has a cheerful, peaceful atmosphere, emphasizing the beauty of spring blossoms in a carefully maintained garden setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示郁金香花园的摄影图像，前景中有一排色彩鲜艳的郁金香，主要以红色和粉色为主。在这些郁金香之间，有几尊抽象风格的雕塑点缀其间。背景中，可以看到更多的游客正在享受这个美丽的花园环境。树木和草地为这个场景增添了自然美，而蓝天则衬托出春日的明媚氛围。

caption:
The image shows the rear view of a bright red classic convertible sports car, likely a Jaguar E-Type 4.2, displayed at an outdoor car show. The car dominates the foreground, parked on grass under strong sunlight. Its glossy red paint is highly reflective, and the rear deck has the chrome badging reading “E-TYPE,” “JAGUAR,” and “4.2.” A black folded soft top or tonneau cover runs across the back of the cockpit.

The car has a low, rounded rear shape with polished chrome bumpers and vertical chrome overriders. Below the bumper are rectangular rear lights and twin exhaust pipes centered underneath. A European-style license plate is mounted at the rear. The windshield is visible above the body, with a small central rearview mirror and a wooden steering wheel seen through the glass. The interior appears dark, with classic round dashboard gauges.

In the background, many people are walking around and looking at vehicles, suggesting a busy classic car exhibition or rally. Some are standing close to the car, holding phones or chatting. Their faces are blurred or not clearly visible. Other vintage cars are parked behind, including a large dark-colored classic car on the right and a red car further back. There is also a signboard advertising an event or display, though the text is only partly readable.

The scene is outdoors on a sunny day, with strong highlights, deep shadows, and a small lens flare glinting off the chrome bumper. A large decorative lamppost or column stands on the right side of the frame, adding to the public-square or promenade setting. Overall, the photo captures the rear of a beautifully restored red Jaguar at a lively classic car gathering.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆红色经典敞篷车的现实主义风格照片。车辆停放在户外，阳光下车身反射出光泽，车牌上清晰可见'UNSE 3H'。在车辆后方，可以看到几位观众正在观看和交谈，他们似乎对这辆古董车很感兴趣。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, tree-lined pedestrian walkway paved with reddish-brown rectangular bricks. The path stretches into the distance, creating a strong sense of depth and perspective as the brick lines converge toward the center background.

A man is walking away from the viewer near the middle of the path. He is wearing a teal T-shirt, gray shorts, and sandals, and he carries a dark backpack over one shoulder. In one hand he appears to be holding sunglasses or a small item. His posture is relaxed, and he seems to be looking slightly to his left as he walks.

The walkway is bordered by low curbs on both sides, with narrow strips of grass and large mature trees growing along the edges. The trees form a dense green canopy overhead, casting shade across the path. Their trunks are thick and textured, some with exposed roots at the base, and the foliage is lush, giving the scene a humid, tropical or subtropical feel.

On the right side, partially hidden by trees, there is a yellow building or wall, possibly part of a temple or historic complex. Hanging from the trees and structures are several yellow diamond-shaped lanterns or decorative signs with red writing and patterns. They appear in a row along the right side of the walkway, adding bright accents against the greenery.

On the left side, there are signs, a green trash bin, benches, flagpoles, and what looks like a stone wall or older structure running parallel to the path. The signs contain text and images, though the details are not fully readable from this distance. A few more pedestrians are visible farther down the path, small and partially obscured by the shade and foliage.

The overall atmosphere is peaceful and shaded, with a mix of natural greenery and cultural or historic architectural elements. The lighting is soft, filtered through the leaves, giving the scene a calm, warm, and slightly secluded feeling.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一个人在绿色树木环绕的公园小径上行走的照片。人物穿着蓝色短袖衬衫和深色裤子，背着一个黑色背包，正从画面左侧走向右侧。小径由红砖铺成，两旁种植着茂密的绿树，为这个场景增添了宁静与生机。在小径的一侧，可以看到几个黄色的交通标志牌，上面有警告或指示性的文字。

caption:
The image is a close-up outdoor photograph featuring a cluster of pale yellow frangipani/plumeria flowers in sharp focus on the right side of the frame. The blossoms have smooth, waxy petals that fade from creamy white at the edges to bright golden yellow near the centers, with some orange tones visible inside the flower throats. Several unopened green-yellow buds and thick stems are clustered around the flowers, giving the foreground a lush, tropical feel.

The background is deliberately blurred, creating a strong depth-of-field effect. Behind the flowers, there are ancient-looking stone temple structures with pointed, tiered spires and weathered gray surfaces. The architecture appears monumental and historic, possibly part of a temple complex. The main temple sits toward the lower left of the image, while smaller temple towers appear farther back across the middle and right side.

A wide expanse of clear blue sky fills most of the upper and left portions of the photograph, giving the scene a bright, calm atmosphere. Near the bottom, there is green grass, a few trees, and hints of colorful tarps or roofs in orange and blue. The sunlight is strong and warm, illuminating the flowers and making them stand out vividly against the soft, distant temple backdrop.

Overall, the image contrasts delicate natural beauty in the foreground with ancient stone architecture in the background, creating a serene and picturesque scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然与人造建筑和谐共存的摄影作品。图像前景中，一束黄色的鸡蛋花紧挨着镜头，花朵绽放得非常鲜艳和生动，而其背后则是一座古老的石质建筑群，建筑的风格古老且具有历史感。整个场景在晴朗的天空下显得格外宁静和美丽。

caption:
The image shows a large Korean Air passenger jet in flight, captured in profile against a pale gray, overcast sky. The aircraft is moving from left to right and appears to be on final approach for landing, with its landing gear fully extended and the main wheels hanging beneath the fuselage.

The plane has Korean Air’s distinctive light turquoise-blue upper fuselage, with a gray underside. Large blue “KOREAN AIR” lettering is visible along the forward half of the aircraft, near the nose. The airline’s red, white, and blue taegeuk-style logo appears prominently on the vertical tail fin, and a small South Korean flag is visible near the top of the tail. The registration marking “HL7714” can be seen on the rear fuselage/tail area, and the aircraft type marking indicates it is a Boeing 777-200.

The wings are swept back, and the nearer wing is partly shadowed, showing the flaps and landing configuration. A large white engine hangs under the wing, with its dark intake visible. The nose gear is extended near the front of the plane, and the multi-wheel main landing gear assemblies are clearly visible beneath the center/rear portion of the fuselage.

The aircraft dominates the frame, positioned slightly above the lower third of the image. At the very bottom, distant city buildings and rooftops are visible, giving a sense that the plane is approaching an airport near an urban area. The background is otherwise mostly empty sky, which makes the bright blue aircraft stand out clearly.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架涂有韩亚航空标志的商用喷气式飞机在飞行中的照片。飞机呈现淡蓝色和白色，机身上清晰地印有'KOREAN AIR'字样，并带有韩亚航空的标志性红色圆圈徽章。飞机的起落架已经放下，准备降落或刚刚着陆。背景中可以看到城市的轮廓，以及天空中散布的云朵。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor scene in bright daylight, likely in a grassy yard or open area beside a building. A uniformed man stands near two parked scooters/motorbikes while handling a working dog.

On the left side, the man is dressed in dark clothing: a black baseball cap, black short-sleeved shirt, dark cargo-style pants, and black boots. He appears to be wearing sunglasses and has equipment attached to his belt, including what looks like a radio or communication device and other utility pouches. His posture is slightly bent forward, and he is looking downward toward his hands or the dog. In one hand, held behind his back, he appears to be holding a green ball, possibly a reward or training toy.

At the man’s feet is a brown dog, likely a trained detection or working dog. The dog is wearing a harness and has its tongue out, suggesting it may be panting in the heat. It is positioned between the man and a white scooter, with its head lowered near the front wheel area as if sniffing or investigating.

To the right, a white scooter is parked facing slightly toward the camera. It has two rearview mirrors, a front headlight assembly, and a black wire basket mounted on the front. Inside the basket is a clear plastic water bottle. The front wheel and tire are clearly visible, and the scooter is standing on grass.

On the left side of the image, partially behind the man, there is a yellow motorbike or scooter with black and orange details. Only part of it is visible, including its seat, frame, and rear wheel.

The background consists of a low building or structure with a brown wall and a gray tiled roof. The roof tiles form a repeating curved pattern, and there are shadows under the roof overhang. The overall lighting is strong and sunny, creating bright highlights on the scooters and grass and deep shadows under the roof and around the man’s clothing. The scene gives the impression of a dog-assisted inspection or training activity involving parked motorcycles.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一名穿着制服的警察和一只警犬在户外进行训练或工作场景的照片。警察站在一辆停靠的摩托车上，旁边是他的警犬，两者似乎正在进行某种任务或训练。背景中有一栋有着传统瓦片屋顶的房子，周围环境看起来像是一个安静的住宅区。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of several large whisky bottles displayed on a retail store shelf, likely in a liquor or supermarket alcohol section. The bottles are arranged side by side and secured in metal anti-theft display frames.

From left to right:

- A large **Chivas Regal 12** blended Scotch whisky bottle is partially visible on the left. It contains amber-colored whisky and has the distinctive ornate Chivas Regal label with red, gold, and cream detailing.
- Next to it is a large **White Horse** blended Scotch whisky bottle. It has a bright yellow label with large red “WHITE HORSE” text and a small black-and-white horse logo near the top. The bottle appears to be a **4.5 liter** size, filled with golden-brown whisky, and held in a gold-colored metal security cradle.
- In the center is a large green glass **Jameson Irish Whiskey** bottle. Its cream-colored label reads “JAMESON” in large black letters and “Triple Distilled Irish Whiskey.” The label includes the Jameson crest and green accents near the bottom. This bottle is also marked as **4.5 litre** and is secured in a green metal frame with a white anti-theft pad or tag attached near the bottom front.
- On the right is a large **Johnnie Walker Red Label** bottle. It has the familiar slanted red label with white lettering and gold trim. The bottle is filled with amber whisky and held in a gold-colored metal security frame. The lower part of the label indicates it is a **3 liter** bottle and **40% vol**.

The background contains more liquor packaging and boxes, including green, red, and orange boxes stacked behind the bottles. Bright overhead store lights create strong reflections on the curved glass surfaces. At the bottom of the shelf, price tags are visible with prices in rubles, suggesting the store may be in a Russian-speaking region. The overall scene is tightly framed, emphasizing the large premium whisky bottles and their labels.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示不同品牌威士忌的摄影图像。前景中，有三个醒目的酒瓶：左侧是一个带有白色马标志的'WHITE HORSE'威士忌瓶子，中间是绿色标签上印有'JAMESON'字样的爱尔兰威士忌瓶子，右侧是红色标签上的'Red Label'威士忌瓶子。每个瓶子都放置在金属支架上，以便于顾客轻松查看和选择。背景模糊地显示了其他商品和货架，但焦点清晰地放在了这些威士忌瓶子上。

caption:
The image shows a dark green Soviet-era tank displayed as an outdoor monument in a snowy park or courtyard. The tank is mounted on a large, sloped, reddish-brown polished stone pedestal, with a metal commemorative plaque on the front. The plaque appears to be in Russian and identifies the vehicle as a legendary T-34/76 tank.

The tank is viewed from a low front-left angle, making it look imposing. Its long cannon barrel points upward and to the right, extending diagonally across the upper part of the image. The turret is rounded and compact, with a red star painted on the side. Snow is scattered across the top of the hull, especially on the front armor plate. The tracks, road wheels, and front fenders are clearly visible, with the left track running along the side and the right front track curving down at the front.

The setting is wintery: snow covers the ground and parts of the monument. Behind the tank is a grove of tall, leafless birch trees with white bark and black markings, creating a dense vertical pattern in the background. Some evergreen trees are also visible. Beyond the trees are modern light-colored buildings with windows and green roof sections, suggesting the monument is located in an urban or institutional area.

The lighting is bright and crisp, likely daylight on a cold winter day. Sunlight reflects off the snow and the polished stone base, while the tank’s dark metal surface contrasts strongly with the pale birch trunks and white snow. The overall scene feels like a military memorial or historical display honoring wartime service.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的军事历史纪念物的照片。照片中心是一个绿色的军用坦克模型，它被安置在一个红色花岗岩基座上，并且前方有一个金属铭牌。坦克周围是积雪覆盖的地面上和一些树木，背景中可以看到一些建筑物。阳光照射下，坦克模型和周围的环境清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a bus terminal or parking area in Thailand on a bright day. The main focus is a large, pale silver-green coach bus positioned in the foreground, angled slightly toward the right. It has a modern rounded front with a wide tinted windshield, large side mirrors, and chrome wheel rims. The windshield and side windows are dark, reflecting the surroundings. Text on the bus is written in both Thai and English, including destinations such as **Chiang Mai**, **Chiang Rai**, and **Chiang Saen**. A sign inside the front windshield also reads **“CHIANG MAI”** in English with Thai text above it. On the side, smaller markings include route or vehicle numbers and “V-CLASS,” suggesting an intercity or long-distance coach service.

Behind and to the left of the main bus is another coach bus, mostly white with blue and pink accents. Its front destination sign appears to show Thai text, likely indicating a route between **Bangkok and Chiang Mai**. On the right side of the image, part of another white bus is visible, with Thai writing on its front sign.

The setting includes a large paved concrete lot, typical of a transport depot or bus station. In the background there is a low building with a tiled roof, along with many overhead utility wires stretching across the sky. A few antennas and a metal chimney or vent pipe rise above the rooftops. The sky is pale blue with some white clouds, and the lighting suggests daytime, possibly midday, with strong sunlight and soft shadows beneath the buses.

Overall, the scene captures several intercity buses parked or waiting at a Thai bus terminal, with the main bus prominently displaying northern Thailand destinations such as Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在车站或停车场的公交车的照片。最前方的公交车是白色的，车身上有绿色和黑色的文字标识，显示它属于泰国的一个公共交通公司。车辆设计现代，前部装有大型挡风玻璃，车窗上贴有目的地信息。背景中可以看到其他几辆不同颜色的公交车，以及一些低矮的建筑物和电线杆。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit roadway on a bridge during what appears to be a running event or race. The scene is bright and slightly overexposed in the sky, suggesting strong morning or late-afternoon sunlight coming from the upper left/front area.

In the foreground, toward the right side of the frame, a runner is closest to the camera. They are wearing a bright yellow/orange event shirt, black leggings, and dark running shoes with pink accents. A race bib is attached around the waist area, and the runner has one arm bent upward in a celebratory or energetic pose while moving forward. Their long shadow stretches diagonally across the pale concrete road, emphasizing the low angle of the sun.

Farther back on the right, another runner in a similar yellow shirt is also moving along the road. Near them, a motorbike with two riders is traveling on the bridge, likely part of event support or normal traffic. In the distance near the center-left, another motorbike can be seen along the bridge.

The bridge has white railings on both sides, with a clean, classical look. Along the top edge of the bridge are tall decorative poles with ornate gold-colored designs, giving the bridge a ceremonial or traditional architectural style. The gold ornaments repeat in a line, creating depth and rhythm across the image.

The road surface is light gray concrete with white lane markings and worn painted strips. A yellow line runs near the left side of the roadway. The wide-angle perspective makes the road feel expansive, with the bridge curving or receding into the background.

Beyond the bridge, there is a lush green landscape with trees, some showing red or orange blossoms. The background is softly hazy, and the trees and distant structures are slightly blurred by the bright light. Overall, the image captures an active, cheerful moment during a race on an elegant white bridge, with warm sunlight, long shadows, and decorative golden details creating a festive atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示马拉松比赛场景的照片，前景中一位穿着黄色运动服的参赛者正在跑步，他的姿态显示出专注和活力。背景中可以看到其他参赛者和观众，以及一排装饰性的白色栏杆和一些树木。整个场景在日光下拍摄，给人一种充满活力和积极向上的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a wide, tree-lined urban street viewed from a sidewalk, likely in a residential or mixed-use neighborhood.

On the left side, a broad paved pedestrian walkway runs into the distance. The sidewalk is made of large rectangular stone slabs, many of them slightly uneven or cracked, giving it an older, well-used appearance. Along the left edge of the walkway is a green park-like strip with tall mature trees. Their trunks are thick and pale in places, with peeling bark, and their leafy branches form a canopy overhead. A small black bollard-style light and a trash bin are visible near the path.

The street occupies the center and right side of the image. It is a multi-lane road with white lane markings and relatively light traffic. Several cars are parked along the far curb, and a few vehicles are visible farther down the road. A narrow grassy strip with trees separates the sidewalk from the asphalt. One large tree trunk stands prominently near the center foreground, partially blocking the view of the buildings across the street.

On the right side, there are mid-rise apartment buildings with balconies, windows, and ground-floor entrances or storefront-like spaces. The buildings are partly obscured by dense trees. Some balconies have railings and appear to contain plants or household items. Near the middle distance, there are café-style umbrellas or awnings on the sidewalk, suggesting a restaurant or outdoor seating area. A signboard is also visible near the curb.

Several pedestrians are present. In the foreground on the right, an older man in a red shirt and jeans is walking along the road edge or near the curb; his face is blurred. Farther down the left sidewalk, a few people are walking, including an adult with a small child and another person with a bicycle. On the far right sidewalk, small groups of pedestrians are moving near the building entrances.

The lighting is soft and somewhat dim, suggesting late afternoon or early evening. The sky is bright but mostly obscured by the tree canopy and buildings. The overall atmosphere is calm and urban, with a quiet boulevard feel: leafy, shaded, and residential, with pedestrians, parked cars, and apartment blocks lining the street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道日常景象的照片。在画面的左侧，一位穿着红色上衣和黑色裤子的人正沿着人行道行走，而右侧则有一位穿着深色衣服的人站在人行道边。街道两旁排列着整齐的树木，其中一些树干直立，树叶茂密。街道上有几辆停靠的汽车，远处可见行人正在过马路。建筑物沿街而建，具有现代建筑风格，窗户关闭，门面简洁。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出宁静的傍晚氛围。

caption:
A wide panoramic view shows a large outdoor water park or resort pool complex set beside a broad lake, with dark mountain ranges stretching across the horizon in the background. The sky dominates the upper half of the image, pale blue with a slightly hazy, overcast look, suggesting early morning, evening, or quiet off-season conditions.

On the left side is a tall multi-level waterslide tower made of green-painted structural beams, metal railings, and staircases. Several slides start from this tower, including a very large bright green open slide that drops steeply from the upper platform and curves down toward the foreground. Behind and beside it are additional smaller green slide sections and enclosed slide entrances.

Near the center is a complex twisting tube slide system in blue and white. It snakes through the air on metal supports, with enclosed and semi-enclosed sections looping and curving before descending toward the pool area. The slide structure stands above a tiled deck and smaller pools below.

On the right and foreground, several large orange open waterslides curve across the image, elevated on metal supports. A blue slide and a yellow slide are partially visible beneath or beside the orange ones, adding to the colorful, layered look of the water park.

The main pool area occupies the lower right and center of the scene. The water is calm and bright turquoise, reflecting the sky and nearby structures. Around the pools are rows of neatly arranged lounge chairs, many paired with closed beige umbrellas. There are also some darker green umbrellas and shaded canopy areas. The deck is paved with light-colored tiles, giving the resort a clean, organized appearance.

In the immediate foreground, a concrete walkway leads down toward the pool area, bordered by small conical evergreen trees planted in dry, reddish-brown soil. The landscaping appears newly planted or still under development in places.

Beyond the pool deck, the lake stretches across the middle distance, smooth and silvery-blue. The far shoreline is lined with rugged hills and mountains, some with darker forested slopes and faint patches of lighter rock. The overall scene feels quiet and empty, with no visible guests, making the colorful slides and rows of chairs stand out against the serene natural backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张采用HDR技术处理的水上乐园照片，展示了一系列色彩鲜艳的滑水道和游泳池。在画面左侧，有一个绿色的螺旋形滑水道，其下方是一个蓝色的游泳池，旁边摆放着一排整齐的遮阳伞。右侧是橙色的滑水道，其下方也设有一个游泳池。整个场景被夕阳的余晖照亮，营造出一种温暖而宁静的氛围。远处可以看到平静的湖泊和轮廓分明的山脉，天空呈现出淡淡的蓝色调，与前景形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a modern multi-level shopping mall or retail arcade, viewed from an upper-floor walkway near a glass-railed escalator opening.

In the foreground, there is a large glass balustrade surrounding an atrium cut-out, with escalators descending to a lower level. The escalator handrails curve diagonally through the lower-right portion of the image, and the transparent glass panels reveal parts of shops and displays on the floor below. The flooring on the upper level is a reddish-brown surface with lighter linear markings.

On the left side, a large **Saks OFF 5TH** store occupies much of the storefront. Its signage appears repeatedly in white and teal lettering on dark panels, including “OFF 5TH” and promotional signs near the entrance. Inside the store, clothing displays, mannequins, racks, and sale signage are visible. An escalator or stairway inside the store appears toward the back, with a sign indicating “more upstairs.”

In the center background, a passageway leads deeper into the mall. Above it, illuminated letters spell out **KALVERPASSAGE**. Several shoppers are walking through this corridor, and the lighting is warm and bright. A white structural column stands prominently in the center of the scene, partially blocking a large digital advertising screen behind it. The screen shows a fashion model wearing a black outfit with a white chain-like pattern and a red garment underneath; only part of the person is visible because of the column. Beneath the screen, the lower edge includes partial text that appears to be part of a brand advertisement.

Mounted around the central column is a cube-shaped red sign for **HEMA**, with white lettering and smaller text reading “since 1926.” To the right, another storefront area features red square signs for **HEMA** and **The North Face** on a pale patterned wall. Above this area is a large purple advertisement or wall graphic reading **“BRAND NEW”** in bold white letters. Nearby, a sign on the wall says **“WALK THIS WAY”** with an arrow-like layout.

The architecture is sleek and contemporary, with a mix of glass, metal, wood-toned wall panels, marble-like columns, and glossy surfaces. The ceiling has a striking geometric glass or illuminated panel design made up of triangular segments in soft tones of white, teal, orange, and pink. Reflections from the ceiling and storefronts appear on the glass railings and walls, adding to the polished indoor shopping-center atmosphere. Overall, the scene feels bright, spacious, and commercial, with multiple retail brands, digital advertising, and shoppers moving through the mall.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代购物中心内部的照片。图像中心是一个带有透明玻璃栏杆的自动扶梯，通向多层楼面。左侧是'KALVERBAAN'和'HEMA'等商店的入口，而右侧则有'THE NORTH FACE'和'BRAND'S REVEAL'等品牌的店铺。上方悬挂着几块大型广告牌，显示了不同的商品和品牌信息。整个场景被设计得既开放又有序，给人一种干净、明亮的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a white **Omron CompAir** medical device, likely a **nebulizer/compressor**, placed on a metal hospital-style trolley or equipment cart.

Key details:

- The device body is glossy white plastic with the **“OMRON CompAIR”** branding visible on the front.
- A **clear plastic air tube** is connected to a circular port on the front-right side of the machine. Next to it is a **blue round cap or control cover** with small slit-like markings.
- On the top surface, there is a rectangular **inspection/calibration label** in Indonesian. It includes text such as:
  - “KEMENTERIAN KESEHATAN RI”
  - “DIREKTORAT JENDERAL …”
  - “DINYATAKAN AMAN UNTUK PELAYANAN”
  - handwritten information that appears to include the device name “Nebulizer” and a calibration date.
- The label has a green border and a small logo on the left, suggesting official testing or approval for service use.
- The machine appears somewhat worn: there are smudges, dust, and small stains on the plastic surface.
- The surrounding cart or support frame shows noticeable **rust and brown staining**, especially around joints and edges.
- In the background, there are curved chrome-colored metal handles or rails, likely part of the trolley or nearby medical equipment.
- The setting appears to be a clinical or hospital environment, though the equipment and trolley look aged and not very clean.
- The photo is taken at a slightly angled close-up perspective, focusing mainly on the device’s top label and front connection port.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示OMRON品牌血压计的照片。血压计的主体为白色，正面贴有绿色和蓝色标签，上面印有品牌名称和型号信息。设备上方有一个银色的水龙头，旁边是不锈钢支架上的黑色水管。背景中可以看到部分墙壁和一个金属架子，整体环境显得有些陈旧且使用痕迹明显。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, street-side scene with a shallow depth of field. In the foreground on the right, a person is standing outdoors and holding a smartphone up to their ear, appearing to be in the middle of a phone call. Their face is intentionally blurred, but visible details include light blond hair styled with bangs and pulled back into a small messy bun or ponytail. A pair of pale pink sunglasses rests on top of their head.

They are wearing a black leather or faux-leather jacket with visible zippers and a colorful scarf wrapped around their neck. The scarf has a floral pattern with large flower shapes in muted tones of orange, red, teal, white, and gray. Their fingernails appear painted a dark color, and the phone has a light-colored case or edge.

The background is heavily out of focus, suggesting an urban or suburban street setting. Several cars are visible, including a white vehicle close behind the person on the right and other vehicles farther down the road. The street stretches into the distance, with parked or moving cars lining it. On the left side of the image there is a strip of green grass beside the sidewalk or curb. In the far background, blurred buildings, signs, and street elements create a busy city-street atmosphere.

The composition places the person prominently in the right foreground, while the blurred traffic and street scene provide context without drawing attention away from them. The lighting appears natural and overcast, giving the image a soft, muted look.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位女性在城市街道上使用手机的照片。她戴着太阳镜，头发扎成一个高马尾，穿着黑色夹克和带有花卉图案的围巾。背景中可以看到模糊的车辆和城市街景，表明这是在一个繁忙的城市环境中拍摄的。

caption:
The image shows a group of pale pink flamingos gathered around a shallow pond in a lush, zoo-like habitat. The scene is filled with greenery, especially dense bamboo and leafy tropical plants in the background, creating a natural enclosure.

Several flamingos stand in and around the water. Their feathers are soft peach-pink with brighter orange accents on their wings and tails. Many have long, thin legs, some with visible identification bands around them. A few birds are standing on one leg, while others have both legs in the water or are bending their long necks downward.

On the left side, several flamingos cluster near the pond’s edge. One bird has its head lowered toward the water, while another has its curved black-tipped beak tucked into its feathers, appearing to preen. In the center-right, a prominent flamingo stands close to the water with its neck curved gracefully, also grooming itself. Farther right, another flamingo stands near the bamboo with its body turned away, showing layered pink and orange plumage.

The pond water is dark green and reflective, mirroring the birds’ legs and pale bodies. Small white feathers or bits of debris float on the surface. Around the pond is a low, sandy bank bordered by dry grass and patches of green vegetation in the foreground.

Overall, the image has a calm, peaceful atmosphere, with the flamingos resting, preening, and wading in a shaded, plant-filled environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一群火烈鸟在自然环境中的照片。图中，几只粉红色的火烈鸟站立或低头觅食，它们的羽毛在阳光下呈现出柔和的粉色光泽。背景是绿色的植被和一片平静的小池塘，池塘中有几片树叶漂浮在水面上。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit landscape with a tall stone tower or lighthouse standing prominently on a grassy hill near the center-right of the frame. The tower is rectangular and vertical, with small openings or windows along its sides and a darker, more detailed top section that appears to include a lantern room or lookout structure. It sits on a low stone base or platform, giving it a historic, monumental appearance.

The foreground is dominated by an expansive field of tall, uneven grass in shades of green, gold, and brown. The grass looks dry in places, especially toward the left, while the right side has a clearer green path or mown strip leading upward toward the hill. A narrow dirt trail runs along the far right edge of the image, curving gently into the distance.

Across the middle of the scene, a low stone wall or walkway stretches horizontally along the ridge below the tower. Small silhouettes of people can be seen near the wall and at the base of the hill, emphasizing the scale of the tower and the open landscape. On the far right, a small group of people stands or walks near the path, appearing tiny against the broad field and sky.

The sky takes up a large portion of the image and is bright, hazy, and softly colored. The left side is pale blue, while the right side is washed with warm sunlight, creating a golden glow and slight overexposure. Wispy clouds are visible near the top and around the bright sunlit area. Several birds are flying in the sky around the tower, appearing as small dark shapes.

Overall, the scene feels calm, open, and windswept, with the historic tower silhouetted against a bright afternoon sky and surrounded by grassy coastal or hillside terrain.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的照片，画面中心是一座高耸的塔楼，位于一片绿色草地上。塔楼的设计简约而优雅，其周围是郁郁葱葱的草地和一些散落的小建筑。在照片的前景，可以看到一条蜿蜒的小径穿过草地，引导视线至塔楼。天空晴朗，阳光从画面上方洒下，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a modern indoor lounge or lobby space with a strong mid-century/contemporary design style. The room is wide and open, with a high, smooth ceiling containing small recessed square lights. The back wall is almost entirely made of tall floor-to-ceiling glass panels framed in dark metal, creating a strong grid pattern and giving a clear view into an outdoor courtyard.

In the foreground, there is a long, low gray sectional sofa positioned horizontally across the room. It has several colorful striped throw pillows in warm tones—red, orange, black, cream, and yellow. Behind and around the sofa are low wooden side tables or console surfaces. In front of it are small round glass-topped tables with slim black pedestal bases.

To the right side of the seating area is a vivid red-orange lounge chair with a sculptural, curved shape and thin metal legs. Nearby are patterned ottomans or poufs with Southwestern-style geometric designs in red, orange, cream, black, and gray. A tall arched floor lamp with a metallic dome shade stands near the red chair, adding to the modern-retro aesthetic.

The floor is covered with large rectangular tiles in a warm gray-brown tone, laid in a staggered pattern. The overall interior color palette combines dark metal framing, gray upholstery, warm wood, and bold accent colors.

Outside the glass wall is a landscaped courtyard with desert-inspired plantings. Several mature trees with thin trunks and airy green foliage stand in gravel or sandy ground. There are paved walkways, low shrubs, cacti along the right side, and modern low-rise buildings in the background with clean white walls and glass doors. On the left side outside, there appears to be a low fire feature or fire pit with visible flames, adding warmth to the courtyard scene.

The space feels calm, upscale, and airy, with abundant natural light pouring through the windows. The composition emphasizes the connection between the stylish indoor lounge and the serene outdoor courtyard.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代室内设计的照片，空间宽敞明亮，配有多种家具和装饰。在照片的中心是一个大型灰色沙发，上面铺有彩色条纹抱枕。沙发前方有一个带有圆形玻璃桌的低矮咖啡桌，旁边是一个有着鲜艳红色座椅的现代风格椅子。在沙发对面，有一个带有几何图案的橙色脚凳。整个房间的设计简洁而时尚，通过大面积的落地窗可以看到外面的庭院景观，包括树木和灌木丛。

caption:
The image shows a wide outdoor landscape beside a calm body of water, likely a lake, lagoon, or coastal inlet. The sky is clear and pale blue, taking up much of the upper half of the frame, with bright daylight suggesting a sunny day.

In the foreground, a man is walking along a grassy shoreline path. His face is blurred, obscuring facial details. He is wearing a light gray T-shirt with a colorful graphic strip across the chest, light blue jeans, and dark open-toe sandals. He is carrying a bright red plastic bag in one hand. His posture suggests he is walking toward the camera at a relaxed pace.

The ground around him is a mix of green-brown grass and patches of pale dirt or sand. On the right side of the image, there is a light-colored dirt or gravel path that curves through the foreground. A long shadow falls to the right of the man, indicating strong sunlight from the left.

To the left and behind him is a broad expanse of still, reflective water. The far shoreline is visible in the distance, with low vegetation, buildings, and faint structures along the horizon. On the right side in the background, there are many colorful boats or containers clustered near the water’s edge, along with large pale mounds that look like sand, salt, or construction material. The scene has a quiet, open, coastal or lakeside atmosphere, with the man as the main subject against a spacious waterside setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男性在自然环境中的照片。男性穿着灰色T恤和蓝色牛仔裤，脚穿棕色鞋子，手持一个红色购物袋，正沿着一条小路行走。他站在一片绿色的草地上，背景是平静的湖泊和远处模糊的建筑群。阳光明媚，天空晴朗，整个场景给人一种宁静和平静的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a modern urban transit or station complex at night, photographed from a low angle looking upward. The scene is dominated by sharp architectural lines, illuminated steel beams, glass panels, and elevated walkways set against a deep black sky.

On the left side, a large building façade rises diagonally across the frame. Its upper wall is clad in pale metallic panels, warmly lit from below so that the surface glows gold and cream. The panels are divided by thin vertical and horizontal seams, giving the wall a precise, grid-like pattern. Beneath it are dark glass windows reflecting faint interior light.

Near the center, an elevated roof structure cuts across the image at a steep diagonal. Under the roof, exposed white steel trusses, beams, and supports are brightly lit, revealing the building’s structural framework. Cylindrical columns support the roof and walkways, and the combination of glass, metal, and light gives the space a futuristic, engineered appearance.

To the right, another elevated walkway or platform extends horizontally, with a glass railing and a long strip of bright white lighting running along its underside. A small human silhouette is visible near the center-right, standing or walking behind the railing, emphasizing the scale of the architecture. Nearby, a green illuminated sign with Japanese text or transit markings glows softly, suggesting this may be a train station, airport terminal, or major transportation hub.

The lower portion of the image shows a darker underpass or roadway area beneath the elevated structures. Large columns descend to the ground, and a metal fence runs across the foreground. There are cool blue-green reflections along the lower wall or roadway, contrasting with the warm yellow lights above. At the bottom right, red and white light streaks from a moving vehicle create a sense of motion.

Overall, the image has a dramatic nighttime atmosphere: strong geometric composition, high contrast between warm artificial lighting and the black sky, and a sleek, contemporary urban design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑夜景的摄影作品，图像中心是一座设计独特的建筑结构，其特征是大面积的玻璃窗户和金属梁架。建筑内部灯光透过窗户洒出，与外部的黑暗形成鲜明对比。在建筑下方，一辆火车正以模糊的动态效果通过，留下了一条长长的光轨。整个场景被夜晚的宁静氛围所包围，营造出一种静谧而现代的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a dense modern cityscape at night, viewed from an elevated pedestrian area behind glass railings. Tall office and hotel towers rise on both sides, creating a canyon-like urban scene. The overall color palette is cool and moody, dominated by deep blue-gray sky tones and bright cyan/teal window lights.

On the left, a high-rise building with a grid of dark windows has many brightly lit office floors, glowing turquoise. Near the center stands a taller, sleek tower with a curved glass corner and a distinctive rectangular cut-out near the top, its illuminated windows forming horizontal bands. On the right, a large building with a warm brown facade is covered in a regular pattern of square windows, many glowing aqua, with a vertical glass atrium section reflecting bright interior lights.

Across the lower half of the scene, an elevated white structure—possibly a rail line, roadway, or pedestrian walkway—sweeps through the image from right to left, adding a strong diagonal line. In the foreground are glass panels, metallic posts, and railings with reflections of city lights. Several vertical light fixtures glow warmly, contrasting with the cool blue-green light from the buildings.

Below, a narrow road runs through the city, with small cars visible and red tail lights streaking or glowing in the distance. There are patches of greenery and trees along the street, lit by artificial lights. A large sign near the lower center reads “SIO-SITE,” suggesting the area may be a commercial or office district. The atmosphere feels sleek, futuristic, and slightly cinematic, with the wet-looking reflections, glass surfaces, and neon-like lighting emphasizing the nighttime urban environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市夜景的照片，画面中心是一座高耸的摩天大楼，其表面反射着周围的灯光。左侧有一座设计简约的建筑，而右侧则是一栋装饰有大量窗户的高楼。在前景中，可以看到一个透明的玻璃结构，下方是绿色植物和一条人行道。整个场景被夜晚的灯光照亮，营造出一种繁忙都市的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor cultural procession or ceremonial parade taking place on a paved courtyard or street beside a traditional-looking building.

In the foreground, several participants are dressed in colorful traditional costumes. They wear bright yellow long-sleeved tops under black sleeveless outer garments, with white and dark blue skirt-like lower garments and wide blue sashes around their waists. Some have large black padded headpieces or hats, decorated with red and white accents. They are holding long vertical poles or spears—some black, some red—with pointed tips or decorative white tassels near the top. Several also carry round shields with bold painted patterns: blue and black circular designs with a starburst or flower-like motif around a central bronze-colored boss.

One participant near the center-left wears a red top with yellow sleeves and a red head covering. Another group farther back wears similar red, yellow, blue, and white clothing and carries long spears angled upward. Their clothing appears coordinated, suggesting they are part of the same performance or ceremonial group.

Along the building wall in the middle distance, another line of participants stands in more formal black-and-gold outfits. They wear ornate black jackets with gold trim and decorative hats, along with patterned batik-style cloth around their waists or legs. They appear to be waiting or forming part of the procession.

The building on the left has cream-colored walls, dark green window frames with yellow trim, and a tiled roof with reddish-brown and dark gray sections. The eaves are decorated with green and yellow ornamental trim. There are large windows with blinds, and a sign on the wall reads “TEPAS” followed by several lines of text that are partly obscured. The architecture and costumes suggest a Javanese or Indonesian cultural setting, possibly at a palace or heritage site.

On the far left, a tourist or spectator with a camera is photographing the event. More spectators and participants are visible in the background on the right side, where the walkway continues under large leafy trees. The atmosphere is bright daylight, with sunlight filtering through the trees and casting soft shadows on the gray stone pavement.

Overall, the scene captures a colorful traditional procession, with participants carrying spears and shields, arranged in lines beside a historic-style building.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统节日庆典的摄影照片，几位身着特色服饰的人物在户外进行游行。他们头戴黑色头饰，身穿黄色和蓝色的传统服装，并手持装饰性的盾牌和长矛。背景中可以看到其他参与者、观众和一些建筑物，营造出一种热闹而庄重的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a weathered stone relief sculpture mounted on the front of a rectangular pedestal or monument in an outdoor garden setting.

At the center of the relief is a full-length classical female figure carved in pale beige stone. She stands facing forward in a contrapposto-like pose, wearing a flowing, draped garment with many deep, vertical folds.
