A white information sheet is also placed behind the windshield. The side mirror is painted the same purple as the body, and the side of the car reflects nearby banners and lighting. Large dark alloy wheels with low-profile tires are visible along the left side.

The setting appears to be a car show booth. The floor is covered in red carpet, and the car is roped off with orange chains. In the background are several promotional banners, including a large black “BUGEYE” sign and other motorsport-related signage. To the right, partially visible behind the purple car, is a bright orange classic vehicle with a roof rack, adding to the show-car atmosphere. The overall scene is colorful, polished, and focused on modified performance cars.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆紫色调的高性能汽车的照片，车辆前部装有宽大的空气动力学套件和黑色的前保险杠。车身上贴有多彩的赞助商标志和文字，如'Alkka'、'BUGGYEYES'等。车辆被一条红色链条围住，暗示它可能在某个展览或活动上展出。背景中可以看到其他汽车和一些模糊的文字标识，但它们并不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a close-up, upward-looking view of a weathered piece of heavy machinery against a bright blue sky. The main subject is a tall, vertical metal mast or guide rail positioned slightly left of center. It has a ladder-like structure with evenly spaced horizontal rungs running up its length. The metal is heavily worn, with chipped yellow-orange paint, rust, grime, and dark staining, giving it an aged industrial appearance.

Attached to the mast on the right side are large mechanical joints and hydraulic components. A thick yellow arm extends horizontally from the mast toward the right edge of the frame, suggesting part of an excavator, drilling rig, or similar construction equipment. A shiny chrome hydraulic piston is visible near the upper right, partially extended from a rust-stained cylinder. Several thin red or dark cables/wires run across the scene, some stretched horizontally to the right and others hanging vertically down the mast.

The lighting is warm and golden, likely from low-angle sunlight, which emphasizes the rust, texture, and worn paint on the metal surfaces. The machinery glows with orange highlights while darker shadows define the rungs and joints.

The background is mostly a clear, vivid blue sky with a faint white streak resembling a distant cloud or contrail on the left. Near the bottom of the image, out-of-focus green trees are visible, indicating the machinery is outdoors. The depth of field is shallow: the central mast and machinery are the focus, while the background trees and some upper parts of the structure appear softly blurred. Overall, the image has a rugged, industrial feel with strong contrast between the rusty yellow machinery and the clean blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工业设备的照片，特写拍摄了一根老旧的黄色金属结构，其表面生锈且有明显的使用痕迹。结构上装有几个螺丝和螺母，以及一个带有红色警示标签的开口。在照片的背景中，可以看到几根电线杆和一些模糊的树木轮廓，这些元素构成了一个自然的环境背景。

caption:
The image shows a busy countryside scene that appears to be a traditional mounted hunt gathering.

In the foreground, a large pack of hounds fills the lower half of the image. Most of the dogs are white or cream with tan, brown, or black markings, and they are clustered closely together on a narrow road and roadside verge. Their tails and bodies overlap, creating a sense of movement and crowding. A few hounds stand off to the right near a stone wall, while others press around two standing people.

Several riders on horseback are gathered among the dogs. The riders wear formal hunting attire: bright red riding coats, beige or white breeches, black riding boots, and black or dark riding helmets. One rider on the right sits on a large brown horse beside a parked grey car. Another rider in a red coat sits on a grey horse near the center, facing left. A third rider in a red coat is on the left, mounted on a brown horse. Their faces appear blurred.

Two people on foot stand among the hounds in the foreground. One, with light-colored hair, wears a green jacket and is bending slightly toward the dogs, with a hand resting on one of them. Another person in a dark blue jacket stands with their back to the camera near the center, surrounded by the pack.

The setting is a rural village lane. On the right side, several cars are parked along the road, including a grey vehicle close to the horse. Behind them are old stone buildings with pitched roofs and chimneys, suggesting a historic village or countryside estate. In the middle background is a small structure with a moss-covered green roof, and behind it stands a large, leafless tree with wide, twisting branches spreading across the sky.

The lighting is warm and low, likely late afternoon or early morning, casting a golden tone on the riders, horses, and buildings. The overall atmosphere is crowded, social, and traditional, with horses, hounds, riders, villagers, parked cars, stone cottages, and bare winter trees all packed into a narrow rural road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到猎狐活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一位身穿红色上衣和黑色裤子的骑手坐在一匹装饰有绿色毛毡的马上，他戴着典型的猎狐帽，显得专注而沉着。在他的周围，一群猎犬似乎在等待命令或休息，它们的毛色各异，有的是白色、灰色和棕色。在画面左侧，两位穿着红色上衣的骑手正准备出发，他们的马匹也装备了相应的狩猎装备。背景中可以看到几座传统的英国乡村房屋和树木，为这个场景增添了一种宁静的乡村氛围。

caption:
The image shows a modern urban office building photographed from a low, upward-looking angle, making the structure appear tall and imposing. The main building dominates the right and center of the frame. It has a contemporary facade made of reflective blue glass panels and light gray or white cladding. The glass surfaces mirror the bright sky and nearby buildings, giving the exterior a sleek, polished appearance.

A prominent vertical glass column runs up the front of the building near the center-right, framed by white metal or concrete borders. This column is made of narrow rectangular window sections stacked in a grid, extending almost to the roofline. On either side of it are flat white wall sections with small, evenly spaced rectangular windows. The building’s corners and side sections are covered in dark blue reflective glass, creating a contrast with the pale cladding.

Near the top of the main building, there is a blue logo or sign partially visible on the white facade. The roofline has angular, stepped architectural forms rather than a simple flat top, adding to the modern design.

The sky is clear and intensely blue, with no clouds visible, suggesting a sunny day. Strong sunlight illuminates the building, producing crisp reflections and shadows.

In the lower left portion of the image, another glass-fronted building is visible. It has cylindrical glass towers and a sign reading “CAMERA DE COMERT SI INDUSTRIE,” indicating a chamber of commerce and industry. At the bottom edges of the frame, parts of streetlights, neighboring apartment blocks, and other urban structures can be seen, placing the scene in a dense city environment.

Overall, the image emphasizes modern commercial architecture, reflective glass surfaces, clean geometric lines, and a bright urban skyline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑风格的摄影图像，主要建筑物是一座高耸的玻璃幕墙办公楼，其设计简洁而现代。大楼顶部有突出的结构和一个明显的标志。建筑的侧面反射出周围环境，包括其他建筑物和蓝天。在图片的左下角，可以看到另一座较小的建筑，与主楼形成对比。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of a modern building photographed from a low angle, looking upward toward the roofline against a clear blue sky.

On the rooftop are large exterior signs mounted on metal support frames. On the left is a prominent square logo divided horizontally: the top half is bright red and the bottom half is dark black or charcoal, with a short white diagonal stripe cutting across the boundary between the two colors. To the right of this logo are large raised letters reading “KB,” rendered in a light gray or metallic finish with dark edging, giving them a three-dimensional appearance. The letters are attached to a metal framework behind them.

The building façade below the signs has a contemporary office-like design. It features beige or light tan exterior wall panels and long horizontal rows of dark windows. The windows appear to have external blinds or slatted shades, creating a striped texture across the glass. A white or light gray roof trim runs along the top edge of the building beneath the signage.

The sky occupies much of the upper part of the image and is bright, cloudless, and evenly blue, suggesting a sunny day. The composition emphasizes the rooftop branding and the clean architectural lines of the building.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示建筑物顶部的摄影图像，其中建筑物的屋顶上安装了两个标志牌。最上方是一个红色背景带有白色字母的标志牌，下方是黑色背景带有银色字母的标志牌。这两个标志牌都以现代简约的设计风格呈现，与建筑物的灰色调相协调。建筑本身为多层结构，窗户排列整齐，整体给人一种简洁而现代的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a bright riverside or harbor scene on a sunny day. Several large white river cruise boats are docked side by side along a quay. The foreground is a wide paved dock area made of concrete, with a yellowish lane marked in large white letters “BUS,” suggesting a bus or service access lane near the waterfront. A short black mooring bollard sits near the water’s edge, and a tall, slim black streetlamp stands near the center of the frame.

On the left, a large white vessel has multiple decks with metal railings, round porthole-style windows, stairways, and an open upper deck furnished with tables, chairs, and a closed patio umbrella. Orange life rings are attached to the railings. The name “CRYSTAL MOZART” is visible near the lower right portion of this boat, with “Valletta” written beneath it.

To the right is another sleek white river cruise ship, with a cleaner, modern design and large rectangular windows. Its stern area displays the name “VIKING MODI.” White patio umbrellas are open on the top deck, and small satellite domes and equipment are visible on the roof. At the far right edge, part of another white boat is cropped into the frame, including a radar mast labeled “JRC.”

The water is mostly hidden by the docked boats but can be seen in narrow gaps, reflecting light near the hulls. In the background, beyond the river, there are green trees, a tall modern high-rise building, and a distinctive communications or observation tower with a circular platform and a red-and-white antenna. The sky dominates the upper half of the image: it is a vivid blue with scattered soft white clouds, giving the scene a calm, open, summery atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示码头场景的现实主义风格照片，图中可见一艘大型白色游船停靠在码头上。游船上装饰着蓝色和红色的条纹，并有多个甲板区域供乘客使用。码头由混凝土铺成，上面标有数字'105'。背景中有几座现代建筑和一个晴朗的蓝天，点缀着几朵白云。

caption:
The image shows a bright, scenic Mediterranean coastal view from an elevated hillside or cliffside path. On the left and foreground, dense green vegetation dominates the scene: pine trees with rounded canopies, shrubs, olive-like foliage, and other Mediterranean plants. A narrow curved walkway with a pale stone wall is partially visible near the bottom left, winding through the greenery. A black, old-fashioned lamp post peeks out among the trees, adding to the garden-like atmosphere.

Near the center-right stands a large, ornate stone building perched dramatically on the edge of a rocky cliff. The building is tall and pale beige or off-white, with classical architectural details: arched windows, decorative columns or pilasters, carved stonework, cornices, balconies, and a symmetrical façade. Its massive vertical walls rise directly above the sea, giving it a monumental appearance. The structure resembles a historic palace, museum, or grand civic building overlooking the coast.

Below the main building, the rocky cliff drops down toward the water. At the base of the cliff there is another smaller, rounded beige building built into the waterfront, with dark rectangular windows and a flat terrace. The coastline is rugged, with stone retaining walls and rocks where small waves break into white foam.

The right half of the image opens onto a wide expanse of calm blue sea. The water is deep blue with lighter turquoise tones near the shore. Several boats and yachts are visible in the distance, including larger white yachts near the middle-right and a small boat closer to the bottom-right corner. Across the bay, low hills and mountains form a hazy blue backdrop, suggesting a warm coastal region. The sky is clear and pale blue with no visible clouds, and the sunlight is strong, creating a crisp, summery atmosphere.

Overall, the scene feels elegant and tranquil: lush greenery, historic architecture, cliffs, luxury boats, and a sparkling Mediterranean coastline under bright daylight.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示地中海风格建筑的自然风光照片。在画面中央，一座高耸的白色建筑物屹立于岩石之上，其设计复杂且具有古典美。周围是郁郁葱葱的树木和灌木丛，与清澈的海水形成鲜明对比。在远处可以看到平静的海面和地平线上的其他岛屿。整个场景被阳光照耀着，呈现出一种宁静而和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows an overhead view of four firefighters walking across a sunlit paved street or parking area. They are wearing dark navy/black uniforms with yellow piping and reflective yellow bands around their lower pant legs. The backs of their shirts read “VIGILI DEL FUOCO,” indicating the Italian fire service.

One firefighter near the center-left is carrying a rectangular blue metal toolbox or equipment case in his right hand. Another firefighter toward the upper right is holding a black firefighter helmet with yellow reflective markings. The firefighter on the lower right appears to be carrying dark gloves or gear, and the person near the bottom is partly cropped by the frame.

The scene is outdoors on gray asphalt with painted markings: a bright blue line or parking boundary runs diagonally in the upper right, and faded yellow markings are visible near the lower left. Strong sunlight creates long, sharp shadows of the firefighters stretching across the pavement. Along the top-left edge there is a raised curb, a tiled sidewalk, scattered dry leaves and debris, and part of a round metal manhole cover. The overall impression is of a group of firefighters moving together after or during an operation, carrying equipment in a hot, bright urban street setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张从高角度拍摄的消防员集体行走的照片。图像中，四位穿着统一黑色T恤和黄色反光条的消防员正在街道上行走。他们的T恤上印有'VOLONTARI DEL FIOLO'字样，表明他们可能是意大利的一支志愿消防队。其中一位消防员戴着头盔，而其他三位则没有戴头盔。他们沿着蓝色的路标线行走，这条线在画面中清晰可见。背景是城市环境的一部分，包括路面、路边的石块和远处模糊的建筑轮廓。

caption:
The image shows an indoor professional basketball game in progress, captured from courtside at a low-to-mid angle.

In the foreground, two basketball players are facing each other in a one-on-one situation:

- On the left is a player wearing a bright blue uniform with white trim. His jersey has the number **4** on the front, and he appears to be controlling or protecting the basketball with his right hand. He is slightly crouched, with his knees bent and his body angled toward the defender. He is wearing blue shorts, white socks, and gray/blue basketball shoes. A tattoo is visible on his upper arm.
- On the right is an opposing player in a white uniform with burgundy/maroon side panels and lettering. He is bent low in a defensive stance, leaning forward with his knees bent and arms lowered, focused on the ballhandler. The back of his jersey shows a large burgundy number and blue text, though it is partially obscured by his posture. He is wearing white socks with red accents and light-colored basketball shoes.

The basketball is between the two players, near the blue-uniformed player’s hand, suggesting he may be dribbling or preparing to make a move. The defender is close, ready to react.

In the background, a referee in a black-and-white shirt is visible on the right side, running or moving along the sideline while watching the play. Behind the players are rows of spectators seated in arena stands; many faces appear blurred. The crowd is seated on green chairs, and the arena lighting is bright.

Along the sideline, there is a long LED advertising board glowing in blue, green, and white tones. Above the crowd, a large dark banner stretches across the wall with a cityscape-like graphic and several logos, including Cyrillic text, indicating the game may be taking place in a Russian-speaking region or involving teams from that area.

The court floor is polished hardwood with red and white boundary markings. The overall scene feels dynamic and tense, as the offensive player in blue sizes up the defender while the crowd watches closely.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张体育摄影风格的照片，捕捉了一场篮球比赛中的紧张时刻。图中显示两位篮球运动员在激烈的对抗中，一位穿着蓝色球衣的球员（号码4）正准备进行防守动作，而另一位穿着白色球衣的球员（号码20）则在运球前进。球场上还有裁判和观众席上的观众，他们都在关注着比赛的进展。

caption:
The image shows a richly decorated church or chapel interior, focused on an ornate altar area with statues, gilded frames, marble columns, and religious artwork.

On the left side, there is a large dark oil painting in a heavy gold frame. The painting is dimly lit and depicts human figures, though the details are shadowy. In front of it stands an elaborate gilded devotional frame or reliquary, covered in scrolling Baroque ornamentation, floral motifs, and a crown-like top. Within this smaller golden frame is an icon-like image of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child, both crowned. Several white candles stand at the base, and the gold surfaces catch warm light, making this lower-left area glow brightly.

In the center is a white marble statue on a pedestal labeled “S. ROCHUS,” identifying the figure as Saint Roch. The statue depicts a robed male saint standing with one leg slightly forward. He holds a long golden staff in one hand and gestures with the other. His clothing is carved with flowing folds, and he has curly hair. His face appears intentionally blurred or obscured in the image. The statue stands in front of the large framed painting, with the gold frame rising behind it.

To the right of Saint Roch is a tall cylindrical marble column with reddish-brown and pink veining. It has a polished surface and a gilded base, matching the opulent style of the altar. Behind and beside the column, the wall is dark gray-brown, giving contrast to the pale statues and gold ornamentation.

On the far right, partially hidden by the column, is another white marble statue on a pedestal labeled “S. LUDOVICUS.” This figure wears a crown and holds a scepter-like object, suggesting a royal saint, likely Saint Louis. The statue is dressed in carved robes and armor-like garments, with drapery sweeping across the body. Its face is also blurred or softened. The figure stands in a recessed niche or against a darker wall, making it appear more shadowed than the central statue.

Overall, the scene has a Baroque or Rococo church aesthetic: dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, abundant gilding, carved marble, devotional imagery, and richly textured surfaces. The composition feels solemn and ornate, with warm golden highlights from the altar area contrasting against the cool white marble statues and the dark background painting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示宗教艺术的摄影作品，图像中心为一尊穿着长袍、手持权杖的圣人雕像，旁边是另一尊头戴王冠、手持剑的圣人雕像。左侧是一个金色装饰华丽的框架，内有一幅描绘人物的油画。整个场景被柔和的光线照亮，营造出一种庄严肃穆的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the entrance gate to **Black Thunder**, likely an amusement or water park. The entrance is a large pastel pink archway with decorative, theme-park-style architecture and bold signage.

At the center-right of the arch, large raised letters spell **“BLACK THUNDER”** in dark gray, while on the left side the same name appears in **Tamil script**. Above the central portion is a colorful cartoon illustration of children splashing in water, reinforcing the water-park theme.

The gate is decorated with many sculptural elements:

- On the left platform, there is a large reclining **lion statue** with a golden-yellow body and brown mane.
- On the right platform, a matching large **tiger statue** lies down, painted yellow with black stripes.
- Several stylized tribal or warrior-like statues stand around the entrance columns, painted in bright patterns.
- A large central decorative figure or totem stands beneath the arch, with a tall spear-like ornament rising above it.
- On top of the arch are additional human-like warrior statues holding spears or weapons.

The entrance has multiple openings for vehicles and visitors. A small car is visible driving through the central passageway into the park. Behind the gate, there are dense green trees and landscaping, suggesting the park is set in a lush, tropical environment.

The sky is bright blue with large white clouds, and tall palm trees are visible on the left side, adding to the warm, sunny, resort-like atmosphere. The ground in front of the entrance is dusty and reddish-brown, and the overall scene feels colorful, playful, and designed to attract visitors.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于热带地区的主题公园入口的照片。入口由两座拱形结构组成，上方装饰有代表不同动物的雕塑，包括一只巨大的金色狮子和一只棕色熊。两侧的柱子上各有一个雕塑，左侧是一个戴着帽子的人形雕塑，右侧是一个骑在马背上的骑士雕塑。正中央是一座高耸的塔状建筑，顶部装饰着一个鹰头雕像。建筑物的正面写有'BLACK THUNDER'字样，表明这是一个名为'Black Thunder'的主题公园。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit cityscape of an old European riverside district, likely Porto, Portugal, with historic buildings clustered on a hillside above a large iron bridge.

In the foreground, a blue-gray steel arched bridge spans across the lower part of the scene. Its structure is made up of dense crisscrossing metal trusses and curved supports, giving it an industrial 19th-century appearance. Along the upper deck of the bridge, many small pedestrians are visible walking or standing, and slender streetlamps line the walkway.

Behind the bridge, the city rises steeply. The hillside is packed with tightly arranged buildings of different heights and ages. Many have white or pale façades, gray stone trim, and traditional terracotta-orange tiled roofs. Some buildings look freshly maintained, while others show weathering, patched walls, exposed stone, or faded paint, adding to the historic character of the scene.

On the left side, there is a large white institutional-looking building with rows of tall rectangular windows framed by ornate gray stonework. It has a broad red-tiled roof and, near the top, a small domed cupola with arched windows. Dark green trees partially obscure portions of this building.

Near the center and upper right, several prominent religious or civic structures dominate the skyline. A tall, ornate bell tower rises in the distance, with decorative stonework and a dark top. Farther right, a large gray stone cathedral-like building stands out, with two massive square towers capped by rounded domes and small pinnacles. Its heavy stone walls and arched openings contrast with the lighter residential buildings around it. Nearby are additional church-like structures with Gothic-style windows and stone façades.

Large leafy green trees are interspersed among the buildings, especially near the cathedral area, softening the dense urban scene. The rooftops create a warm pattern of orange and red across the middle and lower sections of the image.

The sky occupies a large portion of the upper frame and is clear, pale blue, with no visible clouds. The lighting is strong and crisp, suggesting midday or early afternoon. Overall, the image captures a layered historic cityscape: an iconic iron bridge in the foreground, a compact old town with red roofs and white façades in the middle ground, and monumental stone church towers rising above the skyline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市景观的摄影作品，前景是一座蓝色的桥梁，其结构坚固且设计复杂。桥梁下方是宁静的河流，河岸边排列着各式各样的建筑，包括具有历史感的教堂和现代住宅。建筑物的屋顶呈现出丰富的色彩，从橙色到白色不等，与蓝天形成鲜明对比。在画面的中景，一座高耸的塔楼显得格外突出，它的顶部装饰着十字架，增添了宗教氛围。整个场景被阳光照耀，给人一种温暖和平静的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a person standing outdoors in a waterfront park or promenade with a large city skyline in the background.

In the foreground, a man is centered slightly to the right of the frame. His face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial details. He is wearing a plain white short-sleeve athletic T-shirt and a black baseball cap worn backward. A small lavalier microphone is clipped near the collar of his shirt, suggesting he may be speaking on camera or being interviewed. His hands are clasped together at waist level, and he is facing directly toward the camera in a relaxed, upright posture.

Behind him, a wide river or harbor stretches across the middle of the image. A large white-and-blue ferry or passenger boat is passing along the water on the left side of the frame. The boat is partially visible, with a sleek, modern shape and dark-tinted windows.

The background is dominated by a dense urban skyline with many tall buildings and skyscrapers. The architecture includes glass towers, dark rectangular office buildings, and a distinctive light-colored building with a sharp, angled top. The skyline appears hazy in the distance, with soft daylight and muted tones, suggesting a sunny day with some atmospheric haze.

In the lower part of the image, there are green shrubs, grass, and a paved walkway or terrace, indicating the person is standing in a landscaped park area near the water. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the person’s shirt and arms. Overall, the scene has the feel of a filmed outdoor presentation or interview set against a major city waterfront.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男性站在户外的摄影照片，背景是城市天际线和河流。男性穿着白色T恤，双手交叉放在胸前，面朝镜头，表情平静。他的背后是一座城市的高楼大厦，以及一艘停靠在岸边的船只。阳光明媚，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunny seaside entrance leading down toward a beach. In the foreground is a rustic wooden gateway made from weathered beams and posts, supported by low stone walls on either side. Hanging from the horizontal wooden beam is a cheerful yellow sign shaped like a banana. The sign reads: “WELCOME TO BANANA BAYA” in dark lettering.

Beyond the entrance, a narrow wooden boardwalk or path runs straight down the center, guiding the eye toward the sandy beach and the sea. On both sides of the path are lush green shrubs with vivid pink flowers, adding a tropical, resort-like feel. There are also white flowering bushes and dense greenery framing the walkway.

The background is dominated by a stunning ocean view. The water is a vivid gradient of turquoise near the shore, deepening into rich blue farther out. A few tiny swimmers, beach umbrellas, and distant beachgoers are visible near the shoreline, though they are softly blurred. The horizon line stretches across the scene, with faint land or hills visible in the distance.

Above the sea is a wide, bright blue sky with soft white clouds spread across it. The lighting is strong and summery, giving the whole scene a warm, inviting atmosphere. On the far right, a utility pole and overhead wires are visible, slightly interrupting the otherwise natural coastal view. Overall, the image feels like the entrance to a relaxed beach bar, resort, or tropical seaside spot.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海边餐厅入口的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个木制结构，上面挂着一个黄色的'Barbarossa'标志牌，表明这是Barbarossa餐厅的入口。木质结构由石柱支撑，周围种植着红色花朵和绿色植物。通过这个结构可以看到宁静的海滩，蓝色的大海以及在远处航行的小船。阳光明媚，天空晴朗，为整个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, elevated view over a dense modern cityscape under a dramatic blue sky. The horizon sits low in the frame, making the sky the dominant feature. It is bright blue with scattered white and gray cumulus clouds, especially concentrated on the left side where the light appears softer and slightly hazy, as if the sun is behind the cloud cover. The right side of the sky is clearer, with smaller, well-defined clouds floating above the city.

In the lower half of the image, a cluster of high-rise buildings fills the scene. Near the center are several cream and beige residential towers with dark window grids and red-roofed decorative turrets, giving them a slightly ornate, symmetrical appearance. Behind and to the right of these towers stands a tall, sleek blue-glass skyscraper, noticeably higher than most surrounding buildings. Farther right are more modern office and hotel-like towers, including a large pale rectangular building with many evenly spaced windows.

On the left side, there is a prominent striped high-rise with horizontal bands and a thin spire or antenna rising from its roof. The left edge of the image appears to include reflections or streaks on glass, suggesting the photo may have been taken through a window. This creates a slightly blurred, vertical texture over part of the city.

The foreground contains a dense patch of green treetops, possibly a park or landscaped area, contrasting with the urban buildings around it. Streets and smaller low-rise buildings weave through the lower portion of the scene, with rooftops in muted colors such as gray, tan, blue, and red. The city looks busy and tightly packed, with a mix of residential towers, commercial buildings, older low-rise structures, and newer skyscrapers.

Overall, the scene feels bright, expansive, and urban, with the dramatic cloud-filled sky giving the city a spacious, open atmosphere despite the density of the buildings below.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线的摄影图像，画面中心是一座高耸的现代建筑，其黄色外墙在阳光下显得格外醒目。周围分布着不同高度和设计风格的建筑物，从低矮的住宅楼到高层商业大厦，构成了城市的多样面貌。天空中散布着几朵蓬松的白云，而地面上则有车辆和行人穿行其中，显示出城市的活力与繁忙。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a Nintendo Switch and a physical game case on a wooden table. The Switch is lying at an angle on the left side of the frame, with a bright red Joy-Con controller attached on the right side. The Joy-Con’s black analog stick, face buttons, and small plus button are visible. The Switch screen is on and appears to be displaying a Japanese game menu, likely for *Super Smash Bros. Ultimate*. The interface has dark red and black panels, Japanese text, and small menu icons along the right side of the screen.

To the right of the console is the plastic game case for the Japanese version of *Super Smash Bros. Ultimate* for Nintendo Switch. The cover art is colorful and crowded with recognizable Nintendo and gaming characters, including Pikachu, Yoshi, Kirby, Link, and others. The large Japanese title text dominates the lower part of the cover, with “SPECIAL” printed beneath it. A “CERO A” rating mark is visible near the bottom-left of the case, indicating the game is suitable for all ages in Japan.

The scene is warmly lit, with the brown wood grain of the table clearly visible in the foreground. The photo has a shallow depth of field: the Switch and game case are partly in focus, while the background is softly blurred. The overall composition suggests someone is about to play or has been playing *Super Smash Bros. Ultimate* on the Nintendo Switch.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Switch游戏机和《任天堂明星大乱斗特别版》游戏盒的照片。游戏机的屏幕显示着游戏菜单，而盒子则放在旁边，上面有日文标题和一些游戏角色的图像。两者都放置在木质桌面上，背景模糊不清，主要聚焦于前景中的游戏设备。

caption:
The image shows a small outdoor produce market set along a narrow, dusty alley lined with weathered buildings. The scene feels informal and local, with fruit and vegetables displayed directly on the ground and under a simple roadside stall.

In the foreground, several piles of produce are spread out on large white and green woven sacks laid over the dirt. There are reddish-purple sweet potatoes or yams arranged in small heaps on the left, a cluster of brown coconuts near the center front, and many round yellow-green fruits—possibly oranges or mangoes—spread in a wide row. On the right, leafy green vegetables are stacked in a red plastic basin.

A man in light-colored clothing is bent over on the right side, reaching down toward the fruit as if selecting or packing items into a small plastic bag. Behind him is a rustic wooden stall structure shaded by a corrugated metal roof. Numerous bunches of green bananas hang from wooden poles by rope or twine, with a few yellowing bananas visible among them. A large yellow jerrycan sits in front of the stall, partly supporting or standing near the basin of greens.

On the left side, a seated man in a striped shirt sits on a small yellow container or stool beside the produce. Behind him, another person in a dark sports-style shirt stands in the shade. Farther back in the alley, a person in a light striped shirt stands near a doorway. Near the middle of the image, another man wearing a bright orange shirt and a light cap stands holding a phone, catching the sunlight and becoming a visual focal point.

The surroundings are rough and worn: the walls are made of aged plaster or stone, with small barred windows and dark doorways. Overhead, torn tarps, cloths, ropes, and wires stretch across the alley, including a bright green fabric hanging in the background that glows in the sunlight. The ground is uneven and dusty, scattered with leaves, debris, sacks, and small objects.

Lighting plays a strong role in the image. Sunlight filters into the alley from above and from the front, creating bright patches on the produce and ground while leaving the stall and some figures in deep shadow. The overall atmosphere is busy but calm, capturing a candid moment of everyday street commerce in a modest neighborhood market.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示非洲街头市场的照片，画面中心有一位穿着橙色上衣的男子正弯腰在地摊前挑选水果。在他的左侧，一位穿着深色衣服的男子坐在地上，旁边放着一些蔬菜和水果。右侧有另一位男子正在整理挂着的香蕉。背景中可以看到其他商贩和他们的商品，以及悬挂的衣物和其他物品。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一种生活化的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively European city square on a bright, sunny day, with historic architecture dominating the scene.

In the center is a striking multi-story building with an ornate, painted façade. Its exterior is covered in elaborate decorative murals and patterns in warm earthy tones—gold, brown, ochre, and muted red. The artwork includes floral and vine-like motifs, framed figurative scenes, and painted figures set between rows of white-trimmed windows. Near the lower middle of the façade, large red lettering reads “V. J. ROTT,” suggesting the historic Rott building. The roofline is highly decorative, with a sculpted central pediment, urn-like ornaments, small towers, and carved architectural details.

To the left of this painted building is a narrower pale blue building with a red tiled roof and dormer windows, typical of old European town architecture. To the right is a long cream-colored classical building with evenly spaced windows, cornices, and restrained decorative moldings. Farther right, part of another building with a greenish domed roof and a circular window is visible.

The foreground is filled with large cream-colored café umbrellas. They are printed repeatedly with red “Coca-Cola” logos and the phrase “SOLD HERE,” creating a busy commercial layer beneath the historic buildings. Under and around the umbrellas are many people, likely tourists and café visitors, though their faces are blurred. Some are seated, while others walk through the square. A tall outdoor patio heater with a round metal top stands near the center foreground, and decorative wrought-iron fencing or ornamentation appears behind it.

At street level, cars and vans are parked or passing along the square. On the right side, a dark van or signboard with advertising text is visible. The sky above is bright blue with large white clouds, giving the scene a warm summer atmosphere. Overall, the image captures a bustling historic square where ornate old-world architecture, outdoor cafés, tourists, and modern advertising coexist.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的照片，画面中心是一座装饰华丽的建筑，其外墙覆盖着精细的壁画和金色浮雕。建筑上方有一个显眼的标志写着'V. ROOT'。在建筑前，有多个带有'Coca-Cola'广告的遮阳伞，下方是繁忙的人行道，人们在享受户外活动。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为这个场景增添了活力。

caption:
The image shows the rear section of a large Boeing 787 aircraft displayed indoors, likely in an aviation museum or exhibition hangar.

A prominent feature is the tall vertical tail fin on the left side of the image. It is painted bright blue with large white “787” lettering running vertically down the fin. The glossy paint reflects light from the hangar. Below the tail fin, the fuselage transitions into a deep blue lower section with sweeping white and light-blue stripe graphics.

The aircraft’s registration number, **N787BX**, is visible in white near the lower rear fuselage, confirming it as a Boeing 787 test or display aircraft. Along the cream-colored upper fuselage, a row of oval passenger windows runs horizontally. Near the center of the image is a small aircraft door or service hatch with blue striping, and a red “EXIT” marking is visible beneath it.

The airplane is positioned inside a very large covered structure with a high industrial ceiling. The roof is made of corrugated metal panels supported by gray steel trusses and beams. Long skylight panels and rectangular hanging lights are visible overhead, allowing diffuse daylight into the space. The hangar feels spacious and museum-like, with polished concrete floors and viewing barriers around the aircraft.

At the lower left, a bench and a small photo booth or kiosk can be seen, reinforcing the public exhibit setting. Beneath and around the airplane are small platforms, railings, cones, and display infrastructure. Near the bottom center, directional museum signs are partially visible, including one pointing toward “KidPort.”

Overall, the image captures a close-up, side view of the Boeing 787’s tail and rear fuselage inside a large aviation display space, emphasizing the aircraft’s scale, sleek blue-and-white livery, and the structural complexity of the hangar around it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示波音787型号飞机尾部的照片，拍摄于一个室内展览空间。飞机的蓝色和白色涂装在阳光下显得格外醒目，尾翼上清晰地印有'787'字样和注册号N787BX。飞机下方的支撑架和地面上的工具表明它可能正在进行维护或展示。背景中可以看到金属结构的屋顶和一些工业设施，但它们并不是焦点所在。

caption:
The image shows a large, ornate temple or monastery building photographed from the front on a bright sunny day. The structure has a strong East Asian or Mongolian Buddhist architectural style, with tiered roofs, upward-curving eaves, vivid colors, and gold decorative elements.

The building is symmetrical and rises in several levels. The lower portion is a broad white-brick base with red-framed windows and a large central entrance. The entrance has tall red-framed glass doors and windows, with decorative painted trim above. Two stone guardian figures appear to stand on either side of the doorway. A small group of visitors is gathered near the entrance, giving a sense of scale and showing that the building is quite large.

Above the white base is a richly decorated wooden upper section. It features dark red-brown woodwork, rows of windows with lattice-like patterns, and painted ornamental details beneath the rooflines. The balconies and ledges are decorated with circular gold medallions and other gilded features. At the center of one balcony is a golden Buddhist symbol resembling a dharma wheel, flanked by two deer, a common Buddhist motif.

The roof is especially striking. It is covered in turquoise-green tiles and has sweeping, curved edges that turn upward at the corners. The uppermost roof has a tall central vertical section, also green, topped with a large gold finial. Smaller gold ornaments sit at the roof corners. Several large cylindrical golden hanging ornaments or lantern-like elements are attached near the corners of the upper levels.

In the foreground, a wide paved walkway leads directly toward the entrance. There are low green fences, shrubs, benches, signboards, and decorative street lamps with round globe lights on both sides of the path. A few people are walking toward or away from the building, dressed casually, suggesting it may be a tourist or religious site open to visitors.

The sky behind the temple is bright blue with scattered white clouds, making the green roof and gold decorations stand out vividly. Some overhead utility wires cross the scene horizontally, slightly interrupting the view of the building. Overall, the image presents a grand, colorful religious structure with elaborate traditional ornamentation and a lively but calm public courtyard in front.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示亚洲传统建筑风格的建筑特写照片。建筑物具有绿色屋顶和金色装饰，呈现出典型的东方建筑特色。在建筑前的人行道上，有几位行人正在行走或停留，其中一位穿着红色衣服的女性正走向建筑入口。周围环境包括蓝天、几朵白云以及一些路灯和路标，为这个场景增添了一些现代元素。

caption:
The image shows the front of a small medical facility building, viewed straight on from across a paved road or driveway.

At the center of the building is a large white sign above the entrance. It reads:

**“FIRST AID POST”**  
**“MEDICAL SECTION”**  
**“PORT QASIM AUTHORITY”**

The sign also includes a red crescent symbol on the left and a red cross on the right, indicating medical or emergency services. A small Port Qasim Authority-style logo appears above the words.

The building has a blocky, symmetrical design with thick gray concrete walls and a flat roof. Two tall rectangular gray structures frame the central entrance area, giving the facade a heavy, institutional appearance. Above the sign are dark-tinted windows, and above those is a pale upper wall section. A thin vertical pole or antenna rises from the roof.

The entrance is centered below the sign. It has glass double doors, partly covered by black folding metal security gates on both sides. A short set of steps leads up to the doorway, with a narrow ramp running up the middle for wheelchair or stretcher access. The interior visible through the doorway appears dim, with a light-colored wall and a chair or bench inside.

On the right side of the entrance, there is a small outdoor white sink mounted against a tiled section of wall. On both sides of the entrance are barred windows. Several potted plants sit along the front of the building, including leafy shrubs and a taller spiky plant on the right. A ladder is leaning against the left side of the building, with another shorter ladder or object nearby.

The foreground includes a paved driveway or road, with a curb painted in alternating blue and white blocks. Tall palm trees frame the scene on both the left and right sides, their fronds extending into the top of the image. More greenery and trees are visible behind the building. The sky is pale and overcast or hazy, giving the scene a muted, slightly dusty daytime atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示红十字会医疗急救站入口的照片。建筑的正面有一个大型标志牌，上面写着'FIRST AID POST MEDICAL SECTION PORT QASIM AUTHORITY'，表明这是巴基斯坦的一个医疗急救站点。建筑的设计简洁现代，以灰色为主色调，并有几扇窗户和一个绿色的大门。门前有一条由蓝色和白色条纹组成的通道，两侧摆放着一些盆栽植物。在建筑的一侧可以看到一排棕榈树和其他树木，为这个场景增添了一丝自然气息。

caption:
The image shows a crowded outdoor scene in bright sunlight, with several people standing and sitting close together. In the foreground, an adult wearing a black knit beanie and a light gray textured jacket is seated or crouched while holding a small child closely against their chest. The adult’s face is blurred, and their arm wraps protectively around the child. The child has curly dark hair and is wearing a dark navy top, bright pink pants, and a bit of purple fabric visible at the waist. The child’s face is also blurred, and they appear to be leaning into the adult’s shoulder.

To the right, another young child with curly dark hair is partially visible in profile, seated lower in the frame and wearing a dark blue jacket. Their face is blurred as well. Around them, many adults are standing tightly packed; only torsos, arms, legs, and bags are mostly visible. Clothing includes beige trousers, dark jackets, blue jeans, and a bright red garment in the background.

Several bags and belongings appear in the scene. On the left side, a white plastic bag with blue and red markings hangs near someone’s leg. In the upper right area, a person is holding or carrying a large white sack with printed lettering and an image on it, while a dark bag hangs nearby. The background is slightly out of focus, emphasizing the adult and child in the center.

The lighting is strong and directional, creating sharp highlights on clothing and skin and deep shadows between people. The overall impression is of a busy, crowded public setting, possibly a gathering or transit area, with the central focus on a caregiver holding a child closely amid the surrounding crowd.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到的现实生活场景，显示一位戴着黑色帽子、穿着灰色外套的人正紧紧地抱着一个穿着粉色衣服的小孩。小孩的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。在他们的背后，可以看到其他人群和一些背包，暗示着他们可能在一个户外活动中。

caption:
The image shows a historical military reenactment scene with several mounted cavalry riders in period uniforms, likely inspired by Napoleonic-era soldiers.

In the foreground and lower half of the image, a group of riders sit on horses of different colors—white, brown, and dark bay. The soldiers wear ornate uniforms with tall hats, red trim, decorative braiding, and military-style jackets. Several riders on the left wear gray uniforms with red-and-black chest detailing and tall black shakos or helmets decorated with red cords and plume-like ornaments. One central rider has an especially tall black plume rising from his hat.

Near the center-right, a prominent rider is seen mostly from behind. This figure wears a bright blue uniform with yellow trim and a striking red cylindrical hat with gold bands and cords. A fur-trimmed collar or cloak detail is visible around the shoulders, and a sword or sabre hangs at the side. This rider is mounted on a light gray horse and appears to be turning toward the group, as if giving direction or preparing to move.

The background is hazy with thick white-gray smoke drifting across the scene, suggesting musket or cannon fire as part of the reenactment. Behind the smoke is a line of green trees, softly out of focus. On the right side, there is a rustic building with a thatched roof, partially obscured by smoke and vegetation, adding to the historical setting.

The overall atmosphere is dramatic and cinematic: the smoke, mounted soldiers, elaborate uniforms, and rural backdrop create the impression of a staged battlefield or historical cavalry maneuver. The image has shallow focus, with the riders in the foreground clearer than the smoky trees and building behind them.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示历史重演场景的照片，几位身着18世纪风格军装的人物骑在马背上，其中一位身穿蓝色上衣和红色裤子的骑士显得格外引人注目。他们似乎正在参与一场军事活动，背景中可以看到模糊的烟雾和一些树木，营造出一种战争时期的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide, sunlit view of ancient Roman ruins, likely around the Roman Forum/Palatine Hill area in Rome. The scene is filled with weathered brick and stone structures spread across a hillside, with layers of arches, walls, terraces, and partial columns.

In the foreground, a modern metal railing runs horizontally across the bottom of the image, indicating the photo was taken from a viewing platform or walkway. At the lower left, a person in a black sleeveless top leans on the railing, looking out over the ruins. The person is slightly out of focus compared with the architecture beyond.

The middle and background are dominated by extensive ancient masonry. On the left side, there is a large, elevated brick structure with tall arched openings and shadowed interior spaces. A crowd of tourists stands along the top terrace behind a low railing, forming a line of small figures against the stonework. The arches below are dark and recessed, contrasting with the warm tan and reddish tones of the old brick.

Across the center of the image, the ruins become more fragmented: broken walls, partially collapsed arches, stair-like terraces, small doorways, and exposed brick layers create a complex, uneven landscape. Some areas are covered with patches of grass and climbing vegetation, giving the ruins a mix of archaeological and natural textures. A few smaller pathways and railings are visible, suggesting visitor routes through the site.

On the right side, a tall pale stone column stands prominently in front of darker brick ruins. Behind it are more large brick walls with rectangular openings, some heavily worn and pitted. Near the lower center-right, there are tiled roofs of smaller, more intact structures nestled among the ruins.

The upper portion of the image is lined with dense greenery. Tall cypress trees, rounded umbrella pines, and other Mediterranean trees rise above the ruins, forming a dark green canopy against a clear pale blue sky. The strong daylight creates sharp contrasts between illuminated stone surfaces and deep shadows inside the arches.

Overall, the image captures a panoramic view of an ancient archaeological site: layered Roman brickwork, monumental arches, scattered columns, tourist activity, and lush trees under bright, clear weather.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古罗马遗址的摄影照片。在画面中央，可以看到一座宏伟的圆形剧场结构，其石制外墙和圆顶结构清晰可见。周围散布着多座小型建筑遗迹，包括有柱子的房屋和一些破败的拱门。在遗址上方，树木茂密，为这个历史场景增添了一抹生机。图像前景左侧有一位游客正在拍照，而右侧则有一群人站在栏杆旁观看。

caption:
The image shows two packaged **Colgate ZigZag** toothbrushes lying diagonally and slightly overlapping on a plain white background.

- The toothbrush packages are long blister packs with clear molded plastic fronts and colorful cardboard backing.
- Both packages feature the large white **“Colgate”** logo on a bright red section, with **“ZigZag”** printed in bold white lettering on a purple/blue section.
- The front toothbrush, closest to the viewer, has a **purple handle** with a smooth, curved ergonomic shape. Its brush head is on the right side, with **multi-colored bristles** in blue, white, and yellow arranged in angled clusters.
- The second toothbrush behind it appears to have a **blue handle** and a similar bristle pattern. It is partially obscured by the front package.
- The packaging includes printed images of toothbrush bristles and some smaller product text, including Asian-language characters and English words describing features such as zigzag bristles.
- On the far right of each package is a purple hanging tab with a die-cut hole, indicating the products are meant to hang on a store display rack.
- The clear plastic blister reflects light, creating glossy highlights across the red and purple areas.
- The composition is simple and product-focused, with a lot of empty white space above the toothbrushes.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Colgate品牌牙刷的商业摄影风格图片。图中可见两支紫色包装的牙刷，上面印有'Colgate Zig Zag'字样和多种颜色的刷毛图案。牙刷被放置在纯白色的背景上，使得产品本身成为视觉焦点。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit view over a historic Mediterranean old town, seen from an elevated vantage point looking down across tightly packed stone buildings and narrow streets.

Most of the scene is filled with warm orange and terracotta roof tiles, arranged in overlapping rows across sloped rooftops. The roofs vary slightly in color—from bright red-orange to faded ochre and yellowed clay—suggesting different ages and weathering. Several chimneys, vents, skylights, and small dormer windows break up the rooflines, adding texture and detail.

The buildings are constructed from pale beige limestone or sandstone blocks, giving the town a bright, creamy appearance in the strong sunlight. Many façades have tall, narrow windows with shutters, some painted green and others white. The stone walls look old and weathered, with patches of discoloration, cracks, and uneven surfaces that give the area a historic character.

On the left side of the image, a large stone wall or building façade rises steeply, occupying much of the foreground. Its angled edge creates a strong diagonal line that leads the eye down toward the rooftops and street below. In the lower right foreground, part of a curved stone structure or stairway wall is visible, also made of pale stone blocks.

Near the bottom of the image, a narrow pedestrian street runs between the buildings. Several people are walking through the shaded lane, suggesting a busy tourist area. There are awnings and café umbrellas extending from the buildings, with outdoor seating visible beneath them. Red signs hang on some walls, though the text is too small to read clearly.

In the background, more old stone buildings rise behind the rooftops. Some have white shutters and aged façades. A lush green terrace or garden covered with vines and flowering plants appears near the upper center, contrasting with the stone and tile. Tall evergreen trees, including a dark cypress-like tree on the right, add vertical greenery to the scene.

The lighting is bright and golden, likely midday or afternoon sun, giving the entire image a warm, summery feel. Overall, the scene evokes an old European coastal city—historic, dense, and picturesque—with terracotta roofs, limestone architecture, narrow lanes, and a lively pedestrian atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲小镇街道的高分辨率摄影图像。图像捕捉了色彩丰富的建筑立面，其中包含有黄色和红色瓦片屋顶，以及白色墙壁上的窗户和门。在街道上，可以看到一些户外咖啡馆的遮阳伞和闲逛的人群。整个场景被温暖的日光照亮，营造出一种宁静而活跃的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, leafy urban canal scene on a sunny day. A narrow canal runs from the foreground into the distance, slightly curving and narrowing with perspective. The water is very calm and reflective, mirroring the trees, sky, and a tall building in the background. On the left side of the canal there is a well-kept grassy bank, edged by a low stone wall, with rows of trees and some parked cars along a street beyond it.

A small, low pedestrian bridge crosses the canal near the middle of the image. Behind it, the canal continues through a green, tree-lined city corridor. In the distance, a taller modern building with glass and brick sections rises above the surrounding lower buildings, giving the scene an urban backdrop.

The right side of the image features a wide brick-paved promenade lined with mature trees. Their trunks stand in a row along the walkway, and their dense green canopies cast dappled shadows across the pavement. Traditional multi-story buildings with light-colored facades and tall windows line the street on the far right, with parked cars along the curb.

In the foreground on the right, an adult and a child are walking hand in hand along the promenade. The adult is wearing a dark red shirt, light-colored shorts, and a backpack, while the child is wearing a colorful dress. Their faces are blurred. Farther to the right, a person sits on a bench near the parked cars.

The composition has a strong sense of depth, with the canal, walkway, rows of trees, and buildings all leading the eye toward the center of the scene. The lighting is crisp and warm, suggesting a clear spring or summer day. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, green, and leisurely, combining city architecture with a park-like canal setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园景观的照片，阳光明媚的天气下，一位成年女性和一个小孩在铺有砖块的人行道上行走。他们正沿着一条宁静的运河散步，运河两侧是郁郁葱葱的树木和草地。远处可以看到几座现代建筑，与周围的自然环境形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a bright, clear swimming pool with vivid turquoise-blue water and patterned blue pool tiles visible beneath the surface. Sunlight and movement create ripples, reflections, and wavy distortions across the water.

In the lower center of the image, an adult is standing in the pool while holding or supporting a baby. The adult’s face is blurred, and they are wearing a red-and-black swim cap or head covering, along with a long-sleeved swim outfit in dark and purple tones with some patterned fabric. The water reaches around the adult’s waist or lower torso.

The baby is in front of the adult, seated in a light blue inflatable neck or body float. The float has a soft pastel design with small cartoon-style illustrations and colored details. The baby’s head is above the float, with short hair visible, and the baby appears to be looking slightly downward or to the side. The float keeps the baby buoyant on the surface.

In the upper right area of the pool, another person is partially submerged and swimming underwater or near the surface. Only a blurred dark head and a blue/purple torso are visible through the rippling water, with bubbles and splashes around them.

Overall, the scene feels like a relaxed family swimming moment in a clean, brightly lit pool, with the focus on the adult assisting the baby in the inflatable float.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到家庭游泳活动的照片，画面中心是一位穿着红色上衣和蓝色裤子的成年女性，她正蹲在泳池边，用双手托着一个戴着蓝色救生圈的小婴儿。小婴儿似乎正在享受水中的乐趣，周围是清澈的蓝色泳池水面，阳光照耀下波光粼粼。在照片的背景中，可以看到另一位成年人在水中游泳，整个场景充满了轻松愉快的家庭氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide panoramic view of a waterfront cityscape on a bright, sunny day. In the foreground, a broad river fills the lower half of the scene, its surface slightly rippled and reflecting blue and gray tones from the sky. Along the riverbank is a long quay with a paved promenade, railings, mooring points, and a few small figures walking near the water.

A large blue-and-white ship is docked on the right side of the waterfront. Its bow faces slightly toward the viewer, and it has tall white masts and antennas. A smaller sailboat is moored nearby. Behind the quay, a multilane road runs parallel to the river, with a few cars visible, and an elevated bridge or overpass crosses the lower left portion of the image, supported by concrete pillars.

The middle ground rises into a green embankment covered with trees, shrubs, and lawns. A line of streetlights and pathways follows the slope. At the top of the hill stands an impressive group of historic buildings with varied architectural styles. On the left is a red-brick building with a steep red-tiled roof and decorative gabled façades; a sign on the roof reads “AKADEMIA MORSKA,” indicating a maritime academy. In the center is a large pale stone building with greenish copper roofs, arched windows, and a prominent square tower capped by a dark, flared roof and antenna. In front of it are smaller pavilion-like structures with copper-green domes, connected to terraces and grand stairways descending toward the river.

To the right, more ornate red-brick buildings appear, including a tall tower with a dark spire and layered roof sections. Another building has elaborate stepped gables and red roofs, giving the area a historic, institutional character. The architecture suggests a European riverside district, likely in Poland, with a mix of neo-Renaissance and early 20th-century civic design.

The background is dominated by a clear blue sky with large, soft white clouds scattered across it. The overall scene feels calm, open, and picturesque, combining river traffic, greenery, monumental architecture, and a well-maintained urban waterfront.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市河岸景观的摄影照片。在画面前方，一座现代风格的桥梁横跨河流，连接着两岸。河岸边有一艘大型船只停靠，其上覆盖着绿色的遮阳篷。背景中，一系列具有历史感的建筑群耸立，其中最显眼的是一个带有尖顶和圆顶的塔楼。周围环境由郁郁葱葱的树木和宽阔的草地组成，营造出一种宁静和谐的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit urban mosque complex set in a spacious brick-paved courtyard. The mosque has distinctive red-brick and white plaster architecture, with Moorish/Islamic design elements such as pointed arches, decorative crenellations, domes, and slender minaret-like towers.

In the center and left of the scene, the mosque’s long arcade stretches horizontally across the frame. Its façade is patterned with repeated white pointed arch shapes against red brick walls, creating a strong rhythmic design. Several columns support shaded walkways beneath the arches. A large white dome rises from the middle of the building, partially visible behind the front arcade. Multiple towers and minarets stand around the complex: some are red-brick with white bands and small domed tops, while one near the center has an open circular balcony and a loudspeaker mounted near the top.

The foreground is dominated by a wide courtyard paved with reddish bricks arranged in neat patterns. White stone or tile lines cut across the ground in geometric paths, forming long diagonals and rectangular divisions. Low landscaped beds with trimmed shrubs, small trees, and green plants soften the space around the mosque. Near the lower center-right, there is a decorative metal sign or stand on wheels, possibly containing visitor information or notices.

Palm fronds hang into the top-left corner, framing the scene and adding a tropical feel. On the far right edge, part of another building with white walls, dark trim, and red-brick detailing is visible.

Behind the mosque, modern high-rise buildings form a city skyline, contrasting with the historic religious architecture. One building on the left has a visible “Agro Bank” sign. Farther back, tall office and hotel towers rise against a vivid blue sky filled with scattered white clouds. The overall atmosphere is calm, clean, and open, with strong midday sunlight and crisp architectural details.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代与传统建筑风格融合的清真寺的照片。在前景，我们看到一座具有传统设计元素的清真寺，其红砖外墙和白色的尖顶塔楼在蓝天白云下显得格外引人注目。清真寺前是一个宽敞的广场，地面铺有红色砖块，并配有整齐排列的垃圾桶。广场周围种植着绿色植物，为这个城市空间增添了一抹自然色彩。在照片的背景中，可以看到几座现代化的高楼大厦，它们的玻璃幕墙反射着阳光，与清真寺的传统风格形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a large, retired passenger aircraft displayed outdoors in a public park or exhibition area. The plane is mounted above the ground on supports, with its landing gear visible near the rear. It is painted mostly white with a broad blue stripe running along the fuselage and a blue tail section. On the tail, the aircraft is marked “Як-42” and “RA-19751,” with a small Russian flag beneath the model marking. The rear-mounted jet engines are prominent: one engine is visible on the side of the tail, and another large engine nacelle is attached near the rear fuselage.

The aircraft stretches almost the full width of the image from left to right. Its nose is on the left, with cockpit windows visible, while the tail rises high on the right. A row of small circular passenger windows runs along the side of the fuselage. The plane appears to be part of a static display rather than in operation.

In the foreground, several people are walking or standing in the park. A woman with long hair, wearing light jeans and a white top, stands facing the aircraft near the center-left foreground. Other visitors are walking, cycling, or gathering around the display. Some people are partly obscured by bushes and signage. The area includes a paved walkway, neatly trimmed grass, shrubs, and small landscaped flower beds.

A vertical sign near the front of the plane advertises “Green City,” with colorful graphics and dates printed beneath it. Behind the aircraft on the left is a large modern building with a glass or metal facade. A large banner or mural on the building shows racing drivers in uniforms, with the text “RACING” visible and Cyrillic lettering above it.

The sky is bright and partly cloudy, with large white clouds filling the upper background. The overall scene has a sunny, open-air, museum-like or festival atmosphere, with the airplane serving as a major attraction in a landscaped urban public space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在户外的飞机模型的照片。飞机模型停放在草地上，周围有几个人正在参观。模型的尾部印有'RA-19571'的标识，机身主要为白色和蓝色，上面有一些俄文文字。背景中可以看到一些绿色植物、行人和骑自行车的人，以及一块显示足球运动员照片的大广告牌。

caption:
The image shows an ornate historic streetlamp in the foreground, set against the façade of a grand Venetian-style building.

At the center is a tall, weathered metal lamppost with multiple curved arms branching outward. The metal has a greenish-blue patina, suggesting aged bronze or copper, and is decorated with elaborate scrollwork, floral details, and sculptural flourishes. The lamp heads are large, cylindrical lanterns with reddish-pink glass panels, framed by dark green metal ribs and rims. Several of the lanterns are visible at different heights, giving the fixture a dramatic, chandelier-like appearance.

Perched on and around the lamps are numerous pigeons. Some sit on the tops of the lanterns, others balance on the curled metal arms, and a few are tucked near the bases of the lamps. Their dark gray feathers contrast with the warm pink glass and oxidized green metal. One bird appears slightly blurred in flight near the right side, suggesting movement among the otherwise still pigeons.

Behind the lamppost is an intricately detailed historic façade. The upper wall is made of patterned brick or stone in warm peach, cream, and pale terracotta tones, arranged in a diamond-like geometric pattern. There are Gothic-style arched windows with stone frames; one large pointed arch window appears behind the upper right lamp, while smaller arched and circular windows are visible higher up.

The lower portion of the building features elegant white stone arcades and columns. The arches have quatrefoil-like openings and carved decorative borders, with a row of slender columns and balustrades beneath. The architecture is richly ornamented, with carved stone details, pointed arches, and layered moldings, giving the scene a distinctly Venetian Gothic character.

Overall, the image captures a contrast between everyday urban life—pigeons resting on a public lamp—and the grandeur of historic architecture. The warm masonry, pale stone arches, pink lantern glass, and green patinated metal create a soft but richly textured color palette.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示位于一座欧洲古典建筑前的装饰性街灯的照片。街灯由绿色金属制成，顶部和底部各有一个红色灯笼，中间部分则装饰有精细的雕花。数只鸽子栖息在街灯上，增添了生动的自然元素。背景中的建筑物具有典型的欧洲风格，以红砖墙和白色石柱构成，拱形窗户上方装饰着复杂的几何图案。

caption:
The image is a close-up, macro-style photograph of a leafy plant. The main subject is a cluster of fresh, light-green leaves near the center and lower center of the frame. The leaves are small, textured, and slightly fuzzy, with clearly visible veins radiating outward from their centers. Their edges are sharply serrated, giving them a jagged, toothed outline.

A thin, slightly hairy stem runs diagonally from the left side toward the center, supporting the leaf cluster. On the left side of the image, there are darker, reddish-brown leaves or leaf remnants that look older, dried, or damaged compared with the fresh green growth. These darker leaves contrast strongly with the bright new leaves.

The background is heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field, creating a soft green and dark backdrop that suggests surrounding foliage. Some larger, out-of-focus leaves appear in the upper right and lower areas, but the central leaves are the clearest part of the image. The lighting is soft and natural, with a muted, cool green tone overall. The photo emphasizes the fine surface texture, tiny hairs, and serrated shapes of the young leaves.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示植物叶片特写的自然摄影风格图片。图像中心聚焦于几片绿色的叶子，它们排列在枝条上，叶脉清晰可见。背景是模糊的绿色植被，突出了前景中的植物细节。

caption:
The image shows a bright, busy urban boulevard in what appears to be a major shopping and business district, likely in Bangkok. The viewpoint is elevated, looking straight down a wide multi-lane road lined with large commercial buildings, malls, hotels, and advertising screens.

The road dominates the center of the scene, stretching from the foreground into the distance. It is divided by yellow lane markings and carries mixed traffic: buses, cars, taxis, motorcycles, and small trucks. A vivid pink taxi is prominent near the lower center-right, while a large yellow-orange bus occupies the lower left. Several motorcyclists ride in the middle lanes, and traffic becomes denser farther down the road near an elevated pedestrian bridge.

On both sides of the street are modern glass-and-steel buildings. The left side has a large glass-fronted complex with reflective blue-green windows, partially shaded by trees and awnings at street level. On the right, tall buildings crowd the sidewalk, including one with dark glass cladding and another section covered in construction sheeting or protective fabric, suggesting renovation work.

The skyline is filled with advertisements and recognizable commercial signage. In the middle distance, a tall tower rises above the surrounding buildings with a large “BMW 7 Series” advertisement wrapped around it. Below it are signs for “Amari” and “Novotel.” On the right side, a tall sign with a green-and-red “Big C” logo is visible, along with other mall and retail advertisements. Large digital billboards and posters cover several building façades, adding color and a sense of commercial energy.

There is greenery throughout the lower part of the scene: leafy trees along the sidewalks and medians, plus small landscaped areas near the shops. Pedestrian railings painted green run along the roadside, and a pedestrian skywalk or overpass crosses the road in the mid-distance, connecting buildings on both sides.

The weather is sunny and clear. The sky is bright blue with large white clouds, and strong daylight creates sharp shadows on the road and buildings. Overall, the image captures a lively metropolitan shopping avenue with heavy traffic, high-rise development, prominent advertising, and the dense, energetic feel of a modern Southeast Asian city.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的摄影照片。图像捕捉了街道上的车辆、行人和建筑，展现了城市的活力与繁华。在画面中央，一辆粉红色的汽车正沿着道路行驶，而其他各式各样的车辆也在道路上穿行。街道两旁是高楼大厦，其中一些大楼上装饰着大型广告牌。天空中散布着几朵白云，为这个城市场景增添了一丝轻松的气息。

caption:
The image shows a very crowded, sunlit canal-side celebration or boat parade. In the center and lower half, a large group of adults are packed closely together on what appears to be a party boat or floating platform. Many are dressed in festive, flamboyant outfits: bright gold and yellow accessories, bead necklaces, feather boas, wigs, headdresses, sequined clothing, and costume pieces. Several people are holding drinks, dancing, posing, or raising their arms, giving the scene a lively carnival or Pride-parade atmosphere.

A prominent wooden canal boat occupies the middle of the image, stretching horizontally across the frame. It has polished reddish-brown wood paneling and a row of arched glass windows, which reflect the crowd and sunlight. Through the windows, more people can be seen inside or reflected in the glass, adding to the feeling of density and movement.

In the foreground, the crowd is especially colorful. One person near the center wears a turquoise-blue, sparkling outfit with a large decorative headpiece or butterfly-like accessory. Nearby are people wearing gold body paint or gold-toned costumes, yellow feather boas, pearl-like bead strands, caps, sunglasses, and theatrical accessories. The lighting is warm and golden, with strong sunlight creating bright highlights on skin, costumes, and the boat’s glossy wood.

On the right side, more people crowd the edge of the boat and the canal-side area, many wearing summer clothing, sunglasses, and party accessories. In the background, above the boat, spectators stand along a building facade and on a raised balcony or stoop, watching the event. The urban setting includes building windows, railings, steps, and a shaded street-side area behind the canal.

Overall, the image captures a vibrant outdoor festival scene: packed crowds, costumes, music-and-dance energy, warm afternoon light, and the atmosphere of a public boat parade or waterfront celebration.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示街头狂欢节或游行活动的照片，人群聚集在一条街道上，参与者们身着各式各样的服装和装饰。一些人穿着闪亮的金色服饰，而其他人则装扮成海洋生物的样子，如鱼和海豚。他们中的一些人戴着头饰，有的还拿着气球。背景中可以看到观众站在建筑物的阳台上观看这一盛况。

caption:
The image shows an urban street scene on an overcast day, likely in a Japanese city. The viewpoint is from a bridge or raised roadway with a blue-gray metal railing in the foreground. The railing has decorative geometric patterns and bird-like silhouettes worked into the metal, and below it is a curb and a strip of asphalt road.

Behind the railing, several pedestrians are walking along the bridge. On the left, a person in a red jacket and blue cap walks with their head slightly down. On the right, two people are walking together: one wearing a light cream or white hooded coat, and another in a dark coat pulling a black rolling suitcase. Their faces are blurred. The wet-looking pavement and muted light suggest recent rain or damp weather.

The middle and background are filled with a dense cluster of low-rise buildings and traditional-looking houses. Many of the roofs have dark gray ceramic tiles, some with slightly curved edges typical of older Japanese architecture. The buildings are packed closely together, with narrow gaps between them. There are visible air-conditioning units, metal vents, pipes, small balconies, satellite dishes, antennas, and utility lines running across the scene.

Farther back, the architecture becomes more modern and taller, with boxy concrete and glass buildings. Near the center background is a pale tower with a clock face, rising above the rooftops. To the right are darker modern structures, including one black building or scaffolded facade. The sky is pale gray and cloudy, creating a soft, subdued atmosphere. In the far distance on the right, faint hills or mountains are visible through haze, adding depth beyond the urban area.

Overall, the image captures a quiet, everyday cityscape: pedestrians crossing a bridge in front of a layered mix of traditional rooftops, modern buildings, overhead wires, and a misty mountainous background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示京都街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面前方，有两位行人正在一座桥梁上行走，一位穿着红色外套和蓝色裤子，另一位穿着黑色外套和深色裤子。他们似乎在交谈或欣赏周围的景色。桥的栏杆是绿色的，与他们的服饰形成对比。背景中，建筑物密集且具有传统的日式设计，屋顶覆盖着雪，显示出季节可能是冬季。远处可以看到山脉轮廓，天空多云，整体氛围平静而宁静。

caption:
The image shows a bright winter scene in an urban park, centered on a large frozen fountain. The fountain has a broad, circular upper basin covered in thick ice, with long icicles hanging down all around its rim like jagged curtains. Ice has also built up heavily around the central pedestal and lower tiers, forming rounded, opaque white masses and translucent frozen sheets. Water is still visible in the basin below, dark and rippling in places, but much of the surface and surrounding ledge is coated with snow and ice chunks.

Snow is piled along the stone edge of the fountain in the foreground, with scattered broken pieces of ice lying on the frozen surface. The lighting is crisp and cold, with sunlight illuminating the surrounding buildings and casting a bluish winter tone over the ice.

Around the fountain, people are bundled in heavy coats, hats, scarves, and gloves. Some are walking through the snowy park area, while others stand near kiosks and signs. On the right side, there is a green-and-glass booth labeled “Bryant Park Shop” and “Tickets + Info,” suggesting this is part of a winter market or skating village. Other signs and temporary structures appear around the fountain, including white tent-like pavilions and vendor booths.

In the background, tall city buildings rise on all sides, mixing older stone architecture with modern glass skyscrapers. Bare winter trees frame the scene, their branches leafless against the bright sky. The overall atmosphere is lively but very cold, capturing a frozen fountain in the middle of a bustling city winter setting, likely Bryant Park in New York City.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园中被冰封的喷泉的照片。喷泉顶部和边缘覆盖着厚厚的冰层，周围积满了雪。在喷泉的背后，可以看到一些行人正在享受冬日阳光下的休闲时光，而更远处则是城市的高楼大厦，为这个寒冷场景增添了一丝温暖的色彩。

caption:
The image shows an ornate outdoor streetlamp or decorative light installation at night, set against a nearly black sky. The scene is dominated by warm gold and cool blue-white lights.

On the left side is a tall vertical metal post wrapped densely in strings of small yellow-gold lights, with some bright white and blue points sparkling along the structure. Near the top, a horizontal arrow-like ornament stretches across the frame, glowing in golden lights. It resembles a decorative weather vane, with a pointed arrowhead on the right and a feathered tail on the left. Rising above the arrow is a small gilded sculptural figure, possibly a bird or mythical ornament, also covered or illuminated in gold light.

Extending from the post toward the right is a curved, scroll-like support arm outlined in blue-white lights. The arm curls inward in a spiral, creating an elegant decorative flourish. Suspended below it is a large lantern with a domed top. The lantern glows with a strong amber-orange light from within, casting a warm halo around its lower portion. Its frame is outlined with yellow lights, while small white lights sparkle along the top and edges.

The background is very dark, emphasizing the illuminated decorations. On the far right, faint silhouettes of bare tree branches are visible, suggesting a winter or nighttime outdoor setting. The overall mood is festive, elegant, and atmospheric, with the contrast between the warm golden lights and the cool blue-white accents giving the scene a holiday-like appearance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示节日装饰的夜景照片，其中一盏装饰华丽的街灯在夜晚点亮，发出温暖的黄色光芒。灯柱顶部装饰着一个由蓝色和白色LED灯串组成的螺旋形图案，而灯柱本身则被金色的装饰物点缀。背景是深色的夜空，为这个场景增添了一种神秘和庆祝的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a small Eastern Orthodox-style chapel or church set among lush greenery under a bright blue sky. The building is centered in the frame and has a warm cream-and-gold color scheme with white architectural accents.

The most striking feature is the tall bell-tower-like upper section topped by a shiny golden onion dome. The dome has a faceted, scale-like pattern that reflects sunlight, and above it rises a slender metal Orthodox cross. Below the dome is a cylindrical tower with arched windows framed in white; one tall, narrow window with dark red-brown trim is visible near the front. A second golden roof band sits lower on the tower, matching the dome’s metallic finish.

The lower part of the chapel has classical elements: white columns, arched doorways, decorative trim, and a triangular pediment above the entrance. Within the pediment there appears to be a small colorful religious mosaic or icon panel. The front entrance has an ornate dark metal door with decorative scrollwork, framed by a white arch. The building sits on a raised platform with brown stone steps and a reddish-brown base.

Around the chapel is a landscaped area with metal fencing, benches, lamp posts, shrubs, and mature trees. Tall leafy trees rise on the right side of the image, partially framing the church, while more trees and greenery fill the left and background. A construction crane is faintly visible in the far-left background behind the trees.

In the foreground, two parked cars are visible along the street: a dark SUV on the left and a silver sedan on the right. Their license plates are blurred. The overall scene feels sunny, calm, and well-maintained, with the golden church dome standing out vividly against the pale blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座金色圆顶教堂的摄影图像。教堂位于画面中央，其金黄色的圆顶和装饰性细节在蓝天的映衬下显得格外醒目。教堂前有几辆汽车停靠，包括一辆黑色SUV和一辆银色轿车。周围环境由绿色树木和一些建筑构成，而天空则呈现出晴朗的蓝色。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor rugby match in progress on a bright, sunny day. The action is taking place on a green grass field near the sideline, with several players clustered around the ball.

In the center foreground, a rugby player in a light blue kit is carrying the ball low in his right hand while running or cutting across the field. His uniform includes a pale blue jersey and shorts, light blue socks with red-and-yellow striped bands, and bright pink boots. He appears to be leaning forward in motion, focused on advancing the play. Just behind and slightly to his right is a teammate in the same light blue uniform, also moving forward as support.

Opposing players in black-and-white kits are closing in. On the right side of the frame, a player wearing a black jersey with a large white number “13” on the back is facing the ball carrier, preparing to defend. Another black-clad player is partially visible on the left side, turned toward the central action.

A match official or referee in a yellow-and-green uniform is visible in the lower left foreground, running diagonally into the scene. His body is slightly blurred by motion, emphasizing the speed of the play.

In the background, behind the field, there is a low barrier with a digital advertising board displaying bright purple and red graphics. Beyond that is a metal fence with spectators standing behind it. Some spectators wear winter jackets, scarves, or team-colored accessories, suggesting cool weather despite the strong sunlight. A padded post or marker with an orange-and-black top stands near the sideline on the right side of the central action.

The overall scene captures a dynamic moment in a rugby game, with the ball carrier advancing while defenders and support players converge around him. The lighting is strong and crisp, casting defined shadows on the grass.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到橄榄球比赛精彩瞬间的照片。在图像的中心，一名穿着蓝色运动服的球员正专注地控制着橄榄球，准备进行下一步动作。他的对面是一名穿着黄色和黑色运动服的对手球员，似乎正在尝试防守或干扰。场地上的其他球员也在各自的位置上关注着比赛的发展。背景中可以看到观众席和其他一些模糊的运动员身影，为这张照片增添了现场观赛的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively, brightly lit urban shopping and entertainment street at night, likely in a Japanese city. The scene is packed with pedestrians walking through a narrow pedestrian street lined on both sides by tall buildings covered in illuminated signs, restaurant advertisements, and storefront displays.
