The surroundings are lush and rocky, with dense vegetation on both sides. On the left, a steep slope is covered with trees, bushes, vines, and a concrete retaining wall. The foliage includes green, yellow, orange, and reddish tones, suggesting fall. In the background, a hillside neighborhood is visible, with scattered houses in white, red, and dark colors perched among trees and rocky terrain.

The sky is overcast, pale gray, and cloudy, giving the scene a soft, muted light. Overall, the image depicts a calm roadway with traffic-monitoring infrastructure, autumn vegetation, and hillside residential buildings in the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道的照片，画面中心有一辆白色轿车正行驶在道路上。道路两旁设有交通信号灯和各种路标指示牌，包括一个蓝色的左转箭头标志、一个红色的限速50公里/小时标志以及一个禁止停车的标志。背景中可以看到覆盖着绿色植被的山坡上分布着一些房屋，天空多云，整体场景给人一种宁静的城市生活氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide river scene bordered by dense tropical forest. The water fills the lower half of the frame, dark gray-brown with small ripples and faint wake patterns spreading across the surface. Near the bottom center is a small passenger motorboat traveling across the river. The boat has a white cabin roof and front, a dark hull, and an open-sided passenger area with several people seated inside. One person in a bright blue shirt is standing near the front/side of the cabin, while others sit under the canopy, partially shaded.

The boat appears to be moving forward and slightly toward the viewer, creating a subtle wake and disturbed water along its sides. On top of the cabin are several round lights, and the boat has rectangular windows at the front and side. A greenish canopy or frame covers part of the passenger section.

Across the far bank, a thick wall of lush green rainforest stretches horizontally through the middle of the image. The trees are tall and densely packed, with varied shades of green and tangled vegetation, including vines and uneven canopies. Some trunks and branches are visible among the foliage, giving the forest a layered, wild appearance.

Above the forest, the sky is mostly overcast with large, soft, gray-white clouds. The clouds are heavy and textured, suggesting humid or rainy weather. The lighting is diffused, with no harsh shadows, giving the scene a calm, slightly muted atmosphere. Overall, the image conveys a river excursion or transport boat moving through a tropical rainforest environment under a cloudy sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘满载乘客的观光船在河流中航行的照片。船上的人们似乎正在享受周围的自然风光，而船上的导游则在引导他们。周围是茂密的绿色植被和多云的天空，为这个场景增添了一种宁静而自然的感觉。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor cultural performance on a raised stage, likely a Ukrainian folk dance or festival.

In the foreground, a group of female dancers are performing in traditional-style costumes. Most are kneeling or bending forward in a coordinated pose, while two dancers are standing upright. They wear bright white embroidered blouses with red floral patterns, full green skirts with red-and-white trim, red waist sashes or aprons, and red shoes. Several have green headscarves or colorful floral headpieces. The performers’ faces appear blurred.

Across the front of the stage are several black microphone stands with microphones angled toward the performers, suggesting this is part of a live show or public event. A large black speaker sits on the left side near the front edge of the stage, with visible cables running across the blue stage floor.

On the left side of the scene is a decorative building resembling a traditional rural house. It has a thick dark thatched roof and white walls painted with colorful folk floral designs in green, blue, yellow, red, and orange. The painted patterns frame the doorway and decorate the wall, adding to the traditional village atmosphere.

Behind the dancers, there are colorful backdrop panels. One yellow panel contains large blue Ukrainian text beginning with “Національний…”. On the right is a bright blue poster with cartoon-style figures in traditional dress and Ukrainian writing at the top. The poster includes cheerful illustrations, such as clouds and a large stylized character in folk clothing.

In the background, tall leafy trees provide shade and greenery. Near the center-right, a decorative stork figure is perched on top of a tall pole, reinforcing the folk or village theme. Sunlight filters through the trees, creating a warm daytime setting.

Overall, the scene captures a festive outdoor folk performance with traditional costumes, music equipment, decorative rural architecture, and colorful Ukrainian cultural imagery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乌克兰民间舞蹈表演的现场照片。在舞台中央，一群穿着传统绿色和红色服装的舞者正在跳舞，他们的动作协调而充满活力。一位女性舞者站在前方，身穿白色上衣和绿色裙子，头戴装饰性发饰，正指挥着其他舞者。背景中有一座茅草屋顶的小屋，上面挂着'Таутораалінг'的横幅，旁边是一个色彩鲜艳的儿童壁画墙。整个场景被阳光照耀，营造出一种欢快的节日氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, angled photograph of a black smartphone or tablet lying on a dark wooden surface. The device screen is displaying the Google Play Store page for **WhatsApp Messenger**.

At the top of the app page, there is a large teal-blue WhatsApp banner with faint doodle-style icons in the background. Centered on this banner is the familiar **WhatsApp logo**: a green speech bubble with a white telephone handset inside, alongside the word **“WhatsApp”** in large white lettering.

Below the banner, the app listing shows a larger green WhatsApp icon on the left, with the title **“WhatsApp Messenger”** and the developer name **“WhatsApp Inc.”** beneath it. A small age rating icon marked **“3+”** is visible near the title area.

On the right side of the listing is a prominent green **“INSTALL”** button. Beneath the title section, a pale green notification strip reads something like **“This app may not be optimized for your device.”**

Further down, the Play Store stats are partially visible: the app appears to have around **1 billion downloads**, a **4.4 rating**, and category/feature icons such as communication and similar apps. The lower portion of the screen is slightly out of focus, but text such as **“Simple. Personal. Secure.”** and **“READ MORE”** can be seen faintly.

The photo is taken at a diagonal angle, with the top of the device tilted toward the upper right. The screen is bright compared to the darker surroundings, and the black bezel of the device frames the display. The overall image emphasizes the WhatsApp app installation page and its branding.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在智能手机屏幕上的WhatsApp应用的图片。屏幕中央是该应用的图标，旁边有文字说明和一个绿色的下载按钮。下方是安装选项，包括简体中文、繁体中文、英文和其他语言的选择。整个界面设计简洁明了，以用户友好为特点。

caption:
The image shows two children riding bicycles along a rough, narrow dirt path in a bright, open grassy landscape.

In the middle distance, the children are positioned side by side, moving toward the camera. The child on the left is riding a red bicycle and wearing a bright pink short-sleeved shirt with blue shorts. The child on the right is riding a darker-colored bicycle and wearing a neon green shirt with blue shorts. Both children’s faces are blurred, and they appear to be balancing carefully on the uneven ground.

The path is sandy and patchy, with tufts of green grass growing through it. Tall, dry, golden grasses line both sides of the trail, especially around the children, creating a natural corridor. The foreground is slightly out of focus and shows more sandy ground mixed with low green vegetation, emphasizing depth.

In the background, there is a wide, gently sloping green hillside with sparse rocks and patches of exposed earth. A low eroded bank or cut in the terrain runs horizontally behind the children, separating the foreground trail area from the open grassy field beyond.

The lighting is bright and sunny, giving the scene a warm, outdoorsy feel. Overall, the image captures a rural or countryside setting, with the children cycling through a natural, grassy area on a sunny day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两位骑自行车的人在开阔的草原上骑行的照片。最前方的人物穿着红色上衣和黑色短裤，正骑着一辆红色自行车；紧随其后的是另一位穿着绿色上衣和深色裤子的人，他骑着一辆蓝色自行车。他们似乎正在享受户外活动的乐趣，周围是未被修剪的草地和远处模糊的树木。阳光照耀下，整个场景显得生机勃勃。

caption:
The image shows signage mounted on the exterior of a modern building with a gray, paneled facade. The wall is made up of large rectangular metal or composite panels arranged in a grid, with visible horizontal and vertical seams.

Near the upper center-left is a blue-and-white Hamilton logo: a square sign with a stylized white bridge-like graphic on a blue background, framed by a white border. To the right of it, large three-dimensional blue letters spell “Hamilton.” The letters are mounted directly to the wall and cast subtle shadows, suggesting bright daylight.

Below the Hamilton sign is another prominent sign for “Tim Hortons.” The words “Tim Hortons” appear in large red cursive script, also in raised lettering. On either side of the script are red horizontal banner signs: the left one reads “TERRAIN,” and the right one reads “FIELD,” indicating the venue is Tim Hortons Field. The red signs have white lettering and white trim, standing out strongly against the gray background.

There are visible shadows beneath the signage, especially under the red Tim Hortons letters, adding depth. The composition is tightly framed around the building signs, with no people, street, or sky visible. The overall impression is of the exterior entrance or facade of Hamilton’s Tim Hortons Field stadium.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在建筑物外立面的商业标志牌的照片。上方是一个蓝色和白色的徽标，包含一个类似建筑结构的设计，下方是大写的'Hamilton'字样。下方是一个红色的品牌名称，'Tim Hortons'，以及一个较小的文本'FIELD'。整个标志牌被安装在一个灰色的外墙上，背景简洁且没有其他干扰元素。

caption:
The image shows a picturesque rural village scene beside a shallow river or stream. The viewpoint is from the opposite bank, looking across the water toward a cluster of old stone houses and lush gardens.

In the foreground, the river runs horizontally across the bottom half of the image. The water is dark greenish-brown with ripples and small areas of white disturbance where it flows over rocks. Along the near bank are tall grasses, reeds, and wild plants in muted autumn tones—tan, green, and brown—partly obscuring the edge of the water.

Across the river, a low stone embankment made of irregular rocks forms the boundary of a garden. The garden is dense and colorful, filled with shrubs, flowering plants, ornamental grasses, and leafy perennials. There are patches of red and burgundy foliage, bright green bushes, pale yellow-green plants, and climbing vegetation. Near the center, a small wooden bench is tucked into the greenery, giving the garden a quiet, lived-in feel.

Behind the garden stands a row of traditional stone buildings. The houses are built from rough, weathered gray-beige stone, with slate or stone-tiled roofs. Several chimneys rise from the rooftops, and TV antennas are visible, adding modern details to the otherwise historic rural architecture. Some windows have white frames, while one lower structure has green-painted trim or a conservatory-like extension partly hidden by plants. On the right, a lower outbuilding has an aged roof and a wall covered in climbing red foliage.

A large leafy tree towers behind the houses on the right side, its broad canopy spreading above the rooftops. The tree adds height and frames the buildings against the sky.

On the left side of the image, beyond the houses and garden, the land rises into a grassy hillside. The hill is bright green and enclosed by traditional dry-stone walls that curve gently across the slope. A small wooden shed or outbuilding sits near the base of the hill, partly hidden by vegetation.

The sky occupies much of the upper portion of the image. It is bright and partly cloudy, with large white and pale gray clouds and patches of blue sky showing through. The lighting is natural and soft, suggesting a mild day with intermittent sunshine.

Overall, the scene feels peaceful, historic, and pastoral—an old countryside settlement nestled between a river, gardens, stone walls, and rolling green hills.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乡村景观的照片，画面中心有一条清澈的河流穿过前景，河岸上覆盖着绿色植被和多彩的花朵。河流对岸是几座传统的石砌房屋，房屋周围环绕着树木和灌木，营造出一种宁静和谐的氛围。背景中可以看到一片起伏的丘陵，上面覆盖着青草和零星的岩石。天空晴朗，云朵稀疏，为整个场景增添了一抹生动的色彩。

caption:
The image shows a large, imposing classical-style building on a city street, photographed from across a broad road. The building is painted deep red with extensive white architectural trim, giving it a strong contrast and formal appearance. It appears to be a hotel or historic civic building; Russian text on the façade reads “Гостиница Северная” (“Severnaya Hotel” / “Northern Hotel”), and the name “СЕВЕРНАЯ” is also displayed vertically on signs on both sides of the front.

The front façade is curved and symmetrical, dominated by a grand portico with tall white columns. These columns have ornate Corinthian-style capitals and support a decorative entablature with carved detailing. Above the entrance, the words “ГОСТИНИЦА СЕВЕРНАЯ” are set into the upper curved façade, along with the date “1901,” suggesting the building’s historical origin. There are white balustrades on the balconies and roof terrace, and the top level has an open, colonnaded structure or rooftop pavilion.

The building stretches back on both sides, forming a long rectangular block. Rows of evenly spaced windows run along the red walls, framed by white pilasters and decorative moldings. The central entrance has wooden double doors beneath the columns, and several flags are mounted above the doorway, adding a civic or international feel.

In front of the building, numerous cars are parked along the curb, including sedans, SUVs, and vans. A few pedestrians are visible near the entrance and on the sidewalk. There are street signs, including a pedestrian crossing sign, and the road in the foreground is wide and slightly wet or dark, suggesting recent precipitation or cold weather. Small patches of snow or slush are visible near the curb and sidewalk.

Overhead, many utility or trolleybus wires crisscross the sky diagonally, creating a web of dark lines above the building. The sky is mostly cloudy with soft gray and white clouds, but there are patches of pale blue showing through. The overall scene feels like a cold urban day in a Russian city, with the historic red-and-white building serving as the visual centerpiece.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有古典建筑风格的红白相间的建筑物的照片。建筑物位于街道的一侧，拥有多个白色圆柱和一个带栏杆的阳台。街道上停有几辆汽车，天空多云，为场景增添了一丝阴郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a wide urban skyline at sunset, viewed from an elevated position over a dense residential district. The foreground is filled with large apartment blocks—mostly gray, beige, and reddish-brown high-rises—with rows of small windows and balconies. Their façades are partly in shadow, giving the lower half of the image a cooler, darker tone compared with the sky.

Beyond the foreground buildings, the city stretches into the distance in layers of lower rooftops, industrial structures, and faint silhouettes softened by atmospheric haze. Near the center of the horizon stands a very tall, narrow, needle-like skyscraper, sharply silhouetted against the glowing sky. To its right, a low dome-shaped stadium-like structure is visible, and farther right a tall smokestack rises above the skyline.

The sky dominates the scene and is the most dramatic element. It is filled with intense sunset colors: deep orange and red close to the horizon, blending upward into golden yellow and pale amber. Thin, horizontal clouds catch the sunlight, forming bright streaks across the upper sky. Along the horizon, darker cloud masses have glowing edges, especially on the right side, where the sun appears to be hidden behind clouds, creating a fiery backlit effect.

Overall, the image has a panoramic, cinematic feel: a dense modern city under a brilliant orange evening sky, with the contrast between shadowed apartment blocks and the radiant sunset creating a striking atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市天际线在日落时分的照片。图像捕捉到了天空中橙红色的晚霞，太阳即将落下地平线，为整个场景增添了一抹温暖的色彩。建筑物密集排列，形成了城市的轮廓，而远处的山丘和建筑群勾勒出城市的边界。

caption:
The image shows a grand, castle-like historic building rising above dense green trees. It appears to be the Fairmont Le Château Frontenac in Québec City, recognizable by its dramatic green copper roofs, steep turrets, and château-style architecture.

The building dominates the scene, filling most of the frame. Its upper section features a very steep, oxidized copper roof in a vivid green patina, with many small dormer windows set into the roofline. Tall, thin spires and finials extend upward from the roof peaks and turret tops, giving the structure a fairy-tale, fortress-like silhouette.

The façade combines warm reddish-brown brick with pale gray stone trim. Rows of rectangular windows are arranged symmetrically across multiple floors, framed by light stone details. Several projecting gables and ornate stone elements add depth and texture to the front of the building. Rounded corner towers with conical green roofs appear on both sides, reinforcing the castle impression.

In the middle of the building, a row of flagpoles displays flags, including the blue-and-white Québec flag, the red-and-white Canadian flag, and another blue flag. Below and in front of the building, a dark statue of a standing figure is partially visible, placed on a pedestal among the trees.

The lower foreground is filled with lush, bright green foliage, which obscures the base of the building and creates a strong contrast with the stone and copper architecture. On the right side, leafy branches frame the image, and a small portion of a white-roofed pavilion or gazebo-like structure can be seen near the bottom right. The sky is pale and overcast, providing a bright, neutral background that makes the green roofs and architectural details stand out clearly.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一座具有传统欧洲建筑风格的城堡的照片。城堡位于画面中央，其绿色屋顶和红色砖墙在灰蒙蒙的天空下显得格外突出。城堡的多个尖顶塔楼高耸入云，每个塔楼上都装饰有精致的铁艺细节。前景中，树木的绿叶与城堡形成鲜明对比，增添了一丝自然的气息。

caption:
The image shows a large, modern technology exhibition or trade-show booth inside a spacious convention hall. The scene is bright, polished, and crowded, with many attendees gathered and walking through the display area.

At the center of the image is a striking suspended installation: a large black spherical structure made up of many rectangular screens arranged around it. The screens display alternating national flags, including the green Saudi Arabian flag with Arabic script and sword, and the United Arab Emirates flag with red, green, white, and black stripes. The sphere hangs beneath a large circular ceiling feature, creating a futuristic focal point.

Above the sphere is an oversized circular ceiling cutout with vivid magenta/purple LED lighting around its edge. The ceiling design is sleek and curved, with white panels, recessed spotlights, and exposed dark industrial ceiling elements visible beyond the booth structure. The purple lighting gives the booth a high-tech, cyber-themed atmosphere.

On the right side, a mezzanine-like upper level with glass panels and white railings overlooks the booth. Beneath it, a bright pink neon sign reads “CYBER SECURITY.” The booth has clean white flooring, white columns, and a minimalist, glossy design. Behind the cyber security area, there are dark digital-patterned wall graphics and screens, reinforcing the technology theme.

In the lower center and right foreground, many attendees are visible. A large number are men wearing traditional Gulf clothing: white thobes with white or red-checkered head coverings. Others wear Western business attire such as suits, shirts, and trousers. Some people are standing in small groups talking, while others walk through the exhibition space. A man in a light polo shirt stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, looking toward the central installation. Several faces appear blurred.

On the left side of the image, additional exhibition booths are visible in the background, including a blue booth with the name “TELTONIKA” displayed prominently. The left area has a darker carpeted walkway contrasting with the glossy white platform of the main booth. There are also camera equipment and groups of people gathered near the edge of the booth.

Overall, the image captures a busy, upscale technology or cybersecurity expo in the Gulf region, with a dramatic central multimedia display, national flag imagery, polished white architecture, magenta accent lighting, and a crowd of professional attendees.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代科技展览的摄影照片，图中中心是一个巨大的球形显示屏，上面展示了多块屏幕显示着不同的内容。周围是穿着传统服饰的人们，他们似乎在参观或讨论展览的内容。整个场景被现代化的灯光和装饰所环绕，营造出一种高科技的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, angled product shot of a **Myprotein** supplement pouch on a bright white background. Most of the frame is empty white space, while the product occupies the lower and right portions of the image, cropped so only part of the package is visible.

The pouch is primarily **black/dark charcoal** with a slightly glossy, crinkled plastic surface. Along the top and left edges, there is a textured sealed border with a fine grid-like pattern, typical of flexible food or supplement packaging. The package is positioned diagonally, slanting upward from the lower left toward the upper right.

Near the center-left of the visible packaging, the brand name **“MYPROTEIN”** appears in large, bold, white uppercase letters. Beneath it, in smaller thin lettering, is the slogan **“FUEL YOUR AMBITION.”** The typography is clean and modern.

On the right side of the pouch, there is a vertical **bright blue panel**. This panel contains small white icons and text, including a diamond icon with the words **“FINEST QUALITY INGREDIENTS”** around it. Below that, another icon is partially visible, with surrounding text beginning **“CUTTING…”**, though the rest is cropped off.

Lower down on the package, partially cut off by the bottom edge of the image, there is a hot pink label that reads **“WATERMELON FLAVOUR.”** Beneath that, large white lettering is partially visible, likely part of the product name, with only the ending letters such as **“AMINO”** visible.

The lighting is soft and bright, with subtle reflections on the plastic packaging. The focus is sharp on the branding area, while the minimal white background gives the image a clean, commercial product-photography feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示蛋白质粉包装的商业摄影图像。包装正面印有'MYPROTEIN'的品牌名称，下方是'FUEL YOUR AMBITION'的文字，表明产品是为了满足用户的抱负而设计的。包装的顶部有一条蓝色的标签，上面写着'SAFE TO EAT'和'Best Before'等信息。包装的背景是纯白色，突出了产品的细节和颜色。

caption:
The image shows a quiet residential roadside on an overcast, damp day. The foreground is dominated by a wet asphalt road, darkened by recent rain, with two parallel white road lines running diagonally from the lower left toward the right side of the frame. A small utility cover or drain is visible in the road near the bottom center.

On the right side, two parked vehicles sit in a driveway or parking area beside the street. The front vehicle is a dark navy or black compact 4x4/SUV with a boxy shape, roof rails, and muddy tires. Its front end faces toward the left, and the license plate is blurred. Behind it is a silver SUV, also facing left, with a roof rack and rain droplets visible on the windows and bodywork. The vehicles are parked close to a low stone wall made of irregular tan, brown, and reddish rocks.

Behind the cars is a dense, lush garden with many different types of greenery. There are tall, dark evergreen trees on the left, forming a thick vertical mass. To the center-right, a striking palm-like tree rises above the shrubs, with long spiky green leaves and rounded clusters of dense brownish foliage near the top. Other bushes and hedges fill the space around it, including glossy-leaved shrubs and climbing vegetation. A white or pale house is partly hidden behind the plants, with only sections of the roof and wall visible.

On the far left and right, more stone walls and garden borders frame the scene. Some low flowering plants with pale pink or white blossoms appear along the wall at the left. The sky is cloudy and gray, giving the scene a cool, muted atmosphere. Overall, it feels like a damp suburban or village street bordered by mature gardens, stone walls, and parked off-road vehicles.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示两辆汽车停靠在路边的自然光照下的照片。左侧是一辆银色轿车，而右侧是一辆黑色SUV。它们都停放在一条笔直的道路上，道路两侧是整齐排列的石墙和茂密的绿色植被。天空多云，给画面增添了一种平静而阴郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a grand, traditional hall or palace-like reception room with a highly symmetrical layout and ornate architectural detailing.

At the center is a large open sitting area framed by tall cream-colored columns with dark green trim. The columns support an upper balcony or mezzanine level with wooden balustrades. The railings are made of slender, turned wooden spindles painted in pale yellow/cream, with decorative bands in blue, red, purple, and white. Similar colorful striped details appear on column capitals and brackets throughout the space.

The ceiling is very high and elaborately constructed, with exposed wooden panels arranged in geometric triangular and octagonal sections. The beams converge toward the middle, creating a dramatic vaulted effect. Hanging from the center is a large brass or bronze chandelier with many curved arms, adding to the formal, historic atmosphere.

The walls are painted a soft pale green, bordered with dark green trim. Around the upper walls are decorative stained-glass or painted panels with floral and scrolling motifs in dark red, purple, blue, and black. The same ornamental patterns appear on side balcony panels and upper wall sections.

The main seating area at the back is arranged almost like a ceremonial reception space. There are many gold-framed chairs with cream upholstery placed in a semicircular arrangement around the back wall and along both sides. Several small matching tables are positioned among the chairs. In the center rear wall is a decorative panel with a crest or emblem, flanked by ornamental panels and potted palms. Large framed portraits hang on the left and right sides of the back wall, likely depicting important figures or royalty.

The floor is polished and reflective, made of reddish and beige stone or tile. A large dark patterned rug lies in the middle of the room beneath the chandelier, with a small sign placed near its front edge. At the front of the image, two large blue-and-white ceramic planters with green plants stand symmetrically on either side of the entrance to the central hall. More potted plants and gold chairs are visible along the left and right side areas.

On both far sides, there are side corridors or alcoves with additional seating, framed pictures, decorative lamps, and architectural openings. The overall design blends colonial, traditional, and royal decorative influences, with ornate woodwork, painted trim, polished floors, formal furniture, and a balanced, ceremonial arrangement. The scene feels quiet, well-preserved, and museum-like, as though it is part of a historic palace, royal residence, or heritage building.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示传统风格室内设计的照片，中心是一个带有精致装饰的高挑天花板，其上悬挂着复杂的吊灯。两侧是两层楼高的柱子，支撑着整个建筑结构。房间内部摆放着多把金色椅子和一些绿植，营造出一种庄重而优雅的氛围。墙壁上挂有几幅画作，增添了艺术气息。地面铺设有大理石瓷砖，反射出室内的光线。

caption:
The image shows a large boat displayed as an outdoor monument, mounted high on white concrete supports in a landscaped public area.

The boat is viewed from a very low angle near its bow, making the front of the vessel appear large and imposing. Its hull is painted dark gray or black on the upper sides, with a red lower section and a thin white stripe separating the colors. The underside of the boat is visible, showing red paint, seams, dents, and weathered patches. The bow has a worn, slightly rough surface with visible panel lines, cracks, and signs of age or repair.

On the side of the hull near the front, the number “36” is painted in large white numerals. A small rounded structure or cabin-like part is partially visible behind the side of the boat, suggesting it may be an old military or patrol-style vessel. The boat rests on a tall rectangular white pedestal and additional supports beneath it, raising it above the grass like a memorial or museum display.

The setting is green and park-like. There is a grassy lawn around the pedestal, with mature trees on both sides. On the right, a tree has many small red-orange berries or fruits. In the background, partially hidden by foliage, there are low buildings with reddish-orange roofs and brick chimneys. A paved area or road occupies the foreground, with a curb and strip of grass separating it from the monument.

The sky is overcast and pale gray, creating soft, diffuse lighting with few harsh shadows. Overall, the scene feels like a quiet public square or memorial park, centered around a preserved historic boat.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一艘巨大船首的现实主义风格照片。船首被放置在一个白色的基座上，基座位于一片绿色草坪上。船首的颜色为黑色和红色，上面清晰地印有数字'36'。在船首的背后可以看到几棵树木和一些低矮的建筑物，这些元素构成了一个宁静的城市公园环境。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a vivid pink water lily blooming above the surface of a pond. The flower is centered slightly to the right and is the main focus, with long, narrow petals radiating outward in layers. The petals are bright magenta-pink with lighter, almost white highlights near their bases, giving the bloom a glowing appearance. A few small water droplets are visible on the petals, especially on the right side.

At the center of the flower, upright pink stamens cluster together, partially enclosed by the inner petals. The blossom rises on a slender brownish-green stem from the water below.

Surrounding the flower are large, glossy green lily pads. The leaves have visible veins spreading outward from their centers and slightly wavy or serrated edges. Some areas of the leaves are shiny with moisture, and the dark pond water reflects patches of green and pink. In the background, there are additional water lily buds—one tall and striped with green, cream, and pink tones near the upper center, and another partly closed pink bud behind the main flower.

In the lower left corner, part of another pink water lily is visible, cropped by the edge of the frame. Beneath the water, faint brown stems and plant material can be seen. The overall scene feels lush, calm, and tropical, with strong sunlight emphasizing the saturated pinks of the flowers and the deep greens of the lily pads.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示粉红色睡莲的自然摄影风格图片。图像中心是一朵完全开放的睡莲花，其鲜艳的粉红色花瓣在阳光下显得格外生动。花朵位于画面中央偏上位置，周围是几朵尚未开放的花苞和绿色的荷叶。背景中模糊可见更多的荷叶和水面上的波纹，营造出一种宁静而生机勃勃的池塘环境。

caption:
The image shows a rugged coastal landscape dominated by an old stone castle or fortified tower on the right side of the frame. The building is made of weathered reddish-brown and gray stone, with thick walls, small narrow windows, and crenellated or decorative stonework near the roofline. A blue-and-white Scottish saltire flag flies from a pole at the top of the tower, emphasizing the likely Scottish setting.

The castle stands on slightly elevated grassy ground close to the shoreline. Its masonry looks aged and uneven, with patches of lighter stone at the corners and around openings, giving it a historic, medieval character. The sunlight falls warmly on the stone, highlighting the rough texture and varied colors of the walls.

In the foreground, dark, layered coastal rocks stretch across the scene. They are covered in bright yellow-orange lichen and pale patches, creating strong contrast against the black and gray rock. Small pools of water sit in the cracks and depressions between the rocks. Tufts of windblown grass grow among the stones, especially toward the right and center foreground, where the grass is green mixed with dry golden strands.

To the left, the sea extends into the distance, calm but slightly rippled. Across the water, low hills and a distant shoreline are visible under a hazy sky. The horizon is soft, with muted blues and greens fading into the background. A small wooden structure or pier appears near the waterline behind the rocks.

The sky takes up much of the upper left portion of the image and is pale blue with a few faint clouds near the horizon. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and windswept, combining historic architecture, coastal geology, and open seascape in a bright, natural setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海边古老城堡的摄影作品。在画面中，一座红褐色的石制城堡屹立于海岸线上，其上飘扬着一面蓝色旗帜。城堡周围是岩石和绿色植被覆盖的土地，而远处则是平静的海洋和地平线上的山丘轮廓。天空呈现出淡蓝色，云层稀疏，为整个场景增添了一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up of a blue mesh or vinyl windscreen attached to a chain-link fence, likely surrounding a sports field, court, or memorial facility. The material has a fine woven texture, with small perforations visible across the surface, allowing the diamond pattern of the chain-link fence behind it to show through.

On the right-center portion of the image, there is large black text reading “MEMORIAL,” though the word is partially cut off at the bottom and right edge. Above the text is a simple logo or graphic made of vertical bars: one dark bar and two light/white bars, plus a larger teal-blue vertical shape that blends somewhat into the background. The design appears printed directly onto the blue screen.

The fence’s diamond grid is especially visible near the top and upper-left area, where bright daylight shines through. Shadows and reflections create layered patterns on the surface, including diagonal lines and faint silhouettes behind the mesh. The overall color palette is dominated by turquoise-blue, black, and white, with strong sunlight giving the scene a slightly reflective, glossy look. The camera angle is tilted, making the text and fence lines appear diagonal across the frame.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在蓝色遮阳网上的'MEMORIAL'字样和一个白色三角形标志的照片。照片通过铁丝网的缝隙拍摄，背景是模糊的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows the front of a large, barn-like building labeled **“COACHMANS HALL”** on a weathered sign above the entrance. The building has a tall triangular gable with white painted paneling and dark brown trim along the roof edges. The sky above is overcast, giving the scene soft, muted lighting.

The entrance is framed by two large **red sliding barn doors**, both pushed open to reveal a covered passage or small shopping arcade inside. The red doors are tall, made of vertical wooden planks, and mounted on dark metal sliding tracks. Above the entrance, beneath the main sign, there is a dark horizontal wooden facade with a hanging black sign that reads **“AB GALLERY”** in large white letters.

Inside the entryway, several shopfront details are visible: posters, a **Lotto “Play here”** sign, a small freestanding signboard, and a dimly lit interior corridor leading farther back. A small hanging light glows under the doorway.

On the right side of the entrance, a small brown sign says **“No Skating or Biking in Coachman’s Hall Thank you”**. Below it is a planter with green shrubs and a few small flowers. Farther right, mounted near the street, is a blue parking sign that reads **“P 60 8am - 6pm Mon - Sun”** with a directional arrow.

The foreground shows a paved street and curb with yellow road markings and part of a white parking bay line. The overall look is rustic and slightly old-fashioned, with the red barn doors and faded vintage-style lettering giving the building a historic marketplace or arcade feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Coachman's Hall建筑入口的照片。建筑物的正面是白色的，顶部有红色的横梁和屋顶。入口处有一块大型招牌，上面写着'COACHMANS HALL'，并带有金色装饰边框。门上方悬挂着一个黑色的标志牌，上面写有'AB Gallery'。入口两侧各有一个红色的门，左侧的门上挂有宣传海报。门前摆放了一盆绿色植物，增添了一些自然气息。背景中可以看到多云的天空和一些树木。

caption:
The image shows the front of an old, rustic stone building, likely near a waterfront or fishing area. The building fills most of the frame and is made from irregular dark gray, black, and brown stones set in rough mortar. Its surface is weathered, uneven, and patched in places, giving it a handmade, aged appearance.

The roof is a simple pitched roof with reddish clay tiles along the edges, but much of it looks worn and damaged. The top ridge and roof edges appear covered with rough concrete, debris, or dried vegetation. Several loose wires or ropes hang down from the roofline, adding to the improvised, working-structure feel.

On the front wall, slightly left of center, there is a yellow wooden cross or sign-like frame mounted vertically and horizontally. Beneath and around it are many long poles or oars leaning against the wall. Some are plain wooden poles, while others have white bands painted around them; one tall red pole stands out among the muted browns. A weathered turquoise-green rectangular board leans near the bottom center-left, scratched and faded.

On the right side of the wall is a small dark chalkboard or black panel set into a rectangular frame. It has simple chalk drawings on it, including fish-like shapes and rough markings or symbols. Nearby, there are patches of paint or chalk in pale colors on some of the stones.

At the far left, part of an attached lean-to or shelter is visible, made of wood, cloth, and corrugated-looking materials. It is cluttered with ropes, nets, and hanging objects, suggesting fishing equipment or a work area. A bundle of blue netting or fabric appears in the lower-left corner.

The background is mostly a pale blue sky, and on the far right edge there are hints of water and industrial harbor equipment, including a crane-like structure. A person in a light blue garment is partially visible at the lower right edge, walking near the building, but they are not central to the scene.

Overall, the image has a coastal, utilitarian atmosphere: a weather-beaten stone fishing hut or storage building, surrounded by poles, nets, ropes, and signs of daily manual work.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一座由石头堆砌而成的简陋小屋的照片。小屋的屋顶部分已经破损，露出下面的石块和木梁结构。小屋的一侧有一个绿色的门板，上面用粉笔写着'GIFT'字样。门前堆放着各种工具，包括锤子、铲子和其他建筑用品。在小屋的右侧，可以看到一片模糊的水域，可能是一个海湾或海洋。

caption:
The image shows a large Spanish flag flying from a tall flagpole against a clear, dusky blue sky. The flag occupies the right side of the frame, while most of the left and upper portions are open sky, giving the composition a spacious, minimal feel.

The flag is partially wrapped and folded around itself, suggesting a light breeze or a moment when the fabric has twisted around the pole. Its red and yellow horizontal bands are visible, with the central yellow band appearing wider than the red bands above and below. Part of the Spanish coat of arms can be seen on the yellow section, though it is partly obscured by the folds of the fabric. The cloth appears semi-translucent in places, with darker shadows where layers overlap and brighter reddish and golden tones where light passes through.

The flagpole rises vertically near the right side of the image. At the top, a narrow metal section and small hardware pieces are visible, including ropes or halyard lines running alongside the pole. The pole itself continues downward out of the frame.

The lighting is subdued, likely taken during early evening or twilight. The sky has a soft gradient, ranging from a deeper blue near the top to a slightly lighter blue toward the lower left. There are no clouds, buildings, people, or other objects visible, making the flag the clear focal point. The overall mood is quiet and solemn, with the flag standing prominently against the empty sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示西班牙国旗在晴朗天空中飘扬的照片。国旗由上至下依次为黄色、红色和蓝色，中间有西班牙国徽的图案。旗帜被固定在一个高高的旗杆上，在蓝天的映衬下显得格外鲜明。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor coastal or mountainous setting under a dramatic, cloudy sky. In the foreground, a person stands near a weathered concrete barrier or wall. Their face is blurred, and they are turned in profile, leaning slightly forward with their hands tucked into the pockets of a light beige or taupe jacket. They wear a muted brown baseball cap, with gray hair visible beneath it, and loose gray trousers. A pale shirt hangs below the jacket hem.

The person occupies the center-right of the frame, while the left side opens up into a wide expanse of sky. The sky is filled with layered clouds in soft grays, blues, and whites, giving the scene a cool, overcast atmosphere. The lighting appears natural and diffused, with no harsh shadows.

In the lower foreground, the concrete barrier is heavily worn: its white paint is chipped and peeling, revealing dark patches underneath. There are rust stains and rough textures along the wall, adding an aged, rugged feel. On the far right, a taller rough stone or concrete wall with embedded rocks runs upward and back into the scene.

Behind the person, the background reveals a steep green hillside or cliff. The slope is covered in vegetation with patches of exposed rock and a few small structures or roads visible in the distance. The landscape suggests a coastal cliffside village or mountain road overlooking the sea, though the water itself is mostly obscured by haze and the person’s position.

The overall composition has a wide, panoramic feel, with the person framed against the open sky and rugged terrain. The image has strong texture and contrast: soft clouds above, rough chipped concrete below, and lush green cliffs to the right. The mood feels windswept, quiet, and contemplative.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位男性站在海边岩石上的照片。他穿着一件棕色的夹克，搭配灰色裤子和白色衬衫，头戴一顶米色帽子。他的身体略微侧向，似乎在观察远处的景象。背景中，天空多云，海面波光粼粼，而岩石表面覆盖着苔藓和贝壳残骸。

caption:
The image shows a quiet urban street in winter, covered with fresh snow. A two-lane road runs from the foreground into the distance, slightly curving or receding toward a small town center. The asphalt is mostly clear but wet and dark, with snow piled along the edges and on the central roadside areas. Short black-and-yellow bollards line the median/roadside strip on the left side of the road.

On the right, a wide sidewalk is blanketed in snow, though a narrow path has been compacted by footprints and foot traffic. A single person wearing a dark coat and hood walks away from the camera along this sidewalk, carrying a bag in one hand. Beside the sidewalk is a tall fence with stone posts and black metal railings, all capped with thick layers of snow. Large evergreen trees overhang the sidewalk, their branches heavily dusted with white snow.

On the left side of the street are older buildings with pitched roofs and pastel facades, including peach, cream, and pale green tones. Their rooftops and window ledges are coated with snow. Behind and around the buildings are bare deciduous trees, some still holding a few brown leaves, along with smaller snow-covered shrubs. A parked car sits along the left curb, partially surrounded by snow.

Several street signs are visible near the road: a blue parking sign with a white “P,” a red-and-blue no-parking/no-stopping sign, and a red stop sign farther down the street. There are also streetlights and utility poles, with many overhead wires stretching diagonally across the sky and adding a dense network of lines above the road.

The background features a low wooded hillside, dark and muted under the winter light. The sky is overcast and dramatic, filled with heavy gray clouds with a slightly brighter patch near the horizon. The overall atmosphere is cold, calm, and subdued, with the snow softening the townscape and giving the scene a quiet, early-winter feeling.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冬季城市街景的照片。图像中心是一条被雪覆盖的街道，街道两侧排列着各式各样的建筑，包括有窗户和阳台的住宅楼以及一些商店。在街道的一侧，可以看到一个穿着深色冬装的人正在沿着人行道行走。树木的枝叶上积满了厚厚的雪，而天空中布满了厚重的云层，预示着可能的降雪。

caption:
The image shows a large, chalet-style house surrounded by lush greenery on a bright, sunny day.

The house has a steep, red metal roof with multiple sloping sections and prominent triangular gables. The roof appears slightly weathered, with visible panel seams and a chimney rising near the center-left portion. The chimney is made of brick or stone with a darker cap at the top. The upper front gable has a deep overhang and dark wooden underside, giving the building an alpine or mountain-lodge feel.

The exterior walls are a pale mint-green or light cream-green color. On the upper floor, there is a balcony with a dark metal railing. Behind it are glass doors or windows, and a small flower box with blooming plants sits along the balcony edge. Below, a row of wide windows spans the front facade, with additional flower boxes containing red and white flowers. The windows have white frames and curtains visible inside.

The lower portion of the house features a stone foundation or retaining wall made of irregular light-colored stones. A short set of steps and a concrete walkway lead toward the building from the foreground. There is also a covered patio or entrance area on the left side, supported by a cylindrical column, with glass doors beneath it.

The property is surrounded by dense vegetation. Tall evergreen trees rise behind and beside the house, while leafy shrubs fill the right side of the image. A green lawn stretches across the foreground, and sunlight creates bright highlights on the grass and walls. In the background, another building is partially visible to the left, suggesting this may be in a residential or resort-like area.

The sky is clear blue with large, soft white clouds, creating a warm and peaceful atmosphere. Overall, the scene feels like a quiet mountain or countryside home set in a verdant, well-established garden.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一座两层的现代风格住宅的照片。房子的设计简洁，以白色和浅绿色为主色调，搭配红色瓦片屋顶。一楼有一个带有窗户的石墙入口，而二楼则有两扇大窗户和一个带栏杆的阳台。房子周围被郁郁葱葱的树木环绕，包括一棵高大的松树和一些低矮的灌木。在房子前方有一条小径通向房子，而在房子后方可以看到更多的绿色植被和远处的山丘。

caption:
The image shows a large ceremonial parade taking place in an urban plaza, likely in Putrajaya, Malaysia. A massive Malaysian national flag is being carried horizontally across the center of the scene by a large group of uniformed personnel. The flag dominates the composition, stretching almost the full width of the image, with its red and white stripes on the left and the blue canton with the yellow crescent and star on the right.

In the foreground, rows of marching participants move from left to right in front of and alongside the flag. They appear to be members of various uniformed services, wearing different camouflage patterns and dark uniforms—some in green camouflage, others in blue-gray digital camouflage, white-gray camouflage, and black uniforms. Many wear berets, black boots, and white gloves, suggesting a formal parade or national celebration. Their synchronized movement gives the scene a disciplined, ceremonial feel.

Behind the flag, there are many trees partially obscuring a large white building with vertical architectural panels. The building has the text “PERBADANAN PUTRAJAYA” prominently displayed across its facade, indicating the Putrajaya Corporation. Malaysian flags hang repeatedly along the upper levels of this building as decorations. A tall Malaysian flag on a pole stands near the center-right, rising above the giant flag being carried.

On the far right, a raised platform or stage holds a uniformed band or ceremonial group dressed mostly in white, with some darker uniforms visible. A long decorative banner behind them features Malaysian patriotic imagery, including a Malaysian flag graphic, the phrase “Sayangi Malaysiaku,” and illustrations of landmarks, reinforcing the national celebration theme.

The background includes modern government and office buildings with glass and steel facades. On the left, a teal-glass building stands beside another modern structure marked “MENARA PRISMA.” On the right, a tall white-and-glass building frames the scene. The sky is overcast, casting soft, even light over the plaza.

The ground is a broad paved public square with patterned tiles in muted red, gray, and beige tones. Spectators can be seen gathered behind barriers on the left side, watching the procession. Overall, the image captures a patriotic Malaysian parade with a grand flag display, military or uniformed participation, and official buildings forming the backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在城市广场上举行的军事仪式的照片。照片中，一排穿着制服的士兵整齐地排列着，他们正小心翼翼地举着一面巨大的马来西亚国旗。国旗色彩鲜明，与周围的现代建筑和人群形成对比。在士兵的背后，可以看到观众们聚集在一起观看这一庄严的场合。建筑物的设计简洁现代，而天空中的云朵为这个场景增添了一丝柔和的背景。

caption:
The image shows a sunny urban street scene, likely in a town or small city in Spain or another European Mediterranean area. The sky dominates the upper half of the image: it is a vivid blue with a few scattered white clouds, giving the scene a bright, warm midday feel.

On the left side is a modern public-looking building made mostly of reddish-orange brick. It has a distinctive cream-colored cylindrical tower section near the center-left, with a tall vertical recessed window or opening. The building also has balconies with metal railings, dark-framed windows, and a covered entrance supported by round columns. A broad set of shallow red-tiled steps leads up to the entrance, and the foreground pavement is also red brick or terracotta-colored.

In front of the building are several flagpoles. The most visible flag is the European Union flag, blue with yellow stars, blowing strongly in the wind. Beneath or beside it are other flags, including one with red and yellow horizontal colors that appears to be the Spanish flag, and another blue-toned flag. The wind is also visible in strings of small white triangular bunting or pennants stretched across the street to the right.

The foreground includes decorative landscaping: leafy green shrubs on the left, large potted plants, and small palm-like plants in round planters along the walkway and street edge. The bright sunlight creates sharp shadows on the building and ground.

To the right, a street runs alongside the plaza. Several cars are parked along the curb, including white and red vehicles. There are tall modern streetlights and a black traffic signal or pedestrian crossing signal near the right edge. In the background are lower residential or commercial buildings with flat roofs, rooftop antennas, and muted facades in gray, beige, and brick tones. The scene feels calm and orderly, with no large crowds visible—just a quiet civic square or town-center street under clear weather.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影图像，前景左侧有一棵绿叶茂盛的树和一个装有植物的大盆栽。中景是一座现代风格的建筑，其特点是圆顶和几何形状的设计元素。在建筑前方是一个宽阔的人行道，上面种植着几株棕榈树和其他绿色植被。街道上停有多辆汽车，包括一辆红色轿车和一辆黑色SUV。背景中有其他建筑物，其中一些建筑上装饰有彩色的气球。天空晴朗，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a bright, sunlit street scene in what appears to be a Middle Eastern city, likely in Oman based on the yellow Arabic license plates and architectural style.

On the left side, a striking mosque minaret rises above a row of white buildings. The minaret is tall and cylindrical, decorated in vivid shades of blue with ornate floral and geometric patterns in gold, white, and turquoise. Near the top are arched openings, decorative bands, and a rounded dome capped with small golden finials. Its colorful tilework contrasts strongly with the pale buildings and the hazy blue sky.

Below the minaret, the street is lined with whitewashed buildings featuring traditional architectural details: arched windows, carved balcony railings, decorative lattice panels, and shaded verandas. Some of the structures have narrow staircases and recessed entrances. The buildings look dense and closely packed, creating a narrow pedestrian corridor along the street.

A large date palm tree dominates the center-right of the image. Its thick trunk rises from near the curb, and its long, feathery fronds spread outward in many directions, partially covering the view of the street and background. The palm adds a strong tropical/desert character to the scene.

On the right side, several parked cars occupy the curbside, including a black Toyota SUV and a beige Suzuki vehicle in the foreground. Their yellow license plates with Arabic script are clearly visible. A blue parking sign or parking meter with a large yellow “P” stands near the palm tree, reinforcing that this is a parking area.

The street itself is paved with light gray bricks or cobblestones and curves gently into the distance. Red-and-white bollards line part of the walkway near the curb. A few pedestrians are visible: one man stands at the far left in a blue shirt, while others walk farther down the street, including a person in traditional white clothing.

In the background, beyond the palm and buildings, faint rocky hills or mountains can be seen through the haze. The overall atmosphere is hot, dry, and calm, with strong daylight, pale colors, and a quiet urban street lined by traditional white architecture and Islamic decorative elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中东风格城市街景的照片。在画面的左侧，有一座装饰华丽的蓝色尖塔建筑，其顶部装饰着复杂的图案和色彩。街道上停放着多辆汽车，包括一辆金色的SUV车。街道旁边有几棵棕榈树，为这个场景增添了一丝热带气息。街道上有几位行人正在行走，其中一位穿着传统服装的人正从建筑物前走过。远处可以看到更多的建筑物和一片山脉，构成了一个典型的中东城市环境。

caption:
The image shows a large white Class C motorhome/RV parked in profile along a paved roadside turnout. The RV takes up most of the lower half of the frame, while a wide, deep blue sky fills the upper portion. The sky is mostly clear with faint, wispy clouds stretched horizontally.

The motorhome appears to be a Winnebago “Minnie” model, with the word “Minnie” visible on the side and a large stylized “W” graphic below it. It has beige, gray, blue, and brown swooping stripe decals along the side. The vehicle is built on a Ford E-350 chassis, visible on the front cab area. The cab is at the right side of the image, with a white side mirror, tinted window, and rounded front hood. Above the cab is the over-cab sleeping compartment, with a curtained window on the side.

Along the side of the RV are several features: a main entry door near the center-right, multiple rectangular windows with blinds or curtains, exterior storage compartments near the bottom, a small utility hatch, vents, and an extended awning mounted along the upper side. On the roof are rooftop accessories, including what appears to be an air-conditioning unit and a rounded roof vent or cover.

At the rear of the RV, on the left side of the image, several bicycles are mounted on a rear bike rack. The bikes are dark-colored with visible handlebars and wheels, clustered closely together.

The RV is parked beside a low stone barrier made of tan rocks. Beyond the barrier, the background reveals a mountainous landscape with rocky slopes and patches of lingering snow. The scene suggests a high-elevation or alpine viewpoint. The lighting is bright and direct, indicating a sunny day, with crisp shadows under the vehicle. The overall mood is calm and travel-oriented, evoking a road trip or camping stop in the mountains.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆停在路边的房车的照片。房车为白色，车顶有棕色条纹装饰，车身侧面印有'Minnie'字样和一些图案。车辆后部装有一个自行车架，上面放着一辆红色的山地自行车。照片背景是蓝天和远处连绵的山脉，阳光明媚，天空几乎没有云朵。

caption:
The image shows a large city bus driving along a steep urban street in daylight. The bus dominates the foreground, angled slightly toward the viewer from the front-left side, making it appear very close and imposing. It is mostly white with green and yellow striping along the lower side, and it has a dark gray/black front bumper and tinted windows. The front windshield is very large and curved, reflecting trees, buildings, and a web of overhead utility wires. An orange LED route sign is visible near the top of the windshield, though the text is not fully clear.

The bus has multiple side windows and doors, with a few passengers faintly visible through the tinted glass. The driver’s area can also be partially seen through the front window. The side mirror on the left projects outward, and the windshield wipers rest across the lower portion of the glass. The front headlights and indicator lights are visible, and the license plate at the bottom front appears blurred.

The street is paved and slopes upward or downward noticeably, with double yellow lines running down the center. On the right side of the road, farther in the background, a motorcyclist wearing a helmet is riding uphill or along the same road. The bus is traveling close to the curb on the left side of the frame.

The setting appears to be a dense city neighborhood. On the left, there are older buildings with worn, pale-colored walls, barred windows, and decorative metalwork. Many black utility cables stretch across the scene overhead, crisscrossing the sky and reflecting in the bus windows. In the background to the right, there are trees, mid-rise brick apartment buildings, and a tall sign or billboard structure.

The lighting is bright and natural, with strong sunlight illuminating the bus and casting shadows across the road. The sky is partly cloudy, with a mix of blue-gray clouds and bright areas. Overall, the image captures a busy urban transit moment on a steep city street, with the bus as the central subject and the surrounding wires, buildings, and traffic emphasizing a lively metropolitan environment.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公交车的现实主义风格照片。一辆绿色和白色相间的公交车停靠在街道上，车身侧面有'PRTA'的标志，表明它可能属于某个特定的城市交通系统。车辆前方装有前照灯和一个大型的挡风玻璃，车窗反射出周围环境。背景中可以看到建筑物的一部分，以及一些树木和电线杆，这些元素构成了典型的城市街景。

caption:
The image shows the façade of an ornate historic building on a sunny day. The building is painted in a striking combination of deep red and cream, with the cream-colored trim forming elaborate decorative frames, pilasters, moldings, and relief details across the front.

The architecture appears classical or baroque-inspired, with rich ornamentation. The upper façade has tall rectangular windows with dark wooden frames and reflective glass. Some windows are protected by black metal lattice grilles. Around the windows are carved cream moldings, floral garlands, scrollwork, and rectangular decorative panels. Vertical cream pilasters divide the façade into sections, and the wall surfaces between them are painted bright red.

Near the top, there is a raised central dormer or upper structure with a curved pediment and a large dark-framed window. The roofline includes cream cornices and red accent panels, with a black wrought-iron railing visible along part of the roof edge. The sky above is clear and vivid blue, emphasizing the bright colors of the building.

At street level, the building has large arched entrances. In the center is a tall dark wooden double door set within a cream archway. To the right is a large reddish-purple gate or pair of doors with decorative panels. On the left, a smaller arched window or doorway has open reddish shutters. The lower wall features a grid-like pattern of cream trim over red panels, matching the rest of the façade.

In the foreground, there is a patch of green grass and a paved sidewalk running along the building. A leafy green tree partially covers the left side of the image, adding natural contrast to the architectural scene. Behind the historic building, a more modern pale green building is partially visible, creating a contrast between old decorative architecture and newer urban structures. The lighting is bright and crisp, with strong sunlight illuminating the façade and casting soft shadows.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示古典建筑风格的建筑特写照片。建筑物以红色和白色为主色调，装饰有复杂的几何图案和线条。建筑的一侧有一个拱形门廊，上方悬挂着一排窗户，窗户周围装饰有精美的石雕。建筑的另一侧是两扇关闭的深色木门，门上方也有类似的石雕装饰。在建筑前方，可以看到一片绿色的草地和几棵树木，为这座历史悠久的建筑增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows a lush, formal garden under bright daylight, filled with dense greenery and carefully maintained landscaping.

In the foreground is a broad, neatly cut lawn with short, even grass. Near the center front stands an ornate metal or bronze garden lantern or decorative urn on a pedestal. It has a tiered base, carved-looking panels, a rounded perforated body, and a pagoda-like top with curled ornamental edges and a finial.

Behind it, low geometric hedges create structured borders across the garden. The hedges form horizontal lines and layered terraces, emphasizing the formal design. Small red flowers are visible in beds behind the hedges, adding touches of color among the greens.

The middle of the image is dominated by large trees. A broad, feathery-leaved tree spreads across the center, its branches and fern-like foliage forming a wide canopy. To the right is a rounded, glossy-leaved citrus-like tree with many small orange or yellow fruits visible among the leaves. Farther right, a darker tree has reddish-brown hanging foliage or exposed roots, creating a contrast with the surrounding green.

In the background, tall, narrow cypress trees rise vertically, giving the garden a Mediterranean appearance. Their dark green, columnar shapes stand behind the softer, spreading trees. A palm trunk and palm fronds are also visible on the left side, suggesting a warm climate. Beyond the trees, a faint hillside and patches of blue sky can be seen.

There are several decorative garden elements scattered throughout: urns or vases near the hedges, a pale ornamental gate or screen in the mid-right background, and a small multi-globe lamp post partly hidden among the foliage. The sunlight creates bright highlights on the grass and leaves, while the trees cast soft shadows across the lawn. Overall, the scene feels peaceful, elegant, and carefully cultivated, like a botanical garden, palace garden, or historic estate grounds.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示精心设计的花园景观的照片。在画面中央，有一个装饰性的铁制喷泉，其周围是修剪整齐的绿色草坪和丰富的植被。左侧有一棵高大的棕榈树，而右侧则有几棵茂密的树木和灌木。背景中可以看到一些低矮的篱笆和远处的山丘，为这个宁静的场景增添了一丝自然美。

caption:
The image shows a brightly decorated Thai street-food truck parked on the side of a road beside tall green grass or reeds. The vehicle is a small pickup-style food truck, painted in vivid pink, orange, red, and yellow flame-like graphics, giving it a bold, energetic appearance.

Large Thai lettering is printed across the upper side panels and the rear of the truck in white with dark outlines. The back panel also features a cartoon mascot: a red, angry-looking chili or sauce-cup character holding skewers, with additional Thai text above it. Phone numbers are printed along the side and rear in white digits.

The serving side of the truck is open. A large metal awning is lifted outward, creating a shaded service window. Inside the food-preparation area, there are metal counters, pots, containers, and cooking equipment. Along the lower display area, a row of skewers or grilled items appears to be laid out behind a transparent cover or plastic sheet, suggesting the truck sells grilled or spicy street food.

The truck is parked partly on dirt and grass at the edge of a paved road. In the background, tall wild vegetation fills most of the scene, with a pale blue-gray sky above. On the right side of the image, two tall concrete utility poles stand next to the road, with a few wires visible near the top. The lighting is soft and warm, likely late afternoon or early evening, giving the scene a slightly golden tone.

Overall, it depicts a colorful roadside Thai food truck set up for business in a semi-rural area, with its serving window open and cooking equipment visible inside.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国街头小吃车的现实主义风格照片。小吃车装饰着鲜艳的色彩和图案，包括红色、黄色和粉色的设计元素，以及一个醒目的红色恶魔形象。车辆后部有一个开放式的摊位，里面摆放着一些食品。小吃车停靠在一条路边，周围是绿色的植被。

caption:
The image shows a grand, historic European-style palace or château viewed from across a landscaped garden on a bright, clear day. The building dominates the center of the scene, stretching horizontally across the frame with an elegant, symmetrical façade and richly decorated architectural details.

The structure is built in light cream-colored stone with patterned reddish brickwork arranged in diamond motifs across parts of the walls. It has tall rectangular windows with dark wooden frames, decorative pediments, carved stone trim, and ornate balcony railings. A long, covered veranda or gallery runs across much of the front, supported by slender columns and intricate white ironwork or lace-like architectural detailing.

The roofline is highly varied and elaborate. Dark slate mansard roofs cap the different sections of the building, with dormer windows, chimneys, and sculptural ornamentation. On the right side rises a prominent tower with a rounded mansard dome and a tall spire. Near the top of this tower is a visible clock face, giving it the appearance of a clock tower. The central portion of the building projects outward slightly and is crowned by another mansard roof with ornate stone sculptures and decorative cresting. On the left side, there is a smaller rounded turret-like section and a steep triangular roof, adding to the château-like character.

In front of the palace is a formal garden with a wide green lawn, trimmed shrubs, low hedges, and curving gravel paths. A large classical statue stands prominently in the foreground left of center on a white pedestal, depicting a human figure in draped clothing. Near the center front of the building is a circular stone fountain or basin, with steps and balustrades leading up toward the entrance terrace. Several benches are placed around the garden, and small conical shrubs and ornamental plantings are scattered throughout the lawn.

Tall evergreen trees frame the scene on both the left and right edges, emphasizing the palace’s placement within a park-like setting. The background sky is a deep, vivid blue with only faint wisps of cloud, and the strong sunlight highlights the pale stone façade, casting crisp shadows that reveal the building’s relief and decorative details. Overall, the scene feels stately, serene, and well-maintained, suggesting a historic estate, museum, or aristocratic residence set within formal grounds.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座宏伟的古典风格建筑的照片。建筑物位于画面中央，拥有多个尖顶和塔楼，以及装饰性的石雕和阳台。前方是一个精心修剪的草坪，周围种植着整齐的树木和灌木。在建筑前的草坪上，有一个雕塑作品，增添了艺术气息。整个场景被一片清澈的蓝天所环绕，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a city street scene in warm daylight, likely in central London. A long row of docked red-and-gray Santander rental bicycles dominates the foreground and right side of the image. The bikes are lined up neatly in docking stations along the curb, receding into the distance and creating a strong diagonal perspective from the lower right toward the center-left of the frame. The red wheel covers and panels display the Santander branding.

Behind the bicycle dock is a black iron fence enclosing a small planted area with shrubs and several large, leafless trees. The tree trunks are thick and mottled, with pale bark patches, and their bare branches stretch across the upper part of the image, suggesting late autumn or winter.

Across the street are several multi-story buildings with different architectural styles. On the left is a modern-looking brick and concrete building with rectangular windows. In the center is a grand cream-colored stone building with tall windows, decorative cornices, and a row of large white columns at street level. The number “20” is visible near its entrance. To the right is an older dark-brick building with white-trimmed sash windows, small balconies, and a classical entrance labeled “Manor House,” with the number “21” displayed nearby.

A black streetlamp stands near the center of the scene, adding to the traditional urban character. A few parked cars are visible along the curb behind the bike station. There are also a couple of pedestrians: one person on the left appears to be standing near the bikes while looking down, possibly at a phone or adjusting something, and another person on the right is near the bicycle docks, also looking downward.

The road in the foreground is relatively empty of moving traffic, with faint lane markings and scattered leaves on the pavement. The overall atmosphere is calm and orderly, with soft sunlight casting gentle shadows across the buildings, bicycles, and street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道一角的现实主义风格照片，前景中有一排整齐排列的红色自行车共享服务车辆，它们停放在一个有树木和建筑物的城市环境中。在车辆后方，可以看到一位穿着深色外套的人正在人行道上行走，而背景中的建筑则显得有些老旧且破旧。阳光从画面右侧照射下来，给整个场景增添了一种温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dimly lit subway station platform viewed from across the tracks, with the foreground dominated by deep black shadows and vertical structural columns. These dark beams cut the scene into narrow rectangular windows, creating a strong sense of framing and rhythm.

Behind the columns, the opposite platform is visible in a warm, muted light. The wall is covered in classic white rectangular subway tiles, with decorative mosaic bands near the top and thin blue-and-gold horizontal trim near the lower portion. A large mosaic station sign reads “23rd STREET,” though parts of the words are obscured by the dark columns. Another smaller mosaic panel with the number “23” is visible near the center.

Near the upper right-center, a single exposed light fixture glows warmly against a vertical support, casting a soft yellow halo and emphasizing the otherwise low-light atmosphere. The ceiling and track area are mostly swallowed in darkness, giving the image a cinematic, almost noir-like quality.

On the far right side of the platform, a lone person appears in silhouette. They are standing or leaning casually near the platform edge, one leg crossed or bent, holding something close to their chest—possibly a phone. Their figure is nearly black against the pale tiled wall, making them feel isolated within the frame.

Overall, the photograph has a quiet, moody urban atmosphere. The contrast between the bright tiled subway wall and the heavy black foreground columns creates a layered, shadowy composition, with the “23rd Street” signage anchoring the location.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在地铁站内拍摄的照片，光线从左侧的窗户投射进来，照亮了23号街站牌和一名正在行走的人。照片通过对比度和光线处理，营造出一种神秘而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a large group of cyclists gathered in a city street, apparently taking part in a protest or organized ride. The setting appears to be a busy urban intersection in Manhattan, with a green street sign reading “W 60 St” visible at the upper left and tall apartment and office buildings filling the background.

In the left-center background is a large silver globe sculpture made of metal rings and continents, positioned above a transit or advertising structure. Beneath it, a bright illuminated ad reads “TOP OF THE ROCK,” showing a skyline image. Trees line part of the street behind the cyclists, and traffic lights, street lamps, and pedestrian signals are visible around the intersection.

The street is packed with people on bicycles. Many riders are wearing helmets, face masks, bright yellow clothing, or high-visibility vests. Several cyclists appear to be dressed in coordinated yellow tones, suggesting a group action or themed protest ride. The crowd extends deep into the background, with dozens of bikes clustered across the roadway.

In the foreground, a cyclist in an orange-brown shirt, black helmet, black gloves, and shorts rides a light-colored bicycle. A cardboard sign attached to the front of his bike reads “BLM,” referring to Black Lives Matter. On the right side of the image, another cyclist wearing a neon yellow shirt and orange reflective vest rides a bright yellow bike with a handwritten sign on the front basket that says “I CAN’T BREATHE.” This phrase is strongly associated with protests against police brutality and racial injustice.

Other cyclists nearby wear colorful helmets, including red, black, green, and white. Some have backpacks, masks, sunglasses, or reflective gear. The road surface looks rough and dark, possibly recently paved or under construction. The overall mood is active and purposeful, with the cyclists moving together through the city as part of a visible demonstration.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到一群骑自行车的人在城市街道上进行抗议或示威的现实主义风格照片。图像前景中，一位穿着黄色上衣和黑色裤子的男子正骑着一辆装有'FILM'字样的自行车，他的表情专注而坚定。周围是其他穿着各式服装、戴着安全头盔的参与者，他们骑着各种型号的自行车，有的手持标语牌。背景中可以看到城市的高楼大厦和一个巨大的球形装置，这些元素为这张照片增添了一种都市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a calm coastal marina or bay with several small boats floating on gently rippling water. In the foreground, a line of floating buoys—mostly white with a few red sections—stretches horizontally across the lower part of the frame, suggesting a swimming or boating boundary.

Near the center-right foreground is a small white motorboat moored in the water. It has a canopy frame with a pale roof, an outboard Mercury engine at the stern, and visible lettering on the side reading “QUICKSILVER.” A small red flag with a yellow emblem, likely Montenegro’s flag, hangs from the canopy area. The boat is tied to a buoy or anchor line extending toward the right, and a few white fenders hang along its side. A fishing rod or antenna-like pole rises from the boat.

To the left of it, a dark inflatable dinghy with an outboard motor floats nearby. Farther back, several more boats are docked or moored along the shoreline, including white motorboats and small craft clustered near a pier or marina area.

The background is a steep, densely forested hillside covered in dark green vegetation. At the base of the hill, there is a shoreline with trees, a rocky cut or cliff face, and some light-colored retaining walls or structures. A road or elevated walkway runs along the hillside, with what appears to be a small bus or vehicle visible on it. On the right side of the background, a long angled crane or construction arm rises diagonally upward, indicating construction or marina work nearby.

The overall atmosphere is quiet and slightly overcast, with muted colors and soft focus in the background. The water reflects the gray-blue sky and the boats, giving the scene a peaceful seaside harbor feel.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海港景观的照片，前景中有一艘名为'PATERNA'的白色船只停泊在平静的水面上，周围散布着红色和黄色浮标。背景中可以看到其他几艘船只，包括一艘黑色的小船和一些大型游艇。远处是覆盖着绿色植被的山丘，以及一座正在建设中的桥梁结构。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出宁静的海滨氛围。

caption:
The image shows a tranquil lakeside landscape bordered by dense tropical greenery. A broad, calm body of water fills the lower half of the scene, its surface mostly smooth with faint ripples and small sparkles of reflected light. The shoreline curves gently from the lower right toward the center, edged by bright green grass that meets the water in a narrow, slightly muddy strip.

On the right side, lush vegetation dominates the foreground: thick shrubs, glossy dark-green leaves, palms, and layered bushes create a dense garden-like edge. A tall, leaning tree stands near the water, its trunk slanting diagonally out over the lake. Its canopy is irregular, with clusters of green leaves mixed with bare branches, giving it a slightly windswept or weathered appearance. Behind it, taller trees rise upward, including palms and broadleaf trees with branches spreading across the upper right portion of the frame.

Across the lake in the background, the opposite shore is covered in a continuous band of dense forest. The trees form a dark green horizon with varying heights and textures, suggesting a lush, humid environment. The sky above is pale gray-blue with a blanket of soft cloud cover, diffusing the sunlight and giving the scene a hazy, peaceful atmosphere.

Overall, the image feels quiet and natural, with the calm lake, rich greenery, and overhanging trees creating a serene tropical or subtropical waterside setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示宁静湖泊和郁郁葱葱植被的自然风光照片。在画面左侧，有一棵弯曲的树干和茂密的树叶，与湖水形成对比。右侧是密集的绿色植物，包括灌木和树木，它们构成了一个自然的边界。湖面平静，反射着天空的光线，而远处则是覆盖着树木的山丘，为这个场景增添了深度感。

caption:
The image shows a sunny outdoor street scene in what appears to be a residential or semi-urban area. The road is narrow and dusty, with low concrete walls on both sides. Several people are walking along the road toward a decorated event area set up ahead.

In the middle distance, there is a temporary tent or canopy decorated with bright red, yellow, and cream-colored fabric. The draped cloth forms an entrance-like structure, suggesting a celebration, community gathering, ceremony, or festive event. Colorful triangular bunting flags are strung across the street and between poles, adding to the festive atmosphere.

A group of men are gathered near and under the decorated canopy. Some are dressed in light-colored shirts and trousers, while one man walking in the foreground on the left wears a bright red shirt and dark pants. Another man on the right side of the road wears a white patterned shirt and dark pants as he walks toward the event.

On the left side of the road, a black scooter is parked close to the wall. Utility poles and many overhead electrical wires stretch across the sky, creating diagonal lines throughout the upper part of the image. In the background, there are large green trees, including tall leafy ones rising above a light blue building on the right. A tree near the center has clusters of yellow flowers.

On the right side, a pale blue building with a corrugated roof sits behind a wall topped with fencing or barbed wire. In front of it, there is a small construction-like area with piles of sand, stones, and broken blocks. At the far right edge of the image, part of a blue vehicle is visible, including its side mirror and door frame, suggesting the photo may have been taken from inside or beside a vehicle.

The sky is bright and partly cloudy, with soft daylight illuminating the scene. Overall, the image captures a neighborhood street leading into a decorated gathering space, with people arriving and festive decorations visible across the road.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日常城市生活场景的照片，拍摄于一个开阔的街道上。在画面中央，可以看到几位行人正在街道上行走，其中一位穿着红色上衣的人显得格外突出。街道两侧有建筑物和树木，一些电线横跨在空中。在图片左侧，有一辆摩托车停放在路边，而右侧则停放着一辆蓝色汽车的部分车身。整个场景给人一种宁静但繁忙的感觉，人们似乎在进行他们的日常生活活动。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor motorcycle demonstration or gathering taking place on a paved surface, likely under or beside a bridge or overpass. In the foreground, a rider sits on a bright blue Yamaha motorcycle facing left. The motorcycle is shown in profile and occupies most of the lower half of the image. It has blue body panels with white and light-blue graphics, black wheels with blue rim accents, a front headlight fairing, mirrors, exposed engine parts, and a rear luggage rack. A black soft side bag is attached near the back of the bike.

The rider is wearing a glossy black-and-silver full-face helmet with a clear visor, black motorcycle gloves, a pale yellow short-sleeved T-shirt, dark jeans, and black shoes. He is leaning slightly forward with both hands on the handlebars, as if preparing to ride or demonstrating the controls. A second person may be seated behind or very close to the rider, partially hidden, with another set of gloved hands visible near the handlebars.

Behind the motorcycle, a large crowd of spectators stands in a wide semicircle watching the scene. The crowd includes adults, teenagers, and children dressed casually in summer clothing such as T-shirts, shorts, dresses, and sandals. Many faces in the background are blurred, making the focus remain on the motorcyclist and bike. Some spectators have their arms crossed, some are holding phones or cameras, and a few appear to be clapping or watching intently.

The setting is leafy and green, with dense trees and tall trunks filling the background. Sunlight filters through the foliage, creating a bright, summery atmosphere. On the upper right, part of a concrete structure—likely the underside of a bridge or roof—extends into the frame, adding shade over part of the scene. The overall impression is of a public motorcycle show, safety demonstration, or stunt/display event with a large audience gathered around.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示摩托车手在户外活动中表演的照片。摩托车手穿着黄色上衣和黑色裤子，头戴全盔式安全头盔，并佩戴着护目镜。他正骑着一辆蓝色的摩托车，车身上有赞助商的标志。背景中，一群观众站在树木下观看，他们的注意力都集中在摩托车手和他的表演上。

caption:
The image shows a straight-on view along a brick-paved bridge in a European city, likely Amsterdam, with a large pale cream-colored drawbridge structure dominating the center of the frame.

At the center is a tall, old-fashioned bridge mechanism made of painted metal and wood-like panels. It has two large rectangular overhead beams with rows of round rivets or bolt heads along their edges. The structure includes arched openings below, vertical support columns, black metal brackets, hanging chains, and diagonal support rods extending down toward the bridge deck.
