The cream paint looks slightly weathered, giving the bridge a historic, industrial character.

The bridge deck is paved with reddish-brown bricks arranged in neat rows, creating strong perspective lines that lead the eye toward the arched opening and the street beyond. Green metal railings run along both sides of the bridge, and water from the canal is visible at the far left and right edges near the bottom.

Several people are using the bridge. In the foreground on the right, a cyclist is seen from behind, slightly motion-blurred, riding away from the camera. Near the center, another cyclist rides toward the camera; this person wears a tan or mustard-colored coat with a light shearling-style collar and rides a bicycle with a front crate or basket. Other pedestrians and cyclists move through the middle distance, some walking under the bridge arch. A few faces appear blurred by motion or depth of field.

On both sides of the bridge, rows of traditional narrow canal houses line the background. The buildings have tall windows, dark brick facades, decorative gables, and varied rooflines. Some are black or dark brown, while others are lighter cream or white. Bare winter trees stand among the buildings, suggesting a cold season. The sky is overcast and pale gray, casting soft, diffuse light over the scene.

Overall, the image captures a busy urban canal bridge scene with historic architecture, cyclists, pedestrians, and a muted, wintry atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示荷兰阿姆斯特丹典型城市街景的照片。图像中心是一座带有吊桥的桥梁，其设计简约而坚固，是这个城市的一个显著地标。桥上有多位行人和骑自行车的人，他们正沿着桥面行走或骑行。背景中，可以看到排列整齐的房屋，它们的风格和颜色与前景形成对比，增添了照片的文化氛围。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，色彩真实且细节丰富。

caption:
The image shows a person stand-up paddleboarding in the ocean, viewed from behind. The paddler is centered in the frame and appears to be moving away from the camera across choppy, gray-green water.

They are standing on a light blue paddleboard with a rounded nose, partly obscured by splashing waves and white foam. The board is angled slightly forward into the surf, riding over a small breaking wave. Water sprays up around the person’s legs and the board, suggesting motion and effort.

The paddler is wearing a long-sleeved rash guard or wetsuit top that is mostly white on the back, with bright blue sleeves and blue side panels. They also wear green board shorts with horizontal dark stripes. Their short brown hair is visible, and their face is not shown because they are facing the horizon.

They hold a long black paddle diagonally across their body. One hand is extended forward and to the right, gripping the top of the paddle, while the paddle blade trails down toward the left side of the image near the water. Their posture is slightly leaning and braced, indicating they are balancing against the waves while paddling.

The surrounding ocean is active, with rolling waves, frothy whitecaps, and textured water across the foreground and middle ground. The horizon is soft and hazy, blending into a pale, overcast sky. The background is minimal, with no land, boats, or other people visible, giving the scene a wide, open, coastal feeling.

Overall, the image captures a dynamic moment of water sports—energetic, outdoorsy, and slightly adventurous, with the paddler navigating rough surf under a muted sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示冲浪运动的现实主义风格照片，一位穿着蓝色上衣和绿色短裤的男性运动员正在海面上用桨板划水。他的姿势专注而有力，表现出对这项水上运动的热情与技巧。背景是波涛汹涌的大海和阴沉的天空，为这张照片增添了一种挑战性和冒险的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a moody, atmospheric view through glass from a high-rise building. A single person stands near the upper-right portion of the frame, seen mostly as a dark, soft silhouette. They appear to be leaning with their arms resting on a glass balcony railing, looking outward over the city. Their head and shoulders are visible in profile, and they seem to be wearing a striped long-sleeve shirt, though the details are muted by reflections and haze.

The foreground and background blend together through the reflective glass. A dense urban skyline fills the lower half of the image, with numerous high-rise buildings, office towers, and apartment blocks visible below. The city is slightly blurred and softened, giving the scene a dreamlike or contemplative quality. Horizontal railing lines and vertical window panels cut across the composition, creating layered geometric shapes.

The color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by blue-gray, teal, and smoky tones. The lighting feels overcast or late in the day, with no strong direct sunlight. A large pale vertical panel occupies much of the center-left area, while a darker, shadowy vertical band runs along the far left, emphasizing the sense of looking through or across multiple panes of glass.

Overall, the image feels quiet, reflective, and introspective: a lone figure paused high above a sprawling city, partially obscured by reflections, distance, and mist.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张现代摄影风格的照片，展示了一位站在高层建筑露台上的人。人物穿着休闲服装，站立姿态自然，似乎在欣赏远处的城市景观。照片的视角从人物的背后延伸至城市天际线，透过玻璃栏杆可以看到模糊的城市轮廓和建筑物。天空中弥漫着薄雾或烟雾，为整个场景增添了一种朦胧而神秘的感觉。

caption:
The image shows several dried or wilted mushrooms lying horizontally on a bright red/pink surface. The background is plain and evenly colored, making the pale tan mushrooms stand out strongly.

The mushrooms have long, thin, curved stems that look wrinkled, fibrous, and slightly twisted. Their stems are beige to grayish-white, with darker bruised or dirty-looking patches in places. Some of the stems overlap and cross over one another, forming a loose pile.

The caps are small to medium-sized, rounded, and bell-like, with a smooth tan to golden-brown color. A few caps are partially visible from the side, showing darker undersides and gill areas. One larger cap near the center-left is prominent, with a rounded dome shape and a pale cream top fading into a warmer brown edge. Another smaller mushroom in the foreground is out of focus, creating a shallow depth-of-field effect.

The lighting is soft but directional, casting shadows beneath the mushrooms, especially toward the lower right. The focus is sharpest on the central mushrooms and stems, while the foreground and far background are slightly blurred. Overall, the image is a close-up still life of dried mushrooms arranged on a vivid red backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三朵蘑菇的特写摄影图像，蘑菇放置在鲜艳的红色背景上。最左边的蘑菇较小，顶部略显皱褶，而中间和右边的蘑菇则较大，它们的茎部细长且有分叉。这些蘑菇的帽子呈现出淡黄色至浅棕色的渐变，表面粗糙，边缘微微翘起。

caption:
The image shows a roadside police stop involving a large blue cargo truck and a police vehicle.

On the left side of the frame is the front and side of a bright blue DAF semi-truck cab attached to a long gray curtain-sided trailer. The truck is parked along the edge of a paved road. The cab has a Ukrainian-style license plate visible on the front, and the DAF/XF branding can be seen. The trailer is tall and rectangular, with a gray tarp-like side panel fastened along the bottom by a row of black straps and hooks. The upper edge of the trailer has a blue covering or trim.

Near the middle-bottom of the image, two police officers are standing beside the trailer with another person, likely the truck driver or a civilian. The officers wear black uniforms with high-visibility neon yellow-green vests marked “Поліція” in Cyrillic, indicating Ukrainian police. One officer appears to be looking down at something, possibly documents or a phone, while the other officer is gesturing with one arm extended, as if directing or explaining something. The civilian is partly obscured and stands close to the trailer, wearing casual clothing and a cap.

On the right side of the image, behind the trailer, there is a white police SUV with blue and red emergency lights on the roof. The lightbar appears illuminated. The police vehicle also has Ukrainian police markings and colored stripes along the side.

The setting appears to be an urban or suburban roadside in daylight. The road surface is wide and sunlit, with visible cracks and lane markings. In the background there are many green trees, bushes, and a few tall apartment-like buildings partially visible through the foliage. A streetlamp stands near the right side. The overall scene suggests a traffic inspection or roadside check of the truck by police.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示警察与卡车互动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中，两名穿着反光背心的警察站在一辆蓝色的大型运输卡车旁，似乎正在进行检查或交流。卡车后方停着一辆警车，警灯亮起，暗示可能有紧急情况或执法行动。背景是晴朗天气下的绿色树木和一些低矮的建筑物。

caption:
The image is a close-up portrait of a couple dressed in elaborate traditional wedding attire, photographed outdoors with a soft, blurred green background that suggests trees or garden foliage.

On the left is a groom or male figure, shown from the chest up and turned slightly toward the woman. His face is intentionally blurred. He wears a tall, bright turquoise-blue ceremonial hat with gold trim and vertical gold accents. His hair is neatly cut short at the sides. Around his neck are long strands of white jasmine-like flower garlands and layered gold necklaces, including a large ornate pendant with dangling tassel details. His upper chest is bare, and a dark green patterned cloth with gold leaf-like motifs is wrapped around his torso.

On the right is a bride or female figure, also with her face blurred. She is adorned with an intricate gold headpiece featuring butterfly- and flower-shaped ornaments rising above her hair on thin stems. Her hair is styled in a sleek, polished updo with decorative gold accessories and strings of small white flowers draped along the side. She wears sparkling earrings, an ornate gold necklace with crystal-like details, and a large gold bracelet or cuff. Her hand rests gently on the man’s shoulder or chest, showing manicured nails with gold accents.

Both figures are positioned very close together, creating an intimate ceremonial portrait. The overall color palette combines teal blue, deep green, gold, cream-white flowers, and soft natural background tones. The image has a shallow depth of field, keeping the jewelry, headpieces, and clothing details prominent while the background remains dreamy and out of focus.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一对穿着传统服饰的人物的摄影照片。男性戴着一顶蓝色的帽子，脖子上挂着金色的项链和装饰品，身穿绿色的传统服装，并佩戴着与女性相同的饰品。女性则头戴精美的头饰，同样身着绿色的传统服饰，她的头部被模糊处理以保护隐私。两人紧挨在一起，彼此的手臂相互交缠，营造出一种亲密而庄重的氛围。背景虽然模糊，但可以隐约看出是在户外环境中拍摄的。

caption:
The image shows a modern, multi-story residential apartment building on a sunny day under a clear blue sky. The architecture is contemporary, with clean geometric lines, flat roofs, and a mix of white, gray, and warm wood-toned exterior finishes.

The building appears to be about three stories tall, with large wraparound balconies on multiple levels. The balconies have white horizontal slatted metal railings, giving the facade a sleek, uniform look while also providing privacy and shade. Several windows and balcony doors are fitted with white roller shutters, many of which are closed or partially closed.

The upper roof projects outward significantly, creating deep overhangs that shade the balconies below. The roof edge and some facade sections are finished in a dark gray material, contrasting with the mostly white walls. Warm brown wooden cladding panels are placed vertically between windows and balcony sections, adding visual warmth to the otherwise minimalist design.

On the right side of the building, additional smaller balconies protrude from the facade, also enclosed with the same white horizontal railings. A neighboring modern white structure is partially visible on the left side of the image.

In the foreground, there is a landscaped area with neatly maintained grass, shrubs, small bushes, and tall green hedges. A white metal fence and gate run along the front of the property. A narrow paved path or road crosses the lower part of the image, and a dark gray cylindrical bollard or outdoor light fixture stands near the path. A slender streetlamp or garden lamp rises in front of the building near the center.

Overall, the scene conveys a clean, upscale residential environment with modern design, bright sunlight, and well-kept greenery surrounding the building.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代住宅建筑的照片。建筑物为两层高，顶部有平坦的屋顶和多个白色阳台栏杆。建筑的一侧是白色的外墙，而另一侧则是带有棕色和灰色条纹的设计。在建筑前方有一片绿色草坪，旁边种植着一些树木和灌木，营造出宜人的居住环境。一条小路从前景延伸至建筑前，周围没有行人或车辆。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a Government Savings Bank branch, likely in Thailand, based on the large Thai lettering and the English text “Government Savings Bank” on the back wall.

A bright magenta/pink wall dominates the background, with the bank’s circular gold emblem on the left and large white Thai text across the center. Beneath the Thai text, the words “Government Savings Bank” are written in English. The service counter below the sign is white with pink accents, matching the bank’s branding.

Several customers are standing at the counter, appearing to fill out forms or conduct transactions. From left to right, there is a man in a colorful plaid shirt looking down at something in his hands, a woman in a pink top with a brown shoulder bag, a person in a bright green shirt leaning over the counter, and a man in a blue plaid shirt also leaning forward at the counter. The counter area has partitions and small writing surfaces, suggesting it is a customer service or form-filling area.

In the foreground are light wood-colored waiting chairs with metal frames and dark seat cushions. Some people are seated or standing near these chairs. On the right side, a woman in a gray T-shirt and jeans is bending slightly toward a child seated in a red shirt. Another child with a ponytail is visible between the chairs, facing partly toward the camera. The faces of several people appear blurred.

The space looks clean, bright, and modern, with white tiled flooring, pale walls, and overhead lighting. On the far right, there is a desk or workstation with a computer monitor, and behind it a glass partition or doorway. A framed picture hangs on the wall in the background. The overall scene feels like a busy but orderly bank waiting area, with customers either waiting, filling out paperwork, or being served at the counter.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示政府储蓄银行内部的照片，画面中心是一个穿着粉红色上衣的女性正在操作电脑，她的旁边坐着一个穿着红色衣服的小孩。在她身后，有几位顾客正站在柜台前等待服务，其中包括一位穿蓝色衬衫的男性和两位穿白色上衣的女性。整个场景被粉色背景墙所包围，上面印有'SUNMS Government Savings Bank'的字样，以及一个圆形徽章图案。

caption:
The image shows an ornate black metal sculpture or decorative installation standing on a paved walkway in a leafy park. The sculpture is centered in the frame and dominates the foreground. It is made of wrought iron or a similar dark metal, with an elegant, symmetrical design full of curls, spirals, loops, and scrollwork.

The central part of the sculpture has a tall, elongated oval or teardrop-shaped opening, framed by thick black metal. The frame narrows to a point near the top and bottom, giving it a graceful, harp-like or ornamental gate-like appearance. Along the central frame are raised decorative details: small rounded studs, circular accents, and intricate swirling floral-like patterns. At the very top, the metal curls inward into a large spiral, and a similar curling motif appears near the bottom center.

On both sides of the central form are wider decorative wings made of curved metal rods. These side sections extend outward and upward in sweeping arcs, ending in scrolls and loops. The overall shape feels balanced and highly decorative, resembling antique ironwork, a stylized musical instrument, or a fanciful park monument.

The sculpture stands on several curved metal legs attached to a rectangular metal base, which rests on a low stone or concrete pedestal. There appears to be some engraved text on the front edge of the base, though it is not clearly readable in the image.

Behind the sculpture is a park setting with tall trees, dense green foliage, and dappled sunlight filtering through the leaves. A brick or stone-paved path runs behind and around the sculpture. On the left side of the background, several people are walking away along the path; they are slightly out of focus and partially obscured by the sculpture. A park bench and trash bin are also visible on the left. The scene is bright and summery, with patches of sunlight and shadow scattered across the walkway and grass.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示公园中黑色金属雕塑的照片。雕塑位于铺砌的人行道上，其设计复杂且具有装饰性，由多个曲线和螺旋形元素组成，形成一个大型的半圆形结构。背景中可以看到绿色的树木和一些模糊的人物在远处行走。

caption:
The image shows a large commercial passenger jet in Transavia livery just above a runway, likely moments after takeoff or during the final phase of landing. The aircraft is seen in side profile, angled slightly upward with its nose raised, suggesting it is climbing. Its landing gear is still extended, with the nose wheel and main wheels visible below the fuselage.

The plane is predominantly white, with large bright green “transavia” lettering stretching across the side of the fuselage. The tail fin features Transavia’s green circular logo with a white lowercase “t” shape. A smaller version of the same green logo appears on the engine nacelle under the wing. The aircraft registration “PH-HSK” is visible near the rear of the fuselage, and the model marking “Boeing 737-800” can be seen near the tail area.

The wings extend from the midsection of the aircraft, with upward-curved winglets at the tips. The flaps appear partially deployed, consistent with takeoff or landing. The engines are mounted under the wings, and the underside of the aircraft has darker blue and red accent coloring.

The background is dominated by a clear, pale blue sky with no visible clouds. Below the aircraft is a runway bordered by green grass. In the far distance, there are low buildings, trees, and airport infrastructure, slightly blurred due to distance and motion. The overall scene captures the aircraft in motion at an airport on a bright, clear day.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架白色客机在晴朗天气下降落的照片。飞机的机身侧面印有绿色和白色的公司标志，显示它属于transavia航空公司。飞机的起落架已经放下，准备着陆。背景中可以看到一片开阔的草地和远处模糊的城市轮廓。

caption:
The image shows a large pile of used household batteries scattered across the bottom half of the frame. The batteries are mixed in size, color, and type, including AA, AAA, C, D, and possibly 9V-style batteries. Many are lying horizontally or at angles, overlapping one another in a cluttered heap.

In the foreground, several batteries are sharply visible. There are recognizable labels and colors, including black-and-copper Duracell-style batteries, blue-and-yellow Varta batteries, a black “Peak Power Heavy Duty” battery, and various generic or less legible brands. Some batteries show signs of wear: scratched labels, dirt, corrosion, scuffed metal ends, and faded printing. A few battery terminals are clearly visible, including flat negative ends and raised positive caps.

The color palette is busy and varied, with metallic copper, black, blue, yellow, white, red, and silver surfaces creating a dense visual texture. The pile looks like discarded or collected batteries, possibly intended for recycling or safe disposal.

The upper half of the image is mostly bright white and empty, with the background heavily blurred. Toward the middle distance, more batteries are visible but out of focus, forming a soft, colorful band. The shallow depth of field draws attention to the batteries in the foreground while making the background appear hazy and indistinct. Overall, the image conveys a close-up view of battery waste or a collection of spent batteries.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多种不同品牌和型号的电池堆叠在一起的照片。照片中，各种电池紧密地堆积在一起，从左至右，可以看到包括AA、AAA、D型等不同尺寸的电池。电池上的标签清晰可见，显示了不同的品牌和容量信息。背景是纯白色，使得前景中的电池更加突出。

caption:
The image shows a wide coastal landscape under a pale blue, lightly clouded sky. In the foreground, the ground is covered with dense patches of purple heather, forming thick, rounded carpets across uneven grassy terrain. Tall, wind-swept grasses in shades of green, gold, and straw are scattered throughout, giving the scene a wild, natural texture.

The land slopes gently toward the sea on the left side of the image, where the coastline drops away into a calm, grey-blue ocean. The water stretches across the middle distance to a faint, hazy horizon, blending softly with the sky. The sea appears quiet, with only subtle rippling visible.

On the right side, standing prominently on the grassy cliff, is a tall cylindrical stone tower or chimney. It is built from rough, weathered stones in earthy browns, greys, and ochres. The structure tapers slightly as it rises and has an open, dark rim at the top. Its aged appearance suggests it may be an old industrial chimney, mining stack, or historic coastal landmark.

The composition has a strong sense of openness: the expansive sky occupies much of the upper half, while the colorful heather and grasses dominate the foreground. The tower provides a vertical focal point against the otherwise horizontal layers of land, sea, and sky. The overall mood is peaceful, windswept, and slightly rugged, evoking a remote coastal headland in late summer or early autumn.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示自然风光的摄影作品，画面中心是一座孤立的石制塔楼，位于一片覆盖着紫色野花的草地上。塔楼矗立在画面的右侧，与平静的海洋和远处连绵的山脉形成对比。天空呈现出淡蓝色，几朵白云悠闲地飘浮其中。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic, low-angle view of the Sydney Opera House silhouetted against a bright sky. The building’s iconic sail-like roof forms appear almost completely black due to strong backlighting, creating sharp triangular and curved shapes that dominate the lower and central parts of the frame.

A large, steep triangular roof section rises from the bottom left toward the upper center, its peak cutting into the sky. Near the top of this silhouette, a small structure or railing is faintly visible, outlined against the lighter background. To the right, additional Opera House shell forms are partially visible, overlapping in layers; their curved edges catch small highlights, giving subtle hints of the building’s reflective tiled surface despite the overall darkness.

The sun is positioned on the right side of the image, slightly above the horizon line of the building. It appears as a bright white starburst with long, radiating rays, creating a strong lens flare effect and washing the surrounding sky with pale light. The sky transitions from a deep bluish tone on the left to a brighter gray-blue around the sun on the right, emphasizing the contrast between the dark architecture and the intense sunlight.

Along the bottom of the frame, dark horizontal steps or a broad platform are barely visible, forming a textured base beneath the silhouette. The overall mood is stark, architectural, and cinematic, with the image focusing on contrast, geometry, and the recognizable outline of the Opera House rather than surface detail.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代建筑剪影的摄影作品，建筑物在阳光下呈现出深邃的轮廓。太阳位于画面右侧，散发出耀眼的光芒，形成了一个明亮的星芒效果。

caption:
The image shows a tightly packed formation of uniformed soldiers marching in a formal parade. They are moving in synchronized rows, with their bodies angled slightly as if captured mid-step.

The soldiers wear dark teal-green dress uniforms with red piping along the seams and edges. Their jackets are high-collared and decorated with gold details, including shoulder boards, braided aiguillettes draped across the chest, medals, badges, and ribbon-like orange-and-black commemorative pins. Wide gold belts with ornate buckles wrap around their waists.

Each soldier wears a large peaked ceremonial cap with a dark teal crown, a bright red band, red trim around the brim, and gold insignia at the front. The caps also have gold cords and decorative elements above the black visors. Many of the uniforms include sleeve patches featuring crossed weapons or artillery-style symbols in yellow on a dark background.

The soldiers’ hands are in white gloves, and several are visible swinging their arms in unison as they march. Their trousers match the jackets, with red stripes down the sides, and the lower portions of black boots can be seen near the bottom of the frame.

The faces of the soldiers in the foreground are blurred, while the background shows additional rows of uniformed personnel in darker blue attire, also out of focus. The overall scene has a ceremonial, disciplined atmosphere, suggesting a military parade or official public event. The composition emphasizes repetition, symmetry, and the visual impact of the uniforms’ teal, red, gold, and white color scheme.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一排穿着正式军装的军人的照片。他们身穿绿色上衣，配有金色装饰和红色边缘的帽子，以及白色衬衫和领带。每个士兵都佩戴着肩章和腰带，显示了他们的军衔。照片中的士兵们整齐划一地行进，背景模糊，突出了前景中士兵们的制服细节。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic coastal village built into steep cliffs beside the sea, likely one of the colorful towns of Cinque Terre, Italy. The scene is captured at dusk or sunset, with soft pink and lavender clouds spreading across a pale blue sky.

On the left and center, tightly packed houses climb up the rocky hillside. The buildings are narrow and stacked closely together, painted in warm Mediterranean colors: peach, salmon pink, ochre yellow, terracotta, cream, and muted red. Many have dark green shutters, small balconies, flat roof terraces, and awnings. The homes appear layered, almost interlocking, following the uneven contours of the cliff. Behind them, the hillside rises steeply, covered in dark vegetation and exposed rock.

The central cliff is rugged and imposing, made of gray-brown stone with vertical cracks and jagged surfaces. Several buildings sit right at the edge of the cliff, emphasizing how precariously the village is perched above the sea. A narrow path or walkway traces parts of the cliffside, with railings visible along the rock.

At the bottom left, there is a small harbor area with stone arches, a waterfront terrace, and a few boats pulled up near the shore. Tiny lights and people-like shapes suggest restaurants or a gathering area along the water, though the figures are very small.

The right half of the image opens onto the sea. The water is a deep turquoise-blue with foamy white waves washing against dark rocks and the base of the cliff. The long exposure gives the surf a soft, misty appearance, especially where it breaks around the rocks in the foreground. A small breakwater of piled stones extends into the water on the right.

The sky is one of the most striking features: broad, wispy clouds are tinted pink, peach, and purple by the setting sun. The warm tones of the sky complement the pastel buildings, while the cool blue sea creates a strong contrast. Overall, the image feels atmospheric, picturesque, and serene, with a mix of rugged natural coastline and dense, colorful human settlement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示沿海城镇在日落时分的摄影作品。图像捕捉到了建筑物密集地排列在岩石上，色彩斑斓，与背后的天空形成鲜明对比。海浪拍打着岩石边缘，而海水呈现出深蓝色调。整个场景被柔和的日落光线照亮，营造出一种宁静而又生动的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a seafood market display, centered on a large arrangement of fresh salmon steaks. The salmon pieces are cut into thick cross-sections, with pale orange-pink flesh, visible white fat lines, and strips of silvery-gray skin around the edges. They are laid out in a semicircle on a white tray or sheet, with additional salmon cuts placed in front. A small rectangular price or product sign sits in the middle of the display, but its text is blurred and unreadable.

Around the salmon are various other seafood items. On the right side, several whole silver fish are stacked with their heads facing outward, their shiny scales and dark eyes visible. Behind them is a pile of smaller fish, arranged upright or clustered together, with pale bodies and faint pinkish stripes. In the upper center, a larger fish tail hangs or rests above the display, partially out of focus.

The background and sides of the display are decorated with green fern-like leaves or seaweed, giving the counter a fresh, natural presentation. At the bottom front, small plastic containers of fish roe or caviar are visible, including orange and dark-colored roe. The seafood rests on a red market counter or table covering, with pink basins or trays underneath. The overall scene has the look of a busy fishmonger’s stall, with fresh seafood arranged for sale under bright market lighting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种鱼类和海鲜的市场摊位照片。在图像中心，有一盘粉红色的鱼片整齐地排列着，其旁边是几条银色的鱼排成一列。摊位上还摆放了其他种类的海鲜，如带壳的贝类、装在塑料袋中的鱼块以及一些包装好的食品。整个场景被绿色植物装饰环绕，营造出一种新鲜且自然的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of an ornate golden Buddhist temple or pagoda structure, photographed from very close to its base and looking sharply upward. The composition emphasizes height and symmetry, with the architecture rising vertically toward the center of the frame.

At the top is a tall, tapering golden spire, shaped like a slender cone with stacked ring-like ridges around its lower portion. It narrows to a fine point capped by a small rounded finial. Behind and around it is a deep, dark blue evening sky, giving the gold surfaces a striking contrast.

The main structure is richly gilded, covered in small reflective gold tiles that create a textured, shimmering surface. The central façade features a tall, pointed arched opening or doorway, deeply shadowed inside. Around this entrance are elaborate decorative borders with layered, flame-like and floral motifs typical of Thai temple architecture. The edges curve upward in elegant, pointed forms, with small ornamental spires and finials arranged symmetrically.

On both sides of the central entrance are large rectangular golden columns or buttresses, tiled in a fine diamond pattern. Behind them, portions of a rounded golden dome or stupa body are visible, curving outward to the left and right. Near the lower left edge, a smaller golden spire is partially visible, reinforcing the temple complex setting.

The lighting appears warm and artificial, likely from spotlights illuminating the temple at dusk or night. The gold surfaces glow intensely while the recessed doorway remains dark, creating a strong sense of depth. Overall, the image conveys grandeur, sacredness, and vertical majesty, with the gilded architecture towering against the twilight sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示泰国传统建筑风格的寺庙塔楼的照片。塔楼顶部装饰着金色的尖顶和复杂的花纹，塔身由金色的瓷砖覆盖，营造出一种庄严而华丽的感觉。照片在黄昏时分拍摄，天空呈现出深蓝色调，与金色的塔楼形成鲜明对比。

caption:
The image shows a large outdoor tourist information signboard in what appears to be a traditional Japanese town or historic district.

At the top is a long brown directional sign mounted between black metal posts. On the left side of this sign is a large white question mark inside a white circle, indicating information services. Next to it, large Japanese characters read “馬籠観光案内所,” with the English text “Tourist Information Center” below. On the right side, the same message appears in multiple languages, including Chinese and Korean, and a large white arrow points upward/right. Beneath the arrow is “300m,” indicating the tourist information center is 300 meters in that direction.

Below the directional sign is a large framed map board. The main title across the upper left of the board is in Japanese, “馬籠宿の案内図,” meaning a guide map of Magome-juku. Nearby, smaller text reads “Guide Map of Magomejuku,” along with Chinese and Korean translations. The map itself has a brown background with pale roads and pathways winding through the area. It marks many numbered locations, parking areas marked with blue “P” symbols, information points, restrooms, bus stops, and various landmarks. A red label near the upper central part of the map says “You are here,” showing the viewer’s current location.

The map includes many labels in Japanese and some English, suggesting attractions such as museums, historic sites, shrines, temples, viewing points, and walking routes. There are distance markings, including routes toward places such as Nakatsugawa and other nearby destinations. A compass rose is printed near the upper right of the map area.

Along the bottom of the board is a legend and an index. The legend uses icons for facilities such as information posts, toilets, coin lockers, parking, bus stops, post office, and rest areas. Next to it is a long list of numbered lodging, restaurant, and shop entries, organized with small icons and grid references.

On the far right side of the board is a vertical panel with several small photographs of traditional buildings, each paired with explanatory text. These appear to highlight notable historic sites or museums in the Magome area.

The signboard is set in a dark metal frame with black posts. Behind it, parts of traditional-style buildings with dark tiled roofs and wooden walls are visible. Overhead, thin utility wires cross the cloudy gray sky. The overall scene feels like a tourist orientation point in a preserved historic Japanese village or post town.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示旅游信息中心的指示牌和地图的图片。指示牌上方写着'観光案内所 Tourist Information Center'，并附有箭头指向右侧，指示方向。地图详细地展示了马笼宿的周边环境，包括建筑、道路和停车场的位置。在地图下方，有一系列日文文字说明，为游客提供关于景点的信息。

caption:
The image shows the upper portion of an industrial-looking brick tower rising above dense green trees. The building is partially obscured by foliage in the foreground, giving the scene a contrast between nature and old industrial architecture.

At the top of the tower is a large green sign that reads **“závod ČSA”**. The letters are mounted on the roofline and stand out clearly against the pale, overcast sky. The building itself appears to be made of reddish-brown brick with a rectangular, utilitarian design. Its front face has a large grid of blue-gray window panes, many arranged in a strict industrial pattern. Some panes reflect light unevenly, giving the windows a slightly weathered or aged appearance.

The tower has vertical metal rods or antenna-like structures extending upward from the roof area. On the right side, the brick wall continues back, showing the depth of the structure and additional paneling or vents. Lower portions of the building are mostly hidden behind the treetops.

The foreground and sides of the image are filled with leafy green trees and branches. The leaves are fresh and dense, suggesting spring or summer. Taller trees frame the building on the left and right, while a thick canopy covers the lower half of the image. The sky is bright but cloudy, with no visible sun, creating soft, diffused lighting across the scene.

Overall, the image has a quiet, slightly industrial atmosphere: an old factory or mining-related structure standing behind a lush screen of greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示工业建筑的照片，建筑物顶部有一个绿色的标志，上面写着'závody ČSA'。建筑物由红砖构成，窗户排列整齐，顶部装有天线和信号设备。周围是郁郁葱葱的树木，树叶呈现出春季的新绿。

caption:
The image shows the front of a white Honda car with its hood open, viewed from directly in front of the vehicle. The engine bay is exposed, and the Honda emblem is clearly visible on the chrome front grille.

The hood is raised high and supported by a black prop rod positioned slightly left of center. The underside of the hood is visible, showing silver-painted metal structure, a large dark insulation pad on the left side, and a black plastic duct or cover on the right side. The hood’s hinges and mounting points are visible near both sides.

Below the hood, the windshield and black windshield wipers can be seen at the back of the engine bay. The cowl area beneath the windshield is made of black plastic. The engine compartment contains a Honda i-VTEC engine cover near the center-left, with intake manifold runners visible below it. On the right side of the engine bay is the car battery, with a red positive terminal cover. Various hoses, wiring, fluid reservoirs, and plastic air intake components are visible around the engine.

The front fascia includes large clear headlights on both sides, a shiny chrome grille with black slats, and the large central Honda “H” badge. The upper radiator support and hood latch area are visible above the grille, including black plastic trim and vent-like openings.

The vehicle appears to be parked in a covered or semi-covered service area or garage. In the background on the left, there is a red/orange shipping-container-like structure or building wall. On the right side of the background, another vehicle—an SUV or van with its rear open—is parked under a roofed area. The surrounding space is bright with daylight, and there are metal roof beams and greenery visible in the distance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示汽车引擎盖打开的照片，清晰地展示了车辆的发动机和部分内饰。可以看到发动机内部有多个金属部件，包括气缸、活塞和排气管等。车辆的前部标有'Honda'的品牌标志，表明这是本田品牌的汽车。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a Nissan car dealership on a bright day. The scene is photographed from a low angle, looking upward toward the building façade and roadside signage.

On the left side, a modern dealership building has a curved, rounded architectural corner with large glass windows and silver-gray metal cladding. A wide canopy extends outward over the entrance or display area, and bold red “NISSAN” lettering is mounted along the front edge of the canopy. The building’s design is sleek and commercial, with smooth curved lines and reflective glass.

In the lower foreground, part of an orange or reddish-orange vehicle is visible, including the roof and a small rear antenna, suggesting cars are parked or displayed outside the dealership.

Toward the right side of the image, a tall roadside sign displays the Nissan branding prominently. The sign has a white background with large red “NISSAN” letters, and beneath it is Japanese text reading “神奈川日産” (Kanagawa Nissan). Below the main sign is a vertical colorful banner with Japanese writing, likely advertising a campaign or promotion. Near the lower portion of the signpost, there are smaller signs including an “EV QUICK” charging symbol and a red parking sign with a white “P” and arrow.

The background includes a clear blue sky with wispy clouds, giving the scene a sunny, open atmosphere. Along the far right edge, multiple utility poles and dense overhead power lines run vertically through the frame, emphasizing a roadside urban or suburban setting in Japan. In the distance, additional buildings, parked cars, and another sign—possibly for ENEOS—can be seen. Overall, the image captures a Nissan dealership frontage with signage, cars, and surrounding street infrastructure under a bright blue sky.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Nissan汽车经销商外观的照片。在画面的左侧，可以看到部分建筑结构和一辆停靠在路边的红色轿车。正中是一个大型的Nissan品牌标志牌，其上方有一个较小的招牌写着'神奈川屋'。背景是晴朗的蓝天和几根横跨天空的电线。

caption:
The image shows the **Sydney Opera House** viewed from across the water on a bright, clear day.

In the foreground, deep blue harbor water fills the lower portion of the image, textured with small waves and shimmering highlights from the sunlight. Beyond the water is the broad platform and seawall of the Opera House complex, with walkways, railings, stairs, and scattered visitors visible as small figures.

The building dominates the scene with its famous series of large, white, sail-like roof shells. These curved forms rise in overlapping layers, resembling billowing sails or flower petals. The surfaces are pale cream-white and covered with subtle geometric tile patterns that catch the sunlight. The tallest shells are near the center, while smaller shells extend outward to the left and right, creating a rhythmic, sculptural silhouette.

Below the roof forms, the base of the building is a warm beige-brown color, with angular walls, broad stairways, and long horizontal sections. Dark glass windows and recessed openings appear beneath several of the roof shells, adding contrast to the bright white exterior. On the right side, a large stepped area leads upward, with more people walking or standing along the terraces.

The sky is a vivid, cloudless blue, making the white architecture stand out sharply. In the far left background, there are hints of a shoreline with trees, buildings, and red-roofed houses on a hillside. The overall atmosphere is sunny, open, and iconic, emphasizing the Opera House’s distinctive architecture and its waterfront setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示悉尼歌剧院的摄影作品，建筑物以其标志性的白色帆形屋顶和优雅的曲线设计在蓝天背景下显得尤为突出。歌剧院位于一片宽阔的水域旁，水面波光粼粼，反射着阳光。远处可以看到城市的轮廓，但主要焦点仍然是这座著名的建筑。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor roadside shelter or waiting area, likely a bus stop or school/community waiting shelter, set beside a quiet paved road.

In the foreground, there is a long, narrow shelter with a curved translucent blue roof. The roof is supported by bright orange vertical metal posts and beige/wood-toned curved roof frames. Beneath it is a long blue-tiled bench structure with several block-like supports. The shelter sits on a raised tiled platform with light gray and pale pink tiles. Orange safety railings run along the front edge of the platform.

To the left, red-painted concrete steps lead up toward the shelter area. Behind the shelter is a grassy embankment sloping upward. The slope is trimmed but uneven, with patches of exposed soil, small shrubs, and a few low plants. Some small concrete steps are embedded in the hillside, leading upward toward a building partially visible on the upper left.

At the top left, part of a colorful building can be seen. It has painted walls and a sign with readable text beginning “KAMI WARGA…”. Large, carefully trimmed green trees stand around the building, giving the area a maintained, institutional feel—possibly near a school, community hall, or public facility.

On the right side of the shelter, there is a tall utility pole with multiple cables and wires stretching across the sky and along the road. A colorful poster or advertisement is attached to the pole, though the smaller text is not fully legible. Behind it is a red metal frame structure, possibly a signboard or notice board.

The road runs along the right side of the image and curves or continues into the distance. It appears quiet with no visible vehicles or pedestrians. The surface is gray concrete or asphalt with faint red markings. A drainage channel runs between the raised shelter platform and the road.

The background is lush and tropical, with dense green trees, including palm trees, lining the roadside and hillside. The sky is overcast and pale gray, giving the scene a humid, subdued atmosphere. Overall, the image depicts a clean but slightly weathered roadside waiting area in a green, hilly neighborhood or public compound.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示公共汽车站的现实主义风格照片。车站位于一个开阔的区域，有一个蓝色的候车亭和橙色的金属柱子支撑着屋顶。候车亭上方有透明的玻璃顶棚，提供遮蔽。在候车亭旁边是一个绿色的草坪，上面种植了几棵小树和灌木。在候车亭前方，有一条空旷的道路，路边有红色的停车线标记。背景中可以看到一些电线杆和远处的树木，天空多云但光线充足。

caption:
The image shows a rainy urban street scene beside an ornate historic building. In the foreground, several people are gathered close together wearing hooded plastic rain ponchos. The ponchos are bright translucent colors—mostly vivid blue, with one person in a greenish teal poncho near the center. Raindrops are visible on the plastic surfaces, giving them a wet, glossy texture.

On the right, a person in a bright blue hooded poncho stands in profile facing the center of the group. Their hood is pulled tightly around their face, and they appear to be wearing dark gloves. In the middle, another person in a green rain poncho faces them; their face is blurred, and the hood forms a peaked shape over their head. On the left foreground, a person in a pale blue poncho is turned away from the camera, the hood and shoulders filling much of the lower-left portion of the frame.

Behind the group, a man in dark clothing and a black hat or hood appears to be looking down at something in his hands, possibly a phone or camera. Farther down the wet sidewalk, more pedestrians walk in the rain, some carrying umbrellas. The pavement is shiny with water and reflects the gray sky and surrounding shapes.

The background features a grand, old-style building with richly decorated stonework. It has arched windows, carved columns, ornamental trim, and textured stone walls. A red-toned section of the building with decorative architectural details is visible farther down the street. On the left side in the distance, there is a round street clock near leafless trees, reinforcing the cold, wet atmosphere.

Overall, the image has a damp, misty feel, with muted gray surroundings contrasted by the saturated blue and green rain ponchos in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三个人在雨中交谈的照片。他们穿着防水的蓝色雨衣，站在一座古典建筑前的人行道上。左侧的人物背对镜头，而中间和右侧的人物面对面站立，似乎在进行交谈。背景中的建筑物细节模糊，但可以辨认出其哥特式风格的立面和装饰性元素。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a tropical palm tree bearing a cluster of large, smooth, green fruits that resemble coconuts or large palm nuts. The fruits are oval to slightly heart-shaped, with glossy skins ranging from olive green to yellow-green, and some have brown, sun-darkened patches and scuff marks. They are tightly grouped around the trunk, emerging from thick, fibrous leaf bases.

The palm trunk and surrounding leaf stems are rough and textured, with peeling, dried brown sheaths and weathered gray-green surfaces. Some of the old fronds curl downward in long, dry strips, contrasting with the fresh green fruits. Bright sunlight hits the fruits strongly, creating shiny highlights and deep shadows between them, giving the cluster a rounded, three-dimensional appearance.

In the background, large fan-shaped palm leaves fill the scene with vivid green color. The leaves are slightly out of focus, emphasizing the fruit cluster in the foreground. The overall setting feels lush, tropical, and humid, with strong natural light and dense vegetation surrounding the palm.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示棕榈树上成熟椰子的自然摄影图像。图中可见一串绿色和黄色相间的椰子，它们紧密地挂在树枝上，部分椰子表面有明显的凹陷和斑点。背景是模糊的绿色植物叶片，为这张特写照片增添了一丝生机与自然感。

caption:
The image shows a lively pedestrian street or plaza in a historic European city, likely Lisbon, on a bright sunny day. The scene is framed by tall, old buildings on both sides and a wide cobblestone walkway running through the center.

In the foreground, the ground is paved with distinctive black-and-white Portuguese-style mosaic cobblestones, forming geometric patterns and broad bands across the plaza. Several rounded stone bollards sit near the center and edges of the walkway, separating the pedestrian area from café seating and nearby traffic zones.

On the left side, a large building is covered in scaffolding and translucent construction netting, suggesting renovation work. Its façade is mostly obscured, though arched windows and the structure of the building can be seen through the mesh. In front of it are café tables shaded by a large white umbrella, with people sitting and talking. A row of green rental bicycles is partly visible at the lower left. Tall black streetlights rise above the plaza, including one prominent lamp near the top left with a seagull perched on it.

On the right side, elegant white and cream buildings line the street. They have tall rectangular windows with dark green or black trim, stone surrounds, wrought-iron balconies, and decorative architectural details. Several storefronts occupy the ground floors. Visible signs include “United Colors of Benetton” on a white building, multiple red “Vodafone” signs, and a shop or café called “Tendinha.” A folded patio umbrella and outdoor café tables sit along the right edge, with people seated beneath the building façades.

The center of the image is busy with pedestrians walking in both directions. People are dressed casually for warm weather—shorts, T-shirts, summer dresses, backpacks, and hats. Some walk in groups, while others appear to be tourists strolling through the area. A few faces are blurred, and the crowd gives the street a relaxed, bustling atmosphere.

In the distance, the street narrows and slopes gently upward between rows of pastel-colored buildings with red-tiled roofs. Beyond them, on a green hill, a stone castle or fortified structure is visible, with towers and crenellated walls standing against the clear blue sky. This background landmark adds depth and a strong sense of place to the scene.

Overall, the image captures a sunny urban moment in a historic district: old architecture, cafés, shops, tourists, construction, and a scenic hilltop fortress all combined in a vibrant city street.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示繁忙城市街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一群人在铺有石块的人行道上行走，一些人正从左侧进入画面，而其他人则向右侧移动。街道两旁是色彩鲜明的建筑，其中一些建筑正在进行维修或翻新工作，部分墙面被脚手架覆盖。在画面的前景，有几个圆形的石头装饰品散落在地面上。在画面的右侧，可以看到一家户外咖啡馆，顾客们坐在桌边享受着阳光和休闲时光。整个场景被明亮的日光照亮，营造出一个温暖且活跃的城市氛围。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene in what appears to be a European city, likely in Poland based on the police markings (“POLICJA”) and road signs.

In the foreground, the lower half of the image is heavily blurred by the roof or hood of a nearby police vehicle. A bright, out-of-focus red-and-yellow flashing light is visible on the left, suggesting an active police or emergency presence close to the camera.

Beyond the blurred foreground, a wide multi-lane city street stretches into the distance. Tram tracks run down the center of the road, with overhead electrical wires crisscrossing above. Several traffic lights are visible, many showing green, and there are numerous road signs, including blue parking signs, one-way arrows, pedestrian crossing signs, and warning signs near a school area.

A police officer in a high-visibility vest stands near the center of the intersection, positioned on or beside the tram tracks, appearing to direct or monitor traffic. Nearby, a marked Polish police car is stopped or parked facing the camera, while another marked police car is on the right side of the street with its roof light bar visible.

Traffic is moderate. There are buses, cars, vans, and taxis moving or waiting along the road. A large white coach bus labeled “POLBUS” is prominent near the center, and a yellow-and-red city bus is visible farther back. Cars line both sides of the street, and some vehicles are parked along the curb.

The street is flanked by older multi-story buildings with a mix of architectural styles—cream, yellow, and brick facades, balconies, and storefronts. In the distance, a larger red-brick building with modern glass sections stands out. Trees with green and autumn-colored foliage line parts of the street, softening the dense urban setting.

Pedestrians are visible on sidewalks and near crossings, though they are small in the frame. The overall atmosphere suggests a controlled traffic situation or police operation in a central city area, with public transport, cars, pedestrians, and police activity all present at once.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面中央，一名警察站在交通管制区域内，身穿制服并戴着反光背心，正在指挥交通。街道上停有几辆汽车，包括一辆警车和一些私家车。背景中可以看到多层建筑、行人以及一些建筑上的广告牌。整个场景被蓝色的警戒线所环绕，营造出一种紧迫感。

caption:
The image is a close-up, angled view of the side of a bright red Canada Post delivery truck. The camera is positioned very near the vehicle, looking along its side so the truck’s panel stretches diagonally into the distance from left to right.

A large blue Canada Post sign dominates the center-right of the image. It contains white uppercase text reading “CANADA” above “POST,” with the French “POSTES” and “CANADA” visible on the right side. In the middle of the sign is the Canada Post logo: a red circle containing a stylized white envelope or arrow-like mail symbol. Thin white horizontal lines run across the blue sign.

The red truck surface is glossy and reflective, showing subtle reflections and light streaks. There are visible rivets along the metal panels, especially on the left edge and near the top. A vertical seam and a raised rectangular red metal fixture or panel are visible near the upper left-center, fastened with silver screws. Some minor scratches, scuffs, and paint wear can be seen on the red surface, giving the vehicle a used, working appearance.

Near the lower portion of the truck, partially visible white text reads: “From anywhere... to anyone • De partout... jusqu’à vous,” indicating bilingual English and French messaging. On the far right edge, a portion of another white sign or information panel is visible but mostly cut off.

The background is minimal, with a pale blue sky at the top right. The overall impression is of a Canada Post mail truck photographed in bright daylight, emphasizing the bold red color, official branding, and utilitarian metal details of the vehicle.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示加拿大邮政服务标志的红色车辆侧面的照片。标志位于车辆的中央，以蓝色和白色为主色调，上面印有'CANADA POST'的大写字母以及一个小巧的红色邮筒图案。在标志下方，有一行文字写着'From anywhere... to anyone. De partout... jusqu'à vous'，用法语表达着服务范围和目标客户群。车辆的颜色是鲜艳的红色，表面看起来有些磨损，显示出它可能经常用于运输和配送工作。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic nighttime view of Singapore’s Gardens by the Bay, dominated by the illuminated “Supertree” structures. Several enormous tree-like towers rise from the bottom of the frame, their trunks and branching canopies glowing in vivid electric blue and cyan light. The canopies spread outward like giant metallic umbrellas or futuristic coral, made of intricate networks of dark branching rods dotted with small purple-blue lights.

In the background on the left is the Marina Bay Sands hotel, recognizable by its three tall towers connected at the top by a long, boat-shaped sky park. Many of the hotel windows are warmly lit in yellow and orange, creating a striking contrast with the cool blue lighting of the Supertrees. The sky park is edged with bright white and blue light, and small areas of greenery are visible along its top.

The sky above is very dark, almost black at the top, fading into deep purple and navy near the horizon. A few faint clouds are visible behind the central Supertree, softly illuminated by city glow. The overall atmosphere is futuristic, vibrant, and theatrical.

In the middle of the scene, one large Supertree stands prominently in the foreground with a circular illuminated ring around its trunk, glowing red and blue. To the right, more Supertrees are connected by elevated walkways or lighted paths, with thin lines and tiny silhouettes suggesting people or structural elements. The lower portion of the image contains dark silhouettes of trees, shrubs, and garden structures, with scattered green, blue, and white accent lights. On the far right, small tent-like roofs or pavilion tops are faintly visible, lit by colorful lighting.

The composition emphasizes contrast: cool neon blues and purples against warm hotel lights, organic tree-like forms against modern architecture, and bright artificial illumination against the deep night sky. The scene feels like a blend of nature, technology, and urban spectacle.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示新加坡滨海湾花园夜景的摄影作品。图像中心是几个巨大的蓝色发光树形结构，它们被设计成类似棕榈树的形状，并且在夜晚发出明亮的蓝光。这些结构位于一个开阔的空间中，周围环绕着绿色植被和一些较小的建筑。在远处可以看到城市的灯光，为这个场景增添了活力和色彩。

caption:
The image shows a broad urban street lined with a mix of historic and modern buildings on a bright, clear day.

On the left and stretching into the middle of the image is a large, elegant historic building with a pale cream façade. It has tall rectangular windows with dark wooden frames, decorative stone trim, and ornate sculptural details above some of the windows. Near the far left, above a large arched entrance, there is a recessed niche containing a dark statue of a standing historical figure wearing a hat and holding an object, possibly a sword or staff. The entrance below is framed by heavy stonework and an ornate black wrought-iron gate. A round projecting sign hangs near the doorway, and several directory-style signs are mounted beside the entrance.

The building’s façade continues down the street with repeated window patterns, arched ground-floor openings, and subtle classical detailing. Higher up, parts of a reddish tiled roof and dormer windows are visible. The architecture feels European, with a historic, institutional or commercial character.

Along the curb in front of the buildings, many bicycles are parked in rows, suggesting a bike-friendly city. A cyclist in a white shirt is riding through the foreground on the street, slightly blurred from motion. Several pedestrians are walking or standing near the bicycles and entrances; their faces appear blurred. A couple of people are crossing or walking along the street near the center-right.

To the right of the historic façade, the street transitions into more contemporary architecture. There is a modern glass-fronted building with reflective blue-tinted windows and a curved or angled roofline. Beyond it is another modern building with horizontal reddish-brown panels and gray window bands. Farther down the street, more white and light-colored buildings recede into the distance.

The road itself is relatively quiet, with no cars visible in the immediate foreground. It has smooth dark asphalt and a marked edge near the curb. On the far right is a wide sidewalk paved with light stone slabs, bordered by a narrow strip of cobblestone-like paving. A leafy green tree occupies the right edge of the frame, partially shading the sidewalk.

The sky is bright blue with a few small white clouds, and the overall lighting suggests midday or afternoon sunshine. The scene feels calm, clean, and urban, combining historic European architecture, modern development, pedestrian activity, and bicycle culture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。在画面左侧，有一座装饰华丽的老式建筑，其正面有一个雕塑和一个拱形入口。街道上有多位行人正在行走，包括一位穿着粉色衣服的人、一位骑自行车的人以及几位步行者。右侧是现代风格的建筑群，其中一些建筑表面有玻璃幕墙。街道旁边停放着多辆自行车，而远处可以看到更多的行人和车辆。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor urban plaza or public entertainment area at dusk, with a mix of modern architecture, trees, and seating areas.

On the right side, a tall glass tower rises above the surrounding buildings. It has teal-colored metal framing and large transparent window panels, with warm interior lights visible inside. The top of the tower forms a pyramid-like glass roof, and a Canadian flag flies from a pole at its peak, blowing in the wind. A diagonal metal support beam extends outward from the tower, giving the structure a distinctive architectural look.

Below the tower is a lower building with teal-framed windows and a sloped roof. Through the glass, warm lights and some interior details can be seen, suggesting restaurants, shops, or public facilities. To the far right, partially hidden by trees, there are storefronts or entrances with bright neon signage, including red and pink lighting.

Large leafy green trees occupy much of the right and center of the image, partially obscuring the buildings and creating a shaded area. Beneath the trees are picnic tables and outdoor seating where a few people are sitting. A bicycle is parked near a tree trunk, and the ground is paved with stone or concrete.

On the left side, there is a striking red-and-teal structural installation or canopy support. It includes tall cylindrical columns covered in teal tiles, red metal beams, and a white tent-like canopy edge. Some lights are mounted on the structure, and a few people are gathered or walking nearby.

The sky is pale and overcast, with soft evening light. The overall scene feels like a lively public square or market area, combining modern glass architecture, outdoor dining, greenery, and colorful structural elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市景观的照片，前景左侧是一个带有红色标志的建筑结构，旁边是几棵绿树和一些行人。背景中是一座高耸的玻璃幕墙建筑，顶部飘扬着一面红旗。整个场景在傍晚时分拍摄，天空呈现出淡淡的蓝色调，而建筑物内部灯光透出温暖的黄色光芒。

caption:
The image shows a narrow, old European-style cobblestone street descending gently between tall stone and plaster buildings. The scene feels historic and slightly damp, likely after rain, with the cobbles and pavement reflecting a muted sheen.

At the center background is a prominent medieval-looking gate tower or fortified building. It has pale gray plaster walls with patches of exposed stone and weathering near the base. The tower is topped by a steep, pyramidal roof covered in reddish-orange clay tiles. Along the roof ridges are lighter trim stones, and at the very top is a thin metal spire with a decorative weather vane.

At the base of the tower is a large arched passageway, dark inside, suggesting a tunnel or gateway leading through the building. Above and around it are several narrow vertical windows with stone frames, giving the structure a defensive or old-town character.

The street itself is paved with rounded cobblestones in mixed browns, grays, and reddish tones. It curves slightly and slopes downward toward the arch. On the right side is a smoother stone sidewalk running alongside the buildings. The right wall in the foreground is rough, textured stone, with small rocks and mortar creating a rugged surface. A black metal handrail runs along this wall, and an old-fashioned black streetlamp projects from it farther down the lane.

On the right side, attached to one of the buildings, a red-and-yellow flag hangs outward from a pole; it resembles the Spanish flag. The buildings lining the right side are tall and close together, with gray and beige facades, narrow windows, drainpipes, and red metal roof elements or dormers near the top.

On the left side, there is another rough stone wall, lower and partially covered by greenery. A leafy tree with fresh green foliage leans into the frame, softening the otherwise stone-heavy scene. Fallen leaves are scattered lightly on the wet pavement.

The sky is overcast and pale, giving the scene soft, diffuse lighting with no harsh shadows. Overall, the image evokes a quiet historic quarter—possibly in an old town or fortified city—with medieval architecture, narrow lanes, weathered walls, and a calm, atmospheric mood.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲古老城市街道的照片。图像中心是一座具有传统建筑风格的房屋，其特点是尖顶和石墙结构。房屋的正面挂有西班牙国旗，表明它可能位于西班牙某个地区。街道由鹅卵石铺成，呈现出一种历史感。左侧的墙壁上长满了绿色植物，增添了一丝生机。整个场景在阴天的自然光照下拍摄，营造出一种宁静而古老的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a formal, historic-looking conference or diplomatic meeting room. The room is large and symmetrical, with high beige walls bordered by decorative trim and dark wooden paneling along the lower sections. Two polished wooden double doors are visible on the left and right sides, reinforcing the classical, institutional atmosphere.

At the center of the far wall, four large national flags are mounted in a fan-like arrangement on angled poles. From left to right they appear to be the United States flag, the French tricolor, the red flag of China, and the United Kingdom’s Union Jack. The flags are fixed to an ornate wall bracket beneath them. Above, part of a chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its curved metal arms and lit bulbs casting warm light into the room.

The foreground and middle of the room are filled with long rectangular conference tables covered in dark green tablecloths. Around them are many wooden chairs with carved backs and reddish-brown patterned upholstery, arranged closely as if for a large official meeting or negotiation. On the tables are several cut-glass water decanters, small glasses, ashtray-like dishes, microphones, and small tabletop flags, suggesting a diplomatic or international setting.

The lighting is warm and subdued, giving the room an old-world, ceremonial feel. The overall impression is of a formal governmental or treaty-room environment prepared for delegates, with the flags and seating arrangement emphasizing international diplomacy and official discussions.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示正式会议室内部的照片。房间内有排列整齐的长桌和椅子，桌上铺着绿色桌布，并摆放着透明玻璃瓶作为装饰。墙上挂着美国国旗、法国国旗和英国国旗，显示了会议地点可能具有国际意义。天花板上悬挂着一盏大型吊灯，为整个空间提供了充足的照明。

caption:
The image shows an art museum gallery with deep red walls, a checkered marble floor, and several visitors viewing artworks. In the foreground, dominating the right and lower half of the scene, is a large pale marble sculpture of a reclining female figure. She is draped in intricately carved fabric that gathers in folds across her body. Her head is tilted back slightly, one arm raised behind or above her head, and the other arm rests near her chest. The sculpture is displayed on a low plinth and protected by a rope barrier.

Behind the sculpture, a group of museum visitors stands along the wall, looking at paintings. Most are wearing winter coats or jackets. On the left, several people face a large oval-framed painting in an ornate gilded frame. The painting appears to show a colorful religious or classical scene with figures in rich robes. The gold frame is highly decorative, with carved floral and scroll-like details.

Toward the center-right of the wall is a rectangular painting in a gold frame. It depicts an outdoor architectural scene with groups of figures gathered in a plaza or courtyard, possibly a biblical or historical scene. A man in a tan coat stands near the center of the gallery looking toward the artworks, while another person bends slightly near a label or display panel beneath the painting. A child in a mustard-yellow puffer jacket stands nearby.

The gallery space feels formal and historic, with the contrast between the warm red walls, gilded frames, and pale marble sculpture creating a rich visual atmosphere. The composition captures both the artworks and the act of museum-going: people studying paintings while the monumental reclining statue occupies the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在博物馆内的雕塑特写照片。图中，一尊古典风格的女性雕像占据了前景，其细节精致，姿态优雅，穿着古典服饰，躺在地上，似乎在沉思或休息。背景中，一群参观者正围绕着另一件艺术品——一幅油画——进行讨论和欣赏。油画描绘了一群人物在一个户外场景中，周围环境充满了自然风光。整个场景被红色的墙壁所环绕，营造出一种温暖而专注的艺术氛围。

caption:
The image shows a youth soccer goalkeeper standing inside a full-size goal on an outdoor artificial-turf field. The player is wearing a bright yellow long-sleeved goalkeeper jersey, black goalkeeper pants, black gloves or wrist cuffs, and black soccer cleats with white stripes. They are holding a white soccer ball with blue and red accents in both hands at about waist height, slightly crouched as if preparing to distribute the ball or defend the goal.

The white goal frame dominates the scene, with the left post and crossbar clearly visible. A large white net hangs loosely behind and around the player, creating a dense grid pattern across much of the image. The net appears slightly sagging and uneven in places, especially near the top and right side, giving the goal a worn, active-use look.

The goalkeeper stands near the left side of the goal mouth from the viewer’s perspective, close to the left post. Their body is angled slightly forward, knees bent, suggesting alertness or readiness. The face is blurred, and the background is also somewhat out of focus, emphasizing the player and the goal area.

Behind the goal, there is a stadium setting with rows of red seats in the stands. A running track with a reddish surface is visible beyond the field. In the background, another person in a similar yellow top appears near the right side, standing farther away and partially obscured by the net. There are also indistinct figures and signage behind the goal, including a pale sign with Cyrillic-looking lettering.

The overall lighting is bright and slightly overexposed, giving the image a high-key look with washed-out highlights, especially on the white goal frame and net. The scene conveys a youth soccer match or training session, with the goalkeeper having just collected the ball inside the goal area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示足球守门员在比赛中的照片。守门员穿着黄色的球衣和黑色的裤子，站在绿色的人造草皮上，正专注地准备接住一个飞来的足球。他的姿势显示出专业和准备状态。背景中可以看到其他运动员和观众席，但它们模糊且不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a traditional Japanese shrine setting, viewed from a slightly elevated, centered perspective looking down a stone walkway.

In the foreground, a wooden offertory box stands in the middle of a paved path. It has a small roof made of dark, flat tiles and a slatted opening at the top where offerings would be placed. The box is weathered, with visible wood grain, dark metal fittings, and a small drawer-like panel on the front. Behind it, partially obscured by the box, is a person wearing a red, white, and blue knit hat, a light-colored coat, dark pants, and boots, standing as if praying or making an offering.

Directly behind the offertory box is a large stone torii gate. The torii is old and heavily weathered, with dark staining, moss, and pale lichen across its horizontal beams. A thick sacred rope, or shimenawa, hangs beneath the crossbeam, decorated with straw tassels and white zigzag paper streamers called shide. The gate’s two stone pillars are thick and textured, with a smaller horizontal support beam running between them.

On both sides of the torii are large stone lanterns. They are symmetrical in placement and have square windowed chambers, broad mushroom-like stone caps, and rounded bases. Some white lantern decorations with dark floral-like patterns hang nearby. The ground around the shrine is covered in gravel, while the central walkway is made of rectangular stone slabs.

Beyond the torii, the path descends straight down through the shrine grounds, creating a strong sense of depth. Several people can be seen in the distance walking along the approach. Tall evergreen trees frame the scene on both sides, their dense branches rising behind the torii. To the left is the side of a modern-looking building with horizontal paneling and a projecting roof. Farther back, more shrine structures, rooftops, signs, and a street-like approach are visible.

The sky is overcast, casting soft, muted light over the scene. The overall mood is quiet, solemn, and traditional, with the aged stone, sacred rope, lanterns, and tree-lined approach emphasizing the atmosphere of a historic Shinto shrine.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统神社入口的摄影照片。图像中心是一个大型的鸟居，其上方悬挂着一个带有文字的红色牌匾。在鸟居前方，有一个木制的供物台，上面放置了一些供品。一位戴着彩色帽子的人站在供物台后方，似乎正在献祭或祈祷。周围环境由几棵高大的树木和一些传统的日式建筑组成，营造出一种宁静而庄严的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, macro-style photograph of stacked payment cards, with a very shallow depth of field. The most prominent visible detail is a **VISA** logo in dark blue on a white rectangular label near the lower-right portion of the image. The logo sits on top of a red/orange card surface, suggesting a credit or debit card.

A pale, off-white card lies diagonally across the upper portion of the frame, partially covering the red card beneath it. Most of the card details are intentionally out of focus, creating a soft, blurred look. In the upper-right area, there are indistinct blue markings or text, but they are not readable due to the blur.

The red card surface underneath has a glossy finish, with small reflective highlights and what look like tiny water droplets or raised shiny specks scattered across it. The lower edge of the stacked cards is visible, showing thin layered edges and a slight reflective sheen.

The composition is angled, with the cards running diagonally from the lower-left toward the upper-right. The background is very dark, almost black, which makes the bright card surfaces and the Visa logo stand out. Overall, the image has a dramatic, commercial feel, emphasizing banking, payment cards, finance, or electronic transactions while keeping most identifying details obscured.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Visa信用卡的特写照片，卡片堆叠在一起，最上面的一张是白色的，而下面的两张分别是红色和黑色。每张卡上都清晰地印有Visa的标志，以及一些信用卡信息如号码和有效期。背景模糊，呈现出深色调，使得前景中的卡片更加突出。

caption:
The image shows a brightly lit vintage motel sign at night, photographed close-up against a nearly black sky.

Dominating the right side is a tall, angled vertical sign spelling **“MOTEL”** in large block letters. The letters are dark inside with bright white neon outlines, mounted on a pale yellow-green, boomerang-shaped panel that leans slightly to the right. The sign has a mid-century roadside design, with a retro, slightly futuristic shape.

To the left of it is a large curved marquee sign outlined with many small round amber bulbs. Inside the curve, red-orange neon letters spell **“AMERICANA”** in an arc. Beneath it, a smaller neon sign reads **“VACANCY”** in glowing red and white. The neon has a soft halo around it, giving the image a warm, hazy nighttime glow.

At the very top is a white illuminated panel with the **AAA Approved** logo and text, partially cropped by the frame. Below the main sign, another rectangular lit panel reads **“KING AND QUEEN SIZE BEDS.”**

On the lower right, a price board is partially visible. It advertises room rates, including **“SINGLE - ONE PERSON”** with a large **“17”** and smaller **“95”**, and below that another large price beginning with **“19”** and **“95”**, likely for double occupancy. Near the lower center are small credit card decals, including **Visa** and **MasterCard**.

The bottom left shows part of the motel building, including a red neon triangular roofline or awning glowing against brickwork. A small street sign reading **“S MONROE ST”** is visible in the darker area. The whole scene has a nostalgic roadside-Americana feel, with warm reds, oranges, yellows, and whites standing out sharply against the dark night background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在夜晚的汽车旅馆霓虹灯广告牌的照片。广告牌上以红色和白色为主色调，顶部有一个大型的'AMERICANA MOTEL'标志，中间有'Vacancy'字样，下方则是一个较小的'MOTEL'标志。在'Vacancy'旁边还有一个小牌子显示了房间类型的价格信息，包括单人床和双人床的价格。广告牌上方还挂有一个红白相间的'Approved'标志，表明该汽车旅馆已经获得了某种认证。

caption:
The image shows a grand, symmetrical hotel or historic building on a bright, clear day. The façade is painted a warm off-white or cream color, with dark brown tiled rooflines and decorative wooden eaves. The building has a colonial or Mediterranean-style architectural feel, with arched entrances, balconies, ornamental trim, and a formal central entrance.

At the center of the building is a prominent entrance pavilion with a rounded balcony above it. The balcony has a dark railing and greenery along the edge. Above it is an ornate decorative crest or relief, and several flagpoles rise from the roofline, including a red-and-white flag that appears to be the Peruvian flag. The words on the front appear to read “Country Club Lima Hotel.”

The entrance below has a set of wide steps leading up to arched doorways. A short red carpet is placed on the steps, emphasizing the main doorway. Two dark green lampposts stand in front of the entrance, framing the walkway. The central path leads from a paved driveway toward the hotel doors.

The building extends horizontally across the scene with wings on both sides. The side sections have rows of rectangular windows, arched ground-floor openings, balconies with black railings, and potted plants. Two taller rectangular tower-like sections rise near the center-left and center-right, adding balance to the composition.

Two very tall palm trees dominate the foreground, one on the left and one on the right, framing the hotel dramatically. Their thick textured trunks and large crowns of fronds reach high into the blue sky. The sky is cloudless and bright, giving the image a sunny, upscale, tropical atmosphere.

In front of the building are neatly manicured lawns, trimmed hedges, small ornamental shrubs, and a paved pedestrian path. A red bench sits near the center-left foreground, while a luggage cart or hotel trolley stands near the right side of the entrance area. The foreground includes a broad paved driveway with dark expansion lines forming geometric patterns. In the far background to the right, modern high-rise buildings are visible, contrasting with the hotel’s older, elegant architecture.

Overall, the scene presents a luxurious, historic hotel set in a polished garden environment, with a formal entrance, tropical landscaping, and a calm, sunny atmosphere.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有古典建筑风格的建筑物的照片。建筑物位于画面中央，其正面装饰有多个拱形门廊和窗户，顶部有一个带有旗帜的圆形屋顶。建筑物前有两个高大的棕榈树，左侧是一个红色的长椅，而右侧则有一条通往建筑物入口的道路。周围环境由修剪整齐的草坪、几棵树木和远处的现代建筑组成。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor festival or community celebration on a large wooden deck or stage area, set against a dense background of leafless trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. A colorful banner in the background reads “THE GREAT JEWISH FAMILY FESTIVAL,” with a “Lag BaOmer” hot-air-balloon graphic on the left and carnival-style imagery such as a Ferris wheel on the right.

In the foreground and center, a large group of people are dancing in a circle while holding hands. Many of the participants are dressed in traditional-looking black suits, white shirts, and black hats, giving the scene a festive Jewish community atmosphere. Several people are mid-step or mid-hop, with legs lifted and arms extended, creating a lively sense of motion.

Mixed into the crowd are entertainers dressed as clowns. One clown near the center wears a bright multicolored outfit with a vivid pink wig. On the right side, another clown wears a red-and-yellow outfit with white polka dots and a colorful curly wig. There are also other performers in bright costumes, including blue, red, and striped outfits, adding a carnival-like feel.

Behind the dancers is a small live music setup. A drummer is positioned near the center rear, seated behind a drum kit. To the right, musicians are playing instruments, including a guitarist and brass players; a trumpet is visible at the far right. Microphone stands, speakers, cables, instrument cases, and sound equipment are scattered around the stage area. On the left side, a tall stack of large black speakers sits on the deck.

The overall mood is energetic and joyful, with dancing, music, costumes, and festival decorations. The setting feels like a public family event or holiday celebration, combining live entertainment, communal dancing, and children’s-festival style performers.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示户外活动的照片，其中一群穿着黑色西装的人在舞台上跳舞，他们的动作协调一致。舞台的背景中，有几位身着鲜艳服装、戴着面具和头饰的人物正在表演，他们看起来像是喜剧演员或表演者。在照片的右侧，可以看到一块写有'THE GREAT JEWISH CIRCUS FESTIVAL'字样的横幅，表明这是一个犹太节日庆典的一部分。

caption:
The image shows a busy urban street scene in Japan, likely in Kyoto. The camera is positioned at street level, looking down a multi-lane road filled with traffic.

In the center foreground is a large city bus facing the viewer. It is painted in a pale green and dark green color scheme, typical of Kyoto city buses. The destination sign across the top front of the bus displays Japanese text and “Kyoto Sta.” in English, with a large route number “19” on the right. A blue wheelchair-accessibility symbol is also visible beside the route number. Through the wide front windshield, the bus driver can be seen seated at the wheel. The bus has large side mirrors extending outward, windshield wipers resting vertically, and a green license plate blurred at the bottom.

Behind and to the right of the main bus is a line of additional buses, including another green bus and a blue-and-white bus, suggesting heavy public transit traffic or a bus lane. On the far right in the distance, another older-looking green bus is visible traveling along the road.

To the left of the main bus, several cars are packed into adjacent lanes, including a black sedan in the foreground and a silver car behind it. A red bus or vehicle is partially visible farther back on the left side, adding to the sense of congestion.

Above the road are multiple traffic and road signs. A green traffic light is illuminated, indicating vehicles may proceed. A circular speed limit sign shows “40.” A large blue overhead road sign indicates Route 1, with arrows and Japanese text; it also references “E89” and “Daini-Keihan Exp,” pointing toward directions ahead and to the right. Additional Japanese signs are mounted near the traffic lights.

The surroundings include dense greenery on the left, with large leafy trees lining the sidewalk and partially covering buildings. On the right and in the background are mid-rise urban buildings with many windows. A pale pedestrian overpass or elevated structure spans the background. Beyond the buildings, faint blue-green hills or mountains are visible, giving depth to the cityscape.

Overall, the image captures a crowded Kyoto roadway with buses, cars, traffic lights, road signage, urban buildings, and greenery, conveying the atmosphere of a busy city transit corridor.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本城市街道上行驶的公交车的照片。在画面中央，一辆绿色和白色相间的公交车正沿着道路行驶，车身上有'京都19号'的标识。车辆前方显示着目的地为京都车站的信息。周围是其他车辆，包括一辆红色的双层巴士和几辆私家车。背景中可以看到城市的建筑和路标，其中有一个指向京都车站的方向指示牌。

caption:
