The image shows a close-up of a fruiting tree, likely a rambutan tree, with clusters of unripe green rambutan fruits hanging from thin brown branches.

The fruits are round to oval and covered in many long, soft, hair-like spines or tendrils. These tendrils curl outward in all directions, giving each fruit a fuzzy, sea-urchin-like appearance. The fruits are bright yellow-green to lime green, suggesting they are not yet ripe. Several of them have tiny water droplets clinging to the spines, adding a fresh, moist look, as if the photo was taken after rain or in a humid environment.

The fruits grow in clusters along reddish-brown stems. The stems have small dark bumps or nodes along them, and they branch out in different directions across the frame. Some clusters are sharply in focus in the foreground, especially the large fruits near the center and right side, while others in the background are slightly blurred.

Surrounding the fruits are broad, smooth, elliptical leaves in muted dark green and bluish-green tones. The leaves have visible central veins and a slightly waxy surface. Some leaves are large and close to the camera, partly framing the fruit clusters. The background is dense with more foliage and additional blurred green rambutan clusters, creating the impression of a lush tropical garden or orchard.

Overall, the image emphasizes the texture and abundance of the fruit, with the vivid green rambutans standing out against the darker leafy background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一簇绿色果实的自然摄影图像。果实紧密地聚集在树枝上，每个果实由许多小球形部分组成，形成了一个独特的外观。它们被绿叶所环绕，背景模糊，突出了果实的细节和颜色。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a bright café or service-area coffee shop, branded **“COFFEE FELLOWS.”** The scene is viewed from the customer side, looking toward the counter.

At the top center, a large illuminated white sign reads **COFFEE FELLOWS** in bold capital letters, mounted on a dark blue-gray wall. To the left of the sign is the Coffee Fellows logo: a stylized face on a red square, with the brand name beneath it. Above the café area are large horizontal windows or skylight-like panels with metal framing, letting in strong daylight. Wooden beams and warm-toned wood paneling give the space a modern but cozy feel.

The coffee counter stretches across the middle of the image. It has a light wood front with horizontal slats and a dark countertop. Behind the counter are menu boards displaying drinks, snacks, and prices, though the small text is not fully readable. There are posters advertising cold or summer drinks, including one with the phrase **“Summer Breeze.”** A coffee machine, cups, syrups or flavor bottles, packaged products, and display items are arranged behind and on the counter. On the right side of the counter area, a glass display case appears to hold bottled drinks and food items.

Two customers stand in front of the counter with their backs mostly toward the viewer. One man in the center wears a bright blue T-shirt, dark shorts, dark socks, shoes, and a blue cap; he stands with one hand on his hip while looking at the counter. To his right, another man wears a green T-shirt, light-colored shorts, white socks, and dark shoes, also facing the counter. A staff member is partially visible behind the register area.

On the right wall, there is a bright red restroom sign marked **“WC”** with icons for toilets, baby changing, accessibility, and other facilities. Above it is a green emergency exit sign. Next to the restroom sign are shelves holding rows of bagels or donut-shaped bread items.

The left side of the image is filled with a souvenir display rack holding many colorful plush toys and keychains, including turquoise, pink, green, and beige stuffed animals. This gives the impression that the café is inside a travel stop, station, or family-oriented public venue rather than a standalone coffee shop. On the far right, another merchandise display with colorful packaged items and hanging textiles is partially visible.

The floor is tiled in light beige squares with dark grout lines, and sunlight creates bright patches near the right side of the room. Overall, the atmosphere is clean, casual, and busy, combining a coffee counter with snack displays, souvenirs, and public facility signage.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示咖啡店内部的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一个木质柜台，上方悬挂着'COFFEE FELLOWS'的标志牌。一位穿着蓝色T恤和深色短裤的男性顾客站在柜台前，似乎在点单或等待服务。另一位穿着绿色上衣和浅色短裤的男性顾客背对着镜头，站在柜台外侧。店内装饰以木质元素为主，墙上挂有各种菜单和价格表，柜台上摆放着咖啡机和其他饮料设备。整个场景被柔和的自然光照亮，营造出一个温馨舒适的购物环境。

caption:
The image shows a spacious urban architectural scene, likely within a historic civic or governmental complex. The composition contrasts modern monumental architecture with ornate traditional church domes in the background.

On the right side, dominating most of the frame, is a very large pale stone building with a long, repeating façade. Its surface is clad in light beige or cream-colored rectangular stone panels, softly illuminated by warm sunlight. Tall vertical ribs or columns run along the wall at regular intervals, creating a strong sense of rhythm and perspective as the building recedes into the distance. The sunlight gives the stone a golden glow, especially on the rightmost sections.

In the center and lower part of the image is a broad paved plaza made of large rectangular stone slabs. The paving appears slightly reflective, suggesting it may be damp or polished. The open space leads toward a passageway beneath a lower connecting structure. Near the bottom right, a single person dressed in dark clothing walks along the base of the large building, carrying a tan or brown shoulder bag. The figure is small compared with the architecture, emphasizing the scale of the space.

On the left and center-left is a lower, modernist building with a pale stone exterior and large rectangular windows framed in gold or brass-colored metal. The windows have a greenish-blue tint, and curtains are visible behind some of the lower windows. A covered passage or bridge-like section spans across the walkway, supported by a column; beneath it is a small circular height-clearance sign.

Behind this modern structure, ornate historic church architecture rises into view. Several onion domes with polished gold surfaces catch the light, each topped with slender crosses. The domes sit on richly decorated cylindrical drums in deep red, green, and blue tones, creating a striking contrast with the austere stone buildings around them. Additional rooftops with teal-green metal and a small golden spire are visible nearby, adding layers of historic detail.

The sky is pale blue with soft, thin clouds, and the lighting suggests late afternoon or early morning, with warm sunlight coming from the right. At the far left edge, bare tree branches and a small fenced-off area are visible, adding a seasonal or urban maintenance detail. Overall, the image presents a quiet, almost empty architectural courtyard where monumental modern stone walls frame a glimpse of traditional Russian-style golden domes in the background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街景的摄影作品，前景是一座现代风格的建筑，其特点是垂直排列的长条形结构和大面积的玻璃窗户。中景是一位穿着黑色服装的人正在建筑物前走过，背对着镜头。背景是远处的金色圆顶教堂，与现代建筑形成鲜明对比。整个场景在自然光照下拍摄，天空呈现出温暖的色调，给人一种宁静而和谐的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a polished vintage twin‑engine aircraft moving low across a grassy airfield, captured in a side-on panning shot. The plane is oriented nose-left, tail-right, and appears to be either landing or taking off, with its landing gear extended and the wheels just above or lightly touching the grass.

The aircraft has a shiny bare-metal silver finish that reflects the ground and sky. On the forward fuselage, large red text reads “Red Bull,” accompanied by the red charging bull logo. The nose is glazed with multiple framed window panels, giving it the distinctive look of a World War II-era bomber or transport aircraft. The cockpit windows are visible above the nose section, and a pilot or crew member can be seen through the side window.

There are two large radial engine nacelles mounted on the wings, one visible near the center of the frame. The propeller is spinning rapidly, appearing as a faint translucent blur. The wing stretches back toward the twin-tail section, and the aircraft has two vertical stabilizers at the rear. On the right tail fin, a small U.S. flag is visible along with registration markings that appear to read “N6123C.”

The landing gear is down: a small nose wheel is visible beneath the front of the plane, and the larger main landing wheels are beneath the fuselage and wing area. The aircraft’s metal skin shows rivets, panel lines, and subtle reflections, emphasizing its classic construction.

The background consists of a blurred line of green trees and a pale, almost white sky. The foreground grass is also motion-blurred, suggesting the camera followed the aircraft as it moved quickly along the runway or field. The overall impression is of a historic Red Bull-branded aircraft performing a low-speed pass, landing roll, or takeoff run at an airshow or aviation event.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一架涂有'Red Bull'标志的复古飞机在飞行中的照片。飞机呈现出银灰色，机身上清晰地印有'Red Bull'字样和一个醒目的红色图案。它正从画面左侧飞向右侧，背景是模糊的绿色草地和树木。

caption:
The image shows a white utility van parked or driving along a road in an urban roadside setting. The van appears to be a Toyota Hiace-style service vehicle with blue branding and Thai writing on the side. Large blue letters read “TOT,” suggesting it belongs to a telecommunications company. Additional Thai text and a marking that appears to include “SP-215” are printed near the front side panel.

On the roof of the van is a black metal roof rack carrying a very long bamboo pole or bundled bamboo poles that extend far beyond the length of the vehicle, especially toward the front and rear. A coil of black cable is also secured on top of the roof rack, reinforcing the impression that this is a telecom or utility maintenance vehicle. The van has dark tinted windows, a sliding side door, and visible dirt and wear along the lower body panels and wheel arches.

The background is dominated by many overhead electrical and communication wires running horizontally and diagonally across the scene. Several utility poles with insulators and transformers are visible, creating a dense network of cables above and behind the van. A large tree with mostly bare branches and a few small reddish-orange blossoms rises behind the wires. Other greenery, hedges, and trees are visible near the roadside.

To the right side of the image, part of a commercial sign or advertisement can be seen with large colorful numbers, including “99%” and “100,” along with Thai text. There is also a building or structure with a light-colored exterior and a blue trim partially visible behind the van. On the left, a small shrine-like decorative structure with gold coloring can be seen near the roadside, partly obscured by the van and foliage.

The scene appears to be photographed in bright daylight under a clear or lightly hazy sky. The composition emphasizes the service van in the foreground, with the chaotic web of overhead cables and urban infrastructure forming a busy backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一辆白色丰田面包车在城市街道上的照片。车辆的侧面贴有蓝色和黑色的广告，上面写着'TOT'和'SD-215'等字样，并且有一个电话号码。车辆停在一个有电线杆和树木的城市环境中，背景中还可以看到其他汽车和一些模糊的建筑结构。

caption:
The image shows the interior of a small, old-fashioned wooden church or chapel, viewed from the back looking toward the front altar area.

The room is simple and rustic, with a long rectangular layout. Rows of dark, weathered wooden pews fill the foreground and middle of the space, arranged in two sections with an aisle down the center. The pews are handmade-looking, with thick boards, visible grain, knots, scuffs, and worn edges. Their deep brown color contrasts warmly with the pale walls and floor.

At the far end of the room is a modest raised platform or altar area. A wooden pulpit or lectern stands slightly left of center, and behind it are simple wooden altar furnishings, including a small table or communion rail-like structure. Above the altar, mounted on the plain white back wall, is a simple wooden cross. The cross is dark brown and unadorned, emphasizing the plain, traditional character of the space.

The walls are painted white or off-white, but the paint looks aged and slightly worn. The wall surfaces are made of horizontal wooden boards, with many small marks, scratches, and imperfections visible. The ceiling is also wooden, painted a warm tan or light brown, with long narrow planks running lengthwise. The ceiling appears high and slightly sloped, giving the room an open but humble feeling.

Several tall rectangular windows line the side walls. On the left, sunlight streams in through the windows, creating bright patches and warm highlights on the pews and wooden floor. The windows have white frames and simple panes, and through them faint greenery and outdoor light can be seen. The right wall has similar windows, also bringing in daylight. The natural light gives the space a quiet, peaceful atmosphere.

The floor is made of light-colored wooden planks with visible grain patterns. It looks clean but aged, matching the historic character of the room. There are no decorations beyond the cross and simple altar furniture, reinforcing the minimal, rural chapel aesthetic.

Overall, the image depicts a serene, historic church interior—plain, sunlit, and intimate, with weathered wooden pews, white plank walls, a warm wooden ceiling, and a simple cross at the front.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示了一个古老教堂内部的照片。照片中，木质的长椅排列在房间内，墙壁和天花板均为白色，地板为浅色木板。房间中央悬挂着一个简单的十字架，而窗户则让自然光线洒满整个空间。

caption:
The image shows a busy airport apron viewed from inside a terminal, likely through a large window, with faint vertical reflections visible across the scene.

In the middle of the image is a large ANA aircraft parked on the tarmac. It has a white fuselage with a dark blue stripe and a large blue tail fin marked “ANA” in white letters. The slogan “Inspiration of JAPAN” is printed along the side, and “787”/Dreamliner markings are visible near the rear, indicating it is a Boeing 787. A mobile passenger stairway is positioned near the front left door, and several ground vehicles and service carts are parked nearby.

In the foreground, a smaller Air China aircraft is parked parallel to the ANA plane. Its white fuselage has the red Air China phoenix logo on the tail and “AIR CHINA” written in English alongside Chinese characters. A stairway is connected near the front door, with a few ground crew members and service vehicles around the aircraft. Orange safety cones are placed around parts of the plane and equipment.

The concrete apron is wide and sunlit, with painted taxiway and stand markings. Beyond the parked aircraft are runways or taxiways separated by strips of grass and drainage water. In the far background, there is a large construction or industrial area with cranes, scaffolding, fencing, and partially built structures, giving the airport surroundings a busy, developing appearance. The overall scene feels bright, hazy, and active, typical of a large international airport during daytime operations.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在机场停机坪上的两架商用飞机的照片。前方的飞机是Air China，涂装为白色和蓝色，尾翼上印有红色的中国国旗图案。后方的飞机则是All Nippon Airways（ANA），涂装为白色和蓝色，并带有'Inspiration of Japan'的字样。两架飞机都处于停靠状态，周围配有地面服务车辆和其他设施。

caption:
The image is a close-up portrait of a person photographed outdoors with a shallow depth of field. Their face is intentionally blurred, making facial features indistinct, while the focus is largely on their hair and clothing.

The person has very voluminous, dark, tightly curled hair that fills much of the upper and left side of the frame. Individual curls and wispy strands are visible, especially along the top and right edges, where the hair catches soft light and forms loose spirals against the pale background. The hair has a natural, textured look, with some curls extending outward in different directions.

The person is turned slightly to the side, facing toward the right side of the image. Their skin tone appears medium to deep brown, though the face is heavily softened/blurred. They are wearing a tan or camel-colored ribbed turtleneck sweater, visible around the neck and upper chest. Over it appears to be a dark blue shirt or layer, possibly denim or corduroy, with a collar and stitching visible. On top, they wear a darker outer jacket, likely brown or black, with a slightly shiny, leather-like or coated fabric texture.

The background is out of focus and softly lit, with muted gray, beige, and pale blue tones. It suggests an urban or street setting, but no clear objects are distinguishable. The overall mood is calm and intimate, with the composition emphasizing the texture and shape of the hair, layered clothing, and soft natural lighting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位人物特写的照片，其中人物的面部被模糊处理以保护隐私。人物的头发蓬松且卷曲，呈现出自然的黑色调。他们穿着一件深色的外套和一条浅棕色的高领毛衣，整体造型显得休闲而时尚。背景虽然模糊，但可以隐约看出是在户外拍摄，可能是一个城市环境。

caption:
The image shows the exterior of a historic red-brick museum building viewed from a low, upward-looking angle. Two tall, narrow white vertical banners hang down the façade. The left banner reads “STEDELIJK” in large dark letters, and near the top it says “MUSEUM.” The right banner reads “AMSTERDAM,” also in large vertical dark lettering. Together they identify the building as the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam.

The architecture is ornate and old-fashioned, with red brick walls divided by pale stone horizontal bands and decorative stone accents. On the right side of the image, the façade features elaborate sculptural details: carved panels, ornamental stonework, and a statue of a standing human figure set into a recessed niche above a decorative ledge. Higher up, there is a circular ornamental stone feature framed by carved details.

A large window with a pale greenish-blue tint appears in the lower right, reflecting nearby buildings. Near the center-left of the building, a small security camera is mounted on a bracket, pointing outward. The sky on the left side is overcast and pale gray, creating a muted, cloudy atmosphere. Bare tree branches are visible in the lower left corner, suggesting a winter or early spring setting. The composition emphasizes the height of the museum façade and the contrast between the clean modern banners and the richly detailed historic brick architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam建筑外观的照片。建筑物的外墙是红色砖石，上方悬挂着一个白色的长条形标志牌，上面用黑色字体写着'MUSEUM STEDELIJK AMSTERDAM'。建筑的一侧装饰有一个雕像，位于一个复杂的石制基座上，旁边是一个带有窗户的门廊。

caption:
The image shows a lively evening street festival in Japan, captured during blue hour just after sunset. The sky is a deep, vivid blue, creating a striking contrast with the warm golden glow of many paper lanterns.

On the left foreground, a large illuminated paper lantern dominates the scene. It is oval-shaped with horizontal ribbing and a bold black three-comma swirl crest, resembling a traditional tomoe symbol. The lantern hangs from a wooden structure, likely part of a shopfront or festival display, and its warm light casts a soft amber tone against the darker surroundings.

In the center distance, a festival float or decorated shrine structure is covered with rows of glowing lanterns. The lanterns are arranged in tiers, forming a bright focal point at the end of the crowded street. The float has ornate details and a small roofline, with more lanterns and banners attached. Some Japanese characters are visible on the lanterns and signs, adding to the traditional festival atmosphere.

The street is packed with people. Many attendees are wearing summer yukata or kimono-style clothing, including patterned robes and obi sashes. A few people in the foreground wear light-colored yukata, while one person near the center-right wears a dark floral yukata with bright purple and blue flowers. Others are dressed in casual modern clothing. The crowd fills the narrow street, moving toward and around the illuminated float.

Traditional wooden buildings line both sides of the street. On the right, there are dark wooden facades, tiled roofs, balconies, and lit windows. Some modern apartment-like buildings rise behind them, creating a mix of old and contemporary urban architecture. Overhead, several utility wires stretch diagonally across the sky, emphasizing the narrow city street setting.

Additional smaller lanterns hang along the street and from buildings, repeating the same circular crest motif seen on the large foreground lantern. Their warm light gives the scene a festive, intimate feel. The overall mood is celebratory and atmospheric, with the glow of lanterns, dense crowd, traditional clothing, and historic street setting suggesting a major Japanese summer festival.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示日本传统节日庆典的摄影照片。在图像中，我们可以看到一群穿着和服的人们聚集在一起，他们正沿着街道行走，参与着一个夜间活动。天空已经暗下来，但街道上的灯光为场景增添了温暖的氛围。最显眼的是挂在顶部的巨大灯笼，其上印有黑色的图案，而背景中的建筑物则被装饰得如同节日般热闹。

caption:
The image shows a wide, frontal view of a grand historic building, likely a palace or museum, built in an ornate Indo-Saracenic/Rajasthani architectural style. The structure is symmetrical and stretches horizontally across the frame, with a large central section and smaller domed pavilions on both sides.

The building is made of pale beige and sandstone-colored stone, giving it an aged, heritage appearance. It has multiple tiers, arched openings, carved balconies, railings, and decorative columns. At the center rises a prominent multi-level tower topped with a large domed pavilion and smaller domes around it. On both the far left and far right are large chhatri-style domed towers with open archways and decorative eaves. Several smaller domed kiosks line the roofline, adding to the ornate silhouette.

In front of the building is a fenced boundary and a broad pedestrian area. There are scattered people walking or standing near the entrance and along the pavement. Some are dressed in bright colors, including yellow and orange clothing, which stand out against the muted tones of the stone building and gray sky. A large number of pigeons are gathered on the ground near the walkway, while more birds are flying across the sky above the building.

The foreground is dominated by a wide asphalt road with lane markings. On the right side of the road, two people are riding a motorcycle toward the camera. Their figures are slightly dark compared to the brighter background. The road surface is mostly empty, making the motorcycle and the monumental building behind it the main visual focus.

The sky is overcast and pale gray, giving the scene soft, diffused lighting with little shadow. Trees are visible on both sides behind the building, especially to the right, framing the architecture. Overall, the image captures a lively urban heritage scene: an impressive historic monument, birds in motion, pedestrians, and everyday traffic in the foreground.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示印度传统建筑风格的图像，画面中心是一座宏伟的宫殿式建筑，其设计精美，装饰华丽。在宫殿前方的宽阔街道上，有几辆摩托车和行人正在穿行，而一些鸽子则在建筑物前的广场上悠闲地漫步。天空中飞翔着几只鸟儿，为这个场景增添了一丝生动的气息。

caption:
The image shows a theatrical stage performance with dancers in ornate, showgirl-style costumes. The scene is brightly lit with dramatic colored stage lighting and a grand, architectural backdrop.

On the right side, several performers are mid-dance, wearing sparkling white and silver costumes with rhinestone-like embellishments. The women have tall, elaborate orange-red headdresses with gold decorative centers, matching orange fabric accents, white high-heeled boots, and structured white costume pieces around the shoulders, waist, and legs. One dancer in the foreground is posed with one arm extended and one leg lifted, suggesting a choreographed partnered dance move. Beside her, a male performer in a glittering white outfit with green trim holds or guides her arm, also posed dynamically.

Another female dancer stands further right, similarly dressed in a white jeweled costume and orange headdress, with her arm extended outward. On the left side of the stage, more performers in matching attire are visible, though partially obscured and farther away. There are also large, ornate red-and-gold throne-like chairs or decorative props near the lower left, adding to the lavish, cabaret or revue-like atmosphere.

The stage set resembles an old city or palace façade. The background includes stone-textured walls, columns, arches, a domed tower silhouette on the upper left, and a decorative streetlamp near the center-left. The left side is washed in cool blue light, while the right side glows with warm red, orange, and amber tones. A vertical row of bright circular stage bulbs runs near the center-right, and intense spotlights beam through haze or theatrical smoke, creating a glowing, atmospheric effect.

Overall, the image captures a vibrant, glamorous stage show with elaborate costumes, synchronized dance movement, and dramatic lighting against a stylized architectural set.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在剧院或舞台上进行的舞蹈表演的照片。照片中，四位舞者穿着华丽的服装和装饰性的头饰，在聚光灯下跳舞。他们身着白色带有绿色装饰的服装，头戴金色和红色的高顶帽，脚踩白色的长靴。舞台背景模仿了城堡的外观，营造出一种戏剧性的氛围。

caption:
The image shows three adults posing together at what appears to be a formal or nightlife event, in front of a white step-and-repeat backdrop printed repeatedly with the “MOËT & CHANDON CHAMPAGNE” logo and small crown/star details. The lighting is bright and flash-heavy, creating strong highlights on the subjects and shadows on the backdrop.

In the center is a man dressed entirely in black: a black button-up shirt, black trousers, a black belt, and black dress shoes. He stands with his arms around the two women beside him, posing closely for the camera.

On the left is a blonde woman wearing a fitted black lace dress with a sleeveless/halter-style top and a hem that falls above the knee. She has a decorative floral headpiece or hair accessory with red and light-colored flowers. She carries a small black studded crossbody bag and wears black platform high-heeled sandals. One leg is crossed slightly in front of the other in a posed stance, and one hand rests on her hip.

On the right is another blonde woman wearing a black sleeveless top and a short white skirt. She holds a light-colored smartphone in one hand and has a white bag or clutch tucked behind her arm. She is wearing a wristwatch and beige or taupe platform high heels. Her pose is angled toward the man, with one hand near her waist and one leg bent slightly.

The setting has a white wooden plank floor, giving the scene a clean, bright event-photo look. Along the far left edge of the image there is a large vertical white sign or decorative panel with oversized black lettering partially visible. Near the bottom center behind the group, there appears to be a white decorative bottle-shaped object with a shiny gold element. The overall atmosphere suggests a promotional champagne event, party, or red-carpet-style photo area.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张在Moët & Chandon品牌活动上拍摄的照片，展示了三位社交场合中的参与者。左侧的女性穿着黑色蕾丝连衣裙和高跟鞋，头发扎成一个简单的发髻，并佩戴着红色的头饰。中间的男性穿着深色衬衫和黑色裤子，脚踩一双棕色皮鞋。右侧的女性穿着白色无袖上衣和灰色短裤，搭配黑色高跟鞋。他们站在带有Moët & Chandon标志的背景前，背景中还可见到一些模糊的品牌标识。

caption:
The image shows a retail store display shelf filled with packaged headphones and earphones hanging on white metal hooks.

Across the top row are several larger headphone boxes:

- On the far left is a large white box containing bright lime-green over-ear headphones. The packaging has the word “HEADPHONES” printed vertically in large letters along the left side. It mentions “AUX audio playback” and shows small feature icons along the bottom.
- In the center are two nearly identical black boxes labeled “WIRELESS STEREO HEADPHONE.” They have a clear plastic window showing the headphones inside. The boxes include text such as “Fashion and classic texture,” “HD Play Music,” “10M,” “V5.0,” and “HiFi.” A model number “X-1007” is visible, along with a gold circular badge near the lower right.
- On the right is a teal and white headphone box with large vertical text reading “SOUND.” It shows a pair of headphones inside and includes phrases like “High Sound Quality” and “Headphone.” The brand appears to be EZRA, and the model marking looks like “BW03.”

Small white price tags are clipped above and below many hooks. Some top tags show prices around “RM 49.00,” while lower tags show prices such as “RM 11.90,” “RM 12.90,” and “RM 12.17.”

The lower section contains smaller earphone packages:

- Several compact boxed earphones hang in white or transparent packaging.
- Some packages are branded “Sibyl,” including white earbuds in a clear-front box.
- Two dark packages in the middle are labeled “My kingdom” and have a crown graphic near the bottom.
- On the lower right is a tall white box labeled “Slim & foldable,” showing a pair of foldable stereo headphones. The brand “AIMA” and model “AM-009” are visible.

The display is organized on a white slatwall panel with horizontal grooves and multiple metal hooks. The overall scene looks like an electronics/accessories aisle in a store, focused on affordable headphones and earphones.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示各种耳机产品的照片，包括有线和无线耳机。在图像的左侧，有一个绿色头带的有线耳机，其包装盒上印有品牌标志。紧邻着的是两个黑色的无线耳机盒子，上面同样印有品牌标志，并且标有产品型号和特点。右侧是几个白色耳机盒，其中一些已经打开，展示了内部的产品。背景中可以看到其他耳机的包装盒，但它们模糊不清，不是焦点。

caption:
The image shows a close-up of a large pale stone monument featuring carved historical figures arranged along the prow of a ship-like structure. The scene is photographed from below, making the statues appear tall and imposing against a vivid, cloudless blue sky.

On the right, a prominent standing figure faces outward, wearing a large, ornate hat and heavy robes. This figure holds a small model of a sailing ship with curved sails, reinforcing a maritime/exploration theme. Below and slightly in front of this figure is another carved figure kneeling or leaning forward, dressed in armor, with detailed chainmail-like texture and a sword held upright.

To the left are several more sculpted figures clustered together. They wear period clothing such as tunics, robes, caps, and armor. Some hold symbolic objects, including a globe-like sphere, a cross-shaped or navigational instrument, and scroll-like items. The carving includes many fine details: folds in garments, textured hair, belts, cuffs, armor plates, and decorative patterns.

The monument itself is made of light beige or white stone, with visible weathering, gray streaks, dark stains, and small rust-colored marks. The base forms a sharp triangular prow shape, resembling the front of a ship jutting outward. A vertical stone surface is visible at the far left edge, likely part of the larger monument.

Overall, the image conveys a grand commemorative sculpture celebrating exploration, navigation, and historical seafaring figures, with strong sunlight emphasizing the relief and shadows in the stonework.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示历史纪念性雕塑的摄影作品，雕塑位于一个高台上，背景是晴朗的蓝天。雕塑描绘了几位穿着传统服装的人物，他们似乎在进行某种仪式或活动。人物的姿态各异，有的手持乐器，有的背着物品，整体造型庄重而生动。

caption:
The image shows an Egyptian-themed urban complex under a bright blue sky. The most striking feature is a massive golden sphinx-like statue in the foreground, positioned slightly right of center. Its head resembles a lion or feline with a stylized pharaoh headdress, carved facial details, and a weathered, textured surface that catches warm sunlight. The statue rises above surrounding greenery, including palm trees and dense shrubs at the bottom of the scene.

Behind the statue stands a tall beige-and-brown high-rise building with many rows of windows and balconies. Near the top of the building, a red sign reads “SUNWAY.” The building has a hotel or residential-tower appearance, with stepped architectural details and warm cream-colored walls.

To the right is a large pyramid-shaped structure with a bronze or terracotta-colored surface. Its triangular sides are covered with a geometric grid pattern, and a glassy triangular cap sits near the top. The pyramid reinforces the Egyptian theme of the complex.

On the left side, partially behind the main tower, another building has a glass pyramid-like roof structure with another visible “SUNWAY” sign in red lettering. Near the lower left foreground is a small domed structure with a turquoise roof decorated with red-and-white zigzag patterns, adding to the ornamental, theme-park-like architecture.

The scene is framed by tropical landscaping, including palm fronds, leafy trees, and streetlights. The lighting is warm and clear, suggesting daytime with good visibility. Overall, the image depicts the Sunway Pyramid area, combining modern high-rise architecture with large-scale Egyptian-inspired decorative elements.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代城市中一座巨大金色狮子雕塑的照片。雕塑位于画面的前景，占据了大部分视野，其背后是几座现代化的建筑和一个三角形的金字塔形状结构。天空晴朗，云朵稀疏，为整个场景增添了一种宁静而庄严的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a rainy urban street scene, likely in a city center or shopping district. The pavement and road are wet and reflective, with puddles scattered across the brick-patterned sidewalk and asphalt, indicating recent or ongoing rain. The sky is overcast and gray.

In the foreground on the left, two pedestrians walk along the sidewalk under a large patterned umbrella. Their faces are blurred. One person wears a dark raincoat and light gray pants, while the other is partially hidden by the umbrella and appears to be wearing a green coat and jeans. The umbrella has a gray and black decorative floral or lace-like pattern. Behind them, another person with a smaller umbrella is partly visible near the building entrance.

The left side of the image is lined with older multi-story buildings. The nearest building is painted pale green with large arched windows and storefront signage. A prominent sign reads “REVLON” and “LUX ELITE,” suggesting a beauty or cosmetics-related shop. There are decorative metal elements and awnings above the entrance. Farther down the street, a yellow building has a storefront with large Cyrillic lettering reading “АКЦЕНТ” above the windows. The buildings have balconies, enclosed window structures, and a mix of commercial and residential features.

The sidewalk extends into the distance toward an intersection. Several pedestrians can be seen farther away, many carrying umbrellas. A silver car is parked near the curb, and more vehicles are visible on the road, including a white van, a red van, and several cars. The street appears moderately busy but not crowded.

On the right side, there is a tall decorative streetlamp with multiple round white globe lights mounted on a black and bronze pole. Flower baskets filled with red flowers hang beneath the lamps, adding color to the otherwise gray, rainy scene. Trees with dense green leaves line the right side of the street, partially framing the view.

In the background, there are additional apartment or office buildings, billboards, traffic lights, utility wires, and street signs. One traffic light is visible near the intersection, and overhead wires cross the sky. The overall atmosphere is damp, subdued, and urban, with everyday pedestrian and vehicle activity continuing despite the rain.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示雨天城市街道的现实主义风格照片。在画面左侧，两位女性正撑着伞沿着人行道行走，一位穿着黑色外套和牛仔裤，另一位穿着灰色上衣和白色裤子。她们似乎正在交谈，伞下的雨水在人行道上形成了一条小溪流。街道两旁是多层建筑，其中一些建筑上有商店招牌，如'PROMO'和'KREPOST'。街道上的车辆和行人因为下雨而显得有些模糊，远处可以看到更多的建筑物和一些广告牌。整个场景被雨水覆盖，营造出一种宁静而又略带阴郁的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a brightly lit toy display focused on **Disney’s Big Hero 6: The Series** merchandise, especially **Baymax** figures and armor-up playsets. The display has a red, white, and clear plastic retail-booth style setup, with boxed toys on upper shelves and loose demo figures on transparent acrylic stands below.

On the left is a boxed toy labeled **“Squish to Fit Baymax”**. The packaging is mostly white with red accents and a large clear plastic window. Inside, a small white Baymax figure is visible alongside red armor pieces and a turquoise vehicle. The box includes promotional callouts such as **“Squeeze into Wasabi’s car!”**, showing Baymax being compressed into a small teal car, and **“Squeeze into suits”**, showing how the soft figure can fit into armor. There is also a round red button-style label reading **“Squish Me”**. The **Big Hero 6: The Series** logo appears prominently on the right side of the box.

On the right is another large boxed set labeled **“Armor-Up Baymax 2.0”**. This package features Baymax partly dressed in red superhero armor, with additional armor components arranged around him in the molded plastic tray. The red armor includes a helmet, chest plate, shoulder pieces, boots, and arm pieces, with dark purple and black accents. The box also advertises features like **“Easy to Armor”** and **“Choose Your Weapon”**, showing interchangeable weapon attachments. The figure inside has Baymax’s recognizable simple white face peeking through the red helmet.

Below the boxes, several loose display figures are arranged on clear stands. On the lower left is a plain white Baymax figure with his rounded body, small black eyes connected by a thin line, and soft-looking arms. Near the center is a smaller red-armored Baymax figure standing upright, with a red helmet, red limbs, and purple torso panels. On the lower right is a larger red armored Baymax figure, shown close-up, with a glossy red helmet, blue visor-like face area, large shoulder armor, and bulky mechanical-looking body parts.

The overall color palette is dominated by **red, white, purple, and black**, matching Baymax’s superhero armor design. The scene looks like a trade show or toy store display, with shiny packaging, transparent stands, and promotional labels highlighting the toys’ interactive features.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示迪士尼动画《超能陆战队》系列玩具的照片。图中展示了多个不同形态的红色和白色玩具，包括一个穿着飞行服的红色机器人、一个变形为汽车的玩具以及几个穿着不同服装的玩偶。这些玩具被摆放在透明塑料盒内或单独展示在玻璃架子上，背景是商店内部的货架和其他商品。

caption:
The image shows a scenic seaside bell shrine or lookout framed by an open pavilion.

At the center, hanging from the roof beams, is a large bronze bell with a weathered, slightly tarnished surface. The bell has a flared rim and faint decorative engravings around its upper and lower edges. A thick rope hangs down from the clapper area, extending nearly to the bottom of the frame, with a knot near its end for pulling or ringing the bell.

The pavilion structure around the bell is painted in dark green or black metal, with angular crossbeams forming a triangular frame above it. On both the left and right sides are open glass-panel doors or display cases, creating the impression of looking outward through a windowed shrine or observatory. The strong sunlight creates deep shadows under the roof and bright highlights on the metal surfaces.

Beyond the bell is a wide, open view of the ocean. The sea stretches across the middle of the image in bands of blue and turquoise, meeting a pale blue sky at a clean horizon line. The weather appears clear and sunny, with only a few faint clouds near the horizon. Green shrubs and coastal vegetation fill the area just above the railing, emphasizing that the viewpoint is elevated above the shoreline.

In the lower half of the scene, a black metal railing is densely covered with many small padlocks, colorful tags, heart-shaped charms, and keepsakes. The locks and ornaments are packed tightly together, suggesting a lovers’ bell or romantic wishing spot where visitors attach locks or messages. The decorations are mostly red, pink, yellow, green, and metallic gold or brass, creating a colorful contrast against the blue sea.

At the very bottom foreground is an informational plaque or signboard with Japanese text and English text. The English heading appears to refer to a legend, possibly “The heavenly maiden and the five headed dragon.” The sign includes explanatory paragraphs and small illustrations, including a dragon-like figure and a maiden or mythological character.

Overall, the image has a romantic and ceremonial atmosphere: a bronze bell suspended in a seaside pavilion, surrounded by love locks and wishes, with a bright ocean panorama behind it.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示海边观景台的摄影作品，前景中有一个挂着的金色钟，其下方是满是挂锁的栅栏。栅栏上挂满了各种颜色和大小的挂锁，它们似乎象征着爱情或承诺。在照片的背景中，可以看到一片宁静的海洋和晴朗的蓝天。

caption:
The image shows a quiet rural road junction on a sunny day. In the foreground, the asphalt road fills most of the frame, with pale white road markings forming angular edge or yield-style lines across the near lane. The road surface is dark gray and slightly textured, scattered with small twigs, leaves, and bits of debris.

On the left side of the image, very close to the camera, there is a white roadside reflector post with a black band and two circular reflectors. It stands in a strip of green grass and low vegetation along the road edge. Farther ahead, near the center of the image, another similar black-and-white reflector post is visible at the junction.

The road appears to curve or split at an intersection, with a smaller road crossing or joining from the left and another stretch continuing toward the right. The intersection is bordered by grassy verges and shaded by large trees. Tall tree trunks and dense green foliage frame both sides of the scene, especially on the left and right edges, casting broad shadows across the pavement.

Beyond the road, in the middle and background, there is an open agricultural field covered with low green plants and many small white blossoms. Behind the field are more trees and a few distant buildings, partly obscured by greenery. A small road sign and a traffic-related signpost are visible near the far side of the junction, though the text is not clearly readable.

The lighting suggests late afternoon or morning sunlight, with strong highlights on the grass and road and deep shadows under the trees. Overall, the scene feels calm, rural, and lightly trafficked, with no vehicles or people present.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示乡村道路的照片，道路两旁有绿色的草地和树木。在道路的一侧，有一个带有白色条纹的黑色交通标志，指示着道路的方向。道路本身由沥青铺成，上面画有白色的斑马线和箭头标记，引导车辆行驶方向。

caption:
The image shows a spacious airport departure gate area, likely inside a modern terminal concourse. The view is taken from a central aisle, looking straight down the length of the terminal, creating a strong sense of symmetry and depth.

The most striking feature is the enormous arched roof overhead. It is made of a grid of pale metal beams, trusses, cross-bracing, and translucent glass or plastic panels. The roof curves gently downward on both sides, forming a long tunnel-like canopy. A central structural spine runs along the ceiling, dividing the image almost perfectly in half. The repeated lines of the beams and panels create a geometric pattern that recedes into the distance.

Below the roof is a busy gate area with multiple boarding zones. Large black oval signs hang on both sides, marking gates such as **F52** on the left and **F49** on the right. Farther down the terminal, smaller signs indicate **F53**, **F54**, **F55**, **F56**, **F48**, and **F47**. Some of the gate signs include small analog clocks beside the gate numbers.

The floor is mostly covered in a dark red carpet, with a lighter gray central walkway running down the middle. Along both sides of the walkway are seating areas filled with passengers. Some people are seated with bags and laptops, while others stand, walk, or pull rolling suitcases. Queue barriers and stanchions form organized lines near the boarding counters.

In the center foreground is a glass-enclosed vertical structure, possibly an elevator or stairwell enclosure. In front of it is a bright red fire hose reel mounted on a cylindrical metal stand, which stands out against the otherwise gray, white, and muted red color palette.

The terminal feels bright and airy because of the translucent roof panels and large windows along the sides. The overall atmosphere is clean, orderly, and modern, with a strong architectural emphasis on repetition, symmetry, and open space.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示现代机场候机大厅内部的照片。照片中，乘客们坐在座椅上等待登机，一些人正在移动，而其他人则在交谈或阅读。候机厅的天花板由金属梁和玻璃面板构成，呈现出一种开放且通透的设计风格。墙上的指示牌清晰地标出了不同的登机口，如F52、F49等。整个场景被自然光照亮，营造出一个宽敞明亮的氛围。

caption:
The image is a close-up, warmly lit view of a basket filled with individually wrapped chocolate confections. The candies appear to be small blocks or molded pieces of milk and dark chocolate, each sealed in clear, crinkly cellophane that catches the light with bright highlights and reflections. Some pieces look like rounded or irregular chunks, while others are more rectangular or block-like.

The basket is made of wicker or woven material in a warm orange-brown tone, with curved handles visible along the left and right edges. The chocolates are piled densely, creating a layered, textured scene of glossy plastic wrapping, brown chocolate tones, and woven basket strands. A few pieces seem to have small paper tags or labels tucked among them, and there is a partially visible price or product sign in the bottom-left corner with small printed text.

The background is softly blurred due to a shallow depth of field, giving the image a cozy, artisanal shop or market display feel. The overall color palette is warm and inviting, dominated by caramel, amber, tan, and chocolate-brown tones. The lighting emphasizes the shiny cellophane and gives the candies an appealing, handmade confectionery appearance.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示在编织篮子中的巧克力糖果的照片。篮子里的巧克力被透明塑料包装纸包裹，每个包装都清晰地显示了产品的品牌和价格标签。巧克力的颜色从深棕色到浅棕色不等，表面光滑且有光泽。篮子本身是棕色的，由细长的柳条编织而成，增添了自然质朴的感觉。

caption:
The image shows a close, low-angle view of an ornate traditional Chinese stone gateway or memorial arch, likely a **paifang**. The structure is made of pale gray-white stone and fills most of the frame, viewed from below so that the underside of the roof and carved details are emphasized.

At the top is a heavy, decorative tiled roof with upturned ends. The roof has layered eaves, rows of rounded tile caps, and repeated bracket-like supports underneath. The edges include curled, spiral-like ornamental forms, giving the roof a classical Chinese architectural style. The stone appears weathered, with darker staining and age marks along the roofline and carved surfaces.

Beneath the roof is a horizontal stone beam with carved Chinese characters across it. The characters are incised into the stone and appear slightly shadowed, though some are partially obscured by the perspective. The beam and supporting columns are decorated with carved borders and relief patterns, including swirling cloud-like motifs and floral or vine designs.

On the left vertical pillar, more large Chinese characters are carved in a vertical arrangement inside a framed panel. Similar carved panels are visible on the right side, though partly cut off by the edge of the image. The lower portion of the arch includes sculpted brackets with elaborate scrollwork and rounded, cloud-shaped forms.

The background is filled with dense green trees, including tall conifers and leafy branches. The sky above is bright and overexposed, appearing mostly white, which makes the darker roofline and green foliage stand out. The overall scene feels like the entrance to a historic garden, temple, cemetery, or cultural site, with the gateway framed by mature trees and natural greenery.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国传统建筑风格的石拱门的照片。石拱门由精美的雕刻装饰，顶部是典型的中国屋顶结构，上面有翘起的瓦片和复杂的雕花。拱门上刻有汉字，增添了文化气息。背景中模糊可见绿色树木，为这座古典建筑增添了一抹自然色彩。

caption:
The image shows an outdoor street scene, likely near an event or public gathering area. The main subject is a person walking toward the camera in the middle of a paved road. Their face is intentionally blurred. They are wearing a sporty short-sleeved jersey in white, navy, red, and orange with graphic patterns, along with dark athletic pants that have orange and red accents. A race-style bib or number tag is attached to the front of the shirt, showing the number “035.” They are holding a small plastic drink bottle with an orange cap in one hand and wearing white shoes.

The background is slightly out of focus, emphasizing the person in the foreground. On the left side of the image, several vehicles are parked or stopped, including a white Toyota SUV and a black motorcycle with a red bag or item on its seat. Behind them are signs, buildings, and trees. A white scooter is parked or standing near the center-left background.

Several people in dark uniforms are visible in the background, also with blurred faces. They appear to be standing and monitoring the area; one is near the center-left, another farther back, and one is near a large white van on the right side of the frame. The white van has dark tinted windows and is parked along the roadside.

The setting appears to be a broad road or parking area lined with greenery. Large trees create a dark leafy backdrop across the top half of the image. The lighting suggests daytime, possibly late afternoon, with soft natural light and no harsh shadows. The overall scene feels like an organized public event, checkpoint, or race-related area with participants and staff or security nearby.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市街道活动的现实主义风格照片。图像中心是一位穿着运动服的人，正从左向右行走，手中拿着一个橙色的水瓶。背景中，可以看到几辆停在路边的车辆，包括一辆白色的轿车和一辆带有红色装饰的白色摩托车。街道上还有几位行人，其中一位身穿深色衣服的人站在白色轿车旁边。整个场景被拍摄在一个晴朗的日子里，光线明亮且均匀。

caption:
The image shows a quiet village street lined with traditional houses, viewed from a slightly elevated or distant angle. The houses are closely packed together, each with steep, dark, weathered tiled roofs. The roof tiles look old and uneven, with mottled tones of brown, black, gray, and reddish clay, giving the buildings a rustic, historic character.

In the foreground and center-left stands a tall utility pole with a streetlamp attached. Numerous electrical wires stretch across the scene in many directions, cutting diagonally and horizontally through the blue sky and across the house facades. The wires create a dense web that contrasts with the orderly triangular shapes of the roofs.

The houses have distinctive gabled fronts facing the street. Several facades are painted in warm, sunlit colors: cream, white, pale yellow, and a vivid orange. The orange house on the right is especially prominent, with red trim along the edges of its triangular gable and roofline. Its upper gable has a small decorative cross-like motif, and below it are tall, narrow windows with light-colored shutters or blinds. A large arched wooden gate occupies the lower right portion of the building.

Near the center is a white house with a tall triangular gable and decorative cutouts or painted details near the top. It has brown wooden shutters and a large arched gateway at street level. To its left is another pale house with red-brown decorative diamond shapes along the vertical edges of the facade, white shutters, and a dark red arched doorway. The houses appear well-kept but aged, with some staining and wear visible near the bases and roof edges.

The lighting is warm and low, likely late afternoon or early evening, casting strong golden highlights and deep shadows. The sun illuminates the facades from the right, making the orange and white walls glow while the roof tiles remain textured and shadowed.

In the background, beyond the rooftops, a dry rolling hillside is visible under a clear, bright blue sky. The hillside has sparse vegetation and muted brown-green tones, suggesting a rural or semi-rural setting. Overall, the scene feels calm, old-world, and atmospheric, with traditional architecture, warm sunlight, and a tangle of overhead wires defining the village streetscape.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示欧洲传统风格建筑的摄影图像。在画面中，我们可以看到一排色彩鲜艳的房子，它们具有典型的欧洲建筑特征，如尖顶和木制结构。最左侧的房子是白色的，中间的房子是橙色的，而右侧的房子则是棕色的。每座房子都有独特的窗户设计，一些窗户上装饰有白色框架。屋顶由深色瓦片覆盖，呈现出传统的倾斜角度。街道两旁种着树木，背景中可以看到一片绿色的山丘。整个场景被柔和的日光照亮，营造出一种宁静和谐的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunny beach scene with three people near the shoreline, standing among rough rocks and sandy ground beside bright turquoise water.

In the center is a small child, barefoot, stepping carefully down from a rocky area onto uneven sand. The child is wearing a dark short-sleeved top and dark shorts, with hair tied up in a small bun or ponytail. The child’s face is blurred.

On the left, an older woman with light gray-blonde hair is leaning forward to help the child. She is wearing a sleeveless dark top and light blue cropped jeans, and she is barefoot. One of her hands is near the child’s head or hair, while the other is extended toward the child’s back or shoulder, as if steadying them while they climb over the rocks. Sunglasses appear to be resting on top of her head. Her face is also blurred.

On the right, a younger woman is bending down with both arms extended toward the child, ready to catch or guide them. She has dark reddish-brown hair tied up in a bun and is wearing a black sleeveless top and denim shorts with rolled cuffs. She is barefoot, standing on the sandy, rocky surface. Some sand is visible on her lower legs. Her face is blurred as well.

The background is dominated by the ocean, which is a vivid blue-green with small whitecaps, suggesting wind or choppy water. The horizon line is low and straight, with a pale blue sky above and faint wisps of cloud. The foreground consists of coarse sand mixed with shells, small pebbles, and darker jagged rocks. The overall scene feels like a candid family moment at the beach, with the adults helping the child navigate the uneven rocky shoreline.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张捕捉到两位女性和一个小孩在海滩上互动的照片。一位女性站在岩石上，她的头发被风吹起，穿着黑色无袖上衣、牛仔裤和白色运动鞋，正用双手握住另一位女性的手臂，帮助她站立。另一个女性弯腰蹲下，也伸出一只手，似乎是在协助小孩走路。小孩身穿深色背心和短裤，正在小心翼翼地尝试行走。他们背后是波涛汹涌的海洋和晴朗的天空，阳光照耀下的沙滩和岩石清晰可见。

caption:
The image shows a brightly lit snack and souvenir display inside what appears to be a Japanese shopping area, department store food hall, or station retail area.

At the center is a white, illuminated sales kiosk branded **“YOSHIMI”**, with the name printed in large black letters across the middle panels alongside a circular logo in red, yellow, and green. The stand is filled with neatly arranged packaged snacks, mostly in **blue, yellow, and white boxes and bags**. Many of the packages and signs contain Japanese text.

A prominent product theme is **curry-flavored snacks**. Several large signs and boxes show long, stick-shaped fried snacks with the word **“CURRY”** visible in English, along with Japanese writing. The front lower panel features a large advertisement with a photo of golden-brown crunchy sticks and bold Japanese lettering. On the right side, stacks of white boxes with orange/yellow stick patterns are piled high, creating a tidy wall of products. On the left and center shelves, blue and yellow boxes are stacked in rows, with smaller bags and display packets propped upright on clear acrylic stands.

The kiosk has multiple levels: lower shelves with boxed goods, middle display shelves with bags and sample packaging, and upper illuminated panels with product advertisements. Small price tags are placed along the front edges of the shelves; some prices appear in yen, such as **154円**, **648円**, and **540円**, suggesting individual snacks and boxed gift sets.

Around the kiosk are several shoppers and staff members. On the left, a person in a dark uniform or apron stands near another display of packaged foods hanging on racks. On the right side and in the background, people walk through the aisle, some partially cut off by the frame. The faces of several people are blurred or indistinct.

The surrounding environment looks like a busy indoor retail concourse. Overhead, there are rows of fluorescent lights and track lighting. In the background, more shelves and displays are visible, suggesting a larger marketplace or food souvenir section. The floor is made of large gray tiles, and the kiosk’s bright lighting contrasts with the slightly dimmer surrounding walkway. Overall, the scene feels like a Japanese airport, train-station, or department-store food souvenir shop focused on packaged regional snacks.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示YOSHIMI品牌零食的商店内部照片。货架上摆满了各种包装精美的食品，包括薯片、饼干和其他小吃。货架上方有品牌标志和产品名称，而下方则展示了产品的实物图片。在货架旁边，可以看到几位顾客正在浏览其他商品或等待付款。整个场景营造出一种忙碌且充满活力的购物氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunlit scene at a traditional Korean palace or historic building, likely within a royal complex. The architecture dominates the frame, with richly painted wooden details and several visitors dressed in hanbok, traditional Korean clothing, posing and taking photos.

On the left side, there are large green wooden doors or shutters with repeating floral lattice patterns. The panels are weathered, with visible aging and darker hardware hinges, giving the building a historic, well-used appearance. Above the doors are horizontal wooden beams painted in deep red, green, blue, and cream tones.

The upper part of the building is highly ornate. The eaves are decorated with elaborate traditional Korean dancheong patterns—intricate painted designs in green, blue, red, orange, white, and black. The underside of the roof has layered brackets and carved supports, all covered in colorful geometric and floral motifs. The roof extends outward dramatically, with the underside creating a richly textured canopy. Some protective netting is visible along the eaves.

In the center of the image is a large open doorway framed by red wooden pillars and white wall panels. The white panels on either side of the doorway are open like shutters, each with small metal ring handles. Inside the doorway, the interior appears dark, with a red cylindrical column visible just inside.

Several people are gathered in front of the doorway. They are wearing decorative hanbok in pastel and bright colors. One person stands on the wooden threshold in a pale pink skirt with embroidered patterns and a light-colored top, posing for a photo. Another person, wearing a brown floral skirt and a light top with a pale pink head covering, stands below and appears to be taking a picture with a phone. To the right, another visitor wears a vivid red hanbok skirt with gold and floral detailing, paired with a white top, while a fourth person further right wears a pale pink hanbok and looks down at a phone. Their faces are blurred.

The foreground consists of pale stone steps and paving, leading up to the building. On the far right, there is a large dark metal vessel or ceremonial urn on a stone base, and behind it are lower traditional tiled rooftops stretching across the background. The sky is clear and blue, suggesting bright midday or afternoon sunlight. The overall atmosphere is festive and cultural, with the colorful clothing complementing the ornate palace architecture.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示韩国传统建筑和文化的照片。图中，几位身着传统服饰的女性站在一座装饰华丽的宫殿门前。她们穿着色彩鲜艳的传统韩服，有的正走向宫殿入口，有的则在交谈。宫殿的绿色门上饰有复杂的图案，屋顶覆盖着多彩的瓦片，显示出传统的韩国建筑风格。阳光照耀下，整个场景显得生动而和谐。

caption:
The image shows a large Eastern Orthodox-style church standing in a quiet urban or suburban setting on a bright, clear day. The building is predominantly white, with striking cobalt-blue roofs and domes that stand out vividly against the pale blue sky.

At the center of the church is a tall, steep blue spire rising above the main structure. It is topped with a small golden onion-shaped dome and an Orthodox cross. Below it, the tower has white vertical elements and arched openings, giving it a layered, elegant appearance. Around the central tower are several smaller blue onion domes, each capped with a golden finial and cross. The domes are glossy and rounded, typical of Russian or Eastern Orthodox church architecture.

The church façade features many rounded arches and tall, narrow windows. Some windows have dark reddish-brown frames, and the lower parts of the building are accented with darker brown trim. The roof sections are bright blue metal, matching the domes and creating a unified color scheme. A smaller entrance structure with an arched doorway projects from the front right side, also topped with a blue roof.

The church is surrounded by trees and greenery. On the right side of the image, a large leafy tree frames the scene, while smaller trees and shrubs appear around the building. On the left, there are thinner trees, including one with pale bark, possibly a birch. In the far left background, part of a modern apartment building is visible behind the trees.

In the foreground is a paved open area or street with a fence running along the church grounds. There are benches, flower pots, and a no-parking sign near the fence. To the right of the church, there is a smaller, older-looking building with a gray roof and a row of windows, as well as a blue-and-white kiosk or utility structure nearby. A construction or service area with barriers and materials is visible near the far right.

The sky is mostly clear with light, wispy clouds, and the sunlight illuminates the white walls of the church, making the blue and gold details especially bright. The overall atmosphere is calm, spacious, and serene, with the church serving as the dominant architectural focus of the scene.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一座具有俄罗斯东正教特色的教堂的照片。教堂的主体颜色为白色，装饰有蓝色圆顶和金色十字架，显得庄严而神圣。教堂前有一个小型的开放空间，周围种植着树木，并且可以看到一些停放的车辆和一个小型建筑。背景是一个晴朗的蓝天，几朵白云点缀其间。

caption:
The image shows a large group of people gathered outdoors for what appears to be a traditional ceremonial or festive procession. The scene is bright and sunlit, with greenery and trees in the background, along with a metal canopy or arched structure behind the crowd.

Most of the people are dressed in colorful South Asian traditional clothing. Several women in the foreground wear richly patterned saris in vivid colors such as purple, green, blue, teal, orange, and maroon, many with gold borders or embroidered details. They are also wearing jewelry, including necklaces, bangles, earrings, and hair ornaments. The men visible in the group are mostly wearing white traditional clothing, and one man on the right has an orange-bordered cloth draped over his shoulder.

A number of people are carrying ceremonial items. In the center-left, a person holds a shiny metal pot balanced on their head, decorated with long pale straw-like or grain-like strands. Near the center and right, others carry large brown earthen pots on their heads, also decorated with similar pale plant material and white flowers. These pots appear to be part of a ritual arrangement.

In the foreground, one woman in a green sari holds a round metal tray filled with coconuts. Another woman in a blue sari holds a metal tray containing ritual items, including flowers, a small container, and other offerings. On the right, a man in white holds a decorated pot with white flowers, pale straw-like decoration, and a yellow garland hanging from it.

The people are standing close together, facing the camera, giving the impression of a group portrait taken during a celebration or religious/cultural event. The overall atmosphere is festive and ceremonial, with bright fabrics, floral decorations, offerings, and traditional vessels forming the main visual focus.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示印度传统节日庆典的摄影照片。图中，多位参与者身着色彩鲜艳的传统服饰，手持各种装饰品和食物，表情庄重而专注。他们的服饰上饰有复杂的图案和挂饰，展现了丰富的文化细节。背景虽然模糊，但可以辨认出绿色植物和一些不太清晰的人影，为场景增添了一种热闹的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a bright coastal fishing scene on a sunny day. In the center foreground, a person is seated inside or beside a small wooden boat, working with a large tangle of pale fishing net. Their face is blurred, and they are wearing a light-colored wide-brimmed sun hat, a dark long-sleeved shirt, and gloves. Their hands are buried in the netting, suggesting they are untangling, repairing, or preparing it.

The fishing net dominates the lower half of the image, forming a dense, translucent mass of fine white strands. Small orange floats or net markers are scattered throughout it. Around the person are parts of the boat and fishing gear: a red rectangular container or cooler sits to the right, a blue water jug is visible near the center-left, and ropes, bags, and equipment are scattered along the sandy beach.

Two long wooden poles or boat supports cut diagonally across the frame, one stretching from the upper left toward the right side and another lower one running from the left toward the center. These poles frame the person and add a strong diagonal structure to the composition. On the far right, a vertical wooden post wrapped with rope is attached to the boat.

In the background, the beach meets vivid turquoise-blue water. Several small fishing boats float offshore, and a low green island or rocky headland is visible on the horizon to the right. On the left side of the beach, more small boats rest on the sand near large rounded rocks, with a few people or figures faintly visible in the distance.

The sky is a deep, clear blue with thin, wispy white clouds, giving the scene a bright, tropical feel. The lighting is strong and direct, creating high contrast between the sunlit net, sand, and water and the shadowed figure in the middle. Overall, the image captures a working fishing environment on a beach, with the focus on the labor of handling nets against a scenic seaside backdrop.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示渔民在海滩上整理渔网的现实主义风格照片。图中，一位戴着宽边帽、穿着深色衣物的男性正坐在沙滩上，专注地处理着缠绕在一起的白色渔网。他的周围散落着一些捕鱼工具和物品，如蓝色的船桨和黑色的背包。背景是蔚蓝的海洋和晴朗的天空，营造出一种宁静而辛勤工作的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a dense, sunlit garden bed filled with bright summer flowers and lush green foliage.

Dominating the scene are numerous yellow black-eyed Susans or coneflower-like daisies. They have long, narrow golden-yellow petals radiating outward from dark brown to nearly black, rounded central cones. The flowers appear at various heights and angles, some facing directly toward the viewer while others tilt sideways or are partially cropped by the edges of the frame. A few petals show small imperfections, such as tiny holes or curled edges, adding a natural, garden-grown feel.

Interspersed among the yellow flowers are clusters of vivid purple-blue, fuzzy-looking blossoms. These smaller flowers form soft, rounded tufts and button-like clusters, creating a strong color contrast against the yellow petals and green leaves. Some of the purple blooms have deeper violet centers, giving them a textured, layered appearance.

The background and spaces between the flowers are filled with thick green stems and leaves. The foliage varies in shape: some leaves are broad and oval with serrated edges, while others are long, narrow, and upright. Tall green stems rise vertically throughout the image, creating a sense of height and density.

Bright sunlight illuminates the scene from above, producing strong highlights on the yellow petals and glossy green leaves. There are also darker shadowed areas beneath the foliage, giving the image depth and a rich, vibrant contrast. The overall impression is of a lively, crowded flower garden in full bloom, with warm yellow daisies and cool purple blossoms woven together in a lush, natural arrangement.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示多种花卉的自然摄影风格图片。图像中心是几朵黄色的向日葵，它们的花瓣展开，呈现出鲜明的黄色和黑色花心。周围散布着紫色的小花，可能是薰衣草或类似的植物，为画面增添了色彩对比。背景中还有绿色的叶子和其他模糊的植物元素，整体构成了一幅生机勃勃的花园景象。

caption:
The image shows a grand, richly decorated Buddhist temple hall, viewed from the center aisle facing the main altar. The space is dominated by deep red and gold tones, creating a warm, ceremonial atmosphere.

At the far end is an elaborate golden altar with three large Buddhist figures: a central seated figure on a throne-like pedestal, flanked by two standing figures. Behind them is a luminous mural filled with swirling clouds, dragons, and radiant halos, giving the shrine a dramatic and sacred focal point. The altar area is layered with ornate carved panels, lanterns, offerings, flowers, and ritual objects arranged symmetrically.

The architecture is highly ornate. Tall red columns with gold decorative bands frame the shrine, supporting a heavy, gilded canopy with intricate carvings and hanging ornaments. On either side of the altar hang large vertical lanterns with Chinese characters. The ceiling is a grid of square decorative panels, each patterned in green, red, and gold, with recessed lights set among them. Along the upper side walls are long bands of gilded relief carvings, possibly depicting dragons or mythological scenes, illuminated by warm lighting.

The side walls are lined with many small shrine niches or plaques arranged in neat rows, adding to the sense of depth and repetition. Red railings, gold trim, and carved details run throughout the hall, reinforcing the symmetrical and ceremonial design.

In the foreground and middle ground, visitors and worshippers are seated or standing at rows of red-covered tables. The tables are draped in shiny red cloth with subtle gold circular patterns, and many have books, prayer materials, or offerings on them. A central table near the aisle holds fruits, flowers, candles, and other ritual offerings, with pink and red cloths underneath. Several people appear to be praying, reading, or observing quietly, while others stand near the sides or move through the space.

Overall, the image conveys a sense of reverence and grandeur: a vibrant, opulent temple interior filled with gold ornamentation, red lacquered surfaces, intricate religious artwork, and worshippers gathered in a peaceful devotional setting.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示中国佛教寺庙内部的摄影照片。寺庙内部装饰华丽，以红色和金色为主色调，营造出一种庄严而神圣的氛围。中央位置有一尊大型佛像，周围是金色的墙壁和精美的雕塑。前方有几排供桌，上面摆放着鲜花和其他祭品，供信徒进行祈祷或供奉。一些信徒正在朝拜，有的坐在供桌上，有的站立在旁边。整个场景充满了宗教活动的宁静与虔诚。

caption:
The image shows a quiet, sunlit park or garden area with a paved walking path curving gently through it. The scene is dominated by many tall trees, some with dense green foliage and others with sparse, leafless branches stretching across the sky. The branches create intricate dark patterns overhead and cast long, web-like shadows onto the path below.

In the foreground, the path is a light tan concrete or compacted surface, scattered with a few dry leaves and small debris. It curves from the bottom center toward the left side of the image, leading deeper into the park. Along the edges of the path are patches of grass, exposed soil, and fallen leaves, giving the area a natural, slightly dry-season appearance.

On the left side, there is a shaded section with several trees and a few green-painted benches or low seating blocks. A metal pole with signs or fixtures attached stands near the path, and another small red sign is visible farther back among the trees. The ground here is partly covered with dry leaves and dappled sunlight.

In the center of the image, several tree trunks stand close together. One large tree has mostly bare branches spreading widely outward, forming a striking silhouette against the bright sky. Behind it, dense shrubs and smaller trees fill the middle ground with varied shades of green.

On the right side, there is a grassy area bordered by thick bushes and vegetation. A tall, slender light pole stands near the foreground, and at its base there appears to be a small protective basket or wire enclosure around a young tree or stump. The grass is sunlit, with patches of shade from nearby trees.

In the background, beyond the trees and greenery, a few pale-colored apartment or office buildings are visible in the distance, partially obscured by the foliage. The sky is clear and bright, suggesting a warm, sunny day. Overall, the image conveys a peaceful urban park setting, with a mix of natural greenery, walking paths, benches, and distant city buildings.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示城市公园景观的照片，画面中心是一条蜿蜒的步道，两旁是茂密的树木和草地。步道的左侧有一块草坪，上面有几个人在休闲活动。步道的右侧可以看到更多的绿色植被和一些低矮的灌木丛。在照片的远处，可以隐约看到城市的高楼大厦，与公园中的自然环境形成鲜明对比。阳光从画面上方照射下来，为整个场景增添了温暖而宁静的氛围。

caption:
The image shows three men working on a small wooden fishing boat floating on calm, greenish water. The scene appears to be on a river, canal, or lake, with soft ripples and distorted reflections of trees or buildings across the surface.

The boat is narrow and weathered, made of dark wooden planks with a slightly curved bow. It sits low in the water and contains various fishing and boating equipment. Several fishing nets are visible: one pale net with bright pink markings is being held upright near the center of the boat, while another net or bundle of mesh lies draped over the side near the bow and trails slightly toward the water. There are also ropes, a white bucket, a red cooler or container, sandals, and other small gear scattered on the deck.

At the front-left of the boat stands an older shirtless man wearing green shorts. He is barefoot and holding part of a rope or net in his hands. Beside him, near the center, another man wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt and black shorts is handling the tall section of fishing net, lifting or untangling it. Toward the rear of the boat, a third man stands near the stern. He wears a wide-brimmed beige hat, a dark shirt, and dark pants, and he is gripping a long wooden oar or pole. His posture suggests he is steering or stabilizing the boat.

At the stern, there is a small motor mounted behind the boat, and a long metal pole extends diagonally out over the water with a small propeller-like attachment at the end, suggesting a motorized or auxiliary propulsion setup. The water around the boat has gentle ripples, especially near the hull, and the boat’s reflection is faintly visible beneath it.

The overall atmosphere is quiet and work-focused, capturing a candid moment of fishermen preparing, sorting, or retrieving their nets on a calm body of water.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示三位渔民在河中进行捕鱼活动的照片。最左侧的男性站在船头，穿着绿色短裤和黑色背心，正在操作一个长形网状渔具。中间的男性站在船中央，身穿深色上衣和浅色裤子，正专注地查看手中的网。右侧的男性戴着宽边帽，也穿着深色衣物，他似乎在调整或准备使用另一根钓鱼竿。他们所在的木制小船上堆满了渔网和其他捕鱼工具。周围的河水呈现出平静的状态，而远处模糊的树木勾勒出这个场景的背景。

caption:
The image is a close-up portrait of an older man shown from the chest upward. His face is intentionally blurred, obscuring facial features, but a long, full white beard is clearly visible, extending down over his chest with wispy strands.

He is wearing a bright orange turban wrapped in multiple layered folds. The fabric is tightly wound around the head with visible pleats and overlapping bands, creating a textured, sculptural look. A loose, frayed end of the turban fabric sticks out to the left side, and there are small rough edges and threads visible along parts of the wrap. The top of the turban has a gathered, folded section that rises slightly above the main wrap.

The man’s arms are crossed in front of him, with both forearms visible near the bottom of the image. His hands and arms appear weathered, with visible skin texture. He is wearing a dark purple outer garment or jacket, with a blue collared shirt underneath. A small metallic button or snap is visible on the shoulder area of the purple garment.

The background is plain and softly lit, mostly white or light gray, resembling a fabric or tent-like surface with subtle vertical creases. The overall composition centers strongly on the orange turban and white beard, with the vivid orange contrasting against the muted clothing and pale background.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示一位身穿深色衣物、头戴橙色头巾的印度男性特写照片。他的脸部被模糊处理，无法辨认面部特征。头巾呈现出鲜艳的橙色调，与蓝色衣物形成鲜明对比。男性的胡须浓密且白色，覆盖了大部分下巴和颈部。背景是简单的白色墙面，没有其他细节。

caption:
The image shows a dramatic low-angle view of a tall amusement-park ride structure, likely part of a roller coaster or vertical thrill ride, set against a completely clear blue sky.

Most of the frame is filled with open sky, emphasizing the height of the ride. The structure rises from the bottom of the image toward the upper right, creating a strong sense of verticality and scale. The main ride elements include:

- A steep, nearly vertical track or lift section on the right side, bordered by green metal rails with white rectangular panels or track segments running between them.
- A central dark gray support column that extends upward through the image, with additional curved gray tubular supports branching around it.
- A ladder-like or stair-like maintenance walkway running upward near the center, with evenly spaced rungs or steps.
- Several horizontal metal bars and platforms extending outward from the structure, possibly maintenance platforms or support bracing.
- Thin cables or wires running along the sides, adding to the industrial, engineered appearance.
- Near the top, there is a small enclosed or semi-circular platform with railing, suggesting a maintenance access point or observation/technical area.
- A thin antenna-like pole rises above the top of the structure, capped with a small fixture.

The perspective makes the ride look very tall and imposing. The clean blue sky and bright sunlight create sharp contrasts between the green, white, and gray metal components. There are no people visible, and the scene feels quiet despite the ride’s intense, mechanical design.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示过山车轨道的摄影图像。图中，过山车轨道呈螺旋状向上延伸，由银色金属结构支撑，其表面装饰有绿色和白色的条纹。轨道顶部有一个类似控制室的结构，上面装有安全护栏。背景是晴朗的蓝天，没有云朵，为这张图片增添了清晰明亮的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a sunny urban street lined with tall, narrow historic brick buildings, likely in a Dutch city such as Amsterdam. The perspective looks upward slightly from street level, emphasizing the height and slenderness of the canal-house-style façades.

On the right side, the most prominent building is a dark brown brick structure with a steep, decorative stepped or neck gable at the top. It has multiple arched windows stacked vertically, each framed with pale stone trim. Many of the windows have distinctive deep red wooden shutters, some opened outward and others partly closed. The shutters are mounted with black metal hinges, giving the façade a historic, traditional appearance. A black drainpipe runs vertically along the side of the building, and a pale side wall catches strong sunlight, creating a sharp shadow.

Beside it are several other narrow buildings in different shades of brick—dark gray, reddish brown, and tan—each with tall windows and ornate rooflines. Some have white window frames and decorative stone details. Farther down the street, a construction crane is visible above the rooftops, suggesting renovation or building work nearby.

At street level, there are storefronts and signs beneath the residential-looking upper floors. A row of parked scooters and bicycles sits along the sidewalk, reinforcing the urban European setting. A blue parking sign stands near the curb.

In the foreground, a white Volkswagen van with orange striping is parked along the brick-paved sidewalk or parking lane. Its front faces toward the right, and the license plate is blurred. Other cars are parked farther down the street on the left. A small planter with colorful decoration sits near the curb, and a leafless tree branch extends into the frame from the left edge.

The sky is clear and bright blue, with strong daylight illuminating the façades and casting crisp shadows. The overall scene feels like a calm, everyday street view in a historic city center, combining old architecture, modern vehicles, shops, and bicycles.

metadata.legacy_global_caption: 这是一张展示典型欧洲城市街道的照片，画面中心有一辆白色带有橙色条纹的货车停在路边。街道两侧是具有传统建筑风格的房屋，其中一些建筑的窗户上装饰着红色百叶窗。天空晴朗，阳光明媚，为这个场景增添了温暖的氛围。

caption:
The image shows a lively winter town square at dusk or early evening, during a heavy snowfall. The sky is a deep blue, and large snowflakes streak diagonally across the scene, suggesting wind and a long-exposure effect.

At the center-right stands a tall historic clock tower with a pale facade and dark roof. The tower is decorated with warm golden holiday lights along its edges and roofline. Its illuminated clock faces glow softly in pale blue-green, making the time visible from different sides. Below the tower, the adjoining building is also outlined with festive lights, and large glowing star decorations are mounted along the front.
